text.body:
<7.1.1>
|| athaśrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptamaṃ prabhāsakhaṇḍam || 7 || || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha prabhāsakhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate || || tatredaṃ prathamaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyam || 5 || oṃnamaḥ śrīparamātmane paramapuruṣottamāya || oṃ namo hariharahiraṇyagarbhebhyo namo vyāsavālmīkiśukaparāśarebhyaḥ || || vyāsa uvāca || || yaścādyaḥ puruṣaḥ purāṇa iti yaḥ saṃstūyate sarvataḥ someśaḥ surasaṃyutaḥ kṣititale yairvīkṣito hīkṣaṇaiḥ|| te tīrtvā vitatāṃtaraṃ bhavabhayaṃ bhūtyā'bhisaṃbhūṣitāḥ svargaṃ yānavaraiḥprayānti sukṛtairyajñai yathā yajvinaḥ || 1 || prasaradbindunādāya śuddhāmṛtamayātmane || ṣaḍtriṃśattattvadehāya namaścinmātramūrtaye || 2 || amṛtenodarasthena mriyante sarvadevatāḥ || kaṃṭhasthita viṣeṇāpi yo jīvati sa pātuḥ vaḥ || 3 || satrānte sūtamanaghaṃ naimiṣeyā maharṣayaḥ|| purāṇasaṃhitāṃ puṇyāṃ papracchū romaharṣaṇam|| 4 || tvayā sūta mahā buddhe bhagavānbrahmavittamaḥ || itihāsapurāṇārthe vyāsaḥ samyagupāsitaḥ || 5 || tasya te sarvaromāṇi vacasā harṣitāni yat || dvaipāyanasyānubhāvāttato'bhū romaharṣaṇaḥ || 6 || bhavantameva prathamaṃ vyājahāra svayaṃ prabhuḥ || munīnāṃ saṃhitāṃ vaktuṃ vyāsaḥ paurāṇikīṃ kathām || 7 || tvaṃ hi svāyaṃbhuve yajñe sutyāhe vitate hariḥ || saṃbhūtaḥ saṃhitāṃ vaktuṃ svāṃśena puruṣottamaḥ || 8 || tasmādbhavantaṃ pṛcchāmaḥ purāṇe skandakīrtite || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brāhmī yātrā śrutā purā || 9 || adhunā vaiṣṇavīṃ raudrīṃ yātrāṃ sarvārthasaṃyutām || vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ purāṇārthaviśārada || 7.1.1.10 || munīnā vacanaṃ śrutvā sūtaḥ paurāṇikottamaḥ || praṇamya śirasā prāha vyāsaṃ satyavatīsutam || 11 || || romaharṣaṇa uvāca || || śrīvatsāṃkaṃ jagadyoniṃ harimoṃkārarūpiṇam || aprameyaṃ guruṃ devaṃ nirmalaṃ nirmalāśrayam || 12 || haṃsaṃ śuciṣadaṃ vyoma vyāpakaṃ sarvadaṃ śivam || udāsīnaṃ nirāyāsaṃ niṣprapañcaṃ nirañjanam || 13 || śūnyaṃ biṃdusvarūpaṃ tu dhyeyaṃ dhyānavivarjitam || asti nāstīti yaṃ prāhuḥ sudūre cāntike ca yat || 14 || manogrāhyaṃ paraṃ dhāma puruṣākhyaṃ jaganmayam || hṛtpaṃkajasamāsīnaṃ tejorūpaṃ nirindriyam || 15 || evaṃvidhaṃ namaskṛtya paramātmānamīśvaram || kathāṃ vadiṣye dvividhāṃ dviśarīrāṃ tathaiva tu || 16 || divyabhāṣāsamopetāṃ vedādhiṣṭhānasaṃyutām || pañcasaṃdhisamāyuktāṃ ṣaḍalaṃkārabhūṣitām || 17 || saptasādhanasaṃyuktāṃ rasāṣṭaguṇaraṃjitām || guṇairnavabhirākīrṇāṃ daśadoṣavivarjitām || 18 || vibhāṣābhūṣitāṃ tadvadekāyattāṃ manoharām || pañcakāraṇasaṃyuktāṃ catuṣkaraṇasammatām ||19 || punaśca dvividhāṃ tadvajjñānasaṃdohadāyinīm || vyāsena kathitāṃ puṇyāṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ pāpanāśinīm || 7.1.1.20 || yāṃ śrutvā pāpakarmāpi gaccheddhi paramāṃ gatim || duḥkhatrayavinirmuktaḥ sarvātaṅkavivarjitaḥ || 21 || na nāstike kathāṃ puṇyāmimāṃ brūyātkadācana || śraddadhānāya śāntāya kīrtanīyā dvijātaye ||22 || niṣekādiḥ śmaśānānto mantrairyasyodito vidhiḥ || tasya śāstre'dhikāro'sti jñeyo nānyasya kasyacit|| 23 || catuḥpakṣāvadātasya viśuddhirbrāhmaṇasya ca || sadvṛttasyādhikāro'sti śāstre'sminvedasammate || 24 || yathā surāṇāṃ pravaro devadevo maheśvaraḥ || nadīnāṃ ca yathā gaṃgā varṇānāṃ brāhmaṇo yathā || 25 || akṣarāṇāṃ tu sarveṣāmoṃkāraḥ prathamo yathā || pūjyānāṃ tu yathā mātā gurūṇāṃ ca yathā pitā || tathaiva sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ pradhānaṃ skandakīrtitam || 26 || purā kailāsaśikhare brahmādīnāṃ ca sannidhau || skāndaṃ purāṇaṃ kathitaṃ pārvatyagre pinākinā || || 27 || pārvatyā ṣaṇmukhasyāgre tena nandigaṇāya vai || nandinā tu kumārāya tena vyāsāya dhīmate || 28 || vyāsena me samākhyātaṃ bhavadbhyo'haṃ prakīrtaye || 29 || yūyaṃ sadbhāvasaṃyuktā yataḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || tena me bhāṣituṃ śraddhā bhavatāṃ skandasaṃhitām || 7.1.1.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye praśnādhyāyavarṇanaṃ nāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
<7.1.2>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathāyā lakṣaṇaṃ brūhi guṇadoṣānsavistarān || ārṣeyapauruṣeyāṇāṃ kāvyacihnaparīkṣaṇam || kathaṃ jñeyaṃ mahābuddhe śrotumicchāmahe vayam || 1 || || sūta uvāca || || atha saṃkṣepato vakṣye purāṇānāmanukramam || lakṣaṇaṃ caiva saṃkhyāṃ ca uktabhedāṃstathaiva ca || 2 || purā tapaścacārogramamarāṇāṃ pitāmahaḥ || āvirbhūtāstato vedāḥ saṣaḍaṃgapadakramāḥ || 3 || tataḥ purāṇamakhilaṃ sarvaśāstramayaṃ dhruvam || nityaśabdamayaṃ puṇyaṃ śata koṭipravistaram || 4 || nirgataṃ brahmaṇo vaktrādbrāhmaṃ vaiṣṇavameva ca || śaivaṃ bhāgavataṃ caiva bhaviṣyaṃ nāradīyakam || 5 || mārkaṇḍeyamathāgneyaṃ brahmavaivartameva ca || laiṅgaṃ tathā ca vārāhaṃ skāṃdaṃ vāmanameva ca || 6 || kaurmyaṃ mātsyaṃ gāruḍaṃ ca vāyavīyamanantaram || aṣṭādaśaṃ samuddiṣṭaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || || 7 || ekameva purā hyāsīdbrahmāṇḍaṃ śatakoṭidhā || 8 || tato'ṣṭādaśadhā kṛtvā vedavyāso yugeyuge || prakhyāpayati loke'sminsākṣānnārāyaṇāṃśajaḥ || 9 || anyānyupapurāṇāni muninā kathitāni tu || tāni vaḥ kathayiṣyāmi saṃkṣepādavadhāryatām || 7.1.2.10 || ādyaṃ sanatkumāroktaṃ nārasiṃhamataḥ param || tṛtīyaṃ skāndamuddiṣṭaṃ kumāreṇānubhāṣitam || 11|| caturthaṃ śivadharmākhyaṃ sākṣānnandīśabhāṣitam|| durvāsasoktamāścaryyaṃ nāradoktamataḥ param ||12|| kāpilaṃ mānavaṃ caiva tathaivośanaseritam|| brahmāṇḍaṃ vāruṇaṃ cānyatkālikāhvayameva ca|| 13|| māheśvaraṃ tathā sāṃbaṃ sauraṃ sarvārthasaṃcayam||| parāśaroktaṃ paramaṃ mārīcaṃ bhārgavāhvayam ||14|| etānyupapurāṇāni kathitāni dvijottamāḥ||15|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || purāṇasaṃkhyāmācakṣva sūta vistaraśaḥ kramāt|| dānadharmamaśeṣajña yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 16|| || sūta uvāca || || idameva purāṇe'sminpurāṇapuruṣastadā || yaduktavānsa viśvātmā manave tannibodhata ||17|| purāṇaṃ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam || anantaraṃ ca vaktrebhyo vedāstasya vinirgatāḥ||18|| purāṇamekamevāsīttasminkalpāntaretathā|| trivargasādhanaṃ puṇyaṃ śatakoṭipravistaram || 19|| vinirdagdheṣu lokeṣu kṛṣṇenānantarūpiṇā || sāṅgāṃśca caturo vedānpurāṇanyāyavistaram ||7.1.2.20||| mīmāṃsāṃ dharmaśāstraṃ ca parigṛhyātmasātkṛtam || matsyarūpeṇa ca punaḥ kalpādāvudakārṇave||21|| aśeṣameva kathitaṃ brahmaṇe divyacakṣuṣe || brahmā jagāda ca munīṃstrikālajñānadarśanaḥ || 22 || pravṛttiḥ sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ purāṇasyābhavattataḥ || 23 || tataḥ kālakrameṇāsau vyāsarūpadharo hariḥ || aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni saṃkṣepsyati yugeyuge || 24 || caturlakṣapramāṇāni dvāparedvāpare sadā || tadāṣṭādaśadhā kṛṣṇā bhūrloke'sminprabhāṣate || 25 || adyā'pi devaloke tu śatakoṭipravistaram || tadartho'tra caturlakṣaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa niveśitaḥ || 26 || purāṇāni daśāṣṭau ca sāṃprataṃ tadihocyate|| nāmatastāni vakṣyāmi saṃkhyāṃ ca munisattamāḥ || 27 || brahmaṇā'bhihitaṃ pūrvaṃ yāvanmātraṃ marīcaye || brāhmaṃ taddaśasāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ tadihocyate || 28 || likhitvā tacca yo dadyājjaladhenusamanvitam || vaiśākhyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ ca brahmaloke mahīyate || 29 || etadeva yadā padmamabhūddhairaṇmayaṃ jagat || tadvṛttāṃtāśrayāṃtaṃ tatpādmamityucyate budhaiḥ || 7.1.2.30 || pādmaṃ tatpañcapañcāśatsahasrāṇīha paṭhyate || tatpurāṇaṃ ca yo dadyātsuvarṇakamalānvitam || jyeṣṭhe māsi tilairyuktaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 31 || vārāhakalpavṛttāntamadhikṛtya parātparaḥ || yatrāha dharmānakhilāṃstaduktaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ ||32|| caritairañcitaṃ viṣṇostalloke vaiṣṇavaṃ viduḥ || trayoviṃśatisāhasraṃ purāṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam || 33 || tadāṣāḍhe ca yo dadyādghṛtadhenusamanvitam || paurṇamāsyāṃ viśuddhāyāṃ saṃ padaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam || 34 || śrutakalpaprasaṅgena dharmānvāyurathābravīt || yatra tadvāyavīyaṃ syādrudramāhātmyasaṃyutam || 35 || caturviṃśatisāhasraṃ nānā vṛttāntasaṃyutam || dharmārthakāmamokṣaiśca sādhuvṛttasamanvitam|| 36 || śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi guḍadhenusamanvitam || yo dadyāddadhisaṃyuktaṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine || śivaloke sa pūtātmā kalpamekaṃ vasennaraḥ || 37 || punaḥ saṃjāyate martyo brāhmaṇo vedavittamaḥ || vedavidyārthatattvajño vyākhyātattvārthavittamaḥ || 38 || yatrādhikṛtya gāyatrīṃ varṇyate dharmavistaraḥ || vṛtrāsuravadhopetaṃ tadbhāgavatamucyate || 39 || sārasvatasya kalpasya madhye ye syurnarāmarāḥ|| tadvṛttāntodbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ puṇyodvāhasamanvitam || 7.1.2.40 || likhitvā tacca yo dadyāddhemasiṃhasamanvitam || paurṇamāsyāṃ prauṣṭhapadyāṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || ||41|| aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi purāṇaṃ tatprakīrtitam||42|| yatrāha nārado dharmānbṛhatkalpāśrayāṃstviha || pañcaviṃśatsahasrāṇi nāradīyaṃ taducyate ||43|| tadiṣe pañcadaśyāṃ tu yo dadyāddhenusaṃyutam|| uttamāṃ siddhimāpnoti iha loke paratra ca|| sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||44|| yatrādhikṛtya śakunīndharmādharmavicāraṇam || purāṇaṃ navasāhasraṃ mārkaṇḍeyaṃ taducyate || 45|| parilikhya ca yo dadyātsauvarṇakarisaṃyutam || kārtikyāṃ pauṇḍarīkasya yajñasya phalabhāgbhavet || 46 || yattadīśānakalpasya vṛttāntamadhikṛtya ca || vaśiṣṭhāyā'gninā proktamāgneyaṃ tatpracakṣate || 47 || likhitvā tacca yo dadyāddhemapadmasamanvitam || mārgaśīrṣe vidhānena tiladhenuyutaṃ tathā || tacca ṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ sarvakratuphalapradam || 48 || yatrādhikṛtya māhātmyamādityasya caturmukhaḥ || aghorakalpavṛttāntaprasaṃgena jagatpatiḥ || manave kathayāmāsa bhūtagrāmasya lakṣaṇam || 49 || caturdaśasahasrāṇi tathā pañcaśatāni ca || bhaviṣyacaritaprāyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ tadihocyate || 7.1.2.50 || tatpauṣamāsi yo dadyātpaurṇamāsyāṃ vimatsaraḥ || guḍakumbhasamāyuktamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || || 51 || rathaṃtarasya kalpasya vṛttāntamadhikṛtya ca || sāvarṇinā nāradāya kṛṣṇamāhātmyasaṃyutam || proktaṃ brahmavarāhasya caritaṃ varṇyate'tra ca ||52|| tadaṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ brahmavaivartamucyate || purāṇaṃ brahmavaivartaṃ yo dadyādbrāhmaṇottame || māghamāse paurṇamāsyāṃ brahmaloke mahīyate || 53 || yatrāgniliṅgamadhyasthaḥ prāha devo maheśvaraḥ || dharmārthakāmamokṣārthānāgneyamadhikṛtya ca || 54 || kalpaṃ tallaiṅgamityuktaṃ purāṇaṃ brahmaṇā svayam || 55 || tadekādaśasāhasraṃ phālgunyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati || tiladhenusamāyuktaṃ sa yāti śivasātmyatām ||56|| mahāvarāhasya punarmāhātmyamadhikṛtya ca || viṣṇunā'bhihitaṃ kṣoṇyai tadvārāhamihocyate ||57|| mānavasya prasaṃgena dhanyasya munisattamāḥ || caturviṃśatsahasrāṇi tatpurāṇamihocyate || 58 || kāñcanaṃ garuḍaṃ kṛtvā tiladhenusamanvitam|| paurṇamāsyāmatho dadyādbrāhmaṇāya kuṭumbine|| vārāhasyaprasādena padamāpnoti vaiṣṇavam||59|| yatra māheśvarāndharmānadhikṛtya ca ṣaṇmukham || kalpe tatpuruṣe vṛtte caritairupabṛṃhitam ||7.1.2.6||| skāṃdaṃ nāma purāṇaṃ tadekāśīti nigadyate|| sahasrāṇi śataṃ caikamiti martyeṣu paṭhyate||61|| parilekhya ca yo dadyāddhemaśūlasamanvitam || śaivaṃ sa padamāpnoti makaropagame raveḥ || 62 || trivikramasya māhātmyamadhikṛtya caturmukhaḥ || trivargamabhyadhāttattu vāmanaṃ parikīrtitam || 63|| purāṇaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kaurmakalpānugaṃ śivam|| 64 || yaḥ śaradviṣuve dadyāddhemavastrasamanvitam|| kṣaumāvṛtaṃ yutaṃ dhenvā sa padaṃ yāti vaiṣṇavam ||65|| yacca dharmārthakāmānāṃ mokṣasya ca rasātale || māhātmyaṃ kathayāmāsa kūrmarūpī janārdanaḥ ||66|| indradyumnaprasaṃgena ṛṣīṇāṃ śakrasannidhau || saptadaśasahasrāṇi lakṣmīkalpānuṣaṅgikam ||67|| yo dadyādayane kaurmaṃ hemakūrmasamanvitam|| gosahasrapradānasya sa phalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ||68|| śrutīnāṃ yatra kalpādau pravṛttyarthaṃ janārdanaḥ|| matsyarūpī ca manave narasiṃhopavarṇanam ||69|| adhikṛtyābravītsaptakalpavṛttaṃ munivratāḥ||| tanmātsyamiti jānīdhvaṃ sahasrāṇi catudarśa || 7.1.2.70 || viṣuve haimamatsyena dhenvā kṣaumayugānvitam || yo dadyātpṛthivī tena dattā bhavati cākhilā |||| ||71|| yadā vā garuḍe kalpe viśvāṇḍādgaruḍo'bhavat || adhikṛtyābravītkṛṣṇo gāruḍaṃ tadihocyate ||72|| tadaṣṭādaśa caikaṃ ca sahasrāṇīha paṭhyate ||| svarṇahaṃsasamāyuktaṃ yo dadyādayane pare || sa siddhiṃ labhate mukhyāṃ śivaloke ca saṃsthitim || 73 || brahmā brahmāṇḍamāhātmyamadhikṛtyābravītpunaḥ || tacca dvādaśasāhasraṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ dviśatādhikam ||74|| bhaviṣyāṇāṃ ca kalpānāṃ śrūyate yatra vistaraḥ || tadbrahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ tu brahmaṇā samudāhṛtam || 79 || yo dadyāttu vyatīpāta ūrṇāyugasamanvitam || rājasūyasahasrasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 76 || hemadhenvāyutaṃ tacca brahmalokaphalapradam|| caturlakṣamidaṃ proktaṃ vyāsenādbhutakarmaṇā || 77 || idaṃ lokahitārthāya saṃkṣiptaṃ dvāpare dvijāḥ || 78 || idamadyāpi deveṣu śatakoṭipravistaram || upabhedānpravakṣyāmi loke ye saṃpratiṣṭhitāḥ || 79 || pādme purāṇe yatproktaṃ nārasiṃhopavarṇanam || taccāṣṭādaśasāhasraṃ nārasiṃhamihocyate || 7.1.2.80 || nandine yatra māhātmyaṃ kārtikeyena varṇitam || loke nandipurāṇaṃ vai khyātametaddvijottamāḥ || 81 || yatra sāmbaṃ puraskṛtya bhaviṣyati kathānakam || procyate tatpunarloke sāṃbameva munivratāḥ || 82 || evamādityasaṃjñaṃ tu tatraiva paripaṭhyate || aṣṭādaśabhyastu pṛthakpurāṇaṃ yacca dṛśyate || vijānīdhvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāstadetebhyo vinirgatam || 83 || pañcāṅgāni purāṇasya cākhyānamitaratsmṛtam || sargaśca pratisargaśca vaṃśo manvantarāṇi ca || vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam || 84 || brahmaviṣṇvarkarudrāṇāṃ māhātmyaṃ bhuvanasya ca || saṃhāraśca pradṛśyeta purāṇaṃ pañcalakṣaṇam || 85 || dharmaścārthaśca kāmaśca mokṣaśca parikīrtyate || sarveṣvapi purāṇeṣu tadvirūḍhe ca yatphalam || 86 || sātvikeṣu ca kalpeṣu māhātmyamadhikaṃ hareḥ || rājaseṣu ca māhātmyamadhikaṃ brahmaṇo viduḥ || 87 || tadvadagre ca māhātmyaṃ tāmaseṣu śivasya hi || saṃkīrṇe ca sarasvatyāḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca nigadyate || 88 || caturbhirbhagavānviṣṇurdvābhyāṃ brahmā tathā raviḥ || aṣṭādaśapurāṇeṣu śeṣeṣu bhagavāñchivaḥ || 89 || vedavanniścalaṃ manye purāṇaṃ vai dvijottamāḥ || vedāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ sarve purāṇe nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.1.2.90 || bibhetyalpaśrutādvedo māmayaṃ cālayiṣyati || itihāsapurāṇaistu niścalo'yaṃ kṛtaḥ purā || 91 || yanna dṛṣṭaṃ hi vedeṣu na dṛṣṭaṃ smṛtiṣu dvijāḥ || ubhayoryatra dṛṣṭaṃ ca tatpurāṇeṣu gīyate || 92 || yo veda caturo vedānsāṃgopaniṣado dvijaḥ || purāṇaṃ naiva jānāti na ca sa syādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 93 || aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni kṛtvā satyavatīsutaḥ || bhāratākhyānamakarodvedārthairupabṛṃhitam || 94 || lakṣeṇaikena tatproktaṃ dvāparānte mahātmanā || vālmīkinā ca yatproktaṃ rāmopākhyānamuttamam || 95 || brahmaṇā vihitaṃ yacca śatakoṭipravistaram|| āha tannāradāyaiva tena vālmīkaye punaḥ || 96 || vālmīkinā ca loke tu dharmakāmārthasādhakam || || 97 || evaṃ sapādāḥ pañcaite lakṣāḥ puṇyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || purātanasya kalpasya purāṇe tu vidurbudhāḥ || 98 || itihāsapurāṇāni bhidyante kāla gauravāt || skāndaṃ tathā ca brahmāṇḍaṃ purāṇaṃ laiṅgameva ca || 99 || vārāhakalpe viprendrāsteṣāṃ bhedaḥ pravartate || aṣṭādaśaprakāreṇa brahmāṇḍaṃ bhinnameva hi || 7.1.2.100 || aṣṭādaśapurāṇāni tena jātāni bhūtale || laiṅgamekādaśavidhaṃ prabhinnaṃ dvāpare śubham || 101 || skāndaṃ tu saptadhā bhinnaṃ veda vyāsenadhīmatā || ekāśītisahasrāṇi śataṃ caikaṃ tu saṃkhyayā || 102 || tasyā''dyo yo vibhāgastu skandamāhātmyasaṃyutaḥ || māheśvaraḥ samākhyāto dvitīyo vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 103 || tṛtīyo brahmaṇaḥ proktaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃkṣepasūcakaḥ || kāśīmāhātmyasaṃyuktaścaturthaḥ paripaṭhyate || 104 || revāyāḥ pañcamo bhāgaḥ sojjayinyāḥ prakīrtitaḥ || ṣaṣṭhaḥ kalpo nāgaraśca tīrthamāhātmyasūcakaḥ || 105 || saptamo yo vibhāgo'yaṃ smṛtaḥ prābhāsiko dvijāḥ|| sarve dvādaśasāhasrā vibhāgāḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥ || 106 || asminprābhāsikaḥ sarvo varṇyate kṣetravistaraḥ || tīrthānāṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ śaṃkarasya ca || 107 || anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ māhātmyaṃ ca prakīrtyate || iti bhedaḥ purāṇānāṃ saṃkṣepātkathito dvijāḥ || 108 || imamaṣṭādaśānāṃ tu purāṇānāmanukramam|| yaḥ paṭheddhavyakavyeṣu sa yāti bhavanaṃ hareḥ||109|| idaṃ pavitraṃ hi yaśonidhānamidaṃ pitṝṇāmapi vallabhaṃ ca|| idaṃ ca deveṣvamṛtāya nityamidaṃ mahāpātakahṛcca puṃsām||7.1.2.11||| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sasaṃkhyākāṣṭādaśamahāpurāṇopapurāṇavarṇanapūrvaka purāṇapustakadānaphalavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||
<7.1.3>
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| kathito bhavatā sargaḥ pratisargastathaiva ca|| vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇānāmanukramaḥ||1|| manvantarapramāṇaṃ ca brahmāṃḍasya ca vistaraḥ|| jyotiścakrasvarūpaṃ ca yathāvadanuvarṇitam|| śrotumicchāmahe tvattaḥ sāṃprataṃ tīrthavistaram||2|| pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pāpaghnāni śubhāni ca|| tāni sūtaja kārtsnyena yathāvadvaktumarhasi||3|| sūta uvāca|| idaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ purā devyā kailāsaśikharottame|| nānādhātuvicitrāṃge nānāratnasamanvite||4|| nānādrumalatākīrṇe nānāpuṣpopaśobhite|| yakṣavidyādharākīrṇe hyapsarogaṇasevite||5| tatra brahamā ca viṣṇuśca skandanandigaṇeśvarāḥ|| caṃdrādityau grahaiḥ sārdhaṃ nakṣatradhruvamaṇḍalam||6|| vāyuśca varuṇaścaiva kubero dhanadastathā|| īśānaścāgniriṃdraśca yamo nirṛtireva ca||7|| saritaḥ sāgarāḥ sarve parvatā uragāstathā|| brāhmyādyā mātaraścaiva ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ||8|| mūrtimaṃti ca tīrthāni kṣetrāṇyāyatanāni ca|| dānavāsuradaityāśca piśācā bhūtarākṣasāḥ||7.1.3.10 tatra siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ śatayojanavistṛtam||11| lakṣāyutasahasraiśca rudrakoṭibhirāvṛtam|| tanmadhye sarvatobhadraṃ siṃhadvāraiḥ sutoraṇaiḥ||12|| svacchamauktikasaṃkāśaṃ prākāraśikharāvṛtam|| nandīśvaramahākāladvārapālagaṇairvṛtam||13|| kiṃkiṇījālamukharaiḥ satyatākairalaṃkṛtam|| vitānacchatrakhaṃḍaiśca muktādāmapralaṃbitaiḥ||14|| ghaṃṭācāmaraśobhāḍhayairdarpaṇaiścopaśobhitam|| kalaśairdvāravinyastaratnapallavasaṃyutaiḥ||15|| citritaṃ citraśāstrajñai ratnacūrṇaiḥ samujvalaiḥ|| svastikaiḥ patravalyādyairliṃgodbhavalatādibhiḥ||16|| śatasiṃhāsanākīrṇaṃ vedikābhiśca śobhitam|| āsīnai rudravṛndaiśca rudrakanyākadambakaiḥ||17|| lakṣapatradalāḍhyaiśca śvetapadmaiśca bhūṣitam|| apsarobhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ puṣpaprakaravistṛtam||18|| dhūpitaṃ dhūpavarttībhiḥ kuṃkumodakasecitam|| vaṃśavīṇāmṛdaṃgaiśca gomukhairmukhavādanaiḥ||19|| śaṃkhabherīninādena dundubhidhvanitena ca|| garjadbhirgaṇavṛndaiśca meghasvanitanisvanaiḥ||7.1.3.20 || gaṇānāṃ stotraśabdena sāmavedaraveṇa ca|| prekṣaṇīyairmahānādairgeyahuṅkāraśobhitam||21|| vṛṣanarditaśabdena gajavājiraveṇa ca|| kāṃcīnūpuraśabdena samākīrṇadigaṃtaram||22|| sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śrīmacchaṃkarasyaiva maṃdiram|| vaṃśa vīṇāmṛdaṃgaiśca nāditaṃ tatra tatra ha || ṛgvedo mūrtimāṃścaiva śakranīlasamadyutiḥ || 23 || divyagandhānuliptāṃgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || saṃsthitaḥ pūrvatastasya dīpyamānaḥ svatejasā || 24 || uttareṇa yajurvedaḥ śuddhasphaṭikasannibhaḥ || divyakuṇḍaladhārī ca mahākāyo mahābhujaḥ || 25 || sthitaḥ paścima digbhāge sāmavedaḥ sanātanaḥ || raktāṃbaradharaḥ śrīmānpaprarāgasamaprabhaḥ ||26|| sragdāmadhārī citraśca gītabhūṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ || athavāṃ'janavacchayāmaḥ sthito dakṣiṇatastathā || 27 || piṃgākṣo lohitagrīvo harikeśo mahātanuḥ || itihāsaṣaḍaṃgāni purāṇānyakhilāni ca || 28 || vedopaniṣadaśchando mīmāṃsāraṇyakaṃ tathā || svāhākāravaṣaṭkārau rahasyāni tathaiva ca ||29|| etaiḥ samanvitaiścaiva tatra brahmā svayaṃ sthitaḥ || śaktirūpadharairmantrairyogaiśvaryasamanvitaiḥ|| || 7.1.3.30 || sahasrapatrakamalairaṃkitaiḥ surapūjitaiḥ || pūjitairgaṇarudraiśca brahmaviṣviṃdravaṃditaiḥ ||31|| cāmarākṣepavyajanairvījitaiśca samantataḥ || śobhitaśca sadā śrīmāṃścaṃdrakoṭisamaprabhaḥ || 32 || jñānāmṛtasutṛptātmā yogaiśvaryaprasādakaḥ || yogīṃdramānasāṃbhoja rājahaṃso dvijottamaḥ || 33 || ajñānatimiradhvaṃsī ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhūṣaṇaḥ || sarvasaukhyapradātā ca tatrāste caṃdraśekharaḥ ||34|| tasyotsaṃgagatā devī taptakāṃcanasaprabhā || pūjito yoginīvṛndaiḥ sādhakaiḥ surakinnaraiḥ || 35 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || yogasiddhipradā nityaṃ mokṣābhyudayadāyinīm || 36 || saubhāgyakadalīkandamūlabījaṃ ca pārvatī || devasya mukhamālokya vismitā cārulocanā || 37 || ānaṃdabhāvaṃ saṃjñāya ānandāsrāvilekṣaṇam || uvāca devī madhuraṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā satī || 38 || || devyuvāca || || janmakoṭisahasrāṇi janmakoṭiśatāni ca || śodhitastvaṃ jagannātha mayā prāṇanaciṃtayā || 39 || arddhāṃga saṃsthayā vāpi tvadvaktradhyānakāmyayā || tathāpi te jagannātha nāṃto labdhvo maheśvara || 7.1.3.40 || anantarūpiṇe tubhyaṃ devadeva namo'stu te || namo vedarahasyāya namo vedaiḥ stutāya ca || 41 || śmaśānaratinityāya namo gaganacāriṇe || jyeṣṭhasāmarahasyāya śatarudrapriyāya ca || 42 || namo vṛṣakṛtāṃkāya yajurvedadharāya ca || brahmāṃḍakoṭisaṃlagnamāline gaganātmane || 43 || maṇicitritakandāya namaḥ sarvārthasiddhaye || namo vedasvarūpāya dvija siddhipriyāya ca || 44 || puṃstrīvikārarūpāya namaścaṃdrārddhadhāriṇe || namognaye sahomāya ādityavaruṇāya ca || 45 || pṛthivyai cāṃtarikṣāya vāyave dīkṣitāya ca || saṃyogāya viyogāya dhātre kartre'pahāriṇe || 46 || pradīptaśūlahastāya brahmadaṇḍadharāya ca || namaḥ patīnāṃ pataye mahatāṃ pataye namaḥ |||. || 47 || namaḥ kālāgnirudrāya saptalokanivāsine || tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ bhūtānāṃ pataye namaḥ || 48 || namaste bhagavanrudra namaste bhagavañchiva || namaste parataḥ śreṣṭha namaste parataḥ para || 49 || jihvācāpalyabhāvena khedito'si mayā prabho || tatkṣantavyaṃ maheśāna jñānadivya namo'stu te ||7.1.3.50 || || īśvara uvāca || || mamotsaṃgasthitā devi kiṃ tvaṃ sāsrāvilekṣaṇā || adyāpi kimapūrṇaṃ te tatsarvaṃ karavāṇyaham || 51 || varaṃ bravīhi bhadraṃ te stavenānena suvrate || dadāmi te na saṃdehaḥ śokaṃ tyaja maheśvari || 52 || niṣkale sakale devi sthūle sūkṣme carācare || na tatpaśyāmi deveśi yattvayā rahitaṃ bhavet || 53 || ahaṃ te hṛdaye gauri tvaṃ ca me hṛdi saṃsthitā || ahaṃ bhrātā ca putraśca baṃdhurbhartā tathaiva ca || 54 || tvaṃ tu me bhaginī bhāryā duhitā bāṃdhavī snuṣā || ahaṃ yajñapatiryajvā tvaṃ ca śraddhā sadakṣiṇā || 55 || oṃkāro'haṃ vaṣaṭkāraḥ sāmāhamṛgyajustathā || ahamagniśca hotā ca yajamānastathaiva ca || 56 || adhvaryurahamudgātā brahmāhaṃ brahmavittathā || tvaṃ tu devyaraṇī caiva patnī tu parikīrtyase || 57 || svāhā svadhā ca suśroṇi tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || ahamiṣṭo mahāyajñaḥ pūrvo yajñastvamucyase || 58 || puruṣo'haṃ varārohe prakṛtistvaṃ nigadyase || ahaṃ viṣṇurmahāvīryastvaṃ lakṣmīrlokabhāvinī || 59 || ahamindro mahātejāḥ prācī tvaṃ parameśvarī || prajāpatīnāṃ rūpeṇa sarvamāhaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || 7.1.3.60 || teṣāṃ yā nāyikāstāstvaṃ rūpaistaistairavasthitā || divaso'haṃ mahādevi rajanī tvaṃ nigadyase || 61 || nimeṣo'haṃ muhūrtaśca tvaṃ kalā siddhireva ca || ahaṃ tejo'dhikaḥ sūryastvaṃ tu saṃdhyā prakīrttyase || 62 || ahaṃ bījadharaḥ śreṣṭhastvaṃ tu kṣetraṃ varānane| ahaṃ vanaspatiḥ plakṣastvaṃ vanaspatirucyase || || 63 || śeṣarūpadharo nitye phaṇāmaṇivibhūṣitaḥ || revatī tvaṃ viśālākṣi madavibhramalocanā || 64 || mokṣo'haṃ sarvaduḥkhānāṃ tvaṃ tu devi parā gatiḥ || apāṃ patirahaṃ bhadre tvaṃ tu devi saridvarā || 65 || vaḍavāgnirahaṃ bhadre tvaṃ tu dīptiḥ prakīrtitā || prajāpatirahaṃ karttā tvaṃ prajā prakṛtistathā || || 66 || nāgānāmadhipaścāhaṃ pātālatalavāsinām || tvaṃ nāgī nāgarājo'haṃ sahasraphaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 67 || niśākaravaraścāhaṃ śreṣṭhā tvaṃ rajanīkarī || kāmo'haṃ kāmado devi tvaṃ ratiḥ smṛtireva ca || 68 || durvāsāścāpyahaṃ bhadre tvaṃ kṣamā samacāriṇī || lobhamohatapaścāhaṃ tvaṃ tṛṣṇā tāmasī smṛtā || 69 || kakudmānvṛṣabhaścāhaṃ yogamātā tapasvinī || vāyurapyahamavyaktastvaṃ gatirmanasūdanī || 7.1.3.70 || ahaṃ mocayitā lobhe nirmamā tvaṃ yaśasvini || nayo'haṃ sarvakāryeṣu nītistvaṃ kamalekṣaṇā || 71 || ahamannaṃ ca bhoktā ca oṣadhī tvaṃ nigadyase || ahamagniśca dhūmaśca tvamūṣmā jvālameva ca || 72 || ahaṃ saṃvarttako meghastvaṃ ca dhārā hyanekaśaḥ || ahaṃ munīnāṃ rūpeṇa tvaṃ tatpatnī prakīrtitā || 73 || ahaṃ saṃsārakarttā vai tvaṃ tu sṛṣṭirvarānane || ahaṃ śukrāsthiromāṇi tvaṃ majjā balameva ca || 74 || parjanyo'haṃ mahābhāge tvaṃ vṛṣṭiḥ parameśvari || ahaṃ saṃvatsaro devi tvamṛtuḥ parikīrttitā || 75 || ahaṃ kṛtayugo devi tvaṃ tu tretā nigadyase || yugo'haṃ dvāparaḥ śrīmāṃstvaṃ kaliḥ parameśvari || 76 || ākāśaścāpyahaṃ bhadre pṛthivī tvamihocyase || ahamadṛśyamūrtiśca dṛśyamūrtistvamucyase || 77 || varado'haṃ varārohe maṃtrastvamiti cocyase || ahaṃ draṣṭā ca śrotā ca tvaṃ dṛśyā śrutireva ca ||78|| ahaṃ vaktā ramayitā tvaṃ vācyā parameśvari || ahaṃ śrotā ca gātā ca tvaṃ gītirgeyameva ca||79|| ahaṃ trātā ca gandhaśca tvaṃ tu nighrāṇameva ca || ahaṃ sparśayitā kartā sparśyastvaṃ sṛṣṭameva ca || 7.1.3.80 || ahaṃ sarvamidaṃ bhūtaṃ tvaṃ tu devi na saṃśayaḥ || sraṣṭā'haṃ tava deveśi tvaṃ sṛjasyakhilaṃ jagat || 81 || tvayā mayā ca deveśi otaprotamidaṃ jagat || ekadhā daśadhā caiva tathā śatasahasradhā || 82 || aiśvaryeṇa tu saṃyuktau sarvaprāṇi vyavasthitau || ahaṃ tvaṃ ca viśālākṣi satataṃ saṃpratiṣṭhitau || 83 || krīḍāmi krīḍayā devi tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane || tvaṃ dhṛtirdhāriṇī lakṣmīḥ kāṃtā matprakṛtirdhruvam || 84 || ratiḥ smṛtiḥ kāmacārī mama cāṃganivāsinī || devi kiṃ bahunoktena prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 85 || varaṃ varaya devaśi yatkiṃcinmanasi sthitam|| tatte dadāmi tuṣṭo'haṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham || 86 || || devyuvāca || || dhanyāhaṃ kṛtapuṇyāhaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ mayā || yattvayā'haṃ jagannātha harṣadṛṣṭyā'valokitā || 87 || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varaṃ dātuṃ mamecchasi || tanme kathaya deveśa sāṃprataṃ tīrthavistaram || || 88 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pāpaghnāni śivāni ca || tāni deveśa kārtsnyena yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 89 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ puṇyaṃ devarṣisatkṛtam || 7.1.3.90 || tīrthānāṃ darśanaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ snānaṃ caiva sureśvari || śravaṇaṃ ca praśaṃsaṃti sadaiva ṛṣisattamāḥ || 91 || pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthamaṃtarikṣe ca puṣkaram || kedāraṃ ca prayāgaṃ ca vipāśā cormilā tathā || 92 || karṇaveṇā mahādevī caṃdrabhāgā sarasvatī || gaṃgāsāgarasaṃbhedastathā vārāṇasī śubhā || 93 || arghatīrthaṃ samākhyātaṃ gaṃgādvāraṃ tathaiva ca || himasthānaṃ mahātīrthaṃ tathā māyāpurī śubhā || 94 || śatabhadrā mahābhāgā sindhuścaiva mahā nadī || airāvatī ca kapilā śoṇaścaiva mahānadaḥ || 95 || payodhiḥ kauśikī tadvattathā godāvarī śubhā || devakhātaṃ gayā caiva tathā dvārāvatī śubhā || 96 || prabhāsaṃ ca mahātīrthaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 97 || evamādīni tīrthāni yāni saṃti mahītale || tāni dṛṣṭvā tu deveśi punarjanma na vindate ||98|| tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānāmiha bhūtale || saṃjātāni pavitrāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca ||99|| gaṃtavyāni mahādevi svadharmasya vivṛddhaye || aśakyāni śivānyevaṃ gaṃtuṃ caiva sureśvari || manasā tāni sarvāṇi gaṃtavyāni samāhitaiḥ || 7.1.3.100 || | devyuvāca|| bhagavanprāṇinaḥ sarve sarvopadravasaṃkulāḥ|| alpāyuṣaḥ sadā baddhā vyāmohairmaṃdirodbhavaiḥ||101|| tretāyāṃ dvāpare caiva kiṃ nu vai dāruṇe kalau || tasmātteṣāṃ hitārthāya tattīrthaṃ tvaṃ prakīrtaya || yena dṛṣṭena sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ labhyate phalam ||102|| evamuktastu pārvatyā prahasya parameśvaraḥ || uvāca parayā prītyā vācā madhurayā prabhuḥ ||103|| || īśvara uvāca || || tvameva hi carāḥ prāṇāḥ sarvasya jagatoraṇiḥ || tvayā virahito devi muhūrtamapi notsahe ||104|| śivasya ca tathā śakteraṃtaraṃ nāsti pārvati || na tadasti mahādevi yanna jānāsi śobhane || 105 || tvayā vinā'haṃ na kvāsmi na tvaṃ devi mayā vinā || caṃdracaṃdrikayoryadvadagneruṣṇatvameva hi || 106 || tava devi mamāpīha nāsti caivāṃtaraṃ priye || sarvaṃ caiva sureśāni yathāvatkathayāmyaham || 107 || rahasyānāṃ rahasyaṃ tu gopanīyaṃ prayatnataḥ || nāstikāya na dātavyaṃ na ca pāparatāya ca || 108 || dātavyaṃ bhakti yuktāya svaśiṣyāya sutāya vā || pūrvameva mayā khyātaṃ sārātsārataraṃ priye ||109|| tīrthopaniṣadaḥ khyātā liṃgopaniṣadastathā || yogopaniṣado devi pūrvaṃ vai kathitāstava || 7.1.3.110 || || pārvatyuvāca || || leśenāpi na siddhyaṃti kāṃkṣamāṇāḥ paraṃ padam || yonīrbhramaṃto dṛśyaṃte narā nāstikavṛttayaḥ|| || 111 || tīrthavratāni sevante pratyayo naiva jāyate || mohitaṃ tu jagatpūrvaṃ mithyājñānena śaṃkara || 112 || kiṃ te phalaṃ suraśreṣṭha jagadvyāmohane kṛte || 113 || sārātsārataraṃ nātha tava prāṇapriyaṃ hi yat || tanme kathaya deveśa priyāhaṃ yadi te prabho || 114 || ityuktaḥ sa tayā devyā śrīkaṃṭhaḥ suranāyakaḥ || prahasyovāca bhagavāngaṃbhīrārthamidaṃ vacaḥ || 115 || ||īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā pṛṣṭo'haṃ yastvayā'dhunā || niṣphalaṃ tatpravakṣyāmi vastutattvaṃ yathāsthitam || 116 || pūrvamuktāni tīrthāni yāni te surasuṃdari || tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭī ca brahmāṃḍe sacarācare ||117|| teṣāṃ ca gopitaṃ tīrthaṃ prabhāsaṃ caiva suvrate ||118|| evamuktaṃ mahādevi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || dṛṣṭvā saṃskārarahitāḥ kalau pāpena mohitāḥ || 119 || rājasāstāmasāścaiva pāpopahatacetasaḥ || paradāraparadravyaparahiṃsāratā narāḥ || 7.1.3.120 || udvegaṃ ca paraṃ yāṃti pratapyaṃti yatastataḥ || ātmasaṃbhāvitā mūḍhā mithyājñānena mohitāḥ|| varṇāśramaviruddhaṃ tu tīrthe kurvanti ye'dhamāḥ||121|| tīrthayātrāṃ prakurvaṃti daṃbhena kapaṭena ca|| tīrthe mṛtā na sidhyaṃti te narā varavarṇini || 122 || etadarthaṃ mayā devi tīrthāni vividhāni ca || liṃgāni caiva suśroṇi gopitāni prayatnataḥ || na siddhidāni deveśi kalau kalmaṣakāriṇām || 123 || ye narāstu jitakrodhā jitalobhā jiteṃdriyāḥ || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścādambhamatsarāḥ || 124 || madbhāvabhāvitā devi tīrthaṃ sevaṃti suvratāḥ || teṣāṃ caiva hitārthāya kathayāmi yaśaśvini || 125 || prabhāsamiti vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ trailokyavaṃditam || tatkṣetraṃ naiva jānaṃti mama māyāvimohitāḥ || 126 || parohaṃ tvekacittaiśca bahujanmabhirarcitaḥ || te vidaṃti paraṃ kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam || 127 || madbhāvabhāvitā devi mama vrataniṣeviṇaḥ || teṣāṃ prabhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ viditaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 128 || yamaiśca niyamairyuktā ahaṃkāravivarjjitāḥ || teṣāmarthe vadiṣyāmi tava praśnaṃ sudurllabham || brahmaviṣṇvindradevānāṃ purāṇaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || 129 || so'haṃ devi vadiṣyāmi karṇaṃ dehi varānane || pṛthivyāmapi sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ surasuṃdari || 7.1.3.130 || ekaṃ me vallabhaṃ tatra prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || tasmiṃścaiva mahākṣetre tīrthaiḥ somena pūjitaḥ || varāṃstasmai pradāyātha sadaikāṃte sthito hyaham ||131|| tena guhyaṃ kṛtaṃ sthānaṃ tava devi prakāśitam|| tatra me yogayuktasya divyaṃ liṃgaṃ babhūva ha || 132 || divyatejassamā yuktaṃ vahnimekhalamaṃḍitam || lakṣamātrasthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ tu mānavaiḥ || 133 || icchājñānakriyākhyāśca tisro vai śaktayaśca yāḥ || tasmālliṃgātsamutpannā jagatkartṛtvahetave || 134 || tasmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yāti jagadetaccarācaram || punastenaiva saṃbhūtaṃ dṛśyate sacarācaram || 135 || guhyaṃ caiva tu saṃbhūtaṃ na kaścidveda tatparam || janmābhyāsena talliṃgaṃ jñāyate bhuvi mānavaiḥ || 136 || kṣetraṃ prabhāsikaṃ proktaṃ kṣetrajño'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || tatra someśanāmāhamasminkṣetraṃ varānane || 137 || mamāṃśasaṃbhavā ye ca asminkṣetre samudbhavāḥ || teṣāṃ tu viditaṃ liṃgaṃ pūrvakalpe tu bhairavam || 138 || anyairapi yugairdevi idaṃ liṃgaṃ sudurlabham || ghore kaliyuge pāpe viśeṣeṇa ca durlabham || 139 || anyannidarśanaṃ tatra tatpravakṣyāmi pārvati || 7.1.3.140 || kalau yuge mahāghore hetuvādaratā narāḥ || vadiṣyaṃti mahāpāpāḥ sarve pākhaṇḍasaṃsthitāḥ || 141 || mithyā caitatkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ mūrkhaiścāpi prakīrtitam || kva kṣetraṃ kva prabhāvaśca kutra vai santi devatāḥ || 142 || sarvaṃ cāpi tathālīkaṃ mūḍhaiścāpi prakīrtitam || 143 || evaṃ mūrkhā vadiṣyaṃti prahasiṣyanti cāpare || nārakā nāstikā lokāḥ pāpopahatacetasaḥ || siddhiṃ naiva prayāsyaṃti saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge||144|| tīrthe caiva mṛtā ye tu śivanindāparāyaṇāḥ|| tiryagyoniprasūtāśca dṛśyante sarvayoniṣu||145|| etasmātkāraṇāddevi tīrthe caiva suduḥkhitāḥ || dṛśyante yugamāhātmyātsatyaśaucavivarjitāḥ || 146 || idaṃ hi kāraṇaṃ proktaṃ kṣetrāṇāṃ caiva gopane || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ siddhiryena sudurllabhā || 147 || yugeyuge tu tīrthāni kīrtitāni sureśvari || teṣāṃ me vallabhaṃ devi prabhāsaṃ kṣetrameva ca || 148 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || kṣetrabījaṃ mahādevi kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 149 || idaṃ mahāpātakanāśanaṃ ye śroṣyaṃti vai kṣetramahāprabhāvam || te cāpi yāsyanti mama prabhāvāttriviṣṭapaṃ puṇyajanādhivāsam || 7.1.3.150 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devīpraśnavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<7.1.4>
|| sūta uvāca || || evaṃ munīndrāḥ kathite prabhāve śaṃkareṇa tu || punaḥ papraccha sā devī kṛtāṃjalipuṭā satī || 1 || || devyuvāca || || devadeva jagannātha kṣetratīrthamaya prabho || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ vistarātkathayasva me || 2 || kathaṃ tuṣyasi martyānāṃ kṣetre tatra vicetasām || japtaṃ dattaṃ hutaṃ yaṣṭaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ ca yat || prabhāse tu mahākṣetre kasmāttatrākṣayaṃ bhavet || 3 || jātyaṃtarasahasreṣu yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam || tatkathaṃ kṣayamāpnoti tanmamācakṣva śaṃkara || 4 || yadi prabhāsaṃ sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ matam|| kimanyairbahubhistatra karttavyaṃ tīrthavistaraiḥ || 5 || ekaṃ yadi bhavettīrthaṃ mano niḥsaṃśayaṃ bhavet || bahutve sati tīrthānāṃ mano vicalate nṛṇām || 6 || tasmātsarvaṃ parityajya tīrthajālaṃ savistaram || prabhāsasyaiva māhātmyaṃ kathayasva sureśvara || 7 || kṣetrapramāṇaṃ sīmāṃ ca kṣetrasāraṃ hi yatprabho || vaktumarhasi tatsarvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 8 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetramuttamam || sarvakṣetreṣu yatkṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ tu priyaṃ mama || 9 || prabhāse tu parā siddhiḥ prabhāse tu parā gatiḥ || yatra saṃnihito nityamahaṃ bhadre nirantaram || 7.1.4.10 || tasya pramāṇaṃ vakṣyāmi sarvasīmāsamanvitam|| kṣetraṃ tu trividha proktaṃ tatte vakṣyāmyanukramāt || 11 || kṣetraṃ pīṭhaṃ garbhagṛhaṃ prabhāsasya prakīrtyate || yathākramaṃ phalaṃ tasya koṭikoṭiguṇaṃ smṛtam || 12 || kṣetraṃ tu prathamaṃ proktaṃ tacca dvādaśayojanam || pañcayojanamānena kṣetrapīṭhaṃ prakīrtitam || 13 || garbhagṛhaṃ ca gavyūtiḥ karṇikā sā mama priyā || kṣetrasīmā pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu devi yathākramam || 14 || āyāmavyāsataścaiva ādimadhyāntasaṃsthitam || pūrve taptodaka svāmī paścime mādhavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 15 || dakṣiṇe sāgarastadvadbhadrā nadyuttare matā || evaṃ sīmāsamāyuktaṃ kṣetraṃ dvādaśayojanam || 16 || etatprābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvapātakanāśanam|| tanmadhye pīṭhikā proktā pañcayojanavistṛtā || 17 || nyaṃkumanyapareṇaiva vajriṇyāḥ pūrvatastathā || māheśvaryā dakṣiṇataḥ samudrottaratastathā || 18 || āyāmavyāsataścaiva pañcayojanavistaram || pīṭhametatsamākhyātamatho garbhagṛhaṃ śṛṇu || 19 || dakṣiṇottarato yāvatsamudrā tkauraveśvarī || pūrvapaścimato yāvadgomukhāccāśvamedhikam || etadgarbhagṛhaṃ proktaṃ kailāsānmama vallabham || 7.1.4.20 || atrāntare tu deveśi yāni tīrthāni bhūtale || vāpīkūpataḍāgāni devatāyatanāni ca ||21|| sarāṃsi saritaścaiva palvalāni hradāstathā || tāni medhyāni sarvāṇi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca||22|| yatra tatra naraḥ snātvā svargaloke mahīyate || kṣetrasya prathamo bhāgo medhyo māheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 23 || dvitīyo vaiṣṇavo bhāgo brahmabhāgastṛtīyakaḥ || tīrthānāṃ koṭirekā tu brāhme bhāge vyavasthitā || 24 || vaiṣṇave koṭirekā tu tīrthānāṃ varavarṇini || sārddhakoṭistu saṃproktā rudrabhāge ca madhyataḥ || ||25|| evaṃ devi samākhyātaṃ tatkṣetraṃ hi tridaivatam || guhyādguhyataraṃ kṣetraṃ mama priyataraṃ śubhe ||26|| tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭiśca kṣetre proktā vibhāgataḥ || yātrā tu trividhā jñeyā tāṃ śṛṇuṣva varānane || 27 || raudrī tu prathamā yātrā vaiṣṇavī ca dvitīyikā|| brāhmī tṛtīyā saṃkhyātā sarvapātakanāśinī || || 28 || brāhme vibhāge saṃproktā icchāśaktirvarānane || kriyā ca vaiṣṇave bhāge dvitīye tu prakīrtitā ||29|| raudre bhāge tṛtīye tu jñānaśaktirvarānane || yadi pāpo yadi śaṭho yadi naiṣkṛtiko naraḥ || 7.1.4.30 || nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo madhyabhāge vasettu yaḥ || himavaṃtaṃ parityajya parvataṃ gaṃdhamādanam || 31 || kailāsaṃ niṣadhaṃ caiva merupṛṣṭhaṃ mahādyutim || ramyaṃ triśikharaṃ caiva mānasaṃ ca mahāgirim ||32|| devodyānāni ramyāṇi naṃdanaṃ vanameva ca || svargasthānāni ramyāṇi tīrthānyāyatanāni ca || tāni sarvāṇi saṃtyajya prabhāse tu ratirmama || 33 || yastatra vasate devi saṃyatātmā samāhitaḥ || trikālamapi bhuṃjāno vāyubhakṣasamo bhavet || 34 || vighnairāloḍyamāno'pi yaḥ prabhāsaṃ na muṃcati || sa muṃcati jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ janmacakramaśāśvatam || 35 || janmāṃtaraśatairdevi yogo vā yadi labhyate || mokṣasya ca sahasreṇa janmanāṃ labhyate na ca || 36 || prabhāse tu mahādevi ye sthitā kṛtaniścayāḥ || ekena janmanā teṣāṃ mokṣo naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 37 || prabhāse tu sthitā ye vai brāhmaṇāḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || mṛtyuṃjayena saṃyuktaṃ japaṃti śatarudriyam || 38 || kālāgnirudrasāṃnidhye dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritāḥ || jñānaṃ cotpadyate tatra ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtareṇa tu || 39 || śivastu procyate vedo nāmaparyāyavācakaiḥ || tasya cātmasvarūpaṃ tu śatarudraṃ prakīrtitam || 7.1.4.40 || kalpeṣu vedāśca punaḥpunarāvartakāḥ smṛtāḥ || maṃtrāścaiva tathā devi muktvā tu śatarudriyam || 41 || īḍyaṃ caiva tu maṃtreṇa māmeva hi yajaṃti ye || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 42 || samaṃtro'maṃtrako vāpi yastatra vasate naraḥ || so'pi yāṃ gatimāpnoti yajñairdānairna sādhyate || 43 || asmikṣetre svayaṃbhūśca sthitaḥ sākṣānmaheśvaraḥ || rudrāṇāṃ koṭayaścaiva prabhāse saṃvyavasthitāḥ || 44 || dhyāyamānāstathoṃkāraṃ sthitāḥ someśadakṣiṇe ||45 || brahmāṃḍodaramadhye tu yāni tīrthāni suvrate || someśvaraṃ gamiṣyaṃti vaiśākhasya caturdaśī ||46|| manobuddhirahaṃkāraḥ kāmakrodhau tathā'pare || ete rakṣaṃti satataṃ someśaṃ pāpanāśanam || 47 || na sā gatiḥ kurukṣetre gaṃgādvāre tripuṣkare || yā gatirvihitā puṃsāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām || 48 || tiryagyonigatāḥ sattvā ye prabhāse kṛtālayāḥ || kālena nidhanaṃ prāptāstepi yāṃti parāṃ gatim || 49 || tadguhyaṃ devadevasya tattīrthaṃ tattapovanam || tatra brahmādayo devā nārāyaṇapurogamāḥ || 7.1.4.50 || yoginaśca tathā sāṃkhyā bhagavaṃtaṃ sanātanam || upāsate prabhāsaṃ tu madbhaktā matparāyaṇāḥ || 51 || aṣṭau māsānvihāraḥ syādyatīnāṃ saṃyatātmanām || eke ca caturo māsānaṣṭau vā niyataṃ vaset || 52 || prabhāse tu praviṣṭānāṃ vihārastu na vidyate || atra yogaśca mokṣaśca prāpyate durlabho naraiḥ || 53 || tasmātprabhāsaṃ saṃtyajya nānyadgacchettapovanam || prabhāsaṃ ye na sevaṃte mūḍhāste tamasā vṛtāḥ || 54 || viṇmūtraretasāṃ madhye saṃbhavaṃti punaḥpunaḥ || kāmaḥ krodhastathā lobho daṃbhaḥ staṃbho'tha matsaraḥ || || 55 || nidrā taṃdrā tathā''lasyaṃ paiśunyamiti te daśa || ete rakṣaṃti satataṃ someśaṃ tīrthanāyakam || 56 || na prabhāse mṛtaḥ kaścinnarakaṃ yāti kilbiṣī || yāvajjīvaṃ naro yastu vasate kṛtaniścayaḥ ||57|| agnihotraiśca saṃnyāsairāśramaiśca supālitaiḥ || tridaṃḍairekadaṃḍaiśca śaivaiḥ pāśupatairapi ||58|| etairanyaiśca yatibhiḥ prāpyate yatphalaṃ śubham || tatsarvaṃ labhyate devi śrīsomeśvarayātrayā || 59 || eko hyarcayate liṃgaṃ tapasyati tathāparaḥ || tayormadhye tu śreṣṭho yaḥ someśaṃ ca prapūjayet ||7.1.4.6||| yattadyoge ca sāṃkhye ca siddhāṃte paṃcarātrike || anyaiśca śāstrairvijñeyaṃ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitam ||61|| liṃge caiva sthitaṃ sarvaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| tasmālliṃge sadā devaḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 62 || mamaiva sā parā mūrtiḥ śrīsomeśākhyayā sthitā || tena caiṣā tmanātmānamārādhanaparo hyaham || 63 || anekajanmasāhasrairbhramamāṇastu janmabhiḥ || kastāṃ prāpnoti vai muktiṃ vinā someśapūjanāt ||64|| yatkiñcidaśubhaṃ karma kṛtaṃ mānuṣabuddhinā || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti śrīsomeśvarapūjanāt ||65|| anekajanmakoṭībhirjaṃtubhiryatkṛtaṃ hyagham || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti śrīsomeśvarapūjanāt || 66 || tīrthāni yāni loke'sminsevyaṃte pāpamokṣibhiḥ || tāni sarvāṇi śuddhyarthaṃ prabhāse saṃviśaṃti hi ||67|| yo'sau kālāgnirudrastu procyate vedavādibhiḥ || so'yaṃ bhairavanāmnā tu prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 68 || janānāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ kṣetramadhye vyavasthitaḥ || bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya nāśayāmi sureśvari || 69 || jagatsarvaṃ caritvā tu sthito'haṃ sacarācaram || tena bhairavanāmāhaṃ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 7.1.4.70 || agninā yatra taptaṃ tu divyābdānāṃ caturyugam || meghavāhanakalpe tu tatra liṃgaṃ babhūva ha ||71|| agnimīḍeti vedoktaprabhāvaḥ surasuṃdari || kālāgnirudranāmā ca devaiḥ sarvairudāhṛtam || 72 || agnīśāneti deveśi nāmatritayamucyate || kalpekalpe tu nāmāni kathituṃ naiva śakyate || asaṃkhyatvācca kalpānāṃ brahmaṇā ca varānane || 73 || evaṃ caiva rahasyaṃ ca mahāgopyaṃ varānane || snehānmahatyā bhaktyā ca mayā te parikīrtitam ||74|| ekatastu jagatsarvaṃ karma kāṃḍe pratiṣṭhitam || yajñadānatapohomaiḥ svādhyāyaiḥ pitṛtarpaṇaiḥ ||75|| upavāsairvrataiḥ kṛtsnaiścāṃdrāyaṇaśataistathā || ṣaḍrātraiśca trirātraiśca tīrthādigamanaiḥ paraiḥ ||76|| āśramairvividhākārairyatibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ || vānaprasthairgṛhasthaiśca vedakarmaparāyaṇaiḥ ||77|| anyaiśca vividhākārairlokamārgasthitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || na tatpadaṃ paraṃ devi śakyaṃ vīkṣayituṃ kvacit || 78 || yāvanna cārcayeddevi someśaṃ liṃganāyakam || līlayā vāpi tairdraṣṭuṃ tatpadaṃ durlabhaṃ param || 79 || pūjito yairjagannāthaḥ someśaḥ kila bhairavaḥ || tiryagyonigatā ye tu paśupakṣipipīlikāḥ || 7.1.4.80 || antarjjalagatā ye tu kṛmikīṭapataṃgakāḥ || sthāvarā jaṃgamāścānye manuṣyāḥ paśavaḥ striyaḥ || 81 || bālā vṛddhāstathā ṣaṇḍhāḥ śvānagarddabhavāyasāḥ || caṃḍālāḥ puṣkasāḥ śūdrā mlecchā ye'nye viyonijāḥ || 82 || mūrkhāstu paṇḍitāścāpi ye cānye kutsitā bhuvi || te sarve muktimāyāṃti prabhāse ye mṛtāḥ śubhe || 83 || kālānalasya rudrasya kālarājena cāgninā || dagdhāste jantavaḥ sarve prabhāse ye mṛtāḥ śubhe || 84 || durllabhaṃ tu mama kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ devi pāpinām || na tatra labhate mṛtyuṃ pāpātmā lokavaṃdite || 85 || mayā dakṣiṇabhāge ca vighneśaḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ || uttare daṇḍapāṇistu kṣetrametacca rakṣati || 86 || tathānye gaṇapāḥ sarve madājñāvaśavartinaḥ || kṣetraṃ rakṣaṃti deveśi teṣāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || 87 || mahābalastu caṇḍīśo ghaṃṭākarṇastu gomukhaḥ || vināyako mahānādaḥ kākavaktraḥ śubhekṣaṇaḥ || ekākṣo dundubhiścaṃḍastālajaṃghastathaiva ca || 88 || bhūmidaṃḍaśca caṃḍaśca śaṃkukarṇaśca vaidhṛtiḥ || tālacaṇḍo mahātejā vikaṭāsyo hayānanaḥ || 989 || hastivaktraḥ śvānavaktro biḍālavadanastathā || siṃhavyāghramukhāścānye vīrabhadrādayastathā || 7.1.4.90 || vināyakaṃ puraskṛtya deva devaṃ kaparddinam || ekādaśa tathā koṭyo niyutāni trayodaśa || 91 || arbudaṃ ca gaṇānāṃ ca prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ || dvāridvāri pracaṃḍāste śūlamudgarapāṇayaḥ || 92 || prabhāsakṣetraṃ rakṣaṃti devadevasya vai gṛham || na kaścidduṣṭabuddhyā tu praviśediti saṃsthitiḥ || 93 || śatakoṭigaṇaiścāpi pūrvadvāri tu saṃvṛtaḥ || aṭṭahāso gaṇo nāma prabhāsaṃ tatra rakṣati || 94 || kālākṣo bhīṣaṇaścaṃḍo vṛto'ṣṭādaśakoṭibhiḥ || ghaṃṭākarṇagaṇo nāma dakṣiṇaṃ dvāramāśritaḥ ||95|| paścimadvāramāśritya sthitavānviṣṭaro gaṇaḥ || daṇḍapāṇiḥ sthitastatra devadevasya cottare ||96|| yogakṣemaṃ vahannityaṃ prabhāse bhāvitātmanām|| bhīṣaṇākṣastathaiśānyāmāgneyyāṃ chāgavaktrakaḥ || 97 || nairṛtyāṃ caṃḍanādastu vāyavyāṃ bhairavānanaḥ || nandī caiva mahākālo daṇḍapāṇirvināyakaḥ || || 98 || eteṅgarakṣakā madhye śatakoṭigaṇairvṛtāḥ || evaṃ rakṣaṃti bahavo hyasaṃkhyeyā gaṇeśvarāḥ || 99 || kalikalmaṣasaṃbhūtyā yeṣāṃ copahatā matiḥ || na teṣāṃ tadbhavedgamyaṃ sthānamardhendumaulinaḥ || 7.1.4.100 || gaṃdharvaiḥ kinnarairyakṣairapsarobhistathoragaiḥ || siddhaiḥ saṃpūjya deveśaṃ someśaṃ pāpanāśanam || 101 || antardhānaṃ gatairnityaṃ prabhāsaṃ tu niṣevyate || saptalokeṣu ye santi siddhāḥ pātālavāsinaḥ || pradakṣiṇaṃ te kurvaṃti someśaṃ kālabhairavam || 102 ||| pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || lākuliṃ bhārabhūtiṃ ca āṣāḍhiṃ daṇḍameva ca || 103 || puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ caiva amareśaṃ tathāparam ||| bhairavaṃ madhyamaṃ kālaṃ kedāraṃ kaṇavīrakam || 104 || haricaṃdrastu śaileśastathā vastrāṃtikeśvaraḥ || aṭṭahāsaṃ mahendraṃ ca śrīśailaṃ ca gayā tathā || 105 || etāni sarvatīrthāni devaṃ someśvaraṃ prabhum || pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvaṃti tatra liṃgaṃ stuvaṃti ca || 106 || brahmā janārdanaścānye ye devā jagati sthitāḥ || agniliṃgasamīpasthāḥ saṃdhyākāle stuvaṃti ca || 107 || ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || sarve someśvaraṃ yāṃti māghakṛṣṇacaturddaśīm ||| || 108 || tasminkāle ca yo dadyātsomeśe ghṛtakambalam || 109 || ghṛtaṃ rasaṃ tilāndugdhaṃ jalaṃ caṃdrādhivāsitam || ekatra kṛtvā kāśmīramityetadghṛtakaṃbalam ||7.1.4.110||| śivarātryāṃ tu karttavyametadgopyaṃ mama priyam || evaṃ kṛte ca yatpuṇyaṃ gadituṃ tanna śakyate || 111 || tatra dakṣiṇabhāge tu svayaṃ bhūtavināyakam || prathamaṃ pūjayeddevi yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ ||112|| ūṣarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ prabhāsakṣetramūṣaram || pīṭhānāṃ caiva pīṭhaṃ ca kṣetrāṇāṃ kṣetramuttamam || sandehānāṃ ca sarveṣāmayaṃ saṃdeha uttamaḥ || 113 || ye kecidyoginaḥ saṃti śatakoṭipravistarāḥ || teṣāṃ kṣetre prabhāse tu ratirnnānyatra kutracit ||| || 114 || liṃgādīśānabhāge tu saṃsthitā surasundari || 115 || mayā yā kathitā tubhyamumā nāma kalā śubhā || sā satī procyate devi dakṣasya duhitā purā || 116 || dakṣakopāccharīraṃ tu saṃtyajya paramā kalā || himavaṃtagṛhe jātā umānāmnā ca viśrutā || 117 || tena devi tvayā sārddhaṃ tatrasthā varadāḥ smṛtāḥ || navakoṭyastu cāmuṃḍāstasminkṣetre sthitāḥ svayam || 118 || caitre māsi sitāṣṭamyāṃ tatra tvāṃ yadi pūjayet || eka viṃśatijanmāni dāridryaṃ tasya no bhavet || 119 || amā somena saṃyuktā kadācidyadi labhyate || tasyāṃ someśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || || 7.1.4.120 || etatkṣetraṃ mahāguhyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam|| rudrāṇāṃ koṭayo yatra ekādaśa samāsate ||121|| dvādaśātra dineśānāṃ vasavo'ṣṭau samāgatāḥ || gandharvayakṣarakṣāṃsi asaṃkhyātā gaṇeśvarāḥ ||122|| umāpi tatra pārśvasthā sarvadevaistu saṃstutā || nandī ca gaṇanātho yo devadevasya śūlinaḥ||123|| mahākālasya ye cānye gaṇapāḥ saṃti pārśvagāḥ || gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva tathā devī sarasvatī ||124|| anyāśca saritaḥ puṇyā nadāścaiva hradāstathā || samudrāḥ parvatāḥ kūpā vanaspataya eva ca || 125 || sthāvaraṃ jaṃgamaṃ caiva prabhāse tu samāgatam || anye caiva gaṇāstatra prabhāse saṃvyavasthitāḥ || ||126|| na mayā kathitāḥ sarva uddeśena kvacitkvacit || bhaktyā paramayā yukto devadevi vināyakam || tṛtīyaṃ pūjayettatra vāṃchetkṣetraphalaṃ yadi||127|| dvādaśaivaṃ tathā cāṣṭau catvāriṃśacca koṭayaḥ || nadīnāmagnitīrthasya dvāre tiṣṭhaṃti bhāmini || 128 || nirmālyalaṃghanaṃ kiṃcidajñātādyadi vai kṛtam || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti agnitīrthasya darśanāt ||129|| devi kiṃ bahunoktena kṣetrametanmahāprabham || na te varṇayituṃ śakyaṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi||7.1.4.13||| ye cāṃtarikṣe bhuvi ye ca devāstīrthāni vai yāni digaṃtareṣu || kṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pravaraṃ hi teṣāṃ someśvaraṃ devi tathā variṣṭham ||131|| ye cāṃḍajāścodbhijāścaiva jīvāḥ sasvedajāścaiva jarāyujāśca || devi prabhāse tu gatāsavo'tha muktiṃ paraṃ yāṃti na saṃśayo'tra || 132 || iti nigaditametaddevadevasya citraṃ caritamidamaciṃtyaṃ devi te śaṃkarasya || kalikaluṣavidāraṃ sarvaloko'pi yāyādyadi paṭhati śṛṇoti stauti nityaṃ ya ittham || 133 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣetrapramāṇavarṇanaṃ nāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || cha || ||
<7.1.5>
|| sūta uvāca || || ityevamukte vipreṃdrā śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā || punaḥ papraccha sā devī harṣasaṃpūrṇamānasā || 1 || || devyuvāca || || devadeva jagannātha sarvaprāṇahitāya vai || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ vistarādvada me prabho || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || anyaddṛṣṭāṃtarūpaṃ te kathayāmi yaśasvini || yena sṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi kṣetrametanmama priyam || 3 || yā gatirdhyāyatāṃ nityaṃ niḥsaṃgānāṃ ca yoginām || saivaṃ saṃtyajatāṃ prāṇānprabhāse tu parā gatiḥ || 4 || anekakalpasthāyī ca mārkaṃḍeyo mahātapāḥ || so'pi devaṃ virūpākṣaṃ prabhāse tu sadā'rcati ||5|| aṭitvā sarvatīrthāni prabhāsaṃ naiva muṃcati || durvāsāśca mahātejā liṃgasyārādhanodyataḥ || na muṃcati kṣaṇaṃ devi tatkṣetraṃ śaśimaulinaḥ || 6 || bharadvājo marīciśca muniścoddālakastathā || kratuścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca kaśyapo bhṛgureva ca ||| 7 |||| dakṣaścaiva tu sāvarṇiryamaścāṃgirasastathā|| || śuko vibhāṃḍakaścaiva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo'tha gobhilaḥ ||8|| gautamaśca ṛcīkaśca agastyaḥ śaunako mahān|| nārado jamadagniśca viśvāmitro'tha lomaśaḥ || 9 || anye ca ṛṣayaścaiva divyā devarṣayastathā || na muṃcaṃti mahākṣetraṃ liṃgasyārādhanodyatāḥ || 7.1.5.10 || ahaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhāmi liṃgārādhanatatparaḥ || na muṃcāmi mahākṣetraṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane || 11 || sarvatīrthāni deveśi mayā dṛṣṭāni bhūtale || prabhāsena samaṃ kṣetraṃ naiva dṛṣṭaṃ kadācana || 12 || devi ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi yājñavalkyapuraskṛtāḥ || japaṃ kurvaṃti rudrāṇāṃ candrabhāgāṃ vyavasthitāḥ || 13 || catvāriṃśatsahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām || devikātaṭamāśritya japaṃti śatarudriyam || 14 || koṭayaścaiva paṃcāśanmunīnāmūrddhvaretasām || umāpatiṃ samāsādya liṃgaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitam || 15 || rudrāṇāṃ koṭi jāpyaṃ tu kṛtaṃ tatraiva taiḥ purā || koṭistatraiva saṃsiddhāstasmiṃlliṃge na saṃśayaḥ ||16|| śataṃ caiva sahasrāṇāṃ deveśaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇam || pūjayaṃti mahāsiddhā mama kṣetraniṣeviṇaḥ ||17|| vedāṃteṣu ca yatproktaṃ phalaṃ caiva maharṣibhiḥ || tatphalaṃ sakalaṃ tatra caṃdrabhūṣaṇadarśanāt || 18 || agnitīrthe ṛṣīṇāṃ tu koṭiḥ sāgrā sthitā śubhe || rudreśvare smṛtaṃ lakṣaṃ kaṃparddīśe tathaiva ca || 19 || ratneśvare sahasraṃ tu ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām || arkasthale mahāpuṇye koṭiḥ sāgrā sthitā śubhe || 7.1.5.20 || ṣaṣṭiścaiva sahasrāṇi tatra siddheśvare sthitāḥ || sapta caiva sahasrāṇi mārkaṃḍeye tu saṃsthitāḥ || 21 || sarasvatyāṃ brahmakuṇḍe'saṃkhyātā munayaḥ smṛtāḥ || daśārbudasahasrāṇi koṭitritayameva ca || 22 || ṛṣayastatra tiṣṭhaṃti yatra prācī sarasvatī || brahmahatyā gatā yatra śaṃkarasya ca tatkṣaṇāt || 23 || kāyaḥ suvarṇatāṃ prāpa kapālaṃ patitaṃ karāt || jñātvaivaṃ śaṃkinā pūrvaṃ kṛtaṃ tatra mahātapaḥ || 24 || tuṣṭaḥ śrīśaṃkaro devo liṃga vāsavareṇa tu || koṭiyajñaphalaṃ snāne prācyāṃ liṃgasya pūjane || 25 || piṃḍe gayāśataguṇamamāsomayute dine || bhūtāyāṃ piṃḍadastatra kulakoṭiṃ samuddharet || 26 || ye cātra malanāśāya nimaṅkṣyaṃti ca mānavāḥ || daśagodānajaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāmapi bhaviṣyati ||27|| pādena vā krīḍamānā jalaṃ lipsaṃti ye narā || teṣāmapi śrāddhaphalaṃ vidhivatsaṃbhaviṣyati || tatra liṃgāni pūjyāni śūlabhedādikāni tu || 28 || evaṃ vikalpya liṃgāni aśvamedha phalāni tu || darśanenāpi sarveṣāṃ sparśāddhi dviguṇaṃ phalam ||29|| evaṃ tuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ sthitaḥ prācīvane dhruvam || mano'pi ye kariṣyaṃti snānadāneṣu kā kathā ||7.1.5.3||| teṣāṃ tuṣṭo jagannāthaḥ śaṃkaro nīlalohitaḥ || triṃśatkoṭigaṇastatra prācīṃ rakṣaṃti sarvataḥ ||31|| mahāpāpasamācāraḥ pāpiṣṭho vā'ti kilbiṣī || ghuṇākṣaramiva prāṇānprācyāṃ muktvā śivaṃ vrajet || 32 || dadhikaṃbaladānaṃ tu tatra deyaṃ dvijottame || kathitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ sārātsārataraṃ dhruvam || 33 || adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi hiraṇyāśca mahodayam || durvāsasā tapastaptaṃ tatra sūryaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 34 || koṭirekā tu tatraiva ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām || caturviṃśatitattvānāmadhiko balarūpadhṛk || 35 || yatra tiṣṭhati deveśi bhṛgukoṭisamanvitaḥ || anyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ tu koṭyā yacca phalaṃ labhet || 36 || brahmasthāne tathaikena bhojitena tu tatphalam || evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi tatra tiṣṭhāmi nirvṛtaḥ|| koṭirbhirdevaṛṣibhirdevaiḥ saha samāvṛtaḥ || tīrthāni tatra tiṣṭhaṃti aṃtarbhūtāni vai kalau || 38 || tatra kṣetre mahāramye yatra someśvaraḥ sthitaḥ|| mama devi gaṇau dvau tu vibhramaḥ saṃbhramaḥ paraḥ || 39 || tau cātra kṣetrasaṃsthānāṃ lokānāṃ bhramavibhramaiḥ || yojayaṃti sadā cittaṃ vikalpānaikyasaṃkulam || 7.1.5.40 || vināyakopasargāśca daśa doṣāstathā pare || evaṃ kṣetraṃ tu rakṣaṃti pāpināṃ duṣṭacetasām || 41 || daṃḍapāṇiṃ tu ye bhaktyā paśyaṃtīha narottamāḥ || na teṣāṃ jāyate vighnaṃ tatra kṣetranivāsinām || 42 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā vai varṇasaṃkarāḥ || akāmā vā sakāmā vā prabhāse ye mṛtāḥ śubhe || 43 || caṃdrārddhamaulinaḥ sarve lalāṭākṣā vṛṣadhvajāḥ || śive mama pure divye jāyaṃte tatra mānavāḥ || 44 || yastatra vasate vipraḥ saṃyatātmā samāhitaḥ || trikālamapi bhuṃjāno vāyubhakṣasamo bhavet || 45 || meroḥ śakyā guṇā vaktuṃ dvīpānāṃ ca guṇāstathā || samudrāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ śakyā vaktuṃ guṇāḥ priye || 46 || ādidevasya deveśi maheśasya mahāprabhoḥ || śakyā naiva guṇā vaktuṃ varṣākoṭiśatairapi || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣetrastharṣidevagaṇavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<7.1.6>
|| devyuvāca || || atyadbhutaṃ mahādeva māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ mama || apūrvaṃ devadeveśa kadācinna śrutaṃ mayā || 1 || brahmāṃḍe yāni liṃgāni kīrtitāni tvayā mama || teṣāṃ prabhāvenādhikyaṃ someśe tatkathaṃ vada || 2 || kiṃ prabhāvo mahādeva kṣetrasya ca sureśvara || tanme brūhi sureśāna yāthātathyaṃ mamāgrataḥ ||3|| || īśvara uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tava || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ someśasya varānane ||4|| tīrthānāṃ paramaṃ tīrthaṃ vratānāṃ paramaṃ vratam || jāpyānāṃ paramaṃ jāpyaṃ dhyānānāṃ dhyānamuttamam||5|| yogānāṃ paramo yogo rahasyaṃ paramaṃ mahat || tattehaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanā priye||6|| someśaṃ paramaṃ sthānaṃ paṃcavaktrasamanvitam || etalliṃgaṃ na muṃcāmi satyaṃsatyaṃ mayoditam ||7|| yacca tatparamaṃ devi dhruvamakṣayamavyayam || someśaṃ tadvijānīhi mā vikalpamanā bhava||8|| nirbhayaṃ nirmalaṃ nityaṃ nirapekṣaṃ nirāśrayam || niraṃjanaṃ niṣprapaṃcaṃ niḥsaṃgaṃ nirupadravam| || 9 || talliṃgamiti jānīhi prabhāse saṃvyavasthitam || apavargamavijñeyaṃ manoramyamanāmayam || 7.1.6.10 || nityaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ devaṃ makhaghnaṃ sarvatomukham || śivaṃ sarvātmakaṃ sūkṣmamanādyaṃ yacca daivatam || 11 || ātmopalabdhivijñeyaṃ cittaciṃtāvivarjitam || gamāgamavinirmuktaṃ bahiraṃtaśca kevalam || 12 || ātmopalabdhiviṣayaṃ stutigocaravarjitam || niṣkalaṃ vimalātmānaṃ prakaṭaṃ jñānadīpakam ||13|| talliṃgamiti jānīhi prabhāse surasuṃdari || nirāvakāśarahitaṃ śabdaṃ śabdāṃtagocaram || 14 || niṣkalaṃ vimalaṃ devaṃ devadevaṃ surātmakam || hetupramāṇarahitaṃ kalpanābhāvavarjitam ||15|| cittāvalokaviṣayaṃ bahiraṃtarasaṃsthitam || prabhāse taṃ vijānīhi praṇavaṃ liṃgarūpiṇam || 16 || aniṣpaṃdaṃ mahātmānaṃ nirānaṃdāvalokanam || lokāvalokamārgasthaṃ viśuddhajñānakevalam||17|| vidyāviśeṣamārgasthamanekākārasaṃjñitam || svabhāvabhāvanāgrāhyaṃ bhāvātītamalakṣaṇam ||18|| vākprapaṃcādirahitaṃ niṣprapañcātmakaṃ śivam|| jñānajñeyāvalokasthaṃ hetvābhāsavivarjitam||19|| anāhataṃ śabdagataṃ śabdādigaṇasaṃbhavam || evaṃ someśvaraṃ viddhi prabhāse liṃgarūpiṇam || 7.1.6.20 || śabdabrahmagataṃ śāntaṃ sa śabdāṃtagamāspadam || sarvātirikta viṣayaṃ sarvadhyānapade sthitam || 21 || anādimacyutaṃ divyaṃ pramāṇātīta gocaram || adhaścordhvaṃ gataṃ nityaṃ jīvākhyaṃ dehasaṃsthitam || 22 || hṛdādidvādaśāṃtasthaṃ prāṇāpānodayāstagam || agrāhyamindriyātmānaṃ niṣkalaṃkātmakaṃ vibhum ||23|| svarādivyaṃjanātītaṃ varṇādiparivarjitam || vācāmavācyaviṣayamahaṃkārārddharūpiṇam ||24|| apratarkyamanuccāryaṃ kalanākālavarjitam || niḥśabdaṃ niścalaṃ saumyaṃ dehātītaṃ parātparam ||25|| bhūtāvagraharahitaṃ bhāvābhāvavivarjitam || avijñeyaṃ paraṃ sūkṣmaṃ pañcapañcādisaṃbhavam || 26 || aprameyamanaṃtākhyamakṣayaṃ kāmarūpiṇam || prabhavaṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ bījāṃkurasamudbhavam || 27 || vyāpakaṃ sarvakāmākhyamakṣaraṃ paramaṃ mahat || sthūlasūkṣmavibhāgasthaṃ vyaktāvyaktaṃ sanātanam || 28 || kalpakalpāntarahitamanādinidhanaṃ mahat || mahābhūtaṃ mahākāyaṃ śivaṃ nirvāṇabhairavam || 29 || evaṃ sadāśivaṃ viddhi prabhāse liṃgarūpiṇam || yogakriyā vinirmuktaṃ mṛtyuṃjayamanādimat || 7.1.6.30 || sarvopasargarahitaṃ sarvatovyāpakaṃ śivam || avyaktaṃ parato nityaṃ kevalaṃ dvaitavarjitam || 31 || ananyatejasākrāṃtaṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinam|| bhūrisvayaṃprabhaprakhyaṃ sarvatejo'dhikaṃ haram||32|| śaraṇyaṃdevamīśānamoṃkāraṃ śivarūpiṇam|| devadevaṃ mahādevaṃ paṃcavaktraṃ vṛṣadhvajam||33|| nirmalaṃ mānasātītaṃ bhāvagrāhyamanūpamam|| sadā śāṃtaṃ virūpākṣaṃ śūlahastaṃ jaṭādharam||34|| hṛtpadmakośamadhyasthaṃ śūnyarūpaṃ nirañjanam || evaṃ sadāśivaṃ viddhi prabhāse liṅgarūpiṇam || 35 || yo'sau parātparo devo haṃsākhyaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || nādākhyaḥ suvrate devi so'sminsthāne sthitaḥ svayam || 36 || etadādisvarūpaṃ ca mayā yogabalena tu || vijñātaṃ devi gaditaṃ divyamātmānamātmanā || 37 || ṛgvedasthastu pūrvāhṇe madhyāhne yajuṣi sthitaḥ || aparāhṇe tu sāmastho hyatharvastho niśāgame || 38 || vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāṃtamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt || tameva viditvā na bhavettu mṛtyurnānyaḥ paṃthā vidyate vai janānām || 39 || itīritaste tu mahāprabhāvaḥ someśaliṃgasya kṛtaikadeśaḥ || vṛtaṃ na cābdairbahubhiḥ sahasrairvaktuṃ ca kenāpi mukhairna śakyam ||7.1.6.40||| brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro'pīdaṃ paṭhedyadi || nirmuktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||41|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīsomeśvaramahimavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ||6||cha|| ||
<7.1.7>
|| sūta uvāca || || evaṃ tatra tadā devī śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam || harṣotkaṃṭhitayā vācā punaḥ papraccha śaṃkaram || 1 || || devyuvāca || || devadeva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || samastajñānasaṃpanna namaste'stu maheśvara || 2 || namo'stu vai tripuraprahartre mahātmane tārakamardanāya || namo'stu te kṣīrasamudra dāyine śiśormunīndrasya samāhitasya ||3|| namo'stu te sarvajagadvidhātre sarvatra sarvātmaka sarvakartre || namo bhavāyāstu namo'bhavāya namo'stu te sarvagatāya nityam || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || kiṃ devi pṛcchase'dyāpi sarvaṃ te kathitaṃ mayā || saṃdigdhamasti kiṃciccetpunaḥ pṛcchasva bhāmini || 5 || || devyuvāca || || someśvareti yannāma kasminkāle babhūva tat || kiṃ nāmāgre'bhavalliṃgaṃ nāma kiṃ bhavitā'dhunā || 6 || evaṃ yasya prabhāvo vai noktaḥ pūrvaṃ tvayā vibho || anyeṣāṃ tīrthadevānāṃ māhātmyaṃ varṇitaṃ tvayā || na tvīdṛśaṃ tu kathitaṃ śrīsomeśasya yādṛśam || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || pūrvamevāhamevāsaṃ sparśaliṃgasvarūpavān || na ca māṃ tattvato veda janaḥ kaścidiheśvari || 8 || mahākalpe tu sañjāte brahmaṇaḥ prati saṃcare || nāmabhāvaṃ bhavedanyaddevi liṃge punaḥpunaḥ || 9 || atītaṃ brahmaṇāṃ ṣaṭkaṃ saptamo'yaṃ prajāpatiḥ || varttate yo'dhunā devi śatānanda iti śrutaḥ || || 7.1.7.10 || asminbrahmaṇi deveśi saṃjāte hyaṣṭavārṣike || tadā kālātsamārabhya someśa iti viśrutaḥ || 11 || atīteṣu ca deveśi brahmasuptalayādanu || babhūvuryāni nāmāni tāni tvaṃ śṛṇu pārvati || 12 || ādyo viraṃcināmāsīdyadā brahmā pitāmahaḥ || mṛtyuñjayastadā nāma somanāthasya kīrtitam || || 13 || dvitīyo'bhūdyadā brahmā padmabhūriti viśrutaḥ || tadā kālāgnirudreti nāma proktaṃ śubheṃ'bike || 14 || tṛtīyo'bhūdyadā brahmā svayaṃbhūriti viśrutaḥ || amṛteśeti devasya tadā nāma prakīrtitam || 15 || caturtho'bhūdyathā brahmā parameṣṭhīti viśrutaḥ || anāmayeti devasya tadā nāma smṛtaṃ śubhe||16|| paṃcamo'bhūdyadā brahmā surajyeṣṭha iti smṛtaḥ|| kṛttivāseti devasya nāma proktaṃ tadāmbike||17|| ṣaṣṭhaścābhūdyadā brahmā hemagarbha iti śrutaḥ|| tadā bhairavanātheti nāma devasya kīrtitam||18|| ayaṃ yo varttate brahmā śatānaṃda iti smṛtaḥ || somanātheti devasya vartate nāma sāṃpratam||19|| ataḥ paraṃ caturvaktro brahmā yo bhavitā yadā || prāṇanātheti devasya tadā nāma bhaviṣyati||7.1.7.20|| atītā ye vidhātāro bhaviṣyaṃti ca ye'dhunā|| tāvattadvarttate nāma yāvadanyoṣṭavārṣikaḥ || saṃdhyāsaṃdhyāṃśabhedena viṣṇvanaṃtasanātanāḥ || 21 || evaṃ nāmāni devasya saṃkṣepātkīrtitāni me || vistarātkathituṃ naiva śakyaṃte kālagauravāt || 22 || || devyuvāca || || āścaryaṃ devadeveśa yattvayā kathitaṃ prabho || pūrvoktāni ca nāmāni na smaraṃti ca me katham ||23|| etadvistarato brūhi kāraṇaṃ ca jagatpate || sarvabhūtahitārthāya mamānugrahakāmyayā || 24 || || īśvara uvāca || || kalpekalpe mahādevi avatāraṃ karoṣi yat || tena te smaraṇaṃ nāsti prabhāvātprakṛteḥ priye || 25 || tattvāvaraṇamadhye tu tatrādyā tvaṃ pratiṣṭhitā || sā'vatīryāṃḍamadhye tu mayā sārddhaṃ varānane || 26 || anugrahārthaṃ lokānāṃ prādurbhūtā punaḥpunaḥ || ādye kalpe jaganmātā jagadyonirdvitīyake || 27 || tṛtīye śāṃbhavīnāma caturthe viśvarūpiṇī || pañcame naṃdinīnāma ṣaṣṭhe caiva gaṇāṃbikā || 28 || vibhūtiḥ saptame kalpe subhūtiścāṣṭame tadā || ānandā navame kalpe daśame vāmalocanā || 29 || ekādaśe varārohā dvādaśe ca sumaṅgalā || kalpe trayodaśe caiva mahāmāyā hyudāhṛtā || 7.1.7.30 || tataścaturdaśe kalpe'nantānāma prakīrtitā || bhūtamātā paṃcadaśe ṣoḍaśe cottamā smṛtā || 31 || tataḥ saptadaśe kalpe pitṛkalpe tu viśrutā || dakṣasya duhitā jātā satīnāmnī mahāprabhā || 32 || apamānāttu dakṣasya svāṃ tanūmatyajatpunaḥ || umāṃ kalāṃ tu candrasya purāpūrya ca saṃsthitā || 33 || tataḥ pravṛtte vārāhe kalpe tvaṃ surasundari || punarhimavatārādhya duhitā tvamataḥ kṛtā || 34 || tato devyadbhutaṃ taptvā tapaḥ paramaduścaram || bharttāraṃ māṃ punaḥ prāpya pārvatīti nigadyase || 35 || kailāsanilayaścāhaṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ varānane || krīḍāmi tava deveśi yāvatkalpāvasānakam ||36|| idaṃ caturguṇaṃ prāpya dvāpare viṣṇunā saha || mahiṣasya vadhārthāya utpannā kṛṣṇapiṃgalā || 37 || kātyāyanīti durgeti vividhairnāmaparyayaiḥ || navakoṭiprabhedena jātāsi vasudhātale || 38 || yāni te kalpanāmāni pūrvamuktāni sundari || tāni trayodaśākalpādudaktātkathitāni me || 39 || atītāni bhaviṣyāṇi varttamānāni sundari || evaṃ jñeyāni sarvāṇi brahmakalpāvadhi priye || || 7.1.7.40 || || devyuvāca || || somanātheti yannāma tvayā pūrvamudāhṛtam || tatkathaṃ niścalaṃ nāma manyate tripurāṃtaka || 41 || asaṃkhyatvācca caṃdrāṇāṃ janmanāmaprabhedataḥ || manvantare tu saṃjāte yugānāmekasaptatau || 42 || caṃdrasūryādayo devāḥ saṃhriyaṃte punaḥpunaḥ || saptarṣayaḥ surāḥ śakro manustatsūnavo nṛpāḥ || 43 || ekakālaṃ ca sṛjyaṃte saṃhriyaṃte ca pūrvavat || etanme saṃśayaṃ deva yathāvadvaktumarhasi ||44|| || īśvara uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ ||45|| ayaṃ yo varttate brahmā śatānanda iti śrutaḥ|| tasya caivāṣṭame varṣe manuryaḥ prathamo bhavet || 46 || tasminmanvantare devi yaścādau rohiṇīpatiḥ || samudragarbhātsaṃjātaḥ salakṣmīkaustubhādibhiḥ || 47 || tena cārādhitaṃ liṃgaṃ kālabhairavanāmataḥ || mahatā tapasā pūrvaṃ yugāni ca caturddaśe || 48 || tasyādbhutaṃ tapo dṛṣṭvā tuṣṭo'haṃ tasya sundari || varaṃ vṛṇīṣveti mayā sa ca prokto niśākaraḥ || 49 || sahovāca tadā devi bhaktyā saṃstutya māṃ śubhe || 7.1.7.50 || || caṃdra uvāca || || yadi prasanno deveśa varārho yadi vā'pyaham || somanātheti taṃ nāma bhūyādbrahmāvadhi prabho || 51 || ye kecidbhavitāro'nye manvante śītaraśmayaḥ || teṣāṃ bhavatu deveśa devo'yaṃ kuladevatā || || 52 || ārādhayaṃtu te sarve kṣetre'sminsaṃsthitā vibho || svakīyāyuḥpramāṇena brahmaṇaḥ pralayādanu || 53 || somanātheti te nāma brahmāṃḍe sacarācare || khyātiṃ prayātu deveśa tejoliṃga namo'stu te || 54 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamastvityahaṃ procya punarliṃge layaṃ gataḥ || etatte kāraṇaṃ devi proktaṃ sarvamaśeṣataḥ || 55 || niḥsandigdhaṃ tu saṃkṣepātpurā pṛṣṭaṃ yatastvayā || uddeśamātraṃ kathitaṃ śrīsomeśaguṇānprati || samudrasyeva ratnānāmacintyastasya vistaraḥ || 56 || mohanaṃ tadabhaktānāṃ bhaktānāṃ buddhivarddhanam || mūḍhāste naiva paśyaṃti svarūpaṃ mama mohitāḥ || 57 || || devyuvāca || || īdṛśaṃ yasya māhātmyaṃ tejoliṃgasya śaṃkara || kutra tiṣṭhati talliṃgaṃ kṣetre tasminsureśvara || 58 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi prayatnena śrutvā caivāvadhāraya || prabhāsaṃ paramaṃ devi kṣetrametanmama priyam || 59 || devānāmapi saṃsthānaṃ tacca dvādaśayojanam || paṃcayojanamānena pīṭhaṃ tatra prakīrttitam || 7.1.7.60 || tanmadhye madgṛhaṃ devi tacca gavyūtimātrakam || samudrasyottare devi devikāmukhasaṃjñitam || 61 || vajriṇyāḥ pūrvataścaiva yāvannyaṃkumatī nadī || catuṣṭayaṃ ca vistārādāyāmātpaṃcayojanam || 62 || kṣetrapīṭhamiti proktamato garbhagṛhaṃ śṛṇu || samudrātkauravī yāvaddakṣiṇottaramānataḥ || pūrvapaścimato jñeyaṃ gomukhādā''śvamedhakam || 63 || etanmama gṛhaṃ devi na tyajāmi kadācana || tasya madhye sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ yatra tatte prakīrtitam || 64 || vāruṇīṃ diśamāśritya sāgarasya ca sannidhau || kṛtasmarasyāparato dhanvantaraśatatraye || 65 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tuṃ svayaṃbhūtaṃ vyavasthitam || tatra saṃnihito devaḥ śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ|| 66 || etasminnantare devi someśasya samīpataḥ || caturddaśe vibhāge tu dhanuṣāṃ ca śatadvayam || || 67 || samaṃtānmaṃḍalākārā karṇikā sā mama priyā || tasyāṃ ye prāṇinaḥ sarve mṛtāḥ kālena pārvati || 68 || kṛmikīṭapataṃgādyā jīvā uttama madhyamāḥ || nirddhūtakalmaṣāḥ sarve yāṃti lokaṃ mamāpi te ||69|| uttaraṃ dakṣiṇaṃ cāpi ayanaṃ na vicārayet || sarvasteṣāṃ śubhaḥ kālo ye mṛtāḥ kṣetramadhyataḥ || 7.1.7.70 || ādināthena śarveṇa sarvaprāṇihitāya vai || ādyatattvānyathānīya kṣetrametanmahāprabham || prabhāsitaṃ mahādevi yatra siddhyaṃti mānavāḥ ||71|| hanyamāno'pi yo vidvānvasedvighnaśatairapi || kṛtapratijño deveśi yāvajjīvaṃ sureśvari || 72 || sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ yatra gatvā na śocati|| tasya kṣetrasya māhātmyātsthāṇoścādbhutakarmaṇaḥ || 73 || kṛtvā pāpasahasrāṇi paścātsantāpameti vai || prabhāse tu viyujyeta na soṃ'takapurīṃ vrajet || || 74 || jñātvā kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ hāhābhūtamacetanam || niyuktastatra deveśi rakṣārthaṃ vighnanāyakaḥ || 75 || ye tu brāhmaṇavidviṣṭāḥ śivabhaktivitaṃḍakāḥ || brahmaghnāśca kṛtaghnāśca tathā naiṣkṛtikāśca ye || 76 || lokadviṣṭā gurudviṣṭāstīrthāyatanakaṇṭakāḥ || sarvapāparatāścaiva ye cānye tu vikutsitāḥ || 77 || rakṣaṇārthaṃ ha vai teṣāṃ niyukto vighnanāyakaḥ || kālāgnirudrapārśve tu rudratulyaparākramaḥ || 78 || kṣetraṃ rakṣati deveśi pāpiṣṭhānāṃ niyāmakaḥ || mriyaṃte yadi brahmaghnāstathā pātakino narāḥ || 79 || kṣetre cāsminvarārohe teṣāṃ devi gatiṃ śṛṇu || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi divyāni kamalekṣaṇe || 7.1.7.80 || dāsī putrāśca jāyante tadaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ || tataḥ pāpakṣaye devi punaryāṃti viyonitām ||51|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena pāpaṃ tatra na kārayet || anyatrā''vartitaṃ pāpaṃ kṣetre cāsminvinaśyati || 82 || asminpunaḥ kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ paiśācanarakāvaham || bhaktānukaṃpī bhagavāṃstiryagyonigateṣvapi || 83 || dadāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ na tu brahmadviṣāṃ priye|| ye ca dhyānaṃ samāsādya yuktātmānaḥ samāhitāḥ || 84 || saṃniyamyendriyagrāmaṃ japaṃti śatarudriyam|| prabhāse tu sthitā devi te kṛtārthā na saṃśayaḥ || 85 || yadi gacchennaraḥ kaścitprabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || tamupāyaṃ prakurvīta nirgacchenna punaryathā || 86 || etadgopyaṃ varārohe na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit|| gopanīyamidaṃ śāstraṃ yathā prāṇāḥ svakāḥ priye|| 87|| yenedaṃ vihitaṃ śāstraṃ prabhāsakṣetradīpakam|| sa śivaścaiva vijñeyo mānuṣīṃ prakṛtiṃ sthitaḥ||88|| tasyavigrahasaṃstho'haṃ sadā tiṣṭhāmi pārvati|| vaṃditaḥ pūjito dhyāto yathāhaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 89 || kalau ca durllabhaṃ devi prabhāsakṣetramuttamam || idānīṃ tava snehena viśeṣaṃ kathayāmi vai || satyaṃsatyaṃ punaḥ satyaṃ triḥsatyaṃ surasundari || || 7.1.7.90 || yāni liṃgāni bhūrloke someśasteṣu me priyaḥ || asmim̐lliṃge guṇā ye tu te devi viditā mama || 91 || ahameva vijānāmi nānyo veda kathaṃcana || anyeṣu caiva liṃgeṣu ahaṃ pūjyaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 92 || liṃgaṃ cemaṃ punardevi pūjayāmo vayaṃ svayam || 93 || yasminkāle na vai brahmā na bhūmirna divākaraḥ || sarvaṃ caiva jagannātha tasminkāle yaśasvini || 94 || imaṃ liṃgaṃ paraṃ caiva brahmaṇaḥ pralaye tadā || bhāvinīṃ vṛttimāsthāya idaṃ sthānaṃ tu rakṣati || 95 || daśakoṭyastu liṃgānāṃ gaṃgādvārādvarānane || āgatya tāni madhyāhne liṃge'sminyāṃti saṃlayam || 96 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni gaganasthāni yāni tu || snānārthamasya liṃgasya samāgacchaṃti sarvadā || 97 || dhanyāstu khalu te marttyāḥ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitāḥ || someśvaraṃ ye drakṣyaṃti saṃsārabhayamocanam || 98 || devi someśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ ye smariṣyaṃti bhāvitāḥ || sarvapāpakṣayasteṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 99 || etatsmṛtaṃ priyatamaṃ mama devi nityaṃ kṣetraṃ pavitramṛṣisiddhagaṇābhiramyam || asminmṛtāḥ sakalajīvamṛto'pi devi svargātparaṃ samupayāṃti na saṃśayo'tra || 7.1.7.100 || yaṃ devā na vijānaṃti brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || na sāṃkhyena na yogena naiva pāśupatena ca || 101 || kaivalyaṃ niṣkalaṃ yattadasmim̐lliṃge tu labhyate || tāvadbhramaṃti saṃsāre devādyāstu yaśasvini || 102 || yāvatsomeśvaraṃ devaṃ na viṃdaṃti trilocanam || kṣetraṃ prabhāsamityuktaṃ kṣetrajño'haṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 103 || etaṃ tavoktaṃ nanu bodhanāya someśvarasyaiva mahāprabhāvam || ye vai paṭhiṣyaṃti narā nitāṃtaṃ yāsyaṃti te tatpadamiṃdumauleḥ || || 104 || someśvaraṃ devavaraṃ manuṣyā ye bhaktimaṃtaḥ śaraṇaṃ prapannāḥ || te ghorarūpe ca bhayāvahe ca saṃsāracakre na punarbhramaṃti || 105 || ye dakṣiṇā mūrttimupāśritāḥ syurjapaṃti nityaṃ śatarudriyaṃ dvijāḥ || te'sminbhave naiva punarbhavaṃti saṃsārapāraṃ paramaṃ gatā vai || 106 || uddeśamātraṃ kathito mayā te śrīsomanāthasya kṛtaikadeśaḥ || abdairanekairbahubhiryugairvā na śakyamekena mukhena vaktum || 107 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīsomanāthaprādurbhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || ||
<7.1.8>
|| devyuvāca || || punaḥ kathaya deveśa māhātmyaṃ lokaśaṃkara || śrīsomeśvaradevasya sarvapātakanāśanam|| brahmaviṣṇvīśadaivatyaṃ tathātra tritayaṃ vada || ||| 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā mama gopyaṃ purātanam || tasmim̐lliṃge ca yadvṛttamāścaryaṃ paramaṃ mahat || 2 || ṣaṣṭikoṭi sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrddhvaretasām || tasmim̐lliṃge praviṣṭāni te ghṛtāhutirivānale || 3 || siddhirvṛddhistathā tuṣṭirṛddhiḥ puṣṭistu paṃcamī || kīrtiḥ śāṃtistathā lakṣmīstasmiṃlliṃge samutthitā || 4 || saptakoṭyastu maṃtrāṇāṃ siddhīnāṃ caiva saṃbhavaḥ || divyayogarasāścānye divyauṣadhirasāyanāḥ || 5 || gāruḍaṃ bhūtataṃtraṃ ca khecaryo vyaṃtarīstathā || te sarve saha yogena tasmālliṃgātsamutthitāḥ || 6 || anyāścaiva tu yāḥ kāścitsiddhayo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || tāḥ sarvāḥ saha liṃgena tasmātsthānātsamutthitāḥ || 7 || anyaddevi pravakṣyāmi atra siddhiṃ gatāstu ye || mamāṃśasaṃbhavāḥ prāptā asmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gatāḥ || 9 || teṣāṃ ca vikramānsarvānpravakṣyāmyanupūrvaśaḥ || purākramā grahā muṇḍā guḍakāśca sahetukāḥ || 9 || vimalā daṃḍikāścaiva saptaite kutsikāḥ smṛtāḥ || asmiṃlliṃge purā siddhā yogātpāśupatānmama || 7.1.8.10 || rudro viprastathā dānaścaṃdro mantho'valokakaḥ || sūryāvalokaśceti gārgeyāḥ sapta kīrttitāḥ || 11 || someśvare ca te siddhāḥ prabhāse varavarṇini || mūkamanyaḥ śivaścaiva prakāśaḥ kapilastathā || 12 || satkulaḥ karṇikāraśca pauruṣeyāḥ prakīrttitāḥ || someśvare purā siddhāḥ prabhāse pāpanāśane || 13 || yugeyuge purā siddhāstasmim̐lliṃge priye mama || ete cānye ca ye viprā bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge || 14 || tatra siddhiṃ gamiṣyaṃti durllabhāṃ tridaśairapi || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ talliṃgaṃ siddhidaṃ param || 19 || durllabhaṃ sarvamarttyānāṃ prabhāse tu vyavasthitam || na ca kaścidvijānāti aśubhaiḥ karmabhirvṛtaḥ || 16 || grahadoṣāstu ye kecidbhūtadoṣāstathā pare || ḍākinīpretavetālā rākṣasā grahapūtanāḥ || 17 || piśācā yātudhānāśca mātaro jātahārikāḥ || bālagrahāstathā cānye buddhāścaiva tu ye grahāḥ || 18 || jvarabhūta grahāścānye hyatisārabhagaṃdarāḥ || aśmarī mūtrakṛcchraṃ ca rogāścānye sahasraśaḥ || 19 || durnāmakāstathā cānye kuṣṭharogāstathā pare || kṣayarogāstathā cānye vātagulmāstathaiva ca || anye caiva tu ye kecidvyādhayastu prakīrttitāḥ || 7.1.8.20 || someśvaraṃ samāsādya tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || sarva eva vinaśyaṃti vahnau kṣiptamivendhanam || 21 || upasargāśca cānye sarpaghoṇapavṛścikāḥ || sarve tatra vinaśyaṃti śrīsomeśvaradarśanāt || 22 || yo'sau someśvaro nāmnā paścimo bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ || kālāgnirudranātheti paryāyairnāmabhiḥ śrutaḥ || 23 || tasmiṃstiṣṭhāmi deveśi bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ || sarvaṃ ca duṣkṛtaṃ nṛṇāṃ bhakṣayāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || yo'sau prāṇaḥ śarīrastho dehināṃ dehasaṃcaraḥ || brahmāṃḍametadyasyāṃtareko yaścāpyanekadhā || 25 || vedāḥ sarve'pi yaṃ devaṃ praśaṃsaṃti maharṣayaḥ || parasya brahmaṇo rūpaṃ yasya dvāreṇa labhyate || 26 || so'yaṃ devi mahādevaḥ prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ || yathā guptaṃ gṛhe ratnaṃ na kaścidviṃdate naraḥ || 27 || prabhāse tu sthitaṃ tadvadratnabhūtaṃ gṛhe mama || tacca liṃgaṃ purā kalpe saptapātālabhedakam || 28 || kathitaṃ koṭi sūryasya pralayānalasaṃnibham || tenakālāgnirudreti proktaṃ someśvaraḥ purā || 29 || iti devi samāsena kathitaṃ tava pārvati || someśvarasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 7.1.8.30 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsamāhātmye śrīsomeśvaraiśvaryavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
<7.1.9>
|| devyuvāca || || divyaṃ tejo namasyāmi yanme dṛṣṭaṃ purātane || kālāgnirudramadhyasthaṃ prabhāse śaṃkarodbhavam || 1 || yo vedasaṃghairṛṣibhiḥ purāṇairvedoktayogairapi ijyamānaḥ || taṃ devadevaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi someśvaraṃ pāpavināśahetum || 2 || devadeva jagannātha bhaktānugrahakāraka || saṃśayo hṛdi me kaścittaṃ bhavāñchettumarhati || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || kaḥ saṃśayaḥ samutpannastava devi yaśasvini || tanme kathaya kalyāṇi tatsarvaṃ kathayāmyaham || 4 || || devyuvāca || || yadi tvaṃ ca mahādevo muṇḍamālā kathaṃ kṛtā || anādi nidhano dhātā sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 5 || tato vihasya deveśaḥ śaṃkaro vākyamabravīt || anekamuṇḍakoṭībhiryā me mālā virājate || 6 || nārāyaṇa sahasrāṇāṃ brahmaṇāmayutasya ca || kṛtā śiraḥkaroṭībhiranādinidhanā tataḥ || 7 || anyo viṣṇuśca bhavati anyo brahmā bhavatyapi || kalpe kalpe mayā sṛṣṭaḥ kalpe viṣṇuḥ prajāpatiḥ || 8 || ahamevaṃvidho devi kṣetre prābhāsike sthitaḥ || kālāgniliṃgamūle tu muṃḍamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || 9 || akṣasūtradharaḥ śānta ādimadhyāṃtavarjitaḥ || padmāsanastho varado himakundendusannibhaḥ || 7.1.9.10 || mama vāme sthito viṣṇurdakṣiṇe ca pitāmahaḥ || jaṭhare caturo vedāḥ hṛdaye brahma śāśvatam || 11 || agniḥ somaśca sūryaśca locaneṣu vyavasthitāḥ || 12 || evaṃvidho mahādevi prabhāse saṃvyavasthitaḥ || āpyatattvātsamānīte mā te bhūtsaṃśayaḥ kvacit || 13 || evamuktā tadā devī harṣagadgadayā girā || tuṣṭāva devadeveśaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutā || 14 || || devyuvāca || || jaya deva mahādeva sarvabhāvana īśvara || namaste'stu sureśāya parameśāya vai namaḥ ||15|| anādisṛṣṭikartre ca namaḥ sarvagatāya ca || sarvasthāya namastubhyaṃ dhāmnāṃ dhāmne namo'stu te || 16 || ṣaḍaṃtāya namastubhyaṃ dvādaśāntāya te namaḥ || haṃsabheda namastubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ ca mokṣada || 17 || iti stutastadā devyā pracalaccandraśekharaḥ || tatastuṣṭastu bhagavānidaṃ vacanamabravīt|| 18 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahāprājñe tuṣṭo'haṃ vriyatāṃ varaḥ || 19 || || devyuvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa varārhā yadi vāpyaham|| prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmyaṃ punarvistarato vada || 7.1.9.20 || bhūteśa bhagavānviṣṇurdaityānāmantakāgraṇīḥ || sa kasmāddvārakāṃ hitvā prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ || 21 || ṣaṣṭi tīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || dvārakāmadhyasaṃsthāni kathaṃ nyakkṛtavānhariḥ || 22 || amarairāvṛtāṃ puṇyāṃ puṇyakṛdbhirniṣevitām || evaṃ tāṃ dvārakāṃ tyaktvā prabhāsaṃ kathamāgataḥ || 23 || devamānuṣayornetā dyobhuvoḥ prabhavo hariḥ || kimarthaṃ dvārakāṃ tyaktvā prabhāse nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 24 || yaścakraṃ varttayatyeko mānuṣāṇāṃ manomayam || prabhāse sa kathaṃ kālaṃ cakre cakrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ ||25|| gopāyanaṃ yaḥ kurute jagataḥ sārvalaukikam || sa kathaṃ bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ || 26 || yoṃtakāle jalaṃ pītvā kṛtvā toyamayaṃ vapuḥ || lokamekārṇavaṃ cakre dṛṣṭyā dṛṣṭena cātmanā || 27 || sa kathaṃ pañcatāṃ prāpa prabhāse pārvatīpate || yaḥ purāṇe purāṇātmā vārāhaṃ vapurāsthitaḥ || 28 || uddadhāra mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ saśailavanakānanām|| sa kathaṃ tyaktavāngātraṃ prabhāse pāpanāśane || 29 || yena siṃhaṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || sa kathaṃ devadeveśaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ || 7.1.9.30 || sahasracaraṇaṃ devaṃ sahasrākṣaṃ mahāprabham|| sahasraśirasaṃ vedā yamāhurvai yugeyuge || 31 || tatyāja sa kathaṃ devaḥ prabhāse svaṃ kalevaram|| nābhyaraṇyāṃ samudbhūtaṃ yasya paitāmahaṃ gṛham || 32 || ekārṇavagate loke tatpaṃkajamapaṃkajam || yenoddhṛtaṃ kṣaṇenaiva prabhāsasthaḥ sa kiṃ hariḥ || 33 || uttarāṃśe samudrasya kṣīrodasyā mṛtodadheḥ || yaḥ śete śāśvataṃ yogamāsthāya paravīrahā || sa kathaṃ tyaktavāndehaṃ prabhāse parameśvaraḥ || 34 || havyādānyaḥ surāṃścakre kavyādāṃśca pitṝ napi || sa kathaṃ devadeveśaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ || 35 || yugānurūpaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā rūpaṃ lokahitāya vai || dharmamuddharate devaḥ sa kathaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ ||36|| trayo varṇāstrayo lokāstraividyaṃ pāṭhakāstrayaḥ|| traikālyaṃ trīṇi karmāṇi trayo devāstrayo guṇāḥ|| sṛṣṭaṃ yena purā devaḥ sa kathaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ|| 37 || yā gatirddharmayuktānāmagatiḥ pāpakarmiṇām|| cāturvarṇyasya prabhavaścāturvarṇyasya rakṣitā || 38 || cāturvidyasya yo vettā cāturāśramyasaṃsthitaḥ|| kasmātsa dvārakāṃ hitvā prabhāse paṃcatāṃ gataḥ ||39|| digaṃtaraṃ nabhobhūmirāpo vāyurvibhāvasuḥ|| caṃdrasūryadvayaṃ jyotiryugeśaḥ kṣaṇadātanuḥ ||7.1.9.4||| yaḥ paraṃ śrūyate jyotiryaḥ paraṃ śrūyate tapaḥ|| yaḥ paraṃ parataḥ proktaḥ paraṃ yaḥ paramātmavān||41|| ādityādiśca yo divyo yaśca daityāṃtako vibhuḥ|| sa kathaṃ devakīsūnuḥ prabhāse siddhimīyivān ||42|| yugāṃte cāṃtako yaśca yaśca lokāṃtakāṃtakaḥ || seturyo lokasattānāṃ medhyo yo medhyakarmaṇām || 43 || vettā yo vedaviduṣāṃ prabhuryaḥ prabhavātmanām|| somabhūtastu bhūtānāmagnibhūto'gnivartmanām || 44 || manuṣyāṇāṃ manobhūtastapobhūtastapasvinām || vinayo nayabhūtānāṃ tejastejasvināmapi ||45|| vigraho vigrahāṇāṃ yo gatirgatimatāmapi || sa kathaṃ dvārakāṃ hitvā prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ||46|| ākāśaprabhavo vāyurvāyuprāṇo hutāśanaḥ|| devā hutāśanaprāṇāḥ prāṇo'gnermadhusūdanaḥ || sakathaṃ padmajaprāṇaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritaḥ ||47|| || sūta uvāca || || iti proktastadā devyā śaṃkaro lokaśaṃkaraḥ || uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ pārvatīṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 48 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi prabhāsakṣetravistaram || rahasyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ devānāmapi durllabham || 49 || devi kṣetrāṇyanekāni pṛthivyāṃ saṃti bhāmini || tīrthāni koṭisaṃkhyāni prabhāvasteṣu saṃkhyayā || 7.1.9.50 || asaṃkhyeya prabhāvaṃ hi prabhāsaṃ parikīrtitam || brahmatattvaṃ viṣṇutattvaṃ raudratattvaṃ tathaiva ca ||51|| tatra bhūyaḥ samāyogo durllabho'nyeṣu pārvati|| prabhāse devadeveśi tattvānāṃ tritayaṃ sthitam ||52|| caturviṃśatitattvaiśca brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || bālarūpī ca nāmnāṃ ca tatra sthāne sthitaḥ svayam ||53|| paṃcaviśatitattvānāma dhipo devatāgraṇīḥ || tasminsthāne sthitaḥ sākṣāddaityānāmaṃtakaḥ śubhe || 54 || ahaṃ devi tvayā sārddhaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattattvasaṃyutaḥ || nivasāmi mahābhāge prabhāse pāpanāśane || 55 || evaṃ tattvamayaṃ kṣetraṃ sarvatīrthamayaṃ śubham || prabhāsameva jānīhi mā kārṣīḥ saṃśayaṃ kvacit || 56 || api kīṭapataṃgā ye mriyaṃte tatra ye narāḥ || te'pi yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 57 || striyo mlecchāśca śūdrāśca paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ|| prabhāse tu mṛtā devi śivalokaṃ vrajaṃti te || 58|| kāmakrodhena ye baddhā lobhena ca vaśīkṛtāḥ || ajñānatimirākrāṃtā māyātattve ca saṃsthitāḥ || 59 || kālapāśena ye baddhāstṛṣṇājālena mohitāḥ || adharmaniratā ye ca ye ca tiṣṭhaṃti pāpinaḥ || 7.1.9.60 || brahmaghnāśca kṛtaghnāśca ye cānye gurutalpagāḥ || mahāpātakinaścāpi te yānti paramāṃ gatim || 61 || mātṛhaṃtā naro yastu pitṛhaṃtā tathaiva ca || te sarve muktimāyāṃti kiṃ punaḥ śubhakāriṇaḥ || 62 || iti jñātvā mahādevi daityānāmaṃtako hariḥ|| prabhāsakṣetramāsādya tyaktavānsvaṃ kalevaram|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsakṣetre śrīharisthitipraśnavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9||
<7.1.10>
|| īśvara uvāca || || anyacca kathayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ tava bhāmini || yatra kasya cidākhyātaṃ tatte vacmi varānane || 1 || pṛthvībhāge sthito brahmā apāṃ bhāge janārddanaḥ || tejobhāgasthito rudro vāyubhāge tatheśvaraḥ || 2 || ākāśabhāgasaṃsthāne sthitaḥ sākṣātsadāśivaḥ || 3 || yasyayasyaiva yo bhāgastasmiṃstīrthāni yāni vai || tasyatasya na saṃdehaḥ sa sa eveśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 || chāgalaṃḍaṃ dugaṇḍaṃ ca mākoṭaṃ maṇḍaleśvaram || kāliṃjaraṃ vanaṃ caiva śaṃkukarṇaṃ sthaleśvaram || 5 || śūleśvaraṃ ca vikhyātaṃ pṛthvītattve ca saṃsthitam || hariścandraṃ ca śrīśailaṃ jalpeśonnāṃtikeśvaram|| 6 || mahākālaṃ madhyamaṃ ca kedāraṃ bhairavaṃ tathā || pavitrāṣṭakametaddhi jalasaṃsthaṃ varānane || 7 || amareśaṃ prabhāsaṃ ca naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || āṣāḍhiṃ caiva daṇḍiṃ ca bhārabhūtiṃ ca lāṃgalam || 8 || ādi guhyāṣṭakaṃ hyetattejastattve pratiṣṭhitam || gayā caiva kurukṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā || 9 || vimalaṃ cāṭṭahāsaṃ ca māhendraṃ bhīmasaṃjñakam || guhyādguhyataraṃ hyetatproktaṃ vāyvaṣṭakaṃ tava || 7.1.10.10 || vastrāpathaṃ rudrakoṭirjyeṣṭheśvaraṃ mahālayam || gokarṇaṃ rudrakarṇaṃ ca varṇākhyaṃ sthāpasaṃjñakam || 11 || pavitrāṣṭakametaddhi ākāśasthaṃ varānane || etāni tattvatīrthāni sarvāṇi kathitāni vai || 12 || yo yasmindevatā tattve sā tanmāhātmyasūcikā || audakaṃ ca mahātattvaṃ viṣṇoścātipriyaṃ priye || 13 || jalaśāyī smṛtastena nārāyaṇa iti śrutiḥ || āpyatattvaṃ tu tīrthāni yāni proktāni te mayā || 14|| tāni priyāṇi deveśi dhruvaṃ nārāyaṇasya vai || audakaṃ caiva yattattvaṃ tasminprābhāsikaṃ smṛtam || 15 || tatra devo layaṃ yāti harirjanmanijanmani || sa vāsudevaḥ sūkṣmātmā parātparatare sthitaḥ || 16 || sa śivaḥ paramaṃ vyoma anādinidhano vibhuḥ || tasmātparataraṃ nāsti sarvaśāstrāgameṣu ca || 17 || siddhāṃtāgamavedāṃtadarśaneṣu viśeṣataḥ || teṣu caiva na bhinnastu mayā sārddhaṃ yaśasvini || 18 || tasminsthāne hariḥ sākṣātpratyakṣeṇa tu saṃsthitaḥ || liṃgaiścaturbhiḥ saṃyukto jñāyate na ca kenacit || 19 || mokṣārthaṃ naiṣṭhikairvarṇairvrataiścaiva tu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti bhallukātīrthadarśanāt|| 7.1.10.20 || gocarmamātraṃ tatsthānaṃ samaṃtātparimaṇḍalam || na hi kaścidvijānāti vinā śāstreṇa bhāmini|| 21 || viṣuvaṃ vahate tatra nṛṇāmadyāpi pārvati || paṃcaliṃgāni tatraiva paṃcavaktrāṇi kāni cit || 22 || kukkuṭāṃḍakamānāni mahāsthūlāni kānicit|| sarpeṇa veṣṭitānyeva cihnitāni triśūlibhiḥ || 23 || teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa koṭiliṃgārcanaphalam || tasmādidaṃ mahākṣetraṃ brahmādyaiḥ sevyate sadā ||24 || śrutimadbhiśca vipreṃdraiḥ saṃsiddhaiśca tapasvibhiḥ || pratimāsaṃ tathāṣṭamyāṃ pratimāsaṃ caturdaśīm || 25 || śaśibhānūparāge vā kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || prabhāsasthāni liṃgāni prapūjyante varānane || 26 || saṃnihatyāṃ kurukṣetre sarvastīrthāyutaiḥ saha || puṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ caivaṃ prayāgaṃ saṃpṛthūdakam ||27|| ṣaṣṭi tīrthasahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca || māghyāṃmāghyāṃ sameṣyaṃti sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame || 28 || smaraṇāttasya tīrthasya nāmasaṃkīrtanādapi || mṛtyukālabhavādvāpi pāpaṃ tyakṣyati suvrate || 29 || ānarttasāraṃ saumyaṃ ca tathā bhuvanabhūṣaṇam || divyaṃ pāṃcanadaṃ puṇyamādiguhyaṃ mahodayam || 7.1.10.30 || siddha ratnākaraṃ nāma samudrāvaraṇaṃ tathā|| dharmākāraṃ kalādhāraṃ śivagarbhagṛhaṃ tathā ||31|| sarvadevaniveśaṃ ca sarvapātakanāśanam|| asya kṣetrasya nāmāni kalpe kalpe pṛthakpriye || 32 || āyāmādīni jānīhi guhyāni surasundari || ādye kalpe purā devi pramodanamiti smṛtam || 33 || nandanaṃ paritastasya tasyāpi parataḥ śivam || śivātparataraṃ cograṃ bhadrikaṃ parataḥ punaḥ || 34 || samiṃdhanaṃ paraṃ
