tasmātkāmadaṃ ca tataḥ param || siddhidaṃ cāpi dharmajñaṃ vaiśvarūpaṃ ca muktidam|| 35 || tathā śrīpadmanābhaṃ tu śrīvatsaṃ tu mahāprabham|| tathā ca pāpasaṃhāraṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā || 36 || mokṣamārgaṃ varā rohe tathā devi sudarśanam || dharmagarbhaṃ tu dharmāṇāṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam || ataḥ paraṃ bhavantīha utpalāvarttikāni ca || 37 || kṣetrasya madhye yaddevi mama garbhagṛhaṃ smṛtam || tasya nāmāni te devi kathitānyanupūrvaśaḥ || 38 || śrutvā nāmānyaśeṣāṇi kṣetramāhātmyameva ca || teṣāṃ tu vāṃchitā siddhi rbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 39 || etatkīrttayamānasya trikālaṃ tu mahodayam || saṃdhyākālāṃtaraṃ pāpamahorātraṃ vinaśyati || 7.1.10.40 || api vai dāṃbhikāścaiva ye vasaṃtyalpabuddhayaḥ || mūḍhā jīvanikā viprāste'pi yāṃti mṛtā divam || 41 || asya kṣetrasya madhye tu raviyojanamadhyataḥ || upakṣetrāṇi deveśi saṃtyanyāni sahasraśaḥ || 42 || kānicitpadmarūpāṇi yavākārāṇi kānicit || ṣaṭkoṇāni trikoṇāni daṇḍākārāṇi kānicit || 43 || caṃdrabiṃbārddhabhedāni caturasraprabhedataḥ || brahmādidaivatānīśe kṣetramadhye sthitāni tu || 44 || kānicidyojanārddhāni tadardhārdhāni kānicit || nivarttanapramāṇena daṇḍamānena kānicit ||45 || gocarmamānamadhyāni kāniciddhanuṣāṃtaram || yajñopavītamātrāṇi prabhāse saṃti koṭiśaḥ || 46 || aṃgulyaṣṭama bhāgo'pi nabhosti kamalekṣaṇe || na saṃti yasmiṃstīrthāni divyāni ca nabhastale || 47 || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya tiṣṭhaṃti pralayādanu || kedāre caiva yalliṃgaṃ yacca devi mahālaye || 48 || madhyameśvarasaṃsthaṃ ca tathā pāśupateśvaram || śaṃkukarṇeśvaraṃ caiva bhadreśvaramathāpi ca || 49 || some śvaramathaikāgraṃ kāleśvaramajeśvaram || bhairaveśvaramīśānaṃ tathā kāyāvarohaṇam || 7.1.10.50 || cāpaṭeśvarakaṃ puṇyaṃ tathā badarikāśramam || rudrakoṭirmahākoṭi stathā śrīparvataṃ śubham ||51|| kapālī caiva deveśaḥ karavīraṃ tathā punaḥ || oṃkāraṃ paramaṃ puṇyaṃ vaśiṣṭhāśramameva ca || yatra koṭiḥ smṛtā devi rudrāṇāṃ kāmarūpiṇām || 52 || yāni cānyāni sthānāni puṇyāni mama bhūtale || prayāgaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā prabhāse nivasaṃti ca || 53 || uttare raviputrī tu dakṣiṇe sāgaraṃ smṛtam || dakṣiṇottaramāno'yaṃ kṣetrasyāsya prakīrttitaḥ || 54 || rukmiṇyāḥ pūrvataścaiva taptatoyācca paścime || pūrvapaścimamāno'yaṃ prabhāsasya prakīrttitaḥ || 55 || etadantaramāsādya tīrthāni surasundari || pātālādikaṭāhāṃtaṃ tāni tatra vasaṃti vai || 56 || evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi sarvadevamayo hariḥ || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya tatyāja svaṃ kalevaram || 57 || divyaṃ mamedaṃ caritaṃ hi raudraṃ śroṣyaṃti ye parvasu vā sadā vā || te cāpi yāsyaṃti mama prasādāttriviṣṭapaṃ puṇyajanādhivāsam || 58 || iti kathitamaśeṣameva citraṃ caritamidaṃ tava devi puṇyayuktam || itaramapi tavātivallabhaṃ yadvada kathayāmi mahodayaṃ munīnām || 59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsa kṣetrastha tīrthakṣetramāhātmyadvārā prabhāsakṣetrasya sarvakṣetrottamatvavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ ||10|| || cha ||
<7.1.11>
|| sūta uvāca || || iti proktā tadā devi vismayotphullalocanā || romāṃcakañcukā subhrūḥ punaḥ papraccha bhūsurāḥ ||1|| || devyuvāca || || dhanyā'haṃ kṛtapuṇyā'haṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ mayā || yadeṣa kṣetra mahimā mahādevānmayā śrutaḥ ||2|| bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka || pṛṣṭaṃ tu yanmayā pūrvaṃ tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ hara || 3 || punaśca devadeveśa tvadvākyāmṛtaraṃjitā || na tṛptimadhigacchāmi devadeva maheśvara || 4 || kiṃcitpraṣṭumanāścāsmi prabhāsakṣetravistaram || tanme kathaya kāmeśa dayāṃ kṛtvā jagatprabho || || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || pṛthivyā madhyagarbhasthaṃ jaṃbūdvīpamiti smṛtam || tacca vai navadhā bhinnaṃ varṣabhedena sundari||6|| tasyādyaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ taccāpi navadhā smṛtam || navayojanasāhasraṃ dakṣiṇottaramānataḥ || 7 || aśītiśca sahasrāṇi pūrvapaścāyataṃ smṛtam || uttare himavānasti kṣīrodo dakṣiṇe smṛtaḥ || 8 || etasminnaṃtare devi bhārataṃ kṣetramuttamam || kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca tiṣyaṃ yugacatuṣṭayam || 9 || atraivaiṣā yugāvasthā caturvarṇaśca vai janaḥ || catvāri trīṇi ca dve ca tathaivaika śaracchatam || 7.1.11.10 || jīvantyatra narā devi kṛtatretādiṣu kramāt || yadetatpārthivaṃ padmaṃ catuṣpatraṃ mayoditam || 11 || varṣāṇi bhāratādyāni patrāṇyasya caturddiśam|| bhārataṃ ketumālaṃ ca kuru bhadrāśvameva ca||12|| bhārataṃ nāma yadvarṣaṃ dākṣiṇātyaṃ mayoditam|| dakṣiṇāparato yasya pūrveṇa ca mahodadhiḥ || himavānuttareṇāsya kārmukasya yathā guṇaḥ || 13|| tadetadbhārataṃ varṣaṃ sarvabījaṃ varānane || tatkarmabhūmirnānyatra saṃprāptiḥ puṇyapāpayoḥ || 14 || devānāmapi deveśi sadaivaiṣa manorathaḥ || api mānuṣyamāpsyāmo bhārate pratyuta kṣitau || 15 || bhadrāśve'śvaśirā viṣṇurbhārate kūrmasaṃsthitaḥ || varāhaḥ ketumāle ca matsyarūpastathottare || 16 || teṣu nakṣatravinyāsādviṣayāḥ samavasthitāḥ || caturṣvapi mahādevi vigraho nava pādakaḥ || 17 || bhārato yo mahādevi kūrmarūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ || nakṣatragrahavinyāsaṃ tasya te kathayāmyaham || 18 || prāṅmukho bhagavāndevo kūrmarūpī vyavasthitaḥ || ākramya bhārataṃ varṣaṃ navabhedamidaṃ priye || 19 || navadhā saṃsthitasyāsya nakṣatrāṇi nibodha me || kṛttikā rohiṇī saumyaṃ tṛtīyaṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhigam || 7.1.11.20 || raudraṃ punarvasuḥ puṣyaṃ nakṣatratritayaṃ mukhe || āśleṣākhyaṃ tathā paitraṃ phālgunī prathamā priye || 21 || nakṣatratritayaṃ pādamāśritaṃ pūrvadakṣiṇam || phālgunī cottarā hastaṃ citrā carkṣatrayaṃ smṛtam || 22 || kūrmasya dakṣiṇe kukṣau carkṣapādaṃ tathā'param || svātī viśākhā maitraṃ ca nairṛte tritayaṃ smṛtam || 23 || aiṃdraṃ mūlaṃ tathāṣāḍhā pṛṣṭhe tu tritayaṃ smṛtam || āṣāḍhā śravaṇaṃ caiva dhaniṣṭhā cātra śabditā || 24 || nakṣatritayaṃ pāde vāyavye tu yaśasvini || vāruṇaṃ caiva nakṣatraṃ tathā proṣṭhapadādvayam || 25 || kūrmasya vāmakukṣau tu tritayaṃ saṃsthitaṃ priye || revatī cāśvidaivatyaṃ yāmyaṃ carkṣamiti trayam || īśapāde samākhyātaṃ śubhāśubhaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 26 || yasyarkṣasya patiryo vai grahastaddhainyato bhayam || taddeśasya mahādevi tathotkarṣe śubhāgamaḥ || 27 || eṣa kūrmo mayākhyāto bhārate bhagavāniha || nārāyaṇo hyaciṃtyātmā yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 28 || meṣavṛṣau hṛdo madhye mukhe ca mithunādikau || prāgdakṣiṇe tathā pāde karkasiṃhau vyavasthitau || 29 || siṃhakanyātulāścaiva kukṣau rāśitrayaṃ smṛtam || dhaṭo'dha vṛścikāścobhau pāde dakṣiṇapaścime || 7.1.11.30 || pucche tu vṛścikaścaiva sadhanuśca vyavasthitaḥ || vāyavye vāmapāde ca dhanurgrāhādikaṃ trayam || 31 || kumbha mīnau tathā cāsya uttarāṃ kukṣimāśritau || mīnameṣau mahādevi pāde pūrvottare sthitau || 32 || kūrmmadeśāṃstatharkṣāṇi deśeṣveteṣu vai priye || rāśayaśca tatharkṣeṣu grahā rāśivyavasthitāḥ || 33 || tasmādgraharkṣapīḍāsu deśapīḍāṃ vinirdiśet || tatra snānaṃ prakurvaṃti dānaṃ homādikaṃ tathā || 34 || sa eṣa vaiṣṇavaḥ pādo devi madhye graho'sya yaḥ || nārāyaṇākhyo'ciṃtyātmā kāraṇaṃ jagataḥ prabhuḥ || 35 || bhaumaśukrabudheṃdvarkabudhaśukramahīsutāḥ || gurumaṃdāsurācāryā meṣādīnāmadhīśvarāḥ || 36 || evaṃvidho mahādevi kūrmarūpī janārddanaḥ || tasya naiṛtapāde tu saurāṣṭra iti viśrutaḥ || 37 || sa caivaṃ navadhā bhinnaḥ purabhedena suṃdari || tasya yo navamo bhāgaḥ sāgarasya ca sannidhau || 38 || prabhāsa iti vikhyāto mama devi priyaḥ sadā || yojanānāṃ daśadve ca vistīrṇaḥ parimaṇḍalam || 39 || madhyesya pīṭhikā proktā paṃcayojanavistṛtā || tanmadhye madgrahaṃ devi tiṣṭhatyudadhisaṃnidhau || || 7.1.11.40 || tasya madhye mahādevi liṃgarūpo vasāmyaham || 41 || kṛtasmarātpaścimato dhanuṣāṃ ca śatatraye || vasāmi tatra deveśi tvayā saha varānane || 42 || tanme sthānaṃ mahādevi kailāsādapi vallabham || gocarmamātraṃ tatrāpi mahāgopyaṃ varānane || 43 || akathyaṃ devadeveśi tava snehātprakāśitam || etatprābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ prabhayā dīpitaṃ mama || 44 || tena prabhāsamityuktamādikalpe varānane || dvitīye tu prabhā labdhā sarvairdevaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || 45 || mama prabhābhā deveśi tena prābhāsikaṃ smṛtam || prabhāvavanto deveśi yatra saṃti mahāsurāḥ || 46 || athavā tena lokeṣu prabhāsamiti kīrtyate || prathamaṃ bhāsate devi sarveṣāṃ bhuvi tejasām || tīrthānāmāditīrthaṃ yatprabhāsaṃ tena kīrttitam || ||| 47 || prakṛṣṭaṃ bhānurathavā bhāsito viśvakarmaṇā || yatra sākṣātprabhāpāto jātaḥ prābhāsikaṃ tataḥ || 48 || athavā dakṣasaṃśaptenendunā niṣprabheṇa ca || tatra devi prabhā labdhā tena prābhāsikaṃ smṛtam || proddadhe bhāratī devī hyaurvāgniṃ vaḍavānalam || 49 || athavā tena deveśi prabhāsamiti kīrtyate || prakṛṣṭā bhāratī brāhmī viproktā śrūyate'dhvani || sadā yatra mahādevi prabhāsaṃ tena kīrtitam || 7.1.11.50 || prollasadvīcibhirbhāti sarvadā sāgaraḥ priye || tena prabhāsa nāmeti triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 51 || pratyakṣaṃ bhāskaro yatra sadā tiṣṭhati bhāmini || tena prabhāsa nāmeti prasiddhimagamatkṣitau || 52 || prakṛṣṭaṃ bhāvināṃ sarvaṃ kāmaṃ tatra dadāmyaham || tena prabhāsanāmeti tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 53 || kalpabhedena nāmāni tathaiva surasundari || niruktabhedairbahudhā bhidyaṃte kāraṇaiḥ priye || prabhāsamiti yannāma dātavyaṃ niścalaṃ smṛtam || 54 || aptattve saṃsthitaṃ devi viṣṇorādyakalevare || iti te kathitaṃ devi saṃkṣepātkṣetrakāraṇam || 55 || punaste kathayāmyadya yatpṛcchasi varānane || tadbrūhi śīghraṃ kalyāṇi yatte manasi vartate || 56 || || devyuvāca || || asminkalpe yathā jātaṃ kṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ hara || tanme vistarato brūhi utpattiṃ kāraṇaṃ tathā || 57 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yathāvatkṣetrakāraṇam || yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ|| 58 || ādikṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || kathayiṣye varārohe tava snehena bhāmini || 59 || asminkalpe tu yaddevi ādāveva varānane || svāyaṃbhuve manau tatra brahmaṇaḥ sṛjataḥ purā || 7.1.11.60 || dakṣiṇāllocanājjātaḥ pūrvaṃ sūrya iti priye || tataḥ kālāntare tasya bhārye dve ca babhūvatuḥ || 61 || tayostu rājñī dyaurjñeyā nikṣubhā pṛthivī smṛtā || saumyamāsasya saptamyāṃ dyauḥ sūryeṇa ca yujyate || 62 || māghamāse tu saptamyāṃ mahyā saha bhavedraviḥ|| bhūścādityaśca bhagavāngacchate saṃgamaṃ tadā|| 63 || ṛtusnātā mahī tatra garbhaṃ gṛhṇāti bhāskarāt || dyaurjalaṃ sūyate garbhaṃ varṣāsvāsviha bhūtale ||64|| tatastrailokyavṛttyarthaṃ mahī sasyāni sūyate || sasyopayogātsaṃhṛṣṭā juhvatyāhutibhirdvijāḥ || 65 || svāhākārasvadhākārairyajaṃti pitṛdevatāḥ || niḥkṣudhaḥ kurute yasmādgarbhauṣadhisudhā'mṛtaiḥ |1 66 || martyānpitṝṃśca devāṃśca tena bhūrnikṣubhā smṛtā || yathā rājñī ca saṃjātā yasya ceyaṃ sutā matā || || 67 || apatyāni ca yānyasyāstāni vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || marīcirbrahmaṇaḥ putro mārīcaḥ kaśyapaḥ smṛtaḥ || 68 || tasmāddhiraṇyakaśipuḥ prahrādastasya cātmajaḥ || prahrādasya suto nāmnā virocana iti smṛtaḥ || 69 || virocanasya bhaginī saṃjñā yā jananī tu sā || hiraṇyakaśipoḥ pautrī diteḥ putrasya sā smṛtā || 7.1.11.70 || sā viśvakarmaṇaḥ patnī prāhlādī procyate budhaiḥ || 71 || atha nāmnātirūpeti marīciduhitā śubhā || patnī hyaṃgirasaḥ sā tu jananī ca bṛhaspateḥ || 72 || bṛhaspatestu bhaginī viśrutā brahmavādinī || prabhāsasya tu sā patnī vasūnāmaṣṭamasya vai || 73 || prasūtā viśvakarmāṇaṃ sarvaśilpavatāṃ varam || sa caiva nāmnā tvaṣṭā tu punastridaśavārddhakiḥ || 74 || devācāryasya tasyeyaṃ duhitā viśvakarmaṇaḥ || sureṇuriti vikhyātā triṣu lokeṣu bhāminī || 75 || prahrādaputrī yā proktā bhāryā vaṣṭustu sā smṛtā || tasyāṃ sa janayāmāsa putrīstā lokamātaraḥ || 76 || rājñī saṃjñā ca dyaustvaṣṭrī prabhā saiva vibhāvyate || tasyāstu valayā chāyā nikṣubhā sā mahīyasī || 77 || sā tu bhāryā bhagavatī mārtaṃḍasya mahātmanaḥ || sādhvī pativratā devī rūpayauvanaśālinī || 78 || na tu tāṃ nararūpeṇa bhāryāṃ bhajati vai purā || ādityasyeha taptatvaṃ mahatā svena tejasā || 79|| gātreṣvapratirūpeṣu māsikāṃtamivābhavat || saṃjñā ca raviṇā dṛṣṭā nimīlayati locane || yatastataḥ saroṣo'rkaḥ saṃjñāṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.1.11.80 || || raviruvāca || || mayi dṛṣṭe sadā yasmātkuruṣe netrasaṃkṣayam || tasmājjaniṣyase mūḍhe prajāsaṃyamanaṃ yamam || 81 || || īśvara uvāca || || tataḥ sā capalā dṛṣṭiṃ devī cakre bhayākulā || vilolitadṛśaṃ dṛṣṭvā punarāha ca tāṃ raviḥ || 82 || || raviruvāca || || yasmādvilolitā dṛṣṭirmayi dṛṣṭe tvayā punaḥ || tasmādvilolāṃ tanayāṃ nadīṃ tvaṃ prasaviṣyasi || || 83 || || īśvara uvāca || || tatastasyāstu saṃjajñe bhartṛśāpena tena vai || yamaśca yamunā ceyaṃ prakhyātā sumahānadī || tṛtīyaṃ ca sutaṃ jajñe śrāddhadevaṃ manuṃ śubham || 84 || sāpi saṃjñā ravestejo golākāraṃ mahāprabham || asahantī ca sā citte cintayāmāsa vai tadā || 85 || kiṃ karomi kva yāsyāmi kva gatāyāśca nirvṛtiḥ || bhavenmama kathaṃ bhartā kopamarkkaśca neṣyati || 86 || iti saṃcintya bahudhā prajāpatisutā tadā || bahu mene mahābhāgā pitṛsaṃśrayameva ca || 87 || tataḥ pitṛgṛhaṃ gantuṃ kṛtabuddhiryaśasvinī || chāyāmayīmātmatanuṃ pratyaṃgamiva nirmitām || 88 || sammukhaṃ prekṣya tāṃ devīṃ svāṃ chāyāṃ vākyamabravīt || 89 || || saṃjñovāca || || ahaṃ yāsyāmi bhadraṃ te svakaṃ ca bhavanaṃ pituḥ || nirvikāraṃ tvayā tvatra stheyaṃ macchāsanācchubhe || 7.1.11.90 || imau ca bālakau mahyaṃ kanyā ca varavarṇinī || saṃbhāvyā naiva cākhyeyamidaṃ bhagavate tvayā || 91 || pṛṣṭayāpi na vācyaṃ te tathaitadgamanaṃ mama || tenāsmi nāmasaṃjñeti vācyase tatpratiṣṭhayā || 92 || || chāyovāca || || ā keśagrahaṇāddevi ā śāpānnaiva karhicit || ākhyāsyāmi mataṃ tubhyaṃ gamyatāṃ yatra vāṃchitam || 93 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktā sā tadā devī jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ || dadarśa tatra tvaṣṭāraṃ tapasā dhūtakalmaṣam || 94 || bahumānācca tenāpi pūjitā viśvakarmaṇā || varṣāṇāṃ ca sahasraṃ tu vasamānā piturgṛhe || tasthau pitṛgṛhe sā tu kiṃcitkālamaniṃditā || 95 || tatastāṃ prāha cārvaṃgīṃ pitā nāticiroṣitām || stutvā tu tanayāṃ premṇā bahumānapuraḥsaram || 96 || || viśvakarmovāca || || tvāmeva paśyato vatse dināni subahūnyapi || muhūrtārddhasamāni syuḥ kiṃ tu dharmo vilupyate || 97 || bāṃdhaveṣu ciraṃ vāso nārīṇāṃ na yaśaskaraḥ || manorathā bāṃdhavānāṃ nāryā bhartṛgṛhe sthitiḥ || 98 || sā tvaṃ trailokyanāthena bhartrā sūryeṇa saṃyutā || piturgṛhe ciraṃ kālaṃ vastuṃ nārhasi putrike || 99 || tattvaṃ bhartṛgṛhaṃ gaccha dṛṣṭo'haṃ pūjitāsi me || punarāgamanaṃ kāryaṃ darśanāya śucismite || 7.1.11.100 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktā sā tadā pitrā gacchagaccheti sā punaḥ || saṃpūjayitvā pitaraṃ vaḍavārūpadhāriṇī || 101 || meroruttaratastatra varṣaṃ yaddhanuṣākṛti || uttarāḥ kuravo loke prakhyātā ye yaśasvini || 102 || tatra tepe tapaḥ sādhvī nirāhārā'śvarūpiṇī || etasminnaṃtare devi tasyāśchāyā vivasvataḥ || 103 || samīpasthā tadā devī saṃjñāyā vākyatatparā || tasyāṃ ca bhagavānsūryo dvitīyāyāṃ divaspatiḥ || 104 || saṃjñeyamiti manvāno rūpaudāryeṇa mohitaḥ || tasyāṃ ca janayāmāsa dvau putrau kanyakāṃ tathā || 105 || pūrvaṃ yastu manostulyaḥ sāvarṇistena so'bhavat || yaḥ sūryātprathamaṃ jātaḥ putrayoḥ surasundari || 106 || dvitīyo yo'bhavaccānyaḥ sa graho'bhūcchanaiścaraḥ || kanyā 'bhūttapatī yā tāṃ vavre saṃvaraṇo nṛpaḥ || 107 || tāpīnāma nadī ceyaṃ viṃdhyamūlādviniḥsṛtā || nityaṃ puṇyajalā snāne paścimodadhigāminī ||108|| anyā caiva tathā bhadrā jātā putrī mahāprabhā || saṃjñā tu pārthivī chāyā ātmajānāṃ yathākarot || 109 || snehaṃ na pūrvajātānāṃ tathā kṛtavatī satī|| lālanādyupabhogeṣu viśeṣamanuvāsaram||7.1.11.110|| yathā sveṣvanuvarteta na tathānyeṣu bhāminī || manustu kṣāṃtavāṃstasyā bhaviṣyo yo hi pārvati ||111|| merau tiṣṭhati so'dyāpi tapaḥ kurvanvarānane || sarvaṃ tatkṣāṃtavānmāturyamastasyā na cakṣame || 112 || bahuśo yācamānastu chāyayā'tīva kopitaḥ || sa vai kopācca bālyācca bhāvino'rthasya vai balāt || 113 || tāḍanāya tataḥ kopātpādastena samudyataḥ || tathā punaḥ kṣāṃtimatā na tu dehe nipātitaḥ || 114 || padā saṃtarjayāmāsa chāyāṃ saṃjñāsuto yamaḥ || 115 || taṃ śaśāpa tataśchāyā kruddhā sā pārthivī bhṛśam || kiṃcitprasphuramāṇoṣṭhī vicalatpāṇipallavā || 116 || || chāyovāca || || pituḥ patnīmamaryāda yanmāṃ tarjayase padā || bhuvi tasmādayaṃ pādastavādyaiva patiṣyati|| 117 || || || īśvara uvāca || || yamastu tena śāpena bhṛśaṃ pīḍitamānasaḥ || manunā saha dharmātmā pitre sarvaṃ nyavedayat|| 118 || || yama uvāca || || tātaitanmahadāścaryaṃ na dṛṣṭamiha kenacit || mātā vātsalyamutsṛjya śāpaṃ putre prayacchati ||119|| snehena tulyamasmāsu mātādya naiva varttate || visṛjya jyāyaso yasmātkanīyaḥsu bubhūṣati || 7.1.11.120 || tasyā mayodyataḥ pādo na tu dehe nipātitaḥ || bālyādvā yadi vā mohāttadbhavānkṣaṃtumarhati ||121|| śapto'haṃ tāta kopena tayā suta iti sphuṭam || ato na mahyaṃ jananī sā bhavedvadatāṃ vara || 122 || nigurṇeṣvapi putreṣu na mātā nirguṇā bhavet || pādaste patatāṃ putra kathametattayoditam || 123 || tava prasādāccaraṇo na patedbhagavanyathā || mātṛśāpādayaṃ me'dya tathā ciṃtaya gopate || 124 || || raviruvāca || || asaṃśayaṃ mahatputra bhaviṣyatyatra kāraṇam || yena te hyāviśatkrodho dharmajñasya mahātmanaḥ || 125 || sarveṣāmeva śāpānāṃ pratighāto'pi vidyate || na tu mātrābhiśaptānāṃ kvacicchāpanivarttanam || 126 || na yuktametanmithyā tu kartum̐ māturvacastava || kiṃcitte saṃvidhāsyāmi putrasnehādanugraham || 127 || kṛmayo māṃsamādāya prayāsyaṃti mahītalam || kṛtaṃ tasyā vacaḥ satyaṃ tvaṃ ca trāto bhaviṣyasi || 128 || || īśvara uvāca || || ādityastvabravīcchāyāṃ kimarthaṃ tanayeṣu vai || tulyeṣvapyadhikaḥ sneha ekatra kriyate tvayā || 129 || nūnaṃ na caiṣāṃ jananī tvaṃ saṃjñā kvāpi sā gatā || vikaleṣvapyapatyeṣu na mātā śāpadā bhavet || 7.1.11.130 || api doṣasahasrāṇi yadi putraḥ samācaret || prāṇadrohe'pi nirato na mātā pāpamācaret || tasmātsatyaṃ mama brūhi mā śāpavaśagā bhava || 131 || || || īśvara uvāca || || taṃ śaptumudyataṃ dṛṣṭvā chāyāsaṃjñā dinādhipam || bhayena kaṃpatī devī yathāvṛttaṃ mahāsatī || 132 || sā cāha tanayā tvaṣṭurahaṃ saṃjñā vibhāvaso || patnī tava tvayā patyā patiyuktā divākara || 133 || itthaṃ vivasvataḥ sā tu bahuśaḥ pṛcchato'nyathā || na vācā bhāṣate kruddhaḥ śāpaṃ dātuṃ samudyataḥ || 134 || śāpodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sūryaṃ chāyā vivasvataḥ || kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ saṃjñāyāḥ suviceṣṭitam || 135 || tacchrutvā bhagavānsūryo jagāma tvaṣṭurālayam || tataḥ saṃpūjayāmāsa tadā trailokyapūjitam || 136 || nirdagdhukāmaṃ roṣeṇa sāntvayāmāsa pārvati || bhāsvaṃtaṃ nijayā dīptyā nijagehamupāgatam || kva saṃjñeti ca pṛcchantaṃ kathayāmāsa viśvakṛt || 137 || || viśvakarmmovāca || || āgataiva hi me veśma bhavatā śrūyatāṃ vacaḥ || vikhyātaṃ tejasā''ḍhyaṃ ta idaṃ rūpaṃ suduḥsaham || 138 || asahantī tataḥ saṃjñā vane carati vai tapaḥ || drakṣyase tāṃ bhavānadya svabhāryāṃ śubhacāriṇīm || 139 || rūpārthaṃ carate'raṇyaṃ caraṃtī sumahattapaḥ || mataṃ me brahmaṇo vākyādyadi te deva rocate || rūpaṃ nirvarttayāmyadya tava kāṃtaṃ divaspate || 7.1.11.140 || || īśvara uvāca || || yato hi bhāsvato rūpaṃ prāgāsītparimaṃḍalam || tatastatheti taṃ prāha tvaṣṭāraṃ bhagavānraviḥ || 141 || viśvakarmātvanujñātaḥ śākadvīpe vivasvatā || bhṛ(bhū?)mimāropya tattejaḥ śātanāyopacakrame ||142|| bhramatā'śeṣajagatāmadhibhūtena bhāsvatā || samudrā draviṇopetāścukṣubhuśca samantataḥ || 143 || bhramatā khalu deveśi sacaṃdragrahatārakam|| adhogati mahābhāge babhūvākṣiptamākulam ||144|| vikṣiptasalilāḥ sarve babhūvuśca tathā nadāḥ || vyabhidyaṃta tathā śailāḥ śīrṇasānunibaṃdhanāḥ || 145 || dhruvādhārāṇyaśeṣāṇi dhiṣṇyāni varavarṇini || bhrāmyadraśminibaddhāni adho jagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 146 || vyaśīryaṃta mahāmeghā ghorārāvavirāviṇaḥ || bhāsvadbhramaṇavibhrāṃtabhūmyākāśamahītalam || 147 || jagadākulamatyarthaṃ tadā''sīdvaravarṇini || trailokye sakale devi bhramamāṇe maharṣaryaḥ || devāśca brahmaṇā sārddhaṃ bhāsvaṃtamabhituṣṭuvuḥ||148|| || devā ūcuḥ|| || ādidevo'si devānāṃ jātametatsvayaṃ tava || sargasthityaṃtakāleṣu tridhā bhedena tiṣṭhasi || 149 || svasti te'stu jagannātha gharmavarṣahimākara || iṃdra āgamya taṃ devaṃ likhyamānamathāstavīt || jaya deva jagatsvāmiñjaya deva jagatpate ||7.1.11.15||| ṛṣayaśca tataḥ sapta vasiṣṭhātripurogamāḥ || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraiḥ svasti svastīti vādinaḥ || vedoktibhirathāgryābhirvālakhilyāśca tuṣṭuvuḥ || 151 || || vālakhilyā ūcuḥ || || namasta ṛksvarūpāya sāmarūpāya te namaḥ || yajuḥsvarūparūpāya sāmnāṃ dhāmaga te namaḥ || 152 || jñānaikarūpadehāya nirdhūtatamase namaḥ || śuddhajyotiḥsvarūpāya trimūrtāyāmalātmane || 153 || variṣṭhāya vareṇyāya sarvasmai paramātmane || namo'khilajagadvyāpirūpāyānaṃtamūrttaye || 154 || sarvakāraṇabhūtāya niṣṭhāya jñāna cetasām || namaḥ sūryasvarūpāya prakāśālakṣyarūpiṇe || 155 || bhāskarāya namastubhyaṃ tathā dinakṛte namaḥ || sarvasmai hetave caiva saṃdhyājyo tsnākṛte namaḥ || 156 || tvaṃ sarvametadbhagavañjagacca bhramatā tvayā || bhramatyāviśvamakhilaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ sacarācaram || tvadaṃśubhiridaṃ sarvaṃ spṛṣṭaṃ vai jāyate śuci || 157 || kriyate tvatkarasparśairjalādīnāṃ pavitratā || 158 || homadānādiko dharmo nopakārāya jāyate || tāta yāvanna saṃyogi jagadetattvadaṃśubhiḥ || 159 || ṛcaste sakalā hyetāstathā yāni yajūṃṣi ca || sakalāni ca sāmāni nipataṃti tvadaṃgataḥ || 7.1.11.160 || ṛṅmayastvaṃ jagannātha tvameva ca yajurmayaḥ || yataḥ sāmamayaścaiva tato nātha trayīmayaḥ || 161 || tvameva brahmaṇo rūpaṃ paraṃ cāparameva ca || mūrttāmūrttaṃ tathā sūkṣmaṃ sthūlaṃ rūpeṇa saṃsthitaḥ || 162 || nimeṣakāṣṭhādimayaḥ kālarūpakṣaṇātmakaḥ|| prasīda svecchayā rūpaṃ svaṃ tejaḥ śamanaṃ kuru|| tvaṃ deva jagatāṃ hetorduḥkhaṃ sahasi duḥsaham|| 163|| tvaṃ nātha mokṣiṇāṃ mokṣo dhyeyastvaṃ dhyāyatāṃ varaḥ|| tvaṃ gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ karmakāṃḍanivartinām||164|| śaṃ prajābhyo'stu deveśa śanno'stu jagatāṃpate||165|| tvaṃ dhātā visṛjasi viśvameka eva tvaṃ pātā sthitikaraṇāya saṃpravṛttaḥ|| tvayyaṃte layamakhilaṃ prayāti caitattvattonyo na hi tapanāsti sarvadātā || 166 || tvaṃ brahmā hariharasaṃjñitastvamindro vitteśaḥ pitṛpitaraṃbupaḥ samīraḥ || somo'gnirgaganamahādharādirūpaḥ kiṃ na tvaṃ sakalamanorathapradātā || 167 || yajñaistvāmanudinamātmakarmmasaktāḥ stuvanto vividhapadairdvijā yajaṃti || dhyāyantaḥ savinayacetaso bhavantaṃ yogasthāḥ paramapadaṃ prayāṃti marttyā || 168 || tapasi pacasi viśvaṃ pāsi bhasmīkaroṣi prakaṭayasi mayūkhairhlādayatasyaṃśugarbhaiḥ|| sṛjasi kamalajanmā pālayasyacyutākhyaḥ kṣapayasi ca yugāṃte rudrarūpastvamekaḥ||169|| īśvara uvāca|| likhamānastato bhānuṃ viśvakarmā prajāpatiḥ|| udbhūtapulakaḥ stotramidaṃcakre vivasvataḥ||7.1.11.170||| vivasvate praṇatajanānukampine mahātmane samajavasaptasaptaye || satejase kamalakulālibaṃdhave sadā tamaḥpaṭalapaṭāvapāṭine ||171|| pāvanātiśayasarvacakṣuṣe naikakāmaviṣayapradāyine || bhāsurāmalamayūkhamāline sarvabhūtahitakāriṇe namaḥ ||172|| ajāya lokatrayabhāvanāya bhūtātmane gopataye vṛṣāya || namo mahākāruṇikottamāya sūryāya vastuprabhavālayāya || 173 || vivasvate jñānabhṛte'ntarātmane jagatpratiṣṭhāya jagaddhitaiṣiṇe || svayaṃbhuve nirmalalokacakṣuṣe surottamāyāmitatejase namaḥ || 174|| kṣaṇamudayācalabhālitārcciḥ suragaṇagītigariṣṭhagītaḥ || tvamuta mayūkhasahasravajjagati vikāsitapadmanābhaḥ ||175|| tava timirāsavapānamadādbhavati vilohitavigrahatā || mihiravibhāsatayā sutarāṃ tribhuvanabhāvanamātraparaḥ || 176 || rathamāruhya samāvayavaṃ ruciravikalitadivyahayam|| satatamaribale bhagavaṃścarasi jagaddhitabaddharasaḥ || 177 || amṛtamayena rasena samaṃ vibudhapitṝnapi tarppayase || arigaṇasūdana tena tava praṇatimupetya likhāmi vapuḥ || || 178 || śubhasamavarṇamayaṃ racitaṃ tava padapāṃsupavitratamam || natajanavatsala māṃ praṇataṃ tribhuvanapāvana pāhi rave || 179 || iti sakalajagatprasūti bhūtaṃ tribhuvanabhāvanadhāmahetumekam || ravimakhilajagatpradīpabhūtaṃ tridaśavaraṃ praṇato'smi devadevam|| 7.1.11.180 || || īśvara uvāca || || hāhāhūhaśca gandharvo nāradastuṃbarustathā || upagātuṃ samārabdhā gāṃdharvakuśalā ravim|| 181 || ṣaḍjamadhyamagāṃdhāragrāmatrayaviśāradāḥ || mūrchanābhiśca tānaiśca suprayogaiḥ sukhapradam|| 182 || saptasvaravinirvṛttaṃ yatitrayavibhūṣitam|| saptadhātusamāyuktaṃ ṣaḍjāti triguṇāśrayam || 183 || caturgītasamāyuktaṃ catuvarṇasamutthitam || caturvarṇapratīkāraṃ saptālaṃkārabhūṣitam|| 184 || tristhānaśuddhaṃ trilayaṃ samyakkālavyavasthitam|| citte citte ca nṛtye ca raseṣu layasaṃyutam || 185 || caturviṃśadguṇairyuktaṃ jagurgītaṃ ca gāyanāḥ || viśvārcī ca ghṛtācī ca urvaśyatha tilottamā || 186 || menakā sahajanyā ca raṃbhā cāpsarasāṃ varā || caturvidhapadaṃ tālaṃ triprakāraṃ layatrayam || 187 || yatitrayaṃ tathā''todyaṃ nāṭyaṃ caiva caturvidham || nanṛturjagatāmīśe likhyamāne vibhāvasau || 188 || bhāvānbhāvaviśāradyaḥ kurvantyo vidhivadbahūn || devadundubhayaḥ śaṃkhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 189 || anāhatā mahādevi nedire ghananisvanāḥ || gāyadbhiścaiva gaṃdharvairnṛtyadbhiścāpsarogaṇaiḥ || 7.1.11.190 || avādyaṃta tatastatra veṇuvīṇādijharjharāḥ || paṇavāḥ puṣkarāścaiva mṛdaṃgapaṭahānakāḥ || 191 || tūryavāditraghoṣaiśca sarvaṃ kolāhalīkṛtam || tataḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā bhaktinamrātmamūrttayaḥ || 192 || tataḥ kalakale tasminsarvadevasamāgame || saṃvatsaraṃ bhramasthasya viśvakarmā ravestataḥ || 193 || tejasaḥ śātanaṃ cakre stūyamānasya daivataiḥ || devaṃ cakre samāropya bhrāmayāmāsa sūtrabhṛt ||194|| mṛtpiṃḍavatkulālasya saṃspṛśankṣuradhārayā || pataṃgasya stavaṃ kurvanviśvakarmā divaspateḥ|| 195 || tejasaḥ ṣoḍaśaṃ bhāgaṃ maṇḍalasthamadhārayat || śātitaṃ tasya tattejo yāvatpādau varānane || 196 || yattasya ṛṅmayaṃ tejastatprabhāse'patatpriye || yajurmayena deveśi bhāvitā dyaurmahāprabhoḥ || 197 || svargaṃ sāmamayenāpi bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritisthitam || tatastaistejaso bhāgairdaśabhiḥ paṃcabhistathā|| 198 || tena vai nirmitaṃ cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ śūlaṃ harasya ca || mahāprabhaṃ mahākāyaṃ śibikā dhanadasya ca || 199 || daṇḍaḥ pretapateḥ śaktirdevasenāpatestathā || anyeṣāṃ ca surāṇāṃ ca astrāṇyuktāni yāni vai || 7.1.11.200 || yakṣavidyādharāṇāṃ ca tāni cakre sa viśvakṛt || tataḥ ṣoḍaśamaṃ bhāgaṃ bibhartti bhagavānraviḥ|| || tattejo ravibhāgaśca khastho vicarati priye || 201 || iti śātitatejāḥ sa śvaśureṇātiśobhanam || vapurdadhāra mārttaṃḍaḥ puṣpabāṇamanoramam || 202 || tataḥ surūpa dhṛgbhānuruttarānagamatkurūn|| dadṛśe tatra saṃjñāṃ tu vaḍavārūpadhāriṇīm |1 203 || apāpāṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ tapasā niyamena ca || sā ca dṛṣṭvā tamāyāṃtaṃ parapuṃso viśaṃkayā || jagāma saṃmukhaṃ tasya aśvarūpadharasya ca ||204|| tataśca nāsikāyoge tayostatra sametayoḥ|| nāsatyadasrau tanayāvaśvavaktrau vinirgatau ||205|| retasonte ca revantaḥ khaḍgī chatrī tanutrabhṛt || piturgṛhyottamaṃ so'śvaṃ jātamātraḥ palāyata || 206 || sa tasminsakṛdārūḍhastamaśvaṃ naiva muṃcati || tatorkeṇa samādiṣṭau daṃḍanāyakapiṃgalau ||207|| aśvaṃ pratyānayadhvaṃ me mā balācchidrato'syatu || pārśvasthau tiṣṭhatastasya aśvacchidrābhikāṃkṣiṇau||208|| na ca cchidraṃ labhete tau tasyādyāpi mahātmanaḥ|| agre gacchati revaṃte pṛṣṭhagau daṇḍapiṃgalau ||209|| uttarebhyaḥ kurubhyastu nirgatau vegavattarau || dakṣiṇaṃ bhārataṃ prāptau yatra kṣetra prabhāsikam ||7.1.11.21||| atyarthaṃ vegakhinnau tau sa ca revaṃtako'pi hi || prasvinnagātraḥ socchvāso revaṃtastatra saṃsthitaḥ ||211|| muhūrtena samākrāntaṃ lakṣayojanamaṃḍalam || uttarāddakṣiṇaṃ devi revatena mahātmanā || 212 || svinnagātrastato devi prabhāse samavasthitaḥ || daṇḍapiṃgalakasaṃyukto hyaśvārūḍhaḥ sa tiṣṭhati||213|| sāvitryā nairṛte bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ|| rājñīputro yato devi rājā bhaṭṭārakastataḥ|| 214|| loke khyātiṃ samāyāti rājabhaṭṭāriketi ca|| guhyabhaṭṭārakatve ca revaṃto viniyojitaḥ|| 215|| evamabhyetyāha tato bhagavām̐llokatāpanaḥ|| tvamapyaśeṣalokasya pūjyo vatsa bhaviṣyasi|| 216|| araṇye ca mahādāve vairidasyubhayeṣu ca|| tvāṃ smariṣyaṃti ye marttyā mokṣyante te mahāpadaḥ||217|| kṣemamṛddhiṃ sukhaṃ rājyamārogyaṃ kīrtimunnatim|| narāṇāmatituṣṭastvaṃ pūjitaḥ saṃpradāsyasi|| 218 || aśvinau devabhiṣajau kṛtau pitrā mahātmanā|| dharmadṛṣṭiryamaścāsau samo mitre tathā'hite|| 219|| tato niyogaṃ taṃ cāsya cakāra timirāpahaḥ|| yamunāṃ ca nadīṃ cakre kalindāntaravāhinīm || 7.1.11.220 || chāyāsaṃjñāsutaścāpi sāvarṇistu mahāyaśāḥ || bhāvyaḥ sonāgate kāle manuḥ sāvarṇikoṣṭamaḥ || 221 || merupṛṣṭhe tapo ghoramadyāpi carati prabhuḥ || bhrātā śanaiścarastasya graho'bhūcca priye dhruvam || 222 || evaṃ tebhyo varāndattvā revaṃtasyāpi bhāskaraḥ || punarnāma niruktaṃ sa revaṃtasyākarotpramuḥ ||223|| evaṃgacchatyasau yasmātsaṃjñāyāḥ śāṃtidaḥ sutaḥ || aśvānāmādhipatye tu bhānunā ca niyojitaḥ || 224 || kṣemeṇa gacchate'dhvānaṃ yastu pūjayate pathi || sukhaprasādyo marttyānāṃ sadā ca varavarṇini || 225 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rājabhaṭṭārakotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<7.1.12>
|| īśvara uvāca || || yā saṃjñā sā smṛtā rājñī chāyā yā sā tu nikṣubhā || rājṛ dīptau smṛto dhātū rājā rājati yaḥ sadā || 1 || adhikaṃ sarvabhūtebhyastasmādrājā sa ucyate || rājapatnī tu sā yasmāttasmādrājñī prakīrtitā || 2 || kṣubha saṃcalane dhāturniścalā tena nikṣubhā || bhavaṃti hyathavā yasmātsvāṃgīyāḥ kṣudvivarjitāḥ || 3 || chāyā tāṃ viśate divyā smṛtā sā tena nikṣubhā || sāṃprataṃ vartate yo'yaṃ manurloke mahāmate || 4 || tasyānvavāye jātastu śaṃkhacakagadādharaḥ || yamastu mātrā saṃśapto hīnapādo dharātale || 5 || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ liṃgaṃ pūjitavānpriye || 6 || tuṣṭaścāhaṃ tatastasya varāṇāṃ ca śataṃ dadau || adyāpi tatra deveśi yameśvaramiti śrutam || yamadvitīyāyāṃ dṛṣṭvā yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yameśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<7.1.13>
|| devyuvāca || || yadā bhramisthaḥ savitā takṣitaḥ kṣuradhārayā || śvaśureṇa mahādeva jāmātā prītipūrvakam|| 1 || tattejaḥ śātitaṃ bhūri prabhāse yatpapāta vai || tadabhūtkiṃ tadā deva prabhāsātkathayasva me || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sūryamāhātmyamuttamam || yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||3|| dehāvatāro devasya prabhāse'rkasthalasya ca || purāṇākhyānamācakṣe tava devi yaśasvini || 4 || śākadvīpe mahādevi bhramisthasya tadā raveḥ || varṣāṇāṃ tu śataṃ sāgraṃ takṣyamāṇe vibhāvasau || 5 || yadādya bhāgajaṃ tejastatprabhāse'patatpriye || patitaṃ tatra tattejaḥ sthalākāraṃ vyajāyata || 6 || jāṃbūnadamayaṃ devi tatpūrvamabhavatkṣitau || tiṣyamāhātmyayogena śailībhūtaṃ ca sāṃpratam || 7 || tatra cārkamayaṃ rūpaṃ kṛtvā devo divākaraḥ || utpannaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ hitāya dharaṇītale || 8 || hiraṇyagarbhanāmeti kṛte sūryeti kīrtitam || tretāyāṃ savitānāma dvāpare bhāskaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 9 || kalau cārkasthalonāma triṣu lokeṣu kīrtitaḥ || avatīrṇamidaṃ devi svayameva pratiṣṭhitam|| 7.1.13.10 || yadā svārociṣo devi dvitīyo'bhūnmanuḥ purā || tasminkāle'vatīrṇo'sau devastatra divākaraḥ || 11 || bhaktimukti prado devi vyādhiduḥkhavināśakṛt || tasya tejodbhavairvyāptaṃ reṇubhiḥ pañcayojanam || 12 || dakṣiṇottarato devi pañcapūrvāpareṇa tu || uttareṇa samudrasya yāvanmāheśvarī nadī || 13 || nyaṃkumatyāścāparato yāvadeva kṛtasmaram || etadvyāptaṃ mahādevi tattejoreṇubhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 14 || tasya sūkṣmā prabhā yā tu āditejoviniḥsṛtā || tayā vyāptaṃ mahādevi yāvaddvādaśayojanam || 15 || uttare bhāskarasutā dakṣiṇe saritāṃ patiḥ || pūrvapaścimato devi rukmiṇīdvitayaṃ smṛtam || 16 || etasminnantare devi sauraṃ tejaḥ prasarppitam || tena pāvitryamānītaṃ kṣetraṃ dvādaśayojanam || 17 || tasya madhyasya yanmadhyaṃ tadgṛhaṃ mama sundari || tejomaṇḍalamadhyasthaṃ mama sthānaṃ maheśvari || 18 || cakṣurmaṃḍalamadhye tu yathā devi kanīnikā || pūrvapaścimato devi gomukhādā''śvamedhikam|| 19 || dakṣiṇottarato devi samudrātkauraveśvarīm || etasminnaṃtare kṣetre kṣetrajño'haṃ varānane || 7.1.13.20 || yasmādarkasya tejobhirbhāsitaṃ mama tadgṛham || tasmātprabhāsanāmeti kalpe'sminprathitaṃ priye || 21 || tatra paśyati yaḥ sūryamarkkarūpaṃ narottamaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sūryaloke mahīyate || 22 || sa snātaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu tena ceṣṭaṃ mahāmakhaiḥ || sarvadānāni dattāni pūrvajāstena toṣitāḥ || 23 || arkarūpī yataḥ sūryastatra jāto mahītale || tasmāttyājyaḥ sadā cārko bhojane'tra na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || yo dṛṣṭvārkasthalaṃ marttyaścārkapatreṣu bhuṃjati || gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaṃ tena kṛtaṃ bhavati bhāmini || 25 || bhakṣito bhāskarastena sa kuṣṭhī jāyate naraḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena cārkapatrāṇi varjayet || 26 || yātrāyāṃ prathamaṃ devi dṛṣṭo yenārkabhāskaraḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahiṣīṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya vipaścite || || 27 || tāmravarṇaṃ raktavastraṃ tatastuṣyati bhāskaraḥ || tasya caiva tu sāṃnidhye vahnikoṇe vyavasthitam || 28 || nātidūre mahābhāge siddheśvaramiti smṛtam || sarvasiddhipradaṃ devi liṃgaṃ trailokyapūjitam || 29 || jaigīṣavyeśvaraṃnāma pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge'bhavat || kalau siddheśvaramiti prasiddhimagamatpriye || 7.1.13.30 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā manujo devi sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt || tatraiva devadeveśi nātidūre vyavasthitam ||31|| sūryadakṣiṇanairṛtye pātālavivaraṃ priye || maṃdehā rākṣasā yatra tathā śālakaṭaṃkaṭāḥ || 32 || sūryasya tejasā dagdhāḥ pātālamagamanpurā || kalau taddvāramevāsti na pātāle gatiḥ priye || 33 || yoginyastatra rakṣaṃti brāhmyādyā mātarastathā || māghekṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ rātrau mātṛgaṇānyajet || balipuṣpopahāraiśca tataḥ siddhirbhaviṣyati || 34 || iti hi sakaladharmabhāvahetorharakamalāsanaviṣṇusaṃstutasya|| tanuparilikhanaṃ niśamya bhānorvrajati divākaralokamāyuṣoṃ'te||35|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsapavitranāmakaraṇārkasthalotpattivarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 13 || || ||
<7.1.14>
|| devyuvāca || || yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ sūryadaivatam|| tanme vistarato brūhi devadeva jagatpate || 1 || kathamarkasthalo bhūtaḥ prabhāsakṣetrabhūṣaṇaḥ || pūjanīyo mahādevaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 2 || ke maṃtrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ tu keṣu parvasu pūjayet|| jaigīṣavyeśvaro bhūtvā hyabhūtsiddheśvaraḥ katham || tanme kathaya deveśa vistarātsarvameva hi || 3 || pātāle vivaraṃ tatra yoginyastatra kiṃ purā || tathā mātṛgaṇaścaiva kathametadabhūtpurā || 4 || etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa dayāṃ kṛtvā jagatpate || mamācakṣva virūpākṣa yadyahaṃ te priyā hara || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi kathayāmi samāsataḥ || siddheśvaro hyabhūdyena jaigīṣavyeśvaro haraḥ || 6 || pūjāvidhānaṃ vistīrya tanme nigadataḥ śṛṇu || āsīdasminkṛte devi sarva jñānaviśāradaḥ || 7 || putraḥ śatakalākasya jaigīṣavya iti śrutaḥ || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya sa cakre duścaraṃ tapaḥ || 8 || atiṣṭhadvāyubhakṣaśca varṣāṇāṃ śatakaṃ kila || ambubhakṣaḥ sahasraṃ tu śākāhāro'yutaṃ tathā || 9 || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraṃ ca kṛtaṃ sāṃtapanaṃ punaḥ || śoṣayitvā mitāhāro digvāsāḥ samapadyata || 7.1.14.10 || pūrve kalpe svayaṃ bhūtaṃ mahodayamiti śrutam || sa liṃgaṃ devadevasya pratiṣṭhāpyārcayannapi || 11 || bhasmaśāyī bhasmadigdho nṛtta gītairatoṣayat || japena vṛṣanādaiśca tapasā bhāvitaḥ śuciḥ || 12 || tamevaṃ toṣayāṇaṃ tu bhaktyā paramayā yutam || bhagavāṃśca tamabhyetya idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 13 || jaigīṣavya mahābuddhe paśya māṃ divyacakṣuṣā || tuṣṭo'smi varadaścāhaṃ brūhi yatte manogatam || 14 || sa evamukto devena devaṃ dṛṣṭvā trilocanam|| praṇamya śirasā pādāvidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 15 || || jaigīṣavya uvāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa mama tuṣṭo yadi prabho || jñānayogaṃ hi me dehi yaḥ saṃsāranikṛntanam|| 16 || bhagavannānyadicchāmi yogātparataraṃ hitam || tvayi bhaktiśca nityaṃ me devyāṃ skande gaṇeśvare || || 17 || na ca vyādhibhayaṃ bhūyānna ca tejo'pamānatā || anutsekaṃ tathā kṣāṃtiṃ damaṃ śamamathāpi ca || 18 || etānvarānmahādeva tvadicchāmi trilocana || 19 || || īśvara uvāca || || ajaraścāmaraścaiva sarvaśokavivarjitaḥ || mahāyogī mahāvīryo yogaiśvaryasamanvitaḥ||7.1.14.20|| prabhāvāccāsya kṣetrasya guhyasya mama śāśvatam || yogāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ prāpsyase paramaṃ mahat || 21 || bhaviṣyasi muniśreṣṭha yogācāryaḥ suviśrutaḥ || 22 || yaścedaṃ tvatkṛtaṃ ligaṃ niyamenārcayiṣyati || sarvapāpavinirmukto yogaṃ divyamavāpsyati || 23 || jaigīṣavyaguhāṃ cemāṃ prāpya yogaṃ karoti yaḥ || sa saptarātrādyuktātmā saṃsāraṃ saṃtariṣyati || 24 || māsena pūrvajātiṃ ca janmātītaṃ ca vetsyati || ekarātrāttanuṃ śuddhāṃ dvābhyāṃ tārayate pitṝn|| trirātreṇa vyatītena tvaparānsapta tārayet || 25 || punaśca tava viprarṣe ajeyatvaṃ ca yogibhiḥ || icchato darśanaṃ caiva bhaviṣyati ca te mama || 26 || iti devo varāndattvā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || etatkṛtayuge vṛttaṃ tava devi prabhāṣitam || 27 || tretāyuge mahādevi dvāpare'pi tathaiva ca || kaliyugapraveśe tu vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ || 28 || asminprābhāsike kṣetre sūryasthalasamīpataḥ || ārādhayaṃto deveśaṃ guhāmadhyanivāsinam || 29 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣayaścorddharetasaḥ || varṣāyutaṃ tapastaptvā siddhiṃ jagmustadātmikām||7.1.14.30|| tataḥ siddheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kalau khyātaṃ varānane || yadā somena saṃyuktā kṛṣṇā śivacaturdaśī || tadaiva tasya devasya darśanaṃ devi durllabham || 31 || brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyamupajāyate || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate devi siddhaliṃgasya pūjanāt || 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<7.1.15>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyāgneye tu deveśi aruṇena pratiṣṭhitam|| dhanuṣāṃ ca traye tatra siddhaliṃgasamīpataḥ ||1|| sūryasārathinā tatra liṃgaṃ devipratiṣṭhitam|| kalau pāpaharaṃnāma darśanātpāpanāśanam || 2 || caitramāsa trayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ varavarṇini || pūjayedvidhivadbhaktyā pauṃḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāpanāśanotpattivarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<7.1.16>
|| īśvara uvāca || || pātālavivarasyāpi māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam || pūrvapṛṣṭaṃ mahādevi brahmaṇā viśvakarmaṇā || 1 || tamobhāve samutpanne jātāstatraiva rākṣasāḥ || sūryasya dveṣiṇaḥ sarve hyasaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ || || 2 || te tu dṛṣṭvā mahātmānaṃ samudyaṃtaṃ divākaram || te dhūmrapramukhāḥ sarve jahasuḥ sūryamaṃjasā || 3 || asmākamaṃtakaḥ ko'yaṃ vidyate pāpakarmakṛt|| ityūcurvividhā vācaḥ sūryasyāgre sthitāstadā||4|| iti śrutvā tadā devaḥ krodhasphuritādharaḥ|| rākṣasānāṃ vacaścaiva bhakṣyamāṇo divākaraḥ|| 5|| tataḥ krodhābhibhūtena cakṣuṣā cāvalokayat|| sa krūrarakṣaḥkṣayakṛttimiradvipakesarī|| 6|| mahāṃśumānkhagaḥ sūryastadvināśamaciṃtayat|| ajānannaṃtataśchidraṃ rākṣasānāṃ divaspatiḥ|| 7 || sa dharmavicyutāndṛṣṭvā pāpopahatacetasaḥ|| evaṃ saṃciṃtya bhagavāndadhyau dhyānaṃ prabhākaraḥ||8| ajānaṃstejasā grastaṃ trailokyaṃ rajanīcaraiḥ || tataste bhānunā dṛṣṭāḥ krodhādhmātena cakṣuṣā || 9 || nipeturaṃbarabhraṣṭāḥ kṣīṇapuṇyā iva grahāḥ || rākṣasairveṣṭito dhūmro nipatañchuśubheṃ'barāt || 7.1.16.10 || arddhapakvaṃ yathā tālaphalaṃ kapibhirāvṛtam || yadṛcchayā nipetuste yaṃtramuktā yathopalāḥ || 11 || tato vāyu vaśādbhraṣṭā bhittvā bhūmiṃ rasātalam|| jagmuste kṣetramāsādya prabhāsaṃ varavarṇini || 12|| yatra cārkasthalo devaḥ sarvasiddhipradāyakaḥ || tatsānnidhyasthitaṃ devi pātālavivaraṃ mahat || 13 || anyāni koṭiśaḥ saṃti tāni luptāni bhāmini || kṛtasmarātsamārabhya yāvadarkasthalo raviḥ || 14 || devamāturvaraṃ prāpya siddhayo'ṣṭau vyavasthitāḥ || etasminnaṃtare devi sūryakṣetramudāhṛtam || 15 || sūryasya tejaso devi madhyabhāgaṃ hi tatsmṛtam || sarvaṃ hemamayaṃ devi nāpuṇyastatra vīkṣate || 16 || vivarāṇāṃ śataṃ caikaṃ sparśāścaiva tu koṭiśaḥ || tatra saṃti mahādevi siddheśastu prarakṣati || 17 || idaṃ kṣetraṃ mahādevi priyaṃ sūryasya sarvadā || sūryaparvaṇisaṃprāpte kurukṣetrādhikaṃ priye || 18 || brāhmī caiva hiraṇyā ca saṃgamaśca mahodadheḥ || etattrisaṃgamaṃ devi koṭitīrtha phalapradam || 19 || devamātā ca tatraiva maṃkīśastatra tiṣṭhati || nāgasthānaṃ nagasthānaṃ tatraiva samudāhṛtam |1 7.1.16.20 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamarkasthalamahodayam || rākṣasānāṃ ca saṃpātādabhūcca vivaraṃ yathā || 21 || anyāni tatra deveśi luptāni vivarāṇi vai || evaṃ tu prakaṭaṃ tatra dṛśyate'dyāpi bhāmini || 22 || śrīmukhaṃ nāma taddvāraṃ rakṣyate mātṛbhiḥ priye || varṣamekaṃ caturddaśyāṃ niyamādyastu pūjayet || 23 || tatra mātṛgaṇāndevi sunaṃdādyānvidhānataḥ|| paśupuṣpopahāraiśca dhūpadīpaistathottamaiḥ || viprāṇāṃ bhojanairdevi tasya siddhirbhaviṣyati || 24 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatrārkasthalasaṃnidhau || pūjayenmātaraḥ sarvā yadīcchetsiddhimātmanaḥ || 25 || etāstu mātaro devi sunaṃdāgaṇanāmataḥ || khyātiṃ yāṃti prabhāse tu kṣetresminvaravarṇini || 26 || etatsaṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ pātālottaramadhyataḥ || tacchrutvā mucyate devi sarvāpadbhyo narottamaḥ || 27 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye arkasthalamāhātmye pātālavivarasunaṃdādimātṛgaṇotpattivarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || ||16 || || ||
<7.1.17>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha pūjāvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi yaśasvini || arkasthalasya devasya yathā pūjyo narottamaiḥ ||1|| sarveṣāmeva devānāmādirāditya ucyate || ādikarttā tvasau yasmādādityastena cocyate||2|| nādityena vinā rātrirna divā na ca tarpaṇam|| na dharmo vai na cādharmo na saṃtiṣṭheccarācaram || 3 || ādityaḥ pālayetsarvamādityaḥ sṛjate sadā || ādityaḥ saṃharetsarvaṃ tasmādeṣa trayīmayaḥ ||4|| ārādhanavidhiṃ tasya bhāskarasya mahātmanaḥ || kathayāmi mahādevi vedoktairmaṃtravistaraiḥ || taṃ śṛṇuṣva varārohe sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 5 || mūrttisthaḥ pūjyate yena vidhānena maheśvari || dvādaśātmā yathā sūryastatte vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || 6 || mukhaśuddhiṃ ca kṛtvā''dau snānaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥ || vastraśuddhiṃ deha śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sūryaṃ spṛśettataḥ || 7 || dantakāṣṭhavidhānaṃ tu prathamaṃ kathayāmi te || madhūke putralābhaḥ syādarke netrasukhaṃ priye || 9 || vaktṛtvaṃ vai badaryā ca bṛhatyā drurjjanāñjayet || aiśvaryaṃ ca bhavedbilve khadire ca na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || rogakṣayaḥ kadambe tu arthalābho'timuktake || marutāṃ yāti sarvatra āṭarūṣakasaṃbhavaiḥ || 7.1.17.10 || jātipradhānatāṃ jātāvaśvattho yacchate yaśaḥ || śriyaṃ prāpnoti nikhilāṃ śirīṣasya niṣevaṇāt || 11 || priyaṃguṃ sevamānasya saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ bhavet || abhīpsitārthasiddhiḥ syānnityaṃ plakṣaniṣevaṇāt ||12|| na pāṭitaṃ samaśnīyāddaṃtakāṣṭhaṃ na savraṇam || na corddhaśuṣkaṃ vakraṃ vā naiva ca tvagvivarjjitam || 13 ||| vitastimātramaśnīyāddīrghaṃ hrasvaṃ ca varjayet || udaṅmukho vā prāṅmukhaḥ sukhāsīno'tha vāgyataḥ || || 14 || kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā samabhimantrya ca || maṃtreṇānena matimānaśnīyāddantadhāvanam || 15 || varaṃ dattvā'bhijānāsi kāmaṃ caiva vanaspate || siddhiṃ prayaccha me nityaṃ dantakāṣṭha namo'stu te || 16 || trīnvārānparijapyaivaṃ bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam || paścātprakṣālya tatkāṣṭhaṃ śucau deśe vinikṣipet || 17 || daṃtakāṣṭhena deveśi na jihvāṃ parimārjayet || pṛthakpṛthaktadā kāryaṃ yadīcchedvipulaṃ yaśaḥ || 18 || aṃgulyā daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ ca pratyakṣaṃ lavaṇaṃ ca yat || mṛttikābhakṣaṇaṃ caiva tulyaṃ gomāṃsabhakṣaṇaiḥ || 19 || mukhe paryuṣite nityaṃ bhavatyaprayato dvijaḥ || tasmācchuṣkamathārdraṃ vā bhakṣayeddaṃtadhāvanam || 7.1.17.20 || varjite divase caiva gaḍūṣāṃścaiva ṣoḍaśa || tattatpadmasugandhairvā mukhaśuddhiṃ ca kārayet || 21 || mukhaśuddhimakṛtvā yo bhāskaraṃ spṛśati dvijaḥ || trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi sa kuṣṭhī jāyate naraḥ || 22 || evaṃ vastrādi saṃśodhya tataḥ snānaṃ samācaret || śucau manorame sthāne saṃgṛhyāstreṇa mṛttikām|| 23 || sānusvārokārayuto hakāraḥ phaṭsamanvitaḥ || anenāstreṇa saṃgṛhya snānaṃ tatra samācaret || 24 || bhāgatrayaṃ tu saṃśuddhaṃ tṛṇapāṣāṇavarjitam || ekamastreṇa cālabhya tathānyaṃ bhāskareṇa tu || 25 || aṃgaiścaiva tṛtīyaṃ tu abhimaṃtrya sakṛtsakṛt || japtvāstreṇa kṣipeddikṣu nirvighnaṃ tu jalaṃ bhavet || 26 || sūryatīrtha dvitīyena tṛtīyena sakṛtsakṛt || guṃṭhayitvā tataḥ snāyādravitīrthena mānavaḥ || 27 || tūryaśaṃkha ninādena dhyātvā devaṃ divākaram || snātvā rājopacāreṇa punarācamya yatnataḥ || 28 || snānaṃ kṛtvā tato devi maṃtrarājena saṃyutam || harephau biṃdu lakṣmīśca tathā'nyo dīrghayā saha || 29 || mātrayā rephasaṃyukto hakāro biṃdunā saha || sakāraḥ savisargastu maṃtrarājo'yamucyate || 7.1.17.30 || tatastu tarppayenmaṃtrānsarvāṃstāṃstu karāgrajaiḥ || tulanādūrdhvato devānsavyena ca munīṃstathā || pitṝṃścaivāpasavyena hṛdbījena pratarpayet || 31 || yadgītaṃ pravaraṃ loke akṣarāṇāṃ manīṣibhiḥ || ekonaviṃśaṃ mātrāyā akṣaraṃ tatprakīrttitam || 32 || evaṃ snātvā vidhānena saṃdhyāṃ vaṃdedvidhānataḥ || tato vidvānkṣipetpaścādbhāskarāyodakāṃjalim || 33 || japecca tryakṣaraṃ maṃtra ṣaṇmukhaṃ ca yadṛcchayā || maṃtrarājeti yaḥ pūrvaṃ tavākhyāto mayā priye || 34 || paścāttīrthena maṃtrāstu saṃhṛtya hṛdaye nyaset || maṃtrairātmānamekatra kṛtvā cārghaṃ pradāpayet || 35 || raktacaṃdanagaṃdhaistu śuciḥsnāto mahītale || kṛtvā maṃḍalakaṃ vṛttamekacitto vyavasthitaḥ || 36 || gṛhītvā karavīrāṇi tāmre saṃsthāpya bhājane || tilataṃdulasaṃyuktaṃ kuśagandhodakena tu ||37|| raktacaṃdana dhūpena yuktama(?)rghyopasādhitam || kṛtvā śirasi tatpātraṃ jānubhyāmavaniṃ gataḥ|| 38 || mūlamaṃtreṇa saṃyuktamarghyaṃ dadyācca bhānave || mucyate sarvapāpaistu yo hyevaṃ vinivedayet || 39 || yadyugādisahasreṇa vyatīpātaśatena ca || ayanānāṃ sahasreṇa yatphalaṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti sūryāyārghya nivedane || 7.1.17.40 || dīkṣāmaṃtravihīno'pi bhaktyā saṃvatsareṇa tu || phalamargheṇa vai devi labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 41 || yaḥ punardīkṣito vidvānvidhinārghyaṃ nivedayet || nāsau saṃbhavate bhūmau pralayaṃ yāti bhāskare || 42 || iha janmani saubhāgyamāyurārogyasaṃpadam || acirāllabhate devi sabhāryaḥ sukhabhājanam || 43 || evaṃ snānavidhiḥ proktaḥ sauraḥ saṃkṣepatastava || hitāya mānavendrāṇāṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 44 || athavā vedamārgeṇa kuryātsnānaṃ dvijottamaḥ || yadyevaṃ mantravistāre hyaśakto dīkṣayā vinā || 45 || || īśvara uvāca || || atha pūjāvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi yaśasvini || vedamārgeṇa divyena brāhmaṇānāṃ hitāya vai || 46 || evaṃ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāraḥ puṣpādipraguṇīkṛtaḥ || tata āvāhayedbhānuṃ sthāpayetkarṇikopari || 47 || upasthānaṃ tu vai kṛtvā maṃtreṇānena suvrate || udutyaṃ jātavedasamiti maṃtraḥ saṃparikīrtitaḥ || 48 || agniṃ dūteti maṃtreṇa anenāvāhya bhāmini || ākṛṣṇena rajasā maṃtreṇānena vā'rcayet || 49 || haṃsaḥ śuciṣaditi maṃtreṇānena pūjayet || apatyeteti mantreṇa sūryaṃ devi prapūjayet || 7.1.17.50 || adṛśramasya caitena sūryaṃ devi samarccayet || taraṇirviśvadarśeti anena satataṃ japam || 51 || citraṃ devānāmudeti bhadrāṃ devo sadārcayet || vibhūtimarccayennityaṃ yenā pāvaka cakṣasā || 52 || vidyāmepirajaspṛthvityanena vimalāṃ sadā || amoghāṃ pūjayennityaṃ maṃtreṇānena suvrate|| 53 || sapta tvā harito'nena siddhidāṃ sarvakarmasu || vidyutāmarcayeddevaṃ sapta tvā haritena ca || 54 || navamīṃ pūjayeddevīṃ satataṃ sarvatomukhīm || mantreṇānena vai devi udvayantamitīha vai || 55 || udyannadya mitramahaḥ prathamamakṣaraṃ japet || dvitīyaṃ pūjayeddevi śukeṣu me harimeti vai || 56 || udagādayamādityo hyanenāpi tṛtīyakam || tatsaviturvareṇyeti caturthaṃ parikīrtitam || 57 || mahāhivo mahāyeti pañcamaṃ parikīrtitam || hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartata ṣaṣṭhaṃ bījaṃ prakīrtitam || 58 || savitā paścātātsavitā saptamaṃ varavarṇini || evaṃ bījāni vinyasya ādityaṃ sthāpayecchubhe || 59 || ādityaṃ sthāpayitvā tu paścādaṅgāni vinyaset || 7.1.17.60 || āgneyyāṃ hṛdayaṃ nyasya aiśānyāṃ tu śiro nyaset || nairṛtyāṃ tu śikhāṃ caiva kavacaṃ vāyugocare || 61 || astraṃ diśāsu vinyasya svabījena tu karṇikām || amosi prāṇiteneti anena hṛdayaṃ yajet || 62 || śirastu pūjayeddevi āyuṣyaṃ varcaseti vai || gāyatryā tu śikhāṃ pūjya nairṛtyāṃ tu vyavasthitām || 63 || jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratyekaṃ kavacaṃ yajet || dhanvannāgā dhanvaneti anenāstraṃ sadā'rcayet || 64 || netraṃ tu pūjayeddevi aśvinā tejaseti ca || hyataḥ pūrvataḥ somaṃ dakṣiṇena budhaṃ tathā || 65 || paścimena guruṃ nyasya uttareṇa ca bhārgavam || āgneyyāṃ maṅgalaṃ nyasya nairṛtyāṃ tu śanaiścaram || 66 || vāyavyāṃ tu nyasedrāhuṃ ketumīśānagocare || āpyāyasveti mantreṇa devi somaṃ sadārcayet || 67 || udbudhyadhvaṃ mahādevi budhaṃ tatra sadārcayet || bṛhaspateti mantreṇa pūjayetsatataṃ gurum || 68 || śukraḥ śuśukvāniti ca bhārgavaṃ devi pūjayet || agnirmūrddheti mantreṇa sadā maṃgalamarcayet || 69 || śamagniritimantreṇa pūjayedbhāskarātmajam || kayānaścitretimantreṇa devi rāhuṃ sadā'rcayet || 7.1.17.70 || ketuṃ kṛṇveti ketuṃ vai satataṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ || bāhyataḥ pūrvataḥ śukraṃ dakṣiṇena yamaṃ tathā || 71 || aiśānyāmīśvaraṃ viṃdyādāgneyyāmagnirucyate || naiṛteti virūpākṣaṃ pavanaṃ vāyugocare || 72 || tamuṣṭavāma iti vai hyanenendramathārcayet || udīratāmavareti sadā vaivasvataṃ yajet || 73 || tattvāyāmīti mantreṇa varuṇaṃ devi pūjayet || indrāsomāvata iti mantreṇa dhanadaṃ yajet || 74 || pāvakaṃ pūjayeddevi agnimīle purohitam || rakṣohaṇaṃ vājineti virūpākṣaṃ sadārcayet || 75 || vāyavāyāhi mantreṇa vāyuṃ devi sadārcayet || yathākramamimāndevi sarvānvai pūjayedbudhaḥ || 76 || bāhyataḥ pūrvato devi indrādīnāṃ samantataḥ || raktavarṇaṃ mahātejaṃ sitapadmopari sthitam || 77 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitam || dvibhujaṃ caikavaktraṃ ca saumyapañcakadhṛkkaram || 78 || varttulaṃ tejabiṃbaṃ tu madhyasthaṃ raktavāsasam || ādityasya tvidaṃ rūpaṃ sarvalokeṣu pūjitam || dhyātvā saṃpūjayennityaṃ sthaṃḍilaṃ maṇḍalāśrayam || 79 || || devyuvāca || || maṇḍalasthaḥ suraśreṣṭha vidhinā yena bhāskaraḥ || pūjyate mānavairbhaktyā sa vidhiḥ kathitastvayā || 7.1.17.80 || pūjayedvidhinā yena bhāskaraṃ padmasaṃbhavam || mūrttisthaṃ sarvagaṃ devaṃ tanme kathaya śaṃkara || 81 || || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahādevi sādhu pṛṣṭo'smi suvate || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā devi mūrtithaṃ yena pūjayet || 82 || iṣetveti ca mantreṇa uttamāṃgaṃ sadārcayet || agnimīleti mantreṇa pūjayeddakṣiṇaṃ karam || 83 || agna āyāhi mantreṇa pādau devasya pūjayet || ājighreti ca mantreṇa pūjayetpuṣpamālayā || 84 || yogeyogeti mantreṇa muktapuṣpāṃjaliṃ kṣipet || samudrāgaccha yatproktamanena snāpayedravim || 85 || imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhāmini || samudrajyeti mantreṇa kṣālayedvidhivadravim || 86 || sinīvālīti mantreṇa snāpayecchaṃkhavāriṇā || yajñaṃ yajñeti mantreṇa kaṣāyaiḥ parirakṣayet || 87 || snāpayetpayasā devi āpyāyasveti maṃtrataḥ || dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhnā snāpayedvidhivadravim || 88 || imaṃ me gaṃgeti yatproktamanenāpi ca bhāmini || samudrajyeti maṃtreṇa snānamauṣadhibhiḥ smṛtam || 89 || udvartayettato bhānuṃ dvipadābhirvarānane || mānastoketi maṃtreṇa yugapatsnānamācaret || 7.1.17.90 || viṣṇorarāṭamantreṇa snāpayedgaṃdhavāriṇā || sauvarṇena tu maṃtreṇa arghyaṃ pādyaṃ nivedayet || 91 || idaṃ viṣṇurvicakrame maṃtreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet || vedosīti ca maṃtreṇa upavītaṃ pradāpayet || 92 || bṛhaspateti maṃtreṇa dadyādvastrāṇi bhānave || yena śriyaṃ prakurvāṇaḥ puṣpamālāṃ prapūjayet || 93 || dhūrasīti ca maṃtreṇa dhūpaṃ dadyātsaguggalam || samiddhoṃjanamaṃtreṇa aṃjanaṃ tu pradāpayet || 94 || yuṃjāna iti maṃtreṇa bhānuṃ rocanamālabhet || ārārttikaṃ ca vai kuryāddīrghāyutvāya vai punaḥ || 95 || sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sūryaṃ śirasi pūjayet || śaṃbhavāyeti maṃtreṇa ravernetre parāmṛśet || 96 || viśvataścakṣurityevaṃ bhānordehaṃ samālabhet || śrīśca te lakṣmīśceti sarvāṃge pūjayedravim || 97 || || īśvara uvāca | || atha merormahādevi aṣṭaśṛṃgasya suvrate || pūjāvidhānamaṃtrāṃste kathayāmi samāsataḥ ||98|| aṣṭaśṛṃgaṃ mahādevi anena vidhinā'rcayet || prathamaṃ pūjayenmadhye maṃtreṇānena suvrate || 99 || mahāhivomahāyeti nānāpuṣpakadaṃbakaiḥ || trātāramiṃdramaṃtreṇa pūrvaśṛṃgaṃ sadārcayet || 7.1.17.100 || tamuṣṭavāmeti maṃtreṇa pūjayetsurasundari || agnimīle purohitamāgneyaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet || 101 || āgneyyā caiva gāyatryā athavānena pūjayet || yamāya tvā makhāya tvā dakṣiṇaṃ śṛṃgamarca yet ||102|| udīratāmavarepyathavānena pūjayet || āyaṃ gauriti maṃtreṇa nairṛtyaṃ śṛṅgamarcayet||103|| rakṣohaṇaṃ vājinaṃ vā pūjayedasurāṃtikam|| iṃdrāsomā ca yo maṃtro hyathavā tena pūjayet || 104 || abhi tvā sūra nonviti caiśānaṃ śṛṃgamarcayet || yenedaṃ bhūtamiti vā athavānena pūjayet || 105 || namostu sarpebhya iti merupīṭhaṃ sadā'rcayet || hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavarttateti punarmadhye sadārcayet || 106 || savitā paścātāditi vai pūjayetpuṣpa mālayā || trikālamarcayeddevi pradadyādarghyamādarāt ||107|| mātā rudrāṇāṃ duhitā vasūnāṃ pūrvāhne caiva pūjayet || madhyāhne pūjayeddevi tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 108 || ham̐saḥ śuciṣaditi vā aparāhṇe sadārcayet || evaṃ bhānuṃ grahaiḥ sārddha pūjayedvaravarṇini || 109 || || devyuvāca || || yāni puṣpāṇi ceṣṭāni sadā bhāskarapūjane || kāni coktāni deveśa kathayasva prasādataḥ || 7.1.17.110 || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi puṣpā dhyāyamanuttamam || yena cārkasthale devi śīghraṃ tuṣyati pūjitaḥ || 111 || mālatīkusumaiḥ pūjā bhavetsāṃnidhyakārikā || mallikāyāśca kusumairbhogavāñjāyate naraḥ || 112 || saubhāgyaṃ puṃḍarīkaistu bhavatyarthaśca śāśvataḥ || kadaṃbapuṣpairdeveśi paramaiśvaryamaśnute || 113 || bhavatyakṣayamannaṃ ca bakulai rarcane raveḥ || madārapuṣpakaiḥ pūjā sarvakuṣṭhavināśinī || 114 || bilvasya patrakusumaimahatīṃ śriyamaśnute || arkasrajā bhavatyarthaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || || 115 || pradadyādrūpiṇīṃ kanyāṃ pūjito bakulasrajā || kiṃśukairarcito devi na pīḍayati bhāskaraḥ ||116|| agastikusumaistadvadānukūlyaṃ prayaccha ti || karavīraistu deveśi sūryasyānucaro bhavet || 117 || śatapatrasrajā devi sūryasālokyatāṃ vrajet || bakapuṣpairmahādevi dāridyaṃ naiva jāyate ||119|| ṛtukusumena gandhena samabhyarcya divākaram || catuḥsamudramaryādāṃ sa bhuṃkte pṛthivīmimām || 119 || yaḥ sūryāyatanaṃ bhaktyā gairikeṇopalepayet || prāpnuyānmahatīṃ lakṣmīṃ rogaiścāpi pramucyate || 7.1.17.120 || aṣṭādaśeha kuṣṭhāni ye cānye vyādhayo nṛṇām || pralayaṃ yāṃti te sarve mṛdā yadyupalepayet || || 121 || vilepanānāṃ sarveṣāṃ kuṃkumaṃ raktacaṃdanam || puṣpāṇāṃ karavīrāṇi praśastāni varānane ||122|| nātaḥ parataraṃ kiṃcidbhāsvatastuṣṭikārakam || yādṛśaṃ kuṅkumaṃ jātī śatapatraṃ tathā'guruḥ ||123|| kiṃ tasya na bhavelloke yaścaibhiścārcayedravim || upalipyālayaṃ yastu kuryānmaṃḍalakaṃ śubham ||124|| ekenāsya bhavedartho dvābhyāmārogyamaśnute || tribhistu sarvavidyāvāṃścaturbhirbhogavānbhavet ||125|| paṃcabhirvipulaṃ dhānyaṃ ṣaḍbhirāyurbalaṃ yaśaḥ|| saptamaṇḍalatārī syānmaṃḍalādhipatirnaraḥ || 126 || ghṛtadīpapradānena cakṣuṣmāñjāyate naraḥ || kaṭutailasya dīpena svaṃ śatruṃ jayate naraḥ || 127 || tailadīpapradānena sūryaloke mahīyate || madhūkatailadīpena saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labhet || 128. || puṣpāṇāṃ pravarā jātī dhūpānāṃ vijayaḥ paraḥ || gandhānāṃ kuṃkumaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ lepānāṃ raktacaṃdanam || 129 || dīpadāne ghṛtaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ naivedye modakaḥ param || etaistuṣyati deveśaḥ sāṃnidhyaṃ cādhigacchati || 7.1.17.130 || evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhi vatkṛtvā pitṛpradakṣiṇām || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ tatra cārkasthalaṃ priye|| 131 || sukhāsīnastataḥ paśyedraverabhimukhe sthitaḥ || ekaṃ siddhārthakaṃ kṛtvā haste pānīyasaṃyutam || 132 || kāmaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvārkasthalasannidhau || pibetsatoyaṃ taddevi hyaspṛṣṭaṃ daśanaiḥ sakṛt || 133 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi koṭiyātrāphalaṃ labhet || brahmā viṣṇurmahādevo jvalano dhanadastathā || 134 || bhānumāśritya sarve te modante divi suvrate || tasmādbhānusamaṃ devaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi kañcana || 135 || iti kṛtvā mahādevi punarbhānau pradakṣiṇam || kuryānmantreṇa deveśi saptakṛtvo varānane || 136 || tamuṣṭavāma iti ṛkprathamā parikīrtitā || etonvindraṃ stavāmeti dvitīyā parikīrtitā || 137 || iṃdra śuddho na āgahi tṛtīyā parikīrtitā || indraṃ śuddho hi no rayiṃ caturthī parikīrtitā || 138 || asya vāmasyeti śubhe pañcamī parikīrtitā || tribhiṣṭvaṃ deva iti vai ṣaṣṭhī ca parikīrtitā || 139 || daśa sāmāni vai yāni pravarāṇi manīṣibhiḥ || gītāni sāmagairnityaṃ saptamīṃ taistu kārayet ||7.1.17.14||| tāni te kathayāmyadya daśa sāmāni sundari|| huṃkāraḥ praṇavodgīthaḥ prastāvaśca catuṣṭayam || 141 || pañcamaṃ praharo yatra ṣaṣṭhamāraṇyakaṃ tathā || nidhanaṃ saptamaṃ sāmnāṃ saptasiddhimiti smṛtam || 142 || pañcavidhyamiti proktaṃ hrīṃkārapraṇavena tu || aṣṭamaṃ ca tathā sādhyaṃ navamaṃ vāmadevakam || 143 || jyeṣṭhaṃ tu daśamaṃ sāma vedhase priyamuttamam || eteṣāṃ devi sāmnāṃ vai jāpyaṃ kāryaṃ vidhānataḥ || 144 || jyeṣṭhasāmaparaṃ caiva dvitīyaṃ gadataḥ śṛṇu || na ca śrāvyaṃ dvitīyaṃ tu japtavyaṃ muktimicchatā ||145||| tajjāpyaṃ paramaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā || jāpyasya viniyogo'sya lakṣaṇaṃ ca nibodha me || stobhasāraṃ śvāsalīnamoṃkārādi smṛtaṃ budhaiḥ ||146|| ūrbhānuśca tathā dharmaṃ dharmaḥ satyaṃ hyṛta tathā || dharmaṃ ye dharmavaddharme dharme vai nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 147 || yadebhiśca yajecchabdairucitaṃ sāmagairdvijaiḥ || jāpyaṃ caitatparaṃ proktaṃ svayaṃ devena bhānunā || 148 || etadvai japyamānastu punarāvartate na tu || sarvarogavinirmukto mucyate brahmahatyayā || 149 || ājyadohādyadoheti jyeṣṭhasāmno'pi lakṣaṇam ||7.1.17.150|| iti saṃpūjya deveśaṃ tataḥ kuryātparāṃ stutim || ṛgbhirve paṃcabhiścaiva śṛṇuṣvaikamanāstu tāḥ ||151|| ukṣāṇaṃ pṛśnimiti vai prathamā parikīrtitā || catvāri vākparīti vai dvitīyā parikīrtitā || 152 || iṃdraṃ mitraṃ tṛtīyā tu ṛkcaiva parikīrtitā || kṛṣṇaṃ niyānaṃ hi tathā caturthī parikīrtitā || 153 || dvādaśaprathama iti paṃcamī parikīrtitā || yo ratnavāhītyanayā kirīṭaṃ yojayedraveḥ ||154|| gatehanāmityanayā avyaṃgaṃ bhāskaraṃ nyaset || anena vidhinā devi pūjayedvidhivadravim || 155 || ityeṣa te mayā khyātaḥ pratimāpūjane vidhiḥ || || 156 || anenavidhinā yastu satataṃ pūjayedravim || sa prāpnotyadhikānkāmāniha loke paratra ca || 157 || putrārthī labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam || kanyārthī labhate kanyāṃ vidyārthī vedavidbhavet || 158 || niṣkāmaḥ pūjayedyastu sa mokṣaṃ yāti vai dhruvam || asya kṣetrasya māhātmyādarkasūryaprabhāvataḥ || 159 || anyatra brāhmaṇānāṃ ca koṭinā yatphalaṃ labhet|| arkasthale tathaikena bhojitena tu tatphalam || 7.1.17.160 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ sūryaparvaṇi yatkṛtam|| tatsarvaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ sūryakoṭiprabhāvataḥ || 161 || māghamāse naro yastu saptamyāṃ ravivāsare || kṛṣṇapakṣe mahādevi jāgaraṃ śraddhayā''caret || arkasthalasamīpe tu sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 162 || gośatasya pradattasya kurukṣetre ca yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tatrārkasthaladarśanāt || 163 || arkasthalaḥ pūjanīyastatra sthāne nivāsibhiḥ || japāpuṣpairarkapuṣpai rogibhistu viśeṣataḥ || 164 || na ca patrorṇakusumairna caivonmattasaṃbhavaiḥ || na cāmrātakajaiḥ puṣpairarcanīyo divākaraḥ || 165 || āmrātakasya kusumaṃ nirmālyamiva dṛśyate || apratyagraṃ bahiryasmāttasmāttatparivarjayet || 166 || nāvijñātaṃ pradātavyaṃ na mlānaṃ na ca dūṣitam || na ca paryyuṣitaṃ mālyaṃ dātavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā || 167 || devamullocayedyastu tatkṣaṇātpuṣpalobhataḥ || puṣpāṇi ca sugandhāni bhojakenetarāṇi ca || 168 || brahmahatyāmavāpnoti bhojako lobhamohitaḥ || mahārauravamāsādya pacyate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 169 || hanta te kīrttayiṣyāmi dhūpadānavidhiṃ param || pradānāddevadevasya yena dhūpena yatphalam || 7.1.17.170 || sadārcane ca dhūpena sāmīpyaṃ kurute raviḥ || pradadyātsakalaṃ kāmaṃ yadyadicchati mānavaḥ || 171 || tathaivāgurudhūpena nidhiṃ dadyādabhīpsitam || ārogyārthī dhanārthī ca nityadā guggalaṃ dahet || 172 || piṃḍātadhūpadānena sadā tuṣyati bhānumān || ārogyaṃ ca svayaṃ dadyātsaukhyaṃ ca paramaṃ bhavet||173|| śrīvāsakasya dhūpena vāṇijyaṃ sakalaṃ labhet|| rasaṃ sarjarasaṃ caiva dahato'rthāgamo bhavet||174|| devadāruṃ ca dahato bhavatyannamathākṣayam|. vilepanaṃ kuṃkumena sarvakāmaphalapradam||175|| iha loke sukhī bhūtvā akṣayaṃ svargamāpnuyāt|| caṃdanasya pralepena śriyamāyuśca viṃdati || 176 || raktacandanalepena sarvaṃ dadyāddivākaraḥ || api rogaśatairgrastaḥ kṣemamārogyamāpnuyāt || 177 || gatigaṃdhaṃ ca saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ viṃdate naraḥ || kastūrikāmardanakairaiśvaryamatulaṃ labhet || 178 || karpūrasaṃyutairgaṃdhaiḥ kṣmādhipādhipatibhavet || catuḥsamena gaṃdhena sarvā nkāmānavāpnuyāt || 179 || etatte kathitaṃ devi sūryamāhātmyamuttamam || savistaraṃ mayā khyātaṃ kimanyatparipṛcchasi ||7.1.17.180||| || devyuvāca || || yadyevaṃ bhagavānsūryaḥ sarvatejasvināṃ varaḥ || sa kathaṃ grasyate deva saiṃhikeyena rāhuṇā || 181 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu daivi pravakṣyāmi sarva pāpapraṇāśanam || kāraṇaṃ grahaṇasyāpi bhrāṃtervicchedakārakam || 182 || rāhurādityabiṃbasyādhastāttiṣṭhati bhāmini || amṛtārthī vimānastho yāvatsaṃsravate'mṛtam || 183 || biṃbenāṃtarito devi ādityagrahaṇaṃ hi tat || na kaścidgrasituṃ śakta ādityo dahati dhruvam || 184 || brahmādayastamarcaṃti sa ādiḥ sarvanākinām |1 ādityadehajāḥ sarve tathānye devadānavāḥ ||185|| ādikarttā svayaṃ yasmādādityastena cocyate || prabhāse saṃsthito devaḥ sarvapātakanāśanaḥ || 186 || bhuktimuktiprado devo vyādhiduṣkṛtanāśakṛt || tatra siddhāḥ purā devi lokapālā maharṣayaḥ || 187 || siddhā vidyā dharā yakṣā gaṃdharvā munayastathā || dhanado'pi tathā bhīṣmo yayātirgālavastathā || 188 || sāṃbaścaiva tathā devi parāṃ siddhimito gatāḥ || idaṃ rahasyaṃ deveśi sūryamāhātmyamuttamam || 189 || na deyaṃ duṣṭabuddhīnāṃ pāpināṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || na nāstike'śraddadhāne na krūraṃ vā kathaṃcana || 7.1.17.190 || imāṃ kathāmanubrūyāttathā nā'sūyake śive | idaṃ putrāya śiṣyāya dharmiṇe nyāyavartine || 191 || kathanīyaṃ mahābrahma sūryabhaktāya suvrate || arkasthalasya devasya māhātmyamidamuttamam || 192 || yaḥ śrāddhe śrāvayeddevi brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān || tasyānaṃtaṃ bhaveddevi yaddānaṃ puruṣasya vai || 193 || yatredaṃ kīrttyate puṇyaṃ saṃpadastatra vai sadā |1 yātudhānā na hiṃsaṃti tacchrāddhaṃ bhayavihvalāḥ || 194 || paṃktipāvanatāṃ yāṃti ye'pi vai paṃktidūṣakāḥ || sutavāñjanmavāṃśca syātsarvakāmamanoramaḥ ||195 || pravāsibhirbaṃdhuvargaiḥ saṃyujyeta sadā naraḥ || naṣṭaiḥ saṃyujyate cārthairaparaiścāpi ciṃtitaiḥ || 196 || rakṣyate yāginībhiśca priyaiśca na viyujyate || upaspṛśya śucirbhūtvā śṛṇuyādbrāhmaṇaḥ sadā || sarvānkāmāṃśca labhate nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 197 || vaiśyaḥ samṛddhimatulāṃ kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ|| vaṇijaścāpi vāṇijyamakhaṃḍaṃ śatasaṃkhyayā|| labheyuḥ kīrtanādasyāḥ sūryotpattervarānane||198|| śūdrāścaivābhilaṣitānkāmānprāpsyaṃti bhāmini|| apamṛtyubhayaṃ ghoraṃ mṛtyuto'pi mahābhayam||199| naśyate nātra saṃdeho rājadvārakṛtaṃ ca yat|| sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sūryaloke mahīyate || 7.1.17.200 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sūryadaivatam || arkasthalaprasaṃgena kimanyacchrotumicchasi||| || 201 || sthānaṃ śāśvatamojasāṃ gatirapāṃ dīpo diśāmakṣayaḥ siddherdvāramapāvabhedi jagatāṃ sādhāraṇaṃ locanam|| haimaṃ puṣkaramaṃtarikṣasaraso dīptaṃ divaḥ kuṇḍalaṃ kālonmānavibhāvanākṣatalayaṃ biṃbaṃ raveḥ pātu vaḥ || 202 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'rkkasthalamāhātmyārkasthalapūjāvidhānādivarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha ||
<7.1.18>
|| sūta uvāca || || iti proktā tadā devī śaṃkareṇa yaśasvinī || punaḥ papraccha vipreṃdrāḥ kṣetramāhātmyavistaram || 1 || || devyuvāca || || adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ ca tapaḥ prabho || devatvamadaya me jātaṃ tvatprasādena śaṃkara || 2 || adyāhaṃ kṛtakalyāṇī jñānadṛṣṭiḥ kṛtātvayā || adya me bhūṣitau karṇau kṣetra māhātmyabhūṣaṇau || 3 || adya me tejasaḥ piṃḍo jāto jñānaṃ hṛdi sthitam || adya me kulaśīlaṃ ca adya me rūpalakṣaṇam || 4 || adya me bhrāṃti rucchinnā tīrthabhramaṇasaṃbhavā || prabhāse niścalaṃ jātaṃ mano me mānināṃ vara || 5 || ārādhito mayā pūrvaṃ tuṣṭo me'dya sureśvaraḥ || vahninā veṣṭitā sāhame kapādena saṃsthitā || 6 || tattapaḥ saphalaṃ tvadya jātaṃ me bhaktavatsala || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyamadya me prakaṭīkṛtam || 7 || punaḥ pṛcchāmi deveśa yāthā tathyaṃ vada prabho ||8|| adyāpi saṃśayo nātha tīrthamāhātmyasaṃbhavaḥ|| anyatkautūhalaṃ deva kathayasva maheśvara || 9 || ayaṃ yo varttate deva caṃdraste śirasi sthitaḥ || kasyāyaṃ kathamutpannaḥ kasminkāle vada prabho || 7.1.18.10 || || īśvara uvāca || || asminkāle mahādevi vārāha iti viśrute || parārddhe tu dvitī ye'sminvartamāne tu vedhasaḥ || 11 || dvitīyamāsasyādau tu pratipadyā prakīrtitā || vārāheṇoddhṛtā tasyāṃ tathā cādau dharā priye || tena vārāhakalpeti nāma jātaṃ dharātale || 12 || tasminkalpe mahādevi gate saṃdhyāṃśake priye || prathamasya manoścādau devi svāyaṃbhuvasya hi || 13 || kṣīrode mathyamāne tu daivatairdānavairapi || ratnāni jajñire tatra caturddaśamitāni vai || 14 || teṣāṃ madhye mahātejāścaṃdramāstattvasaṃbhava || so'yaṃ mayā dhṛto devi adyāpi śirasi priye || 15 || viṣe pīte mahādevi prabhāsasthasya me sadā || bhūṣaṇaṃ muktaye devairmama caṃdraḥ kṛtaḥ purā || 16 || śaśinābhūṣito yasmāttenāhaṃ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ|| tatra sthāne sthito'dyāpi svayaṃbhūrliṃgamūrttimān||17|| sarvasiddhipradātā ca kalpasthāyī sadā priye || ityetatkathitaṃ devi kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 18 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śivaśirobhūṣaṇa candrotpattivṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || dha ||
<7.1.19>
|| devyuvāca || || yadyevaṃ sakalaścaṃdraḥ kathaṃ na vidhṛtastvayā || antabhāve kalānāṃ tatkāraṇaṃ kathaya prabho || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || amā ṣoḍaśabhedena devi proktā mahākalā || saṃsthitā paramā māyā dehināṃ deha dhāriṇī || 2 || amādipaurṇamāsyaṃtā yā eva śaśinaḥ kalāḥ || tithayastāḥ samākhyātāḥ ṣoḍaśaiva prakīrtitāḥ || 3 || amā sūkṣmā parā śaktiḥ sā tvaṃ devi prakīrtitā || pralayotpattiyogena sthitāḥ kālakramoditāḥ ||4|| ṣoḍaśeva svarā ye tu ādyāḥ sṛṣṭayaṃtakāḥ priye || kālasyāvayavāste ca vijñeyāḥ kālavedibhiḥ || 5 || truṭirlavo nimeṣaśca kalā kāṣṭhā muhūrtakam|| rātryahaḥpakṣamāsāśca ayanaṃ vatsaraṃ yugam || 6 || manvataraṃ tathā kalpaṃ mahākalpaṃ ca ṣoḍaśa || kalā visarjanī yā tu jīvamāśritya vartate ||7|| sā sṛjatyakhilaṃ viśvaṃ viṣuvadvayasaṃyutam || tathā saṃvaraṇī yā tu viśvaṃ saṃharate priye || || netrapātāccaturbhāgastruṭikālo nigadyate || tasmācca dviguṇaṃ viddhi nimiṣaṃ tanmaheśvari || 9 || nimiṣaistriṃśadbhiḥ kāṣṭhā tābhirviśatibhiḥ kalā|| viṃśatikalo muhūrtaḥ syāddinaṃ paṃcadaśaistu taiḥ||7.1.19.10||| dinamānā niśā jñeyā ahorātraṃ dvayādbhavet | taiḥ paṃcadaśabhiḥ pakṣo dvipakṣo māsa ucyate ||11|| māsaiścaivāyanaṃ ṣaḍbhirvarṣaṃ syādayanadvaye || catvāriṃśacca lakṣāṇi lakṣāṇāṃ tritayaṃ punaḥ||12|| viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi jñeyaṃ sauraṃ caturyugam|| caturyugaikasaptatyā manvaṃtaramudāhṛtam||13|| aiṃdrametadbhavedāyuḥ samāsāṃtaṃ ca kīrtitam|| caturdaśendraiḥ pralīnaiḥ kalpaṃ brahmadinaṃ bhavet ||14|| rātriśca tāvatī caiva caturyugasahasrikā|| anena dinamānena śatābdaṃ jīvati priye ||15|| mamaiva nimiṣārddhena sahasrāṇi caturddaśa || vinaśyaṃti tato viṣṇorasaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ ||16|| evaṃ krameṇa deveśi samutpannamidaṃ jagat || śaśisūryavibhāgena citrarūpamanaṃtakam ||17|| kalā devi yadādyaṃtamanādimajamavyayam|| tadānvitaḥ śaśī tasyāmadhomukhamavasthitaḥ || 18 || evaṃ kṣayodayaṃ jñeyaṃ caṃdrārkābhyāmavasthitam || sṛṣṭikramaṃ mayā proktaṃ saṃhāramadhunā śṛṇu || 19 || mahākalpaṃ hataṃ kalpaiḥ kalpaṃ manvaṃtarairhatam || māsaṃ pakṣāhataṃ kṛtvā taṃ cāhorātribhājitam ||7.1.19.2||| ahorātraṃ muhūrtena muhūrtaṃ tu kalāhatam|| kalāṃ kāṣṭhā hatāṃ kṛtvā kāṣṭhāṃ nimiṣabhājitām || 21 || nimiṣaṃ ca lavairhatvā lavaṃ truṭivibhājitam || tadatītaṃ praśāṃtaṃ ca nirvikāramalakṣaṇam ||22|| tasya ceyaṃ parā māyā kalā śirasi dhāritā || sā śaktirdevadevasya viśvākārā parā priye || mohayitvā tu saṃtānaṃ saṃsārayati pārvati ||23|| evametajjagaddevi utpattisthitilakṣaṇam || yatraivotpadyate kṛtsnaṃ punastatraiva līyate || 24 || seyaṃ māyāmayī śaktiḥ śuddhāśuddhasvarūpiṇī || caṃdrarūpā sthitā sā tu tava devi prakāśayet|| 25 || || devyuvāca || || paṃcāgninopasantaptā varṣakoṭīranekadhā || tattapaḥ saphalaṃ jātaṃ me'dya deva jagatpate || 26 || sṛṣṭiyogo mayā jñātaḥ saṃhāraśca maheśvara || candrotpattisvarūpaṃ ca kalāmānaṃ tathaiva ca || 27 || adhunā mama deveśa sandeho hṛdi saṃsthitaḥ || kautūhalaṃ paraṃ deva kathayasva maheśvara || 28 || amṛtādeva saṃbhūtaḥ sarvāhlādakaraḥ śaśī || priyaśca tava deveśa vallabhaścaṃdramāstathā || 29 || caṃdre ca cadi ityeṣa hlādane dhāturiṣyate|| śuklatve cāpatattve ca mayā tveṣa vibhāvyate ||7.1.19.3||| sarvauṣadhīnāmadhipaḥ pitṝṇāṃ prīṇanaṃ param || tadāśrayaśca tvadbhaktastva tsevātatparaḥ śaśī || 31 || tathāpi sakalaṃko'yaṃ kautukaṃ kurute mama || devi brahmāṃḍasaṃghaṭṭamālāmaṃḍitaśekharaḥ || 32 || śīrṣe tava niviṣṭasya kaṣṭaṃ caṃdrasya cedyadi || tarhi nātha na śocyā vai saṃsāre duḥkhabhāginaḥ || 33 || na cāsti triṣu lokeṣu na caitatsaṃbhaviṣyati || yatra śakto bhavatkartuṃ duḥkhasyāsya ca saṃkṣayam|| 34 || sarveṣāṃ vartate śaṃkā yathā mama maheśvara || utpannaṃ kāraṇaṃ kiṃtadyena somasya lāṃchanam || 35 || kimetatkāraṇaṃ deva kathayasva maheśvara || amṛte saṃbhavo yasya kathaṃ tasyāpi lāṃchanam|| 36 || priyaśca tava deveśa lāṃchanaṃ cāpi tiṣṭhati || kautūhalaṃ paraṃ deva tattvaṃ me vaktumarhasi || 37 || evamuktaḥ sa pārvatyā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || uvāca paramaprītaḥ premṇā śailasutāṃ prabhuḥ || 38 || || īśvara uvāca || kiṃ te devi mahāśaṃkādyotpannā varavarṇini || mamopari na karttavyā nirudvignā bhava priye || pitustava prabhāvena lāṃchanaṃ śaśino'bhavat || 39 || bhāvitvātkarmaṇo devi dakṣasyājñāvyatikramāt || samaṃ varttasva bhāryābhirityuktaḥ śaśalāṃchanaḥ || 7.1.19.40 || tadvākyamanyathā cakre tataḥ śaptaḥ śaśī priye|| idaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ tu yaddevi tvayā lāṃchanakāraṇam || 41 || kalpekalpe pṛthagbhāvaṃ kāraṇairasti bhāmini || asaṃkhyātaṃ ca tadvaktuṃ śakyaṃ naiva mayā priye || 42 || asaṃkhyeyāścandramasaḥ saṃbhavaṃti punaḥpunaḥ || vinaśyaṃti ca deveśi sarvamanvantarāntaram ||43 || asaṃkhyātāśca kalpākhyā asaṃkhyātāḥ pitāmahāḥ || harayaścāpyasaṃkhyātā eka eva maheśvaraḥ || 44 || koṭikoṭyayutānyatra brahmāṇḍāni mama priye || jalabudbudavaddevi saṃjātāni tu līlayā|| 45|| tatratatra caturvaktrā brahmāṇo harayo bhavāḥ|| sṛṣṭāḥ pradhānena tadā labdhā śaṃbhostu saṃnidhiḥ||46|| layaṃ caiva tathānyonyamādyaṃtaṃ prakaroti ca|| sargasaṃhārasaṃsthānāṃ karttā devo maheśvaraḥ||47|| sarge ca rajasā pṛktaḥ sattvasthaḥ paripālane|| pratisarge tamoyuktaḥ so'haṃ devi tridhā sthitaḥ||48|| tasmānmāheśvaro brahmā brahmaṇo'dhipatiḥ śivaḥ || sadāśivo bhavedviṣṇurbrahmā sarvātmako hyataḥ || 49 || sa eva bhagavānrudro viṣṇurviśva jagatprabhuḥ || asminnaṇḍe tvimelokā antarviśvamidaṃjagat || 7.1.19.50 || candrasūryagrahā devi brahmāṇḍe'sminmanasvini || saṃkhyātuṃ naiva śakyante ye bhaviṣyaṃti ye gatāḥ || 51 || asminvārāhakalpe tu vartamāne manasvini || ṣaḍatītā mahādevi rohiṇīpatayaḥ purā || 52 || saptamo'yaṃ mahādevi vartate'mṛtasaṃbhavaḥ || dakṣaśāpena yo devi saṃkṣīṇo dṛśyate'dhunā || 53 || atha dvitīye saṃprāpte parārddhe caiva vedhasaḥ || tasya triṃśattime kalpe pitṛ kalpeti viśrute || 54 || svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare prāpte tasyādau tvaṃ satī kila || tasminkāle mahādevi yobhūddakṣaḥ pitā tava || 55 || prāṇātprajāpaterjanma tasya dakṣasya kīrtitam || asminmanvantare devi dakṣaḥ prācetaso'bhavat || 56 || aṃguṣṭhāddakṣiṇāddakṣo bhaviṣyatyadhunā priye || yugeyuge bhavantyete sarve dakṣādayo dvijāḥ || 57 || punaścaiva vinaśyanti vidvāṃstatra na muhyati || tasyāpamānāttvaṃ devi dehaṃ tatyaktha vai purā || 58 || tāvadviyukto'haṃ devi tvayā mukto'bhavaṃ purā || yāvadvarāhakalpasya cākṣuṣasyāntaraṃ priye || 59 || ekaviṃśo manuścāyaṃ kalpe vārāhasaṃjñake || kalpekalpe mahādevi bhavennāmāntaraṃ tava || 7.1.19.60 || asminkalpe tu vārāhe himavattapasārjjite || saṃbhūtā pārvatī devi cākṣuṣasyāṃtare gate || 61 || brahmaṇo dinamekaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsena tavāvadhiḥ || tvaṃ viyuktā mayā sārddhaṃ dakṣakopena bhāmini || 62 || tava krodhena ye śaptā ṛṣayo vai mayā purā || te'pi devi tvayā sārddhaṃ jātā vevasvateṃtare || 63 || bhṛguraṃgirā marīcistu pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || atriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca aṣṭau te brahmaṇaḥ sutāḥ || 64 || dakṣasya yajñe te śaptāḥ pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuventare || jātā devi punaste vai kalpesmiṃścākṣuṣe gate || 65 || devasya mahato yajñe vāruṇīṃ bibhratastanum || brahmaṇo juhvataḥ śukramagnau pūrvaṃ prajepsayā || 66 || ṛṣayo jajñire pūrvaṃ sūryabiṃbasamaprabhāḥ || pitustava samīpaṃ te varaṇāya tava priye || prasthāpitā mayā pūrvaṃ tattvaṃ jānāsi suvrate || 67 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena vacmi te praśnamuttamam || dvitīye tu parārddhe'sminvarttamāne ca vedhasaḥ || 68 || śvetakalpātsamārabhya yāvadvārāhagocaram || samatītāśca ye candrāstāñchṛṇuṣva varānane || 69 || catuḥśatāni deveśi ṣaḍviṃśatyadhikāni tu || gatāni śītaraśmīnāṃ saptaviṃśo'dhunā priye || 7.1.19.70 || vaivasvateṃ'tare prāpte yaścāyaṃ vartate'dhunā || tretāyuge tu daśame dattātreyapuraḥsaraḥ || 71 || saṃjāto rohiṇīnātho yo'dhunā varttate priye || tasyotpattiprasaṃgena viṣṇormānuṣasaṃbhavān || 72 || dehāvatārānvakṣyāmi prāraṃbhātprathamānpriye || pañcamaḥ paṃcadaśyāṃ sa tretāyāṃ tu babhūva ha || 73 || māṃdhātā cakravarttitve tasyotathyapuraḥsaraḥ || ekonaviṃśatretāyāṃ sarvakṣatrāṃtako'bhavat || 74 || jāmadagnyastathā ṣaṣṭho viśvāmitrapuraḥsaraḥ || caturviṃśe yuge rāmo vasiṣṭhena purodhasā || 75 || saptamo rāvaṇasyārthe jajñe daśarathātmajaḥ || aṣṭame dvāpare viṣṇuraṣṭāviṃśe parāśarāt || 76 || vedavyāsastato jajñe jātūkarṇyapuraḥsaraḥ || tatraiva navamo viṣṇuraditeḥ kaśyapātmajaḥ || 77 || devakyāṃ vasudevāttu brahmagargapuraḥsaraḥ || ekaviṃśatamasyāsya dvāparasyāṃśasaṃkṣaye || naṣṭe dharme tadā jajñe viṣṇurvṛṣṇikule svayam || 78 || kartuṃ dharmavyavasthānamasurāṇāṃ praṇāśanaḥ || pūrvajanmani viṣṇuḥ sa pramatirnāma vīryavān || 79 || gotreṇa vai caṃdramasaḥ saṃdhyāmiśre bhaviṣyati || kalkirviṣṇuyaśānāma pārāśaryapratāpavān || 7.1.19.80 || daśamo bhāvyasaṃbhūto yājñavalkyapuraḥsaraḥ || anukarṣaśca vai senāṃ hastyaśvarathasaṃkulām || 81 ||| pragṛhītāyudhairviprairbhṛśaṃ śatasahasraśaḥ || niḥśeṣāñchūdrarājñastāṃstadā sa tu kariṣyati || 82 || pākhaṃḍānmlecchajātīṃśca dasyūṃścaiva sahasraśaḥ || nātyarthaṃ dhārmikā ye ca brahmabrahmadviṣaḥ kvacit || 83 || pravṛttacakro balavāñcchūrāṇāmaṃtako balī || adṛśyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ pṛthivīṃ vicariṣyati || 84 ||| mānavasya tu soṃ'śena devasya bhuvi vai prabhuḥ|| kṣapayitvā tu tānsarvānbhāvinārthena noditān || gaṃgāyamunayormadhye niṣṭhāṃ prāpsyati sānugaḥ || 85 ||| tato vyatīte kalkau tu sāmātye sahasainike || nṛpeṣvapi ca naṣṭeṣu tadātvapraharāḥ prajāḥ || 86 || rakṣaṇe vinivṛtte ca hatvā cānyonyamāhave || parasparahatāstāśca nirākraṃdāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || 87 || kṣīṇe kaliyuge cāsmindaśavarṣasahasrake || sa saṃdhyāṃśe tu niḥśeṣe kṛtaṃ vai pratipatsyati || 88|| yadā caṃdraśca sūryaśca tathā tiṣyabṛhaspatī || ekarāśau sameṣyaṃti prapatsyati tadā kṛtam || 89 || abhijinnāma nakṣatraṃ jayaṃtīnāma śarvarī|| muhūrto vijayo nāma yatra jāto janārddanaḥ || 7.1.19.90 || || devyuvāca || || noktaṃ yathāvadakhilaṃ bhṛguśāpaviceṣṭitam|| pūrvāvatārānme brūhi noktapūrvānmaheśvara||91|| īśvara uvāca|| yadā tu pṛthivī vyāptā dānavairbalavattaraiḥ|| tataḥ prabhṛti śāpena bhṛgunaimittikena ha|| 92|| jajñe punaḥpunarviṣṇuḥ karttuṃ dharmavyavasthitim|| dharmānnārāyaṇaḥ sādhyaḥ saṃbhūtaścākṣuṣeṃtare||93|| yajñaṃ pravartayāmāsa sa ca vaivasvateṃ'tare || prādurbhāve tadā tasya brahmā cāsītpurohitaḥ||94|| caturthyāṃ tu yugākhyāyāmāpanneṣu sureṣviha|| saṃbhūtaḥ sa samudrāttu hiraṇyakaśiporvadhe||95|| dvitīyo narasiṃho'bhūdrudrastasya puraḥsaraḥ|| lokeṣu balisaṃstheṣu tretāyāṃ saptame yuge||96|| daityaistrailokya ākrāṃte tṛtīyo vāmanobhavat|| saṃkṣipyātmānamaṃgeṣu bṛhaspatipuraḥsaraḥ || 97 || tretāyuge tu daśame dattātreyo babhūva ha || naṣṭe dharme caturthāṃśe mārkaṃḍeyapuraḥsaraḥ || ete divyāvatārā vai mānuṣye kathitāḥ purā || 98 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīviṣṇvavatāravarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || cha ||
<7.1.20>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha daityāvatārāṇāṃ kramo hi kathyate punaḥ || hiraṇyakaśipū rājā varṣāṇāmarbudaṃ babhau || 1 || tathā śata sahasrāṇi yāni kāni dvisaptatim || aśītiṃ ca sahasrāṇi trailokyasyeśvaro'bhavat||2|| sautye'hanyatirātrasya kaśyapasyāśvamedhike ||3|| upakṣiptā sanaṃ yattu hoturarthe hiraṇmayam || niṣasāda sa garto(?)'tra hiraṇyakaśipustataḥ || 4 || śatavarṣasahasrāṇāṃ tapaścakre suduścaram || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi dityā garbhe sthitaḥ purā || 5 || hiṇayakaśipordaityaiḥ śloko gītaḥ purātanaḥ || rājā hiraṇyakaśipuryāṃ yāmāśāṃ nirīkṣate || 6 || tasyāṃ tasyāṃ diśi surā namaścakruḥ saharṣibhiḥ 1| paryāye tasya rājābhūdbalirvarṣārbudaṃ punaḥ || 7 || ṣaṣṭiṃ caiva sahasrāṇi triṃśacca niyutāni ca || bale rājyādhikārastu yāva tkālaṃ babhūva ha || 8 || prahlādo nigṛhīto'bhūttāvatkālaṃ tathā suraiḥ 1| iṃdrādayaste vikhyātā asurāñjaghnurojasā || 9 || daityasaṃsthamidaṃ sarvamā sīddaśayugaṃ kila || asapatnaṃ tataḥ sarvamaṣṭādaśayugaṃ punaḥ || 7.1.20.10 || trailokyamidamavyagraṃ maheṃdreṇa tu pālitam || tretāyuge tu daśame kārttavīryo mahābalaḥ || 11 || paṃcāśītisahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ vai narādhipaḥ || sa saptaratnavānsamrāṭ cakravartī babhūva ha || 12 || dvīpeṣu saptasu sa vai khaṅgī carmī śarāsanī || rathī rājā sānucaro yogāccaurānapaśyata || 13 || praṇaṣṭadravyatā yasya smaraṇānna bhavennṛṇām || caturyuge tvatikrāṃte manau hyekādaśe prabhau || 14 || arddhāvaśiṣṭe tasmiṃstu dvāpare saṃpravartite || mānavasya nariṣyaṃto hyāsītputro madaḥ kila ||| || 15 || navamastasya dāyādastṛṇabiṃduriti smṛtaḥ || tretāyugamukhe rājā tṛtīye saṃbabhūva ha || 16 || tasya kanyā tvilavilā rūpe ṇāpratimā'bhavat || pulastyāya sa rājarṣistāṃ kanyāṃ pratyapādayat || 17 || ṛṣirailavilo yasyāṃ viśravāḥ samapadyata || tasya patnyaśca tisrastu paulastyakulamaṃḍanāḥ || 18 || bṛhaspateḥ śubhā kanyā nāmnā vai vedavarṇinī || puṣpotkaṭā ca vīkā ca ubhe mālyavataḥ sute || 19 || kekasī mālinaḥ kanyā tasyāṃ devi śṛṇu prajāḥ || jyeṣṭhaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ tasya suṣuve varavarṇinī || 7.1.20.20 || aṣṭadaṃ(?) haricchmaśruṃ śaṃkukarṇaṃ vilohitam || śvapādaṃ hrasvabāhuṃ ca piṃgalaṃ śucibhūṣaṇam || 21 || tripādaṃ tu mahākāyaṃ sthūlaśīrṣaṃ mahāhanum || evaṃvidhaṃ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā virūpaṃ rūpatastadā || 22|| tadā dṛṣṭvābravīttaṃ tu kubero'yamiti svayam|| kutsāyāṃ kvitiśabdoyaṃ śarīraṃ veramucyate || 23 || kuberaḥ kuśarīratvānnāmnā tena ca soṃkitaḥ || tasya bhāryyā'bhavadvṛddhiḥ putrastu nalakūbaraḥ || 24 || kaikasyajanayatputraṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣasādhipam || śaṃkukarṇaṃ daśagrīvaṃ pigalaṃ raktamūrddhajam|| 25 || vasupādaṃ viṃśadbhujaṃ mahākāyaṃ mahābalam || kālāṃjananibhaṃ caiva daṃṣṭriṇaṃ raktalocanam || 26 || rākṣasenaujasā yuktaṃ rūpeṇa ca balena ca || nisargāddāruṇaḥ krūro rāvaṇādrāvaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ ||27|| hiraṇyakaśipustvāsītsa rājā pūrvajanmani || caturyugāni rājā tu tathā daśa sa rākṣasaḥ ||28|| paṃca koṭīstu varṣāṇāṃ saṃkhyatāḥ saṃkhyāyā priye || niyutānyekaṣaṣṭiṃ ca saṃkhyāvadbhirudāhṛtam || 29 || ṣaṣṭiṃ caiva sahasrāṇi varṣāṇāṃ sa hi rāvaṇaḥ || devatānāmṛṣīṇāṃ ca ghoraṃ kṛtvā prajāgaram || 7.1.20.30 || tretāyuge caturviṃśe rāvaṇastapasaḥ kṣayāt || rāmaṃ dāśarathiṃ prāpya sagaṇaḥ kṣayameyivān || 31 || yo'sau devi daśagrīvaḥ saṃbabhūvārimarddanaḥ || damaghoṣasya rājarṣeḥ putro vikhyātapauruṣaḥ ||32|| śrutaśravāyāṃ caidyastu śiśupālo babhūva ha || rāvaṇaṃ kuṃbhakarṇaṃ ca kanyāṃ śūrpaṇakhāṃ tathā ||33|| vibhīṣaṇaṃ caturthaṃ ca kaikasyajanayatsutān || manoharaḥ prahastaśca mahāpārśvaḥ kharastathā ||34|| puṣpotkaṭāyāste putrāḥ kanyā kumbhīnasī tathā || triśirā dūṣaṇaścaiva vidyujjihvaśca rākṣasaḥ|| kanyaikā śyāmikā nāma vīkāyāḥ prasavaḥ smṛtaḥ||35|| ityete krūrakarmāṇaḥ paulastyā rākṣasā nava || vibhīṣaṇo viśuddhātmā daśamaḥ parikīrtitaḥ ||36|| pulahasya mṛgāḥ putrāḥ sarve vyālāśca daṃṣṭriṇaḥ || bhūtāḥ piśācāḥ sarpāśca śūkarā hastinastathā || ||37|| anapatyaḥ kratustvasminsmṛto vaivasvateṃtare || atreḥ patnyo daśaivāsansundaryaśca pativratāḥ ||38|| bhadrāśvasya ghṛtācyaṃtā jajñire daśa cāpsarāḥ ||39|| bhadrā śūdrā ca madrā ca naladā jaladā tathā || urṇā pūrṇā ca deveśi yā ca gopucchalā smṛtā||7.1.20.40|| tathā tāmarasā nāma daśamī raktakoṭikā || etāsāṃ ca mahādevi khyāto bharttā prabhākaraḥ || 41 || svarbhānunā hate sūrye patitesmindivo mahīm || tamo'bhibhūte lokesminprabhā yena pravarttitā || 42 || svasti testviti caivoktaḥ patanniha divākaraḥ || brahmarṣervacanāttasya na papāta yataḥ prabhuḥ || 43 || tataḥ prabhākaretyuktaḥ prabhurevaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || bhadrāyāṃ janayāmām somaṃ putraṃ yaśasvinam || 44 || tviṣimāndharmaputrastu somo devo varastu saḥ || śītaraśmiḥ samutpannaḥ kṛttikāsu niśācaraḥ|| |45|| pitā somasya vai devi jajñe'trirbhagavānṛṣiḥ || tatrātriḥ sarvalokeśaṃ bhṛtvā sve nayane sthitaḥ || 46 || karmaṇā manasā vācā śubhānyeva samā carat || kāṣṭhakuḍyaśilābhūta ūrddhvabāhurmahādyutiḥ ||47|| sudustaraṃ nāma tapastena taptaṃ mahatpurā || trīṇi varṣasahasrāṇi divyāni surasuṃdari || 48 || tasyorddhvaretasastatra sthitasyānimiṣasya ha || somatvaṃ vapurāpede mahābuddhestu vai śubhe || 49 || ūrddhvamācakrame tasya somasaṃbhāvitātmanaḥ || netrābhyāṃ somaḥ susrāva daśadhā dyotayandiśaḥ || 7.1.20.50 || tadgarbhaṃ vidhinā dṛṣṭā diśodaśa dadhustadā || sametya dhārayāmāsurna ca dhartumaśaknuvan || || 51 || sa tābhyaḥ sahasaiveha digbhyo garbhaśca śāśvataḥ || papāta bhāvayam̐llokāñchītāṃśuḥ sarvabhāvanaḥ || 52 || yadā na dhāraṇe śaktāstasya garbhasya tāḥ striyaḥ || tatastābhyaḥ sa śītāṃśurnipapāta vasuṃdharām || 53 || patitaṃ somamālokya brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ|| rathamāropayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakā myayā || 54 || sa tadaiva mayā devi dharmārthaṃ satyasaṃgaraḥ || yukto vājisahasreṇa sitena surasuṃdari || 55 || tasminnipatite devi putretreḥ paramātma ni || tuṣṭuvurbrahmaṇaḥ putrā mānasāḥ sapta ye śrutāḥ || 56 || tathaivāṃgirasaḥ sarve bhṛgoścaivātmajāstathā || ṛgbhistu sāmabhiścaiva tathaivāṃgirasairapi || || 57 || tasya saṃstūyamānasya tejaḥ somasya bhāsvataḥ || āpyāyamānaṃ lokāṃstrīnbhāsayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ || 58 || sa tena rathamukhyena sāgarāṃtāṃ vasuṃdharām || triḥsaptakṛtvotiyaśāścakārābhipradakṣiṇam || 59 || tasya yaccāpi tattejaḥ pṛthivīmanvapadyata || oṣadhyastāḥ samutpannāste jasā'jvalayanpunaḥ || 7.1.20.60 || tābhirdhinotyayaṃ lokaṃ prajāścaiva caturvidhāḥ || oṣadhyaḥ phalapākāṃtāḥ kaṇāḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ || 61 || vrīhayaśca yavāścaiva godhūmā aṇavastilāḥ || 62 || priyaṃguḥ kovidāraśca koradūṣāḥ satīnakāḥ || māṣā mudgā masūrāśca niṣpāvāḥ sakulatthakāḥ || || 63 || āḍhakyaścaṇakāścaiva kaṇāḥ saptadaśa smṛtāḥ || ityetā oṣadhīnāṃ ca grāmyāṇāṃ jātayaḥ smṛtāḥ || 64 || oṣadhyo yajñiyāścaiva grāmyā raṇyāścaturddaśa || vrīhayaśca yavāścaiva
