godhūmāstvaṇavastilāḥ || 65 || priyaṃguṣaṣṭhā ityete saptamāstu kulatthakāḥ || śyāmākāstvatha nīvārā jartilāḥ sagavedhukāḥ || 66 || ūruvindā markaṭakāstathā veṇuyavāśca ye || grāmyāraṇyāstathā hyetā oṣadhyastu caturdaśa || 67 || tṛṇagulmalatā vīrudvallīgucchādi koṭiśaḥ || eteṣāmadhipaścandro dhārayatyakhilaṃ jagat || 68 || jyotsnābhirbhagavānsomo jagato hitakāmyayā || tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ brahmā brahmavidāṃ varaḥ || 69 || bījauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāṃ maṃtrāṇāṃ ca varānane || so'bhiṣikto mahātejā rājā rājye niśākaraḥ || 7.1.20.70 || trīm̐llokānbhāvayāmāsa svabhāsā bhāsvatāṃ varaḥ|| taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva dyutiḥpuṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ||71|| kīrtirdhṛtiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire|| saptaviṃśatiriṃdostu dākṣāyaṇyo mahāvratāḥ||72|| dadau prācetaso dakṣo nakṣatrāṇīti yā viduḥ|| sa tatprāpya mahdrājyaṃ somaḥ somavatāṃ varaḥ || 73 || samājahre rājasūyaṃ sahasraśatadakṣiṇam || hiraṇyagarbhaścodgātā brahmā brahmatvameyivān || 74 || sadasyastasya bhagavānharirnārāyaṇaḥ prabhuḥ || sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ || 75 || dakṣiṇāmadadātsomastrīm̐llokāṃstu varānane || tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyaśca vai śubhe || || 76 || prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ sarvadevarṣipūjitaḥ || atirājati rājendro daśadhā bhāvayandiśaḥ || 77 || tena tatprāpa duṣprāpyamaiśvaryyamakṛtā tmabhiḥ || sa evaṃ varttate candraścātreya iti viśrutaḥ || 78 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye candrotpattivarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || cha ||
<7.1.21>
|| devyuvāca || || śrutaṃ sarvamaśeṣeṇa candrasyotpatti kāraṇam || cihnaṃ yathā'bhavattasya sāṃprataṃ tatprakīrttaya || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || brahmaṇastu purā devi dakṣo nāma suto'bhavat || prajāḥ sṛjeti uddiṣṭaḥ pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ svayaṃbhuvā || 2 || ṣaṣṭiṃ dakṣo'sṛjatkanyā vairiṇyāṃ vai prajāpatiḥ || dadau sa daśa dharmāya kaśyapāya trayodaśa || 3 || sapta viśatiṃ somāya catasro'riṣṭanemine || dve caiva bhṛguputrāya dve kṛśāśvāya dhīmate || 4 || dve caivāṃgirase tadvattāsāṃ nāmāni vistarāt || śṛṇu tvaṃ devi mātṝṇāṃ prajāvistaramāditaḥ || 5 || marutvatī vasurjāmī laṃbā bhānurarundhatī || saṃkalpā ca muhūrtā ca sādhyā viśvā ca bhāmini || 6 || dharma patnyaḥ samākhyātā dakṣaḥ prācetaso dadau || aditirditirdanustadvadariṣṭā surasaiva ca || 7 || surabhirvinatā caiva nāmnā krodhavaśā tvilā || kadrūstviṣā vasustadvattāsāṃ putrānvadāmi vai || 8 || viśvedevāstu viśvāyāḥ sādhyā sādhyānajījanat || marutvatyāṃ marutvaṃto vasostu vasavastathā || 9 ||| bhānostu bhānavastena muhūrttāyāṃ muhūrttakāḥ || laṃbāyā ghoṣanāmāno nāgavīthistu jāmijā || 7.1.21.10 || saṃkalpāyāstu saṃkalpo dharmaputrā daśa smṛtāḥ || āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivānalo'nilaḥ ||11|| pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavoṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || āpasya putrā vaidaṃḍyaḥ śramaḥ śānto dhvanistathā ||| || 12 || dhruvasya putro bhagavānkālo lokaprakālanaḥ || somasya bhagavāñcharvo dhruvaśca gṛhabodhanaḥ || 13 || hutahavyavahaścaiva dharasya draviṇa smṛtaḥ || manojavo'nilasyāsīdavijñātagatistathā || 14 || devalo bhagavānyogī pratyūṣasyābhavansutāḥ || bṛhaspatestu bhaginī bhuvanā brahmavādinī || 15 || prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca || viśvakarmā sutastasya śilpakarttā prajāpatiḥ || 16 || tuṣitānāṃ tu sādhyānāṃ nāmānyetāni vacmi te || mano'numantā prāṇaśca naro'pānaśca vīryavān || 17 || bhaktirbhayo'naghaścaiva haṃso nārāyaṇastathā || vibhuścaiva prabhuścaiva sādhyā dvādaśa kīrtitāḥ || 18 || kaśyapasya pravakṣyāmi santatiṃ varavarṇini || aṃśo dhātā bhagastvaṣṭā mitro'tha varuṇo ryamā || 19 || vivasvānsavitā pūṣā hyaṃśumānviṣṇureva ca || ete sahasrakiraṇā ādityā dvādaśa smṛtāḥ || 7.1.21.20 || ajaikapādahirbudhnyo virūpākṣo'tha raivataḥ || haraśca bahurūpaśca tryaṃbakaśca sureśvaraḥ || 21 || sāvitraśca jayantaśca pinākī cāparājitaḥ || ete rudrāḥ samākhyātā ekādaśa gaṇeśvarāḥ || 22 || ditiḥ putradvayaṃ lebhe kaśyapādbalagarvitam || hiraṇyakaśipuṃ śreṣṭhaṃ hiraṇyākṣaṃ tathānujam || 23 || hiraṇyakaśipordaityaiḥ ślokogītaḥ purātanaiḥ ||24|| rājā hiraṇyakaśipuryāṃyāmāśāṃ nirīkṣate || tasyāṃ tasyāṃ diśi surā namaścakrurmaharṣibhiḥ || hiraṇyakaśipoḥ putrāścatvāraḥ sumahābalāḥ || 25 || prahlādaḥ pūrvajasteṣāmanuhrādastataḥ paraḥ || hrādaścaiva hradaścaiva putrāścaite prakīrtitāḥ || 26 || ubhau sundopasundau tu hradaputrau babhūvatuḥ || hrādasya putrastveko'bhūnmūka ityabhiviśrutaḥ || 27 || mārīcaḥ suṃdaputrastu tāḍakāyāmajāyata || daṇḍake nihataḥ so'yaṃ rāghaveṇa valīyasā || 28 || mūko vinihataścāpi kairāte sabyasācinā || saṃhrādasya tu daityasya nivātakavacāḥ kule || 29 || tisraḥ koṭyastu vikhyātā nihatāḥ savyasācinā|| gaveṣṭhī kālanemiśca jaṃbho valkala eva ca || 7.1.21.30 || jṛṃbhaḥ ṣaṣṭhonujasteṣāṃ smṛtāḥ prahrādasūnavaḥ || śuṃbhaścaiva niśuṃbhaśca gaveṣṭhinaḥ sutau smṛtau ||31|| dhanukaścāsilomā ca śuṃbhaputrau prakīrtitau || virocanasya putrastu balirekaḥ pratāpavān || 32 || hiraṇyākṣasutāḥ paṃca vikrāṃtāḥ sumahābalāḥ || andhakaḥ śakuniścaiva kālanābhastathaiva ca || 33 || mahānābhaśca vikrāṃto bhūtasaṃtāpanastathā || śataṃ śatasahasrāṇi nihatāstārakāmaye || 34 || iti saṃkṣapataḥ proktā kaśyapānvayasaṃtatiḥ || yayā vyāptaṃ jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam || 35 || atha yāḥ kanyakā dattāḥ saptaviṃśatiriṃdave || tāsāṃ madhye mahādevi priyā tasya ca rohiṇī || 36 || atha nakṣatranāthasya tāsāṃ madhyetivallabhā || babhūva rohiṇī devī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || 37 || sarvāstāḥ saṃparityajya rohiṇyā sahito rahaḥ || reme kāmaparītātmā vaneṣūpavaneṣu ca || ramaṇīyeṣu deśeṣu kandareṣu guhāsu ca || 38 || atha tā duḥkhasaṃpannāḥ patnyaḥ śeṣā yaśasvini || jagmuśca śaraṇaṃ dakṣaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabruvan || 39 || somaḥ sarvā tikramya rohiṇyā saha modate || saṃvatsarasahasraṃ tu krīḍamāno yathāsukham || 7.1.21.40 || avaśiṣṭāstu ṣaḍviṃśanmalinā vigataśriyaḥ || pāṇigrahaṇamārabhya rohiṇyā saha caṃdramāḥ || 41 || saṃvatsarasahasraṃ tu jānātyekāṃ sa śarvarīm || parityaktā vayaṃ tāta śaśinā doṣavarjitāḥ || 42 || sa reme saha rohiṇyā asmākamasukhapradaḥ || asmākaṃ duḥkhadagdhānāṃ śreyo'to maraṇaṃ bhavet || 43 || tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā duḥkhārtānāṃ prajāpatiḥ || brahmatejaḥ samāyuktaḥ putrīsnehena karṣitaḥ || jagāma yatra ṛkṣeśo vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 44 || samaṃ varttasva kanyāsu māmakāsu niśākara || anyathā doṣabhāgī tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 45 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā lajjayāvanataḥ sthitaḥ || bāḍhamityeva ṛkṣeṃdro dakṣasya purato'bravīt || 46 || adyaprabhṛti viprarṣe samaṃ varttayitāsmyaham|| putrībhistava satyaṃ vai śape'haṃ śapathena te || 47 || evaṃ pratijñāsaṃyukte niśānāthe tadāṃbike || sarvā rūpeṇa saṃyuktāstasya kanyā niveditāḥ || 48 || dakṣaḥ svabhavanaṃ gatvā nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ || candro'pi pūrvavaddevi rohiṇyāṃ nirato'bhavat || 49 || saṃparityajya tāḥ sarvāḥ kāmopahatamānasaḥ || atha bhūyastu tāḥ sarvā dakṣaṃ vacanamabruvan || 7.1.21.50 || malināstāḥ kṛśāṃgyaśca dīnāḥ sarvā vicetasaḥ || tato dṛṣṭvā tathārūpaṃ dakṣo mohamupāgataḥ || 51 || labdhasaṃjñaḥ punaḥ so'pi krodhodbhūtatanūruhaḥ || uvāca sarvāḥ svāḥ putrīḥ kimitthaṃ malināṃbarāḥ || kimidaṃ niṣprabhāḥ sarvāḥ kathayadhvaṃ mamānaghāḥ || 52 || asurānsānugāṃścaiva ye cānye surasattamāḥ || adya śāpahatānputryaḥ kariṣyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || 53 || evamuktāstu dakṣeṇa sarvāstāḥ samudairayan || 54 || na cāsmākaṃ niśānātha ṛtumātramapi prabho || prayacchati punastena yuṣmatpārśvaṃ samāgatāḥ || 55 || anādṛtya tu te vākyaṃ rohiṇyāṃ nirato rahaḥ || reme kāmaparītātmā asmākaṃ śokavarddhanaḥ || 56 || tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dakṣaḥ kopamupāgataḥ || gatvā caṃdraṃ mahādevi śaśāpa pramukhe sthitam|| 57 || anādṛtya hi me vākyaṃ yasmāttvaṃ rohiṇīrataḥ || saṃtyajya putrīścāsmākaṃ śeṣā doṣeṇa varjitāḥ || tasmādyakṣmā śarīraṃ te grasiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ|| || 58 || etasminneva kāle tu yakṣmā parvataputrike || dakṣeṇa tu samādiṣṭastasya kāyaṃ samāviśat || 59 || yakṣmaṇā grastakāyo'sau kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine || 7.1.21.60 || evaṃ somastu dakṣeṇa kṛtaśāpo gataprabhaḥ || papāta vasudhāṃ devi niśceṣṭo rohiṇīyutaḥ || 61 || labdhvasaṃjño muhūrtena rohiṇīvākya mabravīt |62| devi kāryaṃ kimadhunā tvatpitrā śāpito hyaham|| kṣayakuṣṭhena saṃyuktaḥ kiṃ karomyadhunā priye||63|| evamuktā rohiṇī tu bāṣpavyākulalocanā|| dakṣaśāpahataṃ dṛṣṭvā somaṃ vacanamabravīt||64|| yena śāpastu te dattastameva śaraṇaṃ vraja|| sa te śāpābhibhūtasya nūnaṃ śreyo vidhāsyati|| 65|| lapsyase tatprasādāttvaṃ prabhāṃ pūrvocitāṃ śubhām|| 66|| rohiṇyā vacanaṃ śrutvā gato dakṣasamīpataḥ || caṃdraḥ provāca vinayādvāṣpa vyākulalocanaḥ || 67 || kuruṣvānugrahaṃ dakṣa prasannenāṃtarātmanā || kopaṃ tyaja maharṣe tvaṃ mamopari dayāṃ kuru |1 68 || tvayā krodhaparītena kāraṇe vāpyakāraṇe || anukaṃpāṃ ca me kṛtvā kāryaṃ śāpasya mokṣaṇam|| 69 || viditaṃ tu mahābhāga śaptohaṃ yena karmaṇā || kuruṣvānugrahaṃ dakṣa mama dīnasya yācataḥ || 7.1.21.70 || evaṃ vilapamānasya somasya tu mahātmanaḥ || anugrahe matiṃ kṛtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt ||71|| || dakṣa uvāca || || mayā śāpahataḥ soma trātuṃ śakyo na daivataiḥ|| yadyadbravīmyahaṃ soma tattatheti na saṃśayaḥ || 72 || āyuḥ karma ca vittaṃ ca vidyā nidhanameva ca || pūrvasṛṣṭāni yānyeva saṃbhavaṃti hi tāni vai || 73 || asurāśca surāścaiva ye cānye yakṣarākṣasāḥ || sarvepi śaktā na trātuṃ varjayitvā maheśvaram ||74|| eṣāṃ śāpo mayā datto'nugrahīṣya ti śaṃkaraḥ|| nānyastrātuṃ bhavecchakto vinā paśupatiṃ bhavam || tattvaṃ śīghrataraṃ gaccha samārādhaya śaṃkara || 75 || na śakto'nyaḥ punaścaṃdraḥ kartuṃ tvāṃ nirmalaṃ punaḥ|| varjayitvā mahādevaṃ śitikaṃṭhamumāpatim ||76|| dakṣasya ca vacaḥ śrutvā kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ|| pratyuvāca tadā somaḥ prahaṣṭenāṃtarātmanā||77|| bhagavanyadi tuṣṭosi mama bhaktasya suvrata || anugrahe kṛtā buddhistadācakṣva kutaḥ śivaḥ || 78 || kasminsthāne mayā dakṣa draṣṭavyo'sau maheśvaraḥ || tatsthānāni cariṣyāmi yāni tāni vadasva me || 79 || || dakṣa uvāca || || śṛṇu soma prayatnena śrutvā caivāvadhāraya || vāruṇīṃ diśamāśritya sāgarānūpasannidhau || 7.1.21.80 || kṛtasmarasyāparato dhanvaṃtaraśatatraye || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ ca svayaṃbhūtaṃ vyavasthitam || 81 || sūryyabiṃbasamaprakhyaṃ sarpa mekhalamaṃḍitam|| kukkuṭāṃḍakamānaṃ tadbhūmimadhye vyavasthitam || 82 || sparśaliṃgaṃ hi tadviddhi tadbhaktyā jñāsyate bhavān || tatra saṃnihito devaḥ śaṃkaraḥ parameśvaraḥ || 83 || gaccha tvaṃ tapasogreṇa ārādhaya sureśvaram || 94 || praśasya devadeveśamātmānaṃ nirmalaṃ kuru || yasyāśu varadānena prāpsyase rūpamuttamam || 85 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyāsaṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvarotpattiprasaṃge dakṣeṇa svaśāpajanyayakṣmarogārttasya caṃdrasya yakṣmakuṣṭharoganivṛttaye śivārādhanopadeśavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || cha || ||
<7.1.22>
īśvara uvāca || || dakṣeṇaivamanujñātaḥ śocankarma svakaṃ tadā || duḥkhaśokaparītātmā prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || 1 || sa gatvā dakṣiṇaṃ tīraṃ sāgarasya samīpataḥ || dadarśa parvataṃ tatra kṛtasmaramiti śrutam || 2 || yakṣavidyādharākīrṇaṃ kinnarairupaśobhitam || caṃdanāgurukarpūrairaśokaistilakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 3 || kalhāraiḥ śatapatraiśca puṣpitaiḥ phalitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || āmrajambūkapitthaiśca dāḍimaiḥ panasaistathā ||4|| niṃbujambīranāgaiśca kadalīkhaṃḍamaṃḍitaiḥ || kramukairnāgavallyādyaiḥ śālaistālaistamālakaiḥ || 5 || bījapūrakakharjūrairdrākṣāmadhurapāṭalaiḥ || bilvacaṃpakatiṃdvādyaiḥ kadaṃbakakubhaistathā || 6 || dhavāśokaśirīṣādyairnānāvṛkṣaiśca śobhitam || kāmaṃ kāmaphalairvṛkṣaiḥ puṣpitaiḥ phalitaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 7 || haṃsakāraṃḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam || kokilābhiḥ śukaiścaiva nānāpakṣininādi tam || 8 || jātismarāḥ pakṣiṇaśca vyājahrurmānuṣīṃ giram || gaṃdharvakiṃnarayugaiḥ siddhavidyādharoragaiḥ || 9 || krīḍadbhirvividhairdivyaiḥ śobhitaṃ parvatottamam || devagaṃdharvanṛtyaiśca veṇuvīṇānināditam || 7.1.22.10 || vedadhvanitaghoṣeṇa yajñahomāgnihotrajaiḥ || samāvṛtaṃ sarvamājyagaṃdhibhirucchritam || 11 || śobhitaṃ carṣibhirdivyaiścāturvidyairdvijottamaiḥ || atriścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || 12 || bhṛguścaiva marīciśca bharadvājo'tha kaśyapaḥ || manuryamoṃ'girā viṣṇuḥ śātātapaparāśarau || 13 || āpastaṃbo'tha saṃvartaḥ kātyaḥ kātyāyano muniḥ || gautamaḥ śaṃkhalikhitau tathā vācaspatirmuniḥ || 14 || jāmadagnyo yājñavalkya ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṃḍakaḥ || gārgyaśaunakadālbhyāśca vyāsa uddālakaḥ śukaḥ || 15 || nāradaḥ parvataścaiva durvāsā ugratāpasaḥ || śākalyo gālavaścaiva jābālirmudgalastathā || 16 || viśvāmitraḥ kauśikaśca jahnurviśvāvasustathā || dhaumyaścaiva śatānando vaiśaṃpāyanajiṣṇavaḥ || 17 || śākaṭāyanavārddhikyāvagniko bādarāyaṇaḥ || vālakhilyā mahātmāno ye ca bhūmaṇḍale sthitāḥ || 18 || te sarve tatra tiṣṭhaṃti parvate tu kṛtasmare || tejasvino brahmaputrā ṛṣayo dhārmikāḥ priye || 19 || jvalaṃtastapasā sarve nirddhūmā iva pāvakāḥ || māsopavāsinaḥ kecitkecitpakṣopavāsinaḥ || 7.1.22.20 || trairātrikāḥ sāṃtapanā nirāhārāstathā pare || kecitpuṣpa phalāhārāḥ śīrṇaparṇāśinastathā || 21 || kecidgomayabhakṣāśca jalāhārāstathā pare || sāgnihotrāḥ suvidvāṃso mokṣamārgārthacintakāḥ || 22 || iti hāsapurāṇādiśrutismṛtiviśāradāḥ || ete cānye ca bahavo mārkaṃḍeyapurogamāḥ || 23 || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā kṛtaparvate || evaṃ kṛtasmarastatra sarvadevaniṣevitaḥ || manvaṃtaresminyo devi nirdagdho vaḍavāgninā || 24 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā parvataṃ ramyaṃ dṛṣṭvā caiva mahodadhim || pradakṣiṇaṃ tataścakre saptakṛtvo niśākaraḥ || gireḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā gato yatra maheśvaraḥ || 25 || samīpe tu samudrasya sparśaliṃgasvarūpavān || prasādayāmāsa vibhuṃ prasannenāṃtarātmanā || 26 || maraṇaṃ veti saṃdhyāya śaraṇaṃ vā maheśvaram || varaṃ śāpābhighātārthaṃ mṛtyuṃ vā śaṃkarānmama || 27 || iti somo matiṃ kṛtvā tapasā'' rādhayañchivam || yāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu phalamūlāśano'bhavat || 28 || pūrṇe varṣasahasre tu caturthe varavarṇini || tutoṣa bhagavānrudro vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || ||29|| parituṣṭo'smi te caṃdra varaṃ varaya suvrata|| kiṃ te kāmaṃ karomyadya brūhi yatsyātsudurllabham||7.1.22.3||| evaṃ pratyakṣamāpannaṃ dṛṣṭvā devaṃ vṛṣadhvajam|| praṇamya taṃ yathābhaktyā stutiṃ cakre niśākaraḥ || 31 || || caṃdra uvāca || || oṃ namo devadevāya śivāya paramātmane || aprameyasvarūpāya byaktāvyaktasvarūpiṇe || 32 || tvaṃ patiryogināmīśa tvayi sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || tvaṃ yajñastvaṃ vaṣaṭkārastvamoṃkāraḥ prajāpatiḥ || 33 || caturviṃśatyadhikaṃ ca bhuvanānāṃ śatadvayam || tasyopari paraṃ jyotirjāgarti tava kevalam ||34 || kalpāṃta ādivārāhamuktabrahmāṃḍasaṃsthitau || ādhārastaṃbhabhūtāya tejoliṃgāya te namaḥ || 35 || namo'nāmayanāmne te namaste kṛttivāsase || namo bhairavanāthāya namaḥ someśvarāya te || 36 || iti saṃjñābhiretābhiḥ stutyābhiramṛteśvaraḥ || bhūtairbhavyairbhaviṣyaiśca stūyase surasattamaiḥ || 37 || ādyo viraṃcināmābhūdbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || mṛtyuñjayeti te nāma tadā'bhūtpārvatīpate || 38 || dvitīyo'bhūdyadā brahmā padmabhūriti viśrutaḥ || tadā kālāgnirudreti tava nāma prakīrtitam || 39 || tṛtīyo'bhūdyadā brahmā svayaṃbhūriti viśrutaḥ || amṛteśeti te nāma kīrtitaṃ kīrtivarddhanam ||7.1.22.40 || caturtho'bhūdyadā brahmā parameṣṭhīti viśrutaḥ || anāmayeti deveśa tava nāma smṛtaṃ tadā || 41 || paṃcamo'bhūdyadā brahmā surajyeṣṭha iti śrutaḥ || kṛttivāseti te nāma babhūva tripurāṃtaka ||42|| ṣaṣṭhaścābhūdyadā brahmā hemagarbha iti smṛtaḥ || tadā bhairavanātheti tava nāma prakīrtitam || 43 || adhunā varttate yo'sau śatānaṃda iti śrutaḥ || ādisomena yaścāsau vāmanetrodbhavena te || 44 || pratiṣṭhārthaṃ tu liṃgasya ānītaścāṣṭavārṣikaḥ || bālarūpī tadā tena somanātheti kīrtitam || 45 || tadāprabhṛti somānāṃ lakṣāṇāṃ dvitayaṃ gatam ||14|| sahasradvitayaṃ caiva śataṃ caiva ṣaḍuttaram || 46 || saptamo'haṃ mahādeva ātreya iti viśrutaḥ || prācetasena dakṣeṇa śaptastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || rakṣa māṃ devadeveśa kṣayiṇaṃ pāparogiṇam|| 47 || iti saṃstuvatastasya caṃdrasya karuṇākaraḥ || tutoṣa bhagavānrudro vākyaṃ cedamuvāca ha || 48 || parituṣṭo'smi te caṃdra varaṃ varaya suvrata || ki te kāmaṃ karomyadya brūhi yatsyātsudurllabham || 49 || mama nāmāni guhyāni mama priyatarāṇi ca || paṭhiṣyaṃti narā ye tu dāsye teṣāṃ manogatam || 7.1.22.50 || atītā ye caṃdramaso bhaviṣyaṃti ca ye'dhunā || teṣāṃ pūjyamidaṃ liṃgaṃ yāvadanyo'ṣṭavārṣikaḥ || 51 || āḥ paraṃ caturvaktro brahmā yo bhavitā yadā || prāṇanātheti devasya tadā nāma bhaviṣyati || 52 || prāṇāstu vāyavaḥ proktāstadārādhananāma tat || prāṇanātheti saṃproktaṃ me'dhunā tadbhaviṣyati || 53 || tasmādagnīśanāmeti kālarudretyanaṃtaram || tāraketi tato nāma bhaviṣyatyeva kīrtitam || 54 || mṛtyuñjayeti devasya bhavitā tadanaṃtaram || tryaṃbakeśastvitīśeti bhuvaneśetyanantaram || 55 || bhūtanātheti ghoreti brahmeśetyatha nāmakam || bhaviṣyaṃ pṛthivīśeti ādināthetyanaṃtaram || 56 || kalpeśvareti devasya caṃdranāthetyanantaram || nāma devasya yadbhāvi sāṃprataṃ te prakāśitam || 57 || ityevamādi nāmāni svasaṃkhyātāni ṣoḍaśa || gatāni saṃbhaviṣyaṃti kālasyānaṃtabhāvataḥ || 58 || ekaikaṃ vartate nāma brahmaṇaḥ pralayāvadhi || tatonyajjāyate nāma yathā nāmānurūpataḥ || 59 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena rahasyaṃ te prakāśitam || vatsa yatkāraṇeneha tapastaptaṃ tvayā'khilam || tanme niḥśeṣato brūhi dāsye tuṣṭo'smi te varam || 7.1.22.60 || || candra uvāca || || ahaṃ śaptastu dakṣeṇa kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || yakṣmaṇā ca kṣayaṃ nītastasmāttvaṃ trātumarhasi || 61 || || śaṃbhuruvāca || || adhunā bhoḥ samaṃ paśya sarvāstā dakṣakanyakāḥ || kṣayaste bhavitā pakṣaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhirbhaviṣyati || 62 || pūrvocitāṃ prabhāṃ soma prāpsyase matprasādataḥ || prācetasasya dakṣasya tapasā hatapāpmanaḥ || 63 || tasyānyathā vacaḥ kartuṃ śakyaṃ nānyaiḥ surairapi || brāhmaṇāḥ kupitā hanyurbhasmīkuryuḥ svatejasā || 64 || devānkuryuradevāṃśca nāśayeyuridaṃ jagat || brāhmaṇāścaiva devāśca teja ekaṃ dvidhā kṛtam || 65 || pratyakṣaṃ brāhmaṇā devāḥ parokṣaṃ divi devatāḥ || na vinā brāhmaṇā devairna devā brāhmaṇairvinā || 66 || ekatra mantrā stiṣṭhanti teja ekatra tiṣṭhati || brāhmaṇā devatā loke brāhmaṇā divi devatāḥ || trailokye brāhmaṇāḥ śreṣṭhā brāhmaṇā eva kāraṇam || 67 || piturniyuktāḥ pitaro bhavaṃti kriyāsu daivīṣu bhavaṃti devāḥ || dvijottamā hastaniṣaktatoyāstenaiva dehena bhavaṃti devāḥ || 68 || ṣaṭka rmatattvābhirateṣu nityaṃ vipreṣu vedārthakutūhaleṣu || na teṣu bhaktyā praviśaṃti ghoraṃ mahābhayaṃ pretabhavaṃ kadācit || 69 || yadbrāhmaṇāḥ stutyatamā vadanti taddevatā karmabhirācaraṃti || tuṣṭeṣu tuṣṭāḥ satataṃ bhavanti pratyakṣadeveṣu parokṣadevāḥ || 7.1.22.70 || yathā rudrā yathā devā maruto vasavo'śvinau || brahmā ca somasūryau ca tathā loke dvijottamāḥ || 71 || devādhīnāḥ prajāḥ sarvā yajñādhīnāśca devatāḥ || te yajñā brāhmaṇādhīnāstasmāddevā dvijottamāḥ || || 72 || brāhmaṇānarcayennityaṃ brāhmaṇāṃstarpayetsadā || brāhmaṇāstārakā loke brāhmaṇātsvargamaśnute || 73 || abhedyamacchedyamanādimakṣayaṃ vidhiṃ purāṇaṃ paripālayanti || mahāmatistānabhipūjya vai dvijānbhavedajeyo divi devarāḍiva || 79 || śakyaṃ hi kavacaṃ bhettuṃ nārācena śareṇa vā || api vajra sahasreṇa brāhmaṇāśīḥ sudurbhidā || 75 || hutena śāmyate pāpaṃ hutamannena śāmyati || annaṃ hiraṇyadānena hiraṇyaṃ brāhmaṇāśiṣā || 76 || ya icchennarakaṃ gaṃtuṃ saputrapaśubāṃdhava || deveṣvadhikṛtaṃ kuryādbrāhmaṇeṣu ca goṣu ca || 77 || brāhmaṇāndveṣṭi yo mohāddevāngāśca makhānyadi || naiva tasya paro loko nā'yaṃ loko durātmanaḥ || 78 || anindyā brāhmaṇā gāvaḥ kāṃcanaṃ salilaṃ striyaḥ|| pṛthivī tu ṣaḍetāni yo nindati sa pātakī ||79|| agraṃ dharmasya rājāno mūlaṃ dharmasya brāhmaṇāḥ || tasmānmūlaṃ na hiṃsīta mūle hyagraṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 7.1.22.80 || phalaṃ dharmasya rājānaḥ puṣpaṃ dharmasya brāhmaṇāḥ || tasmātpuṣpaṃ na hiṃsīta puṣpātsaṃjāyate phalam || 81 || rājā vṛkṣo brāhmaṇāstasya mūlaṃ paurāḥ parṇaṃ mantriṇastasya śākhāḥ || tasmādrājñā brāhmaṇā rakṣaṇīyā mūle gupte nāsti vṛkṣasya nāśaḥ || 82 || āsanno hi dahatyagnirdūrāddahati brāhmaṇaḥ || prarohatyagninā dagdhaṃ brahmadagdhaṃ na rohati || 83 || brāhmaṇānāṃ ca śāpena sarvabhakṣo hutāśanaḥ || samudraścāpyapeyastu viphalaśca puraṃdaraḥ || 84 || tvaṃ candra rājayakṣmī ca pṛthivyāmūṣarāṇi ca || sūryācandramasoḥ pātaḥ punaruddharaṇaṃ tayoḥ || 85 || vanaspatīnāṃ niryāso dānavānāṃ parājayaḥ || nāgānāṃ ca vaśīkāraḥ kṣatrasyotsādanaṃ tathā || devotpatti viparyāso lokānāṃ ca viparyayaḥ || 86 || evamādīni tejāṃsi brāhmaṇānāṃ mahātmanām || tasmādvipreṣu nṛpatiḥ praṇamennityameva ca || 87 || parā mapyāpadaṃ prāpto brāhmaṇānna prakopayet || te hyenaṃ kupitā hanyuḥ sadyaḥ sabalavāhanam || 88 || praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathāgnirdaivataṃ mahat || evaṃ vidvānavidvānvā brāhmaṇo daivataṃ mahat || 89 || śmaśāneṣvapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati || hūyamānaśca yajñeṣu bhūya evābhivarddhate || 7.1.22.90 || evaṃ yadyapya niṣṭeṣu varttate sarvakarmasu || sarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇaḥ pūjyo daivataṃ paramaṃ mahat || 91 || kṣatrasyātipravṛddhasya brāhmaṇānāṃ prabhāvataḥ || brāhmaṃ hi paramaṃ pūjyaṃ kṣatraṃ hi brahmasaṃbhavam || 92 || adbhyo'gnirbrahmataḥ kṣatramaśmano lohamutthitam || teṣāṃ sarvatragaṃ tejaḥ svāsu yoniṣu śāmyati || 93 || yānsamāśritya tiṣṭhanti devalokāśca sarvadā || brahmaiva vacanaṃ yeṣāṃ ko hiṃsyāttāñjijīviṣuḥ || 94 || mriyamāṇo'pyādadīta na rājā brāhmaṇātkaram || na ca kṣudhā 'sya saṃsīdedbrāhmaṇo viṣaye vasan || 95 || yasya rājñaśca viṣaye brāhmaṇaḥ sīdati kṣudhā || tasya tacchatadhā rāṣṭramacirādeva sīdati || 96 || yadrājā kurute pāpaṃ pramādādyacca vibhramāt || vasanto brāhmaṇā rāṣṭre śrotriyāḥ śamayanti tat || 97 || pūrvarātrāṃtarātreṣu dvijairyasya vidhīyate || sa rājā saha rāṣṭreṇa vardhate brahmatejasā || 98 || brāhmaṇānpūjayennityaṃ prātarutthāya bhūmipaḥ || brāhmaṇānāṃ prasādena dīvyanti divi devatāḥ || 99 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena brāhmaṇā māmakī tanuḥ || ye kecitsāgarāṃtāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kīrtitā dvijāḥ || tadūpaṃ devadevasya śivasya paramātmanaḥ || 7.1.22.100 || etāndviṣaṃti ye mūḍhā brāhmaṇānsaṃśitavratān || te māṃ dviṣaṃti vai nūnaṃ pūjanātpūjayanti mām|| 101 || na pradveṣastataḥ kāryo brāhmaṇeṣu vijānatā || pradveṣeṇāśu naśyanti brahmaśāpahatā narāḥ || 102 || ityevaṃ kathitaścandra brāhmaṇānāṃ guṇārṇavaḥ || kuruṣvānantaraṃ kāryyaṃ yadbravīmyahameva te || 103 || śāpasyānugraho datto mayā tava niśākara || na cānyathā vacaḥ karttuṃ śakyaṃ teṣāṃ drijanmanām || 104 || śāpānugrahadaiḥ sarvai devairapi savāsavaiḥ || tasmāccandra tvayā śoko naiva kāryo vijānatā || 105 || kṣayaste bhavitā pakṣaṃ pakṣaṃ vṛddhirbhaviṣyati || athānyadvacanaṃ candra śṛṇu kāryaṃ yathā tvayā || 106 || idaṃ yatsāgaropāṃte tiṣṭhate liṃgamuttamam || dharāmadhyagataṃ tacca devānāṃ dṛṣṭigocaram || 107 || kukkuṭāṃḍasamaprakhyaṃ sarpamekhalamaṃḍitam || mamādyaṃ paramaṃ tejo na cānyo veda kaścana || 108 || itaḥ sāgaramadhye tu dhanuṣāṃ ca śatatraye || tiṣṭhate tatra liṃgaṃ tu suguptaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 109 || ādikalpe maharṣīṇāṃ śāpena patitaṃ mama || liṃgaṃ sāgaramadhye tu tattvaṃ śīghraṃ samānaya || 7.1.22.110 || sparśākhyaṃ yatra me liṃgaṃ tatra sthāne niveśaya || niveśya tu prayatnena sahito viśvakarmaṇā || 111 || tato brahmāṇamāhūya sametaṃ tu munīśvaraiḥ || pratiṣṭhāṃ kāraya vibho iṣṭvā tatra mahāmakhaiḥ || 112 || evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāṃtaradhīyata || tataḥ prabhāṃ punarlebhe rātrinātho varānane || 113 || tataḥ prabhṛti tatkṣetraṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam || niṣprabhasya prabhā dattā prabhāsaṃ tena cocyate || 114 || dakṣasya tu vṛthā śāpo na kṛtastena lāṃchanam || somaḥ prabhāsate lokānvaraṃ prāpya maheśvarāt || vyaktībhūtaḥ sa deveśaḥ somasyaiva mahātmanaḥ || 115 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye somavarapradānavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| || 22 ||
<7.1.23>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tataḥ śāṃtamanā bhūtvā caṃdramā vismayānvitaḥ || śaṃbhubhaktyā parītātmā prabhāsakṣetramāsthitaḥ || 1 || pūrvoktaṃ yattu devena sa tathā kṛtavānvibhuḥ || gatvā sāgaramadhye tu gṛhītvā liṃgamuttamam || 2 || viśvakarmmāṇamāhūya sahitaṃ paricārakaiḥ || ādideśa svayaṃ somastvaṣṭāraṃ devaśilpinam|| 3 || || caṃdra uvāca || || viśvakarmannidaṃ liṃgaṃ mama dattaṃ tu śaṃbhunā || gṛhāṇa tvaṃ mahābāho yuktasthāne niveśaya || 4 || rakṣasva tāvadgantāsmi svakīyaṃ bhavanaṃ vibho || yajñārthamānayiṣyāmi yajñopakaraṇāni ca || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktvā ca tadā caṃdraścaṃdra lokaṃ jagāma ha|| gatvā tatra mahādevi caṃdralokaṃmahāprabham||6|| koṭiyojanavistīrṇaṃ sadāmṛtamayaṃ śubham|| tatrāhūya mahādevi pratīhāraṃ sumedhasam || 7 || maṃtriṇaṃ hemagarbhāṃgaṃ bṛhaspatisamaṃ dhiyā || yajñopaskarasaṃbhāraṃ sarvamādāya satvarāḥ || 8 || prabhāsakṣetraṃ gacchaṃtu mamādeśaparāyaṇāḥ || sāgnibhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ gacchaṃtu kṣetramuttamam || 9 || śīghraṃ saṃpādyatāṃ sarvaṃ yathā yajñaḥ pravartate || sarveṣāmeva viprāṇāṃ caṃdralokanivāsinām || 7.1.23.10 || pṛthakpṛthagvimānaṃ tu deyaṃ teṣāṃ mahādhanam || gavāṃ ca daśalakṣāṇāṃ savatsānāṃ payomucām || 11 || hemabhārairbhūṣitānāṃ kāmadhenūpamatviṣām|| aśvānāṃ śyāmakarṇānāṃ sapādaṃ lakṣameva ca || 12 || daṃtināmayutaṃ caiva ghaṃṭābharaṇaśobhitam || sahasrāṇi ca catvāri rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām || 13 || lakṣaṃ tu karabhāṇāṃ ca maṇimāṇikyasaṃyutam || sainyānāṃ koṭirekā tu caturaṃgabalānvitā || 14 || agniśaucāni vastrāṇi brāhmaṇārthaṃ tathaiva ca || vibhūṣaṇāni divyāni ṛtvigarthaṃ śubhāni ca || 15 || nānābhakṣyāṇi bhojyāni pānāni vividhāni ca || lakṣaṃ karmakarāṇāṃ tu dāsīnāṃ lakṣameva ca || || 16 || dāruvaṃśāvadhi proktaṃ yatkiṃcitsvaṃ madājñayā || anyadyadbrāhmaṇā brūyustatsarvaṃ tatra nīyatām || 17 || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ tu yakṣagaṃdharvarakṣa sām || saptadvīpakṣitīśānāṃ saptapātālavāsinām || 18 || nānānṛpasahasrāṇāṃ ghoṣaṇā kriyatāṃ muhuḥ || sarveṣāṃ ghoṣaṇā kāryā prabhāsāgamanaṃ prati || 19 || ityuktvā maṃtriṇaṃ tatra caṃdramāstvarayā'nvitaḥ || brahmalokaṃ sa gatavānyajñārthaṃ brahmaṇoṃtikam || 7.1.23.20 || so'pi caṃdramaso maṃtrī hemagarbho mahāprabhaḥ || somājñāṃ śirasā kṛtvā yajñasaṃbhārasaṃbhṛtaḥ ||21|| prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatya yajñārthaṃ yatnavānabhūt || tathaiva cāhvayāṃcakre bhūrbhuvaḥsvarnivāsinaḥ || || 22 || śrutvā tu ghoṣaṇāṃ sarve śīghraṃ tatra samāyayuḥ|| raviyojanaparyaṃtaṃ kṣetramālokya tatra tat ||23|| brāhmaṇāṃśca samāhūya somādhyakṣaṃ uvāca tān || yajñāṃgaṃ sarvamānītaṃ mayā somājñayā dvijāḥ || anaṃtaraṃ tu yatkṛtyaṃ bhavadbhistadvidhīyatām || 24 || ityuktā brāhmaṇāḥ sarve taponirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ || tatraiva dadṛśuḥ sarve tvaṣṭāraṃ devaśilpinam || 25 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu dvijāḥ sarve liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā samīpataḥ || kathametaditi procurviśvakarmanbravīhi naḥ || kasmādatra sthitastvaṃ vai śilpikoṭisamanvitaḥ || 26 || || viśvakarmmovāca || || ahaṃ somaniyuktastu yukto'smi liṃgarakṣaṇe || tadājñāpālane yatnaḥ kriyate'to mayā dvijāḥ || 27 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ śrutvā yadā viprā jñātvā sarvaṃ tu kāraṇam || caritā yajñakāryārthaṃ tataścakrurupa kramam || 28 || tatra yojanaparyaṃtaṃ devānāṃ yajanaṃ śubham || taddevayajanaṃ kṛtvā patnīśālāṃ ca cakrire || 29 || havirddhānaṃ sadaścaiva uttarā vedireva ca || brahmaṇaḥ sadanāgnīdhrītyevaṃ sthānāni cakrire || 7.1.23.30 || tatra yojanaparyaṃtaṃ yajñayūpāṃśca maṃḍapān || viśvakarmā cakārāśu kuṃḍāni vividhāni ca || 31 || sahasrasaṃkhyayā tatra kuṇḍānāṃ maṃḍapāvadhi || tatra te brāhmaṇāḥ sarve pratiṣṭhāyajñakovidāḥ || 32 || nānābharaṇaratnaiśca brāhmaṇāḥ samalaṃkṛtāḥ || cakruḥ sarve yathanyāyaṃ śāstraṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥpunaḥ || 33 || vṛkṣāṃstathauṣadhīrdivyā samitpuṣpakuśādikān || homadravyādikaṃ sarva mājyaṃ prājyaṃ navaṃ payaḥ || 34 || tathānyadapi yatkiṃcidyajñopakaraṇaṃ smṛtam || varddhanīkalaśādyaṃ ca sarvaṃ hemamayaṃ śubham || 35 || cakruḥ sarvaṃ yathānyāyaṃ pratiṣṭhāmakhamādṛtāḥ || tatra vipragaṇo hṛṣṭo bhakṣyabhojyāditarpitaḥ || 36 || vedadhvanitanirghoṣairdivaṃ bhūmiṃ ca saṃspṛśan || suśubhe maṃḍapastatra patākābhiralaṃkṛtaḥ || 37 || divyasiṃhāsanopeto muktādāmapariṣkṛtaḥ || divyacandanamālābhiḥ kalpapallavatoraṇaiḥ || 38 || divyagandha sugandhādyaiḥ svargasthānamivābhavat || caturdaśavidhastatra bhūtagrāmaḥ samāgataḥ || 39 || sthāvaraḥ sarpajātiśca pakṣijātistathaiva ca || mṛgasaṃjñaścaturthaśca paśvākhyaḥ pañcamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.1.23.40 || ṣaṣṭhaśca mānuṣaḥ proktaḥ paiśācaḥ saptamaḥ smṛtaḥ || aṣṭamo rākṣasaḥ prokto navamo yajña eva ca || 41 || gāṃdharvaśākrasaumyāśca prājāpatyastathaiva ca || brāhmaśceti samākhyātaścaturdaśavidho gaṇaḥ || 42 || viśvedevāstathā sādhyā maruto vasavastathā || lokapālāstathāṣṭau ca nakṣatrāṇi grahaiḥ saha || 43 || brahmāṇḍe devatā yāśca tāḥ sarvāstatra cāgatāḥ || hṛṣṭāḥ prabhāsake kṣetre prārabdhe yajñakarmmaṇi || 44 || ghṛtakṣīravahā nadyo dadhipāyasakardamāḥ|| pakvānnānāṃ phalānāṃ ca rāśayaḥ parvatopamāḥ || 45 || dṛśyante vividhākārāstasminyajñamahotsave || jagu(?)statraiva gandharvā nanṛtuścāpsarogaṇāḥ || 46 || bhakṣyabhojyaiśca vividhaiḥ kāmapānādibhistathā || tṛptā devāśca munayo bhūtagrāmāścaturdaśa || 47 || evaṃ saṃbhārasahitaṃ yajñāṃgaṃ sarvameva hi || praguṇīkṛtya sacivo muktvā tatraiva rakṣakān || somasyāhvānanārthaṃ ca brahmalokaṃ jagāma ha || 48 || || īśvara uvāca || || sa dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇaḥ pārśve sthitaṃ somamahāprabham || praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau somaṃ brahmāṇameva ca || 49 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā uvāca natakaṃdharaḥ || || hemagarbha uvāca || || bhagavanbhavadādeśādyajñāṃgaṃ sarvameva hi || 7.1.23.50 || tatra prābhāsike kṣetre mayā te praguṇīkṛtam || tatra brahmarṣayaḥ sarve tathā rājarṣayo'pare || 51 || tvanmārgaprekṣakāḥ sarve santiṣṭhante samākulāḥ || anantaraṃ tu yatkṛtyaṃ tadbhavānkartumarhati || 52 || || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktastu tadā candraḥ samudrasya sutena vai || prahasyovāca brahmāṇaṃ candramā lokasākṣiṇam || 53 || bhagavansarvadeveśa mamānugrahakāmyayā || pratiṣṭhāyajñakāmasya mamātithyaṃ kuru prabho || 54 || adya me saphalaṃ janma saphalaṃ ca tapaḥ prabho || devatvamadya me brahmaṃstvatprasādādbhaviṣyati || 55 || mayā ca tapasogreṇa prāptaṃ liṃgamumāpateḥ || tatpratiṣṭhāvidhiṃ sarvaṃ tadbhavānkarttumarhati || 56 || || brahmovāca || || avaśyaṃ tava karttāsmi pratiṣṭhāṃ śaṃkarātmikām || tvadārādhanaliṃge tu someśe'tiviśeṣataḥ || 57 || ye kecidbhavitāro vā atītā ye niśākarāḥ || teṣāṃ somānvayānāṃ ca sarveṣāmādyadaivatam || 58 || yo'sau someśvaro deva ādau bhairavanāmabhṛt || manvantarāntare'tīte pratiṣṭhe'haṃ punaḥpunaḥ ||59|| yadā prābhāsikaṃ kṣetre gato'haṃ cāṣṭavārṣikaḥ || āhūtaḥ pūrvamindreṇa bhairavasya pratiṣṭhite ||7.1.23.60||| tatprabhṛtyeva me nāma bālarūpī nigadyate || anyeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu vṛddharūpī vasāmyaham ||61|| prabhāse tu punaścaṃdra bālyāprabhṛti saṃvase || brahmāṇḍe yāni tīrthāni brāhmaṇāsteṣu ye smṛtāḥ ||62|| teṣāmādyo niśānātha prabhāse'haṃ vyavasthitaḥ || kalpekalpe niśānātha mama nāmāṃtaraṃ bhavet||63|| svayaṃbhūḥ prathame nāma dvitīye padmabhūḥ smṛtaḥ|| tṛtīye viśvakartteti bālarūpī turīyake ||64|| eṣāmeva parīvarto nāmnāṃ bhāvi punaḥpunaḥ || parārddhadvayaparyaṃtaṃ prabhāse saṃsthitasya me ||65|| ādisomena tatraiva śaṃbhornetrodbhavena vai || prabhāse tu tapastaptvā pratyakṣīkṛtaīśvaraḥ ||66|| tato dadau varaṃ tuṣṭaḥ pūrvacandrasya śūladhṛk || yasmādārādhito'haṃ te soma bhaktyā cirantanam ||67|| tasmātsomeśanāmaivamasmim̐lliṃge bhaviṣyati || yāvadbrahmā śatānandaḥ prakṛtau na pralīyate || 68 || ye kecidbhavitāro vai rātrināthā niśākarāḥ || te madārādhanaṃ cātra kariṣyaṃti punaḥpunaḥ ||69|| ityuktvā bhagavāñchaṃbhustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || tasminkāle mayā soma ādyaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||7.1.23.70||| tadāprabhṛti somānāṃ lakṣāṇāṃ dvitayaṃ gatam || sahasradvitayaṃ caiva śataṃ caikaṃ ṣaḍuttaram||71|| saptamastvaṃ mahāvāho varttase soma sāṃpratam || etāvantyeva liṃgāni pratiṣṭhāṃ prāpitāni me || 72 || eṣa evādhunā so'haṃ tadārādhanajaṃ phalam || pratiṣṭhātāsmi bhadraṃ te soma kṛtya mamaiva tat|| 73 || || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā vedavidyāsamanvitaḥ || sarvadevamayo devaiḥ sahitastīrthasaṃyutaḥ || 74 || sanatkumārapramukhai ryogīndrairṛṣibhiḥ saha || bṛhaspatiṃ samāhūya puraskṛtya purodhasam || 75 || haṃsayānaṃ samāruhya koṭibrahmarṣibhiḥ saha || āgataḥ somarājena tadā brahmā jagatpatiḥ || 76 || prābhāsike mahātīrthe yatra dāruvanaṃ smṛtam || ṛṣitoyā nadī yatra mahāpātakanāśinī || 77 || asmiṃstīrthe prabhāse tu brahmabhāgaḥ sa ucyate || tridaivatamidaṃ kṣetraṃ mayā te kathitaṃ priye || 78 || tatrāgatva caturvaktro brāhmabhāge'tinirmale || munīnākārayāmāsa unnata sthānavāsinaḥ || 79 || āyāṃtaṃ vedhasaṃ dṛṣṭvā devarṣigurusaṃyutam || te sarve pūjayāmāsuḥ saṃstavairvedasaṃmitaiḥ || 7.1.23.80 || athovāca dvijānsarvānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || ciramārādhya somena someśaṃ pāpanāśanam || 81 || tasminprasanne somena labdhaṃ liṅgamanuttamam || pratiṣṭhārthaṃ tu devasya āyātā dvijasattamāḥ || 82 || yathā mayā sadā kāryā pratiṣṭhā śaṃkarātmikā || bhavadbhiḥ parikāryā sā mama bhāgasamāśrayaiḥ || 83 || yataḥ kopena bhavatāṃ liṃgaṃ prapatitaṃ bhuvi || pratiṣṭhā tasya kartavyā yuṣmābhirvai na saṃśayaḥ || 84 || || īśvara uvāca || || gṛhītvā'tha munīnsarvānbrahmā lokapitā mahaḥ || ānītaḥ somarājena tadā brahmā jagatpatiḥ || 85 || prābhāsike mahātīrthe sāvitryā sahitaḥ prabhuḥ || kārayāmāsa kuṇḍānāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ śataṃśatam || 86 || ekaike maṇḍape tatra cakre saptadaśartvijaḥ|| guruṇā prerito brahmā tatra devapurodhasā || 87 || pārśve sthitastadā brahmā vidhānairveda bhāṣitaiḥ || dīkṣayāmāsa somaṃ tu rohiṇyā sahitaṃ vibhum || 88 || patnīṃ ca rohiṇīṃ kṛtvā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutām || mṛgacarmadharāṃ devīṃ kṣaumavastrāvaguṃṭhitām ||89 || patnīśālāṃ samānītā ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ || caṃdramā dīkṣayā yukta ṛṣigaṃdharvasaṃstutaḥ || 7.1.23.90 || auduṃbareṇa daṃḍena saṃvṛto mṛgacarmaṇā || atīva tejasā yuktaḥ śuśubhe sadasi sthitaḥ || 91 || tato brahmā mahādevi sarvalokapitāmahaḥ || ṛtvijāṃ varaṇaṃ cakre vedoktavidhinā tadā || 92 || gururhotā vṛtastatra vasiṣṭho'dhvaryureva ca || tatrodgātā marīcistu brahmatve nāradaḥ kṛtaḥ || 93 || sanatkumārasaṃyuktāḥ sadasyāstatra vai kṛtāḥ || vastrairābharaṇairyuktā mukuṭairaṃgulīyakaiḥ || 94 || bhūṣitā bhūṣaṇaughena tasminyajñe tadartvijaḥ || caturṣu tajjñāścatvāra evaṃ te ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ || 95 || prastotā kaśyapastatra pratihartā tu gālavaḥ || subrahmaṇyastathā gargaḥ sadasyaḥ pulahaḥ kṛtaḥ || 96 || hotā śukraḥ samākhyāto neṣṭā kratha udāhṛtaḥ || maitrāvaruṇo durvāsā brāhmaṇācchaṃsī kauśikaḥ || 97 || acchāvākaśca śākalyo grāvasthaḥ kratureva ca || prasthātā pratipūrvo yaḥ śālaṃkāyana eva ca || || 98 || agnīdhraśca manustatra unnetā tvaṃgirāḥ kṛtaḥ || evamādyānmaṇḍapeṣu kṛtvā tānṛtvijaḥ prabhuḥ || 99 || anyeṣu maṇḍapeṣveva pratyekamṛtvijaḥ kṛtāḥ || maṇḍapānāṃ śateṣveva kṛtvā kuṇḍānyakalpayat || 7.1.23.100 || ekaiko maṇḍapastatra viṃśahastapramāṇataḥ || astreṇāśodhya bhūmiṃ tu paṃcagavyena prokṣya ca || 101 || carmaṇā cāvaguṃṭhyaiva ālikhyāstreṇa pārvati || ullikhya prokṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā khātaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 102 || aṣṭau kuṃḍāni saṃkalpya tathaikamaṇḍape priye || lepanaṃ maṇḍape kṛtvā vajrākaraṇameva ca || 103|| caturasrakārmukaṃ ca vartulaṃ kamalākṛti || pūrvāṃ diśaṃ samā rabhya kṛtvā tāni prayatnataḥ || 104 || catuḥkoṇasamāyuktaṃ pūrve kuṇḍaṃ niveśya tu || bhagākṛti tathā''gneyyāṃ dakṣiṇe dhanurākṛti || || 105 || nairṛtye tu trikoṇaṃ vai vartulaṃ paścimena tu || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ caiva vāyavye padmākāraṃ tathottare || 106 || aiśānyāmaṣṭakoṇaṃ tu madhye caikaṃ vidhā nataḥ || pratyekaṃ maṇḍapaṃ śubhraṃ stambhaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiryutam || 107 || dhvajaiḥ satoraṇairyuktaṃ cakre brahmā vidhānataḥ || nyagrodhaṃ pūrvato nyasya dakṣe coduṃbaraṃ tathā || 108 || aśvatthaṃ paścime caiva palāśaṃ cottare kramāt || bāhudaṃḍapramāṇena dhvajāṃstatra niveśya vai || 109 || aindryādau pītavarṇādi patākā parikalpitāḥ || tato brahmā hyagnikuṃḍe cāgnisthāpanamārabhat || 7.1.23.110 || svasthāne brāhmaṇāṃścaiva jāpye caiva nyayojayat || śrīsūktaṃ pāvamānaṃ ca sadā caiva ca vājinam || 111 || vṛṣākapiṃ tathaindraṃ ca bahvṛcaḥ pūrvato'japan || rudrānpuruṣasūktaṃ ca krokādhyāyaṃ(?) ca vaikriyam ||112|| brāhmaṇaṃ paitryamaiṃdraṃ ca japeranyajuṣo yame(?) || devavrataṃ vāmadevyaṃ jyeṣṭhaṃ sāma rathaṃtaram || 113 || bheruṃḍāni ca sāmāni cchaṃdogaḥ paścime'japat || atharvātharvaśirasaṃ skambhastaṃbhamatharvaṇam || 114 || nīlarudramatharvāṇamatharvā cottare'japat || garbhādhānādikaṃ sarvaṃ tato'gnerakarodvibhuḥ || 115 || pūrṇāhutiṃ tato dattvā snānakarma tathā'rabhat || paṃcapallavasaṃyuktaṃ mṛttikābhiḥ samanvitam || 116 || kaṣāyaiḥ paṃcagavyaiśca paṃcāmṛtaphalaistathā || tīrthodakaiḥ sametaṃ tu maṃtraiḥ snānamathārabhat || 117 || netrāṇyutpādya devasya kṛtvā ca tilakakriyām || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni pātāle ca viśeṣataḥ || 118 || svarga loke ca yānyeva tatra tānyāyayustadā || etasminnantare brahmā devānāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā || 119 || bhūmiṃ bhittvā viveśātha tatra liṃgamapaśyata || sparśākhyaṃ taṃ tu saṃchādya madhunā darbhamūlakaiḥ || 7.1.23.120 || tatra brahmaśilāṃ nyasya tasyā ūrdhvaṃ mahāprabham || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa kṛtvā niścalamā tmavān || 121 || sthitvā ca parame tattve maṃtranyāsamathākarot || evaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tatra brahmā jagadguruḥ || pūjayāmāsa vidhinā vedoktairmaṃtra vistaraiḥ || 122 || mantranyāse kṛte tatra brahmaṇā lokakartṝṇā || tatra vipragaṇo hṛṣṭo jayaśabdādimaṃgalaiḥ || nirdhūmaścābhavadvahniḥ sūryakoṭisamaprabhaḥ || 123 || devadundubhayo neduḥ prasannāśca digīśvarāḥ || puṣpavṛṣṭiḥ papātoccaistasminyajñamahotsave || 124 || pratiṣṭhāpya tato liṃgaṃ śrīsomeśaṃ pitāmahaḥ || dāpayāmāsa viprebhyo bhūriśo yajñadakṣiṇām || 125 || sanatkumārapramukhairādyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ || dakṣiṇāmadadātsomastrīm̐llokānbrahmaṇe purā||126|| tebhyo brahmarṣimukhyebhyaḥ sadasyebhyastathaiva ca || dadau hiraṇyaṃ ratnāni koṭiśo bhūridakṣiṇāḥ || 127 || sobhiṣikto mahātejāḥ sarvairbrahmarṣibhistataḥ || trīm̐llokānbhāvayāmāsa svabhāsā bhāsatāṃ varaḥ || 128 || taṃ sinī ca kuhūścaiva dyutiḥ puṣṭiḥ prabhā vasuḥ|| kīrttirdhṛtiśca lakṣmīśca nava devyaḥ siṣevire || 129 || prāpyāvabhṛthamavyagraḥ kṛtvā māheśvaraṃ makham || kṛtārthaḥ paripūrṇaśca saṃbabhūva niśāpatiḥ || 7.1.23.130 || tatastasmai dadau rājyaṃ prājyaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ || bījauṣadhīnāṃ viprāṇāmavannānāṃ ca varānane || 131 || tasminyajñe samājagmurye kecitpṛthivīśvarāḥ || teṣāṃ rājyaṃ dhanaṃ bhogāndadau svargaṃ tathā'kṣayam || 132 || brāhmaṇānbhojayāmāsa svayamevauṣadhīpatiḥ || dadau sarvaṃ tadā teṣāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām ||| ||| 133 || hiraṇyādīnyadāccaiva mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || yo yadarthayate tatra sāmānyaḥ prākṛto janaḥ|| nijakarmānusāreṇa sa lebhe ca tadeva hi ||134|| evaṃ samarthite yajñe sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || sthāpayitvā tu liṃgāni jagmuḥ sarve yathāgatam || 136 || candramāstu punardevi brahmaṇā sahito vibhuḥ || liṃgamārādhayāmāsa prabhāse pāpanāśane || 136 || trikālaṃ pūjayāmāsa dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ || taṃ praṇamya ca deveśi stauti nityaṃ niśāpatiḥ || || 137 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvarapratiṣṭhāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<7.1.24>
|| devyuvāca || || kasminkāle jagannātha tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || kathamārādhanaṃ cakre kṛtārtho rohiṇīpatiḥ || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || tretāyuge ca daśame manorvaivasvatasya hi || saṃjāto rohiṇīnātho yukto durvāsasā priye || 2 || tasminkāle tadā tatra gate varṣasahasrake || tataḥ kṛtvā tapaścāyaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtaśaṃkaraḥ || 3 || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa brahmaṇā lokakartṝṇā || punarvarṣasahasraṃ tu pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram|| 4 || tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā nijakāryārthasiddhaye || stutiṃ cakre niśānāthaḥ pratyakṣīkṛtaśaṃkaraḥ || 5 || || caṃdra uvāca || nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ || nāsti śarvasamo devo nāsti śarvasamā gatiḥ || 6 || yaṃ paṭhaṃti sadā sāṃkhyā ścita yaṃti ca yoginaḥ || paraṃ pradhānaṃ puruṣaṃ tasmai jñeyātmane namaḥ || 7 || utpattau ca vināśe ca kāraṇaṃ yaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ tasmai jñānātmane namaḥ || 8 || yamavyayamanādyaṃtaṃ yaṃ nityaṃ śāśvataṃ dhruvam || niṣkalaṃ paramaṃ brahma tasmai yogātmane namaḥ || 9 || yaḥ pavitraṃ pavitrāṇāmādidevo maheśvaraḥ || punāti darśanādeva tasmai tīrthātmane namaḥ || 7.1.24.10 || yataḥ pravarttate sarvaṃ yasminsarvaṃ vilīyate || pālayedyo jagatsarvaṃ tasmai sarvātmane namaḥ || 11 || aniṣṭomādibhiryajñairyaṃ yajaṃti dvijātayaḥ || saṃpūrṇadakṣiṇaireva tasmai yajñātmane namaḥ || 12 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ sa saṃstute yāvaddivā rātrau niśākaraḥ || abravīdbhagavānprītaḥ prahasanniva śaṃkaraḥ || 13 || || śaṃkara uvāca || || parituṣṭo'smi te vatsa stotre ṇānena śītago || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te bhūyo yatte manogatam || 14 || || caṃdra uvāca || || yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho || sāṃnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa liṃge'sminsarvadā vibho ||15|| ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti cātrasthaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || teṣāṃ tu paramā siddhistvatprasādātsureśvara || || 16 || || śaṃbhuruvāca || || agre tu mama sāṃnidhyamasmim̐lliṃge mahāprabho || viśeṣato'dhunā caṃdra tava bhaktyā niraṃtaram || 17 || sthātavyamadyaprabhṛti kṣetre'sminnumayā saha || yasmāttvayā prabhā labdhā kṣetre'sminmatprasādataḥ || tasmātprabhāsamityevaṃ nāmāsya prabhaviṣyati || 18 || yasmātpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ tvayā soma śubhaṃ mama || somanātheti me nāma tasmātkhyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 19 || yanmamāgretanaṃ nāmakhyātaṃ brahmāvasānikam|| somanātheti ca punastadeva pracariṣyati|| drakṣyaṃti hi narā ye māmatrasthaṃ bhaktitatparāḥ || 7.1.24.20 || śṛṇu teṣāṃ phalaṃ vatsa bhaviṣyati niśākara || na teṣāṃ jāyate vyādhirna dāridryaṃ na durgatiḥ || na ceṣṭena viyogaśca mama caṃdra prabhāvataḥ || 21 || yātrāṃ kurvaṃti ye bhaktyā mama darśanakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || pade padeśvamedhasya teṣāṃ phalamudāhṛtam|| 22 || kiṃ kṛtairbahubhiryajñairupavāsairniśākara || sakṛtpaśyaṃti māṃ ye'tra te sarve lebhire phalam ||| 23 || ekamāsopavāsaṃ tu kurute bhaktitatparaḥ || yāvadvarṣasahasraṃ tu ekaḥ paśyaṃti māmiha || 24 || dvābhyāmapi phalaṃ tulyaṃ nāsti kācidvicāraṇā || 25 || eko bhavedbrahmacārī yāvajjīvaṃ niśākara || sakṛtpaśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam || 26 || eko dānāni sarvāṇi prayacchati dvijātaye || ekaḥ paśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam || 27 || eko vratāni sarvāṇi kurute mṛgalāṃchana || anyaḥ paśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam|| 28|| ekastīrthāni kurute japajāpyāni bhūriśaḥ || anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam || 29 || eko jñānādiyogena mumukṣurjāyate dhruvam|| anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam||7.1.24.3||| ekastu bhṛgupātena yāti mṛtyuṃ niśākara|| anyaḥ paśyati māmatra samaṃ tābhyāṃ phalaṃ smṛtam || 31 || ekaḥ snāti sadā māghaṃ prayāge narasattamaḥ || anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam 32 || ekaḥ piṇḍapradānaṃ ca pitṛtīrthe samācaret || anyaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam || 33 || gosahasraprado hyeko brāhmaṇe vedapārage|| ekaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam || 34 || pañcāgniṃ sādhayedeko grīṣmakāle sudāruṇe || ekaḥ paśyati māmatra phalaṃ tābhyāṃ samaṃ smṛtam || 35 || snātaḥ somagrahe candra somavāre ca bhaktitaḥ || yo māṃ paśyati sarveṣāmeteṣāṃ labhate phalam || 36 || sarasvatī samudraśca somaḥ somagrahastathā || darśanaṃ somanāthasya sakārāḥ pañca durllabhāḥ || 37 || nairaṃtaryeṇa ṣaṇmāsānvidhinā yaḥ prapūjayet || puṇyaṃ tadeva saphalaṃ labhate viṣuvārcanāt || 38 || etadeva tu vijñeyaṃ grahaṇe cottarāyaṇe || saṃkrāṃtidinacchidreṣu ṣaḍaśītimukheṣu ca || 39 || māsaiścaturbhiryatpuṇyaṃ vidhinā''pūjya śaṃkaram || kārttikyāṃ sa labhetpuṇyaṃ caitryāṃ taddviguṇaṃ smṛtam || puṇyametattu phālgunyāmāṣāḍhyāmevameva tu || 7.1.24.40 || eko dadyādgavāṃ lakṣaṃ dogdhrīṇāṃ vedapārage || eko mamārcayelliṃgaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ tato'dhikam || 41 || māsemāse ca yo'śnīyādyāvajjīvaṃ sureśvari || yaścārccayetsakṛlliṃgaṃ samametanna saṃśayaḥ || 42 || tapaḥśīlaguṇopete pātre vedasya pārage || suvarṇakoṭiṃ yaddattvā tatphalaṃ kusumena tu || 43 || arkapuṣpe'pi caikasmiñchivāya vinivedite || daśa dattvā suvarṇāni yatphalaṃ tadavāpnuyāt || 44 || arkapuṣpasahasrebhyaḥ karavīraṃ viśiṣyate || karavīra sahasrebhyo droṇapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 45 || droṇapuṣpasahasrebhyo hyapāmārgaṃ viśiṣyate || apāmārgasahasrebhyaḥ kuśapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || kuśapuṣpa sahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyate || 46 || śamīpuṣpaṃ bṛhatyāśca kusumaṃ tulyamucyate || karavīrasamā jñeyā jātīvijayapāṭalāḥ || 47 || śvetamaṃdāra kusumaṃ sitaṃpadmasamaṃ bhavet || nāgacaṃpakapunnāgadhattūrakusumaṃ smṛtam || 48 || ketakījātimuktaṃ ca kandayūthīmadantikāḥ || śirīṣasarjajaṃbūkakusumāni vivarjjayet || 49 || ākulīkusumaṃ patraṃ karaṃjendrasamudbhavam || bibhītakāni puṣpāṇi kusumāni vivarjjayet || 7.1.24.50 || kanakāni kadaṃbāni rātrau deyāni śaṃkare || devaśeṣāṇi puṣpāṇi divā rātrau ca mallikā || 51 || praharaṃ tiṣṭhate mallī karavīramaharniśam || kīṭakeśāpaviddhāni rātrau paryuṣitāni ca || 52 || svayaṃ patitapuṣpāṇi tyajedupahatāni ca || tulasī śatapatraṃ ca gandhārī damanastathā || 53 || sarvāsāṃ patrajātīnāṃ śreṣṭho marubakaḥ smṛtaḥ || etaiḥ puṣpaviśeṣaistu pūjyaḥ someśvaraḥ sadā || 54 || yātrāyāḥ phalamāpnoti svargaloke mahīyate|| etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ tatraivāntaradhīyata || 55 || candramā yakṣmaṇā muktaḥ svasthānanirato'bhavat || āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ prāsādaṃ paryakalpayat || śuddhasphaṭikasaṃkāśaṃ gokṣīradhavalojjvalam || 56 || prāsādaṃ merunāmānaṃ hemaprākāratoraṇam || caturdaśānye paritaḥ prāsādāḥ parikalpitāḥ || teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi pratyekaṃ tāni me śṛṇu || 57 || kesarī sarvatobhadro nadano nandiśālakaḥ || nandīśo mandaraścaiva śrīvṛkṣo hyamṛtodbhavaḥ || 58 || himavānhemakūṭaśca kailāsaḥ pṛthivījayaḥ || indranīlo mahānīlo bhūdharo ratnakūṭakaḥ || 59 || vaiḍūryaḥ padmarāgaśca vajrako mukuṭojjvalaḥ || airāvato rājahaṃso garuḍo vṛṣabhastathā || 7.1.24.60 || meruḥ prāsādarājā ca devānāmālayo hi saḥ || ādau pañcāṇḍako jñeyaḥ kesarīnāmataḥ sthitaḥ || 61 || caturthāṃśā ca tadvṛddhiryāvanmeruḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 62 || evaṃ pṛthakkārayitvā prāsādāṃśca caturdaśa || brahmādīnāṃ devatānāṃ samīpasthānavāsinām || 63 || daśa cānyānbhūdharādīnvṛṣabhāntānvarānane || ādau kaparddinaṃ kṛtvā prāsādānparyakalpayat || 64 || meruḥ prāsādarājo vai sa tu someśvare kṛtaḥ || tretāyuge tu daśame manovairvasvatasya ca || 65 || kārayitvā maṃḍapāṃśca pratiṣṭhāpya yathāvidhi || nadānāṃ tu śataṃ kṛtvā vāpīkūpa sahasrakam || 66 || gṛhāṇāṃ tu sahasrāṇi dīnānāthāśrayāṇi ca || kārayitvā vidhānena viprebhyaḥ pradadau pṛthak || 67 || niveśya nagaraṃ somaḥ śrīsomeśvarasannidhau || svakarmaṇāṃ pracārārthamathābhyarthayata dvijān || 68 || somo'smi bhavatāṃ rājā prasādātparameṣṭhinaḥ || tathāpi vinayenaiva bhaktyāṃ vijñāpayāmi vaḥ || 69 || dhanaṃ hiraṇyaratnādi dhānyaṃ vrīhiyavādikam || gomahiṣyādipaśavo vastrāṇi vividhāni ca || || 7.1.24.70 || kadalīnālikerāṇi tāṃbūlīpūgamālinaḥ || mano'bhirāmacaramā ārāmāḥ paritaḥ sthitāḥ || 71 || jaṃbūdvīpādhipāḥ sarve bhavatāmatravāsi nām|| ādeśaṃ ca kariṣyaṃti śirasyādhāya śobhanam ||72|| dvīpāṃtarādāgataiśca karpūrāgurucaṃdanaiḥ || anyaiśca vividhairdravyaiḥ saṃpūrṇā bhavatāṃ gṛhāḥ ||73|| paṇyānāṃ śatasaṃkhyānāṃ vyavahāranidarśinaḥ || brahmottarāṇi tanvaṃti vaṇijo lābhakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 74 || bhavatsu bhṛtyabhāvena varttamānā hitaiṣiṇaḥ || te cānye ca tathā paurā nāvasīdaṃti karhicit || 75 || evaṃ saṃpūrṇavibhavairbhavadbhiḥ śreyase mama || kratukriyā vitanyaṃtāṃ vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇāḥ || 76 || brahmādīni ca sarvāṇi pravartaṃtāmaharniśam || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇādīnāṃ kriyatāmārtināśanam || 77 || abhyāgatānāmaucityādātithyaṃ ca vidhīyatām|| tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena sametānāṃ mahātmanām || 78 || brahmarṣīṇāmāśrameṣu dīyatāmāśrayāḥ sadā || mayātra sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvakālaṃ dṛḍhavratāḥ || 79 || pavitrairupacāraiśca pūjayaṃtu dvijottamāḥ || aṣṭau pramāṇapuruṣāḥ paurāṇāṃ kāryadarśinaḥ || 7.1.24.80 || vyavahārānavekṣadhvaṃ smṛtyācāraviśāradāḥ || vyavasthāṃ matkṛtāmetāṃ bhavaṃto'tra dvijottamāḥ || 81|| dhārayaṃtu mahātmāno diggajā iva medinīm || evaṃ prabhutvamāsthāya sthāne'smiñchivaśālini ||82|| śrutismṛtipurāṇoktāndharmānācarata dvijāḥ || niśamya somasya vaco vinītamiti te dvijāḥ || 83 || uvāca kauśikasteṣu gotrāṇāṃ prathamo dvijaḥ || sādhūpadiṣṭamasmākaṃ dvijarājena sarvathā ||84|| sarvametatkariṣyāmaḥ kiṃtu kiṃcinniśāmaya || niyogataḥ pūjayatāṃ śivanirmālyasevinām || || 85 || pātityaṃ jāyate'smākaṃ śrutismṛtivigarhitam || śrutismṛtī hi rudrasya yasmādājñādvayaṃ mahat || 86 || kastadullaṃghayenmūḍhaḥ prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhaga tairapi || 87 || aṣṭamūrteḥ punarmūrttāvagnau devamukhe makhān || kurvāṇāḥ śrutimārgeṇa prīṇayāmo'khilaṃ jagat || 88 || jagadbhagavato rūpaṃ vyaktameta tpuradviṣaḥ || mitho vibhinnamityetadabhinnaṃ punarīśvarāt || 89 || agnau prāstāhutiḥ samyagādityamupatiṣṭhate || ādityājjāyate vṛṣṭirvṛṣṭerannaṃ tataḥ prajāḥ || 7.1.24.90 || śrutismṛtipurāṇādisadabhyāsaprasaṃginām || tattadartheṣu puṇyārthaṃ pravṛttākhilakarmaṇām || 91 || asmākamavakāśo'pi viralo liṃga pūjane || rudrajāpyairmahāyajñairyajānāścaivamīśvaram || 92 || yathākṣaṇaṃ yathākālaṃ liṃgaṃ vedamupāsmahe || yattu te'bhimataṃ soma śrīsomeśvarapūjanam || tacca saṃpādayiṣyāmaḥ saviśeṣaṃ mahāmate || 93 || yena tvadīpsitaṃ sidhyettamupāyaṃ niśāmaya || gaurīśaṃkarasaṃvādaṃ śrutvā bhagavato mukhāt || 94 || nāradaḥ prāha naḥ pūrvaṃ kathayāmastameva te || brahmadevadviṣaḥ pūrvaṃ śataśo daityadānavāḥ || tapobhirugrairvividhaiḥ śaṃkaraṃ pratipedire || 95 || teṣāmatyugratapasāmananyāsaktacetasām || prasādamīśvaraścakre kāruṇyāmṛtasāgaraḥ || 96 || sa hi tribhuvanasvāmī devadevo maheśvaraḥ || apekṣate varaṃ dātuṃ bhaktimevānapāyinīm || 97 || dadau sa bhuvanaiśvaryyaprāyānabhimatānvarān || teṣāṃ bhaktyaiva saṃtuṣṭo devabrahmadviṣāmapi || 98 || brahmaṇā viṣṇunā cāpi yasyāṃto nādhigamyate || tasyātarkyaprabhāvasya ko nu vedāśayaṃ prabhoḥ || 99 || durvṛttebhyo'pi daityebhyastapobhirvaradāyinam || papraccha svacchhṛdayā pārvatī parameśvaram || 7.1.24.100 || || pārvatyuvāca || || bhagavanprasādaṃ te prāpya dhṛṣyaṃto bhuvanatrayam || upadravaṃtīṃdramukhāndevānsaṃkṣobhayaṃti ca || 101 || varaṃ dadāsi kiṃ teṣāṃ tādṛśānāṃ durātmanām || jagataḥ svastaye yeṣāṃ na manāgapi ceṣṭitam || 102|| tvayā dattavarānetāndivyānbhogopabhoginaḥ || avadhīrya tavaiśvaryaṃ kathaṃ viṣṇurnihaṃti ca || 103 || hatānāṃ ca punasteṣāṃ kā gatiḥ syādvada prabho || 104 || || īśvara uvāca || || sāttvikā rājasāścaiva tāmasāśceti vai tridhā || bhavaṃti lokāsteṣvete tamaḥprāyā durāsadāḥ || 105 || suraiḥ saha spardhamānāstapobhirapi tāmasaiḥ || māṃ bhajaṃte muhurmohājjagadutsādanodyatāḥ || 106 || varaṃ dadāmi yatteṣāṃ bhaktistatra tu kāraṇam || ahaṃ hi bhaktyā sugrāhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || ||107|| taponurūpānāsādya varāṃste pāpakāriṇaḥ || viṣṇunā yannihanyate tacca devi nibodha me||108|| ahaṃ hariśca yadbhinnau guṇabhāgo'tra kāraṇam || paramārthādabhinnau ca rahasyaṃ paramaṃ hyadaḥ||109|| ārādhyārādhakādiśca bhedaḥ sāmānya eva nau|| tathā hyahamimāṃ gaṃgāṃ viṣṇoḥ pādāgraniḥsṛtām||7.1.24.11||| vahāmi śirasā bhaktyā tvadīkṣāśaṃkito'pi san || api viṣṇustribhuvanaṃ paritrātuṃ vyavasthayā ||111|| māmupāsya ciraṃ lebhe cakraṃ duṣṭanibarhaṇam|| tvāṃ ca tasya mahāmāyāmaprameyātmano hareḥ || 112|| ārādhayāmi tadbhaktyā trijagajanmakāraṇam || śirasyādhāya cānyāṃ me śaktirūpāṃ tathā hariḥ ||113|| ajo'pi janmānyāsādya lokarakṣāṃ karoti vai || haṃtuṃ hiraṇyakaśipuṃ narasiṃhavapuśca saḥ ||114|| jagajjighāṃsuḥ śamito mayā śarabha rūpiṇā || māṃ ca bāṇaparitrāṇe triśūlodyamakāriṇam || 115 || mānuṣye'pyavatāre'sau staṃbhayitvā sa līlayā || prabhāvaṃ mahimānaṃ ca varddhayanmāmakaṃ hariḥ || varivasyati māṃ nityamaṃtarātmāpi me vibhuḥ || 116 || athāhaṃ paramātmānamenamādyaṃtavarjitam || dhyānayogaiḥ samādhau ca bhāvayāmi niraṃtaram || 117 || tadevaṃ nāvayorbhedo vidyate pāramārthikaḥ || bhedaṃ ca tāratamyaṃ ca mūḍhā eva vitanvate || 119 || vaiṣṇavaṃ rūpamāsthāya durvṛttānhanmi tānaham || gatiṃ ca teṣāmadhunā maheśvari niśāmaya || 119 || mayi bhaktyavasāne tu hareḥ saṃdarśanena ca || krodhadarpābhibhūtatvānna muktiṃ prāpnuvaṃti te || 7.1.24.120 || āvayostu prabhāvena te punarddhautakalmaṣāḥ || brahmarṣīṇāṃ kule janma saṃprāptā muktihetukam || 121 || brahmacārivratā dūrdhvaṃ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ śritāḥ || prācīnakarmasaṃskārātte punarmāmupāsate || 122 || bhaktiyogena cāsthāya vrataṃ pāśupatādikam || śmaśānavāsino nagnā apare caikavāsasaḥ || 123 || bhikṣābhujo bhūtibhṛto malliṃgānyarccayaṃti te || tathā madekāgradhiyo maddhyānaikadṛḍhavratāḥ || 124 || ye tvāmapi namasyaṃti jagatāṃ mama ceśvarīm|| dehāvasānayogena muktiṃ teṣāṃ dadāmyaham || 125 || sārūpyasālokyamayīṃ mayyāveśitacetasām || sāyujyamuktaye nāyaṃ yogaḥ pāśupato yataḥ || smṛtyācāreṇa munibhiḥ sa sadbhistena garhitaḥ || 126 || || dvijā ūcuḥ || || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tāni hopagatāndvijān || svamānamupaneṣyāmo bhaktyāvarjjitamānasān || 127 || śucibhikṣānnakaupīnakamaṇḍalvādisatkṛtāḥ || ananyakāryyāḥ satatamihāgatya tapasvinaḥ || 128 || bhavatpradattairvividhairupahārairataṃdritāḥ || tattvatastattvasaṃkhyāste śivadharmaikatatparāḥ || 129 || śrīsomeśvaramabhyarcya tava śreyo'bhivarddhakāḥ || muktimaṃte gamiṣyaṃti devasyātisudurllabhām|| 7.1.24.130 || tato'nye'tha tato'pyanye tataścānye tapodhanā || parīkṣitāstu te'smābhirbhavitāro niśāpate || 131 || || dvijā ūcuḥ || || ityāha bhagavāndevyā pṛṣṭaḥ sa ca trilocanaḥ || tatraiva nāradaḥ sarvaṃ saṃvādaṃ śivaye rim(?)|| 132 || śrutvā naḥ kathayāmāsa kathāṃ goṣṭhīṣu pṛcchatām|| tava cāsmābhiradhunā sarvametadudīritam || 133 || evamuktastu taiḥ prītaḥ somaḥ svabhavanaṃ yayau || tadājñayā ca tatsarvaṃ yathoktaṃ te'pi kurvate || 134 || || devyuvāca || || evaṃ prabhāvo deveśaḥ someśaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ || kenopāyena tuṣyeta vratena niyamena vā || 135 || || īśvara uvāca || || kathayāmi sphuṭaṃ dharmmaṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ hitāya vai || sa yena tuṣyate devaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ surasundari || 136 || nityopavāsanaktāni vratāni vividhāni ca || tīrthe dānāni sarvāṇi pātre dattānyaśeṣataḥ || 137 || tapaśca taptaṃ tenaiva snātaṃ tenaiva puṣkare || kedāre tu jalaṃ tena gatvā pītaṃ tu niścitam || 138 || tena dṛṣṭaṃ varārohe jyotirliṃgaṃ mahāprabham || somavāravrataṃ divyaṃ yena cīrṇaṃ tu saṃśraye || 139 || kimanyairbahubhirdānairdattaiḥ pātreṣu sundari || 7.1.24.140 || pūjitaṃ yena bhāvena somavāradināṣṭa kam || tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ devi cīrṇaṃ tatra mahāvratam || 141 || itihāsamimaṃ pūrvaṃ kathayāmi tava priye || yathāvṛttaṃ mahādevi somavāravrataṃ prati || 142 || || īśvara uvāca || || kailāsasya maheśāni uttare ca vyavasthitā|| niṣadhopari vistīrṇā purī nāma svayaṃprabhā || || 143 || nānāratnasuśobhāḍhyā nānāgandharvasaṃkulā || sarvāvayavasaṃpūrṇā śakrasyevāmarāvatī || 144 || ghanavāhananāmā ca gandharvastatra tiṣṭhati || bhuṃkte tatra mahābhogāndevairapi sudurlabhān || 145 || navayauvanasaṃyuktā bhāryā tasya manoharā || prauḍhavākyā suśīlā ca pīnonnatapayodharā || 146 || tayā sārddhaṃ tu sambhogānbhuṃkte gaṃdharvanāyakaḥ || utpannā tasya kālena putrī putrāṣṭakopari || 147 || sarvāvayavasaṃpannā sarvavijñānavedinī || gaṃdharvasenā vikhyātā nāmnā sā parameśvari || 148 || kanyānāṃ tu sahasreṣu pravarā rūpaśālinī || kautūhalena sā pitrā proktā krīḍasva bhāmini || 149 || udyāne ramaṇīye'tra nānādrumalatākule || vṛkṣairanekaiḥ saṃkīrṇe phalapuṣpasamanvite || 7.1.24.150 || evaṃ sā ramate nityaṃ kanyāparivṛtā sadā || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā krīḍamānā mātā bhartāramabravīt ||151 || jīvitaṃ niṣphalaṃ svāminmama te saha bāṃdhavaiḥ || yasyedṛśī gṛhe kanyā tiṣṭhate bhartṛvarjjitā || 152 || ityuktaḥ sa tu gaṃdharvo bhāryāṃ vacanamabravīt || anveṣayāmi bharttāraṃ putryarthe tu manoharam || 153 || ityuktvā''hvāpa yāmāsa putrīṃ tāṃ ghanavāhanaḥ || āhūtā pitṛmātṛbhyāṃ tvaritā''gatya sundari || 154 || anukrameṇa sarveṣāṃ patitā pādayoḥ śubhā || ādeśaṃ dehi me tāta ki nu kāryaṃ mayā''dhunā || 155 || uktaṃ ca ghanavāhena harṣitena vacastataḥ || he putri tava yaḥ kaścidvaraḥ saṃprati rocate || divyaṃ drakṣye tvatsadṛśaṃ gaṃdharvāṇāṃ śiromaṇim || 156 || ityuktā krodhatāmrākṣī pitaraṃ vākyamabravīt || mama rūpasya koṭyaṃśe kiṃ kopyasti jagattraye || tacchrutvā cādbhutaṃ vākyaṃ pitā mātā ca mohitau|| 157 || sarve viṣādamāpannā bāṃdhavāśca pare janāḥ || aśobhanamidaṃ vākyaṃ kanyayā yatprabhāṣitam || ityuktvā tu gatāḥ sarve jananījanabāṃdhavāḥ || 158 || sā tatraiva mahodyāne ramate sakhisaṃyutā || hiṃḍolake samārūḍhā vasaṃte māsi bhāmini|| || 159 || tāvaddivyavimānasthaḥ śikhaṇḍī gaṇanāyakaḥ || gacchankhe dadṛśe kanyāṃ rūpaudāryyasamākulām || 7.1.24.160 || gītavādyena nṛtyena ramatīṃ dudubhisvanaiḥ || sa mādhyāhnikasaṃdhyāyāmavatīrya vimānataḥ || 161 || krīḍamāno'psarobhistu tatrodyāne sthitastataḥ || śuśrāva vākyaṃ kanyāyā gaṃdharvaduhitustadā || 162 || na ko'pi sadṛśo loke mama rūpeṇa dṛśyate || devo vā dānavo vāpi koṭyaṃśe mama rūpataḥ || 163 || iti vākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā gaṇaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ || śaśāpa tāṃ sucārvaṃgīṃ sāhaṃkārāṃ gaṇeśvaraḥ || 164 || || gaṇa uvāca || || māṃ dṛṣṭvā yadviśālākṣi rūpasaubhāgyagarvitā || samākṣipasi gaṃdharvāndevādyāṃścaiva garvitā || 165 || tasmātte garvasaṃyukte kuṣṭhamaṃge bhaviṣyati || śrutvā śāpaṃ tataḥ kanyā bhayabhītā tapasvinī || 166 || sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatyāthānugrahārthamayācata || bhagavanmama dīnāyāḥ śāpasyānugrahaṃ prabho || prayaccha tvaṃ mahā bhāga naivaṃ kartrī punaḥ kvacit || 167 || ityuktastava kāruṇyācchikhaṇḍī gaṇanāyakaḥ || anugrahaṃ dadau tasyā gaṃdharvaduhitustadā || 168 ||| || || śikhaṇḍyuvāca || || jātirūpeṇa saṃyukto vidyāhaṃkārasaṃpadā || yo yena garvitaḥ prāṇī sa taṃ prāpya vinaśyati || 169 || tasmādgarvo naiva kāryo garvasyaitatphalaṃ smṛtam || śṛṇuṣvānugrahaṃ bāle śrutvā caivāvadhāraya || 7.1.24.170|| himavadvanamadhyastho gośṛṃga ṛṣipuṃgavaḥ || kariṣyatyupakāraṃ sa evamuktvā gataḥ priye || 171 || tāvatsaṃdhyā samāyātā tatkṣaṇādbhuvanāṃtare || 172 || tato gaṃdharvvatanayā bhagnotsāhā natānanā || parityajya vanaṃ ramyamāgatā pituraṃtike || 173 || kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ kāraṇaṃ kuṣṭhasaṃbhavam || tacchrutvā śokasaṃtaptau pitarau vigataprabhau || 174 || himavaṃtaṃ giriṃ prāptau tvaritau sutayā saha || gośṛṃgasya ṛṣestatra dadṛśāte tathāśramam || 175 || tatra madhyasthitaṃ dṛṣṭvā gośṛṃgamṛṣipuṃgavam || praṇamya daṇḍavadbhūmau stutvā stotrairanekadhā || 176 || upaviṣṭogratastasya praṇipatya punaḥpunaḥ || provāca vacanaṃ tatra pūrvavṛttaṃ yathā'bhavat || 177 || kathite caiva vṛttāṃte punaḥ papraccha kāraṇam|| pṛṣṭe tu kāraṇe tatra gaṃdharvaḥ proktavāṃstadā || 178 || || gaṃdharva uvāca || || duhiturme śarīraṃ tu vyādhikuṣṭhenapīḍitam || yenopaśamanaṃ yāti tattvaṃ karttumihārhasi || 179 || prasādaṃ kuru viprarṣe mama dīnasya sāṃpratam || yathā kuṣṭhaṃ śamaṃ yāti mama putryāstu kāraṇam || || 7.1.24.180 || || gośṛṃga uvāca || || bhārate tu mahātejāstiṣṭhatyudadhisannidhau || devaḥ someśvaronāma sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || 181 || kṣaṇaṃ kṛtvā hi saṃpūjya ekāhāreṇa mānavaiḥ || sarvavyādhivināśāya sarvakāryārthasiddhaye || 182 || somavāravrateneśaṃ samārādhaya śaṃkaram || evaṃ kṛte vyādhināśastava putryā bhaviṣyati || 183 || || īśvara uvāca || || iti tadvacanaṃ śrutvā maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ || tatra gaṃtuṃ manaścakre someśārādhanaṃ prati || 184 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīsomeśvara varṇane somavāravratamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || || dha ||
<7.1.25>
|| īśvara uvāca || || sa gandharvastadā devi ārirādhayiṣurbhavam || somavāravrataṃnāma papraccha munisattamam || 1 || || gandharva uvāca || || kathaṃ somavrataṃ kāryaṃ vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛśam || kasminkāle ca tatkāryaṃ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 2 || || gośṛṃga uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahāprājña sarvasattvopakārakam || yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tadadya kathayāmi te || 3 || sarvarogaharaṃ divyaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || somavāravrataṃnāma sarvakāmaphalapradam || 4 || sarvakālikamādeyaṃ varṇānāṃ śubhakārakam || nārī naraiḥ sadā kāryaṃ dṛṣṭvādṛṣṭvā phalodayam || 5 || brahmaviṣṇvādibhirdevaiḥ kṛtametanmahāvratam || punastu somarājena dakṣaśāpahatena ca || 6 || ārādhito'nena śaṃbhuḥ śaṃbhudhyānapareṇa tu || tatastuṣṭo mahādevaḥ somarājasya bhaktitaḥ ||7 || tenoktaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si pratiṣṭhāstho niraṃtaram || 8 || yāvaccaṃdraśca sūryaśca yāvattiṣṭhaṃti bhūdharāḥ || tāvanme sthāpitaṃ liṃgamumayā saha tiṣṭhatu || 9 || sthāpitaṃ tu tadā tena prārthayitvā maheśvaram || ātmanāmāṃkitaṃ kṛtvā tato rogairvyamucyata|| 7.1.25.10 || tataḥ śuddhaśarīro'sau gaganastho virājate || 11 || tadāprabhṛti ye kecitkurvaṃti bhuvi mānavāḥ || te'pi tatpadamāyāṃti vimalāṃgāśca somavat || 12 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena vidhānaṃ tasya kīrttaye || yasminkasmiṃśca māse vā śukle somasya vāsare || || 13|| daṃtakāṣṭhaṃ purā brāhme kṛtvā snānaṃ samācaret || svadharmavihitaṃ karma kṛtvā sthāne manorame || 14 || susame bhūtale śuddhe nyasya kumbhaṃ suśobhitam || cūtapallavavinyaste caṃdanena sucitrite || 15 || śvetavastraparīdhāne sarvābharaṇabhūṣite || ādau pātre tu saṃnyasya ādhārasahitaṃ śivam || || 16 || aṣṭamūrtyaṣṭakaṃ dikṣu somanāthaṃ saśaktikam || umayā sahitaṃ tatra śvetapuṣpaiśca pūjayet || 17 || vividhaṃ bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca phalaṃ vai bījapūra kam || anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa sarvaṃ tatraiva kārayet || 18 || oṃ namaḥ paṃcavaktrāya daśabāhutrinetriṇe || śvetaṃ vṛṣabhamārūḍha śvetābharaṇabhūṣita || 19 || umādehārddhasaṃyukta namaste sarvamūrtaye || anenaiva tu maṃtreṇa pūjāṃ homaṃ ca kārayet || 7.1.25.20 || kṛtvaivaṃ ca dine rātrau paśyaṃścaivaṃ svapennaraḥ || darbhaśayyā samārūḍho dhyāyansomeśvaraṃ haram || 21 || evaṃ kṛte'ṣṭādaśānāṃ kuṣṭhānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet || dvitīye somavāre tu karaṃjaṃ dantadhāvanam || 22 || devaṃ saṃpūjayetsūkṣmaṃ jyeṣṭhāśaktisamanvitam || śatapatraiḥ pūjayitvā madhu prāśya yathāvidhi || 23 || nāraṃgaṃ tatra dattvā tu śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaret || evaṃ kṛte dvitīye tu golakṣaphalamāpnuyāt || 24 || somavāre tṛtīye tu apāmārgasamudbhavam || daṃtakāṣṭhādikaṃ kṛtvā trinetraṃ ca prapūjayet || 25 || phalaṃ ca dāḍimaṃ dadyājjātīpuṣpaiśca pūjayet || rajanyāmaṃguraṃ prāśya siddhiyuktaṃ tu pūjayet || 26 || caturthe somavāre tu kāṣṭhamaudumbaraṃ smṛtam || pūjayettatra gaurīśaṃ sūkṣmayā sahitaṃ tathā || 27 || nārikelaphalaṃ dadyāddamanena prapūjayet || śarkarāṃ prāśayedrātrau jāgaraṃ caiva kārayet || 28 || pañcame somavāre tu pūjayecca gaṇādhipam || vibhūtyā sahitaṃ devaṃ kundapuṣpaiḥ prapūjayet|| 29 || āśvatthaṃ dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca arghyaṃ vai drākṣayā tathā || mocaṃ ca prāśayedrātrāvaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 7.1.25.30 || ṣaṣṭhe somasya vāre tu surūpaṃ nāma pūjayet || karpūraṃ prāśayettatra bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 31 || saptame somavāre tu dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca mallikā || sarvajñaṃ pūjayettatra dīptayā sahitaṃ tathā || 32 || jambīraṃ ca phalaṃ dadyājjātīpuṣpaiśca pūjayet || lavaṅgaṃ prāśayettatra tasyānantaphalaṃ bhavet || 33 || aṣṭame somavāre tu amoghāyutamīśvaram || kadalīphalakenārghyaṃ marubakena pūjayet || rātrau tu prāśayeddugdhamagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 34 || gaṃgāsnāne kṛte samyakkoṭidhā yatphalaṃ smṛtam || daśahemasahasrāṇāṃ kurukṣetre ravergrahe || 35 || brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣe yaddattvā phala māpnuyāt || tatpuṇyaṃ koṭiguṇitamasminnācarite vrate || 36 || gajānāṃ tu śate datte lakṣe ca rathavājinām|| tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ somavāravrate kṛte || 37 || guggulordhūpanaṃ kṛtvā koṭiśo yatphalaṃ labhet || tatpuṇyaṃ tu bhavettasya somavāravrate kṛte || 38 || sarvaiśvaryasamāyuktaḥ śivatulyaparākramaḥ || rudraloke vasettāvadbrahmaṇaḥ pralayāvadhi || 39 || saṃprāpte navame vāre kuryādudyāpanaṃ śubham || yathā bhavati gandharva tathā vakṣyāmi te'dhunā || 7.1.25.40 || maṃḍalaṃ maṃḍapaṃ kuṇḍaṃ patākādhvajaśobhitam || toraṇāni ca catvāri kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || 41 || madhye vediḥ prakarttavyā caturasrā suśobhanā || niṣpādya maṃḍalaṃ tatra madhye padmaṃ prakalpayet || 42 || kalaśānaṣṭadigbhāge sahiraṇyānpṛthakpṛthak || sthāpayitvā tu śaktistā vāmādyāḥ pūrvataḥ kramāt|| 43 || karṇikāyāṃ tu padmasya śrīsomeśaṃ mahāprabham|| pratimārūpasaṃpannaṃ hemajaṃ śaktisaṃyutam || 44 || rukmaśayyāsamārūḍhaṃ manonmanyā samanvitam || hemapātrādike pātre madhunā paripūrite || 45 || rukmaśayyāsamācchanne tatrasthaṃ pūjayetkramāt || anaṃtādiśikhaṃḍyaṃtairnāmabhiḥ kramaśo'rcayet || 46 || gandhasragdhūpadīpaiśca naivedyaiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || vastrālaṃkāratāṃbūlacchatracāmaradarppaṇam || 47 || dīpaghaṃṭāvitānaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ ca satū likam || someśvaraṃ samuddiśya deyaṃ paurāṇike gurau || 48 || bhūṣayitvā tathā''cāryyaṃ homaṃ tatraiva kārayet || balikarmāvasāne ca rātrau tatraiva jāgṛyāt || 49 || pañcagavyaṃ tataḥ pītvā dhyāyetsomeśvaraṃ hṛdi || prabhāte tu tataḥ snātvā dhyāyettaṃ ca vidhānataḥ || 7.1.25.50 || tato bhaktyā ca gaṃdharva kṣīrakhaṇḍādinirmmitam || bhakṣyabhojyairanekaiśca bhojayedbrāhmaṇānatha || 51 || vastrayugmaṃ tato dattvā gāṃ ca dattvā visarjayet || 52 || evaṃ cīrṇavrataḥ samyaglabhate puṇyamakṣayam || dhanadhānyasamṛddhātmā putradārasamanvitaḥ || 53 || na kule jāyate tasya daridro duḥkhito'pivā || aputro labhate putrānvandhyā putravatī bhavet || 54 || kākavaṃdhyā tu yā nārī mṛtavatsā ca durbhagā || kanyāprasūśca yā kāryamābhiretadviśeṣataḥ || 55 || evaṃ kṛte vidhāne tu dehapāte śivaṃ vrajet || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi kalpakoṭiśatāni ca || bhuṃkte'sau vipulānbho gānyāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 56 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ somavāravrataṃ kramāt || gaccha śīghraṃ mahābhāga yatra someśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || 57 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktaḥ saca gandharvaḥ putryā saha varānane || sarvopahārasaṃyuktaḥ prabhāsakṣetramāśritaḥ || 58 || tatra someśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā ānandāśrupariplutaḥ || yātrākrameṇa saṃpūjya cakre somavrataṃ kramāt || 59 || putryā saha mahābhāgastasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ|| sarvarogavināśaṃ ca sarvakāmasamṛddhidam|| dadau gandharvarājyaṃ ca bhaktiṃ caivātmanastathā || 69 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye someśvaramāhātmyavarṇane gandharvakanyāvṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 || || cha ||
<7.1.26>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha labdhavarastatra kṛtārtho bhaktisaṃyutaḥ|| sthāpayāmāsa liṃgaṃ sa gandharvo ghanavāhanaḥ|| someśāduttare bhāge daṃḍapāṇisamīpataḥ|| gandharveśvaranāmānaṃ gāndharvaphaladāyakam||2|| varadāvāruṇe bhāge dhanuṣāṃ pañcake sthitam|| pañcamyāṃ pūjayitvā ca na duḥkhī jāyate naraḥ|| iti śrī skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gandharveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || cha ||
<7.1.27>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha tatraiva deveśi liṃgaṃ gandharvasenayā || sthāpitaṃ ghanavāhasya putryā gaurīsamīpataḥ || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ tritaye tatra sthitaṃ pūrvavibhāgataḥ || vimaleśvaranāmānaṃ sarvarogavināśanam || 2 || pūjayitvā tṛtīyāyāṃ daurbhāgyairmucyate'ṅganā || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti putrapautrapratiṣṭhitā || 3 || iti vrataṃ mahādevi tretāsaṃdhyāṃśake gate || gandharvasyaivamākhyātaṃ śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam|| 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gandharvaseneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 27 || || ||
<7.1.28>
|| devyuvāca || || ityāścaryamidaṃ deva tvattaḥ sarvaṃ mayā śrutam || mahimānaṃ maheśasya vistareṇa samudbhavam || sāṃprataṃ somanāthasya yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 1 || vidhinā kena dṛśyosau yātrā kāryā kathaṃ nṛbhiḥ || kasminkāle mahādeva niyamāścaiva kīdṛśāḥ || 2 || || || īśvara uvāca || || hemante śiśire vāpi vasante vātha bhāmini || yadā ca jāyate cittaṃ vittaṃ vā parva vā bhavet || 3 || tadaiva yātrā karttavyā bhāvastatraiva kāraṇam || kṛtvā tu niyamaṃ kaṃcitsvagṛhe varavarṇini || 4 || praṇamya manasā rudraṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ yathāvidhi || sthānaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā vāgyataḥ susamāhitaḥ || 5 || niyato niyatāhāro gaccheccaiva tataḥ pathi || kāmakrodhau parityajya lobhamohau tathaiva ca || 6 || īrṣyāmatsaralaulyaṃ ca yātrā kāryā tato nṛbhiḥ || tīrthānugamanaṃ puṇyaṃ yajñebhyo'pi viśiṣyate || 7 || agniṣṭomādiyajñaiśca iṣṭvā vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ || tattatphalamavāpnoti tīrthānugamanena yat || 8 || kaleryugaṃ mahāghoraṃ prāpya pāpasamanvitam || nānyenā'sminnupāyena dharmmaḥ svargaśca labhyate || vinā yātrāṃ mahādevi someśasya na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || ye kurvaṃti narā yātrāṃ śuciśraddhāsamanvitāḥ || kalau yuge kṛtārthāste ye tvanye te nirarthakāḥ || 7.1.28.10 || yathāmahodadhestulyo na cānyo'sti jalāśayaḥ || tathā prābhāsikātkṣetrātsamaṃ tīrthaṃ na vidyate || 11 || anupoṣya trirātrāṇi tīrthānyanabhigamya ca || adattvā kāṃcanaṃ gāśca daridronāma jāyate || 12 || yanyagamyāni tīrthāni durgāṇi viṣamāṇi ca || manasā tāni gamyāni sarvatīrthagatīpsunā || 13 || yasya hastau ca pādau ca manaścaiva susaṃyatam || vidyā tapaśca kīrtiśca sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 14 || niyato niyatāhāraḥ snāna| jāpyaparāyaṇaḥ || vratopavāsanirataḥ sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 15 || akrodhanaśca deveśi satyaśīlo dṛḍhavrataḥ || ātmopamaśca bhūteṣu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || 16 || kurukṣetrāditīrthāni rathagamyāni yāni tu || tānyeva brāhmaṇo yāyādānadoṣo na teṣu vai || 17 || ye sādhavo dhanopetāstīrthānāṃ smaraṇe ratāḥ || tīrthe dānācca yogācca teṣāmabhyadhikaṃ phalam || 18 || ye daridrā dhanairhīnāstīrthānugamaneratāḥ|| teṣāṃ yajñaphalāvāptirvināpi dhanasaṃcayaiḥ ||19|| sarveṣāmeva varṇānāṃ sarvāśramanivāsinām || tīrthaṃ tu phaladaṃ jñeyaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 7.1.28.20 || kāryāṃtareṇa yo gatvā snānaṃ tīrthe samācaret || na ca yātrāphalaṃ tasya snānamātraṃ phalaṃ bhavet || 21 || tīrthānugamanaṃ padbhyāṃ tapaḥparamihocyate || tadeva kṛtvā yānena snānamātraphalaṃ labhet || 22 || yasyānyaḥ kurute śaktyā tīrthayātrāṃ tatheśvari || svakīyadravyayānābhyāṃ phalaṃ tasya caturguṇam || 23 || tīrthānugamanaṃ kṛtvā bhikṣāhārā jiteṃdriyāḥ|| prāpnuvaṃti mahādevi tīrthe daśaguṇaṃ phalam || 24 || chatropānadvihīnastu bhikṣāśī vijiteṃdriyaḥ || mahāpātakajairghorairvipraḥ pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 25 || na bhaikṣaṃ parapākaṃ tu na ca bhaikṣyaṃ pratigraham || somapānasamaṃ bhaikṣyaṃ tasmādbhaikṣaṃ samācaret || 26 || loke'smindvividhaṃ tīrthaṃ svaccha ndairnirmmitaṃ tathā || svayaṃbhūtaṃ prabhāsādyaṃ nirmitaṃ daivataiḥ kṛtam || 27 || svayaṃbhūte mahātīrthe svabhāve ca mahattare || tasmiṃstīrthe pratigṛhya kṛtāḥ sarve pratigrahāḥ || 28 || pratigrahanivṛttasya yātrādaśaguṇaṃ phalam || tena dattāni dānāni yajñairdevāḥ sutarpitāḥ || 29 || yena kṣetraṃ samāsādya nivṛttiḥ paramā kṛtā || vastulaulyāddhi yaḥ kṣetre pratigraharucistathā || 7.1.28.30 || naiva tasya paroloko nāyaṃ loko durātmanaḥ || atha cetpratigṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo vṛttidurbalaḥ || daśāṃśamarjitāddadyādevaṃ tatra na hīyate || 31 || vipraveṣaṃ samāsthāya śūdro bhūtvā pratigraham || tṛṇakāṣṭhasamaṃ vāpi pratigṛhya patatyadhaḥ || 32 || kumbhīpākādikeṣvevaṃ mahānarakakoṭiṣu || yāvadiṃdrasahasrāṇi caturddaśa varānane ||33|| tasmānnaiva pratigrāhyaṃ kimanyairbrāhmaṇairapi || dviprakārasya tīrthasya kṛtasyāpyakṛtasya ca || 34 || svakīyabhāvasaṃyuktaḥ saṃpūrṇaṃ phalamaśnute || labhate ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ sa yaḥ parānnena gacchati || 35 || aśaktasya tathāṃdhasya paṃgoryāyāvarasya ca || vihitaṃ kāraṇāyānamacchidre brāhmaṇe kutaḥ || 36 || snānakhādanapānaiśca voḍhṛbhyastīrthasevakaḥ || dadatsakalamāpnoti phalaṃ tīrthasamudbhavam || 37 || na ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ yatnena labdhārthaṃ yadi yacchati || paṃcamāṃśamatho vāpi dadyāttatra dvijātiṣu || 38 || devatānāṃ gurūṇāṃ ca mātāpitrośca kāmataḥ || puṇyadaḥ samavāpnoti tadevāṣṭaguṇaṃ phalam || 39 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam || puṇyaṃ deyaṃ tu sarvatra nāpuṇyaṃ dīyate kvacit || 7.1.28.40 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ tīrthe bhrātaraṃ suhṛdaṃ gurum || yamuddiśya nimajjeta dvādaśāṃśaṃ labheta saḥ || 41 || kuśaistu pratimāṃ kṛtvā tīrthavāriṣu majjayet || yamuddiśya mahādevi aṣṭabhāgaṃ labheta saḥ || 42 || mahādānāni ye viprā gṛhṇanti jñānadurbalāḥ || vṛkṣāste dvijarūpeṇa jāyaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ || 43 || na vedabalamāśritya pratigraharucirbhavet || ajñānādvā pramādādvā dahate karma netarat || 44 || citikāṣṭhaṃ tu vai spṛṣṭvā yajñayūpaṃ tathaiva ca || vedavikrayiṇaṃ spṛṣṭvā snānameva vidhīyate || 45 || ādeśaṃ paṭhate yastu ādeśaṃ tu dadāti yaḥ || dvāvetau pāpakarmāṇau pātālatalavāsinau || 46 || ādeśaṃ paṭhate yastu saṃjighṛkṣuḥ pratigraham || tīrthe caiva viśeṣeṇa brahmaghnaḥ saiva netaraḥ || sthito vai nṛpaterdvāri na kuryādvedavikrayam || 47 || hatvā gāvo varaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayīta dvijādhamaḥ || varaṃ jīvansamaṃ matsyairna kuryādvedavikrayam || brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || 48 || varaṃ kuryācca taddevi na kuryādvedavikayam || tīrthe caiva viśeṣeṇa mahākṣetre tathaiva ca || 49 || dīyamānaṃ tu vai dānaṃ yastyajettīrthasevakaḥ || tīrthaṃ karoti tīrthaṃ ca sa punāti ca pūrvajān || 7.1.28.50 || yadanyatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tīrthe tadyāti lāghavam|| na tīrthakṛtamanyatra kvacideva vyapohati || 51 || tailapātramivātmānaṃ yo rakṣettīrthasevakaḥ || sa tīrthaphalamaskannaṃ vipraḥ prāpnoti saṃyataḥ || ||| 52 || yasyayasyātti pakvānnamalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu || tīrthagastasya tasyārdhaṃ snātasya viniyacchati || 53 || yo na kliṣṭopi bhikṣeta brāhmaṇa stīrthasevakaḥ || satyavādī samādhisthaḥ sa tīrthasyopakārakaḥ || 54|| kṛte yuge puṣkarāṇi tretāyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā || dvāpare tu kurukṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ kalauyuge || 55 || tiṣṭhedyugasahasraṃtupādenaikena yaḥ pumān || prabhāsayātrāmeko vā samaṃ bhavati vā na vā || 56 || etatkṣetraṃ samāgatya madhyabhāge varānane || yānāni tu parityajya bhāvyaṃ pādacarairnaraiḥ||57|| luṭhitvā loṭhanīṃ tatra luṭhitā yatra devatāḥ || tato nṛtyanhasangāyanbhūtvā kārpaṭikā kṛtiḥ || gacchetsomeśvaraṃ devaṃ dṛṣṭvā cādau kaparddinam|| 58 || īdṛśaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthitaṃ someśvaronmukham || nityaṃ tuṣyaṃti pitaro garjaṃti ca pitā mahāḥ || 59 || asmākaṃ vaṃśajo devaṃ prasthitastāraṇāya naḥ || gatvā someśvaraṃ devi kuryādvapanamāditaḥ || 7.1.28.60 || tīrthopavāsaḥ karttavyo yathāvadvai nibodha me || nāsti gaṃgāsamaṃ tīrthaṃ nāsti kratusamā gatiḥ ||61|| gāyatrīsadṛśaṃ jāpyaṃ homo vyāhṛtibhiḥ samaḥ || aṃtarjale tathā nāsti pāpaghnamaghamarṣaṇāt ||62|| ahiṃsāsadṛśaṃ puṇyaṃ dānātsaṃcayanaṃ param || tapaścānaśanānnāsti tathā tīrthaniṣevaṇāt ||63|| tīrthopavāsāddeveśi adhikaṃ nāsti kiñcana || pāpānāṃ copaśamanaṃ satāmīpsitakārakam || 64 || upavāso vinirddiṣṭo viśeṣāddevatāśraye || brāhmaṇasya tvanaśanaṃ tapaḥ paramihocyate || 65 || ṣaṣṭhakālāśanaṃ śūdre tapaḥ proktaṃ paraṃ budhaiḥ || varṇasaṃkarajātānāṃ dinamekaṃ prakīrtitam || 66 || ṣaṣṭhakālātparaṃ śūdrastapaḥ kuryādyathā kvacit || rāṣṭrahānistadā jñeyā rājñaścopadravo mahān || 67 || śūdrastu ṣaṣṭhakālāśī yathāśaktyā tapaścaret || na darbhānuddharecchūdro na pibetkāpilaṃ payaḥ || 68 || madhyapatre na bhuñjīta brahmavṛkṣasya bhāmini || noccaretpraṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ puroḍāśaṃ na bhakṣayet || 69 || na śikhāṃ nopavītaṃ ca nocca retsaṃskṛtāṃ giram || na paṭhedvedavacanaṃ trairātraṃ na hi sevayet || 7.1.28.70 || namaskāreṇa śūdrasya kriyāsiddhirbhaveddhruvam || niṣiddhācaraṇaṃ kurvanpitṛbhiḥ saha majjati || 71 || yenaikādaśasaṃkhyāni yaṃtritānīṃdriyāṇi vai || sa tīrthaphalamāpnoti naro'nyaḥ kleśabhāgbhavet || 72 || yacca tīrthe pitṛśrāddhaṃ snānaṃ tatra samācaret || hitakārī ca bhūtebhyaḥ so'śnīyāttīrthajaṃ phalam || 73 || dharmadhvajī sadā lubdhaḥ paradārarato hi yaḥ || karoti tīrthagamanaṃ sa naraḥ pātakī bhavet|| 74 || evaṃ jñātvā mahādevi yātrāṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || tīrthopavāsaṃ kṛtvādau śraddhāyukto dṛḍhavrataḥ || 75 || bhojanaṃ naiva kurvīta yadī ccheddhitamātmanaḥ || parānnaṃ naiva bhuñjīta taddine brāhmaṇaḥ kvacit ||76|| hastyaśvarathayānāni bhūmigokāṃcanādikam || sarvaṃ tatparigṛhṇīyādbhojanaṃ na samācaret || 77 || āmācchataguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhuñjato dadato'pi vā || tīrthopavāsaṃ kurvīta tasmāttatra varānane || 78 || vratī ca tīrthayātrī ca vidhavā ca viśeṣataḥ || parānnabhojane devi yasyānnaṃ tasya tatphalam || 79 || vidhavā caiva yā nārī tasyā yātrāvidhiṃ bruve || kuṃkumaṃ candanaṃ caiva tāṃbūlaṃ ca srajastathā || 7.1.28.80 || raktavastrāṇi sarvāṇi śayyā prāstaraṇāni ca || aśiṣṭaiḥ saha saṃbhāṣo dvivāraṃ bhojanaṃ tathā || 81 || puṃsāṃ pradarśanaṃ caiva hāsyaṃ tamasi varjayet || saśabdopānahau caiva nṛtyaṃ gatiṃ ca varjayet || 82 || dhāraṇaṃ caiva keśānāmaṃjanaṃ ca vilepanam || asatījanasaṃsargaṃ pāṃḍityaṃ ca parityajet || 83 || nityaṃ snānaṃ ca kurvīta śvetavastrāṇi dhārayet || yatiśca brahmacārī ca vidhavā ca viśeṣataḥ || 84 || tāṃbūlaṃ madhu māṃsaṃ ca surāpānasamaṃ viduḥ || eteṣāṃ varjjanāddevi samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet || 95 || || devyuvāca || || tapāṃsi kāni kathyante kṣetre prābhā sike naraiḥ || kāni dānāni dīyante keṣu tīrtheṣu vā katham || 86 || || īśvara uvāca|| || tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamiṣyate || dvāpare yajanaṃ dhanyaṃ dānamekaṃ kalau yuge ||87|| tapastapyanti munayaḥ kṛcchracāndrāyaṇādikam || gatvā prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ lokāścānye kṛte yuge ||88|| kalau dānāni dīyante brāhmaṇebhyo yathāvidhi || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapasāṃ prāpyate phalam || 89 || tulāpuruṣabrahmāṇḍapṛthivīkalpapādapāḥ || hiraṇya kāmadhenuśca gajavājirathāstathā || 7.1.28.90 || ratnadhenuhiraṇyāśvasaptasāgara eva ca || mahābhūtaghaṭo viśvacakrakalpalatābhidhaḥ || 91 || prabhāse nṛpatirdadyā nmahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || dhānyaratnaguḍasvarṇatilakārpāsaśarkarāḥ || 92 || sarpirlavaṇarūpyākhyā daśaite parvatāḥ smṛtāḥ || guḍājyadadhimadhvaṃbusalila kṣīraśarkarāḥ || ratnākhyāśca svarūpeṇa daśaitā dhenavo matāḥ || 93 || teṣāmekatamaṃ dānaṃ tīrthetīrthe pṛthakpṛthak || pradeyānyekavāraṃ vā sarasvatyabdhi saṃgame || 94 || sarvasvaṃ cātividuṣe gṛhaṃ vā saparicchadam || bahvalpamapi viprebhyo dātavyaṃ priyamelake ||95|| yatra tīrthe labhelliṃgaṃ tīrthaṃ ca vimalodakam|| tatrāgnikāryaṃ kṛtvādau viśiṣṭaṃ dānamiṣyate ||96|| tarpaṇaṃ pitṛdevānāṃ śrāddhaṃ dānaṃ sadakṣiṇam || tīrthetīrthe ca godānaṃ niyataḥ prakṛto vidhiḥ || || 97 || viśiṣṭakhyātaliṃgeṣu vṛṣadānaṃ vidhīyate || snānaṃ vilepanaṃ pūjāṃ devatānāṃ samācaret || 98 || jagatīṃ cārcayedbhaktyā tathā caivopalepayet || prāsādaṃ dhavalaṃ saudhaṃ kārayejjīrṇamuddharet || 99 || puṣpavāṭīṃ snānakūpaṃ nirmalaṃ kārayedvratī || brāhmaṇānāṃ bhūridānaṃ devapūjākarāya ca || 7.1.28.100 || sarvatra devayātrāyāṃ vidhireṣa pravarttate || tīrthamabhyuddharejjīrṇaṃ mārjayetkathayetphalam || 101 || prasiddhe ca mahādānaṃ madhyame caiva madhyamam || godānaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu suvarṇamatha niṣkrayaḥ || hiraṇyadānaṃ sarveṣāṃ dānānāmeva niṣkṛtiḥ || 102 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā labhate janmanaḥ phalam || tīrtheṣu dānaṃ vakṣyāmi yeṣu yaddīyate tithau || 103 || prabhāse pratipaddānaṃ dātavyaṃ kāṃcanaṃ śubham || dvitīyāyāṃ tathā vastraṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ ca medinīm || ||104 || caturthyāṃ dāpayeddhānyaṃ paṃcamyāṃ kapilāṃ tathā || ṣaṣṭhyāmaśvaṃ ca saptamyāṃ mahiṣīṃ tatra dāpayet || 105|| aṣṭamyāṃ vṛṣabhaṃ dattvā nīlaṃ lakṣaṇasaṃyutam || navamyāṃ tu gṛhaṃ dadyāccakraṃ śaṃkhaṃ gadāṃ tathā || 106 || daśamyāṃ sarvagaṃdhāṃśca ekādaśyāṃ ca mauktikam || dvādaśyāṃ suvratennādyaṃ pravālaṃ vidhivattathā || 107 || striyo deyāstrayodaśyāṃ bhūtāyāṃ jñānado bhavet|| amāvāsyāmanuprāpya sarvadānāni dāpayet || 108 || evaṃ dānaṃ pradattvā tu daśa kṛtvaḥ phalaṃ labhet || 109 || || devyuvāca || || bhaktidānavihīnā ye prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ || snānamantravihīnāśca vada teṣāṃ tu kiṃ phalam || || 7.1.28.110 || || īśvara uvāca || || sadhanā nirddhanā vāpi samaṃtrā maṃtravarjitāḥ || prabhāse nidhanaṃ prāptāḥ sarve yāṃti śivālayam || 111 || ye maṃtrahīnāḥ puruṣā dharmahīnāśca ye mṛtāḥ || teṣāmekaṃ vimānaṃ tu dadāmi sumahatpriye || 112 || snānadānānurūpyeṇa prāpnuvaṃti paraṃ padam || kecitsnānaprabhāvena keciddānena mānavāḥ || 113 || kecilliṃgapraṇāmena kecilliṃgārccanena ca || keciddhyānaprabhāvena kecidyogaprabhāvataḥ || 114 || kecinmaṃ trasya jāpyena kecicca tapasā śubhe || tīrthe saṃnyasanaiḥ kecitkecidbhaktyanusārataḥ ||115 || ete cānye ca bahava uttamādhamamadhyamāḥ || sarve śivapuraṃ yāṃti vimānaiḥ sūryasaṃnibhaiḥ || 116 || triśūlāṃkitahastāśca sarve ca vṛṣavāhanāḥ || divyāpsarogaṇākīrṇāḥ krīḍaṃte matprabhāvataḥ || 117 || evaṃ bhaktyanusāreṇa dadāmi phalamavyayam|| alepakaṃ prabhāsaṃ tu dharmādharmairna lipyate || 118 || dharmaṃ caraṃtyadharmaṃ vā śivaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 119 || janmaprabhṛti yo devi naro netravivarjitaḥ || mama kṣetre mṛtaḥ so'pi rudraloke mahīyate || 7.1.28.120 || janmaprabhṛti yo devi śravaṇābhyāṃ vivarjitaḥ || prabhāse nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ sa bhavenmatparigrahaḥ || 121 || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi tīrthānāṃ sparśane vidhim || mantreṇa maṃtritaṃ tīrthaṃ bhavetsaṃnihitaṃ tathā || |||122 || prathamaṃ cālabhettīrthaṃ praṇavena jalaṃ śuci || avagāhya tataḥ snāyādadhyātmamantrayogataḥ || 123 || oṃnamo devadevāya śitikaṇṭhāya daṃḍine || rudrāya vāmahastāya cakriṇe vedhase namaḥ || 124 || sarasvatī ca sāvitrī vedamātā vibhāvarī || saṃnidhānaṃ kuruṣvātra tīrthe pāpa praṇāśini || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ maṃtra eṣa udāhṛtaḥ || 125 || ityuccārya namaskṛtvā snānaṃ kuryādyathāvidhi || upavāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttasminnahani suvrate || 126 || sā tithirvarṣamekaṃ tu upoṣyā bhaktitatparaiḥ || 127 || || devyuvāca || || kasmiṃstīrthe naraiḥ pūrvaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāgataiḥ || snānaṃ kāryaṃ mahādevi tanme vistarato vada || 128 || || īśvara uvāca || || haṃta te saṃpravakṣyāmi ādyaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāprabham || pūrvaṃ yatra naraiḥ snānaṃ kriyate tacchṛṣuṣva me || 129 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tīrthayātrā vidhānavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || || cha ||
<7.1.29>
|| īśvara uvāca || || agnitīrthaṃ tato gacchetsāgarasya taṭe śubhe || yatrā'sau vāḍavo muktaḥ sarasvatyā varānane || 1 || dakṣiṇe somanāthasya sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ padmakaṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 2 || dhanvaṃtaraśate proktaṃ someśājjalamadhyagam|| kuṇḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ proktaṃ śatahastapramāṇataḥ || tatra snānaṃ prakurvīta vigāhya nidhimaṃbhasām || 3 || ādau kṛtvā tu vapanaṃ some śvarasamīpataḥ || śaṃkaraṃ manasā dhyāyankeśāṃstatra parityajet || samuttārya tataḥ keśānbhūyaḥ snānaṃ samācaret || 4 || yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ manuṣyo vṛttikarśitaḥ || tadeva parvatasute sarvaṃ keśeṣu tiṣṭhati || 5 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena keśāṃstatra vinikṣipet || tadeva somanāthāgre kṛtvā tu dviguṇaṃ phalam|| 6 || agnitīrthasamīpasthaṃ kaparddidvāramadhyagam || tatraiva dviguṇaṃ jñeyamanyatraikaguṇaṃ smṛtam || 7 || kṣurakarma na śastaṃ syādyoṣitāṃ tu varānane || sabhartṛkāṇāṃ tatraiva vidhiṃ tāsāṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 8 || sarvānkeśānsamuddhṛtya cchedayedaṃguladvayam || tato
