devānvidhānena tarppayetpitṛdevatāḥ||9|| muṇḍanaṃ copavāsaśca sarvatīrtheṣvayaṃ vidhiḥ || 7.1.29.10 || gaṃgāyāṃ bhāskare kṣetre mātāpitrorgurau mṛte || ādhāne somapāne ca vapanaṃ saptasu smṛtam || 11 || aśvamedhasahasrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ yaḥ samācaret || nāsau tatphalamāpnoti vapanādyacca labhyate || 12 || vinā mantreṇa yastatra devi snānaṃ samācaret || samāpnoti kvacicchreyo muktvaikaṃ parvavāsaram|| 13 || vinā maṃtraṃ vinā parva kṣurakarma vinā naraiḥ || kuśāgreṇāpi deveśi na spraṣṭavyo mahodadhiḥ || || 14 || evaṃ snātvā vidhānena dattvā'rghyaṃ ca mahodadhau || saṃpūjya puṣpagaṃdhaiśca vastraiḥ puṇyānulepanaiḥ || 15 || hiraṇmayaṃ yathāśaktyā nikṣipettatra kaṃkaṇam || 16 || evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu sparśayellavaṇodadhim || mantreṇānena deveśi tataḥ sāṃnidhyatāṃ vrajet || 17 || oṃ namo viṣṇuguptāya viṣṇurūpāya te namaḥ || sāṃnidhye bhava deveśa sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi || 18 || agniśca reto mṛḍayā ca deho retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ || etadbruvanpārvati satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāhettu patiṃ nadīnām || 19 || oṃ namo ratnagarbhāya mantreṇānena bhāmini || kaṃkaṇaṃ prakṣipettatra tataḥ snāyādyadṛcchayā ||7.1.29.20|| tataśca tarpayeddevānmanuṣyāṃśca pitāmahān|| tilamiśreṇa toyena samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ||21|| ājanmaśatasāhasraṃ yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ|| sakṛtsnātvā vyapoheta sāgare lavaṇāmbhasi||22|| vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ pravṛtte kṣurakarmaṇi|| ātmaprakṛtidānaṃ ca pītavastraṃ tathaiva ca||23|| anena vidhinā tatra samyaksnānaṃ samācaret || sparśayedvāḍavaṃ tejaścānyathā doṣabhāgbhavet || 24 || varaḥ śāpaśca tasyāyaṃ purā datto yathā dvijaiḥ ||| 25 || || devyuvāca || || kutra kutra mahādeva jalasnānādviśudhyati || kimarthaṃ sāgare doṣaḥ prāpyate kautukaṃ mahat || 26 || yatra gaṃgādayaḥ sarvā nadyo viśrāṃtimāgatāḥ || yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ śete yatra lakṣmīḥ svayaṃ sthitā || 27 || kimarthaṃ varaśāpaṃ tu tasya dattaṃ dvijaiḥ purā || sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi mahānme saṃśayo'tra vai || 28 || || īśvara uvāca || || dīrghasatraṃ purā devi prārabdhaṃ surasattamaiḥ || prabhāsaṃ tīrthamāsādya samyakchraddhā samanvitaiḥ || 29 || tataḥ satrāvasāne tu dattvā dānamanekadhā || sarvasvaṃ brāhmaṇendrāṇāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām || 7.1.29.30 || tāvadanye dvijāstatra dakṣiṇārthaṃ samāgatāḥ || deśīyāstatra vāstavyāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 31 || prārthanābhaṅgabhītāśca tato devāḥ savāsavāḥ || praṇaṣṭāstānsurāndṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāścānuvavrajuḥ || 32 || khecaratvaṃ purā devi hyāsīdagrabhuvāṃ mahat || tena yāṃti drutaṃ sarve yatra yatra surālayāḥ || 33 || evaṃ sarvatragāmitvaṃ teṣāṃ vīkṣya divaukasaḥ || praviṣṭāḥ sāgaraṃ bhītā ūcurvākyaṃ ca taṃ punaḥ || 34 || śaraṇaṃ te vayaṃ prāptā brāhmaṇebhyo bhayaṃ gatāḥ || nāsti vittaṃ ca dānārthaṃ tasmādrakṣa mahodadhe || 35 || ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samāptavaradakṣiṇāḥ || ekato bhayabhītasya prāṇinaḥ prāṇarakṣaṇam|| viśeṣataśca devānāṃ rakṣaṇaṃ bahupuṇyadam|| 36 || || samudra uvāca || || brāhmaṇebhyo na bhīḥ kāryā kathaṃcitsurasattamāḥ || ahaṃ vo rakṣayiṣyāmi praviśadhvaṃ mamodare || 37 || tataste vibudhāḥ sarve tasya vākyena harṣitāḥ || praviṣṭā gahvarāṃ kukṣiṃ tasyaiva bhaya varjjitāḥ || 38 || samudro'pi mahatkṛtvā nijarūpaṃ ca bhūriśaḥ || jalajāñjīvasaṃghātāndhṛtvā tīrasamīpataḥ || 39 || tataścakra upāyaṃ sa brāhmaṇānāṃ nipātane || matsyānāmāmiṣaṃ paktvā mahānnena ca gopitam || 7.1.29.40 || athovāca dvijānsarvānpraṇipatya kṛtāṃjaliḥ || prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ viprā muhūrttaṃ mama sāṃpratam|| 41 || ātithyagrahaṇādeva dīnasya praṇatasya ca || yuṣmadarthaṃ mayā samyagetatpākaṃ samāvṛtam || kriyatāṃ bhojanaṃ bhūyo gaṃtavyamanu nākinām || 42 || atha te brāhmaṇā matvā samudraṃ śraddhayānvitam || bāḍhamityeva taṃ procya bubhujuḥ svarṇabhājane || 43 || na vyajānaṃta tanmāṃsaṃ guptaṃ svādu kṣudhārdditāḥ || 44 || tatastṛptāśca te viprā brāhmaṇā vigatakṣudhaḥ || āśīrvādaṃ daduḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsita vratāḥ || 45 || bhojanāṃto brāhmaṇānāṃ prāṇāṃtaḥ kṣatrajanmanām || āśīviṣāṇāṃ sarpāṇāṃ kopo jñeyo mṛtāvadhiḥ || prerayāmāsa devānvai gamyatāmityuvāca tān ||46|| tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvā gacchaṃtaḥ śīghragā viyat || gacchatastāṃstato dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇāstatra vaṃditā || 47 || dakṣiṇārthaṃ samutpetuḥ surānuddiśya pṛṣṭhataḥ || 48 || tataḥ prapatitā bhūmau dvijāste sahasā punaḥ || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇātte vai brāhmaṇā māṃsabhakṣaṇāt|| 49 || niṣkṛtiṃ tāṃ parijñāya samudrasya ruṣānvitāḥ || daduḥ śāpaṃ mahādevi raudraṃ raudravapurddharāḥ || 7.1.29.50 || yasmādabhakṣyaṃ māṃsaṃ vai brāhmaṇānāṃ paraṃ smṛtam || tvayopahṛtamasmākaṃ suguptaṃ bhakṣyasaṃyutam || 51 || ekataḥ sarvamāṃsāni matsyamāṃsaṃ tathaikataḥ || ekataḥ sarvapāpāni paradārāstathaikataḥ || 52 || evaṃ vayaṃ vijānanto yadi māṃsasya dūṣaṇam || tathāpi vaṃcitāḥ sarve aparīkṣitakāriṇaḥ || 53 || yasmātpāpamate krūraṃ tvayā vai vañcitā vayam || māṃsasya bhakṣaṇāttasmādapeyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 54 || aspṛśyastvaṃ dvijeṃdrāṇāmanyeṣāṃ ca nṛṇāṃ bhuvi || tavodakena ye marttyāḥ kariṣyaṃti kubuddhayaḥ || 55 || snānaṃ te narakaṃ ghoraṃ prayāsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || kṛtaghnānāṃ ca ye lokā ye lokāḥ pāpakarmiṇām || 56 || tāṃstavodaka saṃsparśāllapsyaṃte mānavā bhuvi || 57 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ śaptaḥ samudrastairbrāhmaṇairvaravarṇini || tato varṣasahasraṃ tu hyaspṛśyaḥ saṃbabhūva ha || 58 || tatastrāsākulo bhūtvā sarvāṃstānidamabravīt || devakāryamidaṃ viprā mayā kṛtamabuddhinā || 59 || bubhūṣatā paraṃ dharmaṃ śaraṇāgatasaṃbhavam || kāmātkrodhādbhayāllobhādyastyajeccharaṇāgatam || 7.1.29.60 || satyādvāpi sa vijñeyo mahāpātakakārakaḥ || yuṣmadbhītyā samāyātāḥ svargiṇaḥ śaraṇaṃ mama || 61 || te mayā rakṣitāḥ samyagyathāśaktyā hyupāyataḥ || śoṣayiṣye'hamātmānaṃ yasmācchaptaḥ prakopataḥ || 62 || bhavadbhirnotsahe sthātuṃ janasparśavinākṛtaḥ || evamuktvā tato devi samudraḥ saritāṃpatiḥ || ātmānaṃ śoṣayāmāsa duḥkhena mahatā sthitaḥ ||63|| tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sthalākāraṃ mahārṇavam || śanaiḥśanaiḥ prapaśyaṃto bhayena mahatā'nvitāḥ || 64 || ūcurgatvā tu lokeśaṃ devadevaṃ pitāmaham || asmatkṛte dvijaiḥ śaptaḥ sāgaro brāhmaṇottamaiḥ || 65 || sa śoṣayati cātmānaṃ duḥkhena mahatānvitaḥ || samudrājjalamādāya pravarṣaṃti balāhakāḥ || 66 || tataḥ saṃjāyate sasyaṃ sasyādyajñā bhavaṃti ca || yajñaiḥ saṃjāyate tṛptiḥ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām || 67 || evaṃ tasya vināśena nāśo'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati || tasmāttvaṃ rakṣa taṃ gatvā yathā śoṣaṃ na gacchati || 68 || yathā tuṣyaṃti viprāste tathā nītirvidhīyatām || 69 || devānāṃ vacanādbrahmā gatvā sāgarasannidhau || samudrārthe yayāce tānbrāhmaṇānkṣetravāsinaḥ || 7.1.29.70 || || brahmovāca || || prasādaḥ kriyatāmasya sāgarasya dvijottamāḥ || yathā pavitratāṃ yāti madvākyātkriyatāṃ tathā || 71 || pradāsyati sa yuṣmabhyaṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || 72 || yūyaṃ bhaviṣyathātyaṃtaṃ bhūmidevā iti kṣitau || nāmnā madvacanānnūnaṃ satyametanmayoditam || 73 | || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || nānyathā kartumicchāmastava vākyaṃ jagatpate || na ca mithyā''tmano vākyaṃ pramāṇaṃ cātra vai bhavān || 74 || tanno vākyātsuraśreṣṭha hitaṃ vā yadi vāhitam || paraṃ syājjagatāṃ śreyaḥ sarveṣāṃ ca divaukasām || tathā kuru jagannātha asmākaṃ hitakāraṇam || 76 || athovāca nadīnāthaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ|| mā śoṣaya tvamātmānaṃ hitaṃ vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 76 || nānyathā śakyate karttuṃ dvijānāṃ vacanaṃ hi tat || brāhmaṇāḥ kupitā nūnaṃ bhasmīkuryuḥ svatejasā || 77 || devānkuryuradevāṃśca tasmāttānnaiva kopayet || yasmādeva tava sparśastridhā medhyo bhaviṣyati || 78 || parvakāle ca saṃprāpte nadīnāṃ ca samāgame || setubaṃdhe tathā siṃdhau tīrtheṣvanyeṣu saṃyutaḥ || 79 || ityevamādisarveṣu madhye'nyatra na karmaṇi || yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ tava toyasya sparśādeva bhaviṣyati ||7.1.29.80|| gayāśrāddhe tu yatpuṇyaṃ gograhe maraṇena ca || tatphalaṃ tava toyasya sparśādeva bhaviṣyati || 81 || apeyastvaṃ tathā bhāvi svādamātreṇa kevalam || gaṃḍūṣamapi pītaṃ ca toyasyāśubhanāśanam || 82 || bhaviṣyati nṛṇāṃ loke tava saukhyavivarddhanam || pitṝṇāṃ tava toyena yaḥ kariṣyati tarpaṇam || pūrvoktena vidhānena tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 93 || yāvattvaṃ tiṣṭhase loke yāvaccadrārkatārakāḥ || tavodakāmṛtaistṛptāstāvatsthāsyaṃti pūrvajāḥ || 84 || māghe māsi ca yaḥ snāyānnairaṃtaryeṇa bhāvitaḥ || pauṃḍarīkaphalaṃ tasya divasedivase bhavet || 89 || yātrāyāmathavānyatra parvakāle śaśigrahe || atra snāsyati yaḥ samyaksāgare lavaṇāṃbhasi || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpsyati mānavaḥ || 86 || śrīsomeśasamudrasya aṃtare ye mṛtā narāḥ || pāpino'pi gamiṣyaṃti svargaṃ nirdhūtakalmaṣāḥ || 87 || evaṃ bhaviṣyati sadā tava madvacanādvibho || prayacchasva dvijeṃdrāṇāṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || 88 || tena tuṣṭā varaṃ bhūyaḥ pradāsyaṃti tavepsitam || 89 || || īśvara uvāca || || pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā bāḍhamityeva sāgaraḥ || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ suratnāni dadau śraddhā samanvitaḥ ||7.1.29.90|| brāhmaṇairbrahmaṇo vākyamaśeṣaṃ samanuṣṭhitam || kṣurakarma tathā kṛtvā snānaṃ sarve'pi cakrire || 91 || evaṃ pavitratāṃ prāptastīrthatvaṃ lava ṇodadhiḥ || tasya madhye mahādevi liṃgānāṃ paṃcakoṭayaḥ || 92 || asminmanvaṃtare devi adṛśyāḥ sāgare kṛtāḥ || agnikuṇḍaṃ ca tatraiva tathānyatpadmakaṃ saraḥ ||93 || madhye tu prāvṛtaṃ sarvamasminmanvaṃtare priye || cakramainākayormadhye diśi dakṣiṇamucyate || 94 || śātakumbhamaye kumbhe dhanuṣāyutavistṛte || || tatra kuṃbhasya madhyastho vaḍavānalasaṃjñitaḥ || 95 || sūcīvaktro mahākāyaḥ sa jalaṃ pibate sadā || etadaṃtaramāsādya agnitīrthaṃ pracakṣate || 96 || tasya madhye mahāsāraṃ vāḍavaṃ yatra vai mukham || śrīsomeśāddakṣiṇato dhanvaṃtaraśatāvadhi || uttarānmānasātpūrvaṃ yāvadeva kṛtasmaram || 97 || etadgopyaṃ varārohe na deyaṃ yasya kasyacit || brahmaghnopi viśudhyeta śrutvaitannātra saṃśayaḥ || 98 || evaṃ śāpo varo dattaḥ sāgarasya yathā dvijaiḥ || pūrvaṃ ruṣṭaistatastuṣṭaistatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ mayā ||99 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye samudasyāpeyatākāraṇa varṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||29|| ||||
<7.1.30>
|| devyuvāca || || snātvā tatrāgnitīrtheṣu kaṃ devaṃ pūrvamarccayet || nirvighnā jāyate yena yātrā nṛṇāṃ sureśvara || tanme yātrāvidhānaṃ tu yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ snātvā vidhānena dattvārghyaṃ ca mahodadhau || saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca vastraiḥ puṣpāvalepanaiḥ || 2 || hiraṇmayaṃ yathāśaktyā prakṣipettatra kaṃkaṇam || tataḥ pitṝṃstarpayitvā gaccheddevaṃ kapardinam || 3 || puṣpairdhūpaistathā gandhairvastraiḥ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || gaṇānāṃ tveti mantreṇa arghyaṃ cāsmai nivedayet || 4 || śūdrāṇāmatha deveśi maṃtraścāṣṭākṣaraḥ smṛtaḥ || tatra someśvaraṃ gaccheddevaṃ pāpaharaṃ param || 5 || snāpayitvā vidhānena japecca śatarudriyam || tathā rudrānsapañcāṃgāstathānyā rudrasaṃhitāḥ || 6 || snāpayetpayasā caiva dadhnā ghṛtayutena ca || madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet || 7 || karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhiyutena ca || candanena sugandhena pūjyaṃ saṃpūjayettataḥ || 8 || dhūpairbahuvidhairdevaṃ dhūpayitvā yathāvidhi || vastraiḥ saṃveṣṭayetpaścāddadyānnaivedyamuttamam || 9 || ārārtikaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā nṛtyaṃ kuryādyathecchayā || aṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatyaivaṃ gītavādyādikaṃ tataḥ || 7.1.30.10 || dharmaśravaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kāryaṃ prekṣaṇakaṃ vibhoḥ || tato dadyāddvijātibhyastapasvibhyaśca śaktitaḥ || 11 || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ kārpaṭikeṣu ca || vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ pravṛtte krūrakarmaṇi || upavāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttasminnahani bhāmini || 12 || yasminnahani paśyeta devaṃ someśvaraṃ naraḥ || sā tithirvarṣamekaṃ tu upoṣyā bhaktitatparaiḥ || 13 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā labhate janmanaḥ phalam || tathā ca sarvatīrthānāṃ sakalaṃ labhate phalam || ||14|| uddharetpitṛvargaṃ ca mātṛvargaṃ ca bhāmini || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārdhakye yauvane'pi vā || 15 || kṣālayeccaiva tatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ naraḥ || na duḥkhito na dāridro durbhago vā na jāyate || 16 || saptajanmāntareṇaiva dṛṣṭe someśvare vibhau || dhanadhānyasamāyukte sphīte sañjāyate kule || 17 || bhaktirbhavati bhūyo'pi somanāthaṃ prati prabhum || kṣīreṇa snapanaṃ pūrvaṃ tato dhārāsamudbhavam || 18 || prathame prathame yāme mahāsnā namataḥ param || madhyāhne devadevasya ye prapaśyanti mānavāḥ || saṃdhyāmārārtikaṃ bhūyo na jāyante ca mānuṣāḥ || 19 || matvā kaliyugaṃ raudraṃ bahupāpaṃ varānane || nānyena tarate durgāṃ karmaṇā durgatiṃ naraḥ || 7.1.30.20 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye someśvaramāhātmye someśvarapūjāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśodhyāyaḥ || 30 || || cha ||
<7.1.31>
|| devyuvāca || || sakārapaṃcakaṃ proktaṃ yattvayā mama śaṃkara || kathaṃ tadatra saṃvṛttametanme saṃśayaṃ mahat || 1 || kathaṃ vātra samāyātā kutaścāpi sarasvatī || kathaṃ sa vāḍavo jātaḥ kasminkāle kathaṃ hyabhūt || tatsarvaṃ vistareṇedaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi yathā jātā tasminkṣetre sarasvatī || yataścaiva samudbhūtā sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 3 || hiraṇyā vajriṇī nyaṃkuḥ kapilā ca sarasvatī || 4 || ṛṣibhiḥ pañcabhiścātra samāhūtā yathā purā || vāḍavenāgninā yuktā yathā jātā śṛṇuṣva tat || 5 || purā devāsure yuddhe nivṛtte somakāraṇāt || pitāmahasya vacanāttārāṃ candraḥ samarpayat || 6 || tato yātāḥ surāḥ svargaṃ paśyanto'dhomukhā mahīm || dadṛśuste tato devā bhūmyāṃ svargamivāparam || 7 || āśramaṃ munimukhyasya dadhīcerloka viśrutam || sarvarttukusumopetaṃ pādapairupaśobhitam || ketakīkuṭajodbhūta bakulāmodamoditam || 8 || evaṃvidhaṃ samāsādya tadāśramapadaṃ guru || kautukāddraṣṭumārabdhāḥ sarve devā manoramam || 9 || te ca tīrthāśrame tasminyānānyutsṛjya saṃyatāḥ || pravṛttāstamṛṣiṃ draṣṭuṃ prākṛtāḥ puruṣā yathā || 7.1.31.10 || dṛṣṭavaṃtaḥ surāḥ sarve pitāmahamivāparam || tatasta ṛṣiṇā sarve pādyārghyādibhirarccitāḥ || 11 || yathoktamāsanaṃ bhejuḥ sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || teṣāṃ madhye samutthāya śakraḥ provāca taṃ munim || 12 || āyudhāni vimucyāgre bhavāngṛhṇātvimāni hi || tanniśamya vacaḥ prāha dadhīciḥ pākaśāsanam || 13 || muktāstrāṇi mamābhyāśe yūyaṃ yāta triviṣṭapam || taṃ śakraḥ prāha caitāni kāryakāle hyupasthite || 14 || deyāni te punaḥ śatrūnabhijeṣyāmahe raṇe || punaḥpunastataḥ śakraḥ saṃdiśya munisattamam || 15 || asmākameva deyāni na cānyasya tvayā mune|| bāḍhamityudite śakramuktavānmunisattamaḥ||16|| dāsyāmi te samastāni yuddhakāle viśeṣataḥ|| nāsya mithyā bhavedvākyamiti matvā śacīpatiḥ|| muktvāstrāṇi tadabhyāśe punaḥ svargaṃ gatastadā||17|| astrārpaṇaṃ yaḥ prayataḥ prayatnācchṛṇoti rājā bhuvi bhāvitātātmā || so'bhyeti yuddhe vijayaṃ paraṃ hi sutāṃśca dharmārthayaśobhirāmāḥ || 18 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhā sakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vaḍavānalotpattivṛttānte dadhīcimaharṣaye sarvadevakṛtasvasvaśastrasamarpaṇavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśodhyāyaḥ|| 31 ||
<7.1.32>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatasteṣu prayāteṣu devadeveṣvasau muniḥ || śatavarṣāṇi tatrasthastapase prasthito dvijaḥ || 1 || āśramāduttarāttasmāddivyāṃ diśamatho ttarām|| subhadrāpi mahābhāgā tasya yā paricārikā || 2 || astrādāne'samarthā sā ṛṣiṃ provāca bhāminī || nāhaṃ netuṃ samarthāsmi śastrāṇyālabhya pāṇinā ||3|| jalena saha tadvīryaṃ pītavānsa ṛṣistataḥ || ātmasaṃsthāni sarvāṇi divyānyastrāṇyasau muniḥ || kārayitvottarāmāśāṃ jagāma tapasāṃ nidhiḥ || 4 || gaṃgādharaṃ śuklatanuṃ sarppairākīrṇavigraham || śivavatsukhadaṃ puṃsāmapaśyatsa himācalam || 5 || tathāśramaṃ dadarśoccairaśvatthaiḥ paripālitam || caṃdrabhāgopakaṃṭhasthaṃ samitpuṣpakuśānvitam || 6 || sa tasminmuniśādūlo hyavasanmunibhiḥ saha || subhadrayā ca saṃyuktaścaṃdraścaṃdrikayā yathā || 7 || ekadā vasatastasya subhadrā paricārikā || snānārthaṃ yātumārabdhā caturthe'hni rajasvalā || 8 || vrajantyā ca tayā dṛṣṭaṃ kaupīnācchādanaṃ punaḥ || pari tyaktaṃ viditvaivaṃ daivayogādgṛhāṇa sā || 9 || paridhāya punaḥ sā tu kaupīnaṃ retasāyutam || ekāṃte snātumārabdhā jalābhyāśe yathāsukham || 7.1.32.10 || tato devī yathākāmamakasmādvīkṣate hi sā || svodarasthaṃ samutpannaṃ garbhaṃ gurubharālasā || 11 || śocayitvātmanātmānamagarbhāhamihāgatā || tatkena mandabhāginyā mamaivaṃ dūṣaṇaṃ kṛtam|| 12 || lajjābhibhūtā sā tatra praviśyāśvatthavāṭikām || tatra taṃ suṣuve garbhamavijñāya kuto hyayam || 13 || punareva hi sā snātvā avijñāyātmaduṣkṛtam|| śāpaṃ dātuṃ samārabdhā garbhakarttari duḥsaham || 14 || jñānādvā yadi vājñānādyeneyaṃ dūṣaṇā kṛtā || so'dyaiva paṃcatāṃ yātu yadyahaṃ syāṃ pativratā || 15 || yadyahaṃ manasā vāpi kāmaye nāparaṃ patim || etena satyavākyena yātu jāraḥ svayaṃ kṣayam || || 16 || evaṃ śaptvā tu taṃ devī hyajñātvā garbhakāriṇam || punaryātuṃ samārabdhā taddadhīciniketanam || 17 || tatra cārkapratīkāśaṃ garbhamutsṛjya sā tadā || prāptā tapovanaṃ ramyaṃ yatrāsau munipuṃgavaḥ || 18 || atrāṃtare sarvadevā lokapālā mahābalāḥ || astrāṇāṃ kāraṇārthāya munerāśramamāgatāḥ || || 19 || uvāca taṃ muniṃ śakro nyāso yastava suvrata || datto'smābhistu śastrāṇāṃ tāni kṣipraṃ prayaccha naḥ || 7.1.32.20 || ṛṣirāha purā yatra sthāpi tāni mamāśrame || tatraiva tāni tiṣṭhaṃti na cānītāni vāsava || 21 || yattu teṣāṃ balaṃ vīryaṃ saṃgrāme śatrusūdana || tanmayā pītamakhilaṃ saha toyena vāsava || 22|| evaṃ sthite mayā'strāṇi yadi deyāni te'nagha || tatosthīni prayacchāmi tadākārāṇi suvrata || 23 || evamuktaḥ sahasrākṣastamāha munisattamam || nānyeṣu tadbalaṃ raudraṃ yattu teṣu vyavasthitam || 24 || yasmātteṣu vinikṣipya sahasrāṃśaṃ svatejasām || asmākaṃ dattavānrudro rakṣārthaṃ jagatāṃ śivaḥ || 25 || tadvayaṃ tāni sarvāṇi gṛhītvā ca vyavasthitāḥ || lokasya rakṣaṇārthāya saṃjñeyaṃ tena lokapāḥ || 26 || amīṣāmapi śastrāṇā muttamaṃ vajramiṣyate || taddhāraṇādyato'smākaṃ devarājatvamiṣyate || 27 || vajrādapyuttamaṃ cakraṃ yattadviṣṇuparigrahe || daityadānavasaṃghānāṃ tadāyatto jayo'bhavat || 28 || tasmāttāni yathāsmābhiḥ prāpyate munisattama || tathā kuruṣva saṃcintya kāryaṃ kāryavidāṃ vara || 29 || evamukte muniḥ prāha taṃ śakraṃ purataḥ sthitam || tatprāptyarthamupāyaṃ tu kathayāmi tavāparam || 7.1.32.30 || yānyetāni mamāsthīni yūyaṃ taistāni sarvaśaḥ || nirmāpayadhvaṃ śastrāṇi tadākārāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 31 || etāni tatsamutthāni teṣāmapyadhikaṃ balam || sādhayiṣyati bhavatāṃ saṃgrāme yanmamehitam || || 32 || tamuvāca tataḥ śakro dadhīciṃ tapasonidhim || prāṇahāraṃ prakartuṃ te nāhaṃ śakto yamicchasi || 33 || na cāmṛtasya te'sthīni grahītuṃ śaktirasti naḥ || tasmātsarvaṃ samālocya yatkartavyaṃ taducyatām || 34 || evamukto muniḥ prāha etadeva kalevaram || tyajāmi svayamevāhaṃ deva kāryārthasiddhaye || 35 || adhruvaṃ sarvaduḥkhānāmāśrayaṃ sujugupsitam || yadā hyetattadā yuktaḥ parityāgo'sya sāṃpratam || 36 || asya tyāgena me duḥkhaṃ saṃsārotthaṃ na jāyate || yasmājjanmāṃtare jāto mṛtopi hi bhavetpunaḥ || 37 || bhāryā bhaginī duhitā svakarmaphalayojanāt || jātā tenaiva saṃsāre ratikārye jugupsitā || 38 || yasmācca svayamevaitadvapustyajati vai dhruvam || tasmādasya parityāgo varaḥ kāryo'cirātsvayam || 39 ||| evaṃ puraṃdarasyāgre saṃkīrtya sa mahāmuniḥ || dadhīciḥ prāṇasaṃhāraṃ kṛtavānsatvaraṃ tadā || 7.1.32.40 || gatāsuṃ taṃ viditvaivaṃ vibudhāstatkalevaram|| māṃ saśoṇitanirmuktaṃ kathaṃ kāryaṃ vyaciṃtayan || 41 || tatastadasthiśuddhyarthamuvācedaṃ sureśvaraḥ || gaurīṇāṃ karkaśā jihvā tā etadutkhidaṃtviti || 42 || tatastairvibudhairnaṃdā yadā lokeṣu saṃsthitā|| dhyātā tadopayātā sā sakhībhiḥ parivāritā||43|| naṃdā subhadrā surabhiḥ suśīlā sumanāstathā|| iti gomātaraḥ paṃca golokācca samāgatāḥ||44|| ūcustānvibudhānsarvānasmābhiryatprayojanam|| karttavyaṃ tatkariṣyāmaḥ kathyatāṃ suvicāritam|| 45|| devā ūcuḥ|| yadetadṛṣiṇā tyaktaṃ svayameva kalevaram|| etanmāṃsādinirmuktaṃ kriyatāmasthipaṃjaram||46|| tatkṛtvā garhitaṃ karma devādeśātsudāruṇam || punaḥ pitāmahaṃ draṣṭuṃ gatāstāḥ surasattamāḥ || 47 || tatastu dāruṇaṃ karma yacca tābhiranuṣṭhitam || pitāmahasya tatsarvaṃ samācakhyuryathātatham || 48 || tacchrutvā vibudhānsarvānsamāhūya pitāmahaḥ || sarvagātreṣvaspṛśata surabhīḥ śuddhikāmyayā || 49 || tāstu tairvibudhaiḥ spṛṣṭāḥ supūtāḥ samavasthitāḥ || mukhamekaṃ paraṃ tāsāṃ na spṛṣṭamaśuci smṛtam || 7.1.32.50 || apavitraṃ bhavettāsāṃ mukhamekaṃ jugupsitam || śeṣaṃ śarīraṃ sarvāsāṃ viśiṣṭaṃ tu suraiḥ kṛtam || 51 || sarasvatyā tu tāḥ proktā bhavaṃtyo brahmaghātikāḥ || anyathā kāraṇātkasmānna spṛṣṭamamarairmukham || 52 || tatastābhistu sā proktā devī tatra sarasvatī || naitatte vacanaṃ yuktaṃ vaktumevaṃvidhaṃ mukham || 53 || asmākameva hṛdayamanena vacasā tvayā || nirdagdhaṃ yena tasmāttvamacirāddāhamāpsyasi || 54 || śāpaṃ dattvā tatastasyāḥ sarasvatyāstu tāstadā || golokaṃ gatavatyastu surabhyaḥ surapūjitāḥ || 55 || āhūya viśvakarmāṇaṃ takṣāṇaṃ surasattamāḥ || asmākaṃ kuru śastrāṇi tamāhuryuddhakāraṇāt || 56 || etadvacanamākarṇya tāni pūtairnavairdṛḍhaiḥ ||| astrāṇi kārayāmāsa dardhocerasthisaṃcayaiḥ || 57 || pramāṇākārayuktāni devānāṃ tāni saṃyuge || ajeyāni yathā cāsaṃstathā cāsau vinirmame ||| || 58 || vajramiṃdrasya śaktiṃ ca vahnerdaṃḍaṃ yamasya ca || khaḍgaṃ tu niṛteḥ pāśaṃ samyakcakre pracetasaḥ ||59|| vāyordhvajaṃ kuberasya gadāṃ gurvīṃ ca nirmame || viśvakarmā tathā śūlamīśānasya ca nirmame || 7.1.32.60 || gṛhītvaitāni vai devāḥ śastrāṇyastrabalaṃ tadā || vijetuṃ ca tato daityāndānavāṃśca gatāstadā || ||| 61 || atrāṃtare subhadrāpi dadhīceraurdhvadaihikam || kṛtvā tairmunibhiḥ sārdhamanveṣṭuṃ sā gatā sutam || 62 || aśvatthavāṭikāyāṃ ca tamapaśya nmanoramam || dṛṣṭvā roditi jīvaṃtaṃ muktvā bāṣpamathāciram || 63 || aṃbetyābhāṣya tenoktā mā rodīstvaṃ yaśasvini || sarvaṃ purākṛtasyaitatphalaṃ tava mamāpi hi || 64 || yadyathā yatra yeneha karma janmāṃtarārjitam || tadavaśyaṃ hi bhoktavyaṃ tyaja śokamato'khilam || 65 || matparityāgalajjā ca na te kāryeha sundari || phalaṃ purākṛtasyaitadbhoktavyaṃ tanmayāpi hi || 66 || mātarmamopari kuru putrasnehaṃ yaśasvini || bālasya hi parityāgā nmātā doṣeṇa lipyate || 57 || bālenābhihitā sā tu dhyātvā devaṃ janārddanam || kṛtāṃjaliruvācedaṃ kathyatāṃ me suniścitam || 68 || na vijānāmyahaṃ tathyaṃ kasyāyaṃ vīryasaṃbhavaḥ || tasmātkathaya deveśa mama te niścitaṃ vacaḥ || 69 || āhokte mātaraṃ kṛṣṇaḥ subhadrāṃ vai janārddanaḥ || dadhīcestana yaścāyaṃ bhartuste kṣetrasaṃbhavaḥ || 7.1.32.70 || tasyotpattiṃ viditvaivaṃ subhadrā hṛṣṭamānasā || bālamaṃke samāropya arodīdārtayā girā || 71 || āha bālaka utpannaḥ śokasya vada kāraṇam|| athoktaḥ stanyarahitaṃ kathaṃ te jīvitaṃ dhṛtam || 72 || yasmāccaturvidhā sṛṣṭirjīvānāṃ brahmaṇā kṛtā || jarāyujāṃḍajodbhijja svedajāśca tathā smṛtāḥ || 73 || narastrīnapuṃsakākhyāśca jātibhedā jarāyujāḥ || catuṣpadāśca paśavo grāmyāścāraṇyajāstathā || 74 || aṇḍajāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ sarve mīnāḥ kūrmasarīsṛpāḥ || svedajā matkuṇā yūkā daṃśāśca maśakāstathā || 75 || udbhijjāḥ sthāvarāḥ proktāstṛṇagulmalatā dayaḥ || anye'pyevaṃ yathāyogamaṃtarbhūtāḥ sahasraśaḥ || 76 || aṇḍajāḥ pakṣapātena jīvaṃti śiśavo bhuvi || ūṣmaṇā svedajāḥ sarve udbhijjāḥ salilena hi || 77 || samudāyena bhūtānāṃ pañcānāmudbhijaṃ bhuvi || jarāyujāśca stanyena vinā jīvitumakṣamāḥ || 78 || vinā tena kathaṃ putra tvayā prāṇā vidhāritāḥ || tāṃ tathā jananīṃ prāha sa ca bāṣpāvilekṣaṇām||79|| aśvatthaphalaniryāsapānātprāṇā mayā dhṛtāḥ || gauṇaṃ tadā tayā tasya pippalādeti kalpi tam ||7.1.32.80|| nāma tena jagatyasminnityaṃ khyātaṃ mahātmanaḥ || tatrasthairmunibhistasya kṛtāḥ sarvairyathākramam ||81|| saṃskārāḥ pippalādasya vedoktā veda pāragaiḥ|| ṣaḍaṃgopāṃgasaṃyuktā vedāstena samuddhṛtāḥ || tadāśramanivāsibhyo munibhyaśca supuṣkalāḥ ||82|| punastatra sthitaścāsau dṛṣṭvā munikumārakān|| svapitraṃkagatānprāha jananīṃ tāṃ śucismitām ||83|| pitā me kutra bhadraṃ te subhadre kathaya sphuṭam || tadekāṃtasthito yena bālakrīḍāṃ karomyaham || || 84 || evaṃ sā jananī tena yadā pṛṣṭā tapasvinī || tadā roditumārabdhā nottaraṃ kiñcidabravīt || 85 || rudantīṃ tāṃ samālokya kuddho'sau munidārakaḥ || kimasau kutsitaḥ kaścidyena nākhyāsi taṃ mama || 86 || ityukte sutamāhaivaṃ vibudhaiste pitā hataḥ || kopaṃ tyajasva bhadraṃ te dadhīciḥ kathito mayā ||87|| kopavahnipradīptātmā prāha tāṃ jananīṃ punaḥ || kimapakṛtaṃ surāṇāṃ matpitrā kathayasva tat ||88|| || subhadrovāca || || śastrāṇāṃ kāraṇānmūḍhairhato'sau munipuṃgavaḥ || prayacchannapi cānyāni tadākārāṇi suvrata || 89 || śrutvaitadvacanaṃ so'pi munirugratapāstadā || pitā me yo hato devaisteṣāṃ kṛtyāṃ mahābalām || 7.1.32.90 || utthāpya pātayiṣyāmi mūrddhni prāṇāpahārikām || pitāmahamahaṃ muktvā naiva hanyo bhavedyadi || 91 || anyānpramathayiṣyāmi kṛtyāśastreṇa saṃgatān || śaraṇaṃ yadi yāsyaṃti gīrvāṇā madbhayāturāḥ || tathāpi pātayiṣyāmi tenaiva saha saṃgatān || 92 || matvaivaṃ tamṛṣiṃ kuddhaṃ sarve te surasattamāḥ || brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ prāptā bhayena mahatā'rdditāḥ || 93 || tāṃstasya śaraṇaṃ prāptāñjñātvā devaḥ kṛpānvitaḥ ||| tatraiva gatvā tvaritaṃ prāha devāñjanārddanaḥ || 94 || bhavatāṃ rakṣaṇopāyaściṃtito'tra mayā'dhunā || tena tāṃ mohayiṣyāmi kṛtyāṃ haṃtumupasthitām ||95||| atrāṃtare pippalādaḥ piturvairamanusmaran || haṃtuṃ surānvyavasitaḥ praviveśa himācalam || 96 || śrutvā tadapriyaṃ vākyaṃ māturvaktrādvinirgatam || pippalādaḥ punaryātastasmātsthānāddhimācalam || 97 || svargasopānavatpuṃsāṃ sthalībhūtamivāṃbaram || śeṣasyābhogasaṃkāśaṃ prāpto'sau tuhināca lam || 98 || pratijñāṃ kurute yatra sthitaḥ sthāṇurivācalaḥ || haṃtāro ye mama pitustānhaniṣyāmi cāraṇāt || 99 || kṛtyāśastreṇa sakalānamara tvena garvitān || tasminsthitaḥ prakupitaḥ śivāyatanasaṃsadi || 7.1.32.100 || atrasthaḥ sādhayiṣyāmi tāṃ kṛtyāṃ ciṃtayanhṛdi || kṛtyāṃ vā sādhayiṣyāmi yāsye vā yamasādanam || 101 || nirdvandvo nirbhayo bhūtvā nirāhāro hyaharniśam || savyena pāṇinā savyaṃ nirmathyorumahaṃ punaḥ || 102 || tasmā dutpādayiṣyāmi mahākṛtyāmiti sthitaḥ || saṃvatsare tasya gate ūrugātrādviniḥsṛtā || 103 || vaḍavā gurubhārārttā vāḍavenānvitā tadā || ūro rnirgatya sā tasmātsuṣuve sumahābalam ||104|| vaḍavā svodarādgarbhaṃ jvālāmālāsamākulam || vimucya tamṛṣestasya puro garbhaṃ samujjavalam ||105|| punargatā kvāpi tadā na jñātā muninā hi sā || vaḍavānalo narastasyāḥ sa garbho niḥsṛtastadā ||106|| kalpāṃta iva bhūtānāṃ kālāgniriva varcasā || vidyutpuñjapratīkāśaṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā purataḥ sthitam || 107 || sa cāpi vismito'tyaṃtaṃ kimetaditi ciṃtayan || tatastena puraḥsthena vāḍavena ca vahninā || || 108 || ṛṣiḥ proktaḥ pippalādaḥ sādhito'haṃ tvayā balāt || idānīṃ te mayā kāryaṃ karttavyaṃ yatsamāhitam || 109 || kariṣyāmīha tatsarvama sādhyamapi sādhyatām || svoruṃ nirmathya janito yena saṃvatsarādaham || tātoruṇā vihīno'pi kariṣye tvatsamīhitam || 7.1.32.110 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya muniḥ kopasamanvitaḥ || provāca vibudhānsarvānmaddattānbhakṣaya svayam || 111 || piturvadhātkrodhakṛtāvadhānaṃ matvā surā raudramatīva ghoram || sametya sarve puruṣaṃ purāṇaṃ samāśritāste sahasā sabhāryāḥ || 112 || sa tānsamāśvāsya surānvariṣṭhaṃ kopānalaṃ tatra yayau prahṛṣṭaḥ || dṛṣṭvā ca taṃ vai ravipuṃjakāśamuvāca viṣṇurvacanaṃ variṣṭham || 113 || ahaṃ sureśāna tavaiva pārśvaṃ visarjito jātabhayaiśca devaiḥ || mattaḥ śṛṇu tvaṃ vacanaṃ hi pathyaṃ yaccāraṇānāṃ bhavato'pi pathyam || 114 || jñātaṃ balaṃ te vibudhairaciṃtyaṃ vināśanaṃ cātmavatāṃ hyavaśyam || evaṃ sthite kuru vākyaṃ surāṇāmekaikamaddhi prativāsaraṃ tvam || 115 || mukhyānāṃ koṭayastriṃśatsurāṇāṃ balaśālinām || kathaṃ tu bhakṣaṇaṃ teṣāṃ yugapattvaṃ kariṣyasi || 116 || tasmādekaikaśasteṣāṃ karttavyaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ tvayā || naikena bhavatā śakyā vidhātuṃ bhakṣaṇakriyā || 117 || tathā ca pāṃḍurogitvaṃ hutabhukprāptavānpurā || atibhakṣaṇaṃ na yuktaṃ tasmātkuru matiṃ mama || 118 || tathā ca yugapatteṣu bhakṣiteṣu punastvayā || pratyahaṃ bhakṣaṇopāyaściṃtitavyo bubhukṣayā || 119 || saphalaiva pratijñā te nānṛtaṃ munibhāṣitam || evaṃ kṛte'pi te sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati samīhitam ||7.1.32.12|||| tatkariṣyāyahaṃ sarvamāhaivaṃ sa janārdanaḥ || ekaikaśaḥ sa vibudhānbhakṣayiṣyati vāḍavaḥ || 121 || tataḥ surāḥ sureśānaṃ taṃ viṣṇumamitaujasam || praṇamyāhuryathāyuktaṃ śobhanaṃ bhavatā kṛtam || 122 || bhūyo'dya punarevāsya doṣasyopaśamakriyām || kartuṃ tvameva śakto'si nānyastrātā divauka sām|| 123 || tataḥ pītāṃbaradharaḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || yuṣmadbhayaṃ hariṣyāmi tatsurānāha mādhavaḥ || 124 || śrutvaitadvibudhāḥ sarve harṣeṇotphulla locanāḥ || 125 || tatastānvibudhāndṛṣṭvā provāca sa tu vāḍavaḥ || kimidānīṃ mayā kāryaṃ bhavatāṃ kathyatāṃ hi tat || 126 || atrāntare viśva tanurmahaujā vimohayaṃstaṃ jvalanaṃ svabuddhyā || provāca pūrvaṃ vihitā yadāpastā bhakṣayasveti mahānubhāvaḥ || 127 || etadvyavasitaṃ viṣṇoryaḥ śṛṇoti samāhitaḥ || so'ticārabhayānmukto jñānaṃ muktimavāpnuyāt || 128 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vaḍavānalavaṃcanavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || || ||
<7.1.33>
|| devyuvāca || || piturvadhāmarṣasujāta manyunā yadyatkṛtaṃ karma purā maharṣiṇā || dadhīciputreṇa suraprasādhinā sarvaṃ śrutaṃ taddhi mayā samādhinā || 1 || punaḥpunarvai vibudhaiḥ samānaṃ yadvṛttamāsī tkimapi pradhānam || kāryaṃ hi tatsarvamanukrameṇa vijñātumicchāmi kutūhalena || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || ukto yadāsau vibudhaiḥ samastairāpaḥ purā tvaṃ bhuvi bhakṣayasva || yato'marāṇāṃ prathamaṃ hi jātā āpo'grajāḥ sarvasurāsurebhyaḥ || 3 || tenaivamuktastu mahātmanā tadā pradarśayadhvaṃ mama tā yataḥ sthitāḥ || pītvā surāḥ sarvamahaṃ purastātkṛtyaṃ kariṣye surabhakṣaṇaṃ hi || 4 || tatrāpi netuṃ yadi māṃ samarthā yatrāsate vāricayāḥ sametāḥ || ato'nyathā nāhamalīkavādī prāṇe prayāte munivākyakārī || 5 || āhokte puṃḍarīkākṣa aurvaṃ hi vāḍavaṃ tadā || tvāṃ prāpayiṣye yatrāpaḥ kena yānena vāḍava || 6 || || vāḍava uvāca || || nāhaṃ hayādibhiryānairgaṃtuṃ tatra samutsahe || kumārīkarasaṃparkamekaṃ muktvā mataṃ hi me || 7 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || etatte sulabhaṃ yānaṃ tāṃ kanyāmānayāmyaham || yā tvāṃ netuṃ samarthā syādapāṃ sthānaṃ suniścitam || 8 || || īśvara uvāca || || surabhīśāpasaṃtaptā prāgupāttadaśāphalā || sarasvatī yānabhūtā tasya sā viṣṇunā kṛtā || 9 || tato'bravīdvibhurgaṃgāṃ pārśvataḥ samupasthitām || enaṃ vahniṃ mahābhāge vegānnaya mahodadhim|| nānyā śaktā samānetuṃ tvāṃ vinā lokapāvani || 7.1.33.10 || || gaṅgovāca || || nāsti me bhagavañchakti raurvaṃ voḍhuṃ jagatpate|| raudrarūpī mahāneṣa dahatyevānalo bhṛśam || 11 || tatastu yamunāṃ prāha sindhuṃ tasyā hyanantaram || anyā nadīśca vividhāḥ pṛthakpṛthagudāradhīḥ || 12 || aśaktāstāḥ samānetuṃ pṛṣṭāśca surasattamaiḥ || tataḥ sarasvatīṃ prāha devadevo janārddanaḥ || tvameva vaja kalyāṇi pratīcyāṃ lavaṇodadhau || 13 || evaṃ kṛte surāḥ sarve bhaviṣyanti bhayojjhitāḥ || anyathā vāḍavenaite dahyaṃte svena tejasā || 14 || tasmāttvaṃ rakṣa vibudhāne tasmāttumulādbhayāt || māteva bhava suśroṇi surāṇāmabhayapradā || 15 || evamuktā hi sā tena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || āha nāhaṃ svatantrāsmi pitā me dhriyate cirāt || 16 || tasyāhaṃ kāriṇī nityaṃ kumārī ca dhṛtavratā || kālatrayepyasvatantrā śrūyate vibudhaiḥ sutā || 17 || pitrādeśaṃ vinā nāhaṃ padamekamapi kvacit || gacchāmi tasmātko'pyanya upāyaściṃtyatāṃ hare || 18 || tatsvarūpaṃ viditvaivaṃ samabhyetya pitāmaham || tamabravīdvāsudevo devakāryamidaṃ kuru || 19 || nānyathā śakyate netuṃ vāḍavo'gnirmahābalaḥ || adṛṣṭadoṣāṃ muktvemāṃ kumārīṃ tanayāṃ tava || 7.1.33.20 || tacchrutvā viṣṇunā proktaṃ kumārīṃ tanayāṃ tadā || śirasyādhāya sasnehamuvāca prapitāmahaḥ || 21 || yāhi devi surānsarvānrakṣa tvaṃ bhayamāgatān || vinikṣipa tvaṃ nītvainaṃ vāḍavaṃ lavaṇāṃbhasi || piturvākyaṃ hi sā śrutvā provāca śrutilakṣaṇā ||22|| || sarasvatyuvāca || || eṣāsmi prasthitā tāta tava vākyā dasaṃśayam|| raudro'yaṃ vāḍavo vahnistanuṃ me bhakṣayiṣyati || 23 || prāptaṃ kaliyugaṃ raudraṃ sāṃprataṃ pṛthivītale || lokaḥ pāpasamācāraḥ sparśayiṣyati māṃ prabho ||24|| tato duḥkhataraṃ kiṃ syādyatpāpaiḥ saha saṃgamaḥ||25|| || brahmovāca || || yadi pāpajanākīrṇaṃ na vāṃchasi dharātalam || pātālatalasaṃsthā tvaṃ naya vahniṃ mahodadhau||26|| yadātiśramasaṃyuktā vahninā dahyase bhṛśam|| tadā vibhidya vasudhāṃ pratyakṣā bhava putrike||27|| kṛtvā vaktraṃ viśālākṣi prācī bhava sumadhyame|| tato yāsyaṃti tīrthāni tvāṃ śrāṃtāṃ cāruhāsinīm||28|| tāni sarvāṇi cāgatya sāhāyyaṃ te varānane|| kariṣyaṃti trayastriṃśatkoṭyo vai mama śāsanāt||29|| gaccha putri na saṃtāpastvayā kāryaḥ kathaṃcana|| ariṣṭaṃ vraja paṃthānaṃ mā santu paripaṃthinaḥ||7.1.33.30| || īśvara uvāca|| evamuktā tadā tena brahmaṇātha sarasvatī|| tyaktvā bhayaṃ hṛṣṭamanāḥ prayātuṃ samupasthitā||31|| tasyāḥ prayāṇasamaye śaṃkhaduṃdubhiniḥsvanaiḥ || maṃgalānāṃ ca nirghoṣairjagadāpūritaṃ śubhaiḥ || 32 || sitāṃbaradharā devī sitacaṃdanaguṃṭhitā || śāradāṃbudasaṃkāśā tārahāravibhūṣitā || 33 || saṃpūrṇacaṃdravadanā padmapatrāyatekṣaṇā || kīrtiryathā maheṃdrasya pūrayantī diśo daśa || 34 || svatejasā dyotayaṃtī sarvamābhāsayajjagat || anuvrajaṃtī gaṃgā vai tayoktā varavarṇini || 35 || drakṣyāmi tvāṃ punarahaṃ kutra vai vasatīṃ sakhi || evamuktā tayā gaṃgā provāca snigdhayā girā || 36 || yadaiva vīkṣase prācīdiśi prāpsyasi māṃ tadā || suraiḥ parivṛtā sarvaistatrāhaṃ tava suvṛte || 37 || darśanaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi tyaja śokaṃ śucismite || tāmāpṛcchya tato gaṃgāṃ punardarśanamastu te || 38 || gaccha svamālayaṃ bhadre smarttavyā'haṃ tvayā'naghe || yamunāpi tathā caivaṃ gāyatrī sumanoramā || 39 || sāvitrīsahitāḥ sarvāḥ sakhyaḥ saṃpreṣitāstadā || tato visṛjya tāṃ devī nadī bhūtvā sarasvatī || 7.1.33.40 || himavaṃtaṃ giriṃ prāpya plakṣāttatra vinirgatā || avatīrṇā dharāpṛṣṭhe matsyakacchapasaṃkulā || 41 || grāhaḍiṃḍimasaṃpūrṇā timinakragaṇairyutā || hasaṃtī ca mahādevī phenaughaiḥ sarvato diśam||42|| puṇyatoyavahā devīstūyamānā dvijātibhiḥ || vāḍavaṃ vahnimādāya hayavegena niḥsṛtā || 43 || bhittvā vegāddharāpṛṣṭhaṃ praviṣṭātha mahītalam|| yadāyadābhavacchrāṃtā dahyate vāḍavāgninā || tadātadā martyaloke yāti pratyakṣatāṃ nadī || 44 || tatastu jāyate prācī saṃtaptā vāḍavena tu || tato vai yāni tīrthāni kīrttitāni purātanaiḥ || 45 || divyāṃtarikṣabhaumāni sāṃnidhyaṃ yāṃti bhāmini || tataścāśvāsitā taiḥ sā sarasvatī punarnadī || pātālatalamā sādya jagāma makarālayam || 46 || khadirāmodamāsādya tatra sā vīkṣya sāgaram || gaṃtuṃ pravṛttā taṃ vahnimādāya surasuṃdari ||47|| nirūḍhabhāramātmānaṃ devādeśādviciṃtya sā || prahṛṣṭā sumanāstasmātpravṛttā dakṣiṇāmukhī || 48 || etasminneva kāle tu ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ || catvāraśca mahādevi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ || 49 || hariṇaścātha vajraśca nyaṃkuḥ kapila eva ca || tapastapyaṃti tatrasthāḥ svādhyāyāsaktamānasāḥ || 7.1.33.50 || pṛthakpṛthaksamāhūtāḥ snānārthaṃ taiḥ sarasvatī || sāgaraḥ sammukhastasyāḥ sahasā sammupasthitaḥ || 51 || tataḥ sā cintayāmāsa kathaṃ me sukṛtaṃ bhavet || śāpabhītā ca sā sādhvī paṃcasrotāstadā'bhavat || 52 || ekaikaṃ toṣayāmāsa tamṛṣiṃ varavarṇini || tato'syāḥ paṃca nāmāni jātāni pṛthivītale || 53 || hariṇī vajriṇī nyaṃkuḥ kapilā ca sarasvatī || pānāvagāhanānnṛṇāṃ paṃcasrotāḥ sarasvatī || 54 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ || eṣāṃ saṃyogajaṃ cānyannarāṇāṃ paṃcamaṃ hi yat || 55 || etatpaṃcavidhaṃ puṃsāṃ paṃcadhā'vasthitā satī || nāśayetpātakaṃ ghoraṃ sakhībhiḥ sahitā nadī||56|| brahmahatyāṃ mahāghorāṃ pratilomā sarasvatī || pānāvagāhanānnṛṇāṃ nāśayatyakhilaṃ hi sā || 57 || pramādānmadirāpānadoṣeṇopahatātmanām || tadvyapohāya kapilā dvijānāṃ vahate nadī || 58 || upavāsājjapāddhomātsnānātpānāddvijanmanām || saptāhānnāśayetpāpaṃ tattadbhāvena cetasā||59|| svayaṃ te'pi viśudhyaṃti yathoktavidhikāriṇaḥ || nyaṃkuṃ nadīṃ samāsādya mahataḥ pātakātkṛtāt || 7.1.33.60 || snānopāsanapānena vajriṇī gurutalpagam || nāśayatyakhilaṃ puṃsāṃ pāpaṃ bhūribhayaṃkaram || 61 || saṃyogajasya pāpasya haraṇāddhariṇī smṛtā || nadī puṇyajalopetā saptāhamavagāhanāt || 62 || evametāni pāpāni sarvāṇi surasuṃdari || nadī nāśayate tathyaṃ paṃcasrotā sarasvatī || 63 || tato'paśyatpunaścāru sā devī pathi saṃsthitam || parvataṃ sāgarasyāṃte roddhuṃ mārgamiva sthitam || 64 || brahmāṇḍamānadaṇḍo'yaṃ purato girisattamaḥ || vrajantyāḥ surakāryeṇa mama vighnakaraḥ sthitaḥ || || 65 || uccaistaraṃ mahāśailamavalokya sarasvatī || atha vegena ruddhena giriṇā vismitā satī || 66 || evaṃ saṃcintayedyāvanmanasā tanma hādbhutam || tāvanmaṃgalaśabdena pratibuddhaḥ kṛtasmaraḥ || 67 || giriśṛṃgadvaṃdvacaraṃ dadarśa puruṣaṃ ca sā || tāmāha devīṃ sa nago mārgo nāstīha suvrate || 68 || anyatra kvāpi gaccha tvaṃ yatra te'bhimataṃ śubhe || āhaivamukte sā devī naraṃ nagaśiraḥsthitam || 69 || devādeśātsamāyātā na nirodhyā gire tvayā || evamukte giriḥ prāha tāṃ devīṃ sumanoramām || 7.1.33.70 || parvato'haṃ tvayā bhadre kiṃ na jñātaḥ kṛtasmaraḥ || tvatsparśanānna doṣosti kumārī tvaṃ yato'naghe || 71 || atastvāṃ varaye devi bhāryā me bhava suvrate || 72 || || sarasvatyuvāca || || pitā me dhriyate yasmāttena nāhaṃ svayaṃvarā || tava bhāryā bhaviṣyāmi mārgaṃ yaccha mamādhunā || 73 || evamukto giriḥ prāha anicchaṃtīṃ mahābalāt || udvāhayiṣye tvāṃ bhadre kastrātā sti tavādhunā || 74 || sā taṃ manobhavākrāntaṃ matvā divyena cakṣuṣā || āha nāsti mama trātā tvāmeva śaraṇaṃ gatā || 75 || tvayodvāhyā yadya vaśyamahamevaṃ mahābala || asnātāṃ nodvaha vibho snānaṃ karttuṃ ca dehi me || 76 || tāmuvāca tataḥ śailaḥ svasaṃpadabhimānavān || saukhyadaṃ paśya subhage mayi saṃpūrṇavaibhavam || 77 || dvaṃdvāni yatra gāyaṃti kiṃnarāṇāṃ manoramam || śrūyate ca sunidhvānaṃ taṃtrīvādyamathāparam || 78 || tatra tālāstamālāśca pippalāḥ panasāstathā || sadaiva phalapuṣpāścā dṛśyaṃte sumanoramāḥ ||79|| kuṭajaiḥ kovidāraiśca kadaṃvaiḥ kuravaistathā || mattālikulaghuṣṭaiśca bhūdharo bhāti sarvataḥ || 7.1.33.80 || harāṃgarāgavadbhāti kvacitkuṭajakuṅmalaiḥ || kvacittu karṇikāraiśca viṣṇorvāsaḥsamaprabhaḥ || 81 || tamāladalasaṃchannaḥ kvacidvaivasvatadyutiḥ|| kvaciddhātuviliptāṃgo gaṇādhyakṣavapurnagaḥ || 82 || caturmukha ivābhāti haritālavapuḥ kvacit || kvacitsaptacchadairviṣṇorvapuṣā bhātyayaṃ giriḥ|| 83 || kvacitkātyāyanīprakhyaḥ priyaṃgususamākulaḥ || kvacitkesarasaṃyuktairanalābho vibhātyasau || 84 || vṛttaiḥ sapulakaiḥ snigdhaiḥ strīṇāmiva payodharaiḥ || duṣprāpyairalpapuṇyānāṃ kvacidābhāti bilvakaiḥ || 85 || siṃhairvyāghrairmṛgairnāgairvarāhairvānaraistathā || kvacitkvacidasau bhāti parasparamanuvrataiḥ || 86 || śūlikodbhinnamākāśamiva kurvadbhiruccakaiḥ || evamukte pratyuvāca śāradā taṃ nagottamam || 87 || yadi māṃ tvaṃ pariṇaye rudaṃtīmekikāṃ tathā || gṛhāṇa vāḍavaṃ haste yāvatsnānaṃ karomyaham || 88 || evamukte sa jagrāha ta nagedro'pavarjim || kṛtasmarastatsaṃsparśātkṣaṇādbhasmatvamāgataḥ || 89 || tataḥ prabhṛti te tasya pāṣāṇā mṛdutāṃ gatāḥ || gṛhadevakulārthāya gṛhyaṃte śilpibhiḥ saha || 7.1.33.90 || dagdhvā kṛtasmaraṃ devī punarādāya vāḍavam || samudrasya samīpe sā sthitā hṛṣṭatanūruhā || 91 || tatrasthā sā mahādevī tamāha vaḍavānalam || paśya vāḍava garjantaṃ sāgaraṃ purataḥ sthitam || 92 || garjaṃtaṃ so'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā prasarpaṃtaṃ ca vīcibhiḥ || tāmāha kimidaṃ bhadre bhīto me lavaṇodadhiḥ || 93 || prahasyovāca sā bālā ko na bhītastavānala || bhakṣyaste vihito yasmāttava devairmahābala || 94 || sa tasyāstadvacaḥ śrutvā saṃprahṛṣṭastu pāvakaḥ || dāsyāmi te varaṃ bhadre yatheṣṭaṃ prārthayasva naḥ ||95|| tenaivamuktā sā devī vāḍavenāgninā tadā || sasmāra kāraṇātmānaṃ viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanam || 96 || dṛṣṭosāvātmahṛtsaṃsthastayā devo janārddanaḥ || smṛtamātraḥ sarasvatyā parastribhuvaneśvaraḥ ||97|| manodṛṣṭyā vilokyāha sā tamaṃtaḥsthamacyutam || vāḍavo yacchati varamahaṃ taṃ prārthayāmi kim||98|| tatastena hṛdisthena proktā devī sarasvatī || prārthanīyo varo bhadre sūcīvaktratvamādarāt || 99 || tatastvabhihito devyā yadi me tvaṃ varapradaḥ || tataḥ sūcīmukho bhūtvā tvaṃ pibāpo mahābala || 7.1.33.100 || evamuktena tattena sūcīvedhasamaṃ kṛtam || ghaṭikāpūraṇaṃ yadvatpapau tadvadanaṃ jalam || 101 || evaṃ sa vāḍavo vahniḥ surāṇāṃ bhakṣaṇodyataḥ || vaṃcito viṣṇunā yāti medhāmādhāya yatnataḥ || 102 || sargametaṃ naraḥ puṇyaṃ vācyamānaṃ śṛṇoti yaḥ || sa viṣṇu lokamāsādya tenaiva saha modate ||103|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatīvṛttāṃtavaḍavānalavacanavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 33 || cha ||
<7.1.34>
|| īśvara uvāca || || sarasvatī varaṃ prāpya variṣṭhaṃ vaḍavānalāt || punastaṃ sāgare kṣeptumudyatā sā manasvinī || 1 || devādeśātprabhāsasya purataḥ saṃsthitā tadā || samudramāhūya tadā vāḍavārpaṇakāṃkṣiṇī || 2 || tvamādiḥ sarvadevānāṃ tvaṃ prāṇaḥ prāṇināṃ sadā || devādeśādgṛhāṇa tvamāgatyārṇava vāḍavam || 3 || evaṃ saṃciṃtito devyā yadāsāvaṃbhasāṃpatiḥ || tathā jalātsamuttīrya samāyāto mahādyutiḥ || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitā devī divyaṃ viṣṇumivāparam || śyāmaṃ kamalapatrākṣaṃ sāgaraṃ sumanoramam || 5 || vicitramālyābharaṇaṃ citravastrānulepanam|| āpagābhiḥ sarūpābhiḥ strīrūpābhiḥ samāvṛtam || 6 || evaṃvidhaṃ samālokya sā devī brahmaṇaḥ sutā || sarasvatī jalanidhimuvācedaṃ śucismitā || 7 || tvamagrajaḥ sarvabhavodbhavānāṃ tvaṃ jīvitaṃ janmavatāṃ narāṇām || tasmātsurāṇāṃ kuru kāryamiṣṭaṃ vahniṃ gṛhāṇa tvamihopanītam || 8 || atrāṃtare so'pi vimṛśya sarvaṃ kāryaṃ svabuddhyā kimihopapannam || kṛtvā'nalasya grahaṇaṃ mayedaṃ kāryaṃ surāṇāṃ vihitaṃ bhavecca || 9 || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya grahaṇaṃ rucitaṃ tataḥ || vāḍavāgneḥ samudrasya surapīḍākṛte yadā || 7.1.34.10 || tadā tena puraḥsthena devī sābhihitā bhṛśam || vāḍavaṃ saṃprayacchainaṃ suraśatruṃ sarasvati || 11 || tatastayā praṇamyāśu pitāmahapuraḥsarān || cāraṇāṃścārucitrāṃgyā sarasvatyā divi sthitān || 12 || punaśca karasaṃstho'sau vāḍavo'bhihitastayā || tvamapo bhakṣayasveti surairukta imā iti || 13 || evamuktvā samudrasya tadā devyā samarppitaḥ || vāḍavo'gniḥ sarasvatyā surādeśānmahābalaḥ || 14 || taṃ samarpya tatastasmi nnadī bhūtvā sarasvatī || praviṣṭā sāgaraṃ devī nāradeśvaramārgataḥ || 15 || daityasūdanasāṃnidhye dattvārghyaṃ lavaṇāṃbhasi || arghyeśvaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya daityasūdana paścime || 16 || tato'bdhiṃ saṃpraviṣṭā sā paṃcasrotā mahānadī || svarūpeṇaiva sā puṇyā punaḥ puṇyatamā'bhavat || 17 || prabhāsakṣetrasaṃparkātsamudrasya ca saṃgamāt || sāgaro'pi samāsādya sarasvatyāstu vāḍavam || nirdhano vai dhanaṃ prāpyācintayatkva kṣipāmyaham || 18 || sa tenaiva karasthena dīpya mānena sāgaraḥ || vahninā śikharasthena bhāti merurivāparaḥ || 19 || taṃ tathāvidhamālokya tatra ye jalacāriṇaḥ || yādogaṇāste mumucurdāhabhītā mahāsvanam || 7.1.34.20 || taṃ śrutvā bhairavaṃ śabdamāyāto daityasūdanaḥ || āha yādogaṇānsarvānmā bhaiṣṭa sumahābalāḥ || 21 || yasmādanena prathamā āpo bhakṣyā na tatragāḥ || prāṇinastanna bhetavyaṃ bhavadbhistu mamājñayā || 22 || evamuktastu kṛṣṇena tūṣṇīṃbhūtā jalecarāḥ || 23 || tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣu sarveṣu jalajeṣu jaleśvaram || prāhācyutaḥ prakṣipa tvamapāṃ madhye tu vāḍavam || 24 || agādhembhasi tenāsau nikṣipto vāḍavo'nalaḥ || varuṇena pibannāste tajjalaṃ sumahābalaḥ || 25 || tasyocchvāsāniloddhūtaṃ tattoyaṃ sāgarādbahiḥ || nirmaryādeva yuvatiritaścetaścadhāvati || 26 || atha kāle gate devi śuṣyatyaṃbu śanaiḥśanaiḥ || viditvā kṣīyamāṇāstā apo jalanidhistataḥ || 27 || āhaivaṃ puṃḍarīkākṣamapaḥ kuru tvamakṣayāḥ || anyathā sarvanāśena jalānāṃ māmihāgrataḥ || bhakṣayiṣyatyasau vahnirvāḍavo hi janārddana || 28 || etacchrutvā vacastasya samudrasya tu bhīṣaṇam || kṛtaṃ tadakṣayaṃ toyamā tmano bhayanāśanam || 29 || jñātvā surāḥ sarvamidaṃ viceṣṭitaṃ kṛtyānalasyāsya nibaṃdhanaṃ tathā || pralobhanaṃ toyapuraḥsarā dviṣaḥ pupūjire keśavamatra cāriṇam|| 7.1.34.30 || evaṃ sarasvatī prāptā prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || brahmalokānmahādevi sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || 31 || someśāddakṣiṇāgneye sāgarasya samī pataḥ || saṃsthitā tu mahādevī vaḍavānaladhāriṇī || 32 || snātvā'gnitīrthe pūrvaṃ tāṃ pūjayedvidhinā naraḥ || daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ tatra paridhānaṃ sakañcu kam || 33 || dattvā tato mahādevaṃ pūjayecca kaparddinam || iti vṛttaṃ purā devi cākṣuṣasyāṃtare'bhavat || 34 || dadhīcyanvayajātasya vāḍavasya mahā tmanaḥ || asminpunarmahādevi prāpte vaivasvateṃ'tare || aurvastu bhārgave vaṃśe samutpanno mahādvijaḥ || 35|| saṃkṣipto'sau sarasvatyā devamātrā mahāprabhaḥ|| tāvatsthāsyatyapāṃ garbhe yāvanmanvatarāvadhiḥ || 36 || iti te kathitaṃ devi sarasvatyāḥ samudbhavam || śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ kīrttidaṃ puṇyavarddhanam|| 37 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatyavatāramahimavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || || cha ||
<7.1.35>
|| devyuvāca || || bhagavanbhārgave vaṃśe yastvaurvaḥ kathitastvayā || vaivasvateṃ'tare cāsmiṃstasyotpattiṃ vada prabho || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || brāhmaṇā nihatā ye tu kṣatriyairvittakāraṇāt || kṣayaṃ nītāstu te sarve saputrāśca sagarbhataḥ || 2 || mriyamāṇeṣu sarveṣu ekā strī samatiṣṭhata || tayā tu rakṣito garbha ūrvordeśe nidhāya ca || 3 || anyāsāṃ caiva nārīṇāṃ sarvāsāmapi bhāmini || garbhāni pātitāstaistu dravyārthaṃ kṣatriyādhamaiḥ || 4 || kālāṃtare tato bhittvā kurudeśaṃ mahāprabhaḥ || nirgatottaṃbhitaśirā jvaladāsyotibhīṣaṇaḥ || 5 || tadvairaṃ hṛdi cādhāya dadāha vasudhātalam || utpādya vahniṃ tapasā raudramaurvaṃ jalāśanam || 6 || tamindraḥ plāvayāmāsa vṛṣṭyaughairvaravarṇini || na śaśāka yadā netuṃ tadā sa yatavāksthitaḥ || 7 || tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvā brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || abhavanbhayasaṃtrastāḥ sarve prāṃjalayaḥ sthitāḥ || 8 || || devā ūcuḥ || || bhagavanbhārgave vaṃśe jātaḥ ko'pi mahādyutiḥ || agnirūpeṇa sarvaṃ sa dadāha vasudhātalam || || kṛto yatnaḥ purā'smābhistadvināśāya sattama || jalena vṛddhimāyāti tato no bhayamāgatam || 7.1.35.10 || vinaṣṭe bhūtale deva agniṣṭomādikāḥ kriyāḥ|| ucchidyate tato'smākaṃ nāśo nūnaṃ bhaviṣyati || 11 || tasmādyatnaṃ kuru vibho trailokyahitakāmyayā || 12 || tato brahmā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ bhārgavaiśca maha rṣibhiḥ || āgatya cābravīdaurvaṃ kimarthaṃ dahasi kṣitim || 13 || virāmaḥ kriyatāṃ sadyo mamārthaṃ ca dvijottama|| 14 || || aurva uvāca || || eṣa eva nivṛtto'haṃ tava vākyena sattama || eṣa vahnirmayotsṛṣṭaḥ sa vibho tava śāsanāt || 15 || yathā gacchetsamudrāṃtaṃ tathā nītirvidhīya tām || 16 || samāhūya tato devīṃ svāṃ sutāṃ padmasaṃbhavaḥ || uvāca putri gaccha tvaṃ gṛhītvāgniṃ mahodadhim || madvākyaṃ nānyathā kāryaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ mahāprabhe || 17 || || sarasvatyuvāca || || eṣāsmi prasthitā deva tava vākyādasaṃśayam || ityukte sādhu sādhvīti brahmaṇā samudāhṛtā || || 18 || tatobhimaṃtritaṃ vahniṃ kṣiptvā kuṃbhe hiraṇmaye || prāyacchata sarasvatyai svayaṃ brahmā pitāmahaḥ || āśiṣo vividhā dattvā provācedaṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 19 || gaccha putri na saṃtāpastvayā kāryaḥ kathaṃcana || ariṣṭaṃ vraja paṃthānaṃ mā saṃtu paripanthinaḥ || 7.1.35.20 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktā tadā tena brahmaṇā ca sarasvatī || himavaṃtaṃ giriṃ prāpya pippalādāśramāttadā || 21 || udbhūtā sā tadā devī adhastādvṛkṣamūlataḥ || tatkoṭara kuṭīkoṭipraviṣṭānāṃ dvijanmanām || 22 || śrūyante vedanirghoṣā sarasāraktacetasām || viṣṇurāste tatra devo devānāṃ pravaro guruḥ || 23 || tasmā tsthānāttato devī pratīcyabhimukhaṃ yayau || antarddhānena sā prāptā kedāraṃ himamadhyagam || 24 || tatsaṃplāvya gireḥ śṛṃgaṃ kedārasya puraḥ sthitā || tenāgninā karasthena dahyamānā sarasvatī || 25 || bhūmiṃ vidārya tasyādhaḥ praviṣṭā gajagāminī || tadaṃtarddhānamārgeṇa pravṛttā paścimāmukhī || 26 || pāpabhūmimatikramya bhūmiṃ bhittvā vini(?)gatā || tatra kūpaḥ samabhavannāmnā gandharvasaṃjñitaḥ || 27 || tasmātkūpātpunardṛśyā sā babhūva mahānadī || matiḥ smṛtistathā prajñā medhā buddhirgirādharā || 28 || upāsikāḥ sarasvatyāḥ ṣaḍetāḥ prasthitāstadā || punaḥ pravṛttā sā tasmādudbhedātpaścimāmukhī ||29|| bhūtīśvaraṃ samāyātā siddho yatra mahāmuniḥ || bhūtīśvare samīpasthaṃ tatra prāptā manoramam ||7.1.35.30|| tasya dakṣiṇadiksaṃsthaṃ rudrakoṭyupalakṣitam || śrīkaṃṭha deśaṃ vikhyātaṃ gatā sarvauṣadhīyutam || 31 || tasmātpuṇyatamāddeśācchrīkaṇṭhātsā manasvinī || saṃprāptā vahninā sārddhaṃ kurukṣetraṃ sarasvatī || 32 || punastasmātkurukṣetrādvirāṭanagarasya sā || samudbhūtā samīpasthā antarddhānānmanoramā || gopāyano giriryatra tatra sā punarudgatā || 33 || gopā yitā keśavena yatra te pāṇḍunandanāḥ || kurvaṃtaḥ svāni karmāṇi na kaiścidupalakṣitā || 34 || tatra kuṃḍe sthitā devī mahāpātakanāśinī || puna rgopāyanāddevī kṣetraṃ prāptātiśobhanam || 35 || kharjurīvanamāpannā nandānāmnīti tatra sā || sarasvatī punastasmādvanātkharjūrasaṃjñitāt || 36 || merupādaṃ samāsādya mārkaṃḍāśramamāgatā || yatra mārkaṃḍakaṃ tīrthaṃ merupāde samāśritam || 37 || sarasvatī punastasmādarbudāraṇyamāśritā || gatā vaṭavanaṃ ramyaṃ mārkaṃḍeyāśramācchubhāt ||38|| tapastaptaṃ purā yatra vasiṣṭhena samāśritāt || tasmādvaṭavanātpuṇyādudumbaravanaṃ gatā || merupāde ca tatraiva taṇḍiryatrā tapattapaḥ || 39 || ūduṃbaravanāttasmātpunardevī sarasvatī || antarddhānena śikharamanyatprāptā mahānadī || 7.1.35.40 || merupādaṃ tu sumahatsurasiddhaniṣevitam || bhinnāṃjanacayākāraṃ golāṃgūlamiti smṛtam || 41 || sthānaṃ manoramaṃ tasmādudgatā sā sumadhyamā || vaṃśastaṃbātsuvipulā pravṛttā dakṣiṇāmukhī || 42 || tatrodgamavaṭastasyāstatsamākhyo vyavasthitaḥ || tataḥ prabhṛti sā devī suprabhaṃ prakaṭā sthitā || 43 || aṃtarddhānaṃ parityajya prāṇināmanukampayā || tasyāstaṭeṣu ramyeṣu saṃti tīrthāni koṭiśaḥ || 44 || teṣu tīrtheṣu sarveṣu dharmahetuḥ sarasvatī || rudrāvatāra mārge'sminpravaraṃ prathamaṃ smṛtam || 45 || tarattaraṃganāmāḍhyaṃ kākatīrthaṃ mahāprabham || tatra tīrthaṃ punastvanyattīrthaṃ dhāreśvaraṃ smṛtam || 46 || dhāreśvarātpunaścānyadgaṃgodbhedamiti smṛtam || sārasvataṃ tathā gāṃgaṃ yatraikaṃ saṃsthitaṃ jalam || tasmādanyatparaṃ tīrthaṃ puṃḍarīkaṃ tataḥ param || || 47 || mātṛtīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sarvātaṃkaharaṃ param || mātṛtīrthātpunastasmānnātidūre vyavasthitam || 48 || tīrthaṃ tvanarakaṃnāma narakārti bhayāpaham || tatastasmādanarakāttīrthamanyatpunaḥ sthitam || 49 || saṃgameśvaranāmāḍhyaṃ prasiddhaṃ tanmahītale || tatastasmātpunaścānyattīrthaṃ koṭī śvarāhvayam || 7.1.35.50 || tatastasmānmahādevi śaṃbhukuṇḍeśvaraṃ smṛtam || tīrthe sarasvatītīre tasminsiddheśvaraṃ smṛtam || 51 || siddheśvarātpunastasmātpra vṛttā paścimāmukhī || paścimaṃ sāgaraṃ gaṃtuṃ sakhīṃ smṛtvā ruroda sā ||52|| sthitvā pūrvamukhā devī hā gaṃgeti vinā tvayā|| ekākinī maṃdabhāgyā kva gamiṣyāmyabāṃdhavā || 53 || tāṃ vijñāya tato gaṃgā rudatīṃ śokakarśitām || śīghraṃ svargātsamāyātā tīrthānāṃ koṭibhiḥ saha || 54 || tato duḥkhaṃ parityajya tatra prācī sarasvatī || sarvadevaguṇaiyuktā evaṃ tatra sthitā'bhavat || 55 || tatra siddhavaṭaṃnāma tīrthaṃ paitāmahaṃ smṛtam || vaṭeśvarasya purataḥ sarvapāpakṣayaṃkaram || 56 || trikālaṃ yatra rudrastu samāgatya vyavasthitaḥ || tanmahālayamityuktaṃ sthānaṃ tasya mahātmanaḥ || || 57 || piṃḍatārakamityetatprācīnaṃ tīrthamuttamam || kumbhakukṣigiristhaṃ tatpitrye karmaṇi siddhidam || 58 || prācīneśvaradevasya purobhūtaṃ pratiṣṭhitam|| prācī sarasvatī yatra tatra kiṃ mṛgyate param || 59 || nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe tatra tīrthe kirīṭinā || prāyaścittaṃ purā cīrṇaṃ viṣṇunā preritā tmanā || 7.1.35.60 || tena tasmādvinirmuktaḥ pātakātpūrvasaṃcitāt || naratīrthaṃ tataḥ khyātaṃ tatra pāpabhayāpaham || 61 || naratīrthādanyatīrthaṃ puṃḍarīkamiti smṛtam || arjunena sahāgatya yatra snāto hariḥ priye || 62 || prācīneśātparaṃ tīrthaṃ vālakhilyeśvaraṃ mahat || tatra tasmānmahātīrthāttīrthamanyanmahodayam|| 63 || gaṃgāsamāgamaṃnāma tīrthamanyanmahodayam || tatrālokya punardevīṃ dīnāsyāṃ dīnamānasām || 64 || brahmāsṛjatsakhīṃ tasyāḥ kapilāṃ vipulekṣaṇām || hariṇīṃ harirapyāśu vajriṇīmapi devarāṭ || nyaṃkuṃ vinodanārthaṃ ca sarasvatyā dadau haraḥ || 65 || tataḥ prahṛṣṭā sā devī devā deśātsarasvatī || tasmādgantuṃ samārabdhā prācīnā pāpanāśinī || 66 || || īśvara uvāca || || dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthāya punaḥ paścānmukhī tadā || sarasvatī mahādevī vaḍavānaladhāriṇī || taduttare taṭe tīrthamekadvāramiti smṛtam || 67 || ekadvāreṇa yatsenā svargaṃ prāptā tato varāt || tasmāttīrthātpunaścānyattīrthaṃ yatra guheśvaraḥ || 68 || guhena sthāpitaḥ pūrvaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || guheśvarānnātidūre vaṭeśvaramiti smṛtam || 69 || divyaṃ sarasvatītīre vyāsenārādhitaṃ purā || āmarddakī nadī yatra sarasvatyā sahaikatām || 7.1.35.70 || saṃprāptā tanmahātīrthaṃ phaladaṃ sarvadehinām || āmardakī saṃgamaṃ taṃ nāpuṇyo veda kaścana || saṃgameśvaranāmeti tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 71 || muṇḍīśvareti ca tathā prasiddhimagamatkṣitau || muṃḍīśvarasamīpasthaṃ sarasvatyāṃ mahodayam || 72 || nāmnā yatprāṅmukhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitam || māṃḍavyeśvaranāmnā vai yatreśaḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ || 73 || pīlukarṇikasaṃjñaṃ tu tīrthamanyatpunastataḥ || sarasvatītīragatamṛṣiṇā sevitaṃ mahat || 74 || tasmādanyatsarasvatyāṃ tīrthaṃ dvāravatī smṛtam || tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ devi yatra saṃnihito hariḥ || 75 || tatastasya samīpasthaṃ tīrthaṃ govatsasaṃjñitam || yatrāvatīrya govatsasvarūpeṇāṃbikāpatiḥ || 76 || svayaṃ bhūliṃgarūpeṇa saṃsthitastejasāṃ nidhiḥ || govatsānnairṛte bhāge dṛśyate lohayaṣṭikā || 77 || svayaṃbhūliṃgarūpeṇa rudrastatra svayaṃ sthitaḥ || ekaviṃśati vārasya bhaktyā piṃḍasya yatphalam || 78 || gaṃgāyāṃ prāpyate puṃsāṃ śrāddhenaikena tatra tat || tatastasmānmahātīrthādbālakrīḍanakī yathā || 79 || sakhībhiḥ sahitā tatra krīḍatā'sau yathecchayā || ānulomyavilomyena dakṣiṇenottareṇa ca || 7.1.35.80 || rullaṃ prāpya punardevī samudbhūtā manoramā || rullaṃ nāma puraṃ yatra sṛṣṭaṃ devena śaṃbhunā || 81 || saha devaistu pārvatyā dhārāyaṃtraprayogakaiḥ || ekaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu śaṃbhunā tatra rullitam || 82 || rullaṃ tatra hradaṃ nāma sarasvatyāṃ mahodayam || sākṣāttatra mahādeva ānaṃdeśvarasaṃjñitaḥ || 83 || paścimena sthitaṃ tatra śambhorāyatanasya tu || sa merordakṣiṇe pāde nakhastu parikīrtitaḥ || 84 || paśyaṃti ye narāḥ samyakte'pi pāpavivarjitāḥ || aśvamedhasahasrasya prāpnuvaṃti phalaṃ dhruvam || 85 || paratastasya kūṣmāṃḍamunestatrāśramaṃ mahat || kūṣmāṃḍeśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 86 || kollādevī sthitā tatra sarvapāpabhayāpahā || antarddhānena tāṃ kollāṃ saṃprāptā sā mahānadī || 87 || tato'pyaṃtarhitā bhūtvā saṃprāptā tu manoramam || sānuṃ madanasaṃjñaṃ tu kṣetraṃ siddhaniṣevitam || 88 || tato'pyaṃtarhitā bhūtvā punaḥ prāptā himācalam || khādirāmodanāmānaṃ sarvartukusumojjvalam || 89 || tatrāruhya vilokyātha dadarśa sumanoramama || kṣārodaṃ paścimāśāsthaṃ ghanavṛṃdamivonnatam || 7.1.35.90 || evaṃvidhaṃ ca taṃ tatra sā vilokya mahāprabhā || harṣātpaṃcānanā bhūtvā devakāryārthamudyatā || 91 || hariṇī vajriṇī nyaṃkuḥ kapilā ca sarasvatī || paṃcasrotāḥ sthitā tatra muninoktā sarasvatī || 92 || śramāpanodaṃ kurvāṇā munīnāṃ yatra saṃsthitā || tattatpādakamityuktaṃ tīrthaṃ tīrthārthināṃ nṛṇām || sarveṣāṃ pātakānāṃ ca śodhanaṃ tadvarānane || 93 || khādirāmodamāsādya tatrasthā vīkṣya sāgaram || gantuṃ pravṛttā taṃ vahnimādāya surasundari || 94 || dagdhvā kṛtasmaraṃ devī punarādāya vāḍavam || samudrasya samīpasthā sthitā hṛṣṭata nūruhā || 95 || tataḥ praviṣṭā sā devī agādhe lavaṇāṃbhasi || vāḍavaṃ vahnimādāya jalamadhye vyasarjayat || 96 || tatastasyāḥ punaḥ prītaḥ svaya meva hutāśanaḥ || taddṛṣṭvā duṣkaraṃ karma vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 97 || parituṣṭo'smi te bhadre varaṃ varaya suvrate || tatte dāsyāmyahaṃ prīto yadyapi syātsu durlabham || 98 || || īśvara uvāca || || pragṛhya valayaṃ hastādidaṃ vacanamabravīt || idaṃ me valayaṃ vahne vaktre dhāryaṃ sadā tvayā || 99 || anena śakyate yāvattāvattoyaṃ samāhara || na tvayā śoṣaṇīyo'yaṃ samudaḥ saritāṃpatiḥ || 7.1.35.100 || bāḍhamityeva coktvā sa praviṣṭo nidhimaṃbhasām|| evameṣā mahādevi prabhāse tu sarasvatī || gṛhītvā vāḍavaṃ prāptā tuṣṭyarthaṃ ca manīṣiṇām|| 101 || sā viśrāṃtā kurukṣetre bhadrāvarte ca bhāmini || puṣkare śrīkalā devī prabhāse ca mahānadī || 102 || devamāteti sā tatra saṃsthitā lavaṇodadhau || asminmanvaṃtare devi ādau tretāyuge purā||103|| iti vṛttaṃ sarasvatyā vāḍavāgnestathābhavat || manvantare vyatīte'sminbhavitā'nyastu vāḍavaḥ || 104 || jvālāmukheti nāmnā vai rudrakrodhādbhaviṣyati || sarasvatyāstathā nāma khyātiṃ brāhmīti yāsyati || 105 || sarasvatīti vai loke vartate nāma sāṃpratam || atītaṃ nāma yattasyāḥ kamaṃḍalubhaveti ca || ratnākareti sāmudraṃ satyaṃ nāmāṃtaraṃ purā || 106 || asminmanvaṃtare devi sāgareti prakīrtitam || kṣāṃrodeti bhaviṣyaṃ tu nāma devi prakīrti tam || 107 || evaṃ jānāti yaḥ kaścitsa tīrthaphalamaśnute || svarganiḥśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāse tu sarasvatī || 108 || nāpuṇyavadbhiḥ saṃprāptuṃ puṃbhiḥ śakyā mahānadī || prācī sarasvatī devi sarvatra ca sudurlabhā || viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetre prabhāse puṣkare tathā || 109 || evaṃprabhāvā sā devī vaḍavānala dhāriṇī|| agnitīrthasamīpasthā sthitā devī sarasvatī || 7.1.35.110 || tāmādau pūjayedyastu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute || sāgaraṃ yacca tattīrthaṃ pāpaghnaṃ puṇya varddhanam || 111 || darśanādeva tasyaiva mahākratuphalaṃ labhet || agnicitkapilā satrī rājā bhikṣurmahodadhiḥ || 112 || dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punaṃtyete tasmā tpaśyeddhi bhāvitaḥ || agnitīrthe naraḥ snātvā pāvake prakṣipettataḥ || guggulaṃ bhārasahitaṃ sogniloke mahīyate || 113 || evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ prokto hyagni tīrthamahodayaḥ || sarasvatyāśca māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam ||114|| snātvāgnitīrthe vidhivatkaṃkaṇaṃ prakṣipetataḥ || suvarṇasya mahādevi yathāvittānu sārataḥ || 115 || tataḥ sarasvatīṃ pūjya kapardinamathārcayet || 116 || tataḥ kedāranāmānaṃ bhīmeśvaramataḥparam || bhairaveśvaranāmānaṃ caṇḍīśvaramataḥ param|| 117 || tataḥ someśvaraṃ devaṃ pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || navagraheśvarāniṣṭvā rudraikādaśakaṃ tathā || 118 || tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevaṃ brahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam || evaṃ raudrī samākhyātā yātrā pātakanāśinī||119|| māhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyā yo jānāti narottamaḥ|| nivasankṣetramadhye tu sa tīrthaphalamaśnute||7.1.35.12||| evaṃ kṛtvā tato gacchenmahādevīṃ sarasvatīm||121|| sarasvatīvasasamā kuto guṇāḥ sarasvatīvāsasamā kuto ratiḥ|| sarasvatīṃ prāpya divaṃ gatā narāḥ punaḥ smariṣyaṃti nadīṃ sarasvatīm|| 122 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetra māhātmye sarasvatyabdhisamāgamāgnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||35||
<7.1.36>
|| devyuvāca || yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ prācī sarvatra durllabhā || viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetre prabhāse puṣkare tathā || 1 || kathaṃ prabhāsamāsādya saṃsthitā pāpanāśinī || māhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyāḥ prācyāḥ pātakanāśanam || kathayasva maheśāna yadyahaṃ te priyā vibho || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhu proktaṃ tvayā bhadre prācī sarvatra durlabhā || kurukṣetre puṣkare ca tasmātprābhāsike'dhikā || 3 || prabhāse tu mahādevī prācīṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || nāpuṇyo veda deveśi karmanirmūlanakṣamām || 4 || ye pibaṃti narāḥ puṇyāṃ prācīṃ devīṃ sarasvatīm || na te manuṣyā vijñeyāḥ satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane || 5 || dhanyāste munayaste ca puṇyāste ca tapasvinaḥ || ye ca sārasvataṃ toyaṃ pibaṃtyaharahaḥ sadā || 6 || devāste na manuṣyāste nadīstisra pibaṃti ye || caṃdrabhāgāṃ ca gaṃgāṃ ca tathā devīṃ sassvatīm || 7 || bhuktvā vā yadi vā'bhuktvā divā vā yadi vā niśi || na kālaniyamastatra yatra prācī sarasvatī || 8 || prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ ye tu pibaṃti satataṃ mṛgāḥ || te'pi svargaṃ gamiṣyaṃti yajñairdvijavarā yathā || 9 || sarvakāmaprapūrtyarthaṃ nṛṇāṃ tatkṣetramuttamam || ciṃtāmaṇisamā devī yatra prācī sarasvatī || 7.1.36.10 || yathā kāmadughā gāvaḥ sarvakāmaphalapradāḥ || tathā svargāpavargābhyāṃ prācī devī sarasvatī || 11 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām || yatra sthitāni saṃnyāsaṃ tasmātkimadhikaṃ smṛtam || 12 || yatra maṃkaṇakaḥ siddhaḥ prācīne niyatātmavān || brahmahatyāvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ mayā yatra varānane || 13 || vṛṣatīrthe mahāpuṇye prācīkūlasamāśrite || nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe tasmiṃstīrthe kirīṭinā || prāyaścittaṃ purā cīrṇaṃ viṣṇunā preritātmanā ||14|| trailokye sarvatīrthānāṃ tattīrthaṃ pravaraṃ smṛtam || pāpaghnaṃ puṇyajananaṃ prāṇināṃ puṇyakīrttida || 15 || || sūta uvāca || || āhaivamukte sā devī śaṃkaraṃ loka śaṃkaram|| prāyaścittaṃ kathaṃ prāptaḥ pārthaḥ parapuraṃjayaḥ || jñātikṣayodbhavaṃ pāpaṃ kathaṃ nāśamagātprabho ||16|| evamuktaḥ punaḥ prāha viśveśo nīlalohitaḥ || prāyaścittasya saṃprāptaḥ kāraṇaṃ tadyathā sthitam ||17|| || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhadre kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā pavitrātmā prajāyate ||18|| yo'sau devi samākhyātaḥ kirīṭī śvetavāhanaḥ|| sa jitvā kauravānsarvānsaṃhṛtya hayakuñjarān || 19 || paścātsuyodhanaṃ hatvā bhīmena prayayau gṛhān|| nārāyaṇena sahito naro'sau prasthito raṇāt|| 7.1.36.20 || draṣṭuṃ dharmasutaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ praṇataḥ prāṃjaliḥ sthitaḥ|| sa vijñāya tadā''yāntau naranārāyaṇāvubhau || 21 || rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāha dvārasthāndvārapālakān || bhavadbhiretāvāyāṃtau niṣedhyau dvārasaṃsthitau || 22 || nara nārāyaṇau krūrau pāpapaṃkānulepinau || evametaditi proktau tau tadā dvāramāgatau || 23 || bhavantau necchati draṣṭuṃ rājā durnayakāriṇau || tatrasthaḥ pṛṣṭavānbhūyaḥ pratīhāraṃ naraḥ svayam || 24 || āvāṃ kiṃ kāraṇaṃ rājā nekṣate vaśavartinau || provāca praṇato rājā tato dvāḥsthaṃ puraḥsthitam || 25 || nārāyaṇena sahitaṃ naraṃ narakanirbhayam || duryodhanena sahitā bāṃdhavāste yato hatāḥ || pitṛtulyāśca rājānastena vai pāpabhājanam || 26 || evamukte tu tenātha mukhamālokitaṃ hareḥ || tena proktamidaṃ tathyaṃ yatte rājñā prabhāṣitam || 27 || evamukte naraḥ prāha punareva janārddanam || kathayasva kathaṃ pāpātkṛṣṇa śuddhyāmahe vayam || 28 || tīrthasnānena me śuddhiryathā syāttadvada sphuṭam || tacca gaṃgādikaṃ kṛṣṇa yathā'syāghasya nāśanam || 29 || || || kṛṣṇa uvāca || || mā gayāṃ gaccha kauṃteya mā gaṃgāṃ mā ca puṣkaram || tatra gaccha kuruśreṣṭha yatra prācī sarasvatī || 7.1.36.30 || brahmaghnāśca surā pāśca ye cānye pāpakāriṇaḥ || tatra snātvā vimucyaṃte yatra prācī sarasvatī || 31 || nārāyaṇena prokto'sau narastadvacanāddrutam || sahitastena saṃprāptaḥ prācīnaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 32 || trirātropoṣitaḥ snātastrikālaṃ niyatātmavān || tena tasmādvinirmuktaḥ pātakātpūrvasaṃcitāt || 33 ||| vijñāya śuddhamenaṃ tu rājā dharmasuto drutam || bhrātṛbhiḥ sahitaḥ prāptastaṃ draṣṭuṃ narapuṃgavam || 34 || tatastaṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā dharmaputraḥ puraḥsthitam || āliliṃga prahṛṣṭātmā pṛṣṭavāṃścāpyanāmayam || 35 || bhīmādibhirbhrātṛbhiśca tadā gurugaṇairvṛtaḥ || āliṃgitaḥ prahṛṣṭaistu naro guṇagaṇairvṛtaḥ || 36 || etaddhi tanmahātīrthaṃ prācīneti ca śabditam || snānakrameṇa marttyānāmanyeṣāmapi pāvakam || 37 || trirātropoṣitaḥ snātastīrthe'sminbrahmahā'pi yaḥ || vimuktaḥ pātakāttasmānmodate divi rudravat || 38 || prācīne devyahaṃ nityaṃ vasāmi sahitastvayā || prabhāse tu mahākṣetre viśeṣāttatra bhāmini || || 39 || sarasvatyuttare tīre yastyajedātmanastanum || prācīne tu varārohe na cehāgacchate punaḥ || 7.1.36.40 || āpluto vājimedhasya phalaṃ prāpsyati puṣkalam || niyamaiścopavāsaiśca śoṣayeddehamātmanaḥ || 41 || jalāhārā vāyubhakṣāḥ parṇāhārāśca tāpasāḥ || yathā sthaṃḍilagā nityaṃ ye cānyaniyamāḥ pṛthak || 42 || evaṃ maṃkyāśrame yeṣāṃ vasatāṃ mṛtyurāgataḥ || na te manuṣyā devāste satyametadbravīmi te || 43 || asmiṃstīrthe tu yo dadyāttruṭimātraṃ tu kāṃcanam|| śraddhayā dvijamukhyāya merutulyaṃ phalaṃ labhet || 44 || asmiṃstīrthe tu ye śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti ca mānavāḥ || ekaviṃśatkulopetāḥ svargaṃ yāsyaṃti te dhruvam || 45 || pitṝṇāṃ vallabhe tīrthe piṇḍenaikena tarppitāḥ || brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti gayāśrāddhakṛto yathā || || 46 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ snānaṃ ca vihitaṃ sadā || piṇyākaiṃgudakenāpi piṃḍaṃ tatra dadāti yaḥ || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati || 47 || bhūyaścānnaṃ prayacchaṃti mokṣamārgaṃ vrajaṃti te || 48 || dadhi dadyādyo'pi tatra brāhmaṇāya manoramam || so'gnilokaṃ samāsādya bhuṃkte bhogānsuśobhanān|| 49 || ūrṇāṃ prāvaraṇaṃ yo'pi bhaktyā dadyāddvijottame || so'pi yāti parāṃ siddhiṃ martyairanyaiḥ sudurllabhām || 7.1.36.50 || ye cātra malanāśāya viśeyurmānavā jalam|| gopradānasamaṃ teṣāṃ sukhena phalamādiśet || 51 || bhāvena yo narastatra kaścitsnānaṃ samācaret || sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate || 52 || tarpaṇātpiṃḍadānācca narakeṣvapi saṃsthitāḥ || svargaṃ prayāṃti pitaraḥ suputreṇa hi tāritāḥ || 53 || prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ prāpya yāti tīrthaṃ himālayam|| sa karasthaṃ samutsṛjya kūrpareṇa samālihet || 54 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya tasminprāṇānparityajet || taṃtaṃ sakalamāpnoti tīrthamāhātmyayogataḥ || 55 || anyaddevi purā gītaṃ gāṃgeyena yudhiṣṭhire || satyameva hi gaṃgāyāṃ vayaṃ jātā yudhiṣṭhira || 56 || yāḥ kāścitsarito loke tāsāṃ puṇyā sarasvatī || 97 || sarasvatī sarvanadīṣu puṇyā sarasvatī lokasukhāvahā sadā || sarasvatīṃ prāpya suduḥkhitā narāḥ sadā na śocanti paratra ceha ca ||58 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prācīsarasvatīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || cha ||
<7.1.37>
|| devyuvāca || || kimarthaṃ kaṃkaṇaṃ deva kṣipyate lavaṇāṃbhasi || tasyā puṇyaṃ na pūrvoktaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 1 || ke maṃtrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ tatkasminkāle mahatphalam || kiṃ purābhūcca tadvṛttaṃ bhagavankaṃkaṇāśritam || 2 || || || īśvara uvāca || || āsītpurā mahīpālo bṛhadratha iti śrutaḥ || tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī nāmnā ceṃdumatī priyā || 3 || na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca kiṃnarī || tādṛgrūpā mahādevi yādṛśī sā sumadhyamā || 4 || śīlarūpaguṇopetā nityaṃ sā tu pativatā || sarvayoṣidguṇairyuktā yathā sādhvī hyarundhatī || 5 || pradhāna(?)hasrasya saubhāgyamadagarvitā || na vinā sa tayā reme muhūrttamapi pārthivaḥ || 6 || ekadā tasyarājarṣerarddhāsanagatā satī|| yāvattiṣṭhati rājeṃdramṛṣistāvadupāgataḥ|| kaṇvo nāma mahātejāstapasvī vedapāragaḥ||7|| tamāgatamatho dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya pārthivaḥ|| pūjāṃ kṛtvā yathānyāyaṃ dattvā cārghyamanuttamam||8|| sukhāsīnaṃ tato matvā viśrāṃtaṃ munipuṃgavam|| āpṛcchatkuśalaṃ rājā sa sarvaṃ cānvamodayat || 9 || tato dharmakathāṃ cakre sa ṛṣirnṛpasannidhau || 7.1.37.10 || tataḥ kathāvasāne sā bhāryā tasya mahīpateḥ || abravīdamṛtaṃ vākyaṃ kṛtāṃjalipuṭā satī || 11 || || indumatyuvāca || || tvaṃ vetsi bhagavansarvamatītānāgataṃ vibho || pṛcche tvāṃ kautukāviṣṭā tasmāttvaṃ kṣaṃtumarhasi || || 12 || anyadehodbhavaṃ karma mama sarvaṃ prakīrttaya || īdṛśaṃ mama saubhāgyaṃ patirdevasutopamaḥ || 13 || saubhāgyaṃ patidevatvaṃ śīlaṃ trailokyaviśrutam|| kiṃ prabhāvo vratasyaiṣa utāhopoṣitasya vā || 14 || dānasya vā muniśreṣṭha yanme saubhāgyamuttamam|| vaśo rājā mahābāhurmama vākyānugaḥ sadā || || 15 || etanme sarvamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 16 || || sūta uvāca || || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā ca suciraṃ muniḥ || abravītprahasanvākyaṃ kaṇvo vedavidāṃ varaḥ || 17 || || kaṇva uvāca || || śṛṇu rājñi pravakṣyāmi anyadehodbhavaṃ tava || na roṣaśca tvayā kāryo lajjā vāpi sumadhyame || 18 || tvamāsīdanyadehe tu ābhīrī paṃcabhartṛkā || saurāṣṭraviṣaye hīnā devaṃ someśvaraṃ gatā || 19 || tataḥ snātuṃ praviṣṭā ca sāgare lavaṇāṃbhasi || hatā kallolamālābhirvihvalatvamupāgatā || 7.1.37.20 || tava hastāccyutaṃ tatra haimaṃ kaṃkaṇameva ca || naṣṭaṃ samudrasalile paścāttāpastu te sthitaḥ || 21 || atha kālena mahatā paṃcatvaṃ tvamupāgatā || daśārṇādhipatergehe tato jātāsi sundari || 22 || bṛhadrathena coḍhāsi kaṃkaṇasya prabhā vataḥ|| na vrataṃ na tapo dānaṃ tvayā cīrṇaṃ purā śubhe || 23 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || tacchrutvā sā viśālākṣī trapayā'dho mukhī tathā || āsīttūṣṇīṃ tadā devī śrutvā vākyaṃ ca tādṛśam || 24 || evaṃ nivedya sa munī rājapatnīṃ varānane || jagāma bhavanaṃ svaṃ ca āmaṃtrya vasudhādhipam || 25 || jñātvā phalaṃ kaṃkaṇasya munestasya prabhāvataḥ || gatvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ snātvā ca lavaṇāṃbhasi || 26 || prākṣipatkaṃkaṇaṃ tatra prativarṣaṃ(?) mahāprabhe || tato devatvamāpannā prabhāvāttasya bhāmini || 27 || īśvara uvāca || || eṣa prabhāvaḥ sumahānkaṃkaṇasya prakīrtitaḥ || sarvakāmaprado devi sarvapāpapraṇāśanaḥ || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvaramāhātmye kaṃkaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || || ||
<7.1.38>
|| devyuvāca || || yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ paśyetpūrvaṃ kaparddinam || bhagavansaṃśayaṃ hyenaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 1 || sa bhṛtyaḥ kila deveśa tava śambho mahāprabhaḥ || prabhoranantaraṃ bhṛtya eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 2 || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yathā pūjyatamo hi saḥ || kaparddī sarvadevānāmādyo vighneśvaraḥ prabhuḥ || 3 || yo'sāvatīṃdriyagrāhyaḥ prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthitaḥ || someśvaro mahādevi liṃgarūpī sadāśivaḥ || 4 ||| tasya vāme sthito viṣṇurvarāha iti yaḥ smṛtaḥ || tasya dakṣiṇabhāge tu sthito brahmā prajāpatiḥ || kaparddirūpamāsthāya sāvitryāḥ kopakāraṇāt || 5 || kṛte heraṃbanāmā tu tretāyāṃ vighnamarddanaḥ || laṃbodaro dvāpare tu kaparddī tu kalau smṛtaḥ || 6 || evaṃ yugeyuge tasya avatāraḥ pṛthakpṛthak || yathākāryānurūpeṇa jāyate ca punaḥpunaḥ || 7 || aṣṭāviṃśatime tatra devi prāpte caturyuge || kāraṇātmā yathotpannaḥ kaparddī tatra me śṛṇu || 8 || purā dvāparasaṃdhau tu saṃprāpte ca kalau yuge || striyo mlecchāśca śūdrāśca ye cānye pāpakāriṇaḥ || prayāṃti svargamevāśu dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum || 9 || na yajñā na tapo dānaṃ na svādhpāyo vrataṃ na ca || kurvatopi narā devi sarve yāṃti śivālayam || 7.1.38.10 || taṃ prabhāvaṃ viditvaivaṃ someśvarasamudbhavam || agniṣṭomādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā naṣṭāḥ sureśvari || 11 || tato bālāśca vṛddhāśca ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ || śūdrāḥ striyo'pi taṃ dṛṣṭvā prayāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 12 || naṣṭayajñotsave kāle śūnye ca vasudhātale || ūrddhvabāhubhirākrāṃtaṃ paripūrṇaṃ triviṣṭapam || 13 || tato devā maheṃdrādyā duḥkhenaiva samanvitāḥ || paribhūtā manuṣyaiste śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 14 || ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarva indrādyāḥ surasattamāḥ || vyāptoyaṃ mānuṣaiḥ svargaḥ prasādāttava śaṃkara || 15 || nivāsāya prabho'smākaṃ sthānaṃ kiṃcitsamādiśa || ahaṃ śreṣṭho hyahaṃ śreṣṭha ityevaṃ te parasparam|| jalpaṃtaḥ sarvato deva paryaṭaṃti yathecchayā || 16 || dharmarājaḥ sudharmātmā teṣāṃ karma śubhāśubham|| svayaṃ likhitamālokya tūṣṇīmāste suvismitaḥ ||17|| yeṣāmatha kṛtaṃ sajjaṃ kumbhīpākaṃ sudāruṇam || rauravaḥ śālmalirdeva dṛṣṭvā tāndivi saṃsthitān || vailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā vyāpāraṃ tyaktavānasau || || 18 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || pratijñātaṃ mayā sarvaṃ bhaktyā tuṣṭena vai surāḥ || somāya mama sāṃnidhyamasminkṣetre bhaviṣyati || 19 || na śakyamanyathākartumātmano yadudīritam|| evaṃ yāsyaṃti te svargaṃ ye māṃ drakṣyaṃti tatra vai || 7.1.38.20 || bhayodvignāstato devāḥ pārvatīṃ prekṣya viśvataḥ || ūcuḥ prāṃjalayaḥ sarve tvamasmākaṃ gatirbhava || 21 || evamuktvā'stuvandevāḥ stotreṇānena sattama || jānubhyāṃ dharaṇīṃ gatvā śirasyādhāya cāṃjalim || || 22 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaste devadeveśi namaste viśvadhātrike || namaste padmapatrākṣi namaste kāṃcanadyute ||23 || namaste saṃhartri kartri namaste śaṃkarapriye || kālarātri namastubhyaṃ namaste giriputrike||24|| ārye bhadre viśālākṣi namaste lokasundari|| tvaṃ ratistvaṃ dhṛtistvaṃ śrīstvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ sudhā satī || 25 || tvaṃ durgā tvaṃ manirmedhā tvaṃ sarvaṃ tvaṃ vasundharā || tvayā sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 26 || nadīṣu parvatāgreṣu sāgareṣu guhāsu ca || araṇyeṣu ca caityeṣu saṃgrāmeṣvāśrameṣu ca || 27 || trailokye tatra paśyāmo yatra tvaṃ devi na sthitā || etajjñātvā viśālākṣi trāhi no mahato bhayāt ||28|| || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktā tu sā devī devairiṃdrapurogamaiḥ || kāruṇyānnijadehaṃ tvaṃ tadā mardditavatyasi || 29 || mardayaṃtyāstava tadā saṃjātaṃ ca mahanmalam || tatra jajñe gajeṃdrāsyaścaturbāhurmanoharaḥ || 7.1.38.30 || tatobravītsurānsarvānbhavatī karuṇātmikā || eṣa eva mayā sṛṣṭo yuṣmākaṃ hitakāmyayā || 31 || eṣa vighnāni sarvāṇi prāṇināṃ saṃvidhāsyati ||32 || mohena mahatā''viṣṭāḥ kāmopahatabuddhayaḥ || somanāthamapaśyaṃto yāsyaṃti narakaṃ narāḥ ||33|| evaṃ te vacanaṃ śrutvā sarve te hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || svasthānaṃ bhejire devāstyaktvā mānuṣajaṃ bhayam ||34|| athe bhavadanaḥ prāha tvāṃ devi vinayānvitaḥ || kiṃ karomi viśālākṣi ādeśo dīyatāṃ mama || 35 || || śrībhagavatyuvāca || || gaccha prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra saṃnihito haraḥ || tadrakṣa mānuṣāṇāṃ ca yathā nāyāti gocaram ||36|| liṃgaṃ tu devadevasya sthāpitaṃ śaśinā svayam || bhavatyā''deśito nityaṃ nṛṇāṃ vighnaṃ karoti yaḥ || 37 || prasthitaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā somanāthaṃ prati prabhum|| sa karoti mahāvighnaṃ kapardī lokapūjitaḥ || 38 || putradāragṛhakṣetra dhanadhānyasamudbhavam || janayetsa mahāmohaṃ tataḥ paśyati no haram || 39 || athavā gaḍugaṃḍādi vyādhiṃ caiva samutsṛjet || tairgrastaḥ puruṣo mohānna paśyati tato haram|| 7.1.38.40 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena someśvaraparīpsayā || sa nityaṃ pūjanīyastu smartavyastu divāniśam || 41 || stotreṇānena deveśi sarvavighnāṃtakena vai|| samārādhya gaṇādhyakṣaḥ prabhāsakṣetrarakṣakaḥ ||42|| tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi stotraṃ tadvighramardanam|| kapardino mahādevi sāvadhānāvadhāraya || ||43|| oṃ namo vighnarājāya namaste'stu kapardine|| namo mahogradaṃṣṭūāya prabhāsakṣetravāsine||44|| kapardinaṃ namaskṛtya yātrānirvighrahetave|| stoṣye'haṃ vighnarājānaṃ siddhibuddhipriyaṃ śubham ||45|| mahāgaṇapatiṃ śūramajitaṃ jayavarddhanam|| ekadaṃtaṃ ca dvidaṃtaṃ caturdaṃtaṃ caturbhujam||46|| tryakṣaṃ ca śūlahastaṃ ca rakta netraṃ varapradam || ajeyaṃ śaṃkukarṇaṃ ca pracaṇḍaṃ daṃḍanāyakam|| āyaskadaṃḍinaṃ caiva hutavaktraṃ hutapriyam || 47|| anarcito vighnakaraḥ sarvakāryeṣu yo nṛṇām || taṃ namāmi gaṇādhyakṣaṃ bhīmamugramumāsutam || 48 || madavataṃ virūpākṣamibhavaktrasamaprabham || dhruvaṃ ca niścalaṃ śāṃtaṃ taṃ namāmi vināyakam ||49|| tvayā pūrveṇa vapuṣā devānāṃ kāryasiddhaye || gajarūpaṃ samāsthāya trāsitāḥ sarvadānavāḥ || 7.1.38.50 || ṛṣīṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca nāyakatvaṃ prakāśitam || 51 || iti stutaḥ surairagre pūjyase tvaṃ bhavātmaja || tvāmārādhya gaṇādhyakṣamibhavaktrasamaprabham|| 52 || dhruvaṃ ca niścalaṃ śāṃtaṃ parītaṃ vi jayaśriyā || kāryārthaṃ raktakusumai raktacaṃdanavāribhiḥ || 53 || raktāṃbaradharo bhūtvā caturthyāmarcayettu yaḥ || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā niyato niyatāśanaḥ || 54 || rājānaṃ rājaputraṃ vā rājamaṃtriṇameva ca || rājyaṃ vā sarvavighneśo vaśīkuryātsarāṣṭrakam || 55 || yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvayajñeṣu yatphalam|| sa tatphalamavāpnoti smṛtvā devaṃ vināyakam || 56 || viṣamaṃ na bhavettasya na sa gacchetparābhavam || na ca vighnaṃ bhavettasya jano jātismaro bhavet || 57 || ya idaṃ paṭhati stotraṃ ṣaḍbhirmāsairvaraṃ labhet || saṃvatsareṇa siddhiṃ ca labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 58 || prasādāddarśanaṃ yāti tasya someśvaraḥ prabhuḥ|| kapardākāramudaraṃ yato'sya samudāhṛtam|| tato'sya nāma jānīhi kaparddīti mahātmanaḥ || 59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapardivināyakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 38 ||
<7.1.39>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha saṃpūjya vidhinā devadevaṃ kaparddinam || tato gacchenmahādevi ligaṃ kedārasaṃsthitam || 1 || tasyaivāgneyabhāgasthaṃ bhīmeśvarasamīpagam|| svayaṃbhūtaṃ mahādevi kalpaliṃgaṃ mama priyam || 2 || mayā saṃpūjitaṃ devi vṛddhiliṃga mahāprabham|| nirāhārastu yastatra karotyekaṃ prajāgaram || 3 || caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ || rudreśvareti devasya tvāsīnnāma purā yuge || 4 || tiṣyesmiṃstu punaḥ prāpte mlecchasparśabhayāturaḥ || asmim̐lliṃge layaṃ yātaḥ kedāraścābdhisaṃnidhau || 5 || tena kedāranāmeti tasya khyātaṃ dharātale || māghe māsi yatāhāraḥ snātvā tu lavaṇodadhau ||6|| padmake tu mahākuṃḍe madhyesya lavaṇāṃbhasaḥ || rudreśāddakṣiṇe bhāge dhanuṣāṃ daśake sthite || 7 || snātvā vidhānato devi rudreśaṃ cārcayiṣyati || samyakkedārayā trāyāḥ phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati || 8 || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ pūjanānnāśanaṃ mahat || atha tasyaiva devasya itihāsaṃ purātanam || 9 || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ kathyate te surapriye || āsīdrājā purā devi śaśabiṃduriti śrutaḥ || 7.1.39.10 || sārvabhaumo mahīpālo vipakṣagaṇasūdanaḥ || kalidvāparayoḥ saṃdhau sabhūtaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 11 || tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī || 12 || tādṛgrūpā varārohe yathā'sya śubhalocanā|| tasya hemamayaṃ padmaṃ śatapatraṃ manoramam||13|| khecaraṃ vegi nityaṃ ca tasya rājño mahātmanaḥ|| sa tena paryaṭam̐llokānsarvāndevi svakāmataḥ||14|| ekadā phālgune māsi śuklapakṣe varānane || caturddaśyāṃ tu saṃprāptaḥ prabhāsakṣetramuttamam||15|| athāpaśyadṛṣīnsarvāñchrīsomeśapuraḥsthitān || rātrau jāgaraṇārthāya japahomaparāyaṇān|| 16 || sa dṛṣṭvā somanāthaṃ tu praṇipatya vidhānataḥ || pūjayāmāsa sarvāṃ stānyathārhaṃ bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 17 || tataḥ kedāramāsādya saṃsnāpya vidhivatpriye || pūjayitvā vicitrābhiḥ puṣpamālābhirīśvaram || 18 || naivedyairvividhairvastrairbhūṣaṇaiśca manoharaiḥ || tato'tra kārayāmāsa jāgaraṃ susamāhitaḥ || 19 || tataste munayaḥ sarve kutūhalasamanvitāḥ || cyavano yājñavalkyaśca śāṃḍilyaḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ || 7.1.39.20 || raibhyo'tha jaiminiḥ krauṃco nāradaḥ parvataḥ śilaḥ || mārkaṃḍaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā jagmustasya samīpataḥ || 21 || cakruḥ kathāḥ suvicitrā itihāsāni bhūriśaḥ || kīrttayaṃtaḥ sthitāstatra papracchū rājasattamam || 22 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kasmātsomeśvaraṃ devaṃ parityajya narādhipa || kedārasya puro'kārṣīrjāgaraṃ tadbravīhi naḥ || nūnaṃ vetsi phalaṃ cāsya liṃgasya tvaṃ mahodayam || 23 || || || rājovāca || || śṛṇvaṃtu brāhmaṇāḥ sarve anyadehodbhavaṃ mama || purā'haṃ śūdrajātīya āsaṃ brāhmaṇapūjakaḥ || 24 || saurāṣṭraviṣaye śubhre dhanadhānyasamākule || atha kālāṃtare tatra anāvṛṣṭirabhūddvijāḥ || 25 || tato'haṃ kṣudhayāviṣṭaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsthitaḥ || athāpaśyaṃ saraḥ śubhraṃ hariṇīmūlasaṃsthitam || 26 || tacca rāmasaronāma padminīṣaṇḍamaṃḍitam || kṣīrodāṃbudhisaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā snātaḥ klamānvitaḥ || 27 || saṃtarpya ca pitṝndevānpītvā svacchamathodakam || tato'haṃ bhāryayā prokto gṛhāṇemānsaroruhān || 28 || etatsamīpato ramyaṃ dṛśyate sthānamuttamam || vikrīṇīmo'tra gatvā tu yena syādbhojanaṃ vibho || 29 || athāvatīrya salilaṃ gṛhītāni mayā dvijāḥ || kamalāni subhū rīṇi prasthitaśca puraṃ prati || 7.1.39.30 || tatra gatvā ca rathyāsu catvareṣu trikeṣu ca || praphullakamalānyeva kretuṃ vai munisattamāḥ || 31 || na kaścitprati gṛhṇāti astaṃ prāpto divākaraḥ || prāsādaṃ kaṃcidāsādya suptohaṃ saha bhāryayā ||32|| tatra suptasya me buddhiḥ śrutvā gītadhvaniṃ tadā || samutpannā sabhā ryasya kṣudhārtasya viśeṣataḥ || nūnaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hyetatkasmiṃścidvibudhālaye || 33 || saroruhāṇi cādāya vrajāmyatra surālaye || yadi kaścitpragṛhṇāti prāṇayātrā tato bhavet || 34 || athotthāya samāyāto hyatrāhaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || apaśyaṃ liṃgametattu pūjitaṃ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 35 || rudreśvarābhidhamidaṃ vṛddhaliṃgaṃ svayaṃbhuvam || veśyānaṃgavatīnāmnī śivarātriparāyaṇā || 36 || jāgartti puratastasya gītanṛtyotsavādinā || tataḥ kaścinmayā dṛṣṭaḥ kimetadrātrijāgaram ||37|| keyaṃ strī dṛśyate'tyarthaṃ gītanṛtyotsave ratā || so'bravīcchivadharmoktā śivarātriḥ sudharmadā ||38|| tāṃ cānaṃgavatīnāmnī veśyeyaṃ dharmasaṃyutā || jāgartti paramaṃ śreyaḥ śivarātrivrataṃ śubham|| 39 || śivarātrivrataṃ hyetadyaḥ samyakkurute naraḥ || na sa duḥkhamavāpnoti na dāri dryaṃ na baṃdhanam|| 7.1.39.40 || duṣṭaṃ cāriṣṭayogaṃ vā na rogaṃ na bhayaṃ kvacit || sukhasaubhāgyasaṃpanno jāyate satkule naraḥ || 41 || tejasvī ca yaśasvī ca sarvakalyāṇabhājanam || bhavedasya prasādena evamāhurmanīṣiṇaḥ || 42 || || rājovāca || || atha me buddhirutpannā tadvrataṃ prati niścalā || ciṃtitaṃ manasā hyetanmayābrāhmaṇasattamāḥ || 43 || annābhāvānmamotpanna upavāso balādyataḥ || tadahaṃ padmake tīrthesnātvā ca lavaṇāṃbhasi || 44 || etaiḥ saroruhairdevaṃ pūjayāmi maheśvaram|| tato mayā sabhāryeṇa rudreśaḥ saṃprapūjitaḥ || 45 || padmaiśca bhaktiyuktena sabhāryeṇa viśeṣataḥ || jāgratsthitastu devāgre tāṃ rātriṃ saha bhāryayā || 46 || tataḥ prabhātasamaya udite sūryamaṇḍale || sā veśyā māmuvācedaṃ kaladhautapalatrayam || 47 || gṛhāṇamūlyaṃ padmānāṃ na gṛhītaṃ mayā hi tat || sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāsthāya sabhāryeṇa dvijottamāḥ || 48 || tato bhikṣāṃ samāhṛtya prāṇayātrā mayā kṛtā || kālena mahatā prāptaḥ kāladharmaṃ munīśvarāḥ || 49 || iyaṃ me dayitā sādhvī prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || mama dehaṃ samādāya praviṣṭā havyavāhanam|| || 7.1.39.50 || tatprabhāvādahaṃ jātaḥ sarvabhaumo mahīpatiḥ || jātismaraḥ sabhāryastu satyametaddvijottamāḥ || 51 || etasmātkāraṇādasya bhaktirliṃgasya copari || mama nityaṃ sabhāryasya satyametadbravīmi vaḥ || 52 || mayā kriyāvihīnena bhaktibāhyena sattamāḥ || vratametatsamācīrṇaṃ tasyedaṃ sumahatpha lam|| 53 || adhunā bhaktiyuktasya yathopakaraṇānmama || bhaviṣye yatphalaṃ kiṃcinno vedmi ca munīśvarāḥ || yena someśamutsṛjya atrāhaṃ bhakti tatparaḥ || 54 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ śrutvā tu te viprā vismayotphullalocanāḥ || sādhusādhviti jalpaṃto rājānaṃ saṃpraśaṃsire || 55 || pūjayāmāsuraniśaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra svayaṃbhuvam || tato'sau pārthivaśreṣṭho liṃgasyāsyaprasādataḥ || saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ prāpto durllabhāṃ tridaśairapi || 56 || sā ca veśyā bhagavatī śivarātriprabhāvataḥ || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyādraṃbhānāmāpsarā'bhavat || 57 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena talliṃgaṃ pūjayedbudhaḥ || dharmakāmārthamokṣaṃ ca yo vāṃchatyakhilapradam || 58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye kedāreśvara (rudreśvara)liṅgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||39||
<7.1.40>
