īśvara uvāca|| tato gacchenmahādevi śvetaketupratiṣṭhitam|| liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu bhīmenārādhitaṃ purā||1|| kedāreśvarasāṃnidhye nātidūre vyavasthitam|| pūjayate ttadvidhānena kṣīrasnānādibhiḥ kramāt || yātrāphalamabhiprepsuḥ pretya svargaphalāya vai || 2 || || devyuvāca || || śvetaketostu yaddeva liṃgaṃ proktaṃ tvayā mama || tasya jātaṃ kathaṃ deva nāma bhīmeśvareti ca || 3 || kathaṃ vinirmitaṃ pūrvaṃ tasmindṛṣṭe tu kiṃ phalam || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || āsīttretāyuge pūrvaṃ rājā svāyaṃbhuveṃtare || śvetaketuriti khyāto rājarṣiḥ sumahātapāḥ || 5 || sa prabhāsaṃ samāgatya pratiṣṭhāpya mahe śvaram || tapastepe suvipulaṃ sāgarasya taṭe śubhe || 6 || paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme varṣāsvākāśagastathā || hemaṃte jalamadhyastho nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca || 7 || tataścaturddaśe devi tapasā niyamena ca || tuṣṭenokto mayā devi varaṃ varaya suvrata || 8 || śvetaketurathovāca bhaktiṃ dehi suniścalām || sthāne'sminsthīyatāṃ deva yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho || 9 || evamastvityathoktvā'haṃ tasyāṃtarddhānamāgataḥ || tataḥ kālāṃtare'tīte śvetaketurmahāprabhaḥ || 7.1.40.10 || samārādhya tvidaṃ liṃgaṃ prāptaḥ sthānaṃ mahodayam || tato jātaṃ nāma tasya śvetaketvīśvaraṃ śrutam || 11 || agnitīrthe mahāpuṇye sarvapātakanāśane || tataḥ kaliyuge prāpte bhrātṛbhiśca samanvitaḥ || 12 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena yadā prabhāsamāgataḥ || bhīmaseno mahābāhurvāyuputro mamāṃśajaḥ || 13 || talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa kṛtvā jāgeśvaraṃ nijam || matvā tīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ sāgarasya samīpataḥ || 14 || tadā prabhṛti bhīmeśaṃ punarnāmā'bhavacchubham || dṛṣṭamātreṇa tenaiva sakṛlliṃgena bhāmini || 15 || anyajanmakṛtānyeva pāpāni subahūnyapi || nāśamāyāṃti sarvāṇi tathaivāmuṣmikāṇi tu || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhīmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || || ||
<7.1.41>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge sarasvatyā pratiṣṭhitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu someśādagnigocare || 1 || bhairaveśvararūpastu vāḍavaḥ kumbhasaṃsthitaḥ || yatra devyā samānītaḥ sāgarasya samīpataḥ || 2 || viśrāmārthaṃ kṣaṇaṃ muktvā devyā liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || samabhyarcya vidhānena gṛhītvā vaḍavānalam|| samudramadhye cikṣepa devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || 3 || tato hṛṣṭatarā devāḥ śaṃkhadundubhiniḥsvanaiḥ || pūrayantoṃ'baraṃ devīmīḍire puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ || 4 || devamāteti te nāma kṛtvocustāṃ tadā surāḥ || kṛtvā tu bhairavaṃ kāryamasādhyaṃ devadānavaiḥ || 5 || pratiṣṭhitavatī cātra yasmālliṃgaṃ mahodayam || tvaṃ sarvasaritāṃ śreṣṭhā sarvapātakanāśinī || tasmādbhairavanāmeti liṃgaṃ khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 6 || ityuktā tu tadā devī bhairaveśvaranairṛte || sāgarasya sthitā ramye tatra mūrttimatī satī || 7 || pūjayettāṃ vidhānena taṃ tathā bhairaveśvaram || mahānavamyāṃ yatnena kṛtvā snānaṃ vidhānataḥ || sarasvatīṃ pūjayitvā vāgdoṣānmucyate'khilāt || 8 || tasyā liṃgaṃ tu saṃpūjya saṃsnāpya payasā pṛthak || aghoreṇaiva vidhivatsamyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || || ||
<7.1.42>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi caṇḍīśaṃ devamuttamam || someśādīśadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || 1 || daṇḍapāṇestu bhavanāddakṣiṇe nātidūragam || caṃḍyā pratiṣṭhitaṃ pūrvaṃ caṇḍenārādhitaṃ tataḥ || 2 || gaṇena mama deveśi tatkṛtvā duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || tena caṇḍeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale || 3 || snāpayetpayasā pūrvaṃ dadhnā ghṛtayutena ca || madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet || 4 || karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhirasena ca || candanena sugandhena puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayettataḥ || 5 || dagdhvā dhūpaṃ puro devi tato devasya cāgurum || vastraiḥ saṃpūjayetpaścādātmavittānusārataḥ || 6 || naivedyaṃ paramānnaṃ ca dattvā dīpasama nvitam || tato dadyāddvijātibhyo yathāśaktyā tu dakṣiṇām|| 7 || dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthāya yatkiṃcittatra dīyate|| caṇḍīśasya varārohe tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 8 || yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra caṇḍīśasya tu dakṣiṇe || ākalpaṃ tṛptimāyāṃti pitarastasya bhāmini || 9 || ayane cottare prāpte yaḥ kuryādghṛta kambalam || na sa bhūyo'tra saṃsāre janma prāpnoti dāruṇam|| 7.1.42.10 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā yātrāṃ devasya śūlinaḥ || nirmālyātikramodbhūtairajñānādbhakṣaṇodbhavaiḥ || pāpaiḥ pramucyate jaṃtustathā'nyaiḥ karmasaṃbhavaiḥ || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye caṇḍīśamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmadvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 || || ||
<7.1.43>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchedvarārohe liṃgaṃ sūryapratiṣṭhitam || someśātpaścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam|| ādityeśvaranāmānaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tretāyuge mahādevi samudreṇa mahātmanā || ratnaiḥ saṃpūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye || 2 || tena ratneśvaraṃnāma sāṃprataṃ prathitaṃ kṣitau || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya paṃcaratnaiḥ prapūjayet ||3|| tato rājopacāreṇa pūjayedvidhivannaraḥ || evaṃ kṛte mahādevi merudānaphalaṃ labhet ||4|| sarveṣāṃ caiva yajñānāṃ dānānāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ ||5|| tīrthānāṃ cāpi sarveṣāṃ yaccānyatsukṛtaṃ bhuvi || uddharetpitṛvargaṃ ca mātṛvargaṃ ca mānavaḥ || 6 || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā || kṣālayeccaiva tatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā ratneśvaraṃ naraḥ || 7 || dhenudānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tasminsthāne maharṣayaḥ || dhenudastārayennūnaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān || 8 || devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge yo japecchatarudriyam || saṃpūjya vidhivalliṃgaṃ na sa bhūyaḥ prajāyate ||9|| evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktamādityeśamahodayam || śrutvā'vadhārya yatnena mucyate karmabaṃdhanaiḥ || 7.1.43.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ādityeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || || cha ||
<7.1.44>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ādityeśaṃ samabhyarcya punaḥ someśvaraṃ vrajet || taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena paṃcāṃgena viśeṣataḥ || 1 || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ caiva sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || pradakṣiṇādikaṃ kuryātsaṃpaśyecca punaḥpunaḥ || 2 || sūryācandramasorliṃgaṃ triḥkṛtvā prayataḥ śuciḥ || agnīṣomātmakaṃ karma tena sarvaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet || 3 || umādevīṃ tato gacchetsomeśvarasamīpataḥ || dvitīyāṃ tu tato gaccheddaityasūdanasannidhau || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame pramāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || || cha ||
<7.1.45>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi aṃgāreśvaramuttamam || sthāpitaṃ bhūmiputreṇa someśādīśa gocare || 1 || tripuraṃ dagdhukāmasya purā mama varānane || krodhādaśru viniṣkrāṃtaṃ locanatritayena tu ||2|| tacca bhūmau nipatitaṃ tato bhūbhisuto'bhavat || sa prabhāsaṃ tato gatvā bālyātprabhṛti śaṃkaram || 3 || tapasā''rādhayāmāsa bahūnvarṣagaṇānpriye || tasya tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ suprītātmā varaṃ dadau || 4 || so'bravīdyadi me deva tuṣṭosi vṛṣabhadhvaja || grahatvaṃ dehi sarveśa na cānyaṃ varamutsahe || 5 || sa tatheti pratijñāya punastaṃ vākyamabravīt || ihāgatya naro yo māṃ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ || 6 || na bhaviṣyati vai pīḍā tāvakī tasya kutracit || puṣpāṇi raktavarṇāni madhvājyāktāni bhūriśaḥ || 7 || homayiṣyati yo bhaktyā lakṣamekaṃ tadagrataḥ || paṃcopacāravidhinā tvāṃ tu saṃpūjya yatnataḥ || 8 || tasya janmāvadhirnaiva tava pīḍā bhaviṣyati ||| tathā vidrumadānena lapsyate phalamīpsitam || 9 || evamuktvā sa bhagavānatraivāṃtaradhīyana || bhaumo'pi grahamadhyastho vimānena virājate ||7.1.45.1||| evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ bhaumamāhātmyamuttamam|| śrutaṃ harati pāpāni tathārogyaṃ prayacchati || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'gāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 45 || || ||
<7.1.46>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasyaivottarataḥ sthitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu budheśvaramiti śrutam || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ dvitaye caiva nātidūre vyavasthitam || sarvapāpa haraṃ liṃgaṃ darśanādeva bhāmini || 2 || budhena caiva deveśi tatra taptaṃ mahātapaḥ || sthāpitaṃ vimalaṃ liṃgaṃ samārādhya sadāśivam || 3 || varṣāyutāni catvāri saṃpūjya tu vidhānataḥ || ananyacetāḥ śāṃtātmā pratyakṣīkṛtavānbhavam|| 4 || tatastuṣṭamanā devo grahatvaṃ tasya taddadau || taṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena somaputrapratiṣṭhitam|| saumyāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || 5 || na daurbhāgyaṃ kule tasya na caiveṣṭaviyojanam || śatruto na bhayaṃ tasya bhavettasyaprasādataḥ || 6 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ budhadaivatam|| śrutvā'bhinaṃdya prayataḥ prāpnoti paramaṃ padam || 7 || iti śrīskānde mahāpu rāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye budheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || ||
<7.1.47>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ guruniṣevitam|| umāyāḥ pūrvadigbhāge siddheśāgneyagocare || 1 || saṃsthitaṃ tu mahalliṃgaṃ devācārya pratiṣṭhitam || ārādhya parayā bhaktyā liṃgaṃ varṣasahasrakam || 2 || toṣayāmāsa deveśaṃ bhavaṃ śarvamumāpatim || prāptavānakhilānkāmānaprāpyānakṛtātmabhiḥ || 3 || devānāṃ caiva pūjyatvaṃ prāpya jñānamathaiśvaram|| grahatvaṃ ca tathā prāpya modate divi sāṃpratam || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo bhaktyā na durgati mavāpnuyāt|| bṛhaspatikṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ ye paśyaṃti narottamāḥ || 5 || bṛhaspatikṛtā pīḍā naiva teṣāṃ hi jāyate || tatra śuklacaturdaśyāṃ guruvāre tathā priye || || 6 || saṃpūjya vidhivalliṃgaṃ samyagrājopacārataḥ || athavā bhaktibhāvena prāpnuyātparamaṃ padam || 7 || snānaṃ palasahasreṇa paṃcāmṛtarasena yaḥ || karoti bhaktyā martyo vai mucyate sa ṛṇatrayāt ||8|| mātṛkātpaitṛkāddevi tathā gurusamudbhavāt || sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā nirdvaṃdvo muktimāpnuyāt || 9 || evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ gurudaivatam || śṛṇuyādyastu bhāvena tasya prīto gururbhavet || 7.1.47.10 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vṛhaspatīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 |||| ||
<7.1.48>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ śukrapratiṣṭhitam|| sarvapāpaharaṃ devi vibhūtīśvarapaścime||1|| nātidūre sthitaṃ tatra svayaṃ śukreṇa nirmitam|| yatra saṃjīvanīṃ prāpto vidyāṃ rudraprabhāvataḥ ||2|| saṃtapya tu mahāghoraṃ tapovarṣasahasrakam || saṃprasādya virūpākṣaṃ yo'vāpa grahatāṃ sudhīḥ ||3|| grastena śaṃbhunā yena devakāryārthasiddhaye || tatrodaragatenaiva tapastaptaṃ suduṣkaram|| 4|| varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ tuṣṭiṃ nīto maheśvaraḥ || niṣkāsitastataḥ śīghraṃ śukra mārgeṇa śaṃbhunā ||5|| tataḥ śukreti nāmābhūdbhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ || tadārādhayate liṃgaṃ yaḥ kṛtvā niścalaṃ manaḥ ||6|| mṛtyuṃjayaṃ japellakṣaṃ sa samīhitamāpnuyāt||7|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvathavā spṛṣṭvā janmādimaraṇāntakāt|| mucyate pātakānmṛtyoḥ prasādāttasya bhāmini||8|| mṛtasaṃjīvanārthaṃ yadaiśvaryamaṇimādikam|| prāpnuyānnātra saṃdeho yasya bhaktiḥ suniścalā ||9|| paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya devaṃ śukapratiṣṭhitam|| sugandhapuṣpaiḥ saṃpūjya śaukrīṃ pīḍāṃ sa nāpnuyāt ||7.1.48.10|| iti sarvaṃ samāsena māhātmyaṃ śukradaivatam || kathitaṃ tava suśroṇi śrutaṃ pāpabhayāpaham ||11|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śukreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 48 || || ||
<7.1.49>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmācchukreśvarādgaccheddevi liṃgaṃ mahāprabham|| śanaiścaraiśvaraṃnāma mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || budheśvarātpaścimato hyajādevyagnigocare || tasyā dhanuḥ paṃcakena nātidūre vyavasthitam || 2 || kalpaliṃgaṃ mahādevi pūjitaṃ devadānavaiḥ || chāyāputreṇa saṃtaptaṃ tapaḥ paramaduṣkaram || 3 || anādi nidhano devo yena liṃge'vatāritaḥ || prāptavānyo graheśatvaṃ bhaktyā śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ || 4 || yasya dṛṣṭyā bibheti sma devāsuragaṇo mahān || na sa ko'pyasti vai prāṇī brahmāṃḍe sacarācare || 5 || devo vā dānavo vāpi sauriṇā pīḍito na yaḥ || śanivāreṇa saṃpūjya bhaktyā saurīśvaraṃ śivam || || 6 || śamīpatrairmahādevi tilamāṣaguḍaudanaiḥ || saṃtarpya tu vidhānena dadyātkṛṣṇaṃ vṛṣaṃ dvije || 7 || stutvā stotraiśca vividhaiḥ purāṇaśrutisaṃbhavaiḥ || atha vaikena deveśaḥ stotreṇa paritoṣitaḥ || 8 || rājñā daśarathenaiva kṛtena tu balīyasā || stutyaḥ saurīśvaro devaḥ sarvapīḍopaśāṃtaye|| 9 || || devyu vāca || || kathaṃ daśaratho rājā cakre śānaiścarīṃ stutim || kathaṃ saṃtuṣṭimagamattasya devaḥ śanaiścaraḥ || 7.1.49.10 || || īśvara uvāca || || raghuvaṃśe'ti vikhyāto rājā daśaratho balī || cakravartī sa vijñeyaḥ saptadvīpādhipaḥ purā || 11 || kṛttikāṃte śaniṃ kṛtvā daivajñairjñāpito hi saḥ || rohiṇīṃ bheda yitvā tu śaniryāsyati sāṃpratam || 12 || uktaṃ śakaṭabhedaṃ tu surāsurabhayaṃkaram || dvādaśābdaṃ tu durbhikṣaṃ bhaviṣyati sudāruṇam || 13 || etacchrutvā munervākyaṃ maṃtribhiḥ sahito nṛpaḥ || ākulaṃ tu jagaddṛṣṭvā paurajānapadādikam || 14 || vadaṃti satataṃ lokā niyamena samāgatāḥ || deśāśca nagara grāmā bhayākrāṃtāḥ samaṃtataḥ || munīnvasiṣṭhapramukhānpapraccha ca svayaṃ nṛpaḥ || 15 || || daśaratha uvāca || || samādhānaṃ kimatrāste brūhi me dvija sattama || 16 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || prājāpatye ca nakṣatre tasminbhinne kutaḥ prajāḥ || ayaṃ yogo hyasādhyastu brahmādīṃdrādibhiḥ suraiḥ|| || 17 || tadā saṃciṃtya manasā sāhasaṃ paramaṃ mahat || samādāya dhanurdivyaṃ divyairastraiḥ samanvitam || 18 || rathamāruhya vegena gato nakṣatramaṃḍalam ||| rathaṃ tu kāṃcanaṃ divyaṃ maṇiratnavibhūṣitam || 19 || dhvajaiśca cāmaraiśchatraiḥ kiṃkiṇairatha śobhitam|| haṃsavarṇahayairyuktaṃ mahāketusamanvitam || 7.1.49.20 || dīpyamāno mahāratnaiḥ kirīṭamukuṭojjvalaḥ || babhrāja sa tadākāśe dvitīya iva bhāskaraḥ || 21 || ākarṇaṃ cāpamāpūrya saṃhārāstraṃ niyojya ca || kṛttikāṃte śaniṃ jñātvā praviśya kila rohiṇīm || 22 || dṛṣṭvā daśaratho'syāgre tasthau sabhrukuṭīmukhaḥ || saṃhārāstraṃ śanirdṛṣṭvā surāsuravimarddanam|| || 23 || hasitvā tadrayātsauriridaṃ vacanamabravīt || pauruṣaṃ tava rājeṃdra paraṃ ripubhayaṃkaram || 24 || devāsuramanuṣyāśca siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || mayā vilokitāḥ sarve bhayaṃ cāśu vrajaṃti te || 25 || tuṣṭohaṃ tava rājeṃdra tapasā pauruṣeṇa ca || varaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi manasā yadabhīpsitam || 26 || || || daśaratha uvāca || || rohiṇīṃ bhedayitvā tu na gaṃtavyaṃ tvayā śane || saritaḥ sāgarā yāvadyāvaccadrārkamedinī || 27 || yācitaṃ te mayā saure nānya micchāmi te varam || evamuktaḥ śaniḥ prādādvaraṃ tasmai tu śāśvatam || 28 || prāpyaivaṃ tu varaṃ rājā kṛtakṛtyo'bhavattadā || punarevābravītsaurirvaraṃ varaya suvrata || 29 || prārthayāmāsa hṛṣṭātmā varamevaṃ śanestadā || na bhettavyaṃ ca śakaṭaṃ tvayā bhāskaranaṃdana || 7.1.49.30 || dvādaśābdaṃ tu durbhikṣaṃ na kartavyaṃ kadācana || kīrtireṣā madīyā ca trailokye vicariṣyati || 31 || || īśvara uvāca || || varadvayaṃ tataḥ prāpya hṛṣṭaromā sa pārthivaḥ || rathopari dhanurmuktvā bhūtvā caiva kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 32 || dhyātvā sarasvatīṃ devīṃ gaṇanāthaṃ vināyakam || rājā daśarathaḥ stotraṃ saureridamathākarot || 33 || || || rājovāca || || namo nīlamayūkhāya nīlotpalanibhāya ca || namo nirmāṃsadehāya dīrghaśmaśrujaṭāya ca ||34|| namo viśālanetrāya śuṣkodarabhayāna ka || namaḥ paruṣagātrāya sthūlaromāya vai namaḥ || 35 || namo nityaṃ kṣudhārttāya nityataptāya vai namaḥ || namaḥ kālāgnirūpāya kṛtāṃtaka namostu te || 36 || namo dīrghāya śuṣkāya kāladṛṣṭe namo'stu te || namaste koṭarākṣāya durnirīkṣyāya vai namaḥ ||37|| namo ghorāya raudrāya bhīṣaṇāya karā line || namaste sarvabhakṣāya valīmukha namo'stu te || 38 || sūryaputra namaste'stu bhāskare bhayadāyaka || adhodṛṣṭe namastubhyaṃ vapuḥśyāma namo'stu te || 39 || namo mandagate tubhyaṃ nistriṃśāya namonamaḥ || namasta ugrarūpāya caṇḍatejāya te namaḥ || 7.1.49.40 || tapasā dagdhadehāya nityaṃ yogaratāya ca || namaste jñānanetrāya kaśyapātmajasūnave || 41 || tuṣṭo dadāsi vai rājyaṃ ruṣṭo harasi tatkṣaṇāt || devāsuramanuṣyāśca paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ ||42|| tvayā vilokitāḥ saure dainyamāśu vrajaṃti ca || brahmā śakro yamaścaiva ṛṣayaḥ saptatārakāḥ || 43 || rājyabhraṣṭāśca te sarve tava dṛṣṭyā vilokitāḥ || deśāśca nagaragrāmā dvīpāścaivādrayastathā || 44 || raudradṛṣṭyā tu ye dṛṣṭāḥ kṣayaṃ gacchaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 45 || prasādaṃ kuru me saure varārthe'haṃ tavāśritaḥ saure kṣamasvāparādhaṃ sarvabhūtahitāya ca || 46 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ stutastadā saurī rājñā daśarathena ca || maharājaḥ śanirvākyaṃ hṛṣṭaro mā'bravīdidam || 47 || || śaniruvāca || || tuṣṭo'haṃ tava rājendra stavenānena suvrata || varaṃ brūhi pradāsyāmi svecchayā raghunaṃdana || 48 || || || daśaratha uvāca || || adyaprabhṛti piṃgākṣa pīḍā kāryā na kasyacit || devāsuramanuṣyāṇāṃ paśupakṣisarīsṛpām || 49 || || śaniruvāca || || grahāṇāṃ durgraho jñeyo grahapīḍāṃ karomyaham || adeyaṃ prārthitaṃ rājankiṃcidyuktaṃ dadāmyaham || 7.1.49.50 || tvayā proktaṃ mama stotraṃ ye paṭhi ṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || puruṣāśca striyo vāpi madbhayenopapīḍitāḥ || 51 || devāsuramanuṣyāstu siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || mṛtyusthāne sthito vāpi janmaprāṃtagatastathā || 52 || ekakālaṃ dvikālaṃ vā teṣāṃ śreyo dadāmyaham || pūjayitvā japetstotraṃ bhūtvā caiva kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 53 || tasya pīḍāṃ na caivāhamiha kuryāṃ kadācana || janmasthāne sthito vāpi mṛtyusthāne sthito'pi ca || 54 || janmaṛkṣe ca lagne ca daśāsvaṃtardaśāsu ca || rakṣāmi satataṃ tasya pīḍāṃ cānyagrahasya ca || 55 || anenaiva prakāreṇa rpāḍāmuktastvasau bhavet || etatproktaṃ mayā dattaṃ varaṃ ca raghunaṃdana || 56 || || īśvara uvāca || || varadvayaṃ ca saṃprāpya rājā daśarathaḥ purā || mene kṛtārthamātmānaṃ namaskṛtya śanaiścaram || 57 || śaniṃ stutvā'bhyanujñāto rathamāruhya vīryavān || svasthānaṃ gatavānrājā pūjyamāno divaukasaiḥ || 58 || ya idaṃ prātarutthāya saurivāre paṭhennaraḥ || sarvagrahodbhavā pīḍā na bhavedbhuvi tasya tu || 59 || śanaiścaraṃ smareddevaṃ nityaṃ bhaktisamanvitaḥ || pūjayitvā paṭhetstotraṃ tasya tuṣyati bhāskariḥ || 7.1.49.60 || iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ śanidaivatam || sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathamaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śanaiścareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || || cha ||
<7.1.50>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ rāhupratiṣṭhitam || śanaiścareśvarāddevi vāyavye saṃpratiṣṭhitam || 1 || ajādevyāścottarato dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || maṃgalāyāḥ samīpasthaṃ nātidūre vyavasthitam || 2 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu saiṃhikeyapratiṣṭhitam || tatra varṣasahasraṃ tu vaipracittistapo'karot || 3 || svarbhānuḥ sa mahāvīryo vaktrayodhī mahāsurāḥ || samārādhya mahādevaṃ divyena tapasā prabhum || 4 || liṃge'vatārayāmāsa jagaddīpaṃ maheśvaram || yaścainaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā naraḥ samyakca paśyati || tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti api brahmavadhodbhavam || 5 || nāṃdho na badhiro mūko na rogī na ca nirddhanaḥ || kadācijjāyate martyastena dṛṣṭena bhūtale || 6 || sukhasaubhāgyasaṃpannastadā bhavati rūpavān || sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā modate divi devavat || 7 || iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ rāhudaivatam || śrutvā tu mohaniryāto naro niṣkalmaṣo bhavet || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāhvīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || || ||
<7.1.51>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ketuliṃgaṃ mahāprabham || rāhvīśānāduttare ca maṃgalāyāśca dakṣiṇe || 1 || dhanuṣoṃtaramānena nātidūre vyavasthitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam || 2 || keturnāma grahotyugraḥ śivasadbhāvabhāvitaḥ || vartulo'tīva vistīrṇo locanābhyāṃ subhīṣaṇaḥ || 3 || palāladhūmasaṃkāśo grahapīḍāpahārakaḥ || tatrākarottapaścograṃ divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye || 4 || tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo graha tvaṃ pradadau priye || ekādaśaśatānāṃ ca grahāṇāmādhipatyatām || 5 || tatrasthaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā ketuliṃgaṃ mahāprabham || ketūdaye mahāghore tasmindṛṣṭe viśeṣataḥ || 6 || grahapīḍāsu cogrāsu pūjayettaṃ vidhānataḥ || puṣpairgaṃdhaistathā dhūpairnaivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 7 || toṣayedvidhivaddevaṃ ketuṃ kalmaṣanāśanam || 8 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ ketuliṃgaṃ mahodayam || grahapīḍopaśamanaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 9 || etāni nava liṃgāni grahāṇāṃ kathitāni te || yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ tasya pīḍābhayaṃ kutaḥ || 7.1.51.10 || na daurbhāgyaṃ kule tasya na rogī naiva duḥkhitaḥ || jāyate putravaddevi taṃ rakṣaṃti mahāgrahāḥ || 11 || iti te kathitaṃ samyakcaturdaśāyatanaṃ priye || vighneśvaraṃ samārabhya yāvatketupratiṣṭhitam || 12 || navagraheśvarāṇāṃ tu māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || tathaiva paṃcaliṃgānāṃ śrutvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 13 || kaparddinaṃ samārabhya caṃḍanāthāṃtakāni ca || paṃcaiva mudrāliṃgāni nāpuṇyo veda mānavaḥ || 14 || sūryeśvaraṃ samārabhya ketuliṃgāṃtakāni vai || navagrahāṇāṃ liṃgāni nānyo jānāti kaścana || 15 || caturdaśavidhā tvevaṃ proktā''yatanasaṃgatiḥ || yaścaināṃ veda bhāvena sa kṣetraphalamaśnute || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ketvīśvaramāhātmyavarṇananāmaikapaṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 || || cha || ||
<7.1.52>
|| īśvara uvāca || || paṃcātha siddhaliṃgāni kathayāmi yaśasvini || yeṣāṃ darśanato devi siddhā yātrā bhavennṛṇām || 1 || someśādīśadigbhāge varāroheti yā smṛtā || tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param || abhigamya naro bhaktyā aṇimādikamāpnuyāt || 2 || siddhaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktyā tu mānavaḥ || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ siddhalokaṃ sa gacchati || 3 || vighnāni nāśamāyāṃti tatra kṣetranivāsinām || kāmaḥ krodho bhaya lobho rāgo matsara eva ca || 4 || īrṣyā daṃbhastathā''lasyaṃ nidrā mohastvahaṃkṛtiḥ || etāni vighnarūpāṇi siddhervighnakarāṇi tu || 5 || tāni nāśaṃ samāyāṃti tatra siddhe śvarārcanāt || evaṃ jñātvā tu yatnena tatra yātrāṃ samācaret || 6 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi siddheśvaramahodayam|| sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 || || ||
<7.1.53>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kapileśvaramuttamam|| tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge nātidūre vyava sthitam || 1 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu darśanātpāpanāśanam || kapilonāma rājarṣiryatra taptvā mahātapaḥ || 2 || saṃprāptaḥ paramāṃ siddhiṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || devasāṃnidhyamīśānaṃ tasmim̐lliṃge sadā hariḥ || 3 || śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ sarvalokahitārthataḥ || saptakṛtvo mahādevaṃ someśaṃ kapileśvaram|| yaḥ paśyetprayato bhūtvā sa godānaphalaṃ labhet || 4 || tiladhenuṃ ca yo dadyāttasmiṃstīrthe samāhitaḥ || tilasaṃkhyāyugānyeva sa svarge vasati priye || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapileśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tripañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || || a ||
<7.1.54>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃdharveśvaramuttamam || daṇḍapāṇestu bhavanāduttare nikaṭe sthitam||1|| yatra gaṃdharvarājo vai ghanavāheti viśrutaḥ|| tasya gaṃdharvaseneti khyātā putrī mahāprabhā||2|| śikhaṃḍinā gaṇenaiva sā śaptā rūpagarvitā|| tato gośṛṃgaṛṣiṇā dattastasyā anugrahaḥ||3|| somavāravratenaiva someśārādhanaṃ prati|| tataḥ kṣetraṃ samāgatya tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram||4|| liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa tatra gaṃdharvarāṭ svayam|| tathaiva putryā tasyaiva tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam||5|| atha tatraiva deveśi daṃḍapāṇeḥ samīpataḥ || ghanavāheśvaraṃ nāma yo liṃgaṃ yatnato'rcayet || 6 || gaṃdharvalokamāpnoti dṛṣṭvā sa prayataḥ śuciḥ || iti te kathitaṃ devi gāṃdharvaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 7 || tṛtīyaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ puṇyavarddhanam || agnitīrthe naraḥ snātvā pūjya gaṃdharvapūjitam || 8 || ayane cottare prāpte nirvāṇamadhigacchati || śrutvā 'bhinaṃdya māhātmyaṃ mucyate mahato bhayāt || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye gandharveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpaṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ||54||
<7.1.55>
īśvara uvāca|| tato gacchenmahādevi tatpūrve vimaleśvaram|| gauryāḥ pūrvaṃ samīpasthaṃ nātidūre vyavasthitam||1|| gurornairṛtyadigbhāge sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam|| api kṛtvā mahāpāpaṃ nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā || 2 || kṣayābhibhūtadeho vā taṃ samabhyarcya bhaktitaḥ || sarvaduḥkhāntago bhūtvā nirmalaṃ padamāpnuyāt || 3 || gaṃdharvasenā yatraiva vimalā'bhūtkṣayā nvitā || vimaleśvaranāmnā vai talliṃgaṃ prathitaṃ kṣitau || 4 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vimaleśvarasūcakam || māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ turīyaṃ bhavasundari || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vimaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 55 || || cha ||
<7.1.56>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha te paṃcamaṃ vacmi siddhaligaṃ mahāprabham || brahmaṇo nairṛte bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe sthitam || 1 || rāhuliṃgasya cābhyāśe liṃgaṃ dhanadanirmitam || dhanadatvaṃ ca saṃprāpto yatra taptvā mahattapaḥ || 2 || saṃsthāpya vidhivatpūjya liṃgaṃ varṣasahasrakam || alakādhipatirjātastatra śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ || 3 || jātiṃ smṛtvā pūrvikāṃ tu jñātvā dīpadaśāphalam || śivarātre prabhāvaṃ tu prabhāsaṃ punarāgataḥ || 4 || prabhāvātiśayaṃ jñātvā sthāpayāmāsa śaṃkaram || tatra pratyakṣatāṃ nītastapasā yena śaṃkaraḥ || 5 || mahābhaktyā mahādevi tasmim̐lliṃge'vatāritaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo bhaktyā pūjayitvā yathāvidhi || 6 || pañcopacāraiḥ sadbhaktyā gandhadhūpānulepanaiḥ || tasyānvaye daridraśca kadāpi na bhaviṣyati || 7 || ye caitatpūjayiṣyaṃti liṃgaṃ bhaktiyutā narāḥ || ajeyāste bhaviṣyaṃti śatrūṇāṃ darpanāśanāḥ || 8 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ dhanadeśamahodayam || śrutvānumodya yatnena daridro naiva jāyate || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye dhanadeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 56 || || dha ||
<7.1.57>
|| īśvara uvāca || || paṃcaivaṃ siddhaliṃgāni kathitāni tava priye || yaścainaṃ veda saṃketaṃ kṣetravāsī sa ucyate || 1 || atha śaktitrayāṇāṃ te raudrīṇāṃ vacmi vistaram || icchā kriyājñānaśaktyastisrastāḥ parikīrttitāḥ || 2 || punastāsāṃ pūjanāyānukramaṃ kramataḥ śṛṇu || caturdaśa tathā paṃca pūrvamuktāni yāni tu || 3 |||| catvāri trīṇi caikaṃ vā yathāśaktyābhipūjya ca || liṃgāni tāni saṃpūjya śaktīstisrastato'rcayet || 4 || someśādīśadigbhāge varāroheti yā smṛtā || amā kalā sā somasya umā paścātprakīrttitā ||5|| icchāśaktistu sā jñeyāprabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthitā || tatra devi hitārthāya sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi || 6 || tasyā māhātmyamakhilaṃ kathayāmi tavādhunā || purā somena tyaktābhirbhāryābhistu varānane || 7 || ṣaḍviṃśadbhistapastaptaṃ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || gaurī sā''rādhyamānātha divyavarṣagaṇānbahūn || 8 || tāsāṃ pratyakṣatāṃ prāptā pārvatī parameśvarī || uvāca varadā brūta yadvo manasi saṃsthitam || 9 || atha tāścābruvandevi yadi tuṣṭāsi pārvati || saubhāgyaṃ dehi no bhūri lāvaṇyaṃ paramaṃ tathā || 7.1.57.10 || tyaktāḥ sarvā vayaṃ devi nirdoṣāḥ svāminā śubhe || daurbhāgyadoṣasaṃdagdhā daurbhāgyeṇa tu pīḍitāḥ || 11 || || gauryuvāca || || adyaprabhṛti sarvā vaḥ samaṃ drakṣyati rātripaḥ || prasādānmama cārvaṃgyo naitanmithyā bhaviṣyati || 12 || varadā ceti mannāma varadānādbhaviṣyati || ihāgatya tu yā nārī pūjayiṣyati māṃ śubhām || 13 || na daurbhāgyaṃ kule tasyāḥ kvacitprāpsyaṃti yoṣitaḥ || māghamāse tṛtīyāyāmupavāsaparāyaṇā || 14 || yā māṃ drakṣyati suśroṇī mattulyā sā bhavi ṣyati || dampatī ṣoḍaśaivātra paridhāpya prayatnataḥ || 15 || phalāni bhakṣyabhojyaṃ ca pakvānnāni ca ṣoḍaśa || yā pradāsyati vai nārī sā tūmaiva bhaviṣyati || 16 || etadgaurīvrataṃnāma tṛtīyāyāṃ tu kārayet || aprasūtā ca yā nārī yā nārī durbhagā bhavet || 17 || pumānasakṛdapyaivaṃ kṛtvā prāpsyatyabhīpsitam || evamuktvā sthitā tatra sā devī cārulocanā || 18 || paśyate rātrināthaśca sarvāstā rohiṇīṃ yathā || anyāpi duḥkhasaṃdagdhā daurbhāgyeṇa tu pīḍitā || 19 || apūjayadumāṃ devīṃ subhagā sā'bhavattataḥ || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ śaktisaṃbhavam || 7.1.57.20 || someśvare varārohā nāmeti kathitaṃ tava || sarvapāpakṣayakaraṃ sarvadāridryanāśanam || 21 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye varārohāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapaṃcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 || || cha ||
<7.1.58>
īśvara uvāca || || atha dvitīyāṃ te vacmi śaktiṃ devi kriyātmikām || prabhāsasthāṃ mahādevīṃ devānāṃ prītidāyinīm || 1 || someśādvāyave bhāge ṣaṣṭidhanvatare sthitā || tatra pīṭhaṃ mahādevi yoginīgaṇavanditam || 2 || tasminsthāne sthitaṃ devi pātālavivaraṃ mahat || tasminmahāprabhe sthāne rakṣārūpeṇa saṃsthitām || 3 || pātālanidhi nikṣepadivyauṣadhirasāyanam || kṣetramadhye sthitaṃ sarvaṃ tadarcanarato labhet || 4 || bhairavīti ca taddevyāḥ pūrvaṃ nāma prakīrttitam || asminpunaścāṃtare tu aṣṭāviṃśe caturyuge || tretāyugamukhe rājā ajāpālo babhūva ha || 5 || tena cāgatya kṣetresminpaṃcavarṣaśatāni ca || bhairavī pūjitā devī vyādhigrastena bhāmini || 6 || tataḥ provāca taṃ devī saṃtuṣṭā rājasattamam || alaṃ kleśena rājarṣe tuṣṭāhaṃ tava bhaktitaḥ || 7 || ityuktaḥ sa tadā rājā kṛtāñjalipuṭaḥ sudhīḥ || praṇamyovāca tāṃ devīmānaṃdāsrāvilekṣaṇaḥ || 8 || yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi varārho yadi vāpyaham || sarve rogāḥ śarīrānme nāśaṃ yāṃtu bahiḥ kṛtāḥ || 9 || evamuktā tu sā devī punaḥ provāca taṃ nṛpam || sarvameva mahārāja yathoktaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 7.1.58.10 || ityukte tu tadā devyā tasya rājñaḥ kalevarāt || nirgatā vyādhayastatra ajārūpeṇa vai pṛthak || 11 || sahasrāṇāṃ tu pañcaiva niyataṃ sārddhameva ca || iti vṛtte mahādevyā punaḥ prokto narādhipaḥ ||12 || rājannetānajārūpānvyādhīnpālaya kṛtsnaśaḥ || kiṃkurvāṇā bhaviṣyaṃti tavaivādeśakāriṇaḥ || 13 ||| ajāpāleti te nāma khyātaṃ loke bhaviṣyati || tava nāmnā mama nāma ajāpāleśvarīti ca || bhaviṣyati dharāpṛṣṭhe tacca yāvaccaturyugam || || 14 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ yo'tra māṃ pūjayiṣyati || tasyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ dāsye tuṣṭā na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || aśvayukchuklāṣṭamyāṃ ca triḥ kṛtvā tu pradakṣiṇām || someśaṃ madhyataḥ kṛtvā saṃsnāpyābhyarcya māṃ pṛthak || tasya varṣatrayaṃ rājanna bhīḥ śoko bhaviṣyati || 16 || yā tu vaṃdhyā bhavennārī rogiṇī durbhagā tathā || tayoktā navamī kāryā mamāgre tuṣṭivarddhinī || 17 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktvā tu tadā devī tatraivāṃtarhitā'bhavat || prabhāsakṣetramadhyasthaḥ sa rājātulavikramaḥ || 18 || pālayāmāsa dharmātmā tānajānvyādhirūpiṇaḥ || auṣadhīrvividhākārāsteṣāṃ yāḥ puṣṭihetavaḥ || 19 || tatra varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ puṣṭiṃ nītā ajāḥ pṛthak || mahānidhānasaṃsthānamajāpālena nirmiṃtam|| 7.1.58.20 || atha tasyāḥ prasādena sa rājā pṛthuvikramaḥ || saptadvīpādhipo jātaḥ sūryavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ || 21 || || devyuvāca || || atyāścaryamidaṃ deva ajā devyāḥ samudbhavam || punaśca śrotumicchāmi tasya rājñodbhutaṃ mahat || 22 || kathaṃ rājā sa deveśa saptadvīpāṃ vasundharām|| śaśāsa eka evāsau kathaṃ te vyādhayaḥ kṛtāḥ || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || || purā babhūva rājarṣirdilīpa iti viśrutaḥ || dīrgho nāma sutastasya raghustasmādajāyata || 24 || ajaḥputro raghoścāpi tasmādyaścātivīryavān || sa bhairavīṃ samārādhya kṛtvā vyādhīnajāgaṇān ||25|| pālayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo hyajāpālastato'bhavat|| tasminkāle babhūvātha rāvaṇo rākṣaseśvaraḥ||26|| laṃkāsthitaḥ suragaṇānniyuyoja svakarmasu|| akhaṃḍamaṃḍalaṃ candramātapatraṃ cakāra ha||27|| indraṃ senāpatiṃ cakre vāyuṃ pāṃsupramārjakam|| varuṇaṃ dūtakarmasthaṃ dhanadaṃ dhanarakṣakam||28|| yamaṃ saṃyamane'rīṇāṃ yuyuje mantraṇe manum|| meghāśchardaṃti liṃpaṃti drumāḥ puṣpāṇi cikṣipuḥ||29|| saptarṣayaḥ śāṃtiparā brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsinaḥ priyaḥ|| nāgā yāmakakakṣāyāṃ gandharvā gītatatparāḥ||7.1.58.3||| prekṣaṇīye'psarovṛṃdaṃ vādye vidyādharā vṛtāḥ|| gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ pāne gārhapatye hutāśanaḥ||31|| viśvakarmāṃgasaṃskāre tena śilpī niyojitaḥ|| tiṣṭhaṃti pārthivāḥ sarve puraḥ sevāvidhāyinaḥ||32|| dṛśyaṃte bhāsvarai ratnaiḥ praskhalaṃto vibhūṣaṇaiḥ|| tāndṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaḥ prāha prahastaṃ pratihārakam||33|| sevāṃ karttuṃ mama sthāne brūhi ke'tra samāgatāḥ || uvāca sa praṇamyāgre daṇḍapāṇirniśācaraḥ || 34 || eṣa kākutstho māṃdhātā dhundhumāro nalo'rjunaḥ || yayātirnahuṣo bhīmo rāghavo'yaṃ vidūrathaḥ || 35 || ete cānye ca bahavo rājāna iha cāgatāḥ || sevākarāstava sthāne nājāpāla iho gataḥ || 36 || rāvaṇaḥ kupitaḥ prāha śīghraṃ dūta visarjaya || ityuktvā prahito dūto dhūmrākṣo nāma rākṣasaḥ|| 37 || dhūmrākṣa gaccha brūhi tvamajāpālaṃ mamā jñayā || sevāṃ karttuṃ mamāgaccha karaṃ vā yaccha pārthiva || 38 || athavā candrahāsena tvāṃ kariṣye vikaṃdharam || rāvaṇenaivamuktastu dhūmrākṣo garuḍo yathā || || 39 || saṃprāptastāṃ purīṃ ramyāṃ tava rājakulaṃ gataḥ || dadarśāyāṃtamekaṃ sa ajāpālamajāvṛtam || 7.1.58.40 || muktakeśaṃ muktakacchaṃ svarṇakaṃbaladhāriṇam || yaṣṭiskaṃdhaṃ reṇuvṛtaṃ vyādhibhiḥ parivāritam || 41 || nighnaṃtamiva śārdūlaṃ sarvopadravanāśanam || mahyāmālikhya nāmāni vinighnaṃtaṃ dviṣāṃ gaṇam|| 42 || snātaṃ bhuktaṃ nijasthāne kṛtakṛtyaṃ manuṃ yathā || dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanāḥ prāha dhūmrākṣo rāvaṇoditam || 43 || ajāpālo'pi sākṣepaṃ pratyu ktvā kāraṇottaram || preṣayāmāsa dhūmrākṣaṃ tataḥ kṛtyaṃ samādadhe || 44 || jvaramākārayitvā tu provācedaṃ mahīpatiḥ|| gaccha laṃkādhipasthānamācara tvaṃ yathoditam || 45 || niyuktastvajapālena jvaro divi jagāma ha || gatvā ca kaṃpayāmāsa rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram || 46 || rāvaṇastaṃ viditvā tu jvaraṃ paramadāruṇam || provāca tiṣṭhatu nṛpastena me na prayojanam || 47 || tataḥ sa vijvaro rājā babhūva dhanadānujaḥ || evaṃ tasya caritrāṇi saṃti cānyāni koṭiśaḥ || 48 || ajāpālasya deveśi sūryavattviṭkirīṭinaḥ || tenaiṣā''rādhitā devī ajāpālena dhīmatā || sarvarogapraśamanī sarvo padravanāśinī || 49 || pūjayettāṃ vidhānena bhogepsuryadi mānavaḥ || gaṃdhairdhūpairalaṃkārairvastrairanyaiśca bhaktitaḥ || 7.1.58.50 || iti te kathitaṃ sarvamajādevyāḥ samudbhavam || sarvaduḥkhopaśamanaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 51 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapañcāśo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 || || ||
<7.1.59>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha vacmi tṛtīyāṃ te jñānaśaktiṃ śivātmikām || prabhāsakṣetramadhyasthāṃ dāridryaughavināśinīm || 1 || ajeti nāmnīṃ tāṃ devīṃ rāhvīśāddakṣiṇe sthitām || mama vaktrādviniṣkrāṃtā ṣaṣṭhādvai viṣṇupūjitāt || 2 || || devyuvāca || || paṃcavaktrāṇi deveśa prasiddhāni tava prabhau || ṣaṣṭhaṃ yadvadanaṃ deva tasya kiṃ nāma saṃsmṛtam || samutpannā kathaṃ tasmādajādevīti yā śrutā || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi yadgopyaṃ svasuteṣvapi || tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi aprasiddhāgamoditam || 4 || vaktrāṇi mama deveśi saptāsanpūrvameva hi || sadyojātādipaṃcaiva ṣaṣṭhaṃ smṛtamajeti ca || 5 || saptamaṃ picunāmeti saptaivaṃ vadanāni me || tebhyo'jaṃ brahmaṇe dattaṃ picuvaktraṃ tu viṣṇave || 6 || tasmādahaṃ mahādevi paṃcavaktro'dhunā'bhavam || ajastu brahmā sañjajñe picurviṣṇurajāyata || 7 || ajavaktrānmahādevi ajā jātā mahāprabhā || andhāsuraraṇe ghore mama krodhena bhāmini || 8 || khaḍgacarmadharādevī surūpā siṃhavāhinī || marddayantī mahādaityāndevīkoṭisamanvitā || 9 || tasyā bhayena ye daityā vidrutā dakṣiṇārṇavam || pṛṣṭhato'nuyayau tānvai sā devī siṃhavāhinī || 7.1.59.10 || itastataste dhāvanto māryamāṇāśca tadgaṇaiḥ || prabhāsa kṣetrasaṃprāptā naśyamānā mahārṇavam || 11 || kecittatra hatā daityāḥ kecitpātālamāyayuḥ || niḥśeṣānnihatāndṛṣṭvā sā devī siṃhavāhinī || 12 || kṣetraṃ pavitramājñāya tatra sthāne sthitā śubhā || someśādīśakoṇasthā saurīśāduttare sthitā || 13 || yastāṃ tatra sthitāṃ paśyedyoṣidvātha naro'pi vā || sa bhūyātsattvasaubhāgyaiḥ saptajanmāni saṃyutaḥ ||14|| gītavādyādikaṃ nṛtyaṃ yastatra kurute naraḥ || tasyānvaye na daurbhāgyaṃ bhūyāttasyāḥ prasādataḥ|| ||15|| ghṛtena dīpakaṃ tatra yā nārī saṃprayacchati|| raktavartyā mahādevi yāvaṃtastatra taṃtavaḥ || tāvajjanmāṃtarāṇyeva sā saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt||16|| yaścaitattu paṭhennityaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || śṛṇuyādvā'pi yo bhaktyā sa kāmānakhilāllam̐bhet || 17 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ prokto rudraśaktitrayakramaḥ || 18|| etāḥ śaktīḥ pūjayitvā someśaṃ pūjayettataḥ || samyagyātrāphalāpekṣī ekāṃ vā varadāmatha || 19 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 || || cha || || iti rudraśaktitrayasaṃketaḥ || || ||
<7.1.60>
|| īśvara uvāca || || prabhāsakṣetradūtīnāṃ tritayaṃ varavarṇini || atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanāḥ priye || 1 || prathamā maṃgalā devī viśālākṣī dvitīyikā || tathā catvaradevī tu tṛtīyā parikīrtitā || 2 || yathānukramataḥ pūjyāḥ śaktayastā varānane || prabhāsakṣetrayātrāyāḥ phalaprepsurnaro yadi || 3 || || devyuvāca || || kasminsthāne sthitā deva dūtyastāḥ kṣetrarakṣikāḥ || kasya tāḥ kathamārādhyāḥ kathaṃ pūjyā jagatpate ||4|| || || īśvara uvāca || || brāhmī tu maṃgalā proktā viśālākṣī tu vaiṣṇavī || raudrīśaktiḥ samākhyātā devī sā catvarapriyā || 5 || maṃgalā prathamaṃ pūjyā ajādevyuttare sthitā || rāhvīśāddakṣiṇebhāge nātidūre varānane || 6 || someśvarapratiṣṭhāpya prārabdhe yajñakarmaṇi || somena tatra devānāmāgatā sā didṛkṣayā || 7 || brahmādīnāṃ ca sā yasmānmāṃgalyaṃ kṛtavatyume || tasmātsā maṃgalā proktā sarvamāṃgalyadāyinī || 8 || tṛtīyāyāṃ tu yā nārī naro vā pūjayiṣyati || tasyā'maṃgalyaduḥkhāni nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 9 || dampatībhojanaṃ tatra phaladānaṃ sakañcukam || praśastaṃ pṛṣadājyasya prāśanaṃ pāpanāśanam || 7.1.60.10 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam || maṃgalāyāśca māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṅgalāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 || || ||
<7.1.61>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevīṃ kṣetradūtīṃ tu vaiṣṇavīm || śrīdaityasūdanāddevi pūrvabhāge vyavasthitām ||1|| yogeśvaryāstathaiśānyāṃ dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitām || mahādaurbhāgyadagdhānāṃ sthitāṃ bheṣajarūpiṇīm || 2|| cākṣuṣasyāṃtare devi yadā daityā balotkaṭāḥ || hanyamānā viṣṇunā'tha dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāviśan || 3 || tatra varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ daityāścakrurmahāhavam || viṣṇunā saha deveśi divyāstraiśca pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 4 || duḥkhavadhyāṃstato jñātvā viṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ || sasmāra bhairavīṃ śaktiṃ mahāmāyāṃ mahāprabhām ||5|| sā smṛtā kṣaṇamātreṇa viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā|| tatrāgatā mahādevī ānaṃdasphuritekṣaṇā || 6 || viśāle tu kṛte devyā locane viṣṇudarśanāt || viśālākṣī tato jātā tatrasthā daityanāśinī ||7|| asminkalpesamākhyātā lalitomā varānane || umādvayaṃ samākhyātaṃ someśe daityasūdane || 8 || pūrvaṃ someśvare paśyetpaścācchrīdaityasūdane || umā dvayaṃ pūjayitvā tīrthayātrāphalaṃ labhet ||9|| māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ vidhinā yo'rcayettu tām|| na saṃtativihīnaḥ syāttasyakoṭyanvaye naraḥ ||7.1.61.10|| yo nityamīkṣate tatra bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || ārogyasukhasaubhāgyasaṃyukto'sau bhavecciram || 11 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ lalitodbhavam|| śrutaṃ yatpāpanāśāya jāyate dharmavṛddhaye || 12 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye lalitomāviśālākṣī māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 || || cha ||
<7.1.62>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tṛtīyāṃ catvarapriyām || lalitāpūrvadigbhāge daśadhanvaṃtare sthitām || 1 || kṣetradūtīṃ mahāraudrīṃ rudraśaktiṃ mahāprabhām || kṣetrarakṣāvidhau tatra mayā muktāṃ tu madhyataḥ || 2 || koṭibhūtasamāyuktā mahākāyā mahāprabhā || jīrṇe gṛhe tathodyāne prāsādāṭṭālake pathi || 3 || catvareṣu ca sarveṣu kṣetra madhyasthitā satī || rātrau paryaṭate devī bhūtānāṃ koṭibhirvṛtā || 4 || mahānavamyāṃ yastatra nārī vātha naropi vā || nānāpūjopacāraiśca pūjayedvidhivacchubhām || 5 || tasya tuṣṭā'khilānkāmānsādevī saṃpradāsyati || daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ tatra deyaṃ yātrāphalepsubhiḥ ||9|| iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhā tmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || kṣetradūtyāstṛtīyāyāḥ śrutamaiśvaryakārakam || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye catvarādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 || ||||
<7.1.63>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bhairaveśvaramuttamam || yogeśvaryā dakṣiṇato nātidūre byavasthitam || 1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ dibyaiśvaryapradāyakam|| purā daityavināśārthaṃ yadā devī kṛtodyamā || || 2 || tadā bhairavamāhūya dūtatve niyuyoja ha || śivadūtī tadā khyātā paścādyogeśvarīti ca || 3 || bhairavo yatra vai devyā dūtatve viniyojitaḥ || tena liṃgaṃ samākhyātaṃ bhairaveśvaranāmakam || 4 || pūjitaṃ devadaityaiśca bhairaveṇa pratiṣṭhitam || yastatpūjayate bhaktyā kārtikyāṃ vidhinā naraḥ || niraṃtaraṃ vā ṣaṇmāsaṃ so'bhīṣṭaṃ labhate phalam || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāya || 63 || || ||
<7.1.64>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam || lakṣmīśvareti vikhyātaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam || 1 || yatra devyā samānītā lakṣmīrdetyānnihatya ca || tena lakṣmīśvaraṃ nāma svayaṃ devyā pratiṣṭhitam || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā śrīpaṃcamyāṃ vidhānataḥ || na vimukto bhavellakṣmyā yāvanmanvataraṃ priye ||3|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye lakṣmīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||||
<7.1.65>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vai vāḍaveśvaram || lakṣmīśāduttare bhāge viśālākṣyāśca dakṣiṇe || 1 || sthitaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi vāḍavena pratiṣṭhitam|| kṛtasmaro yadā dagdhaḥ parvato vāḍavāgninā || 2 || samīkṛtyākhilaṃ sthānaṃ tena liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || pūjayettaṃ vidhānena daśa saṃsnāpya śaṃkaram || 3 || dadhi dadyācca vai tatra brāhmaṇe vedapārage| so'gnilokamavāpnoti samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vāḍaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||65 ||
<7.1.66>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahāliṃgamarghyeśvaramiti śrutam || uttare tu viśālākṣyā nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi suragandharvapūjitam || yadā devī samāyātā vaḍavānaladhāriṇī || 2 || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya dṛṣṭvā tatra mahodadhim || arghyaṃ dattavatī tatra vidhinā tanmahodadheḥ || 3 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahalliṃgaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā tataḥ || praviveśātha deveśi snānārthaṃ ca mahodadhau || 4 || yasmādarghyaṃ purā dattvā paścā dīśaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || tenārghyeśeti vikhyātaṃ liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 5 || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya vidhinā yastamarcayet || saptajanmāni deveśi sa vidyāmadhigacchati || samyakchāstrapravaktā ca sarvasaṃdehavittamaḥ || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'rghyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 || || a ||
<7.1.67>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gachenmahāliṃgaṃ kāmeśvaramiti śrutam || kāmenārādhitaṃ pūrvaṃ daityasūdanapaścime || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ saptake tatra sthitaṃ devi mahāprabham || nirdagdhastu yadā kāma stṛtīyenāgninā mama || 2 || tadā varṣasahasraṃ tu samārādhya maheśvaram || prapede kāmanāsargaṃ yatrānaṃgaḥ purā kila || 3 || tena kāmeśvaraṃnāma khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ dharātale || sarvapāpaharaṃ devi sarvakāmaphalapradam || 4 || trayodaśyāṃ vidhānena śuklāyāṃ māsi mādhave || saṃpūjya taṃ vidhānena sa strīṇāṃ kāmavadbhavet|| 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasyā saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ ||67||
<7.1.68>
|| īśvara uvāca || || iti proktāni te devi vaktraliṃgāni paṃca vai || atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi yatra gauryāstapo vanam|| sthānaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi surasiddhaniṣevitam|| 1 || someśātpūrvadigbhāge ṣaṣṭidhanvaṃtare sthitam || yatra devyā tapastaptaṃ satyā vai pūrvajanmani || || 2 || kṛtvā ca praṇayātkopaṃ mayā sārddhaṃ varānane || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā sā tapasvinī || 3 || || devyuvāca || || kimarthaṃ sā parityajya satī tvāṃ tapasi sthitā || kasminsthāne sthitā devī etanme vistarādvada || 4 || || īcara.uvāca || || purā''sīstvaṃ mahādevi śyāmavarṇā manasvinī || nāmārthaṃ ca mayā proktā kālīti rahasi sthitā || 5 || sā śrutvā vismayaṃ vākyaṃ bhṛśaṃ roṣaparāyaṇā || abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ bhṛkuṭī kuṭilānanā||6|| yasmātkālītyahaṃ proktā tvayā śaṃbho'tiviplavāt|| tasmādyāsyāmi gaurīti bhaviṣyāmi ca yatra hi||7|| evamuktvā mahābhāgā sakhīgaṇasamāvṛtā|| gatvā prabhāsakṣetraṃ sā pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram|| gaurīśvareti vikhyātaṃ pūjayaṃtī vidhānataḥ||8|| tato liṃgasamīpasthā ekapāde sthitā satī || liṃgamārādhayaṃtī sā cakāra sumahattapaḥ || 9 || paṃcāgnisādhikā devī grīṣma jāpyaparāyaṇā || varṣāsvākāśaśayanā hemaṃte salilāśayā || 7.1.68.10 || yathā yathā tapo vṛddhiṃ yāti tasyā mahāprabhā || tathātathā śarīrasya gauratvaṃ pratipadyate || 11 || kālena mahatā gaurī sarvāṃgeṇātha sā'bhavat || tato vihasya bhagavānuvāca śaśiśekharaḥ || 12 || gaurīti ca muhurvākyamuttiṣṭha vraja mandiram || varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi yatte manasi varttate || 13 || gauryuvāca || || yo māmatra sthitāṃ paśyennārī vā puruṣo'tha vā || sa bhūyātsutasaubhāgyaiḥ saptajanmāni saṃyutaḥ || || 14 || gītavādyādikaṃ nṛtyaṃ yaḥ kuryātpurato mama || tasyānvaye na daurbhāgyaṃ bhūyāttava prasādataḥ || 15 || mayā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ pūrvamabhyarcya māṃ tataḥ|| pūjayiṣyati yo bhaktyā sa yāsyati paraṃ padam || 16 || gaurīśvareti vikhyātaṃ nāma tasya bhavetprabho || tathetyahaṃ pratijñāya tatra sthāne sthito 'bhavam || 17 || devyā saha mahādevi prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || adyāpi ayane prāpte uttare dakṣiṇe'pi vā || 18 || gaurīṃsthānaṃ samabhyeti tatra deva guṇairyutaḥ|| tasminnahani yastatra viśiṣṭāni phalāni ca || saṃprayacchati viprebhyastasya putrā bhavaṃti ca || 19 || putrahīnā tu yā nārī nālikeraṃ prayacchati || putraṃ sā labhate śīghraṃ sabalaṃ lakṣaṇānvitam || 7.1.68.20 || ghṛtena dīpakaṃ tatra yā nārī saṃprayacchati || raktavarttyā mahādevi yāvattasyaiva taṃtava || || 21 || tāvajjanmāṃtarāṇyeva sā saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt || 22 || yā nṛtyaṃ kurute tatra bhaktyā paramayā yutā || ārogyasukhasaubhāgyaiḥ saṃyuktā sā bhavecciram || 23 || tatrāṃte sumahatkuḍaṃ tīrthaṃ svacchodapūritam || yaḥ snānamācarettatra mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 24 || yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha puṇyabhāk || 25 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret || gītavādyādibhirnṛtyai rātrau kurvīta jāgaram || 26|| daṃpatyoḥ paridhānaṃ ca tatra deyaṃ sadakṣiṇam || yaścaitatpaṭhate nityaṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || pārvatyāḥ purato devi sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt ]| 27 || śṛṇuyādvā'pi yo bhaktyā samyagbhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || so'pi saubhāgyamāpnoti yāvajjīvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 28 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaurītapovanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 68 ||
<7.1.69>
|| devyuvāca || || gaurīśvareti vikhyātaṃ yattvayā liṃgamuttamam || kutra tiṣṭhati talliṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanārānam || gaurīśvarasya devasya sarvakāmapradasya vai || 2 || idaṃ tapovanaṃ devi khyātaṃ gauryā mahāprabham || dhanuṣāṃ pacapaṃcāśatsamaṃtātparimaṃḍalam ||3|| tatra madhye sthitā devī ekapādā taponvitā || tasyā uttarato devi kiṃcidīśānasaṃsthitam|| ||4 || dhanuṣāṃ caturaṃte ca liṃgaṃ pāpabhayāpaham || yastatpūjayate bhaktyā liṃgaṃ bhaktiyuto naraḥ || kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 5 || godānaṃ cātra śaṃsaṃti suvarṇaṃ dvijapuṃgave || annadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvapāpapraśāṃtaye || 6 || goghno vā brahmahā vā'pi tathā duṣkṛtakarmakṛt || sarva pāpaiḥ pramucyeta tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye gaurīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 69 ||
<7.1.70>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi varuṇeśvaramuttamam || gaurītapovanāgneyyāṃ dhanuṣāṃ viṃśatau sthitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi varuṇena pratiṣṭhitam || 1 || pūrvaṃ pīto yadā devi samudraḥ kumbhajanmanā || tadā kopena santapto varuṇaḥ saritāṃ patiḥ || 2 || kāmikaṃ tu samājñāya kṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ tadā || tatrātapaddevi tapaḥ sa vai paramaduścaram || 3 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ saṃpūjayati bhaktitaḥ || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ pūjito vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 4 || tataḥ prasanno deveśi nijagaṃgājalena tu || pūrayāmāsa taṃ riktaṃ samudraṃ yādasāṃpatim || 5 || chaṃdayāmāsa taṃ liṃgaṃ varadānairanekadhā || tatprabhṛtyeva te sarve samudrāḥ paripūritāḥ || 6 || varuṇeśvaranāmeti talliṃgaṃ tatprabhṛtyabhūt || 7 || ko hyartho bahubhirliṃgairdṛṣṭairvā surasundari || varuṇeśena dṛṣṭena sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 8 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ taddadhnā snāpayedyadi || sa brāhmaṇaścaturvedo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 9 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāścānye varānane || mūkāṃdhabadhirā bālāḥ striyaścaiva napuṃsakāḥ || 7.1.70.10 || dṛṣṭvā gacchaṃti te devi svargaṃ dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || snānaṃ jāpyaṃ baliṃ homaṃ pūjāṃ stotraṃ ca nartanam || tasminsthāne tu yaḥ kuryāttatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 11 || haimaṃ padmaṃ mauktikaṃ ca dānaṃ tatraiva dāpayet || samyagyātrāphalāpekṣī svargāpekṣī tathā naraḥ || 12 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye varuṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 70 || || cha || ||
<7.1.71>
tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitam || dakṣiṇe varuṇeśasya dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam ||1|| bhāryayā varuṇasyaiva uṣā nāmnyā varānane || kṛtvā tapo mahāghoraṃ bhartṛduḥkhaparītayā || 2 || sthāpitaṃ tu mahalliṃgaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam|| uṣeśvareti vikhyātaṃ sarvasiddhiprapūjitam ||3|| yastatpūjayate bhaktyā liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || mahāpāpaughayukto'pi sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim ||4|| strīṇāṃ saubhāgyaphaladaṃ duḥkhadaurbhāgyanā śanam || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya uṣeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 71 || || cha ||
<7.1.72>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedvighneśaṃ jalavāsasam || sarvavighnavināśāya sarvakāryaprasiddhaye || 1 || varuṇena mahādevi taponirvighnahetave || pūjito jalajairbhaktyā jalavāsāstataḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 || caturthyāṃ tarpayedbhaktyā gandhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ sa modakaiḥ || yathābhaktyanusāreṇa tasya tuṣyedgaṇādhipaḥ || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jalavāsagaṇapatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 || || cha ||
<7.1.73>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kumāreśvaramuttamam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā devi varuṇānnaiṛte sthitam || gaurītapovanāddevi dakṣiṇa sthānasaṃsthitam || 2 || ṣaṇmukhena mahādevi tatra kṛtvā mahattapaḥ || pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ kumāreśastato'bhavat || 3 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā māsamekaṃ nirantaram || ṣaṇmāsasyārcanenaiva yatpuṇyamupajāyate || 4 || tatpuṇyaṃ sakalaṃ tasya kumāreśārcanātsakṛt || labhate divasaikena vidhinā yadi pūjayet || 5 || kāmaṃ krodhaṃ tathā lobhaṃ rāgaṃ tyaktvā tu matsaram || brahmacārī yatirbhūtvā sakṛdapyenamarcayet || 6 || evaṃ saṃpūjite devi samyagyātrā phalaṃ labhet || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kumāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma trisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 73 || || cha ||
<7.1.74>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi śākalyeśvaramuttamam || daityasūdanavāyavye dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā sthitam || 1 || śākalyena mahādevi pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam|| śākalyonāma rājarṣiryatra taptvā mahattapaḥ ||2|| samārādhya mahādevaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtavānbhavam || liṃge'vatārayāmāsa prasannaṃ taṃ maheśvaram || 3 || tasmindṛṣṭe varārohe saptajanmakṛtaṃ nṛṇām || pāpaṃ praṇaśyate śīghraṃ tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 4 || tatrāṣṭamyāṃ caturddaśyāṃ snāpayetpayasā śivam || pūjayecca vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || 5 || hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ samyagyā trāphalepsubhiḥ || catvāri tasya nāmāni kathyamānāni me śṛṇu || 6 || ādau kṛtayuge devi kīrtito bhairaveśvaraḥ || tataḥ sāvarṇimanunā samyagārādhitaḥ priye || 7 || sāvarṇikeśvaraṃ nāma tretāyāṃ tasya saṃjñitam || tatastu dvāpare devi gālavena mahātmanā || samyagā rādhitastatra liṃgarūpīvṛṣadhvajaḥ || 8 || tṛtīyaṃ tasya devasya gālaveśvarasaṃjñitam || kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte śākalyonāma vai muniḥ || 9 || yatra siddhimanuprāpta aiśvaryaṃ cāṇimādikam|| śākalyeśvaranāmeti tataḥ khyātaṃ turīyakam || 7.1.74.10 || evaṃ cāturyugaṃ nāma tasya liṃgasya kīrtitam || pāpaghnaṃ puṇyadaṃ nṝṇāṃ kīrttitaṃ sarvakāmadam || 11 || tasyaiva devadevasya kṣetrotpattiṃ śṛṇu priye || 12 || aṣṭādaśadhanurdevi samaṃtātparimaṇḍalam || mahāpāpaharaṃ devi tatra kṣetranivāsinām|| 13 || kṛmikīṭapataṃgānāṃ tiraścāmapi mokṣadam || yatra kūpāditoyeṣu jalaṃ sārasvataṃ smṛtam || 14 || yatra tatra naraḥ snātvā svargaloke mahīyate || aśvamedhasahasrasya vājapeyaśatasya ca || 15 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || somaparvaṇi saṃprāpte yastatra śucirātmavān || 16 || aghoraṃ ca japetsamyagājyahomasamanvitam || talliṃgasya samīpastho yāvanmāsāvadhiḥ priye || 17 || mahāpātakayukto'pi yukto vā'pyupapātakaiḥ || sa sarvāṃ labhate siddhimuttamāṃ varavarṇini || 18 || kāmikaṃ tatsmṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || aghora vaktraṃ devasya tatrasthaṃ bhairavaṃ mahat|| 19 || bhairaveśvaranāmeti pūrvaṃ khyātamabhūdbhuvi || asminyuge tu saṃprāpte śākalyeśvaranāmakam ||7.1.74.2||| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śākalyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 74 || || dha ||
<7.1.75>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ śākalakaleśvaram || śākalyeśvaranairṛtye dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ sthitam || || 1 || taccaturyuganāmāḍhyaṃ smṛtaṃ pātakanāśanam || pūrvaṃ kāmeśvaraṃnāma tretāyāṃ pulaheśvaram || 2 || dvāpare siddhināthaṃ tu nāradeśaṃ kalau smṛtam || tathā kalakaleśaṃ ca nāma tasyaiva kīrttitam || 3 || samudre ca mahāpuṇye yasminkāle sarasvatī || āgatā sā mahābhāgā hṛṣṭā tuṣṭā saridvarā || tasya toyasya śabdena sāgarasya mahātmanaḥ || 4 || tato devāḥ sagandharvā ṛṣayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ || neduḥ kalakalaṃ tatra tumulaṃ lomaharṣaṇam || || 5 || tena śabdena mahatā mama mūrttiḥ samutthitā || kalkaleśvaranāmeti tato liṃgaṃ prakīrtitam || 6 || iti te pūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ kathitaṃ nāmakāra ṇam|| sāṃprataṃ tu yathā jātaṃ punaḥ kalakaleśvaram|| tatte'haṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || 7 || purā dvāparasaṃdhau ca praviṣṭe tu kalau yuge || nāradastu samāgatya kṣetraṃ prābhāsikaṃ śubham|| saṃcakāra tapaścograṃ tatra liṃgasamīpataḥ || 9 || tato varṣaśate pūrṇe samārādhya vṛṣadhvajam || gāṃdharvaṃ prāpya deveśi bhūṣitaṃ saptabhiḥ svaraiḥ || 9 || tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā talliṃgasya samīpataḥ || sa cakāra mahāyajñaṃ pauṃḍarīkamiti śrutam || 7.1.75.10 || devadevasya tuṣṭyarthaṃ sa sadā bhāvitātmavān || samāhūya ṛṣīṃstatra brahmalokātsahasraśaḥ || 11 || tataḥ saṃbhṛtasaṃbhāro yajñopakaraṇānvitaḥ || kṛtvā kuṇḍādikaṃ sarvaṃ samārebhe tataḥ kratum || 12 || tataḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ prāpte tasminkratau varānane || 13 || athāgamaṃstato viprāstatra kṣetranivāsinaḥ || dakṣiṇārthaṃ mahadevi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 14 || tataḥ sa kautukāviṣṭasteṣāṃ yuddhārthameva hi || prākṣipattatra ratnāni suvarṇaṃ ca mahītale || 15 || tataste brāhmaṇāḥ sarve yudhyamānāḥ parasparam || kolāhalaṃ paraṃ cakrurbahudravyaparīpsayā || 16 || eke digaṃbarā devi tyaktayajñopavītinaḥ || vikacāḥ ke'pi dṛśyaṃte tvanye rudhiraviplavāḥ || 17 || anye parasparaṃ jaghnurmuṣṭibhiścaraṇaistathā || evaṃ tatra tadā kṣiptaṃ yaddravyaṃ nāradena tu || 18 || athābhāve tu vittasya ye ca viprā hyakiṃcanāḥ || vidyāvinayasaṃpannā brāhṇai jarjarīkṛtāḥ ||19|| te tamūcurbhṛśaṃ śāṃtāḥ smayamānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || kalahārthaṃ yato dānaṃ tvayā dattamidaṃ mune || || 7.1.75.20 || vidyāyuktānparityajya vidhiṃ tyaktā tu yājñikam || tasmādasya mune nāma khyātaṃ kalakaleśvaram || 21 || tena nāmnā dvijaśreṣṭha liṃga metadbhaviṣyati || etasmātkāraṇāddevi jātaṃ kalakaleśvaram || 22 || yastaṃ snāpya naro bhaktyā kurute triḥ pradakṣiṇam || sa gacchedrudralokaṃ tu tvatprasādādasaṃśayam || 23 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gaṃdhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || hemaṃ dattvā dvijātibhyaḥ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam || 24 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kalakaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 75 || ||
<7.1.76>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva devadevasya samīpasthaṃ virājate || liṃgadvayaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ lakulīśapratiṣṭhitam || 1 || lakule śvaranāmāsti tasya liṃgadvayasya vai || taddṛṣṭvā devadevasya liṃgadvayamanuttamam || 2 || mucyate sakalātpāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt || tatra śuklacaturddaśyāṃ māsi bhādrapade priye || 3 || upavāsaparo bhūtvā yaḥ karoti prajāgaram || mūrttimaṃtaṃ tu saṃpūjya lakulīśaṃ mahāprabham || 4 || tataḥ saṃpūjya vidhinā tatra liṃgadvayaṃ pṛthak || samyakpūjāvidhānena stutimaṃtrairanukramāt || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye someśvaramāhātmye kalakaleśvarasamīpavarti lakulīśaliṃgadvayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ||76||
<7.1.77>
īśvara uvāca|| tato gacchenmahādevi uttaṃkeśvaramuttamam|| tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || sthāpitaṃ ca svayaṃ bhaktyā uttaṃkena mahātmanā || 1 || taddṛṣṭvā tu mahādevi spṛṣṭvā ca susamāhitaḥ || saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā mucyate sarvakilbiṣāt || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya uttaṃkeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma saptasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 77 || || ||
<7.1.78>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ vaiśvānareśvaram || tasyaivāgneyakoṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam || 1 || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || tatra kaścicchukaḥ pūrvaṃ nīḍaṃ devi cakāra ha || 2 || prāsāde bhāryayā sārddhaṃ nivasa nsuciraṃ sthitaḥ || tatastau daṃpatī nityaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ pracakratuḥ || 3 || kulāyasya vaśāddevi na tu bhaktyā kathaṃcana || kālena mahatā tau ca paṃcatvaṃ samupasthitau || 4 || jātau tena prabhāvena uktau jātismarau bhuvi || lopāmudrāgastyanāmaprasiddhiṃ paramāṃ gatau || 5 || atha gāthā purī gītā agastyena mahātmanā || smaratā pūrvadehaṃ tu vismayenānubhūtijā || 6 || kṛtvā pradakṣiṇaṃ samyagvahnīśaṃ yaḥ prapaśyati || nūnaṃ prasiddhimāpnoti itaścāhaṃ yathā purā || 7 || evaṃ devi tavākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ vahnidaivatam || śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 8 || ghṛtena taṃ tu saṃsnāpya vidhinā vai samarcayet || hema dadyācca vipreṃdra samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 9 || evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet || vahnilokaṃ tu saṃprāpya modate kālamakṣayam || 7.1.78.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāharuyā saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vaiśvānareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptati tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 78 || || cha ||
<7.1.79>
|| īśvara uvāca|| || tato gacchenmahādevi lakulīśaṃ mahāprabham || tasya paścimadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || 1 || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ śāṃtaṃ mūrtisthitaṃ prabhum || samāyātaṃ mahākṣetre tatra kāyāvarohaṇāt || 2 || kṛtvā tatra tapaścograṃ dīkṣayitvātmaśiṣya kān || kuśakādīṃśca catura uktvā śāstrāṇyanekaśaḥ || 3 || nyāyavaiśeṣikādīni tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ|| evaṃ jñātvā tu yaḥ samyaktaṃ samarcayate naraḥ || 4 || kārttikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa ayane cottarepi vā || vidyādānaṃ ca tatraiva dadyādviprāya śāline || 5 || saptajanmāni viprasya dhanāḍhyasya kule śubhe || jāyate matimāndhīmāñchrīmānevaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye lakulīśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikonāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 79 || || ||
<7.1.80>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge liṃgaṃ pātakanāśanam || gautameśvaranāmāḍhyaṃ daityasūdanapaścime || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake devi saṃsthitaṃ sarvakāmadam || śalyenārādhitaṃ yadvai madrarājena bhāmini || 2 || tataḥ kṛtaṃ tapaścograṃ samārādhya maheśvaram || anyo'pyevaṃ naro yastu taṃ samārādhayiṣyati || 3 || sa prāpsyati parāṃ siddhiṃ yathā śalyo mahāmanāḥ || caitra śuklacaturddaśyāṃ snāpayetpayasā tu yaḥ || 4 || gaṃdhodakena ca tataḥ pūjayetkusumottamaiḥ || tathaiva vidhivadbhaktyā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 5 || vācā kṛtaṃ ca yatpāpaṃ manasā karmaṇā'tha vā || tatsarvaṃ naśyate devi tasyaliṃgasya darśanāt || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 || || ||
<7.1.81>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi deveśaṃ daityasūdanam || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinām || 1 || anādiyugasaṃsthānaṃ sarva kāmapradaṃ śubham|| saṃsārasāgare ghore sthitaṃ nauriva tāraṇe || 2 || anye sarve'pi naśyaṃti kalpāṃte brahmaṇo dine || etāni muktvā deveśi nyagrodhaṃ sapta kalpagama ||3|| kalpavṛkṣaṃ tathā'gāraṃ vaiḍūryaṃ parvatottamam|| śrīdaityasūdanaṃ devaṃ mārkaṃḍeyaṃ mahāmunim||4|| akṣayāścāvyayāścaite saptakalpāni sundari || devi kiṃ bahunoktena varṇitena punaḥpunaḥ || 5 || śrīdaityasūdanāddevi nānyāsti bhuvi devatā || yavākāraṃ tu tasyaiva kṣetrapātakanāśanam|| 6 || sevitaṃ carṣibhiḥ siddhairyakṣavidyādharoragaiḥ || tasya sīmāṃ pravakṣyāmi viṣṇukṣetrasya bhāmini || 7 || pūrve yameśvaraṃ yāvacchrīsomeśaṃ tu paścime || uttare tu viśālākṣī dakṣiṇe saritāṃ patiḥ || 8 || etatkṣetraṃ yavākāraṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ pāpanāśanam ||9|| atra kṣetre mṛtā ye tu pāpino'pi narā dhruvam || svargaṃ gacchaṃti te sarve saṃtaḥ sukṛtino yathā ||7.1.81.10|| atra dattaṃ hutaṃ japtaṃ tapastaptaṃ kṛtaṃ hi yat || tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ proktaṃ saptakalpāvadhi priye || 11 || tatraikamapi yo devi brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayiṣyati || vidhinā viṣṇumuddiśya koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 12 || tatropavāsaṃ yaḥ kuryānnaro bhaktisamanvitaḥ || ekenaivopavāsena upavāsāyutaṃ phalam || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā sopavāso jiteṃdriyaḥ || 13 || dvādaśyāṃ kārttike māsi dadyādvipreṣu kāṃcanam || viṣṇuṃ saṃpūjya vidhivanmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 14 || || devyuvāca || || daityasūdananāmeti kathaṃ tasya prakīrtitam || kasminkāle tu deveśa tanme vistarato vada || 15 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || daityasūdanadevasya purā vṛttaṃ mahodayam || 16 || devi tasyaiva nāmāni kalpekalpe bhavaṃti vai|| anādinidhanānyeva saṃbhavanti punaḥpunaḥ||17|| pūrvakalpe śriyā vṛtto vāmanastu dvitīyake|| vajrāṃgastu tṛtīye vai turīye kamalāpriyaḥ||18|| paṃcame duḥkhaharttā ca ṣaṣṭhe tu puruṣottamaḥ|| śrīdaityasūdano devaḥ kalpe vai saptame smṛtaḥ||19|| tasyaiva nāma cotpattiṃ kathayāmi yathārthataḥ || 7.1.81.20 || purā devāsure yuddhe dānavairdevakaṃṭakaiḥ || nirjitā devatāḥ sarve jagmuste śaraṇaṃ harim || kṣīrodavāsinaṃ devamastuvanpraṇatāḥ sthitāḥ || 21 || || devā ūcuḥ|| || jaya deva jagannātha daityāsuravimarddana || vārāharūpamāsthāya uddhṛtā vasudhā tvayā || 22 || uddhṛtā matsyarūpeṇa vedā udadhimadhyataḥ || kūrmarūpī tathā bhūtvā kṣīrodārṇavamaṃthanam || 23 || kṛtvā tvayā jagannātha uddhṛtā śrīrnamo 'stu te || śrīpatiḥ śrīdharo deva ārttānāmartināśanaḥ || 24 || balirvāmanarūpeṇa tvayā baddho'surāriṇā || hiraṇyākṣo mahādaityo hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || 25 || nārasiṃhena rūpeṇa antarikṣe dhṛtastvayā || devamūla mahādeva uddhṛtaṃ bhuvanaṃ tvayā || 26 || tvayā vinā jagannātha bhuvanaṃ niṣprabhī kṛtam || sūryeṇeva tu vikrāntaṃ tamobhiriva dānavaiḥ || 27 || śrutvā stotramidaṃ devi viṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ || uvāca devānbrahmādyānkṣīrodārṇava bodhitaḥ || 28 || bhayaṃ tyajadhvaṃ vai devā dānavānprati sarvathā || acireṇaiva kālena ghātayiṣyāmi dānavān || 29 || evamuktvātha taiḥ sārddhamā jagāma janārddanaḥ || dānavānghātayāmāsa sa cakreṇa pṛthakpṛthak || 7.1.81.30 || bhayārttā dānavāḥ sarve palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya samudrābhimukhā bhavan|| 31 || naśyamānāstato dṛṣṭvā daityāndaityavināśanam || saṃjaghne tānsa cakreṇa niḥśeṣānsarvadānavān || 32 || hateṣu sarvadaityeṣu devabrāhmaṇatāpasaiḥ || kalyāṇamabhavattatra jagatsvasthamanākulam || 33 || tatprabhṛtyeva devasya daityasūdananāma tat || etanmāhātmyamatulaṃ kathitaṃ tava sundari || daityasūdanadevasya mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam || 34 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaḍo nāṃdho na daridro na duḥkhitaḥ || jāyate sapta janmāni satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane || 35 || śravaṇadvādaśīṃ puṇyāṃ rohiṇyāṃ cāṣṭamīṃ śubhām || śayanotthāpanīṃ caiva naraḥ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ || 36 || ekaikenopa vāsena upavāsāyutaṃ phalam || labhate nātra sandeho daityasūdanasannidhau || 37 || caṇḍālaḥ śvapaco vāpi tiryagyonigato'pi vā || prāṇatyāge kṛte tasminnācyutaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 38 || kārtikyāṃ caiva vaiśākhyāṃ māsamekamupoṣayet || daityasūdanamadhyasthaḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 39 ||| ekaikenopavāsena koṭikoṭi pṛthakpṛthak || labhate tatphalaṃ sarvaṃ viṣṇukṣetraprabhāvataḥ || 7.1.81.40 || dīpaṃ dadāti yastatra māsaṃ vā pakṣameva vā || ekaika dīpadānena koṭidīpaphalaṃ labhet || 41 || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya devadevaṃ caturbhujam || ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāraḥ pūjayitvā'cyuto bhavet || 42 || cāturmāsyaṃ vidhānena daityasūdanasannidhau || niyamena kṣipedyastu tasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || 43 || anyakṣetreṣu yatkṛtvā cāturmāsyāni koṭiśaḥ || tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ daityasūdanadarśanāt || 44 || brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyaphalamāpnuyāt || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate sarvaṃ daityasūdanadarśanāt|| 45|| ekādaśyāṃ tu yastatra kurute jāgaraṃ naraḥ || gītanṛtyaistathā vādyaiḥ prekṣaṇīyaistathāvidhaiḥ || sa yāti vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ yaṃ gatvā na nivarttate || 46 || hatyā'yutānīha susaṃcitāni steyāni rukmasya na santi saṃkhyā || nihaṃti kenāpi purā kṛtāni sarvāṇi bhadrā niśi jāgareṇa || 47|| mārgā na te pretapurī na dūtā vanaṃ ca tatkhecarakhaḍgapatram || svapne na paśyaṃti ca te manuṣyā yeṣāṃ gatā jāgaraṇena bhadrā || 48 || kanyāsahasraṃ vidhivaddadāti ratnairalaṃkṛtya svadharmabuddhyā || gavāṃ sahasraṃ kurujāṃgale tu teṣāṃ paraṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ || 49 || kṛtvā caivopavāsaṃ ca yo'śnāti dvādaśīdine || naivedyaṃ tulasīmiśraṃ hatyākoṭivināśanam || 7.1.81.50 || iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || daityasūdanadevasya kimanyatparipṛcchasi || || 51 || pītavastrāṇi devasya gāṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca dāpayet || snātvā cakravare tīrthe mucyate sarvapātakāt || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrīdaityasūdanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 81 || || ||
<7.1.82>
||devyuvāca || || cakratīrtheti kiṃ nāma tvayā proktaṃ vṛṣadhvaja || kutra tiṣṭhati tattīrthaṃ kiṃ prabhāvaṃ vadasva me || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || purā devāsure yuddhe hatvā daityāñjanārddanaḥ || cakraṃ prakṣālayāmāsa tatra vai raktaraṃjitam|| 2 || aṣṭakoṭisutīrthāni tatrānīya svayaṃ hariḥ || tīrthe prakalpayāmāsa śuddhiṃ kṛtvā sudarśane || tīrthasya cakre nāmāpi cakatīrthamiti śrutam|| 3 || aṣṭāyutāni tīrthānāmaṣṭau koṭyastathaiva ca || tatra saṃti mahādevi cakratīrthe na saṃśayaḥ || 4 || yastatra kurute snānamekacitto narottamaḥ|| sarvatīrthābhiṣekasya sa prāpnotyakhilaṃ phalam||5 || tīrthānāmaṣṭakoṭistu nivasaṃti varānane || ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa candrasūryagrahe tathā || 6 || tatra snātvā mahādevi yajñakoṭiphalaṃ labhet || tasyaiva kalpanāmāni śṛṇu te kathayāmyaham || 7 || koṭitīrthaṃ pūrvakalpe śrīnidhānaṃ dvitīyake || tṛtīye śatadhāraṃ ca cakratīrthaṃ caturthake || 8 || evaṃ te kalpanāmāni hyatītānyakhilāni vai || kathitānyevamanyāni jñeyāni vibudhaiḥ kramāt|| 9 || tatra yaddīyate dānaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate || arddhakrośapramāṇaṃ hi viṣṇukṣetraṃ prakīrttitam || 7.1.82.10 || brahmahatyā nopasarpetsatyametanmayoditam || māsopavāsī tatkṣetre agnihotrī yatavrataḥ || 11 || svādhyāyī yajñayājī ca tapaścāṃdrāyaṇā dikam || tilodakaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ ca vidhipūrvakam || 12 || ekarātraṃ trirātraṃ vā kṛcchraṃ sāṃtapanaṃ tathā || māsopavāsaṃ taccaiva anyadvā puṇyakarma tat || 13 || daityārikṣetramāsādya yatkiṃcitkurute naraḥ || anyakṣetrātkoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ bhūyānna saṃśayaḥ || 14 || sudarśane vare tīrthe godānaṃ tatra dāpayet || samyagyātrāphalaprepsuḥ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye || 15 || caṃḍālaḥ śvapaco vā'pi tiryagyonigatastathā || tasmiṃstīrthe mṛtaḥ samyagācyutaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 16 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ cakratīrthasamudbhavam || māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 17 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye daityasūdana māhātmyaprasaṃgena cakratīrthotpattivṛttāntamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 82 || || cha ||
<7.1.83>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasya pūrveṇa saṃsthitām || yogeśvarīṃ mahādevīṃ yogasiddhiphalapradām || 1 || tadutpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu śraddhāsamanvitā || purā dānavaśārdūlo mahiṣākhyo mahābalaḥ || 2 || babhūva pravaro devi sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ || kāmarūpī sa lokāṃstrīnvaśīkṛtvā'bhavatsukhī || 3 || kasmiṃścidatha kāle tu brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || sṛṣṭā manoharā kanyā rūpeṇāpratimā divi || 4 || atapatsā tapo ghoraṃ kanyā rūpavatī satī || nāradena tato dṛṣṭā sā kadācidvarānane || 5 || tataḥ sa sahasā devi vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || aho rūpamaho dhairyamaho kāntiraho vayaḥ || 6 || ityevaṃ cintayaṃstatra nārīṃ vacanamabravīt || kuruṣvātmapradānaṃ me na me dāraparigrahaḥ || tavāhaṃ darśanāddevi kāmavāṇena pīḍitaḥ ||7|| sā'bravīnna hi me kāryaṃ kāmadharmeṇa sattama|| kaumāraṃ vratamāsādya sādhayiṣye yathepsitam ]| 8 || na ca manyustvayā kāryo hyasminnarthe kathaṃcana || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa munirnāradaḥ priye || || 9 || samudrānte'gamaddivyāṃ purīṃ mahiṣapālitām || arcito hi munistena mahiṣeṇa mahātmanā || 7.1.83.10 || pṛṣṭvā hyanāmayaṃ devi dattvā cārghyamanuttamam || so'bravītprāñjalirbhūtvā kimāgamanakāraṇam || brūhi yatte byavasitaṃ sarvaṃ karttāsmi nārada||11|| athovāca munistatra mahiṣaṃ dānaveśvaram|| kanyāratnaṃ samutpannaṃ jaṃbūdvīpe mahāsura ||12 || svarge martye ca pātāle na dṛṣṭaṃ na ca me śrutam || tādṛgrūpamahaṃ yena kāmabāṇavaśīkṛtaḥ || 13 || sa śrutvā vacanaṃ tasya kāmasyotpādanaṃ param|| jagāma yatra sā sādhvī kṣetre prābhāsike sthitā || 14 || tāmeva prārthayāmāsa balena mahatā vṛtaḥ || bhāryā bhava tvaṃ me bhīru bhuṃkṣva bhogānmanoramān|| etattapo mahābhāge viruddhaṃ yauvanasya te || 15 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jahāsa varavarṇinī || tasyā hasaṃtyā deveśi śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 16 || niśvāsātsahasā nāryaḥ śastrahastā bhayānakāḥ || tābhirvidhvaṃsitaṃ sainyaṃ mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ ||17|| tasminnipātyamāne tu sainye dānavasattamaḥ || krodhaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ śīghraṃ tāmevābhimukho yayau ||18|| vidhunvansa hi te tīkṣṇaśṛṃge'bhīkṣṇaṃ bhayānake ||| tayā sārdhaṃ ca sumahatkṛtvā yuddhaṃ mahāsuraḥ ||19|| śṛṃgābhyāṃ jagṛhe devīṃ sā tasyopari saṃsthitā || padbhyāmākramya śūlena nihato daityapuṃgavaḥ ||7.1.83.2|||| chinne śirasi khaṅgena tadrūpo niḥsṛtaḥ pumān || raudro'pi sa gataḥ svargaṃ daityo devyastrapātitaḥ ||21|| tato devagaṇāḥ sarve mahiṣaṃ vīkṣya nirjitam ||| maheṃdrādyāḥ stutiṃ cakrurdevyāstuṣṭena cetasā||22|| || devā ūcuḥ|| namo devi mahābhāge gambhīre bhīmadarśane|| nayasthite susiddhāṃte trinetre viśvatomukhi || 23 || vidyāvidye jaye jāpye mahiṣāsuramardini || sarvage sarvavidyeśe devi viśvasvarūpiṇi ||24|| vītaśoke dhruve devi padmapatrāyatekṣaṇe || śuddhasattve vratasthe ca caṇḍarūpe vibhāvari ||25|| ṛddhisiddhiprade devi kālanṛtye dhṛtipriye || śāṃkari brāhmaṇi brāhmi sarvadevanamaskṛte ||26|| ghaṃṭāhaste śūla haste mahāmahiṣamardini || ugrarūpe virūpākṣi mahāmāye'mṛte śive || 27 || sarvage sarvade devi sarvasattvamayodbhave || vidyāpurāṇaśalyānāṃ janani bhūtadhāriṇi || 28 || sarvadevarahasyānāṃ sarvasattvavatāṃ śubhe || tvameva śaraṇaṃ devi vidyā'vidye śriye'śriye || 29 || evaṃ stutā surairdevi praṇamya ṛṣibhistathā || uvāca hasatī vākyaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam || 7.1.83.30 || || devā ūcuḥ || stavenānena ye devi stuvantyatra narottamāḥ || te saṃtu kāmaiḥ saṃpūrṇā varavarṣā niraṃtaram || 31 || asminkṣetre tvayā vāso nityaṃ kāryaḥ śucismite || 32 || evamastviti sā devī devānuktvā varānane || visṛjya ṛṣisaṃghāṃśca tatraiva niratā'bhavat || 33 || āśvayukchuklapakṣasya navamyāṃ yo varānane || upavāsaparo bhūtvā tāṃ prapaśyati bhaktitaḥ || tasya pāpaṃ kṣayaṃ yāti tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā || 34 || ya etatpaṭhati stotraṃ prātarutthāya mānavaḥ || na bhīḥ saṃpadyate tasya yāvajjīvaṃ narasya vai || 35 || āśvayukchuklapakṣe yā aṣṭamī mūlasaṃyutā || sā mahānāmikā prāṇā yeṣāṃ tasyāṃ gatāḥ śubhe || 36 || teṣāṃ svarge dhruvaṃ vāso vīrāste'psarasāṃ priyāḥ || 37 || manvantareṣu sarveṣu kalpādiṣu sureśvari || eṣa eva kramaḥ prokto viśeṣaṃ śṛṇu sāṃpratam ||38|| āśvayukchuklapakṣe yā paṃcamī pāpanāśinī || tasyāṃ saṃpūjayedrātrau khaḍgamaṃtrairvibhūṣitam || 39 || maṃḍapaṃ kārayettatra navasaptakaraṃ tathā || prāgudakpravaṇe deśe patākābhiralaṃkṛtam || yogeśvaryāḥ saṃnidhāne vidhinā kārayeddvijaḥ||7.1.83.40||| āgneyyāṃ kārayetkuṇḍaṃ hastamātraṃ suśobhanam|| mekhalātrayasaṃyuktaṃ yonyā'śvatthadalābhayā||41|| śāstroktaṃ mantrasaṃyuktaṃ hotavyaṃ pāyasaṃ tataḥ|| tataḥ khaḍgaṃ tu saṃsnāpya paṃcāmṛtarasena vai|| pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairmaṃtrapūrvaṃ dvijottamaiḥ||42|| abhīrviśasanaṃ khaḍgaḥ prāṇibhūto durāsadaḥ || agamyo vijayaścaiva dharmādhārastathaiva ca || ityaṣṭau tava nāmāni svayamuktāni vedhasā || 43 || nakṣatraṃ kṛttikā tubhyaṃ gururdevo maheśvaraḥ || hiraṇyaṃ ca śarīraṃ te dhātā devo janārdanaḥ || pitā pitāmaho deva svena pālaya sarvadā || 44 || || iti khaḍgamantraḥ || || evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā taṃ khaṅgaṃ brāhmaṇottamaiḥ || bhrāmayennagare rātrau nāndīghoṣapuraḥsaram || 45 || sarvasainyena saṃyuktastatra brāhmaṇapuṃgavaiḥ || evaṃ kṛtvā vidhānaṃ tu punaryogeśvarīṃ nayet || uccārya mantramevaṃ vai khaṅgaṃ tasyai samarpayet || 46 || añjanena samālekhya candanena vilepitam || bilvapatrakṛtāṃ mālāṃ tasyai devyai nivedayet || 47 || durge durgārtihe devi sarva durgatināśini || trāhi māṃ sarvadurgeṣu durge'haṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 48 || dattvaivamarghyaṃ deveśi tatra khaṅgaṃ ca jāgṛyāt || nityaṃ saṃpūjya vidhinā aṣṭamyāṃ yāvadeva hi || 49 || tadrātrau jāgaraṃ kṛtvā prabhāte hyaruṇodaye || pātayenmahiṣānmeṣānagrato gatakaṃdharān || 7.1.83.50 || śatamardhaśataṃ vāpi tadardhārdhaṃ yathecchayā || surāsavabhṛtaiḥ kuṃbhaistarpayetparameśvarīm || 51 || kāpālikebhyastaddeyaṃ dāsīdāsajane tathā || tato'parāhnasamaye navamyāṃ syandane sthitām || 52 || yogeśīṃ bhrāmayedrāṣṭre svayaṃ rājā svasainyavān || nadadbhiḥ śaṃkhapaṭahaiḥ paṭhadbhirbaṭucāraṇaiḥ || 53 || bhūtebhyaśca baliṃ dadyānmaṃtreṇānena bhāmini || saraktaṃ sajalaṃ sānnaṃ gandhapuṣpākṣatairyutam || 54 || trīnvārām̐stu triśūlena digvidikṣu kṣipedbalim || baliṃ gṛhṇantvime devā ādityā vasavastathā || 55 || maruto'thāśvinau rudrāḥ suparṇāḥ pannagā grahāḥ || saumyā bhavaṃtu tṛptāśca bhūtāḥ pretāḥ sukhāvahāḥ || 56 || ya evaṃ kurvate yātrāṃ brāhmaṇāḥ kṣetravāsinaḥ || na teṣāṃ śatravo nāgnirna caurā na vināyakāḥ || vighnaṃ kurvaṃti deveśi yogeśvaryāḥ prasādataḥ || 57 || sukhino bhogabhoktāraḥ sarvātaṃkavivarjitāḥ || bhavanti puruṣā bhaktā yogeśvaryā niraṃtaram || 58 || ityeṣa te samākhyāto yogeśvaryā mahotsavaḥ || paṭhatāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ caiva sarvāśubhavināśanaḥ || 59 || śūlāgrabhinnamahiṣāsurapṛṣṭhapīṭhāmutkhātakhaḍga rucirāṃgadabāhudaṃḍām || abhyarcya paṃcavadanānugataṃ navamyāṃ durgāṃ sudurgagahanāni taraṃti martyāḥ || 7.1.83.60 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yogeśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 83 || || cha || ||
<7.1.84>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ādinārāyaṇaṃ harim || tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || pādukāsanasaṃyuktaṃ sarvadaityāṃtakāriṇam || ādau kṛtayuge devi daityo'bhūnmeghavāhanaḥ || 2 || mahābalo mahākāyo yojanāyutavistaraḥ || ajeyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ trailokyakṣayakārakaḥ || brahmaṇā tasya tuṣṭena varo datto varānane || 3 || yadā pādukayā viṣṇustvāṃ haniṣyati saṃyuge || tadaiva mṛtyurbhavitā nānyathā maraṇaṃ tava || 4 || iti labdhavaro daityaḥ saṃtāpayati bhūtalam || yugānāṃ koṭimekāṃ tu sadevāsuramānuṣam || 5 || saṃtapya bahudhā devi dakṣiṇo dadhimāgataḥ || tatra vidhvaṃsayāmāsa ṛṣīṇāmāśramāṇi vai || 6 || tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve vidhvastāśramamaṇḍalāḥ || śaraṇaṃ caiva saṃprāptā devadevaṃ tu keśavam || ajeyaṃ taṃ tu saṃjñātvā tuṣṭuvurgaruḍadhvajam || 7 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || namaḥ paramakalyāṇakalyāṇāyātmayogine || janārddanāya devāya śrīdharāya ca vedhase || 8 || namaḥ kamalakiṃjalkasuvarṇamukuṭāya ca || keśavāyātisūkṣmāya bṛhanmūrte namonamaḥ || 9 || mahātmane vareṇyāya namaḥ paṃkajanābhaye || namo'stu māyāharaye haraye harivedhase || 7.1.84.10 || hiraṇyagarbhagarbhāya jagataḥ kāraṇātmane || acyutāya namo nityamanantāya namonamaḥ || 11 || namo māyāpaṭacchanna jagaddhātre mahātmane || saṃsārasāgarottāra jñānapotapradāyine || akuṃṭhamataye dhātre sargasthityaṃta karmaṇe || 12 || yathā hi vāsudeveti prokte naśyati pātakam || tathā vilayamabhyetu daityo'yaṃ meghavāhanaḥ || 13 || yathā viṣṇuḥ svabhakteṣu pāpamāpnoti saṃsthitam|| tathā vināśamāyātu daityo'yaṃ pāpakarmakṛt || 14 || smṛtamātro yathā viṣṇuḥ sarvaṃ pāpaṃ vyapohati || tathā praṇāśamabhyetu daityo'yaṃ meghavāhanaḥ || 15 || bhavaṃtu bhadrāṇi samastadoṣāḥ prayāṃtu nāśaṃ jagato'khilasya || abhedyabhaktyā parameśvareśe smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve || 16 || ye bhūtale ye divi ye'ntarikṣe rasātale prāṇigaṇāśca kecit || bhavantu te siddhiyutā narottamāḥ smṛte jagaddhātari vāsudeve || 17 || ye prāṇinaḥ kutracidatra saṃti brahmāṇḍamadhye parataśca kecit || teṣāṃ tu siddhiḥ paramāstvaniṃdyā stute jagaddhātari vāsudeve || 18 || || īśvara uvāca || ]| iti stutastadā devi ādinārāyaṇo hariḥ || jñātvā sa bhāvi kāryaṃ tatsamāruhya ca pādukām || 19 || babhūva teṣāṃ pratyakṣa ṛṣīṇāṃ pāpanāśanaḥ || uvāca praṇatānsarvānkiṃ vā kāryaṃ hṛdi sthitam || 7.1.84.20 || kathyatāṃ tatkariṣyāmi yuṣmatstotreṇa tarpitaḥ || 21 || ityuktā ṛṣayaḥ sarve kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ || ādidevaṃ hariṃ procuḥ sarve nataśirodharāḥ || 22 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || jānāsi sarvaṃ tvaṃ deva na cāstyaviditaṃ tava || imaṃ daityaṃ mahādeva saṃharasva mahābalam|| yathedaṃ sakalaṃ viśvaṃ nirātaṃkaṃ bhavetprabho || 23 || ityuktastaistadā viṣṇurdaityamāhūya saṃyuge || tāḍayāmāsa taṃ daityaṃ hṛdi pādukayā śubhe||24|| sa hataḥ patito daityo vigatāsurmahodadhau|| hatvā daityavaraṃ devastatra sthāne sthito'bhavat|| pādukāsanasaṃsthastu tatrādyāpi varānane || 25 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā ekādaśyāṃ narottamaḥ || sośvavamedhaphalaṃ prāpya modate divi devavat || 26 || golakṣaṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā yatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || tadādideve govinde dṛṣṭe bhaktyā phalaṃ labhet || 27 || kalau kṛtayugaṃ teṣāṃ kleśasteṣāṃ sukhādhikaḥ || ādinārāyaṇo devo yeṣāṃ hṛdayasaṃsthitaḥ || 28|| ekādaśyāṃ ravidine snātvā saṃnihitā jale || ādinārāyaṇaṃ pūjya mucyate bhavabandhanāt ||29|| iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam || śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ dāridyaughavināśanam || 7.1.84.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ādinārāyaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītitamodhyāyaḥ || 84 || cha ||
<7.1.85>
|| devyuvāca || || tatra saṃnihitā proktā yā tvayā vṛṣabhadhvaja || kathaṃ deva samāyātā kurukṣetrānmahānadī || kiṃ prabhāvā tu sā proktā phalaṃ snānādikena kim || || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yatra saṃnihitā śubhā || pāpaghnī sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || 2 || ādinārāyaṇāddevi paścime dhanuṣāṃ traye || saṃsthitā sā mahādevī saridrūpā mahānadī || 3 || kathayāmi samāsena tadutpattiṃ śṛṇu priye || jarāsaṃdhabhayāddevi viṣṇuḥ parijanaiḥ saha || 4 || gṛhītvā yādavānsarvānbālavṛddhavaṇigjanān || sa śūnyāṃ mathurāṃ kṛtvā prabhāsaṃ samupāgataḥ || 5 || samudraṃ prārthayāmāsa sthānaṃ saṃvāsahetave || etasminneva kāle tu devadevo divākaraḥ || 6 || saṃgrasto rāhuṇā devi parvakāle hyupasthite || taṃ dṛṣṭvā yādavāḥ sarve viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 7 || aprāptāḥ saṃnihityāyāṃ tānuvāca janārddanaḥ || mā viṣādaṃ yaduśreṣṭhā vrajadhvaṃ mayi saṃsthite || 8 || dṛśyatāṃ matprabhāvo'dya dharmā rthamiha bhūtale || ānayiṣyāmyahaṃ samyakpuṇyaṃ sāṃnihitaṃ saraḥ || 9 || evamuktvā sa bhagavānsamādhistho babhūva ha || evaṃ saṃdhyāyatastasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 7.1.85.10 || prādurbhūtā tatastasya vāridhārā'grataḥ śubhā || bibhedya dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ snānārthaṃ cāsuradviṣaḥ || 11 || tata ste yādavāḥ sarve rāmasāṃbapurogamāḥ || cakruḥ snānaṃ mahādevi rāhugraste divākare || 12 || prāptapuṇyā babhūvuste saṃnihityāsamudbhavam || kurukṣetrasya yātrāyāḥ prāpya samyakphalaṃ hi te || 13 || evaṃ tatsamanuprāptaṃ puṇyaṃ sānnihitaṃ saraḥ || tatra snātvā mahādevi rāhugraste divākare || agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnotyaśeṣataḥ || 14 || yastatra bhojayedvipraṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ vidhipūrvakam || ekena bhojitenaiva koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 15 || yastatra kārayeddhomaṃ saṃnihityāsamīpataḥ || ekaikāhutidānena koṭihomaphalaṃ labhet || 16 || mantrajāpyaṃ tu kurute tatra sthāne sthito yadi || ekaikamaṃtrajāpyena koṭijāpyaphalaṃ labhet || 17 || suvarṇadānaṃ dātavyaṃ tatra yātrāphalepsubhiḥ || snātvā saṃpūjanīyaśca ādidevo janārddanaḥ || 18 || iti vai kathitaṃ samyakphalaṃ sāṃnihitaṃ tava || śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ samyakchraddhāvatāṃ priye || 19 ||| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃnihityāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśīti tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 85 || || ||
<7.1.86>
