|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyāstu dakṣiṇe bhāge sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ mahāprabham || pāṃḍaveśvaranāmāḍhyaṃ paṃcabhiḥ sthāpitaṃ kramāt || 1 || guptacaryāṃ yadā yātāḥ pāṃḍavā vanavāsinaḥ || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ || 2 || tasminkāle mahādevi saṃ prāpte somaparvaṇi || sthāpayāmāsuste sarve liṃgaṃ saṃnihitā taṭe || 3 || mārkaṇḍapramukhānkṛtvā ṛtvijo brāhmaṇottamān || vedoktaiḥ kārayāmāsurabhiṣekaṃ vṛṣāndaduḥ || 4 || tataḥ prasannā ṛṣayo mārkaṃḍapramukhāḥ priye || pratiṣṭhitasya liṃgasya pāṃḍavairvaravarṇini || 5 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || ye caitatpūjayiṣyaṃti liṃgaṃ pāṃḍavapūjitam || te vai pūjyā bhaviṣyaṃti devadānavarakṣasām || 6 || aśvamedhaphalaṃ teṣāṃ samyakchraddhārcanena vai || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho hyasmadvākyaprabhāvataḥ || 7 || snātvā saṃnihitākuṃḍe yo'rcayetpāṃḍaveśvaram || māghe māsi samagre tu sa sākṣātpuruṣottamaḥ || 8 || darśanenāpi tasyāpi pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || viṣṇurūpo hi sa prokto nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 9|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃnihityāmāhātmye pāṃḍaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 86 || |||| ||
<7.1.87>
|| īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ kṛtvā naro yātrāṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || tato gacchenmahādevi rudrānekādaśa kramāt || 1 || prabhāsakṣetramadhyasthānmahāpātakanāśanān || yadekādaśadhā pāpamarjitaṃ manujaiḥ pṛthak || 2 || tadekādaśarudrāṇāṃ pūjanātkṣayameṣyati || saṃkrāṃtāvayane vāpi caṃdrasūryagrahe'thavā || 3 || anyāsu puṇyatithiṣu samyagbhāvena bhāvitaḥ || pūjayedānupūrvyeṇa rudraikādaśakaṃ kramāt || 4 || teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi yānyatītāni me purā || ādye kṛtayuge tāni śṛṇu devi yathārthataḥ || 5 || ajaikapādahirbudhnyo virūpākṣo'tha raivataḥ || haraśca bahurūpaśca tryaṃbakaśca sureśvaraḥ || vṛṣākapiśca śaṃbhuśca kapardī cāparājitaḥ || 6 || ādau kṛtayuge devi tretāyāṃ dvāpare'pi ca || kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte jātaṃ nāmāṃtaraṃ punaḥ || 7 || ekādaśadhā rudrāṇāṃ tāni te vacmi sāṃpratam|| bhūteśo nīlarudraśca kapālī vṛṣavāhanaḥ ||8|| tryaṃbako ghoranāmā ca mahākālo'tha bhairavaḥ || mṛtyuṃjayo'tha kāmeśo yogeśa iti kīrtitaḥ || ekādaśaite rudrāste kathitāḥ kramaśaḥ priye || 9 ]| anādinidhanā devi bhedabhinnāstu te pṛthak || ekādaśasvarūpeṇa pṛthaṅnāmaprabhedataḥ || 7.1.87.10 || || devyuvāca || || bhagavanvistarādbrūhi liṃgaikādaśakakramam || sthānasīmāprabhedena māhātmyotpattikāraṇaiḥ ||11 || kathaṃ pūjyāni tānīśa ke maṃtrāḥ ko vidhiḥ smṛtaḥ || kasminparvaṇi kāle vā sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 12 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || somanāthāditaḥ kṛtvā siddhināthādikāraṇam|| 13 || yacchrutvā mucyate jaṃtuḥ pātakaiḥ pūrvasaṃcitaiḥ || ye caikādaśa rudrā vai tava proktā mayā priye || 14 || daśa te vāyavaḥ proktā ātmā caikādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ || teṣāṃ nāmāni vakṣyāmi vāyūnāṃ śṛṇu me kramāt|| 15 || prāṇo'pānaḥ samānaśca hyudāno vyāna eva ca || nāgaśca kūrmaḥ kṛkalo devadatto dhanaṃjayaḥ|| 16 || ātmā ceti kramājjñeyā rudrādhipatayaḥ kramāt || teṣāṃ yātrāṃ kramādvakṣye sarvaprāṇihitāya vai || 17 || rudrāṇāmādidevo'sau pūrvaṃ someśvaraḥ priye || bhūteśvareti nāmnā vai pūjayettaṃ vidhānataḥ || 18 || rājopacārayogena śraddhāpūtena cetasā || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya sadyojātena pūjayet || 19 || puṣpairmanoharairbhaktyā dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam || tribhiḥ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipatya ca || 7.1.87.20 || rudraikādaśayātrārthī nirvighnārthaṃ vrajettataḥ || bhūteśvareti yannāma proktaṃ tatte bravīmyaham|| 21 || mahadādi viśeṣāṃtaṃ bhūtajālaṃ yadīritam || paṃcaviṃśati saṃkhyākaṃ teṣāmīśo yataḥ smṛtaḥ || 22 || tena bhūteśvaretyuktaṃ nāma tasya purā kila || paṃcaviṃśatitattvāni jñātvā muktimavāpnuyāt || 23 || bhūteśarudraṃ saṃpūjya gacchedvai muktimavyayām || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamādi rudrasya kīrtanam|| kīrtanīyaṃ dvijātīnāṃ kīrtitaṃ puṇyavarddhanam|| 24 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye bhūteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 87 || || cha ||
<7.1.88>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi nīlarudraṃ dvitīyakam|| bhūteśāduttare bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe sthitam || 1 || mahāliṃgaṃ mahādevi gaṇagaṃdharvapūjitam|| saṃsnāpya taṃ vidhānena īśamaṃtreṇa pūjayet|| 2 || kumudotpalasaṃbhāraiḥ samyaksaṃbhāvitātmavān || kṛtvā pradakṣiṇāṃ tasya namaskāreṇa pūjayet || 3 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi rājasūyaphalaṃ labhet || vṛṣastatraiva dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 4 || nīlāṃjananibho daityo nihataścāṃtakaḥ purā || tasya rodayitā strīṇāṃ nīlarudrastataḥ smṛtaḥ||5|| tasya saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || samyakchraddhānvitaiḥ prāpyaṃ śrāvyaṃ taddarśanotsukaiḥ || 6 || itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye nīla rudramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 88 || || cha ||
<7.1.89>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchedvarārohe kapālīśvaramuttamam || rudraṃ tṛtīyaṃ pāpaghnaṃ nīlarudrasyapūrvataḥ || 1 || budheśvarātpaścimato dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || chinnaṃ mayā purā devi brahmaṇaḥ paṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || 2 || tatkapālaṃ kare lagnaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāgataḥ || tato varṣasahasraṃ tu saṃsthitaḥ kṣetramadhyataḥ || 3 || kapāladhārī digvāsāḥ kapālī tena ca smṛtaḥ || tanmayā pūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye || 4 || kapālirūpamāsthāya kapālīśastataḥ smṛtaḥ || sarvapāpaharo nṛṇāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || 5 || mayā tatra niyuktā vai rakṣārthaṃ śūlapāṇayaḥ || gaṇāḥ sahasraśo devi pāpināṃ duṣṭacetasām || 6 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || pūjayettaṃ mahādevaṃ kapālinamanāmayam || 7 || hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage || pūjayitvā vidhānena samyaktatpuruṣāṇunā || 8 || janmaprabhṛti yatpāpaṃ prāṇibhiḥ samupārjitam || ṣaḍaśītimukhe dṛṣṭvā talliṃgaṃ tu vyapohati || 9 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || kapālirudradevasya tṛtīyasya varānane || 7.1.89.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye kapā līśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 89 || || cha ||
<7.1.90>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi caturthaṃ rudramuttamam || vṛṣabheśvaranāmānaṃ kalpaliṃgaṃ surapriyam || 1 || bālarūpī mahādevi yatra brahmā svayaṃ sthitaḥ || tasyaiva cottare bhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || 2 || ādyaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi nāpuṇyo veda mānavaḥ || tasyaiva kalpanāmāni sāṃprataṃ prabravīmi te || 3|| pūrvakalpe mahādevi brahmeśvara iti smṛtaḥ || brahmaṇārādhitaḥ pūrvaṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye || 4 || sṛṣṭikāmena devena tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || caturvidhāṃ bhūtasṛṣṭiṃ tataścakre pitāmahaḥ || 5 || brahmaṇastvīśabhāvena gatastuṣṭiṃ yato haraḥ || tena brahmeśvaraṃ nāma tasmim̐lliṃge purā'bhavat || 6 || tato dvitīyakalpe tu saṃprāpte varavarṇini || raivateśvaranāmeti prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale ||7|| raivato nāma rājā'bhūdbrahmāṃḍe sacarācare || jagadyonirjigāyedaṃ talliṃgasya prabhāvataḥ || 8 || raivateśvaranāmābhūttena liṃgaṃ mahāprabham || punastṛtīyakalpe tu saṃprāpte varavarṇini||9 || vṛṣabheśvaranāmābhūttasya liṃgasya bhāmini || mamaiva vāhanaṃ yo'sau dharmoyaṃ vṛṣarūpadhṛk || 7.1.90.10 || tena tatpūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ divyābdānāṃ sahasrakam|| tatastuṣṭena deveśi nītaḥ sāyujyatāṃ vṛṣaḥ || 11 || tena talliṃgamabhavadvṛṣabheśeti bhūtale || tataścaturthe saṃprāpte vārāhekalpa saṃjñite || 12 || aṣṭāviṃśatime tatra tretāyugamukhe tadā || ikṣvākurnāma rājā'bhūtsūryavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ || 13 || sa liṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa trikālaṃ bhaktibhāvitaḥ || ekāhāro jitāhāro bhūbhiśāyī jiteṃdriyaḥ || 14 || evaṃ kāle bahuvidhe tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || dadau rājyaṃ mahodagraṃ saṃtatiṃ putra pautrikīm|| 15 || ikṣvākvīśvaranāmābhūttenedaṃ liṃgamuttamam || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā devaṃ vṛṣabhavāhanam || .16 || saptajanmakṛtaiḥ pāpairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || triṃśaddhanuṣpramāṇena tasya kṣetracaturddiśam|| 17|| snānaṃ jāpyaṃ baliṃ homaṃ pūjāṃ stotramudīraṇam || tasmiṃstīrthe tu yaḥ kuryāttatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 18 || catuṣkoṇāṃtarā kṣetramevaṃ mātrāpramāṇataḥ || ekarātroṣito bhūtvā tasya liṃgasya sannidhau || 19 || brahmacaryeṇa jāgartti sa pāpaiḥ saṃpramucyate || homajāpyasamādhistho nṛtyagītādivādanaiḥ || 7.1.90.20 || goghno vā brahmahā pāpī mucyate duṣkṛtairnaraḥ || yaḥ saṃprīṇayate viprāṃstatra bhojyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 21 || ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavati bhojitā || bhairavaṃ caiva kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ drutijaṃgamam || 22 || vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ mahā kālaṃ ca naimiṣam || etattīrthāṣṭakaṃ devi tasmim̐lliṃge vyavasthitam || 23 || māghe kṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ tatra yo jāgṛyānniśi || saṃpūjya vidhinā devaṃ sa tīrthāṣṭaphalaṃ labhet || 24 || dadāti tatra yaḥ piṇḍaṃ naṣṭendau śivasaṃnidhau || tṛpyanti pitarastasya yāvadbrahmadināntakam || 25 || dadhikṣīra ghṛtenaiva paṃcagavyakuśodakaiḥ || kuṃkumāgarukarpūraistalligaṃ pūjayenniśi || 26 || saṃmaṃtryāghoramaṃtreṇa dhyātvā devaṃ sadāśivam || evaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi mucyate paṃcapātakaiḥ || 27 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ dadhnā saṃsnāpayedyadi || sa brāhmaṇaścaturvedo jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 28 || kṣīreṇa snāpayeddevi yadi taṃ vṛṣabheśvaram || saptadhenusahasrāṇāṃ sa phalaṃ viṃdate mahat || 29 || janmāṃtareṇa yatpāpaṃ sāṃprataṃ yatkṛtaṃ priye || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti ghṛtasnānena bhāmini || 7.1.90.30 || paṃcagavyena yo devi snāpayedvṛṣabheśvaram || sa dahetsarvapāpāni sarvayajñaphalaṃ labhet || 31 || taddṛṣṭvā brahmahā goghnaḥ steyī ca gurutalpagaḥ || śaraṇāgataghātī ca mitraviśraṃbhaghātakaḥ || 32 || duṣṭapāpasamācāro mātṛhā pitṛhā tathā || mucyate sarvapāpaistu talliṃgārādhanodyataḥ || 33 || kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ yastu pūjayedbrahmaṇā saha || brahmeśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 34 || tena dattaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ guravastena toṣitāḥ || śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ gayātīrthe tena taptaṃ mahattapaḥ || yena devādhidevo'saupūjito vṛṣabheśvaraḥ || 35 || iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ devapūjitam || vṛṣabheśvaradevasya kalpaliṃgasya bhāmini || 36 || yaḥ śṛṇoti mahādevi māhātmyaṃ daivadevatam || mūrkho vā paṃḍito vā'pi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 37 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye vṛṣavāhaneśvaramāhāmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 90 || || cha ||
<7.1.91>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tryaṃbakeśvaramavyayam || tatpaṃcamaṃ samākhyātaṃ rudrāṇāmādidaivatam || 1 || śikhaṃḍīśvaramākhyātaṃ pūrvaṃ tretāyuge priye || taccādyāhaṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā saṃjñāyate naraiḥ ||2|| asti sāṃbapuraṃ devi tatrasthaṃ parameśvari || tasyaivottaradigbhāge sthānaṃ kāpālikaṃ smṛtam || 3 || kapāleśvaranāmā ca yatreśo liṃgamūrtimān || saṃsthitaḥ pāpanāśāya darśanātsparśanānnṛṇām || 4 || tasmādīśānadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃtare || tryaṃbakeśvaranāmā ca tatra rudraḥ sthitaḥ svayam || || 5 || sarvānugrahakarttā ca sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || purā yatrātapaddevi tapo ghoraṃ suduṣkaram || gururnāmā ṛṣivaro devadānavaduḥsaham || 6 || koṭīnāṃ tritayaṃ yena tryaṃbako maṃtranāyakaḥ || japto divyena vidhinā trikālaṃ pūjya śaṃkaram || 7 || tataḥ prasādya deveśaṃ divyaiśvaryamavāpa saḥ || cakre nāma svayaṃ tasya tryaṃbakeśvaramavyayam || 8 || japtvā tu tryaṃbakaṃ maṃtraṃ yataḥ siddhimavāpa saḥ || divyāṣṭaguṇamaiśvaryaṃ tenāsau tryaṃbakeśvaraḥ || 9 || sarvapātaka vidhvaṃsī darśanātsparśanādapi || yastryaṃbakaṃ japedviprastryaṃbakeśvarasaṃnidhau || sa prāpnoti mahāsiddhiṃ pratyakṣaṃ rudra eva saḥ ||7.1.91.10|| darśanādapi tasyātha pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā vidhinā bhāvamāsthitaḥ || vāmadevena maṃtreṇa sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 11 || caitraśuklacaturdaśyāṃ tatra yo jāgṛyānniśi || pūjāstutikathābhiśca sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ phalam || 12 || dhenustatraiva dātavyā samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 13|| iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || tryaṃbakeśvararudrasya nṛṇāṃ puṇyaphalapradam || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye tryaṃbakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 91 ||
<7.1.92>
|| īśvara uvāca|| || tato gacchenmahādevi aghoreśvaramuttamam|| ṣaṣṭhaṃ liṃgaṃ samākhyātaṃ tadvaktraṃ bhairavaṃ smṛtam||1|| tryaṃbakeśvaravāyavye dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam|| sarvakāmapradaṃ puṇyaṃ kalikalmaṣanāśanam||2|. yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā snānapūjādibhiḥ kramāt|| merudānasya kṛtsnasya sa labhenmanujaḥ phalam||3|| dakṣiṇāmūrtimāsthāya yatkiṃcittatra dīyate|| aghoreśvaradevasya tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet||4|| yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute tatra aghoreśvaradakṣiṇe|| ākalpaṃ tṛptimāyāṃti pitarastasya tarpitāḥ || 5|| kiṃ śrāddhena gayātīrthe vājimedhena kiṃ priye || tatra śrāddhena tatsarvaṃ phalamabhyadhikaṃ labhet || 6 || truṭimātra mapi svarṇaṃ yātrāyāṃ yaḥ prayacchati || sa sarvaṃ phalamāpnoti mahādānasya bhūriśaḥ || 7 || brahmakūrcaṃ caredyastu somāṣṭamyāṃ vidhānataḥ || aghoreśvarasāṃnidhye aghoreṇābhimaṃtritam || ṣaḍabdasya mahattena prāyaścittaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavet || 8 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktamaghoreśamahodayam || māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ śrutaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || 9 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśa rudramāhātmye'ghoreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 92 || || cha ||
<7.1.93>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchedvarārohe mahākāleśvaraṃ haram || aghoreśāduttarataḥ kiṃcidvāyavyasaṃsthitam || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā devi śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam || pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge devi smṛtaṃ citrāṃgadeśvaram|| 2 || mahākāleśvaraṃ devi kalau nāma prakīrtitam || kālarūpī mahārudrastasmim̐lliṃge vyavasthitaḥ || 3 || carācaraguruḥ sākṣāddevadānavadarpahā || sūryarūpeṇa yatsarvaṃ brahmāṃḍe grasate priye || 4 || sa devaḥ saṃsthito devi tasmim̐lliṃge mahāprabhaḥ || yastatpūjayate bhaktyā kalye liṃgaṃ mama priyam || ṣaḍakṣareṇa maṃtreṇa mṛtyuṃ jayati tatkṣaṇāt || 5 || kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣeṇa guggulaṃ ghṛtasaṃyutam || yo dahedvidhivattatra pūjāṃ kṛtvā niśāgame || 6 || aparādhasahasraṃ tu kṣamate tasya bhairavaḥ || dhenudānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tasminsthāne maharṣayaḥ || 7 || dhenudastārayennūnaṃ daśa pūrvāndaśāparān || devasya dakṣiṇe bhāge yo japecchatarudriyam || 8 || uddharetpitṛvargaṃ ca mātṛvargaṃ ca mānavaḥ || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā || kṣālayeccaiva tatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā kāleśvaraṃ haram || 9 || ayane cottare prāpte yaḥ kuryādghṛtakaṃbalam || na sa bhūyo'tra saṃsāre janma prāpnoti dāruṇam || 7.1.93.10 || na duḥkhito daridro vā durbhago vā prajāyate || saptajanmāntarāṇyeva mahākāleśadarśanāt || 11 || dhanadhānyasamāyukte sphīte sañjāyate kule || bhaktirbhavati bhūyo'pi mahākāleśvarārcane || 12 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mahākāleśvaraṃ priye || citrāṃgado gaṇo devi tena cārādhitaṃ purā || 13 || divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ tu mahā kāleśvaraṃ hi tat || citrāṃgadeśvaraṃ nāma tena khyātaṃ dharātale || 14 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye mahākāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 93 || || ||
<7.1.94>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bhairaveśvaramuttamam || tasyaiva vahnikoṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃdaśake sthitam ||1|| sarvakāmapradaṃ devi dāridryaughavināśanam || pūrvaṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃnāma khyātaṃ kṛtayuge priye || 2 || caṇḍonāma gaṇo devi tena cārādhitaṃ purā || divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ tu tena caṇḍeśvaraṃ smṛtam || 3 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ spṛṣṭvā ca susamāhitaḥ || mucyate sakalātpāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt || 4 || tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ māse bhādrapade priye || upavāsa paro bhūtvā yaḥ karoti prajāgaram || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 5 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yadupārjitam || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 6 || tilā hiraṇyaṃ vastrāṇi tatra deyaṃ manīṣiṇe || sarvakilviṣanāśārthaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsunā || 7 || bhairavākāramāsthāya kalpānte sa haredyataḥ || viśvaṃ samagraṃ deveśi tenāsau bhairavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8 || asminkalpe mahādevi prabhāsakṣetramāsthitaḥ || babhūva bhairavo rudraḥ kalpānte liṃgamūrtimān || 9 || evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ bhairaveśvaram || yacchrutvā mucyate jantuḥ pātakādatibhairavāt || 7.1.94.10 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 94 || || cha ||
<7.1.95>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchedvarārohe liṃgaṃ mṛtyuñjayeśvaram || tasyaiva vahni koṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ daśake sthitam || 1 || paścime sāgarādityātsthitaṃ dhanuścatuṣṭaye || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || 2 || pūrve yuge samākhyātaṃ nāma nandīśvareti ca || yatra taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ nandināmnā gaṇena me || 3 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ nityaṃ pūjāpareṇa ca || tatra japto mahāmantro mṛtyuñjaya iti śrutaḥ || 4 || koṭīnāṃ niyutaṃ devi tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || dadau gaṇeśatāṃ tasya muktiṃ sāmīpyagāṃ tathā || 5 || mṛtyuñjayena mantreṇa tasya tuṣṭo yato haraḥ || tena mṛtyuñjayeśeti khyātaṃ liṃgaṃ dharātale || 6 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā paśyedvā bhāvitātmavān || nāśayettasya pāpāni saptajanmārjitānyapi || 7 || snāpayetpayasā liṃgaṃ dadhnā ghṛtayutena ca || madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet || 8 || karpūrośīra miśreṇa mṛganābhirasena ca || candanena sugandhena puṣpaiḥ saṃpūjayettataḥ || 9 || dadyāddhūpaṃ puro devi tato devasya cāgurum || vastraiḥ saṃpūjya vividhairātmavittānusārataḥ || 7.1.95.10 || naivedyaṃ paramānnaṃ ca dattvā dīpasamanvitam || aṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇipātaṃ ca tataḥ kāryaṃ ca bhaktitaḥ || 11 || hemadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage || 12 || evaṃ yātrā bhavettasya śāstroktā nātra saṃśayaḥ || evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi labhate janmanaḥ phalam || 13 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ mṛtyuñjayamahodayam || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye mṛtyuñjayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 95 || || cha ||
<7.1.96>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatogacchenmahādevi kāmeśvaramiti smṛtam || tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || ratīśvaramiti khyātaṃ tretāyāṃ tatsure śvari || 1 || yasmindṛṣṭe manuṣyāṇāṃ pūjite tu varānane || naśyecca saptajanmāghaṃ gṛhabhaṃgaśca no bhavet || 2 || || devyuvāca || || kenāyaṃ sthāpito deva kasmātprokto ratīśvaraḥ || darśanenāsya kiṃ śreyaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || ratirnāmābhavatsādhvī kāmapatnī yaśasvinī ||4|| dagdhe manasije pūrvaṃ devena tripurāriṇā|| tadarthāya tapastepe tasmindeśe ratiḥ kila ||5|| aṃguṣṭhāgreṇa tiṣṭhantyā yāvadyugacatuṣṭayam || ārādhito mahādevaḥ śāṃtena manasā priye || 6 || kasmiṃścidatha kāle tu nirbhidya dharaṇītalam || tadagrataḥ samuttasthau ligaṃ māheśvaraṃ priye || 7 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || āhlādayaṃtī sahasā tasyāścittaṃ varānane || 8 || yasmānmāheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ tvadbhaktyā sahasotthitam || pūjayestanmahābhāge tataḥ kāṃtamavāpsyasi ||9|| etacchutvā tu sā sādhvī devadūtasya bhāṣitam|| talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa sa bhaktyā paramayā yutā || 7.1.96.10 || tataḥ kāmaḥ samuttasthau suptotthita iva priye || tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ kāmeśvaramiti śrutam || 11 || tataḥ sā kāmadayitā vākyametaduvāca ha || prahṛṣṭā kāmadevāptyā purataḥ puṣpadhanvanaḥ || 12 || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye cānye liṃgametatsamāhitāḥ || evaṃ te vāṃchitāṃ siddhiṃ bhūyo yāsyaṃti sadgatim|| 13 || mano'bhīṣṭaṃ tathā sarvaṃ yadyapi syātsadurllabham || tatprāpsyaṃti na saṃdeho liṃgasyāsya prasādataḥ || || 14 || evamuktvā gatā sādhvī ratiḥ kāmena saṃyutā || svasthāne pūrṇakāmā sā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || 15 || enaṃ caitratrayodaśyāṃ śuklāyāṃ yaḥ samarcati || sakāmavadbhavennṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam || 16 || hṛti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudramāhātmye kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 96 || || cha ||
<7.1.97>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yogeśvaramiti śrutam || kāmeśādvāyave bhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || 1 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi darśanātpāpanāśanam|| pūrve yuge tu saṃkhyātaṃ gaṇeśvaramiti śrutam|| 2 || purā mama gaṇā devi asaṃkhyātā mahāvalāḥ || kṣetraṃ māheśvaraṃ jñātvā prabhāsaṃ samupāgaman || 3 || tatrasthāśca tapo ghoraṃ tepuste yogamāśritāḥ || divyābdānāṃ sahasraṃ tu tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 4 || sālokyāṃ ca dadau muktiṃ teṣāṃ yogabalena 3 || yasmā tṣaḍaṃgayogena teṣāṃ tuṣṭo vṛṣadhvajaḥ || tena yogeśvaraṃ nāma liṃgaṃ yogaphalapradam || 5 || yastamarcayate bhaktyā samyakpūjāvidhānataḥ || sa yogasiddhimāpnoti modate divi devavat || 6 || yo dadyātkāṃcanaṃ meruṃ kṛtsnāṃ caiva vasundharām || yogeśaṃ pūjayedyastu sa tayoradhikaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7 || vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ saṃpūrṇaphalahetave || evamekādaśa proktā rudrāḥ prābhāsamāśritāḥ || nityaṃ pūjyāśca vaṃdyāśca kṣetrasya phalamīpsubhiḥ || 8 || ya etāṃ caiva śṛṇuyādrudraikādaśasaṃhitām || tasya kṣetraphalaṃ sarvaṃ prabhāsāṃtaravāsinaḥ || 9 || yaścaitānnaiva jānāti rudrānprābhāsamāśritān || sa kṣetramadhyasaṃstho'pi nāstyeva sa paśuḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.1.97.10 || eteṣāṃ caiva rudrāṇāṃ sarvānvāpyekameva vā || someśvaraṃ pūjayitvā japedvai śatarudriyam || sarveṣāṃ labhate puṇyaṃ rudrāṇāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ saṃkhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ tava bhāmini || rudrāṇāṃ pāpaśamanaṃ śrutaṃ puṇyavivarddhanam || 12 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yogeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 97 || || cha ||
<7.1.98>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi caṃḍeśvaramiti śrutam|| someśādvāyave bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ sthitam|| 1 || divyaṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevi sarvapātakanāśanam || tatpūrve tu yuge khyātaṃ manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvāṃtare || 2 || tretāyugamukhe devi pṛthivyā saṃpratiṣṭhitam|| pūrvamanvaṃtare cāsmim̐lliṅgaṃ pṛthvīśvaraṃ priye || 3 || punaścaṃdreṇa tatprāptaṃ liṃgaṃ caṃdreśvaraṃ priye || brahmahatyādipāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ puṇyavarddhanam || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi saptajanmasamudbhavaiḥ || mucyate kalmaṣaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtakṛtyastu jāyate || 5 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ pṛthvīśvaraṃ khyātaṃ talliṃgaṃ pāpa nāśanam || kathaṃ punaḥ samākhyātaṃ candreśvaramiti prabho || etadvistarato brūhi śrotukāmāhamādarāt || 6 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathā pāpapraṇāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā mucyate jaṃtustrividhaiḥ karmabandhanaiḥ || 7 || āsītpūrvaṃ mahādevi daityabhārārdditā mahī || sā'dho vrajaṃtī sahasā gorūpā saṃbabhūva ha || 8 || itastato dhāvamānā na lebhe nirvṛtiṃ kvacit || tato varṣaśate pūrṇe bhramamāṇā kvacitkvacit || 9 || āsasāda mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam || devadānavagaṃdharvaiḥ sevitaṃ pāpanāśanam|| 7.1.98.10 || tatra sthitvā mahākṣetre kṛtvā manasi niścayam || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutā || 11 || varṣāṇāṃ ca śataṃ sāgraṃ kṛte tapasi duścare || tutoṣa bhagavānrudro dharitrīṃ vākyamabravīt || 12 || devi viśvaṃbhare sarvaṃ tapaḥ sucaritaṃ tvayā || mā śokaṃ kuru kalyāṇi bhaviṣyati tavepsitam || 13 || daityā nāśaṃ gamiṣyaṃti viṣṇunā nihatā bhuvi || bhavitrī tvaṃ mahādevi daityabhāravivarjitā || 14 || idaṃ tvayā sthāpitaṃ yalliṃgaṃ paramaśobhanam || dharitrīnāmnā vikhyātaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || || 15 || atrāhaṃ saṃsthito nityaṃ liṃgarūpī mahāprabhuḥ || sthāsyāmi kalpekalpe vai nṛṇāṃ pāpāpahārakaḥ || 16 || mūrtyaṣṭakasamāyukto liṃge 'sminsaṃsthitaḥ sadā || nṛṇāṃ nāśayitā pāpaṃ pūrvajanmaśatārjitam || 17 || bhādre kṛṣṇatṛtīyāyāṃ yaścaitaṃ pūjayiṣyati || so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalamāpsyatyasaṃśayam || 18 || sarvatīrthābhiṣekasya sarveṣāṃ dānakarmaṇām || bhaviṣyati phalaṃ tasya liṃgasyaivāsya pūjanāt || 19 || dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśaṃ yāvatsamaṃtātparimaṃḍalam || kṣetramasya samākhyātaṃ prāṇināṃ muktidāyakam || 7.1.98.20 || tasminmṛtāḥ prāṇino ye kāmato vāpyakāmataḥ || kṛmi kīṭasamā vāpi te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 21 || yo dadyātkāñcanaṃ meruṃ kṛtsnāṃ vā'pi vasundharām || yaḥ pūjayati pṛthvīśaṃ sa tayoradhikaḥ smṛtaḥ ||22|| īśvara uvāca || || iti dattvā varāndevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || pṛthivīśvaranāmābhūttatprabhṛtyeva śaṃkaraḥ || 23 || punarasminmahākalpe vārāha iti viśrute || kadāciddakṣaśāpena kṣīṇaścandro babhūva ha || 24 || papāta bhūtale devi yakṣmaṇā pīḍitaḥ śaśī || kṣetraṃ prabhāsamāsādya tanmahodadhisaṃnidhau || 25 || dṛṣṭvā pṛthvīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ saprabhāvaṃ mahāprabham || tatpūjānirato bhūtvā varṣāṇāṃ tu sahasrakam || 26 || atapatsa tapo raudraṃ śīrṇaparṇāṃbubhakṣakaḥ || yataḥ samabhavaddīptyā sarvāhlādakaraḥ śaśī || 27 || talliṃgasyaiva māhātmyāttataścaṃdreśvaro'bhavat || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyāccaṃdramā gatakalmaṣaḥ || 28 || avāpa siddhimatyugrāṃ sparśaliṃgaprakāśinīm || somanātheti yāṃ prāhuḥ prasiddhāṃ liṃgarūpiṇīm || 29 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ candradaivatam || śrutaṃ harati pāpāni tathā''rogyaṃ prayacchati || 7.1.98.30 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ pṛthvīśvara(caṃdreśvara)māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭanavatitamodhyāyaḥ || 98 || |||5||| || ||
<7.1.99>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yatra cakradharaḥ sthitaḥ || daṃḍapāṇiśca deveśi yatraikasthānasaṃsthitaḥ || 1 || caṃdreśātpūrvadigbhāge | someśāduttaresthitaḥ) || dhanuṣāṃ paṃcasaṃsthāne gaṃdharveśātsamīpataḥ || 2 || umāyā nairṛte bhāge brahmadevarṣisaṃsthitaḥ || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśinīm||3|| pauṃḍrako vāsudevastu vārāṇasyāṃ purā'bhavat|| tena śrutaṃ purāṇaṃ tu paṭhyamānaṃ dvijātibhiḥ||4|| kalpādau dvāparāṃte tu kṣatriyāṇāṃ niveśane || avatāraṃ mahābāhuvāsudevaḥ kariṣyati || 5 || sa tu mūḍhamatirmene ahaṃ viṣṇuriti priye || cihnāni dhārayāmāsa cakrādīni varānane || 6 || sa dūtaṃ preṣayāmāsa dvārakāyāṃ mahodaram || sa gatvā prāha viṣṇuṃ vai cakrādīni parityaja || 7 || ityāha pauṃḍrako rājā nacedvadhamavā psyasi || tataśca bhagavānviṣṇuḥ prāhāsya ruciraṃ vacaḥ || 8 || vācyaḥ sa pauṃḍrako rājā tvayā haṃta vaco mama || gṛhītacakra evāhaṃ kāśīmāgamya te purīm || 9 || saṃtyakṣyāmi tataścakraṃ gadāṃ cemāmasaṃśayam || tadgrāhyaṃ bhavatā cakramanyadvā yattavepsitam || 7.1.99.10 || ityukte'tha gate dūte saṃsmṛtyā'bhyā gataṃ hariḥ || garutmantaṃ samāruhya tvaritastatpuraṃ yayau || 11 || mitrasnehāttatastasya kāśirājaḥ sahānugaḥ || sarvasainyaparīvārastataḥ pauṃḍramupāyayau || 12 || tato balena mahatā kāśirājabalena ca || pauṃḍrako vāsudevo'sau keśavābhimukho yayau || 13|| taṃ dadarśa harirdūrāddurvāre syaṃdane sthitam || cakrahastaṃ gadāśārṅgasaṃyutaṃ garuḍadhvajam || 14 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhāvagaṃbhīraṃ jahāsa garuḍadhvajaḥ || uvāca pauṃḍrakaṃ mūḍhamātmacihnopalakṣitam || 15 || pauṃḍrakoktaṃ tvayā yattu dūtavaktreṇa māṃ prati || samutsṛjeti cihnāni tacca sarvaṃ tyajāmyaham || 16 || cakrametatsamutsṛṣṭaṃ gadeyaṃ ca visa rjitā || garutmāneṣa te gatvā samārohatu vai dhvajam || 17 || ityuccārya vimuktena cakreṇāsau nipātitaḥ || rathaśca gadayā bhagno gajāścā śvāśca cūrṇitāḥ || 18 || tato hāhākṛte loke kāśinātho mahābalī || yuyudhe vāsudevena mitraduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ || 19 || tataḥ śārṅgavinirmuktaiśchittvā tasya śaraiḥ śiraḥ || kāśīpuryāṃ sa cikṣepa kurvam̐llokasya vismayam || 7.1.99.20 || hatvā tu pauṃḍrakaṃ śauriḥ kāśirājaṃ ca sānu gam || punardvāravatīṃ prāpto mṛgayāyā gato yathā || 21 || tataḥ kāśipateḥ putraḥ piturduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ || śaṃkaraṃ toṣayāmāsa sa ca tasmai varaṃ dadau || 22 || sa vavre bhagavankṛtyā piturhaṃturvadhāya me || samuttiṣṭhatu kṛṣṇasya tvatprasādātsureśvara || 23 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyukte dakṣiṇāgnestu madhyataḥ || mahākṛtyā samuttasthau prasthitā dvārakāṃ prati || 24 || jvālāmālākarālāṃ tāṃ yādavā bhayavihvalāḥ || dṛṣṭvā janārddanaṃ sarve śaraṇārthamupāgatāḥ || 25 || tataḥ sudarśanaṃ tasyā mumoca garuḍadhvajaḥ || vadhāya sā tato bhagnā cakratejo'bhipīḍitā || 26 || kṛtyāmanujagāmāśu viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam || kṛtyā vārāṇasīṃ prāptā tasyāścakraṃ tu pṛṣṭhataḥ || 27 || tataḥ sā bhayasaṃtrastā śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇaṃ gatā || somanāthaṃ jagannāthaṃ nānyaḥ śakto hi rakṣitum || 28 || tataścakraṃ varairbāṇaistāḍayāmāsa śaṃkaraḥ || tacca dvāravatīṃ prāptaṃ śivasāyakamiśritam || 29 || taddṛṣṭvā śivanāmāṃkaistāḍitaṃ bhagavānhariḥ || cakraṃ śaraistataḥ kuddho gṛhītvā ca kareṇa tat || jagāma tatra yatrāste someśaḥ kālabhairavaḥ || 7.1.99.30 sa gatvā roṣa tāmrākṣaścakrodyatakaraḥ sthitaḥ || kṛtyāṃ haṃtuṃ matiṃ cakre kālabhairavanirmitām || 31 || dṛṣṭo devaistataḥ sarvaidaṃḍapāṇigaṇena ca || devānāṃ prekṣatāṃ tatra daṇḍapāṇirmahāgaṇaḥ || cakrodyatakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ prāhābjalocanam || 32 || || daṃḍapāṇiruvāca || || mā krodhaṃ kuru deveśa kṛtyāṃ prati jagatprabho || 33 || amoghaṃ yudhi te cakraṃ kṛtyā cāpi ca śāṃkarī || evaṃ cakra vinirmukte bhavetkodho hare yadi || bhaviṣyati mahadduḥkhaṃ lokānāṃ saṃkṣayo hi vā || 34 || na moktavyamataścakra śṛṇu bhūyo vacaśca naḥ || atra sthāne niyukto'haṃ śaṃkareṇa purā hare || 35|| pāpināṃ rakṣaṇārthaṃ vai vighnārthaṃ duṣṭacetasām|| tasmāttvaṃ mama sāṃnidhye tiṣṭha cakradharo hare ||36 || atra cakradharaṃ devaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || dhūpamālyopahāraiśca naivedyairvivi dhairapi || 37 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || eṣa eva nivṛttohaṃ tava vākyāṃkuśena vai || atra cakrodyatakaraḥ sthāsye tava samīpataḥ || 38 || evaṃ hi sthitodevastatra cakradharaḥ priye || daṃḍapāṇiśca bhagavānmama rūpī gaṇeśvaraḥ || 39 || yastau pūjayate bhaktyā daṃḍapāṇiharī kramāt || sa pāpa kaṃcukairmukto gacchecchivapuraṃ naraḥ || 7.1.99.40 || māghe māsi caturddaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || gaṃdhadhūpopahārairyaḥ pūjayeddaṇḍanāyakam || tasya kṣetre nivasato na vighnaṃ jāyate kvacit || 41 || ekādaśyāṃ jitāhāro yo'rcayeccakrapāṇinam || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairyāti viṣṇoḥ salokatām || 42 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ || daṇḍapāṇigaṇasyāpi śrutaṃ pāpaughanāśanam || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ daṇḍapāṇicakradharamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmekonaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||99|| || cha || || ||
<7.1.100>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tayoruttarasaṃsthitam || tathā vāyavyadigbhāge brahmaṇo bālarūpiṇaḥ || 1 || sāṃbādityaṃ suraśreṣṭhe yaḥ sāṃbena pratiṣṭhitaḥ || sthānāni trīṇi devasya dvīpe'sminbhāskarasya tu || 2 || pūrvaṃ mitravanaṃ nāma tathā muṇḍīramucyate || prabhāsakṣetramāsthāya sāṃbādityastṛtīyakaḥ || 3 || tasminkṣetre mahādevi puraṃ yatsāṃbasaṃjñakam || dvitīyaṃ śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ tatra sūryasya nityaśaḥ || 4 || prītyā sāṃba sya tatrārko janasyānugrahāya ca || tatra dvādaśabhāgena mitro maitreṇa cakṣuṣā || 5 || avalokayañjagatsarvaṃ śreyorthaṃ tiṣṭhate sadā || prayuktāṃ vidhivatpūjāṃ gṛhṇāti bhagavānsvayam|| 6 || || devyuvāca || || ko'yaṃ sāṃbaḥ sutaḥ kasya yasya nāmnā raveḥ puram || yasya vā'yaṃ sahasrāṃśurvaradaḥ puṇyakarmaṇaḥ ||7|| || || īśvara uvāca || || ya ete dvādaśādityā virājante mahābalāḥ || teṣāṃ yo viṣṇusaṃjñastu sarvalokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 8 || ihāsau vāsudevatvamavāpa bhagavānvibhuḥ || 9 || tasya sāṃbaḥ suto jajñe jāṃbavatyāṃ mahābalaḥ || sa tu pitrā bhṛśaṃ śaptaḥ kuṣṭharogamavāptavān || tena saṃsthāpitaḥ sūryo nijanāmnā puraṃ kṛtam || 7.1.100.10 || || devyuvāca || || śaptaḥ kasminnimitte'sau pitrā putraḥ svayaṃ punaḥ || nālpaṃ syātkāraṇaṃ deva yenāsau śaptavānsutam || 11 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇuṣvāvahitā bhūtvā tasya yacchāpakāraṇam || durvāsānāma bhagavānmamaivāṃśasamudbhavaḥ || 12 || aṭamānaḥ sa bhagavāṃstrīṃllokānpracacāra ha || atha prāpto dvāravatīṃ lokāḥ saṃjajñire puraḥ || 13 || tamāgatamṛṣiṃ dṛṣṭvā sāṃbo rūpeṇa garvitaḥ || piṃgākṣaṃ jaṭilaṃ rūkṣaṃ visvarūpaṃ kṛśaṃ tathā || 14 || avamānaṃ cakārāsau darśanātsparśanāttathā || dṛṣṭvā tasya mukhaṃ maṃdo vaktraṃ cakre tathātmanaḥ || cakre yadukulaśreṣṭho garvito yauvanena tu || 15 || atha kruddho mahātejā durvāsā ṛṣisattamaḥ || sāṃbaṃ provāca bhagavānvidhunvanmukhamātma naḥ || 16 || yasmādvirūpaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā ātmarūpeṇa garvitaḥ || gamane darśane mahyamahaṃkāraḥ kṛto yataḥ || tasmāttvaṃ kuṣṭharogeṇa na cireṇa grasiṣyase || 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ sāṃbādityamāhātmyopakrame sāṃbāya durvāsasā śāpapradānavarṇanaṃnāma śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 100 || || cha ||
<7.1.101>
|| īśvara uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putrastriṣu lokeṣu garvitaḥ || 1 || sarvalokacaraḥ so'pi yuvā devanamaskṛtaḥ || tathā yadṛcchayā cāyamaṭamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 2 || vāsudevaṃ sa vai draṣṭuṃ nityaṃ dvāravatīṃ purīm || āyāti ṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ krodhena ṛṣi sattamaḥ || 3 || athāśvāgacchatastasya sarve yadukumārakāḥ || ye pradyumnaprabhṛtayaste ca prahvānanāḥ sthitāḥ || 4 || abhāvāccārghyapādyānāṃ pūjāṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ || sāṃbastvavaśyabhāvitvāttasya śāpasya kāraṇāt || 5 || avajñāṃ kurute nityaṃ nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || ratakrīḍā sa vai nityaṃ rūpayauvanagarvitaḥ || 6 || avinītaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa nāradaḥ || asyāhamavinītasya kariṣye vinayaṃ śubham || 7 || evaṃ sa cintayitvātu vāsudevamathābravīt || imāḥ ṣoḍaśasāhasrāḥ striyo yā devasattama || 8 || sarvāstāsāṃ sadā sāṃbe bhāvo deva samāśritaḥ || rūpeṇāpratimaḥ sāṃbo loke'sminsacarācare || 9 || sadā'rhaṃti ca tāstasya darśanaṃ hyapi satstriyaḥ || śrutvaivaṃ nāradādvākyaṃ cintayāmāsa keśavaḥ ||7.1.101.10 || yadetannāradenoktaṃ satyamatra tu kiṃ bhavet || evaṃ ca śrūyate loke cāpalyaṃ strīṣu vidyate || ślokāvimau purā gītau cittajñairyoṣitāṃ dvijaiḥ || 11 || pauṃścalyādaticāpalyādajñānācca svabhāvataḥ || rakṣitā yatnato hyetā vikurvaṃti hi bhartṛṣu || 12 || naitā rūpaṃ parīkṣaṃte nā''sāṃ vayasi saṃśrayaḥ || surūpaṃ vā virūpaṃ vā pumānityeva bhuṃjate || 13 || || īśvara uvāca || || manasā cintayitvaivaṃ kṛṣṇo nāradamabravīt || nahyahaṃ śraddadhāmyetadyadetadbhāṣitaṃ purā || 14 || bruvāṇamevaṃ devaṃ tu nāradaḥ pratyuvāca ha || tathāhaṃ tu kariṣyāmi yathā śraddhāsyate bhavān || 15 || evamuktvā yayau bhūyo nāradastu yathāgatam || tataḥ katipayāhasya dvārakāṃ punarabhyagāt || 16 || tasminnahani devo'pi sahāṃtaḥpaurakairjanaiḥ || anubhūya jalakrīḍāṃ pānamāsevate rahaḥ || 17 || ramye raivatakodyāne nānādrumavibhūṣite || sarvartukusumairnityaṃ vāsite sarvakāmane || 18 || nānājalajaphullābhirdīrghikā bhiralaṃkṛte || haṃsasārasasaṃghuṣṭe cakravākopaśobhite ||19 || tasminsa ramate devaḥ strībhiḥ parivṛtastadā || hāranūpurakeyūrarasanādyairvibhūṣaṇaiḥ || 7.1.101.20 || bhūṣitānāṃ varastrīṇāṃ sarvāṃgīṇāṃ viśeṣataḥ || tatrasthaḥ pibate pānaṃ śubhagandhānvitaṃ śubham || 21 || etasminnaṃtare buddhvā madyamattāstataḥ striyaḥ || uvāca nāradaḥ sāṃbamasmiṃstiṣṭha kumāraka || 22 || tvāṃ samāhvayate devo na yuktaṃ sthātumatra te || tadvākyārthamabuddhvaiva nāradenātha noditaḥ || 23 || gatvā tu satvaraṃ sāṃbaḥ praṇāmamakarotpituḥ || nirddiṣṭamāsanaṃ bheje yathābhāvena viṣṇunā || 24 || etasminnaṃtare tatra yāstu vai cālpasāttvikāḥ || tā dṛṣṭvā sahasā sāṃbaṃ sarvāścukṣubhire striyaḥ || 25 || na sa dṛṣṭaḥ purā yābhiraṃtaḥpuranivāsibhiḥ || madyadoṣāttatastāsāṃ smṛtilopāttathā bahu ||26 || svabhāvato'lpasattvānāṃ jaghanāni visusruvuḥ || śrūyate cāpyayaṃ ślokaḥ purāṇaprathitaḥ kṣitau || 27 || brahmacarye'pi varttaṃtyā yoginyā vā pramādataḥ || prakṛṣṭaṃ puruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā varāṃgaṃ klidyate striyāḥ || 27 || loke'pi dṛśyate hyetanmadyasyāpyatha sevanāt || lajjāṃ muṃcaṃti niḥśaṃkā hrīmatyo hyapi ca striyaḥ || 29 || samāṃsairbhojanaiḥ snigdhaiḥ pānaiḥ sīdhusurāsavaiḥ || gaṃdhairmanojñairvastraiśca kāmaḥ strīṣu vijṛṃbhati || 7.1.101.30 || madyaṃ na deyamatyarthaṃ puruṣeṇa vipaścitā || madonmattāḥ svabhāvena pūrvaṃ saṃti yataḥ striyaḥ || 31 || nārado'pyatha taṃ sāṃbaṃ preṣayitvā tvarānvitaḥ || ājagāmātha tatraiva sāṃbasyānupadena tu || 32 || āyāṃtaṃ tāḥ svayaṃ dṛṣṭvā priyasaumanasaṃ munim|| sahasaivotthitāḥ sarvā madonmattā api striyaḥ || 33 || tāsāmathotthitānāṃ tu vāsudevasya paśyataḥ || bhittvā vāsāṃsyanarghāṇi pātreṣu patitāni tu ||34|| jaghaneṣu vilagnāni tāni petuḥ pṛthakpṛthak || taddṛṣṭvā tu hariḥ kuddhastāḥ śaśāpa tato'balāḥ || 35 || yasmādgatāni cetāṃsi māṃ muktvā'nyatra vaḥ striyaḥ || tasmātpatikṛtām̐llokānāyuṣoṃ'te na yāsyatha || || 36 || patilokātparibhraṣṭāḥ svargamārgāttathaiva ca || bhūtvā hyaśaraṇā bhūyo dasyuhastaṃ gamiṣyatha || 37 || śāpadoṣāttatastasmāttāḥ striyo gāṃ gate harau || hṛtāḥ pāṃcanadaiścaurairarjunasya prapaśyataḥ || 38 || alpasattvāśca yāścāsaṃstā gatā dūṣaṇaṃ striyaḥ || rukmiṇī satyabhāmā ca tathā jāṃbavatī priye || 39 || na prāptā dasyuhastaṃ tāḥ svena sattvena rakṣitāḥ || śaptvaivaṃ tāḥ striyaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāṃbamapyaśapatpunaḥ||7.1.101.40|| yasmādatīva te kāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpamimāḥ striyaḥ || kṣubdhāḥ sarvā yatastasmātkuṣṭharogamavāpnuhi || 41 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sāṃbo lajjāsamanvitaḥ|| uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ sa smarannṛṣisattamam || 42 || animittamahaṃ tāta bhāvadoṣavivarjitaḥ || śapto na me'tra vai kuddho durvāsā nānyathā vadet || 43 || evamuktvā tataḥ sāṃbaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kamalalocanam || tato vairāgyasaṃyuktaścintāśokaparāyaṇaḥ || 44 || prabhāsakṣetramagamatsarvapātakanāśanam || evaṃ tatkṣetramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam || 45 || pratiṣṭhāpya sahasrāṃśuṃ devaṃ pāpaniṣūdanam || tataścārādhayāmāsa paraṃ niyamamāśritaḥ || 46 || trisaṃdhyaṃ pūjayāmāsa divyagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ || stotreṇānena bhaktyā vai stauti nityaṃ dinādhipam || 47 || || sāṃba uvāca || || namastrailokyadīpāya namaste timirāpaha || namaḥ paṃkajanāthāya namaḥ kumudaśatrave || 48 || namo jagatpratiṣṭhāya jagaddhātre namo'stu te || devadeva namasyāmi sūryaṃ trailokyadīpakam || 49 || ādityavarṇo bhuvanasya goptā apūrva eṣa prathamaḥ surāṇām || hiraṇyagarbhaḥ puruṣo mahātmā sa paṭhyate vai tamasaḥ parastāt || 7.1.101.50 || iti stutastadā sūryaḥ prasannenāṃtarātmanā || uvāca darśanaṃ gatvā sāṃbaṃ jāṃbavatīsutam || 51 || sāṃbasāṃba mahāvāho śṛṇu govindanandane || stotreṇānena tuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ brūhi yadīpsitam || 52 || || sāṃba uvāca || || kṛṣṇenāhaṃ suraśreṣṭha śaptaḥ pāpaḥ sudurmatiḥ || kuṣṭhāṃtaṃ kuru me deva yadi tuṣṭo'si me prabho || 53 || || śrībhānuruvāca || || bhūya eva mahābhāga nīrogastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || yādṛgrūpaḥ purā hyāsīrmama caiva prasādataḥ || 54 || adya prabhṛti nekṣyāstā viṣṇubhāryāḥ kathaṃcana || na tāsāṃ darśane jātu sthātavyaṃ yadunandana || 55 || tāsāmīrṣyāparītena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || kuṣṭhaṃ te yādavaśreṣṭha pradattaṃ hi mahātmanā || 56 || yo māṃ stotreṇa cānena samāgatya ca stoṣyati || na tasyānvayasaṃbhūtaḥ kuṣṭhī kaścidbhaviṣyati || 57 || athādityasya nāmāni samyagjānīhi dvādaśa || dvādaśaiva tathānyāni tāni vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || 58 || ādityaḥ savitā sūryo mihiro'rkaḥ pratāpanaḥ || mārttaṃḍo bhāskaro bhānuścitrabhānurddivākaraḥ || 59 || ravirdvādaśanāmaivaṃ jñeyaḥ sāmānyanāmabhiḥ || viṣṇurdhātā bhagaḥ pūṣā mitroṃ'śurvaruṇo 'ryamā || 7.1.101.60 || indro vivasvāṃstvaṣṭā ca parjanyo dvādaśaḥ smṛtaḥ || iti te dvādaśādityāḥ pṛthaktvena prakīrtitāḥ || 61 || uttiṣṭhaṃti sadā hyete māsairdvādaśabhiḥ kramāt || viṣṇustapati vai caitre vaiśākhe cāryamā sadā || 62 || vivasvāñjyeṣṭhamāse tu āṣāḍhe cāṃśumāṃstathā || parjjanyaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi varuṇaḥ prauṣṭhasaṃjñike || 63 || indraścāśvayuje māsi dhātā tapati kārtike || mārgaśīrṣe tathā mitraḥ pauṣe pūṣā divākaraḥ || 64 || māghe bhagastu vijñeyastvaṣṭā tapati phālgune || śatairdvādaśabhirviṣṇū raśmīnāṃ dīpyate sadā || 65 || dīpyate gosahasreṇa śataiśca tribhiraryamā || dvisaptakairvivasvāṃstu aṃśumānpañcakaistribhiḥ || 66 || vivasvāniva parjanyo varuṇaścāryamā iva || indrastu dviguṇaiḥ ṣaḍbhirbhātyekādaśabhiḥ śataiḥ || 67 || mitravacca bhagastvaṣṭā sahasreṇa śatena ca || uttaropakrame'rkasya vardhante raśmayaḥ sadā || dakṣiṇopakrame bhūyo hrasante sūryaraśmayaḥ || 68 || evaṃ dvādaśa mūrtisthaḥ prabhāsakṣetramadhyataḥ || sāṃbādityeti vikhyātaḥ sthāsye manvantarāntare || 69 || māghasya śuklapakṣe tu pañcamyāṃ yādavottama || ekabhaktaṃ sadā khyātaṃ ṣaṣṭhyāṃ naktamudāhṛtam || 7.1.101.70 || saptamyāmupavāsaṃ tu kṛtvā sāṃbārkasaṃnidhau || raktacandanamiśraistu karavīrairmahāvrataḥ || 71 || dattvā kundarakaṃ dhūpaṃ pūjayedbhāskaraṃ budhaḥ || brāhmaṇāndivyabhojyena bhojayitvā'pi śaktitaḥ || 72 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyaksāṃbādityasya pūjanam ||| samyakchraddhāsamāyuktaḥ saṃprāpsyatyakhilaṃ phalam || 73 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || sāṃbo'pi nirjaro bhūtvā dvārakāṃ punarāgamat || 74 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi sāṃbādityamahodayam || śrutaṃ harati pāpāni tathā''rogyaṃ prayacchati || 75 || iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 101 ||
<7.1.102>
tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ kaṃṭakaśodhinīm || tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhanurdvitayasaṃsthitām || 1 || mahiṣaghnīṃ mahākāyāṃ brahmadevarṣipūjitām || purā ye kalmaṣopetā dānavā devakaṃṭakāḥ || 2 || yugeyuge śodhayettāṃstena kaṃṭakaśodhinī || āśvayukchuklapakṣe tu navamyāṃ tāmathārcayet || 3 || paśupuṣpopahāraiśca dīpadhūpaistathottamaiḥ || tasyā'rayo na jāyaṃte yāvadvarṣaṃ varānane || 4 || yastāṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā bhūtāyā nityameva vā || | || taṃ putramiva kalyāṇī saṃrakṣati na saṃśayaḥ || 5 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || devi kaṃṭakaśodhinyāḥ śrutaṃ rakṣākaraṃ param || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbādityasamīpavartikaṃṭakaśodhinīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 102 || || cha ||
<7.1.103>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchedvarārohe kapāleśvaramuttamam || tasyā uttaradigbhāge suragaṃdharvapūjitam|| || 1 || purā yajñe varttamāne dakṣarājasya dhīmataḥ || upaviṣṭeṣu vipreṣu hūyamāne hutāśane || 2 || jālmarūpadharo bhūtvā śaṃkarastatra cāgataḥ || jīrṇakaṃthānvito devi malavāndhūlidhūsaraḥ || 3 || atha te brāhmaṇāḥ kruddhā dṛṣṭvā taṃ jālmarūpiṇam || kapāladhāriṇaṃ sarve dhikchabdaistaṃ jagarhire|| 4 || asakṛtpāpapāpeti gacchagaccha narādhama || yajñavedirna cārhā hi mānuṣāsthidharasya te || 5 || atha prahasya bhagavānyajñavedyāṃ sureśvari || kṣiptvā kapālaṃ naṣṭo'sau na sa jñāto manīṣibhiḥ || 6 || tasminnaṣṭe kapālaṃ tatkṣiptaṃ maṃḍapabāhyataḥ || athānyattatra saṃjātaṃ tadrūpaṃ ca varānane || 7 || kṣiptaṃkṣiptaṃ punastatra jāyate ca mahītale || evaṃ śatasahasrāṇi prayutānyarbudāni ca || 8 || tatra kṣiptāni jātāni tataste vismayānvitāḥ || athocurmunayaḥ sarve nirviṇṇāścāsya ceṣṭitam || 9 || ko'nyo devānmahādevādgaṃgākṣālitaśekharāt || samartha īdṛśaṃ karttumasminyajñe viśeṣataḥ || 7.1.103.10 || tataste vi vidhaiḥ stotraiḥ stuvaṃto vṛṣabhadhvajam || homaṃ cakrurmuhurvahnau maṃtraistaiḥ śatarudriyaiḥ || 11 || tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ prāptasteṣāṃ devo maheśvaraḥ || tataste vividhaiḥ stotraistuṣṭuvuḥ śūlapāṇinam|| vedoktamaṃtrairvividhaiḥ purāṇoktaistathaiva ca || 12 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || oṃ namo mūlaprakṛtaye ajitāya mahātmane || anāvṛtāya devāya niḥspṛhāya namonamaḥ || 13 || nama ādyāya bījāya ārṣeyāya pravarttine || anaṃtarāya caikāya avyaktāya namonamaḥ || ||| 14 || nānāvicitrabhujagāṃgadabhūṣaṇāya sarveśvarāya virajāya namo varāya || viśvātmane paramakāraṇakāraṇāya phullāraviṃdavipulāyatalocanāya || || 15 || adṛśyamavyaktamanādimavyayaṃ yadakṣaraṃ brahma vadaṃti sarvagam || niśāmya yaṃ mṛtyumukhātpramucyate tamādidevaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 16 || evaṃ stutastadā sarvairṛṣibhirgatakalmaṣaiḥ || tatastuṣṭo mahādevasteṣāṃ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || abravīttānṛṣīndevo vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam || 17 || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || yadi tuṣṭo'si no deva sthāne'sminnirato bhava || asaṃkhyātāni yasmācca kapālāni sureśvara || 18 || punaḥ punaḥ pravṛttāni vyapanītānyapi prabho || asminnasaṃśayaṃ sthāne kapāleśvaranāmabhṛt|| 19 || svayaṃ tu liṃgaṃ deveśa tiṣṭhenmanvaṃtarāṃtaram || kapāleśvaranāmnā tvamasminsthāne sthitiṃ kuru|| 7.1.103.20 || yetra tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ || teṣāṃ tu paramaṃ sthānaṃ yaddevairapi durlabham || 21 || bāḍhamityevamuktvā'sau sthita statramaheśvaraḥ || punaḥ pravartito yajño niśānāthasya bhāmini || 22 || tasmindṛṣṭe labhenmartyo vājimedhaphalaṃ priye || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ pūrva janmārjjitairapi || 23 || idaṃ māhātmyamakhilamabhūtsvāyaṃbhuvāṃtare || vaivasvate punaścānyaddakṣayajñavināśakṛt || 24 || kapālīti maheśāno dakṣeṇoktaḥ purā haraḥ || tena yajñasya vidhvaṃsaṃ kapālī tamathākarot || kapāleśvaranāmeti sthitosminmānavāntare || 25 || athāsya nāma devasya sūrya sāvarṇikeṃ'tare || bhaviṣyati varārohe nāma tattveśvareti ca || 26 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ rudradaivatam|| pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ paśupāśavimokṣaṇam || 27 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ kapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryadhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 103 || || cha ||
<7.1.104>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi koṭīśvaramanuttamam || tasmāduttarato devi koṭīśamiti viśrutam || 1 || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ paśupāśavimokṣadam || purā pāśupatā devi kapāleśvarasaṃnidhau || 2 || tapaḥ kurvaṃti vipulaṃ bhasmoddhūlitavigrahāḥ || jaṭāmukuṭasaṃyuktā muṃjamekhaladhāriṇaḥ || 3 || śāṃtāḥ sarve jitakrodhā brāhmaṇāḥ śivayoginaḥ || tapaḥ kurvaṃti tatrasthā vyāpya kṣetraṃ caturddiśam || 4 || koṭisaṃkhyā mahādevi mantrajāpyaparāyaṇāḥ || samyaksaṃsthāpya te liṃgaṃ kapāleśasamīpagam || 5 || tataste pūjayāṃ cakrustalliṃgaṃ bhaktisaṃyutāḥ || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo muktiṃ teṣāṃ dadau haraḥ || 6 || ṛṣayaḥ koṭisaṃkhyātāstasminsiddhā yataḥ priye || tena koṭīśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ nāmnā khyātaṃ dharātale || 7 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā koṭīśvaramanāmayam || sa koṭimantrajāpyasya phalaṃ prāpsyati mānavaḥ || 8 || hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage || koṭihomaphalaṃ tasya samyagyātrāphalaṃ bhavet || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye koṭīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturadhika śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 104 || || cha ||
<7.1.105>
|| īśvara uvāca || || athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ sthānamuttamam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ vistarātkatha yāmi te || 1 || pradhānadevamāhātmyaṃ māhātmyaṃ kalpavāsinām || someśo daityahaṃtā ca vālarūpī pitāmahaḥ ||2|| arkasthalastathādityaḥ prabhāsaḥ śaśibhūṣaṇaḥ || ete ṣaṭpravarā devāḥ kṣetre prābhāsike sthitāḥ || 3 || teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyaḥ prajāyate || mucyate pātakairghorairājanmajanitairdhru vam || 4 || || devyuvāca|| || pūrveṣāmuktadevānāṃ māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tvayā || prabhāse bālarūpīti yatproktaṃ tatkathaṃ vacaḥ || 5 || anyeṣu sarva sthāneṣu vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ || kathaṃ ca samanuprāpto māhātmyaṃ tasya kiṃ smṛtam || 6 || kathaṃ sa pūjyo deveśa yātrā kāryā kathaṃ nṛbhiḥ || etadvistarato brūhi prasanno yadi me prabho || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ brahmasambhavam || yasya śravaṇamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 8 || nāsti brahmasamo devo nāsti brahmasamo guruḥ || nāsti brahmasamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti brahmasamaṃ tapaḥ || 9 || tāvaddhamaṃti saṃsāre duḥkha śokabhayaplutāḥ || na bhavaṃti surajyeṣṭhe yāvadbhaktāḥ pitāmahe || 7.1.105.10 || samāsaktaṃ yathā cittaṃ jantorviṣayagocare || yadyevaṃ brahmaṇi nyastaṃ ko na mucyeta baṃdhanāt || 11 || || devyuvāca || || evaṃ māhātmyasaṃyukto yadi brahmā jagadguruḥ || prābhāsike mahātīrthe kasminsthāne tu saṃsthitaḥ || || 12 || kimarthamāgatastatra kasminkāle surottamaḥ || kathaṃ sa pūjyo vipreṃdraistithau kasyāṃ kramādvada || 13 || || īśvara uvāca || || somanāthasya aiśānyāṃ sāṃbādityāgnigocare || brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaloka ivāparaḥ || 14 tiṣṭhate kalpasaṃsthā vai tatra kalpāṃtavāsinaḥ || tatra sthāne sthito devi bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ || 15 || jagatprabhurlokakartā sattvamūrtirmahāprabhaḥ || āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || 16 || tatrā'karottapo ghoraṃ divyābdānāṃ sahasrakam || saṃsthāpya tu mahāliṃgaṃ sisṛkṣurvividhāḥ prajāḥ || 17 || tataḥ kālāṃtaretīte somena prārthito vibhuḥ || kṣayarogavimuktena samyakchraddhānvitena vai || 18 || liṃgapratiṣṭhāhetorvai kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || koṭibrahmarṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sahito viśvakarmaṇā || kārayāmāsa vidhivatpratiṣṭhāṃ liṃgamuttamam|| 19 || pratiṣṭhāpya tato liṃgaṃ somanāthaṃ varānane || dāpayāmāsa viprebhyo bhūriśo yajñadakṣiṇām || 7.1.105.20 || evaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || varṣāṇi cātra jātāni prabhāse bālarūpiṇaḥ || 21 || catvāriṃśadvayaṃ caiva kṣetramadhyanivāsinaḥ || evaṃ parārddhamagamatprabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ || 22 || || devyuvāca || || brahmaṇo dinamānaṃ tu māsavarṣasahasrakam || tatsarvaṃ vistarādbrūhi yathāyurbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtam || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || || paramāyuḥ smṛto brahmā parārddhaṃ tasya vai gatam|| prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthasya dvitīyaṃ bhavate'dhunā || 24 || yadā prābhāsike kṣetre brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu bālarūpī tadocyate || 25 || anyeṣu sarvatīrtheṣu vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ || muktvā prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ sadaiva vibudhapriye || 26 || brahmāṃḍe yāni tīrthāni brahmāṇasteṣu ye smṛtāḥ || teṣāmādyo mahātejāḥ prabhāse yo vyavasthitaḥ || 27 || kalpekalpe tu nāmāni śṛṇu tvaṃ tāni vai priye || svayaṃbhūḥ prathame kalpe dvitīye padmabhūḥ sthitaḥ || .28 || tṛtīye viśvakarteti bālarūpī caturthake || etāni mukhyanāmāni kathitāni svayaṃbhuvaḥ || 29 || nityaṃ saṃsmarate yastu sa dīrghāyurnaro bhavet ||7.1.105.30|| candrasūryagrahāḥ sarve sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || trailokyaṃ naśyate sarvaṃ brahmarātri samāgame||31|| punardine tu saṃjāte prabuddhaḥ sanpitāmahaḥ|| tathā sṛṣṭiṃ prakurute yathāpūrvamabhūtpriye||32|| dinamānaṃ pravakṣyāmi brahmaṇo lokakartṛṇaḥ || netrabhāgāccaturbhāgastruṭiḥ kālo nigadyate || 33 || tasmācca dviguṇaṃ jñeyaṃ nimiṣāṃtaṃ varānane || nimiṣaiḥ pañcadaśabhiḥ kāṣṭhā ityucyate budhaiḥ|| triṃśadbhiścaiva kāṣṭhābhiḥ kalā proktā manīṣibhiḥ ||34|| triṃśatkalo muhūrtaḥ syāddinaṃ paṃcadaśaistu taiḥ|| dinamānā niśā jñeyā ahorātraṃ tayorbhavet ||35|| taiḥ paṃcadaśabhiḥ pakṣaḥ pakṣābhyāṃ māsa ucyate || māsaiścaivāyanaṃ ṣaṅbhirabdaṃ syādayanadvayāt ||36|| catvāriṃśaddhi lakṣāṇi lakṣāṇāṃ tritayaṃ punaḥ || viṃśatiśca sahasrāṇi jñeyaṃ sauraṃ caturyugam || 37 || caturyugaikasaptatyā manvaṃtaramudāhṛtam || aindrametadbhavedāyuḥ samāsāttava kīrtitam || 38 || svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ pūrvaṃ manuḥ svārociṣastataḥ || auttamastāmasaścaiva raivataścākṣuṣastataḥ || 39|| vaivasvato'rkasāvarṇirbrahmasā varṇireva ca || dharmasāvarṇināmā ca raucyo bhūtyastathaiva ca || 7.1.105.40 || caturdaśaite manavaḥ sam̐khyātāste yathākramam || bhūtānbhaviṣyāniṃdrāṃśca sarvā nvakṣye tava kramāt || 41 || viśvabhukca vipaścicca sukīrtiḥ śibireva ca || vibhurmanobhuvaścaiva tathaujasvī balirbalī || 42 || adbhutaśca tathā śāṃtī ramyo devavaro vṛṣā || ṛtadhāmā divaḥsvāmī śuciḥ śakrāścaturdaśa || 43 || ete sarve vinaśyaṃti brahmaṇo divase priye || rātristu tāvatī jñeyā kalpamānamidaṃ smṛtam || 44 || prathamaṃ śvetakalpastu dvitīyo nīlalohitaḥ || vāmadevastṛtīyastu tato rāthaṃtaro'paraḥ || 45 || rauravaḥ paṃcamaḥ proktaḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ prāṇa iti smṛtaḥ || saptamo'tha bṛhatkalpaḥ kandarpo'ṣṭama ucyate || 46 || sadyo'tha navamaḥ proktaḥ īśāno daśamaḥ smṛtaḥ || dhyāna ekādaśaḥ proktastathā sārasvato'paraḥ || 47 || trayodaśa udānastu garuḍo'tha caturdaśaḥ || kaurmaḥ paṃcadaśo jñeyaḥ paurṇamāsī prajāpateḥ || 48 || ṣoḍaśo nārasiṃhastu samādhistu tataḥ paraḥ || āgneyo'ṣṭādaśaḥ proktaḥ somakalpastato'paraḥ || 49 || bhāvano viṃśatiḥ proktaḥ suptamālīti cāparaḥ || vaikuṇṭhaścārciṣo rudro lakṣmīkalpastathāpareḥ || 7.1.105.50 || saptaviṃśo'tha vairājo gaurīkalpastathoṃ''dhakaḥ || māheśvarastathā proktastripuro yatra ghātitaḥ || 51 || pitṛkalpastathāṃte ca yā kuhūrbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtā || triṃśatkalpāḥ samākhyātā brahmaṇo māsi vai priye || 52 || atītāḥ kathitāḥ sarve vārāho varttate'dhunā || pratipadbrahmaṇo yatra vārāheṇoddhṛtā mahī || 53 || triṃśatkalpaiḥ smṛto māso varṣaṃ dvādaśabhistu taiḥ || anena varṣamānena tadā brahmā'ṣṭavārṣikaḥ || ānītaḥ somarājena somanāthaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 54 || evaṃ kṣetre nivasataḥ prabhāse bālarūpiṇaḥ || parārddhamekamagamaddvitīyaṃ vartate' dhunā || 55 || evaṃ mahāprabhāvo'sau prabhāsakṣetramadhyagaḥ || brahmā svayaṃbhūrbhagavānbālatvātkṣetramāśritaḥ || 56 || sa vai pūjyo namaskāryo vaṃdanīyo manīṣibhiḥ || ādau sa eva pūjyaḥ syātsamyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 57 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā sa māṃ pūjayate bhuvam || yastaṃ dveṣṭi sa māṃ dveṣṭi yosya pūjyo mamaiva saḥ || 58 || brahmaṇā pūjyamānena ahaṃ viṣṇuśca pūjitaḥ || viṣṇunā pūjyamānena ahaṃ brahmā ca pūjitaḥ || 59 || mayā pūjita mātreṇa brahmaviṣṇū ca pūjitau || sattvaṃ brahmā rajo viṣṇustamo'haṃ saṃprakīrtitaḥ || 7.1.105.60 || vāyurbrahmā'nalo rudro viṣṇurāpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ || rātrirviṣṇuraho rudro yā saṃdhyā sa pitāmahaḥ ||61|| sāmavedo hyahaṃ devi brahmā ṛgveda ucyate || yajurvedo bhavedviṣṇuḥ kulādhāro hyatharvaṇaḥ || 62|| uṣṇakālo hyahaṃ devi varṣākālaḥ pitāmahaḥ || śītakālo bhavedviṣṇurevaṃ kālatrayaṃ hi saḥ || 63 || dakṣiṇāgnirahaṃ jñeyo gārhapatyo hariḥ smṛtaḥ || brahmā cāhavanīyastu evaṃ sarvaṃ tridaivatam || 64 || ahaṃ liṃgasvarūpastho bhago viṣṇuḥ prakīrtitaḥ || bījasaṃstho bhavedbrahmā viṣṇurāpaḥ prakīrtitaḥ ||65|| ahamākāśarūpastha evaṃ tattvamayaṃ prabhuḥ || ākāśātsravate yacca tadbījaṃ brahmasaṃsthitam || svarūpaṃ brāhmamāśritya brahmā bījaprarohakaḥ||66|| nābhimadhye sthito brahmā viṣṇuśca hṛdayāṃtare || vaktramadhye ahaṃ devi ādhāraḥ sarvadehinām ||67|| yaścāhaṃ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo brahmā sa hutāśanaḥ || yā devī sa svayaṃ viṣṇuryo viṣṇuḥ sa ca candramāḥ || 68 || yaḥ kālaḥ sa svayaṃ brahmā yo rudraḥ sa ca bhāskaraḥ || evaṃ śaktiviśeṣeṇa paraṃ brahma sthitaṃ priye || 69 || oṃkārastatparaṃ brahma gāyatrī prakṛtiḥ parā || ubhāvetau naro jñātvā na vicyavati mucyate ||7.1.105.7||| evaṃ yo veda deveśi advaitaṃ paramākṣaram || sa sarvaṃ veda naivānyo bhedakarttā narādhamaḥ || 71 || ekarūpaṃ paraṃ brahma kāryabhāvātpṛthaksthitaḥ || yastaṃ dveṣṭi varārohe brahmadveṣṭā sa ucyate || 72 || dakṣiṇāṃge sthito brahmā vāmāṃge mama keśavaḥ || yastayordveṣamādhatte sa dveṣṭā mama bhāmini || 73 || evaṃ jñātvā varārohe hyabhinnenāntarātmanā || brahmāṇaṃ keśavaṃ rudramekarūpeṇa pūja yet || 74 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ brahma māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcādhikaśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 105 || || ||
<7.1.106>
|| devyuvāca || || evamadvaitabhāvena yadbrahma parikīrtitam || tasya pūjā vidhānaṃ me kathayasva yathārthataḥ || 1 || kṣetre prābhāsike deva bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ || sa kathaṃ pūjyate lokaiḥ parabrahmasvarūpavān || 2 || ke mantrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ tadbāhmaṇāstatra kīdṛśāḥ || tatra sthitānāṃ viprāṇāṃ kathaṃ kṣetraphalaṃ bhavet || 3 || katiprakārāste viprāstatra kṣetranivāsinaḥ || kimācārā mahādeva kiṃśīlāḥ kiṃparāyaṇāḥ || 4 || etadvistarato brūhi brāhmaṇānāṃ mahodayam || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahādevi samyakpraśnaviśārade || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā bhūtvā māhātmyaṃ vipradaivatam || 6 || yacchrutvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || ye kecitsāgarāṃtāyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ kīrtitā dvijāḥ || 7 || tadrūpaṃ mama deveśi pratyakṣaṃ dharaṇītale || pratyakṣaṃ brāhmaṇā devāḥ parokṣaṃ divi devatāḥ || 8 || brāhmaṇā matpriyā nityaṃ brāhmaṇā māmakī tanuḥ || yastānarcayate bhaktyā sa māmarcayate sadā || 9 || yastāṃstoṣayate bhaktyā sa ca māṃ paritoṣayet ||7.1.106.1||| ye brāhmaṇāḥ so'hamasaṃśayaṃ priye teṣvarciteṣvarcito'haṃ bhaveyam || teṣveva tuṣṭeṣvahameva tuṣṭo vairaṃ ca tairyasya mamāpi vairam || 11 || yaścandanaiḥ sāgarugandhamālyai rabhyarcayecchailamayīṃ mamārcām|| asau na māmarcayatercayanvai viprārcanādarcita eva cāham || 12 || yāvaṃtaḥ pṛthivīmadhye cīrṇavedavratā dvijāḥ || acīrṇavratavedā vā te'pi pūjyā dvijāḥ priye || 13 || na brāhmaṇānparīkṣeta śrāddhe kṣetranivāsinaḥ || sumahānparivādo'sya brāhmaṇānāṃ parīkṣaṇe || 14 || kāṇāḥ khañjāśca kṛṣṇāśca daridrā vyādhitāstathā || sarve śrāddhe niyoktavyā miśritā vedapāragaiḥ || 15 || brāhmaṇā jātitaḥ pūjyā vedābhyāsāttataḥ param || tatorthaṃ havyakavyeṣu na nindyā brāhmaṇāḥ kvacit || 16 || kāṇānkuṇṭāṃśca kubjāśca daridrānvyādhitānapi|| nāvamanyeddvijānprājño mama rūpaṃ yataḥ smṛtam || 17 || bahavo hi na jānaṃti narā jñānabahiṣkṛtāḥ || yathāhaṃ dvijarūpeṇa carāmi pṛthivīmimām || 18 || madrūpānghnanti ye viprānvikarma kārayaṃti ca || apreṣaṇe preṣayaṃti dāsatvaṃ kārayanti ca || 19 || mṛtāṃstānkarapatreṇa yamadūtā mahābalāḥ || nikṛṃtaṃti yathā kāṣṭhaṃ sūtramārgeṇa śilpinaḥ || 7.1.106.20 || ye caivāślakṣṇayā vācā tarjayanti narādhamāḥ || vadaṃti paruṣaṃ krodhātpādena nihanaṃti ca || 21 || mṛtāṃstānyamalokā hi nihatya dharaṇītale || krūrapādena cākramya krodhasaṃraktalocanāḥ || 22 || agnivarṇaiśca saṃdaṃśairjihvāmuddharate yamaḥ || ye nu viprānnirīkṣante pāpāḥ pāpena cakṣuṣā || 22 || abrahmaṇyāstu te bāhyā nityaṃ brahmadviṣo narāḥ || teṣāṃ ghorā mahākāyā vajratuṃḍā bhayānakāḥ || uddharaṃti muhūrtena cakṣuḥ kākā yamājñayā || 24 || yastāḍayati vipraṃ vai kṣate kuryāddhi śoṇitam || asthibhaṃgaṃ ca vā kuryātprāṇairvāpi viyojayet ||25|| brahmaghnaḥ sa tu vijñeyo na tasmai niṣkṛtiḥ smṛtā || pañcāśatkoṭisaṃkhyeṣu narakeṣvanupūrvaśaḥ || 26 || sa bahūni sahasrāṇi varṣāṇi pacyate bhṛśam|| tasmādvipro varārohe namaskāryo nṛbhiḥ sadā|| 27 || annapānapradānaistu pūjyā hi satataṃ dvijāḥ || sarveṣāṃ caiva dānānāṃ viprāḥ sarve'dhikāriṇaḥ || 28 || nānyaḥ samartho deveśi gṛhṇanyātyadhamāṃ gatim || tapasā pāvito devi brāhmaṇo dhṛtakilviṣaḥ || 29 || na sīdetpratigṛhṇānaḥ pṛthivīmanusāgarām|| nāsti kiṃcinmahādevi duṣkṛtaṃ brāhmaṇasya tu || 7.1.106.30 || yastu sthitaḥ sadā'dhyātme nityaṃ sadbhāvabhāvitaḥ || brāhmaṇo hi mahadbhūtaṃ janmanā saha jāyate || 31 || loke lokeśvarāścāpi sarve brāhmaṇapūjakāḥ || tatastānnāvamanyeta yadīcchejjīvitaṃ ciram || 32 || brāhmaṇāḥ kupitā hanyurbhasmīkuryuḥ svatejasā || lokānanyānsṛjeyuśca lokapālāṃstathā'parān || 33 || apeyaḥ sāgaro yaiśca kṛtaḥ kopānmahātmabhiḥ || yeṣāṃ kopāgniradyāpi daṃḍake nopaśāmyati ||34|| ete svargasya netāro devadevāḥ sanātanāḥ|| ebhiścāpi kṛtaḥ paṃthā devayānaḥ sa ucyate || 35 || te pūjyāste namaskāryāsteṣu sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || te vai lokānimānsarvānpārayaṃti parasparam||36|| gūḍhasvādhyāyatapaso brāhmaṇāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || vidyāsnātā vratasnātā anapāśritya jīvinaḥ||37|| āśīviṣā iva kruddhā upacaryā hi brāhmaṇāḥ|| tapasā dīpyamānāste daheyuḥ sāgarānapi||38|| brāhmaṇeṣu ca tuṣṭuṣu tuṣyaṃte sarvadevatāḥ|| te gatiḥ sarvabhūtānāmadhyātmagaticintakāḥ||39|| ādimadhyāvasānānāṃ jñānānāṃ chinnasaṃśayāḥ|| parāparaviśeṣajñā netāraḥ paramāṃ gatim || avadhyā brāhmaṇāstasmātpāpeṣvapi ratāḥ sadā || 7.1.106.40 || yaśca sarvamidaṃ hanyādbrāhmaṇaṃ cāpi tatsamam || so'gniḥ so'rko mahātejā viṣaṃ bhavati kopitaḥ || 41 || bhūtānāmagrabhugvipro varṇaśreṣṭhaḥ pitā guruḥ || na skandate na vyathate na vinaśyati karhicit||42|| variṣṭhamagnihotrāddhi brāhmaṇasya mukhe hutam|| viprāṇāṃ vapurāśritya sarvāstiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ||43|| ataḥ pūjyāstu te viprā alābhe pratimādayaḥ || 44 || avidyo vā savidyo vā brāhmaṇo mama daivatam || praṇītaścāpraṇītaśca yathāgnirdaivataṃ mahat || 45 || smaśāneṣvapi tejasvī pāvako naiva duṣyati || havyakavyavyapeto'pi brāhmaṇo naiva duṣyati || 46 || mahāpātakavarjyaṃ hi pūjyo vipro varānane || sarvathā brāhmaṇāḥ pūjyāḥ sarvathā daivataṃ mahat || tasmātsarvaprayatnena rakṣedāpadgataṃ dvijam || 47 || evaṃ viprā mahādevi pūjyāḥ sarvatra mānavaiḥ || kiṃ punaḥ saṃjitātmāno viśeṣātkṣetravāsinaḥ || 48 || atha kṣetrasthitānāṃ ca caturāśramavāsinām || viprāṇāṃ vṛttito bhedaṃ pravakṣyāmyānupūrvyaśaḥ || 49 || kṣetrasya saṃnyāsavidhiṃ ye jānaṃti dvijātayaḥ || vṛttibhedaṃ kramāccaiva te kṣetraphalabhāginaḥ || 7.1.106.50 || yathā kṣetre nivasatā vartitavyaṃ dvijātinā || prājāpatyādibhedena tacchṛṇu tvaṃ varānane || 51 || prājāpatyā mahīpālāḥ kapotā graṃthikāstathā || kuṭikāścātha vaitālāḥ padmahaṃsā varānane || 52 || dhṛtarāṣṭrā bakāḥ kaṃkā gopālāścaiva bhāmini || truṭikā maṭharāścaiva guṭikā daṃḍikāḥ pare || 53 || kṣetrasthānāmime bhedā vṛttiṃ teṣāṃ śṛṇuṣva ca || 54 || ahiṃsā guruśuśrūṣā svādhyāyaḥ śaucasaṃyamaḥ || satyamasteyametaddhi prājāpatyaṃ vrataṃ smṛtam || 55 || kṣayapuṣṭyarthavidveṣakarmabhiḥ śāṃtikādibhiḥ || pālayaṃti mahīṃ yasmānmahīpālāstataḥ smṛtāḥ || 56 || patitā ye kaṇā bhūmau saṃharaṃti kapotavat || uddhṛtyājīvanaṃ yeṣāṃ kapotāste tu sādhakāḥ || 57 || gṛhaṃ kṛtvā tu sadgraṃthāḥ sahasaiva tyajaṃti ye || kuṭikā sādhakāste vai śivārādhanatatparāḥ || 58 || tīrthāsaktāḥ sapatnīkā yathālabdhopajīvinaḥ || mahāsāhasayuktāste vaitālākhyāstu sādhakāḥ || 59 || saṃyatāḥ kāmanāsaktā rājyakāmārthasādhakāḥ || padmāste sādhakāḥ khyātā bhikṣācaryāratāḥ sadā || 7.1.106.60 || jñānayogasamāyuktā dvaitācāraratāśca ye || haṃsāste sādhakāḥ khyātāḥ svayamutpannasaṃvidaḥ || 61 || brahmacaryeṇa sattvena tathā'lubdhatayāpi vā || jitaṃ jagaddhārayanto dhṛtarāṣṭrā matāstu ye || 62 || gūḍhāścaraṃti ye jñānaṃ vrataṃ dharmamathāpi vā || svārthaikāgataniṣṭhāstu bakāste sādhakā matāḥ|| || 63 || jalāśrayaṃ samāśritya sthitā utkṛṣṭasiddhaye || bisaśṛṃgāṭakāhārāste kaṃkāḥ sādhakāḥ smṛtāḥ || 64 || gobhiḥ sārddhaṃ vrajaṃtyatra goṣṭhe ca nivasaṃti ye || paṃcagavyarasā ye vai gopālāste tu sādhakāḥ || 65 || kṛcchracāṃdrāyaṇaiścaiva kṣapayaṃti svakaṃ vapuḥ || truṭimātrāśanāste tu truṭikāḥ sādhakā matāḥ || 66 || kṛtvā kuśamayīṃ patnīṃ maṭhe ye gṛhamedhinaḥ || bhaikṣavṛttiratāḥ śuddhā maṭharāste tu sādhakāḥ || 67 || grāsamātrasamānābhirguṭikābhirathāṣṭabhiḥ || kandamūlaphalotthābhirguṭikāste dvijātayaḥ || 68 || svadehadaṇḍanairyuktā rātrau vīrāsane sthitāḥ || daṃḍinaste samākhyātāḥ sarvametattavoditam || 69 || sāmānyo'pi viśeṣaśca vṛttino gṛhiṇo'pi vā || teṣāṃ bhedo mayā khyātāḥ samyakkṣetranivāsinām || 7.1.106.70 || evamādidharmayuktāḥ prabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ || taiḥ pūjyo bhagavāndevo bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ || 71 || mahāpātakino ye tu ye tu viprairbahiṣkṛtāḥ || na ca te saṃspṛśeyurvai brahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam ||| 72 || brahmacārī sadā dāṃto jitakrodho jiteṃdriyaḥ || evaṃ te brāhmaṇāḥ khyātāḥ kṣetramadhyanivāsinaḥ || 73 || taiḥ pūjyo bhagavāndevo bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ || ye vedādhyayane yuktāstaiḥ prapūjyaḥ pitāmahaḥ || || 74 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye madhyayātrāyāṃ brāhmaṇapraśaṃsā varṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 106 || || cha ||
<7.1.107>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha pūjāvidhānaṃ te kathayāmi samāsataḥ || bhaktibhedānpṛthaktasya brahmaṇo bālarūpiṇaḥ || 1 || rathayātrāvidhānaṃ tu stotramaṃtravidhikramam || vividhā bhaktiruddiṣṭā manovākkāyasaṃbhavā || || 2 || laukikī vaidikī cāpi bhavedādhyātmikī tathā || dhyānadhāraṇayā yā tu vedānāṃ smaraṇena ca || brahmaprītikarī caiṣā mānasī bhaktirucyate || 3 || maṃtravedanamaskārairagniśrāddhavidhānakaiḥ || jāpyaiścāraṇyakaiścaiva vācikī bhaktirucyate || 4 || vratopavāsaniyamaiściteṃdriyanirodhibhiḥ || kṛcchra sāṃtapanaiścānyaistathā cāṃdrāyaṇādibhiḥ || 5 || brahmoktaiścopavāsaiśca tathānyaiśca śubhavrataiḥ || kāyikī bhaktirākhyātā trividhā tu dvijanmanām || 6 || goghṛtakṣīradadhibhirmadhvikṣusukuśodakaiḥ || gaṃdhamālyaiśca vividhairvastubhiścopapādibhiḥ || 7 || ghṛtagugguladhūpaiśca kṛṣṇāgurusugaṃdhibhiḥ || bhūṣaṇai haimaratnādyaiścitrābhiḥ sragbhireva ca || 8 || nyāsaiḥ parisaraiḥ stotraiḥ patākābhistathotsavaiḥ || nṛtyavāditragītaiśca sarvavastūpahārakaiḥ || 9 || bhakṣyabhojyānna pānaiśca yā pūjā kriyate naraiḥ || pitāmahaṃ samuddiśya sā bhaktirlaukikī matā || 7.1.107.10 || vedamaṃtrahavirbhāgaiḥ kriyā yā vaidikī smṛtā || 11 || darśe ca paurṇamāsyāṃ ca karttavyaṃ cāgnihotrajam || prāśanaṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ puroḍāśa iti kriyā || 12 || iṣṭirdhṛtiḥ somapānaṃ yājñiyaṃ karma sarvaśaḥ || ṛgyajuḥ sāmajāpyāni saṃhitādhyayanāni ca || kriyate brahmāṇamuddiśya sā bhaktirvedikocyate || 13 || prāṇāyāmaparo nityaṃ dhyānavānvijiteṃdriyaḥ || bhaikṣyabhakṣī vratī cāpi sarvapratyāhṛteṃdriyaḥ || 14 || dhāraṇaṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā dhyāyamānaḥ prajeśvaram || hṛtpadmakarṇikāsīnaṃ raktavarṇaṃ sulocanam ||15|| paśyannuddyotitamukhaṃ brahmāṇaṃ sukaṭītaṭam|| raktavarṇaṃ caturbāhuṃ varadābhayahastakam|| evaṃ yaściṃtayeddevaṃ brahmabhaktaḥ sa ucyate || 16 || vidhiṃ ca śṛṇu me devi yaḥ smṛtaḥ kṣetravāsinām || 17 || nirmamā nirahaṃkārā niḥsaṃgā niṣparigrahāḥ|| caturvargepi niḥsnehāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ ||18|| bhūtānāṃ karmabhirnityaṃ trividhairabhayapradāḥ || prāṇāyāmaparā nityaṃ paradhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || 19 || jāpinaḥ śucayo nityaṃ yatidharmakriyāparāḥ || sāṃkhyayogavidhijñā ye dharmavicchinnasaṃśayāḥ || 7.1.107.20 || brahmapūjāratā nityaṃ te viprāḥ kṣetravāsinaḥ || tairyathā pūjanīyo vai bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ || 21 || tathāhaṃ kīrttayiṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || snātvā tu vimale tīrthe śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuciḥ|| pūjopahārasaṃyuktastato brahmāṇamarcayet || 22 || pūrvaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā paṃcāmṛtarasodakaiḥ || gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpiḥ kuśodakam || 23 || gāyatryā gṛhya gomūtraṃ gaṃdhadvāreti gomayam || āpyāyasveti ca kṣīraṃ dadhikrāvṇeti vai dadhi || 24 || tejo'si śukramityājyaṃ devasya tvā kuśodakam || āpohiṣṭheti maṃtreṇa paṃcagavyena snāpayet || 25 || kapilāpaṃcagavyena kuśavāriyutena ca || snāpayenmaṃtrapūtena brahmasnānaṃ hi tatsmṛtam || 26 || varṣakoṭisahasraistu yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam || surajyeṣṭhaṃ tu saṃsnāpya dahetsarvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 27 || evaṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā brahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam || karpūrāgarutoyena tataḥ saṃsnāpayeddvijaḥ || 28 || evaṃ kṛtvārccayeddevaṃ gāyatrīnyāsayogataḥ || mūrdhnaḥ pādatalaṃ yāvatpraṇavaṃ vinyasedbudhaḥ || 29 || takāraṃ vinyasenmūrdhni sakāraṃ mukhamaṇḍale || vikāraṃ kaṃṭhadeśe tu tukāraṃ cāṃgasaṃdhiṣu || 7.1.107.30 || vakāraṃ hṛdi madhye tu rekāraṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ || ṇikāraṃ dakṣiṇe kukṣau yakāraṃ vāmasaṃjñite || 31 || bhakāraṃ kaṭinābhisthaṃ gokāraṃ pārśvayordvayoḥ || dekāraṃ jānunornyasya vakāraṃ pādapadmayoḥ || 32 || syakāramaṃguṣṭhayornyasya dhīkāramurasi nyaset || makāraṃ jānumūle tu hi kāraṃ guhyamāśritam || 33 || dhikāraṃ hṛdaye nyasya yokāraṃ cādharoṣṭhake || yokāraṃ ca tathaivānyamuttaroṣṭhe nyasetsudhīḥ || 34 || nakāraṃ nāsikāgre tu prakāraṃ netramāśritam || cokāraṃ ca bhruvormadhye dakāraṃ prāṇamāśritam || 35 || yātkāraṃ ca lalāṭāṃte vinyasedvai sureśvari || nyāsaṃ kṛtvā''tmano dehe deve kuryāttathā priye || 36 || sarvopahārasaṃpannaṃ kṛtvā samyaṅnirīkṣayet || kuṃkumāgarukarpūracaṃdanena vimiśritam || 37 || gaṃdhatoyairupaskṛtya gāyatryā praṇavena ca || prokṣayetsarvadravyāṇi paścādarcanamārabhet || 38 || divyai puṣpaiḥ sugaṃdhaiśca mālatīkamalādibhiḥ || aśokaiḥ śatapatraiśca bakulaiḥ pūjayetkramāt || 39 || kṛṣṇāgarusudhūpena ghṛtadīpaistathottamaiḥ || tataḥ pradāpayettatra naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ kramāt || 7.1.107.40 || khaṇḍalaḍḍukaśrīveṣṭakāṃsārāśokapallavaiḥ || svastikollipikādugdhā tilaveṣṭakilāṭikām || 41 || phalāni caiva pakvāni mūlamaṃtreṇa dāpayet || ṛgvedaṃ ca yajurvedaṃ sāmavedaṃ ca pūjayet || 42 || jñānaṃ vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ dharmaṃ saṃpūjayedbudhaḥ || īśānādikramāddevi diśāsu vidiśāsu ca || 43 || caturddaśavidyāsthānāni brahmaṇo'gre prapūjayet || hṛdayāni tato nyasya devasya purataḥ kramāt || 44 || āpohiṣṭheti ṛgiyaṃ hṛdayaṃ parikīrttitam || ṛtaṃ satyaṃ śikhā proktā udutyaṃ netramādiśet || 45 || citraṃ devānāmityevaṃ sarvalokeṣu viśrutam || brahmaṃste chādayāmīti kavacaṃ samudāhṛtam || 46 || bhūrbhuvaḥ svaritīreśa pūjanaṃ parikīrtitam || gāyatryā pūjayeddevamoṃkāreṇābhimaṃtritam|| 47|| praṇavenāparānsarvānṛgvedādīnprapūjayet || gāyatrī paramo maṃtro vedamātā vibhāvarī || 48 || gāyatryakṣaratattvaistu brahmāṇaṃ yastu pūjayet || upoṣya paṃcadaśyāṃ tu sa yāti paramaṃ padam || 49 || saṃsārasāgaraṃ ghoramuttitīrṣurdvijo yadi || prabhāse kārttike māsi brahmāṇaṃ pūjayetsadā || 7.1.107.50 || yasya darśanamātreṇa aśvamedha phalaṃ labhet || kastaṃ na pūjayedvidvānprabhāse bālarūpiṇam || 51 || yasyaikadivasaprāṃte sadevāsuramānavāḥ || vilayaṃ yāṃti deveśi kastaṃ na pratipūjayet || 52 || pitā yaḥ sarvadevānāṃ bhūtānāṃ ca pitāmahaḥ || yasmādeṣa sa taiḥ pūjyo brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣetravāsibhiḥ || 53 || rudrarūpī viśvarūpī sa eva bhuvaneśvaraḥ || paurṇamāsyāmupoṣitvā brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ patim || arcayedyo vidhānena so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 54 || kārttike māsi devasya rathayātrā prakīrttitā || yāṃ kṛtvā mānavo bhaktyā yāti brahmasalokatām || 55 || kārttike māsi deveśi paurṇamāsyāṃ caturmukham || mārgeṇa carmaṇā sārddhaṃ sāvitryā ca paraṃtapaḥ || 56 || bhrāmayennagaraṃ sarvaṃ nānāvādyaiḥ samanvitam || sthāpayedbhrāmayitvā tu sakalaṃ nagaraṃ nṛpaḥ || 57 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvāgre śāṃḍileyaṃ prapūjya ca || āropayedrathe devaṃ puṇyavāditraniḥsvanaiḥ || 58 || rathāgre śāṃḍilīputraṃ pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || brāhmaṇānvācayitvā ca kṛtvā puṇyāhamaṃgalam || 59 || devamāropayitvā tu rathe kuryātprajāgaram || nānāvidhaiḥ prekṣaṇakairbrahmaśeṣaiśca puṣkalaiḥ || 7.1.107.60 || nāroḍhavyaṃ rathe devi śūdreṇa śubhamicchatā || nādharmeṇa viśeṣeṇa muktvaikaṃ bhojakaṃ priye || 61 || brahmaṇo dakṣiṇe pārśve sāvitrīṃ sthāpayetpriye || bhojakaṃ vāmapārśve tu purataḥ paṃkajaṃ nyaset || 62 || evaṃ tūryaninādaiśca śaṃkhaśabdaiśca puṣkalaiḥ || bhrāmayitvā rathaṃ devi puraṃ sarvaṃ ca dakṣiṇam || svasthāne sthāpayedbhūyaḥ kṛtvā nīrājanaṃ budhaḥ || 63 || ya evaṃ kurute yātrāṃ bhaktyā yaścāpi paśyati || rathaṃ vā''karṣayedyastu sa gacchedbrahmaṇaḥ padam || 64 || yo dīpaṃ dhārayettatra brahmaṇo rathapṛṣṭhagaḥ || padepade'śvamedhasya sa phalaṃ viṃdate mahat || 65 || yo na kārayate rājā rathayātrāṃ tu brahmaṇaḥ || sa pacyate mahādevi raurave kālamakṣayam || 66 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena rāṣṭrasya kṣemamicchatā || rathayātrāṃ viśeṣeṇa svayaṃ rājā pravarttayet || 67 || pratipadbrāhmaṇāṃścāpi bhojayedvi dhivatsudhīḥ || vāsobhirahataiścāpi gandhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 68 || kārttike māsyamāvāsyāṃ yastu dīpapradīpanam || śālāyāṃ brahmaṇaḥ kuryātsa gacchetparamaṃ padam || 69 || utsaveṣu ca sarveṣu sarvakāle viśeṣataḥ || pūjayeyurimaṃ viprā brahmāṇaṃ jagatāṃ gurum || 7.1.107.70|| yathākṛtyaprayogeṇa samyakchraddhā samanvitāḥ || pūjyo divyopacāreṇa yathāvittānusārataḥ || 71 || evaṃ te kathitaṃ devi pūjāmāhātmyamuttamam || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyaṃ brahmaṇaḥ bālarūpiṇaḥ || 72 || tasyāhaṃ kathayiṣyāmi nāmnāmaṣṭottaraṃ śatam || pradattvā ca paṭhitvā ca yajñāyutaphalaṃ labhet || 73 || gāyatryā lakṣajāpyena samyagjaptena yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti stotrasyāsya udīraṇāt || 74 || idaṃ stotravaraṃ divyaṃ rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || na deyaṃ duṣṭabuddhīnāṃ nindakānāṃ tathaiva ca || 75 || brāhmaṇāya pradātavyaṃ śrotriyāya mahātmane || viṣṇunā hi purā pṛṣṭaṃ brahmaṇaḥ stotramuttmam || 76 || keṣukeṣu ca sthāneṣu devadeva pitāmaha || saṃcintyastanmamācakṣva tvaṃ hi sarvaviduttama || 77 || || brahmovāca || || puṣkare'haṃ suraśreṣṭho gayāyāṃ prapitāmahaḥ|| kānyakubje vedagarbho bhṛgukṣetre caturmukhaḥ || 78 || kauberyāṃ sṛṣṭikartā ca nandipuryāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || prabhāse bālarūpī ca vārāṇasyāṃ surapriyaḥ ||79|| dvārāvatyāṃ cakradevo vaidiśe bhuvanādhipaḥ || pauṃḍrake puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ pītākṣo hastināpure || 7.1.107.80 || jayaṃtyāṃ vijayaścāsau jayantaḥ puruṣottame || vāḍeṣu padmahasto'haṃ tamolipte tamonudaḥ || 81 || āhicchatryāṃ janānaṃdaḥ kāñcīpuryāṃ janapriyaḥ || karṇāṭasya pure brahmā ṛṣikuṇḍe munistathā || 82 || śrīkaṇṭhe śrīnivāsaśca kāmarūpe śubhaṃkaraḥ || ucchriyāṇe devakarttā sraṣṭā jālaṃdhare tathā || 83 || mallikākhye tathā viṣṇurmahendre bhārgavastathā || gonardaḥ sthavirākāre hyujjayinyāṃ pitāmahaḥ || 84 || kauśāṃbyāṃ tu mahādevo hyayodhyāyāṃ tu rāghavaḥ || viraṃciścitrakūṭe tu vārāho vindhyaparvate || 85 || gaṃgādvāre suraśreṣṭho himavante tu śaṃkaraḥ || dehikāyāṃ srucāhastaḥ padmahastastathā'rbude ||86 || vṛndāvane padmanetraḥ kuśa hastaśca naimiṣe || gopakṣetre ca govindaḥ surendro yamunātaṭe || 87 || bhāgīrathyāṃ padmatanurjanānando janasthale || kauṃkaṇe ca sa madhvakṣaḥ kāmpilye kanakaprabhaḥ || 88 || kheṭake cānnadātā ca śaṃbhuścaiva kratusthale || laṃkāyāṃ caiva paulastyaḥ kāśmīre haṃsavāhanaḥ || 89 || vasiṣṭhaścārbude caiva nāradaścotpalāvane || medhake śrutidātā ca prayāge yajuṣāṃ patiḥ || 7.1.107.90 || śivaliṃge sāmavedo markaṭe ca madhupriyaḥ || nārāyaṇaśca gomante vidarbhāyāṃ dvija priyaḥ || 91 || aṃkulake brahmagarbho brahmavāhe sutapriyaḥ || indraprasthe durādharṣaścaṃpāyāṃ suramardanaḥ || 92 || virajāyāṃ mahārūpaḥ surūpo rāṣṭravardhane || kadaṃbake janādhyakṣo devādhyakṣaḥ samasthale || 93 || gaṃgādharo rudrapīṭhe supīṭhe jaladaḥ smṛtaḥ || tryaṃbake tripurāriśca śrīśaile ca trilocanaḥ || 94 || mahādevaḥ plakṣapure kapāle vedhanāśanaḥ || śṛṅgaverapure śaurirnimiṣe cakradhārakaḥ || 95 || nandipuryāṃ virūpākṣo gautamaḥ plakṣapādape || mālyavānhastināthe tu dvijendro vācike tathā || 96 || indrapuryāṃ divānātho bhūtikāyāṃ puraṃdaraḥ || haṃsabāhuśca candrāyāṃ caṃpāyāṃ garuḍapriyaḥ || 97 || mahodaye mahāyakṣaḥ suyajñaḥ pūtake vane || siddheśvare śuklavarṇo vibhāyāṃ padmabodhakaḥ || 98 || devadāruvane liṃgī udaketha umāpatiḥ || vināyako mātṛsthāne alakāyāṃ dhanādhipaḥ || 99 || trikūṭe caiva goviṃdaḥ pātāle vāsukistathā || kovidāre yugādhyakṣaḥ strīrājye ca surapriyaḥ || 7.1.107.100 || pūrṇagiryāṃ subhogaśca śālmalyāṃ takṣakastathā || amare pāpahā caiva aṃbikāyāṃ sudarśanaḥ || 101 || naravāpyāṃ mahāvīraḥ kāntāre durganāśanaḥ || padmavatyāṃ padmagṛho gagane mṛgalāñchanaḥ || 102 || aṣṭottaraṃ nāmaśataṃ yatraitatparipaṭhyate || tatraiva mama sāṃnidhyaṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ madhusūdana || 103 || teṣāmapi yastvekaṃ paśyedvai bālarūpiṇam || sarveṣāṃ labhate puṇyaṃ pūrvoktānāṃ ca vedhasām ||104|| etairyo nāmabhiḥ kṛṣṇa prabhāse stauti māṃ sadā || sthānaṃ me vijayaṃ labdhvā modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 105 || mānasaṃ vācikaṃ caiva kāyikaṃ caiva duṣkṛtam || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti mama stotrā'nu kīrtanāt || 106 || puṣpopahaurardhūpaiśca brāhmaṇānāṃ ca tarpaṇaiḥ || dhyānena ca sthireṇāśu prāpyate yatphalaṃ naraiḥ || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti mama stotrānu kīrtanāt || 107 || brahmahatyādipāpāni iha loke kṛtānyapi || akāmataḥ kāmato vā tāni naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 108 || idaṃ stotraṃ mamābhīṣṭaṃ śṛṇuyādvā paṭhecca vā || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpnuyānmahadīpsitam || 109 || anyadrahasyaṃ te vacmi śṛṇu kṛṣṇa yathārthataḥ || 7.1.107.110 || āgneyaṃ tu yadā ṛkṣaṃ kārtikyāṃ bhavati kvacit || mahatī sā tithirjñeyā prabhāse mama vallabhā || 111 || prājāpatyaṃ yadā ṛkṣaṃ tithau tasyāṃ bhavedyadi || sā mahākārtikī puṇyā devānāmapi durlabhā || 112 || maṃde vārke gurau vā'pi kārtikī kṛttikāyutā || tatrāśvamedhikaṃ puṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā vai bālarūpiṇam || || 113 || viśākhāsu yadā sūryaḥ kṛttikāsu ca candramāḥ || sa yogaḥ padmako nāma prabhāse durlabho hare || 114 || tasminyoge naro dṛṣṭvā prabhāse bālarūpiṇam || pāpakoṭiyuto vā'pi yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 115 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ stotraṃ brahmaṇā haraye punaḥ || mayā tava samākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ brahmadaivatam ||116 || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || bhūmidānaṃ ca dātavyaṃ tatra yātrāphalepsubhiḥ || || 117 || kamaṃḍaluḥ śvetavastraṃ mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || tatraiva devi deyāni brahmaṇe bālarūpiṇe ||118|| mahāparvaṇi saṃprāpte kuryuḥ pārāyaṇaṃ dvijāḥ || sarve te brāhmaṇā devi kṣetramadhyanivāsinaḥ || 119 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye bālarūpibrahmaṇo māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 107 || || ||
<7.1.108>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vasūnāṃ liṃgamuttamam || someśādīśadigbhāge pañcāśaddhanuṣāntare || 1 || sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevi caturvaktraṃ surapriyam || pratyūṣeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || || 2 || darśanāttasya devasya saptajanmāntarodbhavam|| pāpaṃ praṇāśamāyāti satyaṃsatyaṃ varānane || 3 || || devyuvāca || || ko'sau pratyūṣanāmeti kathaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam|| kasya putraḥ sa vikhyāta etanme vada śaṃkara || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || dakṣo brahmasuto devi prajāpatiriti smṛtaḥ || tasya kanyāḥ purā ṣaṣṭirdadau dharmāya vai daśa || 5 || tāsāṃ madhye mahādevi ekā viśveti viśrutā || sā dharmācca mahādevi aṣṭāvajanayatsutān || 6 || āpo dhruvaśca somaśca dharaścaivā'nalo'nilaḥ || pratyūṣaśca prabhāsaśca vasavo'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥ || 7 || teṣāṃ madhye saptamo'sau pratyūṣa iti viśrutaḥ || sa putrakāmo deveśi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || 8 || sa jñātvā kāmikaṃ kṣetraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || tapaścacāra vipulaṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ priye || dhyāyandevaṃ mahādevaṃ śāntastadgatamānasaḥ || 9 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasya bhaktyā nirañjanaḥ || dadau tasya sutaṃ devi devalaṃ yogināṃ varam || 7.1.108.10 || tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi talliṃgasya prabhāvataḥ || devalo bhagavānyogī pratyūṣasyā'bhavatsutaḥ || 11 || anena kāraṇenāsau pratyūṣeśvarasaṃjñitaḥ || 12 || yaścānapatyaḥ puruṣastaṃ samārādhayiṣyati || tasyānvavāye deveśi saṃtatirna vinaśyati || 13 || yaḥ pratyūṣe mahādevi pratyūṣeśvaramuttamam || pūjayiṣyati sadbhaktyā satataṃ niyatātmavān || tasyaiṣyati kṣayaṃ pāpamapi brahmavadhodbhavama || 14 || vṛṣastatraiva dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 15 || māghe kṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ jāgṛyāttatra vai niśi || sarveṣāṃ dānayajñānāṃ phalaṃ jāgaraṇāllabhet || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsasakṣetramāhātmye pratyūṣeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 108 || || cha ||
<7.1.109>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi anileśvaramuttamam|| tasyottareśānadiksthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ tritaye priye || 1 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi darśanātpāpanāśanam || vasūnāṃ pañcamo yo'sāvanilaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || 2 || sa cā''rādhya mahādevaṃ pratyakṣīkṛtavānbhavam || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 3 || evamīśaprabhāvena sutastasyā'pyabhūdbalī || manojaveti vikhyāto hyavijñātagatistathā || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vyādhinā martyo pīḍyate na kadācana || nāndho na badhiro mūko na rogī na ca nirdhanaḥ || kadācijjāyate martyastena dṛṣṭena bhūtale || 5 || puṣpamekaṃ tu yo dadyāttasya liṃgasya copari || sukhasaubhāgyasaṃpannaḥ sa sadā rūpavānbhavet || 6 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam|| śrutvā'numodya bhāvena sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhyate || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye 'nileśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navottaraśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ ||109|| ||||||
<7.1.110>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchedvarārohe prabhāseśvaramuttamam || gaurītapovanāddevi paścime samudāhṛtam ||1|| dhanuṣāṃ saptake devi nātidūre vyavasthitam || sthāpitaṃ tanmahāliṃgaṃ vasūnāmaṣṭamena hi || 2 || prabhāsa iti nāmnā hi śivapūjāratena vai || sa putrakāmo deveśi prabhāsakṣetramāgataḥ ||3|| pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṅgaṃ cacāra vipulaṃ tapaḥ || āgneyamiti vikhyātaṃ divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye || 4 || tatastasya mahādevi samyakchraddhānvi tasya vai || tutoṣa bhagavānrudro dadau yanmanasīpsitam ||5|| bṛhaspatestu bhaginī bhuvanā brahmavādinī || prabhāsasya tu sā bhāryā vasūnāmaṣṭamasya ca || ||6|| viśvakarmā sutastasyāḥ sṛṣṭikartā prajāpatiḥ|| devānāṃ takṣako vidvānmanormātāmahaḥ smṛtaḥ ||7|| takṣakaḥ sūryabiṃbasya tejasaḥ śātano mahān|| evaṃ tasyā'bhavatputro vasūnāmaṣṭamasya vai || 8 || prabhāsanāmno deveśi talliṃgārādhanodyataḥ || iti te kathitaṃ devi prabhāseśvarasūcakam || 9 || māhātmyaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ śubham || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 7.1.110.10 || bhūmiśāyī nirāhāro japanvai śatarudriyam || māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ snātvā sāgarasaṃgame || 11 || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || 12 || ya evaṃ kurute devi samyagyātrāmahotsavam || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhyate || vṛṣastatraiva dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 13 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāseśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 110 || || cha |
<7.1.111>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi puṣkarāraṇyamuttamam || tasmādīśānakoṇasthaṃ dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhiḥ sthitam || 1 || tatra kuṇḍaṃ mahādevi hyaṣṭapuṣkarasaṃjñitam || sarva pāpaharaṃ devi duṣprāpyamakṛtātmabhiḥ || 2 || tatra kuṇḍasamīpe tu purā rāmeśadhīmatā || sthāpitaṃ tanmahāliṅgaṃ rāmeśvara iti smṛtam || 3 || tasya pūjanamātreṇa mucyate brahmahatyayā || 4 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || bhagavanvistarādbrūhi rāmeśvarasamudbhavam || kathaṃ tatrāgamadrāmaḥ sasītaśca salakṣmaṇaḥ || 5 || kathaṃ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṅgaṃ puṣkare pāpataskare || etadvistarato brūhi phalaṃ māhātmyasaṃyutam || 6 || || īśvara uvāca || || caturviṃśayuge rāmo vasiṣṭhena purodhasā || purā rāvaṇanāśārthaṃ jajñe daśarathātmajaḥ || 7 || tataḥ kālāntare devi ṛṣiśāpānmahātapāḥ || yayau dāśarathī rāmaḥ sasītaḥ sahalakṣmaṇaḥ || 8 || vanavāsāya niṣkrāṃto divyairbrahmarṣibhirvṛtaḥ || tato yātrāprasaṃgena prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || 9 || taṃ deśaṃ tu samāsādya suśrāṃto niṣasāda ha || astaṃ gate tataḥ sūrye parṇānyāstīrya bhūtale || 7.1.111.10 || suṣvāpātha niśāśeṣe dadṛśe pitaraṃ svakam || svapne daśarathaṃ devi saumyarūpaṃ mahāprabham || 11 || prātarutthāya tatsarvaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo nyavedayat || yathā daśarathaḥ svapne dṛṣṭastena mahātmanā || 12 || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || vṛddhikāmāśca pitaro varadāstava rāghava || darśanaṃ hi prayacchaṃti svapnānte hi svavaṃśaje || 13 || etattīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ suguptaṃ śārṅgadhanvanaḥ || puṣkareti samākhyātaṃ śrāddhamatra pradīyatām || 14 || nūnaṃ daśaratho rājā tīrthe cāsminsamīhate || tvayā dattaṃ śubhaṃ piṇḍaṃ tataḥ sa darśanaṃ gataḥ || 15 || || īśvara uvāca || || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rāmo rājīvalocanaḥ || nimaṃtrayāmāsa tadā śrāddhārhānbrāhmaṇāñchubhān || 16 || abravīllakṣmaṇaṃ pārśve sthitaṃ vinatakaṃdharam || phalārthaṃ vraja saumitre śrāddhārthaṃ tvarayā'nvitaḥ || 17 || sa tatheti pratijñāya jagāma raghunaṃdanaḥ || ānayāmāsa śīghraṃ sa phalāni vividhāni ca || 18 || bilvāni ca kapitthāni tindukāni ca bhūriśaḥ || badarāṇi karīrāṇi karamardāni ca priye || 19 || cirbhaṭāni parūṣāṇi mātuliṃgāni vai tathā || nālikerāṇi śubhrāṇi iṃgudīsaṃbhavāni ca || 7.1.111.20 || athaitāni papācāśu sītā janakanaṃdinī || tatastu kutape kāle snātvā
