valkalabhṛcchuciḥ || 21 || brāhmaṇānānayāmāsa śrāddhārhāndvijasattamān || gālavo devalo raibhyo yavakrīto'tha parvataḥ || 22 || bharadvājo vasiṣṭhaśca jāvālirgautamo bhṛguḥ || ete cānye ca bahavo brāhmaṇā vedapāragāḥ || 23 || śrāddhārthaṃ tasya saṃprāptā rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ || etasminneva kāle tu rāmaḥ sītāmabhāṣata || 24 || ehi vaidehi viprāṇāṃ dehi pādāvanejanam || etacchrutvā'tha sā sītā praviṣṭā vṛkṣamadhyataḥ || 25 || gulmairācchādya cātmānaṃ rāmasyādarśane sthitā || muhurmuhuryadā rāmaḥ sītāsītāmabhāṣata || 26 || jñātvā tāṃ lakṣmaṇo naṣṭāṃ kopāviṣṭaṃ ca rāghavam || svayameva tadā cakre brāhmaṇārha pratikriyām || || 27 || atha bhukteṣu vipreṣu kṛta piṃḍapradānake || āgatā jānakī sītā yatra rāmo vyavasthitaḥ || 28 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paruṣairvākyairbhartsayāmāsa rāghavaḥ || dhigdhikpāpe dvijāṃstyaktvā pitṛkṛtyamahodayam || kva gatā'si ca māṃ hitvā śrāddhakāle hyupasthite || 29 || || īśvara uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhayabhītā ca jānakī || 7.1.111.30 || kṛtāñjalipuṭā bhūtvā vepamānā hyabhāṣata || mā kopaṃ kuru kalyāṇa mā māṃ nirbhartsaya prabho || 31 || śṛṇu yasmādvibho'nyatra gatā tyaktvā tavāntikam || dṛṣṭastatra pitā me'dya tathā caiva pitāmahaḥ || 32 || tasya pūrvataraścāpi tathā mātāmahādayaḥ || aṃgeṣu brāhmaṇendrāṇāmākrāntāste pṛthakpṛthak || 33 || tato lajjā samabhavattatra me raghunandana || pitrā tatra mahābāho manojñāni śubhāni ca || 34 || bhakṣyāṇi bhakṣitānyeva yāni vai guṇavanti ca || sa kathaṃ sukaṣāyāṇi kṣārāṇi kaṭukāni ca || bhakṣayiṣyati rājendra tato me duḥkhamāviśat|| 36 || etasmātkāraṇānnaṣṭā lajjayā'haṃ raghūdvaha || dṛṣṭvā śvaśuravargaṃ svaṃ tasmātkopaṃ parityaja || 36 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismito rāghavo'bhavat || viśeṣeṇa dadau tasmiñchrāddhaṃ tīrthe tu puṣkare || 37 || tatra puṣkarasānnidhye dakṣiṇe dhanuṣāṃ traye || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa rāmeśvaramiti śrutam || 35 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || sa prāpnoti paraṃ sthānaṃ yratra devo janārdanaḥ || 39 || kimatra bahunoktena dvādaśyāṃ yatpradāpayet || na tatra parisaṃkhyānaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vidyate || 7.1.111.40 || śukrāṃgārakasaṃyuktā caturthī yā bhavetkvacit || ṣaṣṭhī vātra varārohe tatra śrāddhe mahatphalam || 41 || yāvaddvādaśavarṣāṇi pitaraśca pitāmahāḥ || tarpitā nānyamicchanti puṣkare svakulodbhave || 42 || tatra yo vājinaṃ dadyātsamyagbhaktisamanvitaḥ || aśvamedhasya yajñasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 43 || iti te kathitaṃ samyaṅmāhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || rāmeśvarasya devasya puṣkarasya ca bhāmini || 44 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkaramāhātmye rāmeśvarakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 111 || ||
<7.1.112>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi lakṣmaṇeśvaramuttamam || rāmeśātpūrvadigbhāge dhanustriṃśakasaṃsthitam || 1 || sthāpitaṃ lakṣmaṇenaiva tatra yātrāgatena vai || mahāpāpaharaṃ devi talliṃgaṃ surapūjitam || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā nṛtyagītādivādanaiḥ || homajāpyaiḥ samādhisthaḥ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 3 || annodakaṃ hiraṇyaṃ ca tatra deyaṃ dvijātaye || saṃpūjya devadeveśaṃ gaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || || 4 || māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ viśeṣastatra pūjane || snānaṃ dānaṃ japastatra bhavedakṣayakārakam || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāmeśvarakṣetramāhātmye lakṣmaṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśottaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 112 ||
<7.1.113>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi jānakīśvaramuttamam || rāmeśānnaiṛte bhāge dhanustriṃśakasaṃsthitam || 1 || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ jānakyā''rādhitaṃ purā || pratiṣṭhitaṃ viśeṣeṇa samyagārādhyaśaṃkaram || 2 || pūrvaṃ tasyaiva liṃgasya vasiṣṭheśeti nāma vai || tatpaścājjānakīśeti tretāyāṃ prathitaṃ kṣitau || 3 || tataḥ ṣaṣṭisahasrāṇi vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ || tatra siddhimanuprāptāstena siddheśvareti ca || || 4 || khyātaṃ kalau mahādevi yugaliṃgaṃ mahāprabham|| taddṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpairduḥkhadaurbhāgyasaṃbhavaiḥ || 5 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā || saṃsnāpya vidhivadbhaktyā sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 6 || snātvā ca puṣkare tīrthe yastalligaṃ prapūjayet || niyato niyatāhāro māsamekaṃ nirantaram|| 7 || dinedine bhavettasya vājimedhādhikaṃ phalam || māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ yā nārī taṃ prapūjayet || tadanvaye'pi daurbhāgyaṃ duḥkhaṃ śokaśca no bhavet || 8 || iti te kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || śrutaṃ harati pāpāni saubhāgyaṃ saṃprayacchati || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jānakīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 113 || || cha ||
<7.1.114>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi viṣṇuṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || vāmanasvāmināmānaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || puṣkarānnairṛte bhāge dhanurviśatibhiḥ smṛtam || yadā baddho balirdevi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 2 || tadā tatra padaṃ nyastaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ viśvarūpiṇā || dvitīyaṃ meruśṛṃge tu tṛtīyaṃ gagane priye || 3 || yāvadūrdhvaṃ cotkṣipati tāvadbhinnaṃ sudūrataḥ || pādāgreṇa tu brahmāṇḍaṃ niṣkrāntaṃ salilaṃ tataḥ || 4 || tataḥ svajānumātreṇa saṃprāptaṃ pṛthivītale || tato viṣṇupadī gaṃgā prasiddhimagamatkṣitau || 5 || pūrvaṃ sā puṣkare prāptā puṣkarātsā mahānadī || puṣkaraṃ kathyate vyoma puṣkaraṃ kathyate jalam || tena tatpuṣkaraṃ khyātaṃ saṃnidhānaṃ prajāpateḥ || 6 || tatra snānaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā yaḥ paśyati hareḥ padam || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam || 7 || tatra piṃḍapradānena tṛptiḥ syātkoṭivārṣikī || pitṝṇāṃ ca varārohe hyetadāha hariḥ svayam || 8 || atra gāthā purā gītā vasiṣṭhena maharṣiṇā || vāmanasvāminaṃ dṛṣṭvā tāṃ śṛṇuṣva samāhitā || 9 || snātvā tu puṣkare tīrthe dṛṣṭvā viṣṇupadaṃ tataḥ || api kṛtvā mahatpāpaṃ kimataḥ paritapyate || 7.1.114.10 || yastatropānahau dadyādbrāhmaṇāya yatavrataḥ || sa yānavaramārūḍho viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye vāmanasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 114 || || cha ||
<7.1.115>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi puṣkareśvaramuttamam || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge jānakīśvaramuttamam || 1 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu brahmaputreṇa pūjitam || sanatkumāramuninā śraddhayā hema puṣkaraiḥ || 2 || pūjitaṃ tadvidhānena tena tatpuṣkareśvaram || khyātaṃ tatra varārohe sarvapātakanāśanam || 3 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gaṃṣapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || yātrā kṛtā bhavettena pauṣkarī nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vāmanasvāmimāhātmye puṣkareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 115 || || cha ||
<7.1.116>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ saubhāgyakāriṇīm || kuṇḍeśvarīti vikhyātāṃ puṣkarādvāyugocare || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ triṃśatā devi bhūtanāthācca nairṛte || saṃsthitā pāpadamanī dāridryaughavināśinī || 2 || tasyā nairṛtadigbhāge dhanuḥpañcadaśe sthitam || śaṃkhodakaṃnāma kuṇḍaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 3 || tatra snātvā tu ye martyā nārī vā śubhavāriṇi || pūjayettāṃ mahādevi śaṃkhāvarteti viśrutām || 4 || kalau kuṇḍeśvarīnāma sarvasaukhyapradāyinī || śaṃkho nāma purā devi viṣṇunā nihataḥ priye || 5 || tasya dehaṃ samādāya mahāntaṃ śaṃkharūpiṇam || tīrthodakena saṃpūrya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || 6 || tatra śaṃkhaṃ tu prakṣālya kṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāprabham || tatra pūritavāñchaṅkhaṃ meghagambhīranisvanam ||7 || tasya nādena mahatā devī tatra samāgatā || pṛcchatī kāraṇaṃ tatra tatkuṇḍasya samīpagā || tena kuṇḍeśvarī khyātā kuṇḍaṃ śaṃkhodakaṃ smṛtam || 8 || māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ || nārī vā bhaktisaṃyuktā sa gaurīpadamāpnuyāt || 9 || daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ tatra deyaṃ yātrāphalepsubhiḥ || kañcukaṃ phaladānaṃ ca gauriṇīnāṃ ca bhojanam || 7.1.116.10 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkhodakakuṇḍeśvarīgaurīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 116 || ||
<7.1.117>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bhūtanātheśvaraṃ haram|| kuṇḍeśvaryā īśabhāge dhanuṣāṃ viṃśake'ntare || 1 || kalpaliṃgaṃ mahādevi hyanādinidhanaṃ sthitam || pūrvaṃ tretāyuge devi vīrabhadreśvarīti ca || 2 || prakhyātaṃ bhuvi deveśi kalau bhūteśvaraṃ smṛtam || purā dvāparasaṃdhau ca tatra bhūtāni koṭiśaḥ ||3|| saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ jagmustalliṃgasya prabhāvataḥ || tena bhūteśvaraṃ nāma prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale|| || 4 || tatra kṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ rātrau saṃpūjya śaṃkaram || dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritya aghoraṃ pūjayettu yaḥ || 5 || dṛḍhaṃ jitendriyo bhūtvā nirbhayo dhyānasaṃyu taḥ || tasyaiva jāyate siddhiryā kācidbhūtale sthitā || 6 || tilahemapradānaṃ ca piṇḍadānaṃ ca tatra vai || pitṝnuddiśya dadyādvai teṣāṃ pretatvamuktaye || || 7 || iti nigaditametadbhūtanātheśvarasya pracurakalimalānāṃ nāśanaṃ puṇyahetuḥ || paṭhati ca puruṣo vā yaḥ śṛṇotīha bhaktyā suravaramahimānaṃ mucyate pātakaughaiḥ || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuṃḍeśvarī māhātmye bhūtanātheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 117 || || cha ||
<7.1.118>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gopyādityamanuttamam || bhūteśādvāyave bhāge dhanuṣāṃ triṃśakentare || 1 || balātibaladaityaghnyā dakṣiṇāgneyasaṃsthitam || dhanuṣāṃ daśake devi saṃsthitaṃ pāpanāśanam || 2 || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi mahāpāpaharāṃ śubhām || yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā duḥkhaśokaiḥ pramucyate || 3 || purā kṛṣṇo mahātejā yadā prabhāsamāgataḥ || sahito yādavaiḥ sarvaiḥ ṣaṭpañcāśatikoṭibhiḥ || 4 || ṣoḍaśaiva sahasrāṇi gopyastatra samāgatāḥ || lakṣamekaṃ tathā ṣaṣṭirete kṛṣṇasutāḥ priye || 5 || tatra prābhāsike kṣetre saṃsthitāḥ pāpanāśane || yādavasthalamāsādya yāvadraivatako giri || 6 || tatra dvādaśavarṣāṇi saṃsthitāste mahābalāḥ || kṣetraṃ pavitramādāya śivaliṃgāni te pṛthak || sthāpayāñcakrire sarve hyaṃkitāni svanāmabhiḥ || 7 || evaṃ samagraṃ tatkṣetraṃ yāvaddvādaśayojanam || dhvajaliṃgāṃkitaṃ cakruḥ sarve yādavapuṃgavāḥ || 8 || hastahastāntare devi prāsādāḥ kṣetra madhyataḥ || suvarṇakalaśopetāḥ patākākulitāṃbarāḥ || virājaṃte tu tatrasthāḥ kīrtistaṃbhā hareriva || 9 || tato gopyo mahādevi ādyā yāḥ ṣoḍaśa smṛtāḥ || tāsāṃ nāmāni te vakṣye tāni hmekamanāḥ śṛṇu || 7.1.118.10 || laṃbinī candrikā kāntā krūrā śāntā mahodayā || bhīṣaṇī nandinī'śokā suparṇā vimalā'kṣayā || 11 || śubhadā śobhanā puṇyā haṃsasyaitāḥ kalāḥ smṛtāḥ || haṃsa eva mataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ paramātmā janārdanaḥ || 12 || tasyaitāḥ śaktayo devi ṣoḍaśaiva prakīrtitāḥ || candrarūpī tataḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kalārūpāstu tāḥ smṛtāḥ || 13 || saṃpūrṇamaṇḍalā tāsāṃ mālinī ṣoḍaśī kalā || pratipattithimārabhya vicaratyāsu candramāḥ || 14 || ṣoḍaśaiva kalā yāstā gopīrūpā varānane || ekaikaśastāḥ saṃbhinnāḥ sahasreṇa pṛthakpṛthak || 15 || evaṃ te kathitaṃ devi rahasyaṃ jñānasaṃbhavam || evaṃ yo veda puruṣaḥ sa jñeyo vaiṣṇavo budhaiḥ || 16 || atha tābhiḥ kṛtāñjñātvā prāsādānyādavaiḥ pṛthak || tato gopyo'pi tāḥ sarvāḥ sahasrāṇi tu ṣoḍaśa || kṛṣṇamājñāpya bhāvena sthāpayāṃcakrire ravim || 17 || ṛṣibhirnāradādyaistāstathā kṣetranivāsibhiḥ || taṃ pratiṣṭhāpayāmāsuḥ pratiṣṭhāvidhinā ravim || 18 || pratiṣṭhite tataḥ sūrye dadurdānāni bhūriśaḥ || tataḥ kṣetranivāsibhyo gobhūhemāṃbarāṇi ca || 19 || tatasta ṛṣayaḥ sarve saṃtuṣṭā hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || cakrurnāma ravestatra gopyādityeti viśrutam|| sarvapāpa haraṃ devaṃ mahāsaubhāgyadāyakam || 7.1.118.20 || evaṃ kṛte kṛtārthāstāḥ saṃprāpyātimahadyaśaḥ || jagmuryathāgataṃ sarvā dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutāḥ || 21 || punaḥ kālāntare devi śāpāddurvāsasaḥ priye || yādavasthalatāṃ prāptāḥ prabhāse pāpanāśane || 22 || evaṃ te kathito devi gopyādityasamudbhavaḥ || māhātmyaṃ tasya te vacmi pūjāvandanajaṃ kramāt || 23 || asminmitravane devi yo gopībhiḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || tasya darśanamātreṇa duḥkhaśokaiḥ pramucyate || 24 || sutapteneha tapasā yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ || tāṃ gatiṃ te narā yānti ye gopīravimāśritāḥ || 25 || yena sarvātmanā bhāvo gopyāditye niveśitaḥ || maheśvari kṛtārthatvātsa ślāghyo dhanya eva saḥ || 26 || api naḥ sa kule dhanyo jāyate kulapāvanaḥ || bhāgyavānbhaktibhāvena yena bhānurupāsitaḥ || 27 || saptamyāṃ pūjayedyastu māghe māsyuṣasi priye || saptāvarānsapta pūrvānpitṝnsopyuddharennaraḥ || 28 || chinatti rogānduśceṣṭāndurjayāñjayati hyarīn || 29 || na saptamyāṃ spṛśettailaṃ nīlavastraṃ na dhārayet || na cāpyāmalakaiḥ snānaṃ na kuryātkalahaṃ kvacit || 7.1.118.30 || nīlaraktena vastreṇa yatkarma kurute dvijaḥ || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam || vṛthā tasya mahāyajñā nīlasūtrasya dhāraṇāt || 31 || nīlīraktaṃ yadā vastraṃ viprastvaṃgeṣu dhārayet || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati || 32 || romakūpe yadā gacchedrasaṃ nīlasya kasyacit || patitastu bhavedviprastribhiḥ kṛcchrairvyapohati || 33 || nīlamadhyaṃ yadā gacchetpramādādbrāhmaṇaḥ kvacit || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā pañcagavyena śuddhyati || 34 || nīladāru yadā bhidyedbrāhmaṇānāṃ śarīrake || śoṇitaṃ dṛśyate tatra dvijaścāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 35 || kuryādajñānato yastu nīlaṃ vai dantadhāvanam || kṛtvā kṛcchradvayaṃ tasya śuddhiruktā manīṣibhiḥ || 36 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi gopyādityamahodaya || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ śrutaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || || 37 || gavāṃ śatasahasraistu dattairyatkurujāṃgale || puṇyaṃ bhavati deveśi tadgopyādityadarśane || 38 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gopyādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 118 || || cha || ||
<7.1.119>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi mahādevīṃ mahāprabhām || balātibaladaityaghnīṃ nāmneti prathitāṃ kṣitau || 1 || anādinidhanāṃ devīṃ tatra kṣetre vyavasthitām || koṭibhūtaparīvārāṃ sarvadaityanibarhiṇīm || 2 || || devyuvāca || || balātibaladaityaghnī kathamuktā tvayā prabho || balātibalanāmānau kathaṃ daityau nipātitau || 3 || kutra tiṣṭhati sā devī kiṃprabhāvā maheśvara || māhātmyamakhilaṃ tasyāḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm || yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 5 || āsīdraktāsuronāma mahiṣasya suto balī || mahākāyo mahābāhurhiraṇyākṣa ivāparaḥ || 6 || balātibala nāmānau tasya putrau babhūvatuḥ || tau vijitya surānsarvāndevendrāgnipurogamān || 7 || trailokye'sminnirātaṃkau cakratū rājyamañjasā || tayoḥ senā mukhe vīrāstrayastriṃśatprakīrtitāḥ || 8 || raudrātmāno mahāyodhāḥ sahasrākṣauhiṇīmukhāḥ || siṃhaskandhā mahākāyā durātmāno mahābalāḥ || 9 || dhūmrākṣo bhīmadaṃṣṭraśca kālavaśyo mahāhanuḥ || brahmaghno yajñakopaśca strīghnaḥ pāpaniketanaḥ || 7.1.119.10 || vidyunmālī ca bandhūkaḥ śaṃkukarṇo vibhāvasuḥ || devāṃtako vikarmā ca durbhikṣa krūra eva ca || 11 || hayagrīvo'śvakarṇaśca ketumānvṛṣabho dvijaḥ || śarabhaḥ śalabho vyāghro nikuṃbho maṇiko bakaḥ || 12 || śūrpako vikṣaro mālī kālo daṇḍakakeralaḥ || ete daityā mahākāyāstayoḥ senādhikāriṇaḥ || 13 || evaṃ taiḥ pṛthivī vyāptā pañcāśatkoṭi vistarā || evaṃ jñātvā tadā devā bhayenodvignamānasāḥ || 14 || sarvairdevarṣibhiḥ sārdhaṃ jagmuste himavadvanam || stotreṇānena tāṃ devīṃ tuṣṭuvuḥ prayatāstadā || 15 || || devā ūcuḥ || || jayākṣare jayā'naṃte jayā'vyakte nirāmaye || jaya devi mahāmāye jaya devarṣivaṃdite || 16 || jaya viśveśvare gaṃge jaya sarvārthasiddhide || jaya brahmāṇi kaumāri jaya nārāyaṇīśvari || 17 || jaya brahmāṇi cāmuṃḍe jayendrāṇi maheśvari || jaya mātarmahālakṣmi jaya pārvati sarvage || 18 || jaya devi jagatsṛṣṭe jayairāvati bhārati || jayānaṃte jaya jaye jaya devi jalāvile || 19 || jayeśāni śive śarve jaya nityaṃ jayārcite || mokṣade jaya sarvajñe jaya dharmārthakāmade || 7.1.119.20 || jaya gāyatri kalyāṇi jaya sahye vibhāvari || jaya durge mahākāli śiva dūti jayā'jaye || 21 || jaya caṇḍe mahāmuṇḍe jaya nande śivapriye || jaya kṣemaṃkari śive jaya kalyāṇi revati || 22 || jayome siddhimāṃgalye harasiddhe namostu te || jayāparṇe jayānande mahiṣā'suraghātini || 23 || jaya medhe viśālākṣi jayānaṃge sarasvati || jayāśeṣaguṇāvāse jayāvarte surāntake || 24 || jaya saṃkalpasaṃsiddhe jaya trailokyasuṃdari || jaya śuṃbhaniśuṃbhaghne jaya padme'drisaṃbhave || 25 || jaya kauśiki kaumāri jaya vāruṇi kāmade || namonamaste śarvāṇi bhūyobhūyo jayāmbike || 26 || trāhi nastrāhi no devi śaraṇye śaraṇāgatān || 27 || saivaṃ stutā bhagavatī devaiḥ sarvairvarānane || ātmānaṃ darśayāmāsa bhābhāsitadigantaram || 28 || namaskṛtya tu tāmūcuḥ surāste bhayanāśanīm || balātibalanāmānau hatvā daityau mahābalau || teṣāṃ caiva mahatsainyaṃ pāhyato mahato bhayāt || 29 || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dattvā tebhyo'bhayaṃ tataḥ || babhūvādbhutarūpā sā trinetrā cenduśekharā ||7.1.119.30|| siṃhārūḍhā mahādevi nānāśastrāstradhāriṇī || suvaktrā viṃśatibhujā sphūrjadvidyullatopamā ||31|| tatoṃ 'bikā ninādoccaiḥ sāṭṭahāsaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 32 || tasyā nādena ghoreṇa kṛtsnamāpūritaṃ nabhaḥ || prakaṃpitākhilā corvī saridvāridhimekhalā || 33 || śailatuṃgastanī ramyā pramadeva bhayāturā || te'pi tatrāsurāḥ prāptāścaturaṃgabalānvitāḥ || 34 || samyagviditavikrāntāḥ kālāntakayamopamāḥ || rakṣo dānavadaityāśca pātāle ye'pi saṃsthitāḥ || 35 || te sarva eva daityendrāḥ koṭiśaḥ samupāgatāḥ || tato'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ devyāstatrāsuraiḥ saha || 36 || babhūva sarvabrahmāṇḍe hyakāṇḍakṣayakāraṇam || akṣauhiṇīsahasrāṇi trayastriṃśatsureśvari || 37 || ekaviṃśatsahasrāṇi śatānyaṣṭau ca saptatiḥ || sānugānāṃ sayodhānāṃ rathānāṃ vātaraṃhasām || 38 || hatvā sā līlayā devī ninye kṣayamanākulā || 39 || tato devyā hatānāṃ ca dānavānāṃ mahaujasām || gajavājirathānāṃ ca śarīrairāvṛtā mahī || 7.1.119.40 || kabaṃdhanṛtyasaṃkule sravadvasāsthikarddame || raṇājire niśācarāstato vicerurūrjitāḥ || 41 || śṛgāla gṛdhavāyasāḥ paraṃ prapātamādadhuḥ || kvacitpare niśācarāḥ prapītaśoṇitotkaṭāḥ || pratarpya cātmanaḥ pitṝnsamarcayaṃstathā ṛṣīn || 42 || gajānnarāṃsturaṃgamānbabhakṣire sunirghṛṇāḥ || rathoḍupaistathā pare taraṃti śoṇitārṇavam || 43 || iti pragāḍhasaṃgare surārisaṃghasaṃkule || virājate'mbikā dhanuḥ śarā'siśūladhāriṇī || 44 || gajendradarpamarddanī turaṃgayūthapothinī || surārisainyanāśinī itastataḥ prapaśyatī || 45 || siṃhāṣṭakayukte mahā pretake bhūdharahaṃsaśubhrojjaladbhāsvarābhe vṛṣabhasamāne māninīmatho te daityendravīrāḥ paśyaṃtaḥ samudbhūtaroṣāstato'pi jagmurnadanto ravanto ravaṃ meghanādāḥ || 46 || hāhākāraṃ vikurvāṇā hanyamānāstato'surāḥ || kecitsamudraṃ viviśuradrīnkecicca dānavāḥ || 47 || kecilluñcitamūrdhāno jālmā bhūtvā vane'vasan || dayādharmaṃ bruvāṇāśca nirgraṃthavratamāsthitāḥ || 48 || kecitprāṇaparā bhītāḥ pākhaṇḍāśramamāsthitāḥ || hetuvādaparā mūḍhā niḥśaucā nirapekṣakāḥ || 49 || te cādyāpīha dṛśyante loke kṣapaṇakāḥ kila || tathaiva bhindakāścānye śivaśāstrabahiṣkṛtāḥ || 7.1.119.50 || kecitkaulavratā hyasmindṛśyante sakalairjanaiḥ|| surāstrīmāṃsabhūyiṣṭhā vikarmasthāśca liṅginaḥ || 51 || prāyo naiṣkṛtikāḥ pāpā jihvopasthaparāyaṇā|| evaṃ devyā hatāḥ sarve balātibalasaṃyutāḥ||52|| prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā sā tadāmbikā|| yoginīnāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭyā saṃyutā pāpanāśinī|| balātibalanāśīti prabhāse prathitā kṣitau||53|| devyuvāca|| catuḥṣaṣṭistvayā proktā yoginyo yāḥ sureśvara|| tāsāṃ nāmāni me brūhi sarvapāpaharāṇi ca|| 54|| || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yoginīnāṃ mahodayam || sarvarakṣākaraṃ divyaṃ mahābhayavināśanam || 55 || ādau tatra mahālakṣmīrnaṃdā kṣemaṃkarī tathā || śivadūtī mahābhadrā bhrāmarī candramaṇḍalā || 56 || revatī harasiddhiśca durgā viṣamalocanā || sahajā kulajā kubjā māyāvī śāṃbhavī kriyā || 57 || ādyā sarvagatā śuddhā bhāvagamyā manotigā || vidyāvidyā mahāmāyā suṣumnā sarvamaṃgalā || 58 || oṃkārātmā mahādevi vedārthajananī śivā || purāṇānvīkṣikī dīkṣā cāmuṇḍā śaṃkarapriyā || 59 || brāhmī śāṃtikarī gaurī brahmaṇyā brāhmaṇapriyā || bhadrā bhagavatī kṛṣṇā grahanakṣatramālinī || 7.1.119.60 || tripurā tvaritā nityā sāṃkhyā kuṃḍalinī dhruvā || kalyāṇī śobhanā nirayā niṣkalā paramā kalā || 61 || yoginī yogasadbhāvā yogagamyā guhāśayā || kātyāyanī umā śarvā hyaparṇeti prakīrtitā || 62 || catuḥṣaṣṭirmahādevi evaṃ te parikīrtitāḥ || stotreṇānena divyena bhaktyā yaḥ stauti caṃḍikām || 63 || taṃ putramiva śarvāṇī sarvāpatsvabhirakṣati || caturdaśyāmathāṣṭamyāṃ navamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 64 || upavāsaikabhaktena tathaivāyācitena ca || gṛhītaniyamā devi ye japaṃti ca caṃḍikām || 65 || varṣārdhaṃ varṣamekaṃ vā siddhāste tattvacāriṇaḥ || āśvayukchuklapakṣe ca manvādiṣvaṣṭakāsu ca || 66 || kṛtvā mahotsavaṃ devīṃ yajecchreyo'bhivṛddhaye || pāduke dhārayeddevyā durgābhakto hiraṇmaye || 67 || pramādavighnaśāṃtyarthaṃ kṣurikāṃ ca sadā pumān || paśumāṃsāsavaiścaivamāsuraṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ || 68 || ye yajantyambikāṃ te syurdaityā aiśvaryabhoginaḥ || devatvaṃ sāttvikā yāṃti sāttvikīṃ bhaktimāsthitāḥ || 69 || etatte kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || balātibalanāśinyā devyā sarvārthasādhakam || prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthāyāḥ saṃkṣepātkīrtivardhanam || 70 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balātibaladaityaghnīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 119 || || cha ||
<7.1.120>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gopīśvaramanuttamam || balātibaladaityaghnyā uttare dhanuṣāṃ traye || 1 || saṃsthitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ gopībhiḥ saṃpratiṣṭhitam || samārādhya mahādevaṃ putrahetormaheśvaram || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ pūjitaṃ saṃtatipradam || 2 || caitraśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || gaṃdha puṣpopahāraiśca sa prāpnotīpsitaṃ phalam || 3 || evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || gopīśvarasya devasya prabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ || 4 || iti śrī skānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balātibaladaityaghnīmāhātmye gopīśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 120 || || cha ||
<7.1.121>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi rāmeśvaramanuttamam || jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa svayaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam || 1 || gopīśvarācca vāyavye dhanuṣāṃ triṃśake'ntare || sthitaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi liṃgaṃ pātakanāśanam || 2 || yadā rāmeṇa deveśi jamadagnisutena vai || kṛto mātṛvadho ghoraḥ piturājñānuvartinā || 3 || tadā manasi saṃtāpaṃ kṛtvā nirvedamāgataḥ || tataḥ prasannatāṃ yāto jamadagnirmahātapāḥ || 4 || dadau varaṃ tatastuṣṭo reṇukāyāśca jīvitam || evaṃ yadyapi sā tatra jīvitā varavarṇinī || 5 || tathāpi saghṛṇo devi jāmadagnyo mahāprabhaḥ || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapaścakre tato'dbhutam || 6 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram || divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ sāgraṃ tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 7 || dadau tasyepsitaṃ sarvaṃ svayaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || tataḥ kṛtārthatāṃ prāpto jāmadagnyo mahāṛṣiḥ || 8 || triḥsaptakṛtvaḥ pṛthivīṃ jitvā hatvā ca kṣatriyān || kṛtvā paṃcanadaṃ tatra kurukṣetre mahāmanāḥ || 9 || raktaiḥ saṃpūrṇatāṃ nītvā kṣatriyāṇāṃ varānane || ānṛṇyaṃ samanu prāptaḥ pitṝṇāṃ yo mahābalaḥ || 7.1.121.10 || evaṃ kṣattrāntakaṃ kṛtvā dattvā vipreṣu medinīm || kṛtārthatāmanuprāptastrailokye khyātapauruṣaḥ || 11 || tena tatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā pāpayukto'pi mānavaḥ || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairyāti lokamumāpateḥ || 12 || jyeṣṭhakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ jāgṛyāttatra yo naraḥ || so'śvamedhaphalaṃ prāpya modate divi devavat || 13 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jāmadagnyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 121 || || cha || ||
<7.1.122>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ citrāṃgadeśvaram || tasyaiva nairṛte bhāge dhanurviṃśatibhiḥ sthitam|| 1 || citrāṃgadena deveśi gaṃdharvapatinā priye || kṣetraṃ pavitraṃ jñātvā vai liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam || kṛtvā tapo mahāghoraṃ samārādhya maheśvaram || 2 || atha yo bhāvasaṃyuktastalligaṃ saṃprapūjayet || gāṃdharvalokamāpnoti gandharvaiḥ saha modate || 3 || tatra śuklatrayodaśyāṃ saṃsnāpya vidhinā śivam || pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairgaṃdhadhūpairanu kramāt || sa prāpnotyakhilaṃ kāmaṃ manasā yadyadīpsitam || 4 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citrāṃgadeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 122 || || cha |
<7.1.123>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi rāvaṇeśvaramuttamam || tasmāddakṣiṇanairṛtye dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe sthitam || 1 || pratiṣṭhitaṃ daśāsyena sarvapātakanāśanam || paulastyo rāvaṇo devi rākṣasastu sudāruṇaḥ || 2 || trailokyavijayākāṅkṣī puṣpakeṇa cacāra ha || kasyacittvatha kālasya vimānaṃ tasya puṣpakam|| 3||| vrajadvai vyomamārgeṇa niścalaṃ sahasā'bhavat || staṃbhitaṃ puṣpakaṃ dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇo vismayānvitaḥ || 4 || prahastaṃ preṣayāmāsa kimidaṃ vraja medinīm || ahatā'sya gatiryasmāttrailokye sacarācare || 5 || tatkasmānniścalaṃ jātaṃ vimānaṃ puṣpakaṃ mama || athā'sau satvaro devi jagāma vasudhātale || 6 || apaśyaddevadeveśaṃ śrīsomeśaṃ mahāprabham || stūyamānaṃ suragaṇaiḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 7 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā rākṣase ndrāya tatsarvaṃ vistarātpriye || prahastaḥ kathayāmāsa yaddṛṣṭaṃ kṣetramadhyataḥ || 8 || || prahasta uvāca || || rākṣaseśa mahābāho śivakṣetraṃ nijaṃ prabho || prabhāseti samākhyātaṃ gaṇagandharvasevitam || 9 || tatra someśvaro devaḥ svayaṃ tiṣṭhati śaṅkaraḥ || abbhakṣairvāyubhakṣaiśca daṃtolūkhalibhistathā || ṛṣibhirvālakhilyaiśca pūjyamānaḥ samaṃtataḥ || 7.1.123.10 || prabhāvāttasya devasya nedaṃ gacchati puṣpakam || na sa prālaṃghyate devo hyalaṃghyo yaḥ surāsuraiḥ || 11 || || īśvara uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ || avatīrya dharāpṛṣṭhaṃ someśaṃ samapaśyata || 12 || pūjayāmāsa deveśi bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || ratnairbahuvidhairvastrairgandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || 13 || atha paurajanā dṛṣṭvā rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram || sarvadikṣu varārohe bhayādbhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ || 14 || śūnyaṃ samabhavatsarvaṃ tatra devo vyavasthitaḥ || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 15 || daśagrīva mahābāho ayane cottare tathā || yātrākāle tu devasya sarvapāpapraṇāśane || 16 || dūrataḥ samanuprāptā bhūrilokā dvijātayaḥ || rākṣasānāṃ bhayādbhītāḥ prayāṃti hi diśo daśa || 17 || bhayānmā tvaṃ rākṣasendra yātrāvighnakaro bhava || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhakye yauvane'pi ca || tatsarvaṃ kṣālayenmartyo dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum || 18 || tato'sau rākṣasendrastu gatvaikānte sugahvare || liṃgaṃ ca sthāpayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 19 || tatastannirato bhūtvā sarvaistai rākṣaseśvaraḥ || pūjayāmāsa deveśi upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ || 7.1.123.20 || cakāra puratastasya gītavādyena jāgaram || tato'rdharātrasamaye vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 21 || daśagrīva mahābāho parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha || mama prasādāttrailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ te bhaviṣyati || atra saṃnihito nityaṃ sthāsyāmyahamasaṃśayam || || 22 || ye caitatpūjayiṣyaṃti liṃgaṃ bhaktiyutā narāḥ || ajeyāste bhaviṣyaṃti śatrūṇāṃ rākṣaseśvara || 23 || yāsyaṃti paramāṃ siddhiṃ matprasādādasaṃśayam || evamuktvā varārohe virarāma vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 24 || rāvaṇo'pi sa saṃtuṣṭo bhūyobhūyo maheśvaram || pūjayitvā ca talliṃgaṃ samāruhya ca puṣpakam || trailokyavijayākāṃkṣī iṣṭaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha || 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāvaṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayorviśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 123 || || cha || ||
<7.1.124>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gaurīṃ saubhāgyadāyinīm || paścime rāvaṇeśasya dhanuṣāṃ pañcake sthitām || 1 || yatrātapyattapo ghoraṃ svayaṃ devī hyaruṃdhatī || saubhāgyaṃ kāṃkṣamāṇā sā gaurīpūjāparāyaṇā || 2 || saṃprāptā paramāṃ siddhiṃ tasyā devyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklapakṣe māghe māsi varānane || 3 || yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā sa saubhāgyamavāpnuyāt|| anyajanmani deveśi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 4 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saubhāgyeśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||124||
<7.1.125>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahāliṃgaṃ mahādevi surapriyam || rāvaṇeśvaravāyavye dhanuṣāṃ triṃśake'ntare || 1 || sthitaṃ kāmapradaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || paulomīśvaranāmāḍhacaṃ paulomyā saṃpratiṣṭhitam || 2 || tārakeṇa yadā dhvastāstridaśāḥ saṃgare sthitāḥ || trailokyaṃ vihṛtaṃ sarvaṃ svayamindratvamāgataḥ || 3 || tadā śakraḥ suduḥkhārto bhayodvigno nanāśa vai || tadā tadbhāryayā devi indrāṇyā śokakarṣayā || 4 || indrasya jayamicchantyā śaṃbhurārādhitastayā || tatastuṣṭo mahādevastāmuvāca śubhekṣaṇām|| 5 || || bhagavānuvāca || || utpatsyati suto'smākaṃ ṣaṇmukhastu mahābalaḥ || tārakaṃ daityarājānaṃ sa cainaṃ ghātayiṣyati || 6 || gaccha tvaṃ vijvarā bhūtvā śṛṇu bhūyo vacaśca me || 7 || atra sthitamidaṃ liṃgaṃ yo'smākaṃ pūjayiṣyati || sa nūnaṃ me gaṇo bhūtvā matsakāśamupeṣyati || 8 || evamuktā gatā sādhvī devarāḍyatra saṃsthitaḥ || sarvadduḥkhavinirmuktā sarvadaityabhayojjhitā || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye paulomośvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 125 || || cha ||
<7.1.126>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi śāṃḍilyeśvaramuttamam || brahmaṇaḥ paścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśāṃtare || 1 || mahāprabhāvaṃ liṅgaṃ taddarśanātpāpanāśanam || 2 || śāṃḍilyonāma brahmarṣiḥ sārathirbrahmaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || tapasvī sa mahātejā jñānaniṣṭho jitendriyaḥ || 3 || sa prabhāsaṃ samāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ someśāduttare sthitam || 4 || sa svayaṃ pūjayāmāsa divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye || tato'bhilaṣitaṃ prāpya kṛtakṛtyo babhūva ha || 5 || nandīśvaraprasādena aṇimādiguṇairyutaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu naraḥ sadyo vipāpaḥ saṃprajāyate || 6 || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārdhakye yauvane'pi vā || ajñānājjñānato vā'pi yaḥ karoti naraḥ priye || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti śāṃḍilyeśvaradarśanāt || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye śāṇḍilyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 126 || || cha ||
<7.1.127>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kṣemeśvaramanuttamam || tasmāduttarakoṇasthaṃ kapāleśāgnigocare || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ paṃcadaśake kapāleśvarataḥ sthitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam || 2 || kṣemamūrtiḥ purā rājā babhūva sa mahābalaḥ || tena tatra tapastaptaṃ cirakālaṃ mahātmanā || || 3 || tataḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā bhāvitacetasā || taddṛṣṭvā kṣemamāyāti kāryaṃ kṣemeṇa siddhyati || 4 || sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā bhūyā jjanmanijanmani || evaṃ kṣemeśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ khyātaṃ pātakanāśanam || 5 || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ śrutaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam || darśanenāpi tasyāpi gośatasya phalaṃ smṛtam || 6 || tasmātkṣetraphalākāṃkṣī nityaṃ talliṃgamāśrayet || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣemaṃkareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 127 ||
<7.1.128>
|| īśvara uvāca || tato gacchenmahādevi sāgarādityamuttamam || bhairaveśātpaścimato rudrānmṛtyuñjayāttathā || 1 || kāmeśāddakṣiṇāgneye nātidūre vyavasthitam || sarva rogapraśamanaṃ dāridryaughavighātakam || pratiṣṭhitaṃ mahādevi sagareṇa mahātmanā || 2 || ṣaṣṭiputrasahasrāṇi yaḥ prāpārātisūdanaḥ || sūryaṃ tatra samārādhya sagaraḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || 3 || ya eṣa sāgaro devi yojanāyatavistaraḥ || āyato'śītisāhasraṃ yojanānāṃ prakīrtitaḥ || 4 || asminmanvantare kṣiptaḥ sāgaraiśca caturdiśam || tasyedaṃ kīrtitaṃ devi nāma sāgarasaṃjñitam || 5 || yasyādyāpīha gāyanti purāṇe prathitaṃ yaśaḥ || tenāyaṃ sthāpito devo bhāskaro vāritaskaraḥ || 6 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaḍo nāndho na daridro na duḥkhitaḥ || na caiveṣṭaviyogī syānna rogī naiva pāpakṛt || 7 || māghe māsi mahādevi site pakṣe jitendriyaḥ || ṣaṣṭhyāmupoṣito bhūtvā rātrau tasyāgrataḥ svapet || 8 || vibuddhastvatha saptamyāṃ bhaktyā bhānuṃ samarcayet || brāhmaṇānbhojayedbhaktyā vittaśāṭhyaṃ vivarjayet || 9 || sutapteneha tapasā yajñairvā bahudakṣiṇaiḥ || tāṃ gatiṃ na narā yānti yāṃ gatāḥ sūryamāśritāḥ || 7.1.128.10 || bhaktyā tu puruṣaiḥ pūjā kṛtā dūrvāṃkurairapi || bhānurdadāti hi phalaṃ sarvayajñaiḥ sudurlabham || 11 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena sūryamevābhipūjayet || janakādayo yathā siddhiṃ gatā bhānuṃ prapūjya ca || 12 || sarvātmā sarvalokeśo devadevaḥ prajāpatiḥ || sūrya eva trilokasya mūlaṃ paramadaivatam || 13 || vasante kapilaḥ sūryo grīṣme kāñcanasaprabhaḥ || śvetavarṇaśca varṣāsu pāṃḍuḥ śaradi bhāskaraḥ || 14 || hemante tāmravarṇastu śiśire lohito raviḥ || evaṃ varṇaviśeṣeṇa dhyāyetsūryaṃ yathākramam || 15 || pūjayitvā vidhānena yatātmā saṃyatendriyaḥ || paṭhennāmasahasraṃ tu sarvapātakanāśanam || || 16 || || devyuvāca || || nāmnāṃ sahasraṃ me brūhi prasādāñchaṃkara prabho || tulyaṃ nāmasahasrasya kimapyanyatprakīrtaya || 17 || || || īśvara uvāca || || alaṃ nāmasahasreṇa paṭhasvaivaṃ śubhaṃ stavam || yāni guhyāni nāmāni pavitrāṇi śubhāni ca || tāni te kīrtayiṣyāmi prayatnādavadhāraya || 18 || vikartano vivasvāṃśca mārtaṇḍo bhāskaro raviḥ || lokaprakāśakaḥ śrīmām̐llokacakṣurgraheśvaraḥ || 19 || lokasākṣī trilokeśaḥ karttā harttā tamisrahā || tapanastāpanaścaiva śuciḥ saptāśvavāhanaḥ || 7.1.128.20 || gabhastihasto brahmā ca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || ekaviṃśatirityeṣa stava iṣṭo mahātmanaḥ || 21 || śarīrārogyadaścaiva dhanavṛddhiyaśaskaraḥ || stavarāja iti khyātastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || || 22 || yaścānena mahādevi dve saṃdhye'stamanodaye || stautyarkaṃ prayato bhūtvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sūryalokaṃ sa gacchati || 23 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sāgarārkajam || śrutaṃ duḥkhaughaśamanaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 24 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāgarādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 128 || || cha ||
<7.1.129>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi akṣamāleśvaraṃ param || sāgarārkādīśakoṇe paṃcāśaddhanuṣāntare || 1 || saṃsthitaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ yugaliṃgaṃ mahāprabham || akṣamāleśvaraṃnāma purā tasya prakīrtitam || ugraseneśvaraṃ nāma khyātaṃ tasyaiva sāmpratam || 2|| || devyuvāca || || akṣamāleśvaraṃ nāma yatpūrvaṃ samudāhṛtam || kathaṃ tadabhavaddeva kathayasva prasādataḥ || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || āsītpurā mahādevi satī cādha mayonijā || akṣamāleti vai nāmnā satīdharmaparāyaṇā || 4 || kadācitsamanuprāpte durbhikṣe kālaparyayāt || ṛṣayaśca mahādevi kṣudhākrāntā vicetasaḥ || 5 || sarve cānnaṃ parīpsaṃto gatāścaṇḍālaveśmani || jñātvānnasaṃgrahaṃ tasya prārthayāñcakrurantyajam || 6 || bhobho'ntyaja mahābuddhe rakṣāsmānannadānataḥ || prāṇasaṃdehamāpannānkṛśāṃgānkṣutprapīḍitān || 7 || aho dhanyo'si pūjyo'si na tvamantyaja ucyase || yadasminpralaye yāte sthitaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhe tava || 8 || anāvṛṣṭihate deśe sasye ca pralayaṃ gate || ekaṃ yo bhojayedvipraṃ koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 9 || || antyaja uvāca || aho āścaryamatulaṃ yadetaddṛśyate'dhunā || yadetanmadgṛhaṃ prāptā ṛṣayaścānnakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 7.1.129.10 || śūdrānnamapi nādeyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ kimutāntyajāt || 11 || āmaṃ vā yadi vā pakvaṃ śūdrānnaṃ yastu bhakṣati || sa bhavecchūkaro grāmyastasya vā jāyate kule || 12 || amṛtaṃ bāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyānnaṃ payaḥ smṛtam || vaiśyānnamannamityāhuḥ śūdrānnaṃ rudhiraṃ smṛtam || 13 || śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaṃ śūdreṇa ca sahāsanam || śūdrādannāgamaścaiva jvalaṃtamapi pātayet || 14 || agnihotrī tu yo vipraḥ śūdrānnānna nivartate || ete tasya praṇaśyaṃti ātmā brahma trayo'gnayaḥ || 15 || śūdrānnenodarasthena brāhmaṇo mriyate yadi || ṣaṇmāsābhyantare vipraḥ piśācaḥ so'bhijāyate || 16 || śūdrānnena dvijo yastu agnihotraṃ juhoti ca || caṇḍālo jāyate pretya śūdrāccaiveha daivataḥ || 17 || yastu bhuñjati śūdrānnaṃ māsamekaṃ nirantaram|| iha janmani śūdratvaṃ mṛtaḥ śūdro'bhijāyate || 18 || rājānnaṃ teja ādatte śūdrānnaṃ brahmavarcasam|| āyuḥ suvarṇakārānnaṃ yaśaścarmāvakartinaḥ || 19 || kārukānnaṃ prajā hanti balaṃ nirṇejakasya ca || gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca lokebhyaḥ parikṛntati || 7.1.129.20 || pūyaṃ cikitsakasyānnaṃ puṃścalyāścānnamindriyam|| viṣṭhā vārdhuṣikasyānnaṃ śastravikrayiṇo malam || 21 || sahasrakṛtvastveteṣāmanne yadbhakṣite bhavet || tadekavāraṃ bhuktena kanyāvikrayiṇo bhavet || 22 || sahasrakṛtvastasyaiva bhukte'nne yatphalaṃ bhavet || tadantyajānāmannena sakṛdbhuktena vai bhavet || 23 || tatkathaṃ mama viprendrāścaṃḍālasyādhamātmanaḥ || dharmamevaṃ vijānanto nūnamannaṃ jihīrṣatha || 24 || || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || jīvitātyayamāpanno yo'nnamādriyate tataḥ || ākāśa iva paṃkena na sa pāpena lipyate || 25 || ajīgartaḥ sutaṃ haṃtumupasarpanbubhukṣitaḥ || na cālipyata pāpena kṣutpratīghātamācaran || 26 || bhāradvājaḥ kṣudhārtastu saputro vijane vane || bahvīrgā upajagrāha bṛhajjyotirmahāmanāḥ || 27 || kṣudhārto gītamabhyāgādviśvāmitraḥ śvajāghanīm || caṇḍālahastādādāya dharmādharmavicakṣaṇaḥ || 28 || śvamāṃsamicchannartau tu dharmānna cyayate sma saḥ || prāṇānāṃ parirakṣārthaṃ vāmadevo na liptavān || 29 || evaṃ jñātvā dharmabuddhe sāṃprataṃ mā vicāraya || dadasvānnaṃ dadasvānnamasmākamiha yācatām|| 7.1.129.30 || || caṃḍāla uvāca || || yadyevaṃ bhavatāṃ kāryamidamaṃgīkṛtaṃ dhuvam|| tadiyaṃ matsutā kanyā bhavadbhiḥ parigṛhyatām || 31 || bhavatāṃ yograṇīrjyeṣṭhaḥ sa cemāmudvaheddhruvam || dāsye varṣāśanaṃ paścādīpsitaṃ bhavatāṃ dvijāḥ || 32 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktā ṛṣayo devi lajjayā''natakandharāḥ || pratyālocya yathānyāyaṃ vasiṣṭhaṃ samanūdvahan|| 33 || vasiṣṭho'pi samākhyāya āpaddharmaṃ mahāmanāḥ || kālasyānantaraprekṣī prodvavāhā'ntyajāṅganām || akṣamāleti vai nāmnīṃ prasiddhā bhuvanatraye || 34 || yadā svakīyatejobhirarkabiṃbamarundhata || aruṃdhatī tadā jātā devadānava vaṃditā || 35 || yādṛśena tu bhartrā strī saṃyujyeta yathāvidhi || sā tādṛgeva bhavati samudreṇeva nimnagā || 36 || akṣamālā vasiṣṭhena saṃyuktā'dhama yonijā || śārṅgīva mandapālena jagāma hyarhaṇīyatām || 37 || evaṃ kālakrameṇaiva prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ || saptarṣayo mahātmāno hyaruṃdhatyā samanvitāḥ || 38 || tīrthāni preṣayāmāsuḥ sarvasiddhipradāni tām || 39 || eṣāmanveṣamāṇānāṃ tava devī hyaruṃdhatī|| apaśyalliṃgamekaṃ tu vṛkṣajālāṃtare sthitam || 7.1.129.40 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśamevaṃ jātismarā'bhavat || pūrvasmiñjanmani mayā rajobhāvāṃtarasthayā || 41 || ajñānabhāvāddeveśo nūnaṃ cātrārcitaḥ| śivaḥ || tasmātkarmaphalaṃ prāptamantyajatvaṃ dvijanmanā || 42|| kastena sadṛśo devaḥ śaṃbhunā bhuvanatraye || rājyaṃ niyamināmevaṃ yo ruṣṭo'pi prayacchati || 43 || iti saṃciṃtya manasā tatraiva niratā'bhavat || pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye || 44 || evaṃ tasya prabhāvena dṛśyate gaganāṃtare || aruṃdhatī satī hyeṣā dṛṣṭā duṣkṛtanāśinī || 45 || akṣamāleśvarastvevaṃ yathāvatkathitastava || tatastu dvāparasyānte kalau saṃdhyāṃśake gate || 46 ||| aṃdhāsurasutaścāsīdugrasena iti śrutaḥ || sa prabhāsaṃ samāsādya putrārthaṃ liṃgameyivān || 47 || akṣamāleśvaraṃ nāma jñātvā māhātmyamadbhutam || samārādhya mahādevaṃ nava varṣāṇi paṃca ca || saṃprāptavāṃstadā putraṃ kaṃsāsuramiti śrutam || 48 || tatkālāntaramārabhya ugraseneśvaro'bhavat || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || 49 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ || mahānti pātakānyāhurnaśyaṃti tasya darśanāt || 7.1.129.50 || tatraiva ṛṣipañcamyāṃ prāpte bhādrapade śubhe || akṣamāleśvaraṃ pūjya mucyate nārakādbhayāt || 51 || gopradānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tatrānnamudakaṃ tathā || sarvapāpavināśāya pretyānaṃtasukhāya ca || 52 || iti te kathitaṃ devi hyakṣamāleśvarodbhavam || māhātmyaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ śrutaṃ duḥkhanibarhaṇam || 53 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ugraseneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaraśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 129 || || cha || ||
<7.1.130>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ pāśupateśvaram || ugraseneśvarāddevi pūrvabhāge vyavasthitam || 1 || gopādityāttathāgneyyāṃ dhruveśāddakṣiṇāṃ śritam || sarvapāpaharaṃ devi pūrvabhāge vyavasthitam || 2 || gopādityāttathā liṃgaṃ darśanātsarvakāmadam || asminyuge samākhyātaṃ saṃtoṣeśvarasaṃjñitam || 3 || saṃtuṣṭo bhagavānyasmātteṣāṃ tatra tapasvinām || tena saṃtoṣanāmnā tu prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale || 4 || yugaliṃgaṃ mahādevi siddhisthānaṃ mahāprabham || sthānaṃ pāśupatānāṃ ca bheṣajaṃ pāparogiṇām || 5 || catvāro munayaḥ siddhāstasmim̐lliṃge yaśasvini|| vāmadevastu sāvarṇiraghoraḥ kapilastathā|| tasmim̐lliṃge tu saṃsiddhā anādīśe niraṃjane||6|| tasya devasya sāmīpye vane śrīmukhasaṃjñitam|| lakṣmīsthānaṃ mahādevi siddhayogaistu sevitam||7|| tatra pāśupatāḥ śreṣṭhā mama liṃgārcane ratāḥ|| teṣāṃ caiva nivāsārthaṃ taddevyā nirmitaṃ vanam || 8 || tasya madhye tu suśroṇi liṃgaṃ pūrvamukhaṃ sthitam || tasminpāśupatāḥ siddhā aghorādyā maharṣayaḥ || anenaiva śarīreṇa gatāste śivamandiram || 9 || tatra prābhāsike kṣetre surasiddhaniṣevite || rocate me sadā vāsastasminnāyatane śubhe || sarveṣāmeva sthānānāmatiramyamatipriyam || 7.1.130.10 || tatra pāśupatā devi mama dhyānaparāyaṇāḥ || mama putrāstu te sarve brahmacaryeṇa saṃyutāḥ || 11 || dāntāḥ śāṃtā jitakrodhā brāhmaṇāste tapasvinaḥ || talliṃgasya prabhāvena siddhiṃ te paramāṃ gatāḥ || 12 || tasmāttaṃ pūjayennityaṃ kṣetravāsī dvijottamaḥ || 13 || || devyuvāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka || prabhāse tu mahākṣetre tvadīyavratacāriṇām || 14 || sthānaṃ teṣāṃ mahatpuṇyaṃ yogaṃ pāśupataṃ tathā || kathayasva prasādena liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam || 15 || kimādināma devasya kathaṃ pūjyo narottamaiḥ || kathaṃ pāśupatāstatra sadehāḥ svargamāgatāḥ ||16|| etatkathaya deveśa dayāṃ kṛtvā mama prabho || 17 || || īśvara uvāca || || yastvayā pṛchyate bhadre yogaḥ pāśupato mahān || teṣāṃ caiva prabhāvo yastathā liṃgasya suvrate || 18 || anādīśasya devasya ādināma mahāprabhe || tasmim̐lliṃge tu ye devi madīyavratamāśritāḥ || 19 || ciraṃ niyogaṃ suśroṇi vrataṃ pāśupataṃ mahat || dhārayaṃti yathoktaṃ tu mama vismayakārakam || teṣāmanugrahārthāya mama cittaṃ pradhāvati || 7.1.130.20 || || sūta uvāca || || harasya vacanaṃ śrutvā devī vismayamāgatā || uvāca vacanaṃ viprāḥ sarvalokapatiṃ patim || 21 ||| | mamāpi kautukaṃ deva kimakārṣīttato bhavān || tadbrūhi me mahādeva yadyahaṃ tava vallabhā || 22 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahādevo jagāda tām || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi mama bhaktaviceṣṭitam || 23 || dṛṣṭvā caiva taponiṣṭhāṃ teṣāmādyaḥ sureśvaraḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ devaḥ praṇatānpārśvataḥ sthitān || 24 || || || īśvara uvāca || || gaccha śīghraṃ nandikeśa yatra te mama putrakāḥ || caraṃti ca vrataṃ ghoraṃ madīyaṃ cātiduṣkaram || 25 || tatkṣetrasya prabhāvena bhaktyā ca mama nityaśaḥ || tena te munayaḥ siddhāḥ svaśarīreṇa suvratāḥ || 26 || tasmānmadvacanānnandingaccha prābhāsikaṃ śubham || āmantraya tvaṃ tānsarvānkailāsaṃ śīghramānaya || 27 || idaṃ padmaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ sanālaṃ kalikojjvalam || liṃgasya mūrdhni dattvedaṃ padmanālamihānaya || 28 || muktastadā sa vai nandī devadevena śaṃbhunā || kailāsanilayāttasmātprabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || 29 || dṛṣṭvā caiva punarliṅgaṃ devadevasya śūlinaḥ || dṛṣṭvā tāṃścaiva yogīndrānparaṃ vismayamāgataḥ || 7.1.130.30 || keciddhyānaratāstatra kecidyogaṃ samāśritāḥ || kecidvyākhyāṃ prakurvanti vicāramapi cāpare ||31|| kurvantyanye liṃgapūjāṃ praṇāmaṃ ca tathā'pare || pradakṣiṇaṃ prakurvanti sāṣṭāṃgaṃ praṇamanti ca || 32 || kecitstutiṃ prakurvanti bhāvayajñaistathā pare || kecitpūjāṃ ca kurvanti ahiṃsākusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 33 || bhasmasnānaṃ prakurvaṃti gaṇḍukaiḥ snāpayanti ca || evaṃ vyākulatāṃ yātaṃ tapasvigaṇamaṇḍalam || 34 || tattādṛśamathālokya nandī vismayamāgataḥ || cintayāmāsa manasā sarvaṃ teṣāṃ nirīkṣya ca || 35 || āgato'hamimaṃ deśaṃ na kaścinmāṃ nirīkṣate|| na kenacidahaṃ pṛṣṭo'bhyāgataḥ kutra kasya ca || 36 || ahaṃkārāvṛtāḥ sarve na vadanti ca māṃ kvacit || evaṃ manasi saṃdhāya liṃgapārśvamupāgataḥ || || 37 || dattaṃ liṃgasya tatpadmanālaṃ chittvā tu nandinā || arcayitvā tu tannandī liṃgaṃ pāśupateśvaram || nālaṃ gṛhītvā yatnena ṛṣīnvacanamabravīt || 38 || || nandikeśvara uvāca || || śāsanāddevadevasya bhavatāṃ pārśvamāgataḥ || ājñāpayati deveśastapasvigaṇamaṇḍalam || 39 ||| yuṣmābhistatra gantavyaṃ yatra devaḥ sanātanaḥ || yuṣmānsarvānsamādāya gamiṣyāmi bhavālayam || 7.1.130.40 || uttiṣṭhatāśu gacchāmaḥ kailāsaṃ parvatottamam || tūṣṇīṃbhūtāstataḥ sarve procuste saṃjñayā dvijāḥ || gamyatāmagrato nandinpaścādeṣyāmahe vayam || 41 || evamuktastu munibhirnandī śīghrataraṃ gataḥ || kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ kupitenāntarātmanā || 42 || || nandikeśvara uvāca || || deva tatra gato'haṃ vai yatra te yoginaḥ sthitāḥ || santoṣito na caivāhaṃ kenacittatra saṃsthitaḥ || 43 || na māṃ deva nirīkṣante nālapaṃti kathaṃcana || padmaṃ tatra mayā deva sthāpitaṃ liṃga mūrdhani || 44 ||| uktaṃ deva mayā teṣāṃ yogīndrāṇāṃ maheśvara || ājñaptā devadevena ihāgacchata mā ciram || 45 || etacchrutvā vacaḥ svāminsarve tatra maharṣayaḥ || āgamiṣyāma iti vai pṛṣṭhato gaccha mā ciram || 46 || ityukte taistathā deva ahaṃ śīghramihāgataḥ || śṛṇu cemaṃ gṛhāṇa tvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ kuru me prabho || 47 || ekaṃ me saṃśayaṃ deva cchettumarhasi sāṃpratam || mayā vinā mahādeva āgamiṣyaṃti te katham || saṃśayo me mahādeva kathayasva maheśvara || 48 ||| || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu naṃdinyathāścaryaṃ teṣāṃ vai bhāvitātmanām || na dṛśyanta ime siddhā māṃ muktvā'nyaiḥ surairapi ||49|| madbhāvabhāvitāste vai yogaṃ viṃdaṃti śāṃkaram || paśyaitatkautukaṃ naṃdindarśayāmi tavādhunā || 7.1.130.50 || ānītaṃ yattvayā nālaṃ tasminnāle tu sūkṣmavat || praviśya cāgatāḥ sarve yogaiśvaryabalena ca ||51|| evamuktastadā naṃdī vismayotphullalocanaḥ || apaśyannālamadhyasthānmaharṣīnparamāṇuvat||52|| yathārkaraśmimadhyasthā dṛśyante paramāṇavaḥ || evaṃ tannālamadhyasthā dṛśyaṃta ṛṣayaḥ pṛthak || 53 || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā tadā naṃdī vismayotphullalocanaḥ || āścaryaṃ paramaṃ gatvā kiñcinnevābravītpunaḥ || 54 || evaṃ tatkautukaṃ dṛṣṭvā devī vacanamabravīt || kiṃ dṛśyate mahādeva hṛṣṭaḥ kasmānmaheśvara ||55|| ityukte vacane devyā provācedaṃ maheśvaraḥ|| ||56|| || īśvara uvāca || || yogayuktā mahātmāno yoge pāśupate sthitāḥ || ete māṃ ca samārādhya prabhāsakṣetravāsinam || īdṛśīṃ siddhimāpannāḥ svacchaṃdagaticāriṇaḥ|| 57 || ityuktavati deveśa ṛṣayaste mahāprabhāḥ || padmanālādviniḥsṛtya sarve vai yogamāyayā || pradakṣiṇāṃ prakurvaṃti devaṃ devyā bahiṣkṛtam|| 58 || || devyuvāca || || kimarthaṃ māṃ na paśyaṃti durācārā ime dvijāḥ || vismayo'yaṃ mahādeva kathayasva prasādataḥ || 59 || || || īśvara uvāca || || prakṛtitvānna paśyaṃti siddhā hyete mahātapāḥ || evamuktā tu girijā devedevena śūlinā || 7.1.130.60 || cukopa teṣāṃ suśroṇī śaśāpa krodhitānanā || strīlaulyena durācārā nāśameṣyatha garviṇaḥ || 61 || rājapratigrahāsaktā vṛttyā devārcane ratāḥ|| bhaviṣyatha kalau prāpte liṃgadravyopajīvinaḥ || 62 || veśyāsaktāśca saṃbhrāṃtā sarvalokabahiṣkṛtāḥ || devadravyavināśāya bhaviṣyatha kalau yuge || 63 || iti datte tadā śāpa ṛṣīṇāṃ ca mahātmanām || gaurīṃ prasādayāmāsuste ca sarve sureśvarāḥ || 64 || devadevasya vacanātprasannā sā'bhavatpunaḥ || nālaṃ devo'pi saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇāśāṃ samākṣipat || 65 || patitaṃ tacca vai nālaṃ prabhāsakṣetramadhyataḥ || tadeva liṃgaṃ saṃjātaṃ mahānāleti viśrutam || 66 || kalau yuge ca saṃprāpte taddhruveśvarasaṃjñitam|| saṃsthitaṃ cottareśāne tasmātpāśupateśvarāt ||67 || purā'nādīśanāmeti paścātpāśupateśvaraḥ || prabhāse tu mahākṣetre sthitaḥ pātakanāśanaḥ ||68|| idaṃ sthānaṃ paraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ mama vrataniṣevaṇam || idaṃ liṃgaṃ paraṃ brahma anādīśeti saṃjñitam || 69|| atra siddhiśca muktiśca brāhmaṇānāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || anenaiva śarīreṇa ṣaḍbhirmāsastu siddhyati || 7.1.130.70 || saṃsārasya vimokṣārthamidaṃ liṃgaṃ tu dṛśyatām || durlabhaṃ sarvalokānāmidaṃ mokṣapradaṃ param|| idaṃ pāśupataṃ jñānamasmim̐lliṃge pratiṣṭhitam || 71 || yaścainaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā māghe māsi niraṃtaram || sarveṣāṃ vai kratūnāṃ ca dānānāṃ labhate phalam || 72 || hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 73 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || paśupāśavimokṣārthaṃ samyakpāśupateśvaram || 74 || caturṇāmapi varṇānāṃ pūjyo brāhmaṇa ucyate || tasya caivādhikāro'sti cāsminpāśupateśvare || 75 || yaddevatānāṃ prathamaṃ pavitraṃ viśvavrataṃ pāśupataṃ babhūva || ayaṃ panthā naiṣṭhiko vai mayokto yena devā yāṃti bhuvanāni viśvā || 76 || surāṃ pītvā gurudārāṃśca gatvā steyaṃ kṛtvā brāhmaṇaṃ cāpi hatvā || bhasmacchanno bhasmaśayyāśayāno rudrādhyāyī mucyate pātakebhyaḥ || 77 || agnirityādinā bhasma gṛhītvāṃgāni saṃspṛśet || gṛhṇīyātsaṃyate cāgnau bhasma tadgṛhavāsinām || 78 || agniriti bhasma vāyuriti bhasma jalamiti bhasma sthalamiti bhasma sarvaṃ ha vā idaṃ bhasmābhavat || etāni cakṣūṃṣi nādīkṣitaḥ saṃspṛśet || 79 || brāhmaṇaiśca samādeyaṃ na tu śūdraiḥ kadācana || nādhikāro'sti śūdrasya vrate pāśupate sadā || 7.1.130.80 || brāhmaṇeṣvadhikāro'sti vrate pāśupate śubhe || brāhmaṇīṃ tanumāsthāya saṃbhavāmi yugeyuge || 81 || caṇḍālaveśmanyatha vā smaśāne rājñaśca mārgeśvatha vartmamadhye || karīṣamadhye niḥsṛtā narādhamāḥ śaivaṃ padaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayo'tra || 82 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśī tisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāśupateśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 130 || || cha || ||
<7.1.131>
|| śrīdevyuvāca || || yadetadbhavatā proktaṃ nāleśvaramiti śrutam || dhruveśvareti talliṃgaṃ kathaṃ vai saṃbabhūva ha || 1 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi dhruveśvaramahodayam || yacchrutvā mānavo devi mucyate bhavabaṃdhanāt || 2 || uttānapādanṛpateḥ putro'bhūddhruvasaṃjñitaḥ || mahātmā jñānasaṃpannaḥ sarvajñaḥ priyadarśanaḥ || 3 || sa kadācitsamāsādya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || tatāpa vipulaṃ devi tapaḥ paramadāruṇam || 4 || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || saṃpūjayati sadbhaktyā stauti stotraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || 5 || tatstotraṃ te pravakṣyāmi yenāhaṃ tuṣṭimāgataḥ || 6 || || dhruva uvāca || || kailāsatuṃgaśikharaṃ pravikampyamānaṃ kailāsaśṛṃgasadṛśena daśānanena || yaḥ pādapadmaparipīḍanayā dadhāra taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 7 || yenāsurāścāpi danośca putrā vidyādharoragagaṇaiśca vṛtāḥ samagrāḥ || saṃyojitā na tu phalaṃ phalamūlamuktāstaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 8 || yasyākhilaṃ jagadidaṃ vaśavarti nityaṃ yo'ṣṭābhireva tanubhirbhuvanāni bhuṃkte || yatkāraṇaṃ paramakāraṇakāraṇānāṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ||9|| yaḥ savyapāṇikamalāgranakhena devastatpaṃcamaṃ ca sahasaiva purātiruṣṭaḥ || brāhmaṃ śirastaruṇapadmanibhaṃ cakarta taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi ||7.1.131.10||| yasya praṇamya caraṇau varadasya bhaktyā śrutvā ca vāgbhiramalābhirataṃdritābhiḥ || dīptastamāṃsi nudati svakarairvivasvāṃstaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || || 11 || yaḥ paṭhetstavamidaṃ rucirārthaṃ mānavo dhruvakṛtaṃ niyatātmā || viprasaṃsadi sadā śucisiddhaḥ sa prayāti śivalokamanādim || 12 || tasyaivaṃ stuvato devi tuṣṭo'haṃ bhāvitātmanaḥ || pūrṇe varṣasahasrāṃte dhruvasyāha mahātmanaḥ || 13 || putra tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te jātastvaṃ nirmalo'dhunā || divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya māṃ vigatajvaraḥ || 14 || yacca te manasā kiñcitkāṃkṣitaṃ phalamuttamam || tatsarvaṃ te pradāsyāmi brūhi śīghraṃ mamāgrataḥ || 15 || brāhmyaṃ vā vaiṣṇavaṃ śākraṃ padamanyatsudurlabham || dadāmi nātra saṃdeho bhaktyā saṃprīṇitastava || 16 || || dhruva uvāca || || brāhmyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ māhendraṃ padamāvṛttilakṣaṇam|| viditaṃ mama tatsarvaṃ manasā'pi na kāmaye||17|| yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva bhaktiṃ dehi sunirmalām|| asmim̐lliṃge sadā vāsaṃ kuru deva vṛṣadhvaja||18|| īśvara uvāca|| iti yatprārthitaṃ sarvaṃ taddattaṃ sarvameva hi|| sthānaṃ ca tasya taddhrauvyaṃ tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam||19|| śrāvaṇasya tvamāvāsyāṃ yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || āśvayukpaurṇamāsyāṃ vā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 7.1.131.20 || aputro labhate putraṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam || rūpavānsubhago bhogī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || haṃsayuktavimānena rudraloke mahīyate || 21 || asurasuragaṇānāṃ pūjitasya dhruvasya kathayati kamanīyāṃ kīrtimetāṃ śṛṇoti || sakalasukhanidhānarudralokaṃ suśāṃtaḥ suragaṇadanunāthairarcitaṃ yātyanaṃtam || 22 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye dhruveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||131|| || cha || ||
<7.1.132>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vaiṣṇavīṃ śaktimuttamām || someśādīśadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitām || 1 || siddhalakṣmīti vikhyātā hyatra pīṭhādhidevatā || 2 || brahmāṇḍe prathamaṃ pīṭhaṃ yatprabhāsaṃ vyavasthitam || tatra devi mahāpīṭhe yoginyo bhūcarāḥ khagāḥ || bhairaveṇa same tāstu krīḍante svecchayā priye || 3|| jālaṃdharaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāmarūpaṃ tathaiva ca || śrīmadrudranṛsiṃhaṃ ca caturthaṃ pīṭhamuttamam || 4 || ratnavīryaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ kāśmīraṃ pīṭhameva ca || etāni devi pīṭhāni yo vetti sa ca mantravit || 5 || sarveṣāṃ caiva pīṭhānāmādhāraṃ pīṭhamuttamam || saurāṣṭre tu mahādevi nāmnā khyātaṃ mahodayam || kāmarūpadharaṃ jñānaṃ yatrādyāpi pravartate || 6 || tatra pīṭhe sthitā devī mahālakṣmīti viśrutā || sarvapāpapraśamanī sarvakāryaśubhapradā || 7 || śrīpañcamyāṃ naro yastu pūjayettāṃ vidhānataḥ || gandhapuṣpādibhirbhaktyā tasyālakṣmībhayaṃ kutaḥ || 8 || uttarāṃ diśamāsthāya mahāla kṣmyāstu sannidhau|| yo japenmantrarājñīṃ tāṃ siddhalakṣmīti viśrutām || 9 || lakṣajāpyavidhānena dīkṣāsnānādipūrvakam || daśāṃśahomasaṃyuktaṃ trimadhuśrīphalesubhiḥ || 7.1.132.10 || evaṃ pratyakṣatāṃ yāti tasya lakṣmīrna saṃśayaḥ || dadāti vāṃchitāṃ siddhimiha loke paratra ca || 11 || tṛtīyāyāmathā ṣṭamyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ || yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā tasya siddhiḥ kare sthitā || 12 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddhalakṣmīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 132 || || cha ||
<7.1.133>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitā devi mahākālīti viśrutā || adhaḥ sthite mahāpīṭhe pātālavivarānvite || 1 || sarvaduḥkhapraśamanī sarvaśatrukṣayaṃkarī || pūjanīyā vidhānena kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ mahāniśi || gandhaiḥ puṣpaistathā dhūpaiḥ kravyairbalibhireva ca || 2 || phalatṛtīyāṃ nārī ca kuryādvai tatra bhāvitā || varṣamekaṃ site pakṣe devīṃ pūjya vidhānataḥ || phalāni brāhmaṇe deyānyeva nūnaṃ vidhānataḥ || 3 || etāni varjayennakte hyannāni surasundari || niṣpāvā āḍhakī mudgā māṣāścaiva kulitthakāḥ||4|| masūrā rājamāṣāśca godhūmāstripuṭāstathā || caṇakā vartalā vāpi makuṣṭhāścaivamādayaḥ || 5 || na bhakṣyāstāvatte devi yāvadgaurīvrataṃ caret || tasyāḥ puṇyaphalaṃ vakṣye kathyamānaṃ śṛṇuṣva me || 6 || dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ gṛhe tasyā na kadācitkṣayaṃ vrajet || duḥkhitā durbhagā dīnā sapta janmāni no bhavet || 7 || mahākālīvrataṃ proktaṃ devyā māhātmyasaṃyutam || kṛtaṃ pātakanāśāya sarvakāmasamṛddhaye || 8 || evaṃ devi samākhyātaṃ mahākālīmahodayam || kṣetrapīṭhaṃ mahādevi mantrasiddhipradāyakam || 9 || āśvayukchuklapakṣe tu navamyāṃ tatra jāgṛyāt || pīṭhe pūjābaliṃ dattvā mantraṃ kāmaṃ japanniśi || saumyacittaḥ samāpnoti vāṃchitāṃ siddhimuttamām || 7.1.133.10 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mahākālīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 133 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.134>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi puṣkarāvartakāṃ nadīm || brahmakuṃḍāduttarato nātidūre vyavasthitām || 1 || purā yajñe vartamāne somasya tu mahātmanaḥ || brahmā suragaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ||2|| somanāthapratiṣṭhārthamṛkṣarājanimaṃtritaḥ || pratijñātaṃ purā tena brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || 3 || yāvatsthāsyāmyahaṃ martye kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || tāvatsaṃdhyātrayaṃ vaṃdyaṃ nityameva tripuṣkare || 4 || etasminneva kāle tu lagnakāla upasthite || ādiṣṭaṃ śobhanaṃ kālaṃ brāhmaṇairdaivacintakaiḥ || 5 || tatastaṃ prasthitaṃ jñātvā puṣkare tu pitāmaham || saṃdhyārthaṃ rātrinātho vai vākyametaduvāca ha || 6 ||| daivajñaiḥ kalitaḥ kāla eṣa eva śubhodayaḥ || yathā kālātyayo na syāttathā nītirvidhīyatām || 7 || taṃ jñātvā sāṃprataṃ kālaṃ brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || manasā cintayāmāsa puṣkarāṇi samāhitaḥ || 8 || tāni vai smṛtamātrāṇi brahmaṇā varavarṇini || prādurbhūtāni tatraiva nadyāstīre suśobhane || 9 || āvartāstatra sañjātā jyeṣṭhamadhyakanīyasaḥ || atha nāmākarottasyā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 7.1.134.10 || puṣkarāvartakā nāmnā adyaprabhṛti śobhanā || nadī prayāsyate loke khyātiṃ mama prasādataḥ || 11 || atra snātvā naro bhaktyā tarpayiṣyati yaḥ pitṝn || tripuṣkarasamaṃ puṇyaṃ lapsyate sa tathepsitam || 12 || śrāvaṇe śuklapakṣasya tṛtīyāyāṃ narottamaḥ || yaḥ pitṝṃstarpayettatra tṛptiḥ kalpāyutaṃ bhavet || 13 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkarāvartakānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 134||
<7.1.135>
īśvara uvāca|| tatraiva saṃsthitāṃ paśyeddevīṃ duḥkhāṃtakāriṇīm|| śītaleti purā khyātā yuge dvāparasaṃjñite|| kalau punaḥ samākhyātāṃ kaliduḥkhāntakāriṇīm||1|| śītalaṃ kurute dehaṃ bālānāṃ rogavarjitam|| pūjitā bhaktibhāvena tena sā śītalā smṛtā||2|| visphoṭānāṃ praśāṃtyarthaṃ bālānāṃ caiva kāraṇāt || mānena māpitānkṛtvā masūrāṃstatra kuṭṭayet || 3 || śītalāpurato dattvā bālāḥ santu nirāmayāḥ || visphoṭacarcikādīnāṃ vātādīnāṃ śamo bhavet || 4 || śrāddhaṃ tatraiva kurvīta brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayet || 5 || karpūraṃ kusumaṃ caiva mṛganābhiṃ sucandanam|| puṣpāṇi ca sugandhāni naivedyaṃ ghṛtapāyasam || nivedya devyai tatsarvaṃ daṃpatyoḥ paridhāpayet ||6|| navamyāṃ śuklapakṣe tu mālāṃ vilvamayīṃ śubhām|| bhaktyā nivedya tāṃ devyai sarvasiddhimavāpnuyāt || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye duḥkhāntakāriṇītilāgaurīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||135||||
<7.1.136>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi lomaśeśvaramuttamam || duḥkhāntakāriṇīpūrve dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || 1 || sthāpitaṃ tatra deveśi lomaśena maharṣiṇā || guhāmadhye mahāliṃgaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram || 2 || koṭīnāṃ tritayaṃ sārdhamiṃdrādyāḥ svarbhujaḥ priye || yadā nāśaṃ gamiṣyaṃti tadā tasya kṣayo dhruvam || 3 || yāvaṃti deharomāṇi indrāstāvanta eva ca || kramādindre vinaṣṭe tu tallomapatanaṃ bhavet || 4 || evamīśaprasādena cirāyurlomaśo'bhavat || brahmāṇaḥ ṣaḍvinaśyanti samagrāyuṣi lomaśe || 5 || ya evaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā talliṃgaṃ lomaśārcitam || so'pi dīrghāyurāpnoti nirvyādhirnīrujaḥ sukhī || 6 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye lomaśeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 136 || || || || ||
<7.1.137>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetkṣetrapālamanuttamam || kaṃkālabhairavaṃnāma bhairaveṇa niyojitam || tasya kṣetrasya rakṣārthaṃ prāṇināṃ duṣṭacetasām || 1 || śrāvaṇe śuklapañcamyāmaṣṭamyāmāśvinasya ca || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā balipuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || 2 || tasya kṣetre nivasataḥ puṣkarasya mahātmanaḥ || nirvighnakārī bhavati tathā rakṣati putravat || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kaṃkālabhairavakṣetrapālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 137 || || cha ||
<7.1.138>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva paścime bhāge dhanupāṃ pañcake sthitam || tṛṇabindvīśvaraṃnāma tīvrabhaktyā pratiṣṭhitam || 1 || kṛtvā mahattapo devi tṛṇabiṃdumu nīśvaraḥ || māsimāsi kuśāgreṇa jalabiṃduṃ nipīya vai || 2 || saṃvatsarāṇyanekāni evamārādhya ceśvaram || saṃprāptaṃ paramāṃ siddhiṃ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tṛṇabiṃdvīśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 138 || || cha ||
<7.1.139>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi citrādityamanuttamam || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge vrahmakuṇḍasamīpataḥ || 1 || mahāprabhāvo deveśi sarvadāridryanāśanaḥ || mitro nāma purā devi dharmātmā'bhūddharātale || kāyasthaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ nityaṃ bhūtahite rataḥ || 2 || tasyāpatyadvayaṃ jajña ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ || putraḥ paramatejasvī citronāma varānane || 3 || tathā citrā'bhavatkanyā rūpāḍhyā śīlamaṃḍanā || 4 || ābhyāṃ tu jātamātrābhyāṃ mitraḥ pañcatvameyivān || atha tasya varā bhāryā saha tenāgnimāviśat || 5 || atha tau bālakau dīnāvṛṣibhiḥ paripālitau || vṛddhiṃ gatau mahāraṇye bālāveva sthitau vrate || 6 || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapaḥ paramamāsthitau || pratiṣṭhāpya mahā devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram || 7 || pūjayāmāsa dharmātmā dhūpamālyānulepanaiḥ || vasiṣṭhakathitaiścaiva hyaṣṭaṣaṣṭisamanvitaiḥ || nāmabhiḥ sūryadeveśaṃ tuṣṭāva prāñjaliḥ prabhum || 8 || || citra uvāca || || praṇamya śirasā devaṃ bhāskaraṃ gaganādhipam || ādidevaṃ jagannāthaṃ pāpaghnaṃ roganāśanam || 9 ||| sahasrākṣaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasrakiraṇadyutim || 7.1.139.10 || tamahaṃ saṃstaviṣyāmi saṃpṛktaṃ guhyanāmabhiḥ || muṃḍīrasvāminaṃ prātargaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || kālapriyaṃ tu madhyāhne yamunātīramāśritam || 11 || mūlasthānaṃ cāstamane candrabhāgātaṭe sthitam|| yatra sāṃbaḥ svayaṃ siddha upavāsaparāyaṇaḥ ||12|| vārāṇasyāṃ lohitākṣaṃ gobhilākṣe bṛhanmukham || prayāgeṣu pratiṣṭhānaṃ vṛddhādityaṃ mahādyutim ||13|| koṭyakṣe dvādaśādityaṃ gaṃgādityaṃ caturghaṭe || naimiṣe caiva goghne ca bhadraṃ bhadrapuṭe sthitam ||14|| jayāyāṃ vijayādityaṃ prabhāse svarṇavetasam || kurukṣetre ca sāmaṃtaṃ trimaṃtraṃ ca ilāvṛte ||15|| mahendre kramaṇādityamṛṇe siddheśvaraṃ viduḥ || kauśāṃbyāṃ padmabodhaṃ ca brahmabāhau divākaram||16|| kedāre caṇḍakāṃtiṃ ca nitye ca timirāpaham || gaṃgāmārge śivadvāramādityaṃ bhūpradī pane ||17|| haṃsaṃ sarasvatītīre viśvāmitraṃ pṛthūdake || ujjayinyāṃ naradvīpaṃ siddhāyāmamaladyutim ||18|| sūryaṃ kuntīkumāre ca pañcanadyāṃ vibhāvasum ||| mathurāyāṃ vimalādityaṃ saṃjñādityaṃ tu saṃjñike || 19 || śrīkaṇṭhe caiva mārtaṇḍaṃ daśārṇe daśakaṃ smṛtam || godhane gopatiṃ devaṃ karṇaṃ caiva marusthale ||7.1.139.2||| puṣpaṃ devapure caiva keśavārkaṃ tu lohite || vaidiśe caiva śārdūlaṃ śoṇe vāruṇavāsinam || 21 || vardhamāne ca sāṃbākhyaṃ kāmarūpe śubhaṃkaram || mihiraṃ kānyakubje ca maṃdāraṃ puṇyavardhane || 22 || gandhāre kṣobhaṇādityaṃ laṃkāyāmamaradyutim || karṇādityaṃ ca caṃpāyāṃ prabodhe śubhadarśinam || 23 || dvārā vatyāṃ tu pārvatyaṃ himavante himāpaham || mahātejaṃ tu lauhitye amalāṃge ca dhūjaṭim || 24 || rohike tu kumārākhyaṃ padmāyāṃ padmasaṃbhavam|| dharmādityaṃ tu lāṭāyāṃ marddake sthaviraṃ viduḥ || 25 || sukhapradaṃ tu kauberyāṃ kosale gopatiṃ tathā || kauṃkaṇe tu padmadevaṃ tāpanaṃ vindhyaparvate || 26 || tvaṣṭāraṃ caiva kāśmīre caritre ratnasaṃbhavam || puṣkare hemagarbhasthaṃ vidyātsūryaṃ gabhastike || 27 || prakāśāyāṃ tu mujjhālaṃ tīrthagrāme prabhākaram || kāṃpilye rillakādityaṃ dhanake dhanavāsinam ||28|| analaṃ narmadātīre sarvatra gamanādhikam|| aṣṭaṣaṣṭiṃ tu devasya bhāskarasyāmitadyuteḥ || 29 || prātarutthāya vai nityaṃ śaktimāñchucimānnaraḥ || yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇuyādvāpi sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 7.1.139.30 || rājyārthī labhate rājyaṃ dhanārthī labhate dhanam || putrārthī labhate putrānsaukhyārthī labhate sukham || 31 || rogārto mucyate rogādbaddho mucyeta bandhanāt || yānyānprārthayate kāmāṃstāṃstānprāpnoti mānavaḥ ||32|| || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ ca stuvatastasya citrasya vimalātmanaḥ || tatastuṣṭaḥ sahasrāṃśuḥ kālena mahatā vibhuḥ || 33 || abravīdvatsa bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya suvrata || 34 || so'bravīdyadi me tuṣṭo bhagavaṃstīkṣṇadīdhiteḥ || prauḍhatvaṃ sarvakāryeṣu naya māṃ jñānitāṃ tathā || 35 || tattatheti prati jñātaṃ sūryeṇa varavarṇini || tataḥ sarvajñatāṃ prāptaścitro mitrakulodbhavaḥ ||36|| taṃ jñātvā dharmarājastu buddhyā paramayā yutam|| ciṃtayāmāsa medhāvī lekha ko'yaṃ bhavedyadi || 37 || tato me sarvasiddhiḥ syānnirvṛtiśca parā bhavet || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya dharmarājasya bhāmini||38|| agnitīrthe gate citre snā nārthaṃ lavaṇāmbhasi || sa tatra praviśanneva nītastu yamakiṃkaraiḥ ||39|| saśarīro mahādevi yamādeśaparāyaṇaiḥ || sa citraguptanāmā'bhūdviśvacāritralekhakaḥ || 7.1.139.40 || citrādityetināmā'bhūttato loke varānane || 41 || saptamyāṃ niyatāhāro yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || sapta janmāni dāridryaṃ na duḥkhaṃ tasya jāyate ||42|| tatraiva cāśvo dātavyaḥ sakoṣaṃ khaḍgameva ca || hiraṇyaṃ caiva viprāya evaṃ yātrāphalaṃ labhet ||43|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citrādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||139|||
<7.1.140>
tato gacchenmahādevi nadīṃ citrapathāṃ tataḥ || brahmakuṇḍasamīpasthāṃ citrādityasya madhyataḥ || 1 || yadā ca citraḥ saṃnīto yamadūtaiḥ surapriye || saśarīro mahāprājño yamādeśaparāyaṇaiḥ || 2 || evaṃ jñātvā tu tatrasthā bhaginī tasya duḥkhitā || citrā nadī tato bhūtvā svasā tasya mahātmanaḥ || 3 || praviṣṭā sāgare devi anveṣantī ca bāṃdhavam || tataścitrapathānāma tasyāścakrurdvijātayaḥ || 4 || evaṃ tatra samutpannā sā nadī varavarṇini || 5 || tasyāṃ snātvā naro yastu citrādityaṃ prapaśyati || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ || 6 || asminkaliyuge devi aṃtardhānaṃ gatā nadī || prāvṛṭkāle ca dṛśyeta durlabhaṃ tatra darśanam || 7 || snānaṃ dānaṃ viśeṣeṇa sarvapātakanāśanam || 8 || bhukto vāpyathavā'bhukto rātrau vā yadi vā divā || parvakāle'thavā'kāle pavitro'pyathavā'śuciḥ || 9 || yadaiva dṛśyate tatra nadī citrapathā priye || pramāṇaṃ darśanaṃ tasyā na kālastatra kāraṇam || 7.1.140.10 || dṛṣṭvā nadīṃ mahādevi pitaraḥ svargasaṃsthitāḥ || gāyaṃti tatra sāmāni nṛtyanti ca hasaṃti ca || 11 || asmākaṃ vaṃśajaḥ kaścicchrāddhamatra kariṣyati || yāvatkalpaṃ tathā'smākaṃ prītimutpādayiṣyati || 12 || evaṃ jñātvā narastatra snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca kārayet || sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ pitṝṇāṃ prītaye tathā || || 13 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi yathā citrapathā nadī || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya saṃsthitā pāpanāśinī || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citrapathānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||| || 140 || || cha ||
<7.1.141>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kapardī yatra saṃsthitaḥ || tasyaiva uttare bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ || ciṃtitārthaprado devi cintāmaṇirivāparaḥ || 1 || caturthyāṃ taṃ tu deveśi aṃgārakadine punaḥ || snāpayitvā tu saṃpūjya naivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || santarpya vighnarājeśaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapardicintāmaṇimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 141 || cha ||
<7.1.142>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi citreśvara manuttamam|| dhanuṣāṃ saptake tasya sthitamāgneyadakṣiṇe || 1 || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam || tatra citreśvaraṃ pūjya narakānna bhavedbhayam || 2 || paṭasthitaṃ tasya pāpaṃ citro mārjayati priye || tasmātsarvaprayatnena citreśaṃ pūjayetsadā || yaḥ syātpāpayuto vāpi narakaṃ naiva paśyati || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye citreśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 142 || || cha ||
<7.1.143>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vicitreśvaramuttamam || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidāgneyagocare || dhanuṣāṃ daśake tatra sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || vicitreṇa mahādevi lekha kena yamasya ca || sthāpitaṃ tanmahāliṃgaṃ tapaḥ kṛtvā suduścaram || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjitaṃ caiva muktaḥ syātsarvapātakaiḥ || saṃpūjya ca vidhānena na duḥkhī jāyate naraḥ || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye vicitreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 143 || || cha ||
<7.1.144>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tṛtīyaṃ puṣkaraṃ mahat || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidīśānagocare || kanīyaḥ saṃsmṛtaṃ kuṃḍaṃ puṣkaraṃnāma nāmataḥ || 1 || yatra madhyāhnasamaye brahmaṇā samupāsitā || sandhyā trailokyajananī pratiṣṭhārthaṃ gatena ca || 2 || tatra yaḥ kurute snānaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ || samyakkṛtaṃ bhavettena snānaṃ tatrādipuṣkare || 3 || hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ sarvapāpāpanuttaye || 4 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ tava pauṣkaram || śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkarakuṇḍamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 144 ||
<7.1.145>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedvighneśaṃ pāpanāśanam || gajakuṃbhodaraṃ nāma sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 1 || tatra kuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā caturthyāṃ prayatātmavān || pūjayedyastu taṃ bhaktyā vighneśastasya tuṣyati || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gajakuṃbhodaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvā riṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 145 || || cha || |
<7.1.146>
| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi dharmarājapratiṣṭhitam || yameśvaraṃ mahādevaṃ tasyai vottarataḥ sthitam || 1 || yadā śapto dharmarājaśchāyayā varavarṇini || tadā tasyāpatatpādaḥ sa ca duḥkhānvito'bhavat || 2 || tataḥ prābhāsike kṣetre tapastepe mahātapāḥ || sthāpayāmāsa liṃgaṃ tu tatra devasya śūlinaḥ || 3 || tasya tuṣṭo mahādevastataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || abravīddharma bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya cepsitam || 4 || tadā'bravīddharmarājaḥ pādaḥ prapatito mama || prasādāttava deveśa jāyatāṃ punareva hi || 5 || etalliṃgaṃ suraśreṣṭha yanmayā nirmitaṃ tava || etadye bhaktisaṃyuktāḥ paśyaṃti prāṇino bhuvi || 6 || teṣāṃ tava prasādena bhūyātpāpavimokṣaṇam || 7 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktā hyantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ || yamo'pi labdhapādastu punareva divaṃ yayau || 8 || tasmindṛṣṭe suraśreṣṭha yamalokasamudbhavam || na bhayaṃ vidyate nṛṇāmapi duṣkṛtakāriṇām || || 9 || bhrātṛdvitīyāsaṃyoge snātvā puṣkariṇījale || yameśvarasamīpastho yameśamavalokayet || 7.1.146.10 || tilapātraṃ pradātavyaṃ dīpaṃ gāḥ kāṃcanā dikam || yamadevaṃ samuddiśya mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 146 || || cha ||
<7.1.147>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi brahmakuṇḍamanuttamam || tasyaiva nairṛte bhāge brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ purā || 1 || yadā tu ṛkṣarājena somanāthaḥ prati ṣṭhitaḥ || tadā brahmādayo devāḥ sarve tatra samāgatāḥ || pratiṣṭhārthaṃ hi devasya śaśāṃkena nimantritāḥ || 2 || athā'bravīnniśānātho brahmāṇaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 3 || kṛtaṃ bhavadbhirjānāti sthāpanaṃ vai yathā janaḥ || tathā kuru suraśreṣṭha cihnamātmasamudbhavam || 4 || evaṃ śrutvā tadā brahmā dhyānaṃ kṛtvā tu niścalam || āhvayatsarvatīrthāni puṣkarādīni sarvaśaḥ || 5 || svarge vai yāni tīrthāni tathaiva ca rasātale || tapaḥsāmarthyayogena brahmaṇā ''karṣitāni ca || atastasyaiva nāmnā tu brahmakuṇḍaṃ tu gīyate || 6 || gaṇānāṃ ca sahasraistu caturdaśabhirīkṣyate || ataścābhaktiyuktānāṃ duṣprāpyaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 7 || athābravītsarvadevānbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 8 || atra kuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā yaḥ pitṝṃstarpayiṣyati || agniṣṭomaphalaṃ sava lapsyate sa ca mānavaḥ || tatprasādātsvargaloke vimānena cariṣyati || 9 || godānaṃ cāśvadānaṃ ca tathā svarṇakamaṇḍalum || dadyādviprāya viduṣe sarvapāpāpanuttaye || 7.1.147.10 || paurṇamāsyāṃ mahādevi tathā ca pratipaddine || sarvapāpavināśārthaṃ tatra snāti sarasvatī || 11 || siddhaṃ rasāyanaṃ devi tatra vai hyudakaṃ priye || nānāvarṇasamāyuktamupadeśena siddhyati || 12 || dāridryaduḥkharukchokānmānavaḥ sevate katham || brahmakuṇḍamanuprāpya kalpavṛkṣamivāparam || || 13 || || devyuvāca || || bhagavanvistarādbrūhi brahmakuṇḍamahodayam || sarvaprāṇihitārthāya vistarādvada me prabho || 14 || brahmakuṃḍasya māhātmyaṃ śrotuṃ me kautukaṃ mahat|| lokānāṃ duḥkhanāśāya dāridyakṣayahetave || 15 || bhagavanmānuṣāḥ sarve duḥkhaśokanipīḍitāḥ || bhramaṃti sakalaṃ janma rasāyanavimohitāḥ || 16 || teṣāṃ hitāya me brūhi nirvāṇaṃ rasamuttamam || ādāviha śarīraṃ tu akṣayyaṃ tu yathā bhavet || 17 || aṣṭasiddhisamā yuktaṃ sarvavidyāsamanvitam || kāmarūpaṃ kriyāyuktaṃ sarvavyādhivivarjitam || 18 || tatastu paramaṃ deva nirvāṇaṃ yena vai labhet || mānavaḥ kṛtakṛtyaśca jāyate ca yathā prabho || 19 || tathā kathaya me deva dayāṃ kṛtvā jagatprabho || nirvāṇaparamaṃ kalpaṃ sarvabhrāṃtivivarjitam || prasiddhaṃ sukhadaṃ divyaṃ samā cakṣva maheśvara || 7.1.147.20 || || īśvara uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahādevi lokānāṃ hitakāriṇi || martyaloke mahādevi tīrthaṃ(?) tīrthavaraṃ śubham || || 21 || prabhāsaṃ paramaṃ khyātaṃ tacca dvādaśayojanam || tatra someśvaro devastriṣu lokeṣu viśrutaḥ || 22 || tasya pūrve samākhyātaḥ śrīkṛṣṇo daityasūdanaḥ || caṇḍikā yoginī tatra sakhībhiḥ parivāritā || 23 || tataḥ pūrve diśāṃ bhāge caturvaktreṇa nirmitam || tīrthāttīrthaṃ varaṃ divyaṃ sarvāścaryamayaṃ śubham || 24 || sevitaṃ sarvadevaistu siddhaiḥ sādhyairgrahaistathā || apsaromunibhirdivyairyakṣaiśca pannagaiḥ sadā || 25 || siddhyarthaṃ sarvakāmārthaṃ divyabhogāvahaṃ śubham || brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ brahmaṇā nirmitaṃ yataḥ || 26 || tasya vāyavyakoṇe tu hira ṇyeśaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ || tamārādhya mahādevaṃ hiraṇyeśvaramuttamam || 27 || mahāmantraṃ japetkṣipraṃ daśāṃśaṃ homayetsudhīḥ || homena siddhyate mantraḥ satyaṃ satyaṃ varānane || 28 || tasyottare tu digbhāge kiñcidīśānamāśritaḥ || caturvaktro mahādevi kṣetrapo liṃgarūpadhṛk || 29 || tatsthānaṃ rakṣate devi liṃgarūpeṇa śaṃkaraḥ || tamārādhya prayatnena tataḥ kuṇḍaṃ samāśrayet || 7.1.147.30 || sarvaiśvaryamayaṃ devi nānāvarṇavicitritam || kuṇḍasyāsyeśadigbhāge bhairaveśvaramuttamam || 31 || durgandhā bhāsurā devi vahate rasarūpiṇī || tasyā rasena saṃyuktaṃ pṛthagvarṇaṃ hi karburam || 32 || meghavarṇaṃ mahādivyaṃ rājataṃ ca punaḥ śubham || kapilaṃ dugdhavarṇaṃ ca karpūrābhaṃ suśobhanam || 33 || kadā kastūrikābhāsaṃ kuṃkumacchavikāvaham || saugandhaṃ caṃdanopetaṃ kadācidraudhi rodakam || 34 || ete rasāśca vividhā dṛśyaṃte tatra sarvadā || yasya tuṣṭo mahādevaḥ siddhyate tasya tatkṣaṇāt || 35 || rajataṃ kṣipyate tatra suvarṇa miva jāyate || pratyakṣameva tatraiva rasāyanamanuttamam || 36 || paśyaṃti mānavā devi kautukaṃ tatkṣaṇādbhṛśam || rasaṃ hi paramaṃ divyaṃ tatrasthaṃ ca kalau yuge || 37 || siddhaṃ siddharasaṃ puṃsāṃ vyādhīnāṃ kṣayakārakam || hemabījamayaṃ divyaṃ brahmakuṇḍodbhavaṃ mahat || 38 || idānīṃ te pravakṣyāmi manuṣyāṇāṃ hitāya vai || dāridryaṃ kṣayamāpnoti tatkṣaṇācca yaśasvini || 39 || ādāveva prakurvanti tāmrakumbhaṃ dṛḍhaṃ śubham || tīrthodakaṃ kṣipettatra patraistāmrastathā yutam || 7.1.147.40 || nikṣipya bhūmau tatkumbhaṃ jvālayedanalaṃ tataḥ || cuhlīrūpeṇa ṣaṇmāsaṃ pācayettaṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 41 || paścāduddhṛtya taṃ kumbhaṃ punareva jalaṃ kṣipet || māsamekaṃ punaḥ kuryānmāsamekaṃ punarbhṛśam ||42|| tataḥ sarvāṇi khaṇḍāni ekīkṛtya prayatnataḥ || punarevodakenaiva plāvya cāvartayetpunaḥ || ||43|| kāṃcanaṃ jāyate tatra yadi tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ ||44|| siddhiṃ śarīrajāṃ devi yadīcchenmānavottamaḥ || sa snānamāditaḥ kṛtvā saṃvatsaratrayaṃ punaḥ || || 45 || maunena niyamenaiva mahāmaṃtrajapānvitaḥ || pūjayecca hiraṇyeśaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ prayatnataḥ ||46|| paṃcopacārasaṃyuktaṃ dhyānadhāraṇasaṃyutam || tīrthodakena pākaṃ vai peyaṃ tadvadudumbare ||47|| evaṃ varṣatrayeṇaiva divyadehaḥ prajāyate || tejasvī valavānprājñaḥ sarvavyādhivivarjitaḥ ||48 || jīvedvarṣeśatānyeva trīṇi duḥkhavivarjitaḥ || varṣatrayamavicchinnaṃ yastatra snānamācaret ||49|| vāgīśvarīṃ japennityaṃ pūjāhomasamanvitaḥ || tasya pravartate vāṇī siddhiḥ sārasvatī bhavet ||7.1.147.50|| saṃskṛtaṃ prākṛtaṃ caivāpabhraṃśaṃ bhūtabhāṣitam || gāṃgasrotaḥpravāheṇa udgiredgiramātmavān || aśrāntāṃ ca varārohe hyavicchinnāṃ ca saṃtatam ||51|| vadedvādisahasraistu na śramastasya jāyate || tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa sarvaśāstraviśāradāḥ || 52 || paṃḍitā garvitāḥ sarve tarkaśāstraviśāradāḥ || āgacchanti samaṃ tāta vidyayoddhatakandharāḥ || na śaknuvaṃti te vaktuṃ draṣṭuṃ vaktramapi priye || 53 || vādināṃ ca sahasrāṇi bhanaktyevaṃ nirīkṣaṇāt || 54 || udvāhayati śāstrāṇi vibuddhārthāni satvaram || vimalaṃ pāñcarātraṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ śaivameva ca || 55 || itihāsapurāṇaṃ ca bhūtataṃtraṃ ca gāruḍam || bhairavaṃ ca mahātaṃtraṃ kulamārgaṃ dvidhā priye || 56 || rathapravaravegena vāṇī cāskhalitā bhavet || naśyaṃti vādinaḥ sarve garuḍasyeva pannagāḥ || 57 || na dāridryaṃ na rogaśca na duḥkhaṃ mānasaṃ punaḥ || rājamānyo mahāmānī bhavedbrahmaprasādataḥ || 58 || utsāhabalasaṃyukto devavajjīvate sudhīḥ || dātā bhoktā ca vāggmī ca tīrthasyāsya prasādataḥ || 59 || tailābhyaktasya yattejo jāyate manujeṣu ca || snātamātre tathā tejastīrthasyaiva prasādataḥ || 7.1.147.60 || yatpāpaṃ kurute jaṃtuḥ paiśunyaṃ ca kṛtaghnatām || mitradrohe ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ pāradārikam || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti kuṃḍasnānaratasya ca || 61 || muśalaṃ laṅghayed yastu yo gāstyajati vai dvijaḥ || tatpāpaṃ kṣayamāpnoti brahmakuṇḍasya darśanāt || 62 || pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni daivatāni tathā punaḥ || pūjitāni ca sarvāṇi kuṇḍasnānaprabhāvataḥ || 63 || saptajanmārjitaṃ pāpaṃ darśanātkṣayamāvrajet || 64 || yatpāpaṃ gurugoghne ca parasvaharaṇeṣu ca || tatpāpaṃ kṣayamāpnoti brahmakuṇḍaniṣevaṇāt || 65 || pradakṣiṇaṃ ca yaḥ kuryātsnātvā kuṇḍasya nāmataḥ || saṃkhyayā paṃcadaśa vai śṛṇu tasyāpi yatphalam || 66 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtā tena saptadvīpā vasundharā || saptapātālasahitā tīrthakoṭibhirāvṛtā || 67 || āhāramātraṃ yo dadyāttatra vedavidāṃ vare || lakṣabhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 68 || brahmeśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya hiraṇyeśvaramuttamam || kṣetrapālaṃ caturvaktraṃ pūjayeccintitaṃ labhet || 69 || ekaviṃśatkulai ryuktaḥ sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ || brahmalokaṃ sa vai yāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 7.1.147.70 || viraṃcikuṇḍe snātvā vā yo japedvedamātaram || lakṣajāpyavidhānena sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 71 || sa eva puṇyakarttā ca sa eva puruṣottamaḥ || yātrā tatra kṛtā yena brahmakuṇḍe varānane || 72 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām || brahmakuṇḍaṃ samāśritya brahmadevamupāsate || 73 || tāvadgarjaṃti tīrthāni trailokye sacarācare || yāvadbrahmeśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ na paśyanti narāḥ priye || 74 || brahmakuṇḍe ca pānīyaṃ ye pibanti narāḥ sakṛt || na teṣāṃ saṃkrametpāpaṃ vācikaṃ mānasaṃ tanau || 75 || brahmāṃḍottaramadhye tu yāni tīrthāni saṃti vai || teṣāṃ puṇyamavāpnoti brahmakuṇḍe pradakṣiṇāt || 76 || yājñavalkyo mahātmā ca parabrahmasvarūpavān || so'pi kuṃḍaṃ na muṃceta nikuṃ bhastu gaṇastathā || 77 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ brahmakuṇḍajam || tava snehena deveśi kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 78 || ya idaṃ śṛṇuyānmartyaḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairbrahmalokaṃ ca gacchati || 79 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 147 || || cha ||
<7.1.148>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kūpaṃ kuṃḍalasaṃbhavam || tasyaiva cottare bhāge brahmakuṇḍasamīpataḥ || 1 || yatra siddho mahādevi rūpakuṃḍalahārakaḥ || tatra snātvā naro devi mucyetsteyakṛtādaghāt || 2 || sapta janmāni deveśi na tasyānvayasaṃbhavaḥ || cauraḥ kaścidbhavetkrūrastatra snānaprabhāvataḥ || 3 || śivarātryāṃ viśeṣeṇa piṃḍadānādikāṃ kriyām || kuryācchastrahatānāṃ ca pāpināṃ tatra muktaye || 4 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ kuṇḍalarūpaṃ tu pṛthivyāṃ khyātimāgatam || etatkathaya me deva vistarādvadatāṃ vara || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi mahāpuṇyāṃ kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśanīm || yāṃ śrutvā mucyate pāpānnaro janmaśatārjitāt || 6 || prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyācchivarātryāmupoṣitaḥ || āsītsudarśano rājā pṛthivyāmekarāṭ sudhīḥ | || 7 || dhanyo hi sa dhanāḍhyaśca prajāṃ yatnairapālayat || rājyaṃ tasya susaṃpannaṃ brāhmaṇairupaśobhitam || samṛddhamṛddhisaṃyuktaṃ viṭataskaravarjitam || 8 || tasmiñjanapade ramye purī bhagavatī śubhā || cāturvarṇyasamāyuktā puraprākāramaṃḍitā || 9 || tasminpuravare ramye rājyaṃ nihatakaṇṭakam || karoti bāndhavaiḥ sārddhamṛddhiyuktaḥ sudarśanaḥ || hiraṇyadattasya suto jāto gāṃdhārakanyayā || 7.1.148.10 || tasya bhāryā priyā sādhvī bhartṛvrataparāyaṇā || sunaṃdā nāmavikhyātā kāśirājasutā śubhā || 11 || tayā sārdhaṃ hi rājendro bhogānsa bubhuje sadā || bhuṃjamānasya bhogānvai cirakālo gatastadā ||12|| akarotsa mahāyajñāndadau dānāni bhūriśaḥ || evaṃ kālo gatastasya bhāryayā saha suvrate || 13 || kadācinmāghamāse tu śivarātryāṃ varānane || sasmāra pūrvajātiṃ sa bhāryāmāhūya cābravīt || 14 || || sudarśana uvāca || || śivarātrivrataṃ devi mayā kāryaṃ varānane || vratasyāsya prabhāvena prāptaṃ rājyaṃ mayā kila || 15 || ||rājñyuvāca || || mahānprabhāvo rājendra evamuktaṃ tvayā mama || etanme kāraṇaṃ brūhi āścaryaṃ hṛdi vartate || 16|| || || rājovāca || || śṛṇu tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ śivarātrimupoṣaṇāt || tasmiñchivapure ramye svargadvāre suśobhane||17|| āditīrthe prabhāse tu kāmike tīrtha uttame || 18|| ṛddhiyukte pure tasminnityaṃ dharmānusevite || śivarātryāṃ gato rājñi tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ || 19|| mānavāstatra ye kecitpurarāṣṭrani vāsinaḥ|| tatrāgatā varārohe śivarātryāmupoṣitum || 7.1.148.20 || dhananāmā vaṇikkaścittatraiva vasate sadā || dhanāḍhyaḥ sa tu dharmātmā sadā dharmaparāyaṇaḥ || ||21 || sa bhāryāsahitastatra śivarātrimupoṣitaḥ || tasya bhāryā'bhavatsādhvī rūpayauvanasaṃvṛtā || 22 || pracalanmekhalāhārā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || sa tayā bhāryayā sārdhaṃ kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ ||23|| prabhāsasyāgrato bhūtvā snātaḥ śuklāṃbaraḥ śuciḥ || yathoktena vidhānena bhaktyā nidrāvivarjitaḥ ||24|| tatrāhaṃ caurarūpeṇa pāpaḥ stainyaṃ samāśritaḥ || sacchūdrāṇāṃ kule jāto devabrāhmaṇapūjakaḥ || 25 || pūrvakarmānusaṃyogādvikarmaṇi rataḥ sadā || tasyāṃ rātryāmahaṃ tatra janamadhye tu
