saṃsthitaḥ || 26 || kuṇḍalīnaḥ sthitastatra raṃdhrāpekṣī varānane || vaṇijastasya bhāryāyāśchidrānveṣaṇatatparaḥ || 27 || sā rātrirjāgratastasya gatā me vijane tathā || gītanṛtyādinirghoṣairvedamaṃgalapāṭakaiḥ || 28 || tālaśabdaistathā bandhaiḥ pustakānāṃ ca vācakaiḥ || evaṃ rātryāṃ tu śeṣāyāṃ yāvattiṣṭhati tatra vai || 29 || nirodhena samāyuktā pīḍyamānā śucismitā || dhanibhāryā nirodhārtā devāgārādbahirgatā || 7.1.148.30 || tasyāḥ karṇau troṭayitvā pupluve'haṃ jale sthitaḥ || tataḥ kolāhalastatra kṛtastatpuravāsibhiḥ || 31 || śrutvā kolāhalaṃ śabdaṃ karṇatroṭanajaṃ tadā || dhāvitā rakṣakāstatra rājaśāsanakārakāḥ || 32 || tairahaṃ śastrahastaiśca ulkāhastaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || nirīkṣito'tha na prāptaṃ suvarṇaṃ manmukhe sthitam || || 33 || khaḍgena tīkṣṇadhāreṇa chittvā śīrṣaṃ tadā mama || ulkāhastā nirīkṣanto nāpaśyansvarṇamaṇvapi || 34 || hitvā māṃ te gatāḥ sarve gatvā rājñe nyavedayan || na kiñcittatra saṃprāptaṃ hato'smābhiśca tatkṣaṇāt || 35 || kathayitvā tu te sarve yathādeśaṃ gatāḥ punaḥ || tato vai bandhunā tatra bhayabhītena cetasā || 36 || nikhātaṃ mama tatraiva śiraḥ kāyena saṃyutam || khātaṃ kṛtvā priye tatra brahmatīrthasya cottare || 37 || pihito'haṃ tu tatraiva prabhāse tīrtha uttame || śivarātriprabhāvena tajjātismaratāṃ gataḥ || 38 || rājyaṃ niṣkaṇṭakaṃ prāptaṃ samṛddhaṃ varavarṇini || etatprabhāsamāhātmyaṃ śivarātrerupoṣaṇāt || etatphalaṃ mayā labdhaṃ gatvā tasmādupoṣaye || 39 || || rājñyuvāca || || gacchāvastatra yatraiva kapālaṃ patitaṃ tava || sphoṭite ca kapāle ca hiraṇyaṃ dṛśyate yadi || pratyayo me bhavetpaścāttava vākyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 7.1.148.40 || || rājovāca || || kalpaṃ hi tiṣṭhate cāsthi yāvadbhūmiviparyayaḥ || uttiṣṭha vraja bhadraṃ te prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || 41 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā yadrājñā samudīritam || gamanāya matiṃ cakre śivarātryā upoṣaṇe || 42 || tato'śvairjavanaiyurktaṃ rathaṃ hemavibhūṣitam || āsthāya saha patnyā ca prabhāsaṃ kṣetrameyivān || 43 || vrataṃ kṛtvā prabhāse tu yathoktaṃ varavarṇini || brahmatīrthe samāgatya uddhṛtya sakalaṃ tataḥ ||44|| hiraṇyaṃ darśayāmāsa sphoṭayitvā śavaṃ svayam || 45 || || īśvara uvāca || || jātasaṃpratyayā bhāryā tasya rājño babhūva ha || jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra kalyāṇamuttamam || 46 || jano'pi vismitaḥ sarvo dṛṣṭvā citraṃ tadadbhutam || || 47 || nadī citrapathānāma tatrotpannā varānane || citrādityasya pūrveṇa brahmatīrthasya cottare || 48 || tasyāṃ tattiṣṭhate tatra sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || || 49 || śrāvaṇe māsi saṃprāpte tasminkūpe vidhānataḥ || yaḥ snānaṃ kurute devi śrāddhaṃ tatra viśeṣataḥ || 7.1.148.50 || citrādityaṃ tu saṃpūjya śivaloke mahīyate || 51 || etatte kathitaṃ sarvaṃ śivarātryā mahatphalam || bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 52 || ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvāpi mānavaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto rudraloke mahīyate || 53 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye kuṇḍalakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 148 || || cha ||
<7.1.149>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bhairaveśvaramuttamam || brahmakuṇḍasya īśāne sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || caturvaktraṃ mahādevaṃ saṃsthitaṃ tīrtharakṣaṇe || 1 || tatra snātvā mahākuṇḍe yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || paṃcopacāravidhinā bhaktiyukto yatendriyaḥ || 2 || kulāni yānyatītāni bhaviṣyāṇi ca yāni vai || tārayetsa naro devi nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 3 || na cātra saṃbhavastasya vināśo naiva jāyate || vimānaiścarate nityaṃ divākarasamaprabhaiḥ || 4 || strīsahasrairvṛto nityaṃ krīḍate devava ddivi || 5 || etalliṃgaṃ mahādevi caturvaktraṃ mahāprabham || dṛṣṭvāpi tadvimucyeta sarvapāpaistu mānavaḥ ||6|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhairaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 149 || || cha || ||
<7.1.150>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato brahmeśvaraṃ gacchettasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ brahmakuṇḍasamīpataḥ || triṣu lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ gaṇairmama || 1 || tatra snātvā caturdaśyāmamāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivatkṛtvā brahmeśaṃ pūjayettataḥ || 2 || viprebhyaḥ kāṃcanaṃ dadyātprītaye śaṃkarasya ca || 3 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi labhate janmanaḥ phalam || vipulāṃ kīrtimāyāti modate brahmaṇā priye || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṃḍamāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśadu ttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 150 ||
<7.1.151>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge tṛtīyo bhairavaḥ sthita || brahmakuṇḍasamīpe tu sāvitryā saṃpratiṣṭhitaḥ || 1 || ārādhya tatra deveśaṃ devānāṃ prapitāmaham || vāyubhakṣā nirāhārā toṣayāmāsa śaṃkaram || 2 || tuṣṭaḥ prāheśvaro devi śaṃkarastāṃ varānanām || 3 || yo'sminkuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā malliṃgaṃ pūjayiṣyati || paurṇamāsyāṃ vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || 4 || dāsyaṃ tasya varā niṣṭānmanasā'bhīsitāñchubhān || 5 || mahāpātakayukto'pi mukto bhavati pātakaiḥ || sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sa bhūyādvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 6 || ityevamuktvā deveśi tato'ntardhānamāgataḥ || sāvitrī brahmaloke tu gatā saṃsthāpya śaṃkaram || 7 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ sāvitrīśamahodayam || śṛṇuyādyastu matimānsa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye sāvitrīśvarabhairavamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 151 || || cha ||
<7.1.152>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tṛtīyo bhairavaḥ proktaścaturthaṃ bhairavaṃ śṛṇu || brahmeśātpaścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || 1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarva kāmapradaṃ nṛṇām || nāradeśvaranāmānaṃ sthāpitaṃ nāradena vai || 2 || brahmaloke sthitaḥ pūrvaṃ nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || tatra dṛṣṭvā mahāvīṇāṃ divyāṃ taṃtryayutai ryutām || 3 || sarasvatyā vinirmuktāṃ brahmaloke mahāprabhām || tenāsau kautukāviṣṭo vādayāmāsa tāṃ tadā || 4 || taṃtrībhyo vādyamānābhyo brāhmaṇāḥ patitā bhuvi || sapta svarāste vikhyātā mūrcchitāḥ ṣaḍjakādayaḥ || 5 || tāndṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭo muktvā vīṇāṃ prayatnataḥ || papraccha devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ kimidaṃ kautukaṃ vibho || 6 || vādyamānāsu tantrīṣu patitā brāhmaṇā bhuvi || ka ete brāhmaṇā deva kiṃ mṛtā iva śerate || 7 || || brahmovāca || || ete svarā mahābhāga mūrcchitāḥ patitā bhuvi || ajñānavādanenaiva pāpaṃ jātaṃ tavādhunā || 8 || saptabrāhmaṇavidhvaṃsapātakaṃ te samā gatam || tasmācchīghraṃ vraja mune prabhāsaṃ kṣetramuttamam || 9 || samārādhaya deveśaṃ sarvapāpaviśuddhaye || ityukto nāradastatra saṃtapya ca muhurmuhuḥ || 7.1.152.10 || kṛtvā viṣādaṃ bahuśaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || tatraiva brahmakuṇḍaṃ tu samāsādya prayatnataḥ || 11 || bhairavaṃ pūjayāmāsa divyābdānāṃ śataṃ priye || tato niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā gītajñaścābhavattathā || 12 || tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ nāradeśvarabhairavam || khyātaṃ loke mahādevi sarvapātakanāśanam || 13 || ajñānādvādayedyastu vīṇāṃ caiva tathā svarān || sa tatpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ tatra gacchenmaheśvari || 14 || māghe māsi jitāhārastrikālaṃ yo'rcayettataḥ || nāradeśaṃ bhairavaṃ sa svargarāmāmanoharaḥ || 15 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye nāradeśvarabhairavamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 152 || || cha ||
<7.1.153>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyeśvaramuttamam || brahmakuṇḍasya vāyavye dhanuṣāṃ dvitaye sthitam || 1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam || kṛtasmarācca parato hyagnitīrthācca pūrvataḥ || 2 || yameśvarācca nairṛtye samudrasyottare tathā || tasya liṃgasya prāgbhāge brahmā tepe mahattapaḥ || ārādhayāmāsa tadā devadevaṃ trilocanam || 3 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo brahmanbrūhi varo mama || 4 || || brahmovāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yājayāmīti me matiḥ || sthānaṃ ca yanmahāpuṇyaṃ tanmamākhyātumarhasi || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || kṛtasmarādbrahmakuṃḍaṃ yameśātsāgarāvadhi || etadaṃtaramāsādya pāpī cāpi vimucyate || 6 || vahedviṣuvatī tatra sadā puṇyātmanāṃ nṛṇām || yatra tatra kuru vibho manasā te yathepsitam || 7 || ityuktaḥ sa tadā brahmā prārebhe yajñamuttamam || 8 || tato bhāgārthino devā indrādyāstatra cāgatāḥ|| ṛṣayo bhāgakāmāstu sarve tatra samāgatāḥ ||9|| tato yajñāgatebhyaḥ sa dakṣiṇāmadadātpunaḥ || tato'tha dakṣiṇā kṣīṇā dīyamānā yaśasvini || 7.1.153.10 || tato brahmā bahūdvigno dadhyau vai manasā tadā || baddhāñjalipuṭo bhūtvā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 11 || bhagavanvai virūpākṣa kraturnaiva samāpyate || dakṣiṇāhai(dai?)nyato deva na yāti paripūrṇatām || 12 || dakṣiṇāsahitāḥ sarve yathā yāṃti tathā kuru || pitāmahavacaḥ śrutvā kṛtvā dhyānaṃ tadā mayā || 13 || smṛtā sarasvatī devī devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || āgatā sā mahāpuṇyā uktā devī mayā tadā || 14 || padmayonerdhanaṃ kṣīṇaṃ kraturvai na samāpyate || tasmānmama prasādena bhava kāñcanavāhinī || 15 || sarasvatyāstataḥ srota utthitaṃ paścimāmukham || kāñcanānāṃ tu padmāni ucchritāni sahasraśaḥ || 16 || kāñcanena pravāheṇa toyaṃ sārasvataṃ śubham || daityasūdanamāsādya agnitīrthāvadhi priye || pūrayāmāsa padmaiśca koṭiśaśca samaṃtataḥ || 17 || kāñcanāni tu tānyeva dattvā vipreṣu dakṣiṇām || yajñaṃ nirvartayāmāsa hṛṣṭo brahmā dvijaiḥ saha || 18 || śeṣāṇi yāni padmāni tāni niḥkṣipya bhūtale || tadūrdhvaṃ sthāpayāmāsa ligaṃ tu kanakeśvaram|| 19 || tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya sarvadevanamaskṛtam || ṛṣibhyo dakṣiṇāṃ prādādekaikasya yathākramam || kāñcanānāṃ ca padmānāṃ pratyekamayutaṃ dadau ||7.1.153.20|| tataḥ śeṣāṇi padmāni nihitāni dharātale || brahmakuṇḍasya madhye tu nāpuṇyo labhate naraḥ ||21|| tatkuṇḍatoyamadyāpi nānāvarṇaṃ pradṛśyate || tatrādhaḥ padmasaṃyogānnīraṃ svarṇāyate kṣaṇāt || 22 || hiraṇmayāni padmāni adhaḥ kṛtvā prajāpatiḥ || liṃgamūrdhvaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya svayaṃ pūjitavāṃstadā || hiraṇyakamalairdivyairhiraṇyeśastato'bhavat || 23 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ tathā dāridryanāśanam || dṛṣṭvā hiraṇmayeśānaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 24 || māgha māse caturdaśyāṃ yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || pūjitaṃ tena sakalaṃ brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarācaram || 25 || sarvadānāni dattāni sarve devāśca toṣitāḥ || brahmāṇḍaṃ tena dattaṃ syādyena talliṃgamarcitam || 26 || etanmayā te kathitaṃ snehena varavarṇini || na kasyacinmayā''khyātaṃ mahāgopyaṃ varānane | 27 || ya idaṃ śṛyuyādbhaktyā paṭhedvā bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || sa gaccheddevalokaṃ tu muktaḥ sarvaistu pātakaiḥ || 28 || iti te cātivikhyātāḥ pavitrāḥ pañca bhairavāḥ || brahmakuṇḍasamīpasthāḥ kathitāstava sundari || 29 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye hiraṇyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 153 || ||
<7.1.154>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ pāpavimocanam || hiraṇyeśvaravāyavye dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || 1 || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ darśanātsparśanādapi || ādyaṃ liṃgaṃ mahādevi gāyatryā saṃpratiṣṭhitam || 2 || talliṃgaṃ samanuprāpya gāyatrīṃ japate tu yaḥ || brāhmaṇastu śucirbhūtvā mucyate duṣpratigrahāt || 3 || jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu daṃpatī yastu bhojayet || paridhāpya yathāśaktyā daurbhāgyairmucyate naraḥ || 4 || gaṃdhapuṣpopahāraiśca paurṇamāsyāṃ tu yo'rcayet || brāhmaṇyaṃ jāyate tasya sapta janmāni suṃdari || 5 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || brahmakuṇḍaprasādena sārātsārataraṃ priye || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmakuṇḍamāhātmye gāyatrīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥpañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 154 || || cha ||
<7.1.155>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ratneśvaramanuttamam || tatra taptvā tapo devi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || sthāpitaṃ tatra talliṃgaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ priye || 1 || ratnakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā yastaṃ pūjayate sadā || sarvopacārairbhaktyā sa prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ phalam || 2 || atra kṛtvā tapo ghoraṃ kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā || prāptaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ sarvadaityāntakārakam || 3 || etatsthānaṃ mahādevi sadā priyataraṃ mama || vasāmi tatra deveśi pralaye'pi na saṃtyaje || 4 || smṛtaṃ tadvaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ nāmnā devi sudarśanam || dhanvaṃtarāṇi ṣaṭtriṃśatsamaṃtātparimaṇḍalam || 5 || etadantaramāsādya ye kecitprāṇino'dhamāḥ || mṛtāḥ kālavaśāddevi te yāsyaṃti paraṃ padam || 6 || kāṃcanaṃ tatra garuḍaṃ pītāni vasanāni ca || viṣṇumuddiśya yo dadyātsa tu yātrāphalaṃ labhet || 7 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcapaṃcāśadu ttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 155 || ||cha|| ||
<7.1.156>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vainateyapratiṣṭhitam || ratneśvarāduttarato dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || 1 || vainateyaśca deveśi jñātvā kṣetraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā paṃcamyāṃ tu vidhānataḥ || na viṣaṃ kramate tasya sapta janmāni sarpajam || 3 || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || prāpnuyātsakalaṃ puṇyaṃ modate divi devavat || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmye garuḍe śvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 156 ||
<7.1.157>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi satyabhāmeśvaraṃ śubham || ratneśvarāddakṣiṇe tu dhanuṣāṃtaramāsthitam || 1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sthāpitaṃ satyabhāmayā || kṛṣṇasya kāntayā devi rūpaudāryasametayā || 2 || snātvā tadvaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ nṛṇāṃ pātakanāśanam || 3 || māghe māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ nārī vā puruṣo'pi vā || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 4 || daurbhāgyaduḥkhaśokebhyastathā vighnaiśca duḥkhitaḥ || mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ satyabhāmānvito bhavet || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye satyabhāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 157 ||
<7.1.158>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi anaṃgeśvaramuttamam || ratneśvarādagrataḥsthaṃ dhanuṣāntaramāsthitam || 1 || sthāpitaṃ kāmadevena talliṃgaṃ viṣṇusūnunā || jñātvā tadvaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ kalau pātakanāśanam || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā tu kāmadevasamo bhavet || svargavidyādharīṇāṃ ca jāyate cittamohakaḥ || 3 || tasyānvaye'pi na bhavetkurūpo durbhago'pi vā || 4 || tatrānaṃgatrayodaśyāṃ vratena varavarṇini || viśeṣārādhanaṃ tatra janmasāphalyakāraṇam || 5 || śayyādānaṃ tu dātavyaṃ tatra viprāya śīline || viśeṣādviṣṇubhaktāya samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmye'naṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapaṃcāśaduttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 158 || || cha ||
<7.1.159>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ratnakuṇḍamanuttamam || ratneśāddakṣiṇe bhāge dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitam || mahāpāpopaśamanaṃ viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ svayam || 1 || aṣṭakoṭīstu tīrthāni bhūdyo'ntarikṣagāṇi tu || samānīya tu kṛṣṇena tatra kṣiptāni bhūriśaḥ || 2 || gaṇānāṃ koṭirekā tu tatkuṇḍaṃ rakṣati priye || kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte duṣprāpyamakṛtātmabhiḥ || 3 || tatra snātvā mahādevi vidhidṛṣṭena karmaṇā || prāpnuyādaśvamedhasya phalaṃ śataguṇottaram || 4 || ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa piṃḍaṃ tatra pradāpayet || akṣayyāṃ tṛptimāyāṃti pitarastasya bhāmini || 5 || kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ tatra ekādaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ || vāñchitaṃ labhate devi yadi śraddhā dṛḍhā bhavet || 6 || deyāni pītavastrāṇi tathā dhenuḥ payasvinī || tatra viṣṇuṃ samuddiśya samyagyātrāphalāptaye || 7 || hemakuṇḍaṃ kṛte proktaṃ tretāyāṃ raupyanāmakam || dvāpare cakrakuṃḍaṃ tu ratnakuṃḍaṃ kalau smṛtam || 8 || pātālavāhinīgaṃgā srotāṃsi tatra bhūriśaḥ || samānītāni hariṇā tatra tiṣṭhaṃti bhāmini || 9 || tatra snānena deveśi sarvatīrthābhiṣecanam || 7.1.159.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ratneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||159||
<7.1.160>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi rājabhaṭṭārakaṃ param || raivantakaṃ sūryaputramaśvārūḍhaṃ mahābalam || 1 || saṃsthitaṃ kṣetramadhye tu sāvitryā nairṛte priye || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi sarvāpadbhyo vimucyate ||2|| ravivāreṇa saptamyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || tasyā'nvaye'pi no devi daridrī jāyate naraḥ||3|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena tamevārādhayenmanāk || nirvighnaṃ kṣetravāsārthaṃ rājā vā'śvavivṛddhaye || 4 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye raivaṃtakarājabhaṭṭārakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 160 ||cha|| ||
<7.1.161>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || īśāne lakṣmaṇeśācca dhanuṣāṃ ṣoḍaśe priye ||1|| ananteśvaranāmānamanantena pratiṣṭhitam || nāgarājena deveśi jñātvā kṣetraṃ tu pāvanam || 2 || yastu taṃ pūjayeddevi paṃcamyāṃ phālgune site || pañcopacāravidhinā jitāhāro jitendriyaḥ || 3 || na taṃ daśaṃti phaṇino daśa varṣāṇi paṃca ca || viṣaṃ na kramate devi dehe tvacarameva vā || 4 || tasmāttaṃ pūjayedyatnātpaṃcamyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 5 || tatrānaṃtavrataṃ kāryaṃ madhupāyasasaṃyutam || pāyasaṃ madhusaṃyuktaṃ deyaṃ viprāya bhojanam || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'nanteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 161 || || cha ||
<7.1.162>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasmāddakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || lakṣmaṇeśācca pūrvasmim̐lliṃgamaṣṭakuleśvaram || 1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ mahāviṣapraṇāśanam || pūjitaṃ siddhagandharvairvāñchitārthapradāyakam || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate martyaḥ kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ vidhānataḥ || sa muktaḥ pātakairghorairnāgaloke mahīyate || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'ṣṭakuleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttara śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 162 || || cha ||
<7.1.163>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasmātpūrveṇa saṃsthitam || nāsatyeśvaranāmānaṃ mahā kalmaṣanāśanam || 1 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāsatyeśvarāśvineśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 163 || || cha ||
<7.1.164>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasmātpūrveṇa saṃsthitam || mahāpāpaughaśamanaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam || 1 || aśvineśvaranāmānaṃ dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam || sarvarogapraśamanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sarvārthasādhakam || 2 || ye kecidrogiṇo loke teṣāṃ tadbheṣajaṃ mahat || māghamāse dvitīyāyāṃ darśanaṃ tasya durlabham || 3 || tasmātpaśyecca tadbhaktyā yadi śreyo'bhikāṃkṣitam || mahāpāpaughaśamanaṃ pūjitaṃ sarvakāmadam || 4 || iti liṅgadvayaṃ devi sūryaputrapratiṣṭhitam || tasminneva dine paśyetsaṃyatātmā narottamaḥ || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'śvineśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 164 || || cha ||
<7.1.165>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sāvitrīṃ lokamātaram || mahā pāpapraśamanīṃ someśādīśadiksthitām || 1 || saṃyatātmā naraḥ paśyettatra tāṃ niyatātmavān || 2 || brahmaṇā yaṣṭukāmena sāvitrī sahadharmiṇī || kṛtā tāṃ balato jñātvā gāyatrīṃ kopamāviśat || 3 || tataḥ saṃtyajya sā devī brahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam || sapatnīroṣasantaptā prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritā || 4 || tapaḥ karoti vipulaṃ devairapi suduḥsaham || tatra sthale sthitā devī sā'dyāpi priyadarśanā || 5 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || kimarthaṃ sā parityaktā sāvitrī brahmaṇā purā || gāyatrī ca kathaṃ prāptā kena cāsya niveditā || 6 || kīdṛśīṃ tāṃ ca gāyatrīṃ labdhavānpadmasaṃbhavaḥ || yastāṃ patnīṃ samutsṛjya tasyāmeva mano dadhau || 7 || kasya sā duhitā deva kimarthaṃ ca vivāhitā || etanme kautukaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 8 || || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāvitryāścaritaṃ mahat || yathā sā brahmaṇā tyaktā gāyatrī ca vivāhitā || 9 || purā buddhiḥ samutpannā brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ || iti vedā mayā proktā yajñārthaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.1.165.10 || yajñaiḥ saṃtarpitā devā vṛṣṭiṃ dāsyaṃti bhūtale || tataścauṣadhayaḥ sarvā bhaviṣyaṃti dharātale || 11 || tasmātsaṃjāyate śukraṃ śukrātsṛṣṭiḥ pravartate || sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ tato yajñaṃ karomyaham || 12 || dṛṣṭvā māṃ yajña āsaktaṃ ye ca viprā dharātale || te yajñānpracariṣyaṃti śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 13 || evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā yajñārthaṃ surasuṃdari || tīrthaṃ niveśayāmāsa puṣkaraṃ nāma nāmataḥ || 14 || yajñavāṭo mahāṃstatra āsīttasya mahātmanaḥ || tatra devarṣayaḥ sarve devāḥ sendrapurogamāḥ || 15 || samāyātā mahādevi yajñe paitāmahe tadā || puṇyāste'pi dvijaśreṣṭhāstatrartvijaḥ prajajñire || 16 || sāvitrī lokajananī patnī tasya mahātmanaḥ || gṛhakārye samāsaktā dīkṣā kālavyatikramāt || adhvaryuṇā samāhūtā sāvitrī vākyamabravīt || 17 || || sāvitryuvāca || || adyāpi na kṛto veṣo na gṛhe gṛhamaṇḍanam || lakṣmīrnādyāpi saṃprāptā na bhavānī na jāhnavī || 18 || na svāhā na svadhā caiva tathā caivāpyaruṃdhatī || indrāṇī devapatnyo'nyāḥ kathamekākinī vraje || 19 || uktaḥ pitāmaho gatvā pulastyena mahātmanā || sāvitrī deva nāyāti prasaktā gṛhakarmaṇi || 7.1.165.20 || tvatpatnī kimidaṃ karma phalena saṃpravartate || tacchrutvā dīkṣito vācaṃ śikhī muṃḍī mṛgājinī || 21 || patnīkopena saṃtaptaḥ prāha devaṃ puraṃdaram || 22 || gaccha madvacanācchakra patnīmanyāṃ kutaścana || gṛhītvā śīghramāgaccha na syātkālātyayo yathā || 23 || jagāma balahā tūrṇaṃ vacanātparameṣṭhinaḥ || apaśyamānaḥ kāṃcitstrīṃ yā yogyā haṃsavāhane || 24 || atha śāpādbibhītena sahasrākṣeṇa dhīmatā || dṛṣṭā gopālakanyaikā rūpayauvanaśālinī || 25 || bibhratī tatra pūrṇaṃ sā kumbhaṃ kanyetyacodayat || tāṃ gṛhītvā tataḥ śakraḥ samāyādyatra dīkṣitaḥ || devadevaścaturvaktro viṣṇurudrasamanvitaḥ || 26 || saṃpradānaṃ tu kṛtavānkanyāyā madhusūdanaḥ ||27|| preritaḥ śaṃkareṇaiva brahmā devarṣibhistathā|| pariṇīyatāṃ tato dīkṣāṃ tasyāścakre yathātmanaḥ ||28 || tataḥ pravartito yajñaḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ ||29|| atrirhotārcikastatra pulastyo'dhvaryureva ca|| udgātā'tho marīciśca brahmāhaṃ surapuṃgavaḥ||7.1.165.30|| sanatkumārapramukhāḥ sadasyāstasya nirmitāḥ|| vastrairābharaṇairyuktā mukuṭairaṃgulīyakaiḥ || 31 || bhūṣitā bhūṣaṇopetā ekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak || trayastrayaḥ pṛṣṭhato'nye te caivaṃ ṣoḍaśartvijaḥ ||32|| proktā bhavadbhi ryajñe'sminnanugṛhyo'smi sarvadā || patnī mameyaṃ gāyatrī yajñe'sminnanugṛhyatām || 33 || mṛduvastradharāṃ sākṣātkṣaumavastrāvaguṇṭhitām || niṣkramya patnīśālāta ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ || 34 || audumbareṇa daṇḍena saṃvṛto mṛgacarmaṇā || tayā sārdhaṃ praviṣṭaśca brahmā taṃ yajñamaṇḍapam ||35|| || īśvara uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu saṃprāptā devayoṣitaḥ || saṃprāptā yatra sāvitrī yajñe tasminnimaṃtritāḥ || 36 || bhṛgoḥ khyātyāṃ samutpannā viṣṇupatnī yaśasvinī || āmantritā sā lakṣmīśca tatrāyātā tvarānvitā || 37 || tatra devī mahābhāgā yoganidrādibhūṣitā || devī kāṃtistathā śraddhā dyutistuṣṭistathaiva ca || 38 || satī yā dakṣatanayā umā yā pārvatī śubhā || trailokyasundarī devī strīṇāṃ saubhāgyadāyakā ||39|| jayā ca vijayā caiva gaurī caiva mahādhanā || manojavā vāyupatnī ṛddhiśca dhanadapriyā || 7.1.165.40 || devakanyāstathā''yātā dānavyo danuvaṃśajāḥ || saptarṣīṇāṃ tathā patnya ṛṣīṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca || 41 || plavā mitrā duhitaro vidyādharagaṇāstathā || pitaro rakṣasāṃ kanyāstathā'nyā lokamātaraḥ || 42 || vadhūbhiścaiva mukhyābhiḥ sāvitrī gantumicchati || adityādyāstathā devyo dakṣakanyāḥ samāgatāḥ || 43 || tābhiḥ parivṛtā sārdhaṃ brahmāṇī kamalālayā || kāścinmodakamādāya kāścitpūpaṃ varānane || 44 || phalāni tu samādāya prayātā brahmaṇo'ntikam || āḍhakīścaiva niṣpāvānrājamāṣāṃstathā'parāḥ || 45 || dāḍimāni vicitrāṇi mātuliṃgāni śobhane|| karīrāṇi tathā cānyā gṛhītvā karamardakān||46|| kausuṃbhaṃ jīrakaṃ caiva kharjūraṃ cāparāstathā|| utatīścāparā gṛhya nālikerāṇi cāparāḥ||47|| drākṣayā pūritaṃ cāmraṃ śṛṅgārāya yathā purā|| karburāṇi vicitrāṇi jaṃbūkāni śubhāni ca||48|| akṣoḍāmalakāngṛhya jaṃbīrāṇi tathā parāḥ || bilvāni paripakvāni cirbhaṭāni varānane || 49 || annapānādhikārāṇi bahūni vividhāni ca || śarkarāputtalīṃ cānyā vastre kausumbhake tathā || 7.1.165.50 || evamādīni cānyāni gṛhya pūrve varānane || sāvitryā sahitāḥ sarvāḥ saṃprāptāstu tadā śubhāḥ || 51 || sāvitrīmāgatāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhītastatra puraṃdaraḥ || adhomukhaḥ sthito brahmā kimeṣā māṃ vadiṣyati || 52 || trapānvitau viṣṇurudrau sarve cānye dvijātayaḥ || sabhāsadastathā bhītāstathaivānye divaukasaḥ || 53 || putrapautrā bhāgineyā mātulā bhrātarastathā || ṛtavo nāma ye devā devānāmapi devatāḥ || 54 || vilakṣāstu tathā sarve sāvitrī kiṃ vadiṣyati || brahmavākyāni vācyāni kiṃ nu vai gopakanyayā || || 55 || maunībhūtāstu śṛṇvānāḥ sarveṣāṃ vadatāṃ giraḥ || adhvaryuṇā samāhūtā nāgatā varavarṇinī || 56 || śakreṇānyā tathā''nītā dattā sā viṣṇunā svayam || anumoditā ca rudreṇa pitrā dattā svayaṃ tathā || 57 || kathaṃ sā bhavitā yajñaḥ samāptiṃ vā kathaṃ vrajet || evaṃ cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ praviṣṭā kamalālayā || 58 || vṛto brahmā bhāryayā sa ṛtvigbhirvedapāragaiḥ || hūyante cāgnayastatra brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ || 59 || patnīśāle tathā gopī raupyaśṛṃgā samekhalā || kṣaumavastraparīdhānā dhyāyantī parameśvaram || 7.1.165.60 || pativratā patiprāṇā prādhānyena niveśitā || kṛpānvitā viśālākṣī tejasā bhāskaropamā || 61 || dyotayaṃtī sadastatra sūryasyeva yathā prabhā || jvalamānastathā vahnirbhramaṃte cartvijastathā || 62 || paśūnāmavadānāni gṛhṇaṃti dvijasattamāḥ || prāptā bhāgārthino devā vilaṃbasamayo'bhavat || 63 || kālahīnaṃ na kartavyaṃ kṛtaṃ na phaladaṃ bhavet || vedeṣvayamadhīkāro dṛṣṭaḥ sarvo manīṣibhiḥ || 64 || pravargye kriyamāṇe tu brāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ || kṣīradvaye hūyamāne maṃtreṇādhvaryuṇā tathā || 65 || upahūtopahūtena āgateṣu dvijanmasu || kriyamāṇe tathā bhakṣye dṛṣṭvā devī krudhānvitā || uvāca devī brahmāṇaṃ sadomadhye tu mauninam || 66 || kimevaṃ budhyate deva kṛtametadviceṣṭitam || māṃ parityajya yaḥ kāmātkṛtavānasi kilbiṣam || 67 || na tulyā pādarajasā samā sā'dhiśiraḥ kṛtā || 68 || yadvadaṃti narāḥ sarve saṃgatāḥ sadasi sthitāḥ || āścaryaṃ ca prabhūṇāṃ tu kurute yaṃ yamicchati || 69 || bhavatā rūpalobhena kṛtaṃ karma vigarhitam || 7.1.165.70 || na putreṣu kṛtā lajjā pautreṣu ca na te vibho || kāmakārakṛtaṃ manye hyetatkarma vigarhitam || 71 || pitāmaho'si devānāmṛṣīṇāṃ prapitāmahaḥ || kathaṃ na te trapā jātā ātmanaḥ paśyatastanum || 72 || lokamadhye kṛtaṃ hāsyamiha caiva vigarhitaḥ || yadyeṣa te sthito bhāvastiṣṭha deva namo'stu te ||73|| ahaṃ kathaṃ sakhīnāṃ tu darśayiṣyāmi vai mukham || bhartrā me vihitā patnī kathametadahaṃ vade || 74 || || brahmovāca || || ṛtvigbhirahamājñapto dīkṣā kālo'tivartate || patnīṃ vinā na homotra śīghraṃ patnīmihānaya || 75 || śakreṇaiṣā samānītā dattā caivā'tha viṣṇunā || gṛhītā ca mayā tvaṃ hi kṣamasvaikaṃ mayā kṛtam || na cāparādhyaṃ bhūyo'nyaṃ kariṣye tava suvrate || 76 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktā tadā kruddhā brahmāṇaṃ śaptumudyatā|| yadi me'sti tapastaptaṃ guravo yadi toṣitāḥ || 77 || sarvabrāhmaṇaśālāsu sthāneṣu vividheṣvapi || na tu te brāhmaṇāḥ pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti kadācana || || 78 || ṛte vai kārtikīmekāṃ pūjāṃ sāṃvatsarīṃ tava || kariṣyaṃti dvijāḥ sarve satyenānena te śape || etadbuddhvā na kopostu hato hanti na saṃśayaḥ || || 79 || || sāvitryuvāca || || bhobhoḥ śakra tvayānītā ābhīrī brahmaṇo'ntikam || yasmādīdṛkkṛtaṃ karma tasmāttvaṃ lapsyase phalam ||7.1.165.80|| yadā saṃgrāmamadhye tvaṃ sthātā śakra bhaviṣyasi || tadā tvaṃ śatrubhirbaddho nītaḥ paramikāṃ daśām || 81 || akiṃcano naṣṭasutaḥ śatrūṇāṃ nagare sthitaḥ|| parābhavaṃ mahatprāpya acirādeva mokṣyase || 82 || śakraṃ śaptvā tadā devī viṣṇuṃ cā'tha vacobravīt || 83 || guruvākyena te janma yadā martye bhavi ṣyati || bhāryāvirahajaṃ duḥkhaṃ tadā tvaṃ tatra bhokṣyase || 84 || hṛtāṃ śatrugaṇaiḥ patnīṃ pare pāre mahodadheḥ || na ca tvaṃ jñāyase sītāṃ śokopahacetanaḥ || 85 || bhrātrā saha parāṃ kāṣṭhāmāpadaṃ duḥkhitastathā || paśūnāṃ caiva saṃyogaścirakālaṃ bhaviṣyati || 86 || tathā''ha rudraṃ kupitā yadā dāruvane sthitaḥ || tadā te munayaḥ kruddhāḥ śāpaṃ dāsyaṃti te hara || 87 || bhobhoḥ kāpālika kṣudra patnyo'smākaṃ jihīrṣasi || tadetadbhūṣitaṃ liṃga bhūmau rudra patiṣyati || 88 || vihīnaḥ pauruṣeṇa tvaṃ muniśāpācca pīḍitaḥ || gaṃgātīre sthitā patnī sā tvāmāśvāsayiṣyati || 89 || agne tvaṃ sarvabhakṣo'si pūrvaṃ putreṇa me kṛtaḥ || bhrūṇahā dharma ityeṣa kathaṃ dagdhaṃ dahāmyaham || 7.1.165.90 || jātavedasa rudrastvāṃ retasā plāvayiṣyati || medhyeṣu ca kṛtajvālā jvālayā tvāṃ jvaliṣyati || 91 || brāhmaṇānṛtvijaḥ sarvānsāvitrī hyaśapattadā || 92 || pratigrahāgnihotrāśca vṛthā dārā vṛthāśramāḥ || sadā kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni lobhādeva gamiṣyatha || 93 || parānneṣu sadā tṛptā atṛptāḥ svagṛheṣu ca || ayājyayājanaṃ kṛtvā kutsitasya pratigraham || 94 || vṛthā dhanārjanaṃ kṛtvā vyavaścaiva tathā vṛthā || mṛtānāṃ tena pretatvaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 95 || evaṃ śakraṃ tathā viṣṇuṃ rudraṃ vai pāvakaṃ tathā || brahmāṇaṃ brāhmaṇāṃścaiva sarvāṃstānaśapattadā || 96 || śāpaṃ dattvā tathā teṣāṃ tadā sāvasthitā sthirā || 97 || lakṣmīḥ prāha sakhīṃ tāṃ ca indrāṇī ca varānanā || anyā devyastathā prāhuḥ sā''ha sthāsyāmi nātra vai || tatra cāhaṃ gamiṣyāmi yatra śroṣye na tu dhvanim || 98 || tatastāḥ pramadāḥ sarvāḥ prayātāḥ svaṃ niketanam || sāvitrī kupitā tāsāṃ punaḥ śāpāya codyatā || 99 || yasmānmāṃ saṃparityajya gatāstā devayoṣitaḥ || tāsāmapi tathā śāpaṃ pradāsye kupitā bhṛśam || 7.1.165.100 || naikatra vāso lakṣmyāstu bhaviṣyati kadācana || rudrāpi caṃcalā tāvanmūrkheṣu ca vasiṣyasi || 101 || mleccheṣu parvatīyeṣu kutsite kuṣṭhite tathā || vācāṭe cāvalipte ca abhiśaste durātmani || evaṃvidhe nare tubhyaṃ vasatiḥ śāpakāritā || 102 || śāpaṃ dattvā tatastasyā indrāṇīmaśapattadā || 103 || tvaṣṭurvācā gṛhītendre patyau te duṣṭakāriṇi || nahuṣāya gate rājye dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ yācayiṣyati || || 104 || ahamindraḥ kathaṃ caiṣā nopatiṣṭhati cālasā || sarvāndevānhaniṣyāmi lapsye nāhaṃ śacīṃ yadi || 105 || naṣṭā tvaṃ ca tadā śastā vane mahati duḥkhitā || vasiṣyasi durācāre śāpena mama garvite || 106 || devabhāryāsu sarvāsu tadā śāpamayacchata || 107 || na cāpatyakṛtā prītiḥ sarvāsveva bhaviṣyati || dahyamānā divārātrau vaṃdhyāśabdena duḥkhitāḥ ||108|| gaurīmevaṃ tathā śaptvā sā devī varavarṇinī || uccai ruroda sāvitrī bhartṛ yajñādbahiḥ sthitā || 109 || rodamānā tu sā dṛṣṭā viṣṇunā ca prasāditā || mā rodīstvaṃ viśālākṣi ehyāgaccha sadaḥ śubhe || 7.1.165.110 || praviṣṭā ca śubhe yāge mekhalāṃ kṣaumavāsasī || gṛhāṇa dīkṣāṃ brahmāṇi pādau te praṇame śubhe || 111 || evamuktā'bravīdenaṃ nāhaṃ kuryāṃ vacastava || tatrāhaṃ ca gamiṣyāmi yatra śroṣye na ca dhvanim || 112 || etāvaduktvā vyaramaduccaiḥ sthāne kṣitau sthitā || 113 || viṣṇustadagrataḥ sthitvā baddhvā ca karasaṃpuṭam || tuṣṭāva praṇato bhūtvā bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 114 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || namo'stu te mahādevi bhūrbhuvaḥsvastrayīmayi || sāvitri durgatariṇi tvaṃ vāṇī saptadhā smṛtā || 115 || sarvāṇi stutiśāstrāṇi lakṣaṇāni tathaiva ca || bhaviṣyā sarvaśāstrāṇāṃ tvaṃ tu devi namo'stu te || || 116 || śvetā tvaṃ śvetarūpāsi śaśāṃkena samānanā || śaśiraśmiprakāśena hariṇorasi rājase || divyakuṃḍalapūrṇābhyāṃ śravaṇābhyāṃ vibhūṣitā || || 117 || tvaṃ siddhistvaṃ tathā ṛddhiḥ kīrtiḥ śrīḥ saṃtatirmatiḥ || saṃdhyā rātri prabhātastvaṃ kālarātristvameva ca || 118 || karṣukāṇāṃ yathā sītā bhūtānāṃ dhāriṇī tathā || evaṃ stuvaṃtaṃ sāvitrī viṣṇuṃ provāca suvratā || 119 || samyakstutā tvayā putra ajeyastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || avatāre sadā vatsa pitṛmātṛsu vallabhaḥ || 7.1.165.120 || anena stavarājena stoṣyate yastu māṃ sadā || sarvadoṣavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ sthānaṃ gamiṣyati || 121 || gaccha yajñaṃ ciraṃ tasya samāptiṃ naya putraka || 122 || kurukṣetre prayāge ca bhaviṣye yajñakarmaṇi || samīpagā sthitā bhartuḥ kariṣye tava bhāṣitam || 123 || evamukto gato viṣṇurbrahmaṇaḥ sada uttamam || sāvitrī tu samāyātā prabhāse varavarṇini ||124|| gatāyāmatha sāvitryāṃ gāyatrī vākyamabravīt ||125|| śṛṇvaṃtu munayo vākyaṃ madīyaṃ bhartṛsannidhau || yadahaṃ vacmi saṃtuṣṭā varadānāya codyatā || 126 || brahmāṇaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti narā bhaktisamanvitāḥ || teṣāṃ vastraṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ dārāḥ saukhyaṃ sutāśca vai || 127 || avicchinnaṃ tathā saukhyaṃ gṛhaṃ vai putrapautrikam || bhuktvā'sau suciraṃ kālaṃ tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyati ||128|| śakrāhaṃ te varaṃ vacmi saṃgrāme śatrubhiḥ saha || tadā brahmā mocayitā gatvā śatruniketanam || 129 || saputraśatrunāśāttvaṃ lapsyase ca paraṃ mudam || akaṃṭakaṃ mahadrājyaṃ trailokye te bhaviṣyati || 7.1.165.130 || martyaloke yadā viṣṇo hyavatāraṃ kariṣyasi || bhrātrā saha paraṃ duḥkhaṃ svabhāryā haraṇaṃ ca yat || 131 || hatvā śatruṃ punarbhāryāṃ lapsyase surasannidhau || gṛhītvā tāṃ punaḥ prājyaṃ rājyaṃ kṛtvā gamiṣyasi || 132 || ekādaśa sahasrāṇi kṛtvā rājyaṃ punardivam|| khyātiste vipulā loke cānurāgo bhaviṣyati|| 133 || gāyatrī brāhmaṇāṃstāṃśca sarvānevābravīdidam ||134 || yuṣmākaṃ prīṇanaṃ kṛtvā' tṛptiṃ yāsyaṃti devatāḥ|| bhavaṃto bhūmidevā vai sarve pūjyā bhaviṣyatha || 135 || yuṣmākaṃ pūjanaṃ kṛtvā dattvā dānānyanekaśaḥ|| prāṇāyāmena caikena sarvametattariṣyatha||136|| prabhāse tu viśeṣeṇa japtvā māṃ vedamātaram|| pratigrahakṛtāndoṣānna prāpsyadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ||137 || puṣkare cānnadānena prītāḥ sarve ca devatāḥ || ekasminbhojite vipre koṭirbhavatibhojitā || 138 || brahmahatyādipāpāni duritāni ca yāni ca || tariṣyaṃti narāḥ sarve datte yuṣmatkare dhane || 139 || mahīyadhve tu jāpyena prāṇāyāmaistribhiḥ kṛtaiḥ || brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva naśyati || 7.1.165.140 || daśabhirjanmajanitaṃ śatena tu purā kṛtam || triyugaṃ tu sahasreṇa gāyatrī haṃti kilbiṣam || 141 || evaṃ jñātvā sadā pūjyā jāpye ca mama vai kṛte || bhaviṣyadhvaṃ na sandeho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 142 || oṃkāreṇa trimātreṇa sārdhena ca viśeṣataḥ || pūjyāḥ sarve na sandeho japtvā māṃ śirasā saha || 143 || aṣṭākṣarasthitā cāhaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ mayā tvidam || mātā'haṃ sarvavedānāṃ vedaiḥ sarvairalaṅkatā || 144|| jatvā māṃ paramāṃ sirddhi paśyanti dvijasattamāḥ || prādhānyaṃ mama jāpyena sarveṣāṃ vo bhaviṣyati || 145 || gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ|| nāyaṃtritaścaturvedaḥ sarvāśī sarvavikrayī||146|| yasmādbhavatāṃ sāvitryā śāpo datto sade tviha|| atra dattaṃ hutaṃ cāpi sarvamakṣayakārakam|| datto varo mayā tena yuṣmākaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 147 || agnihotraparā viprāstrikālaṃ homadāyinaḥ || svargaṃ te tu gamiṣyaṃti ekaviṃśatibhiḥ kulaiḥ || 148 || evaṃ śakre ca viṣṇau ca rudre vai pāvake tathā || brahmaṇo brahmaṇānāṃ ca gāyatrī sā varaṃ dadau || tasminkāle varaṃ dattvā brahmaṇaḥ pārśvagā'bhavat || 149 || hariṇā tu samākhyātaṃ lakṣmyāḥ śāpasya kāraṇam || yuvatīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ śāpastāsāṃ pṛthakpṛthak || 7.1.165.150 || lakṣmyāstadā varaṃ prādādgāyatrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā || 151 || akutsitāḥ sadā putri tava vāsena śobhane || bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ sarvebhyaḥ prītidāyakāḥ || 152 || ye tvayā vīkṣitāḥ sarve sarve vai puṇyabhājanāḥ || teṣāṃ jātiḥ kulaṃ śīlaṃ dharmaścaiva varānane || 153 || parityaktāstvayā ye tu te narā duḥkhabhāginaḥ || sabhāyāṃ te na śobhante manyante na ca pārthivaiḥ || 154 || āśiṣaścaiva teṣāṃ tu kurvate vai dvijottamāḥ || saujanyaṃ teṣu kurvanti naptā bhrātā pitā guruḥ || 155 || bāṃdhavo'si na saṃdeho na jīve'haṃ tvayā vinā || tvayi dṛṣṭe prasannā me dṛṣṭirbhavati śobhanā || manaḥ prasīdate'tyarthaṃ satyaṃsatyaṃ vadāmi te || 156 || evaṃvidhāni vākyāni tvayā dṛṣṭyā nirīkṣite || sajjanāste vadiṣyanti janānāṃ prītidāyakāḥ || 157 || indrāṇi nahuṣaḥ prāpya svargaṃ tvāṃ yācayiṣyati || adṛṣṭvā tu hataḥ pāpo agastyavacanāddrutam|| 158 || sarpatvaṃ samanuprāpya prārthayiṣyati taṃ munim || darpeṇāhaṃ vinaṣṭo'smi śaraṇaṃ me mune bhava || 159 || vākyena tena tasyāsau nṛpasya bhagavānṛṣiḥ || kṛtvā manasi kāruṇyamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 7.1.165.160 || utpatsyati kule rājā tvadīye kurunaṃdana || sārpaṃ kalevaraṃ dṛṣṭvā praśnaistvāmuddhariṣyati || 161 || so'pyajagaratāṃ tyaktvā punaḥ svargaṃ gamiṣyati || aśvamedhe kṛte bhartrā saha yāsi punardivi || prāpsyase vara dānena mamānena sulocane || 162 || devapatnyastadā sarvāstuṣṭayā paribhāṣitāḥ || apatyairapi hīnāḥ syurnaiva duḥkhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 163 || iti dattvā varāndevī gāyatrī lokasaṃmatā || jagāmādarśanaṃ devī sarveṣāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā || 164 || sāvitrī tu tadā devī prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatā || kṛtasmarasya śṛṅge tu śrīsomeśvarapūrvataḥ || 165 || manvantare cākṣuṣe ca dvitīye dvāpare śubhe || tatra yajñaḥ samārabdho brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || 166 || yajñe yātā mahātmāno devāḥ saptarṣayo varāḥ || svāyaṃbhuve tu ye śastāḥ śaptāste cābhavanpurā || 167 || tasmātkālātsamārabhya prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ || 168 || sāvitrī lokajananī lokānugrahakāriṇī || yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā pakṣamekaṃ niraṃtaram || brahmapūjāvidhānena tasya putro dhruvo bhavet || 169 || pāṇḍukūpe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā liṃgāni pañca vai || pāṇḍavaiḥ sthāpitānīha dṛṣṭvā yajñaphalaṃ labhet || 7.1.165.170 || jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sāvitrīsthalasaṃnidhau || paṭhedyo brahmasūktāni mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 171 || etatte sarvavikhyātamākhyātaṃ kalmaṣāpaham || yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā sa gacchetparamaṃ padam || 172 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāvitrīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaṣaṣṭyutaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 165 || || cha ||
<7.1.166>
|| devyuvāca || || prabhāse saṃsthitā yā tu sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā || tasyāścaritraṃ me brūhi devadeva jagatpate || 1 || vratamāhātmyasaṃyuktamitihāsasamanvitam || pāti vratyakaraṃ strīṇāṃ mahābhāgyaṃ mahodayam || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || kathayāmi mahādevi sāvitryāścaritaṃ mahat || prabhāsakṣetrasaṃsthāyāḥ sthala sthāne maheśvari || yathā cīrṇaṃ vratakaraṃ sāvitryā rājakanyayā || 3 || āsīnmadreṣu dharmātmā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || pārthivo'śvapatirnāma paurajānapada priyaḥ || 4 || kṣamāvānanapatyaśca satyavādī jitendriyaḥ || prabhāsakṣetrayātrāyāmājagāma sa bhūpatiḥ || yātrāṃ kurvanvidhānena sāvitrīsthalamāgataḥ || 5 || sa sabhāryo vratamidaṃ tatra cakre nṛpaḥ svayam || sāvitrīti prasiddhaṃ yatsarvakāmaphalapradam || 6 || tasya tuṣṭā'bhavaddevi sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā || bhūrbhuvaḥsvaritītyeṣā sākṣānmūrtimatī sthitā || 7 || kamaṃḍaludharā devī jagāmādarśanaṃ punaḥ || kālena vahunā jātā duhitā devarūpiṇī || 8 || sāvitryā prītayā dattā sāvitryāḥ pūjayā tathā || sāvitrītyeva nāmā'syāścakre viprājñayā nṛpaḥ|| 9 || sā vigrāhavatīva śrīḥ prāvardhata nṛpātmajā || sāvitrī sukumārāṃgī yauvanasthā babhūva ha || 7.1.166.10 || yā sumadhyā pṛthuśroṇī pratimā kāñcanī yathā || prāpteyaṃ devakanyā vā dṛṣṭvā tāṃ menire janāḥ || || 11 || sā tu padmā viśālākṣī prajvalatīva tejasā || cacāra sā ca sāvitrī vrataṃ yadbhṛguṇoditam ||12|| athopoṣya śiraḥsnātā devatāmabhigamya ca || hutvāgniṃ vidhivadviprānvācayedvaravarṇinī ||13|| tebhyaḥ sumanasaḥ śeṣāṃ pratigṛhya nṛpātmajā|| sakhīparivṛtā'bhyetya devī śrīvatsarūpiṇī ||14|| sā'bhivādya pituḥ pādau śeṣāṃ pūrvaṃ nivedya ca || kṛtāñjalirvarārohā nṛpateḥ pārśvataḥ sthitā || 15 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā yauvanaprāptāṃ svāṃ sutāṃ devarūpiṇīm || uvāca rājā saṃmantrya putryarthaṃ saha mantribhiḥ || 16 || putri pradānakālaste na hi kaścidvṛṇoti mām || vicārayanna paśyāmi varaṃ tulyamihātmanaḥ || ||17|| devādīnāṃ yathā vācyo na bhaveyaṃ tathā kuru || paṭhyamānaṃ mayā putri dharmaśāstreṣu ca śrutam ||18|| piturgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā || brahmahatyā pitustasya sā kanyā vṛṣalī smṛtā || 19 || ato'rthaṃ preṣayāmi tvāṃ kuru putri svayaṃvaram || vṛddhairamātyaiḥ sahitā śīghraṃ gacchāvadhāraya || || 7.1.166.20 || evamastviti sāvitrī procya tasmādviniryayau || tapovanāni ramyāṇi rājarṣīṇāṃ jagāma sā || 21 || mānyānāṃ tatra vṛddhānāṃ kṛtvā pādābhivandanam || tato'bhigamya tīrthāni sarvāṇyevāśramāṇi ca || 22 || ājagāma punarveśma sāvitrī saha maṃtribhiḥ || tatrāpaśyata devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ purataḥ śucim || 23 || āsīnamāsane vipraṃ praṇamya smitabhāṣiṇī || kathayāmāsa tatkāryaṃ yenāraṇyaṃ gatā ca sā || 24 || || sāvitryuvāca || āsīcchālveṣu dharmātmā kṣatriyaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || dyumatsena iti khyāto daivādandho vabhūva saḥ || 25 || āryasya bālaputrasya dyumatsenasya rukmiṇā || sāmantena hṛtaṃ rājyaṃ chidre'sminpūrvavairiṇā || 26 || sa bālavatsayā sārdhaṃ bhāryayā prasthito vanam || 27 || sa tasya ca vane vṛddhaḥ putraḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || satyavāganurūpo me bharteti manasepsitaḥ || 28 || || nārada uvāca || || aho bata mahatkaṣṭaṃ sāvitryā nṛpate kṛtam || bālasvabhāvādanayā guṇavānsatyavāgvṛtaḥ || 29 || satyaṃ vadatyasya pitā satyaṃ mātā prabhāṣate || satyaṃ vadeti munibhiḥ satyavānnāma vai kṛtam ||7.1.166.30|| nityaṃ cāśvāḥ priyāstasya karotyaśvāśca mṛnmayān || citre'pi ca likhatyaśvāṃścitrāśva iti cocyate || 31 || satyavānraṃtidevasya śiṣyo dānaguṇaiḥ samaḥ || brahmaṇyaḥ satyavādī ca śibirauśīnaro yathā || 32 || yayātiriva codāraḥ somavatpriyadarśanaḥ || rūpeṇānyatamo'śvibhyāṃ dyumatsenasuto balī || 33 || eko doṣo'sti nānyaśca so'dyaprabhṛti satyavān || saṃvatsareṇa kṣīṇāyurdehatyāgaṃ kariṣyati || 34 || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā duhitā prāha pārthivam || 35 || || sāvitryuvāca || || sakṛjjalpaṃti rājānaḥ sakṛjjalpaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ || sakṛtkanyā pradīyeta trīṇyetāni sakṛtsakṛt || 36 || dīrghāyurathavālpāyuḥ saguṇo nirguṇo'pi vā || sakṛdvṛto mayā bhartā na dvitīyaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 37 || manasā niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato vācā'bhidhīyate || kriyate karmaṇā paścātpramāṇaṃ hi manastataḥ || 38 || || nārada uvāca || || yadyetadiṣṭaṃ bhavataḥ śīghrameva vidhīyatām || avighnena tu sāvitryāḥ pradānaṃ duhitustava || 39 || evamuktvā samutpatya nārūdastridivaṃ gataḥ || rājā ca duhituḥ sarvaṃ vaivāhikamathākarot || śubhe muhūrte pārśvasthairbrāhmaṇairvedapāragaiḥ || 7.1.166.40 || sāvitryapi ca taṃ labdhvā bhartāraṃ manaseptitam ||| mumude'tīva tanvaṃgī svargaṃ prāpyeva puṇyakṛt || 41 || evaṃ tatrāśrame teṣāṃ tadā nivasatāṃ satām || kālastu paśyatāṃ kiñcidaticakrāma pārvati || 42 || sāvitryāstu tadā nāryāstiṣṭhantyāśca divāniśam || nāradena yaduktaṃ tadvākyaṃ manasi vartate || 43 || tataḥ kāle bahutithe vyatikrānte kadācana || prāptaḥ kālo'tha martavyo yatra satyavrato nṛpaḥ || 44 || jyeṣṭhamāse site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ rajanīmukhe || gaṇayaṃtyāśca sāvitryā nāradoktaṃ vaco hṛdi || 45 || caturthe'hani martavyamiti saṃciṃtya bhāminī || vrataṃ trirātramuddiśya divārātraṃ sthitā''śrame || 46 || tatastrirātraṃ nyavasatsnātvā saṃtarpya devatām || śvaśrūśvaśurayoḥ pādau vavaṃde cāruhāsinī || 47 || atha pratasthe paraśuṃ gṛhītvā satyavānvanam || sāvitryapi ca bhartāraṃ gacchaṃtaṃ pṛṣṭhato'nvayāt || 48 || tato gṛhītvā tarasā phalapuṣpasamitkuśān || atha śuṣkāṇi cādāya kāṣṭhabhāramakalpayat || 49 || atha pāṭayataḥ kāṣṭhaṃ jātā śirasi vedanā || kāṣṭhabhāraṃ kṣaṇāttyaktvā vaṭaśākhāvalaṃbitaḥ || 7.1.166.50 || sāvitrīṃ prāha śiraso vedanā māṃ prabādhate || tavotsaṃge kṣaṇaṃ tāvatsvaptumicchāmi sundari || 51 || viśramasva mahābāho sāvitrī prāha duḥkhitā || paścādapi gamiṣyāmi hyāśramaṃ śramanāśanam || || 52 || yāvadutsaṃgagaṃ kṛtvā śirosya tu mahītale || tāvaddadarśa sāvitrī puruṣaṃ kṛṣṇapiṃgalam || 53 || kirīṭinaṃ pītavastraṃ sākṣātsūryamivoditam || tamuvācātha sāvitrī praṇamya madhurākṣaram || 54 || kastvaṃ devo'thavā daityo yo māṃ dharṣitumāgataḥ || na cāhaṃ kenacicchakyā svadharmāddeva rodhitum || 55 || viddhi māṃ puruṣaśreṣṭha dīptāmagniśikhāmiva || 56 || || yama uvāca || || yamaḥ saṃyamanaścāsmi sarvalokabhayaṃkaraḥ || 57 || kṣīṇāyureṣa te bhartā saṃnidhau te pativrate || na śakyaḥ kiṃkarairnetumato'haṃ svayamāgataḥ || 58 || evamuktvā satyavrataśarīrātpāśasaṃyutaḥ || aṃguṣṭhamātraṃ puruṣaṃ nicakarṣa yamo balāt || 59 || atha prayātumārebhe paṃthānaṃ pitṛsevitam || sāvitryapi varārohā pṛṣṭhato'nujagāma ha || 7.1.166.60 || pativratatvāccāśrāṃtā tāmuvāca yamastathā || nivarta gaccha sāvitri muhūrtaṃ tvamihāgatā || 61 || eṣa mārgo viśālākṣi na kenāpyanugamyate || 62 || || sāvitryuvāca || || na śramo na ca me glāniḥ kadācidapi jāyate || bhartāramanugacchantyā viśiṣṭasya ca saṃnidhau || 63 || satāṃ santo gatirnānyā strīṇāṃ bhartā sadā gatiḥ || vedo varṇāśramāṇāṃ ca śiṣyāṇāṃ ca gatirguruḥ || 64 || sarveṣāmeva bhūtānāṃ sthānamasti mahītale || bharttāramekamutsṛjya strīṇāṃ nānyaḥ samāśrayaḥ || 65 || evamanyaiḥ sumadhurairvākyairdharmārthasaṃhitaiḥ || tutoṣa sūryatanayaḥ sāvitrīṃ vākyamabravīt || 66 || || yama uvāca || || tuṣṭo'smi tava bhadraṃ te varaṃ varaya bhāmini || sāpi vavre ca rājyaṃ svaṃ vinayāvanatānanā || 67 || cakṣuḥprāptiṃ tathā rājyaṃ śvaśurasya mahātmanaḥ || pituḥ putraśataṃ caiva putrāṇāṃ śatamātmanaḥ || 68 || jīvitaṃ ca tathā bharturdharmasiddhiṃ ca śāśvatīm || dharmarājo varaṃ dattvā preṣayāmāsa tāṃ tataḥ || 69 || atha bhartāramāsādya sāvitrī hṛṣṭamānasā || jagāma svāśramapadaṃ saha bhartrā nirākulā || 7.1.166.70 || jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ ca tayā cīrṇaṃ vrataṃ tvidam || māhātmyato'sya nṛpateścakṣuḥprāptirabhūtpuraḥ || 71 || tataḥ svadeśarājyaṃ ca prāpa niṣkaṇṭakaṃ nṛpaḥ || pitāsyāḥ putraśatakaṃ sā ca lebhe sutāñchatam || 72 || evaṃ vratasya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ sakalaṃ mayā || 73 || || || devyuvāca || || kīdṛśaṃ tadvrataṃ deva sāvitryā caritaṃ mahat || tasmiṃstu jyeṣṭhamāse hi vidhānaṃ tasya kīdṛśam || 74 || kā devatā vrate tasminke mantrāḥ kiṃ phalaṃ vibho || vistareṇa maheśa tvaṃ brūhi dharmaṃ sanātanam || 76 || || īśvara uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ devadeveśi sāvitrīvratamā darāt || kathayāmi yathā cīrṇaṃ tayā satyā maheśvari || 76 || trayodaśyāṃ tu jyeṣṭhasya dantadhāvanapūrvakam || trirātraṃ niyamaṃ kuryādupavāsasya bhāmini || 77 || aśaktastu trayodaśyāṃ naktaṃ kuryājjitendriyaḥ || ayācitaṃ caturdaśyāṃ hyupavāsena pūrṇimām || 78 || nityaṃ snātvā taḍāge vā mahānadyāṃ ca nirjhare || pāṃḍukūpe tu suśroṇi sarvasnānaphalaṃ labhet || 79 || viśeṣātpūrṇimāyāṃ tu snānaṃ sarṣapamṛjjalaiḥ || 7.1.166.80 || gṛhītvā vālukaṃ pātre prasthamātre yaśasvini || athavā dhānyamādāya yavaśālitilādikam || 81 || tato vaṃśamaye pātre vastrayugmena veṣṭite || sāvitrīpratimāṃ kṛtvā sarvāvayavaśobhitām|| 82 || sauvarṇīṃ mṛnmayīṃ vāpi svaśaktyā dārunirmitām || raktavastradvayaṃ dadyātsāvitryā brahmaṇaḥ sitam || 83 || sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇā sārdhamevaṃ śaktyā prapūjayet || gandhaiḥ sugandhapuṣpaiśca dhūpanaivedyadīpakaiḥ || 94 || pūrṇakośātakaiḥ pakvaiḥ kūṣmāṇḍakarkaṭīphalaiḥ || nālikeraiḥ sakharjūraiḥ kapitthairdāḍimaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 85 || jaṃbūjaṃbīranāriṃgairakṣoṭaiḥ panasaistathā || jīrakaiḥ kaṭukhaṇḍaiśca guḍena lavaṇena ca || 86 || virūḍhaiḥ saptadhānyaiśca vaṃśapātraprakalpitaiḥ || raṃjayetpaṭṭasūtraiśca śubhaiḥ kuṃkumakesaraiḥ || 87 || avatāraṃ karotyevaṃ sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ priyā || 88 || tāmarccayīta mantreṇa sāvitryā brahmaṇā samam|| itareṣāṃ purāṇokto maṃtro'yaṃ samudāhṛtaḥ || 89 || oṃkārapūrvake devi vīṇāpustakadhāriṇi || vedāṃbike namastubhyamavaidhavyaṃ prayaccha me ||7.1.166.90|| evaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivajjāgaraṃ tatra kārayet|| gītavāditraśabdenanaranārīkadaṃbakam || nṛtyaddhasannayedrātriṃ nṛtyaśāstraviśāradaiḥ || 91 || sāvitryākhyānakaṃ cāpi vācayīta dvijottamān|| yāvatprabhātasamayaṃ gītabhāvarasaiḥ saha || 92 || vivāhamevaṃ kṛtvā tu sāvitryā brahmaṇā saha || paridhāpya sitairvastrairdaṃpatīnāṃ tu saptakam || 93 || gṛhadānaṃ pradātavyaṃ sarvopaskarasaṃyutam || brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣe sāvitrīṃ vinivedayet || 94 || atha sāvitrīkalpajñe sāvitryākhyānavācake || daivajñe hyuñchavṛttisthe daridre cāgnihotriṇi || 95 || evaṃ dattvā vidhānena tasyāṃ rātrau nimantrayet || paurṇamāsyāṃ vaṭādhastāddaṃpatīnāṃ caturdaśa || 96 || tataḥ prabhātasamaye uṣaḥkāla upasthite || bhakṣyabhojyādikaṃ sarvaṃ sāvitrīsthalamānayet || 97|| pākaṃ kṛtvā tu śucinā rakṣāṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ || brāhmaṇāngṛhiṇīyuktāṃstata āhvānayetsudhīḥ || 98 || sāvitryāḥ sthalake tatra kṛtvā pādābhiṣecanam || susnātānbrāhmaṇāṃstatra sabhāryānupaveśayet || 99 || sāvitryāḥ purato devi daṃpatyorbhojanaṃ dadet || tenāhaṃ bhojitastatra bhavāmīha na saṃśaya || 7.1.166.100 || dvitīyaṃ bhojayedyastu bhojitastena keśavaḥ || lakṣmyāḥ sahāyo varado varāṃstasya prayacchati || 101 || sāvitryā sahito brahmā tṛtīye bhojito bhavet || ekaikaṃ bhojanaṃ tatra koṭibhojasamaṃ smṛtam || 102 || aṣṭādaśaprakāreṇa ṣaḍrasīkṛtabhojanam || devyāstatra mahādevi sāvitrīsthalasannidhau || 103 || vidhavā na kule tasya na vaṃdhyā na ca durbhagā || na kanyājananī cāpi na ca syādbharturapriyā || aṣṭau doṣāstu nārīṇāṃ na bhavaṃti kadācana || 104 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena sāvitryagre ca bhojanam || dātavyaṃ sarvadā devi kaṭunīlavivarjitam || 105 || na cāmlaṃ na ca vai kṣāraṃ strīṇāṃ bhojyaṃ kadācana || paṃcaprakāraṃ madhuraṃ hṛdyaṃ sarvaṃ susaṃskṛtam || 106 || ghṛtapūrṇāpūpakāśca bahukṣīrasamanvitāḥ || pūpakāstādṛśāḥ kāryā dvitīyā'śokavartikā || 107 || tṛtīyā pūpikā kāryā kharjureṇa samanvitāḥ || caturthaścaiva saṃyāvo guḍājyābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ || || 108 || āhlādakāriṇī puṃsāṃ strīṇāṃ cātīva vallabhā || dhanadhānyajanopetaṃ nārīnaraśatākulam || pūpakaistu kulaṃ tasyā jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 109 || na jvaro na ca saṃtāpo duḥkhaṃ ca na viyogajam || aśokavartidānena kulānāmekaviṃśatiḥ || 7.1.166.110 || vadhūbhiśca sutaiścaiva dāsīdāsairanantakaiḥ || pūritaṃ ca kulaṃ tasyāḥ pūrikā yā prayacchati || 111 || putriṇyo vai duhitaro vadhūbhiḥ sahitāḥ kule || śikhariṇīpradātrīṇāṃ yuvatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 112 || modate ca kulaṃ sarvaṃ sarvasiddhiprapūritam || modakānāṃ pradānena evamāha pitāmahaḥ || 113 || etacca gauriṇīnāṃ tu bhojanaṃ hi viśiṣyate || 114 || subhagā putriṇī sādhvī dhanaṛddhisamanvitā || sahasrabhojinī devi bhavejjanmanijanmani || 115 || pānāni caiva mukhyāni hṛdyāni madhurāṇi ca || drākṣāpānaṃ tu ciṃcāyāḥ pānaṃ guḍasamanvitam || 116 || sarasena tu toyena kṛtakhaṇḍena vai śubham || suvāsinīnāṃ peyaṃ vai dātavyaṃ ca dvijanmanām || 117 || itarairitarāṇyeva varṇayogyāni yāni ca || surabhīṇi ca pānāni tāsu yogyāni dāpayet || 118 || pratipūjya vidhānena vastradānaiḥ sakaṃcukaiḥ || kuṅkumenānuliptāṃgāḥ sragdāmabhiralaṃkṛtāḥ || gaṃdhairdhūpaiśca saṃpūjya nālikerānpradāpayet || 119 || netrāṇāṃ cāñjanaṃ kṛtvā sindūraṃ caiva mastake || pūgīphalāni hṛdyāni vāsitāni mṛdūni ca || haste dattvā sapātrāṇi praṇipatya visarjayet || 7.1.166.120 || svayaṃ ca bhojayetpaścādbaṃdhubhirbālakaiḥ saha || 121 || athavā naiva saṃpadyettīrthe caiva tu bhojanam || gṛhe gatvā prabhoktavyaṃ tuṣṭā devī yathā bhavet || 112 || evameva pitṝṇāṃ ca āgamya sve ca mandire || piṇḍapradānapūrvaṃ tu śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || pitarastasya tuṣṭā vai bhavanti brahmaṇo dinam ||123|| tīrthādaṣṭaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ svagṛhe dadataḥ śubhe || na ca paśyanti vai nīcāḥ śrāddhaṃ dattaṃ dvijātibhiḥ || 124 || ekānte tu gṛhe gupte pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamiṣyate || nīcaṃ dṛṣṭvā hataṃ tattu pitṝṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhati || 125 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ guptaṃ ca kārayet || pitṝṇāṃ tṛptidaṃ proktaṃ svayameva svayaṃbhuvā ||126|| gaurībhojyādikā yā tu utsargātkriyate kriyā || rājasī sā samākhyātā janānāṃ kīrtidāyinī || 127 || idaṃ dānaṃ sadā deyamātmano hita micchatā || śrāddhe caiva viśeṣeṇa yadīcchetsāttvikaṃ phalam || 128 || idamudyāpanaṃ devi sāvitryāstu vratasya ca || sarvapātakaśuddhyarthaṃ kāryaṃ devi naraiḥ sadā || akāmataḥ kāmato vā pāpaṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || 129 || iha loke tu saubhāgyaṃ dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ varāḥ striyaḥ || bhavaṃti vividhāsteṣāṃ yairyātrā tatra vai kṛtā || 7.1.166.130 || idaṃ yātrāvidhānaṃ tu bhaktyā yaḥ kurute naraḥ || śṛṇoti vā sa pāpaistu sarvaireva pramucyate || 131 || jyeṣṭhasya pūrṇimāyāṃ tu sāvitrīsthalake śubhe || pradakṣiṇā yaḥ kurute phaladānairyathāvidhi || 132 || aṣṭottaraśataṃ vāpi tadardhārdhaṃ tadardhakam || yaḥ karoti naro devi sṛṣṭvā tatra pradakṣiṇām || 133 || agamyāgamanaṃ yaiśca kṛtaṃ jñānācca mānavaiḥ || anyāni pātakānyevaṃ naśyaṃte nātra saṃśayaḥ || 134 || yairgatvā sthalake saṃdhyā sāvitryāḥ samupāsitā || svapatnyāścaiva hastena pāṃḍukūpajalena ca || 135 || bhṛṃgārakanakenaiva mṛnmayenātha bhāmini || ānīya tu jalaṃ puṇyaṃ saṃdhyopāstiṃ karoti yaḥ || tena dvādaśavarṣāṇi bhavetsaṃdhyā hyupāsitā || 136 || aśvamedhaphalaṃ snāne dāne daśaguṇaṃ tathā || upavāse tvanaṃtaṃ ca kathāyāḥ śravaṇe tathā || 137 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāvitrīvratavidhipūjanaprakārodyāpanādikathanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 166 || || cha || ||
<7.1.167>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tatrasthāṃ bhūtamātṛkām || sāvitryā vārūṇe bhāge śatadhanvaṃtare sthitām || navakoṭi gaṇairyuktāṃ pretabhūtasamākulām || pūjitāṃ siddhagaṃdharvairdevādibhiranekaśaḥ || 2 || || devyuvāca || || bhūtamāteti saṃhṛṣṭā grāmegrāme purepure || gāyannṛtyanhasam̐llokaḥ sarvataḥ paridhāvati || 3 || unmattavatpralapate kṣitau patati mattavat || kruddhavaddhāvati parānmṛtavatkṛṣyate hi saḥ || 4 || sukhabhaṃgāṃśca kurute loko vātagṛhītavat || bhūtavadbhasmamūtrāṃbukardamānavagāhate || 5 || kimeṣa śāstranirdiṣṭo mārgaḥ kimuta laukikaḥ || muhyate me mano deva tena tvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 6 || kathaṃ sā puruṣaiḥ pūjyā prabhāsakṣetravāsibhiḥ || kasmāttatra gatā devī kasminkāle samāgatā || kasmindine tu māse tu tasyāḥ kāryo mahotsavaḥ || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yatte kiṃcinmanogatam || āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca bhavantīti matirmama || 8 || cākṣuṣasyāntare'tīte prāpte vaivasvate'ntare || dakṣāpamānātsaṃjātā tadā parvataputrikā || 9 || dvāpare tu dvitīye vai dattā tvaṃ parvatena me || vivāhe caiva saṃjāte sarvadevamanorame || 7.1.167.10 || tvayā ca sahitaḥ pūrvaṃ mandare cārukaṃdare || akrīḍaṃ ca mudā yukto divyakrīḍanakaiḥ priye || pīnonnatanitaṃbena bhrājamānā kuconnatām || 11 || sitābjavadanāṃ hṛṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭvā'haṃ tvāṃ mahāprabhām || dagdhakāmataroḥ kandakaṃdalīmiva niḥsṛtām || mahārhaśayanasthāṃ tvāṃ tadā kāmitavānaham || 12 || surate tava saṃjātaṃ divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ yadā || tadā devi samutthāya nirodhānnirgatā bahiḥ || || 13 || tavodakātsamuttasthau nāryekā gahvarodarā || kṛṣṇā karālavadanā piṃgākṣī muktamūrdhajā || 14 || kapālamālābharaṇā baddhamuṇḍārdhapiṃḍakā || khaṭvāṃgakaṃkāladharā ruṇḍamuṃḍakarā śivā || 15 || dvīpicarmāmbaradharā raṇatkiṃkiṇimekhalā || ḍamaḍḍamarukārā ca phetkārapūritāmbarā || 16 || tasyāśca pārśvagā anyāstāsāṃ nāmāni me śṛṇu || sakhyo brāhmaṇarākṣasyastāsāṃ caiva sudarśanāḥ || 17 || daśakoṭiprabhedena dharāṃ vyāpya susaṃsthitāḥ || mukhyāstatra catasro vai mahābalaparākramāḥ || 18 || raktavarṇā mahājihvā'kṣayā vai pāpakāriṇī || etāsāmanvaye jātāḥ pṛthivyāṃ brahmarākṣasāḥ || 19 || śleṣmātakatarau hyete prāyaśaḥ sukṛtālayāḥ || uttālatālacapalā nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca || 7.1.167.20 || vijñeyā iha loke'sminbhūtānāṃ mūlanāyakāḥ || atikṛṣṇā bhavantyete vyaṃtarāntaracāriṇaḥ || 21 || vṛkṣāgramātramākāśaṃ te caraṃti na saṃśayaḥ || || 22 || tathaiva mama vīryāttu madrūpābharaṇaḥ pumān || kapālakhaṭvāṃgadharo jātaścarmaviguṇṭhitaḥ || 23 || anugamyamāno bahubhirbhūtairapi bhayaṃkaraḥ || siṃhaśārdūlavadanairvadanollikhitāṃbaraiḥ || 24 || evaṃ devi tadā jātaḥ kṣudhākrānto babhāṣa mām || ato'haṃ kṣudhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā varaṃ hīmaṃ ca dattavān || 25 || yuvayorhastasaṃsparśānnaktamevāstu sarvaśaḥ || naktaṃ caiva balīyāṃsau divā nātibalāvubhau || putravadrakṣataṃ lokāndharmaścaivānupālyatām || || 26 || ityuktau tau mayā tatra bhūtamātṛgaṇau priye || ekībhūtau kṣaṇenaiva tau bhavānībhavodbhavau || 27 || dṛṣṭvā hṛṣṭamanāścāhamavocaṃ tvāṃ śucismite || 28 || kalyāṇi paśyapaśyaitau mamāṃśācca samudbhavau || bībhatsādbhutaśṛṃgāradhāriṇau hāsyakāriṇau ||29|| bhrātṛbhāṃḍā bhūtamātā tathaivodakasevitā || saṃjñātrayaṃ smṛtaṃ devi loke vikhyātapauruṣam ||7.1.167.30|| punaḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭau dṛṣṭvā māmūcatustadā || āvayorbhagavankutra sthāne vāso bhaviṣyati ||31|| ityuktavantau tau tatra vareṇa cchanditau mayā || asti saurāṣṭraviṣaye bhārate kṣetramuttamam ||32|| prabhāseti samākhyātaṃ tatra kṣemaṃ mama priyam || kūrmasya nairṛte bhāge sthitaṃ vai dakṣiṇe pare||33|| svātī viśākhā maitraṃ ca yatra ṛkṣatrayaṃ smṛtam|| tasminsthāne sadā stheyaṃ yāvanmanvantarāvadhi||34|| anyadā jīvikaṃ vacmi tava bhūtapriye sadā || 35 || yatra kaṇṭakino vṛkṣā yatra niṣpāvavallarī || bhāryā punarbhūrvalmīkastāste vasatayaściram || 36 || yasmingṛhe narāḥ pañca strītrayaṃ tāvatīśca gāḥ || andhakāreṃdhanāgniśca tadgṛhe vasatistava || 37 || bhūtaiḥ pretaiḥ piśācaiśca yatsthānaṃ samadhiṣṭhitam || ekāvi cāṣṭabāleyaṃ trigavaṃ pañcamāhiṣam || ṣaḍaśvaṃ saptamātaṃgaṃ tadgṛhe vasatistava || 38 || uddālakānnapiṭakaṃ tadvatsthālyādibhājanam || yatra tatraiva kṣiptaṃ ca tava tacca pratiśrayam || 39 || muśalolūkhale strīṇāmāsyā tadvaduduṃbare || bhāṣaṇaṃ kaṭukaṃ caiva tatra devi sthitistava || 7.1.167.40 || khādyante yatra dhānyāni pakvāpakvāni veśmani || tadvacchākhāśca tatra tvaṃ bhūtaiḥ saha cariṣyasi || 41 || sthālīpidhāne yatrāgniṃ dadate vikalā narāḥ || gṛhe tatra duriṣṭānāmaśeṣāṇāṃ samāśrayaḥ || 42 || mānuṣyāsthi gṛhe yatra ahorātre vyavasthitam || tatrāyaṃ bhūtanivaho yatheṣṭaṃ vicariṣyati || 43 || sarvasmādadhikaṃ ye na pravadanti pinākinam || sādhāraṇaṃ vadaṃtyenaṃ tatra bhūtaiḥ samāviśa || 44 || kanyā ca yatra vai vallī rohīnāma jaṭī gṛhe || agastya pādapo vāpi baṃdhujīvo gṛheṣu vai || 45 || karavīro viśeṣeṇa naṃdyāvartastathaiva ca || mallikā vā gṛhe yeṣāṃ bhūtayogyaṃ gṛhaṃ hi tat || 46 || tālaṃ tamālaṃ bhallātaṃ tiṃtiṇīkhaṃḍameva vā || bakulaṃ kadalīkhaṃḍaṃ kadaṃbaḥ khadiro'pi vā ||47|| nyagrodho hi gṛhe yeṣāmaśvatthaṃ cūta eva vā || uduṃbaraśca panasaḥ sarvabhūta priyaṃ hi tat ||48|| yatra kākagṛhaṃ vai syādārāme vā gṛhe'pi vā || bhikṣubiṃbaṃ ca vai yatra gṛhe dakṣiṇake tathā ||49|| biṃbamūrdhvaṃ ca yatrasthaṃ tatra bhūtaniveśanam ||7.1.167.50|| liṃgārcanaṃ na yatraiva yatra nāsti japādikam || yatra bhaktivihīnā vai bhūtānāṃ tāngṛhānvadet ||51|| malināsyāstu ye martyā malināṃbara dhāriṇaḥ || maladaṃtā gṛhasthā ye gṛhaṃ teṣāṃ samāviśa ||52|| agamyaniratā ye tu maithune vyabhicārataḥ || saṃdhyāyāṃ maithunaṃ yāṃti gṛhaṃ teṣāṃ samāviśa || || 53 || bahunā kiṃ pralāpena nityakarmabahiṣkṛtāḥ || rudrabhaktivihīnā ye gṛhaṃ teṣāṃ samāviśa || 54 || adattvā bhuṃjate yo'nnaṃ baṃdhubhyo'nnaṃ tathodakam || sapiṇḍānsodakāṃścaiva tatkālāttānnarānbhaja || 55 || yatra bhāryā ca bhartā ca parasparavirodhinau || saha bhūtairgṛhaṃ tasya viśa tvaṃ bhayavarjjitā || 56 || vāsudeve ratirnāsti yatra nāsti sadā hariḥ || japahomādikaṃ nāsti bhasma nāsti gṛhe nṛṇām || 57 || parvasvapyarcanaṃ nāsti caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 58 || kṛṣṇāṣṭamyāṃ ca ye martyāḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ bhasmavarjitāḥ || paṃcadaśyāṃ mahādevaṃ na yajaṃti ca yatra vai ||59|| paurajānapadairyatra prākprasiddhā mahotsavāḥ || kriyate pūrvavannaiva tadgṛhaṃ vasatistava || 7.1.167.60 || vedaghoṣo na yatrāsti gurupūjādikaṃ na ca || pitṛkarmavihīnaṃ ca tadbhūtasya gṛhaṃ smṛtam ||| || 61 || rātraurātrau gṛhe yasminkalaho jāyate mithaḥ || bālānāṃ prekṣamāṇānāṃ yatra vṛddhaśca pūrvataḥ || bhakṣayettatra vai hṛṣṭā bhūtaiḥ saha samāviśa ||62|| kasminmāse dine cāpi bhavitrī lokapūjitā || ityukto'haṃ tayā devi tāmavocaṃ punaḥ priye ||63|| amā yā mādhave māsi tasminyā ca caturdaśī || tasyāṃ mahotsavastatra bhavitā te ciraṃtanaḥ||64|| yāḥ striyastāṃ ca yakṣyaṃti tasminkāle mahotsave|| balibhiḥ puṣpadhūpaiśca mā tāsāṃ tvaṃ gṛhe viśa||65|| nārāyaṇa hṛṣīkeśa puṇḍarīkākṣa mādhava || acyutānaṃta goviṃda vāsudeva janārdana || 66 || nṛsiṃha vāmanāciṃtya keśaveti ca ye janāḥ || rudra rudreti rudreti śivāya ca namonamaḥ || 67 || vakṣyaṃti satataṃ hṛṣṭāsteṣāṃ dhanagṛhādiṣu || ārāme caiva goṣṭhe ca mā viśethāḥ kathaṃcana || 68 || deśācārāñjñā tidharmāñjapaṃ homaṃ ca maṃgalam || daivatejyāṃ vidhānena śaucaṃ kurvaṃti ye janāḥ || lokāpavādabhītā ye pumāṃsasteṣu mā viśa ||69|| || devyuvāca || kadā pūjā prakartavyā bhūtamātuḥ sukhārthibhiḥ || puruṣairdevadeveśa etanme vaktumarhasi || 7.1.167.70 || || īśvara uvāca || || sarvatraiṣā bhagavatī bālānāṃ hitakāriṇī || nāmabhedaiḥ kālabhedaiḥ kriyābhedaiśca pūjyate ||71|| pratipatprabhṛti vaiśākhe yāvaccaturdaśītithiḥ || tāvatpūjā prakartavyā preraṇīprekṣaṇīyakaiḥ || 72 || bhagnāmapi gatāṃ caināṃ jarattarutale sthitām || secayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā jalasaṃpūrṇagaṃḍukaiḥ || 73 || grīvāsūtrakasindūraiḥ puṣpairdhūpaistathārcayet|| tatra siddhavaṭaḥ pūjyaḥ śākhāṃ cāsya vinikṣipet|| 74 || pūjitāṃ tāṃ narairyatnādavalokya śubhepsubhiḥ || bhojayetkṣiprāsaṃyāvakṛśarāpūpapāyasaiḥ ||75|| evaṃ vidhiṃ yaḥ kurute puruṣo bhaktibhāvataḥ || sa putrapaśuvṛddhiṃ ca śarīrārogyamāpnuyāt ||76|| na śākinyo gṛhe tasya na piśācā na rākṣasāḥ || pīḍāṃ kurvanti śiśavo yānti vṛddhimanāmayām || 77 || atha devi pravakṣyāmi pratipatprabhṛti kramāt || yathotsavo naraiḥ kāryaḥ preraṇīprekṣaṇīyakaiḥ ||78|| vikarmaphalanirddeśaiḥ pākhaṃḍānāṃ viṭaṃbanaiḥ || pradarśyate hāsyaparairnarairadbhutaceṣṭitaiḥ || 79 || pañcamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa rātrau kolāhalaḥ śubhe || jāgaraṃ tatra kurvīta devīṃ pūjya prayatnataḥ || 7.1.167.80 || viśvasya dhanalobhena svādhyāyo nihataḥ patiḥ|| āropyamāṇaṃ śūlāgramenaṃ paśyata bho janāḥ||81|| dṛṣṭo bhavadbhirduṣṭaḥ sa paradārāvamarśakaḥ || chittvā hastau ca khaḍgena kharārūḍhastu gacchati || 82 || śīrṇaścaivāsipatreṇa asyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || sukhāsana samārūḍhaḥ sukṛtī yātyasau sukham || 83 || he janāḥ kiṃ na paśyadhvaṃ svāmidrohakaraṃ param || karapatrairvidāryaṃtamucchalacchoṇitāntaram || 84 || cauraḥ kilāyaṃ saṃprāptaḥ sarvodvegakaraḥ paraḥ || daṃḍaprahārābhihato nīyate daṃḍapāśakaiḥ || 85 || prekṣakaiśceṣṭitaḥ śaśvadāraṭanvividhaiḥ svaraiḥ || saṃyamya nīyate hantuṃ lajjito'dhomukho janāḥ || 86 || sitakeśaṃ sitaśmaśruṃ sitāṃbaradharadhvajam || viṭaṃkādyaiśca ceṭībhirhanyamānaṃ na paśyathi ||87|| gṛhānniṣkrāmya māṃ raṃḍāṃ gṛhaṃ nītvā'karodratim || kasmādasau na kurute mūḍho bharaṇapoṣaṇam || 88 || bhairavābharaṇo netā sadā ghūrṇitalocanaḥ || pravṛttataṃdravanmūḍho vadhyaścāsāvitastataḥ ||89|| nirvedeko'sya hṛdaye dhanakṣetrādisaṃbhavaḥ || gṛhītaṃ yadanenādya bālenāpi mahāvratam || raktākṣaṃ kākakṛṣṇāṃgaṃ satvaraṃ kiṃ na paśyathi || 7.1.167.90 || tarukoṭaragānbaddhvā anyāñchṛṃkhalayā tathā || śaraughaiḥ kāṣṭhakaiścaiva bahubhiḥ śakalīkṛtān || 91 || vimuktahakkāhuṃkārā nsuprahārānnirīkṣata || 92 || imāṃ kṛṣṇārdhavadanāṃ grahīṣyasi durātmikām || vimuktakeśāṃ nṛtyantīṃ paśyadhvaṃ yoginīmiva || 93 || gambhīra nūpuradhvānapravṛddhoddhatatāṃḍavā || unmattanetracaraṇā yātyeṣā ḍimbhamaṇḍalī || 94 || kaṭītaṭasthapiṭikollasatkaṃbaladhāriṇī || aṭate naṭatī hyurvī paritaśca gṛhādgṛham || 95 || ityevamādibhirnityaṃ preraṇīprekṣaṇīyakaiḥ || prerayettānmahānitthaṃ putrabhrātṛsuhṛdvṛtaḥ || 96 || ekādaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā dīpaṃ prajvālya kuṇḍakam || mukhabiṃbāni tatraiva lepadārukṛtāni vai || 97 || vicitrāṇi mahārhāṇi raudraśāntāni kārayet || mātṛṇāṃ caṇḍikādīnāṃ rākṣasānāṃ tathaiva ca || 98 || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ śākinīnāṃ tathaiva ca || mukhāni kārayettatra hāvabhāvakṛtāni ca || 99 || rakṣibhirbahubhirguptaṃ tirya gdhvanipuraḥsaram || amāvāsyāṃ mahādevi kṣipetpūjākramairnaraḥ || 7.1.167.100 || tataḥ pradoṣasamaye yatra devī janairvṛtā || tatra gacchenmahārāvaiḥ phetkārā kulakīrtanaiḥ || 101 || vīracaryāvidhānena nagare bhrāmayenniśi || vīracaryā sa kathito dīpaḥ sarvārthasādhakaḥ || 102 || nityaṃ niṣkrāmayeddīpaṃ yāva tpañcadaśī tithiḥ || pañcadaśyāṃ prakurvīta bhūtamāturmahotsavam || tasya gṛheśvaraṃ yāvadgṛhe vighnaṃ na jāyate || 103 || atha kālāntare'tīte bhūtamātuḥ śarīrataḥ || jātāḥ prasvedabindubhyaḥ piśācāḥ pañcakoṭayaḥ || 104 || sarve te krūravadanā jihvājvālākṛśodarāḥ || pāṇipātrāḥ piśācāste nisṛṣṭabalibhojanāḥ || 105 || dhamanīsaṃtatāḥ śuṣkāḥ śmaśrulāścarmavāsasaḥ || ulūkhalairābharaṇaiḥ śūrpacchatrāsanāṃbarāḥ || 106 || naktaṃ jvalitakeśāḍhyā aṃgārānudgiraṃti vai || aṃgārakāḥ piśācāste mātṛmārgānusāriṇaḥ || 107 || ākarṇadāritāsyāśca laṃbabhrūsthūlanāsikāḥ || balāḍhyāste piśācā vai sūtikāgṛhavāsinaḥ || 108 || pṛṣṭhataḥ pāṇipādāśca pṛṣṭhagā vātaraṃhasā || viṣādanāḥ piśācāste saṃgrāme piśitāśanāḥ || || 109 || evaṃvidhānpiśācāṃstu dṛṣṭvā dīnānukampayā || tebhyo'hamavadaṃ kiñcitkāruṇyādalpacetasām || 7.1.167.110 || antardhānaṃ prajādehe kāmarūpitvameva ca || ubhayoḥ saṃdhyayoścāraṃ sthānānyājīvitaṃ tathā || 111 || gṛhāṇi yāni nagnāni śūnyānyāyatanāni ca || vidhvastāni ca yāni syū racanāroṣitāni ca|| 112 || rājamārgoparathyāśca catvarāṇi trikāṇi ca || dvārāṇyaṭṭālakāṃścaiva nirgamānsaṃkramāṃstathā || || 113 || patho nadīśca tīrthāni caityavṛkṣānmahāpathān || sthānāni tu piśācānāṃ nivāsāyādadāṃ priye || 114 || adhārmikā janāsteṣāmā jīvo vihitaḥ purā || varṇāśramācārahīnāḥ kāruśilpijanāstathā || 115 || anutāpāśca sādhūnāṃ caurā viśvāsaghātinaḥ || etairanyaiśca bahubhiranyāyopārjitairdhanaiḥ || 116 || ārabhyate kriyā yāstu piśācāstatra devatāḥ || madhumāsadine dadhnā tilacūrṇasurāsavaiḥ || 117 || pūpairhāridrakṛśaraistilairikṣuguḍaudanaiḥ || kṛṣṇāni caiva vāsāṃsi dhūmrāḥ sumanasastathā || 118 || sarvabhūtapiśācānāṃ kṛtā devī mayā śubhā || evaṃvidhā bhūtamātā sarvabhūtagaṇairvṛtā || 119 || prabhāse saṃsthitā devī samudrāduttareṇa tu || ya etāṃ veda vai devyā utpattiṃ pāpanāśinīm || 7.1.167.120 || kutsitā saṃtati stasya na bhavecca kadācana || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ na doṣaiḥ paribhūyate || 121 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sarvasaubhāgyasaṃyutaḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nārīhṛdayanaṃdanaḥ || 122 || ye mānayaṃti nijahāsakalairvilāsaiḥ saṃsevayā abhayadā bhavabhūtamātām || te bhrātṛbhṛtyasutabaṃdhujanairyutāśca sarvopasarga rahitāḥ sukhino bhavanti || 123 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhūta mātṛkāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 167 || || cha ||
<7.1.168>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ śālakaṭaṃkaṭām || sāvitryā dakṣiṇe bhāge raivatātpūrvataḥ sthitām || 1 || mahāpāpopaśamanīṃ sarvaduḥkhavināśanīm || pūjitāṃ sarvagandharvaiḥ sphuraddaṃṣṭrograbhīṣaṇām || 2 || mahāpracaṇḍadaityaghnīṃ paulastyena pratiṣṭhitām || mahiṣaghnīṃ mahākāyāṃ kṣetre prābhāsike sthitām || 3 || māghe māse caturdaśyāṃ yastā mārādhayennaraḥ || sa bhavetpaśumāndhīmām̐llakṣmīvānputravānsudhīḥ || 4 || yastāṃ paśupradānena santarpayati bhaktitaḥ || balipūjopahāraiśca sa syācchatru vivarjitaḥ || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śālakaṭaṃkaṭā māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 168 || || cha ||
<7.1.169>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vaivasvateśvaram|| devyā dakṣiṇadigbhāge dhanustriṃśakasaṃsthitam || 1 || vaivasvatena manunā sthāpitaṃ sarvakāmadam|| tatsamīpe devakhātaṃ tiṣṭhate tu mahādbhutam || 2 || snātvā tatra varārohe yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || pañcopacārairvidhinā bhaktiprahvo jitendriyaḥ || japedaghoravidhinā stotraṃ siddhiṃ sa cāpnuyāt || || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vaivasvateśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 169 || || cha ||
<7.1.170>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tatra mātṛgaṇānsudhīḥ || tatraiva baladevīṃ ca nātidūre vyavasthitām || 1 || śrāvaṇyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ || pāyasairmadhunā vāpi divyapuṣpopahārakaiḥ || || 2 || tasya varṣaṃ mahādevi sukhaṃ gacchetsupūjitam || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mātṛgaṇabaladevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaraśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 170 || || cha || ||
<7.1.171>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devīmekallavīrikām || ekallavīrāyāmye tu nātidūre vyavasthitām || 1 || pūrvaṃ daśaratho yo'sau sūryavaṃśavibhūṣaṇaḥ || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapaścakre suduścaram || 2 || liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhāpya toṣayāmāsa śāṃkaram || sa devaṃ prārthayāmāsa putraṃ caivāmitaujasam || || 3 || dadau tasya tadā putraṃ devaṃ trailokyapūjitam || rāmeti nāma yasyāsīttrailokye prathitaṃ yaśaḥ || 4 || yasyādyāpīha gāyanti bhūrbhuvaḥsvarni vāsinaḥ || devadaityāsurāḥ sarve vālmīkyādyā maharṣayaḥ || 5 || talliṃgasya prabhāvena prāptaṃ rājñā mahadyaśaḥ || kārtikyāṃ kārtike māsi vidhinā yastamarcayet || dīpapūjopahāreṇa yaśasvī so'pi jāyate || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye daśaratheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 171 || || cha ||
<7.1.172>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahā devi liṃgaṃ tadbharateśvaram || tasmāduttarakoṇasthaṃ nātidūraṃ vyavasthitam || 1 || bharatonāma rājā'bhūdāgnīdhraḥ prathitaḥ kṣitau || yasyedaṃ bhārataṃ varṣaṃ nāmnā lokeṣu gīyate || 2 || sa ca cakre tapo ghoraṃ kṣetre'sminpārvati priye || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || 3 || putrakāmo naraśreṣṭhaḥ pūjayāmāsa śaṃkaram || tatastuṣṭaḥ sa bhagavānvaraṃ dātuṃ samutsukaḥ || 4 || aṣṭau putrāndadau tasmai kanyāṃ caikāṃ yaśasvinīm || sa tu prāpyābhilaṣitaṃ kṛtakṛtyo narādhipaḥ || 5 || bhārataṃ navadhā kṛtvā putrebhyaḥ pradadau pṛthak || teṣāṃ nāmāṃkitānyeva tato dvīpāni jajñire || 6 || indradvīpaḥ kaseruśca tāmravarṇo gabhastimān || nāgadvīpastathā saumyo gāndharvastvatha cāruṇaḥ || 7 || ayaṃ tu navamo dvīpaḥ kumāryā saṃjñitaḥ priye || aṣṭau dvīpāḥ samudreṇa plāvitāśca tathāpare || 8 || grāmādideśasaṃyuktāḥ sthitāḥ sāgaramadhyagāḥ || eka eva sthitasteṣāṃ kumāryākhyastu sāṃpratam || 9 || biṃdusaraḥ prabhṛtyeva sāgarāddakṣiṇottaram || yojanānāṃ sahasraṃ tu ekaṃ vistīrṇa eva tu || 7.1.172.10 || yojanānāṃ sahasrāṇi nava dairghyaṃ prakīrtitam || tasyaitajjṛmbhitaṃ devi bharatasya mahātmanaḥ || 11 || ṣaṭpañcāśadaśvamedhāngaṃgāmanu cakāra yaḥ|| yastriṃśadyamunāprānte bharato lokapūjitaḥ || 12 || sa ceśvaraprasādena modate divi devavat || 13 || yastatpratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhārataṃ pūjayiṣyati || sa sarvayajñadānānāṃ phalaṃ prāpayitā dhuvam || 14 || kārttikyāṃ kṛttikā yoge yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || na sa paśyati svapnepi narakaṃ ghoradāruṇam || 15 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bharateśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 172 || || cha || ||
<7.1.173>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam || ekasthānasthitānāṃ tu sāvitryāstatra paścime || 1 || liṃgānāṃ dvitayaṃ pūrve paścime sammukhadvayam || kuśakeśvaranāmeti liṃgaṃ vai prathamaṃ smṛtam || 2 || gargeśvaraṃ dvitīyaṃ tu tṛtīyaṃ puṣkareśvaram || maitreyeśvaranāmeti caturthaṃ samudāhṛtam || 3 || etāni yastu liṃgāni paśyedbhaktyā jitendriyaḥ || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairgacchecchivapuraṃ mahat || || 4 || śuklapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ vaiśākhe tu viśeṣataḥ || snānaṃ kṛtvā prayatnena brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayet || 5 || tebhyo dadyādyathāśaktyā kāñcanaṃ vasanāni ca || evaṃ kṛte bhavedyātrā paripūrṇā sureśvari || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuśakādiliṃgacatuṣṭayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaratatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 173 || || cha ||
<7.1.174>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kuntīśvaramanuttamam || sāvitryāḥ pūrvabhāgasthaṃ khātamadhye vyavasthitam || 1 || kuntyā pratiṣṭhitaṃ devi kṣetre prābhāsike priye || pāṇḍavāstu yadā pūrvaṃ prabhāsakṣetramāgatāḥ || 2 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena kuntyā caiva samanvitāḥ || tasminkāle mahādevi jñātvā kṣetramanuttamam||3|| kuntyā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapāpabhayāpaham|| kārtikyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ|| sa sarvakāmatṛptātmā rudraloke mahīyate||4|| vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā yadupārjitam|| tatsarvaṃ naśyate devi tasya liṃgasya darśanāt||5|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuntīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 174 ||
<7.1.175>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi puṇyamarkasthalaṃ śubham || tasmādāgneyakoṇasthaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānuṣo devi na śocyaḥ saṃprajāyate || sapta janmāni deveśi dāridryaṃ naiva jāyate || 2 || kuṣṭhāni nāśamāyāṃti taṃ dṛṣṭvā daśadhā priye || gośatasya pradattasya kurukṣetreṣu yatphalam || 3 || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti dṛṣṭvā vārkasthalaṃ ravim || snātvā trisaṃgame tīrthe saptaiva ravivāsarān ||4|| brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu mahiṣīṃ tatra dāpayet || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu svargaloke mahīyate || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'rkasthalamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 175 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.176>
|| īśvara uvāca || || || tato gacchenmahādevi siddheśvaramiti smṛtam || arkasthalāttathā''gneyyāṃ nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || aṣṭādaśa sahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām || tasmim̐lliṃge tu siddhāni siddheśvaramataḥ smṛtam || 2 || snātvā'rcayennaro bhaktyā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || saṃpūjya vidhivaddevaṃ dadyādvipreṣu dakṣiṇām || sarvakāmasamṛddhastu sa yāti paramaṃ padam || | || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāharūyā saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsajñetramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 176 ||
<7.1.177>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge lakulīśastu mūrtimān || svayaṃ tiṣṭhati deveśi kṛtvā ghoraṃ tapaḥ purā || 1 || saṃsthitaḥ pāpaśamane tatra sthāne sthalopari || kārtikyāṃ kṛttikāyoge yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || 2 || sa pūjyate mahādevi sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye lakulīśamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptasaptatyuttaraśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 177 || || cha ||
<7.1.178>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasmāddakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || bhārgaveśvaranāmānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || yastaṃ pūjayate devi divyapuṣpopahārakaiḥ || sa bhavetkṛtakṛtyastu sarvakāmaiḥ samṛddhimān || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhārgaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭasaptatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 178 || || cha ||
<7.1.179>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || siddheśāddakṣiṇe koṇe dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || māṇḍavyeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || māghe māse caturdaśyāṃ pūjāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || kuryādyo'tīndriyo martyo na sa martye punarvrajet || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsajñetramāhātmye māṇḍavyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonā śītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 179 || || cha ||
<7.1.180>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetpuṣpadanteśvaraṃ śubham || puṣpadanteśvaronāma gaṇeśaḥ śaṃkarasya tu ||1|| tena taptaṃ tapo ghoraṃ tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate jaṃturjanmasaṃsārabandhanāt || prāpnuyādīpsitānkāmāniha loke paratra ca || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣpadanteśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 180 || || cha ||
<7.1.181>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kṣetrapeśvaramuttamam || siddheśvara samīpasthaṃ pūrvasminnātidūrataḥ || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā śuklapañcamyāṃ na ca nāgaiḥ sa daśyate || 2 || pūjayettaṃ vidhānena gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || bhojayedbrāhmaṇāñchaktyā bhakṣyabhojyairanekaśaḥ || 3 || itiśrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye kṣetrapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 181 || ||
<7.1.182>
tato mātṛgaṇānpaśyedvasunandādināmataḥ || arka sthalasamīpasthāndakṣiṇe nātidūrataḥ || 1 || āśvayukchuklapakṣe tu navamyāṃ niyatātmavān || yastāḥ pūjayate mātṝrvidhinā bhāvitātmavān || 2 || sa samṛddhimavāpnoti durāpāmakṛtātmabhiḥ || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyecchrīmukhaṃ vivarapriyam || 3 || tasminneva dine pūjyaṃ siddhikāmairnaraiḥ sadā || etatpūrvaṃ mayākhyātaṃ tava vistarataḥ priye || 4 || tasminneva dine pūjyaṃ tīrthayātrāprasaṃgataḥ || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vasunandāmātṛgaṇaśrīmukhavivara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 182 ||
<7.1.183>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi miśratīrthamanuttamam || trisaṃgameti vikhyātaṃ sauraṃ tīrthamanuttamam || 1 || sarasvatī hiraṇyā ca samudraścaiva bhāmini || trayāṇāṃ saṃgamo yatra duṣprāpyo daivatairapi || 2 || sarveṣāṃ tatra tīrthānāṃ pradhānaṃ tīrthamuttamam || sūryaparvaṇi saṃprāpte kurukṣetrādviśiṣyate || 3 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japastatra sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 4 || maṃkīśvarānmahādevi yāvalliṃgaṃ kṛtasmaram || etasminnantare devi tīrthānāṃ daśakoṭayaḥ || 5 || kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca śvapacā vā narādhamāḥ || so'pi svargamavāpnoti kiṃ punarbhāvitātmavān || 6 || tatra pītāni vastrāṇi kāñcanaṃ surabhistathā || brāhmaṇāya pradātavyā samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 7 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snātvā yastarpayetpitṝn || tarpitāḥ pitarastena yāvaccandrārkatārakam || 8 || etattrisaṃgamaṃ devi mahāpātakanāśanam || durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vaiśākhyāṃ tu viśeṣataḥ || 9 || vṛṣo tsargo viśeṣeṇa tatra kāryo narottamaiḥ || sarvapāpavināśāya pitṝṇāṃ prītaye priye || 7.1.183.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye trisaṃgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 183 ||
<7.1.184>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi maṃkīśvaramanuttamam || trisaṃgamasamīpasthaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam|| 1 || maṃkīnāma ṛṣiḥ pūrvamāsītsa tapatāṃ varaḥ || sa ca jñātvā mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ śaṃkarapriyam || 2 || atapadvai tapo ghoraṃ kandamūlaphalāśanaḥ || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || 3 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo dadau prīto varaṃ tadā || sa vavre yadi tuṣṭo'si asminsthāne sthito bhava || 4 || mannāmāṃkitaliṃgastu vasa kalpāyutāyutam || evamastvityathetyuktvā tatraivāntaradhīyata || 5 || tadāprabhṛti talliṃgaṃ maṃkīśvaramiti śrutam|| māghe māse trayodaśyāṃ caturdaśyāmathāpi vā || 6 || pūjyāḥ paṃcopacāreṇa prāpnuyādīpsitaṃ phalam || godānaṃ tatra vai deyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 7 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṃkīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 184 || || cha ||
<7.1.185>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devamātaramavyayām || maṃkīśānnairṛte bhāge gaurīrūpasamāśritām|| devamātā sarasvatyā nāma lokeṣu gīyate || 1 || pādukāsanasaṃsthā ca tatra devī sarasvatī || gaurīrūpeṇa sā tatra vaḍavāśritavigrahā || 2 || mātṛvadrakṣitā devā vaḍavānalabhītitaḥ || devamāteti loke'smiṃ stataḥ sā vibudhaiḥ kṛtā || 3 || māghe māse tṛtīyāyāṃ yastāmarcayate naraḥ || nārī vā saṃyatā sādhvī sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 4 || daṃpatī bhoja yedyastu pāyasaiḥ śarkarādibhiḥ || gaurīsahasrabhojyasya dattasya phalamāpnuyāt || 5 || suvarṇapādukā deyā tatra viprāya śīline || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devamātṛgaurīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcā śītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 185 || || cha ||
<7.1.186>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi nāgasthānamanuttamam || maṃkīśātpaścime bhāge saṃgamatritayaṃ gatam || 1 || pāpaghnaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ pātālavivaraṃ mahat || 2 || balabhadraḥ purā devi śrutvā kṛṣṇasya paṃcatām || bhallatīrthe tu bhallena tataḥ prabhāsamāgataḥ || 3 || kṣetraṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi jñātvā sarvārthasiddhidam || yādavānāṃ kṣayaṃ kṛtvā tato vairāgyameyivān || || 4 || śeṣanāgeśarūpeṇa niṣkramya ca śarīrataḥ || gacchangacchaṃstadā prāpya tīrthaṃ traisaṃgamaṃ param || 5 || pātālasya tadā dṛṣṭvā dvāraṃ vivararūpakam || praviṣṭo'tha jagāmāśu yatrānaṃtaḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ || 6 || yato nāgasvarūpeṇa sthāne'smiṃśca samāviśat || tatprabhṛtyeva deveśi nāgasthānamiti śrutam || 7 || nāgarādityapūrveṇa yatra kāyo visarjitaḥ || tadadyāpi prasiddhaṃ vai śeṣasthānamiti śrutam || 8 || ataḥ snātvā mahādevi tatra tīrthe trisaṃgame | nāgasthānaṃ samabhyarcya pañcamyāmakṛtāśanaḥ ||9|| śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathāśaktyā dattvā viprāya dakṣiṇām || vimuktaḥ sarvaduḥkhebhyo rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 10 || pāyasaṃ madhusaṃmiśraṃ bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ samanvitam || śeṣanāgaṃ samuddiśya vipraṃ yastatra bhojayet || koṭibhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāga sthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 186 || || cha ||
<7.1.187>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sarvakāmaphalapradam || prabhāsapaṃcakaṃ puṇyamādyaṃ tatra vyavasthitam || 1 || tasyaiva paścime bhāge prabhāsa iti cocyate || vṛddhaprabhāsaśca tato dakṣiṇe nātidūrataḥ || 2 || jala prabhāsaśca tato dakṣiṇena varānane || kṛtasmaraprabhāsaśca śmaśānaṃ yatra bhairavam || 3 || evaṃ paṃcaprabhāsānyaḥ paśyedbhaktayā samanvitaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 4 || na nivartati yatprāpya duṣprāpyaṃ tridaśairapi || prabhāsaṃ prathamaṃ tīrthaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 5 || devānāmapi duṣprāpyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || prabhāse tvekarātreṇa amāvāsyāṃ kṛtodakaḥ || 6 || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || 7 || janmanāṃ ca sahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ kurute naraḥ || snānādevāsya naśyeta sāgare lavaṇāṃbhasi || 8 || caturdaśyāmamāvāsyāṃ pañcadaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā brāhmaṇānbhojya śaktitaḥ || 9 || dattvā gāṃ kāṃcanaṃ tebhyaḥ śivaḥ prīto bhavatviti || evaṃ kṛtvā naro devi kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 7.1.187.10 || || devyuvāca || || prabhāsapaṃcakaṃ hyetadyattvayā parikīrtitam || kathamatra samudbhūtametanme kautukaṃ mahat || 11 || eka eva śruto'smābhiḥ prabhāsastīrthavāsitaḥ || prabhāsāḥ paṃca deveśa yattvayā parikīrtitāḥ || 12 || etanme saṃśayaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || || 13 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ
