pāpapraṇāśanīm || yāṃ śrutvā mānavo bhaktyā prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 14 || purā maheśvaro devaścacāra vasudhāmimām || divyarūpadharaḥ kānto digvāsāḥ sa yadṛcchayā || 15 || evaṃ ca ramamāṇastu ṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ mahat || jagāma kautukāviṣṭo bhikṣārthaṃ dāruke vane || 16 || bhramamāṇasya tasyātha dṛṣṭvā rūpamanuttamam || tā nāryaḥ kāmasaṃtaptā babhūvurvyathitendriyāḥ || 17 || sānurāgāstataḥ sarvā anugacchaṃti taṃ sadā || samāliṃgaṃti tāḥ kāścitkāśca vīkṣaṃti rāgataḥ || 18 || prārthayaṃti tathā cānyāḥ parityajya gṛhānsvakān || 19 || evaṃ tāsāṃ svarūpaṃ te dṛṣṭvā sarve maharṣayaḥ || kopena mahatā yuktāḥ śepustaṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || || 7.1.187.20 || yasmāttvaṃ nagnatāmetya āśrame'sminmamāgataḥ || mohayānaḥ striyo'smākaṃ lajjāṃ naivaṃ karoṣi ca || tasmātte patatālliṃgaṃ sadya eva vṛṣadhvaja || 21 || tatastatpatitaṃ liṃgaṃ tatkṣaṇācchaṃkarasya ca || tasminprapatite bhūmau prākaṃpata vasuṃdharā || 22 || kṣubhitāḥ sāgarāḥ sarve maryādā vijahustadā || śīrṇāni giriśṛṃgāṇi trastāḥ sarve divaukasaḥ || 23 || tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ samahoragakinnarāḥ || ūcuḥ pitāmahaṃ gatvā kimetatkāraṇaṃ vibho || 24 || sāgarāḥ kṣubhitā yena plāvayaṃti vasuṃdharām || śīryaṃte giriśṛṅgāṇi kaṃpate ca vasuṃdharā || 25 || cihnāni lokanāśāya dṛśyante dāruṇāni ca || teṣāṃ tadvacana śrutvā brahmaloke pitāmahaḥ || 26 || dhyātvā tu suciraṃ kālaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || śivaliṃgaṃ nipatitaṃ pṛthivyāṃ surasattamāḥ || 27 || śāpena ṛṣimukhyānāṃ bhārgavāṇāṃ mahātmanām || tasminnipatite bhūmau trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 28 || etadavasthatāṃ prāptaṃ tasmāttatraiva gamyatām || viṣṇunā saha gīrvāṇāstathā nītirvidhīyatām || 29 || tataḥ kṣīrodadhiṃ jagmurbrahmādyāstridivaukasaḥ || yatra śete caturbāhuryoganidrāṃ ca saṃgataḥ || 7.1.187.30 || tasmai sarvaṃ samācakhyustenaiva sahitāstataḥ || jagmuryatra mahādevo liṃgena rahito vibhuḥ || 31 || ūcuḥ samāhitāḥ sarve praṇipatya divaukasaḥ ||32|| liṃgamutkṣipyatāmetadyatkṣitau patitaṃ vibho || ete mahārṇavāḥ sarve plāvayaṃti vasuṃdharām ||33|| || bhagavānuvāca || || ṛṣibhiḥ pātitaṃ hyetanmama liṃgaṃ sureśvarāḥ || na tu śakyo mayā kartuṃ bādhasteṣāṃ mahātmanām ||34|| śāpo hi bhārgavendrāṇāmato me śrūyatāṃ vacaḥ || pūjayadhvaṃ surāḥ sarve brahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ ||35|| liṃgametattataḥ sarve sarvaṃ lipsatha sattamāḥ || prakṛtiṃ sāgarāḥ sarve yāsyaṃti girayastathā || 36 || etatpuṇyatame kṣetre dhṛtvā sarve samāhitāḥ || athoddhṛtya surāḥ sarve prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ ||37|| tatraiva nidadhuḥ sarve tataḥ pūjāṃ pracakrire || brahmaṇā pūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 38 || śakreṇātha kubereṇa yamena varuṇena ca || ūcuścaiva tato devā liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || 39 || adyaprabhṛti rudrasya liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || bhaviṣyāmo na saṃdehastathā pitṛgaṇāśca ye || 7.1.187.40 || ya enaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti bhaktiyuktāśca mānavāḥ || yāsyaṃti te surāvāsaṃ saśarīrā narottamāḥ || 41 || atraiva prathamaṃ ligaṃ yatosmā'bhiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || prabhāsaṃ nāma cāsyāpi prabhāseti bhaviṣyati || 42 || evamuktvā gatāḥ sarve tridivaṃ surasattamāḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tridivaṃ yānti bhūyāṃsaḥ prāṇino bhuvi || 43 || tatastriviṣṭapaṃ vyāptaṃ bahubhiḥ prāṇibhiḥ priye || taddṛṣṭvā tridivaṃ vyāptaṃ sahasrākṣaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ || 44 || jñātvā liṃgaprabhāvaṃ tu tataścāgatya bhūtalam || vajreṇācchādayāmāsa samaṃtātsa varānane || 45 || tataḥ prabhṛti no devi svargaṃ gacchaṃti mānavāḥ || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaḥ prabhāsasya mahodayaḥ || sarvapāpopaśamanaḥ sarvakāmaphalaṃ pradaḥ ||46|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prabhāsapañcakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 187 || || cha ||
<7.1.188>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tatra sthāne tu saṃsthitam || rudreśvaretināmānaṃ svayaṃbhūtaṃ dharātale || 1 || ādiprabhāsātpurato dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || rudreṇa dhyānamāsthāya svaṃ tejastatra yojitam || 2 || tato rudreśvaraṃnāma sarvapātakanāśanam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rudreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 188 || || cha ||
<7.1.189>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva paścime bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || caṇḍikā karmamoṭī ca yoginī koṭisaṃyutā || pīṭhatrayaṃ mahādevi ādyaṃ trailokyavanditam || 1 || navamyāṃ tatra saṃpūjya devīpīṭhaṃ ca yoginīm || sa sarvānprāpnuyātkāmānbhavetsvargāṃganāpriyaḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsajñetramāhātmye karmamoṭīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 189 || || cha || ||
<7.1.190>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tatra muktipradaṃ harim || prabhāsānnairṛte bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || ekādaśyāṃ jitāhāro yastaṃ devi prapūjayet || māghemāse viśeṣeṇa so'gniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet || 2 || yastatrānaśanaṃ kuryādvrataṃ cāndrāyaṇādikam || so'nya tīrthātkoṭiguṇaṃ prāpnuyātphalamīpsitam || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye mokṣasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 190 || || cha ||
<7.1.191>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ajīgarteśvaraṃ haram || candravāpīsamīpasthaṃ karmamoṭīsamīpataḥ || 1 || tasyāṃ snātvā mahādevi yastalligaṃ prapūjayet || sa muktaḥ pātakairghorairgacchecchivapadaṃ mahat || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jīgarteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 191 || || ||
<7.1.192>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi viśvakarmapratiṣṭhitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi mokṣasvāmina uttare || 1 || dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake devi sthitaṃ pātakanāśanam || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyagyātrāphalamavāpnuyāt || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ darśanāttasya naśyati || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye viśvakarmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 192 || || cha ||
<7.1.193>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yameśvaramanuttamam || tasyaiva nairṛte bhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || darśanātpāpaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma triṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 193 || || cha ||
<7.1.194>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ devaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || jñātvā prabhāvaṃ kṣetrasya sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tatra kṛtvā tapaścograṃ liṃgaṃ devaiḥ pratiṣṭhitam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi kṛtakṛtyaḥ prajāyate || 2 || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu brāhmaṇe vedapārage || samyakca labhate devi yātrāyāḥ phalamūrjitam || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'mareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 194 || || cha ||
<7.1.195>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato vṛddhaprabhāsaṃ tu gacchecca niyatātmavān || ādiprabhāsāddakṣiṇato nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || caturmukhaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ darśanātpāpanāśanam || 2 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || kathaṃ vṛddhaprabhāsaṃ tu nāma tasyābhavatprabho || tasmindṛṣṭe phalaṃ kiṃ syātstute saṃpūjite tathā || 3 || etatkathaya me deva saṃkṣepānnātivistarāt || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || ādau svāyaṃbhuve devi pūrvamanvantare purā || tretāyuge caturthe tu prabhāse kṣetra uttame || 5 || tasminkāle mahādevi pūrvamanvaṃtare purā || tretāyuge caturthe tu ṛṣayastatra saṃgatāḥ || 6 || darśanārthaṃ prabhāsasya uttarāpathagāminaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā''cchāditaṃ devaṃ vajreṇa tu maheśvari || 7 || viṣādaṃ paramaṃ jagmurvākyaṃ cedamathābuvan || adṛṣṭvā śāṃkaraṃ ligaṃ na yāsyāmo vayaṃ gṛham || 8 || svargārthino vayaṃ prāptā mahadadhvānameva hi || tasmādatraiva tiṣṭhāmo yāvalliṃgasya darśanam || 9 || evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā parasmiṃstapasi sthitāḥ || varṣāsvākāśagā bhūtvā hemaṃte salilāśrayāḥ || 7.1.195.10 || pañcāgnisādhanā grīṣme niyatā brahmacāriṇaḥ || bahūnvarṣagaṇānviprā jarāgrastāstadā'bhavan || 11 || evaṃ vṛddhatvamāpannā yadā te varavarṇini || chandyamānā varaiste tu śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā || 12 || liṃgasya darśanaṃ muktvā na te'nyaṃ vavrire varam || 13 || teṣāṃ tu niścayaṃ jñātvā sarveṣāṃ vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || anukampāparo bhūtvā svaliṃgaṃ tānadarśayat || 14 || etasminneva kāle tu bhittvā caiva vasundharām || utthitaṃ sahasā liṃgaṃ tadeva varavarṇini || 15 || ṛṣayaste ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve ca tridivaṃ gatāḥ || atha teṣu prayāteṣu śakrastaptamanā hyabhūt || 16 || tamapi cchādayāmāsa vajreṇa śataparvaṇā || 17 || vṛddhabhāve yatasteṣāmṛṣīṇāṃ darśanaṃ gataḥ || ato vṛddhaprabhāsaṃ tatkīrtyate vasudhātale || 18 || tasmindṛṣṭe varārohe adyāpi labhate phalam || rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ naro bhaktisamanvitaḥ || 19 || evaṃ tatra samutpannaṃ prabhāsaṃ vṛddhasaṃjñakam || tatrokṣā brāhmaṇe deyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 7.1.195.20 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vṛddhaprabhāsamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 195 || cha ||
<7.1.196>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi prabhāsaṃ jalasaṃsthitam || vṛddhaprabhāsāddakṣiṇato nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || tasyaiva devi devasya śṛṇu māhātmyamuttamam || 2 || jāmadagnyena rāmeṇa yadā kṣattravadhaḥ kṛtaḥ || tadā'sya paramā jātā ghṛṇā manasi bhāmini || 3 || tatastvārādhayāmāsa mahādevaṃ sureśvaram|| ugraṃ tapaḥ samāsthāya bahūnvarṣa gaṇānpriye || 4 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasya pratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || abravīdvaradaste'haṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata || 5 || || rāma uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama || darśayasva svakaṃ liṃgaṃ yajñe vajreṇa chāditam || 6 || ghṛṇā me mahatī jātā hatvemānkṣatriyānbahūn || darśanāttava liṃgasya yena me naśyate ghṛṇā || 7 || tathā me pātakaṃ sarvaṃ prasādāttava śaṃkara || 8 || || śaṃkara uvāca || || mama liṃgaṃ sahasrākṣa utthitaṃ tu punaḥpunaḥ || vajreṇācchādayatyeva bhayena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 9 || na te'haṃ darśanaṃ yāsye liṃgarūpī kadācana || 7.1.196.10 || yanmāṃ vadasi ghṛṇayā vṛto'haṃ pātakena tu || tatte'haṃ nāśayiṣyāmi sparśanāttu dvijottama || 11 || asmiñjalāśraye puṇye jalamadhye mahāmate || utthāsyati mahāliṃgaṃ tasya tvaṃ darśanaṃ kuru || || 12 || gamiṣyati ghṛṇā sarvā niṣpāpastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || uktvaivamudatiṣṭhacca jalamadhyādvarānane || 13 || jalaprabhāsanāmāsya tato jātaṃ dharātale || tasyālaṃ sparśanāddevi śivalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ || 14 || ekaṃ bhojayate yo'tra brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam || bhojito'haṃ bhavettena sapatnīko na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || eṣā jalaprabhāsasya saṃbhūtiste mayoditā || śrutā pāpopaśamanī sarvakāmaphalapradā || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jalaprabhāsamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 196 || |||
<7.1.197>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi jamadagnīśvaraṃ śivam || vṛddhaprabhāsasāmīpye nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sthāpitaṃ jamadagninā || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate ca ṛṇatrayāt || 2 || snātvā nidhānavāpyāṃ ca saṃpūjya prāpnuyāddhanam || nidhānaṃ pāṃḍavairlabdhaṃ tatra sthāne purā priye || 3 || nidhānenaiva sā khyātā vāpī trailokyavaṃditā || 4 || tasyāṃ snātvā mahādevi durbhagā subhagā bhavet || labhate vāñchitānkāmāniti proktaṃ mayā tava || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jamadagnīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 197 || ||
<7.1.198>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi mahāprabhāsamuttamam || jalaprabhāsato yāmye yamamārgavighātakam || 1 || śṛṇu tasyaiva māhātmyaṃ yathā jātaṃ dharātale || || 2 || pūrvaṃ tretāyuge devi sparśaliṃgaṃ tu tatsmṛtam || divyaṃ tejomayaṃ nṛṇāṃ sparśanānmuktidāyakam || 3 || atha kāle ca kasmiṃścidvajriṇācchāditaṃ priye || indreṇāgatya vasudhāṃ bhayākrāṃtena sundari || 4 || uṣmā tadudbhavo devi nirgacchannavarodhitaḥ || daśakoṭipravistīrṇaṃ jvālāgraṃ liṃgarūpadhṛk || 5 || prabhāsakṣetramāsthāya bhittvā''virbhāvamāsthitam || vajreṇa ruṃdhite devi bhittvā caiva vasuṃdharām || 6 || dhūmasaṃghaiḥ sametaṃ tu vyāpayāmāsa tajjagat || tatastrailokyamakhilaṃ jvālābhirvyākulīkṛtam || 7 || tataḥ suragaṇāḥ sarva ṛṣayo vedapāragāḥ || astuvanvividhaiḥ sūktairvedoktaiḥ śaśiśekharam || 8 || saṃharasva suraśreṣṭha tejaḥ svadahanātmakam || trai lokyaṃ vyākulībhūtamevaṃ sarvaṃ carācaram || na yāvatpralayaṃ yāti tāvadrakṣa sureśvara || 9 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamābhāṣamāṇeṣu tridiveṣu sureśvari || tattejaḥ pañcadhāviṣṭaṃ vyāpyāśeṣaṃ jagattrayam || || 7.1.198.10 || pañcaprabhāsarūpeṇa bhittvā tatra vasundharām|| yena mārgeṇa niṣkrāntaṃ tanmārge ca mahanmahaḥ || 11 || tatra taiḥ sthāpitaṃ dvāraṃ supradeśe'śmajaṃ priye || pihite'tha ca raṃdhre'smindhūmo nāśamupeyivān || 12 || svasthāścaivābhavam̐llokāstejastatraiva saṃsthitam || evaṃ mayā preritāste liṃgaṃ tatra samādadhuḥ || 13 || tanmahastatra deveśi viśrāmamakarottadā || tato mahāprabhāseti kīrtyate devadānavaiḥ || 14 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā liṃgaṃ puṣpaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 15 || dṛṣṭena tena deveśi mucyate pātakairnaraḥ || labhate vāñchitānkāmānmanasā cepsitānpriye || 16 || hiraṇyaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe śaṃsitavrate || godānaṃ vidhivattatra deyaṃ caiva dvijanmane || 17 || evaṃ kṛtvā mahādevi labhate janmanaḥ phalam || rājasūyāśvamedhānāṃ prāpnuyātphalamūrjitam || 18 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pañcamaprabhāsakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭānavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 198 || || cha ||
<7.1.199>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || sarasvatyāstaṭe ramye devaṃ tatra kṛtasmaram || 1 || svayaṃbhūtaṃ mahādevi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā jātaṃ mahītale || 2 || purā kāmo mayā dagdho yadā tatra varānane || tadā ratiḥ samāgamya vilalāpa suduḥkhitā || 3 || tāṃ tu śokāturāṃ dṛṣṭvā tatrāhaṃ karuṇānvitaḥ || avocaṃ mā rudiṣveti tava bhartā punaḥ śubhe || samutthāsyati kālena matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ || 4 || || devyuvāca || || kimarthaṃ sa purā dagdhaḥ kāmadevastvayā vibho || kathamāpa punarjanma vistarātkathayasva me || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || dakṣaḥ prajāpatiḥ pūrvaṃ babhūva tvatpitā priye || śataṃ sutānāṃ jajñe'sya gaurīṇāṃ dīrghacakṣuṣām || 6 || dadau tvāṃ prathamaṃ mahyaṃ satīnāmeti kīrtitām || dadau daśa ca dharmāya śraddhā medhā dhṛtiḥ kṣamā || 7 || anasūyā śucirlajjā smṛtiḥ śaktiḥ śrutistathā || dve bhārye kāmadevāya ratiḥ prītistathaiva ca || 8 || ekāṃ svāhāṃ dadau vahneḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca tataḥ svadhām || saptaviṃśacchaśāṅkāya aśvinyādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 9 || tavāpi viditā devi revatyantāstathā jane || kaśyapāya dadau devi sa tu kanyāstrayodaśa || 7.1.199.10 || aditiśca ditiścaiva vinatā kadrureva ca || siṃhikā suprabhā caiva ulūkī yā varānane || 11 || anuviddhā sitā caiva īrṣyā hiṃsā tathā parā || māyā niṣkṛtisaṃyuktā dakṣaḥ pūrvaṃ mahāmatiḥ || 12 || gaurī ca suprabhā caiva vārttā sādhvī sumālikā || varuṇāya dadau pañca tadā'sau parvatātmaje || 13 || bhadrā ca madirā caiva vidyā dhanyā dhanā śubhā || dadau pañca kuberāya patnyarthaṃ parvatātmaje || 14 || jayā ca vijayā caiva madhuspandā irāvatī || supriyā janakā kāntā subhadrā dhārmikā śubhā || 15 || rudrāṇāṃ pradadau kanyā daśānāṃ dharmavittadā || prabhāvatī subhadrā ca vimalā nirmalā'nṛtā || 16 || tīvrā dakṣāruṇā vidyā dhārapālā ca varcasā || ādityānāṃ dadau dakṣaḥ kanyādvādaśakaṃ priye || 17 || yoganidrābhibhūtasya saṃsarpā saramā guhā || mālā caṃpā tathā jyotsnā sa viśvebhyaśca eva ca || 18 || aśvibhyāṃ dve tathā kanye suveṣā bhūṣaṇā śubhā || ekā kanyā tathā vāyordattā etāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 19 || sāvitrīṃ brahmaṇe prādāllakṣmīṃ viṣṇormahātmanaḥ || kasyacittvatha kālasya sa īje dakṣiṇāvatā || 7.1.199.20 || yajñena parvatasute himavante mahāgirau || yajñavāṭo hyabhūttasya sarvakāmasamṛddhimān || 21 || tasminyajñe samāyātā ādityā vasava stathā || viśvedevāśca maruto lokapālāśca sarvaśaḥ || 22 || brahmā viṣṇuḥ sahasrākṣo vāruṇo yama eva ca || dhanadaśca kumāraśca tathā nadyaśca sāgarāḥ || || 23 || vāpyaḥ kūpāstathā caiva taḍāgāḥ palvalāni ca || suparṇaścātha ye nāgāḥ sarve mūrtā vyavasthitāḥ || 24 || dānavāpsarasaścaiva yakṣāḥ kinnaraguhyakāḥ || sānugāste sabhāryāśca vedavedāṃgapāragāḥ || 25 || maharṣayo mahābhāgāstathā devarṣayaśca ye || te bhāryāsahitāstatra vasaṃti ca varānane ||26|| kapālamālābharaṇaścitābhasma bibharti yaḥ || apavitratayā śaṃbhurnāhūtastu tathāvidhaḥ || 27 || yatastataḥ samāyātāḥ kailāse parvatottame || aśvinyādyā bhaginyastāstvāṃ pratīdaṃ vaco'buvan || 28 || kiṃ tuṣṭeva ca kalyāṇi tiṣṭhasi tvaṃ sumadhyame || vayaṃ ca prasthitāḥ sarvāḥ pituryajñe sabhartṛkāḥ||29|| vayamākāritāstena sutāḥ sarvā yaśasvini || na tvāmāhūtavāndakṣastrapate śaṃkarādyataḥ||7.1.199.30|| tāsāṃ vacanamākarṇya satī prāha krudhānvitā|| hā dhigdakṣa durācāra kiṃ vadiṣye maheśvaram ||31|| kathaṃ saṃdarśaye vaktramityuktvā''tmānamātmanā || visasarja tapoyogātsasmārānyanna kiñcana ||32|| atha dṛṣṭvā mahādevaḥ satīṃ prāṇairvinā sthitām || avamānāttathā''tmānaṃ tyaktvā matvā kapālinam ||33|| gaṇānsaṃpreṣayāmāsa yajñavidhvaṃsanāya ca || te gatāśca gaṇā raudrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 34 || vikṛtā vikṛtākārā asaṃkhyātā mahābalāḥ || rudreṇa preritāndṛṣṭvā vīrabhadrapurogamān ||35|| tato devagaṇāḥ sarve vasavaḥ saha bhāskaraiḥ || viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca dhanurhastā mahābalāḥ || 36 || yuddhāya ca viniṣkrāntā muñcantaḥ sāyakāñchitān || te sametya tato'nyonyaṃ pramathā vibudhaiḥ saha || 37 || mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi vāridhārāṃ yathā ghanāḥ || teṣāṃ hastī gaṇenātha śūlena hṛdi bheditaḥ || 38 || sa tu tena prahāreṇa visaṃjño niṣasāda ha || atha muṣṭyā hataḥ kumbhe nāga airāvaṇastadā || 39 || sahasā sa hatastena vāraṇo bhairavānravān|| vinadañjavamāsthāya yajñavāṭamupādravat || 7.1.199.40 || viśvedevā nirucchvāsāḥ kṛtā raudrairmahāśaraiḥ || cakarṣa sa dhanuṣyeṇa vasumānbalavataraḥ || || 41 || nistejasastadādityāḥ kṛtāstena raṇājire || etasminnantare devāḥ kṛtāstena parāṅmukhāḥ || 42 || tataste śaraṇaṃ jagmurviṣṇuṃ tatra ca saṃsthitam || tataḥ kopasamāviṣṭo viṣṇurdevānsavāsavān || 43 || dṛṣṭvā vidrāvitānsarvānmumocāśu sudarśanam || tamāpatantaṃ vegena viṣṇoścakraṃ sudarśanam || 44 || prasārya vaktraṃ sahasā udarasthaṃ cakāra ha || tasmiṃścakre tadā graste amoghe parvatātmaje || 45 || cukopa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śārṅgahasto 'bhyadhāvata || sa hatvā daśabhistīkṣṇairnaṃdiṃ bhṛṅgiṃ śatena ca || 46 || mahākālaṃ sahasreṇa hyayutena gaṇādhipam || bāṇānāmayutairbhittvā vīrabhadramupādravat || 47 || taṃ hatvā gadayā viṣṇurvihvalaṃ rudhirokṣitam || gṛhītvā pādayorbhūmau nijaghānātiroṣitaḥ || 48 || hanyamānasya tasyātha bhūmau cakraṃ sudarśanam|| rudhirodgārasaṃyuktaṃ prahāramakaronna tu ||49|| rudralabdhavaro devi vīrabhadro gaṇeśvaraḥ || yanna pañcatvamāpanno gadayā pīḍito'pi saḥ || 7.1.199.50 || patitaṃ vīkṣya taṃ sarve viṣṇutejobalārditāḥ || vidrutāḥ sarvato yātā yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 51 || tasmai sarvaṃ tathā vṛttaṃ samācakhyuḥ parābhavam || vikramaṃ vīrabhadrasya tataḥ kruddho maheśvaraḥ || 52 || pragṛhya sahasā śūlaṃ prasthitaḥ svagaṇaiḥ saha || yajñavāṭaṃ tu dakṣasya parābhavabhavaṃ tataḥ || vikramanvīrabhadreṇa yatra viṣṇuḥ svayaṃ sthitaḥ ||53|| tamāyāntaṃ samālokya kopayuktaṃ maheśvaram || saṃgrāme so'jayaṃ matvā tatraivāntaradhīyata ||54|| marudbhiḥ sārdhamindro'pi vasubhiḥ saha kinnaraiḥ || śivaḥ krodhaparītātmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ ||55|| kevalaṃ brāhmaṇāstatra sthitāḥ sadasi bhāmini || te dṛṣṭvā śaṃkaraṃ prāptaṃ kopasaṃraktalocanam || 56 || homaṃ cakrustato bhītā rudramaṃtraiḥ samaṃtataḥ || anye trāsasamāyuktāḥ palāyaṃte diśo daśa || 57 || athāgatya mahādevo dṛṣṭvā tānbrāhmaṇottamān || apaśyamāno vibudhāṃstatra yajñaṃ jaghāna saḥ || 58 || sa ca mṛgavapurbhūtvā praṇaṣṭaḥ śivabhītitaḥ || pṛṣṭhatastu dhanuṣpāṇirjagāma bhagavāñchivaḥ || adyāpi dṛśyate vyomni tārārūpo maheśvari || 59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye dakṣayajñavidhvaṃsanonāma navanavatyuttaraśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 199 || || cha ||
<7.1.200>
|| īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ vidhvaṃsite yajñe gatāste brāhmaṇā gṛham || aprāptakāmanā devi ye cānye tatra vai gatāḥ || 1 || haro'pi vigatāmarṣaḥ kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ || 2 || etasminneva kāle tu tārakonāma dānavaḥ || utpannaḥ sa mahābāhurdevānāṃ baladarpahā || 3 || tena indrādikānsarvānsurāñjitvā mahāhave || svargaḥ svairvyāpito devi brahmalokaṃ tato gatāḥ || ūcuḥ surā duḥkhayuktā brahmāṇaṃ parvatātmaje || 4 || tārakeṇa suraśreṣṭha svargānnirvāsitā vayam || svayamindraḥ samabhavadvasavo'nye tathā kṛtāḥ || 5 || rudrāḥ sādhyāstathā viśve aśvinau marutastathā || ādityāśca vadhopāyaṃ tasmādvada pitāmaha || 6 || || brahmovāca || || avadhyaḥ sa tu sarveṣāṃ devānāmiti me matiḥ || ṛte tu śāṃkaraṃ tejo nānyena vinipātyate || tasmādgacchata bhadraṃ vo devadevaṃ maheśvaram || 7 || tasya bhāryā mṛtā pūrvaṃ jātā himavato gṛhe || tasyāṃ ca jāyate putraḥ sa haniṣyati tārakam || tasmātprasādayadhvaṃ vai tadarthaṃ śūlapāṇinam || 8 || tato devaiḥ samādiṣṭaḥ kāmadevo varānane || mṛtabhāryaṃ haraṃ gatvā tataḥ pīḍaya sāyakaiḥ || 9 || yenāsau kāmasaṃtapto bhāryārthaṃ yatnavānbhavet ||6 ayaṃ gacchatu te bhrātā vasaṃtaśca manoharaḥ || 7.1.200.10 || sa tatheti pratijñāya kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ || tato dṛṣṭvā mahādevaḥ kāmadevaṃ dhṛtāyudham || 11 || vasantasahitaṃ devi rudro'ndhakaniṣūdanaḥ || gaṃgādvāramanuprāpya apaśyadyāvadagrataḥ || 12 || dattāyudhaṃ kāmadevaṃ dudruve sa bhayātpunaḥ || tato vārāṇasīṃ gatvā naimiṣaṃ puṣkaraṃ tathā || 13 || śrīkaṃṭhaṃ rudrakoṭiṃ ca kurukṣetraṃ gayāṃ tathā || jvālāmārgaṃ prayāgaṃ ca viśālāmarbudaṃ śubham || 14 || bahūnvarṣagaṇānevaṃ bhramansa dharaṇītale || kāmadevabhayāddevi devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 15 || avaikṣata tadā kāmaṃ visphārya nayanaṃ tadā || tṛtīyaṃ devadeveśi devadevastrilocanaḥ || 16 || tasya taṃ vīkṣamāṇasya saṃjātāḥ pāvakārciṣaḥ || tābhiḥ sa dhanuṣā yukto bhasmasātsamapadyata || 17 || taṃ dagdhvā bhagavāñchaṃbhurgatvā roṣasya nirṇayam || nivāsamakarottatra kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || 18 || tasmindagdhe tadā kāme ratiḥ śokaparāyaṇā || vilalāpa suduḥkhārtā patibhaktiparāyaṇā || 19 || hā nāthanātha bhoḥ svāminkiṃ jahāsi pativratām || pativratāṃ patiprāṇāṃ kasmānmāṃ tyajasi prabho || 7.1.200.20 || evaṃ vilapatīṃ tāṃ tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || mā tvaṃ ruda viśālākṣi punareva patistava || 21 || prasādāddevadevasya ucchvāsyati śivasya tu || etāṃ vācaṃ ratiḥ śrutvā tataḥ svasthā babhūva ha || 22 || tato devāḥ śivaṃ natvā prārthayāmāsurīśvari || kalatrasaṃgrahaṃ deva kuru kāryārthasaṃgrahe || 23 || eṣa kāmastvayā dagdhaḥ krodhena mahatā svayam || vinā tena vibho naṣṭā sṛṣṭirvai dharaṇītale || 24 || || bhagavānuvāca || || eṣa kāmo mayā dagdhaḥ krodhena surasattamāḥ || tasmādanaṃga evaiṣa prajāsu pracariṣyati || tadvīryastatprabhāvaśca vinā dehaṃ bhaviṣyati || 25 || || devā ūcuḥ || || bhagavankuru pūrvaṃ tvaṃ saṃsmarasva ratīśvaram || hitāya sarva lokānāṃ yathā naḥ pratyayo bhavet || 26 || tataḥ sa smṛtavānkāmaṃ svayaṃ devo maheśvaraḥ || tatastacchāśvataṃ liṃgaṃ samuttasthau mahītale || 27 || kṛtasmaraḥ punastatra anaṃgo balavāṃstathā || tenoḍhā śailajā tena śaṃkareṇa mahātmanā || 28 || jātaḥ skandaḥ suraśreṣṭhastārako yena sūditaḥ || patitenaiva liṃgena yasmāccaiva kṛtasmaraḥ || 29 || tasmātkṛtasmaro loke kīrtyate sa mahītale || taṃ dṛṣṭvā na jaḍo nāṃdho nāsukhī na ca durbhagaḥ || jāyate tu kadā martyo na daridro na rogavān || 7.1.200.30 || evaṃ te sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || dagdho yathā smaraḥ pūrvaṃ punarvīryānvitaḥ sthitaḥ || 31 || || īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ dakṣiṇena kṛtasmarāt || kāmakuṃḍeti vai nāma yatrodbhūtaḥ punaḥ smaraḥ || 32 || anaṃgarūpī devyatra snānādvai rūpavānbhavet || ikṣavastatra vai deyāḥ suvarṇaṃ gāstathaiva ca || vastrāṇi caiva vidhivadbrāhmaṇe vedapārage ||33|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kāmakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 200 || || cha || ||
<7.1.201>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasminsthāne mahādevi smaśānaṃ kālabhairavam || brahmakuṇḍaṃ varārohe yāvaddevaḥ kṛtasmaraḥ||1|| tatra ye prāṇino dagdhā mṛtāḥ kālaviparyayāt || te sarve muktimāyāṃti mahāpātakino'pi vā ||2|| kṛtasmarānmahādevi yāvanmaṃkīśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || mahāsmaśānaṃ taddevi apunarbhavadāyakam ||3|| tasminsthāne vahedyatra viṣuvaṃ prāṇināṃ priye || tatroṣaraṃ smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ tanme priyataraṃ sadā ||4|| kalpāṃte'pi na muṃcāmi avimuktātpriyaṃ mama|| 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kālabhairavasmaśānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 201 || || cha ||
<7.1.202>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi rāmeśvaramanuttamam || maṃkīśāddakṣiṇe bhāge āgneye tu kṛtasmarāt || pūrvatastu sarasvatyā balabhadrapratiṣṭhitam || 1 || yatra mukto'bhavaddevi rāmo brahmavadhātkila || pātakātpratilomāṃ tāmagāhata sarasvatīm || 2 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ sa pātakānmuktaḥ kathaṃ pāpamabhūtpurā || kathaṃ tatsthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ kiṃprabhāvaṃ vadasva me || 3 || || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā mānavo devi muktaḥ saṃsārasāgarāt || sarvānkāmānsa labhate satataṃ manasi priyān || 4 || rāmaḥ pūrvaṃ parāṃ prītiṃ kṛtvā kṛṣṇasya lāṃgalī || cintayāmāsa bahudhā kiṃ kṛtaṃ sukṛtaṃ bhavet || 5 || kṛṣṇena hi vinā nāhaṃ yāsye duryodhanāntikam || pāṇḍavānvā samāśritya kathaṃ duryodhanaṃ nṛpam || 6 || jāmātaraṃ tathā śiṣyaṃ ghātayiṣye nareśvaram || tasmānna pārthaṃ yāsyāmi nāpi duryodhanaṃ nṛpam || 7 || tīrtheṣvāplāvayiṣyāmi tāvadātmānamātmanā || kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca yāvadaṃtāya kalpate || || 8 || ityādiśya hṛṣīkeśaṃ pārthaduryodhanāvapi || jagāma dvārakāṃ śauriḥ svasainyaiśca parīvṛtaḥ || 9 || gatvā dvārāvatīṃ rāmo hṛṣṭatuṣṭajanākulām || svairantaḥpuragaiḥ sārdhaṃ papau pānaṃ halāyudhaḥ || 7.1.202.10 || pītapāno jagāmātha raivatodyānamṛddhimat || haste gṛhītvā sa gadāṃ revatyādibhiranvitaḥ || 11 || strīkadaṃbakamadhyastho yayau mattavadāskhalan || dadarśa ca vanaṃ vīro ramaṇīyamanuttamam || 12 || sarvatra tarupuṣpāḍhyaṃ śākhāmṛgagaṇākulam || puṣpa padmavanopetaṃ sapalvalamahāvanam || 13 || sa śṛṇvanprītijanakānvanyānmadakalāñchubhān || śrotraramyānsumadhurāñchabdānkhagasukheritān || 14 || sarvataḥ phalaratnāḍhyānsarvataḥ kusumojjvalān || apaśyatpādapāṃścaiva vihagairanumoditān || 15 || āmrānāgrātakānbhavyānnālikerānsatiṃdukān || ābalvanāṃsthā pītāndāḍimānbījapūrakān|| panasām̐llakucānmocāṃstāpāṃścāpi manoharān || pālevatānkusaṃkullānnalinānatha vetasān || 17 || bhallātakānāmalakīṃstindukāṃśca mahāphalān || iṃgudānkaramardāṃśca harītakabibhītakān || 18 || etānanyāṃśca sa tarūndadarśa yadunandanaḥ || tathaivāśokapunnāgaketakībakulāṃstathā || 19 || caṃpakānsaptaparṇāṃśca karṇikārānsumālatīḥ || pārijātānkovidārā nmandārendīvarāṃstathā || 7.1.202.20 || pāṭalānpuṣpitānrambhāndevadārudrumāṃstathā || śālāṃstālāṃśca stamālāṃniculānvañjulāṃstathā || 21 || cakoraiḥ śatapatraiśca bhṛṃgarājaiḥ samāvṛtān || kokilaiḥ kalaviṃkaiśca hārītairjīvajīvakaiḥ || 22 || priyaputraiścātakaiśca śukairanyairvihaṃgamaiḥ || śrotraramyaṃ sumadhuraṃ kūja dbhiścāpyadhiṣṭhitaiḥ || 23 || sarāṃsi ca sapadmāni manojñasalilāni ca || kumudaiḥ puṇḍarīkaiśca tathā rocanakotpalaiḥ || 24 || kahlāraiḥ kamalaiścāpi carcitāni samaṃtataḥ || kadaṃbaiścakravākaiśca tathaiva jalakukkuṭaiḥ || 25 || kāraṇḍavaiḥ plavairhaṃsaiḥ kūrmairmaṃḍubhireva ca || etairanyaiśca kīrṇāni tathānyairjalavā sibhiḥ || 26 || krameṇa saṃcaranrāmaḥ prekṣamāṇo manoramam || jagāmānugataḥ strībhirlatāgṛhamanuttamam || 27 || sa dadarśa dvijāṃstatra vedavedāṃgapāra gān || kauśikānbhārgavāṃścaiva bhāradvājāṃśca gautamān || 28 || vividheṣu ca saṃbhūtānvaṃśeṣu dvijasattamān || kathāśravaṇasotkaṇṭhānupaviṣṭānmahā tmanaḥ || 29 || kṛṣṇājinottarīyeṣu kūrceṣu ca vṛsīṣu ca || sūte ca teṣāṃ madhyasthaṃ kathayānaṃ kathāḥ śubhāḥ || 7.1.202.30 || paurāṇikāḥ surarṣīṇāmā dyānāṃ caritakriyāḥ || dṛṣṭvā rāmaṃ dvijāḥ sarve madhupānāruṇekṣaṇam || 31 || matto'yamiti manvānāḥ samuttasthustvarānvitāḥ || pūjayanto haladharaṃ tamṛte sūtavaṃśajam || 32 || tataḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo halī sūtaṃ mahābalaḥ || nijaghāna vivṛttākṣaḥ kṣobhitāśeṣadānavaḥ || 33 || anvāsite padaṃ brāhmyaṃ tasminsūte nipātite || niṣkrāntāste dvijāḥ sarve vanātkṛṣṇājināṃbarāḥ || 34 || avadhūtaṃ tathātmānaṃ manyamāno halāyudhaḥ || cintayāmāsa sumahanmayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam || 35 || brahmāsanagato hyeṣa yaḥ sūto vinipātitaḥ|| tathā hyete dvijāḥ sarve māmavekṣya vinirgatāḥ || 36 || śarīrasya ca me gandho lohasyevāsukhāvahaḥ || ātmānaṃ cāvagacchāmi brahmaghnamiti kutsitam || 37 || dhiṅmamārthaṃ tathā madyaṃ mahimānamakīrtidam || yenā viṣṭena sumahanmayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam||38|| smṛtyuktaṃ te kariṣyāmi prāyaścittaṃ yathāvidhi|| uktamastyeva manunā prāyaścittādikaṃ kramāt||39|| japaḥ pracchannapāpānāṃ manastāpa eva ca|| bhūtātmanastapovidye buddherjñānaṃ viśodhanam||7.1.202.40|| kṣetreśvarasya vijñānādviśuddhiḥ paramā matā|| śarīrasya viśuddhistu prāyaścittaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ|| 41|| tato'dyataḥ kariṣyāmi vrataṃ dvādaśavārṣikam|| svakarmakhyāpanaṃ kurvanprāyaścittamanuttamam||42|| iyaṃ viśuddhirajñānāddhatvā cākāmato dvijam || kāmato brāhmaṇavadhe niṣkṛtirna vidhīyate || 43 || yaḥ kāmato mahāpāpaṃ naraḥ kurynātkathaṃcana || na tasya niṣkṛtirdṛṣṭā bhṛgvagnipatanādṛte || 44 || akāmataḥ kṛte pāpe prāyaścittaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || kāmakārakṛte'pyāhureke śrutinidarśanāt || 45 || vidhiḥ prāthamikastasmāddvitīye dviguṇaṃ caret || tṛtīye triguṇaṃ proktaṃ caturthe nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 46 || auṣadhaṃ snehamāhāraṃ dadadgobrāhmaṇādiṣu || dīyamāne vipattiḥ syānna sa pāpena lipyate || 47 || akāraṇaṃ tu yaḥ kaściddvijaḥ prāṇānparityajet || tasyaiva tatra doṣaḥ syānna tu yo'smai dadāti tat || 48 || pariṣkṛto yadā vipro hatvā''tmānaṃ mṛto yadi || nirguṇaḥ sahasā krodhādgṛhakṣetrādikāraṇāt || 49 || trivārṣikaṃ vrataṃ kuryā tpratilomāṃ sarasvatīm || gacchedvāpi viśuddhyarthaṃ tatpāpasyeti niścitam || 7.1.202.50 || uddiśya kupito hatvā toṣitaṃ vāsayetpunaḥ || tasminmṛte na doṣo'sti dvayorucchrāvaṇe kṛte || 51 || ṣaṇḍhaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā śūdrahatyāvrataṃ caret || bahūnāmekakāryāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śastradhāriṇām || 52 || yadyeko ghātayettatra sarve te ghātakāḥ smṛtāḥ || prāyaścitte vyavasite yadi kartā vipadyate || 53 || enastatprāpnuyādenamiha loke paratra ca || tadahaṃ kiṃ karomyeṣa kva gacchāmi durātmavān || 54 || dhiṅmāṃ ca pāpacaritaṃ mahāduṣkṛtakarmiṇam || 55 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityevaṃ vilapanyāvacchokā kulitamānasaḥ || tāvadākāśasaṃbhūtā vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 56 || bhobho rāma na saṃtāpastvayā kāryaḥ kathaṃcana || gaccha prābhāsikaṃ kṣetraṃ yatra devī sarasvatī || 57 || pañcasrotāḥ sthitā tatra pañcapātakanāśanī || nadīnāṃ pravarā sā tu brahmabhūtā sarasvatī || 58 || ekataḥ sarvatīrthāni brahmāṇḍe sacarācare || gaṃgādīni naraśreṣṭha teṣāṃ puṇyā sarasvatī || 59 || tāvadgarjaṃti pāpāni brahmahatyādikāni ca || yāvanna dṛśyate devī prabhāsasthā sara svatī || 7.1.202.60 || tasmāttatraiva gaccha tvaṃ yatra devī sarasvatī || nānyaistīrthaiḥ sahasraistvaṃ kartuṃ śakyo vikalmaṣaḥ || 61 || tanmā kārṣīrvilaṃbaṃ tvaṃ gaccha tīraṃ mahodadheḥ || prābhāsike mahādevīṃ pratilomāṃ vigāhaya || 62 || tatraivārādhaya vibhuṃ liṃgarūpiṇamīśvaram || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāpāpācchārī rāttvaṃ vimokṣyasi || 63 || iti śrutvā vaco rāmaḥ paramānaṃdapūritaḥ || prabhāsakṣetragamane matiṃ cakre mahāmanāḥ || 64 || tataḥ svasainyasaṃyukto dravyopaskarasaṃyutaḥ || ājagāma mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam || 65 || dṛṣṭvā manorama tīrthaṃ sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame || cakāra hṛdi saṃkalpaṃ prati lomāvagāhane || 66 || āhūya brāhmaṇāṃstatra prabhāsakṣetravāsinaḥ || samyagyātrāvidhānena yātrāṃ tatrākarodvibhuḥ || 67 || yāni prābhāsike kṣetre tīrthāni vividhāni tu || raviyojanasaṃsthāni teṣu yātrāṃ cakāra saḥ || 68 || pratyekaṃ ca dadau teṣu dānāni vividhāni tu || tathā'dhaḥ sthāpa yāmāsa sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame || 69 || pūrvabhāge mahāliṃgaṃ kṛtvā yajñavidhikriyām || evaṃ kṛte mahādevi vimuktaḥ pātakairabhūt || 7.1.202.70 || nirmarlāṃgastato devi dināni daśa saṃsthitaḥ || tatastāṃ caiva sa snātvā pratilomāṃ kramādyayau || plakṣāvaharaṇaṃ yāvatsamudrācca himāhvayam || || 71 || evaṃ muktaḥ sa pāpaughai rāmo'bhūtprathitaḥ priye || tasya liṃgasya māhātmyātsarasvatyāḥ prasādataḥ || 72 || yastatpūjayate devi liṃgaṃ pāpabhayāpaham || rāmeśvareti kathitaṃ so'pi mucyeta pātakāt || 73 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa brahmakūrcavidhānataḥ || yastatra kurute devi so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 74 || snātvā tatra varārohe sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame || rāmeśvaretināmānaṃ tataḥ saṃpūjya śaṃkaram || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 75 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi rāmeśvaramahodayam || yacchrutvā mānavaḥ samyakchraddhāvānprāpnuyāddivam || 76 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rāmeśvarakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 202 || || cha ||
<7.1.203>
||īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi maṃkīśvara mahālayam || rāmeśāduttare bhāge devamātuḥ samīpagam || 1 || arkasthalāttato yāmye pūrvataśca kṛtasmarāt || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ tu maṃkinā sthāpitaṃ purā || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyagaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 3 || || devyuvāca || || ko'sau maṃkirmahādeva kathaṃ liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || kiṃ prabhāvaṃ ca talliṃgametanme vada vistarāt || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || maṃkirnāmābhavatpūrvaṃ kubjakāyo dvijottamaḥ || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādyatapastepe mahattamam || 5 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || na tutoṣa harastasya vahuvarṣagaṇārcitaḥ || 6 || tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya siddhiṃ prāptā hyanekaśaḥ || tatrārādhya mahādevaṃ svargalokamito gatāḥ || 7 || tato duḥkhaṃ samabhavanmaṃkestatra varānane || kasmānme bhagavāṃstuṣṭiṃ na gacchati maheśvaraḥ || 8 || tatastīvraratiṃ cakre kṛtvā tīvranivartanam || evaṃ vṛddhatvamāpanno japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 9 || tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo vayaso'nte varaṃ dadau || parituṣṭo'smi te maṃke brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 7.1.203.10 || || maṃkiruvāca || || kiṃ vareṇa suraśreṣṭha mama vṛddhasya sāṃpratam || kiñcinme paramaṃ duḥkhaṃ sthitasyātra paraṃ prabho || 11 || || śiva uvāca || || śṛṇu yatkāraṇaṃ tatra teṣāṃ tava tapasvinām || vratacaryāptaye viprāḥ pūjayantyadhikaṃ hi te ||12|| te puṣpāṇi samānīya nānāvarṇāni sarvaśaḥ || vṛkṣāṇāmatigaṃdhīni na teṣāṃ harṣakāraṇam || 13 || tvaṃ punaḥ kubjarūpaśca yajñapūjāparāyaṇaḥ || na ca prāpnoṣi vṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhāgrāṇyatiyatnavān || 14 || ekenāpi pradattena puṣpeṇa dvijasattama || bhaktyā śirasi liṃgasya labhyate yājñikaṃ phalam|| 15 || liṃgasya dakṣiṇe brahmā svayameva vyavasthitaḥ || vāme ca bhagavānviṣṇurmadhyehaṃ vai pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 16 || trayo'pi pūjitāstena yena liṃgaṃ prapūjitam || 17 || bilvapatraṃ śamīpatraṃ karavīraṃ ca mālatīm || unmattakaṃ campakaṃ ca sadyaḥ prītikaraṃ bhavet || 18 || caṃpakāśoka kahlāraiḥ karavīraistathā mama || pūjeṣṭā dvijaśārdūla ye cānye vahugaṃdhinaḥ || etairhi pūjito nityaṃ śīghraṃ tuṣṭiṃ prayāmyaham || 19 || || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama || ihāgatya naraḥ snātvā yo jalenāpi siñcati || 7.1.203.20 || liṃgametaddhi sarvāsāṃ pūjānāṃ phalamāpnuyāt || adyaprabhṛti ye vṛkṣā daivikāḥ pārthivāśca ye || teṣāṃ sānnidhyamatrāstu prasādāttava śaṃkara || 21 || || bhagavānuvāca || || salilenāpi yaḥ pūjāmasmim̐lliṃge vidhāsyati || tasya pūjāphalaṃ sarvaṃ bhaviṣyati dvijottama || || 22 || vṛkṣāṇāmatrasānnidhyaṃ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati || adyaprabhṛti nāmnaitannāgasthānaṃ bhaviṣyati || 23 || yatastu sarvanāgānāṃ sāṃnidhya matra saṃsthitam | tvamapi dvijaśārdūla prayāsyasi mamāntikam || 24 || evamuktvā tu bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata || maṃkistu dehamutsajya śivalokaṃ tato gataḥ || 25 || ityevaṃ kathitaṃ devi maṃkīśodbhavamuttamam || śrutaṃ harati pāpāni samyakchraddhāsamanvitaiḥ || 26 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṃkīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 203 || || cha ||
<7.1.204>
|| devyuvāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka || sarasvatyāśca māhātmyaṃ vistarātkathayasva me || 1 || yātrāgatānāṃ deveśi puruṣāṇāṃ jitātmanām|| mukhadvāre tu kiṃ puṇyaṃ snānadāne ca śaṃkara || 2 || avagāhanena cānyatra phalaṃ kiṃsvitprajāyate || śrāddhasya kiṃ vidhānaṃ tu ke maṃtrāstatra ke dvijāḥ || 3 || kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiñca bhoktavyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi || kāni dānāni deyāni nṛbhiryātrā phalepsubhiḥ || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devipravakṣyāmi dānaśrāddhavidhikramam || sarasvatyāśca māhātmyaṃ kīrtyamānaṃ nibodha me || 5 || puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ toyaṃ yatra tatrāvagāhyate || sāgareṇa tu saṃmiśraṃ devānāmapi durlabham || 6 || sarasvatī sarvanadīṣu puṇyā sarasvatī lokasukhāvagāhā || sarasvatīṃ prāpya na duḥkhitā narāḥ sadā na śocaṃti paratra ceha vā || 7 || puṇyaṃ sārasvataṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyakṛllabhate naraḥ || durlabhaṃ triṣu lokeṣu vaiśākhyā somaparvaṇi || 8 || amā somena saṃyuktā yadi tatraiva labhyate || tatra kiṃ kriyate devi parvakoṭiśatairapi || 9 || cāndrāyaṇāni kṛcchrāṇi mahāsāṃ tapanāni ca || prāyaścittāni dīyante yatra nāsti sarasvatī ||7.1.204.10|| yāvadasthi śarīrasya tiṣṭhetsārasvate jale || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṇuloke vase nnaraḥ || jātyandhaiste samā jñeyā mṛtaiḥ paṃgubhireva ca || 11 || samarthā ye na paśyanti prabhāsasthāṃ sarasvatīm || te deśāstāni tīrthāni āśramāste ca parvatāḥ || 12 || yeṣāṃ sarasvatī devī madhye yāti saridvarā || trailokyapāvanīṃ puṇyāṃ saṃśritā ye sarasvatīm || saṃsārakardamāmodamājighranti na te punaḥ || 13 || śabdavidyeva vistīrṇā mataiva jagataḥ priyā || satāṃ matiriva svacchā ramaṇīyā sarasvatī || 14 || trailokyaśobhitāṃ devīṃ divya toyāṃ sunirmalām|| sa nīco yaḥ pumānetāṃ na vandeta sarasvatīm || 15 || svarganiśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāse tu sarasvatī || nāpuṇyavadbhiḥ saṃprāptuṃ puṃbhiḥ śakyā mahānadī || 16 || candrabhāgā ca gaṃgā ca tathā yatra sarasvatī || devāste na manuṣyāste tisro nadyaḥ pibanti ye ||17|| satyameva mayā devi jāhnavī śirasā dhṛtā || yāḥ kāścitsarito loke tāsāṃ puṇyā sarasvatī || 18|| darśanena sarasvatyā rājasūyo na rājate || gaṃḍūṣaścāśvamedhādvai sarva kratuvaraṃ payaḥ ||19|| bhasmāsthicarmatoyāni nakhakeśādikāni ca || vātairapi dhutānyeva tathā sārasvate jale ||7.1.204.2||| vahanti yeṣāṃ kālena te na kāla vaśā narāḥ || devi kiṃ bahunoktena varṇitena punaḥpunaḥ|| sarasvatyāḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati ||21|| tatraiva durlabhaṃ snānaṃ yatra sāgarasaṃgamaḥ || tatra snānena dānena koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet ||22|| yatra sārasvataṃ toyaṃ sāgarormisamākulam || tatra snāsyaṃti ye martyā bhāgyavanto yugeyuge ||23|| te dhanyāste namaskāryāsteṣāṃ sphītataraṃ yaśaḥ || yeṣāṃ kalevaraṃ nṝṇāṃ siktaṃ sārasvatairjalaiḥ || 24 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sarasvatīsaṃgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 204 || cha ||
<7.1.205>
|| devyuvāca || || bhagandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka || brūhi śrāddhavidhiṃ puṇyaṃ vistarājjagatāṃpate || 1 || kasminvāsarabhāge tu śrāddhakṛcchrāddhamācaret || asminsarasvatī tīrthe prabhāsakṣetra uttame || 2 || kasmiṃstīrthe kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ bahupuṇyaphalaṃ bhavet || etatsarvaṃ mahādeva yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || prātaḥkāle muhūtāṃstrīnsaṃgavastāvadeva tu || madhyāhnastrimuhūrtaḥ syādaparāhṇastataḥ param || 4 || sāyāhnastrimuhūrtaḥ syācchrāddhaṃ tatra na kārayet || rākṣasīnāma sā velā garhitā sarvakarmasu || 5 || ahno muhūrtā vikhyātā daśapaṃca ca sarvadā || tatrāṣṭamo muhūrto yaḥ sa kālaḥ kutapaḥ smṛtaḥ || 6 || madhyāhne sarvadā yasmānmandībhavati bhāskaraḥ || tasmādanaṃtaphaladastadārambho bhaviṣyati || 7 || madhyāhnaḥ khaḍgapātraṃ tu tathānye kālakambalāḥ ||| rūpyaṃ darbhāṃstilā gāvo dauhitraścāṣṭamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 8 || pāpaṃ kutsitamityāhustasya santāpakāriṇaḥ || aṣṭa caivaṃ matāstasmātkutapā iti viśrutāḥ| || 9 || ūrdhvaṃ muhūrtātkutapādyanmuhūrtacatuṣṭayam || muhūrtapañcakaṃ caiva svadhābhavanamiṣyate || 7.1.205.10 || viṣṇordehasamudbhūtāḥ kuśāḥ kṛṣṇāstilāstathā ||| śrāddhasya rakṣaṇārthāya etatprāhurdivaukasaḥ || 11 || tilodakāñjalirdeyo jalasthaistīrthavāsibhiḥ || sadarbhahastenaikena śrāddhasevanamiṣyate || 12 || trīṇi śrāddhe pavitrāṇi dauhitraḥ kutapastilāḥ || trīṇi cātra praśaṃsaṃti śuddhimakrodhamatvarām || 13 || dauhitraṃ khaḍgamityuktaṃ lalāṭe śṛṅgamasti yat || tasya śṛṃgasya yatpātraṃ taddauhitramiti smṛtam || 14 || kṣīriṇī vāpi citrā gaustatkṣīrāyadghṛtaṃ bhavet || taddauhitramiti proktaṃ daive pitrye ca karmaṇi || 15 || darbhāgraṃ daivamityuktaṃ samūlāgraṃ tu paitṛkam || tatrāvalaṃbino ye tu kuśāste kutapāḥ smṛtāḥ || 16 || śarīradravyadārābhūmanomaṃtradvi janmanām || śuddhiḥ saptasu vijñeyā śrāddhakāle viśeṣataḥ||17|| saptadhā dravyaśuddhistu sottamā madhyamā'dhamā ||18|| śrutaṃ śauryaṃ tapaḥ kanyā śiṣyādyaṃ cānvayāgatam || dhanaṃ saptavidhaṃ śuklamupāyopyasya tādṛśaḥ || 19 || kutsitaṃ kṛṣivāṇijyaṃ śuklaṃ śilpānuvṛttibhiḥ || kṛtopakārādāptaṃ ca śaṃbalaṃ samudāhṛtam || 7.1.205.20 || utkocataśca yatprāptaṃ yatprāptaṃ caiva sāhasāt || vyājenopārjitaṃ yacca tatkṛṣṇaṃ samudāhṛtam || 21 || anyāyopārjitairdravyai ryacchrāddhaṃ kriyate naraiḥ || tṛpyaṃti tena caṇḍālāḥ puṣkasādyāsu yoniṣu || 22 || annaprakiraṇaṃ yattu manuṣyaiḥ kriyate bhuvi || tena tṛptimupāyāṃti ye piśācatvamāgatāḥ || 23 || yatpayaḥ snānavastrotthaṃ bhūmau patati putraka || tena ye tarutāṃ prāptāsteṣāṃtṛptiḥ prajāyate || 24 || yāstu gaṃdhāṃbukaṇikāḥ pataṃti dharaṇītale || tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ ye devatvamupāgatāḥ || 25 || uddhṛteṣvapi piṇḍeṣu yāścānnakaṇikā bhuvi || tābhirāpyāyanaṃ teṣāṃ tiryaktvaṃ ca kule gatāḥ ||26|| ye cādagdhāḥ kule bālāḥ striyo yāścāpyasaṃskṛtāḥ || vipannāste tu vikirasaṃmārjanasulālasāḥ ||27|| bhuktvā vā bhramate yacca jalaṃ yaccāhni sevate || brāhmaṇānāṃ tathānnena tena tṛptiṃ prayāṃti te || 28 || piśācatvamanuprāptāḥ kṛmikīṭatvameva ye || atha kālānpravakṣyāmi kathyamā nānnibodha me || 29 || śrāddhaṃ kāryamamāvāsyāṃ māsimāsīṃdusaṃkṣaye || tathāṣṭakāsu viprāptau sūryendugrahaṇe tathā || 7.1.205.30 || ayane viṣuve yugme sāmānye cārkasaṃkrame || amāvāsyāṣṭakāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || 31 || ārdrāmaghārohiṇīṣu dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃgame || gajacchāyāvyatīpāte viṣṭivaidhṛti vāsare || 32 || vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ kārttikasya ca || paṃcadaśyāṃ tu māghasya nabhasye ca trayodaśī || 33 || yugādayaḥ smṛtā etā datta syākṣayakārikāḥ || 34 || yasya manvantarasyādau rathārūḍho divākaraḥ || māghamāsasya saptamyāṃ sā tu syādrathasaptamī || 35 || vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ phālgunasya ca || paṃcamī caitramāsasya tasyaivāntyā tathāparā || 36 || śuklatrayodaśī māghe kārttikasya ca saptamī || kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśīti ca || manvantarāḥ smṛtā hyetā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ || 37 || śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathāṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā || kārttikī phālgunī caitrī jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī tithiḥ || 38 || manvādayaḥ smṛtāścaitā dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ || navamī mārgaśīrṣasya saptaitāḥ saṃsmarā myaham || 39 || kalpanāmādayo devi dattasyākṣayakārikāḥ || tathā manvantarasyādau dvādaśaiva varānane || 7.1.205.40 || nityaṃ naimittikaṃ kāmyaṃ vṛddhi śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakam || pārvaṇaṃ cātivijñānaṃ goṣṭhaṃ śuddhyarthamuttamam || 41 || karmāṃgaṃ navamaṃ proktaṃ daivakaṃ daśamaṃ smṛtam || ekādaśaṃ kṣayāhaṃ tu puṣṭyarthe dvādaśaṃ smṛtam || 42 || sarveṣāmeva śrāddhānāṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sāṃvatsaraṃ smṛtam || ahanyahani yacchrāddhaṃ nityaṃ tatparikīrtitam || 43 || vaiśvadevavihīnaṃ tu aśaktāvudakena tu || ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tannaimittikamucyate || 44 || kāmena vihitaṃ kāmyamabhipretārthasiddhaye || vṛddhau yatkriyate śrāddhaṃ vṛddhi śrāddhaṃ taducyate || 45 || ye samānā iti dvābhyāmetacchrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍanam || amāvāsyāṃ tu yacchrāddhaṃ tatpārvaṇamudāhṛtam || 46 || goṣṭhyāṃ yatkri yate śrāddhaṃ tadgoṣṭhīśrāddhamucyate || kriyate pāpaśuddhyarthaṃ śuddhiśrāddhaṃ taducyate || 47 || niṣekakāle some ca sīmantonnayane tathā || tathā puṃsavane caiva śrāddhaṃ karmāṃgameva ca || 48 || devamuddiśya kriyate yattaddaivakamucyate || gaccheddeśāntaraṃ yastu śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ tu sarpiṣā || 49 || puṣṭyarthametadvijñeyaṃ kṣayāhaṃ dvādaśaṃ smṛtam || mṛte'hani pituryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt || 7.1.205.50 || mātuścaiva varārohe vatsarānte mṛte'hani || nāhaṃ tasya mahādevi pūjāṃ gṛhṇāmi no hariḥ || 51 || mṛtāharyo na jānāti mānavo yadi vā kvacit || tena kāryamamāvāsyāṃ śrāddhaṃ māghe'tha mārgake || 52 || atha viprānpravakṣyāmi śrāddhe ye kecana kṣamāḥ || viśiṣṭaḥ śrotriyo yogī vedavidyāsamanvitaḥ || 53 || triṇāciketastrimadhustrisuparṇaḥ ṣaḍaṃgavit || dauhitrakastu jāmātā svasrīyaḥ śvaśurastathā || 54 || pañcāgnikarmaniṣṭhaśca taponiṣṭhaśca mātulaḥ || pitṛmātṛparaścaiva śiṣyasaṃbaṃdhibāṃdhavaḥ || 55 || vedārthavitpravaktā ca brahmacārī sahasradaḥ || saṃbaṃdhinaṃ tathā saṃtaṃ dauhitraṃ duhituḥ patim || 56 || bhāgineyaṃ viśeṣeṇa tathā bandhugaṇānapi || nātikramennarastvetānmūrkhānapi varānane || 57 || na brāhmaṇānparīkṣeta devakarmaṇyupa sthite || paitrakarmaṇi saṃprāpte parīkṣeta prayatnataḥ || 58 || ye stenāḥ patitāḥ klībā ye ca nāstikavṛttayaḥ || tānhavyakavyayorviprānanarhānmanura bravīt || 59 || jaṭilaṃ cānadhīyānaṃ durbalaṃ kitavaṃ tathā || yājayaṃti ca ye śūdrāṃstāṃśca śrāddhe na pūjayet || 7.1.205.60 || cikitsakāndevalakānmāṃsa vikrayiṇastathā || vipaṇaiḥ pīrajīvaṃto varjyāḥ syurhavyakavyayoḥ || 61 || preṣyo grāmyaśca rājñaśca kunakhī śyāvadaṃtakaḥ || pratiroddhā guroścaiva tyaktā gnirvārdhuṣistathā || 62 || yakṣmī ca paśupālaśca parivettā nirākṛtiḥ || brahmadhrukparivittiśca gaṇābhyantara eva ca || 63 || kuśīlaścaiva kāṇaśca vṛṣalīpatireva ca || paunarbhavaśca kānīnaḥ kitavo madyapastathā || 64 || pāparogyabhiśastaśca dāṃbhiko rasavikrayī || dhanuḥśarāṇāṃ karttā ca yaśca syāddidhiṣūpatiḥ || 65 || mitradhruḍdūtavṛttiśca putrācāryastathaiva ca || bhramarī maṇḍapālī ca citrāṃgaḥ piśunastathā || 66 || unmattoṃ'dhaśca badhiro vedanindaka eva ca || hayago'śvoṣṭradamako nakṣatrairyaśca jīvati || 67 || pakṣiṇāṃ poṣako yaśca yuddhācāryastathaiva ca || srotaḥsaṃbhedako yaśca veśyānāṃ poṣaṇe rataḥ || 68 || gṛhasaṃveśako dūtaḥ kṛṣyāropaka eva ca || ākheṭī śyenajīvī ca kanyādūṣaka eva ca || 69 || hiṃsro vṛṣalaputraśca gaṇānāṃ caiva yājakaḥ || ācārahīnaḥ klībaśca nityayājanakastathā || 7.1.205.70 || kṛṣijīvī ślīpadī ca sadbhirnindita eva ca || aurabhriko māhiṣikaḥ parapūrvā patistathā || pretaniryātakāścaiva varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || 71 || etānvai garhitācārānapāṃkteyāndvijādhamān || dvijānāṃ sati lābhe tū bhayatraiva vivarjayet || 72 || vīkṣāṃdho vaikataḥ kāṇaḥ kuṣṭhī ca vṛṣalīpatiḥ || pāparogī sahasrasya dāturnāśayate phalam || 73 || yāvadbhiḥ saṃspṛśatyaṅgairbrāhmaṇāñchrūdrayājakaḥ || tāvatāṃ na bhavetpretya dāturvā tasya paitrikam || 74 || ādau māhiṣakaṃ dṛṣṭvā madhye ca vṛṣalīpatim || ante vārdhuṣikaṃ dṛṣṭvā nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ || 75 || mahiṣī procyate bhāryā sā vaidhavye'bhicāriṇī || tasyāṃ yaḥ kṣapate doṣāṃ sa vai māhiṣikaḥ smṛtaḥ || 76 || vṛṣalītyucyate śūdrī tasyā yaśca patirbhavet || tadoṣṭhalālāsaṃsargātpatito vṛṣalīpatiḥ || || 77 || svaṃ vṛṣaṃ tu parityaktvā pareṇa tu vṛṣāyate || vṛṣalī sā tu vijñeyā na śūdrī vṛṣalī bhavet || 78 || caṇḍālī baṃdhakī veśyā rajaḥsthā yā ca kanyakā || kuṭilā ca svagotrā ca vṛṣalyaḥ sapta kīrtitāḥ || 79 || piturgehe tu yā kanyā rajaḥ paśyatyasaṃskṛtā || patitāḥ pitarastasyāḥ kanyā sā vṛṣalī bhavet || 7.1.205.80 || yastu tāṃ varayetkanyāṃ brāhmaṇo jñānapūrvataḥ || aśrāddheyamapāṃkteyaṃ taṃ vidyādvṛṣalīpatim || 81 || gaurī kanyā pradhānā vai madhyamā kanyakā matā || rohiṇī tatsamā jñeyā adhamā ca rajasvalā || 82 || aprāpte rajasi gaurī prāpte rajasi rohiṇī || avyaṃjanakṛtā kanyā kucahīnā tu nagnikā || 83 || saptavarṣā bhavedgaurī navavarṣā tu nagnikā || daśavarṣā bhavetkanyā hyata ūrdhvaṃ rajasvalā || 84 || vyaṃjanairhanti vai putrānkulaṃ hanyātpayodharā || gatimiṣṭāṃ tathā lokānhaṃti sā rajasā pituḥ || 85 || ya udvahedrajoyuktāṃ sa jñeyo vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 86 || yatkarotyekarātreṇa vṛṣalīsevanāddvijaḥ || tadbhaikṣyabhugjapannityaṃ tribhirvarṣairvyapohati || 87 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe śrāddhānarhabrāhmaṇaparīkṣaṇakathanaṃnāma pañcottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 205 || || cha || ||
<7.1.206>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha śrāddhavidhiṃ vakṣye pārvaṇasya vidhānataḥ || yathākramaṃ mahādevi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || 1 || kṛtvāpasavyaṃ pūrvedyuḥ pitṛpūrvaṃ nimaṃtrayet || bhavadbhiḥ pitṛkāryaṃ naḥ saṃpādyaṃ ca prasīdatha || 2 || savarṇānpreṣayedāptāndvijānāmupamantraṇe || 3 || abhojyaṃ brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ kṣatriyādyairnimantritaiḥ || tathaiva brāhmaṇasyānnaṃ brāhmaṇena nimantritauḥ || 4 || brāhmaṇānnaṃ dadecchūdraḥ śūdrānnaṃ brāhmaṇo dadet || ubhāvetāvabhojyānnau bhuktvā cāndrāyaṇaṃ caret || 5 || upanikṣepadharmeṇa śūdrānnaṃ yaḥ paceddvijaḥ || abhojyaṃ tadbhavedannaṃ sa ca vipraḥ patedadhaḥ || 6 || śūdrānnaṃ śūdrasaṃparkaḥ śūdreṇa ca sahāsanam || śūdrājjñānāgamaścaiva jvalaṃtamapi pātayet || 7 || śūdrānnopahatā viprā vihvalā ratilālasāḥ || kupitāḥ kiṃ kariṣyaṃti nirviṣā iva pannagāḥ ||8|| nagnaḥ syānmalavadvāsā nagnaḥ kaupīnavastradhṛk || dvikaccho'nuttarīyaśca vikaccho'vastra eva ca ||9|| nagnaḥ kāṣāyavastraḥ syānnagnaścārdhapaṭaḥ smṛtaḥ || acchinnāgraṃ tu yadvastraṃ mṛdā prakṣālitaṃ tu yat || 7.1.206.10 || ahataṃ dhāturaktaṃ vā tatpavitramiti sthitam || agrato vasate mūrkho dūre cāsya guṇānvitaḥ || 11 || guṇānvite ca dātavyaṃ nāsti mūrkhe vyatikramaḥ || yastvāsannamatikramya brāhmaṇaṃ patitādṛte || dūrasthaṃ pūjayenmūḍho guṇāḍhyaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 12 || vedavidyāvratasnāte śrotriye gṛhamāgate || krīḍantyoṣadhayaḥ sarvā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim||13|| saṃdhyayorubhayorjāpye bhojane daṃtadhāvane|| pitṛkārye ca daive ca tathā mūtrapurīṣayoḥ|| gurūṇāṃ saṃnidhau dāne yoge caiva viśeṣataḥ || eteṣu maunamātiṣṭhansvargaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 15 || yadi vāgyamalopaḥ syājjapādiṣu kathaṃcana || vyāharedvaiṣṇavaṃ maṃtraṃ smaredvā viṣṇumavyayam || 16 || dāne snāne jape home bhojane devatārcane || devānāmṛjavo darbhāḥ pitṝṇāṃ dviguṇāstathā || 17 || udaṅmukhastu devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || agninā bhasmanā vāpi yavenāpyudakena vā || dvārasaṃkramaṇenāpi paṃktidoṣo na vidyate || 18 || iṣṭaśrāddhe kraturdakṣo vṛddhau satyavasū smṛtau || naimittike kālakāmau kāmye cādhvavirocanau || 19 || purūravā ārdravaśca pārvaṇe samudāhṛtau || puṣṭiṃ prajāṃ ca nyagrodhe buddhiṃ prajñāṃ dhṛtiṃ smṛtim || 7.1.206.20 || rakṣoghnaṃ ca yaśasyaṃ ca kāśmīryaṃ pātramucyate || saubhāgyamuttamaṃ loke madhūke samudāhṛtam || 21 || phālgunapātre tu kurvāṇaḥ sarvakāmānavāpnuyāt || parāṃ dyutimathārke tu prākāśyaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 22 || bilve lakṣmīṃ tapo medhāṃ nityamāyuṣyameva ca || kṣetrārāmataḍāgeṣu sarvapātreṣu caiva hi || 23 || varṣatyajasraṃ parjanye veṇupātreṣu kurvataḥ || eteṣāṃ labhyate puṇyaṃ suvarṇai rajataistathā || 24 || palāśaphalanyagrodhaplakṣāśvatthavikaṃkatāḥ || audumbarastathā bilvaṃ caṃdanaṃ yajñiyāśca ye || 25 || saralo devadāruśca śālāśca khadirāstathā || samidarthaṃ praśastāḥ syurete vṛkṣā viśeṣataḥ || 26 || śleṣmātako naktamālyaḥ kapitthaḥ śālmalī tathā || niṃbo bibhītakaścaiva śrāddhakarmaṇi garhitāḥ ||27|| aniṣṭaśabdāṃ saṃkīrṇā rūkṣāṃ jantumatīmapi || pratigaṃdhāṃ tu tāṃ bhūmiṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi garhayet ||28|| traiśaṃkavaṃ tyajeddeśaṃsarvadvādaśayojanam || uttareṇa mahānadyā dakṣiṇena ca kevalam || 29 || deśastraiśaṃ kavonāma varjitaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi || kāraskārāḥ kaliṃgāśca siṃdhoruttarameva ca || praṇaṣṭāśramadharmāśca varjyā deśāḥ prayatnataḥ ||7.1.206.30|| brāhmaṇaṃ tu kṛtaṃ proktaṃ tretā tu kṣatriyaṃ smṛtam || vaiśyaṃ dvāparamityāhuḥ śūdraṃ kaliyugaṃ smṛtam ||31|| kṛte tu pitaraḥ pūjyāstretāyāṃ ca surāstathā || munayo dvāpare nityaṃ pākhaṃḍāśca kalau yuge ||32|| śuklapakṣasya pūrvāhṇe śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || kṛṣṇapakṣe'parāhne tu rauhiṇaṃ na vilaṃghayet ||33|| ratnimātrapramāṇaṃ ca pitṛtīrthaṃ tu saṃskṛtam || upamūle tathā lūnāḥ prastarārthe kuśottamāḥ||| tathā śyāmākanīvārā dūrvāśca samudāhṛtāḥ || sva kīrtimatāṃ śreṣṭho bahukeśaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||35|| tasya keśā nipatitā bhūmau kāśatvamāgatāḥ || tasmānmedhyāḥ sadā kāśāḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi pūjitāḥ ||36|| piṇḍanirvapaṇaṃ teṣu kartavyaṃ bhūtimicchatā|| uṣṇamannaṃ dvijātibhyaḥ śraddhayā viniveśayet|| 37|| anyatra phalapuṣpebhyaḥ pānakebhyaśca paṇḍitaḥ|| haste dattvā tu vai snehāllavaṇaṃ vyañjanāni ca|| āyasena ca pātreṇa tadvai rakṣāṃsi bhuñjate|| dvijapātreṣu dattvānnaṃ tūṣṇīṃ saṃkalpamācaret||39|| darvyādisthena no teṣāṃ saṃbandho dṛśyate yataḥ || yaśca śūkaravadbhuṃkte yaśca pāṇitale dvijaḥ || na tadaśnaṃti pitaro yaḥ savācaṃ samaśnute || 7.1.206.40 || dvihāyanasya vatsasya viśaṃtyāsyaṃ yathā sukham || tathā kuryātpramāṇena piṇḍānvyāsena bhāṣitam || 41 || na strī pracālayettāni jñānahīno na cāvrataḥ || svayaṃ putro'thavā yasya vāñchedabhyudayaṃ param || 42 || bhājaneṣu ca tiṣṭhatsu svastiṃ kurvanti ye dvijāḥ || tadannamasurairbhuktaṃ nirāśāḥ pitaro gatāḥ || 43 || apsvekaṃ plāvayetpiṇḍamekaṃ patnyai nivedayet || ekaṃ vai juhuyādagnāveṣā tu trividhā gatiḥ || 44 || chandogaṃ bhojayecchrāddhe vaiśvadeve ca bahvṛcam || puṣṭikarmaṇyathādhvaryuṃ śāntikarmaṇyatharvaṇam || 45 || dvau deve'tharvaṇau viprau prāṅmukhau ca niveśayet || pitrye hyudaṅmukhānkuryādbahvṛcādhvaryusāmagān || 46 || jātyaśca sarvā dātavyā mallikā śvetayūthikā || jalodbhavāni sarvāṇi kusumāni ca campakam|| 47 || madhūkaṃ rāmaṭhaṃ caiva karpūraṃ maricaṃ guḍam || śrāddhakarmaṇi śastāni saiṃdhavaṃ trapusaṃ tathā || 48|| brāhmaṇaḥ kambalo gāvaḥ sūryogniratithiśca vai || tilā darbhāśca kālaśca navaite kutapāḥ smṛtāḥ || 49 || āpadyanagnau tīrthe ca caṃdrasūryagrahe tathā || nācaretsaṃgrahe caiva tathaivāstamupāgate || 7.1.206.50 || saṃśuddhā syāccaturthe'hni snātā nārī rajasvalā || daive karmaṇi pitrye ca pañcame'hani śuddhyati || 51 || dravyābhāve dvijābhāve pravāse putrajanmani || āmaśrāddhaṃ prakurvīta yasya bhāryā rajasvalā || 52 || sarpaviprahatānāṃ ca daṃṣṭriśṛṃgisarīsṛpaiḥ || ātmanastyāgināṃ caiva śrāddhameṣāṃ na kārayet || 53 || caṇḍālādudakātsarpādbrāhmaṇādvaidyutādapi || daṃṣṭribhyaśca paśubhyaśca maraṇaṃ pāpakarmaṇām || 54 || sarvairanumataṃ kṛtvā jyeṣṭhenaiva ca yatkṛtam || dravyeṇa ca vibhaktena sarvaireva kṛtaṃ bhavet || || 55 || amāvāsyāṃ pitṛśrāddhe maṃthanaṃ yastu kārayet || tattakraṃ madirātulyaṃ ghṛtaṃ gomāṃsavatsmṛtam || 56 || bhuṃjaṃti kramaśaḥ pūrve tathā piṃḍāśiṣo 'pi ca || nimaṃtrito dvijaḥ śrāddhe na śayīta striyā saha || 57 || śrādabhukprātarutthāya prakuryāddantadhāvanam || śrāddhakartā na kurvīta dantānāṃ dhāvanaṃ budhaḥ || 58 || varṣevarṣe tu yacchrāddhaṃ mātāpitrormṛte'hani || malamāse na kartavyaṃ vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā || 59 || garbhe vārdhuṣike prete bhṛtye māsānumāsike || ābdike ca tathā śrāddhe nādhimāso vidhīyate || 7.1.206.60 || vivāhādau smṛtaḥ sauro yajñādau sāvanaḥ smṛtaḥ || ābdike pitṛkārye tu cāndro māsaḥ praśasyate || 61 || yasminrāśau gate sūrye vipattiḥ syāddvijanmanaḥ || tadrāśāveva kartavyaṃ pitṛkāryaṃ mṛte'hani || 62 || vaṣaṭkāraśca homaśca parva cāgrāyaṇaṃ tathā || malamāse'pi kartavyaṃ kāmyā iṣṭīrvivarjayet || 63 || agnyādhyeyaṃ pratiṣṭhāṃ ca yajñadānavratāni ca || vedavratavṛṣotsargacūḍākaraṇamekhalāḥ || 64 || māṃgalyamabhiṣekaṃ ca malamāse vivarjayet || nityanaimittike kuryātprayataḥ sanmalimluce || tīrthe snānaṃ gaja cchāyāṃ pretaśrāddhaṃ tathaiva ca || 65 || rasā yatra praśasyante bhoktāro baṃdhugotriṇaḥ || rājavārtādi saṃkraṃdo rakṣaḥśrāddhasya lakṣaṇam|| 66 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā paraśrāddhe yastu bhuṃkte ca vihvalaḥ || pataṃti pitarastasya luptapiṇḍodakakriyāḥ ||67|| tailamudvartanaṃ snānaṃ dantadhāvanameva ca || klṛptaromanakhebhyaśca dadyādgatvāpare'hani || 68 || nimantritā yathānyāyaṃ havye kavye dvijottamāḥ || kathaṃcidapyatikrāmetpāpaḥ śūkaratāṃ vrajet || 69 || daive ca pitṛ śrāddhe cāpyāśaucaṃ jāyate yadā || āśaucānte'thavā tatra tebhyaḥ śrāddhaṃ pradīyate || 7.1.206.70 || atha śrāddhāvasāne tu āśiṣastatra dāpayet || dīrghā nāgāstathā nadyo viṣṇostrīṇi padāni ca || evameṣāṃ pramāṇena dīrghamāyuravāpnuyām || 71 || apāṃ madhye sthitā devāḥ sarvamapsu pratiṣṭhitam || brāhmaṇasya kare nyastāḥ śivā āpo bhavantu naḥ || 72|| lakṣmīrvasati puṣpeṣu lakṣmīrvasati puṣkare || lakṣmīrvasatu vāse me saumanasyaṃ dadātu me || 73 || akṣataṃ cā'stu me puṇyaṃ śāṃtiḥ puṣṭirdhṛtiśca me || yadyacchreyaskaraṃ loke tattadastu sadā mama || 74 || dakṣiṇāyāṃ tu sarvatra bahudeyaṃ tathāstu naḥ || evamastviti tairvācyaṃ mūrdhnā grāhyaṃ ca tena tat ||75 || piṃḍamagnau sadā deyādbhogārthī satataṃ naraḥ || prajārthaṃ patnyai vai dadyānmadhyamaṃ maṃtrapūrvakam || 76 || uttamāṃ dyutimavicchangoṣu nityaṃ pradāpayet || ājñāmicchedyaśaḥ kīrtimapsu nityaṃ praveśayet || 77 || prārthayandīrghamāyuśca vāyasebhyaḥ pradāpayet || kumāralokamanvicchankukkuṭebhyaḥ pradāpayet || 78 || ākāśe prakṣipedvāpi sthito vā dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || pitṝṇāṃ sthānamākāśaṃ dakṣiṇā caiva diktathā || 79 || naktaṃ tu varjayecchrāddhaṃ rāhoranyatra darśanāt || sarvasvenāpi kartavyaṃ kṣipraṃ vai rāhudarśanāt || 7.1.206.80 || uparāge na kuryādyaḥ paṃke gauriva sīdati || kurvāṇastu taretpāpaṃ sā ca nauriva sāgare || 81 || kṛṣṇamāṣāstilāścaiva śreṣṭhāḥ syuryavaśālayaḥ || mahāyavā vrīhiyavāstathaiva ca masūrikāḥ || 82 || kṛṣṇāḥ śvetāśca vā grāhyāḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi sarvadā || bilvāmalakamṛdvīkaṃ panasāmrātadāḍimam || 83 || bhavyaṃ pārāpataṃ caiva kharjūraṃ karamarddakam || sakorakā badaryaśca tālakaṃdaṃ tathā bisam || 84 || tamālāsanakaṃdaṃ ca māvellaṃ śatakaṃdalī || kāleyaṃ kālaśākaṃ ca mudgānnaṃ ca suvarcalam||85|| māṃsaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi śākaṃ vyoṣaṃ vetrāṃkurastathā || kaṭphalaṃ vajrakaṃ drākṣāṃ lakucaṃ mocameva ca || || 86 || priyāmalakadurgrīvaṃ tiṃḍukaṃ madhusāhvayam || vaikaṃkataṃ nālikeraṃ śṛṅgāṭakaparūṣakam || 87 || pippalīmaricaṃ caiva paṭolī bṛhatīphalam|| ārāmasya tu sīmā'ntaḥ saṃbhavaṃ sarvameva tu ||88|| evamādīni cānyāni puṣpāṇi śrāddhakarmaṇi|| masūrāḥ śatapuṣpyāśca kusumaṃ śrīniketanam ||89|| varyā svātiyavā nityaṃ tathā vṛṣayavāsakau || vaṃśā karīrā surasā mārjitā bhūtṛṇāni ca || 7.1.206.90 || varjanīyāni vakṣyāmi śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ || laśunaṃ gṛṃjanaṃ caiva palāṃḍuṃ piṇḍamūlakam || mogaraṃ cātra vaidehaṃ dīrghamūlakameva ca || 91 || divasasyāṣṭame bhāge mandībhūte divākare || āsuraṃ tadbhavecchrāddhaṃ pitṛṇāṃ nopatiṣṭhate || 92 || caturthe prahare prāpte yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || vṛthā śrāddhamavāpnoti dātā ca narakaṃ vrajet || 93 || lekhāprabhṛtyathāditye muhūrtāstraya eva ca || prātastasyottaraṃ kālaṃ bhagamāhurvipaścitaḥ || 94 || saṃgavastrimuhūrto'yaṃ madhyāhnastu samantataḥ || tataśca trimuhūrtāśca aparāhṇo vidhīyate || 95 || pañcamo'tha dināṃśo yaḥ sa sāyāhna iti smṛtaḥ || 96 || || tathā ca śrutiḥ || || yadaivādityo'tha vasanto yadā saṃgaviko'tha grīṣmo yadā vā mādhyaṃdino'tha varṣā yadaparāhṇo'tha śarat || ghadevāstametyatha hemanta iti || 97 || prārabhya kutape śrāddhe kuryādārohaṇaṃ budhaḥ || vidhijño vidhimāsthāya rohiṇaṃ na tu laṃghayet || 98 || aṣṭamo yo muhūrtaśca kutapaḥ sa nigadyate || navamo rauhiṇaḥ prokta iti śrāddhavido viduḥ || 99 || ekoddiṣṭaṃ tu madhyāhnaṃ prātarvai jātakarmaṇi || pitryārthaṃ nirvapetpākaṃ vaiśvadevārthameva ca || 7.1.206.100 || vaiśvadeve na pitryārthaṃ na pitryaṃ vaiśvadevike || kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ mahādevi brāhmaṇāṃśca visarjya ca || 101 || vaiśvadevādikaṃ karma tataḥ kuryādvarānane || bahuhavyendhane cāgnau susamiddhe viśeṣataḥ || 102 || vidhūme lelihāne ca kuryātkarma prasiddhaye || aprabuddhe sadhūme ca juhuyādyo hutāśane || || 103 || yajamāno bhavedandhaḥ kuputra iti niścitam || durgandhaścaiva kṛṣṇaśca nīlaścaiva viśeṣataḥ || 104 || bhūmiṃ vigāhate yatra tatra vidyātparābhavam || arciṣmānpiṃgalaśikhaḥ sarpiḥkāṃcanasaprabhaḥ || 105 || snigdhaḥ pradakṣiṇaścaiva vahniḥ syātkāryasiddhaye || aṃjanābhyaṃjanaṃ gaṃdhānmantrapraṇayanaṃ tathā || 106 || kāśaiḥ punarbhavetkāryaṃ hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || aṣṭajātikapuṣpaṃ ca añjanaṃ nityameva hi || 107 || kṛṣṇebhyaśca tilebhyaśca tailaṃ yatnātsurakṣitam || candanāgaruṇī cobhe tamālośīrapadmakam || 108 || dhūpaśca gauggulaḥ śreṣṭhastauruṣko dhūpa eva ca || śuklāḥ sumanasaḥ śreṣṭhāstathā padmotpalāni ca || 109 || gandhavantyupapannāni yāni cānyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || niśigaṃdhā japā bhiṇḍirūpakaḥ sakuraṃṭakaḥ || 7.1.206.110 || puṣpāṇi varjanīyāni śrāddhakarmaṇi nityaśaḥ || sauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ pitṝṇāṃ pātramucyate || 111 || rajatasya tathā kiñciddarśanaṃ puṇyadāyakam || kṛṣṇājinasya sānnidhyaṃ darśanaṃ dānameva ca || 112 || rakṣoghnaṃ caiva varcasyaṃ paśūnputrāṃśca tārayet || atha mantraṃ pravakṣyāmi amṛtaṃ brahmanirmitam || 113 || devatābhyaḥ pitṛbhyaśca mahāyogibhya eva ca || namaḥ svāhāyai svadhāyai nityameva namonamaḥ || 114 || ādyāvasāne śrāddhasya trirāvartamimaṃ japan || aśvamedhaphalaṃ hyetadvipraiḥ saṃjñāya pūjitam ||115 || piṇḍanirvapaṇe vāpi japedenaṃ samāhitaḥ || pitaraḥ kṣipramāyānti rākṣasāḥ pradravanti ca || 116 || saptārciṣaṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvakāmaśubhapradam || 117 || amūrtānāṃ ca mūrtānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ dīptatejasām || namasyāmi sadā teṣāṃ dhyāyināṃ divyacakṣuṣām || 118 || indrādīnāṃ ca netāro dakṣamārīcayastayā || tānnamasyāmi sarvānvai pitṝṃścaivauṣadhīstathā || 119 || nakṣatrāṇāṃ grahāṇāṃ ca vāyvagnyośca pitṝnapi || dyāvāpṛthivyośca sadā namasyāmi kṛtāñjaliḥ || 7.1.206.120 || namaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ saptabhyo namo lokeṣu saptasu || svayaṃbhuve namasyāmo brahmaṇe yogacakṣuṣe ||121|| etattvaduktaṃ saptarṣibrahmarṣigaṇasevitam || pavitraṃ paramaṃ hyetacchrīmadrakṣovināśanam || 122|| anena vidhinā yuktastrīnvārāṃstu japennaraḥ || bhaktyā paramayā yuktaḥ śraddadhāno jitendriyaḥ ||123|| saptārciṣaṃ japedyastu nityameva samāhitaḥ || sa tu saptasamudrāyāḥ pṛthivyā ekarāḍbhavet ||124|| śrāddhakalpaṃ paṭhedyo vai sa bhavetpaṃktipāvanaḥ || aṣṭādaśānāṃ vidyānāṃ sa ca vai pāragaḥ smṛtaḥ || 125 || pūjāṃ puṣṭiṃ smṛtiṃ medhāṃ rājyamārogyameva ca || prītā nityaṃ prayacchanti mānuṣāṇāṃ pitāmahāḥ || 126 || evaṃ prabhāsakṣetre sa sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame || kuryācchrāddhaṃ vidhānena prabhāse caiva bhāmini || 127 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame śrāddhakalpe śrāddhavidhivarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 206 || || cha ||
<7.1.207>
|| īśvara uvāca || || ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi śrāddhadānānyanukramāt || tāraṇāya ca bhūtānāṃ sarasvatyabdhisaṃgame || 1 || loke śreṣṭhatamaṃ sarvaṃ hyātmanaścāpi yatpriyam || sarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ dātavyaṃ tadevākṣayyamicchatām || 2 || jāṃbūnadamayaṃ divyaṃ vimānaṃ sūryasannibham || divyāpsarobhiḥ saṃkīrṇamannado labhate'kṣayam || 3 || ācchādanaṃ tu yo dadyādahataṃ śrāddhakarmaṇi || āyuḥ prakāśamaiśvaryaṃ rūpaṃ tu labhate ca saḥ || 4 || kamaṇḍaluṃ ca yo dadyādbrāhmaṇe vedapārage || madhukṣīrasravā dhenurdātāramanugacchati || 5 || yaḥ śrāddhe abhayaṃ dadyātprāṇināṃ jīvitaiṣiṇām || aśvadānasahasreṇa rathadānaśatena ca || dantināṃ ca sahasreṇa abhayaṃ ca viśiṣyate || 6 || yāni ratnāni medinyāṃ vāhanāni striyastathā || kṣipraṃ prāpnoti tatsarvaṃ pitṛbhaktastu mānavaḥ || 7 || pitaraḥ sarvalokeṣu tithikāleṣu devatāḥ || sarve puruṣamāyāṃti nipānamiva dhenavaḥ || 8 || mā sma te pratigaccheyuḥ parvakāle hyapūjitāḥ || moghāsteṣāṃ bhavantvāśāḥ paratreha ca mā kvacit || 9 || sarasvatyāstu sānnidhyaṃ yastvekaṃ bhojayeddvijam || koṭibhojyaphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.1.207.10 || amāvāsyāṃ naro yastu parānnamupabhuñjate || tasya māsakṛtaṃ puṇyamannadātuḥ prajāyate || 11 || ṣaṇmāsamayane bhuṃkte trīnmāsānviṣuve smṛtam || varṣairdvādaśabhiścaiva yatpuṇyaṃ samupārjitam || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti bhuktvā sūryendusaṃplave || 12 || sāgraṃ māsaṃ raveḥ krāntāvādyaśrāddhe trivatsaram || māsike'pyatha varṣasya ṣaṇmāse tvardhavatsaram || 13 || tathā saṃcayanaśrāddhe jātijanmakṛtaṃ nṛṇām || mṛta śayyāpratigrāhī vedasyaiva ca vikrayī || brahmasvahārī ca narastasya śuddhirna vidyate| || 14 || taḍāgānāṃ sahasreṇa hyaśvamedhaśatena ca || gavāṃ koṭi pradānena bhūmihartā na śuddhyati || 15 || suvarṇamāṣaṃ gāmekāṃ bhūmerapyardhamaṃgulam || harannarakamāpnoti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 16 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ daridrasya tu yaddhanam || guroḥ patnī hiraṇyaṃ ca svargasthamapi pātayet| || 17 || sahasrasaṃmitā dhenuranaḍvāndaśa dhenavaḥ || daśānaḍutsamaṃ yānaṃ daśayānasamo hayaḥ || 18 || daśahayasamā kanyā bhūmidānaṃ tato'dhikam || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vikrayaṃ naiva kārayet || 19 || viśeṣato mahākṣetre sarvapātakanāśane || citikāṣṭhaṃ ca vai spṛṣṭvā yajñayūpāṃstathaiva ca || vedavikrayakartāraṃ spṛṣṭvā snānaṃ vidhīyate || 7.1.207.20 || ādeśaṃ paṭhate yastu ādeśaṃ ca dadāti yaḥ || dvāvetau pāpakarmāṇau pātālatalavāsinau || 21 || ādeśaṃ paṭhate yastu rājadvāre tu mānavaḥ || so'pi devi bhavedvṛkṣa ūṣare kaṃṭakāvṛtaḥ || sthito vai nṛpatidvāri yaḥ kuryādvedavikrayam ||22|| brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || varaṃ kurvandhruvaṃ devi na kuryādvedavikrayam ||23|| hatvā gāśca varaṃ māṃsaṃ bhakṣayīta dvijādhamaḥ || varaṃ jīvetsamaṃ mlecchairna kuryādvedavikrayam || 24 || pratyakṣoktiḥ pratyayaśca praśnapūrvaḥ pratigrahaḥ || yājanā'dhyāpane vādaḥ ṣaḍvidho vedavikrayaḥ || 25 || vedākṣarāṇi yāvanti niyuṃkte svārthakāraṇāt || tāvatīrbhrūṇahatyā vai prāpnuyādvedavikrayī || 26 || vedānuyogādyo dadyādbrāhmaṇāya pratigraham || sa pūrvaṃ narakaṃ yāti brāhmaṇastadanantaram || 27 || vaiśvadevena hīnā ye hīnāścātithyato'pi ye || karmaṇā sarvavṛṣalā vedayuktā hyapi dvijāḥ || 28 || yeṣāmadhyayanaṃ nāsti ye ca kecidanagnayaḥ || kulaṃ vā'śrotriyaṃ yeṣāṃ te sarve śūdrajātayaḥ || 29 || mṛte'hani pituryastu na kuryācchrāddhamādarāt || mātuścaiva varārohe sa dvijaḥ śūdrasaṃnibhaḥ || 7.1.207.30 || mṛtake yastu bhuñjīta gṛhītaśaśibhāskare || gajacchāyāsu yaḥ kaścittaṃ ca śūdravadācaret || 31 || brahmacāriṇi yajñe ca yatau śilpini dīkṣite || yajñe vivāhe satre ca sūtakaṃ na kadācana || 32 || gorakṣakānvaṇijakāṃstathā kārukuśīlavān || spṛśyānvārdhuṣikāṃścaiva viprānśūdravadācaret || 33 || brāhmaṇaḥ patanīyeṣu vartamāno vikarmasu || dāmbhiko duṣkṛtaprāyaḥ sa ca śūdrasamaḥ smṛtaḥ || 34 || asnātāśī malaṃ bhuṃkte ajāpī pūyaśoṇitam || ahutvā tu kṛmīnbhuṃkte adattvā viṣabhojanam || 35 || parānnena tu bhuktena mithunaṃ yo'dhigacchati || yasyānnaṃ tasya te putrā annācchukraṃ pravartate || 36 || rājānnaṃ teja ādatte śūdrānnaṃ brahmavarcasam || āyuḥ suvarṇakārānnaṃ yaśaścarmāvakartinaḥ || 37 || kārukānnaṃ prajā hanti balaṃ nirṇejakasya ca || gaṇānnaṃ gaṇikānnaṃ ca lokebhyaḥ parikṛntati || 38 || pūyaṃ cikitsakasyānnaṃ puṃścalyāstvannamindriyam || viṣṭhā vārdhuṣikasyānnaṃ śastravikrayiṇo malam || 39 || gāyatrīsāramātro'pi varaṃ vipraḥ suyantritaḥ || nāyaṃtritaścaturvedī sarvāśī sarvavikrayī || 7.1.207.40 || sadyaḥ patati māṃsena lākṣayā lavaṇena ca || tryaheṇa śūdro bhavati brāhmaṇaḥ kṣīravikrayāt || 41 || rasā rasairniyaṃtavyā na tveva lavaṇaṃ rasaiḥ || kṛtānnaṃ ca kṛtānnena tilā dhānyena tatsamāḥ || 42 || bhojanābhyañjanāddānādyadanyatkurute tilaiḥ || kṛmibhūtaḥ sa viṣṭhāyāṃ pitṛbhiḥ saha majjati || 43 || apūpaśca hiraṇyaṃ ca gāmaśvaṃ pṛthivīṃ tilān || avidvānpratigṛhṇāti bhasmībhavati kāṣṭhavat ||44|| hiraṇyamāyu ratnaṃ ca bhūrgauścākarṣatastanum || aśvaścakṣustvacaṃ vāso ghṛtaṃ tejastilāḥ prajāḥ || 45 || tila agnihotrī tapasvī ca kṣaṇavānkriyate yadi || agnihotraṃ tapaścaiva sarvaṃ taddhanino dhanam || 46 || somavikrayaṇe viṣṭhā bheṣaje pūyaśoṇitam || naṣṭaṃ devalake dānaṃ hyapratiṣṭhaṃ ca vārdhuke || 47 || devārcanaparo vipro vittārthī bhuvanatraye || asau devalakonāma havyakavyeṣu garhitaḥ || 48 || bhrāturmṛtasyabhāyāyāṃ yo gacchetkāmapūrvakam || dharmeṇāpi niyuktāyāṃ sa jñeyo didhiṣūpatiḥ || 49 || dārāgnihotrasaṃyogaṃ kurute yo'graje sthite || parivettā sa vijñeyaḥ parivittistu pūrvajaḥ || 7.1.207.50 || yo naro'nyasya vāsāṃsi kūpodyānagṛhāṇi ca || adattānyupayuṃjānaḥ sa tatpāpaturīyabhāk || 51 || āmantritastu yaḥ śrāddhe vṛṣalyā saha modate || dāturyadduṣkṛtaṃ kiñcittatsarvaṃ pratipadyate || 52 || ṛtāmṛtābhyāṃ jīveta mṛtena pramṛtena vā || satyānṛtābhyāṃ jīveta na śvavṛttyā kathaṃcana || 53 || bhakṣyaṃ nityamṛtaṃ jñeyamamṛtaṃ syādayācitam || mṛtaṃ tu vṛddhyājīvitvaṃ pramṛtaṃ karṣaṇaṃ smṛtam || 54 || satyānṛtaṃ ca vāṇijyaṃ tena caivopajīvyate || sevā śvavṛttirākhyātā tasmāttāṃ parivarjayeta || 55 || viprayoniṃ samāsādya saṃkaraṃ parivarjayet || mānuṣyaṃ durlabhaṃ loke brāhmaṇyamadhikaṃ tataḥ || 56 || ekaśayyāsanaṃ paktirbhāṇḍapakvānnamiśraṇam || yājanādhyāpanaṃ yonistathā ca saha bhojanam || navadhā saṃkaraḥ prokto na kartavyo'dhamaiḥ saha || 57 || ajīvankarmaṇā svena vipraḥ kṣāttraṃ samāśrayet || vaiśyakarmā'thavā kuryādvārṣalaṃ parivarjayet || 58 || kusīdaṃ kṛṣivāṇijyaṃ prakurvīta svayaṃ kṛtam || āpatkāle svayaṃ kurvansnānena spṛśyate dvijaḥ || ||59|| labdhalābhaḥ pitṝndevānbrāṃhmaṇāṃścaiva tarpayet || te tṛptāstasya tatpāpaṃ śamayaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ||7.1.207.60|| jalagośakaṭārāmayāñcāvṛddhivaṇikkriyāḥ || anūpaṃ parvato rājā durbhikṣe jīvikā smṛtāḥ || 61 || asato'pi samādāya sādhubhyo yaḥ prayacchati || dhanaṃ svāminamātmānaṃ saṃtārayati dustarāt || 62 || śūdre samaguṇaṃ dānaṃ vaiśye taddviguṇaṃ smṛtam || śrotriye tacca sāhasramanantaṃ cāgnihotrike || 63 || brāhmaṇātikramo nāsti nācaredyo vyavasthitim || jvalaṃtamagnimutsṛjya na hi bhasmani hūyate || 64 || vidyātapobhyāṃ hīnena naiva grāhyaḥ pratigrahaḥ || gṛhṇanpradātāramadho nayatyātmānameva ca || 65 || tasmācchrotriya evārho guṇavāñchīlavāñchuciḥ || avyaṃgastatra nirdoṣaḥ pātrāṇāṃ paramaṃ smṛtam || 66 || kapālasthaṃ yathā toyaṃ śvadṛtau ca yathā payaḥ || dūṣitaṃ sthānadoṣeṇa vṛttahīne tathā śrutam || 67 || dattaṃ pātramatikramya yadapātre pratigrahaḥ || taddattaṃ gāmatikramya gardabhasya gavāhnikam || 68 || vṛttaṃ tasmāttu saṃrakṣedvittameti gataṃ punaḥ || akṣīṇo vittataḥ kṣīṇo vṛttatastu hato hataḥ || 69 || prathamaṃ tu gurau dānaṃ dattvā śreṣṭhamanukramāt || tato'nyeṣāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ dadyātpātrānurūpataḥ || 7.1.207.70 || gurau ca dattaṃ yaddānaṃ dattaṃ pātreṣu mānavaiḥ || niṣphalaṃ tadbhavetpretya yātyutādhogatiṃ prati || 71 || avamānaṃ guroḥ kṛtvā kopayitvā tu durmatiḥ || gurvamānahato mūḍho na śāṃtimadhi gacchati || 72 || gurorabhāve tatputraṃ tadbhāryāṃ tatsutaṃ vinā || putraṃ prapautraṃ dauhitraṃ hyanyaṃ vā tatkulodbhavam || 73 || paṃcayojanamadhye tu śrūyate svagururyadā || tadā nātikrameddānaṃ dadyātpātreṣu mānavaḥ || 74 || yatiścetprārthayellobhāddīyamānaṃ pratigraham || na tasya deyaṃ vidvadbhirna lobhaḥ śasyate yateḥ || 75 || dhanaṃ prāpya yatirloke maunaṃ jñānaṃ ca nābhyaset || upabhogaṃ tu dānena jīvitaṃ brahmacaryayā || 76 || kule janma ca dīkṣābhirye gatāste narottamāḥ|| saubhāgyamāpnuyālloke nūnaṃ rasavivarjanāt||77|| āyuṣmatyaḥ prajāḥ sarvā bhavantyāmiṣavarjanāt||78|| cīravalkaladhṛktyaktvā vastrāṇyābharaṇāni ca|| nāgādhipatyaṃ prāpnoti upavāsena mānavaḥ||79|| krīḍate satyavākyena svarge vai devataiḥ saha|| ahiṃsayā tathā''rogyaṃ dānātkīrtimanukramāt||7.1.207.80|| dvijaśuśrūṣayā rājyaṃ dvijatvaṃ cātipuṣkalam|| divyarūpamavāpnoti devaśuśrūṣayā naraḥ||81|| annadānādbhavettṛptiḥ sarvakāmairanuttamaiḥ || dīpasya tu pradānena cakṣuṣmāñjāyate naraḥ || 82 || tuṣṭirbhavetsarvakālaṃ pradānādgandhamālyayoḥ || lavaṇasya tu dātārastilānāṃ sarpiṣastathā || tejasvino'pi jāyante bhoginaścirajīvinaḥ || 83 || sucitravastrābharaṇopadhānaṃ dadyānnaro yaḥ śayanaṃ dvijāya || rūpānvitāṃ pakṣmavatīṃ manojñāṃ bhāryāmarālopacitāṃ labhetsaḥ || 84 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe pātrāpātravicāravarṇanaṃnāma saptottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 207 ||
<7.1.208>
|| devyuvāca || || idaṃ deyamidaṃ deyamiti proktaṃ tu yacchrutau || dānādānaviśeṣāṃstu śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 1 || kāni dānāni śastāni kasmai deyāni kānyapi || kālaṃ deśaṃ ca pātraṃ ca sarvamācakṣva me vibho || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || vṛthā janmāni catvāri vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa || sujanmāni ca catvāri mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || 3 || || devyuvāca|| || etadvistarato brūhi devadevajagatpate || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || vṛthā janmāni catvāri yāni tāni nibodha me || kuputrāṇāṃ vṛthā janma ye ca dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ || pravāsaṃ ye ca gacchaṃti paradāraratāḥ sadā || 5 || parapākaṃ ca ye'śnaṃti para dāraratāśca ye || apratyākhyaṃ vṛthā dānaṃ sadoṣaṃ ca tathā priye || 6 || ārūḍhapatite caiva anyāyopārjitaṃ dhanam || vṛthā brahmahane dānaṃ patite taskare tathā || 7 || guroścāprītijanane kṛtaghne grāmayājake || brahmabandhau ca yaddattaṃ yaddattaṃ vṛṣalīpatau || 8 || vedavikrayiṇe caiva yasya copapatirgṛhe || strīnirjite ca yaddattaṃ vṛthādānāni ṣoḍaśa || 9 || sujanma ca suputrāṇāṃ ye ca dharme ratā narāḥ || pravāsaṃ na ca gacchaṃti paradāraparāṅmukhāḥ || 7.1.208.10 || gāvaḥ suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ ratnāni ca sarasvatī || tilāḥ kanyā gajośvaśca śayyā vastraṃ tathā mahī || 11 || dhānyaṃ payaśca cchatraṃ ca gṛhaṃ copaskarānvitam|| etānyeva mahādevi mahādānāni ṣoḍaśa || 12 || garvāvṛtastu yo dadyādbhayātkrodhāttathaiva ca || bhuṃkte dānaphalaṃ taddhi garbhastho nātra saṃśaya || 13 || bālatve'pi ca so'śnāti yaddattaṃ daṃbhakāraṇāt || manyunā maṃtunā caiva tathaivārthasya kāraṇāt || 14 || deśe kāle ca pātre ca śuddhena manasā tathā || nyāyārjitaṃ ca yo dadyādyauvane sa tadaśnute || 15 || anyāyenārjitaṃ dravyamapātre pratipāditam || kliṣṭaṃ ca vidhihīnaṃ ca vṛddhabhāve tadaśnute||16|| tasmāddeśe ca kāle ca supātre vidhinā naraḥ|| śubhārjitaṃ prayuñjīta śraddhayā śāṭhyavarjitaḥ|| 17|| svādhyāyāḍhyaṃ yogavaṃtaṃ praśāṃtaṃ purāṇajñaṃ pāpabhīruṃ vadānyam|| strīṣu kṣāntaṃ dhārmikaṃ gośaraṇyaṃ vrataiḥ krāntaṃ tādṛśaṃ pātramāhuḥ||18|| satyaṃ damastapaḥ śaucaṃ santoṣo'nairṣyamārjavam || jñānaṃ śamo dayā dānametatpātrasya lakṣaṇam || 19 || evaṃvidhe tu yatpātre gāmekāṃ tu prayacchati || samānavatsāṃ kapilāṃ dhenuṃ sarvaguṇānvitām || 7.1.208.20 || raupyapādāṃ svarṇaśṛṅgīṃ rudraloke mahīyate || ekāṃ gāṃ daśagurdadyādgośatī ca tathā daśa || 21 || śataṃ sahasragurdadyātsarve samaphalāḥ smṛtāḥ || suśīlā somasaṃpannā taruṇī ca payasvinī || savatsā nyāyalabdhā ca pradeyā brāhmaṇāya gauḥ || 22 || vaṃdhyā sarogā hīnāṃgī duṣṭā vṛddhā mṛtaprajā || anyāyalabdhā dūrasthā nedṛśī gāṃ pradāpayet || 23 || yo hīdṛśīṃ gāṃ dadāti devoddeśena mānavaḥ || pratyutādhogatiṃ yāti kliśyate ca maheśvari || 24 || ruṣṭā kliṣṭā durbalā vyādhitā ca na dātavyā yā ca mūlyairadattaiḥ || leśo viprebhyo yayā jāyate vai tasyā dātuścāphalāḥ sarvalokāḥ || 25 || atithaye praśāntāya sīdate cāhitāgnaye || śrotriyāya tathaikāpi dattā bahuguṇā bhavet || 26 || gāṃ vikrīṇāti ceddevi brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ || nāsau praśasyate pātraṃ brāhmaṇo naiva sa smṛtaḥ || 27 || bahubhyo na pradeyāni gaurgṛhaṃ śayanaṃ striyaḥ || vibhaktā dakṣiṇā hyeṣā dātāraṃ nopatiṣṭhati || 28 || prāsādā yatra sauvarṇāḥ śayyā ravrojjvalāstathā || varāścāpsaraso yatra tatra gacchaṃti gopradāḥ || 29 || nāsti bhūmisamaṃ dānaṃ nāsti gaṃgāsamā sarit || nāsti satyātparo dharmo nānyo devo maheśvarāt || || 7.1.208.30 || uccaiḥ pāṣāṇayuktā ca na samā naiva coṣarā || na nadīkūlavikaṭā bhūmirdeyā kadācana || 31 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi svarge vasati bhūmidaḥ || ācchettā cānumaṃtā ca tānyeva narakaṃ vrajet ||32|| kurute puruṣaḥ pāpaṃ yatkiñcidvṛttikarśitaḥ || api gocarmamātreṇa bhūmidānena śuddhyati || 33 || chatraṃ śayyāsanaṃ śaṃkho gajāśvāścāmarāḥ striyaḥ || bhūmiścaiṣāṃ pradānasya śivalokaḥ phalaṃ smṛtam || 34 || āditye'hani saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe candra sūryayoḥ || pāraṇaiścaiva godāne nopoṣyaḥ pautravāngṛhī || 35 || indukṣaye tu saṃkrāntyāmekādaśyāṃ śate kṛte || upavāsaṃ na kurvīta yadīcchetsaṃtatiṃ dhruvam|| 36 || yathā śuklā tathā kṛṣṇā na viśeṣo'sti kaścana || tathāpi vardhate dharmaḥ śuklāyāmeva sarvadā || 37 || daśamyekādaśīviddhā dvādaśī ca kṣayaṃ gatā || naktaṃ tatra prakurvīta nopavāso vidhīyate || 38 || upoṣyaikādaśīṃ yastu trayodaśyāṃ tu pāraṇam || karoti tasya naśyettu dvādaśa dadvādaśīphalam||39|| upavāse tathā śrāddhe na khādeddantadhāvanam|| dantānāṃ kāṣṭhasaṃgācca hanti saptakulāni vai||7.1.208.40|| darśaṃ ca paurṇamāsaṃ ca pituḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam|| pūrvaviddhamakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || 41 || hāniśca saṃtateḥ proktā daurbhāgyaṃ samavāpnuyāt || dravyābhāvetha śrāddhasya vidhiṃ vakṣyāmi tattvataḥ || 42 || ekenāpi hi vipreṇa ṣaṭpiṇḍaṃ śrāddhamācaret || ṣaḍarghyānpārayettatra tebhyo dadyādyathāvidhi || 43 || pitā bhuṃkte dvija kare mukhe bhuṃkte pitāmahaḥ || prapitāmahastālusthaḥ kaṇṭhe mātāmahaḥ smṛtaḥ || 44 || pramātāmahastu hṛdaye vṛddho nābhau tu saṃsthitaḥ || alābhe brāhmaṇasyaiva kuśaḥ kāryo dvijaḥ priye || idaṃ sarvapurāṇebhyaḥ sāramuddhatya cocyate || 45 || na caitannāstike deyaṃ piśune vedanindake || prātaḥprātaridaṃ śrāvyaṃ pūjayitvā maheśvaram|| 46 || kulīnaṃ sarvaśāstrajñaṃ yathā devaṃ maheśvaram || asya dharmasya vaktāraṃ chatraṃ dadyātprapūjayet || 47 || apūjyādvācakādyastu ślokamekaṃ śṛṇoti ca || nāsau puṇyamavāpnoti śāstracauraḥ smṛto hi saḥ || 48 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayedvācakaṃ budhaḥ || anyathā niṣphalaṃ tasya pustakaśravaṇaṃ bhavet|| 49 || yasyaiva tiṣṭhate gehe śāstrametatsadurlabham || tasya devi gṛhe tīrthaiḥ saha tiṣṭhecchivaḥ svayam || 7.1.208.50 || bahunātra kimuktena bhavenmokṣasya bhājanam || na caitatpiśune deyaṃ nāstike daṃbhasaṃyute | 51 || idaṃ śāntāya dāntāya deyaṃ śaivadvijanmane || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śrāddhakalpe dānapātrabrāhmaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 208 ||
<7.1.209>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi mārkaṇḍeyeśamuttamam || tasmāduttaradigbhāge mārkaṇḍena pratiṣṭhitam ||1|| sāvitryāḥ pūrvabhāge tu nātidūre vyavasthitam || maharṣirabhavatpūrvaṃ mārkaṇḍeya iti śrutaḥ || 2 || ajaraścāmaraścaiva prasādātpadmayoninaḥ || sa gatvā tatra viprendro devadevasya śūlinaḥ || liṃgaṃ tu sthāpayāmāsa jñātvā tatkṣetramuttamam || 3 || sa taṃ pūjya vidhānena sthitvā dakṣiṇato muniḥ || padmāsanadharo bhūtvā dhyānāvasthastadā'bhavat || 4 || tasya dhyānaratasyaiva prayutānyarbudāni ca || yugānāṃ samatītāni na jānāti munīśvaraḥ || 5 || atha lopaṃ samāpannaḥ prāsādaḥ śāṃkaraḥ sthitaḥ || kālena mahatā devi pāṃsubhirmārutodbhavaiḥ || 6 || kasyacittvatha kālasya prabuddho munisattamaḥ || apaśyatpāṃsubhirvyāptaṃ tatsarvaṃ śivamandiram || 7 || tataḥ kṛcchrātsa niṣkrāntaḥ khanitvā munipuṃgavaḥ || akarotsumahādvāraṃ pūjārthaṃ tasya bhāmini || 8 || praviśya tatra yo bhaktyā pūjayedvṛṣabhadhvajam || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || || 9 || devyuvāca || amaratvaṃ kathaṃ prāpto mārkaṃṇḍo munisattamaḥ || abhavatkautukaṃ hyetattasmāttvaṃ vaktumarhasi || 7.1.209.10 || amaratvaṃ yato nāsti prāṇināṃ bhuvi śaṃkara || devānāmapi kalpāṃte sa kathaṃ na mṛto muniḥ || 11 || || īśvara uvāca || || athātastvāṃ prava kṣyāmi yathāsāvamaro'bhavat || āsīnmuniḥ purākalpe mṛkaṇḍa iti viśrutaḥ || 12 || bhṛgoḥ putro mahābhāgaḥ sabhāryastapasi sthitaḥ || tasya putrastadā jāto vasatastu vanāṃtare || 13 || sa pāñcavārṣiko bhūtvā bāla eva guṇānvitaḥ || kasyacittvatha kālasya jñānī tatra samāgataḥ ||14|| tena dṛṣṭastadā bālaḥ prāṃgaṇe vicaranpriye || smṛtvā'hasacciraṃ kālaṃ bhāvyarthaṃ prati noditaḥ || 15 || tasya pitrā sa dṛṣṭastu sāmudrajño viduttamaḥ || hāsyasya kāraṇaṃ pṛṣṭo vismayānvitacetasā || 16 || kasmānme sutamālokya smitaṃ vipra kṛtaṃ tvayā || tatra me kāraṇaṃ brahmanyathāvadvaktumarhasi || || 17 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā jñānī vipro vaco'bravīt || 18 || ayaṃ putrastava mune sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutaḥ || adyaprabhṛti ṣaṇmāsamadhye mṛtyumavāpsyati || 19 || yadi jīvetpunarayaṃ cirāyurvai bhaviṣyati || ato mayā kṛtaṃ hāsyaṃ vicitrā karmaṇo gatiḥ || 7.1.209.20 || etacchrutvā vaco raudraṃ jñāninā samudāhṛtam || vratopanayanaṃ cakre bālakasya pitā tadā || 21 || āha cainamṛṣiḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇamāgatam|| abhivādyāstrayo varṇāstataḥ śreyo hyavāpsyasi || 22 || evamuktaḥ sa vai vipraḥ karotyevābhivādanam || na varṇāvarajaṃ vetti bālabhāvādvarānane || 23 || paṃcamāsā hyatikrāntā divasāḥ pañcaviṃśatiḥ || etasminneva kāle tu prāptāḥ saptarṣayo'malāḥ || 24 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tena mārgeṇa bhāmini || kālena tena sarve'tha yathāvadabhivādanaiḥ || āyuṣmānbhava tairuktaḥ sa bālo daṇḍavalkalī || 25 || uktvā te tu punarbālaṃ vīkṣya vai kṣīṇajīvitam || dināni paṃca te hyāyurjñātvā bhītāstato'nṛtāt || 26 || brahmacāriṇamādāya gatāste brahmaṇo'ntike || pratimucyāgrato bālaṃ praṇemuste pitāmaham || 27 || tatastenāpi bālena brahmā caivābhivāditaḥ || cirāyurbrahmaṇā bālaḥ prokto'sāvṛṣisannidhau || 28 || tataste munayaḥ prītāḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ pitāmahāt || pitāmahastu tāndṛṣṭvā ṛṣīnprovāca vismitān || kena kāryeṇa vā''yātāḥ kena bālo niveditaḥ ||29|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bhṛgoḥ putro mṛkaṇḍastu kṣīṇāyustasya bālakaḥ || akālena pitā jñātvā babaṃdhāsya ca mekhalām || 7.1.209.30 || yajñopavītaṃ ca tatastena vipreṇa bodhitaḥ || yaṃ kañciddrakṣyase loke bhramantaṃ bhūtale dvijam || 31 || tasyābhivādanaṃ kāryaṃ nityameva ca putraka || tato vayamanenaiva dṛṣṭā bālena sattama || || 32 || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena daivayogātpitāmaha || cirāyureṣa vai prokto hyamībhiścābhivāditaiḥ || 33 || tvatsakāśaṃ samānītastvayā caivamudāhṛtaḥ || kathaṃ vāganṛtā deva hyasmākaṃ bhavatā saha || 34 || uvāca bālamuddiśya prahasanpadmasaṃbhavaḥ || matsamānāyuṣo bālo mārkaṇḍeyo bhaviṣyati || 35 || kalpasyādau tathā cānte sahāyo me
