bhaviṣyati || tatastu munayaḥ prītā gṛhītvā munidārakam || tasminneva pradeśe tu mumucuśceṣṭitaṃ yataḥ || 36 || tīrthayātrāṃ gatā viprā mārkaṇḍeyo gṛhaṃ yayau || gatvā gṛhamathovāca mṛkaṇḍaṃ munisattamam || 37 || brahmalokamahaṃ nīto munibhistāta saptabhiḥ || ukto'yaṃ brahmaṇā kalpasyādau cānte ca me sakhā || 38 || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho matsamāyuśca bālakaḥ || tatastaiḥ punarānīto muktaścaivāśramaṃ prati || 39 || matkṛte hi dvijaśreṣṭha yātu te manaso jvaraḥ || mārkaṇḍeyavacaḥ śrutvā mṛkaṇḍo munisattamaḥ || jagāma paramaṃ harṣaṃ kṣaṇamekaṃ suduḥsaham || 7.1.209.40 || tatau dhairyaṃ samāsthāya vākyametaduvāca ha || 41 || adya me saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || yattvayā me suputreṇa dṛṣṭo lokapitāmahaḥ || 42 || vājapeyasahasreṇa rājasūyaśatena ca || yaṃ na paśyanti vidvāṃsaḥ sa tvayā līlayā suta || 43 || dṛṣṭaścirāyurapyevaṃ kṛtastenābjayoninā || divārātramahaṃ tāta tava duḥkhena dukhitaḥ || na nidrāmanugacchāmi tanmeduḥkhaṃ gataṃ mahat || 44 || iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 209 || || cha ||
<7.1.210>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi pulastyeśvaramuttamam || mārkaṃḍeyottere bhāge dhanuṣāṃ pañcake sthitam || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || saptajanmārjitātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pulastyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 210 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.211>
|| īśvara uvāca || || pulastyeśvarāttato devi nairṛte dhanuṣāṣṭake || pulaheśvaranāmānaṃ taṃ ca bhaktyā prapūjayet || 1 || hiraṇyadānaṃ dattvā vai samyagyātrāphalaṃ labhet || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pulaheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 211 || || cha || ||
<7.1.212>
īśvara uvāca || || pulaheśvarāttato devi nairṛte dhanuṣāṣṭake || kratvīśvaretināmānaṃ mahākratuphalapradam ||1|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi pauṃḍarīkaphalaṃ labhet || saptajanmani dāridryaṃ na duḥkhaṃ tatra jāyate ||2|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kratvīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 212||
<7.1.213>
īśvara uvāca|| kratvīśātpūrvadigbhāge dhanuḥṣoḍaśakāntare|| kaśyapeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi dhanavānputravānbhavet || sarvapātakayukto'pi mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kaśyapeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 213 || ||
<7.1.214>
|| īśvara uvāca || || dhanuṣāmaṣṭabhistasmādīśāne kaśyapeśvarāt || kauśakeśvaranāmānaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || vasiṣṭhatanayānhatvā tatra kauśikasattamaḥ || sthāpayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ muktapāpastato'bhavat || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā tu labhate vāñchitaṃ phalam||3|| iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kauśikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmacaturdaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| || 214 ||
<7.1.215>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kumāreśvaramuttamam || mārkaṇḍeśvarato devi dakṣiṇe nātidūrataḥ || dhanurviṃśatibhistatra sthitaṃ svāmipratiṣṭhitam || 1 || tataḥ kṛtvā tapo ghoraṃ kārttikeyena bhābhini || paradārāpahārotthapāpānāṃ nāśahetave || 2 || liṃgaṃ sthāpitavāṃstatra sa muktaḥ kilviṣāttataḥ || vairāgyādyauvanaṃ tyaktvā kaumāraṃ punarādade || 3 || pitṝnhatvā sumālī ca tamārādhitavānpurā || so'pi mukto'bhavaddevi pāpātpitṛvadhodbhavāt || 4 || kumāreśvaranāmaitatpūjitaṃ vai surāsuraiḥ || tasyāgrataḥ kumārasya kūpastiṣṭhati bhāmini || 5 || tatra snātvā pūjayedyaḥ śūlinaṃ svāmipūjitam || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairgacchetsvāmipuraṃ mahat || 6 || śātakauṃbhamayaṃ yastu tāmracūḍaṃ dvijātaye || dadyātsvāminamuddiśya sa tu yātrāphalaṃ labhet || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye kumāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 215 || ||
<7.1.216>
|| īśvara uvāca|| || mārkaṇḍeśvarato devi uttare liṃgamuttamam|| dhanuṣāṃ pañcadaśabhirgautameśvaranāmakam || 1 || guruṃ hatvā purā devi gautamaḥ pāpaduḥkhitaḥ || tatra liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tasmātpāpādvyamucyata || 2 || yastatra kapilāṃ dadyātsnātvā nadyāṃ vidhānataḥ || saṃpūjya vidhivalliṃgaṃ mucyate pañcapātakaiḥ ||3|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gautameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||216|| ||
<7.1.217>
|| īśvara uvāca || || gautameśvarato devi paścime nātidūrataḥ || dhanuḥṣoḍaśabhirdevi devarājeśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || 1 || liṃgaṃ sa sthāpayāmāsa tataḥ pāpairvyamucyata || yastaṃ samāhitamanāḥ pūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ || sa ca mānavasaṃbhūtātpātakātsaṃpramokṣyati || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devarājeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||217||
<7.1.218>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva mānavaṃ liṃgaṃ manunā saṃpratiṣṭhitam || pūrvaṃ hatvā sutaṃ devi manuḥ pāpasamanvitaḥ || 1 || kṣetraṃ pāpaharaṃ jñātvā tatra prātiṣṭhadīśvaram|| muktaścaivābhavatpāpāttasmātputravadhodbhavāt||2|| pūjayenmānavo yastu sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mānaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||218|| ||
<7.1.219>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādāgneyakoṇe tu mārkaṃḍeyasamīpagam || guhāliṃgaṃ mahādevi nīlakaṇṭheti viśrutam || 1 || viṣṇunā pūjitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarva pātakanāśanam || 2 || tatra yaḥ pūjayedbhaktyā talliṃgaṃ pāpamocanam|| sa putrapaśumāndhīmānmodate pṛthivītale || 3 || evaṃ tatra mahādevi mārkaṇḍeyeśa sannidhau || ṛṣīṇāmāśramā ye'tra dṛśyante'dyāpi bhāmini || 4 || aṣṭāśītisahasrāṇi ṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām || tatra sthitāni deveśi mārkaṇḍeyāśramāṃtike || 5 || ṛṣīṇāṃ ca guhāstatra sarvā liṃgasamanvitāḥ || dṛśyante puṇyatapasāṃ tadāśramanivāsinām || 6 || tatra yaḥ sthāpayelliṃgaṃ mārkaṃḍeśasamīpagam|| kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya modate divi devavat || 7 || sarve śivamayā lokāḥ śive sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || tasmācchivaṃ yajedvidvānya icchecchriyamātmanaḥ || 8 || śivabhakto na yo rājā bhakto'nyeṣu sureṣu ca || svapatiṃ yuvatī tyaktvā ramate'nyeṣu vai yathā || 9 || brahmādayaḥ surāḥ sarve rājānaśca maharddhikāḥ || mānavā munayaścaiva sarve liṃgaṃ yajaṃti ca || 7.1.219.10 || svanāmakṛtacihnāni liṃgānīṃdrādibhiḥ kramāt || sthāpitāni yathā sthāne mānavairapi bhūriśaḥ || 11 || sthāpanādbrahmahatyāṃ ca bhrūṇahatyāṃ tathaiva ca || mahāpāpāni cānyāni nistīrṇāḥ śivatejasā || 12 || vṛtraṃ hatvā purā śakro māhendraṃ sthāpya śaṃkaram || liṃgaṃ ca muktapāpaughastato'sau tridivaṃ gataḥ || 13 || sthāpayitvā śivaṃ sūryo gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || nirāmayo'bhūtsomaśca prabhāse paścimodadheḥ || 14 || kāśyāṃ caiva tathādityaḥ sahye garuḍakāśyapau || pratiṣṭhāṃ paramāṃ prāptau pratiṣṭhāpya jagatpatim || 15 || khyātadoṣā hyahilyā'pi bhartṛśaptā'bhavattadā || sthāpyeśānaṃ punaḥ strītvaṃ lebhe putrāṃstathottamān || 16 || paśyaṃtyadyāpi yāḥ snātvā tatrāhilyeśvaraṃ striyaḥ || puruṣāścāpi taddoṣairmucyante nātra saṃśayaḥ || 17 || sthāpayitveśvaraṃ śvetaśaile balivirocanau || ubhāvapi hi saṃjātāvamarau balināṃ varau || || 18 || rāmeṇa rāvaṇaṃ hatvā sasainyaṃ tridaśeśvaram || sthāpito vidhivadbhaktyā tīre nadanadīpateḥ || 19 || svāyaṃbhuvarṣidaivādiliṃgahīnā na bhūḥ kvacita || vyā pārānsakalāṃstyaktvā pūjayadhvaṃ śivaṃ sadā || nikaṭā iva dṛśyaṃte kṛtāṃtanagaropagāḥ || 7.1.219.20 || devi kiṃ bahunoktena varṇitena punaḥ punaḥ || prabhāsakṣetrasāraṃ tu mārkaṇḍeyāśramaṃ prati || 21 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye mārkaṇḍeyeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 219 || || cha ||
<7.1.220>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ trailokyapūjitam || vṛṣadhvajeśvaraṃ nāma sthitaṃ dakṣiṇatastathā || 1 || yattadakṣaramavyaktaṃ paraṃ yasmānna vidyate || yogagamyamanādyaṃtaṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja saṃmitam || 2 || sarvāścaryamayaṃ devi buddhigrāhyaṃ nirāmayam|| viśvataḥ pāṇipādaṃ ca viśvato'kṣiśiromukham || 3 || taṃ ca devaṃ ciraṃ sthāṇuṃ vṛṣabhadhvajasaṃjñitam || pṛthurmarucca bharataḥ śaśabindurgayaḥ śibiḥ || 4 || rāmoṃ'barīṣo māṃdhātā dilīpo'tha bhagīrathaḥ || suhotro raṃtidevaśca yayātiḥ sagarastathā || 5 || ṣoḍaśaite nṛpā dhanyāḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāśritāḥ || vṛṣadhvajeśamārādhya yajñairiṣṭvā divaṃ gatāḥ || 6 || satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi sāraṃ vacmi punaḥpunaḥ || asāre dagdhasaṃsāre sāraṃ tatra śivārcanam || 7 || punarjanma punarmṛtyuḥ punaḥ kleśaḥ punarjarā || aharaharghaṭīnyāyo na kadācidapīdṛśaḥ || || 8 || tadā śvetasya saṃsāragrantheratyantadurbhidaḥ || paraṃ nirmūlavicchedi kriyatāṃ tadbhavārcanam || 9 || tasya cintāmaṇirgehe tasya kalpadrumaḥ kule || kuberaḥ kiṃkarastasya bhaktiryasya śive sthitā || 7.1.220.10 || seyaṃ lakṣmīḥ purā puṃsāṃ seyaṃ bhaktiḥ samīhitā || seyaṃ śreyaskarī mūrtirbhaktiryā vṛṣabhadhvaje || 11 || puṣpaiḥ paṃcabhirapyatra pūjayitvā maheśvaram || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 12 || vṛṣabhastatra dātavyo vṛṣabhadhvaja saṃnidhau || sarvapātakanāśārthaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 13 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vṛṣabhadhvajeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 220 ||
<7.1.221>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ ca ṛṇamocanam || tasmindṛṣṭe ṛṇaṃ na syānmātāpitṛsamudbhavam || 1 || pitarastu purā sarve divyakṣetraṃ samāgatāḥ || prabhāse tapasā yuktāḥ sthitā varṣagaṇānbahūn || 2 || agniṣvāttā barhiṣadaḥ somapā ājyapāstathā || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ sarve bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 3 || tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭasteṣāṃ maheśvaraḥ || tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ gatvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 4 || parituṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ vo brūta yanmanasepsitam ||5|| || pitara ūcuḥ || || asmākaṃ dīyatāṃ vṛttirjagatyasminsvayaṃ kṛte || devānāṃ ca ṛṣīṇāṃ ca mānuṣāṇāṃ mahītale || 6 || bhavāneva paro loke sarveṣāṃ padmasaṃbhava|| āgatya varṇāścatvāra iha ye śraddhayānvitāḥ || 7 || paitṛkāttu ṛṇānmuktā bhavaṃtu gatakalmaṣāḥ || vyantaratvaṃ suraśreṣṭha yeṣāṃ vai pitaro gatāḥ || 8 || sarppe vahni viṣairvā ye nāśaṃ nītāḥ pitāmahāḥ || aputrā vā saputrā vā sapiṇḍīkaraṇaṃ vinā || 9 || na kṛtāni purā yeṣāmekoddiṣṭāni ṣoḍaśa || tathā naiva vṛṣotsargo gohatāścātha cāntyajaiḥ || 7.1.221.10 || athāpare ye ca mṛtāḥ śaucena tu vinā kṛtāḥ || te cātra tarpitāḥ sarve prayāntu paramāṃ gatim || 11 || || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || snātvā tu salile puṇye pitṛṇāṃ caiva tarpaṇam || ye kariṣyaṃti manujāḥ pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || 12 || ahaṃ varapradasteṣāṃ tārayiṣyāmi tatkṣaṇāt || pitṛnsarvānna saṃdeho yadi pāpaśatairvṛtāḥ || 13 || asmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā yo liṃgaṃ pūjayiṣyati || yuṣmābhiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sa muktaḥ paitṛkādṛṇāt || 14|| yasmādṛṇātpramucyeta asya liṃgasya darśanāt || tasmānmayā kṛtaṃ nāma hyetasya ṛṇamocanam || | 15 || || īśvara uvāca || || hiraṇyaṃ mastake dattvā yaḥ snāti ṛṇamocane || ātmā vai tāritastena dattaṃ bhavati gośatam || 16 || evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstatraivāntaradhīyata || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret || pūjayettanmahādevi pitṛliṃgaṃ surapriyam || 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṇamocanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 221 || || cha ||
<7.1.222>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ liṃgaṃ rukmavatyā pratiṣṭhitam|| sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam|| 1 || tatra snātvā mahātīrthe liṃgaṃ saṃplāvya yatnataḥ || viprebhyo dāpayedvittaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rukmavatīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 222 || || cha || ||
<7.1.223>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ trailokyapūjitam || gātrotsargamiti khyātaṃ tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam|| 1 || yatra gātraṃ parityaktaṃ balabhadreṇa dhīmatā || anyaiścaiva mahābhāgairyādavaistatra saṃyuge || 2 || yatra te yādavāḥ kṣīṇā brahmaśāpabalāhinā || etatpuruṣottamaṃ kṣetraṃ samantāddhanuṣāṃ śatam|| 3 || yatra sākṣātsvayaṃ devi tiṣṭhate puruṣottamaḥ || tadeva vaiṣṇavaṃ kṣetraṃ kalau pātakanāśanam|| 4 || rahasyaṃ paramaṃ devi tīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ hi tat|| pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge devi pretatīrthaṃ ca saṃsmṛtam || kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte gātrotsargamiti tvabhūt || 5 || ṛṇamocanapārśve tu madhye tu pāpamocanāt|| etanmadhyaṃ samāśritya mṛtaḥ pāpairvimucyate || 6 || tasya kiṃ varṇyate devi yatrānantaphalaṃ mahat || athamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ snātvā hyavāpyate || 7 || yatrāśvatthaṃ samāsādya samādhinyastamānasaḥ || mumoca dustyajānprāṇānbrahmadvāreṇa keśavaḥ || 8 || tatra nārāyaṇaṃ sākṣādbalabhadraṃ ca rukmiṇīm || pūjayitvā vidhānena mucyate pātakatrayāt || 9 || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā yaḥ saṃtarpayate pitṝn || pretatvātpitaro muktā bhavanti śrāddhadāyinaḥ || 7.1.223.10 ||| goghnaḥ surāpo durmedhā brahmahā gurutalpagaḥ || tatra snātvā naraḥ sadyo vipāpaḥ saṃprapadyate || 11 || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā || ajñānājjñānato vāpi yaḥ karoti naraḥ priye || tatra snātvā pramucyeta tīrthe gātrapramocane || 12 || tatra piṇḍapradānena pitṝṇāṃ jāyate parā || tṛptirvarṣaśataṃ yāvadetadāha purā hariḥ || 13 || yaḥ punaścānnadānaṃ tu tatra kuryātsamāhitaḥ || tasyānvaye'pi deveśi na preto jāyate naraḥ ||14|| || ||śrīdevyuvāca || || pretatīrthamiti proktaṃ paścādgātravimocanam || vada me devadeveśa pretatīrthasya kāraṇam|| 19 || || īśvara uvāca|| || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi pretatīrthasya kāraṇam|| yacchrutvā mānavo bhaktyā muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 16 || purā''sīdgautamonāma maharṣiḥ śaṃsitavrataḥ || bhṛgukalpātsamāyātaḥ kṣetre prābhāsike śubhe || 17 || ayane cottare puṇye śrīsomeśadidṛkṣayā || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ snātvā tīrtheṣu kṛtsnaśaḥ || 18 || sa gacchaṃstīrthayātrāyāṃ gātrotsargaṃ tato gataḥ || 19 || athāsau brāhmaṇo devi yāvatsīmāmupāgataḥ || tāvadviṣṇupriyaṃ tatra dadṛśe vaiṣṇavaṃ vanam || 7.1.223.20 || puruṣottamanāmāḍhyaṃ kṣetraṃ ca dhanuṣāṃ śatam || tasminkṣetre sa cāpaśyatpaṃca pretānsudāruṇān || 21 || mahāvṛkṣasamārūḍhānmahākāyānmahotkaṭān|| ūrdhvakeśāñchaṃkukarṇānsnāyunaddhakalevarān || 22 || vimāṃsarudhirānnagnānatha kṛṣṇakalevarān || dṛṣṭvā'sau bhayasaṃtrasto vinaṣṭo'smītyacintayat || 23 || dhyātvā''ha suciraṃ kālaṃ dhairyamāsthāya yatnataḥ || ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārā dṛṣṭāḥ pūrvaṃ mayā purā || 24 || na kadācidyathā yūyaṃ kimarthaṃ kṣetramadhyataḥ || dhāvamānāḥ suduḥkhārtā etanme kautukaṃ mahat || 25 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || vayaṃ pretā mahābhāga dūrādiha samāgatāḥ || śrutvā tīrthavaraṃ puṇyaṃ praveśaṃ na labhāmahe ||26|| gaṇairaṃtardhānagataiḥ prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ || lekhako rohakaścaiva sūcakaḥ śīghragastathā || 27 || ahaṃ paryuṣitonāma pañcamaḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ || 28 || || gautama uvāca || || pretayonau pravṛttānāṃ kena nāmāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || yuṣmākaṃ nirmitānyevametanme kautukaṃ mahat || 29 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || yācamānasya viprasya likhatyeṣa dharātale || nottaraṃ paṭhate kiñcittenāsau lekhakaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.1.223.30 || dvitīyo brāhmaṇabhayātprāsādamadhirohati || tato'sau rohakākhyo'bhūcchṛṇu vipra tṛtīyakam || 31 || sūcitā bahavo'nena brāhmaṇā vittasaṃyutāḥ | rājñe pāpena tenāsau sūcako bhuvi viśrutaḥ || 32|| brāhmaṇaiḥ prārthyamānastu śīghraṃ dhāvati nityaśaḥ || na kadāciddadāti sma tenāsau śīghragaḥ smṛtaḥ || 33 || mayā kadannaṃ dattaṃ ca paryuṣitaṃ brāhmaṇottame || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sadā dānaṃ miṣṭānnena tu poṣaṇam || tasmātparyuṣitonāma saṃjāto'haṃ dharātale || 34 || || gautama uvāca || || na vinā bhojanenaiva vartante prāṇino bhuvi || kimāhārā bhavanto vai vadadhvaṃ mama kautukāt || 35 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || prāpte bhojanakāle tu yatra yuddhaṃ pravartate || tasyānnasya rasaṃ sarvaṃ bhuṃjāmo dvijasattama || 36 || nānulipte dharāpṛṣṭhe yatra bhuṃjanti mānavāḥ || bhraṣṭaśaucā dvijaśreṣṭha tadasmākaṃ tu bhojanam || 37 || aprakṣālitapādastu yo bhuṃkte dakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || yo veṣṭitaśirā bhuṃkte pretā bhuṃjanti nityaśaḥ || 38 || śrāddhaṃ saṃpaśyate śvā cennārī caiva rajasvalā || antyajaḥ śūkaraścānnaṃ tadasmākaṃ tu bhojanam || 39 || tyaktvā kramāgataṃ vipraṃ pūjitaṃ prapitāmahaiḥ || yo dānaṃ dadate'nyasmai tasmai cā'tuṣṭacetasā || 7.1.223.40 || tasya dānasya yatpuṇyaṃ tadasmākaṃ prajāyate || yasmingṛhe sadocchiṣṭaṃ sadā ca kalaho bhavet || vaiśvadevavihīne tu tatra bhuṃjāmahe vayam || 41 || || gautama uvāca || || yuṣmākaṃ kīdṛśe gehe praveśo na ca vidyate || satyaṃ vadata mā'satyaṃ satyaṃ sādhuṣu saṃgatam || 42 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || vaiśvadevodbhavā yatra dhūmavartiḥ pradṛśyate || tasmingehe na cāsmākaṃ praveśo vidyate dvija || 43 || yasmingṛhe prabhāte tu kriyate copalepanam || vidyate veda nirghoṣastatrāsmākaṃ na kiṃcana || 44 || || gautama uvāca || || kena karmavipākena pretatvaṃ vrajate naraḥ || etanme vistareṇaiva yathāvadvaktu marhatha || 45 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || mṛṣā'pahāriṇo ye ca ye cocchiṣṭā vrajanti ca || gobrāhmaṇahatāścaiva pretatvaṃ te vrajanti hi || 46 || paiśunyaniratā ye ca kūṭasākṣyaratā narāḥ || nyāyapakṣe na vartaṃte mṛtāḥ pretā bhavaṃti te || 47 || śleṣmamūtrapurīṣāṇi ye kṣipanti sarovare || pretatvaṃ te samāsādya vicaraṃti ca mānavāḥ ||48|| dīyamānaṃ tu viprāṇāṃ goṣu viprātureṣu ca || mā dehīti prajalpantaste ca pretā bhavaṃti ca ||49|| śūdrānnenodarasthena yadi vipro mriyeta vai || pretatvaṃ yātyasau nūnaṃ yadyapi syātṣaḍaṃgavit || 7.1.223.50 || yastrīnhale balīvardānvāhayenmadasaṃyutaḥ || amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 51 || nāstiko niṃdakaḥ kṣudro nityanaimittyavarjitaḥ || brāhmaṇāndveṣṭi yo nūnaṃ sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 52 || viśvāsaghātako yastu brahmahā strīvadhe rataḥ || goghno gurughraḥ pitṛhā sa preto jāyate naraḥ||53|| yasya naiva pradattāni ekoddiṣṭāni ṣoḍaśa || mṛtasya na vṛṣotsargaḥ sa preto jāyate naraḥ || 54 || etaddhi sarvamākhyātaṃ yatpṛṣṭāḥ sma dvijottama || bhūyo brūhi dvijaśreṣṭha yaścāsti tava saṃśayaḥ || 55 || || gautama uvāca || || yena karmavipākenana preto jāyate naraḥ || tanme vadata niḥśeṣaṃ kautukaṃ me'tra vidyate || 56 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || tīrthayātrā rato yastu devārcanaparāyaṇaḥ || brāhmaṇeṣu sadā bhakto na preto jāyate naraḥ || 57 || nityaṃ śṛṇoti śāstrāṇi nityaṃ sevati paṃḍitān|| vṛddhāṃstu pṛcchate nityaṃ na sa preto vijāyate || 58 || etasmātkāraṇātprāptā vayaṃ sarve sudūrataḥ || śaknumo praveṣṭuṃ ca puṇye'sminkṣetra uttame || 59 || nirviṇṇāḥ pretarūpeṇa tasmāttvaṃ dvijasattama || gatirbhava mahābhāga sarveṣāṃ naḥ prayatnataḥ || 7.1.223.60 || || gautama uvāca || || kathaṃ vo jāyate mokṣo vadadhvaṃ kṛtsnaśo mama || kṛpayāviṣṭacitto'haṃ yatiṣye nātra saṃśayaḥ ||61|| || pretā ūcuḥ || || prabhūtakālamasmākaṃ pretatve tiṣṭhatāṃ vibho || na tvabhyeti pumānkaścidasmākaṃ yo gatirbhavet || 62 || tasmāttvaṃ dehi naḥ śrāddhaṃ gatvā kṣetraṃ tu vaiṣṇavam|| nāmagotrāṇi cādāya mokṣaṃ yāsyāmahe tataḥ || 63 || || || īśvara uvāca || || tato'sau brāhmaṇo gatvā dayāviṣṭo harergṛham || śrāddhaṃ ca pradadau teṣāmekaikasya pṛthakpṛthak || 64 || yasyayasya yadā śrāddhaṃ karoti dvijasattamaḥ || sa rātrau svapna etyainaṃ darśane vākyamabravīt || 65 || prasādāttava viprendra mukto'haṃ pretayonitaḥ || svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi vimānaṃ me hyupasthitam || 66 || evaṃ saṃtāritāstena catvāraste dvijottamāḥ || 67 || athāsau brāhmaṇaśreṣṭhaḥ saṃprāpte pañcame dine || pradadau vidhipūrvaṃ tu śrāddhaṃ paryuṣitasya ca || 68 || athāpaśyata svapnānte prāptaṃ paryuṣitaṃ naram || dīnavākyaṃ parikliṣṭaṃ niḥśvasantaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || 69|| || || paryuṣita uvāca || || na me jātā gatirvipra maṃdabhāgyasya pāpinaḥ || mayā hṛtaṃ taḍāgārthaṃ yadvittaṃ praguṇīkṛtam || 7.1.223.70 || || gautama uvāca || || kathaṃ te jāyate mokṣo vada śīghramaśeṣataḥ || kariṣye nātra saṃdeho yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 71 || || paryuṣita uvāca || ||| ayane cottare prāpte gatvā tīrthaṃ haripriyam || śrāddhaṃ tvaṃ dehi me nūnaṃ tato gatirbhaviṣyati || 72 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktaḥ sa viprendrastena pretena vai muniḥ || ayane cottare prāpte gatvā tīrthaṃ haripriyam || pradadau vidhivacchrāddhaṃ tataḥ paryuṣitāya ca || 73 || tataḥ paryuṣito rātrau svapnānte vākyamabravīt || prasannavadano bhūtvā divyamālyavapurdharaḥ || 74 || || paryuṣita uvāca || || mukto'haṃ tvatprasādena pretabhāvāddvijottama || svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmi vimānaṃ me hyupasthitam || 75 || devatvaṃ ca mayā prāptaṃ samartho'haṃ dvijottama || varaṃ dadāmi te vipra gṛhāṇa tvaṃ varaṃ śubham || 76 || brahmaghne ca surāpe ca caure bhagnavrate tathā || niṣkṛtirvihitā sadbhiḥ kṛtaghne nāsti niṣkṛtiḥ || 77 || || gautama uvāca || || yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ samartho'si varaprada || yatra sthāne mayā dṛṣṭāḥ pretā yūyaṃ suduḥkhitāḥ || tatrāhaṃ cāśramaṃ kṛtvā kariṣye cottamaṃ tapaḥ || 78 || nirgatāsmi gṛhaṃ bhūyo snātvā tīrthamidaṃ mahat || tatra yo bhānavo bhaktyā pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || 79 || vidhivaddāsyati śrāddhaṃ snātvā saṃtarpya devatāḥ || yuṣmatprasādatastasya hyanvaye'pi kadācana || mā bhūyātpretabhāvo hi api pāpānvitasya bhoḥ || 7.1.223.80 || || paryuṣita uvāca || || gaccha tvaṃ cāśramaṃ tatra kuru brāhmaṇasattama || gamiṣyasi parāṃ siddhiṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi || 81 || tatra ye mānavā bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ dāsyaṃti sattamāḥ || pitṝṇāṃ te vimānasthā yāsyaṃti tridivālayam || 82 || na teṣāṃ vaṃśajaḥ kaścitpretatvaṃ ca gamiṣyati || prāhuḥ saptapadīṃ maitrīṃ paṃḍitāḥ sthirabuddhayaḥ || 83 || mitratāṃ tu puraskṛtya kiṃ tadvakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || tavāśramapadaṃ puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati mahītale || 84 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ sarvaduḥkhavi nāśanam || mannāmnā khyātimāyātu pretatīrthamiti prabho || 85 || || īśvara uvāca || || taṃ tatheti pratijñāya gatastatra dvijottamaḥ || yathā vedoktamārgeṃṇa sarvaṃ kṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ || 86 || so'pi svargamanuprāpto hṛṣṭaḥ paryuṣitaḥ priye || etatsarvaṃ purāvṛttaṃ sthāne'smingātramocane || 87 || yaḥ śṛṇoti naraḥ samyaksarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyate || śayanotthāpane yoge yaḥ paśyetpuruṣottamam || gātrotsarge tu gatvā'sau yajñāyutaphalaṃ labhet || 88 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puruṣottamatīrthapretatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 223 || || cha ||
<7.1.224>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgamiṃdrapratiṣṭhitam || pāpamocananāmāḍhyaṃ dakṣiṇe puruṣottamāt|| 1 || vṛtraṃ hatvā purā śakro brahmahatyāsamanvitaḥ || abravītsa ṛṣīndivyānkathameṣā gamiṣyati || 2 || brahmahatyā hi duṣprekṣyā vivarṇajananī mama || durgaṃdhacāriṇī caiva sarvatejovināśinī || 3 || athocustaṃ suragaṇā nāradādyā maharṣayaḥ || prabhāsaṃ gaccha deveśa kṣetraṃ pāpaharaṃ hi tat || 4 || tatrārādhya mahādevaṃ mokṣyase brahmahatyayā || sa tatheti pratijñāya gatastatra varānane || 5 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ || tasya pūjārato nityaṃ dhūpagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ || 6 || tato'sya gātradaurgaṃdhyaṃ nāśamāśvabhyagacchata || vivarṇatvaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ vapuścābhūttathottamam|| 7 || atha hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || tatrāgatya naro bhaktyā yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati || 8 || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ nāśaṃ tasya prayāsyati || evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ prahṛṣṭastridivaṃ yayau || 9 || brahmahatyāvinirmuktaḥ pūjyamāno divaukasaiḥ || godānaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage || brahmahatyāpanodārthaṃ tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret || 7.1.224.10 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya indreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 224 ||
<7.1.225>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatogacchenmahādevi devaṃ cā'narakeśvaram|| tasmāduttaradigbhāge sarvapātakanāśanam || tanmāhātmyaṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanāḥ priye || 1|| mathurānāma vikhyātā nagarī dharaṇītale|| tatra vipro'bhavatpūrvaṃ devaśarmeti viśrutaḥ || agastyagotro vidvānvai sa tu dāridryapīḍitaḥ || 2 || athāparo'bhavattatra tādṛgrūpavayo'nvitaḥ || tannāma gotro deveśi brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ || 3 || atha prāha yamo dūtaṃ raudramūrdhaśiroruham || gaccha bho mathurāṃ śīghraṃ devaśarmāṇamānaya || 4 || athāgatya tato dūto gṛhītvā tatra vai gataḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvātha yamo natvā prāha dūtaṃ krudhānvitaḥ || 5 || nāyamānetumādiṣṭo devaśarmāṃ mayā tava || anyosti devaśarmā yasta mānaya gatāyuṣam || enaṃ vipraṃ ca dīrghāyuṃ naya tatrāvilaṃbitam || 6 || || īśvara uvāca || || athābravīdbrāhmaṇo vai nāhaṃ yāsye gṛhaṃ vibho || dāridryeṇātinirviṇṇo yāvajjīvaṃ sureśvara || ihaiva kṣapayiṣyāmi śeṣamāyustavāṃtike || 7 || || yama uvāca || || akāle nātra cāyāti kaścidbrāhmaṇasattama || muhūrtamapi no jīvetpūrṇakālena vai bhuvi || 8 || ata eva hi me nāma dharmarājeti viśrutam || 9 || na me suhṛnna me dveṣyaḥ kaścidasti dharātale || viddhaḥ śaraśatenāpi nā'kāle mriyate yataḥ || 7.1.225.10 || kuśāgreṇāpi viddhaḥ sankāle pūrṇe na jīvati || tasmādgaccha dvijaśreṣṭha yāvadgātraṃ na dahyate || 11 || athābravīdbrāhmaṇo'sau yadi preṣayase prabho || praśnamekaṃ mayā pṛṣṭo yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 12 || na vṛthā jāyate deva sādhūnāṃ darśanaṃ kvacit || yuṣmākaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa tasmādetadbravīmyaham || 13 || ete ye narakā raudrā dṛśyante ca sudāruṇāḥ || karmaṇā kena kaṃ gacchenmānavo narakaṃ yama || 14 || kati saṃkhyāḥ syurete ca narakāḥ kiṃpramāṇataḥ || etatsarvaṃ suraśreṣṭha yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 15 || || yama uvāca || || śṛṇu deva pravakṣyāmi yāvanto narakāḥ sthitāḥ || karmaṇā yena gaccheta mānavo dvijasattama || ekaviṃśatsamākhyātā narakā mama mandire || 16 || yānetānprekṣase vipra yaṃtra madhye vyavasthitān || pīḍyamānānkiṃkarairme kṛtaghnānpā pasaṃyutān || 17 || lohāsyavāyasā yeṣāṃ netroddhāraṃ prakurvate || etairnirīkṣitānyeva kalatrāṇi durātmabhiḥ || 18 || pareṣāṃ dvijaśārdūla sarāgaiḥ pāpi bhiḥ sadā || kumbhīpākagatānetānatha paśyasi pāpinaḥ || 19 || kūṭasākṣyaratā hyete kaṭuvāṅniratāstathā || ete lohamayāstambhānsaṃtaptānpāvakapra bhān || 7.1.225.20 || āliṃgaṃti durātmānaḥ paradāraratāstu ye || ete vaitaraṇīmadhye pūyaśoṇitasaṃkule || 21 || ye tiṣṭhaṃti dvijaśreṣṭha sarve viśvāsaghātakāḥ || asipatravane ghore bhidyante ye tu khaṇḍaśaḥ || te naṣṭāḥ svāminaṃ tyaktvā saṃgrāme samupasthite || 22 || aṃgārarāśīnvai dīptānye gāhante narādhamāḥ || svāmidroharatā hyete tathā hetupravādakāḥ || 23 || lohaśaṃkubhirākīrṇamākramanti narādhamāḥ || krandamānā dvijaśreṣṭha upānaddānavarjitāḥ || 24 || adhomukhā nibaddhā ye vṛkṣāgre pāvakopari || brahmahatyānvitāḥ sarva ete caiva narādhamāḥ || 25 || maśakairmatkuṇaiḥ kākairye bhakṣyaṃte vihaṃgamaiḥ || vratabhaṃgaratā hyete vratinā caiva hiṃsakāḥ || 26 || kuṭhārakaṇṭhitā hyete bhūyaḥ saṃti tathāvidhāḥ || gohantāro durātmāno devabrāhmaṇāniṃdakā || 27 || ye bhakṣyaṃte śṛgālaiśca vṛkairlohamayairmukhaiḥ || parasvānāṃ ca hartāraḥ parastrīṇāṃ ca hartṛkāḥ || ātmamāṃsāni ye pāpā bhakṣayaṃti bubhukṣitāḥ || || 28 || na dattamannametaistu kadācidvai dvijottama || rudhiraṃ ye pibaṃtyete vasāpūyapariplutam || brāhmaṇānāṃ vināśāya gavāmete sadā sthitāḥ || || 29 || kūṭaśālmalibaddhāśca tīkṣṇakaṇṭakapīḍitāḥ || chidrānveṣaṇasaṃyuktāḥ pareṣāṃ nityasaṃsthitāḥ || 7.1.225.30 || krakacena tu chidyante ya ime dvijasattama || abhakṣyaniratā hyete svadharmasya vidūṣakāḥ || 31 || kanyāvikrayakarttāraḥ kanyānāṃ jīvabhaṃjakāḥ || purīṣamadhyagā hyete pacyaṃte mama kiṃkaraiḥ || 32 || saṃdeśairdāruṇairjihvā yeṣāmutpāṭyate muhuḥ || vāglopaniratā hyete mṛṣāvādaparāyaṇāḥ || 33 || ye śītena prabādhyaṃte vepa mānā muhurmuhuḥ || devasvānāṃ ca hartāro brāhmaṇānāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 34 || teṣāṃ śirasi nikṣipto bhūribhāro dvijottama || ato'mī brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha pūtkā rayanti bhairavam || 35 || || yama uvāca || || evametatsamākhyātaṃ tava sarvaṃ dvijottama || narakāṇāṃ svarūpaṃ tu karmaṇāṃ vai yathākramam || 36 || gaccha śīghraṃ mahābhāga yāvatkāyo na dahyate || 37 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || kathaya tvaṃ suraśreṣṭha mama sarvaṃ samāhitaḥ || na gacchetkarmaṇā yena narakaṃ mānavaḥ kvacit || 38 || satāṃ saptapadaṃ maitramityāhurbuddhikovidāḥ || mitratāṃ ca puraskṛtya samāsādvaktumarhasi || 39 || || yama uvāca || || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādyā narakeśvaramuttamam || yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā narakaṃ sa na paśyati || 7.1.225.40 || sthāpitaṃ yanmayā liṃgaṃ śivabhaktyā yutena ca || etadguhyaṃ mayā proktaṃ tava prītyai dvijottama || 41 || gopanīyaṃ prayatnena mama vākyādasaṃśayam || evamuktastadā vipraḥ svayamevāvaniṃ yayau || 42 || labdhvā kalevaraṃ so'tha vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || tatsmṛtvā vacanaṃ sarvaṃ dharmarājasya dhīmataḥ || 43 || gatvā tatra sa nityaṃ vai pūjayāmāsa taṃ prabhum || yāvajjīvaṃ varārohe tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ gataḥ || 44 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhaktyā tamavalokayan || api pātakayukto'pi na yāti narake naraḥ || 45 || āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ || yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 46 || kṛṣṇājinaṃ tatra deyaṃ brāhmaṇe vedapārage || yāvattilānāṃ saṃkhyānaṃ tāvatsvarge mahīyate || 47 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye 'narakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 225 || || cha ||
<7.1.226>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva pūrvabhāge tu nairṛte pāpamocanāt || megheśvareti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || anāvṛṣṭibhaye jāte śāṃtiṃ tatraiva kārayet || vāruṇīṃ vipramukhyaistu bhāvayedudakairmahīm || 2 || meghaiḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ yatra nityaṃ prapūjyate || anāvṛṣṭibhayaṃ kiṃcinna ca tatra prajāyate || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye megheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 226 || ||
<7.1.227>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi balabhadrapratiṣṭhitam || liṃgaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ gātrotsargāttaduttare || 1 || mahāliṃgaṃ mahādevi mahāsiddhi phalapradam || balabhadreṇa vidhinā sthāpitaṃ pāpaśuddhaye || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāt || tṛtīyārevatīyoge sa yogeśapadaṃ labhet || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balabhadreśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 227 || || cha ||
<7.1.228>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi mātṛsthānamanuttamam || bhairaveśeti vikhyātaṃ sarvabhayavināśanam || 1 || caturdaśyāṃ vidhānena kṛṣṇapakṣe yatātmavān || pūjayedgandhapuṣpaiśca balidānaistathottamaiḥ || 2 || taṃ putramiva yoginyo rakṣaṃti bhuvi mātaraḥ || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye bhairaveśvaramātṛgaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 228 || || cha ||
<7.1.229>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm || anarakeśato devi aiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitām || 1 || svayaṃbhūtāṃ dharāmadhyādānītāṃ viṣṇunā purā || yādavānāṃ tu muktyarthaṃ sarvapāpopaśāntaye || 2 || yastatra kurute snānaṃ kathaṃcitpuṇyasaṃcayāt || śrāddhaṃ caiva vidhānena na sa śocetkṛtākṛte || 3 || brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyaphalamāpnuyāt || tatpuṇyaṃ prāpnuyāddevi kārtikyāṃ jāhnavījale || 4 || kalau yuge tu saṃprāpte durllabhaṃ tatra darśanam|| kiṃ punaḥ snānadānaṃ tu prabhāse jāhnavījale || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 229 || || cha ||
<7.1.230>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ gaṇapatipriyam || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ samyaṅmayā tatra niyojitaḥ || 1 || gaṅgāyā dakṣiṇe devi kṣetrarakṣaṇatatparaḥ || māghe kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || 2 || divyamodakanaivedyaiḥ puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ kramāt || na tasya jāyate vighnaṃ yāvatkṣetre vasatyasau || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṇapatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 230 || ||
<7.1.231>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yatra jāṃbavatī nadī || purā jāṃbavatīnāma viṣṇoryā mahiṣīpriyā || apṛcchadarjunaṃ sādhvī vada vārtāṃ kurū dvaha || 1 || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā arjuno niśvasanmuhuḥ || vāṣpagadgadayā vācā idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 2 || parityaktā vayaṃ bhadre yādavaiḥ sumahātmabhiḥ ||9 baladevasya vīrasya sātyakeśca mahātmanaḥ || 3 || anyeṣāṃ yaduvīrāṇāṃ pāpakarmātinirghṛṇaḥ || jijīviṣuriha prāpto vāsudevanirākṛtaḥ || 4 || sā śrutvā bhartṛnidhanamarjunācca mahāsatī || gaṃgātīre samutpādya pāvakaṃ pāvakaprabhā || samutsṛjya mahākāyaṃ nadībhūtvā viniryayau || 5 || sā gṛhītvā satī bharturbhasma sarvaṃ citestathā || praviṣṭā sāgaraṃ devi tadā jāṃbavatī śubhā ||6|| yā nārī tatra deveśi bhaktyā snānaṃ samācaret || tadanvayepi kācitstrī na vaidhavyamavāpnuyāt || 7 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret || naro vā yadi vā nārī prāpnoti paramāṃ gatim || 8 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jāṃbavatīnadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaradvi śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 231 || || cha ||
<7.1.232>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kūpaṃ trailokyapūjitam || paścime tasya tīrthasya pāṃḍavānāṃ mahātmanām || 1 || yadā'raṇyamanuprāptāḥ pāṃḍavāḥ pṛthivītale || bhramamāṇā mahādevi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ || 2 || tataste nyavasaṃstatra kiṃcitkālaṃ samāhitāḥ || gatvā kṣetraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ tataḥ kṛṣṇā'bravīdidam || 3 || brāhmaṇānāṃ sahasrāṇi bhuṃjate bhavatāṃ gṛhe || dūre jalāśrayaścaiva na tāvaṃtaśca kiṃkarāḥ || 4 || tasmājjalāśrayaḥ kāryaṃ āśramasya samīpataḥ || yatra snānaṃ kariṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ saṃprasādataḥ || 5 || tatastu pāṃḍavāḥ sarve sahitāste varānane || akhanaṃstatra te kūpaṃ draupadīvākyapreritāḥ || 6 || athājagāma tatraiva bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ || śrutvā samāgatānpārthāndvārāvatyāḥ sabāṃdhavaḥ || 7 || pradyumnena ca sāṃbena gadena niṣadhena ca || yuyudhānena rāmeṇa cārudeṣṇena dhīmatā || 8 || anyaiḥ parivṛtaḥ śūrairyādavairyuddha durmadaiḥ || te sametya yathānyāyaṃ samastā yadupuṃgavāḥ || 9 || tataḥ kathāvasāne ca kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || vāsudevaḥ pāṃḍusutamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || || 7.1.232.10 || yudhiṣṭhira mahābāho kiṃ te kāmakaromyaham || rājyaṃ dhānyaṃ dhanaṃ cāpi athavā ripunāśanam || 11 || || yudhiṣṭhira uvāca || || śaktastvaṃ yādavaśreṣṭha sarvakarmasvasaṃśayaḥ || pratijñātaṃ tvayā pūrvaṃ varṣairdvādaśabhiḥ priyam|| 12 || tannāsti triṣu lokeṣu yanna siddhyati bhūtale || tvayi tuṣṭe jagannātha sarvadevanamaskṛte || 13 || avaśyaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si mama sarvajagatpate || atra sāṃnidhyamāgaccha kūpe nityaṃ janārdana || 14 || atrāgatya naro yastu bhaktyā snānaṃ samācaret || sa yātu vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ prasādāttava keśava || 15 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā tadā'mantrya yudhiṣṭhiram || prayayau dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 16 || tasmiñchrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet || prasādāddevadevasya viṣṇoramitatejasaḥ || 17 || tadardhaṃ tarpaṇenaiva snānātpādamavāpnuyāt || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra śrāddhaṃ samācaret || 18 || jyeṣṭhasya paurṇamāsyāṃ yaḥ snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati || sāvitrīṃ caiva saṃpūjya sa yāsyati paramaṃ padam || 19 || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ ||7.1.232.20|| iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāṃḍavakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 232 || || cha ||
<7.1.233>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva pūjayeddevi paṃca liṃgāni bhāvitaḥ || pratiṣṭhitāni deveśi pāṃḍavaiśca mahātmabhiḥ || 1 || yastānpūjayate bhaktyā sa muktaḥ pātakairbhavet || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye pāṃḍaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 233 ||
<7.1.234>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || daśāśvamedhikaṃnāma mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || vājimedhaḥ purā ceṣṭaṃ daśabhistatra bhāmini || bharatena samāgatya matvā kṣetramanuttamam || 2 || tatra tṛptaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ somanāthena bhāmini || kṛpaṇāḥ khānapānaiśca dakṣiṇābhirdvijātayaḥ || 3 || athocustridaśāḥ sarve suprītā bharataṃ nṛpam || tuṣṭāstava mahābāho yajñaiḥ saṃtarpitā vayam || varaṃ vṛṇīṣva rājeṃdra yatte manasi varttate || 4. || || rājovāca || || atrāgatya naro bhaktyā yaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ sa prāpnotu phalaṃ śubham || 5 || || devā ūcuḥ || || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ śraddhayā phalamāpsyati || daśāśvamedhikaṃnāma tīrthametanmahītale || khyātiṃ yāsyati rājeṃdra nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 6 || || īśvara uvāca || || tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale || daśāśvamedhikamiti sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 7 || aiṃdravāruṇamāśritya gomukhādā''śvamedhikam || atrāṃtare mahādevi śivakṣetraṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 8 || sarvapāpaharaṃ divyaṃ svargasopānasaṃnibham || sapādakoṭitīrthānāṃ sthānaṃ tatparikīrtitama || 9 || prāṇatyāge kṛte tatra śivaloke ca modate || tiryagyonigatāḥ pāpā kīṭapakṣimṛgādayaḥ || 7.1.234.10 || te'pi yāṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || tilodakapradānena mātṛkāḥ paitṛkāstathā || 11 || pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || tatreṣṭā brahmaṇā pūrvamasaṃkhyātā makhottamāḥ || 12 || śakraśca devarājatve tatreṣṭvā samavāptavān || kārttavīryeṇa tatraiva kṛtaṃ yajñaśataṃ purā || 13 || evaṃ tatpravaraṃ sthānaṃ kṣetragarbhāṃtikaṃ priye || mṛtānāṃ tatra jaṃtūnāmapunarbhavadāyakam || 14 || vṛṣotsargaṃ tu yastatra kuryādvai bhāvitātmavān || yāvaṃti vṛṣaromāṇi tāvatsvarge mahīyate || 15 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye daśāśvamedhamāhatmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 234 || || cha ||
<7.1.235>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyelliṃgatrayamanuttamam || śatamedhaṃ sahasramedhaṃ koṭimedhamiti kramāt || 1 || dakṣiṇe śatamedhaṃ tu śatayajñaphalapradam || kārtavīryyeṇa tatraiva kṛtaṃ yajñaśataṃ purā || 2 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || madhyabhāge'tra yalliṃgaṃ koṭimedheti viśrutam || 3 || tatreṣṭā brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ koṭi saṃkhyā makhottamāḥ || saṃsthāpya tu mahādevaṃ śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkarama || 4 || tasya uttarabhāgasthaṃ sahasrakratusaṃjñakam || śakraśca devarājo'pi sahasraṃ yaṣṭavānkratūn || 5 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ devānāmādidaivatam || gaṃdhapuṣpādividhinā paṃcāmṛtarasodakaiḥ || 6 || sa prāpnuyātphalaṃ devi liṃganāmodbhavaṃ kramāt || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ ||7|| daśalakṣāṇi tīrthānāṃ tatra tiṣṭhaṃti bhāmini || liṃgatrayaṃ tathā madhye sarvapātakanāśanam || || 8 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye daśāśvamedhamāhātmye śatamedhādi liṃgatrayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 235 || || cha || ||
<7.1.236>
tato gacchenmahādevi durvāsādityamuttamam || yatra durvāsasā taptaṃ tapo varṣasahasrakam || nirāhāro jitāhāraḥ sūryārādhanatatparaḥ || 1 || evaṃ kālena mahatā divyatejā janādhipaḥ || pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ gatvā prāha sūryo mahāmunim || 2 || || sūrya uvāca || || mā brahmansāhasaṃ kārṣīrvaraṃ varaya suvrata || aprāpyamapi dāsyāmi yatte manasi vartate || 3 || || || durvāsā uvāca || || prasanno yadi me deva varārho yadi cā'pyaham || atra sthāne tvayā stheyaṃ yāvattiṣṭhati medinī || 4 || durvāsādityanā mā'tra loke khyātiṃ ca gacchatu || mayā pratiṣṭhitā yā tu pratimā tava sundarī ||5 || tasyāṃ sāṃnidhyamevāstu tava deva jagatpate || sāṃnidhyaṃ kuruta cātra yamunā duhitā tava || tvatsutastu mahātejā dharmarājo mahābalaḥ || 6 || || sūrya uvāca || || etatsarvaṃ muniśreṣṭha tvayoktaṃ saṃbhaviṣyati || tīrthānāṃ koṭiranyā ca gaṃgādīnāṃ mahāmune || 7 || āgamiṣyati te sthānaṃ niścitaṃ vacanānmama || atra sthāne mayā brahmansthātavyaṃ saha daivataiḥ || 8|| ādityānāṃ prabhāvaistu brahmāṃḍodaravāsinām|| teṣāṃ māhātmyasaṃyuktaḥ sthāsye cātra mahāmune || 9 || savitṝṇāṃ sahasreṇa dṛṣṭenaiva tu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ durvāsādityadarśanāt||7.1.236.10|| lapsyaṃte prāṇinaḥ sarve yajñakoṭiphalaṃ tathā || evamuktvā tadā sūryaḥ sasmāra tanayāṃ nijām || tathā ca dharmerājānaṃ sarvaprāṇiniyāmakam || 11 || smṛtamātrā tatra bhittvā pātālatalamudyayau || sā nadīrūpiṇī devī tīrthakoṭisamanvitā||12|| yamaśca tatra bhagavānkāladaṃḍadharastadā || ūcatuḥ praṇayopetau sūryaṃ bhuvanasākṣiṇam || 13 || || yama uvāca || || ājñāpayatu māṃ devo yamunāṃ ca jagatprabhuḥ || kāryaṃ yadbhāvino'rthasya tatkariṣye na saṃśayaḥ ||14|| || sūta uvāca || || atra kṣetre svarūpeṇa sthātavyaṃ vacanānmama || pāpināṃ prāṇināṃ cātra rakṣā kāryā prayatnataḥ || 15 || sūryabhaktāḥ sadā rakṣyā brāhmaṇā gṛhamedhinaḥ || tvaṃ cāpi yamune cātra koṭitīrthena saṃyutā || 16 || vasa tvaṃ bhava suprītā sthāne durvāsasodbhave || ityevamuktvā deveśastatra durvāsasoṃ'tike ||17|| paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāmaṃtarddhānamagātprabhuḥ || durvāsāstu tadā hṛṣṭo yāvatpaśyati svāśramam||18|| tāvatpātālamārgeṇa yamunā prādurābhavat || yamaśca bhagavāṃstatra dṛṣṭaḥ kṣetraparūpadhṛk ||19|| || īśvara uvāca || || itthaṃ samabhavattatra yamunodbhedamuttamam|| kuṇḍamādityato yāmye duṃdubhistatra pūrvataḥ || 7.1.236.20 || kṣetrapālo mahādevi yato duṃdubhiniḥsvanaḥ || tatra snātvā mahākuṇḍe yaḥ saṃtarpayate pitṝn|| 21 || daśa varṣāṇi pañcaiva tṛptiṃ yāṃti pitāmahaḥ || piṃḍadānena dattena pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭimāvahet || narake tu sthitānāṃ ca muktirbhūyānna saṃśayaḥ ||22|| māghe māsi site pakṣe saptamyāṃ saṃyatātmavān || durvāsārkaṃ ca saṃpūjya mucyate brahmahatyayā || 23 || snātvā tu yamunā kuṇḍe mādhave māsi mānavaḥ || pūjayedbhaktibhāvena raviṃ gaganabhūṣaṇam || 24 || paṭhetsahasraṃ nāmnā tu durvāsādityasaṃnidhau || ṣaṇmāsānmucyate jaṃturyadyapi brahmahā naraḥ || 25|| sarvamaṃgalamāṃgalyaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || durvāsādityanāmānaṃ sūryaṃ ko nu na pūjayet || 26 || na tadasti bhayaṃ kiṃcidyadanena na śāmyati || darśanenāpi sūryasya tatra durvāsasaḥ priye || 27 || saṃpadyaṃte tathā kāmāḥ sarva eva yathepsitāḥ || baṃdhyānāṃ putraphaladaṃ bhītānāṃ bhayanāśanam|| 28 || bhūtipradaṃ daridrāṇāṃ kuṣṭhināṃ paramauṣadham || bālānāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ graharakṣonivāraṇam || mahāpāpopaśamanaṃ durvāsādityadarśanam|| 29 || hemāśvastatra dātavyaḥ sūryamuddiśya bhāmini || brāhmaṇe vedasaṃyukte tena dattā mahī bhavet || 7.1.236.30 || yastatra pūjayeddevaṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca dundubhim || sa putrapaśumāndhīmāñchrīmānbhavati mānavaḥ || 31 || na bhayaṃ jāyate tasya trividhaṃ varavarṇini || ardhagavyūtimātraṃ tu tatra kṣetraṃ raveḥ smṛtam|| 32 || na tatra praviśejjantuḥ sūryabhaktivivarjitaḥ || ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sūryadaivatam || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye durvāsādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 236 || || cha ||
<7.1.237>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yādavasthalamuttamam || yādavā yatra naṣṭā vai ṣaṭpaṃcāśacca koṭayaḥ || 1 || yatra vajreśvaro devo vajreṇārādhitaḥ sadā || yatrābhūddivyadṛṣṭīnāmṛṣīṇāmāśramaṃ kulam || 2 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ vinaṣṭā bhagavannandhakā vṛṣṇibhiḥ saha || paśyato vāsudevasya bhojāścaiva mahārathāḥ || 3 || kena śaptāstu te vīrā naṣṭā vṛṣṇyandhakādayaḥ || bhojāścaiva mahādeva vistareṇa vadasva me || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || ṣaṭtriṃśe ca kalau varṣe saṃprāpte'ndhakavṛṣṇayaḥ || anyonyaṃ muśalaiste hi nijaghnuḥ kālanoditāḥ || 5 || viśvāmitraṃ ca kaṇvaṃ ca nāradaṃ ca yaśasvinam || sāraṇapramukhānbhojāndadṛśurdvārakāṃ gatān || 6 || te vai sāṃbaṃ samāninyurbhūṣayitvā striyaṃ yathā || abruvannupasaṃgamya devadaṃḍanipīḍitāḥ || 7 || iyaṃ strī putrakāmasya babhroramitatejasaḥ || ṛṣayaḥ sādhu jānīta kimiyaṃ janayiṣyati || 8 || ityuktāste tadā devi vipralaṃbhapradharṣitāḥ || pratyabruvaṃstānmunayastacchṛṇuṣva yathātatham || 9 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya muśalaṃ ghoramāyasam|| vāsudevasya dāyādaḥ sāṃbo'yaṃ janayiṣyati || 7.1.237.10 || yena yūyaṃ sudurvṛttā nṛśaṃsā jātamanyavaḥ || ucchettāraḥ kulaṃ sarvamṛte rāmājjanārddanāt || 11 || tyaktvā yāsyati vaḥ śrīmāṃtyaktvā bhūmiṃ halāyudhaḥ || jarā kṛṣṇaṃ mahābhāgaṃ śayānaṃ tu nivetsyati || 12 || ityabruvaṃstato devi pralabdhāste durātmabhiḥ || munayaḥ krodharaktākṣāḥ samīkṣyātha parasparam || 13 || tathoktā munayaste tu tataḥ keśavamabhyayuḥ || athāvadattadā vṛṣṇīñchrutvaivaṃ madhusūdanaḥ || 14 || abhijño matimāṃstasya bhavitavyaṃ tatheti tat || evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaḥ praviveśa punargṛhān || 15 || kṛtāṃtamanyathākarttuṃ naicchatsa jagataḥ prabhuḥ || śvobhūte satataḥ sāṃbo musalaṃ tadasūta vai ||16|| yena vṛṇṣyandhakakule puruṣā bhasmasātkṛtāḥ|| vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya kiṃkarapratimaṃ mahat || 17 || (kiṃkarayamakiṃkara) asūta śāpajaṃ ghoraṃ tacca rājñe nyavedayat || viṣaṇṇo'tha tato rājā sūkṣmaṃ cūrṇamakārayat || 18 || prākṣipatsāgare tatra puruṣo rājaśāsitaḥ || athovāca svanagare vacanādāhukasya hi || 19 || janārddanasya rāmasya babhroścaiva mahātmanaḥ || adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ vṛṣṇandhakagṛheṣviha || surāsavo na karttavyaḥ sarvairviṣayavāsibhiḥ || 7.1.237.2||| yaśca vo viditaṃ kuryādevaṃ kaścitkvacinnaraḥ || sa jīvañchūlamārohetsvayaṃ kṛtvā sabāṃdhavaḥ || 21 || tato rājabhayātsarve niyamaṃ tatra cakrire || narāḥ śāsanamājñāya rāmasyākliṣṭakarmaṇaḥ || 22 || evaṃ prayatamānānāṃ vṛṣṇīnāmandhakaiḥ saha || kālo gṛhāṇi sarvāṇi paricakrāma nityaśaḥ || 23 || karālo vikaṭo muṃḍaḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇapiṃgalaḥ || sammārjanī mahāketurjapāpuṣpāvataṃsakaḥ || 24 || kṛkalāsavāhanaśca rattikākarṇabhūṣaṇaḥ || gṛhāṇyavekṣya vṛṣṇīnāṃ nādṛśyata punaḥ kvacit || 25 || tasya cāsanmaheṣvāsāḥ śaraiḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || na cāśakyata veddhuṃ sa sarvabhūtāpyayaṃ sadā || 26 || utpedire mahāvātā dāruṇā hi dine dine || vṛṣṇyandhakavināśāya bahavo lomaharṣaṇāḥ || 27 || vivṛddhya mūṣikā rathyāvitunnamaṇikāstathā || keśāndadaṃśuḥ suptānāṃ nṛṇāṃ yuvatayo niśi || 28 || cīcīkūcītyavāśaṃta sārikā vṛṣṇiveśmasu || nopaśāmyati śabdaśca sa divārātrameva vā || 29 || anvakurvannulūkāśca vāyasānvṛṣṇiveśmasu || ajāḥ śivānāṃ ca rutamanvakurvata bhāmini || 7.1.237.30 || pāṃḍurāraktapādāśca vihagāḥ kālapreritāḥ || vṛṣṇyandhakagṛheṣvevaṃ kapotā vyacaraṃstadā || 31 || vyajāyaṃta kharā goṣu karabhāścāśvatarīṣu ca || śunīṣvapi biḍālāśca mūṣakā nakulīṣu ca || 32 || tāpatrayāṃta pāpāni kurvaṃto vṛṣṇayastathā || adviṣanbrāhmaṇāṃścāpi pitṝndevāṃstathaiva ca ||33|| gurūṃścāpyavamanyaṃte na tu rāmajanārdanau || bhāryāḥ patīnvyuccaraṃti patnīśca puruṣāstathā || 34 || vibhāvasuḥ prajvalito vāmaṃ viparivarttate || nīlalohitamāṃjiṣṭhā visṛjaṃścārciṣaḥ pṛthak || 35 || udayāstamane nityaṃ paryastaḥ syāddivākaraḥ || vyadṛśyata sakṛtpuṃbhiḥ kabandhaiḥ parivāritaḥ || 36 || mahānaseṣu siddhāṃte saṃskṛte'nne tu bhāmini || uttāryamāṇe kṛmayo dṛśyaṃte ca varānane || 37 || puṇyāhe vācyamāne ca paṭhatsu ca mahātmasu || abhidhāvaṃti śrūyaṃte na cādṛśyata kaścana || 38 || parasparasya nakṣatraṃ hanyamānaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || grahairapaśyansarvaiste nātmanastu kathañcana || 39 || na hutaṃ pācayatyagnirvṛṣṇyaṃdhakapuraskṛtam || samaṃtātpratyavāśaṃta rāsabhā dāruṇasvanāḥ || 7.1.237.40 || evaṃ paśyanhṛṣīkeśaḥ saṃprāptānkālaparyayān || trayodaśīṃ hyamāvāsyāṃ tāṃ dṛṣṭvā prābravīdidam|| 41 || trayodaśī paṃcadaśī kṛteyaṃ rāhuṇā punaḥ || tadā ca bhārate yuddhe prāptā cādya kṣayāya naḥ || 42 || dhigdhigityevakālaṃ taṃ pariciṃtya janārdanaḥ || mene prāptaṃ sa ṣaṭtriṃśaṃ varṣaṃ keśiniṣūdanaḥ || putraśokābhisaṃtaptā gāṃdhārī yaduvāca ha || 43 || evaṃ paśyanhṛṣīkeśastadidaṃ samupasthitam|| idaṃ ca samanuprāptamabravīdyadyudhiṣṭhiraḥ || 44 || purā vyūḍheṣvanīkeṣu dṛṣṭvotpātānsudāruṇān|| puṇyagranthasya śravaṇācchāṃtihomādviśodhanāt ||45|| pūtatīrthābhiṣekāṃcca nānyacchreyo bhavediti || ityuktvā vāsudevastaccikīrṣansatyameva ca || ājñāpayāmāsa tadā tīrthayātrāmariṃdamaḥ || 46 || aghoṣayaṃta puruṣāstatra keśavaśāsanāt || tīrthayātrā prabhāse vai kāryeti varavarṇini || 47 || athāriṣṭāni vakṣyāmi purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati || kālī strī pāṃḍurairdaṃtaiḥ praviśya nagarīṃ niśi || 48 || striyaḥ svapneṣu muṣṇantī dvārakāṃ prati dhāvati || agnihotraniketaṃ ca sumedhyeṣu ca veśmasu || 49 || vṛṣṇyaṃdhakāṃśca khādaṃtī svapne dṛṣṭā bhayānakā || kurvaṃtī bhīṣaṇaṃ nādaṃ kurkuṭaśvānasaṃyutā || 7.1.237.50 || tathā sahasraśo raudrāścaturbāhava eva ca || strīṇāṃ garbheṣvajāyaṃta rākṣasā guhyakāstathā || || 51 || alaṃkārāśca cchatrāṇi dhvajāśca kavacāni ca || hriyamāṇāni dṛśyaṃte rakṣobhistu bhayānakaiḥ || 52|| yaccāgnidattaṃ kṛṣṇasya vajranābhamayasmayam || divamācakrame cakraṃ vṛṣṇīnāṃ paśyatāṃ tadā || 53 || yuktaṃ rathaṃ divyamādityavarṇaṃ bhayāvahaṃ paśyato dārukasya || te sāgarasyopariṣṭādvartamānānmanojavāṃścaturo vājimukhyān || 54 || tālaḥ suparṇaśca mahādhvajau tau supūjitau rāmajanārdanābhyām || uccairjaguḥ svapsaraso divāniśaṃ vācaṃ cocurgamyatāṃ tīrthayātrām || 55 || tato jigamiṣaṃtaste vṛṣṇyaṃdhakamahārathāḥ || sāṃtaḥpurāstīrthayātrāmīhaṃte sma nararṣabhāḥ ||56|| tato māṃsaparā hṛṣṭāḥ peyaṃ veśmasu vṛṣṇayaḥ || bahu nānāvidhaṃ cakrurmāṃsāni vividhāni ca || 57 || tathā sīdhuṣu baddheṣu niryayurnagarādbahiḥ || yānairaśvairgajaiścaiva śrīmaṃtastigmatejasaḥ || 58 || tataḥ prabhāse nyavasanyathoddeśaṃ yathāgṛham || prabhūtabhakṣyapeyāste sadārā yādavāstadā || 59 || nirviṣṭāṃstānniśamyātha samudrāṃte sa yogavit || jagāmāmaṃtrya tānvīrānuddhavorthaviśāradaḥ || 7.1.237.60 || prasthitaṃ taṃ mahātmānamabhivādya kṛtāṃjalim|| jānanvināśaṃ bhojānāṃ naicchadvārayituṃ hariḥ || 61 || tataḥ kālaparītāste vṛṣṇyaṃdhakamahārathāḥ || apaśyannuddhavaṃ yāṃtaṃ tejasā''dīpya rodasī || 62 || brāhmaṇārtheṣu yatklṛptamannaṃ teṣāṃ varānane || tadvāhanebhyaḥ pradaduḥ surāgaṃdharasānvitam||63|| tatastūryaśatākīrṇaṃ naṭanarttakasaṃkulam|| prāvarttata mahāpānaṃ prabhāse tigmatejasām|| 64|| kṛṣṇasya saṃnidhau rāmaḥ sahitaḥ kṛtavarmaṇā || apibadyuyudhānaśca gado babhrustathaiva ca ||65|| tataḥ pariṣado madhye yuyudhāno madotkaṭaḥ || abravītkṛtavarmāṇamavahasyāvamanya ca || 66 || kaḥ kṣatriyo manyamānaḥ suptānhanyānmṛtāniva || na tanmṛṣyata hārdikyastvayā tatsādhu yatkṛtam || 67 || ityukte yuyudhānena pūjayāmāsa tadvacaḥ || pradyumno rathināṃ śreṣṭho hārdikyamatha bhartsayan || 68 || tataḥ punarapi kruddhaḥ kṛtavarmā tamabravīt || nirviśanniva sāvajñaṃ tadā savyena pāṇinā || 69 || bhūriśravāśchinnabāhuryuddhe prāyogatastvayā || vyādheneva nṛśaṃsena kathaṃ vaireṇa ghātitaḥ || 7.1.237.70 || iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā keśavaḥ paravīrahā || tiryaksaroṣayā dṛṣṭyā vīkṣāṃcakre samaḥ pumān || 71 || maṇiṃ syamaṃtakaṃ caiva yaḥ sa satrājito'bhavat || sa kathaṃ smārayāmāsa sātyakirmadhusūdanam || 72 || tacchrutvā keśavasyāṃkamagamadrudatī satī || satyabhāmā prakṣubhitā kopayantī janārddanam || 73 || tata utthāya sa krodhātsātyakirvākyamabravīt || paṃcānāṃ draupadeyānāṃ dhṛṣṭadyumnaśikhaṃḍinaḥ || 74 || eṣa gacchāmi padavīṃ satye tava pathe sadā || sauptike nihatā ye ca suptāstena durātmanā || 75 || droṇaputrasahāyena pāpena kṛtavarmaṇā || samāptaṃ cāyurasyādya yaśaścāpi sumadhyame || 76 || itīdamuktvā khaṅgena keśavasya samīpataḥ || abhihatya śiraḥ kruddhaściccheda kṛtavarmaṇaḥ || 77 || tathānyānapi nighnaṃtaṃ yuyudhānaṃ samaṃtataḥ || anvadhāvaddhṛṣīkeśo vinivārayiṣustathā || 78 || ekībhūtāstatastasya kālaparyāyapreritāḥ || bhojāṃdhakā mahārājaṃ śaineyaṃ paryavārayan || 79 || tāndṛṣṭvā''patatastūrṇamabhikruddhāñjanārddanaḥ || na cukrodha mahātejā jānankālasya paryayam || 7.1.237.80 || te ca pānamadāviṣṭāścoditāścaiva manyunā || yuyudhānamathājaghnurucchiṣṭai rbhojanaistathā || 81 || hanyamāne tu śaineye kuddho rukmiṇinaṃdanaḥ || tadaṃtaramathādhāvanmokṣayiṣyañchineḥ sutam || 82 || sa bhojaiḥ saha saṃyuktaḥ sātyakiścāṃdhakaiḥ saha || bahutvāttu hatau vīrāvubhau kṛṣṇasya paśyataḥ || 83 || hataṃ dṛṣṭvā tu śaineyaṃ putraṃ ca yadunaṃdanaḥ || erakāṇāṃ tadā muṣṭiṃ kopājjagrāha keśavaḥ || 84 || tadabhūnmuśalaṃ ghoraṃ vajrakalpamayasmayam || jaghāna tena kṛṣṇopi ye tasya pramukhe sthitāḥ || 89 || tatoṃ'dhakāśca bhojāśca śinayo vṛṣṇayastadā || nyaghnannanyonyamākrandairmuśalaiḥ kālapreritāḥ || 86 || yaścaikāmerakāṃ kaścijjagrāha ruṣito naraḥ || vajrabhūtā ca sā devi hyadṛśyata tadā priye || 87 || tṛṇaṃ ca muśalībhūtamaṇvapi tatra dṛśyate || brahmadaṃḍakṛtaṃ sarvamiti tadviddhi bhāmini || 88 || āvidhyāvidhya deveśi praharaṃti sma sāyakān|| tadvajrabhūtaṃ muśalamapaśyaṃta tadā dṛḍham || 89 || avadhītpitaraṃ putraḥ pitā putraṃ ca bhāmini || mattāste paryaṭaṃti sma yodhamānāḥ parasparam || 7.1.237.90 || pataṃgā iva cāgnau tu nyapatanyadupuṃgavāḥ || nāsītpalāyane buddhirvadhyamānasya kasyacit || 91 || taṃ tu paśyanmahābāhurjānankālasyaparyayam || muśalaṃ samavaṣṭabhya tasthau sa madhusūdanaḥ || 92 || sāṃbaṃ ca nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā cārudeṣṇaṃ ca mādhavaḥ || pradyumnamaniruddhaṃ ca tataścukrodha bhāmini || 93 || yādavānkṣmāśayānāṃśca bhṛśaṃ kopasamanvitaḥ || sa niḥśeṣaṃ tadā cakre śārṅgacakragadādharaḥ || 94 || evaṃ tatra mahādevi abhavadyādava sthalam || gavyūtimātraṃ taddevi yādavānāṃ citāḥ smṛtāḥ || 95 || teṣāṃ kilāsthinicayaiḥ sthalarūpaṃ babhūva tat || bhasmapuṃjanibhākāraṃ tenābhūdyādava sthalam || 96 || divyaratnasamāyuktaṃ maṇimāṇikyapūritam || yādavānāṃ kirīṭaiśca divyagandhaiḥ supūritam|| 97 || teṣāṃ rakṣānimittaṃ hi gaṃgā gaṇapatistathā || yādavānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ jīvito vajra eva hi || 98 || vayasoṃte tataḥ so'pi prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || niṣicya svasutaṃ rājye nāmnā khyātaṃ mahadbalam || 99 || tenāpi sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ yādavendreṇa dhīmatā || vajreśvaramiti khyātaṃ tatsthitaṃ yādavasthale ||7.1.237.100|| tatraiva suciraṃ kālaṃ tapastaptaṃ supuṣkalam || nāradasyopadeśena prabhāse pāpanāśane || 101 || prāptavānparamāṃ siddhiṃ sa rājā yādavottamaḥ || tatraiva yo naraḥ samyaksnātvā jāṃbavatī jale || 102 || vajreśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya brāhmaṇāṃstatra bhojayet || yādavasthalasāmīpye gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 103 || ṣaṭkoṇaṃ tatra dātavyamaṃgulyā yādavasthale || yātrāphalamavāpnoti samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 104 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye yādavasthalotpattau vajreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 237 || || cha ||
<7.1.238>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyāṃ pāpanāśinīm || sarvakāmapradāṃ puṇyāṃ dāridryasyāṃtakāriṇīm || 1 || tatra snātvā vidhānena kṛtvā piṃḍodaka kriyām || prāpnuyādakṣayām̐llokānpitṝnuddhṛtya pāpataḥ ||2|| ekaṃ yo bhojayettatra brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam || tenāyutasahasraṃ hi bhojitaṃ syāddvijanmanām || || 3 || tatra hemarathā deyo brāhmaṇe vedapārage || vidhinā śivamuddiśya yātrāyutaphalaṃ labhet || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye hiraṇyānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 238 || || cha || ||
<7.1.239>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyāpārśvataḥ sthitam || pratyuktaṃ nāgarādityaṃ sarvavyādhivināśanam || 1 || purā satrājitā rājñā dvāravatyāṃ gatena tu || ārādhito bhāskaro'bhūdyādavena mahātmanā || 2 || mahāvratamupāsthāya nighnaputreṇa dhīmatā || tasya tuṣṭastadā bhānuḥ syamantakamaṇiṃ dadau ||3|| sa maṇiḥ savate nityaṃ bhārānaṣṭau dinedine || (savate sūte) suvarṇasya suśuddhasya bhaktyā vratatapoyutaḥ || 4 || bhūyo'pi bhānunā prokto varaṃ brūhi varānane || sa cāha devadeveśaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram || 5 || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva varadānaṃ karoṣi ca || atraiva cāśrame puṇye nityaṃ saṃnihito bhava || 6 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā sūryaḥ satrājitaṃ nṛpam || abhinaṃdya varaṃ tasya tatraivādarśanaṃ gataḥ || 7 || tenāpi nighnaputreṇa devadevasya bhāsvataḥ || sthāpitā pratimā śubhrā tatraiva varavarṇini || 8 || śaṃkhaduṃdubhinirghoṣairbrahmaghoṣaiścapuṣkalaiḥ || tatastunāgarānsarvānsamāhūya dvijottamān || abravītpraṇato bhūtvā dattvā vṛttimanuttamām ||9|| yuṣmatpādaprasādena sūryasyānugraheṇa vai || sādhayitvā tapaścograṃ sthāpitā pratimā mayā ||7.1.239.10|| iṃdralokādihānītā jitvā śakraṃ surāriṇā|| daśānanasya putreṇa laṃkāyāṃ sthāpitā purā ||11|| taṃ nihatya tu rāmeṇa lakṣmaṇānugatena vai|| ayodhyāyāṃ samānītā saumitrijayalakṣikā||12|| mitrāvaruṇaputrāya vasiṣṭhāya samarpitā|| tenāpi mama tuṣṭena dvārakāyāṃ niveditā||13|| mayāpi sthāpitā cātra jñātvā kṣetramanuttamam || kimatra bahunoktena bhavadbhiḥ sarvathaiva hi ||14|| paripālyā prayatnena yāvaccaṃdrārkatārakam|| tasmādyuṣmākamādiṣṭā pratimeyaṃ mayā śubhā || 15 || nāgarāṇāṃ tu viprāṇāṃ someśapuravāsinām || tasmānnāma mayā dattaṃ nāgarādityameva hi || 16 || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ|| || sarvameva kariṣyāmo devasya paripālanam || yāvanmahī ca caṃdrārkau yāvattiṣṭhati sāgaraḥ || tāvatte hyakṣayā kīrtiḥ sthāne cāsminbhaviṣyati||17|| evamuktvā tu te sarve nāgarā dvijapuṃgavāḥ || rājāpi tuṣṭaḥ prayayau tadā dvāravatīṃ purīm ||18 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi tasmindṛṣṭe tu yatphalam || gośatasya prayāgeṣu samyagdattasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti nāgarārkasya darśanāt|| 19|| dāridryaduḥkhaśokārtteḥ konyosti haraṇakṣamaḥ|| prabhāse pāvane kṣetre muktvā nāgarabhāskaram || 7.1.239.20 || baṃdhakuṣṭhādikaṃ duḥkhaṃ ye bhajaṃtyalpabuddhayaḥ || tatra te naiva jānaṃti vaidyaṃ nāgarabhāskaram || 21 || snātvā hiraṇyātoyena yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || kalpakoṭisahasrāṇi sūryaloke mahīyate ||22|| śuklapakṣe tu saptamyāṃ yadā saṃkramate raviḥ || mahājayā tadā khyātā saptamī bhāskarapriyā || 23 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ pitṛdevābhipūjanam || sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ proktaṃ bhāskarasyavaco yathā || 24 || ekaṃ yo bhojayettatra brāhmaṇaṃ sūryasaṃnidhau || koṭibhojyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena ityāha bhagavānhariḥ || 25 || etanmayā te kathitaṃ purā noktaṃ varānane || yaḥ śṛṇoti naro bhaktyā sa gacchedbhāskaraṃ padam||26|| sūryasya devi nāmāni rahasyāni śṛṇuśva me|| alaṃ nāmasahasreṇa paṭhasvainaṃ śubhaṃ stavam||27|| vikarttano vivasvāṃśca mārttaṃḍo bhāskaro raviḥ || lokaprakāśakaḥ śrīmām̐llokacakṣurgraheśvaraḥ || 28 || lokasākṣī trilokeśaḥ karttā harttā tamisrahā || tapanastāpanaścaiva śuciḥ saptāśvavāhanaḥ || 29 || gabhastihasto brahmā ca sarvadevanamaskṛtaḥ || ekaviṃśaka ityeṣa nāgarārkastavaḥ smṛtaḥ || 7.1.239.30 || stavarāja iti khyātaḥ śarīrārogyavṛddhidaḥ || 31 || ya etena mahādevi dve saṃdhye'stamanodaye || nāgarārkaṃ tu saṃstauti sa labhedvāṃchitaṃ phalam|| 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāgarārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 239 || || cha ||
<7.1.240>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi balabhadraṃ sureśvaram || subhadrāṃ ca tathā kṛṣṇaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || pūrva kalpe mahādevi dehamatrātyajaddhariḥ || asminkalpepi ca punargātrotsargamiti smṛtam || 2 || tatra ye pūjayiṣyaṃti nāgarādityasaṃnidhau || balabhadraṃ subhadrāṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ te svargagāminaḥ ||3|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye balabhadra subhadrā kṛṣṇa māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 240 || cha ||
<7.1.241>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedbalabhadrakalevaram || śeṣarūpeṇa yatrāsau prātyajatsvakalevaram|| 1 || gatastraisaṃgame tīrthe tatra pātālavartmanā || asminmitravane devi gavyūtidvayavistṛte || 2 || kalevaraṃ sthitaṃ devi liṃgākāraṃ mahāprabham || revatyā sahitaṃ tatra śeṣanāmeti viśrutam ||3|| yatra siddhaḥ purā devi jarānāmā tu kaulikaḥ || viṣṇuhaṃtā bhallatīrthe so'sminsthāne layaṃ gataḥ || 4 || tatprabhṛtyeva sakale śeṣa ityabhiviśrutaḥ || caitre śuklatrayodaśyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || sa putrapautrapaśumānvarṣaṃ kṣemeṇa gacchati ||5|| masūrikādirogebhyaḥ śiśūnāṃ na bhayaṃ bhavet || visphoṭakādirogebhyo na bhayaṃ jāyate kvacit ||6|| asminkṣetre mahāsiddhe siddhayajñastu yaḥ smṛtaḥ || varṇānāṃ sāṃtarālānāṃ sarveṣāṃ cātivallabhaḥ ||7|| paśupuṣpopahāraiśca balidānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || saṃtuṣṭiṃ śīghramāyāti śeṣo'śeṣāghanāśanaḥ || || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śeṣamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśa duttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 241 || ||
<7.1.242>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yatra devīkumārikā || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge sthitā rakṣārthameva hi || 1 || purā rathaṃtare kalpe rururnāma mahāsuraḥ || utpannaḥ sa mahākāyaḥ sarvalokabhayāvahaḥ || 2 || tena devāḥ sagandharvāstrāsitāstridaśā layāt || tasya bhītyā tataḥ sarve brahmalokamadhisthitāḥ || 3 || tathā bhūmitale viprānyajvano'tha tapasvinaḥ || nijaghāna sa duṣṭātmā ye cānye dharmacāriṇaḥ || 4 || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ tadā''sīddharaṇītalam|| naṣṭayajñotsavaṃ sarvaṃ rurorbhayanipīḍitam|| 5 || tataḥ pravyathitā devāstathā sarve maharṣayaḥ || sametyāmaṃtrayanmaṃtraṃ vadhārthaṃ tasya durmateḥ || 6 || tataḥ kāyodbhavaḥ svedaḥ sarveṣāṃ samajāyata || teṣāṃ ciṃtayatāṃ devi nirodhājjagṛhuśca tam || ||7|| tatra kanyā samutpannā divyā kamalalocanā || vyāpayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ sarveṣāṃ purataḥ sthitā ||8|| sarvāndevāṃstataḥ prāha kimarthaṃ nirmitāsmya ham || tadvaḥ kāryaṃ kariṣyāmi śrutvā tasyāstadā giram|| 9 || ācakhyuḥ saṃkaṭaṃ tasyāste devā ruruceṣṭitam || śrutvā jahāsa sā devī devānāṃ kārya siddhaye || 7.1.242.10 || tasyā hasaṃtyā niścerurvarāṃgāḥ kanyakāḥ punaḥ || pāśāṃkuśadharāḥ sarvāḥ pīnaśroṇipayodharāḥ || 11 || phetkārārāvamātreṇa trāsa yaṃtyaścarācaram || anvagātsā rururyatra tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ yaśasvinī || 12 || athābhūttumulaṃ tāsāṃ yuddhaṃ ghoraṃ tu taiḥ saha || śastrāstrairvividhairghoraiḥ śatrupakṣa kṣayaṃkaraiḥ || 13 || tābhistadanugāḥ sarve prahārairjarjarīkṛtāḥ|| parāṅmukhāḥ kṣaṇenaiva jātāḥ kecinnipātitāḥ || 14 || tato hataṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā rururmāyāmathā'sṛjat || tāmasīṃnāma deveśi tayāmuhyata naiva sā || 15 || tamobhūte tatastatra devī daityaṃ tadā rurum || śaktyā bibheda hṛdaye tato mūrchāṃ jagāma ha || 16 || muhūrttāllabdhasaṃjño'tha jñātvā tasyāḥ parākramam || palāyanakṛtotsāhaḥ samudrābhimukho yayau || 17 || sā'pi devī jagāmātha pṛṣṭhato'sya durātmanaḥ || stūyamānā suragaṇaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ samahoragaiḥ || 18 || tataḥ praviśya jaladhiṃ taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ ruṣā || khaṅgāgreṇa śiraśchittvā carmamuṇḍadharā tataḥ || 19 || niścakrāma punastasmātprabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatā || kanyā sainyena saṃyuktā bahurūpeṇa bhāsvatā || 7.1.242.20 || devaiḥ suvismitairdṛṣṭā carmamuṇḍadharā varā || tato devāḥ stutiṃ cakruḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāḥ sthitāḥ || 21 || || devā ūcuḥ || || jaya tvaṃ devi cāmuṃḍe jaya bhūtāpahāriṇi || jaya sarvagate devi kālarātri namo'stu te || 22 || bhīmarūpe śive vidye mahāmāye mahodaye || mahābhāge jaye jṛmbhe bhīmākṣi bhīmadarśane || 23 || mahāmāye vicitrāṃgi geyanṛtyapriye śubhe || vikarāli mahākāli kālike kālarūpiṇi || 24 || prāsahaste daṇḍahaste bhīmahaste bhayānane || cāmuṇḍe jvalamānāsye tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭre mahābale || śavayānasthite devi pretasaṃghaniṣevite || 25 || evaṃ stutā tadā devī sarvaiḥ śakrapurogamaiḥ || prahṛṣṭavadanā bhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 26 || varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ bhadraṃ vo nityaṃ yanmanasi sthitam || ahaṃ dāsyāmi tatsarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham || 27 || || devā ūcuḥ || || kṛtakṛtyāstvayā bhadre dānavasya niṣūdanāt || 28 || stotreṇānena yo devi tvāṃ vai stauti varānane || tasya tvaṃ varadā devi bhava sarvagatā satī || 29 || yaścedaṃ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā tava devi samudbhavam || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ sa prāpnotu parāṃ gatim || 7.1.242.30 || asminkṣetre tvayā devi sthitiḥ kāryā sadā śubhe || 31 || atra tvāṃ pūjayedyastu śuklapakṣe samāhitaḥ || navamyāmāśvine māsi tasya kāryaṃ sadā śubham|| 32 || || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktā mahādevī tatraiva niratā'bhavat || devāstriviṣṭapaṃ jagmuḥ prahṛṣṭā hataśatravaḥ ||33|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kumārīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||242|| ||
<7.1.243>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kṣetrapālaṃ mahāprabham || īśāne saṃsthitaṃ devaṃ maṃtramālāvibhūṣitam || 1 || hiraṇyātaṭamāśritya rakṣārthaṃ samupasthitam || tatraiva hīrakaṃ kṣetraṃ tasminrakṣāṃ karoti saḥ || 2 || kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ tatra taṃ pūjayennaraḥ || gaṃdhapuṣpopahāraiśca tathā bali nivedanaiḥ || 3 || evaṃ saṃpūjito devaḥ sarvakāmaprado bhavet || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye maṃtrāvalikṣetrapālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 243 ||
<7.1.244>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vicitreśvaramuttamam || hiraṇyātīranilayaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 1 || vicitreṇa mahādevi lekhakena yamasya ca || tapaḥ kṛtvā mahāraudraṃ liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam|| 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi yamalokaṃ na paśyati || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vicitreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 244 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.245>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tatraivoparisaṃsthitam || sarasvatyāstaṭe devi parṇādityasya paścime || 1 || tatrāste sumahalliṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā purā || brahmeśvareti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 2 || tatra snātvā dvitīyāyāṃ sopavāso jiteṃdriyaḥ || arcayeddevadeveśaṃ nāmnā brahmeśvaraṃ śubham|| tarpayecca pitṝñchrāddhe yadīcchecchāśvataṃ padam || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame pramāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 245 || || cha ||
<7.1.246>
|| īśvara uvāca || ||| tato gacchenmahādevi piṃgalīṃ pāpanāśinīm || ṛṣitīrthātpaścimato nadīṃ sāgaragāminīm || 1 || tasyāḥ saṃdarśanāddevi rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ || purā maharṣayaḥ prāptāḥ someśvaradidṛkṣayā || 2 || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya nadītīre vyavasthitāḥ || dākṣiṇātyā mahādevi kṛṣṇavarṇā virūpakāḥ ||3|| tatrāśramavare snātvā paśyanto rūpamātmanaḥ || kāmena sadṛśaṃ sarve vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 4 || tataste sahitāḥ sarve vismayotphullalocanāḥ || atra snātā vayaṃ sarve yataḥ piṃgatvamāgatāḥ || ataḥ prabhṛti nāmāsyāstataḥ piṃgā bhaviṣyati || 5 || yetra snānaṃ kariṣyanti bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || na teṣāmanvaye kaścidbhaviṣyati kurūpavān || 6 || darśanātpitṛmedhasya lapsyate mānavaḥ phalam || snānena dviguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ tarpaṇena caturguṇam || 7 || asaṃkhyātaṃ phalaṃ tasya yo'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati || evamuktvā tataḥ sarva ṛṣayo varavarṇini || 8 || vyabhajaṃstannadītīraṃ sarve te munisattamāḥ || yajñopavītamātrāṇi cakrustīrthāni sarvataḥ || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye piṃgā nadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 246 || || cha ||
<7.1.247>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetsūryaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || tathā ca piṃgalāṃ devīṃ pārvatīrūpadhāriṇīm || 1 || tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣeṇa hyupavāsaṃ karoti yaḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dhanavānputravānbhavet || 2 || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyecchukeśvaramiti śrutam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi muktaḥ syātsarvapātakaiḥ || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye piṃgalādityapiṃgādevīśukreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśa duttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 247 || || cha ||
<7.1.248>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi pūrvoktaṃ brahmapūjitam || sarasvatyāstaṭe saṃsthaṃ parṇādityasya paścime || 1 || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || sṛjato brahmaṇaḥ pūrvaṃ bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham || 2 || utpannādbhutarūpāḍhyā nārī kamalalocanā || kaṃbugrīvā sukeśāṃtā biṃboṣṭhī tanumadhyamā || 3 || gaṃbhīranābhiḥ suśroṇī pīnaśroṇipayodharā || pūrṇacandramukhī sā tu gūḍhagulphā sitānanā || 4 || na devī na ca gandharvī nāsurī na ca pannagī || yādṛgrūpā varārohā tādṛśī sā vyajāyata || 5 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā rūpasaṃpannāṃ brahmā kāmavaśo'bhavat || atha tāṃ prārthayāmāsa ratyarthaṃ varavarṇini || 6 || atha prārthayatastasya nyapatatpaṃcamaṃ śiraḥ || khararūpaṃ mahādevi tena pāpena tatkṣaṇāt|| 7 || tato jñātvā mahatpāpaṃ duhituḥ kāmasaṃbhavam || ghṛṇayā parayā yuktaḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ || 8 || na kāyasya yataḥ śuddhirvinā tīrthāvagāhanāt || sa snātaḥ salile puṇye sarasvatyā varānane || 9 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa devadevasya śūlinaḥ || tato vikalmaṣo bhūtvā jagāma svagṛhaṃ punaḥ || 7.1.248.10 || snātvā sārasvate toye yastalliṃgaṃ prapaśyati || sarvapāpavinirmukto brahmaloke mahīyate || 11 || caitre śuklacaturdaśyāṃ yastaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 12 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 248 || cha ||
<7.1.249>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ vai saṃgameśvaram || golakṣamiti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam | 1 || tasyaiva paścime bhāge sarvakāmaphalapradam || ṛṣiruddālakonāma purā hyāsīnmahātapāḥ || 2 || sa purā saṃgamaṃ prāpya sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || sarasvatyāśca piṃgāyāstapastepe sureśvari || 3 || tatastapasyatastasya tapo raudraṃ mahātmanaḥ || purato hyutthitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā yuktasya sundari || 4 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || uddālaka mahābāho śṛṇuṣvaitadvaco mama || 5 || adyaprabhṛti vāso'tra mama nityaṃ bhaviṣyati || yasmādatra samutpannaṃ saṃgame liṃgamuttamam || saṃgameśvaramityeva nāma cāsya bhavi ṣyati || 6 || yetra snānaṃ narāḥ kṛtvā saṃgame lokaviśrute || saṃgameśvaramīkṣante te yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa divārātramataṃdritaḥ || tato dehāvasāne'sau gato yatra maheśvaraḥ || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame ,prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 249 || cha ||
<7.1.250>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || gaṃgeśvareti vikhyātaṃ saṃgameśvarapaścime || 1 || yadā gaṃgā samāhūtā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || antakāle'bhiṣekārthaṃ svakāyasya varānane || 2 || tato dṛṣṭvā tu tatkṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ hyṛṣiniṣevitam || sarvatra vyāpitaṃ liṃgairāśramaiśca tapasvinām || 3 || tato gaṃgāsaricchreṣṭhā pūrvasāgaragāminī || sthāpayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ śivabhaktiparāyaṇā || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu varārohe gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 250 || || cha ||
<7.1.251>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi śaṃkarādityamuttamam || gaṃgeśvarasya pūrveṇa śaṃkareṇa pratiṣṭhitam || 1 || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ caiva tu śuklāyāmenaṃ yaḥ pūjayiṣyati || gamiṣyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ || 2 || raktacaṃdanamiśraiśca raktapuṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ || tāmrapātre samādhāya yo'rghyaṃ dāsyati mānavaḥ || sa yāsyati parāṃ siddhiṃ na ca yāti daridratām|| 3 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tasminkṣetre varānane || pūjayecchaṃkarādityaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkarādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo' dhyāyaḥ || 251 || || cha ||
<7.1.252>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || tatra śaṃkaranātheti prasiddhaṃ pāpanāśanam || || 1 || sthāpitaṃ bhānunā devi kṛtvā tatra mahattapaḥ || tamarcayitvā deveśaṃ sopavāso maheśvaram|| 2 || brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra śrāddhaṃ kuryājjitendriyaḥ || śaktyā hiraṇyaṃ vāsāṃsi vipre dadyātsamāhitaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṅkaranāthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 252 || || cha || ||
<7.1.253>
|| īśvara uvāca || tato gacchenmahādevi gupheśvaramanuttamam|| hiraṇyā uttare bhāge sarvapātakanāśanam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi koṭihatyāṃ vyapohati|| 1 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gupheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||253|| ||cha||
<7.1.254>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetsarvapātakanāśanam || ghaṇṭeśvaramiti khyātaṃ devadānavavanditam || pūjitaṃ hyṛṣibhiḥ siddhairvāṃchitārthaphalapradam || 1 || vāre somasya cāṣṭamyāṃ yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || sa labhedvāṃchitānkāmānmuktaḥ syātpātakena hi ||2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye ghaṃṭeśvaramāhāratmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 254 || || cha ||
<7.1.255>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || tasyaiva paścime bhāge ṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām || 1 || tasmiṃstrinetrā matsyāśca dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi bhāmini || aṃgirā gautamo'gastyaḥ sumatiḥ susakhistathā || 2 || viśvāmitraḥ sthūlaśirāḥ saṃvarttaḥ pratimarddanaḥ || raibhyo bṛhaspatiścaiva cyavanaḥ kaśyapo bhṛguḥ || 3 || durvāsā jāmadagnyaśca mārkaṃḍeyo'tha gālavaḥ || uśanā'tha bharadvājo yavakrītastritastathā || 4 || sthūlākṣaḥ sakalākṣaśca kaṇvo medhātithiḥ kuśaḥ || nāradaḥ parvataścaiva vasiṣṭho'ruṃdhatī tathā || 5 || kāṇvo'tha gautamo dhaumyaḥ śatānando'kṛtavraṇaḥ || jamadagnistathā rāmo bakaścetyevamādayaḥ || kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaścaiva putraśiṣyaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 6 || etatkṣetraṃ samā sādya prabhāsaṃ munisattamāḥ || tapastepurmahātmāno vividhaṃ paramādbhutam || 7 || evaṃ te niyatātmāno damayuktāstapasvinaḥ || samādhinā jigīṣante brahmalokaṃ sanātanam|| 8 || athābhavadanāvṛṣṭiḥ kadācinmahatī priye || kṛcchraṃ prāpto hyabhūttatra sarvalokaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ || 9 || tato niranne loke'sminnātmānaṃ te parīpsavaḥ || mṛtaṃ kumāramādāya kṛcchraṃ prāptāstadā'pacan || 7.1.255.10 || athoparicarastatra kliśyamānānhi tānṛṣīn|| dṛṣṭvā rājā vṛṣādarbhiḥ provācedaṃ vacastadā|| 11|| rājovāca || pratigraho brāhmaṇānāṃ dṛṣṭā vṛttiraniṃditā|| tasmātpratigrahaṃ matta gṛhṇīdhvaṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || 12|| mudgānmāṣāṃśca vrīhīṃśca tathā ratnāni kāṃcanam || yuṣmākaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi yaccānyadapi durllabham || nivarttadhvamataḥ sarve hyetasmātpātakātparam|||| 13 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || tajjānaṃtaḥ kathaṃ rājangṛhṇīmaste pratigraham || 14 || daśasūnāsamaścakrī daśacakrisamo dhvajī || daśadhvaji samā veśyā daśaveśyāsamo nṛpaḥ || 15 || yo rājñāṃ pratigṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo lobhamohitaḥ || tāmisrādiṣu ghoreṣu narakeṣu sa pacyate || 16 || tadgaccha kuśalaṃ te'stu saha dānena pārthiva || anyeṣāṃ dīyatāmetadityuktvā te vanaṃ yayuḥ || 17 || atha rājñaḥ samādeśāttatra gatvā ca maṃtriṇaḥ || ūdumbarāṇi vyakiranhemagarbhāṇi bhūtale ||18|| atha tāni vyacinvaṃśca ṛṣayo varavarṇini || gurūṇīti viditvā tu na grāhyāṇyaṃgirā'bravīt || 19 || || atriruvāca || || nāsmahenāsmahe mūḍha vayamajñānabuddhayaḥ || haimānīmāni jānīmaḥ pratibuddhāḥ sma jāḍyataḥ ||7.1.255.20|| || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || dharmārthaṃ saṃcayo yasya dravyāṇāṃ sa na śasyate || tapaḥsaṃcayanaṃ manye vasiṣṭho dhanasaṃcayam || 21 || tyajadhvaṃ saṃcayānsarvāñjātīnāṃ samupadravān || na hi saṃcayavānkaściddṛśyate nirupadravaḥ || 22 || yathāyathā na gṛhṇāti brāhmaṇo'satpratigraham || tathātathā'niśaṃ cāsya brahmatejastu vardhate || 23 || akiṃcanatvaṃ rājyaṃ ca tulayā samatolayam|| akiṃcanatvamadhikaṃ rājyādapi na saṃśayaḥ || 24 || ||kaśyapa uvāca || || anartho brāhmaṇasyaiṣa yadarthanicayo mahān || arthaiśvaryavimūḍho'pi śreyaso bhraśyate dvijaḥ || 25 || arthasaṃpadvimohāya bahuśokāya caiva hi || tasmādarthamanarthākhyaṃ śreyo'rthī dūratastyajet || 26 || yasya dharmārthamapyarthāstasyāpi na hi dṛśyate || prakṣālanāddhi paṃkasya dūrādasparśanaṃ varam ||27|| || bharadvāja uvāca|| || jīryaṃti jīryataḥ keśā daṃtā jīryaṃti jīryataḥ|| cakṣuḥ śrotre ca jīryete tṛṣṇaikā na tu jīryate || 28 || sūcī sūtra tathā vastre samānayati sūcikā || tadvatsaṃsārasūtrasya tṛṣṇā sūcī vidhīyate || 29 || yathā śṛṃgaṃ ruroḥ kāye varddhamāne hi varddhate || anaṃtapārā durvārā tṛṣṇā duḥkhapradā sadā || adharmabahulā caiva tasmāttāṃ parivarjayet|| ||| 7.1.255.30 || || gautama uvāca || || saṃtuṣṭaḥ ko na śaknoti phalaiścāpi hi varttitum|| sarvo'pīṃdriyalobhena saṃkaṭānyabhigāhate ||31|| sarvatra saṃpadastasya saṃtuṣṭaṃ yasya mānasam || upānadgūḍhapādasya nanu carmāvṛteva bhūḥ || 32 || saṃtoṣāmṛtatṛptānāṃ yatsukhaṃ śāṃtacetasām|| kutastaddhanalubdhānāṃ sukhaṃ cāśāṃtacetasām ||33|| || viśvāmitra uvāca || || kāmaṃ kāmayamānasya yadi kāmaḥ sa siddhyati || tathainamaparaḥ kāmo bhūyo vidhyati bāṇavat ||34|| na jātu kāmaḥ kāmānāmupabhogena śāmyati || haviṣā kṛṣṇavartmeva bhūya evābhivarddhate || 35 || kāmānabhilaṣanlobhānna naraḥ sukhamedhate|| samālabhya tarucchāyāṃ bhavanaṃ vāñcho naraḥ ||36|| catuḥsāgarasaṃyuktāṃ yo bhuṃkte pṛthivīmimām || ekastu vanavāsī ca sa kṛtārtho na pārthivaḥ ||37|| || || jamadagniruvāca || || pratigrahasamartho yastapo varddhayate mahān|| na karoti tapastasya jāyate ca sahasradhā || 38 || pratigrahasamarthānāṃ nivṛttānāṃ pratigrahāt || ya eva dadatāṃ lokāsta evāpratigṛhṇatām || 39 || || aruṃdhatyuvāca || || bisataṃturyathā nityaṃ samaṃtānnālasaṃsthitaḥ || tṛṣṇā caivamanādyaṃtā tathā dehāśritā sadā || 7.1.255.40 || yā dustyajā durmatibhiryā na jīryati jīryataḥ || yo'sau prāṇāṃtiko rogastāṃ tṛṣṇāṃ tyajataḥ sukham || || 41 || || caṃḍovāca || || ugrātpratigrahādyasmādbibhyatyete maheśvarāḥ || balīyāṃso durbalavattathā caiva bibhemyaham || 42 || || paśumukha uvāca || || yadācaraṃti vidvāṃsaḥ sadā dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || tadeva viduṣā kāryamātmano hitamicchatā || 43 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktvā hemagarbhāṇi tyaktvā tāni phalāni ca || ṛṣayo jagmuranyatra sarva eva dṛḍhavratāḥ || 44 || tataste vicaraṃto vai dadṛśuḥ sumahatsaraḥ || padminībhiḥ samākīrṇaṃ sarvato varavarṇini || 45 || tasmindeśe tadā prāptaḥ parivrājaḥ śunomukhaḥ || tenaiva sahitāstatra snātāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ || 46 || tatrāvatāraṃ kṛtvā tairgṛhītāni bisāni tu || nikṣipya sarasastīre cakruḥ puṇyāṃ jalakriyām || 47 || athottīrya jalāttasmātte sametya parasparam || bisāni tānyapaśyaṃta idaṃ vacanamabruvan || 48 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kena kṣudhābhitaptānāmasmākaṃ pāpakarmaṇā || bisāni tāni sarvāṇi hṛtāni ca munīśvarāḥ || || 49 || te śaṃkamānāstvanyonyaṃ paryapṛcchandvijottamāḥ || cakruste śapathānsarve yathānyāyaṃ ca bhāmini || 7.1.255.50 || || kaśyapa uvāca || || sarvabhakṣaḥ sa bhavatu nyāsalopaṃ karotu saḥ || kūṭasākṣitvamabhyetu bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 51 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || anṛtau maithunaṃ yātu para nārīṃ viśeṣataḥ || atithiḥ syāttathānyonyaṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 52 || || bharadvāja uvāca|| nṛśaṃso vai sa bhavatu samṛddhyā cāpyahaṃkṛ taḥ || matsarī piśunaścaiva bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 53 || || viśvāmitra uvāca || || nityaṃ kāmarataḥ sostu divā sevatu maithunam || nīcakarmarataścaiva bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 54 || || jamadagniruvāca || || kanyāṃ yacchatu vṛddhāya sa bhūyādvṛṣalīpatiḥ || astu vārddhuṣiko nityaṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 55 || || gautama uvāca || || sa gṛhṇātvavikādānaṃ karotu hayavikrayam || prakarotu gurorniṃdāṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 56 || (?)atriruvāca || || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ nityaṃ durmatiḥ so'vamanyatām || śūdraṃ pṛcchatu dharmārthaṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ || 57 || || arundhatyuvāca || || karotu patyuḥ pūrvaṃ sā bhojanaṃ śayanaṃ tathā || nārī duṣṭasamācārā bisastainyaṃ karoti yā || 58 || || caṇḍovāca || || svāminaḥ pratikūlāstu dharmadveṣaṃ karotu ca || sādhudveṣaparā caiva bisastainyaṃ karoti yā ||59|| || paśumukha uvāca || || parasya preṣyatāṃ yātu sadā janmanijanmani || sarvadharma kriyāhīno bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ||7.1.255.60|| || śunomukha uvāca|| || vedānsa paṭhatu nyāyādgṛhasthaḥ syātpriyātithiḥ || satyaṃ vadatu cājasraṃ bisastainyaṃ karoti yaḥ ||61|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || iṣṭametaddvijātīnāṃ yastvayā śapathaḥ kṛtaḥ || tvayā kṛtaṃ bisastainyaṃ sarveṣāṃ naḥ śunomukha ||62|| || śunomukha uvāca || || mayā hṛtāni sarveṣāṃ bisānīmāni vai dvijāḥ || dharmaṃ vai śrotukāmena jānīdhvaṃ māṃ puraṃdaram||63|| alobhādakṣayā lokā jitā vai munisattamāḥ || prārthayadhvaṃ varaṃ śubhraṃ sarvameva hyasaṃśayam ||64|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || ihāgatya naro yastu trirātropoṣitaḥ śuciḥ || kṛtvā snānaṃ pitṝṃstarpya śrāddhaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ||65|| sarvatīrthodbhavaṃ tasya puṇyaṃ bhūyātpuraṃdara || nādhogatimavāpnoti vibudhaissaha modatām || tathetyuktvā tataḥ śakrasta traivāntarhito'bhavat||66|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṣitīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃ nāma pañcapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||255||
<7.1.256>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi naṃdādityaṃ samāhitaḥ || naṃdena sthāpitaṃ pūrvaṃ tatraivāmitabuddhinā ||1|| naṃdo rājā purā hyāsītsarvalokasukhapradaḥ || na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhi nākāle maraṇaṃ nṛṇām|| 2 || tasmiñchāsati dharmajñe na cāvṛṣṭikṛtaṃ bhayam || kasyacittvatha kālasya pūrvakarmānusārataḥ|| 3 || kuṣṭhena mahatā vyāpto vairāgyaparamaṃ gataḥ|| tena rogābhibhūtena devadevo divākaraḥ|| pratiṣṭhito nadītīre sa ca rogādvimocitaḥ || 4 || || devyuvāca || || kimasau rogavānrājā sārvabhaumo mahīpatiḥ || tasya dharmaratasyāpi kasmādroga samudbhavaḥ || 5 || ||īśvara uvāca || || eṣa dharmasadācāro naṃdo rājā pratāpavān || vyacaratsarvalokānsa vimānavaramāsthitaḥ || 6|| vimānaṃ tasya tuṣṭena dattaṃ vai viṣṇunā svayam || kāmagaṃ varavarṇena barhiṇena vināditam || 7 || sa
