kadācinnṛpaśreṣṭho vicaraṃstatra saṃsthitaḥ || gatavānmānasaṃ divyaṃ saro devagaṇānvitam|| 8 || tatrāpaśyadbṛhatpadmaṃ saromadhyagataṃ sitam || tatra cāṃguṣṭhamātraṃ tu sthitaṃ puruṣasattamam || 9 || raktavāsobhirācchannaṃ dvibhujaṃ tigmatejasam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā sārathiṃ prāha padmametatsamāhara ||7.1.256.10|| idaṃ tu śirasā bibhratsarvalokasya sannidhau || ślāghanīyo bhaviṣyāmi tasmādāhara mā ciram|| 11 || evamuktastatastena sārathiḥ praviveśa ha || grahītumupacakrāma tatpadmaṃ varavarṇini|| spṛṣṭamātre tadā padme huṃkāraḥ samapadyata||12|| rājā ca tatkṣaṇāttena śabdena samajāyata || kuṣṭhī vigatavarṇaśca balavīryavivarjitaḥ || 13 || tathāgatamathātmānaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa puruṣarṣabhaḥ || tasthau tatraiva śokārtaḥ kimetaditi ciṃtayan || 14 || tasya ciṃtayato dhīmānājagāma mahātapāḥ || vasiṣṭho brahmaputrastu sa taṃ papraccha pārthivaḥ || 15 || eṣa me bhagavañjāto dehasyāsya viparyayaḥ || kuṣṭharogābhibhūtātmā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe || 16 || upāyaṃ brūhi me brahmanvyādhitasya cikitsitam || utāho vratamanyadvā dānaṃ yajñamathāpi vā || 17 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || etadbrahmodbhavaṃ nāma padmaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || dṛṣṭamātreṇa cānena dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarva devatāḥ || 18 || etaddhi dṛśyate dhanyaiḥ padmaṃ kaiḥ kvāpi pārthiva || etasmindṛṣṭamātre tu yo jalaṃ viśate naraḥ || 19 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ padaṃ nirvāṇa māpnuyāt || eṣa dṛṣṭvā tu te sūto hartuṃ toye praviṣṭavān || 7.1.256.20 || tava vākyena rājeṃdra mṛto'sau rogavānbhavet || brahmaputro'pyahaṃ tena paśyāmi parameśvaram || 21 || ahanyahani cāgacchaṃstvaṃ punardṛṣṭavānasi || vāṃchaṃti devatā nityamamuṃ hṛdi manoratham || 22 || mānase brahmapadmaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā snātvā kadā vayam || prāpsyāmaḥ paramaṃ brahma yadgatvā na punarbhavet||23|| idaṃ ca kāraṇaṃ bhūyo dvitīyaṃ śṛṇu pārthiva || kuṣṭhasya yattvayā prāptaṃ hartukāmena paṃkajam || || 24 || pradyotanastu garbhe'sminsvayameva vyavasthitaḥ || tavaiṣā buddhirabhavaddṛṣṭvedaṃ varapaṃkajam || 25 || dhārayāmi śirasyenaṃ lokamadhye vibhūṣaṇam || idaṃ cintayataḥ pāpamevaṃ devena darśitam || 26 || tataḥ sarvaprayatnena tamārādhaya bhāskaram || prasādāddevadevasya mokṣyase nātra saṃśayaḥ ||27|| prabhāsaṃ gaccha rājeṃdra tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || tatra siddhirbhavecchīghramārttānāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi || 28 || || īśvara uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya māheśvaryāstaṭe śubhe || 29 || naṃdādityaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya gaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ || pūjayāmāsa taṃ devi puṣpairuccāvacaistathā || 7.1.256.30 || tasya tuṣṭo divānātho varado'hamathābravīt || 31 || || nanda uvāca || || kuṣṭhena mahatā vyāptaṃ paśya māṃ surasattama || yathā'yaṃ nāśamāyāti tathā kuru divākara || 32 || sānnidhyaṃ kuru deveśa sthāne'sminnityadā vibho || 33 || || sūrya uvāca || || nīrogastvaṃ mahārāja sadya eva bhaviṣyasi || atra ye māṃ samāgatya drakṣyaṃti ca narā bhuvi || 34 || saptamyāṃ sūryavāreṇa yāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim|| atra me sūryavāreṇa sāṃnidhyaṃ saptamīdine || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho gamiṣye tvaṃ sukhī bhava || 35 || evamuktvā sahasrāṃśustatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 36 || nīrogatvamavā pyāsau kṛtvā rājyamanuttamam || jagāma paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo divākaraḥ || tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ prayatnataḥ || 37 || naṃdādityaṃ punardṛṣṭvā na punarmarttyatāṃ vrajeta|| pradadyātkapilāṃ tatra brāhmaṇe vedapārage || 38 || ahorātroṣito bhūtvā ghṛtadhenumathāpi vā || na tasya guṇituṃ śakyā saṃkhyā puṇyasya kenacit || 39 || ityevaṃ devadevasya māhātmyaṃ dīptadīdhiteḥ || kathitaṃ tava suśroṇi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 7.1.256.40 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nandādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ ||256||
<7.1.257>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tritakūpamiti smṛtam|| naṃdādityasya pūrveṇa yojanatritayena tu || 1 || purā babhūva rājedraḥ saurāṣṭraviṣaye sudhīḥ || ātreya iti vikhyāto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ ||2|| tasya putratrayaṃ jajña ṛtukālābhigāminaḥ || ekataścadvitaścaiva tritaścaiveti bhāmini ||3|| tritasteṣāṃ kaniṣṭho'bhūdvedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || sarvaireva guṇairyukto mūrkho jyeṣṭhau babhūvatuḥ || 4 || kasyacittvathakālasya ātreyo dvija sattamaḥ || tapaḥ kṛtvā tu vipulaṃ kāladharmamupeyivān|| 5 || tatasteṣāṃ trito rājā babhūva guṇavattaraḥ || dhuramākarṣayāmāsa putro'yaṃ tasya yā purā || 6|| tasya buddhiḥ samutpannā kathaṃ yajñaṃ karomyaham || sannimaṃtrya dvijaśreṣṭhānyajñakarmasvadhiṣṭhitān || 7 || indrādīṃśca surānsarvānāvāhya vidhipūrvakam || dakṣiṇārthaṃ dvijendrāṇāṃ prabhāsaṃ sa jagāma ha || gṛhītvā bhrātarau jyeṣṭhau gavārthaṃ prasthito dvijaḥ || 8 || yasya yasya gṛhe yāti sa trito vedapāragaḥ || tatra tatra varāṃ pūjāṃ lebhe gāścaiva puṣkalāḥ || 9 || evaṃ sa godhanaṃ prāpya bhrātṛbhyāṃ sahitastadā || gṛhāya prasthito devi nirvṛtiṃ paramāṃ gataḥ || 7.1.257.10 || tritastābhyāṃ puro yāti pṛṣṭhato bhrātarau ca tau || godhanaṃ cālayaṃtaste prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ || 11 || atha tadgodhanaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhūri dānārthamāhṛtam || bhrātṛbhyāṃ tritaye ceti pāpā matirajāyata || 12 || parasparamūcatustau bhrātarau duṣṭacetasau || trito yajñeṣu kuśalo vedeṣu kuśalastathā|| 13 || mānyaḥ pūjyaśca sarvatra āvāṃ mūrkhau nirarthakau || etaddhi godhanaṃ sarvaṃ trito dāsyati sanmakhe || 14 || asmākaṃ pitṛparyāto yadāptaṃ tatsamaṃ bhavet|| tasmādatraiva yukto'sya vadho vai tritayajñinaḥ || 15 || evaṃ tau niścayaṃ kṛtvā prasthitau bhrātarāvubhau || tritastu purato yāti nirvikalpa ṛjuḥ sudhīḥ ||16|| anu tatra samuttasthau vyāghro raudratarākṛtiḥ || vyāditāsyo ravaṃ devi vyanadbhairavaṃ tataḥ || 17 || tasya śabdena tā gāvo naṣṭā jagmurdiśo daśa || andhakūpo mahāṃstatra pradeśe dāruṇo'bhavat || 18 || ekato dāruṇo vyāghraḥ kūpo'nyatra sudāruṇaḥ || dṛṣṭvā te bhrātaraḥ sarve bhayodvignāḥ pradudruvuḥ||19 || atha te viṣamaṃ prāpya taṭaṃ kūpasya bhāmini || sthitā yāvadgato vyāghrastato gaṃtuṃ mano dadhuḥ || 7.1.257.20 || atha tābhyāṃ trito devi bhrātṛbhyāṃ nṛpasattama || prakṣipto dāruṇe kūpe jīrṇe toyavivarjite || 21 || tatastadgodhanaṃ gṛhya prasthitau hṛṣṭamānasau || tritastu patitastatra kūpe jalavivarjite || 22 || cintayāmāsa medhāvī nāhaṃ śocāmi jīvitum || mayāhūtā dvijaśreṣṭhā yajñārthaṃ vedapāragāḥ || indrādyāśca surāḥ sarve sa kratuḥ syānna me tvataḥ || 23 || sa evaṃ cintayāmāsa vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ || mānasaṃ yajñamārabhya tatraiva varavarṇini || 24 || svayameva sa sūktāni proktvā proktvā dvijottamaḥ || kṛtavānbālukāhomaṃ tena tuṣṭāśca devatāḥ || 25 || śraddhāṃ tasya viditvā tu bhūyastṛptāstu devatāḥ || āgatya brāhmaṇaṃ procuḥ kūpamadhye vyavasthitam || || 26 || || devā ūcuḥ || || bhobho vipra tvayā nūnaṃ sarve saṃtarpitā vayam || mānasena tu yajñena tasmādbrūhi manogatam || 27 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || yadi devāḥ prasannā me kūpānniṣkamaṇe tvaham || yaṣṭā svaṃ maṃdiraṃ gatvā devayajñaṃ karomyaham|| 28 || || īśvara uvāca || atha devaiḥ samādiṣṭā tasminkūpe sarasvatī || nirgatya vasudhāṃ bhittvā pūrayāmāsa vāriṇā || 29 || atha niṣkramya vipro'sau yātaḥ svabhavanaṃ prati || tataḥ prabhṛti deveśi tritakūpaḥ sa ucyate || 7.1.257.30 || snātvā tatra śucirbhūtvā tvatha saṃtarpayetpitṝn || aśvamedhamavāpnoti sarvapāpavivarjitaḥ || 31 || tila dānaṃ tu deveśi tatra śastaṃ sakāñcanam || pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ tīrthaṃ nityaṃ caiva tu bhāmini || 32 || agniṣvāttā barhiṣada āyaṃtuna iti smṛtāḥ || ye divyāḥ pitaro devi teṣāṃ sāṃnidhyamatra hi || 33 || darśanādapi tīrthasya tasya vai surasattame || mucyante prāṇinaḥ pāpādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt || || 34 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya yadīcchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tritakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 257||
<7.1.258>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi śaśāpānamiti smṛtam || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || yasminsnātvā naraḥ samyaṅnāpamṛtyubhayaṃ labhet || śṛṇu yasmāttadutpattiṃ vadato mama vallabhe || 2 || mathitvā sāgaraṃ devā gṛhītvā'mṛtamuttamam || satvarāstatra te gatvā papuścaiva yathepsayā || 3 || pibatāṃ tatra pīyūṣaṃ devānāṃ varavarṇini || biṃdavaḥ patitā bhūmau śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || 4 || etasminneva kāle tu śaśakastatra cāgataḥ || praviṣṭaḥ salile tatra tṛṣārto varavarṇini || 5 || amaratvamanuprāpto varddhate salilālaye || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tridaśāḥ sarve sparddhamānā muhurmuhuḥ || jñātvāmṛtānvitaṃ toyaṃ maṃtraṃ cakrurbhayānvitāḥ || 6 || amṛtaṃ patitaṃ bhūmau bhakṣayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || tato'marttyā bhaviṣyaṃti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 7 || tiryagyonyāṃ samutpannaḥ kṛpaṇaḥ śaśako hyayam || asmābhiḥ sparddhate tasmāttato bhayamupasthitam || 8 || atha prāpto niśānātho vyādhinā sa pariplutaḥ || abravīttridaśānsarvānamṛtaṃ me prayacchata || 9 || kṛcchreṇa mahatā prāpto nāhaṃ śakto visarpitum || athocustridaśāḥ sarve sarvamasmābhirbhakṣitam || 7.1.258.10 || vismṛtastvaṃ niśānātha cirātkasmādihāgataḥ || kuruṣva vacanaṃ caṃdra asmākaṃ timirāpaha || || 11 || asmiñjale'mṛtaṃ bhūri patitaṃ pibatāṃ hi naḥ || tatpibasva niśānātha sarvametajjalāśayam || 12 || arddhaṃ nipatitaṃ cātra satyametanniśāmaya || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā śītaraśmistvarānvitaḥ || 13 || tṛṣārto vā'pibattoyaṃ śaśakena samanvitam || asthiśeṣaṃ tu tattasya kāyaṃ pīyūṣabhakṣaṇāt || 14 || tatkṣaṇātpuṣṭimagamatkāṃtyā paramayā yutaḥ || dhātuṣu kṣīyamāṇeṣu puṣṭo hi sudhayā hi saḥ || 15 || sa cāpi śaśakastasya na mṛto jaṭharaṃ gataḥ || adyāpi dṛśyate tatra dehe pīyūṣabhakṣaṇāt ||16|| tatkṣaṇāttuṣṭimagamatkāṃtyā paramayā yutaḥ || abruvankhanyatāmetadyathā bhūyo jalaṃ bhavet || || 17 || asmākaṃ saṃgamādetacchuṣkaṃ śvabhraṃ jalāśayam || tadyuktaṃ ca kṛtaṃ karma naitatsādhuviceṣṭitam || 18 || tato'khanaṃśca te sarve yāvattoyavinirgamaḥ || athābruvaṃstataḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahatānvitāḥ || 19 || yasmācchaśena saṃyuktaṃ pītametajjalāśayam || caṃdreṇa hi śaśāpānaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati || || 7.1.258.20 || atrāgatya naraḥ snānaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati bhaktitaḥ || sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 21 || atrānnaṃ saṃpradāsyaṃti brāhmaṇebhyaḥ samā hitāḥ || sarvayajñaphalaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || asmindṛṣṭe surāḥ sarve dṛṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || evamuktvā surāḥ sarve jagmuścaiva surālayam|| 23 || atha kālena mahatā prāptā tatra sarasvatī || vaḍavāgniṃ samādāya tayānuplāvitaṃ punaḥ ||24|| tato medhyataraṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ ca varavarṇini || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret || 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaśāpānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāpañcāśaduttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 258 || || cha ||
<7.1.259>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi parṇādityaṃ sureśvaram || prācīsarasvatīkūle taṭe cottarataḥ sthitam|| 1 || purā tretāyuge devi parṇādonāma vai dvijaḥ || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam || ārādhayāmāsa raviṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 2 || tarpayitvā tataḥ sūryaṃ dhūpamālyavilepanaiḥ || vedoktaiḥ stavanaiḥ sūktairdivārātraṃ samāhitaḥ || 3 || evaṃ ca dhyāyatastasya kālena mahatā tataḥ || tutoṣa bhagavānsūryo vākyametaduvāca ha || 4 || parituṣṭo'smi viprendra tapasānena suvrata || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yanmanasepsitam|| 5 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || eṣa eva varaḥ kāmo yattuṣṭo bhagavānsvayam || darśanaṃ tava deveśa svapneṣvapi ca durllabham|| 6 || avaśyaṃ yadi dātavyo varo mama divākara || atra saṃnihato deva sadā tvaṃ bhava bhāskara || 7 || tava prasādātte yāṃtu tava lokaṃ divā kara || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyantardhānaṃ gato raviḥ || 8 || parṇādo'pi sthitastatra tasyārādhanatatparaḥ || tatra bhādrapade māse ṣaṣṭhyāṃ snānaṃ samācaret || parṇādityaṃ tataḥ paśyenna sa duḥkhamavāpnuyāt || 9 || gośatasya prayāge tu samyagdattasya yatphalam || tatphalaṃ labhate martyaḥ parṇādityasya darśanāt || 7.1.259.10 || ye sevaṃte mahākuṣṭhaṃ pāṃgulyaṃ ca vivarcikāḥ || parṇādityaṃ na jānaṃti nūnaṃ te maṃdabuddhayaḥ || 11 || iti śrīskānde mahapurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye parṇādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||259| || cha || ||
<7.1.260>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param || tasyaiva paścime bhāge siddhaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ purā ||1 || siddhā nāma surāḥ pūrvaṃ tatrāgatya varānane || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ siddhyarthaṃ sarvavastuṣu || 2|| tatastuṣṭo mahādevi teṣāṃ dṛṣṭvā tapo mahat || aṇimādikamaiśvaryaṃ teṣāṃ sarvaṃ dadau śivaḥ || 3 || abravīdatra me nityaṃ sānidhyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 4 || caitre śuklacaturddaśyāṃ yo'tra māṃ pūjayiṣyati || sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ prasādānmama puṇyakṛt || 5 || evamuktvā'tha bhagavāñjagāmādarśanaṃ tataḥ || siddhāścaiva tadā''gatya pūjayaṃti maheśvaram || 6 || yastamārādhayedbhaktyā saṃsiddhiṃ labhate'dbhutām|| īpsitāṃ ca suraśreṣṭhe tasmāttaṃ pūjayetsadā || 7 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 260 ||
<7.1.261>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yatra nyaṃkumatī nadī || maryādārthaṃ samānītā kṣetraśāṃtyai ca śaṃbhunā || 1 || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge sarvapāpapraṇāśinī || tasyāṃ snātvā ca vai samyagyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || sa pitṝṃstārayetsarvānnarakānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || vaiśākhe śuklapakṣe tu tṛtīyāyāṃ ca bhāmini || snātvā tu tarpayedbhaktyā tiladarbhajalaiḥ priye || śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ bhavettena gaṃgāyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 261 || || cha ||
<7.1.262>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi varāhaṃ tatra saṃsthitam || goṣpadāddakṣiṇe bhāge sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe yastaṃ pūjayate naraḥ || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairgacchedviṣṇupadaṃ mahat || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye varāhasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 262 || cha ||
<7.1.263>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi cchāyāliṃgamiti smṛtam || uttare nyaṃkumatyāśca bahvāścaryaṃ mahatphalam || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate paṃcapātakaiḥ || sārddhadvādaśahastaṃ tu yojanatritayena tu || na paśyaṃti mahādevi pāpiṣṭhā ye tu mānavāḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye chāyāliṃga māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 263 || || cha ||
<7.1.264>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitā devi guphā pātakanāśinī || ṛṣīṇāṃ saṃsthitiryatra siddhānāṃ puṇyacetasām || 1 || tatra gatvā mahādevi guphāṃ yaḥ paśyate naraḥ || sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyaścāṃdrāyaṇaphalaṃ labhet|| 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye naṃdinīguphāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥṣaṣṭyu ttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 264 || || cha ||
<7.1.265>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi aiśānyāṃ diśi saṃsthitām || devīṃ kanakanaṃdākhyāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām|| 1 || tatra śuklatṛtīyāyāṃ caitre māsi vidhānataḥ || yātrāṃ kuryācca matimānsarvakāmamavāpnuyāt || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kanakanaṃdāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| || 265 || || cha ||
<7.1.266>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kumbhīśvaramanuttamam || śarabhasthānataḥ pūrve nātidūre vyavasthitam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ ||1|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kuṃbhīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 266 ||
<7.1.267>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sthānaṃ gaṃgāpatheti ca || yatra gaṃgā mahāsrotā gaṃgeśvaraḥ śivastathā || 1 || samudragāminī devi sā gaṃgā pāpanāśinī || uttāneti bhuvi khyātā nadī trailokyabhūṣaṇā || 2 || tatra snātvā mahādevi gaṃgeśaṃ yastu pūjayet|| muktaḥ syātpātakairghorairaśvamedhāyutaṃ labhet|| 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṅgāpathagaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 267 ||
<7.1.268>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi camasodbhedamuttamam || yatra brahmā'karotsatraṃ varṣāṇāmayutaṃ priye || 1 || camasaiḥ pītavantaste somaṃ devā maharṣayaḥ || camasodbhedanāmeti tena khyātaṃ dharātale || 2 || tatra snātvā sarasvatyāṃ piṃḍadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ || gayākoṭiguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ vaiśākhyāṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye camasodbhedamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭaṣaṣṭyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||| 268 ||
<7.1.269>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vidurasyāśramaṃ mahat || yatrākarottapo raudraṃ viduro dharma mūrttimān || 1 || pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ liṃgaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||2|| vidurāṭṭālakaṃ nāma gaṇagaṃdharvasevitam || dvādaśasthānakaṃ sthānaṃ nālpapuṇyena labhyate || 3 || nāvarṣaṇaṃ bhavettatra kadācidapi pārvati || liṃgāni tatra divyāni paśyetpāpopaśāṃtaye || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye vidurāśrama māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||269|| || cha ||
<7.1.270>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi yatra prācī sarasvatī || tatra sthāne sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ maṃkīśvaramiti śrutam || 1 || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi sarvapātakanāśinīm || śṛṇu devi mahābhāge hyāścaryaṃ yadabhūtpurā || 2 || ṛṣirmaṃkaṇako nāma sa tepe paramaṃ tapaḥ || prācīmetya yatāhāro nityaṃ svādhyāyatatparaḥ|| 3 || bahuvarṣasahasrāṇi tasyātītāni bhāmini || kasyacittvatha kālasya viddhādasya varānane || 4 || karācchākaraso jātaḥ kuśāgreṇeti naḥ śrutam || sa taṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ||5|| mene siddhiṃ parāṃ prāpto harṣānnṛtyamathākarot || tasminsaṃnṛtyamāne ca jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || 6 || anarttata varārohe prabhāvāttasya vai muneḥ || tato devā maheṃdrādyā brahmaviṣṇupurassarāḥ || ūcustripurahaṃtāraṃ nāyaṃ nṛtyettathā kuru || 7 || calitāḥ parvatāḥ sthānātkṣubhito makarālayaḥ || dharaṇī khaṇḍaśo deva vṛkṣāśca nidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 8 || utpathāśca mahānadyo grahā unmārgasaṃsthitāḥ || trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ yāvatprāpnoti saṃkṣayam ||9|| tāvannivārayasvainaṃ nānyaḥ śakto nivāraṇe || 7.1.270.10 || sa tatheti pratijñāya gatvā tasya samīpataḥ || dvijarūpaṃ samāsthāya tamṛṣiṃ vākyamabravīt || 11 || ko harṣaviṣayaḥ kasmāttvayaitannṛtyate dvija || tasmātkāryaṃ vadāśu tvaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ dvijaḥ || 12 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || kiṃ na paśyasi me brahmankarācchākara saṃ cyutam|| ata eva hi me nṛtyaṃ siddho'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 13 || || īśvara uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ || aṃguṣṭhaṃ tāḍayāmāsa aṃgulyagreṇa bhāmini || 14 || tato vinirgataṃ bhasma tatkṣaṇāddhimapāṃḍuram || athābravītprahasyainaṃ bhagavānbhūtabhāvanaḥ || 15 || paśya meṃ'guṣṭhato brahmanbhūri bhasma vinirgatam || na nṛtye'haṃ na me harṣastathāpi munisattama || 16 || taddṛṣṭvā sumahāścaryaṃ vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || abravītprāṃjalirbhūtvā harṣagadgadayā girā || 17 || nānyaṃ devamahaṃ manye .tvāṃ muktvā vṛṣabhadhvajam || nānyasya vidyate śaktirīdṛśī dharaṇītale || 18 || || || bhagavānuvāca || || jñāto'smi muniśārdūla tvayā vedavidāṃ vara || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yanmanasepsitam || 19 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || prasādāddevadevasya nṛtyena mahatā vibho || yathā na syāttapohānistathā nītirvidhīyatām || 7.1.270.20 || || śaṃbhuruvāca || || tapaste varddhatāṃ vipra matprasādātsahasradhā || prācīmanviha vatsyāmi tvayā sārddhamahaṃ sadā || 21 || sarasvatī mahāpuṇyā kṣetre cāsminviśeṣataḥ || sarasvatyuttare tīre yastyajedātmanastanum || 22 || prācīne hyṛṣiśārdūla na cehāgacchate punaḥ || āpluto vājimedhasya phalaṃ prāpnoti puṣkalam || 23 || niyamaiścopa vāsaiśca śoṣayandehamātmanaḥ|| jalāhārā vāyubhakṣāḥ parṇāhārāśca tāpasāḥ || tathā ca sthaṃḍilaśayā ye cānye niyatāḥ pṛthak |||24|| ye snānamācariṣyaṃti tīrthe'sminniyamānvitāḥ || te yāṃti paramāṃ siddhiṃ brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ padam || 25 || asmiṃstīrthe tu yo dānaṃ truṭimātraṃ ca kāṃcanam || dadāti dvijamukhyāya merutulyaṃ bhavetphalam ||26|| asmiṃstīrthe tu ye śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃtīha mānavāḥ|| ekaviṃśatkulopetāḥ svargaṃ yāsyaṃti te dhruvam ||27|| pitṝṇāṃ vallabhaṃ tīrthaṃ piṃḍenaikena tarpitāḥ || brahmalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti suputreṇeha tāritāḥ || 28 || bhūyaścānnaṃ prayacchaṃti mokṣamārgaṃ vrajaṃti te || 29 || atra ye śubha karmāṇaḥ prabhāsasthāṃ sarasvatīm || paśyaṃti tepi yāsyaṃti svargalokaṃ dvijottamāḥ ||7.1.270.30|| ye punastatra bhāvena narāḥ snānaparāyaṇāḥ || brahmalokaṃ samāsādya te ramiṣyaṃti sarvadā || 31 || dadhi pradadyādyo'pīha brāhmaṇāya manoramam || so'pyagnilokamāsādya bhuṃkte bhogānsuśobhanān || 32 || ūrṇāprāvaraṇaṃ yo'pi bhaktyā dadyāddvijottame || so'pi yāti parāṃ siddhiṃ martyairanyaiḥ sudurlabhām || 33 || ye cātra malanāśāya viśeyurmānavā jalam || gopradānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ sukhena phalamādiśet || 34 || bhāvena hi naraḥ kaścittatra snānaṃ samācaret || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 35 || tarpaṇātpiṃḍadānācca narakeṣvapi saṃsthitāḥ || svargaṃ prayāṃti pitaraḥ suputreṇeha tāritāḥ || 36 || te labhaṃte'kṣayāṃllokā nbrahmaviṣṇvīśaśabditān || bhūyastvannaṃ prayacchanti mokṣamārgaṃ labhaṃti te || 37 || svarganiśreṇisaṃbhūtā prabhāse tu sarasvatī || nāpuṇyavadbhiḥ saṃprāptuṃ puṃbhiḥ śakyā mahānadī || 38 || prācī sarasvatī caiva anyatraiva tu durlabhā || viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetre prabhāse puṣkare tathā || 39 || prācīṃ sarasvatīṃ prāpya yonyattīrthaṃ hi mārgate || sa karasthaṃ samutsṛjya kūrpareṇa samācaret || 7.1.270.40 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ snānaṃ ca vihitaṃ sadā || piṇyākeṃgudakenāpi piṃḍaṃ tatra dadāti yaḥ || pitṝṇāmakṣayaṃ bhūyātpitṛlokaṃ sa gacchati || 41 || sarasvatīvāsasamā kuto ratiḥ sarasvatīvāsasamāḥ kuto guṇāḥ || sarasvatīṃ prāpya gatā divaṃ narāḥ punaḥ smariṣyaṃti nadīṃ sarasvatīm || 42 || || īśvara uvāca || || uktvaivaṃ bhagavāndevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || sāṃnidhyamakarottatra tataḥprabhṛti śaṃkaraḥ || 43 || atra gāthā purā gītā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || snehārdreṇa ca cittena dharmaputraṃ prati priye || 44 || mā gaṃgāṃ vraja kauṃteya mā prayāgaṃ ca puṣkaram || tatra gaccha kuruśreṣṭha yatra prācī sarasvatī || 45 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || māhātmyaṃ ca sarasvatyā bhūyaḥ kiṃ śrotumicchasi || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prācīsarasvatīmaṃkīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 270 || || cha || ||
<7.1.271>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva saṃnikṛṣṭe tu liṃgaṃ jvāleśvaraṃ smṛtam || śaraḥ pāśupato yatra jvalanvai tripurāriṇā || 1 || pātito yatpradeśe tu tena jvāleśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye jvāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 271 ||
<7.1.272>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyetprācī devyāstu saṃnidhau|| liṃgatrayaṃ samākhyātaṃ tripurāṇāṃ mahātmanām ||1|| vidyunmālī tārakākhyaḥ kapolākhyastathaiva ca || taiśca pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate ||2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye tripuraliṃgatrayamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||272||
<7.1.273>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi śaṃḍatīrthamanuttamam || sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 1 || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇuṣvaikamanāḥ priye || purā paṃcaśirā āsīdbrahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || 2 || śirastasya mayā chinnaṃ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || tatra gaṃdhavatī jātā brahmaṇaḥ sā ca śoṇitaiḥ || 3 || tatrodgatā mahātālāstena tālavanaṃ smṛtam || atha karatale lagnaṃ kapālaṃ brahmaṇo mama || 4 || śarīraṃ kṛṣṇatāṃ yātaṃ mama caiva vṛṣasya ca || atha tīrthānyanekāni gatohaṃ pāpaśaṃkayā || 5 || na kvacidvrajate pāpaṃ tataḥ prabhāsamāgataḥ || kṣetre tatra mayā dṛṣṭā prācī devī sarasvatī || 6 || tatra me vṛṣabhaḥ snātuṃ praviṣṭo jalamadhyataḥ || tatkṣaṇācchvetatā prāpto muktohamapi hatyayā || 7 || karamadhye ca me lagnaṃ kapālaṃ patitaṃ tadā || kapālamocanaścāsau liṃgarūpī sthito'bhavat || 8 || tatrāpi yo dadecchrāddhaṃ prācīdevyāstu saṃnidhau || mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ caiva tṛptaṃ kulaśataṃ tathā || 9 || bhavecca tasya tṛptistu yāvatkalpāstu saptatiḥ || māsa āśvayuje devi kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī || tatra dadyāttu yaḥ śrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāmūrtimāśritaḥ || 7.1.273.10 || yathāvittopacāreṇa supātre ca yathāvidhi || yāvadyugasahasraṃ tu tṛptāḥ syuste pitāmahāḥ || 11 || annasuvarṇadānaṃ ca dadhikaṃbalameva ca || tatra deyaṃ vidhānena sarvapāpopaśuddhaye || 12 || kṛṣṇarūpī vṛṣo devi yadā śvetatvamāgataḥ || śaṃḍatīrthamitikhyātaṃ tena trailokyapūjitam || 13 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃḍatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trisaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 273 || || cha ||
<7.1.274>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sūryaprācīṃ mahāprabhām || sarvapāpopaśamanīṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām || 1 || tatra snātvā mahādevi mucyate pañcapātakaiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sūryaprācīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsapta tyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 274 ||
<7.1.275>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ caiva trilocanam || ṛṣitīrthasamīpe tu sarvapātakanāśanam || nyaṅkumatyuttare kūla ṛṣibhiḥ pūjitaṃ purā || 1 || trinetrā matsyakā yatra jalaṃ sphaṭikasannibham || tatra snātvā naro devi mucyate brahmahatyayā || 2 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ māse bhādrapade tathā || upavāsaṃ tu kurvīta rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || 3 || prātaḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta vidhivatpūjayecchivam || rudraloke vaseddevi varṣāṇāmayutatrayam || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye trinetreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 275 ||
<7.1.276>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ṛṣitīrthasya sannidhau || kāmikaṃ hi paraṃ kṣetraṃ devikānāma nāmataḥ || 1 || mahāsiddhivanaṃ tatra ṛṣisiddhasamāvṛtam || nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ parvatairupaśobhitam|| 2 || caṃpakairbakulairdivyairaśokaiḥ stabakaiḥ paraiḥ || punnāgaiḥ kiṃkirātaiśca sugandhairnāgakesaraiḥ || 3 || mallikotpalapuṣpaiśca pāṭalāpārijātakaiḥ || cūtacaṃpakapitthaiśca śrīphalaiḥ panasaistathā || 4 || kharjūrairbadaraiścānyairmātuliṃgaiḥ sadāḍimaiḥ || jaṃbīraiścaiva divyaiśca nāraṃgairupa śobhitam|| 5 || śikhibhiḥ kokilābhiśca gīyamānaṃ tu ṣaṭpadaiḥ || mṛgairṛkṣairvarāhaiśca siṃhairvyāghraistathā paraiḥ || 6 || śvāpadairvividhākāraiḥ kandarai rgahvaraistathā || surāsuragaṇaiḥ siddhairyakṣagandharvapannagaiḥ || 7 || apsaroraganāgaiśca bahubhistu samākulam || kecitstuvaṃti īśaṃ tu kecinnṛtyaṃti cāgrataḥ || 8 || puṣpairvṛṣṭiṃ tu muñcaṃti mukhavādyāni cāpare || hasaṃti cāpare hṛṣṭā garjaṃti ca tathāpare || 9 || ūrddhvabāhavastathā cānye anye dhyāyaṃti tadgatāḥ || tasminsthānaṃ mahādevi devikāyāstaṭe śubhe || 7.1.276.10 || umāpatīśvaro nāma tatrāhaṃ saṃsthitaḥ sadā || yugeyuge sadā pūrṇe kalpe manvantare tathā || 11 || na tyajāmi sadā devi devikāyāstaṭaṃ śubham || durllabhaṃ sarvaloke'sminpavitraṃ supriyaṃ hi me || 12 || tvayā saha sthitaścāhaṃ tasmi nsthāne varānane || umayā yuktadehatvāttena khyātaṃ umāpatiḥ || 13 || puṣyamāse tvamāvasyāṃ dadyācchrāddhaṃ samāhitaḥ || na paśyāmi kṣayaṃ tasya tasmindattasya pārvati || 14 || brahmahatyāsahasraṃ tu tasya darśanato vrajet || gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi tatra dadyādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 15 || sa ekaḥ paramaḥ putro yo gatvā tatra sundari || dadecchrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca tasyāṃto naiva vidyate || 16 || devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samāhūtā snānārthaṃ sā saridvarā || deviketi samākhyātā tena sā pāpanāśinī || 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāyāmumāpatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭsaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 276 || || cha || ||
<7.1.277>
tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ paśyedbhūdharaṃnāma nāmataḥ || uddhṛtya pṛthivīṃ yasmāddaṃṣṭrāgreṇa dadhāra saḥ || 1 || bhūdharastena cākhyāto devikātaṭasaṃsthitaḥ || vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudantaḥ srucīmukhaḥ || 2 || agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣo mahātapāḥ || ahorātrekṣaṇaparo vedāṃgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ || 3 || ādyanāsaḥ sruvatuṃḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān || prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimā nnānādīkṣāvirājitaḥ || 4 || dakṣiṇāhṛdayo yogī mahāsatraśayo mahān || upākarmoṣṭharucakaḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ || 5 || nānācchandogatipatho brahmoktakramavikramaḥ || bhūtvā yajñavarāho'sau tatra sthāne sthito'bhavat || 6 || puṣyamāse hyamāvāsyāmekādaśyāmathāpi vā || prāpte prāvṛṣi kāle ca jñātvā kanyāgataṃ ravim || 7 || pāyasaṃ guḍasaṃyuktaṃ haviṣyaṃ ca guḍaplutam || namo vaḥ pitaro rasāya annādyamabhimaṃtrayet || 8 || tejo'siśukramityājyaṃ dadhikrāvṇena vai dadhi || kṣīramājyāya mantreṇa vyañjanāni ca yāni tu || 9 || bhakṣyabhojyāni sarvāṇi mahānindreṇa dāpayet || saṃvatsa roniyo maṃtraṃ japtvā tenodakaṃ dvijaḥ || 7.1.277.10 || evaṃ saṃbhojya vai viprānpiṇḍadānaṃ tu dāpayet || ityanena vidhānena yastatra śrāddhakṛdbhavet ||11|| tasya tṛptāstu pitaro yāvadiṃdrāścaturddaśa || gayāśrāddhaṃ vināpīha gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet||12|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmye bhūdharayajñavarāhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptasaptatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||277||
<7.1.278>
||īśvara uvāca|||| tato gacchenmahādevi śūlasthānamiti śrutam|| devikāyāstaṭe ramye bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram || 1 || yatrātapattapo ghoraṃ vālmīkirmunipuṃgavaḥ || vālmīkināmā viprarṣiryatra siddho mahāmuniḥ || 2 || yatra saptarṣayo muṣṭāstenaiva muninā priye || tasyaiva paścime bhāge marīcipramukhā dvijāḥ || 3 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ tu siddho vālmīkiḥ kathaṃ caurye'karonmanaḥ || kathaṃ saptarṣayo muṣṭā etanme vada śaṃkara || 4 || || īśvara uvāca|| || āsītpūrvaṃ dvijo devi nāmnā khyātaḥ śamīmukhaḥ || gārhasthye vartamānasya tasya putro vyajāyata || vaiśākha iti nāmnā'sau raudrakarmā vyajāyata || 5 || muktvaikāṃ guruśuśrūṣāṃ nānyatkiṃcidasau dvijaḥ || akarocchobhanaṃ karma divāprabhṛti nityaśaḥ || 6 || atha kālena mahatā pitarau tasya tau priye || vārddhakyabhāvamāpannau bhartavyau tasya vihvalau || 7 || sa nityaṃ padavīṃ gatvā muṣṭvā lokānsvaśaktitaḥ || dravyamādāya pitarau bhāryāṃ cāpi pupoṣa ca || 8 || kasyacittvatha kālasya tena mārgeṇa gacchataḥ || saptarṣīṃśca tadāpaśyattīrthayātrāparāyaṇān || 9 || tāndṛṣṭvā yaṣṭimudyamya bhartsayanpa ruṣākṣaraiḥ || vākyairuvāca tānsarvāṃstiṣṭhadhvamiti bhūriśaḥ || 7.1.278.10 || atha te munayaḥ śāṃtāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ || samāḥ śatrau ca mitre ca roṣarāgavivarjitāḥ || 11 || asmākaṃ darśanaṃ cāsya saṃbhāṣyamṛṣibhiḥ saha || saṃjātaṃ niṣphalaṃ mā syādityuvācāṃgirā vacaḥ || 12 || || || aṃgirā uvāca || || bhobhostaskara me vākyaṃ śṛṇuṣvāvahitaḥ kṣaṇāt || ātmanastu hitārthāya satyaṃ caiva vadāmyaham || tava kaḥ poṣyavargo'sti tacca sarvaṃ vadasva me || 13 || || taskara uvāca || || syātāṃ me pitarau vṛddhau bhāryaikā'patyavarjjitā || ekā dāsī hyahaṃ ṣaṣṭho nānyadastyadhikaṃ mune || 14 || || aṃgirā uvāca || || gatvā pṛcchasva tānsarvānpuṣṭānpāpārjitairdhanaiḥ|| ahaṃ karomi pāpāni sarve yūyaṃ tu bhakṣakāḥ ||15|| tatpāpaṃ bhavitā kasya kathayaṃtviti me laghu || tathaiva gatvā papraccha pitarau tāvathocatuḥ ||16|| || mātāpitarāvūcatuḥ|| || ekaḥ pāpāni kurute phalaṃ bhuṃkte mahā janaḥ || bhoktāro vipramucyaṃte kartā doṣeṇa lipyate ||17|| yaḥ karotyaśubhaṃ karma kuṭuṃbārthaṃ tu maṃdadhīḥ|| ātmā na vallabhastasya nūnaṃ puṃsaḥ supāpinaḥ || 18 || || īśvara uvāca || || tayoḥ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā punarbhītamanāstadā || tayostu saṃnatiṃ kṛtvā pitarau punarabravīt|| 19 || yuvābhyāṃ hitamevāhaṃ yatkaromyaśubhaṃ kvacit || tasyāṃśaṃ bhujyate kiṃcidyuvābhyāṃ vā na vocyatām ||7.1.278.20|| || pitarāvūcatuḥ || || pūrve vayasi putra tvamāvābhyāṃ pālya eva hi || uttare tu vayaṃ pālyāḥ samyakputra tvayā punaḥ || 21 || itaretaradharmo'yaṃ nirdiṣṭaḥ padmayoninā || āvābhyāṃ yatkṛtaṃ karma yuṣmadarthaṃ śubhāśubham || bhokṣyāmo vayameveha tatsarvaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || |22 || atha tvamapi yadvatsa prakaroṣi śubhāśubham || bhokṣyase sakalaṃ tadvatsvayaṃ nānyaḥ paratra ca ||23|| avaśyaṃ svayamaśnāti kṛtaṃ karma śubhāśubham| tasmānnareṇa kartavyaṃ śubhaṃ karma vipaścitā || 24 || cauryaṃ vātha kṛṣiṃ vātha kusīdaṃ vātha putraka || vāṇijyamathavā preṣyaṃ kṛtvā'smākaṃ ca bhojanam || aharniśaṃ tvayā deyaṃ na doṣo'smāsu putraka || 25 || tābhyāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato bhāryāmabhāṣata | tadeva vākyaṃ sā'vocadyatproktaṃ gurubhiḥ purā || tato vairāgyamāpanno vaiśākho munisattamaḥ || 26 || garhayannevamātmānaṃ bhūyobhūyaḥ suduḥkhitaḥ || dhiṅmāṃ duṣkṛtakarmāṇaṃ pāpakarmarataṃ sadā || 27 || vivekena parityaktaṃ satsaṃgena vivarjitam || yaḥ karoti naraḥ pāpaṃ na sevayati paṃḍitān || na cātmā vallabhastasya etanme vartate hṛdi || 28 || evaṃ vikalpahṛdayo gatvā sa ṛṣisannidhau || uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā gamyatāmiti sādaram || || 29 || vṛsī pragṛhyatāmeṣā tathaiva ca kamaṇḍaluḥ || valkalāni ca cīrāṇi mṛgacarmāṇyaśeṣataḥ || 7.1.278.30 || kṣamyatāmaparādho me dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca || satsaṃgena viyuktasya mūrkhasya munisattamāḥ || 31 || adyaprabhṛti nivṛttaḥ karmaṇo'syāhameva ca || raudrasya sunṛśaṃsasya sādhubhirgarhitasya ca || tasmātkathayatāsmākaṃ nivṛttiṃ cāsya karmaṇaḥ||32|| yena yuṣmatprasādena pāpānmokṣamahaṃ vraje|| upavāso'tha mantro vā niyamo vātha saṃyamaḥ||33|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā vatsa tattvamekamanāḥ śṛṇu|| saṃgṛhya kīrtayiṣyāmastvayā''khyeyaṃ na kasyacit||34|| tena japtena pāpatmanmokṣaṃ prāpsyasi niścitam|| jhāṭaghoṭastvayā kīrttyo mantro'yaṃ caturakṣaraḥ||35|| sarvapāpaharo nṛṇāṃ svargamokṣaphalapradaḥ|| sa tadaivaṃ hi taiḥ prokto vaiśākho munipuṃgavaiḥ || tasthau jāpyaparo nityaṃ gatāste munipuṃgavāḥ || 36 || tasyaivaṃ japato devi devikāyāstaṭe śubhe || aniśaṃ guru bhaktasya samādhiḥ samapadyata || 37 || kṣutpipāsā tadā naṣṭā śuddhimāyātkalevaram || 38 || maṃtre tīrthe dvije deve daivajñe bheṣaje gurau || yādṛśī bhāva nā yasya siddhirbhavati tādṛśī || 39 || nirmalo'yaṃ svabhāvena paramātmā yathā hitaḥ || upādhisaṃgamāsādya vikāraṃ sphaṭiko yathā|| 7.1.278.40 || yathā ca bhramarī vaṃdhyā labdhvā jīvamaṇuṃ kvacit || svasthāne sthāpya taṃ dhyāyedbhramarī dhyānasaṃyutā || 41 || sa tu taddhyānasaṃvṛddho jīvo bhavati tādṛśaḥ || anyayonyudbhavo vāpi tathā nidarśanaṃ satām||42|| ādiṣṭo guruṇā yaśca vikalpaṃ yadi gacchati|| nāsau siddhimavāpnoti maṃdabhāgyo yathā nidhim|| 43 || evaṃ varṣasahasrāṇi samatītāni bhūriśaḥ|| tasya jāpyaparasyaiva amṛtatvaṃ gatasya ca || 44 || tataḥ kālakrameṇaiva valmīkena sa veṣṭitaḥ || yenāsau sarvato vyāpto na ca taṃ sa bubodha vai || 45 || kasyacittvathakālasya munayaste samāgatāḥ || taṃ pradeśaṃ tu saṃprekṣya sahāyyamitaretaram|| ūcuḥ parasparaṃ sarve dattvā caiva karaiḥ karam ||46|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || atrāsau taskaraḥ prāpto vaiśākho dāruṇākṛtiḥ || yena sarve vayaṃ muṣṭā asmi nsthāne samāgatāḥ || 47 || evaṃ saṃjalpamānāste śuśruvuḥ śabdamuttamam || valmīkamadhyato vyaktaṃ tataste kautukānvitāḥ || 48 || akhanaṃstatra valmīkaṃ kuśībhiḥ parvatopamam || 49 || atha te dadṛśustatra viśākhaṃ munisattamāḥ || japaṃtamasakṛnmatraṃ tameva caturakṣaram || 7.1.278.50 || taṃ samādhigataṃ jñātvā bheṣajairyogasaṃmataiḥ || mamarduḥ sarvato viprāstatra suptatanau bhṛśam || 51 || tato'bravīdṛṣrīnsarvānsvamarthaṃ gṛhyatāṃ dvijāḥ || yuṣmadīyaṃ gṛhītaṃ yatpā penākṛtabuddhinā || 52 || gamyatāṃ tīrthayātrāyāṃ sarve muktā mayā dvijāḥ || vācyau me pitarau gatvā tathā bhāryā dvijottamāḥ || 53 || sarva saṃgaparityakto viśākhaḥ samapadyata || darśanaṃ kāṃkṣate naiva bhavadbhistu yathā purā || 54 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bahuvarṣāṇyatītāni tavātra vasato mune || sarve te nidhanaṃ prāptā ye cānye te kuṭuṃbinaḥ || 55 || vayaṃ cirātsamāyātāḥ sthāne'sminmunisattamāḥ || sa tvaṃ siddhimanuprāpto maṃtrādasmādasaṃśayam || 56 || yasmāttvaṃ maṃtramekāgro dhyāyanvalmīkamāśritaḥ || tasmādvālmīkināmā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi mahītale || 57 || svacchaṃdā bhāratī devī jihvāgre te bhaviṣyati || kṛtvā rāmāyaṇaṃ kāvyaṃ tato mokṣaṃ gamiṣyasi|| 58 || viśākha uvāca || || gṛhyatāṃ dvijaśārdūlāḥ prasannā gurudakṣiṇām|| yenāhamanṛṇo bhūtvā karomi sumahattapaḥ || 59 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || eṣā no dakṣiṇā vipra yastvaṃ siddhimupāgataḥ || sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā kṛtakṛtyā vayaṃ mune || 7.1.278.60 || varaṃ varaya bhūyastvaṃ yaste manasi vartate || 61 || || vālmīkiruvāca || || bhavaṃto yadi tuṣṭā me yadi deyo varo mama || kathyatāṃ tarhi me śīghraṃ ko devo hyatra saṃsthitaḥ || devikāyāstaṭe ramye sarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 62 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || śṛṇuṣvaikamanā vipra yo devaścātra saṃsthitaḥ || paśya niṃbamimaṃ vipra bahuśākhāpravistaram || 63 || asya mūle sthitaḥ sūryyaḥ kalpādau brahmaṇoṃ'śajaḥ || tamārādhaya yattesāvasya sthānasya devatā || 64 || sūryakṣetraṃ samākhyātamidaṃ gavyūtimātrakam || atra sthāne sthitā yepi teṣāṃ svargo dhruvaṃ bhavet || 65 || adyaprabhṛti viprendra mūlasthānamiti śrutam || sthānaṃ sūryasya viprendra kāryā cātra tvayā sthitiḥ || || 66 || adyaprabhṛti vipreṃdra tīrthametanmahītale || gamiṣyati parāṃ khyātiṃ devikātaṭamāśritam || 67 || vayaṃ muṣṭā yato vipra mūlasthāne purā sthitāḥ || mūlasthāneti vai nāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 68 || atra ye mānavā bhaktyā snānaṃ sūryasya saṃgame || uttare tu kariṣyaṃti te yāsyaṃti triviṣṭapam || 69 || tarpaṇaṃ tilamiśreṇa jalena dvijasattamāḥ || gayāśrāddhasamā tuṣṭiḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 7.1.278.70 || atra ye mānavā bhaktyā śrāddhaṃ dāsyaṃti sattamāḥ || śākamūlaphalairvāpi samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ || 71 || teṣāṃ yāsyaṃti pitaro mokṣaṃ naivātra saṃśayaḥ || 72 | api kīṭapataṃgā ye pakṣiṇaḥ paśavo mṛgāḥ || tṛṣārtā jalasaṃsparśādyāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || 73 || vayameva sadātrasthāḥ śrāvaṇe māsi sattama || paurṇamāsyāṃ bhaviṣyāmastava snehādasaṃśayam || 74 || tasminnahani yastoyaiḥ pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati || tasyāṣṭādaśakuṣṭhāni kṣayaṃ yāsyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt || 75 || kapālodumbarākhyeṃdramaṇḍalākhyavicarcikāḥ || ṛṣyacarmaikakiṭibhasidhmālasavipādikāḥ || 76 || dadrusitā rucisphoṭaṃ puṇḍarīkaṃ sakākaṇam || pāmā carmadalaṃ ceti kuṣṭhānyaṣṭādaśaiva tu || 77 || gamiṣyaṃti na saṃdeha ityuktvāṃtardadhuśca te || ṛṣiḥ siṣeve ca raviṃ cakre rāmāyaṇaṃ tataḥ || 78 || tasmātpaśyecca taṃ devaṃ sarvayajñaphalapradam || śṛṇuyācca kathāṃ caināṃ sarvapātakanāśinīm || 79 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmyamūlasthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭasaptatyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||278||
<7.1.279>
|| īśvara uvāca || tato gacchenmahādevi cyavanārkamanuttamam || hiraṇyāpūrvabhāgasthaṃ cyavanena pratiṣṭhitam||1|| sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ pūjitaṃ vidhivannaraiḥ || saptamyāṃ ca vidhānena yaḥ stoṣyati raviṃ naraḥ || 2 || aṣṭottaraśatairnāmnāṃ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || śṛṇu tāni mahādevi śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ || 3 || kṣaṇaṃ tvaṃ kuru deveśi sarvaṃ vakṣyāmyaśeṣataḥ || dhaumyena tu yathāpūrvaṃ pārthāya sumahātmane || 4 || nāmāṣṭaśatamākhyātaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva mahāmate || sūryo'ryamā bhagastvaṣṭā pūṣā'rkaḥ savitā raviḥ || 5 || gabhastimānajaḥ kālo mṛtyurddhātā prabhākaraḥ || pṛthivyāpaśca tejaśca khaṃ vāyuśca parāyaṇaḥ || 6 || somo bṛhaspatiḥ śukro budhoṃ'gāraka eva ca || indro vivasvāndīptāṃśuḥ śuciḥ sauriḥ śanaiścaraḥ || || 7 || brahmā rudraśca viṣṇuśca skando vaiśravaṇo yamaḥ || vaidyuto jāṭharaścāgniriṃdhanastejasāṃ patiḥ || 8 || dharmadhvajo vedakarttā vedāṃgo vedavāhanaḥ || kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaśca kaliḥ sarvāmarāśrayaḥ || 9 || kalākāṣṭhāmuhūrttāśca pakṣā māsā aharniśāḥ || saṃvatsarakaro'śvasthaḥ kālacakro vibhāvasuḥ || 7.1.279.10 || puruṣaḥ śāśvato yogī vyaktāvyaktaḥ sanātanaḥ || lokādhyakṣaḥ prajādhyakṣo viśvakarmā tamonudaḥ ||11|| varuṇaḥ sāgaroṃśuśca jīvanto jīvano'rihā || bhūtāśrayo bhūtapatiḥ sarvabhūtaniṣevitaḥ || 12 || sraṣṭā saṃvarttako vahniḥ sarvasyādikaro'malaḥ || anaṃtaḥ kapilo bhānuḥ kāmadaḥ sarvatomukhaḥ || 13 || jayo viṣādo varadaḥ sarvadhātuniṣevitaḥ || samaḥ suvarṇo bhūtādiḥ śīghragaḥ prāṇadhārakaḥ || 14 || dhanvaṃtarirdhūmaketurādidevo'diteḥ sutaḥ|| dvādaśātmā'raviṃdākṣaḥ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ ||15|| svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam || dehakarttā praśāṃtātmā viśvātmā viśvatomukhaḥ || carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā maitreṇa vapuṣā'nvitaḥ || 15 || etadvai kīrtanīyasya sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ || nāmnāmaṣṭottaraśataṃ proktaṃ śakreṇa dhīmatā || 17 || śakrācca nāradaḥ prāpto dhaumyastu tadanantaram || dhaumyādyudhiṣṭhiraḥ prāpya sarvānkāmānavāptavān || 18 || etāni kīrtanīyasya sūryasyāmitatejasaḥ || nāmāni yaḥ paṭhennityaṃ sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 19 || surapitṛmanujayakṣasevitamasuraniśācarasiddhavaṃditam || varakanakahutāśanaprabhaṃ tvamapi nama hitāya bhāskaram || 7.1.279.20 || sūryodaye yastu samāhitaḥ paṭhetsa putralābhaṃ dhanaratnasaṃcayān || labheta jātismaratāṃ sadā naraḥ smṛtiṃ ca medhāṃ ca sa viṃdate pumān |||| 21|| imaṃ stavaṃ devavarasya yo naraḥ prakīrttayecchuddhamanāḥ samāhitaḥ || sa mucyate śokadavāgnisārāllabheta kāmānmanasā yathepsitān ||22|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavanādityamāhātmyasūryāṣṭottaraśatanāma māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 279||
<7.1.280>
īśvara uvāca|| tato gacchenmahādevi cyavaneśvaramuttamam|| tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || yatra śaryātinā dattā sukanyā sā maharṣaye || yatra saṃstaṃbhitaṃ sainyamānāhārttamathākarot || 2 ||| (ānāhajaṭhara ādhmānam) eṣa śaryātiyajñasya deśo devi prakāśate || prabhāsakṣetramadhye tu sākṣātpātakanāśanaḥ || 3 || sākṣāttatrābhajatsomamaśvibhyāṃ saha kauśikaḥ || cukopa bhārgavaścaiva mahendrāya mahātapāḥ || 4 || saṃstaṃbhayāmāsa ca taṃ vāsavaṃ cyavanaḥ prabhuḥ || sukanyāṃ cāpi bhāryāṃ sa rājaputrīmavāptavān || 5 || || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ viṣṭaṃbhitastena bhagavānpākaśāsanaḥ || kimarthaṃ bhārgavaścāpi kopaṃ cakre mahātapāḥ || 6 || nāsatyau ca kathaṃ brahmankṛ tavānsomapāyinau || tatsarvaṃ ca yathāvṛttamākhyātu bhagavānmama || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || bhṛgormaharṣeḥ putro'bhūccyavano nāma nāmataḥ || sa prabhāsaṃ samāsādya tapastepe mahāmuniḥ || 8 || sthāṇubhūto mahātejā vīrasthāne ca bhāmini || atiṣṭhatsuciraṃ kālamekadeśe varānane || 9 || sa valmīko'bhavattatra latābhirabhisaṃvṛtaḥ || kālena mahatā devi samākīrṇaḥ pipīlakaiḥ || 7.1.280.10 || sa tathā saṃvṛto dhīmānmṛtpiṃḍa iva sarvataḥ || tapyate sma tapo ghoraṃ valmīkena samāvṛtaḥ || 11 || athāsya yātakālasya śaryātirnāma pārthivaḥ || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena śrīsomeśadidṛkṣayā || ājagāma mahākṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam || 12 || tasya strīṇāṃ sahasrāṇi catvāryāsanparigrahāḥ || ekaiva tu sutā śubhrā sukanyānāma nāmataḥ || || 13 || sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā || caṃkramyamāṇā valmīkaṃ bhārgavasya samāsadat || 14 || sā caiva sudatī tatra paśyamānā manoramān || vanaspatīnvicinvaṃtī vijahāra sakhīvṛtā || 15 || rūpeṇa vayasā caiva surāpānamadena ca || babhaṃja vanavṛkṣāṇāṃ śākhāḥ parama puṣpitāḥ || 16 || tāṃ sakhīrahitāmekāmekavastrāmalaṃkṛtām || dadarśa bhārgavo dhīmāṃścaraṃtīmiva vidyutam || 17 || tāṃ paśyamāno vijane sa reme paramadyutiḥ || kṣāmakaṇṭhaśca brahmarṣistapobalasamanvitaḥ || 18 || tāmabhāṣata kalyāṇīṃ sā cāsya na śṛṇoti vai || tataḥ sukanyā valmīke dṛṣṭvā bhārgavacakṣuṣī || 19 || kautūhalātkaṇṭakena buddhimohabalātkṛtā || kinnu khalvidamityuktvā nirbibhedāsya locane || 7.1.280.20 || akudhyatsa tayā viddho netre paramamanyumān || tataḥ śaryātisainyasya śakṛnmūtre samāvṛṇot || 21 || tato ruddhe śakṛnmūtre sainyamānāhaduḥkhitam || tathāgatamabhibhekṣya paryatapyata pārthivaḥ || 22 || taponityasya vṛddhasya roṣaṇasya viśeṣataḥ || kenāpakṛtamadyeha bhārgavasya mahātmanaḥ || jñātaṃ vā yadi vā'jñātaṃ tadidaṃ brūta mā ciram|| 23 || tatrocuḥ sainikāḥ sarve na vidmo'pakṛtaṃ vayam || sarvopāyairyathākāmaṃ bhavānsamadhigacchatu || 24 || tataḥ sa pṛthivīpālaḥ sāmnā cogreṇa ca svayam || paryapṛcchatsuhṛdvargaṃ pratyajānanna caiva te || 25 || ānāhārttaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā tatsainyaṃ saṃmukhoditam|| pitaraṃ duḥkhitaṃ cāpi sukanyaivamathābravīt || 26 || mayā tāteha valmīke dṛṣṭaṃ sarvamabhijvalat || uddyotavadavijñānāttanmayā viddhamantikāt || 27 || etacchrutvā tu śaryāti rvalmīkaṃ kṣipramabhyagāt|| tatrāpaśyattapovṛddhaṃ vayovṛddhaṃ ca bhārgavam || 28 || athāvadatsvasainyārthaṃ prāṃjaliḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || ajñānādbālayā yatte kṛtaṃ tatkṣaṃtumarhasi || 29 || tato'bravīnmahīpālaṃ cyavano bhārgavastadā || rūpaudāryasamāyuktāṃ lobhamohasamāvṛtām || 7.1.280.30 || tāmeva pratigṛhyāhaṃ rājanduhitaraṃ tava || kṣamiṣyāmi mahīpāla satyametadbravīmi te || 31 || || īśvara uvāca || || ṛṣervacanamājñāya śaryātiravicārayan|| dadau duhitaraṃ tasmai cyavanāya mahātmane || 32 || pratigṛhya ca tāṃ kanyāṃ bhagavānprasasāda ha || prāpte prasāde rājā tu sasainyaḥ puramāvrajat || 33 || sukanyāpi patiṃ labdhvā tapasvinamaninditam || nityaṃ paryacaratprītyā tapasā niyamena ca || 34 || agnīnāmatithīnāṃ ca śuśrūṣuranasūyayā || samārādhayata kṣipraṃ cyavanaṃ sā śubhānanā || 35 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsa kṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 280 || || cha ||
<7.1.281>
|| īśvara uvāca || || kasyacittvatha kālasya tridaśāvaśvinau priye || kṛtābhiṣekāṃ vivṛtāṃ sukanyāṃ tāmapaśyatām || 1 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā darśanīyāṃgīṃ devarājasutāmiva || ūcatuḥ samabhidrutya nāsatyāvaśvināvatha || 2 || kasya tvamasi vāmoru kiṃ vane'smiṃścikīrṣasi|| icchāvastvāṃ ca vijñātuṃ tattvamākhyāhi śobhane || 3 || tataḥ sukanyā saṃvītā tāvuvāca surottamau || śaryātitanayāṃ vittaṃ bhāryāṃ ca cyavanasya mām || 4 || tato'śvinau prahasyaināmabrūtāṃ punareva tu || kathaṃ tvaṃ ca viditvā tu pitrā dattā''gatā vane || 5 || bhrājase gaganoddeśe vidyutsaudāmanī yathā || na deveṣvapi tulyāṃ hi tava paśyāva bhāmini || 6 || sarvābharaṇasaṃpannā paramāṃbaradhāriṇī || māmaivamanavadyāṃgi tyajainamavivekinam || 7 || kasmādevaṃvidhā bhūtvā jarājarjaritaṃ bhuvi || tvamupāsye hi kalyāṇi kāmabhāvabahiṣkṛtam || 8 || asamarthaṃ paritrāṇe poṣaṇe vā śucismite || sā tvaṃ cyavanamutsṛjya varayasvaikamāvayoḥ || 9 || patyarthaṃ devagarbhābhe mā vṛthā yauvanaṃ kṛthāḥ || evamuktā sukanyā sā surau tāvidamabravīt ||7.1.281.10 || ratā'haṃ cyavane patyau na caivaṃ pariśaṃkatam || tāvabrūtāṃ punaścaitāmāvāṃ devabhiṣagvarau || 11 || yuvānaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ kariṣyāvaḥ patiṃ tava || tatastasyāvayoścaiva patimekatamaṃ vṛṇu || 12 || etena samayenāvāṃ śamaṃ naya sumadhyame || sā tayorvacanāddevi upasaṃgamya bhārgavam || uvāca vākyaṃ yattābhyāmuktaṃ bhṛgusutaṃ prati || 13 || tadvākyaṃ cyavano bhāryāmuvācādriyatāmiti || ityuktā cyavanenātha sukanyā tāvuvāca vai || 14 || evaṃ devau bhavadbhyāṃ yatproktaṃ tatkiyatāṃ laghu || ityuktau bhiṣajau tatra tayā caiva sukanyayā || ūcatū rājaputrīṃ tāṃ patistava viśatvapaḥ || 15 || tato'paścyavanaḥ śīghraṃ rūpārthī praviveśa ha || aśvināvapi taddevi tataḥ prāviśatāṃ jalam || 16 || tato muhūrttāduttīrṇāḥ sarve te sarasastataḥ || divyarūpadharāḥ sarve yuvāno mṛṣṭakuṇḍalāḥ || 17 || divyaveṣadharāścaiva manasaḥ prītivarddhanāḥ || te'bruvansahitāḥ sarve vṛṇīṣvānyatamaṃ śubhe || 18 || asmākamīpsitaṃ bhadre yatastvaṃ varavarṇinī || yatra vāpyabhi kāmāsi taṃ vṛṇīṣva suśobhane || 19 || sā samīkṣya tu tānsarvāṃstulyarūpadharānsthitān || niścitya manasā buddhyā devi vavre patiṃ svakam || 7.1.281.20 || labdhvā tu cyavano bhāryāṃ vayorūpamavasthitaḥ || hṛṣṭo'bravīnmahātejāstau nāsatyāvidaṃ vacaḥ || 21 || yadahaṃ rūpasaṃpanno vayasā ca samanvitaḥ || kṛto bhavadbhyāṃ vṛddhaḥ sanbhāryāṃ ca prāptavānnijām || tadbrūtaṃ vai vidhāsyāmi bhavatoryadabhīpsitam || 22 || || aśvināvūcatuḥ || || āvāṃ tu devabhiṣajau na ca śakraḥ karoti nau || somapānārhatāṃ tasmātkuru nau somapāyinau || 23 || || cyavana uvāca || || ahaṃ vāṃ yajñabhāgārhau kariṣye somapāyinau || 24 || || īśvara uvāca || || tatastau hṛṣṭamanasau nāsatyau divi jagmatuḥ || cyavano'pi sukanyā ca surāviva vijahratuḥ || 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 281 || || cha ||
<7.1.282>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tataḥ śrutvā ca śaryātirvalabhīsthāna saṃsthitaḥ || vayasthaṃ cyavanaṃ śrutvā ānandodgatamānasaḥ || 1 || prahṛṣṭaḥ senayā sārddhaṃ sa prāyādbhārgavāśramam || cyavanaṃ ca sukanyāṃ ca hṛṣṭāṃ deva sutāmiva || 2 || gato mahīpaḥ śaryātiḥ kṛtsnānaṃdamahodadhiḥ || ṛṣiṇā satkṛtastena sabhāryaḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || tatropaviṣṭaḥ kalyāṇīḥ kathāścakre mahāmanāḥ || 3 || athainaṃ bhārgavo devi hyuvāca parisāṃtvayan || yājayiṣyāmi rājaṃstvāṃ saṃbhārānupakalpaya || 4 || tataḥ paramasaṃhṛṣṭaḥ śaryātiḥ pṛthivīpatiḥ || cyavanasya mahādevi tadvākyaṃ pratyapūjayat || 5 || praśaste'hani yājñīye sarvakāmasamṛddhimat || kārayāmāsa śaryātiryajñāyatanamuttamam || 6 || tatraiva cyavano devi yājayāmāsa bhārgavam || adbhutāni ca tatrāsanyāni tāni maheśvari || 7 || agṛhṇāccyavanaḥ somamaśvinordevayostadā || tamindro vārayāmāsa mā gṛhāṇa tayorgraham || 8.|| || indra uvāca || || ubhāvetau na somārhau nāsatyāviti me matiḥ || bhiṣajau devatānāṃ hi karmaṇā tena garhitau || 9 || || cyavana uvāca || || mā'vamaṃsthā mahātmānau rūpadraviṇavarcasau || yau cakratuśca māmadya vṛṃdārakamivājaram || 7.1.282.10 || samatvenānyadevānāṃ kathaṃ vai nekṣate bhavān|| aśvināvapi devendra devau viddhi paraṃtapa || 11 || || indra uvāca || || cikitsakau karmakarau kāmarūpasamanvitau || loke caraṃtau martyānāṃ kathaṃ somamihārhataḥ || 12 || || īśvara uvāca || || etadeva yadā vākyamāmreḍayati vāsavaḥ || anādṛtya tataḥ śakraṃ grahaṃ jagrāha bhārgavaḥ || 13 || grahīṣyaṃtaṃ tataḥ somamaśvinoḥ sattamaṃ tadā || samīkṣya balabhiddeva idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 14 || ābhyāmarthāya somaṃ tvaṃ grahīṣyasi yadi svayam || vajraṃ te prahariṣyāmi ghorarūpamanuttamam || 15 || evamuktaḥ svayamindramabhivīkṣya sa bhārgavaḥ || jagrāha vidhivatsomamaśvibhyāmuttamaṃ graham || 16 || tato'smai prāharatkopādvajramiṃdraḥ śacīpatiḥ || tasya praharato bāhuṃ staṃbhayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || 17 || staṃbhayitvātha cyavano juhuve mantrato'nalam || kṛtyārthī sumahātejā devaṃ hiṃsitumudyataḥ || 18 || tatra kṛtyodbhavo yajñe munestasya tapobalāt || madonāma mahāvīryo mahākāyo mahāsuraḥ || 19 || śarīraṃ yasya nirdeṣṭumaśakyaṃ ca surāsuraiḥ || tasya pramāṇaṃ vapuṣā na tulyamiha vidyate || 7.1.282.20 || tasyāsyaṃ cābhavedghoraṃ daṃṣṭrā durdarśanaṃ mahat || hanurekaḥ sthitastasya bhūmāveko divaṃ gataḥ || 21 || catasraścāpi tā daṃṣṭrā yojanānāṃ śataṃśatam || itare tvasya daśanā babhūburdaśayojanāḥ ||22 || prākārasadṛśākārā mūlāgrasamadarśanāḥ || nāmnā parvatasaṃkāśāścāyutāyutayojanāḥ || 23 || netre raviśaśiprakhye bhruvāvaṃtakasannibhe || lelihajjihvayā vaktraṃ vidyuccalitalolayā || vyāttānano ghoradṛṣṭirgrasanniva jagadbalāt || 24 || sa bhakṣayiṣyansaṃkruddhaḥ śatakratumupādravat || mahatā ghoranādena lokāñchabdena chādayan || 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmye cyavanena nāsatyayajñabhāgapratirodhakavajra mocanodyataśakranāśāya kṛtyodbhavamadanāmakamahā'surotpādanavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma dvyaśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 282 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.283>
|| īśvara uvāca || || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ghoravadanaṃ madaṃ devaḥ śatakratuḥ || āyāṃtaṃ bhakṣayiṣyantaṃ vyāttānanamivāntakam || 1 || bhayātstaṃbhitarūpeṇa lelihānaṃ muhurmuhuḥ || praṇato'bravīnmahādevi cyavanaṃ bhayapīḍitaḥ || 2 || somārhāvaśvināvetāvadyaprabhṛti bhārgava || bhaviṣyataḥ sarvametadvacaḥ satyaṃ bravīmi te || 3 || mā te mithyā samārambho bhavatvatha tapodhana || jānāmi cāhaṃ viprarṣe na mithyā tvaṃ kariṣyasi || 4 || somārhāvaśvināvetau yathaivādya tvayā kṛtau || bhūya eva tu te vīryaṃ prakāśediti bhārgava || 5 || sukanyāyāḥ pituścāsya loke kīrtirbhavediti || ato mayaitadvihitaṃ tadvīryasya prakāśanam || tasmātprasādaṃ kuru me bhavatvetadyathecchasi || 6 || evamuktasya śakreṇa cyavanasya mahātmanaḥ || manyurvyupāramacchīghraṃ mānaścaiva sureśituḥ || 7 || madaṃ ca vyabhajaddevi pāne strīṣu ca vīryavān || akṣeṣu mṛgayāyāṃ ca pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || tathā madaṃ vinikṣipya śakraṃ saṃtarpya ceṃdunā || 8 || aśvibhyāṃ sahitānsarvānyājayitvā ca taṃ nṛpam || vikhyāpya vīryaṃ sarveṣu lokeṣu varavarṇini || 9 || sukanyayā mahāraṇye kṣetre'sminvijahāra saḥ || tasyaitaddevi saṃyuktaṃ cyavaneśvaranāmabhṛt || 7.1.283.10 || liṃgaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ cyava nena pratiṣṭhitam || pūjayettaṃ vidhānena so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet ||11|| tasmāccandramasastīrthamṛṣayaḥ paryupāsate || vaikhānasākhyā ṛṣayo vālakhilyāstathaiva ca || 12 || atrāśvine māsi naraḥ paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || śrāddhaṃ kuryādvidhānena brāhmaṇānbhojayetpṛthak || koṭitīrthaphalaṃ tasya bhavennai'vātra saṃśayaḥ || 13 || ya imāṃ śṛṇuyāddevi kathāṃ pātakanāśinīm || samastajanmasaṃbhūtātpāpānmukto bhavennaraḥ || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryaśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||283 || ||
<7.1.284>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sukanyāsara utamam || yatrāśvinau nimagnau tau cyavanena sahāṃbike || samānarūpo hyabhavaccyavano yatra so'śvinā || 1 || yatra prāptavatī kāmaṃ sukanyā varavarṇinī || saraḥsnānaprabhāvena tena kanyāsaraḥ smṛtam || tatra snātā śubhā nārī tṛtīyāyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || 2 || saptajanmasahasrāṇi gṛhabhaṃgaṃ na cāpnuyāt || daridro vikalo dīno nāṃdhastasyā bhavetpatiḥ || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmye sukanyāsaromāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturaśītyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 284 || || cha ||
<7.1.285>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi punarnyaṃkumatīṃ nadīm || tatra kṛtvā gayāśrāddhaṃ goṣpade tīrtha uttame || 1 || tataḥ paśyedvarāhaṃ tu tasmāddharigṛhaṃ vrajet || tatra mātṛstu saṃpūjya snātvā sāgarasaṃgame || 2 || nyaṃkumatyarṇavopete tataḥ pūrvamanu vrajet || agasterāśramaṃ divyaṃ kṣudhāharamitismṛtam || 3 || yatrelvalaṃ ca vātāpiṃ saṃhṛtya bhagavānmuniḥ || muktvā''padbhyo brāhmaṇāṃśca tebhyaḥ sthānaṃ tato dadau || 4 || agastyāśramametaddhi agastipriyamuttamam || nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe ramye sarvapātakanāśane || 5 || || devyuvāca || || agastineha vātāpiḥ kimarthamupaśāmitaḥ || atra vai kiṃprabhāvaśca sa daityo brāhmaṇāṃtakaḥ || kimarthaṃ codgato manyuragastestu mahātmanaḥ ||6|| || īśvara uvāca || || ilvalo nāma daityendra āsīdvai varavarṇini || maṇimatyāṃ purā puryāṃ vātāpistasya cānujaḥ || 7 || sa brāhmaṇaṃ tapoyuktamuvāca ditinaṃdanaḥ || putra me bhagavannekamiṃdratulyaṃ prayacchatu ||8|| tasminsa brāhmaṇo naicchatputraṃ dātuṃ tathāvidham || cukrodha ditijastasya brāhmaṇasya tato bhṛśam || 9 || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya sa daityaḥ pāpabuddhimān || meṣarūpī ca vātāpiḥ kāmarūpo'bhavatkṣaṇāt || 7.1.285.10 || saṃskṛtya bhojayettatra viprānsa ca jighāṃsati || samā hvayati taṃ vācā gataṃ caiva tataḥ kṣayam || 11 || sa punardehamāsthāya jīvansma pratyadṛśyata || tato vātāpirapi taṃ chāgaṃ kṛtvā susaṃskṛtam || brāhmaṇaṃ bhojayitvā tu punareva samāhvayat || 12 || sa tasya pārśvaṃ nirbhidya brāhmaṇasya mahātmanaḥ || vātāpiḥ prahasaṃstatra niścakrāma dvijodarāt || 13 || evaṃ sa brāhmaṇāndevi bhojayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || vinirbhidyodaraṃ teṣāmevaṃ haṃti dvijānbahūn ||14|| tato vai brāhmaṇāḥ sarve bhayabhītāḥ pradudruvuḥ || agasterāśramaṃ jagmuḥ kathayāmāsuragrataḥ || 15 || bhagavañchṛṇu no vākyamasmākaṃ tu bhayāvaham || nimaṃtritāḥ sma sarve vā ilvalena vayaṃ prabho || 16 || asmākaṃ mṛtyurūpaṃ tadbhojanaṃ nāsti saṃśayaḥ || tadasmānrakṣa bhagavanviṣaṇṇāgatacetasaḥ || 17 || tataḥ prabhāsamāsādya yatra tau daityapuṃgavau || brahmaghrau pāpaniratau dadarśa sa mahāmuniḥ || 18 || vātāpiṃ saṃskṛtaṃ dṛṣṭvā meṣarūpaṃ mahāsuram || uvāca dehi me bhojyaṃ bubhukṣā mama vartate || 19 || ityuktau svāgataṃ tatra cakrāte munaye tadā || bhagavanbhojanaṃ tubhyaṃ dāsye'haṃ bahuvistaram || kiyanmānastavāhārastāvanmānaṃ pacāmyaham || 7.1.285.20 || || agastya uvāca || || annaṃ pacasva daityendra kiṃcittṛptirbhaviṣyati || evamastviti daityendraḥ pakvamāha mahāmune ||21|| āsyatāmāsanamidaṃ bhujyatāṃ svecchayā mune || ityukto'ghoramaṃtraṃ sa japankalpāṃtakārakam || dhuryāsanamathāsādya niṣasāda mahāmuniḥ || 22 || taṃ paryaveṣaddaityeṃdra ilvalaḥ prahasanniva || śatahastapramāṇena rāśimannasya so'karot || 23 || tato haṣṭamanā'gastyaḥ prāgrasatkavaladvayam || rūpaṃ kṛtvā mahattadvadyadvatsāgaraśoṣaṇe || 24 || samastameva tadbhojyaṃ vātāpiṃ bubhuje tataḥ || bhuktavatyasuro hvānamakarottasya ilvalaḥ || 25 || tato'sau dattavānannamagastyasya mahātmanaḥ || bhasmīcakāra sarvaṃ sa tadannaṃ ca sadānavam ||26|| ilvalaṃ krodhamuṣṭyā tu bhasmīcakre mahāmuniḥ || tato hāhāravaṃ kṛtvā sarve daityā nanaṃśire || 27 || tato'gastyo mahātejā āhūya dvijapuṃgavān || tatsthānaṃ ca dadau tebhyo daityrānāṃ dravyapūritam|| 28 || kṣudhā hṛtā tato devi tatrāgastyasya dānavaiḥ || tena kṣudhā haraṃnāma sthānamāsīdvijanmanām || 29 || tasya paścimabhāge tu nātidūre vyavasthitam || gaṃgeśvaramiti khyātaṃ gaṃgayā yatpratiṣṭhitam || 7.1.285.30 || vātāpibhakṣaṇepūrvamagastyena mahātmanā || daityasaṃbhakṣaṇotpannasarvapātakaśuddhaye || samāhūtā mahādevi gaṃgāpātakanāśinī || 31 || tato devi samā yātā gaṃgā pātakanāśinī || śuddhiṃ cakāra tasyarṣestatra sthāne sthitā'bhavat ||32|| agastyasyā''śrame ramye nṛṇāṃ pāpabhayāpahe || tatra gaṃgeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā abhakṣyodbhavapātakāt|| mucyate nātra saṃdehaḥ snānadānajapādinā || 33 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathameprabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye'gastyāśramagaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 285 ||
<7.1.286>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bālārkaṃ pāpanāśanam || agastyāśramato devi uttare nātidūrataḥ || 1 || bāla eva tu yatrārkastapastepe purā priye || tena bālārka ityetannāma khyātaṃ dharātale || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ravivāreṇa na kuṣṭhī jāyate naraḥ || bālānāṃ rogajā pīḍā na saṃbhūyātkadācana || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye bālārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍaśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 286 || || cha ||
<7.1.287>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi ajāpāleśvarīṃ śubhām || agastyasthānapūrveṇa nātidūre vyavasthitām || 1 || raghuvaṃśasamudbhūto hyajāpālo nṛpottamaḥ || sa tatra devīmārādhya pāparogavaśaṃkarīm || 2 || ajārūpāṃśca rogānvai cārayāmāsa bhūmipaḥ || tatra tāṃ sthāpayāmāsa svanāmnā pāpanāśinīm ||| || 3 || yastāṃ pūjayate bhaktyā tṛtīyāyāṃ vidhānataḥ || bala buddhiryaśo vidyāṃ saubhāgyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye'jāpāleśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 287 || ||
<7.1.288>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bālādityamiti śrutam || agatsyasthānataḥ pūrve gavyūtidvitayena tu|| 1 || sthānaṃ sapāṭikānāma tasyadakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || gavyūtimātraṃ deveśi bālārka iti viśrutam || 2 || yatra cārādhitā vidyā viśvāmitreṇa dhīmatā || saṃsthāpya liṃgatritayaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya tathā ravim || 3 || vidyāyāḥ sādhanaṃ cakre siddhiṃ sūryādavāptavān | bālādityeti tenāsau tataḥ khyātimagātprabhuḥ || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi bhāskarapāpataskaram|| na dāridryamavāpnoti yāvajjīvati mānavaḥ || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bālārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāśītyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 288 || || || ||
<7.1.289>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe devi tasmādgavyūtimātrataḥ || pātālagāminī gaṃgā saṃsthitā pāpanāśinī || 1 || viśvāmitreṇa cāhūtā snānārthaṃ varavarṇini || tatra snātvā mahādevi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || tatra gaṃgeśvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā viśvāmitreśvaraṃ tathā || bāleśvaraṃ ca saṃprekṣya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bālārkamāhātmye pātāla gaṃgeśvaraviśvāmitreśvarabāleśvarābhidhaliṃgatrayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 289 || cha ||
<7.1.290>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kuberasthānamuttamam || yatra siddhaḥ purā devi kubero dhanado'bhavat || 1 || brāhmaṇaścaurarūpeṇa tatra sthāne'vasatpurā || sa ca me bhaktiyogena purā vai dhanadaḥ kṛtaḥ|| 2 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ sa brāhmaṇo bhūtvā caurarūpo narādhamaḥ || tanme kathaya deveśa dhanadaḥ sa yathā'bhavat || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || tasminnarthe mahādevi yadvṛttaṃ cauttameṃ'tare || kathayiṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ śivamāhātmyasūcakam || 4 || kaścidāsīddvijo devi devaśarmeti viśrutaḥ || prabhāsakṣetranilayo nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe'vasat || 5 || putrakṣetrakalatrādivyāpāraikarataḥ sadā || vihāyātha sa gārhasthyaṃ dhanārthaṃ lobha mohitaḥ || pracacāra mahīmetāṃ sagrāmanagarāṃtarām || 6 || bhāryā tasya vilolākṣī tasya gehādvinirgatā || svacchaṃdacāriṇī nityaṃ nityaṃ cānaṃgamohitā || 7 || tasyāṃ kadācitputrastu śūdrājjāto vidhervaśāt || duṣṭātmā'tīva nirmukto nāmnā duḥsaha ityataḥ || 8 || so'tha kālena mahatā nāmakarmapravartitaḥ || vyasanopahataḥ pāpastyakto bandhujanaistathā || 9 || pūjopakaraṇaṃ dravyaṃ sa kasmiṃścicchivālaye || bahudoṣāmukhe dṛṣṭvā hartukāmo'viśattataḥ||| || 7.1.290.10|| yāvaddīpo gataprāyo vartticchedo'bhavatkila || tāvattena daśā dattā dravyānveṣaṇakāraṇāt || 11 || prabuddhaścotthitastatra devapūjākaro naraḥ || ko'yaṃ koyamiti proccairvyāharatparighāyudhaḥ ||12|| sa ca prāṇabhayānnaṣṭaḥ śūdrajaścāpi mūḍhadhīḥ || vinindannātmano janma karma cāpi suduḥkhita||13|| purapālairhato'vanyāṃ mṛtaḥ kālādabhūcca saḥ|| gaṃdhāraviṣaye rājā khyāto nāmnā sudurmukhaḥ||14|| gītavādyaratastatra veśyāsu nirato bhṛśam|| prajopadravakṛnmūrkhaḥ sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 15 || kintvarcayansadaivāsau liṃgaṃ rājyakramāgatam || puṣpasragdhūpanaivedyagaṃdhādibhiramantravat ||16 || mukhyeṣu ca sadā kāle devatāyataneṣu ca || dadyātsa bahulāndīpānvartibhiśca samujjvalān || 17 || kadācinmṛgayāsakto babhrāma sa ca vīryavān|| prabhāsa kṣetramāgātya pūrvasaṃskārabhāvitaḥ || 18 || parairabhihato yuddhe nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe || śivapūjāvidhānena vidhvastāśeṣapātakaḥ || 19 || tato viśravasaścāsau putro'bhūdbhuvi viśrutaḥ || yaḥ sa eva mahātejāḥ sarvayajñādhipo balī || 7.1.290.20 || kubera iti dharmātmā śrutaśīlasamanvitaḥ || liṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhayāmāsa nyaṃkumatyāśca pūrvataḥ || 21 || kauberātpaścime bhāge somanātheti viśrutam || saṃpūjya ca yatheśānaṃ nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe || stotreṇānena cāstauṣīdbhaktyā taṃ sarvakāmadam || 22 || mūrtiḥ kvāpi maheśvarasya mahatī yajñasya mūlodayā tumbī tuṃgaphalāvatī ca śataśo brahmāṇḍakoṭistathā || yanmānaṃ na pitāmaho na ca harirbrahmāṇḍamadhyasthito jānātyanyasureṣu kā ca gaṇanā sā saṃtataṃ vo'vatāt || 23 || namāmyahaṃ devamajaṃ purāṇamu pendramindrāvararājajuṣṭam || śaśāṃkasūryāgnisamānanetraṃ vṛṣendracihnaṃ pralayādihetum || 24 || sarveśvaraikatribalaikabandhuṃ yogādhigamyaṃ jagato'dhivāsam || taṃ vismayādhāramanaṃtaśaktiṃ jñānodbhavaṃ dhairyaguṇādhikaṃ ca || 25 || pinākapāśāṃkuśaśūlahastaṃ kapardinaṃ meghasamānaghoṣam || sakālakaṇṭhaṃ sphaṭikāvabhāsaṃ namāmi śaṃbhuṃ bhuvanaikanātham || 26 || kapālinaṃ mālinamādidevaṃ jaṭādharaṃ bhīmabhujaṃgahāram || prabhāsitāraṃ ca sahasramūrtiṃ sahasraśīrṣaṃ puruṣaṃ viśiṣṭam || 27 || yadakṣaraṃ nirguṇamaprameyaṃ sajyotirekaṃ pravadaṃti saṃtaḥ || dūraṃgamaṃ vedyamaniṃdyavandyaṃ sarveṣu hṛtsthaṃ paramaṃ pavitram || 28 || tejonibhaṃ bālamṛgāṃkamauliṃ namāmi rudraṃ sphuradugravaktram || kālendhanaṃ kāmadamastasaṃgaṃ dharmāsanasthaṃ prakṛtidvayastham || 29 || atīndriyaṃ viśvabhujaṃ jitāriṃ guṇatrayātītamajaṃ nirīham || tamomayaṃ vedamayaṃ cidaṃśaṃ prajāpatīśaṃ puruhūtamindram || anāgataikadhvanirūpamādyaṃ dhyāyaṃti yaṃ yogavido yatīndrāḥ || 7.1.290.30 || saṃsārapāśacchiduraṃ vimuktaḥ punaḥ punastvāṃ praṇamāmi devam || 31 || nirūpamāsyaṃ ca balaprabhāvaṃ na ca svabhāvaṃ paramasya puṃsaḥ || vijñāyate viṣṇupitāmahādyaistaṃ vāmadevaṃ praṇamāmyaciṃtyam || 32 || śivaṃ samārādhya tamugramūrttiṃ papau samudraṃ bhagavānagastyaḥ || lebhe dilīpo'pyakhilāṃśca kāmāṃstaṃ viśvayoniṃ śaraṇaṃ prapadye || 33 || devendravandyoddhara māmanāthaṃ śambho kṛpākāruṇikaḥ kila tvam || duḥkhā'rṇave magnamumeśa dīnaṃ samuddhara tvaṃ bhava śaṃkaro'si || 34 || saṃpūjayanto divi devasaṃghā brahmendrarudrā viharaṃti kāmam || taṃ staumi naumīha japāmi śarvaṃ vande'bhivaṃdyaṃ śaraṇaṃ prapannaḥ ||35|| stutvaivamīśaṃ virarāma yāvattāvatsa rudro'rkasahasratejāḥ || dadau ca tasmai varadoṃ'dhakārirvaratrayaṃ vaiśravaṇāya devaḥ|| sakhyaṃ ca dikpālapadaṃ caturthaṃ dhanādhipatyaṃ ca divaukasāṃ ca || 36 || yasmādatra tvayā samyaṅnyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe || ārādhito'haṃ vidhivatkṛtvā mūrttiṃ mahīmayīm || 37 || tasmāttavaiva nāmnā tatsthānaṃ khyātaṃ bhaviṣyati || kuberanagaretyevaṃ mama prītipradāyakam || 38|| tvayā pratiṣṭhitaṃ liṃgamasmātsthānācca paścime || umānāthasya vidhivatsomanātheti tatsmṛtam || 39 || śrīpaṃcamyāṃ vidhānena yastacca pūjayiṣyati || saptapuruṣāvadhiryāvattasya lakṣmīrbhaviṣyati || 7.1.290.40 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye kuberanagarotpattikuberasthāpitasomanāthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||290|| || cha ||
<7.1.291>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmāduttarabhāge tu sthānātkauberasaṃjñakāt || bhadrakālī mahādevi vāṃchitārthapradāyinī || 1 || dakṣayajñasya vidhvaṃse vīrabhadrasamanvitā || bhadrakālī mahādevī dakṣayajñavināśinī || 2 || caitre māsi tṛtīyāyāṃ devīṃ tāṃ yastu pūjayet || navakoṭyastu cāmuṇḍā bhaviṣyaṃti supūjitāḥ || saubhāgyaṃ vijayaṃ caiva tasya lakṣmīrbhaviṣyati || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye bhadrakālīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 291 || || cha ||
<7.1.292>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmāduttarabhāge tu sthānātkauravasaṃjñakāt || bhadrakālī mahādevi tapaḥ kṛtvā sudustaram || 1 || raviṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa bhaktyā paramayā yutā || ravivāreṇa saptamyāṃ rakta puṣpānulepanaiḥ || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || mucyate vātapittotthai rogairanyaiśca puṣkalaiḥ || 3 || aśvastatraiva dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye bhadrakālībālārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvinavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 292 || || cha ||
<7.1.293>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādvaiśravaṇa sthānānnairṛtyāṃ varavarṇini || svayaṃ sthitaḥ kuberastu sarvadāridryanāśanaḥ || 1 || makarādinidhānaistu aṣṭābhiḥ paribhūṣitaḥ || pañcamyāṃ pūjayedbhaktyā gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || nidhānaprāptiratulā nirvighnā tasya jāyate || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāmakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye kuberasthānotpattau kuberamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trinavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 293 || |||
<7.1.294>
|| īśvara uvāca || tato gacchenmahādevi kauberātpūrvasaṃsthitam || gavyūtipaṃcake devi puṣkaraṃnāma nāmataḥ || yatra siddho mahādevi kaivarto matsyaghātakaḥ || 1 || || devyuvāca || || savistaraṃ mama brūhi kathaṃ sa siddhimāpa vai || kathayasva prasādena devadeva maheśvara || 2 || || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu tvaṃ yatpurāvṛttaṃ devi svārociṣeṃtare || āsītkaściddurācāraḥ kaivarto matsyaghātakaḥ || 3 || sa kadāciccaranpāpaḥ puṣkare tu jagāma vai || dadarśa śāṃkaraṃ veśma latāpādapasaṃkulam || 4 || sa māghamāse śītārttaḥ klinnajālasamanvitaḥ || prāsādamārurohārttaḥ sūryatāpajighṛkṣayā || 5 || tataḥ sa klinnajālaṃ tacchoṣaṇāya raveḥ karaiḥ || prāsādadhvajadaṃḍāgre saṃprasāritavāṃstadā || 6 || tataḥ prāsādato devi jāḍyātsaṃpatitaḥ kramāt || sa mṛtaḥ sahasā devi tasminkṣetre śivasya ca || 7 || jālaṃ tasya prabhūtena jīrṇakālena yattadā || dhvajā baddhā yato jālaiḥ prāsāde sā śubhe'bhavat || 8 || tato'sau dhvajamāhātmyājjāto'vanyāṃ narādhipaḥ || ṛtadhvajeti vikhyātaḥ saurāṣṭraviṣaye sudhīḥ || sa hi sphūrjaddhvajāgreṇa rathena paryaṭanmahīm || 9 || kāmabhogābhibhūtātmā rājyaṃ cakre pratāpavān || tato'sau bhavane śaṃbhordadau śobhāsamanvitām || dhvajāṃ śubhrāṃ vicitrāṃ ca nānyatkiṃcidapi prabhuḥ || 7.1.294.10 || tato jātismaro rājā prabhāsakṣetramāgataḥ|| tatrāyatanaṃ dhvajājālasamanvitam||11|| ajogandhasya devasya pūrvamārādhitasya ca || prāsādaṃ kārayāmāsa śivopakaraṇāni ca||12|| nityaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā talliṃgaṃ pāpanāśanam || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi rājyaṃ cakre mahāmanāḥ || 13 || talliṃgasya prabhāvena tataḥ kālāddivaṃ gataḥ || tasmāttatra prayatnena gatvā liṃgaṃ prapūjayet || 14 || snātvā paścimataḥ kuṇḍe puṣkare pāpataskare || yatra brahmā'yajatpūrvaṃ yajñairvipuladakṣiṇaiḥ || 15 || samāhūya ca tīrthāni puṣkarāttatra bhāmini || tasminkuṇḍe tu vinyasya ajogandha samīpataḥ || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgamajogandheti nāmataḥ || 16 || tripuṣkare mahādevi kuṇḍe pātakanāśane || sauvarṇaṃ kamalaṃ tatra dadyādbrāhmaṇapuṃgave || 17 || devaṃ saṃpūjya vidhivadgandhapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ saptajanmārjitairapi || 18 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye puṣkara māhātmye'jogandheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturṇavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 294 || || cha ||
<7.1.295>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādīśāna digbhāge indrasthānamanuttamam || gavyūtipañcamātreṇa yatra candrasaraḥ priye || 1 || tasmāduttaradigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || yatra candrodakaṃ devi jarādāridryanāśanam || 2|| candrānuvṛddhyā tadvṛddhiḥ kṣayastatsaṃkṣaye bhavet|| tasminpāpayuge'pyevaṃ kadācitsaṃpradṛśyate||3|| tatra snātvā mahādevi yadi pāpasahasrakam|| kṛtaṃ so'tra samāyāti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā||4|| tatrāhilyāprasaṃgotthamahāpātakabhīruṇā|| gautamodbhavaśāpena vilakṣyīkṛtacetasā || 5 || indreṇa ca purā devi iṣṭaṃ vipuladakṣiṇaiḥ || tatra varṣasahasrāṇi saṃsthāpya śivamīśvaram || indreśvareti nāmnā vai sarvapātaka nāśanam || 6 || candratīrthe naraḥ snātvā saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || indreśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye candrodakatīrthamāhātmya indreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcanavatyuttara dviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 295 || || cha ||
<7.1.296>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādāgneyadigbhāge gavyūtisaptakena ca || sthānaṃ devakulaṃnāma devānāṃ yatra saṃgamaḥ || 1 || ṛṣīṇāṃ yatra siddhānāṃ purā liṃge nipātite || yasmājjāto mahādevi tasmāddevakulaṃ smṛtam || 2 || tasya paścimadigbhāga ṛṣitoyā mahānadī || ṛṣīṇāṃ vallabhā devi sarvapātakanāśinī || 3 || tatra snātvā naraḥ samyakpitṝṇāṃ nirvapennaraḥ || saptavarṣāyutānyeva pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet || 4 || suvarṇaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu ajinaṃ kaṃbalaṃ tathā || āṣāḍhe tvamāvāsyāyāṃ yatkiñciddīyate dhruvam || 5 || varddhate ṣoḍaśaguṇaṃ yāvadāyāti pūrṇimā || 6 || suvarṇaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu ajinaṃ kaṃbalaṃ tathā || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ saptajanmakṛtairapi || 7 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṣitoyānadīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṇṇavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||296|| ||
<7.1.297>
|| devyuvāca || || devadeva jagannātha saṃsārārṇavatāraka || savistaraṃ tu me brūhi ṛṣitoyāmahodayam || 1 || ṛṣitoyeti tannāma kathaṃ khyātaṃ dharātale || kathaṃ sā punarāyātā devadāruvane śubhe || 2 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi sāvadhānā vaco mama || māhātmyamṛṣitoyāyāḥ sarvapātakanāśanam || 3 || devadāruvane puṇya ṛṣayastapasā yutāḥ || nivasaṃti varārohe śataśotha sahasraśaḥ || 4 || teṣāṃ nivasatāṃ tatra bahukālo gataḥ priye || putrapautraiḥ pravṛddhāste dārukaṃ vyāpya saṃsthitāḥ || 85 || te sarve ciṃtayāmāsuḥ sametya ca parasparam || sarasvatī mahāpuṇyā śirasyādhāya vāḍavam || 6 || prabhāsaṃ cirakālena kṣetraṃ caiva gamiṣyati || vāpīkūpataḍāgādi muktvā sāgaragāminīm || 7 || nāhlādaṃ kurute cetaḥ snānadānajapeṣu ca || brahmāṇaṃ prārthayiṣyāmo gatvā brahmaniketanam || 8 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ nimantrya te sarve ṛṣayastapasojjvalāḥ|| gatāste brahmalokaṃ tu draṣṭuṃ devaṃ pitāmaham || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmāṇaṃ kamalodbhavam || 9 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || namaḥ praṇavarūpāya viśva kartre namonamaḥ || tathā viśvasya rakṣitre namo'stu paramātmane || 7.1.297.10 || tathā tasyaiva saṃhartre namo brahmasvarūpiṇe || pitāmaha namastubhyaṃ surajyeṣṭha namo'stu te || 11 || caturvaktra namastubhyaṃ padmayone namo'stu te || viraṃcaye namastubhyaṃ vidhaye vedhase namaḥ || 12 || cidānanda namastubhyaṃ hiraṇyagarbha te namaḥ || haṃsavāhana te nityaṃ padmāsana namo'stute || 13 || evaṃ saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāmṛṣīṇāmūrdhvaretasām || uvāca paramaprīto brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ || 14 || svāgataṃ vai dvijaśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ kṛtavānaham || stotreṇānena divyena vṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam || 15 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || abhiṣekāya no deva nadī pāpapraṇāśinī || vilokyate suraśreṣṭha dehi no varamuttamam || 16 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktastaistadā brahmā munibhistapasojjvalaiḥ || vīkṣāṃcakre tadā sarvā mūrtimatyaśca nimnagāḥ || 17 || gaṅgā ca yamunā caiva tathā devī sarasvatī || candrabhāgā ca revā ca śarayūrgaṃḍakī tathā || 18 || tāpī caiva varārohe tathā godāvarī nadī || kāverī candraputrī ca śiprā carmaṇvatī tathā || 19 || sindhuśca vedikā caiva nadāḥ sarve varānane || mūrtimatyaḥ sthitāḥ sarvāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpanāśinī || 7.1.297.20 || dṛṣṭvā pitāmahaḥ sarvā gatvarā dharaṇīṃ prati || devadāruvane ramye prabhāse kṣetra uttame || kamaṇḍalau kṛtā dṛṣṭirviviśustāḥ kamaṇḍalum || 21 || | | brahmovāca || || dhṛtāḥ sarvā mahāpuṇyā nadyo brahmakamaṇḍalau|| praviṣṭāḥ pṛthivīṃ yāṃtu ṛṣīṇāmanukampayā || 22 || prahiṇomi yadyekāṃ ca hyanyā ruṣyati me dvijāḥ || tasmātsarvāḥ pramokṣyāmi kamaṇḍalukṛtālayāḥ || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || tato brahmā mumocā'tha tatrasthāśca mahāpagāḥ || muktvā brahmā munīnsarvānprovācedaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 24 || ṛṣibhiḥ prārthyamānena nadyo muktā mayā yataḥ || toyarūpā mahāvegā abhiṣekāya satvarāḥ || 25 || ṛṣitoyeti nāmnā sā bhaviṣyati dharātale || ṛṣīṇāṃ vallabhā devī sarvapātakanāśinī || 26 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ devi samāyātā devadāruvane nadī || ṛṣitoyeti vikhyātā pavitrā ca varānane || 27 || tūryaduṃdubhinirghoṣairvedamaṅgalaniḥsvanaiḥ || samudraṃ prāpitā devī ṛṣibhirvedapāragaiḥ || 28 || sarvatra sulabhā devī triṣu sthāneṣu durlabhā || mahodaye mahātīrthe mūlacaṃḍīśasannidhau || 29 || samudreṇa sametā tu yatra sā pūrvavāhinī || yatrarṣitoyā labhyeta tatra kiṃ mṛgyate param ||7.1.297.30|| manuṣyāste sadā dhanyāstattoyaṃ tu pibaṃti ye || asthīni yatra līyaṃte ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇa tu || 31 || prātaḥkāle vahedgaṃgā sāyaṃ ca yamunā tathā || 32 || nadīsahasrasaṃyuktā madhyāhne tu sarasvatī || aparāhṇe vahedrevā sāyāhne sūryaputrikā || 33 || evaṃ jānannaro yastu tatra snāna vicakṣaṇaḥ || ācaredvidhinā śrāddhaṃ sa tasyāḥ phalabhāgbhavet || 34 || evaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktamṛṣitoyāmahodayam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ṛṣitoyāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 297 ||
<7.1.298>
īśvara uvāca || || ṛṣitoyāpaścime tu tatra gavyūtimātrataḥ || saṃgāleśvaranāmāsti sarvapātakanāśanaḥ || 1 || guptastatra prayāgaśca devo vai mādhavastathā || jāhnavī yamunā caiva devī tatra sarasvatī || 2 || anyāni tatra tīrthāni bahūni ca varānane || snātvā dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 3 || || pārvatyuvāca || || kathaya tvaṃ maheśāna sarvadevanamaskṛta || tīrtharājaḥ prayāgastu kathaṃ viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || 4 || kathaṃ gaṃgā ca yamunā tathā devī sarasvatī || anyānyapi bahūnyeva tīrthāni vṛṣabhadhvaja || 5 || samāyātāni tatraiva saṃgāleśvarasaṃnidhau || saṃgāleśeti kiṃ nāma hyetanme vada kautukam || 6 || || īśvara uvāca || || purā vai liṃgapatane sarvadevasamāgame || sārdhatritayakoṭīni puṇyāni surasundari || 7 || tīrthāni tīrtharājo'yaṃ prayāgaḥ samupasthitaḥ || ātmānaṃ gopayāmāsa tīrthakoṭibhirāvṛtam || 8 || tatastatra samāyātā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || vibudhāstīrtharājaṃ taṃ dadṛśurdivyacakṣuṣā || 9 || tīrthakoṭibhirākīrṇaṃ pavitraṃ pāpanāśanam || liṃgasya patanaṃ śrutvā mahāduḥkhena saṃvṛtāḥ || 7.1.298.10 || sthitāḥ sarve tadā devi brahmādyāḥ surasattamāḥ || 11 || etasminneva kāle tu devo rudraḥ sanātanaḥ || nirānaṃdaḥ samāyāto vākyametaduvāca ha || 12 || śṛṇudhvaṃ vacanaṃ devā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || ṛṣiśāpānnipatitaṃ mama liṃgamanuttamam || tasmālliṃgaṃ pūjayata sarva kāmārthasiddhaye ||13 || evamuktvā mahādevo deśe tasminsthitaḥ priye || brāhmaṃ ca vaiṣṇavaṃ raudraṃ tatra kuṇḍatrayaṃ smṛtam || 14 || caturthaṃ trisaṃgamākhyaṃ nadīnāṃ yatra saṃgamaḥ || gaṃgāyāśca sarasvatyāḥ sūryaputryāstathaiva ca || 15 || koṭirekā ca tīrthānāṃ brahmakuṇḍe vyavasthitā || tathā ca vaiṣṇave kuṇḍe koṭirekā prakīrtitā || 16 || sārdhakoṭistu saṃproktā śivakuṇḍe prakīrtitā || paścime brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca pūrve vai vaiṣṇavaṃ smṛtam || 17 || madhyabhāge sthitaṃ yacca rudrakuṇḍaṃ prakīrtitam || kuṇḍamadhyādvinirgatya yatra gaṃgā varānane || 18 || sūryaputryā sametā ca tattrisaṃgama ucyate || anayoraṃtare sūkṣme tatra guptā sarasvatī || 19 || eṣu sannihito nityaṃ prayāgastīrthanāyakaḥ || atrāgatya naro yastu māghamāse varānane || 7.1.298.20 || snāyātprabhātasamaye makarasthe ravau priye || kiñcidabhyudite sūrye śṛṇu tasya ca yatphalam || 21 || ādyenaikena snānena pāpaṃ yanmanasā kṛtam|| vyapohati naraḥ samyakchraddhāyukto jitendriyaḥ || 22 || vācikaṃ tu dvitīyena kāyikaṃ tu tṛtīyakāt || saṃsargajaṃ caturthena rahasyaṃ pañcamena tu || 23 || upapātakāni ṣaṣṭhena snānenaiva vyapohati||24|| abhiṣekeṇa kuṇḍānāṃ saptakṛtvo varānane|| mahāṃti caiva pāpāni kṣālyaṃte puruṣaiḥ sadā||25|| yaḥ snāti sakalaṃ māsaṃ prayāge guptasaṃjñake || brahmādibhirna tadvaktuṃ śakyate kalpakoṭibhiḥ || 26 || yāni kāni ca tīrthāni prabhāse saṃti bhāmini || tebhyo'tivallabhaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 27 || eṣāṃ saṃrakṣaṇārthāya mayā vai tatra mātaraḥ || pūjanīyāḥ prayatnena naivedyairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 28 || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ śraddhāyuktena cetasā || tāsāmanucarā devi bhūtapretāśca koṭiśaḥ || 29 || teṣāṃ bhayavināśāya tā mātṝśca prapūjayet || asmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati ||7.1.298.30|| yaḥ kaścitkurute śrāddhaṃ pitṝnuddiśya bhaktitaḥ || uddharecca piturvargaṃ māturvargaṃ narottamaḥ ||31|| vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ tasya phalamanantakam || 32 || evaṃ guptaprayāgasya māhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ tava || śrutvābhinandya puruṣaḥ prāpnuyācchaṃkarālayam || 33 || iti śrīskāṃdemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye guptaprayā gamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭanavatyuttaradviśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 298 || || cha ||
<7.1.299>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge nātidūre vyavasthi tam|| śaṃkhacakragadādhārī mādhavastatra saṃsthitaḥ || 1 || ekādaśyāṃ site pakṣe sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā gaṃdhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānamapunarbhavadāyakam || 2 || atra gāthā purā gītā brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || viṣṇukuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā yo vai mādhavamarcayet || sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo hariḥ svayam || 3 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ viṣṇudaivatam || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam|| 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mādhavamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navanavatyuttaradvi śatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 299 || || cha ||
<7.1.300>
