|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyaivottaradigbhāge kiñcidvāyavyasaṃsthitam || saṃgāleśvaranāmāsti sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tatra brahmā ca viṣṇuśca liṃgasyārādhanodyatau || śakraścaiva mahātejā liṃgaṃ pūjitavānpriye || 2 || varuṇo dhanadaścaiva dharmarājo'tha pāvakaḥ || ādityairvasubhiścaiva lokapālaiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 3 || ārādhitaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ saṃgāleśvaranāmabhṛt || pūjayitvā tu te sarve dṛṣṭvā māhātmyamuttamam || 4 || ūcuśca sahasā devi paramānaṃdasaṃyutāḥ || devānāṃ nivahairyasmātsamāgatya pratiṣṭhitam || saṃgāleśvaranāmāsya bhaviṣyati dharātale || 5 || saṃgāleśvaranāmānaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || na teṣāmanvaye kaścinnirdhanaḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 6 || gosahasrasya dattasya kurukṣetre ca yatphalam || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti saṃgāleśvaradarśanāt || 7 || amāvāsyāṃ ca saṃprāpya snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || yaḥ karoti naraḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ roṣavarjitaḥ || pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 8 || ardhakrośaṃ ca tatkṣetraṃ samaṃtātparimaṇḍalam || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 9 || asminkṣetre mahādevi jīvā uttamamadhyamāḥ || kālena nidhanaṃ prāptāste'pi yāṃti parāṃ gatim ||7.1.300.10||| gṛhītvānaśanaṃ ye tu prāṇāṃstyakṣyaṃti mānavāḥ || niścayaṃ te mahādevi līyaṃte parameśvare ||11|| gavā hatā dvijahatā ye ca vai daṃṣṭribhirhatā|| ātmano ghātakā ye tu sarpadaṣṭāśca ye mṛtāḥ || 12 || śayyāyāṃ vigataprāṇā ye ca śaucavivarjitāḥ || asmiṃstīrthe mahāpuṇye apunarbhavadāyake|| 13 || dattaiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ śrāddhairvṛṣotsarge kṛte punaḥ || vidhivadbhojitairviprairbhavenmuktirna saṃśayaḥ || 14 || evamuktvā surāḥ sarve gatavaṃtastriviṣṭapam || 15 || saṃgāleśvaramāhātmyaṃ saṃkṣepātkathitaṃ tava || śrutaṃ harati pāpāni duḥkhaśokāṃstathaiva ca || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 300 || || cha ||
<7.1.301>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi siddheśvaramanuttamam || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || 1 || yadā devaiḥ sametyāśu śivaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || saṃgāleśvara nāmāḍhyaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || 2 || tadā siddhagaṇāḥ sarve samārādhya vṛṣadhvajam || sthāpayāṃcakrire liṃgaṃ sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 3 || tatsiddheśvara nāmāḍhyaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotraistadā siddhagaṇāḥ śivam || 4 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo yācyatāṃ varamuttamam || namaskṛtya tataḥ sarve procuśca śaśiśekharam || 5 || ihāgatya naro yastu snātvā ca vidhipūrvakam || arcayetsiddhanāthaṃ ca japecca śatarudriyam || 6 || aghoraṃ vā japenmantraṃ gāyatryaṃ ca maheśvaram || ṣaṇmāsābhyantareṇaiva japecca munisattamāḥ || aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ saṃsiddhiṃ prāpnuyāddhruvam ||7 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyaṃtardhānaṃ gato haraḥ || siddheśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya hyaghoraṃ ca japennaraḥ || 8 || āśvayukkṛṣṇapakṣe tu caturdaśyāṃ mahāniśi || dhairyamālaṃbya nirbhīkaḥ sa siddhiṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 9 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam || siddheśvarasya devasya sarvakāmaphalapradam || 7.1.301.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikottaratriśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 301 ||
<7.1.302>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃdharveśvaramuttamam || tasyaivottaradigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ paṃcake sthitam ||1|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā ca mahādevi rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ || gaṃdharvaiḥ sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ snātvā saṃpūjayetsakṛt || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti raktakaṇṭhaśca jāyate || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃdharveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 302 ||
<7.1.303>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi uttare devamuttamam || yastamārādhayeddevaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || || 1 || tasyaiva paścime bhāge dhanuṣāṃ tritaye sthitam || śeṣādipramukhairnāgairmahatā tapasā yutaiḥ || samārādhya mahādevaṃ sthāpitaṃ liṃgamuttamam || 2 || yastamārādhayeddevaṃ sarpairārādhitaṃ purā || na viṣaṃ kramate dehe tasya janmāvadhi priye || 3 || sarpāstasya prasīdanti na kuṃthaṃti kadācana || tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena talliṃgaṃ pūjayennaraḥ || 4 || tatra liṃgānyanekāni ṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitāni tu || gaṃgātīre mahāpuṇye paścime varavarṇini || 5 || tāni dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgāleśvaramāhātmya uttareśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tryuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 303 ||
<7.1.304>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gaṃgāṃ tripathagāminīm || saṃgāleśādathaiśānyāṃ dhanuṣāṃ saptake sthitām|| 1 || tasyāṃ trinetrā matsyāḥ syurnityamāṃbhasikāḥ priye || kalauyuge'pi dṛśyaṃte satyaṃsatyaṃ mayoditam || 2 || tasyāṃ snātvā mahādevi mucyate pañcapātakaiḥ || 3 || || sūta uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā vismitā girijā satī || uvāca taṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ pracalaccaṃdraśekharam ||4|| || pārvatyuvāca || || kathaṃ tatra samāyātā gaṃgā tripathagāminī || kathaṃ trinetrāḥ saṃjātā matsyā āṃbhasikāḥ śiva || 5 || etadvistarato brūhi yadyahaṃ te priyā vibho || 6 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi yadi pṛcchasi māṃ śubhe || āstikāḥ śraddadhānāśca bhavaṃtīti matirmama || 7|| yadā śapto mahādevo hyajñānatimirāvṛtaiḥ || ṛṣibhiḥ kopayuktaiśca kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || 8 || tadā te munayaḥ sarve śaptaṃ jñātvā maheśvaram || nirānaṃdaṃ jagatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭvā cātmānameva ca || 9 || ārādhya parameśānaṃ dadhataṃ gajarūpakam || unnataṃ sthānamānīya sānaṃdaṃ cakrire dvijāḥ || 7.1.304.10 || tataḥ prabhṛti sarve te śivadrohakaraṃ param || ātmānaṃ menire nityaṃ prasanne'pi maheśvare || 11 || mahodayānmahātīrthaṃ sarva āgatya satvaram || tapastepurmahāghoraṃ saṃgāleśvarasannidhau || 12 || saṃgāleśvaranāmānaṃ sarve pūjya yathāvidhi || bhṛguratristathā maṃkiḥ kaśyapaḥ kaṇva eva ca || 13 || gautamaḥ kauśikaścaiva kuśikaśca mahātapāḥ || śūkaro'tha bharadvājo bhārgaviśca mahātapāḥ || 14 || jātūkarṇyo vasiṣṭhaśca sāvarṇiśca parāśaraḥ || śāṃḍilyaśca pulastyaśca vatsaścaiva mahātapāḥ || 15 || ete cānye ca bahavo hyasaṃkhyātā maharṣayaḥ || 16 || saṃgāleśvaramāsādya prabhāse pāpanāśane || tapaḥ kurvaṃti satataṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || 17 || tataḥ kālena mahatā te sarve munipuṃgavāḥ || dhyānāttrilocanasyaiva adṛṣṭe tu maheśvare || 18 || trinetratvamanuprāptāstaponiṣṭhāstapodhanāḥ || parasparaṃ vīkṣamāṇāstrinetrasyābhiśaṃkayā || 19 || stuvaṃti vividhaiḥ stotrairmanyamānā maheśvaram || jñātvā dhyānena devasya trinetratvamupāgatāḥ || 7.1.304.20 || cakurugraṃ tapaste tu pūjāṃ devasya śūlinaḥ || teṣu vai tapyamāneṣu kṛpāviṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 21 || uvāca tānmunīnsarvāñchṛṇudhvaṃ varamuttamam|| prasanno'haṃ muniśreṣṭhāstapasā pūjayāpi ca || 22 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yadi prasanno deveśa varaṃ no dātumarhasi || gaṃgāmānaya vegena hyabhiṣekāya no hara || 23 || tasyāṃ kṛtābhiṣekāstu tava drohakarā vayam || ajñānabhāvātpūtatvaṃ yāsyāmaḥ pṛthivītale || 24 || || || īśvara uvāca || || yūyaṃ pavitrakaraṇāḥ pāvanānāṃ ca pāvanāḥ || gaṃgāṃ caivānayiṣyāmi yuṣmākaṃ cittatuṣṭaye || 25 || pāvitryādbhavatāṃ jātaṃ trainetryaṃ munisattamāḥ || evamuktvā tataḥ śaṃbhurdhyānastimitalocanaḥ || sasmāra kṣaṇamātreṇa gaṃgāṃ mīnakulāvṛtām || 26 || smṛtamātrā tadā devī gaṃgā tripathagāminī || bhitvā bhūmitalaṃ prāptā tatra mīnakulāvṛtā || 27 || ṛṣibhiśca yadā dṛṣṭā gaṃgā mīnayutā śubhā || dṛṣṭamātrāstu te matsyāstrinetratvamupāgatāḥ || 28 || || īśvara uvāca || || yuṣmākaṃ darśanādviprāstrinetratvamupāgatāḥ || etannidarśanaṃ sarvaṃ lokānāṃ ca pradarśanam || 29 || ||| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || asminkuṃḍe mahādeva matsyānāṃ saṃtatiḥ sadā || trinetrā tvatprasādena bhūyātsarvā yugeyuge || 7.1.304.30 || asminkuṃḍe samāgatya naraḥ snānaṃ karoti yaḥ || dadāti hema viprāya gāśca vastraṃ tathā tilān || 31 || amāvāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa trinetraḥ sa prajāyatām || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyantardhānaṃ gato haraḥ || 32 || brāhmaṇāstuṣṭisaṃyuktā gatāḥ sarve mahodayam || 33 || etatte kathitaṃ devi gaṃgāmāhātmyamuttamam || śrutaṃ pāpapraśamanaṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 34 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgāleśvarasamīpavarti gaṃgāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 304 ||
<7.1.305>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasyāḥ pūrveṇa saṃsthitam|| nāradādityanāmānaṃ jarādāridryanāśanam || 1 || paścime mūlacaṃḍīśāddhanuṣāṃ ca śatatraye || ārādhya nārado devi bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram || jarā nirmuktadehastu tatkṣaṇātsamapadyata ||2 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ jarāmanuprāpto nārado munipuṃgavaḥ || kathamārādhitaḥ sūrya etanme vada śaṃkara || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || yadā dvāravatīṃ prāpto nārado munipuṃgavaḥ || sarve dṛṣṭāstadā tena viṣṇoḥ putrā mahābalāḥ || 4 || tadrājakulamadhye tu krīḍamānā parasparam || āyāṃtaṃ nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve vinayasaṃyutāḥ || 5 || namaścakruryathānyāyaṃ vinā sāṃbaṃ tvarānvitāḥ || avinītaṃ tu taṃ dṛṣṭvā kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ || 6 || śarīramadamatto'si yasmātsāṃba hareḥ suta || acireṇaiva kālena śāpaṃ prāpsyasi dāruṇam || 7|| || sāṃba uvāca || || namaskāreṇa kiṃ kāryamṛṣīṇāṃ ca jitātmanām|| āśīrvādena teṣāṃ ca tapohāniḥ prajāyate || 8 || munīnāṃ yaḥ svabhāvo hi tvayi leśo na nārada || vidyate brahmaṇaḥ putra ucyate kimataḥ param|| 9 || na kalatraṃ na te putrā na ca pautraprapautrakāḥ || na gṛhaṃ naiva ca dvāraṃ na hi gāvo na vatsakāḥ || 7.1.305.10 || brahmaṇo mānasaḥ putro brahmacarye vyavasthitaḥ || ayuktaṃ kurute nityaṃ kasmātprakṛtirīdṛśī || 11 || yuddhaṃ vinā na te saukhyaṃ saukhyaṃ na kalahaṃ vinā || yādṛśastādṛśo vāpi vāgvādo'pi sadā priyaḥ || 12 || snānaṃ saṃdhyā japo homastarpaṇaṃ pitṛdevayoḥ || nāradaḥ kurute cānyadanyatkurvaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ || 13 || kaumāreṇa tu garviṣṭho yasmānmāṃ śāpayiṣyasi || tasmāttvamapi viprarṣe jarāyukto bhaviṣyasi || 14 || evaṃ śaptastadā devi nārado munipuṃgavaḥ || ekānte nirmale sthāne kaṃṭakāsthivivarjite || 15 || kṛṣṇājinaparicchinne hyupaviṣṭo varāsane || ṛṣitoyā taṭe ramye pratiṣṭhāpya mahāmuniḥ || 16 || sūryasya pratimāṃ ramyāṃ sarvadāridryanāśinīm || tuṣṭāva vividhaiḥ stotrairādityaṃ timirāpaham || 17 || namasta ṛksvarūpāya sāmnāṃ dhāmaga te namaḥ || jñānaikarūpadehāya nirdhūtatamase namaḥ || 18 || śuddhajyotiḥsvarūpāya nirmūrtāyāmalātmane || variṣṭhāya vareṇyāya sarvasmai paramātmane || 19 || namo'khilajagadvyāpisvarūpānaṃdamūrtaye || sarvakāraṇapūtāya niṣṭhāyai jñānacetasām || 7.1.305.20 || namaḥ sarvasvarūpāya prakāśālakṣyarūpiṇe || bhāskarāya namastubhyaṃ tathā dinakṛte namaḥ || 21 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ saṃstuvatastasya puratastasya cetasā || prādurbabhūva deveśi jagaccakṣuḥ sanātanaḥ || uvāca paramaṃ prīto nāradaṃ munipuṃgavam || 22 || || sūrya uvāca || || varaṃ varaya viprarṣe yaste manasi vartate || tuṣṭo'haṃ tava dāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 23 || || nārada uvāca || kumāra vayasā yukto jarāyuktakalevaraḥ || prasādātsyāṃ hi te deva yadi tuṣṭo divākara || 24 || saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa yastvāṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || tasya roga bhayaṃ mā'stu prasādāttimirāpaha|| 25 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā hyantardhānaṃ gato raviḥ || ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ sakalaṃ tava || nāradādityadevasya sarvapātakanāśanam|| 26 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāradādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 305 ||
<7.1.306>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sāṃbādityamanuttamam || tasmāduttarabhāge tu sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || yatra sāṃbastapastaptvā hyārādhya ca divākaram || prāptavānsundaraṃ dehaṃ sahasrāṃśuprasādataḥ || 2 || yadā roṣeṇa saṃśaptaḥ pitrā jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || ārādhayāmāsa tadā viṣṇuṃ kamalalocanam || 3 || anugrahārthaṃ śāpasya sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || prasannavadano bhūtvā viṣṇuḥ provāca taṃ prati || 4 || gaccha prābhāsike kṣetre brahmabhāgamanuttamam || ṛṣitoyātaṭe ramye brāhmaṇairupaśobhite || 5 || tatrā'haṃ sūryarūpeṇa varaṃ dāsyāmi putraka || ityuktaḥ sa tadā sāṃbo viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 6 || gataḥ prābhāsike kṣetre ramye śivapure śive || tatrārādhya paraṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ vāritaskaram || 7 || prasādayāmāsa tadā stutvā stotrairanekadhā || 8 || pratyuvāca raviḥ sāṃbaṃ prasannaste stavena vai || śīghraṃ gaccha naraśreṣṭha ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe || 9 || ityuktaḥ sa tadā''gatya ṛṣitoyātaṭaṃ śubham || nārado yatra brahmarṣistapastapyati caiva hi || 7.1.306.10 || tatra gatvā hareḥ sūnurunnatasthānavāsinaḥ || āsanye brāhmaṇāstānsa idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 11 || || sāṃba uvāca || || eṣa vai brahmaṇo bhāgaḥ prabhāse kṣetra uttame || atra vai brāhmaṇā ye tu te vai śreṣṭhāḥ smṛtā bhuvi || 12 || bhavatāṃ vacanādviprāḥ sūryamārādhayāmyaham || mama vai pūrvamādiṣṭaṃ sthānametacca viṣṇunā || 13 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || siddhiste bhavitā sāṃba ārādhaya divākaram || ityuktaḥ sa tadā vipraiḥ praviṣṭo'tha prabhākaram|| 14 || nityamārādhayāmāsa sāṃbo jāṃbavatīsutaḥ || taponiṣṭhaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuḥ kāruṇiko mahān || 15 || idaṃ vai cintayāmāsa putravātsalyasaṃyutaḥ || yathaiśvaryaprado rudro yathā viṣṇuśca muktidaḥ || 16 || yajñairiṣṭo hi devendro yathā svargapradaḥ smṛtaḥ || śuddhikartṛ yathā toyaṃ mṛttikābhasmasaṃyutam || dahanātmā yathā vahnirvighnaharttā gaṇeśvaraḥ || 17 || svacchaṃdabhāratīdāne yathā brahmasutā nṛṇām || tathā''rogyapradātā ca nānyo devo divākarāt || 18 || anekadhā''rādhito'pi sa devo bhāskaraḥ śuciḥ || na dadāti varaṃ yattu tanme śāpasya kāraṇāt || 19 || evaṃ saṃcintya bhagavānviṣṇuḥ kamalalocanaḥ || sūryarūpaṃ samāśritya tasya tuṣṭo janārdanaḥ || 7.1.306.20 || yo'paranārāyaṇakhyastasyaiva sannidhau sthitaḥ || pratyakṣaḥ sa tato viṣṇuḥ sūryarūpī divākaraḥ || uvāca paramaprīto varadaḥ puṇyakarmaṇām || 21 || alaṃ kleśena te sāṃba kimarthaṃ tapyase tapaḥ || prasanno'haṃ hareḥ sūno varaṃ varaya suvrata || 22 || || sāṃba uvāca || || nirmalastvatprasādena kuṣṭhamuktakalevaraḥ || bhavāni devadeveśa pratyakṣā'mbarabhūṣaṇa || asminsthāne sthito ramye nityaṃ sannihito bhava || 23 || || sūrya uvāca || || adhunā nirmalo dehastava sāṃba bhaviṣyati || ihāgatya naro yastu saptamyāṃ ravivāsare || upavāsaparo bhūtvā rātrau jāgaraṇe sthitaḥ || 24 || aṣṭādaśāni kuṣṭhāni pāparogāstathaiva ca || kadācinna bhaviṣyanti kule tasya mahātmanaḥ || 25 || kṛtvā snānaṃ naro yastu bhaktiyukto jitendriyaḥ || pūjayedravivāreṇa sāṃbādityaṃ mahāprabham || sa rogahīno dhanavānputravāñjāyate naraḥ || 26 || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidīśānamāśritam || kuṃḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ svacchodapari pūritam|| 27 || tatra snātvāc vidhivatkuryācchrāddhaṃ vicakṣaṇaḥ || bhojayedbrāhmaṇānyastu sāṃbādityaṃ prapūjayet || 28 || sarvakāmasamṛddhātmā sūrya loke mahīyate || 29|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye sāṃbāditya māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍuttaratriśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 306 || || cha ||
<7.1.307>
|| īśvara uvāca || || sāṃbādityācca pūrveṇa kiñcidāgneyasaṃsthitaḥ || aparanārāyaṇonāma yasmānnāsti paro bhuvi || 1 || sa tu sāṃbasya deveśi sūryo viṣṇusvarūpavān || aparāṃ mūrtimāsthāya viṣṇurūpo varaṃ dadau || 2 || tenāpareti nāmnā vai khyāto viṣṇuḥ purā'bhavat || phālgunāmalapakṣe tu ekādaśyāṃ vidhānataḥ || 3 || pūjayetpuṇḍarīkākṣaṃ tatra sūryasvarūpiṇam || mukto bhavati pāpebhyaḥ sarvakāmaiḥ samṛdhyate || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātsye'paranārāyaṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 307 || || cha ||
<7.1.308>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmānnārāyaṇātpūrve kiṃcidīśānasaṃsthitam || mūlacaṇḍīśanāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatrayaṃ || 1 || yatra liṃgaṃ purā'smākaṃ pātitaṃ tvṛṣibhiḥ priye || krodharaktekṣaṇairdevi mūlacaṇḍīśatā(?) gatam || 2 || ādyaṃ liṃgodbhavaṃ devi ṛṣikopānnipātitam || ye kecidṛṣayastatra devadāruvane sthitāḥ || 3 || kālāṃtare mahādevi ahaṃ tatra samāgataḥ || teṣāṃ jijñāsayā devi tataste roṣitā bhavan || śaptastato'haṃ deveśi cakrurme liṃgapātanam || 4 || || || devyuvāca || || roṣopahatasadbhāvāḥ kathamete dvijātayaḥ || saṃjātā etadākhyāhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ mama || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || ḍiṃḍi rūpaḥ purā devi bhūtvā'haṃ dāruke vane || ṛṣīṇāmāśrame puṇye nagno bhikṣācaro'bhavam || bhikṣaṃtamāśrame dṛṣṭvā tāḥ sarvā ṛṣiyoṣitaḥ || 6 || kāmasya vaśamāpannāḥ priyamutsṛjya sarvataḥ|| tamūrdhvaliṃgamālokya jaṭāmukuṭadhāriṇam || 7 || || bhikṣaṃtaṃ bhasmadigdhāṃgaṃ jhaṣaketumivāparam || vikṣobhitāśca naḥ sarve dārā etena ḍiṃḍinā || 8 || tasmācchāpaṃ ca dāsyāma ṛṣayaste tadā'bruvan || tataḥ śāpodakaṃ gṛhya saṃdhyātvā'tha tapodhanāḥ || 9 || asya liṃgamadho yātu dṛśyate yatsadonnatam || ityukte patitaṃ liṃgaṃ tatra devakule mama || 7.1.308.10 || mūlacaṇḍīśanāmnā tu vikhyātaṃ bhuvanatraye || talliṃgaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā kopopahatacetasaḥ || punarhaṃtuṃ samārabdhā ḍiṃḍinaṃ te tapodhanāḥ || 11 || vṛsikāpāṇayaḥ kecitkamaṃḍaludharāḥ pare || gṛhītvā pādukāścānye tasya dhāvaṃti pṛṣṭhataḥ || 12 || ḍiṃḍiścāṃtarhito bhūtvā tvāmuvāca sumadhyamām || roṣopahatacetaskānpaśyaitāṃstvaṃ tapodhanān || 13 || etasmātkāraṇāddevi tava vākyānmayā'naghe || na kṛto'nugrahasteṣāṃ saroṣāṇāṃ tapasvinām || 14 || atrāṃtare te munayo hyapaśyaṃto hi ḍiṃḍinam || nirānaṃdaṃ gatāḥ sarve draṣṭuṃ devaṃ pitāmaham|| 15 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vibudheśānaṃ viraṃciṃ vigatajvaram || praṇamya śirasā sarva ṛṣayaḥ prāhuraṃjasā || 16 || bhagavanḍiṃḍi rūpeṇa kaścidasti tapodhanaḥ || vidhvaṃsanāya dārāṇāṃ praviṣṭaḥ kila bhikṣitum|| 17 || śapto'smābhistu durvṛttastasya liṃgaṃ nipātitam|| tasminnipatite'smākaṃ tathaiva patitāni ca || 18 || gato'sau kāraṇāttasmāttalliṃge patite vayam || nirānaṃdāḥ sthitāḥ sarva ācakṣvaitaddhi kāraṇam ||19||| || || brahmovāca || || aśobhanamidaṃ kāryaṃ yuṣmābhiryatkṛtaṃ mahat| rudrasyātisurūpasya serṣyā ye hantumudyatāḥ ||7.1.308.20|| āsurīṃ dānavīṃ daivīṃ yakṣiṇīṃ kiṃnarīṃ tathā || vidyādharīṃ ca gandharvīṃ nāgakanyāṃ manoramām || etā varastriyastyaktvā yuṣmadīyāsu tāsvapi || 21 || āhlādaṃ kurute sarve naiva jānīta bho dvijāḥ || trailokyanāyakāṃ sarvāṃ rūpātiśayasaṃyutām || 22 || tāṃ tyaktvā munipatnīnāmāhlādaṃ kurute katham || tayā rudro hi vijñapta ṛṣīṇāṃ kurvanugraham || 23 || tena vākyena pārvatyā jijñāsārthaṃ kṛtaṃ manaḥ || caturddaśavidhasyāpi bhūtagrāmasya yaḥ prabhuḥ || 24 || sa śapto ḍiṃḍirūpastu bhavadbhiḥ karaṇeśvaraḥ || tacchāpācchaptamevaitatsamastaṃ tadguṇāspadam || devatiryaṅmanuṣyāṇāṃ nirānaṃdamiti sthitam || 25 || śāpenānena bhavatāṃ mahā doṣaḥ prajāyate || ārādhyaṃ nānyathā liṃgamunnatiṃ yātyadhogatam || 26 || evamukte'tha devena viprā ūcuḥ pitāmaham || draṣṭavyaḥ kutra so'smābhiḥ kathayasva yathāsthitam || 27 || || brahmovāca || || āste gajasvarūpeṇa kuberāśramasaṃsthitaḥ || tatra gatvā tamāsādya toṣayadhvaṃ pinākinam || || 28 || etacchrutvā vacastasya sarve te hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || gaṃtuṃ pravṛttāḥ sahasā koṭisaṃkhyāstapodhanāḥ || 29 || ciṃtayaṃtaḥ śubhaṃ deśaṃ draṣṭuṃ taṃ gajarūpiṇam || rudraṃ pitāmahākhyātaṃ kuberāśramavāsinam || 7.1.308.30 || kṣutkāmakaṃṭhāstṛṣitāngaurī matvā tapodhanān || ādāya gorasaṃ teṣāṃ kāruṇyātsā puraḥ sthitā || 31 || asitāṃ kuṭilāṃ snigdhāmāyatāṃ bhujagīmiva || veṇīṃ śirasi bibhrāṇā gaurī gorasasaṃyutā || 32 || sā tānāha munīnsarvānyanmayā parvatāhṛtam|| kapitthaphalasaṃgaṃdhaṃ gorasaṃ tvamṛtopamam ||33|| tayaivamuktā viprāstu āhustāṃ vipulekṣaṇām || snātvā ca sarve pāsyāmo gorasaṃ tu tvayāhṛtam || 34 || tataḥ śrutvā tathā devyā snānārthaṃ tīrthamuttamam || taptodakenasaṃpūrṇaṃ kṛtaṃ kuṇḍaṃ manoramam || 35 || tatra te saṃplutāḥ sarve vimuktā vipulācchramāt|| kṛtā''hnā gorasasvaiva pānārthaṃ samupasthitāḥ||36|| patrairdivākaratarorvidhāya puṭakāñchubhān || upaviśya kramātsarve te pibaṃti sma gorasam || 37 || gorasena tadā teṣāmamṛteneva pūritān|| bubhukṣitānāṃ puṭakānmunīnāṃ tṛptikāraṇāt ||38|| punaḥ pūrayate gaurī pītvā te tṛptimāgatāḥ|| kṣuttṛṣāśramanirmuktāḥ punarjātā iva sthitāḥ ||39|| svasthacittaistato jñātvā neyaṃ gopālisaṃjñikā || anugrahārthamasmākaṃ gaurīyaṃ samupāgatā ||7.1.308.40|| praṇamya śirasā sarve tāmūcuste sumadhyamām|| ume kathaya kutrasthaṃ drakṣyāmo rudramekadā || 41 || tathoktāste mahātmānastaṃ paśyata mahāgajam || gajatāṃ ca samāsādya saṃcaraṃtaṃ mahābalam || 42 || bhavadbhirnijabhaktyāyaṃ saṃgrāhyo hi yathāsukham || te tadvacanamāsādya sametyaikatra ca dvijāḥ || || 43 || pavitrāstaṃ gajaṃ draṣṭuṃ bhāvitenāṃtarātmanā || yatraikatra sthitā viprāstatra tīrthaṃ mahodayam || saṃgameśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu pūrvaṃ sarvatra viśrutam || 44 || tatastasmātpravṛttāste draṣṭukāmā mahāgajam || kuṃḍikāḥ saṃparityajya saṃnahyātmānamātmanā ||45|| yatra tāḥ kuṃḍikāstyaktāstattīrthaṃ kuṇḍikāhvayam || sarvapāpaharaṃ puṃsāṃ dṛṣṭā'dṛṣṭaphalapradam || 46 || kuberasyāśramaṃ prāpya tataste munisattamāḥ || nālikeravanīsaṃsthaṃ dadṛśustaṃ dvipaṃ tadā || 47 || kare grahītumārabdhāḥ svakarairhṛṣṭamānasāḥ || gajastānkarasaṃlagnānvicikṣepa tapodhanān || 48 || kāścidaṃgasamālagnānsamaṃtādbhayavarjitān || evaṃ sa taiḥ punaḥ sarvairmaśakairiva ceṣṭitam || 49 || krīḍāṃ karoti vividhāṃ vanasaṃstho haradvipaḥ || tadrūpaṃ saṃparityajya rudro raudragajātmakam || 7.1.308.50 || punaranyaccakārāsau ḍiṃḍirūpaṃ manoramam || jayaśabdapraghoṣeṇa vedamaṅgalagītakaiḥ || 51 || unnāmitaṃ punastena yatra liṃgaṃ mahodayam || tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam || 52 || gajarūpadharastatra sthitaḥ sthāne mahābalaḥ || gaṇanāthasvarūpeṇa hyunnato jagati sthitaḥ || 53 || ḍiṃḍirūpa dharo bhūtvā rudraḥ prāha tapodhanān || yanmayā bhavatāṃ kāryaṃ kartavyaṃ tadihocyatām || 54 || evamuktastu tairuktaḥ sarvajñānakriyāparaiḥ || sānandāḥ prāṇinaḥ saṃtu tvatprasādātpurā yathā || 55 || kṣaṃtavyaṃ devadeveśa kṛtaṃ yanmūḍhamānasaiḥ || tvatprasādātsureśāna tattvaṃ sānugraho bhava || 56 || evamastviti tenoktāste sarve vigatajvarāḥ || talliṃgānukṛtiṃ liṃgamījire munayastathā || cakruste munayaḥ sarve stutiṃ vigatamatsarāḥ || 57 || kṣamasva devadeveśa kurvasmākamanugraham || asmim̐lliṃge layaṃ gaccha mūlacaṇḍīśasaṃjñake || trikālaṃ devadeveśa grāhyā hyatra kalā tvayā || 58 || || || īśvara uvāca || || caṇḍī tu procyate devī tasyā īśastvahaṃ smṛtaḥ || tasya mūlaṃ smṛtaṃ liṃgaṃ tadatra patitaṃ yataḥ || 59 || tasmāttanmūla caṇḍīśa iti khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || vā pīkūpataḍāgānāṃ śataistu vipulairapi || 7.1.308.60 || kṛtairyajjāyate puṇyaṃ tatpuṇyaṃ liṃgadarśanāt || brahmāṇḍaṃ sakalaṃ dattvā yatpuṇyaphalamāpnuyāt || 61 || tatpuṇyaṃ labhate devi mūlacaṇḍīśadarśanāt || tatra dānāni deyāni ṣoḍaśaiva narottamaiḥ || 62 || evaṃ tadbhavitā sarvaṃ yanmayoktaṃ dvijottamāḥ || yāta dāruvanaṃ viprāḥ sarve yūyaṃ tapodhanāḥ || mayā sarve samādiṣṭā yāta dāruvanaṃ dvijāḥ || 63 || tatastu saṃprāpya mahadvaco mama sarve prahṛṣṭā munayo mahodayam || gatvā ca taddāruvanaṃ maheśvari punaśca ceruḥ sutapastapodhanāḥ || 64 || etasmātkāraṇāddevi mūlacaṇḍīśasaṃjñitam || liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāmarddhacandreṇa bhūṣitam || 65 || dohanī dugthadānena munīnāṃ tṛṣitātmanām || śramāpahāraṃ yaddevi tvayā kṛtamanuttamam || tattaptodakanāmnā vā abhūtkuṇḍaṃ dharātale ||66 || ṛṣitoyājale snātvā caṇḍīśaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet || sa pracaṇḍo bhavedbhūmau bhuvanānāmadhīśvaraḥ || 67 || etatsaṃkṣepato devi māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ tava || mūlacaṇḍīśadevasya śrutaṃ pātakanāśanam || 68 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye taptodakakuṇḍotpattau mūlacaṇḍīśotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭottara triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 308 || || cha ||
<7.1.309>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vināyakamanuttamam || caturmukheti vikhyātaṃ caṇḍīśāduttare sthitam || 1 || kiñcidīśānadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ ca catuṣṭaye || taṃ prayatnācca saṃpūjya sarvavighnaiḥ pramucyate || 2 || gandhapuṣpādibhistatra bhakṣyairbhojyaiḥ samodakaiḥ || caturmukhaṃ caturthyāṃ tu saṃpūjya siddhibhāgbhavet || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahapurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye caturmukhavināyaka māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 309 || cha ||
<7.1.310>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādvāyavyadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ dvitaye sthitam || kalaṃbeśvaranāmānaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ||| somavāre tvamāvāsyā tatraiva bahupuṇyadā || viprāṇāṃ bhojanaṃ deyaṃ tatra puṇya phalepsubhiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kalaṃbeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma daśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 310 || || cha ||
<7.1.311>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi gopālasvāminaṃ harim || caṇḍīśātpūrvadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ viṃśatau sthitam || 1 || sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ dāridryaughavināśanam|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca māghe māsi viśeṣataḥ || pūjā jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tatra gacchetparaṃ padam || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gopāla svāmiharimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 311 || || cha ||
<7.1.312>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmāduttaradigbhāge dhanuṣāmaṣṭabhiḥ priye || bakulasvāminaṃ sūryaṃ taṃ paśyedduḥkhanāśanam || 1 || ravivāreṇa saptamyāṃ kuryājjāgaraṇaṃ naraḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti sūryaloke mahīyate || || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bakulasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāda śottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 312 || || cha ||
<7.1.313>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādvāyavyadigbhāge dhanuḥṣoḍaśabhiḥ sthitaḥ || uttarārkaśca nāmnā vai sadyaḥ pratyayakārakaḥ || mucyate sarvarogaistu kṛtvā vai niṃbasaptamīm|| 1 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya uttarārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 313 || || cha ||
<7.1.314>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha devakulāgneyyāṃ gavyūtyā tatra saṃsthitam || samudrasya taṭe ramyamṛṣitīrthamanuttamam || 1 || pāṣāṇākṛtayastatra ṛṣayo'dyāpi saṃsthitāḥ || dṛśyaṃte mānuṣe devi sarvapātakanāśanāḥ || 2 || tatra jyeṣṭhe tvamāvāsyāṃ prāpyate nādhamairnnaraiḥ || piṃḍadānaṃ viśeṣeṇa snānaṃ śraddhāsamanvitaiḥ || 3 || ṛṣitoyāsaṃgame tu snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ sudurlabham || gopradānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tatra te munipugavāḥ || bhojanaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu yathāśaktyā pradāpayet ||4|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mūlacaṃḍīśamāhātmya ṛṣitīrthasaṃgamamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 314 || || cha ||
<7.1.315>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi marudāryāṃ mahāprabhām || tasmātpaścimadigbhāge krośārddhena vyavasthitām || 1 || marudbhiḥ pūjitāṃ devīṃ sarvakāmaphalapradām || mahānavamyāṃ yatnena saptamyāṃ pūjayennaraḥ || gaṃdhapuṣpādividhinā sarvakāmaprasiddhaye || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye marudāryādevīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 315 || || cha ||
<7.1.316>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha devakulātpūrve paṃcagavyūtimātrataḥ || śaṃbarasthāna madhye tu kṣemādityeti viśrutaḥ || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi bhavetkṣemārthasiddhibhāk || saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa pūjitaḥ sarvakāmadaḥ || 2 || iti devakulasthāne kathitā tīrthasaṃsthitiḥ || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetra māhātmye kṣemādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 316 ||
<7.1.317>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ kaṃṭakaśoṣiṇīm || uttareṇa devakulāddakṣiṇenonnatātsthitāt || 1 || tasyotpattiṃ pravakṣyāmi śṛṇu hyekamanāḥ priye || unnatāddakṣiṇe bhāge yajaṃte dvijasattamāḥ || 2 || bhṛguratrirmarīciśca bharadvājo'tha kaśyapaḥ || kaṇvo maṃkiśca sāvarṇirjātūkarṇyastathaiva ca || 3 || vatsaścaiva vasiṣṭhaśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥ || manuryamoṃ'girā viṣṇuḥ śātātapaparāśarau || 4 || śāṃḍilyaḥ kauśikaścaiva gautamo gārgya eva ca || dālbhyaśca śaunakaścaiva śākalyo gālavastathā || 5 || jābālirmudgalaścaiva ṛṣyaśṛṃgo vibhāṃḍakaḥ || viśvāmitraḥ śatānaṃdo jahnurviśvāvasustathā || 6 || ete cānye ca munayo yajaṃte vividhairmakhaiḥ || yajñavāṭaṃ ca nirmāya ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe || 7 || devagandharvanṛtyaiśca veṇuvīṇānināditam || vedadhvanitaghoṣeṇa yajñahomāgnihotrajaiḥ || 8 || dhūpaiḥ samāvṛtaṃ sarvamājyagaṃdhibhirarcitam || śobhitaṃ munibhirdivyaiścāturvedyairdvijottamaiḥ || 9 || evaṃvidhaṃ pradeśaṃ tu dṛṣṭvā daityā mahābalāḥ || samudramadhyādāyātā yajñavidhvaṃsahetave || 7.1.317.10 || māyāvino mahākāyāḥ śyāmavarṇā mahodarāḥ || laṃbabhrūśmaśrunāsāgrā raktākṣā raktamūrdhajāḥ || 11 || yajñaṃ samāgatāḥ sarve daityāścaiva varānane || tāndṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve raudrarūpānbhayaṃkarān || 12 || kecinnipatitā bhūmau tathānye 'gnau srucīkarāḥ || patnīśālāṃ samāviṣṭā havirdhānaṃ tathā pare || 13 || ṛtvijastu sadomadhye sthitā vācaṃyamāstathā || 14 || evaṃ devi yadā vṛttaṃ munīnāṃ ca mahātmanām || tadādhvaryurmahātejā dhairyamālambya sādaraḥ || 15 || agnihotraṃ haviṣyaṃ ca havirvinyasya mantravit || susamiddhaṃ juhāvāgniṃ rakṣasāṃ nāśahetave || 16 || hute haviṣi deveśi tatkṣaṇādeva cotthitā || śaktiḥ śaktitriśūlāḍhyā carmahastā mahojjvalā || 17 || tayā te nihatā daityā yajñavidhvaṃsakāriṇaḥ || tatastāṃ vividhaiḥ stotrairmunayastuṣṭuvustadā || 18 || prasannā bhūyasī devī tānṛṣīnpratyuvāca ha || varaṃ vṛṇudhvaṃ munayo dāsyāmi varamuttamam|| 19 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kṛtaṃ vai sakalaṃ kāryaṃ yajñā no rakṣitāstvayā || yadi deyo varo'smākaṃ tvayā cāsuramarddini || 7.1.317.20 || asminsthāne sadā tiṣṭha munīnāṃ hitakāmyayā || kaṃṭakāḥ śoṣitā daityāstena kaṃṭakaśoṣiṇī || adyaprabhṛti nāmāstu tena devi sadā tviha || 21 || || īśvara uvāca || || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā sā devyantarhitā tadā || aṣṭamyāṃ vā navamyāṃ vā pūjayiṣyati mā navaḥ || 22 || rākṣasebhyaḥ piśācebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na jāyate || prāpnuyātparamāṃ siddhiṃ mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 23 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kaṃṭakaśoṣaṇīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||317|| ||
<7.1.318>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasyāśca pūrvadigbhāge nātidūre vyavasthitam || liṃgaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ hi sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || brahmeśvareti nāmāḍhyaṃ brāhmaṇaiśca pratiṣṭhitam || ṛṣitoyājale snātvā talliṃgaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet || sa bhavedvedavidvipro jāḍyabhāvavivarjitaḥ || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye brahmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśottaratriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 318 ||
<7.1.319>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hyunnatasthānamuttamam || tasyaivottaradigbhāga ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe || 1 || etatsthānaṃ mahādevi viprebhyaḥ prādadāṃ balāt || sarvasīmāsamāyuktaṃ caṃḍīgaṇasurakṣitam || 2 || || devyuvāca || || kathamunnatanāmāsya babhūva surasattama || kathaṃ tvayā balāddattaṃ kiyatsīmāsamanvitam || 3 || etatsarvaṃ mamācakṣva saṃkṣepānnātivistarāt || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā mānavo devi mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 5 || etatsarvaṃ purā proktaṃ sthānasaṃketakāraṇam || tṛtīye brahmaṇaḥ kuṃḍe sṛṣṭisaṃkṣepasūcake || 6 || tathāpi te pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepācchuṇu pārvati || 7 || unnāmitaṃ punastatra yatra liṃgaṃ mahodaye || tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam|| 8 || athavā connataṃ dvāraṃ pūrvaṃ prābhāsikasya vai || tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam || 9 || vidyayā tapasā caiva yatrotkṛṣṭā maharṣayaḥ || tadunnatamiti proktaṃ sthānaṃ sthānavatāṃ varam || 7.1.319.10 || yadā devakule viprā mūlacaṃḍīśasaṃjñakam || prasādya ca mahādevaṃ punaḥ prāptā mahodayam || 11 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi tapastepurmaharṣayaḥ || dhyāyamānā maheśānamanādinidhanaṃ param || 12 || teṣu vai tapyamāneṣu koṭisaṃkhyeṣu pārvati || ṛṣitoyātaṭe ramye pavitre pāpanāśane || bhikṣurbhūtvā gataścāhaṃ punastatraiva bhāmini || 13 || trikālaṃ darśibhistatra doṣarāgavivarjitaiḥ || tapasvibhistadā sarvairlakṣito'haṃ varānane || 14 || dṛṣṭamātrastadā viprairvirarāma maheśvaraḥ || kva yāsi vidito deva ityuktvānuyayurdvijāḥ || 15 || yāvadāyāṃti munaya īśeśeti prabhāṣakāḥ || dhāvamānāḥ svatapasā dyotayanto diśodaśa || 16 || liṃgameva prapaśyaṃti na paśyaṃti maheśvaram || 17 || yeye ca dadṛśurliṃgaṃ mūlacaṇḍīśasaṃjñakam || tadā ca munayaḥ sarve sadehāḥ svargamāyayuḥ || 18 || yadā triviṣṭapaṃ vyāptaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ vai śatayajvanā || āyāṃti ca tathaivānye munayastapasojvalāḥ || 19 || etadaṃtaramāsādya samāgatya mahītale || liṃgamācchādayāmāsa vajreṇaiva śatakratuḥ || 7.1.319.20 || aṣṭādaśasahasrāṇi munīnāmūrdhvaretasām || sthitāni na tu paśyaṃti liṃgametadanuttamam || 21 || śakrastu sahasā dṛṣṭo vajreṇaiva samanvitaḥ || yāvadvadaṃti śāpaṃ te tāvannaṣṭaḥ puraṃdaraḥ || 22|| dṛṣṭvā tānkopasaṃyuktānbhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ || uvāca sāṃtvayandevo vācā madhurayā munīn || 23 || kathaṃ khinnā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ sadā śāṃtiparāyaṇāḥ || prasannavadanā bhūtvā śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ mama || 24 || bhavadbhirjñānasaṃyuktaiḥ svargaḥ kiṃ manyate bahu || yatraike vasavaḥ proktā ādityāśca tathā pare ||25 || rudrasaṃjñāstathā caike hyaśvināvapi cāparau || eteṣāmadhipaḥ kaścideka indraḥ prakīrtitaḥ || 26 || svapuṇyasaṃkhyayā prāpte yasmādvibhraśyate naraiḥ || evaṃ duḥkhasamāyuktaḥ svargo naiveṣyate budhaiḥ || 27 || etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama || gṛhṇīdhvaṃ nagaraṃ ramyaṃ nivāsāya mahāprabham || 28 || hūyaṃtāmagnihotrāṇi devatāḥ sarvadā dvijāḥ || ijyaṃtāṃ vividhairyāgaiḥ kriyatāṃ pitṛpūjanam || 29 || ātithyaṃ kriyatā nityaṃ vedābhyāsastathaiva hi || 7.1.319.30 || evaṃ hi kurvatāṃ nityaṃ vinā jñānasya saṃcayaiḥ || prasādānmama viprendrāḥ prāṃte muktirbhaviṣyati || 31 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || asamarthāḥ paritrāṇe jitāhārāstaponvitāḥ || nagareṇeha kiṃ kurmastava bhaktimabhīpsavaḥ || || 32 || || īśvara uvāca || || bhaviṣyati sadā bhaktiryuṣmākaṃ parameśvare || gṛhṇīdhvaṃ nagaraṃ ramyaṃ kurudhvaṃ vacanaṃ mama || 33 || ityuktvā bhagavāndeva īṣanmīlitalocanaḥ || sasmāra viśvakarmāṇaṃ sarvaśilpavatāṃ varam || 34 || smṛtamātro viśvakarmā prāṃjaliścāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || ājñāpayatu māṃ devo vacanaṃ karavāṇi te || 35 || || īśvara uvāca || || nagaraṃ kriyatāṃ tvaṣṭarviprārthaṃ suṃdaraṃ śubham || 36 || ityukto viśvakarmā sa bhūmiṃ vīkṣya samaṃtataḥ || uvāca praṇato bhūtvā śaṃkaraṃ lokaśaṃkaram || 37 || parīkṣitā mayā bhūmirna yuktaṃ nagaraṃ tviha || atra devakulaṃ sākṣālliṃgasya patanaṃ tathā || 38 || yatibhiścātra vastavyaṃ na yuktaṃ gṛhamedhinām || 39 || trirātraṃ paṃcarātraṃ vā saptarātraṃ maheśvara || pakṣaṃ māsamṛtuṃ vāpi hyayanaṃ yāvadeva ca || putradārayutaistīrthe vastavyaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ || 7.1.319.40 || vasatyūrdhvaṃ tu ṣaṇmāsādyadā tīrthe gṛhādhipaḥ || avajñā jāyate tasya manaścāpalyabhāvataḥ || tadā dharmādvinaśyaṃti sakalā gṛhamedhinaḥ || 41 || ityuktaḥ sa tadā devastena vai viśvakarmaṇā || punaḥ provāca taṃ tasya praśasya vacanaṃ śivaḥ || 42 || rocate me na vāso'tra viprāṇāṃ gṛhamedhinām || yatra connāmitaṃ liṃgamṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe || tatra nirmāpaya tvaṣṭarnagaraṃ śilpināṃ vara || 43 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā viśvakarmā tvarānvitaḥ || gatvā cakāra nagaraṃ śilpikoṭibhirāvṛtaḥ || 44 || unnataṃ nāma yalloke vikhyātaṃ surasundari || tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā vilokya nagaraṃ śivaḥ || āhūya brāhmaṇānsarvānuvācānatakandharaḥ ||45 || idaṃ sthānaṃ varaṃ ramyaṃ nirmitaṃ viśvakarmaṇā || grāmāṇāṃ ca sahasraistu proktaṃ sarvāsu dikṣu ca||46 || nagarātsarvataḥ puṇyo deśo nagnaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || aṣṭayojanavistīrṇa āyāmavyāsatastathā || 47 || nagno bhūtvā haro yatra deśe bhrāṃto yadṛcchayā || taṃ nagnaharamityāhurdeśaṃ puṇyatamaṃ janāḥ || 48 || pūrve tu śāṃkarī cā''ryā paścime nyaṃkumatyapi || uttare kanakanaṃdā dakṣiṇe sāgarāvadhiḥ || etadaṃtaramāsādya deśo nagnaharaḥ smṛtaḥ || 49 || aṣṭayojanamānena āyāmavyāsatastathā || prokto'yaṃ sakalo deśa unnatena samaṃ mayā || 7.1.319.50 || gṛhyatāṃ nagaraśreṣṭhaṃ prasīdadhvaṃ dvijottamāḥ || atra bhaktiśca muktiśca bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 51 || ityuktāste tadā sarve viprā ūcurmaheśvaram || 52 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || īśvarājñā vṛthā kartuṃ na śakyā paramātmanaḥ || tapo'gnihotraniṣṭhānāṃ vedādhyayanaśālinām ||53|| asmākaṃ rakṣitā ko'sti kalikāle ca dāruṇe || ko dātā''rogyadaḥ kaśca ko vai muktiṃ pradāsyati || 54 || || īśvara uvāca || || mahākāla svarūpeṇa sthitvā tīrthe mahodaye || nāśayiṣyāmi śatrūnvaḥ samyagārādhito hyaham || 55 || unnato vighnarājastu vighnacchettā bhaviṣyati || gaṇanāthasvarūpo'yaṃ dhanado nidhīnāṃ patiḥ || 56 || yuṣmabhyaṃ dāsyati dravyaṃ samyagārādhito'pi saḥ || ārogyadāyako nityaṃ durgādityo bhaviṣyati || 57 || mahodayaṃ mahānandadāyakaṃ vo bhaviṣyati || samyagārādhito brahmā sarvakāryeṣu sarvadā || sarvānkāmāṃśca muktiṃ ca yuṣmabhyaṃ saṃpradāsyati || 58 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || yadi tīrthāni tiṣṭhaṃti sarvāṇi surasattama || saṃgāleśvaratīrthe ca tathā devakule śive || || 59 || kalāvapi mahāraudre hyasmākaṃ pāvanāya vai || sthātavyaṃ tarhi gṛhṇīmo nānyathā ca maheśvara || 7.1.319.60 || sa tatheti pratijñāya dadau tebhyaḥ puraṃ varam || saptabhaumaiḥ śaśāṃkābhaiḥ prāsādaiḥ paribhūṣitam || nānāgrāmasamāyuktaṃ sarvataḥ sīmayānvitam || 61 || || sūta uvāca || || evaṃ tebhyo hi nagaraṃ dattvā devo maheśvaraḥ || dadarśa viśvakarmāṇaṃ prāñjaliṃ purataḥ sthitam || 62 || || viśvakarmovāca || || vilokyatāṃ mahādeva nagaraṃ nagaropamam || sauvarṇasthalamāruhya nirmitaṃ tvatprasādataḥ || 63 || viśvakarmavacaḥ śrutvā bhagavāṃstripurāntakaḥ || samāruroha sthalakaṃ saha sarvairmaharṣibhiḥ || 64 || nagaraṃ vilokayāmāsa ramyaṃ prākāramaṇḍitam || ṛṣayastuṣṭuvuḥ sarve tatrasthaṃ tripurāntakam || tānuvāca mahādevo vṛṇudhvaṃ varamutta mam|| 65 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva sthalakeśvaranāmabhṛt || avalokayaṃśca nagaraṃ sadā tiṣṭha sthale hara || 66 || ityuktastaistadā devaḥ sthalake'sminsadā sthitaḥ || kṛte ratnamayaṃ devi tretāyāṃ ca hiraṇmayam || 67 || raupyaṃ ca dvāpare proktaṃ sthalamaśmamayaṃ kalau || evaṃ tatra sthito devaḥ sthalakeśvaranāmataḥ || 68 || sadā pūjyo mahādeva unnatasthānavāsibhiḥ || māghe māsi caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣastatra jāgare || 69 || ityetatkathitaṃ devi hyunnatasya mahodyam || śrutaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ sarvakāmaphalapradam || 7.1.319.70 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasthānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 319 || || cha ||
<7.1.320>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmācca pūrvadigbhāge kiñcidāgneyasaṃsthitam || liṃgadvayaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ viśvakarmapratiṣṭhitam || 1 || yadā vai nagaraṃ kartuṃ tvaṣṭā tatra samāgataḥ || pratiṣṭhāpya mahādevaṃ nagaraṃ kṛtavāṃstataḥ || 2 || kṛtvā ca nagaraṃ ramyaṃ liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || punaḥ pratiṣṭhitaṃ rligaṃ tena vai viśvakarmaṇā || 3 || karmādau karmaṇaścānte yātrodvāhagṛhādike || liṃgadvayaṃ pūjayitvā siddhimāpnoti tatkṣaṇāt || 4 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gaṃdhāmṛtarasodakaiḥ || naivedyai vividhairdevi liṃgayugmaṃ prapūjayet || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasthānamāhātmye liṃgadvayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśottaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 320 || || cha ||
<7.1.321>
|| īśvara uvāca || || atha te kīrtayiṣyāmi rahasyaṃ sthānamuttamam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṝṇāmunnatasthānavāsinām || 1 || śreṣṭhadevasya māhātmyaṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ || unnatasthānasaṃsthasya devasya bālarūpiṇaḥ || yasya darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 2 || || devyuvāca || bālarūpīti yatproktamunnataṃ tatkathaṃ vada || sthāneṣvanyeṣu sarvatra vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ || 3 || kasminsthāne sthitastatra kimarthaṃ tatra vā gataḥ || kathaṃ sa pūjyo viprendraistithau kasyāṃ kramādvada || 4 || || || īśvara uvāca || || ṛṣitoyāpaścime tu aiśānyāṃ sthalakeśvarāt || brahmaṇaḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaloka ivāparaḥ || 5 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca pūjyāḥ prābhāsike sadā || brahmabhāge sthito brahmā ṛṣitoyātaṭe śubhe || 6 || rudrabhāge'gnitīrthe ca pūjyo rudraḥ sanātanaḥ || girau raivatake ramye pūjyo dāmodaro hariḥ || 7 || somena prārthito devo bālarūpī pitāmahaḥ || āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu hyunnate sthāna uttame || 8 || dṛṣṭvā brahmā dvijāñchreṣṭhāṃstatra sthāne sthito vibhuḥ || 9 || nāsti brahmasamo devo nāsti brahmasamo guruḥ || nāsti brahmasamaṃ jñānaṃ nāsti brahmasamaṃ tapaḥ || 7.1.321.10 || tāvadbhramaṃti saṃsāre duḥkhaśokabhayāplutāḥ || na bhavaṃti surajyeṣṭhe yāvadbhaktāḥ pitāmahe || 11 || samāsaktaṃ yathā cittaṃ jaṃtorviṣayagocare || yadyevaṃ brahmaṇi nyastaṃ ko na mucyeta baṃdhanāt || 12 || paramāyuḥ smṛto brahmā parārdhaṃ tasya vai gatam || unnatasthānasaṃsthasya dvitīyaṃ bhavitā'dhunā || 13 ||| yadāsāvunnate sthāne brahmalokātpitāmahaḥ || āgataścāṣṭavarṣastu bālarūpī tadocyate || 14 || sthāneṣvanyeṣu viprāṇāṃ vṛddharūpī pitāmahaḥ || yuktaṃ tadunnatasthānaṃ sadā ca brahmaṇaḥ priyam || 15 || snātvā ca vidhivatpūrvaṃ brahmakuṃḍe narottama || pūjayetpuṣpadhūpādyairbrahmāṇaṃ bālarūpiṇam || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasthāne brahmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatyuttara triśatatamodhyāyaḥ || 321 || || cha ||
<7.1.322>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇasaṃsthitam || durgādityetināmānaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 1 || yadā duḥkhamanuprāptā durgā duḥkhavināśinī || sūryamārādhayāmāsa tadā duḥkhavinuttaye || 2 || tataḥ kālena bahunā tasyāstuṣṭo divākaraḥ || uvāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ durgāṃ devo mahāprabhām || varaṃ varaya deveśi tapasā tuṣṭavānaham || 3 || || durgovāca || || yadi tuṣṭo divānātha duḥkhasaṃghaṃ vināśaya || 4 || || sūrya uvāca || || acireṇaiva kālena bhagavāṃstripurāṃtakaḥ || saṃprāpsyatyuttamaṃ liṃgamunnate sthāna uttame || 5 || durgādityeti me nāma iha devi bhaviṣyati || evamuktvā mahādevi tatraivāntardadhe raviḥ || saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa durgādityaṃ prapūjayet || 6 || tasya duḥkhāni sarvāṇi kuṣṭhāni vividhāni ca || vilayaṃ yāṃti deveśi durgādityaprapūjanāt || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisā haruyāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye durgādityamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 322 || cha || ||
<7.1.323>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tataḥ paśyenmahādevi tasya dakṣiṇataḥ sthitam || kṣemeśvareti vikhyātamṛṣitoyātaṭe sthitam || 1 || bhūtīśvareti nāmāsya pūrvaṃ ca parikīrtitam || kṣemeśeti kalau devi tasya nāma prakīrtitam ||2|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā ca muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ ||3|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kṣemeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 323 || || cha ||
<7.1.324>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmāduttaradigbhāge kiṃcidvāyavyamāśritam || vināyakaṃ prapaśyecca sarvasiddhipradāyakam || 1 || yo'sau devi mayā khyātaḥ sakhā me dhanadaḥ purā || gaṇanāthasvarūpeṇa nidhīnāṃ paripālakaḥ || lokānāṃ siddhidānārthamasminsthāne sthitaḥ priye || 2 || caturthyāṃ bhaumavāreṇa bhakṣyabhojyaḥ samodakaiḥ || pūjayedvidhivaddevi tasya siddhirbhaveddhruvam || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṇanāthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 324 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.325>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi vināyakamanuttamam || ṛṣitoyātaṭe ramye sarvavighnanivāraṇam || 1 || yo'sau devagaṇādhyakṣaḥ sākṣācca tripurāntakaḥ || gajarūpaṃ samāśritya hyunnate jagati sthitaḥ || prābhāsike mahākṣetre gaṇānāṃ koṭibhirvṛtaḥ || 2 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrā nirvighnahetave || ārādhyo gaṇanāthaśca puṣpadhūpādibhiḥ sadā || 3 || caturthyāṃ ca caturthyāṃ ca sarvairnagaravāsibhiḥ || tasminmahotsavaḥ kāryo rāṣṭrakṣemārtha siddhaye || 4 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcaviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 325 ||
<7.1.326>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasyaivottarataḥ sthitam || mahākāleśvaraṃ devaṃ sarvarakṣākaraṃ param || 1 || adhiṣṭhātā purasyāsya bhairavo rudrarūpadhṛk || darśe ca pūrṇimāyāṃ ca mahāpūjāṃ prakārayet || 2 || mahodaye naraḥ snātvā mahākālaṃ prapaśyati || dhanāḍhyo jāyate loke saptajanmasahasrakam || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mahākālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 326 || || cha ||
<7.1.327>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato mahodayaṃ gacchettasmādīśānasaṃsthitam || 1 || vidhinā tatra yaḥ snāti tarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || pratigrahakṛtāddoṣānna bhayaṃ tasya vidyate || 2 || mahodayaṃ mahānandadāyakaṃ ca dvijanmanām || pratigrahaprasaktānāṃ viṣayāsaktacetasām || teṣāmapi dadenmuktiṃ tena khyātaṃ mahodayam || 3 || tasya vai rakṣaṇārthāya mahākālasya cottare || niyuktāśca mahādevi mātarastatra saṃsthitāḥ || tasminsnātvā naraḥ pūrvaṃ mātṝstāśca prapūjayet || 4 || evaṃ devi mayā khyātaṃ mahodayamahodayam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāmabhiṣekācca muktidam || 5 || ardhakrośe ca tattīrthaṃ samaṃtātparimaṃḍalam || etanmadhyaṃ mahāsāraṃ sadaiva munivallabham || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mahodayamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma sapta viṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 327 || || cha ||
<7.1.328>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādvāyavyadigbhāge sthitaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || saṃgameśvaranāmāḍhyamṛṣayo yatra saṃgatāḥ || 1 || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge kuṇḍikā pāpanāśinī || vaḍavānalasaṃyuktā yatrāyātā sarasvatī || 2 || kuṃḍikāyāṃ naraḥ snātvā saṃgameśvaramarcayet || tasya janmasahasrāṇi lakṣmyāḥ putrai priyaiḥ saha || asaṃgamaṃ mahādevi na kadācitprajāyate || 3 || mucyate pātakaiḥ sarvairājanma maraṇāṃtikaiḥ ||4|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃgameśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭāviṃśatyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 328|| || cha ||
<7.1.329>
|| īśvara uvāca || || athottare devakulāttatra gavyūtimātrataḥ || uttamasthānamiti ca prakhyātaṃ dharaṇītale || 1 || tasyottare tu digbhāge dhanurdvādaśakāṃtare || unnato vighnarājastu sarvapratyūhanāśanaḥ || 2 || caturthyāṃ pūjitaḥ samyaksugaṃdhaiḥ phalamodakaiḥ || dadāti vāṃchitānkāmāṃstrailokye vijayī bhavet ||3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya unnatavināyakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 329 ||
<7.1.330>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmāttadunnatasthānāduttare yojanatrayāt || tatra taptodakasvāmī talo yatra hataḥ purā || 1 || daityānāmadhipo devi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || kṛtvā varṣaśataṃ yuddhaṃ talasvāmī tato'bhavat || 2 || taptakuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā talasvāminamarcayet || hṛtvā piṃḍapradānaṃ tu koṭiyātrāphalaṃ labhet || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye talasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśaduttaratriśa tatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 330 || || cha ||
<7.1.331>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kālamegheti viśrutam || tasmāttaṃ pūrvadigbhāge kṣetrapaṃ liṃgarūpiṇam || 1 || aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturddaśyāṃ pūjyo'sau balibhirnaraiḥ || vāṃchitārthapradaḥ samyaksa kalau kalpapādapaḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kālameghamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 331 || ||
<7.1.332>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmāddakṣiṇadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ paṃcabhiḥ priye || tatra taptodakuṃḍāni saṃtyadyāpi varānane || 1 || kuṇḍataḥ pūrvadigbhāge dhanuṣāṃ pañcaviṃśatau || rukmiṇī saṃsthitā devī sarvapātakanāśinī || 2|| snātvā taptodake kuṇḍe koṭihatyāvināśane|| tataḥ saṃpūjayeddevīṃ rukmiṇīṃ rukmadāyinīm || sapta janmāni nārīṇāṃ gṛhabhaṃgo na jāyate || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye rukmiṇīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāya || 332 ||
<7.1.333>
|| īśvara uvāca || || balabhadrācca pūrveṇa sthitā cāsītsaridvarā || durvāseśvaranāmeti balaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 1 || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sarvasukhāvaham|| snātvā cāsya tvamāvāsyāṃ piṃḍadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ || 2 || kalpakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet || durvāseśvaranāmānaṃ tatra pūjya vidhānataḥ || 3 || koṭiyajñaphalaṃ prāpya sarvānkāmā navāpnuyāt|| tatra liṃgānyanekāni ṛṣibhiḥ sthāpitāni tu || 4 || dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā pūjayitvā muktaḥ syātsarvakilbiṣaiḥ || ityetatkathitaṃ devi kṣetrādyaṃ taṃ yathākramam || 5 || bhadrāyāḥ paścimātpūrvaṃ yathānukramamāditaḥ || śrutaṃ pāpopaśamanaṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradam || 6 || atha kṣetrasya paridhisthānaṃ madhumatīti ca || tasmānnairṛtyadigbhāge sthānaṃ khaṃḍaghaṭeti ca || 7 || tatra piṃgeśvaro devaḥ samudrataṭasannidhau || kūpānāṃ saptakaṃ tatra pitṝṇāṃ yatra pāṇayaḥ || dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi deveśi yatra parvaṇiparvaṇi || 8 || tatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā gayākoṭiguṇaṃ phalam || labhate nā'tra sandehaḥ somāmā yadi jāyate || 9 || tatraiva nātidūre tu bhadrāyāḥ saṃgamaḥ smṛtaḥ || paścimātsaṃgamātpūrvaḥ saṃgamaḥ samudāhṛtaḥ || 7.1.333.10 || yatpuṇyaṃ labhate devi pūrva paścimasaṃgame || gaṃgāsāgarayostatra tadbhadrāsaṃgame labhet || 11 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye taptodakasvāmimāhātmye madhumatyāṃ piṃgeśvarabhadrāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 333 || ||
<7.1.334>
|| īśvara uvāca || || bhagavandevadeveśa saṃsārārṇavatāraka || pṛcchāmi tvāmahaṃ bhaktyā kiñcitkautūhalātpunaḥ || 1 || yattvayā kathitaṃ deva talasvāmimahodayam || kiṃ tatra kāraṇaṃ deva talo yena nipātitaḥ || 2 || ko'sau talaḥ samākhyātaḥ kiṃvīryaḥ kiṃparāyaṇaḥ || kasmātsthānātsamutpannaḥ kathaṃ jātaśca me vada || 3 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi rahasyaṃ pāpanāśanam || yanna kasyacidākhyātaṃ tatte vakṣyāmya śeṣataḥ || 4 || devā api na jānaṃti talasotpattikāraṇam || pūrvaṃ kṛtayuge devi govindeti prakīrtitaḥ || 5 || tretāyāṃ vāmanaḥ svāmī stutisvāmī tṛtīyake || kalau yuge mahādevi talasvāmī prakīrtitaḥ || 6 || tathā taptodakasvāmī tasya nāmāṃtaraṃ priye || adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi talotpattiṃ tava priye || 7 || āsīnmahendranāmā ca dānavo raudrarūpadhṛk || koṭivarṣāṇi tenaiva tapastaptaṃ purā priye || 8 || sa tapobalamāviṣṭo jigye devānsavāsavān || jitvā devāṃstataḥ sarvāṃstataḥ kāle samāgataḥ || 9 || yuddhaṃ sa prārthayāmāsa mayā sārddhaṃ subhīṣaṇam || tato'bhavanmahāyuddhaṃ brahmāṇḍakṣayakārakam || 7.1.334.10 || tataḥ kopānmahāyuddhe mama dehādvarānane || jvālā tatra samutpannā tanmadhye sa talo'bhavat || 11 || tena dṛṣṭo mahendro'sau garjangiriguhāśrayaḥ || 12 || kathaṃ garjasi he mūḍha yuddhaṃ kuru mayā saha || ityukte tatra deveśi tena yuddhamavartata || 13 || tatra pravarttite yuddhe talamāhendrayostayoḥ || 14 || rudravīryasya yuktena talenodārakarmaṇā || mallayuddhena balinā mahendro vinipātitaḥ || 15 || tatastaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayaṃ sa talo gataḥ || gataprāṇaṃ tadā jñātvā harṣānnṛtyamathākarot || 16 || tasminsaṃnṛtyamāne tu sarve sthāvarajaṃgamam || cakaṃpe tu varārohe prabhāvāttasya vīryataḥ || 17 || tato bhārabharākāntā dharaṇī talapīḍitā || atīvabhayasaṃtrastāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || 18 || kṣubhitā girayaḥ sarve vidrutāśca mahārṇavāḥ|| taravo nidhanaṃ jagmurnadyo vāhāṃśca tatyajuḥ||19|| gataprabhāvāḥ sūryādyā jyotīṃṣi na virejire|| trailokyaṃ vyākulībhūtaṃ talanṛtyaprabhāvataḥ || 7.1.334.20 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve śaraṇaṃ rudramāyayuḥ || vṛttaṃ yathāvatkathitaṃ tato rudra uvāca tān ||21|| avadhyo me talo devāḥ putratve hi pratiṣṭhitaḥ || evamuktvā hṛṣīkeśaṃ prabhāsakṣetravāsinam || 22 || stutisvāmītināmānaṃ sthitaṃ durvāsasaḥ puraḥ || prabhāsakṣetrasāmīpye pūrvabhāge pratiṣṭhitam || 23 || taptodakuṃḍasāmīpye tatra gacchata bhoḥ surāḥ || kalpekalpe tu tenaiva vidhyate'sau hi dānavaḥ || 24 || evamukte tadā devāḥ prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgatāḥ || tatra te vibudhā jagmuryatra taptodakādhipaḥ || 25 || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ tatra devāḥ śraddhāsamanvitāḥ || tuṣṭuvuḥ parayā bhaktyā devadevaṃ janārddanam|| 26 || vaikuṃṭha trāhi no devāṃstalenoccāṭitā vayam || mahendrakrodhasaṃbhūtarudratejodbhavena vai || 27 || asmābhī rudrasāmīpye kāryaṃ sarvaṃ niveditam || tataḥ prasthāpitāḥ sarve rudreṇa parameṣṭhinā || tava pārśve mahādeva nastvaṃ deva gatirbhava || 28 || iti śrutvā vacasteṣāṃ devadevo janārddanaḥ || dānavasyavadhārthāya devānāṃ rakṣaṇāya ca || cakre yatnaṃ mahābāhuḥ prabhāsakṣetravallabhaḥ || 29 || samāhūya tadā daityaṃ prabhāsakṣetramadhyataḥ || yuddhaṃ cakre tato devi viśvapralayakārakam ||7.1.334.30 || tatastu devāḥ sarve ca svasainyaparivāritāḥ || cakruryuddhaṃ ca daityena sumahallomaharṣaṇam || 31 || tataḥ parvatasaṃkāśaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ mahābalam || uvāca capalāpāṃgo garuḍakṛtavāhanaḥ || 32 || aho daitya mahābāho mallayuddhaṃ dadasva me || tvadbāhuyugalaṃ dṛṣṭvā na yuddhe vāṃchitaṃ mama || 33 || nārāyaṇavacaḥ śrutvā karamudyamya dānavaḥ || abhyadhāvattadā daityaḥ kālāntakasamaprabhaḥ || 34 || tataḥ pravartitaṃ yuddhamanyonyaṃ jayakāṃkṣiṇoḥ || jaṃghābhyāṃ pādabandhena bāhubhyāṃ bāhubaṃdhanam || 35 || kaṃṭhena bandhayankaṃṭhamudareṇodaraṃ tathā || etasminnantare devāḥ sabhayāḥ saṃbabhūvire || 36 || tataḥ pīḍāsamākrāṃto viṣṇuḥ saṃsmarate haram || tatkṣaṇādāgato rudraḥ kiṃ karomi mahābalaḥ || 37 || || || viṣṇuruvāca || || śrāṃto'haṃ devadeveśa mallayuddhena śaṃkara || taptodakaṃ kuruṣveha śramanāśāya sāṃpratam || 38 || tatastalaṃ haniṣyāmi kṣaṇa mātreṇa bhairavam || 39 || || īśvara uvāca || || ādau kṛtayuge kṛṣṇa umayā yatkṛtaṃ purā || ṛṣīṇāṃ śramanāśārthaṃ taptodaṃ tatra nirmitam || 7.1.334.40 || taddaityapāpamāhātmyātpunaḥ śītalatāṃ gatam || punastaduṣṇatāṃ nītaṃ tataḥ kalpāṃtasaṃsthitau || 41 || evamuktvā tadā devaṃ vīkṣāṃcakre maheśvaraḥ || tṛtīya locanenaiva jvālāmālopaśobhinā || 42 || tena jvālāsamūhena vyāptaṃ kuṇḍaṃ caturdiśam || taptodakuṇḍamabhavattena khyātaṃ dharātale || 43 || tato nārāyaṇeneha kṣālitaṃ gātrasuttamam|| kṣālanāttasya devasya śramo nāśamupāgamat || 44 || tatastuṣṭamanā devastīrthānāṃ daśakoṭikāḥ || sa smṛtvā tatra vidhivatkṣiptvā snātvā varānane || 45 || tataścakre mahāyuddhaṃ talenātibhayaṃkaram || jaghāna sa talaṃ daityaṃ muṣṭighātena mastake || 46 || tasminpravṛtte tumule tu yuddhe cakaṃpire bhūbhisametalokāḥ || vitrastadevā na diśo virejurmahāṃdhakārāvṛtamūrchitaṃ jagat || 47 || naṣṭāśca siddhā jagato'sya śāṃtiṃ karotu vai pāpavināśano hariḥ || trāhīti deveśi maharṣisaṃghā bhūtāni bhītāni tathā vadanti ||48|| tato vai mallayuddhena pātito bhuvi dānavaḥ|| kaṃṭhamākramya pādena khaṅgena paripīḍitaḥ || 49 || hāsyaṃ cakāra daityo'tha viṣṇunā''krāṃtakaṃdharaḥ || tamāha puṇḍarīkākṣa kimetaddhāsyakāraṇam ||7.1.334.50|| vṛddhau harṣamavāpnoti kṣaye bhavati duḥkhitaḥ || ityeṣā laukikī gāthā tatte daitya viparyayaḥ ||51|| ityuktastu tadā daityaḥ pratyuvāca janārddanam || agniṣṭomādibhiryajñaivedābhyāsairanekadhā || 52 || nityopavāsaniyamaiḥ snānadānairjapādibhiḥ || nirmalairyogayuktaiśca prāpyate yatparaṃ padam || 53 || tanmayā duṣṭabhāvena prāptaṃ viṣṇoḥ paraṃ padam || ityukte bhagavānviṣṇurvaradānaparo'bhavat || 54 || uvāca paramaṃ vākyaṃ talaṃ daityādhināyakam || varaṃ varaya daityeṃdra yatte manasi saṃsthitam || 55 || iti viṣṇorvacaḥ śrutvā prārthayāmāsa dānavaḥ || mamākhyā varttate loke tathā kuru mahīdhara || 56 || mārgamāse tu śuklāyāmekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || yastvāṃ paśyati bhāvena tasya pāpaṃ vinaśyatu || 57 || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā devo harṣamupāgataḥ || nānāduṃdubhayo neduḥ puṣpavarṣaṃ papāta ca || 58 || viṣṇormūrdhni mahābhāge lokāḥ svasthā babhūvire || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve nṛtyaṃti ca mudānvitāḥ || vadaṃti harṣasaṃyuktā nārāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 59 || etattīrthaṃ mahātīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || śramāpanodanaṃ viṣṇorbrahmahatyādiśodhanam ||7.1.334.60|| sthito nārāyaṇastatra bhairavastatra śaṃkaraḥ || kṣetrapālasvarūpeṇa kālamegheti viśrutaḥ || 61 || tasya yātrāvidhiṃ vakṣye gatvā tatra śucirnaraḥ || smaredviṣṇuṃ mahādevi talasvāmīti yaḥ śrutaḥ || 62 || stuyādviṣṇuṃ mahādevi idaṃ viṣṇuṛcā priye || sahasraśīrṣāmaṃtreṇa tarpaṇādi prakārayet || 63 || evaṃ snātvā vidhānena dattvā cārghyaṃ janārddane || saṃpūjya gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca vastraiḥ puṣpānulepanaiḥ || 64 || madhunekṣurasenaiva kuṃkumena vilepayet || karpūrośīramiśreṇa mṛganābhiyutena ca || 65 || vastraiḥ saṃveṣṭayetpaścāddadyānnaivedyamuttamam || dharmaśravaṇasaṃyuktaṃ kāryaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ || 66 || vṛṣabhastatra dātavyaḥ suvarṇaṃ vastrayugmakam || | viprāya vedayuktāya śrotriyāya pradāpayet || 67 || upavāsaṃ tataḥ kuryāttasminnahani bhāmini || rukmiṇīṃ ca prapaśyeta namaskṛtya janārddanam || 68 || evaṃ kṛtvā naro bhaktyā labhate janmajaṃ phalam || sarveṣāmeva yajñānāṃ dānānāṃ labhate phalam || 69 || tathā ca sarvatīrthānāṃ vratānāṃ labhate phalam || uddharettu piturvargaṃ mātṛvargaṃ tathaiva ca || 7.1.334.70 || janmaprabhṛtipāpānāṃ kṛtānāṃ nāśanaṃ bhavet || na duḥkhaṃ ca na dāridryaṃ durbhagatvaṃ na jāyate || 71 || sapta janmāṃtaraṃ yāvattalasvāmipradarśanāt || suvarṇānāṃ sahasreṇa brāhmaṇe vedapārage || dattena yatphalaṃ devi tatkuṇḍe snānato labhet || 72 || evaṃ talasvāmicaritramuttamaṃ śrutaṃ purā siddhamaharṣisaṃghaiḥ || śrutvā prabhāvaṃ taladevasannidhau prāpnoti sarvaṃ manasā yadīpsitam || 73 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye talasvāmimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 334 || || cha ||
<7.1.335>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tataḥ paścimato gacchennyaṃkumatyāstaṭe śubhe || dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāśritya sthitaṃ tīrthaṃ mahāprabham || 1 || śaṃkhāvarttamitikhyātaṃ yatra citrāṃkitā śilā || svayaṃbhūtā mahādevi raktagarbhā suśobhanā || 2 || chinne tvadyāpi tatraiva suraktaṃ saṃpradṛśyate || viṣṇukṣetraṃ hi tatproktaṃ śaṃkho yatra hataḥ purā || 3 || vedāpahārī deveśi viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || kṛtaṃ śakhodakaṃ tīrthaṃ śaṃkhākāraṃ tu dṛśyate || 4 || tatra snātvā naro devi mucyate brahmahatyayā || sapta janmāni vipratvaṃ śūdrasyāpi prajā yate || 5 || pūrvaṃ tatraiva gatvā ca tato rudragayāṃ vrajet || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 6 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śaṃkhāvarttatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśaduttaratriśata tamo'dhyāyaḥ || 335 || || cha ||
<7.1.336>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi goṣpadaṃ tīrthamuttamam || yatra śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kṛtvā gayāsaptaguṇaṃ phalam|| labhate nātra saṃdeho yadi śraddhā dṛḍhā bhavet || 1 || yatra śrāddhaṃ pṛthuḥ kṛtvā pitaraṃ pāpayonitaḥ || uddadhāra mahādevi venaṃnāma mahāprabhum || || 2 || || devyuvāca || || kasminsthāne sthitaṃ tīrthamutpattistasya kīdṛśī || kathaṃ sa venarājo vā uddhṛtaḥ pāpayonitaḥ || 3 || gayāsaptaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ kathaṃ tatra prajāyate || śrāddhasya kiṃ vidhānaṃ tu ke maṃtrāstatra ke dvijāḥ || etanme kautukaṃ deva yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 4 || || īśvara uvāca || || idaṃ rahasyaṃ deveśi yattvayā paripṛcchitam|| aprakāśyamidaṃ tīrthamasminpāpayuge priye || 5 || tathāpi saṃpravakṣyāmi tava snehātsureśvari || na pāpina idaṃ brūyānnaiva tarkaratāya vai || 6 || na nāstikāya deveśi na suvarṇetarāya ca || asti devi mahāsiddhā puṇyā nyaṃkumatī nadī || 7 || maryādārthaṃ mayā''nītā kṣetrasyāsya maheśvari|| saṃsthitā pāpaśamanī parṇādityācca dakṣiṇe|| 8 || nārāyaṇagṛhātsaumye nātidūre vyavasthitā|| tasyā madhye mahādevi tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || 9 || goṣpadaṃ nāma vikhyātaṃ koṭipāpaharaṃ nṛṇām|| goṣpadasya samīpe tu nātidūre vyavasthitaḥ || 7.1.336.10 || ananto nāma nāgendraḥ svayaṃbhūto dharātale || tasya tīrthasya rakṣārthaṃ viṣṇunā sanniyojitaḥ || 11 || kāṃkṣaṃti pitaraḥ putrānnarakādatibhīravaḥ || gaṃtā yo goṣpade putraḥ sa nastrātā bhaviṣyati || goṣpade ca sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā pitṝṇāmutsavo bhavet || 12 || padbhyāmapi jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā asmabhyaṃ kiṃ na dāsyati || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ yo no dadyājjalāṃjalim || prabhāsakṣetramāsādya goṣpade tīrtha uttame || 13 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ khaḍgamāṃsena yaḥ sakṛt || śrāddhaṃ kuryātprayatnena kālaśākena vā punaḥ || 14 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ goṣpade dattadīpakaḥ || ākalpakālikā dīptistenā'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati || 15 || goṣpade cānnaśatā yaḥ pitarastena putriṇaḥ || dinamekamapi sthitvā punātyāsaptamaṃ kulam || || 16 || piṇḍaṃ dadyācca pitrāderātmano'pi svayaṃ naraḥ || piṇyākeṃgudakenāpi tena mucyedvarānane || 17 || brahmajñānena kiṃ yogairgograhe maraṇena kim || kiṃ kurukṣetravāsena goṣpade yadi gacchati || 18 || sakṛttīrthābhigamanaṃ sakṛtpiṇḍaprapātanam || durllabhaṃ kiṃ punarnityamasmiṃstīrthe vyavasthitam|| 19 || arddhakośaṃ tu tattīrthaṃ tadarddhārddhaṃ tu durllabham || tanmadhye śrāddhakṛtpuṇyaṃ gayāsaptaguṇaṃ labhet || 7.1.336.20 || śrāddhakṛdgoṣpade yastu pitṝṇāmanṛṇo hi saḥ || padamadhye viśeṣeṇa kulānāṃ śatamuddharet || 21 || gṛhāccalitamātrasya goṣpade gamanaṃ prati || svargārohaṇasopānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu padepade || 22 || pāyasenaiva madhunā saktunā piṣṭakena ca || caruṇā taṃdulādyairvā piṃḍadānaṃ vidhīyate || 23 || gopracāre tu yaḥ piṇḍā ñchamīpatrapramāṇataḥ || kandamūlaphalādyairvā dattvā svargaṃ nayetpitṝn || 24 || goṣpade piṇḍadānena yatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ || na tacchakyaṃ mayā vaktuṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 25 || athātaḥ saṃpravakṣyāmi samyagyātrāvidhiṃ śubham || yātrāvidhānaṃ ca tathā samyakchraddhānvitā śṛṇu || || 26 || yadi tīrthaṃ naro gacchedgayāśrāddhaphalepsayā || tathāvidhavidhānena yātrā kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || 27 || brahmacārī śucirbhūtvā hastapādeṣu saṃyataḥ || śraddhāvānāstiko bhāvī gacchettīrthaṃ tataḥ sudhīḥ || 28 || na nāstikasya saṃsargaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe naraścaret || sarvopaskarasaṃyuktaḥ śrāddhārha dravyasaṃyutaḥ || gacchettīrthaṃ sādhusaṃgī gayāṃ manasi mānayan || 29 || evaṃ yastu dvijo gacchetpratigrahavivarjitaḥ || padepade'śvamedhasya phalaṃ prāpnotya saṃśayam|| 7.1.336.30 || tatra snātvā nyaṃkumatyāṃ siddhaye pitṛmuktaye || snātvātha tarppaṇaṃ kuryāddevādīnāṃ yathāvidhi || 31 || brahmādistaṃbaparyaṃtā devarṣi manumānavāḥ || tṛpyantu pitaraḥ sarve mātṛmātāmahādayaḥ || 32 || evaṃ saṃtarpya vidhinā kṛtvā homādikaṃ naraḥ || śrāddhaṃ sapiṇḍakaṃ kuryātsvataṃtroktavidhānataḥ || 33 || āmantrya brāhmaṇāṃstatra śāstrajāndoṣavarjitān || evaṃ kṛtopacārastu imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 34 || kavyavāḍanalaḥ somo yamaścaivāryamā tathā || agniṣvāttā barhiṣadaḥ somapāḥ pitṛdevatāḥ || āgacchantu mahābhāgā yuṣmābhī rakṣitā stviha || 35 || madīyāḥ pitaro ye ca kule jātāḥ sanābhayaḥ || teṣāṃ piṇḍapradātā'hamāgato'sminpitāmahāḥ || 36 || evamuktvā mahādevi imaṃ mantramudīrayet || 37 || pitā pitāmahaścaiva tathaiva prapitāmahaḥ || mātā pitāmahī caiva tathaiva prapitāmahī || 38 || mātāmahaḥ pramātā ca tathā vṛddhapramātṛkaḥ || teṣāṃ piṃḍo mayā datto hyakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām || 39 || oṃ namo bhānave bhartre'bjabhaumasomarū piṇe || evaṃ natvā'rcayitvā tu imāṃ stutimatho paṭhet || 7.1.336.40 || tatra goṣpadasāmīpye caruṇā suśṛtena ca || pitṝṇāmanāthānāṃ ca maṃtraiḥ piṃḍāṃśca nirvapet || 41 || asmatkule mṛtā ye ca gatiryeṣāṃ na vidyate || raurave cāṃdhatāmisre kālasūtre ca ye gatāḥ || teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya imaṃ piṃḍaṃ dadāmyaham || || 42 || anekayātanāsaṃsthāḥ pretalokeṣu ye gatāḥ || teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya imaṃ piṃḍaṃ dadāmyaham || 43 || paśuyonigatā ye ca ye ca kīṭasarī sṛpāḥ || athavā vṛkṣayonisthāstebhyaḥ piṃḍaṃ dadāmyaham ||44|| asaṃkhyā yātanāsaṃsthā ye nītā yamaśāsakaiḥ|| teṣāmuddharaṇārthāya imaṃ piṃḍaṃ dadāmyaham || 45 || ye'bāṃdhavā bāṃdhavā ye ye'nyajanmani bāṃdhavāḥ || te sarve tṛptimāyāṃtu piṃḍenānena sarvadā || 46 || ye kecitpretarūpeṇa varttaṃte pitaro mama || te sarve tṛptimāyāṃtu piṃḍenānena sarvadā || 47 || divyāṃtarikṣabhūmisthapitaro bāṃdhavādayaḥ || mṛtāścāsaṃskṛtā ye ca teṣāṃ piṃḍostu muktaye || || 48 || pitṛvaṃśe mṛtā ye ca mātṛvaṃśe tathaiva ca || guruśvaśurabaṃdhūnāṃ ye cānye bāṃdhavā mṛtāḥ || 49 || ye me kule luptapiṃḍāḥ putradāravivarjitāḥ || kriyālopagatā ye ca jātyaṃdhāḥ paṃgavastathā || 7.1.336.50 || virūpā āmagarbhā ye'jñātā jñātāḥ kule mama || teṣāṃ piṃḍo mayā datto hyakṣayyamupatiṣṭhatām|| ||51|| pretatvātpitaro muktā bhavaṃtu mama śāśvatam || yatkiṃcinmadhusamiśraṃ gokṣīraṃ ghṛtapāyasam ||52|| akṣayyamupatiṣṭhettvattvasmiṃstīrthe tu goṣpade|| svādhyāyaṃ śrāvayettatra purāṇānyakhilānyapi || 53 || brahmaviṣṇvarkarudrāṇāṃ stavāni vividhāni ca|| aiṃdrāṇi somasūktāni pāvamānīśca śaktitaḥ || || 54 || bṛhadrathaṃtaraṃ tadvajjyeṣṭhasāma sarauravam|| tathaiva śāṃtikādhyāyaṃ madhubrāhmaṇameva ca ||55|| maṃḍalaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tatra prītakāri ca yatpunaḥ || viprāṇāmātmanaścaiva tatsarvaṃ samudīrayet||56|| evaṃ nyaṃkumatīmadhye goṣpade tīrtha uttame || dattvā piṃḍāṃśca vidhivatpunarmaṃtramimaṃ paṭhet || 57 || sākṣiṇaḥ saṃtu me devā brahmādyā ṛṣipuṃgavāḥ || mayedaṃ tīrthamāsādya pitṝṇāṃ niṣkṛtiḥ kṛtā ||58|| āgato'smi idaṃ tīrthaṃ pitṛkārye surottamāḥ || bhavaṃtu sākṣiṇaḥ sarve muktaścāhamṛṇatrayāt|| 59 || evaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya goṣpadaṃ tīrthamuttamam || viprebhyo dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā nadyāṃ piṃḍānvisarjayet || 7.1.336.60 || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu tadvatkṛṣṇājinaṃ priye || aṣṭakāsu ca vṛddhau ca gayāyāṃ mṛtavāsare || 61 || atra mātuḥ pṛthakchrāddhamanyatra patinā saha || vṛddhiśrāddhe tu mātrādi gayāyāṃ pitṛpūrvakam|| 62 || gayāvadatraiva punaḥ śrāddhaṃ kāryaṃ narottamaiḥ || tasmādguptagayā proktā iyaṃ sā viṣṇunā svayam || 63 || gaṃdhadānena gaṃdhāptiḥ saubhāgyaṃ puṣpadānataḥ || dhūpadānena rājyāptirdīptirdīpapradānataḥ || 64 || dhvajadānātpāpahāniryātrākṛdbrahmalokabhāk || śrāddhapiṃḍaprado loke viṣṇurneṣyati vai pitṝn|| 65 || ekaṃ yo bhojayettatra brāhmaṇaṃ śaṃsitavratam|| gopracāre mahātīrthe koṭirbhavatibhojitā || 66 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktastatra śrāddhavidhistava || atha te kathayiṣyāmi itihāsaṃ purātanam || 67 || venasya rājñaścaritaṃ pṛthoścaiva mahātmanaḥ || yathā tatrābhavanmuktistasya cāṃḍālayonitaḥ || tatsarvaṃ śṛṇu deveśi samyakchraddhāsamānvitā || 68 || piśunāya na pāpāya nāśiṣyāyāhitāya ca || kathanīyamidaṃ puṇyaṃ nāvratāya kathaṃcana || 69 || svargyaṃ yaśasyamāyuṣyaṃ dhanyaṃ vedena saṃmitam || rahasyamṛṣibhiḥ proktaṃ śṛṇuyādyo'nasūyakaḥ || 7.1.336.70 || yaścainaṃ śrāvayenmartyaḥ pṛtho rvainyasya saṃbhavam || brāhmaṇebhyo namaskṛtvā na sa śocetkṛtā'kṛte ||71|| goptā dharmasya rājā'sau babhau cātrisamaprabhaḥ || atrivaṃśasamutpanno hyaṃgo nāma prajāpatiḥ || 72 || tasya putro'bhavedveno nātyarthaṃ dhārmikastathā || jāto mṛtyusutāyāṃ vai sunīthāyāṃ prajāpatiḥ||73 || samātāmaha doṣeṇa tena kālātmakānanaḥ || sa dharmaṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā pāpabuddhirajāyata || 74 || sthitimutthāpayāmāsa dharmopetāṃ sanātanīm || vedaśāstrāṇyatikramya hyadharma nirato'bhavat || 75 || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāḥ prajāstasminpraśāsati || ḍiṃḍimaṃ ghoṣayāmāsa sa rājā viṣaye svake || 76 || na dātavyaṃ na yaṣṭavyaṃ mayi rājyaṃ praśāsati || āsītpratijñā krūreyaṃ vināśe pratyupasthite || 77|| ahamīḍyaśca pūjyaśca sarvayajñairdvijottamaiḥ || mayi yajñā vidhātavyā mayi hotavyamityapi ||78|| tamatikrāṃtamaryādaṃ prajāpīḍanatatparam || ūcurmaharṣayaḥ kruddhā marīcipramukhāstadā ||79|| mā'dharmaṃ vena kārṣīstvaṃ naiṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || atrervaṃśe prasūto'si prajāpatirasaṃśayam || 7.1.336.80 || pālayiṣye prajāśceti pūrvaṃ te samayaḥ kṛtaḥ || tāṃstathāvādinaḥ sarvānbrahmarṣīnabravīttadā || 81 || venaḥ prahasya durbuddhiridaṃ vacanakovidaḥ || sraṣṭā dharmasya kaścānyaḥ śrotavyaṃ kasya vā mayā || 82 || vīryaśrutatapaḥsatyairmayānyaḥ kaḥ samo bhuvi || madātmāno na nūnaṃ māṃ yūyaṃ jānītha tattvataḥ || 83 || prabhavaṃ sarvalokānāṃ dharmāṇāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ|| itthaṃ dehena pṛthivīṃ bhāvena yajanena ca || 84 || sṛjeyaṃ ca graseyaṃ ca nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || yadā na śakyate staṃbhānmattaścaiva vimohitaḥ || 85 || anunetuṃ nṛpo venastatra kruddhā maharṣayaḥ || ātharvaṇena maṃtreṇa hatvā taṃ te mahābalam || 86 || tato'sya vāmabāhuṃ te mamaṃthurbhṛśakopitāḥ || tasmācca mathyamānādvai jajñe pūrvamiti śrutiḥ || 87 || hrasvo'timātraḥ puruṣaḥ kṛṣṇaścāpi tadā priye || sa bhītaḥ prāñjaliścaiva tasthivānsaṃmukhe priye || 88 || tamāttaṃ vihvalaṃ dṛṣṭvā niṣīdetyabruvankila || niṣādo vaṃśakartā vai tenābhūtpṛthuvikramaḥ || 89 || dhīvarānasṛjaccāpi venapāpasamudbhavān || ye cānye vindhyanilayāstathā vai tuṃbarāḥ khasāḥ || 7.1.336.90 || adharme rucayaścāpi varddhitā venapāpajāḥ || punarmaharṣayastetha pāṇiṃ venasya dakṣiṇam ||91|| araṇīmiva saṃrabdhā mamaṃthurjāta manyavaḥ || pṛthustasmātsamutpannaḥ karājjvalanasaṃnibhaḥ || 92 || pṛthoḥ karatalāccāpi yasmājātastataḥ pṛthuḥ || dīpyamānaśca vapuṣā sākṣādagniriva jvalan || 93 || dhanurājagavaṃ gṛhya śarāṃścāśīviṣopamān || khaṅgaṃ ca rakṣanrakṣārthaṃ kavacaṃ ca mahāprabham || 94 || tasmiñjāte'tha bhūtāni saṃprahṛṣṭāni sarvaśaḥ || saṃbabhūvurmahādevi venaśca tridivaṃ gataḥ || 95 || tato nadyaḥ samudrāśca ratnānyādāya sarvaśaḥ || abhiṣekāya te sarve rājānamupatasthire || || 96 || pitāmahaśca bhagavānṛṣibhiśca sahāmaraiḥ || sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṃgamāni ca sarvaśaḥ || 97 || samāgamya tadā vainyamabhyaṣiṃcannarādhi pam || so'bhiṣikto mahātejā devairaṃgirasādibhiḥ || 98 || adhirājye mahābhāgaḥ pṛthurvainyaḥ pratāpavān || pitrā na raṃjitāścāsya prajā vainyena raṃjitāḥ || 99 || tato rājeti nāmāsya anurāgādajāyata || āpaḥ stastaṃbhire cāsya samudramabhiyāsyataḥ || 7.1.336.100 || parvatāścāpi śīryaṃte dhvajasaṃgo'pi nā'bhavat || akṛṣṭapacyā pṛthivī sidhyaṃtyannāni ciṃtayā || sarvakāmadughā gāvaḥ puṭakepuṭake madhu || 101 || tasminneva tadā kāle puna rjajñe'tha māgadhaḥ || sāmageṣu ca gāyatsu srugbhāṃḍādvaiśvadevikāt || 102 || sāmageṣu samutpannastasmānmagadha ucyate || aiṃdreṇa haviṣā cāpi haviḥ pṛktaṃ bṛhaspatiḥ || 103 || yadā juhāva ceṃdrāya tatastato vyajāyata || pramādastatra saṃjajñe prāyaścittaṃ ca karmasu || 104 || śeṣahavyena yatpṛktamabhibhūtaṃ gurorhaviḥ || adharottarasvāreṇa jajñe tadvarṇavaikṛtam ||105|| yajñastasyāṃ samabhavadbrāhmaṇyāṃ kṣatrayonitaḥ || tataḥ pūrveṇa sādharmyāttulyadharmāḥ prakīrttitāḥ|| || 106 || madhyamo hyeṣa tattvasya dharmaḥ kṣatropajīvanam || rathanāgāśvacaritaṃ jaghanyaṃ ca cikitsitam || 107 || pṛthoḥ kathārthaṃ tau tatra samā hūtau maharṣibhiḥ || tāvūcurmunayaḥ sarve stūyatāmiti pārthivaḥ || 108 || karmabhiścānurūpo hi yatoyaṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ || tānūcatustadā sarvānṛṣīṃśca sūtamāgadhau || 109 || āvāṃ devānṛṣīṃścaiva prīṇayāva svakarmabhiḥ || na cāsya vidvo vai karma na tathā lakṣaṇaṃ yaśa || 7.1.336.110 || stotraṃ yenāsya saṃkurvo rājñastejasvino dvijāḥ || ṛṣibhistau niyuktau tu bhaviṣyaiḥ stūyatāmiti ||111|| yāni karmāṇi kṛtavānpṛthuḥ paścānmahābalaḥ || tāni gītāni baddhāni stuvadbhiḥ sūtamāgadhaiḥ || 112 || tataḥ śrutārthaḥ suprītaḥ pṛthuḥ prādātprajeśvaraḥ || anūpadeśaṃ sūtāya māgadhānmāgadhāya ca || 1 13|| tadādi pṛthivīpālāḥ stūyante sūtamāgadhaiḥ || āśīrvādaiḥ praśaṃsyaṃte sūtamāgadhabaṃdibhiḥ || 114 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaṃ prītāḥ prajā ūcurmaharṣayaḥ || eṣa vo vṛttido vainyo vihito'tha narādhipaḥ || 115 || tato vainyaṃ mahābhāgaṃ prajāḥ samabhidudruvuḥ || tvaṃ no vṛttividhāteti maharṣivacanāttathā || || 116 || so'bhīhitaḥ prajābhistu prajāhitacikīrṣayā || dhanurgṛhītvā bāṇāṃśca vasudhāmārdayadbalī || 117 || tato vainyabhayatrastā gaurbhūtvā prādravanmahī || tāṃ dhenuṃ pṛthurādāya dravantīmanvadhāvata || 118 || sā lokānbrahmalokādīngatvā vainyabhayāttadā || dadarśa cāgrato vainyaṃ kārmukodyatapāṇinam || 119 || jvaladbhirviśikhaistīkṣṇairdīptatejaḥsamanvitaiḥ || mahāyogaṃ mahātmānaṃ durddharṣamamarairapi || 7.1.336.120 || alabhaṃtī tu sā trāṇaṃ vainyamevābhyapadyata || kṛtāṃjalipuṭā devī pūjyā lokaistribhissadā ||121|| uvāca cainaṃ nādharmyaṃ strīvadhaṃ paripaśyasi || kathaṃ dhārayitā cāsi prajā rājanmayā vinā || 122 || mayi lokāḥ sthitā rājanmayedaṃ dhāryate jagat || madṛte tu vinaśyeyuḥ prajāḥ pārthiva viddhi tat || 123 || sa māṃ nārhasi haṃtuṃ vai śreyaścettvaṃ cikīrṣasi || prajānāṃ pṛthivīpāla śṛṇuṣvedaṃ vaco mama ||124|| upāyataḥ samārabdhāḥ sarve sidhyaṃtyupakramāḥ || hatvā māṃ tvaṃ na śakto vai prajāḥ pālayituṃ nṛpa || 125 || anukūlā bhaviṣyāmi tyaja kopaṃ mahādyute || avadhyāśca striyaḥ prāhustiryagyonigatā api || ||126|| ekasminnidhanaṃ prāpte pāpiṣṭhe krūrakarmaṇi || bahūnāṃ bhavati kṣemastatra puṇyaprado vadhaḥ || satyevaṃ pṛthivīpāla dharmmaṃ mā tyaktumarhasi ||127|| evaṃvidhaṃ tu tadvākyaṃ śrutvā rājā mahābalaḥ || krodhaṃ nigṛhya dharmātmā vasudhāmidamabravīt || 128 || ekasyārthe ca yo hanyādātmano vā parasya vā || ekaṃ vāpi bahūnvāpi kāmataścāsti pātakam || 129 || yasmiṃstu nidhanaṃ prāptā edhante bahavaḥ sukham || tasminhate ca bhūyo hi pātakaṃ nāsti tasya vai || 7.1.336.130 || so'haṃ prajānimittaṃ tvāṃ haniṣyāmi vasundhare || yadi me vacanaṃ nādya kariṣyasi jagaddhitam || 131 || tvāṃ nihatyādya bāṇena macchāsanaparāṅmukhīm|| ātmānaṃ pṛthukṛtveha prajā dhārayitāsmyaham ||132|| sā tvaṃ vacanamāsthāya mama dharmabhṛtāṃvare|| sañjīvaya prajā nityaṃ śaktā hyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 133 || duhitṛtvaṃ hi me gaccha evametanmahaccharam || niyacche tvadvadhārthaṃ ca prayuktaṃ ghoradarśanam || pratyuvāca tato vainyamevamuktā mahāsatī || 134 || sarvametadahaṃ rājanvidhāsyāmi na saṃśayaḥ || vatsaṃ tu mama saṃyukṣva kṣareyaṃ yena vatsalā || 135 || samāṃ ca kuru sarvatra māṃ tvaṃ sarvabhṛtāṃ vara || yathā visyandamānāhaṃ kṣīraṃ sarvatra bhāvaye ||136|| || īśvara uvāca || || tata utsārayāmāsa śilājālāni sarvaśaḥ|| dhanuṣkoṭyā tato vainyastena śailā vivarddhitāḥ ||137|| manvatareṣvatīteṣu caivamāsīdvasundharā || svabhāvenābhavattasyāḥ samāni viṣamāṇi ca ||138|| na hi pūrvanisarge vai viṣamaṃ pṛthivītalam|| pravibhāgaḥ purāṇāṃ ca grāmāṇāṃ cātha vidyate || 139 || na sasyāni na gorakṣaṃ na kṛṣirna vaṇikpathaḥ || 7.1.336.140 || cākṣuṣasyāṃtare pūrvamāsīdetatpurā kila || vaivasvate'ntare cāsminsarvasyaitasya saṃbhavaḥ || samatvaṃ yatrayatrāsīdbhūmeḥ kasmiṃścideva hi||141|| tatratatra prajāstā vai nivasanti sma sarvadā || āhāraḥ phalamūlaṃ tu prajānāmabhavatkila || 142 || kṛcchreṇaiva tadā tāsāmityevamanuśuśruma || vainyātprabhṛtiloke'sminsarvasyaitasya saṃbhavaḥ ||143|| saṃkalpayitvā vatsaṃ tu cākṣuṣaṃ manumīśvaram || pṛthurdudoha sasyāni svahaste pṛthivīṃ tataḥ ||144|| sasyāni tena dugdhā vai venyeneyaṃ vasundharā || manuṃ vai cākṣuṣaṃ kṛtvā vatsaṃ pātre ca bhūmaye || 145 || tenānnena tadā tā vai varttayante sadā prajāḥ || ṛṣibhiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasundharā ||146|| vatsaḥ somastatasteṣāṃ dogdhā cāpi bṛhaspatiḥ || pātramāsanhi cchandāṃsi gāyatryādīni sarvaśaḥ || 147 || kṣīramāsīttadā teṣāṃ tapo brahma ca śāśvatam|| punastato devagaṇaiḥ puraṃdarapurogamaiḥ || 148 || sauvarṇaṃ pātramādāya dugdheyaṃ śrūyate mahī || vatsastu maghavā cāsīddogdhā ca savitā'bhavat || 149 || kṣīramūrjāmadhu proktaṃ vartaṃte tena devatāḥ || pitṛbhiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasundharā || || 7.1.336.150 || rājataṃ pātramādāya svadhā tvakṣayyatṛptaye || vaivasvato yamastvāsītteṣāṃ vatsaḥ pratāpavān || 151 || aṃtakaścābhavaddogdhā pitṛṇāṃ bhagavā nprabhuḥ || asuraiḥ śrūyate cāpi punardugdhā vasundharā || 152 || āyasaṃ pātramādāya balamādhāya sarvaśaḥ || virocanastu prāhlādisteṣāṃ vatsaḥ pratāpavān || 153 || ṛtvigdvimūrddhā daityānāṃ dogdhā tu ditinandanaḥ || māyākṣīraṃ dudohāsau daityānāṃ tṛptikārakam || 154 || tenaite māyayā'dyāpi sarve māyāvido'surāḥ || varttayaṃti mahāvīryāstadeteṣāṃ paraṃ balam|| 155 || nāgaiśca śrūyate dugdhā vatsaṃ kṛtvā tu takṣakam || alābupātramādāya viṣaṃ kṣīraṃ tadā mahat || 156 || teṣāṃ vai vāsukirdogdhā kādraveyo mahāyaśāḥ || nāgānāṃ vai mahādevi sarpāṇāṃ caiva sarvaśaḥ ||157|| tena vai varttayantyugrā mahākāyā viṣolbaṇāḥ || tadāhārāstadācārāstadvīryāstadapāśrayāḥ || 158 || āmapātre punardugdhā tvaṃtarddhānamiyaṃ mahī || vatsaṃ vaiśravaṇaṃ kṛtvā yakṣapuṇyajanaistathā || 159 || dogdhā rajatanāgastu cintāmaṇicarastu yaḥ || yakṣādhipo mahātejā vaśī jñānī mahātapāḥ || 7.1.336.160 || tena te varttayaṃ tīti yakṣā vasubhirūrjitaiḥ || rākṣasaiśca piśācaiśca punardugdhā vasundharā || 161 || brahmopendrastu dogdhā vai teṣāmāsītkuberataḥ || vatsaḥ sumālī balavānkṣīraṃ rudhirameva ca ||162|| kapālapātre nirdugdhā tvaṃtarddhānaṃ tu rākṣasaiḥ || tena kṣīreṇa rakṣāṃsi varttayantīha sarvaśaḥ ||163|| padmapatreṣu vai dugdhā gaṃdharvāpsarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || vatsaṃ caitrarathaṃ kṛtvā śucigandhānmahī tadā || 164 || teṣāṃ vatso rucistvāsīddogdhā putro muneḥ śubhaḥ || śailaistu śrūyate devi punardugdhā vasuṃdharā || 165 || tadauṣadhīrmūrtimatī ratnāni vividhāni ca || vatsastu himavāṃsteṣāṃ dogdhā merurmahāgiriḥ || 166 || pātraṃ śilāmayaṃ hyāsīttena śailāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || śrūyate vṛkṣavīrudbhiḥ punardugdhā vasundharā || 167 || pālāśaṃ pātramādāya cchinnadagdhaprarohaṇam || dogdhā tu puṣpitaḥ śālaḥ plakṣo vatso yaśasvini || sarvakāmadughā dogdhā pṛthivī bhūtabhāvinī || 168 || saiṣā dhātrī vidhātrī ca dharaṇī ca vasundharā || dugdhā hitārthaṃ lokānāṃ pṛthunā iti naḥ śrutam || 169 || carācarasya lokasya pratiṣṭhā yonireva ca || āsīdiyaṃ samudrāṃtā medinīti pariśrutā||7.1.336.170|| madhukaiṭabhayoḥ pūrvaṃ medomāṃsapariplutā || vasundhārayate yasmādvasudhā tena kīrtitā || 171 || tato'bhyupagamādrājñaḥ pṛthorvainyasya dhīmataḥ || duhitṛtvamanuprāptā pṛthivītyucyate tataḥ || 172 || prathitā pravibhaktā ca śobhitā ca vasundharā || dugdhā hi yatnato rājñā pattanākaramālinī || 173 || evaṃ prabhāvo rājāsīdvainyaḥ sa nṛpasattamaḥ || tataḥ sa raṃjayāmāsa dharmeṇa pṛthivīṃ tadā || 174 || tato rājeti śabdo'tha pṛthivyāṃ raṃjanādabhūt || sa rājyaṃ prāpya vainyastu ciṃtayāmāsa pārthivaḥ || 175 || pitā mama hyadharmiṣṭho yajñādyucchittikārakaḥ|| kasminsthāne gataścāsau jñeyaṃ sthānaṃ kathaṃ mayā || 176 || kathaṃ tasya kriyā kāryā hatasya brāhmaṇaiḥ kila || kathaṃ gatirbhavettasya yajñadānakriyābalāt || 177 || ityeva ciṃtayā tasya nāradobhyājagāma ha || tasyaivamāsanaṃ dattvā praṇipatya ca pṛṣṭavān || 178 || bhagavansarvalokasya jānāsi tvaṃ śubhāśubham || pitā mama durācāro devabrāhmaṇaniṃdakaḥ || 179 || svakarmaṇā hato vipraiḥ paralokamavāptavān || kasmiṃsthāne gatastātaḥ śvabhraṃ vā svargameva ca || 7.1.336.180 || tato'bravīnnāradastu jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā || śṛṇu rājanmahābāho yatra tiṣṭhati te pitā || 181 || atra deśo marurnāma jalavṛkṣavivarjitaḥ || tatra deśe mahāraudre janakaste narottama || 182 || mlecchamadhye samutpanno yakṣmī kuṣṭhasamanvitaḥ || ucchiṣṭabhojī mlecchānāṃ kṛmibhiḥ saṃyuto vraṇaiḥ || || 183 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || hāhākāraṃ tataḥ kṛtvā mūrchito nipapāta ha ||184 || ciṃtayāmāsa duḥkhārtaḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ mayā bhavet || ityevaṃ ciṃtayānasya matirjātā mahātmanaḥ || putraḥ sa kathyate loke pitaraṃ trāyate tu yaḥ || 185 || sa kathaṃ tu mayā tātaḥ pāpānmukto bhaviṣyati || evaṃ saṃciṃtya sa tato nāradaṃ paryapṛcchata || 186 || bhagavankathitaṃ sarvaṃ piturmama viceṣṭitam || kena tasya bhavenmuktiḥ karmaṇā dvijasattama || vratairdānaistapobhirvā tīrthānāṃ yātrayā vada || 177 || || nārada uvāca || || gaccha rājanpradhānāni tīrthāni manujeśvara || pitaraṃ teṣu cānīya tasmādrājanmarusthalāt || 188 || yatra devāḥ saprabhāvāstīrthāni vimalāni ca || tatra gaccha mahārāja tīrthayātrāṃ kuru prabho || 189 || evaṃ hyavitathaṃ viddhi mokṣaste bhavitā pituḥ || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ || sacive bhāramādhāya svarājasya jagāma ha || 7.1.336.190 || sa gatvā marubhūmiṃ tu mlecchamadhye dadarśa ha || kuṣṭharogeṇa mahatā kṣayeṇa ca samāvṛtam || 191 || gavyūtimātraṃ tatraiva śūnyaṃ mānuṣavarjitam || evaṃ dṛṣṭvā sa rājā tu saṃtapto vākyamabravīt || 192 || he mleccha rogipuruṣaṃ svagṛhaṃ ca nayāmyaham || tatrāhamenaṃ nirujaṃ karomi yadi manyatha || 193 || jñātveti sarve te mlecchāḥ puruṣaṃ taṃ dayāparam || ūcuḥ praṇatasarvāṃgāḥ śīghra naya jagatpate || asmadbhāgyavaśānnātha tvamevātra samāgataḥ || 194 || durgaṃdhopahatā lokāstvayā nātha sukhīkṛtāḥ || tata ānāyya puruṣāñchibikāvāhanocitān || 195 || tataḥ śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rājño dayāvaham || prāpustīrthānyanekāni kedārādīni koṭiśaḥ || 196 || yatrayatra sa gaccheta vainyo venena saṃyutaḥ || tatra tatraiva tīrthānāmākraṃdaḥ śrūyate mahān|| || 197 || hā daiva ripurāyāti asmākaṃ nāśahetave || adhunā kva gamiṣyāma iti ciṃtā punaḥpunaḥ||198|| darśanenāpi tasyaiva hāhākāraṃ vidhāya vai|| | palāyaṃte ca tīrthāni devā naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt ||199|| evaṃ varṣatrayaṃ rājā tīrthayātrāṃ cakāra vai || na tasya muktirdadṛśe tataḥ śokamagātparam ||7.1.336.200|| tatastu preritā bhṛtyāḥ kurukṣetre mahāprabhe || yadi vāpi punastatra pāpamuktirbhavettataḥ || 201 || gṛhītvā śibikāṃ skandhe kurukṣetre gatāḥ priye || tatra nītvā sthāṇutīrthamavatārya ca te gatāḥ || 202 || tataḥ sa rājā madhyāhne cikīrṣuḥ snānamādarāt || tasyaiva tu pitustatra tathā dānāni ṣoḍaśa || 203 || brāhmaṇebhyastathā ditsuḥ śraddhāvānbhāvatatparaḥ || tato vāyuścāṃtarikṣa idaṃ vacanamabravīt || 204 || mā tāta sāhasaṃ kuryāstīrthaṃ rakṣa prayatnataḥ || ayaṃ pāpena ghoreṇa samaṃtātpariveṣṭitaḥ || 205 || vedanindāsamācāro brahmahatyāśatairyutaḥ || so'yaṃ pāpo durācārastīrthaṃ nāśaṃ nayiṣyati || 206 || mā tīrthaṃ nāśaya vibho mahadeno bhaviṣyati || etadvāyorvacaḥ śrutvā duḥkhena mahatārditaḥ || uvāca śokasaṃtaptaḥ piturduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ || 207 || hā daiveti ca cukrośa ūrddhvabāhuḥ punaḥpunaḥ || eṣa ghoreṇa pāpena atīva pariveṣṭitaḥ || 208 || yadanenāpi tīrthena śuddhaḥ karttuṃ na śakyate || prāyaścittaṃ kariṣye'haṃ piturarthe na saṃśayaḥ || 209 || evaṃ tasya vacaḥ śrutvā dayāṃ kṛtvā mahīyasīm || antarikṣabhavāṃ vācaṃ khecarāḥ punarabruvan || 7.1.336.210 || bhobho rājannṛpaśreṣṭha tyaktvā śokaṃ vacaḥ śṛṇu || yena te janakasyāsya bhavetpāpakṣayo mahān || 211 || asti kṣetraṃ mahāsiddhaṃ prabhāsamiti viśrutam || sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ
