mahāpātakanāśanam || 212 || brahmatattvaṃ haritattvaṃ rudratattvaṃ tṛtīyakam || tasminneva mahākṣetre prabhāse śaṃkarapriye || 213 || śākteyaṃ yadi vā cāṃdraṃ sauraṃ sārasvataṃ tathā || āgneyaṃ vāruṇaṃ cāpi smṛtaṃ kṣetramanuttamam || 214 || brahmāṇḍe yāni tīrthāni purā kṣetrāṇi yāni tu || prabhāsamāgamiṣyanti saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge || 215 || aṣṭau koṭisahasrāṇi aṣṭau koṭiśatāni ca || kṣetraṃ rakṣaṃti tatrasthāḥ prabhāsaṃ śāṃkarā gaṇāḥ || 216 || iyaṃ sarasvatī puṇyā sarvatraiva hi vidyate || pañcasrotāḥ prabhāse tu duṣprāpyā tridaśairapi || 217 || tasyā yatpañcamaṃ srotanyaṃkumatyāstaṭāni ca || tasya madhye sthitaṃ tīrthaṃ goṣpadeti ca viśrutam || 218 || tatra pretaśilā madhye pretānāṃ muktidāyikā || yatra pretāḥ purā muktā aṣṭāviṃśatikoṭayaḥ || 219 || pāpināṃ muktidaṃ tīrthamādyā rudragayā smṛtā || tadasmingoṣpadaṃnāma kalau khyātaṃ dharātale || 7.1.336.220 || yadā kṣīrodamathanānniḥsṛtā lokamātaraḥ || tadā devaiḥ sametāstu āgatāstīrthasannidhau || 221 || padaṃ tatra nimagnaṃ ca nandāyāśca śilātale || śilāṃ khurāṃkitāṃ dṛṣṭvā jānudeśāṃkitāṃ tathā || 222 || vismitāḥ sarvadevā vai papracchurgāṃ ca nandinīm || kimetaddṛśyate devi padaṃ pretaśilātale || kathaṃ tu khedaḥ sañjātaścāsmākaṃ skhalanaṃ katham|| 223 || || nandinyuvāca || || idaṃ mama padaṃ devāḥ śilāsaṃsthaṃ virājate || gaganāṃgaṇabhūmisthaṃ candrabiṃbamivāparam|| 224 || adyaprabhṛti bho devāstrailokye sacarācare || goṣpadaṃnāma vikhyātaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 225 || atrāgatya naro yastu snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ kariṣyati || gayāsaptaguṇaṃtasya phalaṃ devā bhaviṣyati || 226 || na vāro na ca nakṣatraṃ na kālastatra kāraṇam|| yadaiva dṛśyate tīrthaṃ tadā parvasahasrakam || 227 || athavā parvakāṃkṣā cettāni me śṛṇupārvati || ayane viṣuve yugme sāmānye cārkasaṃkrame || 228 || amāvāsyāṣṭakāyāṃ ca kṛṣṇapakṣe viśeṣataḥ || ārdrāmaghārohiṇīṣu dravyabrāhmaṇasaṃgame || 229 || gajacchāyā vyatīpāte vaidhṛte dhṛtacāmare || vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ navamyāṃ kārtikasya tu || 7.1.336.230 || pañcadaśyāṃ ca māghasya nabhasye ca trayodaśīm || yugādayaḥ smṛtā hyetāstasminkāle ca vā punaḥ || 231 || manvantarādau kāryaṃ ca tatra śrāddhaṃ vijānatā || āśvayukchuklanavamī dvādaśī kārtike tathā ||232|| tṛtīyā caitramāsasya tathā bhādrapadasya ca || phālgunasya tvamāvāsyā pauṣasyaikādaśī tathā || 233 || āṣāḍhasyāpi daśamī māghamāsasya saptamī || śrāvaṇasyāṣṭamī kṛṣṇā tathā''ṣāḍhī ca pūrṇimā || 234 || kārtikī phālgunī caiva jyaiṣṭhī pañcadaśī tathā || manvantarādayaścaitā dattasyā kṣayakārikāḥ || 235 || vaiśākhasya tṛtīyāyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ phālgunasya ca || pañcamī caitramāsasya tasyaivāṃtyā tathā parā || 236 || śuklā trayo daśī māghe kārtikasya tu saptamī || navamī mārgaśīrṣasya saptaitāḥ kalpakādimāḥ || 237 || kalpatṛptirbhavecchrāddhe kalpādau tu kṛte purā || ityevamuktvā sā nandā devānāṃ pratinandinī || antarddhānaṃ jagāmāśu dīpo vātahato yathā ||238|| itīdaṃ kautukaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || brahmarṣayo devarṣayaḥ ślokaṃ paurāṇikaṃ jaguḥ || 239 || aho tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ nandāyāstapaso balam || sakṛcchrāddhena dattena gayāsaptaguṇaṃ phalam || 7.1.336.240 || evamuktvā tatodevāścakruḥ śrāddhādikāṃ kriyām|| yathoktaṃ phalamāpuste naṃdinyā pūrvabhāṣitam || 241 || itthaṃ tvamapi rājendra gaccha śīghraṃ hi goṣpadam|| tatra śrāddhādikaṃ kṛtvā lapsyase phalamīpsitam || 242 || ayaṃ te janako rājanpāpināṃ pravaraḥ smṛtaḥ || nānyaistīrthaśataiḥ śakyaḥ proddhartuṃ goṣpadaṃ vinā || 243 || tasmādvraja mahārāja mā kārṣīstvaṃ vilaṃbanam || evaṃ śrutvā tadā rājā prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāgataḥ ||244|| tatra sthānasthitānviprāṃstīrthamāhātmyakovidān|| agrekṛtya mahārājo yayau nyaṃkumatīṃ nadīm || 245 || tai rājño darśitaṃ tīrthaṃ padaṃ pretaśilāsthitam || taddṛṣṭvā vimalaṃ tīrthaṃ vismayotphullalocanaḥ || cakre kuṇḍāni vedīśca maṇḍapānyajñasiddhaye || 246 || tato yajñaḥ samārabdho vidhivadbhūridakṣiṇaḥ || pratyakṣaṃ pitara stasya babhūvurjvalanaprabhāḥ || 247 || tataḥ śraddhāṃ samāsthāya śrāddhairyajñairmahodayam || te cābruvanvacastuṣṭāḥ pitaro rājasattamam || 248 || dhanyo'si rājanpuṇyo'si vayaṃ dhanyatarāstvayā || yadatra tīrthe śrāddhena uddhṛtā bhavatā vayam || 249 || evamuktvā tataḥ sarve venena pitaraḥ saha || vimānavarasaṃsthāśca jagmuste tridivālayam || 7.1.336.250 || gacchannuvāca venastaṃ rājānaṃ pṛthuvakṣasam || rājañjanmāni catvāri abhūvaṃ cānyajanmani || 251 || kuṣṭhī pāpo durācāraścāṃḍālocchiṣṭabhuktathā || so'haṃ pāpavinirmukto gacchāmi tridivālayam || 252 || tadgaccha tvaṃ mahābhāga rājyaṃ bhuṃkṣva cirāya ca || kṛtaṃ te sakalaṃ kāryaṃ putreṇa kriyate ca yat || 253 || evaṃ śrutvā tadā rājā mumude jñātisaṃyutaḥ || brāhmaṇānharṣayāmāsa dānairbhūkāṃcanādibhiḥ || 254 || na tadasti jagatyasmiṃstatra yanna dadau nṛpaḥ || dṛṣṭvā prabhāvaṃ tīrthasya pratyakṣaṃ pitṛdarśanam ||255|| evaṃ rājā sa kṛtvā tu svakīyaṃ sthāna māyayau || bhuktvā bhūmiṃ tu sakalāṃ pretya svargaṃ samāptavān || 256 || evaṃ prabhāvaṃ tatkṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ pāpanāśanam || yasminnāyāṃti tīrthāni devāstiṣṭhaṃti koṭiśaḥ || 257 || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya yonyattīrthaṃ hi mārgate || sa karasthaṃ samutsṛjya kūrpareṇa samālihet || 258 || abruvanpitaraścaināṃ gāthāṃ paurāṇikīṃ priye || gayāṃ gaṃtuṃ na śaknoti yadi putraḥ kathaṃcana || tadā yatnena gaṃtavyaṃ goṣpadaṃ tīrthamuttamam || 259 || kandairmūlaiḥ phalairvāpi piṇyākeṃgudakena vā || api naḥ sa kule bhūyādyo'tra śrāddhaṃ pradāsyati || 7.1.336.260 || tatra snātvā prayatnena brāhmaṇānvedavittamān || āmaṃtrya vidhivacchrāddhe bhojayitvā prayatnataḥ || piṃḍadānaṃ tu karttavyaṃ pitṛṇāṃ tṛptimicchatām ||261|| na tithirna ca nakṣatraṃ parva māsādikaṃ na hi || sarvadā tatra gaṃtavyaṃ śraddhā yuktena cetasā || 262 || na kālaniyamastatra pramāṇaṃ darśanaṃ yataḥ || tatrākṣayatṛtīyāyāṃ durllabhaṃ gamanaṃ priye || 263 || kārttikyāṃ māghasaptamyāṃ padmake vā'tha parvaṇi ||264|| hiraṇyadānaṃ godānaṃ vastraṃ rūpyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tilāḥ || dātavyāstatra yuktena pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimicchatā || 265 || evaṃ te kathitaṃ devi tīrthaguhyaṃ mahodayam || na kathyaṃ duṣṭabuddhīnāṃ pāpināṃ krūracetasām ||266|| śraddhāyuktāya dātavyaṃ pitṛbhaktiratāya ca || śrāddhakāle viśeṣeṇa paṭhe dbhaktyā purāṇavit || 267 || pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptistena dvādaśavārṣikī || śrotavyaṃ prayatairnityaṃ narairnarakabhīrubhiḥ || paṭhitavyaṃ sadā bhaktyā viprāṇāṃ bhuṃjatā puraḥ || 268 || pānīyamapyatra tilairvimiśraṃ dadyātpitṛbhyaḥ prayato manuṣyaḥ || śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāsahasraṃ rahasyametatpitaro vadaṃti ||269|| idaṃ rahasya yaśaso nidhānamidaṃ pitṝṇāmativallabhaṃ ca || idaṃ ca vedeṣvamṛtāya nityamidaṃ mahāpāpaharaṃ ca puṃsām || 7.1.336.270 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīnadīmāhātmye goṣpadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 336 || || cha ||
<7.1.337>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi nārāyaṇagṛhaṃ param || goṣpadāddakṣiṇe bhāge sāgarasya taṭe śubhe || 1 || nyaṃkumatyāḥ samīpe tu sarvapātakanāśane || tatrakalpāṃtarasthāyī svayaṃ tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ || 2 || pitṝṇāmuddharaṇārthāya hyasminraudre kalau yuge || yadā daityavināśaṃ sa kurute bhagavānhariḥ || 3 || viśrāmārthaṃ tadā tatra gṛhe tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ || nārāyaṇagṛhaṃ tena vikhyātaṃ jagatītale || 4|| kṛte janārdanonāma tretāyāṃ madhusūdanaḥ || dvāpare puṇḍarīkākṣaḥ kalau nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || 5 || evaṃ caturyuge prāpte punaḥpunararindama || kṛtvā dharmavyavasthānaṃ tatsthānaṃ pratipadyate || 6 || ekādaśyāṃ nirāhāro yastaṃ devaṃ prapaśyati || sa paśyati dhruvaṃ sthāne pratyānantaṃ hareḥ padam || 7|| tena pītāni vastrāṇi deyāni dvijapuṃgave || snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca kartavyaṃ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ || 8 || iti te kathitaṃ mahāprabhāvaṃ harisaṃketaniketanodbhavam || śṛṇute vā prayatastu yaḥ sudhīḥ paṭhate vā labhate sa sadgatim || 9 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nyaṃkumatīmāhātmye nārāyaṇagṛhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 337 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.338>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devikātaṭasaṃsthitam || jāleśvareti vikhyātaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || 1 || manvantare cākṣuṣe ca samprāpte dvāpare yuge || nāmnā jāleśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ devikātaṭasaṃsthitam || 2 || pūjyate nāgakanyābhirna tatpaśyaṃti mānavāḥ || mahā tejomaṇimayaṃ caṃdrabiṃbasamaprabham || smaraṇāttasya devasya brahmahatyā praṇaśyati || 3 || || devyuvāca || || kathaṃ jāleśvaraṃ nāma kasminkāle babhūva tat || 4 || sādhubhiḥ saha saṃvāsātke guṇāḥ parikīrttitāḥ || ke lokāḥ kāni puṇyāni tatsarvaṃ śaṃsa me prabho || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || atraivodāharaṃtīmamitihāsaṃ purātanam || nābhāgasya ca saṃvādamāpastaṃbataponidheḥ || 6 || maharṣirātmavānpūrvamāpastaṃbo dvijāgraṇīḥ || upāvasansadā rambho babhūva bhagavāṃstadā || 7 || nityaṃ krodhaṃ ca lobhaṃ ca mohaṃ drohaṃ visṛjya saḥ || devikāsarito madhye viveśa salilāśaye || 8 || kṣetre prābhāsike ramye samyagjñātvā śivapriye || tatrāsya vasataḥ kālaḥ samatīto mahāṃstadā || 9 || pareṇa dhyānayogena sthāṇubhūtasya tiṣṭhataḥ || tataḥ kadācidāgatya taṃ deśaṃ matsyajīvinaḥ || 7.1.338.10 || prasārya sumahajjālaṃ sarve cākarṣayanbalāt || atha taṃ ca mahāmatsyaṃ niṣādā baladarpitāḥ || 11 || tasmāduttārayāmāsuḥ salilādbrahmanaṃdanam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tapasā dīptaṃ kaivarttā bhayavihvalāḥ || śirobhiḥ praṇipatyoccairidaṃ vacanamabruvan || 12 || || niṣādā ūcuḥ || || ajñānātkṛtapāpānāmasmākaṃ kṣantumarhasi || kiṃ vā kāryaṃ priyaṃ te'dya tadājñāpaya suvrata || 13 || sa munistanmahaddṛṣṭvā matsyānāṃ kadanaṃ kṛtam|| kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo dāśānprovāca duḥkhitaḥ || 14 || kena me syādupāyo hi sarve svārthe bata sthitāḥ || jñānināmapi yaccetaḥ kevalātmahite ratam || 15 || jñāninopi yadā svārthamāśritya dhyānamāsthitāḥ || duḥkhārttānīha sattvāni kva yāsyaṃti sukhaṃ tataḥ || 16 || yo'bhivāṃchati bhoktuṃ vai duḥkhānyekāṃtato janaḥ || pāpātpāpataraṃ taṃ hi pravadaṃti mumukṣavaḥ || 17 || ko nu me syādupāyo hi yenāhaṃ duḥkhitātmavān|| aṃtaḥ praviṣṭaḥ sattvānāṃ bhaveyaṃ sarvaduḥkhabhuk || 18 || yanmamāsti śubhaṃ kicittadenānupagacchatu || yatkṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ taiśca tadaśeṣamupetu mām || 19 || dṛṣṭvāṃdhānkṛpaṇānvyaṃgānanāthānrogiṇastathā || dayā na jāyate yasya sa rakṣa iti me matiḥ || 7.1.338.20 || prāṇasaṃśayamāpannānprāṇino bhayavihvalān || yo na rakṣati śaktopi sa tatpāpaṃ samaśnute || 21 || āhurjanānāmārttānāṃ sukhaṃ yadupajāyate || tasya svargo'pavargo vā kalāṃ nārhati ṣoḍaśīm || || 22 || tasmānnaitānahaṃ dīnāṃstyaktvā mīnānsuduḥkhitān || padamātraṃ tu yāsyāmi kiṃ punastridaśālayam || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || || niśamyaitadṛṣervākyaṃ dāśāste jātasaṃbhramāḥ || yathāvṛttaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nābhāgāya nyavedayan || 24 || nābhāgo'pi tataḥ śrutvā taṃ draṣṭuṃ brahmanandanam || tvaritaḥ prayayau tatra sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ || 25 || sa samyakpūjayitvā taṃ devakalpamuniṃ nṛpaḥ || provāca bhagavanbrūhi kiṃ karomi tavājñayā ||26|| || || āpastaṃba uvāca || || śrameṇa mahatāviṣṭāḥ kaivarttā duḥkhajīvinaḥ || mama mūlyaṃ prayaccheti yadyogyaṃ manyase nṛpa || 27 || || nābhāga uvāca || || sahasrāṇāṃ śataṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyo dadāmyaham || nigrahākhyasya bhagavanyathāha brahmanaṃdanaḥ || 28 || || āpastaṃba uvāca || || nāhaṃ śatasahasraiśca niyamyaḥ pārthiva tvayā || sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamamātyaiḥ saha ciṃtaya || 29 || || nābhāga uvāca || || koṭiḥ pradīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ niṣādebhyo dvijottama || yadyetadapi te mūlyaṃ tato bhūyaḥ pradīyate || 7.1.338.30 || || āpastaṃba uvāca || || nārhaṃ mūlyaṃ ca me koṭiradhikaṃ vāpi pārthiva || sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha ciṃtaya || 31 || || nābhāga uvāca || || arddharājyaṃ samastaṃ vā niṣādebhyaḥ pradīyatām || etanmūlyamahaṃ manye kiṃ vā'nyanmanyase dvija || 32 || || āpastaṃba uvāca || || ardharājyasamastaṃ vā nāhamarhāmi pārthiva || sadṛśaṃ dīyatāṃ mūlyamṛṣibhiḥ saha ciṃtaya || 33 || maharṣestadvacaḥ śrutvā nābhāgaḥ sa viṣādavān || cintayāmāsa duḥkhārtaḥ sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ || 34 || tataḥ kaścidṛṣistatra lomaśastu mahātapāḥ || nābhāgamabravīnmā bhaistoṣayiṣyāmi taṃ munim || 35 || || nābhāga uvāca || || brūhi mūlyaṃ mahābhāga munerasya mahātmanaḥ || paritrāyasva māmasmātsajñātikulabāṃdhavam || 36 || nirdahedbhagavānrudrastrailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| kiṃ punarmānuṣaṃ hīnamatyaṃtavi ṣayātmakam || 37 || || lomaśa uvāca || || tvamīḍyo hi mahārāja jagatpūjyo dvijottamaḥ || gāvaśca divyāstasmādgaurmūlyamamyai pradīyatām|| 39 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ rājā sāmātyaḥ sapurohitaḥ || harṣeṇa mahatāviṣṭaḥ provācedaṃ vacomunim || 39 || uttiṣṭhottiṣṭha bhagavankrīta eva na saṃśayaḥ || etadyogyatamaṃ mūlyaṃ bhavato munisattama || 7.1.338.40 || || āpastaṃba uvāca || || uttiṣṭhāmyeṣa suprītaḥ samyakkrīto'smi pārthiva || gobhyo mūlyaṃ na paśyāmi pavitraṃ paramaṃ bhuvi || 41 || gāvaḥ pradakṣiṇīkāryāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ || maṃgalāyatanaṃ devyaḥ sṛṣṭā hyetāḥ svayaṃbhuvā|| || 42 || agnyagārāṇi viprāṇāṃ devatāyatanāni ca || yadgomayena śuddhyaṃti kiṃbhūtamadhikaṃ tataḥ ||43|| gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ kṣīraṃ dadhi sarpistathaiva ca || gavāṃ paṃca pavitrāṇi punaṃti sakalaṃ jagat ||44|| gāvo mamāgrato nityaṃ gāvaḥ pṛṣṭhata eva ca || gāvo me hradaye caiva gavāṃ madhye vasāmyahama ||45|| evaṃ japannaro maṃtraṃ trisaṃdhyaṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ svargalokaṃ ca gacchati || 46 || tṛṇāhāraparā gāvaḥ karttavyā bhaktito'nvaham|| akṛtvā svayamāhāraṃ kurvanprāpnoti durgatim || 47 || tenāgnayo hutāḥ samyakpitaraścāpi tarpitāḥ || devāśca pūjitāstena yo dadāti gavāhnikam||48|| mantraḥ || saurabheyī jagatpūjyā devī viṣṇupade sthitā || sarvameva mayā dattaṃ pratīcchatu sutoṣitā||49|| rakṣaṇādbālaputrāṇāṃ gavāṃ kaṇḍūyanāttathā || kṣīṇārtarakṣaṇāccaiva naraḥ svarge mahīyate | 7.1.338.50 || ādirgāvo hi martyasya madhye cāṃte prakīrtitāḥ || rakṣaṃti tāstu devānāṃ kṣīrājyamamṛtaṃ sadā || 51 || tasmādgāvaḥ pradātavyāḥ pūjanīyāśca nityaśaḥ || svargasya saṃgamā hyetāḥ sopānamiva nirmitāḥ || 52 || etacchrutvā niṣādāste gavāṃ māhātmyamutta mam || praṇipatya mahātmānamāpastaṃbamathābruvan || 53 || || niṣādā ūcuḥ || || saṃbhāṣo darśanaṃ sparśaḥ kīrtanaṃ smaraṇaṃ tathā || pāvanāni kilaitāni sādhūnāmiti ca śrutam || 54 || saṃbhāṣo darśanaṃ caiva sahāsmābhiḥ kṛtaṃ tvayā || kuruṣvānugrahaṃ tasmādgaureṣā pratigṛhyatām || 55 || || āpastaṃba uvāca || || etā vaḥ pratigṛhṇāmi gāṃ yūyaṃ muktakilviṣāḥ || niṣādā gacchata svargaṃ saha matsyairjaloddhṛtaiḥ ||56|| prāṇināṃ prītimutpādya nindite nāpi karmaṇā || narakaṃ yadi paśyāmi vatsyāmi svarga eva tat || 57 || yanmayā sukṛtaṃ kiñcinmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || kṛtaṃ syāttena duḥkhārtāḥ sarve yāṃtu śubhāṃ gatim || 58 || tatastasya prasādena maharṣerbhāvitātmanaḥ || niṣādāstena vākyena saha matsyairdivaṃ gatāḥ || 59 || tāndṛṣṭvā vrajataḥ svargaṃ samatsyānmatsyajīvinaḥ || sāmātyabhṛtyo nṛpatirvismayādidamabravīt || 7.1.338.60 || sevyāḥ śreyo'rthibhiḥ santaḥ puṇyatīrthe jalopamāḥ || kṣaṇo pāsanamapyatra na yeṣāṃ niṣphalaṃ bhavet || 61 || sadbhiḥ saha sadāsīta sadbhiḥ kurvīta satkathām || satāṃ vratena varteta nāsadbhiḥ kiñcidācaret || 62 || satāṃ samāgamādete samatsyā matsyajīvinaḥ || triviṣṭapamanuprāptā narāḥ puṇyakṛto yathā || 63 || āpastaṃbo munistatra lomaśaśca mahāmanāḥ || varaistaṃ vividhairiṣṭaiśchaṃdayāmāsaturnṛpam|| 64 || tataḥ sa varayāmāsa dharmabuddhiṃ sudurlabhām || tatheti coktvā tau prītyā taṃ nṛpaṃ vai śaśaṃsatuḥ || 65 || aho dhanyo'si rājendra yatte dharmaparā matiḥ || dharmaḥ sudurlabhaḥ puṃsāṃ viśeṣeṇa mahīkṣitām || 66 || yadi rājā madāviṣṭaḥ svadharmaṃ na pari tyajet || tato jagati kastasmātpumānabhyadhiko bhavet || 67 || dhruvaṃ janma sadā rājñāṃ mohaścāpi sadā dhruvaḥ || mohāddhruvaśca narako rājyaṃ nindantyato budhāḥ || 68 || rājyaṃ hi bahu manyaṃte narā viṣayalolupāḥ || manīṣiṇastu paśyanti tadeva narakopamam || 69 || tasmāllokadvayadhvaṃsī na karttavyo madastvayā || yadīcchasi mahārāja śāśvatīṃ gatimātmanaḥ || 7.1.338.70 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktvā tau mahātmānau jagmatuḥ svaṃ svamāśramam || nābhāgo'pi varaṃ labdhvā prahṛṣṭaḥ prāviśatpuram || 71 || etatte kathitaṃ devi prabhāvaṃ devikodbhavam || ṛṣiṇā sthāpitaścāpi bhavo jāle śvarastadā || 72 || jāle nipatito yasmāddāśānāmṛṣisattamaḥ || jāleśvareti nāmāsau vikhyātaḥ pṛthivītale || 73 || tatra snātvā mahādevi jāleśvarasamarcanāt || āpastaṃbaśca nābhāgo niṣādā matsyajīvinaḥ || 74 || matsyaiḥ saha gatāḥ svargaṃ devikāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || caitrasyaiva tu māsasya śuklapakṣe trayodaśīm || 75 || dadyātpiṇḍaṃ pitṛbhyo yastasyāṃto naiva vidyate || godānaṃ tatra deyaṃ tu brāhmaṇe vedapārage || śrotavyaṃ caiva māhātmyaṃ draṣṭavyo jālakeśvaraḥ || 76 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikā nadīmāhātmye jāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 338 || cha ||
<7.1.339>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kūpaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || devikāyāstaṭe ramye huṃkāreṇaiva pūryate || 1 || tato'dhastātpunaryāti salilaṃ tatra bhāmini || taṇḍīnāma purā prokto devikātaṭamāsthitaḥ || 2 || tapastepe mahādevi śivabhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || tasyaivaṃ tapyamānasya tasmindeśe varānane || 3 || ājagāma mṛgo vṛddhastaṃ deśamandha dṛkpriye || sa papāta mahāgarte agādhe jalavarjite || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛpayāviṣṭaḥ sa munirmaunamāsthitaḥ || huṃkāraṃ kurute tatra bhūyobhūyaśca bhāmini || 5 || atha huṃkāraśabdena tasya gartaḥ prapūritaḥ || tato mṛgo viniṣkrāṃtaḥ kṛcchreṇa salilātpriye || 6 || mānuṣaṃ rūpamāśritya tamṛṣiṃ paryapṛcchata || vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā kāmyadaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam || 7 || mṛgatve patitaścātra naro bhūtvā vinirgataḥ || so'bravīttasya māhātmyaṃ salilasya dvijottamaḥ || 8 || ato'haṃ naratāṃ prāpto nānyadastīha kāraṇam || tatastatsalilaṃ bhūyaḥ praviṣṭaṃ dharaṇītale || 9 || tato huṃkṛtavānbhūyaḥ sa ṛṣiḥ kautukānvitaḥ || āpūritaḥ punaḥ kūpaḥ salilena purā yathā || 7.1.339.10 || tataḥ sa kṛtavānsnānaṃ tathā ca pitṛtarpaṇam|| matvā tīrthavaraṃ tatra tataḥ prāptaḥ parāṃ gatim || 11 || adyāpi huṃkṛte tasminsalilaughaḥ pravartate || tatra gatvā naro bhaktyā api pāparato'pi yaḥ || 12 || na mānuṣyaṃ punarjanma prāpnoti jagatītale || tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || 13 || mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ pitṛloke mahīyate || kulāni tārayetsapta atītā'nāgatāni ca || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmye huṃkārakūpamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 339 || || cha ||
<7.1.340>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tatra sthāne tu saṃsthitam|| caṇḍīśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tatra śuklacaturddaśyāṃ kārtike māsi bhāmini || upavāsaparo bhūtvā yaḥ karoti prajāgaram || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye devikāmāhātmye caṇḍīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 340 || || cha ||
<7.1.341>
|| īśvara uvāca || || āśāpūraṃ tato gacchedvighnarājamakalmaṣam || śaśibhūṣaṇa vāyavye saṃsthitaṃ vighnanāśanam|| āśāṃ pūrayate yasmāttenāśāpūrakaḥ smṛtaḥ ||1 || yatra rāmeṇa deveśi sītayā lakṣmaṇena ca || samārādhya ca vighneśaṃ prāptaṃ kāmamabhīpsitam|| 2 || yatra caṃdramasā devi samārādhya gaṇādhipam || labdhaṃ tadvāṃchitaṃ pūrvaṃ sarvakuṣṭhavināśanam || 3 || caturthyāṃ śuklapakṣe ca māsi bhādrapade tathā || tatra saṃpūjya deveśaṃ modakairbhojayeddvijān || 4 || vāñchitāṃ labhate siddhiṃ vighnarājaprasādataḥ || kṣetrasyāsya mahādevi rakṣārthaṃ tu mayā purā || 5 || tato niyukto deveśi yāyināṃ vighnanāśanaḥ || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya āśāpūravighnarāja māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatśariṃśaduttara triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 341 ||
<7.1.342>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasya dakṣiṇanairṛtye nātidūre vyavasthitam || liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ devi svayaṃ somapratiṣṭhitam || 1 || tatraivāmṛtakuṇḍaṃ tu kalākuṇḍaṃ tu tatsmṛtam || tatra snātvā tu caṃdreśaṃ yo naraḥ pūjayiṣyati || 2 || sa tu varṣasahasrasya tapaḥphalamavāpsyati || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ devi taḍāgaṃ caṃdranirmitam || 3 || dhanuḥṣoḍaśavistāraṃ caṃdreśātpūrvapaścime || tatpūrvaṃ te samākhyātaṃ muktidānādipūrvakam || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya āśāpūramāhātmye caṃdreśvarakalākuṇḍatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 342 || ||
<7.1.343>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kapileśvaramuttamam || śīrābhūṣaṇapūrveṇa koṭitīrthācca paścime ||1 || jaradgaveśāddakṣiṇe samudrottaratastathā || etadvai kāpilaṃ kṣetraṃ nāpuṇyaiḥ prāpyate naraiḥ || 2 || kapilena purā devi yatra taptaṃ tapo mahat || varṣāṇāmayutaṃ sāgraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya maheśvaram || 3 || samāhūtā tatra devī kapiladhārā mahānadī || samudramadhye sā'dyāpi puṇyavadbhiḥ pradṛśyate || 4 || tatra snātvā mahādevi kapilāṣaṣṭhyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || kapilāṃ dāpayettatra gokoṭiphalabhāgbhavet || 5 || sarveṣāṃ caiva pāpānāṃ prāyaścittamidaṃ smṛtam || kapileśvaraṃ tu saṃpūjya kanyākoṭiphalaṃ labhet || 6 || || devyuvāca || || āścaryaṃ mama deveśa kapilaṣaṣṭhyā maheśvara || vidhānaṃ śrotumicchāmi dānamantrādi pūrvakam || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || janmajīvitamadhye tu yadyekā labhyate naraiḥ || saṃyogayuktā sā ṣaṣṭhī tatkiṃ devi bravīmyaham || 8 || prauṣṭhapadyasite pakṣe ṣaṣṭhyāmaṃgārako yadi || vyatīpātaśca rohiṇyāṃ sā ṣaṣṭhī kapilā smṛtā ||9|| tatra kṣetre naraḥ snātvā athavārkasthale śubhe || mṛdā śukla tilaiścaiva kapilāsaṃgame śubhe || 7.1.343.10 || kṛtasnānajapaḥ paścātsūryāyārghyaṃ nivedayet || raktacaṃdanatoyena karavīrayutena ca || kṛtvārghapātraṃ śirasi maṃtreṇānena dāpayet || 11 || namastrailokyanāthāya udbhāsitajagattraya || vedaraśme namastubhyaṃ gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 12 || sūryaṃ pradakṣiṇīkṛtya saṃpūjya kapileśvaram|| upalipte śubhe deśe puṣpākṣatavibhūṣite || 13 || sthāpayedavraṇaṃ kumbhaṃ candanodakapūritam || paṃcaratnasamāyuktaṃ dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitam||14|| raktavastrayugacchannaṃ tāmrapātreṇa saṃyutam || ratho rukmaphalasyaiva ekacitravicitritaḥ || 15 || sauvarṇapalasaṃyuktāṃ mūrtiṃ sūryasya kārayet|| kuṃbhasyopari saṃsthāpya gaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ samarcayet || 16 || kapileśvarasānnidhye maṇḍape homasaṃskṛte || ādityaṃ pūjayeddevaṃ nāmabhiḥ svairyathoditaiḥ || || 17 || ādityabhāskara rave bhāno svayaṃ divākara || prabhākara namastubhyaṃ sasārānmāṃ samuddhara || 18 || bhuktimuktiprado yasmāttasmācchāṃtiṃ prayaccha naḥ ||19|| || prārthanāmantraḥ || || namonamaste varada ṛksāmayajuṣāṃpate || namo'stuviśvarūpāya viśvadhāmne namo'stu te ||7.1.343.20|| amṛtaṃ devi te kṣīraṃ pavitramiha puṣṭidam|| tvatprasādātpramucyaṃte manujāḥ sarvapātakaiḥ || 21 || brahmaṇotpādite devi vahnikuṇḍānmahāprabhe || namaste kapile puṇye sarvadevanamaskṛte ||22|| sarvadevamaye devi sarvatīrthamaye śubhe|| dātāraṃ pūjayānaṃ māṃ brahmalokaṃ naya svayam||23 || || pūjāmaṃtraḥ || || evaṃ saṃpūjya kapilāṃ kumbhasthaṃ ca divākaram|| brāhmaṇe vedaviduṣa ubhayaṃ pratipādayet ||24|| vyāsāya sūryabhaktāya maṃtreṇānena dāpayet ||25|| divyamūrttirjagaccakṣu rdvādaśātmā divākaraḥ || kapilāsahito devo mama muktiṃ prayacchatu || 26 || yasmāttvaṃ kapile puṇyā sarvalokasya pāvanī || pradattā saha sūryeṇa mama muktipradā bhava || 27 || palena dakṣiṇā kāryā tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ || śaktito dakṣiṇāyuktāṃ tāṃ dhenuṃ pratipādayet || 28 || yo'nena vidhinā kuryā tṣaṣṭhīṃ kapilasaṃjñitām|| so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 29 || yatphalaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ sarvamāpnoti yaḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kapilāṃ caret || 7.1.343.30 || kapilākoṭisahasrāṇi kapilākoṭiśatāni ca || sūryaparvaṇi yaddattvā tatphalaṃ koṭiśo bhavet || 31 || koṭigoroma saṃkhyāni varṣāṇi varavarṇini || tāvatsa vasate svarge yaḥ ṣaṣṭhīṃ kapilāṃ caret || 32 || jñānato'jñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ pūrvasaṃcitam || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti ityāha kapilo muniḥ ||33|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kapi ladhārākapileśvaramāhātmye kapilāṣaṣṭhīvratavidhānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 343 || cha ||
<7.1.344>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || kapileśvarasyaiśānyāmuttareṇa vyavasthitam || 1 || jaradgaveśvaraṃnāma jaradgavapratiṣṭhitam || brahmahatyādi pāpānāṃ nāśanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || tatraiva saṃsthitā devi devī aṃśumatī nadī || tatra snātvā vidhānena piḍadānaṃ tu dāpayet || 3 || varṣakoṭiśataṃ sāgraṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptimāvahet || vṛṣabhastatra dātavyo brāhmaṇe vedapārage || 4 || tatastu pūjayeddevaṃ gandhapuṣpairjaradgavam || pañcāmṛtarasenaiva tathā guggu ludhūpanaiḥ || 5 || stutidaṇḍanamaskāraiḥ pradakṣiṇairaharniśam || brāhmaṇānbhojayettatra bhakṣyabhojyaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || ekena bhojitenaiva koṭirbhavati bhojitā || 6 || kṛte siddhodakaṃnāma tattīrthaṃ parikīrttitam || jaradgaveśvaraṃ tīrthaṃ kalau tu parikīrtyate || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmyeṃ'śumatīmāhātmye jaradgaveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 344 || || cha ||
<7.1.345>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vai hāṭakeśvaram || jaradgavātpūrvabhāge dhanuṣāṃ ṣaṣṭibhistribhiḥ || 1 || nāmnā naleśvaraṃ devi sthāpitaṃ tu nalena vai || damayantīyutenaiva jñātvā kṣetraṃ taduttamam || 2 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavo devi pūjayitvā vidhānataḥ || kalibhirmucyate jaṃturdyūte ca vijayī bhavet || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye naleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 345 || cha ||
<7.1.346>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādāgneyadigbhāge sthitaḥ karkoṭako raviḥ || pūrvakalpe mahādevi smṛtaḥ karkoṭakānvitaḥ || 1 || tasya darśanamātreṇa prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || saptamyāṃ ravivāreṇa dhūpa gaṃdhānulepanaiḥ || pūjayedyo vidhānena mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye karkoṭakārkamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 346 || || cha ||
<7.1.346(2)>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi liṃgaṃ vai hāṭakeśvaram || naleśvarātpūrvabhāge śatadhanvaṃtaradvaye || 1 || agastyāmravanaṃnāma tatra sthāne tu saṃsthitam || ciṃtāmaṇestu pūrveṇa īśāne triśataṃdhanuḥ || tatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamagastyena mahātmanā || 2 || || devyuvāca || || kasminkāle mahādeva sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 3 || || || īśvara uvāca || || purā daityagaṇā raudrā babhūvurvaravarṇini || kālakeyā iti khyātāstrailokyocchedakārakāḥ || 4 || atha te nihatāḥ sarve viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || daityasūdananāmnā tu prabhāsakṣetravāsinā || 5 || kṛtvā vyāghrasya rūpaṃ tu nāmnā cakramukhīti ca || hatā vai tena rūpeṇa tato'bhūddaityasūdanaḥ || 6 || hataśeṣāḥ samudrāṃte praviṣṭā bhayavihvalāḥ || tataste maṃtrayāmāsuḥ pīḍyaṃte devatāḥ katham ||7|| hanyaṃtāṃ dharmiṇo ye'tra vidyaṃte dhara ṇītale || tapaḥsvādhyāyaniratā yajñadānaratāśca ye || 5 || atha te samayaṃ kṛtvā rātrau niṣkramya sāgarāt || nirjaghnustāpasāṃstatra yajñadānaratānpriye || 9 || prabhāse tu mahādevi tatra dvādaśayojane || vasiṣṭhasyāśrame tatra maharṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām || 7.1. 346(2).10 || bhakṣitāni sahasrāṇi paṃca sapta ca tāpasān || śatāni paṃca raibhyasya viśvāmitrasya ṣoḍaśa || 11 || cyavanasya ca saptaiva jābālerdviśataṃ muneḥ || vālakhilyāśrame puṇye ṣaṭchatāni durātmabhiḥ || 12 || yatra kvacidbhavedyajñastatra gatvā niśāgame || yajñadānasamāyuktānṛtvijo bhakṣayaṃti ca || 13 || tato bhayākulāḥ sarve babhūvurjagatī tale || na ca kaścidvijānāti daityānāṃ tu viceṣṭitam || 14 || rātrau svapaṃti munayaḥ sukhaśayyāgatāśca te || prabhāte tvadhvare teṣāmasthisaṃghāśca kevalam ||15|| tato dharmakriyāstyaktā bhūtale sarvamānavaiḥ || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ bhūtalaṃ samapadyata || 16 || athānye tāpasā rātrau saṃyutāśca ca dhṛtāyudhāḥ || athocchedaṃ gate dharme pīḍitāstridivaukasaḥ || 17 || kimetaditi jalpaṃto brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || bhagavaṃstāpasāḥ sarve tathā ye jñānaśīlinaḥ || 18 || bhakṣyante kenacidrātrau mṛtyumeva prayānti ca || naṣṭadharmakriyāḥ sarve bhūtale prapitāmaha || 19 || yo dharmamācaredahni sa rātrau mṛtyumeti ca || na svādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ samaste bhūtale vibho || 7.1. 346(2).20 || dharmābhāvādvayaṃ sarve saṃdehaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā dhyātvā devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || abravīttridaśānsarvānsandehaṃ paramaṃ gatān || 21 || kāleyā iti vikhyātā dānavā raudrakāriṇaḥ || te samudraṃ samāsādya tāpasānbhakṣayaṃti ca || 22 || yuṣmākaṃ ca vināśāya te na śakyā niṣūditum || yatadhvameṣāṃ nāśāya no cennāśo bhaviṣyati || 23 || vrajadhvaṃ bhūtale śīghramagastyo yatra tiṣṭhati|| vratacaryārato nityaṃ prabhāse kṣetra uttame || 24 || sa śaktaḥ sāgaraṃ pātuṃ mitrāvaruṇasaṃbhavaḥ || prasādyaśca sa yuṣmābhiḥ samudraṃ piba sattama || 25 || tatastathā kṛte tena te sarve dānavādhamāḥ || vadhyā yuṣmākaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti evaṃ ca tridiveśvarāḥ || 26 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || prabhāsaṃ kṣetramāsādya agastyaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 27 || || devā ūcuḥ || || rakṣarakṣa dvijaśreṣṭha trailokyaṃ saṃśayaṃ gatam || kālakeyaiḥ pratidhvastaṃ samudraṃ samupāśritaiḥ || 28 || taṃ śoṣaya dvijaśreṣṭha hitārthaṃ tridivaukasām || nānyaḥ śaktaḥ pumānkaścitkartumīdṛkkriyā vibho || 29 || || īśvara uvāca || || evamuktaḥ suragaṇairagastyo munipuṅgavaḥ || jagāma tridaśaiḥ sārdhaṃ samudraṃ prati harṣitaḥ || 7.1. 346(2).30 || gīyamānastu gaṃdharvaiḥ stūyamānastu kinnaraiḥ || ślāghyamānastu vibudhairvākyametaduvāca ha || 31 || eṣa trailokyarakṣārthaṃ śoṣayāmi mahārṇavam || drakṣyadhvaṃ kautukaṃ devāḥ samīnamakarairmahat || 32 || evamuktvā dvijaśreṣṭho hyagastyo bhagavānmuniḥ || gaṃḍūṣamakarotsarvaṃ sāgaraṃ saritāṃpatim || 33 || pīte tatra mahāsindhāvagatsye na mahātmanā || dānavā bhayasaṃtrastā itaścetaśca babhramuḥ || 34 || vadhyamānāḥ suraistatra śastraiḥ suniśitaistathā || kāṃtāramanye gacchaṃtaḥ palāyanaparāyaṇā || 35 || hatabhūyeṣu daityeṣu vidārya dharaṇītalam || pātālaṃ viviśustūrṇaṃ rudhireṇa pariplutāḥ || 36 || athocustridaśā hṛṣṭā agastyaṃ munisattamam || siddhaṃ no vāṃchitaṃ sarvaṃ pūryatāṃ sāgaraḥ punaḥ || 37 || || agastya uvāca || || jīrṇaṃ toyaṃ mayā devāstathaivāmedhyatāṃ gatam || utpatsyati raghūṇāṃ hi kule nṛpatisattamaḥ || 38 || bhagīratheti vikhyātaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || sa jñātikāraṇādeva gaṃgāṃ tatrānayiṣyati || 39 || brahmalokātsaricchreṣṭhāṃ tayā pūrṇo bhaviṣyati|| evamuktvā suraiḥ sārddhaṃ svasthānaṃ cāgamanmuniḥ || 7.1. 346(2).40 || tataḥ svamāśramaṃ prāptaṃ devā vākyamathābuvan || anena karmaṇā brahmanparituṣṭā vayaṃ mune || 41 || kiṃ kurmo brūhi te'bhīṣṭaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 42 || || agastya uvāca || || yāvadbrahmasahasrāṇi paṃcaviṃśatikoṭayaḥ || vaimāniko bhaviṣyāmi dakṣiṇāṃbaramūrddhani || 43 || atrāgatya naro yastu mamāśramapade śubhe || hāṭakeśvarasāṃnidhye prabhāsakṣetra uttame || 44 || snānamācarate samyaksa yātu paramāṃ gatim || pātālādavatīrṇaṃ taṃ liṃgarūpaṃ maheśvaram || 45 || mayā tapaḥ prabhāvena sthāpitaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet || dinedine bhavettasya gośatasya phalaṃ dhruvam || 46 || lopāmudrāsahāyaṃ māṃ yo martyaḥ saṃprapūjayet || arghyaṃ dadyādvidhānena kāśa puṣpaiḥ samāhitaḥ || 47 || prāpte śaradi kāle ca sa yātu paramāṃ gatim || lopāmudrāsahāyaṃ māṃ hāṭakeśvarasaṃyutam || 48 || ayane cottare pūjya golakṣa phalamāpnuyāt || yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute cātra ayane cottare dvijaḥ|| bhūyāttasya phalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ gayāśrāddhasya sattamāḥ || 49 || || īśvara uvāca || || bāḍhamitye va te coktvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ|| svasthānaṃ tu gatāḥ sarve saṃhṛṣṭamanasastadā ||7.1. 346(2).50|| tasmātsarvaprayatnena prāpte śaradi mānavaḥ|| agastyasyāśramaṃ gatvā hāṭakeśaṃ prapūjayet || 51 || agastyeśvaranāmānaṃ kalpaliṃgaṃ surapriyam || yaścaitacchuṇuyādbhaktyā ṛṣestasya viceṣṭitam|| ahorātrakṛtātpāpāttatkṣaṇā deva mucyate || 52 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye hāṭakeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 346(2) || || cha ||
<7.1.347>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi paścime nāradeśvarīm || nāradeśvarasāṃnidhye sarvadaurbhāgyanāśanīm || 1 || yā nārī pūjayeddevīṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ samāhitā || tadanvaye na daurbhāgyayuktā nārī bhaviṣyati || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nāradeśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 347 || || cha ||
<7.1.348>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devīṃ maṃtravibhūṣaṇām || bhīmeśvarasya sānnidhye somenārādhitāṃ purā || 1 || śrāvaṇe māsi vidhinā yā nārī tāṃ prapūjayet || tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklapakṣe sā duḥkhairmucyate'khilaiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mantravibhūṣaṇāgaurī māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭācatvāriṃśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 348 ||
<7.1.349>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi viśveśaṃ durgakūṭakam || bhallatīrthasya pūrveṇa yoginīcakradakṣiṇe || 1 || ārādhito'sau bhīmena sarvakāmaprado'bhavat || phālgunasya caturthyāṃ tu śuklapakṣe vidhānataḥ || || 2 || yastaṃ pūjayate devaṃ gandhapuṣpaiḥ samodakaiḥ || nirvighnaṃ jāyate tasya varṣamekaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye durgakūṭagaṇapatimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 349 || cha || ||
<7.1.350>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tasmādvai kauraveśvarīm || yasya nāmnā kurukṣetraṃ tena sārādhitā purā || 1 || ārādhitā'sau bhīmena kṛtvā kṣetrasya rakṣaṇam || mahānavamyāṃ yatnena yastāṃ pūjayate naraḥ || taṃ putramiva kalyāṇī rakṣate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 2 || bhojanaṃ tatra dātavyaṃ daṃpatīnāṃ na saṃśayaḥ || divyairbhakṣyaiḥ sumiṣṭānnaiḥ sā tuṣyati tataḥ stutā || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye kauraveśvarīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 350 || || cha ||
<7.1.351>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi suparṇelāṃ ca bhairavīm || durgakūṭāddakṣiṇato dhanuḥpaṃcaśatāṃtare || 1 || suparṇena purā devi pātālādamṛtaṃ hṛtam || gṛhītvā tatra muktaṃ tu nāgānāṃ paśyatāṃ kila || 2 || tato devyā tadā dṛṣṭvā rakṣitaṃ nāgapārśvataḥ || tataḥ suparṇeletyevaṃ khyātā sā vasudhātale || 3 || ilā tu kathyate bhūmiḥ suparṇena pratiṣṭhitā || tataḥ suparṇeletyeva nāmnā pātakanāśinī || 4 || suparṇakuṇḍe tatraiva snātvā tāṃ pūjayennaraḥ || viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyānnāpadbhirmriyate naraḥ || jīvavatsā bhavennārī ātmajaiścāpyalaṃkṛtā || 5 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye suparṇelāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||351|| || cha ||
<7.1.352>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi bhallatīrthamanuttamam || tasyāśca paścime bhāge yatra viṣṇuścaturbhujaḥ || 1 || yatra tyaktaṃ śarīraṃ tu viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || tasminmitravane ramye yojanārddhārddhavistṛte || 2 || yugeyuge mahādevi kalpamanvatarādiṣu || tatraiva saṃsthitirviṣṇornānyatra ca ratirbhavet || 3 || kṣetrāṇāmādikṣetraṃ tu vaiṣṇavaṃ tadvidurbudhāḥ|| tisraḥ koṭyarddhakoṭiśca tīrthānāṃ pravarāṇi ca|| 4 || divi bhuvyaṃtarikṣe ca tāni tatraiva bhāmini|| tatra mūrtimatī gaṃgā svayameva vyavasthitā || 5 || viṣṇoḥ saṃplavanārthāya prāṇināṃ ca hitāya vai || gaṃgā gayā kurukṣetraṃ naimiṣaṃ puṣkarāṇi ca || 6 || purī dvāravatīṃ tyaktvā atraiva vasate hariḥ || tasyaurdhvadaihikaṃ devi prakaromi yugeyuge || 7 || nabhasye dvādaśīyoge tatra gatvā svayaṃ priye || karomi tadvidhānena tatra brāhmaṇapuṃgavaiḥ || 8 || tatra dattvā tu dānāni vidhivadvedapārage || tatraiva dvādaśīyoge snātvā caiva vidhānataḥ || 9 || santarpya ca pitṝnbhaktyā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || tatra viṣṇuṃ tu saṃpūjya kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ niśi || 7.1.352.10 || dīpādidānaṃ kṛtvā tu kṛtakṛtyo'bhijāyate || 11 || atha tasya pravakṣyāmi purāvṛtta mahaṃ priye || saṃhṛtya yādavānsarvānvāsudevaḥ pratāpavān || 12 || durvāsasā'nuliptena pāyasena padastale || vajrāṃgabhūtadehastu sarvavyāpī janārddanaḥ || || 13 || gatvā tīre samudrasya samādhistho babhūva ha || sarvasrotāṃsi saṃyamya niveśyātmānamātmani || 14 || etasminnaṃtare prāpto bāṇahasto jarābhidhaḥ || dāśaputro'tikṛṣṇāṃgo matsyaghātī ca pāpakṛt || 15 || tena dṛṣṭastato dūrānniṣādātmasamudbhavaḥ || viṣṇoḥ padaṃ mṛgaṃ matvā śaraṃ tasya mumoca ha || 16 || tato'sau paśyate yāvadgatvā tasya ca saṃnidhau || caturbāhuṃ mahākāyaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || 17 || puruṣaṃ nīlameghābhaṃ puḍarīkanibhe kṣaṇam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā bhayabhītastu vepamānaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || abravīnna mayā jñātastvaṃ vibho divyarūpadhṛk || 18 || ajñānāttvaṃ mayā viddhastvatpadāgre surottama || kṣantumarhasi me nātha na tvaṃ kroddhumihārhasi || 19 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || śāpasyāṃtodya me bhadra śarapātātkṛtastvayā || tasmāttvaṃ matprasādena svargaṃ gaccha mahādyute || 7.1.352.20 || ye cānye māmihāgatya drakṣyaṃti hi narottamāḥ || te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatrāhaṃ nityasaṃsthitaḥ || 21 || bhallenāhaṃ yato viddhastvayā pādatale śubhe || bhallatīrthamiti khyātaṃ tato hyetadbhaviṣyati || 22 || harikṣetramiti proktaṃ pūrvaṃ svāyaṃbhuve'ntare || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtardadhe viṣṇurlubdhako'pi divaṃ gataḥ || ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ || viṣṇulokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti prītyā te matprasādataḥ || 24 || ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti pitṛbhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || tṛptiṃ teṣāṃ gamiṣyaṃti pitaraścaiva tarpitāḥ || 25 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena prāpya tatkṣetramuttamam || dṛśyo devaścaturbāhuḥ snātvā tīrthe tu bhallake || 26 || madbhaktibaladarpiṣṭhā matpriyaṃ na namaṃti ye || vāsudevaṃ na te jñeyā madbhaktāḥ pāpino hi te||27|| madbhakto'pi hi yo bhūtvā bhuṃkta ekādaśīdine|| malliṃgasyārcanaṃ kāryaṃ na tena pāpabuddhinā||28|| yā tithirdayitā viṣṇoḥ sā tithirmama vallabhā|| na tāṃ copoṣayedyastu sa pāpiṣṭhatarādhikaḥ||29|| tadvatsa dvādaśīyoge bhallatīrthasya saṃnidhau|| yastu māṃ pūjayedbhaktyā nārī vā'pi naro'pi vā || tasya janmasahasrāṇi gṛhabhaṃgo na jāyate||7.1.352.30|| ityetatkathitaṃ devi māhātmyaṃ pāpanāśanam|| bhallatīrthasya viṣṇostu sarva pātakanāśanam ||31|| tatra viṣṇostu sāṃnidhye vāyavye kumbhamuttamam|| bhallatīrthaṃ tu vikhyātaṃ yatra bhallahato hariḥ ||32|| tatra deyāni vāsāṃsi padaṃ gāvo vidhānataḥ || deyāni vipramukhyebhyaḥ samyagyātrāphalepsubhiḥ||33|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bhallatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||352||
<7.1.353>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kardamālamanuttamam || tīrthaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame || candrārkatapane naṣṭe jyotiṣi pralayaṃ gate || 2 || rasātalagatāmurvīṃ dṛṣṭvā devo janārdanaḥ || vārāhaṃ rūpamāsthāya daṃṣṭrāgreṇa varānane || utkṣipya dharaṇīṃ mūrdhnā svasthāne saṃnyaveśayat || 3|| uddhṛtya bhagavānviṣṇurvākyametaduvāca ha || 4 || atra sthāne sthitenaiva mayā tvaṃ devi coddhṛtā || mamātra niyataṃ vāsaḥ sadaivāyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 5 || ye pitṝṃstarpayiṣyaṃti kardamāle varānane || ākalpaṃ tarpitāstena bhaviṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 6 || tatra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti śākairmūlaphalena vā || bhaviṣyati kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ sarvatīrtheṣu vai śubhe || 7 || atra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā yo māṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || api kīṭapataṃgā ye nidhanaṃ yāṃti mānavāḥ || te mṛtāstri divaṃ yānti sukṛtena yathā dvijāḥ || 8 || tato dvīpeṣu jāyante dhanāḍhyāścottame kule || daṃṣṭrābhedena yattoyaṃ nirgataṃ te śarīrataḥ || 9 || tatra snātvā naro devi tiryagyonau na jāyate || 7.1.353.10 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi yathāvṛttamāścaryaṃ tatra vai purā || mṛgayūthaṃ susantrastaṃ lubdhakaiḥ paripīḍitam || praviṣṭaṃ kardamāle tu sadyo mānuṣatāṃ gatam || 11 || atha te lubdhakā dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanāḥ || apṛcchaṃta ca saṃbhrātāstānmartyānvaravarṇini || 12 || mṛgayūthamanuprāptaṃ kena mārgeṇa nirgatam || athocuste vayaṃ prāptā mānuṣaṃ mṛgarūpiṇaḥ || 13 || etattīrthaprabhāvo'yaṃ na vidmo hyātma kāraṇam || tataste lubdhakāstyaktvā dhanūṃṣi saśarāṇi ca || tatra snātvā mahābhāge muktāśca sarvapātakaiḥ || 14 || || pārvatyuvāca || || bhagavanvistaraṃ brūhi kardamālamahodayam || utpattiṃ ca vidhānaṃ ca kṣetrasīmādikaṃ kramāt || 15 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi rahasyaṃ tu karda mālasamudbhavam || gūḍhaṃ brahmarṣisarvasvaṃ na deyaṃ kasyacittvayā || 16 || pūrvamekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame || candrārkapavane naṣṭe jyotiṣi pralayaṃ gate || 17 || ekārṇavaṃ jagadidaṃ brahmāpaśyadaśeṣataḥ || tasminvasumatī magnā pātālatalamāgatā || 18 || tato yajñavarāho'sau kṛtvā yajñamayaṃ vapuḥ || uddadhāra mahīṃ kṛtsnāṃ daṃṣṭrāgreṇa varānane || 19 || vedapādo yūpadaṃṣṭraḥ kratudaṃtaḥsrucīmukhaḥ || agnijihvo darbharomā brahmaśīrṣā mahātapāḥ || 7.1.353.20 || ahorātrekṣaṇaparo vedāṃgaśrutibhūṣaṇaḥ || ājyanāsaḥ sruvatuḍaḥ sāmaghoṣasvano mahān || 21 || prāgvaṃśakāyo dyutimānmātrādīkṣābhirāvṛtaḥ || dakṣiṇā hṛdayo yogī mahāsatramaho mahān || 22 || upākarmoṣṭharucakaḥ pravargyāvartabhūṣaṇaḥ || nānācchandogatipatho brahmoktakramavikramaḥ ||23 || bhūtvā yajñavarāho'sāvuddadhāra mahīṃ tataḥ || tasyoddhṛtavataḥ pṛthvīṃ daṃṣṭrāgraṃ nirgataṃ bahiḥ || 24 || tasminprābhāsike kṣetre karddamena vilepitam || taddaṃṣṭrāgraṃ yato devi karddamālaṃ tataḥ smṛtam || 25 || daṇḍodbhedaṃ mahākuṇḍaṃ yatra daṃṣṭrā susaṃsthitā || taddaṃṣṭrayoddhṛtaṃ toyaṃ koṭigaṃgābhiṣekavat || 26 || tatra gavyūti mātraṃ tu viṣṇukṣetraṃ sanātanam || deśāṃtaraṃ gatā ye ca daṇḍodbhede mriyaṃti vai || yāvatkalpasahasrāṇi viṣṇulokaṃ vrajaṃti te ||27|| yastu paśyenmahādevi kardamāle tu sūkaram || koṭihiṃsāyuto vāpi sa prāpsyati parāṃ gatim || 28 || daśajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ naśyettaddarśanātpriye || janmāntarasahasreṣu yatkṛtaṃ pāpasaṃcayam || 29 || kardamāle tu vārāhaṃ dṛṣṭvā tannāśameṣyati || hemakoṭisahasrāṇi gavāṃ koṭiśatāni ca || 7.1.353.30 || dattvā yallabhate puṇyaṃ sakṛdvārāhadarśanāt || kalau yuge mahāraudre prāṇināṃ ca bhayāvahe || nānyatra jāyate muktirmuktvā kṣetraṃ tu saukaram || 31 || etatsārataraṃ devi proktamuddeśatastava || karddamālasya māhātmyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 32 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye karddamālamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ ||353 || || cha ||
<7.1.354>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devagupteśvaraṃ priye || tatra paścimavāyavye yatra somo'karottapaḥ || 1 || gupto bhūtvā kuṣṭharogāllajjayādhomukhaḥ sthitaḥ || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu prabhāsakṣetra uttame || 2 || tataḥ pratyakṣatāṃ yātaḥ sarvadevapatiḥ śivaḥ || tuṣṭo babhūva caṃdrasya kṣayanāśaṃ tathā'karot || 3 || kṣayarogavinirmuktastato'bhūnmṛgalāṃchanaḥ || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāliṃgaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam || 4 || guptastepe tapo yasmāttasmādgupteśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || sarvakuṣṭhaharo devo darśanātsparśanādapi || 5 || somavāre viśeṣeṇa yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || tasyānvaye'pi deveśi kuṣṭhī kaścinna jāyate || 6 || iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gupteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo 'dhyāyaḥ || 354 ||
<7.1.355>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi devaṃ bahusuvarṇakam || hiraṇyāpūrvadigbhāge sthāne bahusuvarṇake || 1 || dharmaputreṇa yatraiva kṛto yajñaḥ suduṣkaraḥ || nāmnā bahusuvarṇeti sthāpya liṃgaṃ mahāprabham || 2 || sarvakratūnāṃ phaladaṃ nāmnā sarveśvaraṃ viduḥ || tatraiva saṃsthitaṃ liṃgaṃ pūrṇaṃ sārasvatairjalaiḥ || 3 || snātvā tatra varārohe piṇḍadānaṃ dadāti yaḥ || kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya rudraloke mahīyate || 4 || yastaṃ pūja yate bhaktyā gandhapuṣpairvidhānataḥ || koṭipūjāphalaṃ tasya tathetyāha sadāśivaḥ || 5 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye bahusuvarṇeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 355 || || cha || || ||
<7.1.356>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi śṛṃgeśvaramanuttamam || śukasthānasya sānnidhye sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || snātvā tatraiva vidhivacchṛṃgeśaṃ pūjayennaraḥ || muktaḥ syātpātakaiḥ sarvairṛṣyaśṛṃgo yathā purā || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śṛṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 356 || || cha ||
<7.1.357>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tasmādīśānadigbhāge tatkoṭinagaraṃ smṛtam || tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge sthitaṃ yojanamātrakam || koṭīśvaraṃ mahāliṃgaṃ koṭiyajñaphalapradam || 1 || snātvā tatra vidhānena yastalliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ koṭiyajñaphalaṃ labhet || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye koṭīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapaṃcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 357 || || cha || ||
<7.1.358>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi tīrthaṃ nārāyaṇābhidham || tasyaiveśānadigbhāge vāpī śāṃḍilyakīrtitā || 1 || snātvā tatraiva vidhivacchāṃḍilyaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet || ṛṣipaṃcamyāṃ vidhinā nārī caiva pativratā || spṛṣṭvāspṛṣṭvā vimucyeta rajodoṣabhayāddhruvam || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye nārāyaṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmā ṣṭāpaṃcāśaduttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 358 || || cha ||
<7.1.359>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi sthānaṃ śṛṃgasaro'bhidham || 1 || śṛṃgāreśvaranāmā ca tatra devaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || śṛṅgāraṃ vidhivaccakre yatra gopīyuto hariḥ || 2 || śṛṅgāreśvaranāmā ca tena pāpaughanāśanaḥ || pūjayedyo vidhānena tatra sthāne sthitaṃ bhavam || dāridryaduḥkhasaṃyukto na sa bhūyādbhave kvacit || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye śṛṃgāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 359 ||
<7.1.360>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyātaṭasaṃsthitam || ghaṭikāsthānamiti ca yatra siddhaḥ purā ṛṣiḥ || 1 || nāḍyaikayā mṛkaṇḍastu dhyānayogādvarānane || tatraiva sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ mārkaṃḍeśvaranāmataḥ || sarvapāpopaśamanaṃ darśanātpūjanādapi || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye mārkaṃḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭyuttara triśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 360 ||
<7.1.361>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi maṇḍūkeśvaramityapi || māṃḍūkyāyananāmnā vai liṃgaṃ tatra pratiṣṭhitam || 1 || tatra koṭihrado devi tathā koṭīśvaraḥ śivaḥ || tatra mātṛgaṇaścaiva sthitaḥ kāmaphalapradaḥ || 2 || snātvā koṭi hrade tīrthe talliṃgaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet || mātṝstatraiva saṃpūjya duḥkhaśokādvimucyate || 3 || tasmātpūrveṇa deveśi yojanaikena nirmalam || tritakūpeti vikhyātaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || sarveṣāṃ devi tīrthānāṃ yattatraiva vyavasthitiḥ || 4 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye koṭihrada maṇḍūkeśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃ nāmaikaṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 361 ||
<7.1.362>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi goṣpadasyottare sthitam || gavyūtidvitayenaiva valāya iti viśrutam || 1 || tatraikādaśarudrāṇāṃ sthānaliṃgānyapi priye || ajaikapādahirbudhnyaḥ saṃtītyādīni nāmataḥ || pūjayettāni vidhivanmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmya ekādaśarudraliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 362 || || cha || ||
<7.1.363>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyātaṭasaṃsthitam || sthānaṃ tuṇḍapuraṃnāma yatrāsau ghargharo hradaḥ || 1 || tatra kandeśvaro devo yatra baddhā jaṭā mayā || tatra snātvā naraḥ samyaktṃ devaṃ yaḥ prapūjayet || sa muktaḥ pātakairghoraiḥ prāpnuyācchāsanaṃ śubham || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye hiraṇyātuṇḍapura ghargharahradakandeśvara māhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatata mo'dhyāyaḥ ||363||
<7.1.364>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi saṃvarteśvaramuttamam || indreśvarātpaścimataḥ pūrvataścārkabhāskarāta || 1 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tu mahādevaṃ snātvā puṣkariṇījale || daśānāmaśvamedhānāṃ phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 2 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye saṃvarteśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 364 || || cha || ||
<7.1.365>
|| || īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi hiraṇyāyāśca uttare || siddhisthānāni divyāni yatra siddhā maharṣayaḥ || 1 || tatra liṃgānyanekāni śakyaṃte kathituṃ na hi || sāgraṃ śataṃ punastatra liṃgānāṃ pravaraṃ smṛtam ||2|| vajriṇyāstu taṭe devi liṃgānyekonaviṃśatiḥ || nyaṃkumatyāstaṭe devi sahasraṃ dviśatādhikam || 3 || prādhānyena varārohe pūrve svāyaṃbhuveṃ'tare || kapilāyāstaṭedevi liṃgānāṃ ṣaṣṭiruttamā || 4 || sarasvatyāṃ punastatra liṃgasaṃkhyā na vidyate || evaṃ paṃcamukhā devi liṃgamālā vibhūṣitā || 5 || prabhāse kathitā devi paṃcasrotāḥ sarasvatī || yasyāḥ pravāhaiḥ saṃbhinnaṃ kṣetraṃ dvādaśayojanam || || 6|| tatra vāpīṣu kūpeṣu yatra tatrodbhavaṃ jalam || sārasvataṃ tu tajjñeyaṃ te dhanyā ye pibaṃti tat || 7 || yatratatra naraḥ snātvā samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || sārasvatasnānaphalaṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 8 || yatproktaṃ sparśaliṃgaṃ tu śrīsomeśeti viśrutam || prabhāsakṣetraliṃgānāṃ kalā tasyaiva śāṃkarī ||9 || yadvā tadvā pūjayitvā liṃgaṃ kṣetrasya madhyagam || śrīsomeśamiti jñātvā someśaḥ pūjito bhavet ||7.1.366.10|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye prakīrṇasthānaliṃgamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaṣaṣṭyuttaratriśatatamo'dhyāyaḥ || 365 || || cha || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathamaṃ prabhāsakṣetra māhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam || 7.1 ||
<7.2.1>
|| || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || śrīsarasvatyai namaḥ || || atha śrīskāde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīyaṃ śrīvastrāpathakṣetramāhātmyaṃ prārabhyate || || || īśvara uvāca || || atha te saṃpravakṣyāmi kṣetragarbhaṃ mahodayam || tadvastrāpathamāhātmyaṃ yatra raivatako giriḥ || 1 || dāmodaraṃ raivatake bhavaṃ vastrāpathe tathā || etadraivatakaṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāpathamiti smṛtam || 2 || suvarṇarevā yatrasthā nadī pātakanāśanī || yatra sākṣātsthitaḥ kṛṣṇo dāmodara iti smṛtaḥ || 3 || yatra sthitaṃ mṛgīkuṇḍaṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || sakṛcchrāddhe kṛte yatra kalpakoṭisahasrakam || pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptirapunarbhavakāṃkṣiṇī || 4 || || devyuvāca || || bhagavanvistarādbrūhi dāmodaramahodayam || kṣetragarbhasya māhātmyaṃ karṇikārūpasaṃsthitam || 5 || || īśvara uvāca || || śṛṇu devi pravakṣyāmi dāmodarahariṃ prati || itihāsaṃ purākhyātamṛṣibhiḥ kalpavāsibhiḥ || 6 || gaṃgātīre śubhe ramye puṇye janapadākule || ṛṣibhiḥ sevite nityaṃ svargamārgaprade dhruvam || 7 || tatra jñānavido viprā yajaṃti vividhairmakhaiḥ || ṛṣayaḥ sāṃkhyayogena dānenaivetare janāḥ || 8 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā svargamabhīpsavaḥ || sevaṃte tajjalaṃ divyaṃ devānāmapi durlabham || 9 || tatra rājā gajonāma balī sarvajanādhipaḥ || gaṃgājalābhiṣekārthaṃ tyakvā rājyaṃ jagāma ha || 7.2.1.10 || bhāryā tasya satī sādhvī putriṇī rūpasaṃyutā || sā'pyayātsaha tenaiva bhartrā vai bhartṛvatsalā || 11 || saṃgatā nāma nāmnā ca dakṣā dākṣāyaṇī yathā || evaṃ nivasatostatra varṣāṇāmayutaṃ gatam || 12 || ājagāma ṛṣistatra bhadronāma mahāyaśāḥ || sahito bahubhirviprairjapahomaparāyaṇaiḥ || 13 || tyaktvā saṃsāramārgaṃ tu svargamārgajigīṣavaḥ || gaṃgāniṣevaṇaṃ kṛtvā sphoṭayitvā''tmajaṃ malam || 14 || jalaṃ dattvā tu bhūtebhyaḥ pūjayitvā janārddanam|| yāvadyāṃti nadītīra ṛṣayo bhadrakādayaḥ || tāvatpaśyaṃti rājānaṃ gajaṃ varagajopamam ||15|| tenaiva dṛṣṭā munayo rājñā nihatakalmaṣāḥ || saptarṣayo yathā svarge surarājena dhīmatā ||16|| tamṛṣiṃ sa ca saṃprekṣya padāni daśa paṃca ca || āgacchantvatra pūjārhā bhavato mama mandiram|| 17 || paśyaṃtu saṃgatāṃ sarve mama bhāryāṃ yaśasvinīm || tasyāḥ pūjāṃ samādāya yo mārgo manasi sthitaḥ || 18 || taṃ gacchadhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ puṇyāḥ puṇyamabhīpsavaḥ || evamuktāstu te rājñā ṛṣayaḥ kautukānvitāḥ || ājagmurmaṃdiraṃ śubhraṃ puraṃdarapuropamam || 19 || āsanāni vicitrāṇi dattvā teṣāṃ manasvinī || saṃgatā rājarājena sārddhamagre vyavasthitā ||7.2.1.20|| kṛtvā karapuṭaṃ rājā ṛṣīṇāṃ puṇyakarmaṇām || babhāṣe vacanaṃ rājā bhadro bhadraṃ susaṃgatam||21|| vasudhā vasusaṃpūrṇā maṃḍitā nagarī purī || parvataiśca samudraiśca saridbhiśca sarovaraiḥ ||22|| grāmaiścatuṣpathairghorairgokulairākulīkṛtā || nararatnairaśvaratnairgajaratnaistu saṃkulā || 23 || dustyajā bhogabhoktṛṇāṃ paraṃ jñānamajānatām || saṃsāre'tra mahāghore punarāvṛttikāriṇi || 24 || pataṃti puruṣā bhadra patrāṇīva punaḥpunaḥ || kṛtena yena vipreṃdra svargaṃ prāpnoti nirmalam || dānena tapasā caiva tattvamā cakṣva suvrata || 25 || || bhadra uvāca || || tīrthāni toyapūrṇāni devāḥ pāṣāṇamṛnmayāḥ || ātmasthaṃ ye na paśyaṃti te na paśyaṃti tatparam || 26 || saṃti tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || puṇyatoyā pavitraśca saritaḥ sāgarāstathā || bahupuṇyapradā pṛthvī sthānesthāne padepade || 27 || yadyasti tava rājeṃdra jñānaṃ jñānavatāṃ vara || viṣṇuṃ jiṣṇuṃ hṛṣīkeśaṃ śaṃkhinaṃ gadinaṃ tathā || 28 || caturbhujaṃ mahābāhuṃ prabhāse daityasūdanam || vārāhaṃ vāmanaṃ caiva nārasiṃhaṃ balārjunam || 29 || rāmaṃ rāmaṃ ca rāmaṃ ca puruṣottamameva ca || puṃḍarīkekṣaṇaṃ caiva gadāpāṇiṃ tathaiva ca || 7.2.1.30 || rāghavaṃ śakradamanaṃ goviṃdaṃ bahupuṇyadam || jayaṃ ca bhūdharaṃ caiva devadevaṃ janārddanam || 31 || surottamaṃ śrīdharaṃ ca hariṃ yogīśvaraṃ tathā || kapileśaṃ bhūtanāthaṃ śvetadvīpapatiṃ harim || 32 || badaryāśramavāsau ca naranārāyaṇau tathā || padmanābhaṃ sunābhaṃ ca hayagrīvaṃ viśāṃ pate || 33 || dvijanāthaṃ dharānāthaṃ khaḍgapāṇiṃ tathaiva ca || dāmodaraṃ jalāvāsaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ harim ||34|| etānyeva hi sthānāni devadevasya cakriṇaḥ || gacchate yatra tatraiva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 35 || gaṃgā ca yamunā caiva tathā devī sarasvatī || dṛṣadvatī gomatī ca tāpī kāveriṇī tathā || 36 || | | narmadā śarmadā caiva nadī godāvarī tathā || śatadruśca tathā viṃdhyā payoṣṇī varadā tathā || 37 || carmaṇvatī ca sarayūrgaṃḍakī caṃḍapāpahā || caṃdrabhāgā vipāśā ca śoṇaścaiva punaḥpunaḥ || 38 || etāścānyāśca bahavo himavatprabhavāḥ śubhāḥ || tāsu snāto naraḥ svargaṃ yāti pātakavarjitaḥ || 39 || vanāni naṃdanādīni parvatā maṃdarādayaḥ || nāmoccāreṇa yeṣāṃ hi pāpaṃ yāti rasātale ||7.2.1.40 || || gaja uvāca || || bhadraṃ hi bhāṣitaṃ bhadra ākhyānamamṛtopamam || pṛcchāmi sarvadharmajña tvāmahaṃ kiṃcideva hi || 41 || yasminmāse dine yasmiṃstīrthe yasminkramānnaraiḥ || akṣayaṃ sevyate svargastanmamācakṣva suvrata || 42 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyo devatārcanam || akṣayo yena vai svargastanme gaditumarhasi || 43 || || bhadra uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ rājaśārdūla kathāṃ kathayato mama || yāṃ śrutvā mucyate pāpānnaro naravarottama || 44 || ṛṣīṇāṃ kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ nāradena mahātmanā || 45 || evaṃ pṛṣṭaśca taiḥ sarvairnārado munisattamaḥ || kathayāmāsa saṃhṛṣṭo meghadudubhinisvanaiḥ || 46 || ramye himavataḥ pṛṣṭhe samavāye mayā śrutam|| tadahaṃ tava vakṣyāmi śrotukāmaṃ nararṣabha || 47 || tīrthānyeva hi sarvāṇi punarāvarttakāni tu || akṣayām̐llabhate lokāṃstattīrthaṃ kathayāmi te || 48 || mārgaśīrṣe kānyakubja uṣitvā rājasattama || na śocati naro nārī svargaṃ yāti parāvaram ||49|| pauṣasya paurṇamāsī yā yadi sā kriyate'rbude || varṣāṇāmarbudaṃ svarge modate pitṛbhiḥ saha ||7.2.1.50|| māghyāṃ yadi gayāśrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ yacchate naraḥ || tra yāṇāmapi devānāṃ caturthaḥ sa prajāyate ||51|| phālgunyāṃ himavatpṛṣṭhe vasannekāṃ niśāṃ naraḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra devo janārddanaḥ || 52 || caitryāṃ śrāddhaṃ prabhāse tu ye kurvaṃti manīṣiṇaḥ || na te marttyā bhavantīha kulajaiḥ saha sattamāḥ || 53 || caturbhuje tu vaiśākhyāṃ ye kurvaṃti jalapriye || tathāvaṃtyāṃ naraḥ kaścitsa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 54 || jyaiṣṭhyāṃ jyeṣṭharkṣayuktāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ ca tritakūpake || kuryuryugāni te trīṇi vasaṃti nākasadmani || 55 || yo vrajeśavane nadyāṃ dināni nava paṃca ca || tiṣṭhate ca naraḥ svargaṃ vaikuṇṭhamabhigacchati || 56 || śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya pūrṇāyāṃ pūrvasāgare || snānaṃ dānaṃ japaṃ śrāddhaṃ naraḥ kurvanna śocati || 57 || tathā bhādrapade kṣetre prabhāse śaśibhūṣaṇam || pūjayitvā naro liṃgaṃ devaliṃgī bhavettataḥ || 58 || āśvine caṃdrabhāgāyāṃ śrāddhaṃ snānaṃ karoti yaḥ || sthānaṃ yugasahasrāṇāṃ kṛtaṃ tena triviṣṭape || 59 || aṣṭākṣaraiścaturbāhuṃ dhyāyaṃti munisattamāḥ || bahunā'tra kimuktena gajāhaṃ pravadāmi te || 7.2.1.60 || dāmodarasamaṃ tīrthaṃ na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || māsānāṃ kārttikaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ kārttike bhīṣmapaṃcakam || 61 || tatrāpi dvādaśī śreṣṭhā rājandāmodare jale || kimanyairbahubhistīrtheḥ ki kṣetraiḥ ki mahāvanaiḥ || dāmodare naraḥ snātvā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 62 || || gaja uvāca || || bhadra bhadraṃ tvayā proktaṃ rasāyanamivāparam || bhūyo'haṃ śrotumicchāmi tīrthasyāsya mahāphalam || 63 || ke deśāḥ kiṃ pramāṇaṃ tu kā nadī keḥ ca parvatāḥ || janā vasaṃti ke tatra ṛṣayaḥ ke tapasvinaḥ || 64 || || bhadra uvāca || || pṛthivī vasusaṃpūrṇā sāgareṇa tu veṣṭitā || maṃḍitā nagarairgrāmaiḥ suraiḥ parapuraṃjaya || 65 || vārāṇasī prabhāsaṃ ca saṃgamaṃ sitakṛṣṇayoḥ || evaṃ sārāṇi tīrthāni yasmānmṛtyuharāṇi ca || 66 || dāmodareti ye nūnaṃ smaraṃto yatra tatra hi|| te vasaṃti harergehaṃ na saraṃti kadācana || 67 || somanāthasya sānnidhya udayanto girirmahān || tasya paścimabhāge tu raivataka iti smṛtaḥ || 68 || vāhinī vahate tatra nadī kāṃcanaśekharāt || dhātavastatra te raktāḥ śvetā nīlāstathā'sitāḥ || 69 || pāṣāṇāḥ kuñjarākārāścānye sairibhasannibhāḥ || caṇakākṛtayaścānye anye gokṣurakaprabhāḥ || 7.2.1.70 || vṛkṣā vallyaśca gulmāśca saṃtānāḥ saṃtyanekaśaḥ || sarvaṃ tatkāṃcanamayaṃ mūlaṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ dalam || 71 || na hi paśyati pāpātmā muktaḥ pāpena paśyati || sevyate sa girirnityaṃ dhātuvādaparairnaraiḥ || 72 || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyairvaiśyaiḥ śūdraiḥ śūdrānugairbahiḥ || pakṣiṇastatra bahavaḥ śivāśivagirastadā || 73 || haṃsasārasacakrāhvāḥ śukakokilabarhiṇaḥ || mṛgāśca vānarendrāśca haṃsā vyāghrāstathaiva ca || 74 || tattīrthasya prabhāvena na duṣṭānyācaraṃti te || kālena mṛtyumāyāṃti paśupakṣisarīsṛpāḥ || 785 || sarve vimānamārūḍhā gacchanti harimandiram|| vāyunā pātitaṃ yatra patrapuṣpaphalādikam || 76 || tasyā nadyā jalaṃ spṛṣṭvā sarvaṃ vai muktimāpnute || sā nadī pṛthivīṃ bhittvā pātālādāgatā nṛpa || 77 || pūrvaṃ pannagarājastu tena mārgeṇa cāgataḥ || snātuṃ dāmodare tīrthe yamamṛtyupraghātini || 78 || svargādāgatya candro'pi yaṣṭuṃ yajñaṃ supuṣkalam || yakṣmarogādvinirmukto gataḥ svargaṃ nirāmayaḥ || 79 || balinā caiva dānāni dattānyāgatya kārtike || hariścandreṇa vidhinā nalena nahuṣeṇa ca || 7.2.1.80 || nābhāgenāṃbarīṣādyaiḥ kṛtaṃ karma suduṣkaram || dattvā dānānyanekāni gajā gāvo hayā rathāḥ || 81 || anaḍutkāṃcanā bhūmiṃ ratnāni vividhāni ca || chatrāṇi vipramukhyebhyo yānāni caiva vāsasī || 82 || annāni rasamiśrāṇi dattvā dāmodarāgrataḥ || gatāste viṣṇu bhuvanaṃ nāgacchaṃti mahītale || 83 || patraṃ puṣpaṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ tasmiṃstīrthe dadāti yaḥ || dvijānāṃ bhaktisaṃyuktaḥ sa yāti jalaśāyinam || 84 || prakṛtiṃ cāpi yo dadyānmuṣṭiṃ vātha kṣudhārthine || vimānavaramārūḍhaḥ sa somaṃ prati gacchati || 85 || dāmodarāgrataḥ kṛtvā parvatānannasaṃbhavān || pūjitānphalapuṣpaiśca dīpaṃ dadyātsavarttikam || 86 || avāpya duṣkaraṃ sthānaṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || caturaṃgulamātrepi datte dāmodarāgrataḥ || 87 || dāne yugasahasrāṇi svargaloke mahīyate || mā gaccha himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ malayaṃ mā ca mandaram || 88 || gaccha raivatakaṃ śailaṃ yatra dāmodaraḥ sthitaḥ || kṛtvā māsopavāsaṃ tu dvijo dāmodarāgrataḥ || 89 || na nivartati kālena dāmodarapuraṃ vrajet || karotyanaśanaṃ yaśca naro nāryathavā punaḥ || sarva lokānatikramya sa harergehamāpnuyāt || 7.2.1.90 || vighnāni tatra tiṣṭhanti nityaṃ pañcaśatāni ca || dharmavidhvaṃsakartṝṇi narastatra na gacchati || 91 || pradyumnabalaśaineyagadācakrādibhiḥ sadā || śatalakṣapramāṇaistu sevyate sa girirmahān || 92 || krīḍaṃti nāryasteṣāṃ hi nityaṃ dāmodarāgrataḥ || sucandravadanā gauryaḥ śyāmāścaiva sumadhyamāḥ || 93 || nitaṃbinyaḥ sukeśāśca śubhrāḥ svāyatalocanāḥ || sugaṃḍā lalitāścaiva sukakṣāḥ supayodharāḥ || 94 || śobhamānāḥ sujaṃghāśca supādāḥ sundarāṃgulīḥ || rājaputryo girau tasminhasaṃti ca ramaṃti ca || 95 || kausuṃbhaṃ pādayugale kuṃkumaṃ pītakaṃcukam|| brāhmaṇībhyo dadantīha sparddhamānāḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 96 || bhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca peyaṃ ca lehyaṃ coṣyaṃ ca picchilam || tāṃbūlaṃ puṣpasaṃyuktaṃ kārtike harivāsare || 97 || dṛṣṭvā tu revatīkuṃḍaṃ pradadyātphalamuttamam || putriṇī ṛddhisaṃpannā subhagā jāyate satī || 98 || evaṃ kṛtvā tu sā rātri nīyate nidrayā vinā || vedaghoṣaiḥ supuṇyaistu bhāratākhyānavācanaiḥ || 99 || huṃkṛtaistalaśabdaiśca tālaśabdaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || deśabhāṣāvibhāṣiṇyo rāmāmaṇḍalamadhyataḥ || hāsyanṛtyasamāyuktā rājandāmodarāgrataḥ || 7.2.1.100 || pañcapāṣāṇakaṃ harmyaṃ yaḥ karoti śivālayam || paṃcavarṣasahasrāṇi svarga loke mahīyate || 101 || daśapāṣāṇasaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā dāmodarāgrataḥ || daśavarṣasahasrāṇi svarge hallati mallati || 102 || śatapāṣāṇakaṃ harmyaṃ yaḥ karoti mahannṛpa || mandiraṃ sundaraṃ śubhraṃ sa yāti harimandiram || 103 || kṛtvā sāhasrikaṃ caityaṃ bahurūpasamanvitam || sarvām̐llokānatikramya paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 104 || paṃcavarṇadhvajaṃ dadyāddāmodaragṛhopari || taṃ tu pramāṇavarṣāṇi divyāni sa divaṃ vrajet || 105 || tasya gavyūtimātreṇa kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ śubham || yaddṛṣṭvā sarvapāpāni vilīyante bahūni ca || 106 || rājaṃstatpadamāyāti yadgatvā na nivarttate || pūjayitvā bhavaṃ devaṃ bhavasaṃbhavanāśanam || 107 || naro nārī nṛpaśreṣṭha śivaloke mahīyate || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya bhadrasya ca subhāṣitam || 108 || āgataḥ kārtikīṃ karttuṃ deve dāmodare tataḥ || ṛgyajuḥsāmasaṃyuktairbrāhmaṇairbrahmavittamaiḥ || 109 || kṣatriyaiḥ kṣatradharmajñairvaiśyairdānaparāyaṇaiḥ || saha śūdraiḥ samāyātastasmiṃstīrthe gajo nṛpaḥ || 7.2.1.110 || dattvā dānānyanekāni hutvā havirhutāśane || agniṣṭomādikānyajñānhayamedhādikānbahūn || cakāra vidhivadrājā gajastatra samāhitaḥ || 111 || tataśca nyavasattatra tapaḥ kartuṃ saharṣibhiḥ || ūrddhvapādāḥ sthitā viprāḥ pītvā dhūmamadhomukhāḥ || śuṣkapatrāśanāścānye anye vai phalabhojanāḥ || 112 || mūlāni cānye bhakṣaṃti anye vāryaṃśanā dvijāḥ || ālokaṃti svamanye ca tathānye jalaśāyinaḥ || 113 || pañcāgnisādhakāścānye śilācūrṇasya bhakṣakāḥ || japaṃti cānye saṃśuddhā gāyatrīṃ vedamātaram || sāvitrīṃ manasā cānye devīmanye sarasvatīm|| 114 || sūktāni hi pavitrāṇi brahmaṇā nirmitāni ca || anye'vasaṃstadā tatra dvādaśākṣaracintakāḥ || 115 || ālokya sarvaśāstrāṇi vicārya ca punaḥpunaḥ || idameva suniṣpannaṃ dhyeyo nārāyaṇaḥ sadā || 116 || ārādhitaḥ suduṣpāre bhave bhagavato vinā || tathā nānyo mahādevātpatantaṃ yo'bhirakṣati || 117 || gatāgatāni vartaṃte caṃdrasūryādayo grahāḥ || adyāpi na nivartaṃte dvādaśākṣaraciṃtakāḥ || 118 ||| ye'kṣarā ṛṣayaścānye devalokajigīṣavaḥ || prāpnuvaṃti tataḥ sthānaṃ dagdhabījaṃ ca tattathā || 119 || sakṛduccaritaṃ yena harirityakṣaradvayam || baddhaḥ parikarastena mokṣāya gamanaṃ prati || 7.2.1.120 || ekabhaktaṃ tathā naktamayācyamuṣitaṃ tathā|| evamādīni cānyāni kṛtvā dāmodarāgrataḥ || kṛtakṛtyā bhavaṃtīha yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam|| 121 || sa rājā ṛṣibhiḥ sārddhaṃ yāvattiṣṭhati tatra vai || vimānāni sahasrāṇi tāvattatrāgatāni ca || 122 || gaṃdharvāpsarastatra siddhacāraṇakinnarāḥ || sarve vimānamārūḍhāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 123|| sarvairjanapadaiḥ sārddha sa rājā bhāryayā saha || gato vimānamārūḍho yattatpadamanāmayam || 124 || ya idaṃ paṭhate nityaṃ śṛṇuyādvā'pi mānavaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ paraṃ brahmādhigacchati || 125 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye dāmodaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha || ||
<7.2.2>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ punaḥ || yatprabhāsasya sarvasvaṃ kṣetraṃ nābhiḥ priyaṃ mama || 1 || yatra sākṣādbhavo devaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || pṛthivyāṃ sa tvadhiṣṭhātā tattvānāmādimaḥ prabhuḥ || 2 || sa svayaṃbhūḥ sthitastatra prabhāse bhūtido bhavaḥ || bhavatīdaṃ jagadyasmāttasmādbhava iti smṛtaḥ || 3 || yaḥ sakṛtkurute yātrāṃ kṣetre vastrāpathe punaḥ || vigāhya tatra tīrthāni kṛtakṛtyaḥ sa jāyate || 4 || atha dṛṣṭvā bhavaṃ devaṃ sakṛtpūjyavidhānataḥ || kedārayātrāphalabhāksa bhavenmanujottamaḥ || 5 || caitre māsi bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā na punarjāyate bhuvi || vaiśākhyāmathavā samyagbhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimucyate || 6 || vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre narmadāyāṃ tu yatphalam || tatphalaṃ nimiṣārddhena bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā dinedine || 7 || durllabhastatra vāsastu durllabhaṃ bhavadarśanam || pretatvaṃ naiva tasyāsti na yāmyā nārakī vyathā || 8 || yeṣāṃ bhavālaye prāṇā gatā vai varavarṇini || dhanyānāmapi dhanyāste devānāmapi devatāḥ || 9 || vastrāpathe matiryeṣāṃ bhave yeṣāṃ matiḥ sthirā || godānaṃ tatra śaṃsaṃti brāhmaṇānāṃ ca bhojanam|| piṃḍadānaṃ ca tatraiva kalpāṃtaṃ tṛptimā vahet|| 7.2.2.10 || iti saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ māhātmyaṃ te bhavodbhavam || śrutaṃ pāpopaśamanaṃ yajñāyutaphalapradam || 11 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye vastrāpathakṣetrabhavamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || cha||
<7.2.3>
|| īśvara uvāca || atha vastrāpathe kṣetre saṃti tīrthāni koṭiśaḥ|| tathāpi sāraṃ te vacmi sarvatīrthamahodayam || 1 || dāmodare nadī proktā svarṇareṣeti yā smṛtā || brahmakuṇḍaṃ ca tatraiva tathā brahmeśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 2 || kālameghaśca saṃprokto bhavo dāmodaraḥ smṛtaḥ || gavyūtidvitayenaiva kālikā tatra kīrtitā || 3 || indreśvaraśca tatraiva raivataḥ parvatastathā || ujjayaṃtaśca tatraiva devaḥ kumbhīśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 4 || bhīmeśvaraśca tatraiva tataḥ kṣetraṃ mahāprabham || tailasāraṇikaṃnāma tretāyāṃ haimamārakam || 5 || paṃcagavyūtimātraṃ tu tatkṣetraṃ saṃprakīrtitam || mṛgīkuṇḍaṃ ca tatraiva sarvapātakanāśanam || 6 || etadvastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ ratnadhātvostathā''karam || kathitaṃ tava deveśi punaḥ saṃkṣepato mayā || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye pravaratīrthānukīrtananāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 || || cha ||
<7.2.4>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi dunnāvilleti viśrutam || yojanasyāṃtare devi paścime maṃgalasthiteḥ || 1 || dunnako yatra bhīmena bhuktvā tyaktaḥ purā priye || tatraiva vivaraṃ divyaṃ mahā pātālamārgadam || 2 || tasya kalpaḥ purā proktaḥ pātālottarasaṃgrahe || tatra liṃgānyanekāni siddhasthānāni ṣoḍaśa || 3 || suvarṇasyākaraḥ pūrvaṃ tatsthānamabhavatpriye || tasminsthāne narairdevi gantavyaṃ bhūtilipsayā || 4 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye dunnāvillahṛdgiristhānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<7.2.5>
|| īśvara uvāca || || tato gacchenmahādevi maṃgalātpaścime sthitam || gaṃgāsrotastathā liṃgaṃ surārkaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 1 || tāngacchedvidhivaddevi yadi yātrāphalepsutā || snātvā piṇḍapradānaṃ ca kuryāttatra yathārthataḥ || brāhmaṇebhyastathā deyamannaṃ bhūri sadakṣiṇam || 2 || iti te kathitaṃ mayā priye kalipāpaughavināśanaṃ śubham || nikhilaṃ tīrthamahodayodayaṃ paṭhitaṃ sadvinihaṃti pāpasaṃhatim || 3 || idaṃ na deyaṃ durbuddheḥ sutarāṃ pāpanāśanam || śrotavyaṃ vidhinā tadvadbhaviṣyoktavidhānataḥ || 4 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe prathame prabhāsakṣetramāhātmye gaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || | cha ||
<7.2.6>
|| īśvara uvāca || || adhunā saṃpravakṣyāmi maṃgalātpaścime vrajet || tatra siddheśvaraṃ paśyetsarvasiddhipradāyakam || 1 || tatraiva cakratīrthaṃ tu tīrthakoṭiphalapradam || lokeśvaraṃ svayaṃbhūtaṃ pūrvamiṃdreśvareti ca || 2 || dṛṣṭvā taṃ vidhivaddevi tato yakṣavanaṃ vrajet || maṃgalātpaścime bhāge yatra devī svayaṃ sthitā || 3 || yakṣeśvarī mahābhāgā vāṃchitārthapradāyinī || tāṃ saṃpūjya vidhānena tato vastrāpathaṃ punaḥ || 4 || giriṃ raivatakaṃ gatvā kuryādyātrāvidhānataḥ || mṛgīkuṃḍāditīrthāni saṃti tatraiva koṭiśaḥ || 5 || yadbhuktiśikhare devi sīmāliṃgaṃ hi tatsmṛtam || daśakoṭistu tīrthāni tatra saṃti varāna ne || 6 || yatra vai yādavāḥ siddhāḥ kalau ye buddhirūpiṇaḥ || śatasahasrārbudaṃ ca liṃgaṃ tatraiva tiṣṭhati || 7 || gajeṃdrasya padaṃ tatra tatraiva rasakūpikāḥ || sapta kuṇḍāni tatraiva raivate parvatottame || 8 || aṃbikā ca sthitā devī pradyumnaḥ sāṃba eva ca || liṃgākāre parvate tu tatra tīrthāni koṭiśaḥ || 9 || mṛgīkuṃḍaṃ ca tatraiva kālameghastathaiva ca || kṣetrapālasvarūpeṇa mahodadhi svayaṃ sthitaḥ || dāmodaraśca tatraiva bhavo brahmāḍanāyakaḥ || 7.2.6.10 || || || pārvatyuvāca || || śrutāni tava tīrthāni deveśa vadatastava || gaṃgā sarasvatī puṇyā yamunā ca mahānadī || 11 || godāvarī gomatī ca nadī tāpī ca narmadā || sarayūḥ svarṇarekhā ca tamasā pāpanāśinī || 12 || nadyaḥ samudrasaṃyogāḥ sarvāḥ puṇyāḥ śrutā mayā || mokṣāraṇyāni divyāni| divyakṣetrāṇi yāni ca || 13 || nagaryo muktidāyinyastāḥ śrutāstvatprasādataḥ || brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ sūryeṃduvaruṇasya ca || 14 || devatānā mṛṣīṇāṃ ca saṃti sthānānyanekaśaḥ || paraṃ deva tvayā puṇyaṃ prabhāsaṃ kathitaṃ mama || 15 || tasmādyaccādhikaṃ proktaṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ tvayā || śṛṇvaṃtyā ca mayā pūrvaṃ na pṛṣṭaṃ kāraṇaṃ tadā || 16 || idānīṃ ca śrutaṃ sarvaṃ svasthāhaṃ kāraṇaṃ vada || prabhāvaṃ prathamaṃ brūhi kṣetrasya ca bhavasya ca || 17 || kasmindeśe ca tattīrthaṃ śivaḥ kenātra saṃsthitaḥ || svayaṃbhūrbhagavānrudraḥ kathaṃ tatra sthitaḥ svayam || prabho me mahadāścaryaṃ vartate tadvadādhunā || 18 || || īśvara uvāca || || vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya prabhāvaṃ prathamaṃ śṛṇu || paścādbhavasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu tvaṃ ca varānane || 19 || kānyakubje mahākṣetre rājā bhojeti viśrutaḥ || purā puṇyayuge dharmyaḥ prajā dharmeṇa śāsati || 7.2.6.20 || viśālākṣo dīrghabāhurvidvānvāggmī priyaṃvadaḥ || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇo bahvāścaryavilokakaḥ || 21 || vanātkadācidabhyetya vanapālobravīdidam || āścaryaṃ bhramatā deva vane dṛṣṭaṃ mayādhunā || 22 || girau viṣamabhūbhāge vahuvṛkṣasamākule || mṛgayūthagatā nārī mayā dṛṣṭā mṛgānanā || 23 || mṛgavatplavate bālā sadā tatraiva dṛśyate || iti śrutvā vaco rājā tuṣṭastasmai dhanaṃ dadau || 24 || caturaṃ turagaṃ divyaṃ vāsasī svarṇabhūṣaṇam|| idānīmeva yāsyāmi senādhyakṣa tvayā saha ||25|| aśvānāṃ daśasāhasraṃ vāgurāṇāṃ tvanekadhā || pattayo yāṃtu sarvatra veṣṭayaṃtu giriṃvaram ||26|| na haṃtavyo mṛgaḥ kaścidrakṣaṇīyā hi sā mṛgī || strīveṣadhāriṇī nārī mṛgī bhavati bhūtale ||27|| kva yāsyati varākī sā madbalaiḥ paripīḍitā || śastrāstravarjitaṃ sainyaṃ vanapālapadānugam ||28|| ahorātreṇa saṃprāptaṃ bahuvyādhajanāgrataḥ || aśvādhirūḍho balavānbhojarājo yayau svayam || 29 || niḥśabdapadasañcāraḥ saṃjñāsaṃketabhāṣakaḥ || giriṃ saṃveṣṭayāmāsa vāgurābhiḥ svayaṃ nṛpaḥ || 7.2.6.30 || vanapālena sahito mṛgayūthaṃ dadarśa saḥ || sā mṛgī mṛgamadhyasthā nārīdehā mukhe mṛgī || mṛgavacceṣṭate bālā dhāvate ca mṛgaiḥ saha || 31 || aśvagaṃdhā nsamāghrāya santrastā mṛgayūthapāḥ || kṣubdhā bhrāntāḥ kṣaṇe tasminsarve yāṃti diśo daśa || 32 || mṛgavaktrā tu yā nārī mṛgaiḥ kati payaiḥ saha || plavamānā nipatitā vāgurāyāṃ vicetanā || 33 || balādhyakṣeṇa vidhṛtā mṛgaiḥ saha śanairnṛpaḥ || dadarśa mahadāścaryaṃ bhoja rājo janairvṛtaḥ || 34 || tataḥ kolāhalo jātaḥ paramānaṃdinisvanaḥ || mṛgaiḥ saha samāninye kānyakubjaṃ mṛgīṃ nṛpaḥ || 35 || divyavastrasamā cchannā divyābharaṇabhūṣitā || narayānasthitā nārī praviveśa mṛgairvṛtā || 36 || vāditrairbrahmaghoṣaiśca nīyate nṛpamaṃdiram || janairjānapadairmārge dṛśyate nṛpamandire || 37 || nīyamānā nāgaraiśca mahadāścaryabhāṣakaiḥ || puṇye muhūrtte saṃprāpte sā mṛgī nṛpamandiram || 38 || pratīhāreṇa rājendra vacasā vārito janaḥ || gataḥ senāpatiḥ sainyaṃ gṛhītvā svaniketanam || 39 || rājāpi svagṛhaṃ prāpya snātvā saṃpūjya devatāḥ || tāṃ mṛgīṃ snāpayāmāsa divyagandhānulepanām|| 7.2.6.40 || kuṅkumena viliptāṃgīṃ divyavastrāvaguṃṭhitām || yathocitaṃ yathāsthānaṃ divyābharaṇabhūṣitām || 41 || ekāṃte nirjane rājā babhāṣe cārulocanām || kā tvaṃ kasya sutā kena kāraṇena mṛgaiḥ saha || 42 || strīṇāṃ śarīraṃ te kasmānmṛgīṇāṃ vadanaṃ kutaḥ || iti sarvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 43 || evaṃ sā procyamānāpi na babhāṣe kathaṃcana || mūkavanna vijānāti na ca bhuṃkte sulocanā || 44 || na bhuṃkte pṛthivīpālo na rājyaṃ bahu manyate || na dārairvidyate kāryaṃ nāśvairna ca gajai rathaiḥ || 45 || tadeva rājyaṃ te dārāste gajāstaddhanaṃ bahu || pramadāmadasaṃraktaṃ yatra saṃkrīḍate manaḥ || 46 || āhūyāha pratīhāraṃ tayā saṃmohito nṛpaḥ || purodhasaṃ guruṃ viśanācāryāñchīghramānaya || 47 || daivajñānatha mantrajñānbhiṣajastāṃtrikāṃstathā || iti sannodito rājñā pratīhāro yayau svayam || 48 || ājagāma sa vegena samānīya dvijo ttamān|| rājñe vijñāpayāmāsa deva viprāḥ samāgatāḥ || 49 || praveśaya guruṃ dvāḥsthaṃ saṃprāptānmaddhite ratān || iti sannodito rājñā tathā cakre sa buddhimān|| 7.2.6.50 || abhyutthāya nṛpaḥ pūrvaṃ namaskṛtya prapūjya ca || āsaneṣūpaviṣṭāṃstānbabhāṣe kāryatatparaḥ || 51 || idamāścaryamevaikaṃ kathaṃ śakyaṃ niveditum || jānīta hi svayaṃ sarve lokataḥ śāstrato'pi vā || 52 || kathameṣā samutpannā kasyedaṃ karmaṇaḥ phalam || asyāṃ kena prakāreṇa vacanaṃ mānuṣaṃ bhavet || 53 || svayaṃ manuṣyavadanā kathameṣā bhaviṣyati || sāvadhānairdvijairbhūyaḥ sarvaṃ saṃcintya cocyatām || 54 || || viprā ūcuḥ || || deva sārasvato nāma kurukṣetre dvijottamaḥ || ūrddhvaretāḥ sarasvatyāṃ tapastepe jitendriyaḥ || 55 || kathayiṣyati sarvaṃ te tenādiṣṭā mṛgī svayam || iti śrutvā vaco rājā yayau sārasvataṃ dvijam || 56 || sarasvatījale snātaṃ prabhāse dhyānatatparam || dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇīkṛtya sāṣṭāṃgaṃ taṃ praṇamya ca || upaviṣṭo nṛpo bhūmau prāṃjaliḥ sañjitendriyaḥ || 57 || manuṣyapadasaṃcāraṃ śrutvā jñātvā ca kāraṇam || sārasvato babhāṣe'tha taṃ nṛpaṃ bhakti tatparam || 58 || || sārasvata uvāca || || bhojarāja śubhaṃ testu jñātaṃ tatkāraṇaṃ mayā || mṛgānanā tvayā nārī samānītā vanātkila || 59 || mahadāścaryamevaitattava cetasi varttate || ādiṣṭā tu mayā bālā sarvaṃ te kathayiṣyati || 7.2.6.60 || jānāmyahaṃ mahārāja caritraṃ janma yādṛśam || āścaryaṃ saṃbhavelloke kathyamānaṃ tayā svayam || 61 || ityādiśya gato vegādrathenādityavarcasā || ahorātradvayenaiva saṃprāpto nṛpa mandiram || 62 || praviśya ca mṛgīṃ dṛṣṭvā yatrāste mṛgalocanā || tayā sārasvato jñāto dharmajñaḥ sarvaviddvijaḥ || 63 || || mṛgyuvāca || || eṣa sarvaṃ hi jānāti kāraṇaṃ yacca yādṛśam || varttamānaṃ bhaviṣyaṃ ca bhūtaṃ yadbhuvanatraye || 64 || etena maraṇaṃ jñātaṃ madīyaṃ pūrvajanmani || vastrāpathe mahākṣetre tapastaptaṃ bhavālaye || 65 || vidhūya kaluṣaṃ sarvaṃ jñānamutpādya yatnataḥ || jarāmaraṇanirmuktaḥ pratyakṣaṃ dṛṣṭavānbhavam || 66 || asya tuṣṭo bhavo devo jñātaṃ tīrthasya kāraṇam || ādiṣṭayā mayā vācyaṃ bhavejjanmani kāraṇam || 67 || iti cintāparā yāvattāvadvipraḥ samāgataḥ || tasmai praṇāmaparamā mūrcchitā nipapāta sā || 68 || atha sārasvato jñānājjñātavānkāraṇaṃ ca tat || ānayantu dvijā vegātkalaśaṃ toyasaṃbhṛtam || || 69 || savauṃṣadhīḥ pallavāṃśca dūrvāḥ puṣpāṇi cākṣatān|| dhūpaṃ ca caṃdanaṃ caiva gomayaṃ madhusarpiṣī || 7.2.6.70 || ityādiṣṭairdvijairvegātsamānītaṃ nṛpājñayā || upalipya ca bhūbhāgaṃ svastikaṃ saṃniveśya ca || 71 || tatrāgnikāryaṃ kṛtvā'tha vedānkubhe nidhāya saḥ || indraṃ tasmiṃśca vinyasya dikpālāṃśca yathākramam || hutvāgniṃ sa caruṃ kṛtvā grahapūjāmakārayat || 72 || toyaṃ suvarṇapātrasthaṃ kṛtvā kuṃbhānsvayaṃ guruḥ || abhiṣekaṃ tataścakre muhūrte sārvakāmike || 73 || abhiṣiktā tu sā tena pūtā snānārthavāriṇā || jātā sacetanā bālā sarvaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā || 74 || śṛṇoti sarvaṃ jānāti caritraṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ || badarīphalamātraṃ tu puroḍāśaṃ dadau guruḥ || 75 || tayopabhuktaṃ yatnena tataścakre sa mārjjanam || mānuṣe vacane karṇe dadau jñānaṃ gurustataḥ || 76 || gurave dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā tataḥ sā ca mṛgānanā || bhojarājāya sarva ca caritraṃ pūrvajanmanaḥ || || 77 || vaktuṃ pracakrame bālyādyadvṛttaṃ pūrvajanmani || namaskṛtya guruṃ pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇānkṣatriyāṃstathā || 78 || || mṛgyuvāca || || na viṣādastvayā kāryo rājañcchrutvā mayoditam || itastvaṃ saptame sthāne kaliṃgādhipateḥ sutaḥ || 79 || mṛte pitari bālastvaṃ svabhiṣiktaḥ svamaṃtribhiḥ || ahaṃ hi vaṃgarājasya saṃjātā duhitā kila || 7.2.6.80 || pariṇītā tvayā deva pitrā dattā svayaṃ nṛpa || tvayā'haṃ paṭṭamahiṣī kṛtā yoṣidvarā yataḥ || 81 || yuvā jātaḥ krameṇaiva hiṃsraḥ krūro babhūva ha || na vedaśāstrakuśalo dayādharmavivarjitaḥ || 82 || lubdho mānī mahākrodhī satyācāra bahiṣkṛtaḥ || na devaṃ na guruṃ viprānno jānāti durāśayaḥ || 83 || viraktā hi prajāstasya brāhmaṇocchedakārakaḥ || samāsannairnṛpaistasya deśaḥ sarvo viluṃpitaḥ || sainyaṃ sarvaṃ samādāya yuddhāyopajagāma saḥ || 84 || sahaivāhaṃ gatā deva yuddhaṃ jātaṃ nṛpaiḥ saha || hāritaṃ sainikaistasya gatā naṣṭā diśo daśa || 85 || tyaktvā dharmaṃ nijaṃ rājā palāyanaparo'bhavat || gacchamānastu nṛpatiḥ śatrubhiḥ paripīḍitaḥ || 86 || tavāsmivādī duṣṭātmā hato lokavirodhakaḥ || dehaṃ tasya gṛhītvāgnau praviṣṭāhaṃ nṛpottama || 87 || mṛtasyaivaṃ gatirnāsti narake sa vipacyate || mṛtaṃ kāṃtaṃ samādāya bhāryāgnau praviśedyadi || 88 || sā tārayati pāpiṣṭhaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || iha pāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā paścātsvarge mahīyate || 89 || atastvaṃ brāhmaṇo jāto deśe mālavake nṛpa || tasyaiva tatra bhāryāhaṃ saṃbhūtā brāhmaṇī nṛpa || 7.2.6.90 || dhanadhānyasamṛddho'bhūttathā jīvadhanādhikaḥ || mṛtaḥ pitā mṛtā mātā sa ca bhrātṛvivarjitaḥ || 91 || dhanadhānyasamṛddho'pi lubdho bhramati bhūtale || atīva kopano vipro vedapāṭhavivarjitaḥ || 92 || snānasaṃdhyādihīnaśca māyāvī yācate janam || bhaktiṃ karomi paramāṃ sa ca krudhyati māṃ prati || 93 || saṃtānaṃ tasya vai nāsti dhanarakṣāparo hi saḥ || na dadāti na cāśnāti na juhoti sa rakṣati || 94 || na tarpaṇaṃ tilairvipro vidadhātyatilo bhataḥ || kārttike'pi ca saṃprāpte viṣṇupūjāvivarjitaḥ || 95 || dīpaṃ dadāti no vipro māsamekaṃ nirantaram || na bhuṃkte śākapatraṃ sa ekāhāro niraṃtaram || 96 || māse nabhasye saṃprāpte prāpte kṛṣṇe nṛpottama || na karoti gṛhe śrāddhaṃ snānatarpaṇavarjitaḥ || 97 || na jānāti dinaṃ pitryaṃ pakṣamekaṃ nirantaram || anyatra bhuṃkte vipro'sau kṣayāhe'pi samāgate || 98 || makarasthe'pi saṃkrāṃtau kṛśarānnaṃ dadāti na || tilānsuvarṇaṃ tāraṃ vā vastraṃ vā phalameva ca || śākapatraṃ sa puṣpaṃ vā na dadāti tatheṃdhanam || 99 || gavāṃ gavāhnikaṃ naiva kathaṃ muktirbhaviṣyati || na yāti viṣṇuśaraṇaṃ saṃprāpte dakṣiṇāyane || 7.2.6.100 || dhenuṃ dadāti no vipro grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ || 101 || ekāpi dattā supayasvinī sā savastraghaṃṭābharaṇopapannā || vatsena yuktā hi dadāti dātre muktiṃ kulasyāsya karoti vṛddhim|| 102 || yāvaṃti romāṇi bhavaṃti tasyāstāvaṃti varṣāṇi mahīyate saḥ || brahmālaye siddha gaṇairvṛto'sau saṃtiṣṭhate sūryasamānatejāḥ || 103 || devālayaṃ no vidadhāti vāpīṃ kūpaṃ taḍāgaṃ na karoti kuṇḍam || puṇyaṃ vivāhaṃ sujanopakāraṃ nāsau satāṃ vā dvijamaṃdiraṃ ca || 104 || dhanaṃ sadā bhūmigataṃ karoti dharmaṃ na jānāti kulasya cāsau || ahaṃ hi tasyānugatā bhavāmi kathaṃ hi kāṃtaṃ parivaṃ cayāmi || 105 || evaṃ hi varttamānaḥ sa kāladharmamupeyivān || dhanalobhānmayā deva maraṇaṃ parivarjitam ||106|| paśyantyā gotribhiḥ sarvaṃ gṛhītaṃ dhanasaṃcayam || kālena mahatā deva mṛtā'haṃ dvijamaṃdire || 107 || śvetasarpaḥ samabhavaddeśe tasminnarottama || tatraivāhaṃ brāhmaṇasya saṃjātā tanayā nṛpa || 108 || varṣeṣṭame tu saṃprāpte pariṇītā dvijanmanā || tasminneva gṛhe sarpo madīye vasate nṛpa || 109 || bhāryā mameti saṃdaṣṭo rātrau bharttā mahā hinā || mṛto'pi brāhmaṇaiḥ sarpo laguḍairvinipātitaḥ || 7.2.6.110 || vaidhavyaṃ mama dattvā tu dvijasarpau mṛtāvubhau || pitrā mātrā mahāśokaṃ kṛtvā me muṇḍitaṃ śiraḥ || 111 || vasānā śvetavastraṃ ca viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇā || māsopavāsaniratā yāni tīrthānyanekaśaḥ || 112 || sarpastu makaro jāto godāvaryāṃ śivālaye || devaṃ bhīmeśvaraṃ draṣṭuṃ gatā'haṃ svajanaiḥ saha || 113 || yāvatsnātuṃ praviṣṭā'haṃ vṛtā sarvajanairnṛpa || makareṇa tadā dṛṣṭā bhāryeyaṃ mama vallabhā || gṛhītā makareṇāhaṃ netumaṃtarjale nṛpa || 114 || hāhākāraḥ samabhavajjanaḥ kṣubdhaḥ samaṃtataḥ || kuṃtāghātena kenāsau makarastu nipātitaḥ || 115 || jhaṣavaktraḥ sthitā cāhaṃ mṛtā kṛṣṭā janairbahiḥ || agniṃ dattvā jale kṣiptvā bhasma lokā gṛhāngatāḥ || 116 || strīvadhāllubdhvako jāto jhaṣastīrthaprabhāvataḥ || mānuṣīṃ yonimāpannastasminneva mahāvane ||117|| agnerjalācca sarpācca gajātsiṃhādavṛṣādapi || jhaṣādvisphoṭakānmṛtyuryeṣāṃ te narake gatāḥ || 118 || ātmahā bhrūṇahā strīhā brahmaghnaḥ kūṭasākṣyadaḥ || kanyāvikrayakartā ca mithyā bratadharastu yaḥ || || 119 || vikrīṇāti kratuṃ yastu madyapaḥ syāddvijastu yaḥ || rājadrohī svarṇacauro brahmavṛttivilopakaḥ || 7.2.6.120 || goghnastu nikṣepaharo grāmasīmāharastu yaḥ || sarve te narakaṃ yāṃti yā ca strī pativaṃcakā || 121 || jhaṣamṛtyuprabhāvena jātā krauṃcī vane nṛpa || godāvarīvane vyādho bhramate mṛgamārgakaḥ || 122 || vane krauṃcaḥ sakāmo māṃ mudā kāmayitumudyataḥ || dṛṣṭāhaṃ bhramatā tena vyādhenākṛṣya kārmukam || 123 || hataḥ krauṃco mṛto rāja nnaṣṭā sthānādahaṃ tataḥ || godāvarīvane tasminnevaṃrūpaṃ dadarśa tam || 124 || ṛṣirvyādhaṃ śaśāpātha dṛṣṭvā karma vigarhitam || kāmadharmamakurvāṇaṃ priyā saṃbhāṣatatparam || krauṃcaṃ tvamavadhīryasmāttasmātsiṃho bhaviṣyasi || 125 || ṛṣistena vinītena sthitvā santoṣito nṛpa || ṛṣirvadati tasyāgre na me mithyā vaco bhavet || 126 || siṃhasthasya prasādaṃ
