te kariṣye muktihetave || surāṣṭradeśe bhavitā siṃho raivatake girau || 127 || vastrāpathe mahā kṣetre muktiste vihitā dhruvā || ityuktvā sa ṛṣirdeva gato bhīmeśvaraṃ prati || durvacaḥśravaṇādvyādhaḥ kramātpaṃcatvamāyayau || 128 || krauṃcī krauṃcaviyogena gatā sā ca vanāṃtare || mṛtā daivavaśājjātā mṛgī raivatake girau || 129 || mṛgayūthagatā nityaṃ modate madavihvalā || vyādhaḥ siṃhaḥ samabhavadgirestasya mahāvane || 7.2.6.130 || kāmārtā bhramatā dṛṣṭā mṛgī siṃhena yatnataḥ || tatra saṃbhramate nityaṃ siṃhaścāpi mṛgī vane || 131 || siṃho'pi daivayogena mameyamiti manyate || paraṃ hiṃsrasvabhāvena tāmādātuṃ pracakrame || 132 || calatvaṃ mṛgajātīnāṃ vihitaṃ vedhasā svayam || punargatā mṛgī yūthaṃ krīḍate cārulocanā || 133 || bhavasya paścime bhāge tatra raivatake girau || anuyātaḥ śanaiḥ so'tha mṛgendro mṛgayūthapaḥ || utpapāta tataḥ siṃho saṃghasya mūrddhani || 134 || siṃhasya na mṛgaiḥ kāryaṃ hariṇīṃ prati paśyataḥ || yatra sā hariṇī yāti yayau siṃhastathaiva tām || 135 || yadā vegaṃ mṛgī cakre siṃhaḥ kuddhastadā vane || siṃho'pi vegavāñjāto mṛgīvegādhiko'bhavat | 136 || yadā siṃhena saṃkrāṃtā dadau jhampāṃ mṛgī tu sā || bhavasyāgre nadītoye patitā jalamūrddhani || 137 || laṃbate tu śarīraṃ me veṇau protaṃ śiro mama || siṃhaḥ sahaiva patito mṛtaḥ payasi madhyataḥ || 138 || svarṇareṣājale deva viśīrṇaṃ mama tadvapuḥ || na tu vaktraṃ nipatitaṃ tvaksāraśirasi sthitam || 139 || etaccaritraṃ yatsarvaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ sārasvatena vai || tattīrthasya prabhāvena siṃhastvaṃ samajāyathāḥ || 7.2.6.140 || idaṃ hi saptamaṃ janma sarvapāpakṣayodayam || kānyakubje mahādeśe rājā bhojetiviśrutaḥ || 141 || ahaṃ hi hariṇīgarbhe jātā mānuṣarūpiṇī || jātaṃ vaktraṃ mṛgīṇāṃ me yasmānna patitaṃ jale || 142 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye bhavamāhātmye mṛgānanābhojavṛttāntavarṇane sārasvatamaharṣisaṃskṛtapuroḍāśaprāśanasamupa labdhaspaṣṭavākprasara mṛgānanākathitobhayaprāksaptajanmavṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || || cha ||
<7.2.7>
|| rājovāca || || kathaṃ tvaṃ hariṇīrūpe jātā mānuṣarūpiṇī || kena saṃvardhitā bālye kathaṃ te rūpamīdṛśam || 1 || || mṛgyuvāca || || śṛṇu deva pravakṣyāmi yadvṛttaṃ kanyake vane || ṛṣiruddālakonāma gaṃgākūle mahātapāḥ || 2 || prabhāte mūtramutsṛṣṭuṃ gato deva vanāṃtare || mūtrāṃte patito bhūmau vīryabiṃdurdvijanmanaḥ || 3 || yāvatsa calito vipraḥ śaucaṃ kṛtvā prayatnataḥ || tāvanmṛgī samāyātā dṛṣṭvā puṣpavanāṃtarāt || 4 || cāpalyādbhakṣitaṃ vīryaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ brahmarṣiṇā svayam || yasmādaśnāti me vīryaṃ tasmādgarbho bhaviṣyati || 5 || mamarūpā tavavaktrā nārī garbhe bhaviṣyati || varddhayiṣyati devyastāṃ rasairdivyaiḥ sutāṃ tava || 6 || kenāpi daivayogena jñānaṃ tasyā bhaviṣyati || evamuddālakādeva saṃjātāhaṃ mṛgānanā || praviśyāgnau mṛtā pūrvaṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ narādhipa || 7 || tasmājjātaṃ satītvaṃ me saptajanmani vai prabho || yattvayā kurvatā rājyaṃ pāpaṃ vai samupārjitam || 8 || kṣattradharmaṃ parityajya palāyanaparo mṛtaḥ || tadeno hi mayā dagdhaṃ citāgnau nṛpasattama || 9 || patiṃ gṛhītvā yā nārī mṛtamagnau viśedyadi || sā tārayati bhartāramātmānaṃ ca kuladvayam || 7.2.7.10 || gograhe deśabhaṃge ca saṃgrāme sammukhe mṛtaḥ || sa sūryamaṇḍalaṃ bhittvā brahmaloke mahīyate ||11|| anāśakaṃ yo vidadhāti marttyo dinedine yajñasahasrapuṇyam || sa yāti yānena gaṇānvitena vidhūya pāpāni suraiḥ sa pūjyate || 12|| gaṃgājale prayāge vā kedāre puṣkare ca ye || vastrāpathe prabhāse ca mṛtāste svargagāminaḥ || 13 || dvārāvatyāṃ kurukṣetre yogābhyāsena ye mṛtāḥ || harirityakṣaraṃ mṛtyau yeṣāṃ te svargagāminaḥ || 14 || pūjayitvā hariṃ ye tu bhūmau darbhatilaiḥ saha || tilāṃśca pañcalohaṃ ca dattvā ye tu payasvinīm || 15 || ye mṛtā rājaśārdūla te narāḥ svarga gāminaḥ || utpādya putrānsaṃsthāpya pitṛpaitāmahe pade || 16 || nirmalā niṣkalaṃkā ye te mṛtāḥ svargagāminaḥ || vratopavāsaniratāḥ satyācāraparāyaṇāḥ || ahiṃsāniratāḥ śāṃtāste narāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 17 || sāpavādo raṇaṃ tyaktvā mṛto yasmānnarādhipa || saptayoniṣu te janma tasmājjātaṃ mayā saha || 18 || tvāṃ vinā me patirmā bhūnmaraṇe yācitaṃ mayā || tadāṃtarikṣe rājendra vāguvācāśarīriṇī || ādau pāpaphalaṃ bhuktvā paścā tsvargaṃ gamiṣyasi || 19|| yadi vastrāpathe gatvā śiraḥ kaścidvimuṃcati || svarṇarekhājale rājanmānuṣaṃ syānmukhaṃ mama || 7.2.7.20 || ahaṃ mānuṣavaktrā'smi pāpacchāyā''vṛtaṃ mukham || dṛśyate mṛgavaktrābhaṃ tasmācchīghraṃ vimuṃcaya || 21 || iti śrutvā vaco rājā sārasvatamudaikṣata || jano vihasya sānandaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ mṛgīvacaḥ || 22 || ityuktvā''ha dvijendraḥ sa evaṃ kuru nṛpottama || evaṃ rājñā samādiṣṭaḥ pratīhāro yayau vanam || 23 || vastrāpathe mahātīrthe bhavaṃ draṣṭuṃ tvarānvitaḥ || tvaksārajālirmahatī svarṇarekhājalopari || 24 || varttate tacchiro yatra vaṃśaprotaṃ mahāvane || sārasvatasya śiṣyeṇa kuśalena niveditam|| 25 || tīrthaṃ vastrāpathaṃ gatvā bhavasyāgre mahānadī || jāle tatra śiro dṛṣṭaṃ tacca toye vimocitam || 26 || snātvā saṃpūjya tīrtheśaṃ pratīhāraḥ samabhyagāt || śiṣyeṇa sahito vegādrathenādityavarcasā || 27 || yadāgataḥ pratīhārastadā sārasvatena sā || vṛtā cāndrāyaṇenaiva māsamekaṃ nirantaram || 28 || saṃpūrṇe tu vrate tasyā divyaṃ vaktraṃ sulocanam || suśobhanaṃ dīrghakeśaṃ dīrghakarṇaṃ śubhadvijam || 29 || kambugrīvaṃ padmagaṃdhaṃ sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutam|| vratāṃte mūrcchitā bālā gatajñānā vabhūva sā || 7.2.7.30 || na devī na ca gaṃdharvī nāsurī na ca kiṃnarī || yādṛśī sā tadā jātā tīrthabhāvena sundarī || 31 || pariṇītā tu sā tena bhojarājena sundarī || mṛgīmukhīti vikhyātā devī sā bhuvaneśvarī || 32 || na jānāti punaḥ kiṃcidyadvṛttaṃ rājamandire || kṛtā sā paṭṭamahiṣī bhojarājena dhīmatā || 33 || || īśvara uvāca || || deśānāṃ pravaro deśo girīṇāṃ pravaro giriḥ || kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ vanānāmuttamaṃ vanam || 34 || gaṃgā sarasvatī tāpī svarṇarekhājale sthitā || brahmā viṣṇuśca sūryaśca sarva indrādayaḥ surāḥ || 35 || nāgā yakṣāśca gandharvā asminkṣetre vyavasthitāḥ || brahmāṃḍaṃ nirmitaṃ yena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 36 || devā brahmādayo jātāḥ sa bhavo'tra vyavasthitaḥ || śivo bhaveti vikhyātaḥ svayaṃ devastrilocanaḥ || 37 || veveti skandaracanādbhavānī cātra saṃsthitā || ato yannādhikaṃ proktaṃ tīrthaṃ devi mayā tava || 38 || tasmiñjale snānaparo naro yadi saṃdhyāṃ vidhāyānu karoti tarpaṇam || śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ ca dadāti dakṣiṇāṃ bhavodbhavaṃ paśyati mucyate bhavāt || 39 || atha yadi bhavapūjāṃ divyapuṣpaiḥ karoti tadanu śivaśiveti stotrapāṭhaṃ ca gītam || suravara gaṇavṛndaiḥ stūyamāno vimānaiḥ suravaraśivarūpo mānavo yāti nākam || 7.2.7.40 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye svarṇarekhāyāṃ mṛgānanāyāḥ pūrvajanmamṛgamukhaprakṣepaṇena divyamukhatvaprāptyuttaraṃ bhojanṛpatipariṇaya vṛttāntapūrvakaṃ svarṇarekhāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || cha ||
<7.2.8>
|| bhojarāja uvāca || || prabho sārasvata mayā śrutaṃ māhātmyamuttamam || vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya gire raivatakasya ca || 1 || viśeṣeṇa svarṇarekhābhavasya ca jalasya ca || idānīṃ śrotumicchāmi tīrthotpattiṃ vadasva me|| 2 || brahmaviṣṇuśivādīnāṃ madhye ko'yaṃ vyavasthitaḥ || keyaṃ nadī svarṇarekhā sarvapātakanāśinī || 3 || kasmādbrahmādayā devā asmiṃstīrthe samāgatāḥ || kathaṃ nārāyaṇo devaḥ svayameva samāgataḥ || 4 || hemālayaṃ parityajya bhavānī girimūrddhani || saṃsthitā skandamādāya devairindrādibhiḥ saha || 5 || || sārasvata uvāca || || śṛṇu sarvaṃ mahārāja kathayiṣye savistaram || yena vai kathyamānena sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 6 || purā brahmadinasyāṃte jagadetaccarācaram || saṃhṛtya bhagavānrudro brahmaviṣṇupuraskṛtaḥ || 7 || tāṃ ca te sakalāṃ rātrimekamūrttibhavāstrayaḥ || tiṣṭhanti rātri paryante punarbhinnā bhavaṃti te || 8 || brahmaviṣṇuśivā devā rajaḥsattvatamomayāḥ || sṛṣṭiṃ karoti bhagavānbrahmā pālayate hariḥ || 9 || sarvaṃ saṃharate rudro jagatkālapramāṇataḥ || tenādau bhagavānsṛṣṭo dakṣo nāma prajāpatiḥ || 7.2.8.10 || sarve saṃkṣepataḥ kṛtvā brahmāṇḍaṃ sacarā caram || bhinnā devāstrayo jātāḥ satyalokavyavasthitāḥ || 11 || trayo bhuvaṃ samāsādya kautukāviṣṭacetasaḥ || kailāsaṃ te girivaraṃ samārūḍhāḥ surervṛtāḥ || 12 || ahaṃ jyeṣṭho ahaṃ jyeṣṭho vādo'bhūdbrahmarudrayoḥ || tadā kruddho mahādevo brahmāṇaṃ hantumudyataḥ || 13 || viṣṇunā vārito brahmā na te vādastu yujyate || tattvaṃ nāhaṃ yadā nedaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ sacarācaram || 14 || eka eva tadā devo jale śete maheśvaraḥ || jāgarti ca yadā devaḥ svecchayā kautukāttataḥ || 15 || anena tvaṃ kṛtaḥ pūrvamahaṃ paścāttvayā kṛtaḥ || brahmāṃḍaṃ kūrmarūpeṇa dhṛtamasya prasādataḥ || 16 || anupraviṣṭā brahmāṃḍaṃ prasādācchaṃ karasya ca || sṛṣṭistvayā kṛtā sarvā mayi rakṣā vyavasthitā || 17 || udāsīnavadāsīnaḥ saṃsārātsāramīkṣate || eka eva śivo devaḥ sarvavyāpī maheśvaraḥ || 18 || pitāmahatvaṃ saṃjātaṃ prasādācchaṃkarasya te || prasādayāmāsa haraṃ śrutvā brahmā vaco hareḥ || 19 || anādinidhano devo bahuśīrṣo mahābhujaḥ || ityādivedavacanaistatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || prāha brahmanvaraṃ yatte vṛṇīṣva manasi sthitam || 7.2.8.20 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye brahmarudravivāde viṣṇuvacanena brahmakṛtarudraprasādanavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ ||8|| || cha ||
<7.2.9>
|| brahmovāca || || yadi sṛṣṭaṃ mayā sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || tadā mūrtimimāṃ tyaktvā bhavaḥ sṛṣṭo mayā'dhunā || 1 || pitāmahamahattvaṃ syāttathā śīghraṃ vidhīyatām || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā viṣṇunā sa pramoditaḥ || 2 || mahadāścaryajanake saṃprāpto girimūrddhani || na vicārastvayākāryaḥ karttavyaṃ brahmabhāṣitam || 3 || tathetyuktvā śivo devastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || brahmā yayau meruśṛṃgaṃ manasaḥ śirasi sthitam || 4 || tapastepe prajānātho vedoccāraṇatatparaḥ || atharvavedoccaraṇaṃ yāvaccakre pitāmahaḥ || 5 || mukhādrudraḥ samabhavadraudrarūpo bhavāpahaḥ|| arddhanārīnaravapurduṣprekṣyo'tibhayaṃkaraḥ||6|| vibhajātmānamityuktvā brahmā cāṃtardadhe bhayāt || tathoktosau dvidhā strītvaṃ puruṣatvaṃ tathā'karot || 7 || bibheda puruṣatvaṃ ca daśadhā caikadhā punaḥ || ekādaśaite kathitā rudrāstribhuvaneśvarāḥ || 8 || kṛtvā nāmāni sarveṣāṃ devakārye niyojitāḥ || vibhajya punarīśānī svātmānaṃ śaṃkarādvibhoḥ || 9 || mahādevaniyogena pitāmahamupasthitā || tāmāha bhagavānbrahmā dakṣasya duhitā bhava || 7.2.9.10 || sāpi tasya niyogena prādurāsītprajāpateḥ || niyogādbrahmaṇo dakṣo dadau rudrāya tāṃ satīm ||11|| dākṣīṃ rudro'pi jagrāha svakīyāmeva śūlabhṛt || atha brahmā babhāṣe taṃ sṛṣṭiṃ kuru satīpate ||12|| || || rudra uvāca || || sṛṣṭirmayā na karttavyā karttavyā bhavatā svayam || pālanaṃ viṣṇunā kāryaṃ saṃhartā'haṃ vyavasthitaḥ ||13|| sthāṇuvatsaṃsthito yasmā ttasmātsthāṇurbhavāmyaham ||14|| rajorūpāḥ sattvarūpāstamorūpāśca ye narāḥ || sarve te bhavatā kāryā guṇatrayavibhāgataḥ||15|| yadā te tāmasaiḥ kāryaṃ tadā raudro bhava svayam || yadā te rājasaiḥ kāryaṃ tadā tvaṃ rājaso bhava|| sāttvikaiste yadā kāryaṃ tadā tvaṃ sāttviko bhava ||16|| || īśvara uvāca || || ityājñāpya ca brahmāṇaṃ svayaṃ sṛṣṭyādikarmasu || gṛhītvā tāṃ satīṃ rudraḥ kailāsamadhitiṣṭhati || 17 || dakṣaḥ kālena mahatā harasyālayamāyayau || 18|| atha rudraḥ samutthāya kṛtavāngauravaṃ bahu || tato yathocitāṃ pūjāṃ na dakṣo bahu manyate ||19|| tadā vai tamasāviṣṭaḥ so'dhikaṃ brāhmaṇaḥ śubhaḥ|| pūjāmanarghyāmanvicchañjagāma kupito gṛham || 7.2.9.20 || kadācittāṃ gṛhaṃ prāptāṃ satīṃ dakṣaḥ sudurmanāḥ || bhartrā saha viniṃdyaināṃ bhartsayāmāsa vai ruṣā ||21|| paṃcavaktro daśabhujo mukhe netratrayānvitaḥ|| kaparddī khaṃḍacaṃdrosau tathāsau nīlalohitaḥ||22|| kapālī śūlahasto'sau gajacarmāvaguṃṭhitaḥ || nāsya mātā na ca pitā na bhrātā na ca bāndhavaḥ ||23|| sarpāsthimaṃḍitagrīvastyaktvā hemavibhūṣaṇam || bhikṣayā bhojanaṃ yasya kathamannaṃ pradāsyati || 24 || kadācitpūrvato yāti gacchanyāti sa paścime || dakṣiṇasyāṃ vṛṣo yāti svayaṃ yāti sa cottare || 25 || tiryagūrdhvamadho yāti naiva yāti na tiṣṭhati || iti citraṃ caritraṃ te bhartturnānyasya dṛśyate || 26 || nirguṇaḥ sa guṇātīto niḥsneho mūkavatsthitaḥ || sarvajñaḥ sarvagaḥ sarvaḥ paṭhyate bhuvanatraye || 27 || kadācinnaiva jānāti na śṛṇoti na paśyati || daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca rākṣasānāṃ dadāti yaḥ ||28|| na cāsya ca pitā kaścinna ca bhrātāsti kaścana || eka eva vṛṣārūḍho nagno bhramati bhūtale ||29|| na gṛhaṃ na dhanaṃ gotramanādinidhanovyayaḥ || sthirabuddhirna caivāsau krīḍate bhuvanatraye ||7.2.9.30|| kadācitsatyaloke sau pātālamadhitiṣṭhati || girisānuṣu śete'sāvaśivopi śivaḥ smṛtaḥ || 31 || śrīkhaṃḍādīni saṃtyajya sadā bhasmāvaguṃṭhitaḥ|| sarvadeti vacaḥ satyaṃ kimanyatsa pradāsyati|| 32 || dhiktvāṃ jāmātaraṃ dhiktaṃ yayoḥ snehaḥ parasparam || tasya tvaṃ vallabhā bhāryā sa ca prāṇādhikastava || 33 || na ca pitrāsti te kāryaṃ na mātrā na sakhīṣu ca || kevalaṃ bhartṛbhaktā tvaṃ tasmādgaccha gṛhānmama ||34|| anye jāmātaraḥ sarve bhartustava pinākinaḥ || tvamadyaivāśu cāsmākaṃ gṛhādgaccha varaṃ prati || 35 || tasya tadvākyamākarṇya sā devī śaṃkarapriyā || viniṃdya pitaraṃ dakṣaṃ dhyātvā devaṃ maheśvaram || 36 || śvetavastrā jale snātvā dadāhātmānamātmanā || yācitastu śivo bharttā punarjanmāṃtare tayā ||37|| pitā me himavānastu menāgarbhe bhavāmyaham || atrāṃtare(?) himavatā tapasā toṣito haraḥ || pratyakṣaṃ darśanaṃ dattvā himavaṃtaṃ vaco'bravīt || 38 || eṣā dattā sutā tubhyaṃ pariṇeṣyāmi tāmaham || devānāṃ kāryyasiddhyarthaṃ girirājo bhaviṣyasi || 39 || ātmamūrttau praviṣṭāṃ tāṃ jñātvā devo maheśvaraḥ || śaśāpa dakṣaṃ kupitaḥ samāgatyātha tadgṛham || 7.2.9.40 || tyaktvā dehamimaṃ brāhmyaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ kule bhava || svāyaṃbhuvatvaṃ saṃtyajya dakṣa prācetaso bhava || 41 || svasyāṃ sutāyāmūḍhāyāṃ putramutpādayiṣyasi || evaṃ śaptvā mahādevo yayau kailāsaparvatam || 42 || svāyabhuvo'pi kālena dakṣaḥ prācetaso'bhavat || bhavānīṃ sa sutāṃ labdhvā giristuṣṭo himā layaḥ || 43 || menāpi tāṃ sutāṃ labdhvā dhanyaṃ mene gṛhāśramam || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā jāyamānāṃ ca svecchayaiva varānanām || 44 || menā himavataḥ patnī prāhedaṃ parvateśvaram|| paśya bālāmimāṃ rājanrājīvasadṛśānanām|| 45 || hitāya sarvabhūtānāṃ jātāṃ ca tapasā śubhām || so'pi dṛṣṭvā mahādevīṃ taruṇādityasannibhām || 46 || kapardinīṃ caturvaktrāṃ trinetrāmatilālasām|| aṣṭahastāṃ viśālākṣīṃ caṃdrāvayavabhūṣaṇām || 47 || praṇamya śirasā bhūmau tejasā tu suvihvalaḥ || bhītaḥ kṛtāṃjaliḥ stabdhaḥ provāca parameśvarīm || 48 || || himavānuvāca || || kā tvaṃ devi viśālākṣi śaṃsa me saṃśayo mahān || 49 || || devyuvāca || || māṃ viddhi paramāṃ śaktiṃ maheśvarasamāśrayām || ananyāmavyayāmekāṃ yāṃ paśyaṃti mumukṣavaḥ || 7.2.9.50 || divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya me rūpamaiśvaram || etāvaduktvā vijñānaṃ dattvā himavate svayam || 51 || sūryakoṭipratīkāśaṃ tejobiṃbaṃ nirākulam || jvālā mālāsahasrāḍhyaṃ kālānalaśatopamam || 52 || daṃṣṭrākarālamuddharṣaṃ jaṭāmaṃḍalamaṃḍitam || praśāṃtaṃ saumyavadanamanaṃtāścaryasaṃyutam || 53 || caṃdrāvayavalakṣmāṇaṃ caṃdrakoṭisamaprabham || kirīṭinaṃ gadāhastaṃ nupurairupaśobhitam || 54|| divyamālyāṃbaradharaṃ divyagaṃdhānulepanam || śaṃkhacakradharaṃ kāmyaṃ trinetraṃ kṛttivāsasam || 55 || aṃḍasthaṃ cāṃḍabāhyasthaṃ bāhyamabhyaṃtaraṃ param || sarvaśaktimayaṃ śubhraṃ sarvālaṃkārasaṃyutam ||56|| brahmendropendrayogīndrairvandyamāna padāṃbujam || sarvataḥ pāṇipādāṃtaṃ sarvato'kṣiśiromukham|| 57 || sarvamāvṛtya tiṣṭhaṃtaṃ dadarśa parameśvaram || dṛṣṭvā nandīśvaraṃ devaṃ devyā maheśvaraṃ param || || 58 || bhayena ca samāviṣṭaḥ sa rājā hṛṣṭamānasaḥ || ātmanyādhāya cātmānamoṃkāraṃ samanusmaran || 59 || nāmnāmaṣṭasahasreṇa stutvā'sau hima vāngiriḥ || 7.2.9.60 || bhūyaḥ praṇamya bhūtātmā provācedaṃ kṛtāṃjaliḥ || yadetadaiśvaraṃ rūpaṃ jātaṃ te parameśvari || 61 || bhīto'smi sāṃprataṃ dṛṣṭvā tattvamanyatpradarśaya || evamuktā ca sā devī tena śailena pārvatī || 62 || saṃhṛtya darśayāmāsa svarūpamaparaṃ param || nīlotpaladalaprakhyaṃ nīlotpalasugaṃdhikam || ||63|| dvinetraṃ dvibhujaṃ saumyaṃ nīlālakavibhūṣitam || raktapādāṃbujatalaṃ suraktakarapallavam ||64|| śrīmadviśālasadvṛttaṃ lalāṭatilakojjvalam || bhūṣitaṃ cārusarvāṃgaṃ bhūṣaṇairatikomalam ||65|| dadhānaṃ corasā mālāṃ viśālāṃ hemanirmitām || īṣatsmitaṃ subiṃboṣṭhaṃ nūpurārāvaśobhitam || 66 || prasannavadanaṃ divyaṃ cārubhrūmahimāspadam || tadīdṛśaṃ samālokya svarūpaṃ śailasattamaḥ || bhayaṃ saṃtyajya hṛṣṭātmā babhāṣe parameśvarīm || 67 || || himavānuvāca || || adya me saphalaṃ janma adya me saphalāḥ kriyāḥ || yanme sākṣāttvamavyaktā prasannā dṛṣṭigocarā || idānīṃ kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ tanme brūhi maheśvari ||68|| || || maheśvaryuvāca || || śivapūjā tvayā kāryā dhyānena tapasā sadā || ahaṃ tasmai pradātavyā kenacitkāraṇena vai || 69 || yādṛśastu tvayā dṛṣṭo dhyeyo vai tādṛśastvayā || eka eva śivo devaḥ sarvādhāro dharādharaḥ ||7.2.9.70|| || sārasvata uvāca || || tapaśca kṛtavānrudraḥ samāgamya himācalam || tasyomā paramāṃ bhaktiṃ cakāra śivasaṃnidhau ||71|| devakāryeṇa kenāpi devo vai jñāpitaḥ prabhuḥ || upayeme haro devīmumāṃ tribhuvaneśvarīm || 72 || sa śaptaḥ śaṃbhunā pūrvaṃ dakṣaḥ prācetaso nṛpaḥ || viniṃdya pūrvavaireṇa gaṃgādvāre'yajaddharim ||73|| devāśca yajñabhāgārthamāhūtā viṣṇunā svayam || sahaiva munibhiḥ sarvairāgatā munipuṃgavāḥ || 74 || dṛṣṭvā devakulaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śaṃkareṇa vinā''gatam || dadhīco nāma viprarṣiḥ prācetasamathābravīt || 75 || || dadhīciruvāca || || brahmādyāstu piśācāṃtā yasyājñānuvidhāyinaḥ || sa hi vaḥ sāṃprataṃ rudro vidhinā kiṃ na pūjyate || 76 || || dakṣa uvāca || || sarveṣveva hi yajñeṣu na bhāgaḥ parikalpitaḥ || na maṃtrā bhāryayā sārddhaṃ śaṃkarasyeti neṣyate || 77 || vihasya dakṣaṃ kupito vacaḥ prāha mahāmuniḥ || śṛṇvatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ sarvajñānamayaḥ svayam ||78|| yataḥ pravṛttirviśvātmā yaścāsau bhuvaneśvaraḥ || na tvaṃ pūjayase rudraṃ devaiḥ saṃpūjyate haraḥ ||79|| || dakṣa uvāca || || asthimālādharo nagnaḥ saṃhartā tāmaso haraḥ || viṣakaṃṭhaḥ śūlahastaḥ kapālī nāgaveṣṭitaḥ || 7.2.9.80 || īśvaro hi jagatsraṣṭā prabhuryo'sau sanātanaḥ || sattvātmako'sau bhagavānijyate sarvakarmasu || 81 || || dadhīciruvāca || || kiṃ tvayā bhagavāneṣa sahasrāṃśurna dṛśyate || sarvalokaikasaṃhartā kālātmā parameśvaraḥ || 82 || eṣa rudro mahādevaḥ kaparddī cāgraṇīrharaḥ || ādityo bhagavānsūryo nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ || 83 || || || dakṣa uvāca || || ya ete dvādaśādityā āgatā yajñabhāginaḥ || sarve sūryā iti jñeyā na hyanyo vidyate raviḥ || 84 || evamukte tu munayaḥ samāyātā didṛkṣavaḥ || bāḍhamityabruvandakṣaṃ tasya sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ || 85 || tapasāviṣṭamanaso na paśyaṃti vṛṣadhvajam || sahasraśo'tha śataśo bahuśo'tha ya eva hi || 86 || devāṃśca sarve bhāgārthamāgatā vāsavādayaḥ || nāpaśyandevamīśānamṛte nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 87 || rudraṃ krodhaparaṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmā brahmāsanādyayau || antarhite bhagavati dakṣo nārāyaṇaṃ harim || 88 || rakṣakaṃ jagatāṃ devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ svayam || pravartayāmāsa ca taṃ yajñaṃ dakṣo'tha nirbhayaḥ || 89 || rakṣako bhagavānviṣṇuḥ śaraṇāgatarakṣakaḥ || punaḥ prāhādhvare dakṣaṃ dadhīco bhagavannṛpa || 7.2.9.90 || nirbhayaḥ śṛṇu dakṣa tvaṃ yajñabhaṃgo bhavi ṣyati || apūjyapūjanāddakṣa pūjyasya ca vivarjanāt || 91 || naraḥ pāpamavāpnoti mahadvai nātra saṃśayaḥ || asatāṃ pragraho yatra satāṃ caiva vimānatā || || 92 || daṇḍo devakṛtastatra sadyaḥ patati dāruṇaḥ || evamuktvā sa viprarṣiḥ śaśāpeśvaravidviṣaḥ || 93 || yasmādbahiṣkṛto devo bhavadbhiḥ parameśvaraḥ || bhaviṣyadhvaṃ trayībāhyāḥ sarve'pīśvaravidviṣaḥ || 94 || mithyārītisamācārā mithyājñānaprabhāṣiṇaḥ || prāpte kaliyuge ghore kalijaiḥ kila pīḍitāḥ || 95 || kṛtvā tapobalaṃ ghoraṃ gacchadhvaṃ narakaṃ punaḥ || bhaviṣyati hṛṣīkeśaḥ svāmī vo'pi parāṅmukhaḥ || 96 || || sārasvata uvāca || || evamuktvā sa brahmarṣirvirarāma taponidhiḥ || jagāma manasā rudramaśeṣādhvaranāśanam || 97 || etasminnaṃtare devī mahādevaṃ maheśvaram || gatvā vijñāpayāmāsa jñātvā dakṣamakhaṃ śivā || 98 || || devyuvāca || || dakṣo yajñena yajate pitā me pūrvajanmani || tena tvaṃ dūṣitaḥ pūrvamahaṃ cātīva duḥkhitā || vināśayasva taṃ yajñaṃ varamenaṃ vṛṇomyaham || 99 || || sārasvata uvāca || || evaṃ vijñāpito devyā devadevo maheśvaraḥ || sasarja sahasā rudraṃ dakṣayajñajighāṃsayā || 7.2.9.100 || sahasraśirasaṃ krūraṃ sahasrākṣaṃ mahābhujam || sahasrapāṇiṃ durddharṣaṃ yugāṃtānalasannibham || 101 || daṃṣṭrākarālaṃ duṣprekṣyaṃ śaṃkhacakradharaṃ prabhum|| daṇḍahastaṃ mahānādaṃ śārṅgiṇaṃ bhūtibhūṣaṇam || 102 || vīrabhadra iti khyātaṃ devadevasamanvitam || sa jātamātro deveśamupatasthe kṛtāṃjaliḥ || 103 || tamāha dakṣasya makhaṃ vināśaya śamastu taṃ || vinindya māṃ sa yajate gaṃgādvāre gaṇeśvara || 104 || tato baṃdhapramuktena siṃheneva ca līlayā || vīrabhadreṇa dakṣasya nāśārthaṃ roma coddhutam || 105 || romṇā sahasraśo rudrā nisṛṣṭāstena dhīmatā || romajā iti vikhyātāstatra sāhāyyakāriṇaḥ || 106 || śūlaśaktigadāhastā daṇḍopalakarāstathā || kālāgnirudrasaṃkāśā nādayanto diśo daśa ||107|| sarve vṛṣasamārūḍhāḥ sabhā ryāścātibhīṣaṇāḥ || samāśritya gaṇaśreṣṭhaṃ yayurdakṣamakhaṃ prati || 108 || devāṃganāsahasrāḍhyamapsarogītināditam || vīṇāveṇuninādāḍhyaṃ vedavādābhi nāditam || 109 || dṛṣṭvā dakṣaṃ samāsīnaṃ devaibrahmarṣibhiḥ saha || uvāca sa vṛṣārūḍho dakṣaṃ vīraḥ smayanniva || 7.2.9.110 || vayaṃ hyacaturāḥ sarve śarvasyāmitate jasaḥ || bhāgārthalipsayā prāptā bhāgānyaccha tvamīpsitān || 111 || bhāgo bhavadbhyo deyastu nāsmabhyamiti kathyatām || tato vayaṃ viniścitya kariṣyāmo yathocitam || 112 || evamuktā gaṇeśena prajāpatipuraḥsarāḥ || 113 || || devā ūcuḥ || || pramāṇaṃ no vijānītha bhāgaṃ maṃtrā iti dhuvam|| 114 || || maṃtrā ūcuḥ || || surā yūyaṃ tamobhūtāstamopahatacetasaḥ || ye nādhvarasya rājānaṃ pūjayeyurmaheśvaram || 115 || īśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarvadevatanurharaḥ || || gaṇa uvāca || || pūjyate sarvayajñeṣu kathaṃ dakṣo na pūjayet||116|| maṃtrāḥ pramāṇaṃ na kṛtā yuṣmābhirbalagarvitaiḥ || yasmādasahyaṃ tasmānno nāśayāmyadya garvitam ||117|| ityuktvā yajñaśālāṃ tāṃ devo'hangaṇapuṃgavaḥ || gaṇeśvarāśca saṃkruddhā yūpānutpāṭya cikṣipuḥ||118|| prastotāraṃ sahotāramadhvaryuṃ ca gaṇeśvaraḥ || gṛhītvā bhīṣaṇāḥ sarve gaṃgāsrotasi cikṣipuḥ ||119|| vīrabhadro'pi dīptātmā vajrayuktaṃ karaṃ hareḥ|| vyaṣṭaṃbhayadadīnātmā tathānyeṣāṃ divaukasām || 7.2.9.120 || bhaganetre tathotpāṭya karāgreṇaiva līlayā || nihatya muṣṭinā daṃḍaiḥ saptāśvaṃ ca nyapātayat || 121 || tathā caṃdramasaṃ devaṃ pādāṃguṣṭhena līlayā || dharṣayāmāsa valavānsmayamāno gaṇeśvaraḥ || 122 || vahnerhastadvayaṃ chittvā jihvāmutpāṭya līlayā || jaghāna mūrdhni pādena munīnapi munīśvarān || 123 || tathā viṣṇuṃ sagaruḍaṃ samāyātaṃ mahābalaḥ || vivyādha niśitairbāṇaiḥ staṃbhayitvā sudarśanam || 124 || tataḥ sahasraśo bhadraḥ sasarja garuḍānbahūn || vainateyādabhyadhikāngaruḍaṃ te pradudruvuḥ || 125 || tāndṛṣṭvā garuḍo dhīmānpalāyanaparo'bhavat || tatsthito mādhavo vegādyathā gauḥ siṃhapīḍitā || 126 || aṃtarhite vainateye viṣṇau ca padmasaṃbhavaḥ || āgatya vārayāmāsa vīrabhadraṃ śivapriyam || 127 || prasādayāmāsa sa taṃ gauravātparameṣṭhinaḥ || te'dṛśyaṃ naiva jānaṃti rudraṃ tatrāgataṃ surāḥ || 128 || sa devo viṣṇunā jñāto brahmaṇā ca dadhīcinā || tuṣṭāva bhagavānbrahmā dakṣo viṣṇudivaukasaḥ|| 129 || viśeṣātpārvatīṃ devīmīśvarārddhaśarīriṇīm || stotrairnānāvidhairdakṣaḥ praṇamya ca kṛtāñjaliḥ || 7.2.9.130 || tato bhagavatī prāha prahasaṃtī maheśvaram || tvameva jagataḥ sraṣṭā saṃhartā caiva rakṣakaḥ || 131 || anugrāhyo bhagavatā dakṣaścāpi divau kasaḥ || tataḥ prahasya bhagavānkarpaddī nīlalohitaḥ || uvāca praṇatāndevāndakṣaṃ prācetasaṃ haraḥ ||132|| gacchadhvaṃ devatāḥ sarvāḥ prasanno bhavatāmaham || saṃpūjyaḥ sarvayajñeṣu prathamaṃ devakarmaṇi || 133 || tvaṃ cāpi śṛṇu me dakṣa vacanaṃ sarvarakṣaṇam || tyaktvā lokeṣaṇāmenāṃ madbhakto bhava yatnataḥ || 134 || bhaviṣyasi gaṇeśānaḥ kalpāṃte'nugrahānmama || tāvattiṣṭha mamādeśātsvādhikāreṣu nirvṛtaḥ || ityuktvā'darśanaṃ prāpto dakṣasyāmitatejasaḥ || 135 || dadhīcinā śivo dṛṣṭo vijñaptaḥ śāpamocane || kathaṃ śāpaṃ mayā dattaṃ tariṣyaṃti tavājñayā || 136 || || śiva uvāca || || bhaviṣyaṃti trayī bāhyāḥ saṃprāpte tu kalau yuge || paṭhiṣyaṃti ca ye vedāste viprāḥ svargagāminaḥ || 137 || āgamā viṣṇuracitāḥ paṭhyante ye dvijātibhiḥ || tepi svargaṃ prayāsyaṃti matprasādānna saṃśayaḥ || 138 || kalikālaprabhāvena yeṣāṃ pāṭho na vidyate || gṛhasthadharmācaraṇaṃ kartavyaṃ mama pūjanam || 139 || avaśyaṃ ca mayā kāryaṃ teṣāṃ pāpavimocanam || bhikṣāṃ bhramāmi madhyāhne atīte bhasmaguṃṭhitaḥ || 7.2.9.140 || jaṭājūṭadharaḥ śāṃto bhikṣāpātrakaro dvijaḥ || yo dadāti ca me bhikṣāṃ svargaṃ yāti sa mānavaḥ || 141 || upānahau vā cchatraṃ vā kaupīnaṃ vā kamaṃḍalum || yo dadāti tapasvibhyo naro muktaḥ sa pātakaiḥ || dadhīceḥ sa varāndattvā vabhāṣe saha viṣṇunā || 142 || || rudra uvāca || || yaste mitraṃ sa me mitraṃ yaste ripuḥ sa me ripuḥ || yastvāṃ pūjayate viṣṇo sa māṃ pūjayate dhruvam || 143 || yaḥ stauti tvāṃ sa māṃ stauti priyo yaste sa me priyaḥ || ahaṃ yatra ca tatra tvaṃ nāsti bhedaḥ parasparam || 144 || || kṛṣṇa uvāca || || evametatparaṃ deva vaktavyaṃ yattathaiva tat || arddhanārīnaravapuryadā dṛṣṭo mayā purā || 145 || neyaṃ nārī mayā dṛṣṭā dṛṣṭaṃ rūpaṃ kilātmanaḥ || śaṃkhacakragadāhastaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitam || 146 || śrīvatsāṃkaṃ pītavastraṃ kaustubhena virāji tam || dvitīyārddhaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ śūlahastaṃ trilocanam || 147 || caṃdrāvayavasaṃyuktaṃ jaṭājūṭakapālinam || ekībhāvaṃ prapannohaṃ yathā pūrvaṃ tathā'dhunā || na māṃ gaurī prapaśyeta prapaśyāmi tathaiva ca || 148 || || īśvara uvāca || || āvayoraṃtaraṃ nāsti caikarūpāvubhāvapi || yo jānāti sa jānāti satyalokaṃ sa gacchati || 149 || ityuktvā sa yayau tatra kailāsaṃ parvatottamam || kṛṣṇopi maṃdaraṃ prāpto devakāryeṇa kenacit || 7.2.9.150 || atrāṃtare daityarājo mahādevaprasādataḥ || hiraṇyanetratanayo bādhatesau jagattrayam || 151 || amaratvaṃ harāllabdhvā kāmāṃdho naiva paśyati || harāṃgadhāriṇīṃ devīṃ divyarūpāṃ sulocanām ||152|| mameti sa ca jānāti yācate ca haraṃ prati|| haro'pi kāryavyasanastyaktvā kailāsaparvatam ||153|| maṃdaraṃ samanuprāpto devaṃ draṣṭuṃ janārddanam || parasparaṃ samālocyāmuṃcaddevīṃ sa maṃdare || 154 || nārāyaṇagṛhe devī sthitā devīgaṇairvṛtā || atrāṃtare gautamastu govadhānmalinīkṛtaḥ || 155 || pavitrīkaraṇāyāsya bhikṣurūpadharo haraḥ || gautamasya gṛhaṃ prāpto maṃdaraṃ cāṃdhako gataḥ ||156|| yayāce pārvatīṃ duṣṭo yuddhaṃ cakre sa viṣṇunā || hāritaṃ tu gaṇaiḥ sarvairdevīṃ daityo na paśyati ||157|| strīrūpadhārī kṛṣṇo'sau gaurīṃ rakṣati maṃdire || gaurīṇāṃ tu śataṃ cakre haristatra sa māyayā || 158 || viṣṇordehasamudbhūtā divyarūpā varastriyaḥ || andhako naiva jānāti kaiṣā gaurī nu pārvatī || 159 || vilaṃbastatra sañjāto mohito viṣṇumāyayā || tāvacchivaḥ samāyātaḥ kṛtvā gautamapāvanam || 7.2.9.160 || bhikṣāmātreṇa cānnena gautamo nirmalīkṛtaḥ || soṃdhakena tadā yuddhaṃ cakre rudro'pi kopitaḥ || 161 || amaro'sau harājjātaḥ śūle protaḥ sudāruṇe || śūlasthastu stutiṃ cakre tasya tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 162 || gaṇeśatvaṃ dadau tasmai yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || svasarūpāmumādevīṃ kṛṣṇastasmai dadau svayam || 163 || gaurīrūpāḥ striyaścānyā dharitryāṃ tāstu preṣitāḥ || kṛtvā nāmāni sarvāsāṃ loke pūjyā bhaviṣyatha || 164 || etā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti pūjayiṣyanti te śivām || śivāṃ ye pūjayiṣyaṃti te'rcayante haraṃ harim ||165|| umāṃ samādāya yayau haro giriṃ vṛṣaṃ samāruhya surāsurārcitaḥ || haristu reme ramayā sahāṃdhake hate ca devāḥ surarājamāyayuḥ ||165|| brahmeśanārāyaṇapuṇyacetasāṃ śṛṇvanti citraṃ caritaṃ mahātmanām|| mucyaṃti pāpaiḥ kalikālasaṃbhavairyāsyaṃti nākaṃ gaṇavṛndavaṃditāḥ || 167 || evaṃ kāle varttamāne haraḥ kailāsaparvate || rakṣodānavadaityaistu gṛhyate'sau varānbahūn || 168 || brahmadattavaro raudrastārakākhyo mahāsuraḥ || tena sarvaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ tasya naṣṭā surā raṇe || 169 || mahādevasutenājau haṃtavyo'sau sasarja tam || kārtikeyamumāputraṃ rudravīryasamudbhavam || 7.2.9.170 || devairindrādibhiḥ sarvaiḥ senādhyakṣyebhiṣecitaḥ || tenāpi daivayogena tārakākhyo nipātitaḥ || 171 || kailāsaśikharāsīno devadevo jagadguruḥ || umayā saha saṃtuṣṭo nandibhadrādibhirvṛtaḥ || 172 || skandena gajavaktreṇa dhanādhyakṣeṇa saṃyutaḥ || atha hāsaparaṃ devaṃ śanaiḥ provāca taṃ śivā || 173 || kena deva prakāreṇa toṣaṃ yāsyasi śaṃkara || martyānāṃ kena dānena tapasā niyamena vā || 174 || kena vā karmaṇā deva kena mantreṇa vā punaḥ || snānena kena deveśa kena dhūpena tuṣyasi || 175 || puṣpeṇa kena me nātha kena patreṇa śaṃkara || kayā saṃtuṣyase stutyā sāhasena ca kena vai || 176 || naivedyena ca kena tvaṃ kena homena tuṣyasi || kena kaṣṭena vā deva kenārgheṇa mama prabho || 177 || ṣoḍaśaite mayā praśnāḥ pṛṣṭā me nirṇayaṃ vada || 178 || || śaṃkara uvāca || || sādhu pṛṣṭaṃ tvayā devi kathayiṣye mama priyam || śivapūjāprakāro'yaṃ kriyate vacasā guroḥ ||179|| abhayaṃ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ dānaṃ devi mama priyam || satyaṃ tapaḥ samākhyātaṃ paradāravivarjanam || 7.2.9.180 || priyo me niyamo devi karma tallokarañjanam || mayoṃ namaḥ śivāyeti mantro'yamurarīkṛtaḥ || 181 || sarvapāpavinirmukto mama devi sa vallabhaḥ || pāpatyāgo bhavetsnānaṃ dhūpo me gauggulaḥ priyaḥ || || 182 || dhattūrakasya puṣpaṃ me bilvapatraṃ mama priyam || stutiḥ śivaśivāyeti sāhasaṃ raṇakarmaṇi || 183 || na bibheti naro yastu tasyāgre saṃbhavāmyaham || haṃtakāro gavāṃ yastu naivedyaṃ mama vallabham || 184 || pūrṇāhutyā parā prītirjāyate mama sundari|| śuśrūṣā vallabhaṃ kaṣṭaṃ yatīnāṃ ca tapasvinām || 185 || sūryodaye mahādevi madhyāhne'stamane tathā || argho yo dīyate sūrye vallabho'sau mama priye || 186 || kiṃ dānaiḥ kiṃ tapobhirvā kiṃ yajñairbhāvavarjitaiḥ|| dayā satyaṃ ghṛṇā'steyaṃ daṃbhapaiśunyavarjitam|| bhaktyā yaddīyate stokaṃ devi tadvallabhaṃ mama|| 187|| evaṃ yāvatkathayati praśnānsūkṣmānyathoditān || tāvadbrahmādibhirdevairviṣṇustatra yayau svayam || 188 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || nāhaṃ pālayituṃ śaktastvaṃ dadāsi varānbahūn || daityānāṃ dānavādīnāṃ rākṣasānāṃ maheśvara || 189 || vikṛtiṃ yāṃti paścātte kaṣṭaṃ vadhyā bhavaṃti me || patreṇa puṣpamātreṇa oṃkāreṇa śivena ca || muktiṃ yāti naro deva bhavabhaktiṃ karotu kaḥ || 7.2.9.190 || indrādayo'pi ye devā yajñairāpyāyayaṃti te || na yajaṃti dvijā yajñānbhikṣādānena tuṣyasi || 191 || || rudra uvāca || || indrādibhirna me kāryaṃ brahmā me kiṃ kariṣyati || yena kena prakāreṇa prajāḥ pālyāstvayā 'dhunā || 192 || madīyā prakṛtistveṣā tāṃ kathaṃ tyaktumutsahe || tvayāhaṃ brahmaṇā devairvarakarmaṇi yojitaḥ || 193 || idānīmeva kiṃ naṣṭaṃ muktvā devīṃ tavāgrataḥ || bhūtvā mūrtiṃ parityajya ekākī vicarāmyaham || 194 || ityuktvā sa śivo devastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || gate tasmiñchive tatra saṃkṣobhaḥ sumahānabhūt || 195 || umā provāca cendrādīnbrahmaviṣṇugaṇāṃstathā || idānīṃ kiṃ mayā kāryaṃ bhavadbhiḥ śivavarjitaiḥ || 196 || atrāntare ca ye cānye devāstatra samāgatāḥ || ṛṣayaścaiva siddhāśca tathā nāradaparvatau || 197 || gaṃgāsarasvatīnadyo nāgā yakṣāḥ samāgatāḥ || brahmādibhiḥ samālocya kathametadbhaviṣyati || 198 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || sahaiva gamyatāṃ tatra yatra devo gataḥ śivaḥ || svalpā yāsena te yāntu narāḥ svargaṃ śivājñayā || 199 || satyaloke narā yāntu devā yāntu dharātalam || rakṣodānavadaityānāṃ varānyacchatu śaṃkaraḥ || 7.2.9.200 || teṣāṃ bādhā mayā kāryā yai ca syurdharmalopakāḥ || hṛṣṭe śive mayā kāryā vyavasthā svargagāminām || || 201 || trayīdharmaṃ parityajya ye'nyaṃ dharmamupāsate || te narā narakaṃ yāṃtu yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 202 || yadā'dṛśyaḥ śivo jātaḥ pravi veśa girervanam || girīṇāṃ madhyamāsthāya tyaktvā divye sa vāsasī || 203 || gajājinaṃ parityajya tyaktvā mūrttiṃ maheśvaraḥ || bhittvā bhūmitalaṃ devaḥ sthāṇurūpo babhūva saḥ || 204 || yasmātsvaṃyabhūrbhavati bhavaṃstasmātsvayaṃ haraḥ || atrāṃtare surāḥ sarve na paśyaṃti maheśvaram || jñānātītaṃ kalātītaṃ divyadhyānabahiḥ sthitam || 205 || yadā devā vyākulāḥ saṃpataṃti ravirvāyuraṃbaraṃ toyamurvī || nije sthāne varttamānā umāyāḥ śaśaṃsurvai devadevaṃ surāṇām || 206 || svarge dharitryāṃ caritaṃ taleṣu deveṣu martyeṣu sarīsṛpeṣu || sthūleṣu sūkṣmeṣu yathā tathaiva satyaṃ hi vācyaṃ padamasmadīyam || 207 || tato devāḥ pracalitāḥ kṛtvā gaurīṃ purassaram || naṃdi bhadrādayaḥ sarve devā iṃdrādayastathā || 208 || skandena sahitā devī siṃhārūḍhā yayau svayam || adhiruhya garutmaṃtaṃ yayau viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || 209 || haṃsādhirūḍho bhagavānbrahmā yāti sa pṛṣṭhataḥ || airāvataṃ samāruhya devarājo'gamatsvayam || || 7.2.9.210 || gaṃgā sarasvatī devī yamunā ca mahānadī || devatāśca gatāḥ sarve nāgā yakṣāḥ sakiṃnarāḥ || 211 || gatāḥ saṃkṣepataḥ sarve yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || adhiruhya gireḥ śṛṃgamaṃbā devī vyavasthitā || 212 || viṣṇurmuktvā garutmaṃtaṃ sthito raivatake girau || stutiṃ cakre tadā devī jagurgītaṃ susaṃyatāḥ || 213 || airāvatapadākrāṃto na cacāla sa parvataḥ || bhittvā bhūmitalaṃ tatra nāgarājaḥ samāgataḥ || 214 || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāstena raṃdhreṇa cāgatāḥ || brahmā viṣṇuryadā devāḥ stutiṃ cakruḥ samaṃtataḥ || 215 || dadarśa rūpaṃ bhagavānbhavo devastadā haraḥ || 216 || tato hṛṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve aṃbā hṛṣṭā gaṇāśca te || gamyatāṃ deva kailāsaṃ devyeti saṃpramoditaḥ || 217 || || īśvara uvāca || || yadi hṛṣṭāḥ surāḥ sarve gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || girau raivatake viṣṇuraṃbā cātraiva tiṣṭhatu ||218|| sarasvatī ca yamunā revā cāsminvyavasthitāḥ || svarṇarūpaṃ jalaṃ yasmātsvarṇarekheti sā nadī || 219 || vastrāpathamidaṃ kṣetraṃ bhavo devo'tra tiṣṭhatu || tīrthametanmayā proktaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam || atra snāto naro nārī mucyate sarva pātakaiḥ ||7.2.9.220|| iti procya śivo devaḥ kalāṃ nyasya bhave tadā || paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ yayau kailāsaparvatam || 221 || aṃbeti skandavadanātkalāṃ nyasya girau tadā || devena sahitā devī vṛṣārūḍhā yayau svayam || 222 || nārāyaṇo raivatake girau ramye sthitaḥ svayam || kalpādau ca yugādau ca sthito viṣṇuḥ sadā girau || 223 || bahurātrasthito devaḥ kṛtvā daityanibarhaṇam || reme raivatake devo yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 224 || nārasiṃhena rūpeṇa hiraṇyakaśipurhataḥ || hatvā tadā gatastatra nārasiṃhaṃ mumoca ha || 225 || mahāvarāharūpeṇa hiraṇyākṣo nipātitaḥ || tadeva muktvā deveśaḥ sthito raivatake girau || 226 || sa pṛthuṃ pārthivaṃ kṛtvā devakāryeṇa vai nṛpa || girau raivatake deva uvāsa surapūjitaḥ || 227 || atrāgatya pṛthuḥ pūrvaṃ cakre devaprapūjanam || japamālā tadā kaṇṭhe pṛthunā saṃniveśitā || dāmodareti deveśanāma cakre pṛthuḥ svayam || 228 || vastrāpathe devavaro bhavaḥ sthito dāmodaro raivatake vyavasthitaḥ || aṃbetidevī girimūrdhni saṃsthitā devāśca sarve paritaḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || 229 || kṣetrādhipāstīrthavarasya rakṣakā devena muktā bhavasaṃnidhānataḥ || paśyaṃti ye devavaraṃ bhavābhidhaṃ mucyaṃti te yāṃti divaṃ narā bhuvaḥ || 7.2.9.230 || vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya bhavasya ca mayā tava || utpattiḥ kathitā rājankimanyacchrotumicchasi || 231 || śṛṇoti paṭhate yaśca kathāṃ cemāṃ samaṃtataḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ svargaloke mahīyate || 232 || brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca bhrūṇahā gurutalpagaḥ || svarṇarekhājale snāto mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 233 || ye ca kīṭapataṃgādyāḥ svarṇarekhā jale mṛtāḥ || sarvapātakanirmuktāste prayāṃti surālayam || 134 || svarṇarekhājale snātvā saṃdhyāṃ śrāddhaṃ karoti yaḥ || vastrāpathe bhavaṃ pūjya brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 235 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye bhavotpattivṛttāṃta varṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
<7.2.10>
|| pārvatyuvāca || || aho tīrthasya māhātmyaṃ gire raivatakasya ca || bhavasya devadevasya tathā vastrāpathasya ca || 1 || gaṃgā sarasvatī caiva gomatī narmadā nadī || svarṇarekhājale sarvāstathā brahmā savāsavaḥ || 2 || brahmendra viṣṇumukhyānāṃ devānāṃ śaṃkarasya ca || vāso viracitastatra yāvadbrahmadinaṃ bhavet || 3 || kṣetratīrthaprabhāvaṃ ca prasādāttava śaṃkara || śrutaṃ savistaraṃ sarvamidaṃ tvaduditaṃ mayā || 4 || maheśvara prabho brūhi kiṃ cakāra janeśvaraḥ || bhojarājo mṛgīṃ prāpya sa ca sārasvato muniḥ || 5 || || || īśvara uvāca || || tāsu sarvāsu nārīṣu rūpaudāryaguṇādhikā || nityaṃ pramuditā śāṃtā nityaṃ maṃgalakārikā || 6 || mātā svasā sakhī putrī strīṣu saṃbandhavardhanī || pitā bhrātā guruḥ putraḥ puruṣeṣu tathā kṛtaḥ || 7 || evaṃ guṇavatīṃ bhāryāṃ prāpya hṛṣṭo janeśvaraḥ || sārasvataṃ muniṃ stutvā rājā vacanamabravīt || 8 || || rājovāca || || brahmā viṣṇurharaḥ sūrya indro'gnirmarutāṃ gaṇaḥ || brahmacaryeṇa tapasā tvayā santoṣitāḥ prabho || 9 || daivataṃ paramaṃ me tvaṃ pitā mātā guruḥ prabhuḥ || yena janmāṃtaraṃ sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ kathitaṃ mama || 7.2.10.10 || surāṣṭradeśo vikhyāto girī raivatako mahān || bhavaḥ svayaṃbhūrbhagavānkṣetre vastrāpathe śrutaḥ || 11 || ujjayaṃtagirermūrdhni gaurīskandagaṇeśvarāḥ || bhāvayaṃto bhavaṃ sarve saṃsthitā brahmavāsaram || 12 || vāmano nagaraṃ sthāpya śivaṃ siddheśvaraṃ prati || jitvā daityaṃ baliṃ baddhvā svayaṃ raivatake sthitaḥ || 13 || ityetatsarvamāścaryaṃ jīvadbhiryadi dṛśyate || tīrthayātrāvidhānena bhavo vastrāpathe hariḥ || 14 || tyaktvā rājyaṃ priyānputrānpattyaśvarathakuñjarān || putraṃ rājye pratiṣṭhāpya gantavyaṃ niścitaṃ mayā || 15 || tvatprasādācchrutaṃ sarvaṃ gamyate yadi dṛśyate || tīrthayātrāvidhānena bhavo vastrāpathe hariḥ || 16 || sūryalokaṃ somalokamiṃdralokaṃ hareḥ puram || brahmalokamatikramya yāsye'haṃ śivamaṃdiram || 17 || śrutvā hi vākyaṃ vividhaṃ narendrātprahṛṣṭaromā sa munirbabhūva || jijñāsamāno hi nṛpasya sarvaṃ nivārayāmāsa munirnarendram || 18 || || sārasvata uvāca || || gṛhe'pi devā haraviṣṇumukhyā jalāni darbhā nṛpate tilāśca || anekadeśāṃtaradarśanārthaṃ mano nivāryaṃ nṛpate tvayeti || 19 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye vastrāpatha kṣetrayātrotsukasya bhojabhūpasya sārasvatamunikṛtopadeśavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||
<7.2.11>
|| īśvara uvāca || || sārasvatasya viprasya śrutvā bhojanṛpo vacaḥ || vivarṇavadano bhūtvā pragṛhyāṃghrī vaco'bravīt || 1 || mune naivaṃ tvayā vācyaṃ gaṃtavyaṃ niścitaṃ mayā || narāṇāṃ puṇyadā yātrā kathayasva kathaṃ bhavet || 2 || kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ ca moktavyaṃ kiṃ deyaṃ kiṃ na dīyate || tīrthopavāsaḥ snānaṃ ca saṃdhyāsnānavidhikramaḥ || pūjā nidrā japo rātrau sarvaṃ saṃkṣepato vada || 3 || || sārasvata uvāca || || surāṣṭradeśe gantavyaṃ girau raivatake yadi || nṛpa yātrāvidhiṃ vakṣye tvamekāgramanāḥ śṛṇu || || 4 || bṛhaspatibalaṃ gṛhya sūryaṃ saṃtarpya cottamam || vāmataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ sarvaṃ vṛtvā saṃśodhya vāsaram || 5 || caṃdralagnaṃ grahājjñātvā baliṣṭhājjanmarāśitaḥ|| śakunaṃ ca śubhaṃ labdhvā prasthātavyaṃ nṛpairnṛpa || 6 || tīrthe sadaiva gaṃtavyaṃ sarve māsāśca śobhanāḥ || tithayaścottamāḥ sarvāḥ snānadānārcanādiṣu || 7 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ māsāṃte pūrṇimādine || saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe kālā ete proktā bhavārcane ||8|| kailāsaṃ parvataṃ tyaktvā devīṃ devāṃśca saṃgatān|| vaiśākhe paṃcadaśyāṃ tu bhūmiṃ bhittvā bhavo'bhavat || 9 || tasminneva dine devī svarṇarekhā nadī talāt || paṃthānaṃ vāsukiṃ prāpya sarvapāpapraṇāśanī || 7.2.11.10 || | airāvatapadākrāṃta ujjayanto mahāgiriḥ || susrāva toyaṃ bahudhā gajapādodbhavaṃ śuci || 11 || devā brahmādayaḥ sarve gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || vastrāpathe mahākṣetre bhavabhāvena saṃgatāḥ || 12 || vastrāpathasya kṣetrasya pramāṇaṃ śṛṇu bhūpate || harasya tyajato bhūmau patitaṃ vastrabhūṣaṇam || 13 || tāvanmātraṃ smṛtaṃ kṣetraṃ devairvastrāpathaṃ kṛtam || uttareṇa nadī bhadrā pūrvasyāṃ yojanadvayam || 14 || dakṣiṇena baleḥ sthānamujjayanto nadīmanu || aparasyāṃ paraṃ nadyo saṃgamaṃ vāmanātpurāt || 15 || etadvastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam || kṣetrasya vistaro jñeyo yojanānāṃ catuṣṭayam || 16 || vaiśākhapaṃcadaśyāṃ tu bhavo bhāvena bhūpate || pūjyate śivaloke tu sthīyate brahmavāsaram || 17 || ato vasaṃte saṃprāpte prayāṇaṃ kuru bhūpate || nigṛhya niyamānbhūtvā śuciḥ snāto jitendriyaḥ || 18 || gajavājirathāṃstyaktā padābhyāṃ yāti yo naraḥ || puṣpakeṇa vimānena sa yāti śivamaṃdiram || 19 || ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca || bhikṣāhāreṇa toyena phalāhāreṇa vā yadi || 7.2.11.20 || upavāsena kṛcchreṇa śākāhāreṇa yāti yaḥ || sa yāti sundarīvṛndairvījyamāno gaṇairdivi || 21 || malasnānaṃ vinā mārge pādābhyaṃgavivarjitaḥ || maladhārī kṣīṇatanuryaṣṭihasto jitendriyaḥ || 22 || śītātapajalakliṣṭaḥ śivasmaraṇatatparaḥ || yadi yāti naro yāti sa bhittvā sūryamaṃḍalam || 23 || narakasthānapi pitṝnmātṛtaḥ pitṛto nṛpa || akṣayaṃ sapta saptaiva nayedevaṃ śivālaye || 24 || luṇṭhanbhūmau yadā yāti mṛgacarmāvaguṃṭhitaḥ || daṇḍapramāṇabhūmervā saṃkhyāṃ kurvannaro yadi || 25 || araṇye nirjale sthāne jalāṃtaḥparipīḍitaḥ || śaraṇyaṃ śaṃkaraṃ kṛtvā mano niścalamātmanaḥ || 26 || saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ samudravasanāṃ nṛpa || sa labdhvā bahubhiryajñairyajñe dattvā ca medinīm || 27 || saptabhaumavimānastho divyadeho harākṛtiḥ || nirīkṣya medinīṃ maṃdaṃ kṛta maṃgalamaṇḍanam || 28 || mṛganetrābhujasparśalagnapīnapayodharaḥ || gītavādyavinodena satyalokaṃ vrajennaraḥ || 29 || vidhāya bhujavegaṃ vā pādau baddhvā śanaiḥ śanaiḥ || maunena mānuṣo māyāṃ tyaktvā yāti śivālaye || 7.2.11.30 || brahmaghno vā surāpo vā steyī vā gurutalpagaḥ || kṛtaghno mucyate pāpairmṛto muktimavāpnuyāt || 31 || mātaraṃ pitaraṃ deśaṃ bhrātaraṃ svajanabāṃdhavān || grāmaṃ bhūmiṃ gṛhaṃ tyaktvā kṛtvā ceṃdriyasaṃyamam || 32 || gṛhītvā śivasaṃskāraṃ naro bhrāmyati bhūtale || draṣṭuṃ tīrthānyanekāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || 33 || kasmiṃstīrthe śubhe sthāne chittvā saṃsārabandhanam || abhayāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dattvā śivaśiveti bhāṣakaḥ || 34 || ekāṃte nirjane sthāne śivasmaraṇatatparaḥ || yadi tiṣṭhati taṃ yānti namaskartuṃ narādhipa || 35 || āyāṃti devatāḥ sarve cihnaṃ tasya nirīkṣitum || vimānavṛndairnetavyaḥ kadāsau puruṣottamaḥ || 36 || yadā tu pañcatvamupaiti kāle kalevaraṃ skandhakṛtaṃ naraiśca || nirīkṣyamāṇaḥ surasundarībhiḥ sa nīyamāno madavihvalābhiḥ || 37 || surendrasūryāgnidhaneśarudraiḥ saṃpūjyamānaḥ śivarūpadhārī || surādilokānpravimucya vegācchivālaye tiṣṭhati rudrabhaktaḥ || 38 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetra māhātmye vastrāpathayātrāvidhānavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<7.2.12>
|| sārasvata uvāca || || gaṃgodakaṃ madhughṛte kuṃkumāgurucaṃda nam || guggulaṃ bilvapatrāṇi bakapuṣpaṃ ca yo vahet || 1 || padacārī śucitanurbhāraṃ skandhe nidhāya ca || tīrthe snātvā śivaṃ viṣṇuṃ brahmāṇaṃ śaṃkaraṃ priyam || 2 || dṛṣṭvā nivedayedyastu sa muktaḥ sarvabandhanaiḥ || sa naro gaṇatāṃ yāti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 3 || kalatramitraputrairvā bhrātṛbhiḥ svajanairnaraiḥ || sahito vā narairyāti tīrthe devaṃ viciṃtya ca || 4 || devamūrtiṃ śubhāṃ kṛtvā rathasthāṃ supratiṣṭhitām || candanāgurukarpūrairarcitāṃ kuṃkumena ca || 5 || pūjayanvividhaiḥ puṣpairdhūpadīpādikairnṛpa || gītanṛtyaiḥ savāditrairhāsyalāsyairanekadhā || 6 || dharitrīṃ kāṃcanaṃ gāśca jalānnavasanāni ca || tṛṇendhane priyāṃ vāṇīṃ yacchanyāti naro yadi || 7 || devāṃganākaragrāhagṛhīto nandanaṃ vanam || prāpya bhuṃkte śubhānbhogānyāvadācandratārakam || 8 || tīrthe saṃcaritaḥ puruṣo rogaiḥ prāṇānvimuñcati || adṛṣṭvā daivataṃ tīrthe dṛṣṭatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 9 || saṃsāradoṣānvividhānvicintya strīputramitreṣvapi baṃdhamuktaḥ || vijñāya baddhaṃ puruṣaṃ pradhānaiḥ sa sarvatīrthāni karoti deham || 7.2.12.10 || ājanmajanmāṃntarasaṃcitāni dagdhvā sa pāpāni naro narendra || tejomayaṃ sarvagataṃ purāṇaṃ bhavodbhavaṃ paśyati mucyate saḥ ||11|| tīrthe vipravaco grāhyaṃ snātvā saṃdhyārcanādikam || darbhāstilā haviṣyānnaṃ prayogāḥ śraddhayā kṛtāḥ ||12|| agastyaṃ bhṛṅgarājaṃ ca puṣpaṃ śatadalaṃ śubham || karpūrāguruśrīkhaṃḍaṃ kuṃkumaṃ tulasīdalam || 13 || bilvapramāṇapiṃḍeṣu dīpoddyotitabhūmiṣu || tāṃbūla phalanaivedyaṃ tiladarbhodakena ca || 14 || tīrthe saṃkalpitaṃ martyaistadanaṃtaṃ prajāyate || ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇeṣu ca || 15 || māsāṃte'para pakṣe tu kṣayāhe pitṛmātṛke || gajacchāyāṃ trayodaśyāṃ dravye prāptau dvijottamaḥ || 16 || gṛhe śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāmṛṇamuktaye || gṛhācchataguṇaṃ nadyāṃ yā nadī yāti sāgaram || 17 || prabhāse puṣkare rājangaṃgāyāṃ piṃḍatārake || prayāge nṛpagomatyāṃ bhavadāmodarāgrataḥ || 18 || narmadādiṣu tīrtheṣu kuryācchrāddhaṃ naro yadi || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ pitaro yāṃti sadgatim|| 19 || saṃtānamuttamaṃ labdhvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān || divyaṃ vimānamāruhya prānte yāti surālayam|| 7.2.12.20 || jātakarmādiyajñeṣu vivāhe yajñakarmaṇi || devapratiṣṭhāprāraṃbhe vṛddhiśrāddhaṃ prakalpayet || 21 || tṛpyanti devatāḥ sarvā stṛpyaṃti pitaro nṛṇām|| vṛddhiśrāddhakṛto gehe jāyate sarvamaṃgalam || 22 || kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho madyamadādayaḥ || māyā mātsaryapaiśunyamaviveko vicāraṇā || 23 || ahaṃkāro yadṛcchā ca cāpalyaṃ laulyatā nṛpa || atyāyāsopyanāyāsaḥ pramādo drohasāhasam || 24 || ālasyaṃ dīrghasūtratvaṃ paradāropasevanam || alpāhāro nirāhāraḥ śokaścauryaṃ nṛpottama || 25 || etāndoṣāngṛhe nityaṃ varjayanyadi vartate || sa naro maṇḍanaṃ bhūmerdeśasya nagarasya ca || 26 || śrīmānvidvānkulīno'sau sa eva puruṣottamaḥ || sarvatīrthābhiṣekaśca nityaṃ tasya prajāyate || 27 || tadā tīrthaphalaṃ samyaktyaktadoṣasya jāyate || snānaṃ sandhyā japo homaḥ pitṛdevarṣitarpaṇam || śrāddhaṃ devasya pūjā ca tyaktadoṣasya jāyate || 28 || prayāge vā kurukṣetre sarasvatyāṃ ca sāgare || gayāyāṃ vā rudrapade naranārāyaṇāśrame || 29 || prabhāse puṣkare kṛṣṇe gomatyāṃ piṃḍatārake || vastrāpathe girau puṇye tathā dāmodare nṛpa || 7.2.12.30 || bhīmeśvare narmadāyāṃ skāṃde rāmeśvarādiṣu || ujjayinyāṃ mahākāle vārāṇasyāṃ ca bhūrbhuvaḥ || 31 || kāliṃdyāṃ mathurāyāṃ ca sakṛdyāti naro yadi || sadoṣo mucyate doṣairbrahmahatyādibhiḥ kṛtaiḥ || || 32 || api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā pakṣī vā sūkaro'pi vā || kharoṣṭrakuṃjarā vājimṛgasiṃhasarīsṛpāḥ || 33 || jñānato'jñānato rājaṃsteṣu sthā neṣu ye mṛtāḥ || sarve te puṇyakarmāṇaḥ svargaṃ bhuktvā sukhaṃ bahu || 34 || caturvarṇeṣu sarve te jāyaṃte karmabaṃdhanāt || karmabaṃdhaṃ vihāyāśu muktiṃ yāṃti narāḥ punaḥ || 35 || modaṃte tīrthamaraṇātsvargabhogāvasānataḥ || saṃprāpya bhārate khaṃḍe karmabhūmiṃ mahodayam || 36 || anekāścaryasaṃyuktaṃ bahuparvatamaṃḍitam || gaṃgāyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ samudraiḥ saha saṃgatāḥ || 37 || padepade nidhānāni saṃti tīrthānyanekaśaḥ || yeṣāṃ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 38 || pātālamārgā bahavaḥ svargamārgaśca dṛśyate || gagane dṛśyate sūryo hṛdaye dṛśyate haraḥ || 39 || dhyānena jñānayogena tapasā vacasā guroḥ || satyena sāhasenaiva dṛśyate bhuvanatrayam || 7.2.12.40 || vedasmṛtipurāṇaiśca ye na paśyaṃti bhūtalam || pātālaṃ svargalokaṃ ca vaṃcitāste narā iha || 41 || ye virajyaṃti na strīṣu kāmāsaktā vicetasaḥ || dehonyathā varastrīṇāmanyathā taiśca ciṃtitam || 42 || janmabhūmiṣu te raktā janyaṃte jaṃtavaḥ punaḥ || muktimārgātpunarbhraṣṭā jāyaṃte paśuyoniṣu || 43 || dhanāni saṃprāpya varāṭikāṃ ye dvijātimukhyāya vidhāya pūjām || yacchaṃti no nirmalacetanā ye narādhamā daivahatā mṛtāste || 44 || dehaṃ supuṣṭaṃ vijaraṃ ca yauvanaṃ labdhvā na gaṃgādiṣu yāṃti ye narāḥ || mātā pitā no na suto na bāṃdhavo bhāryā svasā no duhitā na vidyate || 45 || ekastu yo yāti kathaṃ na kliśyate mūrkho na jānāti bhavaṃ maheśvaram || snātvā na paśyaṃti haraṃ maheśvaraṃ daivena te vai muṣitā narādhamāḥ || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye yātrā vidhivarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 ||
<7.2.13>
|| sārasvata uvāca || || chittvā śubhāśubhaṃ karma muktimicchecchivāṃ tataḥ || idaṃ na śakyate karttuṃ śubhaṃ kāryaṃ tadā naraiḥ || 1 || utthāyotthāya snātavyaṃ pūjyau hariharau svayam || satyaṃ vācyaṃ hitaṃ kāryaṃ dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 2 || parāpavādabhīrutvaṃ paradārānvivarjayet || suvarṇabhūmiharaṇabrahmadevasvavarjanam || 3 || brāhmaṇastrīnareṃdrāṇāṃ bālavṛddhatapasvinām || pitṛmātṛgurūṇāṃ ca nāpriyaṃ manasā vadet || 4 || deśakālaparijñānaṃ pātrāpātravivecanam || chāyā nṛṇāṃ na vaktavyā takrāgnīṃdhanakāṃjikam ||5|| auṣadhaṃ śākamarthibhyo dātavyaṃ gṛha medhibhiḥ || ekādaśīpaṃcadaśīcaturdaśyaṣṭamīṣu ca || 6 || amāvāsyāvyatīpātasaṃkrāṃtigrahaṇeṣu ca || vaidhṛte pitṛmātrośca kṣayāhadivaseṣu ca || 7 || yugādimanvādidine gṛhe kāryo mahotsavaḥ || tīrthe vā gamanaṃ kāryaṃ gṛhācchataguṇaṃ yataḥ || 8 || idriyāṇāṃ jayaḥ kāryo madyaṃ dyūtaṃ vivarjayet || vivādaṃ gamanaṃ yuddhaṃ gṛhī yatnena varjayet || 9 || snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homo devapūjā dvijārcanam || akṣayaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ vidhivaccedbhavetkṛtam || 7.2.13.10 || ekāpi gauḥ pradātavyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇā || dogdhrī savatsā taruṇī dvijamukhyāya kalpitā || 11 || saṃprāpya bhārataṃ khaṃḍaṃ mānuṣaṃ janma cottamam || dhanyo dadāti yo dhenuṃ sa naraḥ sūryamaṇḍalam|| bhittvā yāti vimānena gamyamāno gavādibhiḥ ||12|| sapta janmāni pāpāni kṛtvā pāpīha cādhamaḥ|| eko dadāti yo dhenuṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 13 || yadā sa nīyate baddho yamamārgeṇa kiṃkaraiḥ || tadā naṃdā samāgatya svaṃ putramiva paśyati || 14 || vijitya huṃkṛtenaiva tāndūtāndūrataḥ sthitān || gopradaṃ taṃ samādāya prayāti śivamandiram ||15|| vṛṣo dharma hati prokto yena muktaḥ sa mucyate || goṣu madhye pitṝnsarvānharamuddiśya vā harim ||16|| sūryabrahmapure vāso jāyate brahmavāsare || dṛḍhaṃ kakudminaṃ saṃtaṃ yuvānaṃ bhārasādhanam ||17|| halakṣamaṃ balīvardaṃ dattvā viprāya parvasu || tamāruhya naro yāti golokaṃ śivasaṃnidhau || 18 || aśvaṃ sāstaraṇaṃ dattvā khalīnena ca saṃyutam || aśvarājabalātsvarge modate brāhmavāsaram || 19 || gajadānādgajeṃdreṇa nīyate naṃdanaṃ vanam || pṛthivyāṃ sāgarāṃtāyāmeṣa rājā bhaviṣyati ||7.2.13.20|| gṛhaṃ sopaskaraṃ dattvā viprāya gṛhamedhine || labhate naṃdane divyaṃ vimānaṃ sārvakāmikam || 21 || dravyaṃ pṛthivyāṃ paramaṃ suvarṇaṃ hṛṣyaṃti devā yadi dīyate tataḥ || sūryopi tasmai ruciraṃ vimānaṃ dadāti tāvadbhramate'tra yāvat ||22|| raupyaṃ pitṝṇāmativallabhaṃ taddattvā naro nirmalatāmupaiti || somasya lokaṃ labhate sa tāvadbhuve nivaddhā ṛṣayo hi yāvat || 23 || śrīkhaṃḍakarpūrasamākulāni tāṃbūlaratnādiphalāni dattvā || puṣpāṇi vastrāṇi sukhena yāti sākaṃ śaśāṃkaṃ divi devavṛṃdaiḥ || || 24 || takrodakatailaghṛtadugdhekṣurasamadhūni yo dadyāt || kharjūrakhaṃḍadrākṣāvātāmāṃjīrakaiḥ sākam || 25 || darbhākṣatamṛdgomayadūrvāyajñopavītāni || tilacarmasūryapiṭakaṃ dattvā khyātaściraṃ svarge || 26 || ātmāhārāccaturbhāgaṃ siddhānnādyadi dīyate || hantakāraḥ sa taṃ dattvā dhruvaṃ yāti dhruvālaye || || 27 || ātmāhārapramāṇena pratyahaṃ goṣu dīyate || gavāhnikaṃ tāsu dattvā naro yāti surālayam || 28 || kaṃḍanīpeṣaṇīcullīmārjanībhiśca yatkṛtam || pāpaṃ gṛhī kṣālayati dadadbhikṣāṃ dinaṃ prati || 29 || grāsamātrā bhavedbhikṣā sā nityaṃ yatra dīyate || tadgṛhaṃ gṛhamanyacca smaśānamiva dṛśyate || 7.2.13.30 || kumbhānsodakasiddhānnāṃśchatropānatkamaṃḍalum || aṃgulīyakavāsāṃsi dattvā yāti naro divi || 31 || śrāṃtasya yānaṃ tṛṣitasya pānamannaṃ kṣudhārttasya naro narendra || dattvā vimānena surāṃganābhiḥ saṃstūyamānastridivaṃ sa yāti || 32 || bhojanaṃ satataṃ deyaṃ yathāśaktyā ghṛta plutam || tanmayā hi yataḥ prāṇā ataḥ puṣyaṃti prāṇinaḥ || 33 || kṣutpīḍā mahatī loke hyannaṃ tadbheṣajaṃ smṛtam || tena sā śāṃtimāyāti tatonnaṃ deyamuttamam || 34 || annaṃ vastraṃ phalaṃ toyaṃ takraṃ śākaṃ ghṛtaṃ madhu || patraṃ puṣpaṃ tathopānatkaṃthāṃ yaṣṭiṃ kamaṃḍalum || 35 || chatrapātre vrataṃ vidyā akṣamālā surārcanam || kanyā kuśopavītāni bījauṣadhagṛhāṇi ca || 36 || sasyaṃ kṣetraṃ yajñapātraṃ yogapaṭṭaṃ ca pāduke || kṛṣṇājinaṃ buddhidānaṃ dharmādeśakathānakam || 37 || athaitatsaṃtataṃ deyaṃ tena śreyo mahadbhavet || sarvapāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā dātā yāti śivālayam || 38 || śrāddhe gṛhasthā bhoktavyāḥ kulīnā vedapāragāḥ || akrodhanāḥ snānaśīlāḥ svadeśācāratatparāḥ || 39 || āmaṃtrya pūrvadivase nirīhā api ye dvijāḥ || alolupā vyādhihīnā na tu ye grāmayājinaḥ || 7.2.13.40 || teṣāṃ puraḥ pradātavyaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ vidhānataḥ || śrāddhaṃ śraddhāvihīnena kṛtamapyakṛtaṃ bhavet || 41 || tasmācchraddhānvitaiḥ śrāddhaṃ karttavyaṃ krodhavarjitaiḥ || vānaprastho brahmacārī pathikastīrthasevakaḥ || 42 || atithirvaiśvadevāṃte sa pūjyaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi || sarvadā yatayaḥ pūjyāḥ svaśaktyā gṛhamedhibhiḥ || 43 || yātrāvidhimatho vakṣye setihāsaṃ nṛpottama || 44 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye tīrthayātrāvidhivarṇane śrāddhadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 13 || || cha ||
<7.2.14>
|| sārasvata uvāca || || vastrāpathe mahākṣetre nagare vāmane purā || putraśokābhisaṃtapto vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 1 || ājagāma tapastaptuṃ svarṇarekhānadītaṭe || īśānakoṇe nagarātsvarṇarekhānadījale || 2 || snātvā dhyātvā śivaṃ devaṃ manasā'cintayadyadā || tadā rudraḥ samāyātastrinetro vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || maharṣe tava tuṣṭo'haṃ kiṃ karomi vadasva tat || 3 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva varo deyo mamādhunā || tadā'tra bhavatā stheyaṃ yāvadācaṃdratārakam || 4 || atra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti ye narāḥ pāpakarmiṇaḥ || teṣāṃ pāpakṣayo deva kartavyo bhavatā sadā || 5 || narā ye pāpakarmāṇaḥ pūjayaṃti trilocanam || tānnarānnaya deveśa vimānaiḥ śivamaṃdiram || 6 || || sārasvata uvāca || || tathetyuktā haro devastatraivāṃtara dhīyata || hiraṇyakaśipuṃ hatvā narasiṃho mahābalaḥ || trailokyamiṃdrāya dadau kālarudraṃ svayaṃ yayau || 7 || tadanvaye balirjātaḥ sa cātīva balā dhikaḥ || ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ baliścakre balādhikaḥ || akṛṣṭapacyā sujalā dharitrī sasyaśālinī || 8 || gandhavaṃti ca puṣpāṇi rasavaṃti phalāni ca || āskandhaphalino vṛkṣāḥ puṭake puṭake madhu || 9 || caturvedā dvijāḥ sarve kṣatriyā yuddhakovidāḥ || goṣu sevāparā vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ śuśrūṣaṇe ratāḥ || || 7.2.14.10 || sadācārā janapadā ītivyādhivivarjitāḥ || hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāḥ sarve sadānaṃdāḥ sadodyatāḥ || 11 || kuṃkumāguruliptāṃgāḥ suveṣāḥ sādhumaṃḍitāḥ || dāridryaduḥkhamaraṇairvimuktāścirajīvinaḥ || 12 || dīpoddyotitabhūbhāgā rātrāvapi yathā dine || vicaraṃti tathā martyā devā devālaye yathā || || 13 || pṛthivyāṃ svargarūpāyāṃ rājyaṃ cakre'suro baliḥ || nityaṃ vivāhavāditrairnāditaṃ bhūpamaṃdiram || 14 || dharitrīṃ bubhuje daityo devarājo yathā divi || devendro balinā nityaṃ yajñaiḥ saṃtoṣitastadā || 15 || devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca nāsti yuddhaṃ parasparam || eka eva mahīpālo yuddhaṃ nāsti dharātale || 16 || sapatnakakalirnāma nāsti yuddhaṃ harergajaiḥ || na sarppanakulairnityaṃ na biḍālaiśca mūṣakaiḥ || 17 || maitrībhāvaṃ gataṃ sarvaṃ jagatsthāvara jaṃgamam || trailokyabhramaṇaṃ kṛtvā nārado naṃdane vane || 18 || gato na paśyate yuddhaṃ trailokye sacarācare || tāvattasyodare pīḍā mahatī samajāyata || 19 || na me snānādinā kāryaṃ tarppaṇaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || japahomādinā sarvamanyathā mama ceṣṭitam || 7.2.14.20 || tatsnānaṃ yatra yudhyante gajā daṃtavighaṭṭanaiḥ || sā saṃdhyā yatra nihataiḥ kabandhairbhūrvibhūṣitā || 21 || kuṃtaghātavinirbhinnagajakumbhodbhavāsṛjā || tṛpyaṃti yatra kravyādāstarpaṇaṃ tanmama priyam || 22 || gajaśīrṣairagamyāste nihatāḥ kṣatriyā raṇe || sa homo yatra hūyaṃte gajāśca narapuṃgavāḥ || 23 || śabdāgnau nāradasyāyaṃ homastrai lokyaviśrutaḥ || chinnapādaśirohastairaṃtarāṃtravilabitaiḥ || 24 || yadarcyate bhūmitalaṃ tanme nityaṃ surārcanam || kiṃ devairdivi me kāryaṃ kiṃ manuṣyairdharātale || 25 || pannagaiḥ kiṃ tu pātāle na yudhyante parasparam || tathā kariṣye devendrādupendrācca dharātale || 26 || rasātalaṃ baliryātu satyamastu vaco mama || jīvitenāpi rājyena yadā dāmodaraṃ harim || 27 || toṣayiṣyati yatnena tadendro'sau bhaviṣyati || devendro vṛtrahā bhūtvā bhraṣṭarājyo bhaviṣyati || 28 || yadā vastrāpathe gatvā bhavaṃ bhāvena pūjayet || surādhipastadā bhūyo brahmahatyāvivarjitaḥ || 29 || anena mantrajāpyena sa śāṃtodarave danaḥ || nārado devarājasya samīpaṃ sahasā yayau || 7.2.14.30 || siṃhāsanaṃ samāruhya nandane saṃsthito hariḥ || āste parivṛto deverdevarājo mahābalaḥ || || 31 || nirīkṣamāṇo nṛtyantīṃ raṃbhāṃ tāṃ surasundarīm|| āyāṃtaṃ dadṛśe devo nāradaṃ vismayānvitaḥ || 32 || aho viruddho bhagavānnārado mayi dṛśyate || nṛtyate kiṃ na vā nṛtye gīyate kiṃ na gīyate || 33 || vādyatāṃ tālamānaiḥ kiṃ yāvacciṃtāparo hariḥ || ṛṣiḥ samāgatastāvajjalābhyukṣaṇata tparaḥ || 34 || siṃhāsanaṃ parityajya samutthāyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || svāgatenābhivādyātha babhāṣe nāradaṃ hariḥ || 32 || maharṣe svāgataṃ te'dya kuto vā''ga myate tvayā || snāne saṃdhyārcane home kuśalaṃ tava vidyate || 36 || iti prokto vihasyātha babhāṣe nārado harim || yadyetajjāyate mahyaṃ kimanyena prayojanam || 37|| prekṣaṇīkasya te sthānaṃ nāhaṃ paśyāmi svarpate || yāvadrājyaṃ balestāvattvayā me na prayojanam || 38 || ādityādyā grahāḥ sarve kāla mānena yojitāḥ || āhutyā plāvitā meghā varṣaṃti hṛṣitā bhuvi ||39|| rogādimaraṇaṃ nāsti yamo dharmeṇa pīḍitaḥ ||7.2.14.40|| ekātapatrāṃ pṛthivīṃ bubhuje sa narādhipaḥ || trailokyanātheti mahānṛpeti saṃgrāmavidyākuśaleti nityam || trailokyalakṣmīkucakāmuketi saṃstūyate cāraṇabaṃdivṛndaiḥ |41|| brahmeti kṛṣṇeti hareti bhūmāviṃdreti sūryeti dhanādhipeti || devārinātheti surādhipeti jegīyate cāraṇabaṃdivṛndaiḥ || 42 || yuddhaṃ vinā daityagaṇā hasaṃti mattāḥ pramattāḥ kariṇo nadaṃti || rathādhirūḍhāḥ puruṣā bhramaṃti senādhipā strīṣu gṛhe ramaṃti||43|| yajñāgnidhūmena nabho virājate suvarṇarūpā pṛthivī virājate|| śūnyaṃ tu vedairbhuvanaṃ ca śobhate dhiṣṇyaṃ balerdairtyaigaṇaiśca śobhate || 44 || balirna jānāti surādhipaṃ tvāṃ surāśca sarve baliyajñabhojinaḥ || tvameva te'riṃ hṛdi ciṃtaya svayaṃ yuktaṃ tavedaṃ kathitaṃ mayeti || 45 || raṃbhā na rājate raṃge menakā tvāṃ na manyate || tilottamāpi manute balirājaṃ sureśvaram || 46 || urvaśī caiva taṃ yāti sukeśā saha bhāṣate || mañjughoṣā mukhaṃ vaktraṃ kṛtvā tvāṃ na nirīkṣate || 47 || pulomā pulakodbhedaṃ na karoti baliṃ vinā || paulomī purato gatvā baliṃ stauti ca maṃtharā || 48 || nāradaḥ parvataścaiva hāhā hūhūśca tuṃburuḥ || balirājyaṃ praśaṃsaṃti rudrasyāgre mayā śrutam || || 49 || ājyāhutībhiḥ santuṣṭā ṛṣayo brahmasadmani || brahmaṇo'gre praśaṃsaṃti tadevaṃ kathitaṃ mayā || 7.2.14.50 || bṛhaspatiryadācaṣṭe na tadvācyaṃ mayā tava || iṃdrāṇī balinaṃ matvā baliṃ citreṣu paśyati || 51 || anena vākyena surādhipastu cacāla kopāvaritastadānīm || gajeti vajreti jagāda sūtaṃ samānayāsiṃ kavacaṃ rathaṃ ca || 52 || rathena sūryo maruto gajena vṛṣeṇa rudro mahiṣeṇa sauriḥ || vādyaṃtu vādyāni raṇāya me'dya caṇḍī gaṇeśāstvaritāḥ prayātu || 53 || dṛṣṭvā surendraṃ saṃkruddhaṃ bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ || ṛṣimadhye gato vidvānbabhāṣe samayocitam || 54 || sāmādyā nītayaḥ proktāścatasro manunā purā || sāmasādhyeṣu kāryeṣu daṇḍastena na pātyatām || 55 || ato hyupendrmāhūya maṃtrayantu surottamāḥ || tadadhīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 56 || vinaṣṭeṣu ca kāryeṣu tasya vācyaṃ śubhāśubham || sa eva prathamaṃ gacchetpṛthivyāṃ svārthasiddhaye || 57 || tatheti devairvijñaptastathā cakre sureśvaraḥ || mandare'tha girau viṣṇuḥ satyalokātsamāgataḥ || 58 || ṛṣayastatra te yāṃtu samānetuṃ janārddanam || ityukto nāradaḥ svargātsnātuṃ prāptaḥ sa mandare || 59 || gautamo'trirbharadvājo viśvāmitro'tha kaśyapaḥ || jamadagnirvasiṣṭhaśca saṃprāptā harimandire || 7.2.14.60 || girau gaṃgā jale snānaṃ saṃdhyāṃ cakre sa nāradaḥ || yāvadāste tadā hṛṣṭā vālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ || 61 || vinayenābhivādyātha kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ || ṛṣayo mandare prāptā viṣṇuṃ netuṃ surālaye || 62 || ṛṣayo darśanaṃ karttuṃ bhavatāmapi yujyate || tadetadvacanaṃ śrutvā harṣitāste maharṣayaḥ || 63 || aṃguṣṭhaparvamātrāṃstānvāmanānharimandire|| gatāngaṃgājale snātuṃ vālakhilyānpuro hariḥ|| 64|| jahāsa vāmanānsarvānbhāvikāryabalāttataḥ|| brahmaputrā vālakhilyāḥ sarve te śaṃsitavratāḥ || 65 || lajjānvitāḥ krodhaparā uccairūcuḥ parasparam || kenāpi devakāryeṇa vāmano'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || 66 || ṛṣibhirvi ṣṇunā sarve pratibodhya prasāditāḥ || bhāgyamokṣaḥ kadā viṣṇorbhaviṣyati taducyatām ||67|| prabhāsādadhikaṃ kṣetraṃ yadā vastrāpathaṃ bhavet || bhaviṣyati tadā vṛddhirdhruvamaṇḍalavyāpinī || tathā vastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhaviṣyati yavādhikam || 68 || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ doṣamukto bhaviṣyati || asādhyasādhanī śaktirbhaviṣyati sthirā tava || 69 || vastrāpathe somanāthaṃ yaḥ paśyati sa paśyati || indropendrau samāliṃgyāthāsīnau tau varāsane || 7.2.14.70 || || || viṣṇuruvāca || || kiṃ te kāryaṃ devarāja tadavaśyaṃ karomyaham || 71 || || indra uvāca || || hiraṇyakaśiporvaṃśe balirdaityo mahā balaḥ || tenedaṃ sakalaṃ vyāptaṃ devā yajñabhujaḥ kṛtāḥ || 72 || devaloke bhūmiloko gataḥ sarvo'pi keśava || yāvanno vikṛtiṃ yāti pūrvavairamanusmaran || bhraṣṭarājyo balistāvatpātālamadhitiṣṭhatu || 73 || sūryasomānvaye kaścidrājā bhavatu bhūtale || 74 || || sārasvata uvāca || || ityetadvacanaṃ śrutvā svayaṃ saṃcintya cetasā || tathā kariṣye taṃ procya munīnprāha janārdanaḥ || 75 || ṛṣayastatra gacchaṃtu kārayantu mahāmakham || ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi sādhayiṣyāmi taṃ balim || 76 || ityuktā munayaḥ sarve gatāste yajñamaṇḍape || dvādaśāho mahāyajñaḥ prārabdhaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ || 77 || surāṣṭradeśaṃ vikhyātaṃ kṣetraṃ vastrāpathaṃ nṛpa || tasya dakṣiṇadigbhāge baleḥ siddhaṃ mahāpuram || 78 || kṣetrādbahiḥ samārabdho yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ || śukreṇāmantritāḥ sarve munayo yajñakarmaṇi || atihṛṣṭo baliryajñe dadau dānānyanekadhā || 79 || svarṇapātreṣu sarveṣu dīyate bhojanaṃ bahu || atithirbrāhmaṇo vidvānsarvasvenāpi pūjyate || dānādyajño bhavetpūrṇo dānahīno vṛthā bhavet || 7.2.14.80 || etasminneva kāle tu viṣṇurvāmanatāṃ gataḥ || madhyadeśe caturvedo brāhmaṇastīrthayātrikaḥ || mahodaro hrasvabhujaḥ khañjapādo mahāśirāḥ || 81 || mahāhanuḥ sthūlajaṃghaḥ sthūlagrīvo'tilaṃpaṭaḥ || śvetavastro baddhaśikhaśchatropānatkamaṇḍalūn || 82 || draṣṭuṃ tīrthānyanekāni babhrāma sa mahītale || surāṣṭradeśe saṃprāptaḥ kṣetre vastrāpathe dvijaḥ || 83 || svarṇarekhā nadītīre ciṃtayāmāsa vāmanaḥ || prathamaṃ kiṃ bhavaṃ dṛṣṭvā yāmi someśvaraṃ śivam || 84 || atha someśvaraṃ pūjya paścādyāsyāmi mandaram || iti cintāparo bhūtvā kṛtyaṃ sañcintya cetasā || atra sthitaḥ somanāthaṃ pūjayiṣyāmi niścitam || 85 || vastrāpathe mahākṣetre bhavaṃ someśvaraṃ vṛthā || pūjayaṃti janā nityaṃ tathā kāryaṃ mayā dhuvam || 86 || deśānāmuttamo deśo girīṇāmuttamo giriḥ || kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ nadīnāmuttamā sarit || 87 || divyaṃ vanaṃ vanānāṃ tu devānāmuttamo bhavaḥ || yadā someśvaro devo bhūmiṃ bhittvā bhaviṣyati || 88 || tadāmramaṇḍale divyaṃ kṣetrametadyavādhikam || caitra śuklacaturdaśyāmagnisādhanatatparaḥ || 89 || ūrdhvabāhuḥ sūryakāle bhavaṃ tāvatsa paśyati || madhyaṃdinaṃ paraṃ yāte dinanāthe vilaṃbite || 7.2.14.90 || agni tāpāṃgasaṃtaptastāvatpaśyati śaṃkaram || somanāthaṃ śivaṃ śāṃtaṃ sarvadevanamaskṛtam || arghyeṇa puṣpamiśreṇa jalamiśreṇa bhāmini || 91 || || || sārasvata uvāca || || bhūmiṃ bhittvātha deveśaḥ svayaṃ someśvaraḥ sthitaḥ || liṃgarūpo mahādevo yāvadābrahmavāsaram || 92 || || someśvara uvāca || || siddhastvaṃ matprasādena kāryaṃ siddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || ityukto vāmano devaṃ pratyuvāca maheśvaram || 93 || || vāmana uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva yadi deyo varo mama || tadā'tra liṃge sthātavyamastu divyaṃ puro mama || 94 || yastu svāyaṃbhuvaṃ liṃgaṃ vāmane nagare mama || pūjayiṣyati brahmaghno goghno vā bālaghātakaḥ || 95 || gurudrohī svarṇacoro mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || nirdoṣaḥ pūjayedyastu sakṛtsomeśvaraṃ haram || 96 || mṛto vimānamāruhya divyastrīpariveṣṭitaḥ || saṃstūyamāno dikpālairyātu svarge śivālaye || 97 || brahmalokamatikramya rudraloke sa gacchatu || tathetyuktvā somanāthastatraivāntaradhīyata || 98 || prakāśya vāmano ligaṃ somanāthaṃ svayaṃbhuvam || prāptajñāno labdhavṛddhiryayau draṣṭuṃ bhavaṃ haram || 99 || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ svarṇarekhājale sthitāḥ || etāṃ someśvarotpattiṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti narāḥ striyaḥ || sarvapāpakṣayasteṣāṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ ||7.2.14.100 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye someśvarotpattivarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || || cha ||
<7.2.15>
|| sārasvata uvāca || || athāsau vāmano vipro labdhajñāno bhavārcane || jagāma tadvanaṃ ramyaṃ gire raivatakasya yat || 1 || yatra vṛkṣā bahuvidhā dīrghaśākhāḥ phalānvitāḥ || vaṭodumbarabilvāśca sarjārjunakadaṃbakāḥ || 2 || palāśāśvatthaniṃbāśca dhavāṭīvāruṇīdrumāḥ || śamīkaṃkolaliṃbāṃśca bījapūrī ca dāḍimaḥ ||3|| badarī niṃbakaḥ pūgaḥ kadalī śallakī śivā|| tālahiṃtālaśirasā bījakāvaṃśakhādirāḥ ||4|| ajagāsanagāgucchā iṃgudīkoraveṃgudāḥ || brahmavṛkṣāḥ kurubakāḥ karaṃjāḥ putrajīvinaḥ|| || 5 || aṃkollāḥ pāribhadrāśca kalaṃbāḥ panasāstathā || ujjvalāśca haridrāśca gaṃgaḍīvāyavā drumāḥ || 6 || tesuṇḍakāḥ śirīṣāśca kharjūrīkaravaṃdikāḥ|| sevālī śālmalī śālā madhūkāśca vibhītakāḥ ||7|| harītakyaḥ kaṭāhāśca karyaṣṭā āṭarūṣakāḥ || vikacchavaḥ kapitthāśca rohiṇīvetrakadrumāḥ ||8|| madanaphalānirguṇḍīpāṭalānaṃdipādapāḥ || lavaṃgailālavalyaśca santānā agarudrumāḥ || 9 || śrīkhaṇḍakarpūranagāḥ kalpavṛkṣā nagotamāḥ || vāmanena tadā dṛṣṭāśchāyāvṛkṣāḥ surārcitāḥ || 7.2.15.10 || udayāstamane yeṣāṃ chāyā na pratihanyate || teṣāṃ darśanamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 11 || ye janāḥ puṇyakarmāṇasteṣāṃ te dṛṣṭigocarāḥ || etānpaśyanyayau vṛkṣāṃstato raivatakaṃ girim || 12 || yāvannirīkṣate tuṃgaṃ śikharaṃ tasya mūrddhani || āścaryaṃ dadṛśe vipro mahallokabhayaṃkaram || 13 || dhūmajvalanamadhyasthānpuruṣānpaṃca paśyati || kṛṣṇāṃgānkhecarānraudrānkṛṣṇāguruvibhūṣitān || 14 || sārameya samārūḍhānkarihastānsamekhalān || khaṅgakheṭakahastāṃśca ḍamaruḍḍāmarasvanān|||35| saghargharīkacaraṇanyāsanāditaparvatān || phetkārabhāsurākārānkāśakuñcitamūrddhajān || 16 || naramāṃsavasāsārakavalavyagratālukān || janagaṃdhasamājñānabhavatīvravilocanān || 17 || pañcāgnisādhanāvyāptadivyacakṣuḥ prabhāvataḥ || devānpaśyati viprendro jñātakāryaparaṃparaḥ || 18 || ete kṣetrādhipāḥ pañca mahādevena nirmitāḥ || mahābalā raivatake nivasaṃti girau sadā || || 19 || svecchācārānnarānmarttyānvārayati nage tathā || hariṃ haraṃ nadīṃ devīṃ na paśyaṃti giriṃ yathā || 7.2.15.20 || dṛṣṭvā jñātvā stutiṃ cakre dhyātvā devaṃ maheśvaram || jayaṃti duṣṭadaityeṃdrayuddhadhyānāṃkitaṃ vapuḥ || bibhrati bhrātaro ye te paṃceṃdrasamavikramāḥ || 21 || rudravaktrodbhavā dakṣā dakṣādhvaravināśakāḥ || svāvalīḍhāhutīnaṣṭabhītavāḍavanaṃditāḥ ||22 || kuṅkumāgarukarpūraliptāṃgāḥ suvibhūṣitāḥ || madirāmodamattāṃganṛtyagītakarāḥ surāḥ||23|| brahmāṃḍabhramaṇaśrāṃta svagaṃdhatrastasaṃcarāḥ || manojavāḥ kāmagamā kṣetrapālā jayaṃti te || 24 || ityādivacanāttuṣṭā dvijasyāgre svayaṃ sthitāḥ || ekapādo'smyahaṃ caiko dvitīyo giridāruṇaḥ || 25 || tṛtīyo meghanādastu siṃhanādaścaturthakaḥ || paṃcamaḥ kālamegho'haṃ kurmaḥ kiṃ te vadasva tat || 26 || || || || dvija uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭā bhavaṃto me yadi deyo varo dhuvam || aho āpralayaṃ yāvatsthātavyaṃ matpratiṣṭhitaiḥ || 27 || ekapādo giri taṭe praharṣātprathamaṃ sthitaḥ || vasatau vasatā tena girau ca giridāruṇaḥ || 28 || pratiṣṭhitaḥ prasādyātha varado'sau svayaṃ sthitaḥ || ujjayaṃtagirermūrdhni meghanādaḥ svayaṃ yayau || 29 || bhavānīśaṃkaraṃ ramyaṃ siṃhanādastathāviśat || svayaṃ vastrāpathenaiva bhavasyāgre nirūpitaḥ || 7.2.15.30 || svaṇarekhānadītīre kālamegho mahābalaḥ || sarvalokopakārārthaṃ tīrthaṃ saṃsthāpitaṃ purā || 31 || vāmanena svayaṃ gatvā kṣetrapālāstu pūjitāḥ || purā yugādau rājeṃdra sarve devāḥ samāgatāḥ || 32 || surāṣṭradeśe saṃprāptāḥ puṇye raivatake girau || rakṣārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ vadhārthaṃ devavairiṇām || 33 || viṣṇoḥ kaṇṭhe tadā muktā jayamālā surottamaiḥ || dāmodareti vikhyātaṃ dattaṃ nāmottamaṃ hareḥ || 34 || tatrādau kārtike śukle vāsare viṣṇuvallabhe || upoṣya sahite devaistattīrthaṃ viṣṇunā kṛtam || 35 || sarvatīrthamayī puṇyā svarṇarekhā nadī sthitā || bhuktimuktipradaṃ puṇyaṃ viṣṇulokapradāyakam || 36 || kṣālanaṃ sarvapāpānāṃ rogadāridryanāśanam || dāmodaraṃ raivatake paramānaṃdadāyakam || 37 || ye paśyaṃti vimānaiste nīyaṃte viṣṇumaṃdire || na gṛhe kārtikaḥ kāryo viśeṣādbhīṣmapaṃcakam|| 38 || paṃcakāddvādaśī śreṣṭhā kāryā dāmodare jale || prātaḥsnānaṃ prakarttavyaṃ saṃprāpte kārtike janaiḥ || 39|| māsopavāsaḥ karttavyo yatibhirbrahmacāribhiḥ || satībhirvidhavābhiśca muktisthānamabhīpsubhiḥ || 7.2.15.40 || ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca || upavāsevana kṛcchreṇa śākāhāreṇa vā punaḥ || 41 || saṃsevyaḥ kārttike viṣṇurdīpadānaparairnaraiḥ || brahmacaryaparairmāso nīyate yadi mānavaiḥ || 42 || tadā viṣṇupure vāsaḥ kriyate viṣṇunā saha || pañcopavāsāḥ karttavyāḥ saṃprāpte bhīṣmapaṃcake || 43 || ekādaśīṃ samārabhya paṃcamī pūrṇimādinam|| tadetatpaṃcakaṃ proktaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām|| 44 || sarveṣāmapi māsānāṃ pañcakātkārtikādapi || ekādaśī kārtikasya puṇyā dāmodare kṛtā || 45 || miṣṭānnaṃ kārtike deyaṃ haviṣyaṃ saghṛtaplutam|| suvarṇaṃ rajataṃ vastraṃ toyamannaṃ phalāni ca || 46 || māsāṃte vividhaṃ deyaṃ gaustilāḥ kusumāni ca || sarvadāneṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarva tīrtheṣu yatphalam|| 47 || aśvamedhādibhiryajñairgayāyāṃ piṃḍadasya yat || tatphalaṃ jāyate nṝṇāṃ dṛṣṭe dāmodare nṛpa || 48 || ekādaśyāṃ kṛtasnāno deva pūjāparo bhavet || snāpya pañcāmṛtenaiva tatastīrthodakena ca || 49 || kuṃkumāgaruśrīkhaṃḍakarpūrodakamiśritaiḥ || pūjayitvā tataḥ puṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugaṃ dhibhiḥ || 7.2.15.50 || mālatīkusumaiḥ śubhrairbahubhistulasīdalaiḥ || vastrayajñopavītaṃ ca dattvā dhūpaṃ pradhūpayet||51|| dīpaṃ dadyāddhṛtenaiva tailenāpi ghṛtaṃ vinā|| naivedyaṃ vividhaṃ deyaṃ phalaṃ tāṃbūlameva ca || 52 || prāsādapūjā karttavyā dhvajadānādinā nṛpa || gauḥ savatsā tato deyā saṃsārārṇavatāriṇī || 53 || tataḥ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā gītavāditranisvanaiḥ || vedapāṭhapurāṇaiśca vyākhyādivyakathādibhiḥ || 54 || devāgre jāgaraḥ kāryo dīpo deyoṃ'tibhūmiṣu || saptadhānyamayāḥ sapta parvatā dīpasaṃyutāḥ || 55 || phalatāṃbūlapakvānnapūritāḥ parikalpitāḥ || vidvadbhiḥ śrotriyaiḥ śrāṃtairbrāhmaṇairgṛhamedhibhiḥ || 56 || strībhiśca naraśārdūla śrotavyā vaiṣṇavī kathā || evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ rāgakrodhavivarjitaiḥ || 57 || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrāvudite sūryamaḍale || pūrvāṃ saṃdhyāṃ tataḥ snātvā kṛtvā madhyāhnamācaret||58|| devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca saṃtarpya vidhipūrvakam|| kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tu dadyāddānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ|| 59|| devaṃ dāmodaraṃ pūjya puṣpadhūpādinā punaḥ || narasiṃhaṃ suraṃ pūjya vainateyaṃ ca pūjayet || 7.2.15.60 || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ rātrāvutthāpya madhusūdanam || dvādaśībhuktimāsādya kāryaṃ pāraṇakaṃ naraiḥ || 61 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca sahitaḥ putrabāṃdhavaiḥ || vikalāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ deyamannaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 62 || dāmodare raivatake svarṇarekhānadījale || evaṃ yaḥ kurute yātrāṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 63 || brahmaghnaśca surāpaśca grāmasīmāvilopakaḥ || rājadrohī gurudrohī mithyāvratadharaśca yaḥ || 64 || kūṭasākṣyaprado yaśca yaśca nyāsāpahārakaḥ || bālastrīghātako vipraḥ saṃdhyāsnānavivarjitaḥ || 65 || devabrahma svaharttā ca vedavikrayakārakaḥ || kanyāvikrayakarttā ca devabrāhmaṇaniṃdakaḥ ||66|| viśvāsaghātako vipraḥ śūdrānnādo'tha lubdhakaḥ || nāyakaḥ paradārāṇāṃ svayaṃdattāpahārakaḥ || 67 || parvamaithunasevī ca tathā vai setubhedakaḥ || pariṇītāmṛtusnātāṃ svayaṃ yo nābhigacchati || 68 || brāhmaṇī vidhavā bālā na bhavecchrutadhāriṇī || mahāpātakinaścaite tathānye bahavo nṛpa || 69 || svarṇarekhājale snātvā dṛṣṭvā dāmodaraṃ harim || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 7.2.15.70 || na tu ye pāpakarmāṇaḥ samāyātāḥ prajāgare || saṃsārasāgare tīrthe gacchaṃti na hareḥ puram || 71 || yathā yathā yāti naraḥ prajāgare tathātathā viṣṇupure viciṃtyate || vāsaḥ surairvaiṣṇavalokahetave mṛdaṃgagītadhvaninādite gṛhe || 72 || gadāsi śaṃkhāridharāścaturbhujā daiteyadarpāpaharūpadhāriṇaḥ || pragīyamānāḥ surasuṃdarībhiste yāṃti khaṃ khecaragātrasaṃgāḥ || 73 || vārāhakalpe prathamaṃ yugādau dāmodaro raivatake prasiddhaḥ || saiṣā nadī yā saritāṃ variṣṭhā so'yaṃ hariryo bhuvanasya kartā || 74 || idaṃ purāṇaṃ paṭhate śṛṇoti naro vimānairmadhusūda nālaye || devāṃganādattabhujaścaturbhujaḥ sa nīyate devagaṇairabhiṣṭutaḥ || 75 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye sārasvataproktatīrthayātrāvidhāne śrīdāmodaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||15||
<7.2.16>
|| rājovāca || athāsau vāmano vipraḥ praviṣṭo gahane vane || ekākī kiṃ cakārātha kautukaṃ tadvadasva me || 1 || || sārasvata uvāca || || athāsau vāmano vipro gatvā raivatake girau || svarṇarekhānadītoye snātvātha vidhipūrvakam || 2 || sugaṃdhapuṣpadhūpādyairdevaṃ saṃpūjya bhaktitaḥ || tasthau tadagrato rājannekākī nirjane vane ||3 || sarvasattvasamāyukte sarīsṛpasamākule|| anekasvarasaṃghuṣṭe mayūradhvaninādite || 4 || kokilārāvaramye ca vanakukkuṭaghoṣite || khadyotadyotite tasminvalīmukhavidhūnite ||5|| kvacidvaṃśāgninā śāṃte kvacitpuṣpitapādape || gaganāsaktaviṭape sūryatāpavivarjite ||6|| lubdhakāghāta saṃtrastabhrāṃtasūkaraśaṃbare || saṃhṛṣṭakṣatriyavātasthānadānavicakṣaṇe || 7|| anekāścaryasaṃpannaṃ sasmāra manasā harim || taṃ bhītamiva vijñāya narasiṃhaḥ samāyayau || 8 || rakṣārthaṃ tasya viprasya babhāṣe purataḥ sthitaḥ || na bhetavyaṃ tvayā vipra vada te kiṃ karomyaham || 9 || || vipra uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo varo deyo narasiṃha tvayā mama || sadātra rakṣā karttavyā sarveṣāṃ tīrthavāsinām ||7.2.16.10 || devasyāgre sadā stheyaṃ yāvadiṃdrāścaturddaśa || evamastviti taṃ procya tathā cakre haristadā || 11 || ato dāmodarasyāgre narasiṃhaḥ sa pūjyate || vanaṃ saumyaṃ kṛtaṃ tena tīrtharakṣāṃ karoti saḥ || 12 || bhūtapretādisaṃvāso vane tasminna jāyate || narasiṃhaprabhāvena naṣṭaṃ siṃhādijaṃ bhayam || 13|| kārttike vāsare viṣṇordvādaśyāṃ pāraṇe kṛte || dāmodaraṃ namaskṛtya bhavaṃ draṣṭuṃ tato yayau || 14 || caturdaśyāṃ kṛtasnāno bhavaṃ saṃpūjya bhāvataḥ || bhavabhāvabhavaṃ pāpaṃ bhasmībhūtaṃ bhavārcanāt || 15|| sa kṣīṇapāpanicayo jāto devasya darśanāt || bhavasyāgre sthitaṃ śāṃtaṃ tathā vastrāpathasya ca || 16|| taṃ kālameghaṃ samabhyarcya tato vastrāpathaṃ yayau || devaṃ saṃpūjya maṃtraiḥ sa vedoktairvidhipūrvakam || 17 || dhūpadīpādinaivedyaiḥ sarvaṃ cakre sa vāmanaḥ || pradakṣiṇāśataṃ kṛtvā bhavasyāgre vyavasthitaḥ || 18 || yāvannirīkṣate sarvaṃ tāvatpaśyati parvatam || ujjayaṃtaṃ girivaraṃ mainākasya sahodaram || 19 || surāṣṭradeśe vikhyātaṃ yugādau prathamaṃ sthitam || bhūdharaṃ bhūdharairyuktaṃ śilāpādapamaṃḍitam || 7.2.16.20 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā ciṃtayāmāsa sūkṣmāndharmānsa vāmanaḥ || alpāyāsānsubahulānputralakṣmīpradāyakān || 21 || avaśyaṃ kriya māṇeṣu svadharma upajāyate || dṛṣṭvā nadīṃ sāgaragāṃ snātvā pāpaiḥ pramucyate || 22 || gāṃ spṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ natvā saṃpūjya gurudevatāḥ || tapasvinaṃ yatiṃ śāṃtaṃ śrotriyaṃ brahmacāriṇam || 23 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ bhaginīṃ tatpatiṃ duhitāṃ patim || bhāgineyamatha dauhitraṃ mitrasaṃbadhibāṃdhavān || saṃbhojya pātakaiḥ sarvairmucyaṃte gṛhamedhinaḥ || 24 || rājā gajāśvanakulaṃ satīvṛṣamahīdharāḥ || ādarśakṣīravṛkṣāśca satatānnapradāstu te || 25 || dṛṣṭamātrāḥ punantyete ye nityaṃ satyavādinaḥ || vedadharmakathāṃ śrutvā bhuktimuktipradā narān ||26|| smṛtvā hariharau gaṃgāṃ kṛtvā tīreṇa mārjanam || gatvā jāgaraṇe viṣṇordattvā dānaṃ ca śaktitaḥ || 27|| tāṃbūlaṃ kusumaṃ dīpaṃ naivedyaṃ tulasīdalam || gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ ca vādyaṃ ca vidhāya suramaṃdire || 28 || ete sūkṣmāḥ smṛtā dharmāḥ kriyamāṇā mahodayāḥ || ato girīndraṃ paśyāmi sarvadevālayaṃ śubham ||29 || teṣāṃ karatale svargaḥ śikharaṃ yāṃti ye narāḥ || 7.2.16.30|| iti jñātvā samā rūḍho vāmano girimūrddhani || airāvatapadākrāṃtyā yatra toyaṃ viniḥsṛtam ||31|| tataḥ śikharamārūḍhāṃ bhavānīṃ skandamātaram || draṣṭuṃ sa vāmano yāti śikhare gaganāśrite || 32 || yathāyathā girivare samārohaṃti mānavāḥ || tathātathā vimucyaṃte pātakaiḥ sarvadehinaḥ || 33 || iti kṛtvā matiṃ vipro jagāma girimūrddhani || bhavabhakto bhavānīṃ sa dadarśa skandamātaram ||34|| aṃbeti bhāṣate skaṃdastato'nye sarvadevatāḥ || pṛthivyāṃ mānavāḥ sarve pātāle sarvapannagāḥ || 35 || ato hyaṃbeti vikhyātā pūjyate girimūrddhani || saṃpūjya vividhairmukhyaiḥ phalairnānāvidhairdvijaḥ || 36 || gaganāsaktaśikhare saṃsthitaḥ kautukānvitaḥ || ekākī śikhare tasminnūrddhvabāhurvyavasthitaḥ ||37|| nirīkṣya medinīṃ sarvāṃ saparvatasasāgarām|| ādyaṃ sanātanaṃ devaṃ bhāskaraṃ triguṇātmakam ||38|| sarvatejomayaṃ sarvadevaṃ devairnamaskṛtam || bhramamāṇaṃ nirādhāraṃ kālamānaprayojakam ||39|| yāvatpaśyati taṃ viprastāvatpaśyati śaṃkaram || digaṃbaraṃ bhavaṃ devaṃ samaṃtādaśmaguṃṭhitam || 7.2.16.40 || buddharūpākṛtiṃ devaṃ sarvajñaṃ guṇabhūṣitam || kṛśāṃgaṃ jaṭilaṃ saumyaṃ vyomamārge svayaṃ sthitam || 41 || || || śrīśiva uvāca || || śṛṇu vāmana tuṣṭo'haṃ dāsye te vividhānvarān || trailokyavyāpinī vṛddhirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 42 || pratibhāsyaṃti te vedā gītanṛtyādikaṃ ca yat || asādhyasādhanī śakti bhaviṣyati tava sthirā || paraṃ vastrāpathe gatvā kuru tīrthāvalokanam || 43 || || vāmana uvāca || || vastrāpathe mahādeva yāni tīrthāni tāni me || vada deva viśeṣeṇa yadyasti karuṇā mayi ||44|| || rudra uvāca || || vastrāpathasya vāyavye koṇe divyaṃ sarovaram || tasya paścimadigbhāge jālirgahanapallavā || 45 || bilvavṛkṣamayī madhye liṃgaṃ tatrāsti mṛnmayam || yatrāsau lubdhakaḥ siddho gato mama pure purā || 46 || tasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyā vinaśyati || iṃdro vai vṛtrahā yasminvimukto brahmahatyayā || 47 || tasmādruttaradigbhāge dhanadena pratiṣṭhitam || liṃgaṃ trailokyavikhyātaṃ tatra devī triśūlinī || 48 || yasyā darśanamātreṇa putro'sya nalakūbara|| pāśānuṣaktahasto'bhūddevaṃ cakre triśūlinam || 49 || bhavasya nairṛte koṇe gaṇo heraṃbasaṃjñitaḥ || yamena kurvatā liṃgaṃ prathamaṃ ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 7.2.16.50 || vicitraṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ citragupto'ti vismitaḥ || dṛṣṭvā samāgato draṣṭuṃ devaṃ taṃ mṛnmayaṃ purā || 51 || tenāpi nirmitaṃ liṃgaṃ tasminkṣetre dvijottama || citragupteśvaraṃnāma vikhyātaṃ bhuvana traye || 52 || paścimena cakāroccaiḥ prajāpatirudāradhīḥ || kedārākhyaṃ tadā liṃgaṃ girau raivatake sthitam || prajāpatiḥ svayaṃ tasthau tatra parvatasānuni || 53 || || rudra uvāca || || iṃdreśvarasya māhātmyaṃ kathayiṣye śṛṇuṣva tat || īśānakoṇe vikhyātaṃ bhavasya viditaṃ mama || 54 || ||vāmana uvāca || || kasmādiṃdraḥ samāyātaḥ kathaṃ cakre haraṃ hariḥ|| kathāṃ savistarāmetāṃ kathayasva mama prabho || 55 || || rudra uvāca || || lubdhakastu purā siddhaḥ śivarātriprajāgarāt || śivaloke tadā prāptaṃ vimānaṃ gaṇasaṃyutam || 56 || sarvatragaṃ suruciraṃ divyastrīgītanāditam || tadāruhya samāyāto draṣṭuṃ tāṃ nagarīṃ hareḥ || 57 || yasyāṃ yuddhaṃ samabhavadgaṇānāṃ yamakiṃkaraiḥ || āgacchamānaṃ taṃ jñātvā devarājena ciṃtitam || 58 || pūjyo'yaṃ haravatsarvaiścitraguptayamādibhiḥ || iṃdro gajaṃ samāruhya mahiṣeṇa yamo yataḥ || 59 || vidhāya lekhanīṃ karṇe citragupto yamājñayā || tato hūtā gaṇāḥ sarve ye nītā dharaṇītalāt || 7.2.16.60 || nijāparādhasaṃtaptā gatāste dakṣiṇāmukham || āthityapū jā kartavyā lubdhake gṛhamāgate || 61 || apūjite gate hyasminharo māṃ śapayiṣyati || tasmātpūjāṃ kariṣyāmi yathā tuṣyati śaṃkaraḥ || 62 || devaṃ draṣṭuṃ samāyātaṃ dadarśādūrataḥ sthitam|| vimānasthaṃ harākāraṃ sūryakoṭisamaprabham || 63 || saṃstūyamānaṃ caritaiḥ śivarātreḥ śivasya ca || māghe māse caturddaśyāṃ kṛṣṇāyāṃ jāgare kṛte ||64|| tadevaṃ jāyate sarvaṃ sureśvara dharātale || evaṃ devāṃganā kācidācakṣaṃtī puraṃdaram || nivārya hastamudyamya gajeṃdraṃ cārulocanā || 65 || kiṃ dānairbahubhirdattairvrataiḥ kiṃ kiṃ surārcanaiḥ || kiṃ yogaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiśca brahmacaryyaiḥ sureśvara || 66 || gayāyāṃ piṃḍadānena prayāgamaraṇena kim || someśvare sarasvatyāṃ somaparvaṇi kiṃ gataiḥ || 67 || kurukṣetragataiḥ kiṃ syādrāhugraste divākare || tulāsuvarṇadānena vedapāṭhena kiṃ bhavet ||68|| sarvapāpakṣayo yena vṛṣotsargeṇa tena kim || godānaṃ kiṃ karotyevaṃ jaladānaṃ tathaiva ca || 69 || ayane viṣuve caiva saṃkrāṃtau kīdṛśaṃ phalam || māghamāse caturdaśyāṃ yādṛśaṃ jāgare kṛte || 7.2.16.70 || yamaḥ saṃbhāṣate vāṇyā mahiṣopari saṃsthitaḥ || paśya rudrasya māhātmyaṃ citragupta vicāraya || 71 || ayaṃ sa lubdhako yena haraḥ saṃpūjitaḥ purā || surāṣṭradeśe vikhyātaṃ tīrthaṃ vastrāpathaṃ śṛṇu || 72 || ujjayaṃto giristatra tathā raivatako giriḥ || mahatī varttate jālistayormadhye mayā śrutam || 73 || mṛnmayaṃ vartate ligaṃ rātrau cānena pūjitaḥ || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ karttuṃ yena kāryeṇa cāgataḥ || 74 || tadasmābhiḥ kathaṃ vācyaṃ svayaṃ jānaṃti te surāḥ || varāṃganā varaṃ draṣṭuṃ varayaṃti parasparam || iṃdrāvāsātsamāyātā naṃdane vegavattarāḥ || 75 || viraṃcinā rāyaṇaśaṃkaratviṣā dehena cāgacchati ko'pi pūruṣaḥ || purīṃ sureśādhipaternirīkṣituṃ bharttā mamāyaṃ tava cāsti kiṃ patiḥ || 76 || mṛdaṃgavīṇā paṭahasvarastutaiḥ pravodhitābhiḥ surarājamandire || devo haro'yaṃ na naro harākṛtirdṛṣṭoṃganābhistava kiṃ kimāvayoḥ || 77 || gāyaṃti kāścidvihasaṃti kāścinnṛtyaṃti kāścitprapaṭhaṃti kāścit || vadanti kāścijjayaśabdasaṃyutairvākyairanekairgurusannidhāne || 78 || kācicchivaṃ stauti śivāṃ tathānyā pṛcchatyathānyā kimu bilvapatrāt || kiṃ vopavāsena phalaṃ tavedaṃ nidrākṣayeṇātha phalaṃ tavaitat || 79 || tāsāṃ nānāvidhā vācaḥ śrūyante nandane vane || brahmalokādikā vārttāḥ kṛtvā ca tadanantaram || 7.2.16.80 || devendro lubdhakaṃ bhūyo babhāṣe kautukānvitaḥ|| kasmindeśe girau jālirliṃgaṃ yatrāsti darśaya || 81 || || lubdhaka uvāca || || surāṣṭradeśe vikhyāto yasmindeśe sarasvatī || vāḍavaṃ śirasā dhṛtvā praviṣṭā lavaṇodadhau || 82 || yatra sā gomatī yāti yatrāste gandhamādanaḥ || ujjayaṃto girivaro yatra raivatako giriḥ || 83 || tatra vastrāpathaṃ kṣetraṃ bhavastatra vyavasthitaḥ || tatrāste mṛnmayaṃ liṃgaṃ jālimadhye surottama || 84 || || indra uvāca || || sahitaistatra gaṃtavyaṃ pūjayiṣye bhavaṃ svayam || jālimadhye tathā liṃgaṃ darśayasva ca lubdhaka || 85 || paradārādikaṃ pāpaṃ daityānāṃ tu vikṛṃtane || vadhe vṛtrasya saṃjātaṃ tatsarvaṃ kṣālayāmyaham || 86 || ityuktvā sahitāḥ sarve saṃprāptā girimūrddhani|| vāhanāni ca te tyaktvā prasthitāḥ pādacāriṇaḥ || 87 || ujjayantagirermūrdhni gajarājaḥ samāgataḥ || tadāgracaraṇaṃ tasya dadau mūrdhani kāraṇāt || 88 || tenākrānto girivarastoyaṃ susrāva nirmalam || gajapādodbhavaṃ vāri bhaviṣyati sadā sthiram || 89 || iti proktaṃ surendreṇa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā || sarve samāgatāstatra yatra jālirvyavasthitā || 7.2.16.90 || saṃpūjya vividhaiḥ puṣpairmāghamāse
