caturdaśī || tasyāṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā sañjāto nirmalo hariḥ || 91 || vastrāpathe bhavaṃ pūjya hariṃ raivatake girau || indreśvaraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya saṃprāptaḥ svanikatanam|| 92 || lubdhako'pi vimānena saṃprāpto harimandire || ityuktvā sa bhavo devastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 93 || vāmanopi tataścakre tatra tīrthāvagāhanam || yādṛgrūpaḥ śivo dṛṣṭaḥ sūryabiṃbe digaṃbaraḥ || 94 || padmāsanasthitaḥ saumyastathā taṃ tatra saṃsmaran || pratiṣṭhāpya mahāmūrttiṃ pūjayāmāsa vāsaram || 95 || mano'bhīṣṭārthasiddhyarthaṃ tataḥ siddhimavāptavān || nemināthaśivetyevaṃ nāma cakre sa vāmanaḥ || 96|| bhavasya paścime bhāge pratyāsanne dharātale || vāmano vasatiṃ cakre tīrthe vastrāpathe tadā || 97 || ato yavādhikaṃ proktaṃ tīrthaṃ devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || iṃdreṇa kurvatā devaṃ samāgatya bhavāgrataḥ || 98 || yavādhikaṃ prabhāsāttu tīrthametadbhavājñayā || anyeṣāṃ ṣaḍguṇaṃ tīrthaṃ bhaviṣyati śivājñayā || 99 || ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ kimanyatparipṛcchasi || 7.2.16.100 || || || rājovāca || || śivarātriprabhāvoyamatulaḥ parikīrttitaḥ || ajānatā kṛtā tena lubdhakena purā śrutam || 101 || idānīṃ vada karttavyā kathamanyairjanairvibho || kiṃ grāhyaṃ kiṃ nu moktavyaṃ śivarātryāṃ vadasva me || 102 || || sārasvata uvāca || || saṃprāpya mānuṣaṃ janma jñātvā devaṃ maheśvaram || śivarātriḥ sadā kāryā bhuktimuktipradāyinī || 103 || īdṛśaṃ jāyate puṇyamekayā kṛtayā nṛpa || ye kurvaṃti sadā marttyāsteṣāṃ puṇyamanaṃtakam ||104 || dvādaśābdaṃ vratamidaṃ karttavyaṃ prativatsaram|| jīvitaṃ caṃcalaṃ nṛṇāṃ yadi kartuṃ na śakyate || 105 || tadā dvādaśabhirmāsairvrata metatsamāpyate || māghamāse caturdaśyāṃ prārambhaḥ kriyate nṛpa || 106 || pratimāsaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ pauṣāṃte tu samāpyate || vighnaścejjāyate madhye kathaṃ ciddaivayogataḥ || 107 || na bhavedvratabhaṃgastu punaḥ kāryamanantaram || dvādaśaiva prakartavyāḥ kṛtvā saṃkhyā viśeṣataḥ || 108 || kṛtaṃ na naśyate loke śubhaṃ vā yadi vā'śubham || kṛṣṇāyāṃ tu caturdaśyāṃ kṛtapūrvāhnikakriyaḥ || 109 || upavāsaniyamo grāhyo nadyāṃ snānaṃ vidhīyate || tadabhāve taḍāgādau kāryaṃ snānaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 7.2.16.110 || tailābhyaṃgo na karttavyo na kāryaṃ gamanaṃ kvacit || tīrthasevā prakarttavyā tasmiṃścāgamanaṃ śubham || 111 || śivarātriḥ sadā kāryā liṃge svāyaṃbhuve naraiḥ || tadabhāve mahāpuṇye liṃge varṣaśatādhike || 112 || girau vane samudrāṃte nadyāṃ yacca śivālaye || tadvai svāyaṃbhuvaṃ liṃgaṃ svayaṃ tatraiva saṃsthitam || 113 || vāluliṃgādikaṃ liṃgaṃ pūjitaṃ phaladaṃ smṛtam || divā saṃpūjya yatnena puṣpadhūpādinā naraḥ || 114 || varjayenmadirāṃ dyūtaṃ nārīṃ nakhanikṛntanam || brahmacaryaparaiḥ śāṃtaiḥ karttavyaṃ samupoṣaṇam || 115 || rātrau devāgrato gatvā karttavyāḥ sapta parvatāḥ || pakvānnaphalatāṃbūlapuṣpadhūpādicarcitāḥ || 116 || ghṛtena dīpaḥ karttavyaḥ pāpanāśanahetave || yato dīpasya māhātmyaṃ vijñeyaṃ muktidāyakam || 117 || dīpaḥ sadaiva karttavyo gṛhe devālaye naraiḥ || divā niśi ca saṃdhyāyāṃ dīpaḥ kāryaḥ svaśaktitaḥ || 118 || kiñciduddyotamātreṇa devāstuṣyaṃti bhūtale || pitṝṇāṃ prathamaṃ dīpaḥ karttavyaḥ śrāddhakarmaṇi || 119 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ yathā nidrā na jā yate || śivarātriprabhāvo'yaṃ śrotavyaḥ śivasaṃnidhau || 7.2.16.120 || śivasya caritaṃ rātrau śrotavyaṃ bahuvistaram || gītaṃ nṛtyaṃ tathā vādyaṃ kartavyaṃ śivasaṃnidhau || 121 || evaṃ sā nīyate rātrirmukhyaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ yataḥ || rātrau deyāni dānāni śaktyā vai tatra jāgare || 122 || punaḥ snātvā prabhāte tu karttavyaṃ śivapūjanam || pūjanīyāśca yatayo bhojanācchādanādibhiḥ || 123 || tapasvināṃ pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhibhiḥ || dvādaśāṣṭau ca catvāro bhoktavyā eka eva vā || 124 || eko'pi brahmacārī yo brahmavicchivapūjakaḥ || sahasrāṇāṃ samo bhaktyā gṛhe saṃbhojito bhavet || 125 ||| akṣārālavaṇaṃ patre bhoktavyaṃ vāgyataiḥ svayam || putramitrakalatrāṇāṃ dātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ puraḥ || 126 || anena vidhinā kāryā śivarātriḥ śivavrataiḥ || dvādaśaitā yadā pūrṇāstilapātrāṇi vai tadā || 127 || dvādaśaiva pradeyānigurubrāhmaṇajñātiṣu || vratāṃte gauḥ pradātavyā kṛṣṇā vatsayutā dṛḍhā ||128|| savastrābharaṇā deyā ghaṃṭābharaṇabhūṣitā || aṃgulīyakavāsāṃsi cchatropānatkamaṇḍalu || 129 || gurave dakṣiṇā deyābrāhmaṇebhyaḥ svaśaktitaḥ || evaṃ kṛtvā tato deyaṃ tapasvibhyo'tha bhojanam || miṣṭānnaṃ vividhaṃ dattvā kṣamāpya ca visarjayet || 7.2.16.130 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute satyaṃ tasya pāpaṃ na vidyate || saṃtānamuttamaṃ labdhvā bhuktvā bhogānanuttamān|| 131 || divyavimānamārūḍho divyastrīpariveṣṭitaḥ || gativāditranirghoṣairnīyate śivamandire||132|| tadetatkathitaṃ puṇyaṃ śivarātrivrataṃ mayā || kṛtena yena lokānāṃ sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 133 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye śivarātrimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 ||
<7.2.17>
|| rājovāca || || vicitramidamākhyānaṃ tvatprasādācchrutaṃ mayā || dṛṣṭvā nārāyaṇaṃ śakraṃ nārado maṃdare girau || 1 || kiṃ cakāra munīṃdro'tha tanme vistarato mune || vada saṃsārasaraṇodbhūtamāyāprapīḍitam || kathāmṛtajalaughena vitṛṣaṃ kuru māṃ prabho || 2 || || sārasvata uvāca || || athāsau nārado devaṃ jñātvā śaptaṃ dvijanmanā || bhṛguṇā ca tathā pūrvaṃ nānyathaitadbhaviṣyati || 3 || bhaviṣyaṃ yadbhavaṃ deva vartamānaṃ viciṃtyatām || ayaṃ ca vāmano bhūtvā viṣṇuryāsyati tāṃ purīm || 4 || nigrahaṃ sa baleḥ paścātkariṣyati mama priyam || yuddhaṃ vinā kathaṃ stheyaṃ vartamānaṃ maholbaṇam || 5 || devadānavayuddhāni daityagandharva rakṣasām || nivāritāni sarvāṇi sarīsṛpapatatriṇām || 6 || sāpatnajaḥ kalirnāsti mama bhāgyaparikṣaye || devendro guruṇā pūrvaṃ vāritaḥ kiṃ karomyaham || 7 || mānanīyo gururme'yamatastaṃ na śapāmyaham || yuddhārthaṃ tu tato yatno na sidhyati karomi kim || 8 || kenāpi daivayogena puruṣārtho na sidhyati || tathāpi yatnaḥ kartavyaḥ puruṣārthe vipaścitā || daivaṃ puruṣakāreṇa vināpi phalati kvacit || 9 || yaduktaṃ tadvaco vyarthaṃ yataḥ siddhiḥ prayatnataḥ || baliṃ gatvā bhaṇiṣyāmi yathā yuddhaṃ kariṣyati || 7.2.17.10 || na śroṣyati sa cedvākyaṃ niścitaṃ taṃ śapāmyaham || ityuktvā sa yayau vegānnārado balimaṃdire || nimeṣāṃtaramātreṇa śiṣyābhyāṃ gagane sthitaḥ || 11 || prāsāde śailasaṃkāśe saptabhaume mahojjvale || tasyopari sabhā divyā nirmitā viśvakarmaṇā || 12 || tasyāṃ siṃhāsanaṃ divyaṃ tatrāsīno balirnṛpa || daityaiḥ parivṛtaḥ sarvaiḥ prauḍhihāsyakathāparaiḥ || 13 || ṛṣibhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ śāṃtaista thaivośanasā svayam|| putramitrakalatraiśca saṃvṛto divyamandire || 14 || devāṃganākaragrāhagṛhītairdivyacāmaraiḥ || saṃvījyamāno daityendraḥ stūyamānaḥ sa cāraṇaiḥ || 15 || yāvadāste madonmattā mantrayaṃti parasparam || daityadānavamukhyā ye te sarve yuddhakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 16 || utthāyotthāya bhāṣaṃte pragalbhaṃte suraiḥ saha || asmadīyamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sāṃprataṃ gatam || 17 || śukrabuddhyā vinā yuddhaṃ prāpsyate kiṃ mahodayaḥ || daityendro devarājena snehaṃ ca kuruto yadi || 18 || airāvaṇaṃ sadā mattaṃ kathaṃ no yācate baliḥ || caturaṃ turagaṃ kasmānnārpayati divākaraḥ || 19 || yāvannākramyate lubdho dhanādhyakṣo raṇājire || tāvannārpayate vittaṃ yadā tatsaṃcitaṃ suraiḥ || 7.2.17.20 || na darśayati ratnāni jalarāśī rasātalāt || yāvanna mandaraṃ kṣiptvā vimathnīmo vayaṃ ca tam || 21 || yathāmṛtakalāścandrādbhujyante kramaśaḥ suraiḥ || evaṃ bhāgaṃ baleḥ kasmānna dadāti jalātmakaḥ || 22 || svardhunī śītalo vātaḥ padmarkijalkavāsitaḥ || svarge vāti śanairyadvattathā na balimaṃdire || 23 || indracāpodyatā meghā jalaṃ muṃcaṃti bhūtale|| balikhaṅgoddhutāḥ svargaṃ punaste yāṃti bhūtalāt||24|| asmadīye dharāpṛṣṭhe yamo mārayate janam || naivaṃ svarge na pātāle paśyāho kāryakāraṇam ||25|| āyurvṛttiṃ sutānsaukhyamasmākaṃ likhati svayam || lalāṭe citragupto'sau na devānāṃ tu tatsamam ||26|| varṣāśītātapāḥ kālā vartaṃte bhuvi sāṃpratam || na svarge naiva pātāle bhītā bhūmau bhramaṃti hi || 27 || ekavīryodbhavā yūyaṃ svasrīyā devadānavāḥ || bhūmau sthitā vayaṃ kasmāddevāḥ kenoparikṛtāḥ || ||28|| samudre mathyamāne tu daityendro vaṃcitaḥ suraiḥ || ekataḥ sarvadevāśca baliścaivaikataḥ sthitaḥ ||29|| utpanneṣu ca ratneṣu bhāgyaṃ vai yasya yādṛśam || gajāśvakalpavṛkṣādyāścaṃdragogaṇadaṃtinaḥ ||7.2.17.30|| gṛhītvā hyamṛtaṃ devairvayaṃ pāne niyojitāḥ || etayā cūrṇitā yūyaṃ na jānīthātigarvitāḥ || 31 || pītāvaśeṣaṃ pīyūṣaṃ satyaloke dhṛtaṃ suraiḥ || ahotikuṭilā devāḥ kasmāccheṣaṃ na dīyate || 32 || surāmṛtamiti jñātvā pīyūṣādvaṃcitā vayam || tilatailamevamiṣṭaṃ yairna dṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtaṃ kvacit|| 33 || viṣṇorvakracaritrāṇāṃ saṃkhyā kartu na śakyate|| tathāpi kathyate tuṣṭairhṛṣṭaistairyadanuṣṭhitam ||34|| gaurāṃgī sundarī subhrūḥ pīnonnatapayodharā || sukeśā caṃdravadanā karṇāsaktavilocanā||35|| valitrayāṃkitā madhye bālā muṣṭyāpi gṛhyate || sthalāraviṃdacaraṇā lateva bhujabhūṣitā || 36 || sā sarvābharaṇopetā sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutā || trailokyamohinī devī saṃjātā'mṛtamanthane || 37 || amṛtādutthitā pūrvaṃ yasya sā tasya taddhruvam || trailokyaṃ vaśagaṃ tasya yasya sā cārulocanā || 38 || tayā saṃmohitāḥ sarve devadānavarākṣasāḥ || vimucya manthanaṃ sarve tāṃ grahītuṃ samudyatāḥ || 39 || ekā strī bahavo devā dānavādaityarākṣasāḥ || vivādaḥ sumahāñjātaḥ kathamatra bhaviṣyati || 7.2.17.40 || āgatya viṣṇunā sarve bhuje dhṛtvā nivāritāḥ || asyārthe kimaho vādaḥ kriyate bhoḥ parasparam || 41 || amṛtārthe samārambho mahilārthe vinaśyati || saṃketaṃ prathamaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇunā cuṃbitā punaḥ || 42 || divyarūpadharaḥ sragvī vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || kaustubhoddyotitatanuḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ ||43|| tasyā haste śubhāṃ mālāṃ dattvā viṣṇuḥ puraḥ sthitaḥ || uddhṛtya bāhuṃ sarveṣāṃ babhāṣe vacanaṃ hariḥ || 44 || kurvaṃtu kuṇḍalaṃ sarve tiṣṭhantu svayamāsane || vilokya svecchayā lakṣmīrvaramālāṃ prayacchatu || 45 || svayaṃvaravibhedaṃ yaḥ kariṣyatyatilaṃpaṭaḥ || sa vadhyaḥ sahitaiḥ sarvaiḥ parastrīlubdhako yathā || 46 || paradārakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ strīvadhyā tasya jāyatām|| anyo'pi yaḥ karotyevamevamastu taducyatām||47|| sādhāraṇaṃ hariṃ jñātvā tathetyuktvā tathā kṛtam|| devadānavadaityānāṃ gaṃdharvoragarakṣasām|| madhye yo'bhimato bhartā sa te satyaṃ bhavediti ||48 || tenāsau mohitā pūrvaṃ dṛṣṭidānena karṣitā || ādyaṃ saṃmohanaṃ strīṇāṃ cakre dṛṣṭinirīkṣaṇam||49|| evameveti tatkarṇe hastaṃ dattvā yaducyate|| dadhāti hṛdi yaṃ nārī kāmabāṇaprapīḍitā || 7.2.17.50 || tameva varayedatra kaścinnāstyeva saṃśayaḥ || saṃjāte kalahe pūrvaṃ hariṇā taṃ nivartitum || 51 || yadā gṛhītā sarvaiḥ sā hariṃ naiva vimuṃcati || tvameva bhartā sā''caṣṭe muṃca māṃ vraja dūrataḥ || 52 || muktvā dūraṃ tato viṣṇuḥ praviṣṭaḥ suramaṇḍale || tadā sarve ca māmuktvā yathāsthānaṃ svayaṃ gatāḥ ||53|| ācaṣṭa vijayā pūrvaṃ sarvāndevānyathākramam|| sā ca nirīkṣate paścāttaṃ vicārya vimuñcati || 54 || udāsīnaḥ śivaḥ śāṃto gaurīkāṃtastrilocanaḥ || nānyāṃ nirīkṣate nityaṃ dhyānāsaktastrilocanaḥ || 55 || pitāmahoyamityuktaṃ yadā sakhyā tadā tayā || namaskṛtya gataṃ dūre kṛtvā maunaṃ na paśyati || 56 || ādityaṃ padmakaṃ muñca dahanaṃ dahanātmakam|| vāti vāto gatā dūre varuṇo me pitā yataḥ || 57 || paulomīvadanāsakto devendro me na rocate || 58 || vadhabaṃdhakṛtacchedabhedadaṇḍavikarṣa ṇam|| kurvanna kurute saumyaṃ rūpaṃ vaivasvato yamaḥ || 59 || devadānavagaṃdharvadaityapannagarākṣasān || 7.2.17.60 || dṛṣṭvātyugrāṃstato yāti dṛṣṭo'sau puruṣo ttamaḥ || karṇāṃtalocanabhrāṃtavaktraṃ dṛṣṭyāvalokya tam || 61 || saubhāgyātiśayākrāṃtaṃ ramyaṃ kāmamanoharam || saṃjātapulakodbhedasvedavārikaṇāṃkitam || || 62 || devadānavadaityendrakrodhadṛṣṭinirīkṣitam || ramyaṃ rāmā varaṃ cakre dadau mālāṃ tataḥ svayam||63|| daityāḥ parasparaṃ procuḥ prekṣya tatsuraceṣṭitam || vibhāgaṃ paśya devānāṃ svarge sarve svayaṃ gatāḥ|| 64|| pātālasya tale yūyaṃ mānavā dharaṇītale|| devāstribhuvane yāṃtu na vayaṃ svargagāminaḥ|| 65|| mānavāḥ kṣatriyā rājyaṃ kurvaṃtu pṛthivītale|| pātālaṃ tu parityajya dhātrī yadi tu rakṣyate|| 66|| daityadānavajaiḥ kaiścidrākṣasaistanna śobhanam|| atha kiṃ bahunoktena rājā tribhuvane baliḥ||67|| saṃvibhajyātha ratnāni samaṃ rājyaṃ vidhīyatām|| yāvadevaṃ pragalbhaṃte tāvatpaśyaṃti nāradam || 68 || gaganātsamupāyāṃtaṃ dvitīyamiva bhāskaram || brahmadaṃḍakarāsaktayuddhapustakadhāriṇam || 69 || kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ chatravīṇākamaṇḍalūn || mauṃjīguṇatrayāsaktagraṃthipravaramekhalam || 7.2.17.70 || brahmarūpadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ divyarudrākṣabhūṣitam || gata kalpakṛtagraṃthisūtramālāvalaṃbitam || 71 || viraṃciharasaṃvādo janmāhaṃkāragarvitaḥ || saṃkruddhaiḥ kriyate ko'dya ciṃtātatparamānasam || || 72 || āyātaṃ nāradaṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ samupasthitāḥ || prabho prasādaḥ kriyatāmāgaṃtavyaṃ gṛhe mama || 73 || dhanyo'haṃ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ yasya me tvaṃ gṛhāgataḥ || ityukto balinā vipro viveśāsuramaṃdire || āsanaṃ pādyamarghyaṃ ca dattvā saṃpūjito dvijaḥ || 74 || praviśya sahitāḥ sarve saṃviṣṭā daityadānavāḥ || śukreṇa sahito daityo babhāṣe nāradaṃ baliḥ || 75 || idaṃ rājyamime dārā ime putrā ahaṃ baliḥ || brūhi yenātra te kāryaṃ dānaṃ me prathamaṃ vratam || 76 || || nārada uvāca || || bhaktyā tuṣyaṃti ye viprāste viprā bhūmidevatāḥ || na tu ye pūjitāḥ śaktyā punaryācaṃti te'dhamāḥ|| | || 77 || tvayā'haṃ pūjito hṛṣṭo na vittairme prayojanam || hṛṣṭo'haṃ tava rājyena yajñairdānairvrataistathā || 78. || devaiḥ kṛtaṃ vipriyaṃ te kiṃcitpaśyāmyahaṃ bale || tvayā saṃpūjyamāno'pi devarājo na tuṣyati || 79 || na kṣamaṃti surāḥ sarve tava rājyaṃ dharātale || svarge me tāpako jāto devānāṃ tava vigrahe || || 7.2.17.80 || saṃnahya prathamaṃ yāti yaḥ sainyaṃ śatrubhūmiṣu || sa kṣatriyo vijayate tasya rājyaṃ ca vardhate ||81|| ucchedastava rājyasya bhaviṣyati śrutaṃ mayā || evaṃ jñātvā yathāyuktaṃ tacchīghraṃ tu vidhīyatām || 82 || || baliruvāca || || yairguṇaiḥ kurute rājyaṃ rājā tānvada me vibho || dānaṃ pātre pradātavyaṃ mayā tvamapi taṃ vada || 83 || || nārada uvāca || || ṣaḍviṃśadguṇasaṃpanno rājā rājyaṃ karoti ca || sa rājyaphalamāpnoti śṛṇu tatkathayāmyaham || 84 || careddharmānakaṭuko muṃcetsnehamanāstike || anṛśaṃsaścaredarthaṃ caretkāmamanuddhataḥ ||85|| priyaṃ brūyādakṛpaṇaḥ śūraḥ syādavikatthanaḥ || dātā cā''yāmavarjaḥ syātpragalbhaḥ syādaniṣṭhuraḥ || 86 || saṃdadhīta na cānāryānvigṛhṇīyānna baṃdhubhiḥ || nānāptaiścārayeccārānkuryātkāryamapīḍayan ||87|| arthānbrūyānna cāpatsu guṇānbrūyānna cātmanaḥ || ādadyānna ca sādhubhyo nāsatpuruṣamāśrayet || 88 || nāparīkṣya nayeddaṇḍaṃ na ca maṃtraṃ prakāśayet || visṛjenna ca lubdhebhyo viśvasennāpakāriṣu || 89 || āptaiḥ suguptadāraḥ syādrakṣyaścānyo ghṛṇī nṛpaḥ || striyaṃ seveta nātyarthaṃ mṛṣṭaṃ bhuṃjīta nā'hitam || 7.2.17.90 || asteyaḥ pūjayenmānyānguruṃ sevedamāyayā || arcyo devo na dambhena śriyamicchedakutsitām || 91 || seveta praṇayaṃ kṛtvā dakṣaḥ syādatha kālavit || sāṃtvavākyaṃ sadā vācyamanugṛhṇanna cākṣipet|| 92 || praharenna ca viprāya hatvā śatrūnna śeṣayet || krodhaṃ kuryānna cākasmānmṛduḥ syānnāpakāriṣu || 93 || evaṃ rājye ciraṃ stheyaṃ yadi śreya ihecchasi || tapaḥsvādhyāyadānāni tīrthayātrā''śramāṇi ca || 94 || yogenātmaprabodhasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || tvayā saṃsāravairāgyaṃ karttavyaṃ viprapūjanam ||95|| yaṣṭavyaṃ vividhairyajñairdhyeyo nārāyaṇo hariḥ || prasaṃgena samāyāto yāsye raivatake girau || 96 || tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurnadī trailokyapāvanī || tatrāste ca śivāvṛkṣo bahupuṣpaphalānvitaḥ || tatra gatvā kariṣyāmi vrataṃ tadviṣṇuvallabham || 97 || || baliruvāca || || ko'yaṃ raivatakonāma vrataṃ kiṃ viṣṇuvallabham || śivāvṛkṣāstu ke proktāstatkathaṃ kathayasva me || 98 || || || nārada uvāca || || purā yugādau daityendra sapakṣāḥ parvatāḥ kṛtāḥ || saṃciṃtya brahmaṇā paścādacalāste kṛtāḥ punaḥ || 99 || utpataṃti mahākāyā nipataṃti yadṛcchayā || merumaṃdarakailāsā vacasā saṃsthitāḥ sthirāḥ || 7.2.17.100 || vāritā na sthitā ye tu ta iṃdreṇa sthirīkṛtāḥ || merordakṣiṇa śṛṃge tu kumudeti sa parvataḥ || 101 || divyaḥ sapakṣaḥ sauvarṇo divyavṛkṣaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || tasyopari purī divyā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇunā kṛtā || 102 || tasyā madhye gṛhaṃ divyaṃ yasmillam̐kṣmīḥ sadā sthitā || meroḥ śṛṃge purī ramyā gṛhaṃ tatra manoramam || 103 || tatrāste sa bhavo devo bhavānī yatra saṃsthitā || sabhā māheśvarī ramyā sauvarṇī ratnamaṃḍitā || 104 || tatrāste bhagavānviṣṇurdevairbrahmādibhirvṛtaḥ || tasyāṃ viṣṇuḥ sadā yāti devaṃ draṣṭuṃ maheśvaram || 105 || sauvarṇaiḥ kumudairyasmādasau sarvatra maṃḍitaḥ || kumudeti kṛtaṃ nāma devaistatra samāgataiḥ || 106 || ekadā bhagavānrudro girau tasminsamāgataḥ || draṣṭuṃ tacchikhare ramye tāṃ purīṃ viṣṇupālitām || 107 || gṛhāgataṃ haraṃ dṛṣṭvā hariṇā sa tu pūjitaḥ || lakṣmyā saṃpūjitā gaurī harṣitā tatra saṃsthitā || 108 || ekāsanopaviṣṭau tau maṃtrayaṃtau parasparam || hareṇa kāraṇaṃ jñātvā tatsarvaṃ kathitaṃ hareḥ || 109 || tvayeyaṃ nagarī kāryā maṃdare parvatottame || praṣṭavyaḥ kāraṇaṃ nāhamavaśyaṃ tadbhaviṣyati || 7.2.17.110 || hara eva vijānāti kāraṇaṃ katamo'pi na || evaṃ tatheti tau proktvā saṃsthitau parvato'pi saḥ || 111 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā saṃgataṃ rudraṃ kumudaḥ svayamāyayau || dhanyo'haṃ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ yasya me gṛhamāgatau || 112 || dvābhyāmukto girivaro dadāva kiṃ varaṃ tava || ityuktaḥ parvatastābhyāṃ varaṃ vavre sa mūḍhadhīḥ || 113 || bhaviṣyatkāryahetutvādbhaviṣyati na tadvṛthā || yatrāhaṃ tatra vastavyaṃ bhavadbhyāmastu me varaḥ || 114 || matsannidhau samāgatya sthātavyaṃ brahmavāsaram || tathetyuktvā sapatnīkau gatau hariharāvubhau || 116 || pañcamo yo manuḥ pūrvaṃ raivato nāma viśrutaḥ || tasyotpattau tu yadvṛttaṃ kumudāgre śṛṇuṣva tat || 116 || ṛṣirāsīnmahābhāga ṛtavāgiti viśrutaḥ || tasyāputrasya putro'bhūdrevatyante mahātmanaḥ || 117 || sa tasya vidhivaccakre jātakarmādikāḥ kriyāḥ || tathopanayanādyāśca sa cāśīlo'bhavannṛpa || 118 || yataḥ prabhṛti jāto'sau tataḥ prabhṛtyasāvṛṣiḥ || dīrgharogaparāmarśamavāpātīva durddharam || 119 ||| mātā cāsya parāmārtiṃ kuṣṭharogābhipīḍitā || jagāma cintāṃ sa ṛṣiḥ kimetaditi duḥkhitaḥ || 7.2.17.120 || mūrkhastu maṃdadhīḥ putro duḥkhaṃ janayate pituḥ || amārgago viśeṣeṇa duḥkhādduḥkhataraṃ hi tat || 121 || aputratā manuṣyāṇāṃ śreyase na kuputratā || suhṛdāṃ nopakārāya pitṝṇāṃ nāpi tṛptaye || 122 || suputro hṛdaye'bhyeti mātāpitrordinedine || pitrorduḥkhāya dhigjanma tasya duṣkṛtakarmaṇaḥ || 123 || dhanyāste tanayā ye syuḥ savarlokābhisaṃmatāḥ || paropakāriṇaḥ śāṃtāḥ sādhukarmaṇyanuvratāḥ || 124 || anirvṛtaṃ nirānaṃdaṃ duḥkhaśokapariplutam || narakāya na svargāya kuputratvaṃ hi janminaḥ || 125 || karoti suhṛdāṃ dainyamahitānāṃ tathā mudam || akāle tu jarāṃ pitroḥ kuputraḥ kurute kila || 126 || || nārada uvāca || evaṃ so'tyantaduṣṭasya putrasya caritairmuniḥ || dahyamānamanovṛttirvṛddhagargamapṛcchata || 127 || || ṛtavāguvāca || || suvratena purā vedā adhītā vidhinā mayā || samāpya vidyā vidhavatkṛto dāraparigrahaḥ || 128 || sadāreṇa hi yāḥ kāryāḥ śrautasmārttādikāḥ kriyāḥ || tāḥ kṛtāśca vidhānena kāmaṃ samanurudhya ca || 129 || putrārthaṃ janitaścāyaṃ puṃnāmno vicyutau mune || so'yaṃ kimātmadoṣeṇa māturdoṣeṇa kiṃ mama || asmadduḥkhāvaho jāto dauḥśīlyādvada kovida || 7.2.17.130 || || garga uvāca || || revatyante muniśreṣṭha jāto'yaṃ tanayastava || tena duḥkhāya te duṣṭe kāle yasmādajāyata || 131 || tavāpacāro naivāsya māturnāpi kulasya ca || anyaddauḥśīlyahetutvaṃ revatyaṃta upāgatam || 132 || revatī aśvinormadhyamāśleṣāmaghayostathā || jyeṣṭhāmūlarkṣayoḥ proktaṃ gaṃḍāṃtaṃ tu bhayāvaham || 133 || gaṃḍatraye tu ye jātā naranārīturaṃgamāḥ || tiṣṭhaṃti na ciraṃ gehe tiṣṭhanto'pi bhayaṃkarāḥ || evamukto'tha gargeṇa cukrodhātīva kopanaḥ || 134 || || ṛtavāguvāca || || yasmānmamaika putrasya revatyante samudbhavaḥ || 135 || revatī kiṃ na jānāti māṃ vipraḥ śāpayiṣyati || jājvalyamānā gaganāttasmātpatatu revatī || 136 || || || nārada uvāca || || tenaivaṃ vyāhṛte vākye revatyṛkṣaṃ papāta ha || paśyataḥ sarvalokasya vismayāviṣṭacetasaḥ || 137 || īśvarecchāprabhāvena patitā girimūrddhani || revatyṛkṣaṃ nipatitaṃ kumudādrau samantataḥ || 138 || surāṣṭradeśe sa prāptaḥ patito bhūtale śubhe || himācalasya putro ya ujjayaṃto girirmahān|| 139 || kumudena samaṃ maitrī kṛtā pūrvaṃ parasparam || yatra tvaṃ sthāsyase sthātā tatrāhamapi niścitam || 7.2.17.140 || iti kṛtvā gṛhītvātha gaṃgāvāri sayāmunam || sārasvataṃ tathā puṇyaṃ siṃcituṃ taṃ samāgataḥ || 141 || āhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatsaṃsthitau tau parasparam || kumudādriśca tatpātātkhyāto raivatako'bhavat || 142 || atīva ramyaḥ sarvasyāṃ pṛthivyāṃ pṛthivīpate || kumudādriśca sauvarṇo revatīcyavanātpunaḥ || 143 || paṃkajābhaḥ sa bāhyena jāto varṇena bhūpate || meruvarṇaḥ sa madhye tu sauvarṇaḥ parvatottamaḥ || 144 || tataḥ sañjanayāmāsa kanyāṃ raivatako giriḥ || revatīkāṃti saṃbhūtāṃ revatīsadṛśānanām|| 145 || pramuco nāma rājarṣistena dṛṣṭā varāṃganā || pitṛvadrevatīnāma kṛtaṃ tasyā nṛpottama || 146 || revatīti ca vikhyātā sā sarvatra varāṃganā || sarvatejomayaṃ sthānaṃ sarvatīrthajalāśrayam || 147 || gaṃgājalapravāhaiśca saṃyuktaṃ yāmunaistathā || sthitaṃ sārasvataṃ toyaṃ tatra garteṣu tattrayam || 148 || vikhyātaṃ revatīkuṃḍaṃ yatra jātā ca revatī || smaraṇāddarśanātsnānātsarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 149 || sā bālā varddhitā tena pramuṃcena mahātmanā || yauvanaṃ tu tayā prāptaṃ tasminraivatake girau || 7.2.17.150 || tāṃ tu yauvanasaṃpannāṃ dṛṣṭvā'tha pramuco muni || ekāṃte cintayāmāsa ko'syā bhartā bhaviṣyati || 151 || hūtvāhūtvā sa papraccha guruṃ vahniṃ dvijottamaḥ || prasādaṃ kuru me brūhi ko'syā bhartā bhaviṣyati || 152 || anyo'syāḥ sadṛśaḥ ko'pi vaṃśe nāsti karomi kim || vahnikuṇḍātsamutthāya proktavānhavyavāhanaḥ || 153 || śṛṇu me vacanaṃ vipra yo'syā bhartā bhaviṣyati || priyavratānvayabhavo mahābalaparākramaḥ || 154 || putro vikramaśīlasya kāliṃdījaṭharodbhavaḥ || durdamo nāma bhavitā bhartā hyasyā mahīpatiḥ || 155 || atrāṃtare samāyāto durdamaḥ sa mahīpatiḥ || girau mṛgavadhākāṃkṣī muniṃ gehe na paśyati || priye'yi tātaḥ kva gata ehi satyaṃ bravīhi me || 156 || || nārada uvāca || || agniśālāsthitenaiva tacchrutaṃ vacanaṃ priyam || priyetyāmantraṇaṃ ko'yaṃ karoti mama veśmani || || 157 || sa dadarśa mahātmānaṃ rājānaṃ durdamaṃ muniḥ || jaharṣa durdamaṃ dṛṣṭvā muniḥ prāha sa gautamam || 158 || śiṣyaṃ vinayasampannamarghyaṃ pādyaṃ samānaya || ekaṃ tāvadayaṃ bhūpaścirakālādupāgataḥ || 159 || jāmātā sāṃprataṃ rājā yogyāsya ca sutā mama || tataḥ sa ciṃtayāmāsa rājā jāmātṛ kāraṇam|| 7.2.17.160 || maunena vidhinā rājā jagṛhe'rghyaṃ dvijājñayā || tamāsanagataṃ vipro gṛhītārghyaṃ mahāmuniḥ || 161 || prastutaṃ prāha rājendraṃ nṛpate kuśalaṃ pure || kośe bale ca mitre ca bhṛtyāmātya prajāsu ca || tathātmani mahābāho yatra sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam || 162 || patnī ca te kuśalinī yā'tra sthāne hi tiṣṭhati || anyāsāṃ kuśalaṃ brūhi yāḥ saṃti tava maṃdire || 163 || || rājovāca || || tvatprasādādakuśalaṃ nāsti rājye kvacinmama || jātakautūhalo'smyasmi mama bhāryā'tra kā mune || 164 || || pramuca uvāca || || revatī te varā bhāryā kiṃ na vetsi nṛpottama || trailokyasundarī yā tu kathaṃ sā vismṛtā tava || 165 || || rājovāca || || subhadrāṃ śāṃtapāpāṃ ca kāverītanayāṃ tathā || sūrātmajānujātāṃ ca kadaṃbāṃ ca varaprajām || 166 || vipāṭhāṃ naṃdinīṃ caiva vedmi bhāryāṃ gṛhe mama || tiṣṭhanti naiva jānāmi bhāryā me revatī kutaḥ |||367 || ṛṣiruvāca || || priyeti sāṃprataṃ proktā revatī sā priyā tava || tadanyathā na bhavitā vacanaṃ nṛpasattama || 168 || || rājovāca || || nāsti bhāvakṛto doṣaḥ kṣamyatāṃ tadvaco mama || vinirgataṃ vacovaktrānnāhaṃ jāne dvijottama || 169 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || nāsti bhāvakṛto doṣaḥ parivedmi kuruṣva tat || vahninā kathitastvaṃ me jāmātādya bhaviṣyasi || 7.2.17.170 || ityādivacanai rājā bhāryā mene sa revatīm || ṛṣistathodyataḥ kartuṃ vivāhaṃ vidhi pūrvakam || uvāca kanyā pitaraṃ kiñcinme śrūyatāṃ pitaḥ || 171 || yadi me patinā tāta vivāhaṃ kartumicchasi || revatyṛkṣaṃ vivāhaṃ me tatkarotu prasādataḥ || 172 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || revatyṛkṣaśca na vai bhadre candrayoge divi sthitam || ṛkṣāṇyanyānyapi saṃti subhrūrvaivāhakāni ca || 173 || || || kanyovāca || || tāta tena vinā kālo vikalaḥ pratibhāti me || vivāho vikale tāta madvidhāyāḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 174| || pramuñca uvāca || || ṛtavāgiti vikhyātastapasvī revatīṃ prati || cakāra kopaṃ kruddhena tenarkṣaṃ tannipātitam || 175 || mayā cāsmai pratijñātā bhāryeti viditaṃ tava || na cecchasi vivāhaṃ tvaṃ saṃkaṭaṃ naḥ samāgatam || 176 || || kanyovāca || || ṛtavāgeva sa muniḥ kimetattaptavānsvayam || na tvayā mama tātena brahmabandhoḥ sutā'smi kim || 177 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || brahmabandhoḥ sutā na tvaṃ tapasvī nāsti me'dhikaḥ || sutā tvaṃ ca mayā deyā nānyatkartuṃ samutsahe || 178 || || kanyovāca || || tapasvī yadi me tātastatkimṛkṣamidaṃ divi || samāropya vivāho me kasmānna kriyate punaḥ || 179 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || evaṃ bhavatu bhadraṃ te bhadre prītimatī bhava || āropayāmīndumārge revatyṛkṣaṃ kṛte tava || 7.2.17.180 || tatastapaḥprabhāvena revatyṛkṣaṃ mahāmuniḥ || yathā pūrvaṃ tathā cakre somayogi dvijottamaḥ || vivāhaṃ duhituḥ kṛtvā jāmātaramuvāca ha || 181 || audvāhikaṃ te bhūpāla kathyatāṃ kiṃ dadāmyaham|| duṣprāpamapi dāsyāmi vidyate me mahattapaḥ || 182 || || rājovāca || || manoḥ svāyaṃbhuvasyāhamutpannaḥ saṃtatau mune || manvaṃtarādhipaṃ putraṃ tvatprasādādvṛṇomyaham || 183 || || ṛṣiruvāca || || bhaviṣyati mahīpālo mahābalaparākramaḥ|| revatī revatīkuṇḍe snātvā putraṃ janiṣyati|| 184|| evaṃ kṛtvā gato rājā sā ca putramajījanat|| raivateti kṛtaṃ nāma babhūva sa manurnṛpaḥ|| 185|| amunā ca tadā proktamasminraivatake girau|| striyaḥ snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti tāsāṃ putrā mahābalāḥ|| dīrghāyuṣo bhaviṣyaṃti duḥkhadāridryavarjitāḥ || 186 || || nārada uvāca || || ityukte parvato rājandīrgho bhūtvā papāta saḥ || etau tau saṃsmṛtau devau sabhāryau hariśaṃkarau || 187 || smṛtamātrau tadā''yātau tena baddhau purā yataḥ || yatrāhaṃ tatra sthātavyaṃ bhavadbhyāmiti niścitam ||188|| ato viṣṇuharau devau sthitau tau parvatottame || girau raivatake ramye svarṇarekhānadījale || ārādhayaddhariṃ devaṃ revatī tāṃ ca sobravīt || 189 || bhavatāccaṃdrayogaste gagane brāhmaṇājñayā || anyadvṛṇīṣva tuṣṭo'haṃ varaṃ manasi yatsthitam || 7.2.17.190 || || revatyuvāca || || girau raivatake deva sthātavyaṃ bhavatā sadā || mayā snānaṃ kṛtaṃ yatra tatra snāsyaṃti ye janāḥ || 191 || teṣāṃ viṣṇupure vāso bhavatviti vṛtaṃ mayā || evamastu tadā procya girau raivatake sthitaḥ || dāmodaraścaturbāhuḥ svayaṃ rudropi saṃsthitaḥ || 192 || gaṃgādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ saṃsthitā viṣṇunā saha || kṣīrode mathyamāne tu yadā vṛkṣaḥ samutthitaḥ || 193 || āmardde devadaityānāṃ tena sāmardakī smṛtā || || asminvṛkṣe sthitā lakṣmīḥ sadā pitṛgṛhe nṛpa || 194 || śivālakṣmīḥ smṛto vṛkṣaḥ sevyate surasattamaiḥ || devairbrahmādibhiḥ sarvairvṛkṣo'sau vaiṣṇavaḥ smṛtaḥ|| 195|| sarvaiḥ saṃciṃtya mukto'sau girau raivatake purā|| asya vṛkṣasya yātrāṃ ye kariṣyaṃti harerdine || 196|| phālgune ca site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama|| teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāśca bhaviṣyaṃti guṇādhikāḥ|| prāṃte viṣṇupure vāso jāyatenātra saṃśayaḥ ||197|| || baliruvāca || || kathametadvrataṃ kāryaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ viṣṇuvallabham || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ vidhinā kena tadvada || 198 || || nārada uvāca || || phālgunasya site pakṣa ekādaśyāmupoṣitaḥ || snātvā nadyāṃ taḍāge vā vāpyāṃ kūpe gṛhe'pi vā || 199 || gatvā girau vane vā'pi yatra sā prāpyate śivā || pūjyā puṣpaiḥ śubhai rātrau kāryaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ naraiḥ || 7.2.17.200 || aṣṭādhikaśataiḥ kāryā phalaistasyāḥ pradakṣiṇā || pradakṣiṇīkṛtya nagaṃ bhoktavyaṃ tu phalaṃ naraiḥ ||201|| karakaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ tu karttavyaṃ pātrasaṃyutam || haviṣyānnaṃ tu karttavyaṃ dīpaḥ kāryo vidhānataḥ || 202 || evaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ kathāśravaṇatatparaiḥ || mucyaṃte dehinaḥ pāpaiḥ kalijaiḥ kāyasaṃbhavaiḥ || 203 || dehāṃte te narāḥ sarve pūjyaṃte harimaṃdire || 204 || || sārasvata uvāca || || ityuktvā nārado daityaṃ yayau raivatakaṃ girim || daityendro maṃtrayāmāsa kiṃkāryaṃ sāṃprataṃ mayā || 205 || na rocate suraiḥ sārddhaṃ vigraho me surottamāḥ || 206 || || maṃtriṇa ūcuḥ || || nāsti kṣamā bhṛśaṃ teṣāṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ gṛhe satām|| aśaktamapi maṃsyaṃte svayamāyāṃti te yataḥ || tasmātsvayaṃ prayāsyāmo devendraṃ sahitā vayam || 207 || iti śrutvā dadau ḍhakkāṃ prathamaṃ suravigrahe || gṛhītvā vāhinīṃ daityāḥ prasthitā meru parvate || 208 || yatra sā nagarī ramyā devarājasya pūrvataḥ || āgacchamānāṃ tāṃ jñātvā vāhinīṃ meruparvate || 209 || devarājasamādeśāccalitā deva vāhinī || sumeroḥ pūrvadigbhāge yuddhamāsītparasparam|| 7.2.17.210 || devasainyaṃ yadā sarvaṃ daityasainyenasaṃyutam|| mahāpralayasādṛśyaṃ yuddhaṃ vṛttaṃ tadā tayoḥ || || 211 || airāvaṇaṃ samāruhya devarājaḥ samāgataḥ || rathamāruhya daityendro yuddhāyānye samāgatāḥ || 212 || devā yajñabhujo yasmāttasmānna yuddha kāṃkṣiṇaḥ || airāvaṇo baliṃ dṛṣṭvā na cacālāgrato mṛdhe || 213 || saṃgrāme vimukho yāti diggajaiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ || adhvare bāhunā yena saṃkalpaṃ kṛtavānbaliḥ || 214 || tena vai sa surānsarvānvārayāmāsa saṃyuge || vāritā vimukhā yāṃti devarājaḥ karotu kim || 215 || kuliśaṃ na kurute karma bhujamuktaṃ na gacchati ||216|| evaṃ bahūni yuddhāni nivṛttāni tadā tayoḥ || na haṃtuṃ śakyaṃte yuddhe devairdaityā mahābalāḥ || 217 || balākāṃkṣāḥ sthitā devā guruṇā te prabodhitāḥ|| amarā devatāḥ sarva iti śukreṇa vāritāḥ || 218 || avatāraṃ harerjñātvā pañcamaṃ vāmanaṃ sthitam || atihṛṣṭo'marāvatyāṃ rājyaṃ cakre sureśvaraḥ || 219 || nanartta yuddhe daityendraḥ svagṛhe yajate surān|| pātālābhisṛtā daityā rājyaṃ kurvaṃti mānavāḥ || 7.2.17.220 || tadā devagaṇāḥ sarve mantrayanti suraiḥ saha || daityo lokadvayaṃ śāsti svargaṃ śāsti sureśvaraḥ || 221 || kṣaṃtavyaṃ tāvadevāsya vāmano raivataṃ girim|| yāvadyāti suraiḥ kāryaṃ maunaṃ daityajitairapi || 222 || yadāprabhṛti sañjāto vāmano dharaṇītale || tadāprabhṛti daityānāṃ dunirmittāni jajñire || 223 || śivā praviśya nagare rauti sā visvaraṃ niśi || bhramanti nagare kākā divārātraṃ virāviṇaḥ || 224 || sarppāḥ sarppaṃti geheṣu kṛṣṇā raudrā viṣolbaṇāḥ || kaṃkā gṛdhrā bakā bhrāṃtā bhramanti nagaropari || 225 || jāyante vimukhā garbhāḥ strīṣu goṣu mṛgīṣu vā || ghṛtaṃ dugdhaṃ ca naivāsti tile tailaṃ na vidyate || 226 || jane jānapado nityaṃ yudhyate ca parasparam || kālī karālavadanā dīrghakeśī vilocanā || 227 || ajñātā rudatī yāti nagare sā gṛhaṃ prati || ko'yaṃ na jñāyate kasmāttapasvī bhasmaguṃṭhitaḥ || 228 || yatirmaunavratī nagna puro yāti gṛhegṛhe || ḍamarūḍḍāmaruṃ paścāddhuṃkāraṃ vidadhāti ca ||229|| akāle kupitā meghā jalaṃ muñcaṃti puṣkalam || karakaiḥ pūritā garbhā garjaṃti girayo bahu || 7.2.17.230 || samajāyata bhūkaṃpo digdāhaścāpyajāyata || militvā śvagaṇaḥ sarvo mukhamuccairvidhāya ca || 231 || rauti rātrau pure nityaṃ ghūkaḥ śabdaṃ viśabdate || balirājyakṣayo jāto divi ketūdayo niśi|| || 232 || ādityamaṇḍale vedhaḥ kīlakairdṛśyate kṛtaḥ || kabandhasaṃkule vyomni candramā na prakāśate || 233 || sa jāto rohiṇīvedho yo jāto yugavyatyaye || nakṣatrāṇi divā lokairgaṇyante guṇavattaraiḥ || 234 || bījānāṃ vyatyayo jajñe bhūmistrīgomṛgīṣu ca || aśvā hreṣaṃti sahasā madaṃ kurvaṃti no gajāḥ || 239 || mantriṇāṃ maṃtrito mantro bhidyate rājyasaṃkṣaye || ghṛtāhutyā huto vahnirjvalati na tadā dvijaiḥ || 236 || pracaṇḍaḥ pāvano vāti vātyayā ghūrṇitadrumaḥ || dhvajā jvalanti caityeṣu nabho bhavati dhūsaram || 237 || ete cānye ca bahava utpātā balino gṛhe || saṃjātā vāmane jāte nāradāgamanādanu || 238 || anyacca jāyate raudraṃ yaddivā svapnadarśanam || saṃnahyaṃte yadā daityāḥ patitā nipataṃti ca || 239 || nimittāni sa sainyasya dṛṣṭvaivaṃ na pravarttate || sadā saṃtiṣṭhate gehe rājyaṃ ca kurute baliḥ || 7.2.17.240 || śarīre na sukhaṃ tasya gātrabhaṃgaḥ śirovyathā || jvarito na sukhaṃ śete na bhuṃkte na pibatyasau || na bhuktaṃ jīryate lokaḥ sarvopi vyākulīkṛtaḥ ||241|| viparītaṃ jagaddṛṣṭvā balirvyākulamānasaḥ || mantrayāmāsa kimidaṃ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha duḥkhitaḥ || 242 || śukraṃ guruṃ samānīya sabhāyāṃ saṃniveśya ca || papraccha kuśalaṃ daityo bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || viparītamidaṃ sarvaṃ varttate tadvadasva me || 243 || nāradena yaduktaṃ me guro satyaṃ bhaviṣyati || utpātaśāṃtikaṃ brūhi brāhmaṇaiḥ sahito mama || 244 || || śukra uvāca || || utpātaśāṃtaye kāryo yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ || brāhmaṇaiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ sārddhaṃ dvādaśābdo vidhīyatām || 245 || ṛṣayo brāhmaṇā ye ca munayo brahmacāriṇaḥ || āgacchantu mahāyajñe ye ca dūre'pi saṃsthitāḥ || 246 || nagarātpūrvadigbhāge karttavyo yajñamaṇḍapaḥ || yasya yasyābhirucitaṃ deyaṃ dānaṃ tvayā nṛpa || tathā kariṣya ityuktvā yajñārthaṃ tatparobhavat || 247 || ānāyya brāhmaṇānsarvānkuśalānyajñakarmaṇi || gṛhītā yajñadīkṣā tairyajñe vai sarva dakṣiṇe || 248 || brāhmaṇāya mayā deyaṃ sarvasvamiha yācite || śarīraputramitrāṇi dārāndāsyāmi yācitaḥ || 249 || dātavyaṃ satataṃ dānaṃ brāhmaṇebhyo mayādhvare || vāritenāpi na stheyaṃ dātavyaṃ niścitaṃ mayā || yācitaścenna dāsyāmi tadā vyartho mamā'dhvaraḥ ||7.2.17.250|| vidhāya maṇḍapaṃ divyaṃ bahuyojanavistaram || tatra dānāni dīyante bhojanācchādanāni ca || 251|| saptarṣayaḥ samāyātā gaganāddharaṇītale || digbhyaḥ samāgatāḥ sarve brāhmaṇāḥ saṃti ye bhuvi || 252 || kṣatriyāśca samāyātā vigṛhya vividhaṃ vasu || nivedayanti te rājñe prārabdhe yajñakarmaṇi || 253 || āsamudrātsamāyātā naṭanarttakayācakāḥ || gītavāditranirghoṣo vedadhvanivimiśritaḥ || 254 || trailokyaṃ badhirīcakre dehidehīti yācitam || mā dehīti vaco nāsti stokaṃ dehīti caiva na || 255 || yadyadyo yācate vastu tattasmai tatra dīyate || brāhmaṇo hi na so'pyasti yo hi taṃ bahu yācate || 256 || bhojanācchādanārthaṃ ca na gṛhṇaṃti dvijātayaḥ || suvarṇaratnaraupyāṇi tathāśvarathakuṃjarān||257|| gṛhagobhūmigrāmāṃśca na gṛhṇaṃti dvijātayaḥ || balirājyena saṃtuṣṭāḥ kiṃ kurvati dhanena te || 258 || evaṃ pravartate yajño mahānsarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ || 259 || nṛtyaṃti gāyaṃti paṭhaṃti cānye stuvaṃti yajñaṃ bahudānayuktam || brahmendra rudragrahasūryacaṃdrāḥ prasāditā āhutibhiśca mantraiḥ || 7.2.17.260 || baliṃ praśaṃsaṃti guruṃ tathānye hotārameke parivārameke || prajāpaternāpi surādhipasya samāpyate cedatha yāsyati dhuvam|| pradāya rājyaṃ dvijapuṃgavebhyaḥ saputramitraiḥ sahito rasātalam ||261|| itīti vācaḥ pravadaṃti vāḍavāḥ śṛṇvaṃti daityāḥ kimidaṃ vadaṃti || baleḥ puraḥsthāḥ kathayaṃti saṃgatā baliḥ prahṛṣṭaḥ pradadāti yācitam || 262 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye baliyajñaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 ||
<7.2.18>
|| rājovāca || || vastrāpathe mahākṣetre samprāpto vāmano yadā || tadāprabhṛti kiṃ cakre tanme vistarato vada || 1 || || sārasvata uvāca || || vāmano vasatiṃ cakre bhavasyāgre nṛpottama || svarṇarekhājale snātvā bhavaṃ sampūjya bhāvataḥ || 2 || ekāṃte nirmale sthāne kaṇṭakāsthivivarjite || kṛṣṇājinaparicchanna upaviṣṭo varā sane || 3 || kṛtvā padmāsanaṃ dhīro niścalo'bhūddvijottamaḥ || vidhāya kandharābaṃdhamṛjunāsāvalokakaḥ || 4 || gṛhakṣetrakalatrāṇāṃ ciṃtāṃ muktvā dhanasya ca || māyāṃ ca vaiṣṇavīṃ tyaktvā kṛtamauno jitendriyaḥ || 5 || nirāhāro jitakrodho muktasaṃsārabaṃdhanaḥ || bhujau padmāsane kṛtvā kiñcinmīlitalo canaḥ || manoticaṃcalaṃ jñātvā sthiraṃ cakre hṛdi dvijaḥ || 6 || krameṇābhyāsayogena bhinnāṃścakre sa caikataḥ || prāṇāpānavyānodānasamānākhyāṃśca mārutān || 64 || evaṃ taṃ hṛdaye kṛtvā gṛhītvā sarvasandhiṣu || ānīya brahmaṇaḥ sthāne dṛḍhaṃ brahmaṇyayojayat || 8 || gṛhītvā pavanaṃ bāhyaṃ yadā pūra yate tanum || tadā sa pūrako jñeyo recakaṃ tu vadāmyaham || 9 || yadā cābhyantaro vāyurbāhye yāti kramānnṛpa || tadā sa recako jñeyaḥ stambhanātku mbhako bhavet || 7.2.18.10 || pañcaviṃśatitattvāni yadā jānaṃti yoginaḥ || mucyante pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ saptajanmakṛtairapi || 11 || || rājovāca || kāni tattvāni ko dehī kiṃ jñeyaṃ yogināṃ vada || utpannajñānasadbhāvo yogayuktaḥ kathaṃ bhavet || 12 || || īśvara uvāca || || prakṛtiśca tato buddhirahaṃkārastato'bhavat || tanmātrapaṃcakaṃ tasmādeṣā prakṛtiraṣṭadhā || 13 || buddhīndriyāṇi pañcaiva pañca karmeṃdriyāṇi ca || ekādaśaṃ mano viddhi mahā bhūtāni paṃca ca || 14 || gaṇaḥ ṣoḍaśakaḥ sāṃkhye vistareṇa prakīrtitaḥ || caturviṃśatitattvāni puruṣaḥ paṃcaviṃśakaḥ || 15 || dehīti procyate dehe sa cātmānaṃ ca paśyati || viṃdanti paramātmānaṃ ṣaṣṭhaṃ taṃ viṃśateḥ param || 16 || āsanādiprakārā ye te jñeyāḥ prathamaṃ sadā || yadā dīpaśikhāprāyaṃ jyotiḥ paśyaṃti te hṛdi || 17 || utpannajñānasadbhāvā bhaṇyāste yogino budhaiḥ || pūrvaṃ jarāṃ jarayati rogā naśyati dūrataḥ || 18 || sarvapāpacaye kṣīṇe paścānmṛtyuṃ sa viṃdati || mṛto loke naro nāsti yogī jānāti cetsvayam || 19 || tadā dvārāṇi saṃruddhya daśa prāṇānsa muñcati || puṇya pāpakṣayaṃ kṛtvā prāṇā gacchaṃti yoginām || aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ prāpnuvaṃti śivālaye || 7.2.18.20 || anena dhyānayogena bhavaṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || manasā ciṃtitaṃ sarvaṃ samprāptaṃ bhavadarśanāt || 21 || evamāste yadā vipro vāmano bhavasannidhau || gaganādavatīrṇaṃ taṃ tadā paśyati nāradam ||22|| || vāmana uvāca || || maharṣe kuśalaṃ te'dya kasmādāgamyate tvayā || praṇamāmi maharṣe tvāṃ brahmaiva tvaṃ jagattraye || 23 || || nārada uvāca || || svarga lokādahaṃ prāptaḥ kuśalaṃ kiṃ bravīmi te || 24 || yātāyātairdineśasya pūryyate brahmaṇo dinam || dināṃte jāyate rātrī rātrau naśyaṃti devatāḥ || 25 || kā kathā mṛtyulokasya ye mriyaṃte dinedine || nabho dhūmākulaṃ jātaṃ devā baligṛhe gatāḥ || 26 || saptarṣayo gatāstatra brahmaṇā brahmacāriṇaḥ || hāhāhūhūstuṃbaruśca gatau nāradaparvatau || 27 || apsarogaṇagandharvāḥ saṃprāptā balimaṃdire || utpātaśāṃtiko yajñaḥ kriyate balinā svayam || 28 || tatraiva gantumicchāmi draṣṭuṃ yajñaṃ balergṛhe || sahasramekaṃ yajñānāmekonaṃ vidadhe baliḥ || 29 || daityānāṃ bhuvanaṃ sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇe'sminbhaviṣyati || asāvatiśayaḥ ko'pi prārabdho yajñakarmaṇi || dvijātibhyo mayā deyaṃ yena yadyācyate svayam || 7.2.18.30 || vāritenāpi me deyaṃ satyamastu vaco mama || ātmānamapi dārāṃśca rājyaṃ putrānpriyānmama || 31 || prārthitaścenna dāsyāmi vyartho bhavatu me'dhvaraḥ || anena vacasā jātā mahatī me śiro vyathā || pratijñāya kathaṃ yajñaḥ saṃpūrṇo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || 32 || bhaṃgopāyaṃ na paśyāmi bhramāmi bhuvanatraye || vidhvaṃsakāriṇaṃ jñātvā bhavaṃtaṃ paryupasthitaḥ || 33 || yathā na pūryate yajñastathedānīṃ vidhīyatām || 34 || || vāmana uvāca || || maharṣe śṛṇu me vākyaṃ kā śaktirmama vidyate || ko'haṃ kasmātkariṣyāmi yajñe devāḥ samāgatāḥ || 35 || ṛṣayo brāhmaṇāḥ sarve kathaṃ vyartho bhaviṣyati || aparaṃ śṛṇu me vākyaṃ brahmarṣe brahmaṇaspate || 36 || na kalatraṃ na te putrāḥ kasmātprakṛtirīdṛśī || yuddhaṃ vinā na te saukhyaṃ na saukhyaṃ kalahaṃ vinā || 37 || yādṛśastā dṛśo vā'pi vāgvādo'pi sadā priyaḥ || snānaṃ saṃdhyā japo homastarpaṇaṃ pitṛdevayoḥ || 36 || nāradaḥ kurute cānyadanyatkurvaṃti brāhmaṇāḥ || mamāpi kautukaṃ jātaṃ maharṣe vada satvaram || 39 || || nārada uvāca || || pādmakalpe vyatikrāṃte rātryaṃte śṛṇu vāmana|| brahmāṇḍaṃ vāriṇā vyāptamanyatkiṃ cinna vidyate || 7.2.18.40 || apsu śete devadevaḥ sa ca nārāyaṇaḥ smṛtaḥ || sa brahmā sa śivo nāsti bhedasteṣāṃ parasparam || 41 || yadā bhavaṃti te bhinnā stadā devatrayaṃ ca te || karttuṃ vārāhakalpaṃ tu bhinnā jātāstrayastadā || 42 || brahmaviṣṇuharā devā rajaḥsattvatamomayāḥ || sṛṣṭiṃ brahmā karotyevaṃ tāṃ ca pālayate hariḥ ||43|| haraḥ saṃharate sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || evaṃ pravartya deveśa upaviṣṭā varāsane || kailāsaśikhare ramye maṃtrayaṃti parasparam ||44|| trayāṇāṃ ko varo devaḥ ko jyeṣṭhaḥ ko guṇādhikaḥ|| caturtho nāsti yo vetti sahasā te trayaḥ sthitāḥ||45|| tebhyaḥ samutthitaṃ jyotirekībhūtaṃ tadaṃbare|| kālamānena yuktaṃ tadbhrāmte ravimaṃḍalam ||46|| ahaṃ jyeṣṭho hyahaṃ jyeṣṭho vādo'bhūddharabrahmaṇoḥ || dvayorvivadatoḥ krodhātsaṃjāto'haṃ mukhātprabho || 47 || kathaṃ deva na jānāsi yaduktaṃ brahmaṇā tadā || daśāvatārāste raṃtuṃ matsyakūrmādayaḥ purā || 48 || rudreṇa vāritā gatvā kalaho vo na yujyate || tathaiva kṛtavānviṣṇuravatārāndaśaiva tān || 49 || kalpādau brahmaṇo vaktrātsaṃjāto'haṃ dvijottama || kalahājanma me yasmāttasmānme kalahaḥ priyaḥ || 7.2.18.50 || kalpādau sṛjatā pūrvaṃ cinvitaṃ brahmaṇā svayam || vedāntinā kathaṃ sṛṣṭiḥ karttavyā'ho hare mayā || 51 || naṣṭānvedānna jānāmi kva vedāste gatā iti || pṛthvīmapi na jānāmi kiṃ sthāne kimadho gatā || 52 || gaṃtuṃ na vidyate śaktirjalamadhye mamādhunā || avatāraistvayā kāryaṃ daśabhiḥ sṛṣṭirakṣaṇam || 93 || jale jalecaro matsyo mahānadyāṃ bhaviṣyasi || ādāya vedānvegena mama tvaṃ dātumarhasi || 54 || tathā ca kṛtavāndevo matsyarūpaṃ jale mahat || vedānsamānayāmāsa dadau ca brahmaṇe purā || kūrmarūpaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā maṃdaraṃ dhārayiṣyasi || 55 || ityukto brahmaṇā viṣṇurlakṣmīstvāṃ varayiṣyati || purā citraṃ caritraṃ te mathane dṛṣṭavānaham ||56|| yadā rasātalaṃ prāptā pṛthivī naiva dṛśyate || brahmāṃḍārthe sthānakṛte tatra sā naiva dṛśyate || || 57|| vārāhaṃ kriyatāṃ rūpaṃ brahmaṇā preritaḥ svayam || mahāvarāharūpaṃ sa kṛtvā bhūmeradho gataḥ || 58 || uddhṛtya ca tadā viṣṇurdaṃṣṭrāgreṇa vasuṃdharām || sa nināya yathāsthānaṃ mustāṃ va dharaṇītalāt || 59 || avatāraṃ tṛtīyaṃ vai harasyāpi manoharam || yena sā pṛthivī pṛthvī parvataiḥ sahitā dhṛtā ||7.2.18.60|| caturthaṃ narasiṃhaṃ vai kathayāmi sudāruṇam|| ādityā aditeḥ putrā diteḥ putrau mahāvalau || 61 || hiraṇyakaśipurdaityo hiraṇyākṣo mahābalaḥ || svarge devāḥ sthitāḥ sarve pātāle daityadānavāḥ || 62 || hiraṇyakaśipuścakre daityo rājyaṃ rasātale || manuputrā dharāpṛṣṭhe sthāpitā devadānavaiḥ || 63 || vyavasthāṃ tāmatikramya hiraṇyakaśipurdvija || rājyaṃ cakre dharāpṛṣṭhe surendraṃ sa vijitya ca || 64 || saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ gṛhītvā sā'marāvatīm|| grahītukāmo bubhuje putrapautraiḥ kṛtādaraḥ || 65 || prahlādapramukhānputrānsa pīḍayati maṃdadhīḥ || putreṣu pāṭhyamāneṣu prahlādo'pi papāṭha tat || 66 || yena vai paṭhyamānena jāyate tasya vedanā || bhuvanadvayarājyena daityo devānna manyate || 67 || tapasā toṣito brahmā dadau tasmai varaṃ prabhuḥ || amaratvaṃ sa devebhyo manuṣyebhyaḥ surottama || 68 || kasmādapi na me bhūyānmaraṇaṃ yadi cedbhavet || kiṃcitsiṃho naraḥ kiṃcidyo bhaveddharaṇīdharaḥ || 69 || tasmātkararuhaibhinno mariṣye na dharātale || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā gato brahmā ca vismayam || 7.2.18.70 || kālena gacchatā tasya saṃjāto vigraho mahān|| devāḥ kiṃ me kariṣyaṃti viṣṇunā kiṃ prayojanam || 71 || yaṣṭavyo'haṃ sadā yajñai rudraḥ kiṃ me kariṣyati || evaṃ hi varttamānasya prahlādaḥ stauti taṃ harim || || 72 || yenāsya jāyate mṛtyustameva smarate harim || yadāsau vāryamāṇo'pi virauti ca hariṃ harim || 73 || caturbhujaṃ śaṃkhagadāsidhāriṇaṃ pītāṃbaraṃ kaustubha lāñchitaṃ sadā || smarāmi viṣṇuṃ jagadekanāyakaṃ dadāti muktiṃ smṛtamātra eva yaḥ || 74 || anena vacasā kṣubdho daityo detyāndideśa ha || mārayadhvaṃ tu taṃ duṣṭaṃ gaja sarpajalāgnitaḥ || 75 || || prahlāda uvāca || || gajepi viṣṇurbhujage'pi viṣṇurjale'pi viṣṇurjvalane'pi viṣṇuḥ || tvayi sthito daitya mayi sthitaśca viṣṇuṃ vinā daityagaṇā'pi nāsti || 76 || yadā sa māryamāṇo'pi mṛtyuṃ prāpnoti na kvacit || hiraṇyakaśiporvakṣo dahyate krodhavahninā || tadā śikṣayituṃ putraṃ mukhāgre saṃniveśya ca || 77 || vacobhiḥ kaṭhinaiḥ putraṃ svayaṃ hantuṃ samudyataḥ || | dhiktvā nārāyaṇaṃ stauṣi mamāriṃ stauṣi cetpunaḥ||78|| puṣpalāvaṃ laviṣyāmi śiraste'haṃ varāsinā || ahaṃ viṣṇurahaṃ brahmā rudra indro varaṃ vada ||79|| ātmīyaṃ pitaraṃ muktvā kamanyaṃ stauṣi bālaka || 7.2.18.80 || yadā na paṭhate bālaḥ stauti no pitaraṃ svakam || daṇḍenāhatya guruṇā prahlādaḥ preritaḥ punaḥ|| vadaikaṃ vacanaṃ śiṣya dehi me gurudakṣiṇām|| 81 || yathā me tuṣyate svāmī dadāti vipulaṃ dhanam || 82 || || prahlāda uvāca || || praharasva prathamaṃ māṃ kariṣye vacanaṃ guro || staumi viṣṇumahaṃ yena trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| 83 || kṛtaṃ saṃvarddhitaṃ śāṃtaṃ sa me viṣṇuḥ prasīdatu || brahmā viṣṇurharo viṣṇurindro vāyuryamo'nalaḥ ||84|| prakṛtyādīni tattvāni puruṣaṃ paṃcaviṃśakam || pitṛdehe gurordehe mama dehe'pi saṃsthitaḥ || 85 || evaṃ jānankathaṃ staumi mriyamāṇaṃ narādhamam || 86 || || gururuvāca || || nareṣu ko'dhamaḥ śiṣya janmādimaraṇe'dhama || kathaṃ na pitaraṃ stauṣi mriyamāṇo hariṃ harim || | || 87 || || prahlāda uvāca || || bhojane śayane yāne jvare niṣṭhīvane raṇe || harirityakṣaraṃ nāsti maraṇe'sau narādhamaḥ || 88 || bhaye rājakule yuddhe vyādhau strīsaṃgame vane || aśaktau vā'tha saṃnyāse maraṇe bhūmisaṃsthitāḥ || smaraṃti mātaraṃ mūrkhāḥ pitaraṃ ca narādhamāḥ ||89|| mātā nāsti pitā nāsti nāsti me svajano janaḥ || hariṃ vinā na ko'pyasti yadyuktaṃ tadvidhīyatām || 7.2.18.90 || ityādivacanaiḥ kruddho hantuṃ daityaḥ samutthitaḥ|| tadā mātā samāgatya putrasya purataḥ sthitā ||91|| bhrātaraḥ svajano bhaginī bhāṣate mā hariṃ vada || ahaṃ mātā svasā ceyaṃ bhrātaraḥ svajano janaḥ || yathā saṃmilitairvatsa sthīyate vahuvāsaram || 92 || || prahlāda uvāca || || mātā me kā svasā me kā bhrātaraḥ ke pitā ca kaḥ || svajanaṃ śṛṇu me mātaḥ sahitaiḥ sthīyate sadā || 93 || yasyāḥ pītaṃ mayā mūtraṃ purīṣamudare bahu || sā mātā narako'smākamagre vaktuṃ na śakyate || 94 || nirmito na dvitīyastu nirmito viśvakarmaṇā || tvādṛśastu pumānkaścidyasya no hadaye hariḥ || 95 || daśamāsaṃ dhruvaṃ manye mūtraṃ pāsyati tarpitaḥ || bhrātaro bhrātaraḥ satyaṃ garbhe'pi syuḥ kathaṃ yadi || 96 || yudhyatastānkathaṃ mātā varākī vārayiṣyati || svajano dṛśyate vṛddhaḥ pareṣu paṇḍitāyate || 97 || kuṭuṃbaṃ bhaṇyate kasmādyaśca nāyāti yāti ca || baṃdhanaṃ ca kuṭumbasya jāyate narakāya naḥ || 98 || mātā me vidyate cānyā pitānyo bhrātaraśca ye|| svasā svajanasamvandhaṃ jñātvā muktimavāpnuyāt || 99 || mātā prakṛtirasmākaṃ svasā buddhirnigadyate || ahaṃkārastato jāto yo'hamityanumīyate || || 7.2.18.100 || tanmātrāḥ sodarāḥ pañca ye gacchanti sahaiva me || eṣā prakṛtirasmākaṃ vikāraḥ svajano mama || 101 || eteṣāṃ vāhako yastu puruṣaḥ pañca viṃśakaḥ || sa me pitā śarīre'sminparamātmā hariḥ sthitaḥ || 102 || yadyasau cityante citte dṛśyate hṛdaye hariḥ || aṇimādiguṇaiśvaryaṃ padaṃ tasyaiva jāyate || 103 || bhavatā sammataṃ rājyaṃ tanme nityaṃ tṛṇaiḥ samam || yatra no pūjyate viṣṇurbrahmā rudro'nilo'nalaḥ || 104 || pratyakṣo dṛśyate yastu nirālambo bhramatyasau || sa eva bhagavānviṣṇurya ete gagane sthitāḥ || 105 || dhruve baddhā grahāḥ sarve ya ete'pyuḍavaḥ sthitāḥ || te sarve viṣṇuvacasā na pataṃti dharātale || 106 || 230a kāle vināśaḥ sarveṣāṃ tenaiva vihitaḥ svayam || iti saṃciṃtya me nāsti bhavadbhyo maraṇādbhayam || 107 || iti tadvacanasyāṃte padā hatvā pitā'bravīt || kutrā'sau hanmi tatpūrvaṃ paścāttvāṃ haribhāṣiṇam || 108 || || prahlāda uvāca || || pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tānyeva bhagavānhariḥ || sthale jale kiṃ bahunā sarvaṃ viṣṇumayaṃ jagat || 109 || tṛṇe kāṣṭhe gṛhe kṣetre dravye dehe sthito hariḥ || jñāyate jñānayogena dṛśyate kiṃ nu cakṣuṣā || 7.2.18.110 || brahmālaye yāti rasātale vā dharātale'sau bhramati kṣaṇena || āghrāti gandhaṃ vidadhāti sarvaṃ śṛṇoti jānāti sa cātra viṣṇuḥ || 111 || ityuktaḥ sahajāṃ māyāṃ tyaktvā siṃhāsanotthitaḥ || dṛḍhaṃ parikaraṃ baddhvā khaṅgaṃ cākṛṣya cojjvalam || 112 || hatvā taṃ phalakāgreṇa babhāṣe dussahaṃ vacaḥ || idānīṃ smara re viṣṇuṃ no cejjavalitaku ṇḍalam || patiṣyati śiro bhūmau phalaṃ pakvaṃ yathā nagāt || 113 || no ceddarśaya taṃ viṣṇumasmātstaṃbhādvinirgatam || prahlādastu bhayaṃ tyaktvā cakre padmāsanaṃ bhuvi || 114 || vidhāya kaṃdharāṃ netumuccaiḥ śvāsaṃ nirudhya ca || hṛdi dhyātvā hariṃ devaṃ maraṇāyonmukhaḥ sthitaḥ || 115 || prabho mayā tadā dṛṣṭamāścaryaṃ gaganādbhuvi || puṣpamālā sthitā kaṇṭhe prahlādasya svayaṃ gatā || 116 || gaganaṃ vyāpyamānaṃ ca kiṃkimevaṃ kṛtaṃ janaiḥ || jhaṭiti truṭyati stambhācchabdena kṣubhito janaḥ || 117 || dharaṇī yāti pātālaṃ dyaurvā bhūmiṃ sameṣyati || patiṣyati śiro bhūmau khaḍgaghātāhataṃ nu kim || 118 || tāvatstaṃbhādviniṣkrāntaḥ siṃhanādo bhayaṃkaraḥ || bhūmau nipatitāḥ sarve daityāḥ śabdena mūrcchitāḥ || 119 || hiraṇyakaśiporhastātkhaḍgacarma papāta ca || na sa jānāti kiṃ kimetaditi punaḥpunaḥ || 7.2.18.120 || utthito vīkṣate yāvattāvatpaśyati taṃ harim || adho naraṃ sthitaṃ siṃhamupariṣṭādvibhī ṣaṇam || 121 || daṃṣṭrā karālavadanaṃ lelihānamivāṃbaram || jājvalyamānavapuṣaṃ pucchācchoṭitamastakam || 122 || mahākaṇṭhakṛtārāvaṃ saśabda miva toyadam || samucchvasitakeśāṃtaṃ durnirīkṣyaṃ surāsuraiḥ || 123 || narasiṃhamatho dṛṣṭvā nipapāta punaḥ kṣitau || vigṛhya keśapāśe taṃ bhrāmayāmāsa cāṃbaram || 124 || bhrāmayitvā śataguṇaṃ pṛthivyāṃ samapothayat || na mamāra sa daityendro brahmaṇo varakāraṇāt || 125 || gaganasthaistadā devai ruccaiḥ saṃsmārito hariḥ || daityaṃ jānuni cānīya vakṣo hṛṣṭo nirīkṣya ca || 126 || jayajayeti yakṣānāṃ surāṇāṃ so'vadhārayat || śabdaṃ karṇe bhujau sajjau kṛtvā tau padmalāṃchitau || 127 || bibheda vakṣo daityasya vajraghātakiṇāṃkitam|| nakhaiḥ kundasumaprakhyairasthisaṃghātakarśitam || 128 || bhinne vakṣasi daityendro mamāra ca papāta ca || tadā saharṣamabhavattrailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| 129 || mamāpi tṛptiḥ sañjātā prasādāttava keśava|| yadā puratraye dagdhe prasādācchaṃkarasya ca || 7.2.18.130 || hiṇyākṣe punarjātā sā kāle vinipātite || idānīṃ nāsti me tṛptiḥ kutra yāmi karomi kim|| 131 || pṛthivyāṃ kṣatriyāḥ santi na yudhyaṃte parasparam|| devānāṃ dānavaiḥ sārddhaṃ nāsti yuddhaṃ kathaṃ prabho ||132|| idānīṃ balinā vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| pañcamo yo'vatāraste na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati || valinigrahakālo'yaṃ taddarśaya janārdana || 133 || || sārasvata uvāca || || tadetatsakalaṃ śrutvā babhāṣe vāmano munim || 134 || || vāmana uvāca || || śṛṇu nārada yadvṛttaṃ hiṇyakaśipau hate || daityarājaḥ kṛto rājā prahlādo'tīva vaiṣṇavaḥ || 135 || tena rājyaṃ dharāpṛṣṭhe kṛtaṃ saṃvatsarānbahūn|| tasyāpi kurvato rājyaṃ vigraho hi suraiḥ samam || 136 || no paśyāmyapi daityānāṃ pūrvavairamanusmaran|| utpādya putrānsabahūnrājyaṃ cakre sa puṣkalam||137|| virocanādbalirjāto bāla eva yadā'bhavat || ekānte sa hariṃ jñātvā tadā yogena kenacit || 138 || muktvā rājyaṃ priyānputrāngato'sau girisānuṣu || kalpāntasthāyinaṃ dehaṃ tasya cakre janārddanaḥ || 139 || daityānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca bahūnāṃ rājyakāraṇe || vivādotīva saṃjātaḥ ko no rājā bhavediti || 7.2.18.140 || || nārada uvāca || || hiṇyākṣasya ye putrāḥ pautrāśca balavattarāḥ || virocanaprabhṛtayaḥ santi ye balavattarāḥ || 141 || vṛṣaparvāpi balavānrājyārthe samupasthitaḥ || indravitteśavaruṇā vāyuḥ sūryonalo yamaḥ || 142 || daityena sadṛśā na syurbalarūpakṣamādibhiḥ || audāryādiguṇaiḥ kṛtvā santatyā cāsurādhikaḥ || 143 || śukreṇā cāryamāṇāste yuddhyaṃte ca parasparam|| amṛtāharaṇe dauṣṭyaṃ yadā daityāḥ smaranti tat ||144|| pītāvaśeṣamamṛtaṃ kasmādyacchaṃti devatāḥ || nāsmākamiti saṃnahya yudhyante ca parasparam || 145 || kadācidapi no yuddhaṃ viśrāṃtimupagacchati || ekakāryodyatā yasmādbahavo daityadānavāḥ || 146 || pītvā'mṛtaṃ surā jātā amarāste jayanti ca || devadānavadaityānāṃ gandharvoragarakṣasām || viṣṇurbalādhiko yuddhe tadetatkāraṇaṃ vada || 147 || || || vāmana uvāca || || anādinidhanaḥ karttā pātā harttā janārdanaḥ|| eko'yaṃ sa śivo devaḥ sa cāyaṃ brahmasaṃjñitaḥ || ekasya tu yadā kāryaṃ jāyate bhuvane nṛpa || 148 || tasya dehaṃ samāśritya mṛtyukāryaṃ kurvaṃti te || brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ viṣṇoḥ karadaṃ varado yataḥ || tasmādbalādhiko viṣṇurna tathānyo'sti kaścana || 149 || pālanāyodyato viṣṇuḥ kimanyaiścarmacakṣubhiḥ || indrādyāśca surāḥ sarve viṣṇorvyāpārakāriṇaḥ || 7.2.18.150 || sṛṣṭiṃ kṛtvā tato brahmā kailāse saṃsthito haraḥ || na śakyate surairviṣṇurbhrāmyante bhuvanatraye || 151 || jagatyasminyadā kaścidvaiparītyena vartate || tasyocchedaṃ samāgatya karotyeva janārdanaḥ || 152 || tvamejaya mahābāho na mano nāradā'dayam || sarvapāpaharāṃ divyāṃ tāṃ kathāṃ kathayāmyaham || 153 || purā vivadatāṃ teṣāṃ daityānāṃ rājyahetave || prahlādena samāgatya vyavasthā vihitā svayam || 154 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃ panno dīrghāyurbalavattaraḥ || yajñaśīlaḥ sadānaṃdo bahuputrotidurjayaḥ || 155 || na yudhyate suraiḥ sākaṃ viṣṇuṃ yo vetti durjayam || saṃgrāme maraṇaṃ nāsti yasya yaḥ sarvadakṣiṇaḥ || 156 || ātmano vacanaṃ vyarthaṃ na karoti kathaṃcana || sarveṣāṃ putrapautrāṇāṃ madhye yo rājate śriyā || 157 || abhiṣiktastu śukreṇa sa vo rājā bhavediti || gurupramāṇamityuktvā yayau yatrāgataḥ punaḥ || 158 || tathā ca kṛtavaṃtaste sahitā daityadānavāḥ || virocanaprabhṛtayaḥ putrāḥ pautrāḥ svayaṃgatāḥ || 159 || pratyekaṃ vīkṣitāḥ sarve guruṇā jñānapūrvakam || prahlādena guṇāḥ proktā na te saṃti virocane ||7.2.18.160|| anyeṣāmapi daityānāṃ vṛṣaparvāpi nedṛśaḥ || yathā nirīkṣitāḥ putrā baliprabhṛtayo mune || sarvānsaṃvīkṣya śukreṇa balau dṛṣṭā guṇāstathā || 161 || balidehe'dhikāndṛṣṭvā daityebhyo viniveditāḥ || balirguṇādhiko daityāḥ kathaṃ kāryaṃ bhavenmayā || 162 || kenāpi daivayogena baliriṃdro bhaviṣyati || yādṛśastu pitā loke tādṛśastu suto bhavet || 163 || pautraśca niścitaṃ tādṛgbhavatīti na cetsutaḥ || prahlādastu mahāyogī vaiṣṇavo viṣṇuvallabhaḥ || 164 || tasmādvirocane keciddhiraṇyakaśiporguṇāḥ || jyeṣṭho virocano rājye yadi cetkriyate'surāḥ || narasiṃhaḥ samāgatya niścitaṃ mārayiṣyati || 165 || muktaṃ virocanenāpi rājyaṃ maraṇabhīruṇā || prahlādasya guṇāḥ sarve balidehe vyavasthitāḥ || 166 || evaṃ te samayaṃ kṛtvā baliṃ rājye'bhyaṣiṃcayan || yaḥ prahlādaḥ sa vai viṣṇuryo viṣṇuḥ sa baliḥ svayam || 167 || ato mitrīkṛto devairvigrahaistu vivarjitaḥ || ekībhāvaṃ kṛtaṃ sarvaṃ balirājye surāsuraiḥ || 168 || tasyāpi bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā deveṃdro mama maṃdire || samāgatā vālakhilyāḥ śaptohaṃ vāmanaḥ kṛtaḥ || 169 || prasādya te mayā proktāḥ śāpamuktipradā mama || bhaviṣyatīti tairuktaṃ balinigrahaṇādanu || 7.2.18.170 || tavāpi kautukaṃ yuddhe baliryajñaṃ karoti ca || devānāṃ nigraho nāsti sarve yajñe samāgatāḥ || 171 || sa māṃ yajati yajñena vadhaṃ tasya karotu kaḥ || ahaṃ ca vāmano jāto nāradaḥ kautukānvitaḥ || 172 || viparītamidaṃ sarvaṃ varttate mama cetasi || tathā'pi kramayogena sarvaṃ bhavyaṃ karomyaham || 173 || || nārada uvāca || || prasādaṃ kuru deveśa yuddhārthaṃ kautukaṃ mama || ekena brāhmaṇenājau hanyaṃte kṣatriyā yadā || pitrā proktaṃ ca me pūrvaṃ tadā yuddhaṃ bhaviṣyati||174|| brāhmaṇosi bhavāñjātaḥ kadā yuddhaṃ kariṣyasi || vihasya vāmano brūte satyaṃ tava bhaviṣyati ||175|| jamadagnisuto bhūtvā guruṃ kṛtvā maheśvaram|| kārttavīryaṃ vadhiṣyāmi bahubhiḥ kṣatriyaiḥ saha||176|| samaṃtapaṃcake paṃca kariṣye rudhirahradān || tatrāhaṃ tarpayiṣyāmi pitṝnatha pitāmahān || 177 || puṇyakṣetraṃ kariṣyāmi bhavāṃstatrāgamiṣya ti || paraṃ ca kautukaṃ yuddhe bhaviṣyati tava priyam || 178 || brāhmaṇebhyo grahīṣyaṃti yadā kuṃ kṣatriyāḥ punaḥ || tadaiva tānhaniṣyāmi punardā syāmi medinīm || 179 || trisaptavāraṃ dāsyāmi jitvā jitvā vasuṃdharām || śastranyāsaṃ kariṣyāmi nirviṇṇo yuddhakarmaṇi || vihariṣyāmi ramyeṣu vaneṣu girisānuṣu || 7.2.18.180 || laṃkāyāṃ rāvaṇo rājyaṃ kariṣyati mahābalaḥ || trailokyakaṃṭakaṃ nāma yadāsau dhārayiṣyati || 181 || tadā dāśarathī rāmaḥ kausalyānaṃdavarddhanaḥ || bhaviṣye bhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ gamiṣye yajñamaṃḍape || 182 || tāḍakāṃ tāḍayitvāhaṃ subāhuṃ yajñamaṃdire || nītvā yajñādgamiṣyāmi sītāyāstu svayaṃvare || 183 || pariṇeṣyābhi tāṃ sītāṃ bhaṃktvā māheśvaraṃ dhanuḥ || tyaktvā rājyaṃ gamiṣyāmi vane varṣāṃścaturdaśa || 184 || sītāharaṇajaṃ duḥkhaṃ prathamaṃ me bhaviṣyati || nāsākarṇavihīnāṃ tāṃ kariṣye rākṣasīṃ vane || 185 || caturddaśasahasrāṇi triśiraḥkharadūṣaṇān || dhatvā haniṣye mārīcaṃ rākṣasaṃ mṛgarūpiṇam ||186|| hṛtadāro gamiṣyāmi dagdhvā gṛdhraṃ jaṭāyuṣam || sugrīveṇa samaṃ maitrīṃ kṛtvā hatvā'tha vālinam || 187 || samudraṃ baṃdhayiṣyāmi nalapramukhavānaraiḥ || laṃkāṃ saṃveṣṭayiṣyāmi mārayiṣyāmi rākṣasān || 188 || kumbhakarṇaṃ nihatyājau meghanādaṃ tato raṇe || nihatya rāvaṇaṃ rakṣaḥ paśyatāṃ sarvarakṣasām || 189 || vibhīṣaṇāya dāsyāmi laṃkāṃ devavinirmitām|| ayodhyāṃ punarāgatya kṛtvā rājyamakaṃṭakam ||7.2.18.190|| kāladurvāsasościtracaritreṇāmarāvatīm || yāsyehaṃ bhrātṛbhiḥ sārddhaṃ rājyaṃ putre nivedya ca ||191|| dvāpare samanuprāpte kṣatriyairbahubhirmahī|| bhārākrāṃtā na śaknoti pātālaṃ gaṃtumudyatā ||192|| mathurāyāṃ tadā karttā kaṃso rājyaṃ mahāsuraḥ || śiśupālajarāsaṃdhau kālanemirmahāsuraḥ || 193 || pauṃḍrako vāsudevaśca bāṇo rājā mahāsuraḥ || gajavājituraṃgāḍhyā vadhyaṃte me tadā mune || 194 || kalau svalpodakā meghā alpadugdhāśca dhenavaḥ || dugdhe ghṛtaṃ na caivāsti nāsti satyaṃ janeṣu ca || 195 || corairupahatā lokā vyādhibhiḥ paripīḍitāḥ || trātāraṃ nābhi gacchaṃti yuddhāvasthāṃ gatā api || 196 || kṣudrāḥ paścimavāhinyo nadyaḥ śuṣyaṃti kārttike || ekādaśīvrataṃ nāsti kṛṣṇā yā ca caturddaśī ||197|| na jānāti janaḥ kaścidvikrāṃtamapi sve gṛhe || daridropahataṃ sarvaṃ saṃdhyāsnānavivarjitam || bhaviṣyati kalau sarvaṃ na tatpūrvayugatraye || 198 || pitaraṃ mātaraṃ putrastyaktvā bhāryāṃ niṣevate || na guruḥ svajanaḥ kaścitko'pi kaṃ nānusevate || 199 || yathāyathā kalirvyāptiṃ karoti dharaṇītale || tathātathā janaḥ sarva ekākāro bhaviṣyati || 7.2.18.200 || mlecchairupahataṃ sarvaṃ saṃdhyāsnānavivarjitam|| kalkirityabhivikhyāto bhaviṣye brāhmaṇo hyaham ||201|| mlecchānāṃ chedanaṃ kṛtvā yājñavalyapurohitaḥ || bahusvarṇena yajñena yakṣye niṣkṛtikāraṇāt || 202 || bhaviṣyaṃtyavatārā me yuddhaṃ teṣu bhaviṣyati || idānīṃ balinā yuddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti na devatāḥ || 203 || sa māṃ yajati daityendro na me vadhyo balirbhavet || sarvasvadānaniyamaṃ karoti sa mahādhvare || || 204 || || sārasvata uvāca || || ityuktvā nāradaṃ devo visṛjya tamathābhyagāt || draṣṭuṃ balikṛtaṃ yajñaṃ devakāryaprasiddhaye || 205 || vāmano nagaraṃ gatvā vīkṣamāṇo gṛhādgṛham || brāhmaṇānāṃ gṛhaṃ gatvā bhojanaṃ sa tu yācate || 206 || nityaṃ snānaparo vipro vedādhyayanatatparaḥ || vāmano labhate bhikṣāṃ bhojanaṃ dvijamaṃdire || 207 || catuṣpatheṣu ramyeṣu devatāyataneṣu ca || āste parivṛto lokaiścālayanvipulāṃ kaṭim || 208 || śiro vidhūnate sthūlaṃ sthūlaskandho mahāhanuḥ || nṛtyate tālamānena gāyatyatimanoharam|| 209 || vedānadhīte caturo vāmano dvijasaṃsadi || daityānāṃ tanayāḥ sarve brāhmaṇānāṃ tathaiva ca || 7.2.18.210 || vāmanaṃ paryupāsaṃte divārātraṃ manoramam || atha taiḥ sakalairnīto vāmano yajñamaṃḍape || 211 || niścitaṃ maṭhikāsthānaṃ yācitavyo balistvayā || tadāsmākaṃ mahacchreyo deśasya nagarasya ca || 212 || vijñapto vāmanaḥ sarvairdaityadvijakumārakaiḥ || vāmana vastavyaṃ daityeṃdranagare sadā || 213 || || sārasvata uvāca || || praviveśa tathetyuktvā vāmano yajñamaṃḍape || tataḥ kolāhalo jāto dvāḥsthairdvāri kṛto mahān|| 214 || brāhmaṇairbahubhiḥ sārddhaṃ vedānuccārayansthitaḥ || tato vedadhvanirjāto mahānvai yajñamaṃḍapre || 215 || praviṣṭau prathamaṃ daityau daityāya viniveditaḥ || draṣṭuṃ samāgato deva brāhmaṇo vāmano'dhvare || 216 || bhavaṃtaṃ kautukāttāvaddvāradeśe samāviśat || eka eva yathāyāti vāmanastava sannidhau || 217 || nirīho vāmano deva yāvattatraiva kiṃcana || vedānāṃ tu dhvaniṃ kṛtvā caturṇāmekavaktrataḥ || 218 || balirhṛṣṭo'bravīdvākyaṃ dvāḥsthamenaṃ praveśaya || pūjayiṣyāmi vipredraṃ dāsye cāsya yadīpsitam ||219|| smarāmi smṛtivākyāni yāni prāha gururmama || kiṃcidvedamayaṃ pātraṃ kiṃcitpātraṃ tapomayam|| 7.2.18.220 || āgamiṣyati yatpātraṃ tatpātraṃ tārayiṣyati || yajñe pravarttamāne tu dātavyā dakṣiṇā mayā ||221|| vāmano na vicāryastu satyamastu vaco mama || iti śrutvā guruḥ śukro vārayāmāsa taṃ balim|| 222 || śukra uvāca || || dvāri pūjyā dvijāḥ saveṃ dīnāṃdha kṛpaṇādayaḥ || badhirā vāmanāḥ kubjā rogiṇo ye tu niṣṭhurāḥ ||223|| suvarṇarajatairvastrairvāmano dvāri pūjyatām || caturṇāṃ tu vṛthā janma vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa || 224 || aputrāṇāṃ vṛthā janma ye ca dharmabahiṣkṛtāḥ || parapākaṃ ca yeśnaṃti paradāraratāśca ye ||225|| anyāyenārjitaṃ vittaṃ na deyaṃ śreya icchatā || vyarthamabrāhmaṇe dānamārūḍhapatite tathā ||226|| saṃdhyāhīne dvije naṣṭe patite taskare tathā || guroścāprītijanake pitṛmātṛparāṅmukhe || || 227 || brahmabandhau ca yaddataṃ yaddattaṃ vṛṣalīpatau || vedavikrayake caiva kṛtaghne grāmayājake || 228 || strīnirjite ca yaddattaṃ vyālagrāhe tathaiva ca || parivāreṣu yaddattaṃ vṛthā dānāni ṣoḍaśa || 229 || || sārasvata uvāca || || atrāṃtare balirbrūte naivaṃ vācyaṃ tvayā guro || vedānadhīte yaḥ kaścitsa me viṣṇuḥ samāgataḥ || 7.2.18.230 || na vilaṃbastu karttavyaḥ śrotriye gṛhamāgate || abhyutthānena vacasā pādaprakṣālanena ca || 231 || yathā śaktyā pradātavyaṃ bhojanaṃ gṛhamedhinā || apūjito yadā yāti vāmano maṃḍapādbahiḥ || 232 || tadāyaṃ vyarthatāṃ yāti yajñaḥ sarvasvadakṣiṇaḥ || atrāṃtare samānīto vāmano balisaṃnidhau || 233 || āyāṃtaṃ dadṛśe daityo vāmanaṃ viṣṇurūpiṇam || jājvalyamānaṃ vapuṣā piṃgalaṃ sūryasaṃnibham ||234|| utthāyābhimukhaḥ prāyānnamaskṛtyāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || dhanyo'haṃ yasya me yajñe prāpto viṣṇusamo dvijaḥ || 235 || vedimadhye samānīto dadau tasyāsanaṃ baliḥ || pādyamācamanīyaṃ ca dattvārghyaṃ viṣṭaraṃ baliḥ || śrīkhaṃḍagaṃdhapuṣpādyaiḥ pūjayitvāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || 236 || madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ tasmai satvaraṃ sa nivedya ca || āghrāte madhuparke ca vāmanena tataḥ param || 237 || svāgataṃ balinā proktaṃ svastītyuktaṃ dvijanmanā || ahamarthī samāyāto dīyatāṃ vada kiṃ vibho || 238 || medinīṃ dehi me daitya kiyanmātrāṃ dvijottama || vāsārthaṃ mama daityendra dīyatāṃ me krama trayam || 239 || vidhāya maṭhikāṃ divyāṃ śiṣyānadhyāpayāmyaham || dattaṃ kramatrayaṃ tubhyaṃ gṛhītaṃ vāmano'bravīt || 7.2.18.240 || mā dehītyavadacchukro viṣṇureva sanātanaḥ || hṛṣṭo brūte baliḥ śukraṃ pātraṃ syātkimataḥ param || 241 || savyaṃ kṛtvā balirdarbhānsākṣatāndakṣiṇe kare || prayogaṃ na guruścakre na muṃcati jalaṃ kare || 242 || vismitā ṛṣayaḥ sarve hotāro ye sabhāsadaḥ || brāhmaṇā baṭavo daityā bhāryāputrāśca bāṃdhavāḥ || 243 || dattaṃ gṛhītamityukte kasmāttoyaṃ na muñcati || vāmanāya kare toyaṃ vivekāya pradīyate || 244 || yaddānaṃ vacasā dattaṃ karmaṇā nopapādyate || vidhāya narake pūye yajamānaṃ na niṣkṛtiḥ || 245 || uśanā prāha daityendra vāmano harirityayam || kenāpi daivayogena tvāṃ draṣṭuṃ samupāgataḥ || 246 || apriyaṃ vā priyaṃ vāpi na jāne kiṃ kariṣyati || babhāṣe bhārgavaṃ yaṣṭā śrūyatāṃ vacanaṃ guro || 247 || procyate dānakāleṣu yajamānairdvijairapi || ahamindro dvijo viṣṇurdravyamādityadevatā || tatkathaṃ na mayā deyaṃ viṣṇave prīyatāmiti || 248 || ityuktvā sa dadau toyaṃ vāmanāya kare baliḥ || tataḥ kimidamityuktvā saṃsthito maṇḍapādbahiḥ ||249|| madhye'pi vāmano vipro balimātro vabhūva saḥ || dattahasto'surendreṇa grahītuṃ tu padatrayam ||7.2.18.250 || yajamānadvijau haṣṭau dṛṣṭau yajñe surādibhiḥ || vavṛdhe vāmanotīva kṛtvā rūpaṃ caturbhujam ||251|| nārado'pi samāyāto babhāṣe ki kṛtaṃ bale || śiṣyābhyāṃ sahito hṛṣṭo narīnarti puraḥ sthitaḥ || 252 || gṛhāṇa dakṣiṇāṃ deva sabhāryo bhāṣate baliḥ || adya kiṃ na mayā prāptaṃ yadgṛhṇāti janārddanaḥ || || 253 || sārddhakramakṣayaṃ kṛtvā dharaṇīṃ yācate trayam || yadasti tena kartavyaḥ santoṣo madhusūdana || 254 || varddhamānaṃ hariṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ || tuṣṭuvurgagane yāṃtaṃ bhagavaṃtaṃ janārddanam || 255 || || devarṣaya ūcuḥ || || jaya deva jayānanta jaya viṣṇo jayā'cyuta || jaya matsya namastubhyaṃ jaya kūrma dharādhara || 256 || varāhāya namastubhyaṃ narasiṃha namonamaḥ || jāmadagnya namastubhyaṃ jaya rāma salakṣmaṇa || 257 || jaya kṛṣṇa jagannātha jaya devakinandana || namāmi buddhaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ ca kalkinaṃ praṇamāmyaham ||258|| || sārasvata uvāca || || narīnarti tathā stauti nārado gaganaṃ gataḥ || yoginaḥ sanakādyā ye stuvaṃti ca janārdanam || 259 || antarikṣe gate kṛṣṇe varddhamāne baleḥ puraḥ || ūrdhvavaktrāḥ sthitāḥ sarve nirī kṣante divākaram || 7.2.18.260 || dṛṣṭacchatrākṛtistāvatpaścādūrdhvaṃ gato hariḥ || cūḍāmaṇirivābhāti bhāskaro harimastake || 261 || daityairnirīkṣitaḥ samyaglalāṭe tilakāyate || hariḥ saṃvarddhate yāvatkarṇe'sau kuṇḍalāyate ||262|| varddhamānasya ca harerhṛdaye kaustubhāyate || iṃdrādyā devatā rudrā vasavo gagane sthitāḥ || 263 || ūrdhvaṃ punaryatra harirna tatra gaganaṃ matam || vanamālā tadā kaṇṭhe vāsavena niveśitā || 264 || pṛthivī kampate sarvā divisthaṃ sūryamaṇḍalam || kiṃ bhaviṣyati daityāste bhītāḥ paśyaṃti bhāskaram || 265 || nābhau padmāyate sūryaḥ kaṭau ca raśanāyate || evaṃ saṃvarddhito viṣṇurjagṛhe ca padadvayam || 266 || sthānaṃ nāsti tṛtīyasya brahmāṃḍaṃ sakalaṃ kṛtam || ahardaṇḍo jagatsraṣṭā brahmadaṃḍāyate tadā || 267 || devadānava gaṃdharvamanuṣyoragapannagaiḥ || pūjyate caraṇo viṣṇoḥ stūyate cānumīyate || 268 || dharmātmā yatadaṇḍo hi gaṃdharvairgīyate muhuḥ || jyotiścakrākṣadaṃḍaḥ kiṃ hariṇā nirmitaḥ svayam || 269 || jitvedaṃ bhuvanaṃ gaṃgā dhvajadaṃḍo'maraiḥ kṛtaḥ || trivikramāṃghridaṇḍo'yaṃ kīrtidaṃḍāyate dhruvam|| 7.2.18.270 || vegenākṣipya hariṇā nīto brahmāṃḍamastake || pādastanmastakaṃ bhittvā bahiryāsyati vegataḥ || 271 || tāvadbrahmāṃḍavego'yaṃ virāḍiti hi saṃjñitaḥ || sa sarva bījarūpo hi paramātmeti gadyate || 272 || tenedaṃ sakalaṃ jātaṃ pādasyāgre vyavasthitam|| brahmāṃḍabhedanaṃ kṛtvā na gantavyaṃ bahistvayā || 273 || tenaiva saha brahmāṃḍe paphāla caraṇo hareḥ || brahmāṃḍaṃ jarjaraṃ jātaṃ pādasaṃkocanādapi || 274 || bhinne tasminsamāyātaṃ brāhmaṃ toyaṃ jagattraye || viṣṇupādodbhavā gaṃgā mastakānniḥsṛtā tadā || 275 || trailokyaplāvinī devī yā rudreṇa svayaṃ dhṛtā || svardhunī pūjyate svarge gaṃgeti gāṃ gatā satī || || 276 || pātāle sā yadā prāptā khyātā tripathagaiva sā || yasyāḥ smaraṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 277 || darśanādaśvamedhasya saṃpūrṇasya phalaṃ labhet || snānamātreṇa naśyeta saptajanmakṛtaṃ tvagham ||278|| snātvā saṃpūjayedyastu devau hariharau naraḥ || indralokamatikramya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || || 279 || viṣṇupādodakaṃ pītvā jñātvā tattvāni saṃyamī || upoṣya divasaṃ viṣṇormuktiṃ gacchati dehavān|| 7.2.18.280 || śuddhasvabhāvasattvasthā viraktā janmabhūmiṣu || saṃsārabaṃdhanaṃ chittvā yāti te paramāṃ gatim || 281 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye balinigrahavṛttāṃtavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<7.2.19>
|| rājovāca || || gṛhītvā dakṣiṇāṃ daityānmahāviṣṇurjanārdanaḥ ||| cakāra kiṃ mamācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 1 || || sārasvata uvāca || || evaṃ stutaḥ surairdevo gṛhītvā medinīṃ hariḥ || baliṃ nirvāsayāmāsa saṃpūrṇe yajñakarmaṇi || yajñāṃte dakṣiṇāṃ labdhvā saṃpūrṇo'bhūdathādhvaraḥ || 2 || bhagavānapyasaṃpūrṇe tṛtīye tu krame vibhuḥ || samabhyetya baliṃ prāha īṣatprasphuritādharaḥ || 3 || ṛṇe bhavati daityendra baṃdhanaṃ ghoradarśanam || tvaṃ pūraya padaṃ tanme nocedbandhaṃ pratīccha bhoḥ || 4 || tanmurārivacaḥ śrutvā puro bhūtvā baleḥ sutaḥ || bāṇo vāmanamācaṣṭe tadā taṃ viśvarūpiṇam || 5 || kṛtvā mahīmalpatarāṃ vapuḥ kṛtvā tu vāmanam|| padatrayaṃ yācayitvā viśvarūpamagāḥ katham || 6 || yadi tṛtīyaṃ kramaṇaṃ yācase jagadīśvara || punarvāmanatāṃ yāhi balirdāsyati tatpadam|| 7 || yādṛgvidhāya balinā vāmanāyodakaṃ kṛtam|| tattādṛśāya dātavyamatha kiṃ viśvarūpiṇe || 8 || bhavatkṛtamidaṃ viśvaṃ viśvasminvartate baliḥ || chadmanā naiva gṛhṇanti sādhavo ye maheśvara || 9 || jagadetajjagannātha tāvakaṃ yadi manyase || jñātvā balimamaryādaṃ bhavadbhaktiparāṅmukham || 7.2.19.10 || kaṃṭhapāśena niṣkāsya kena vai vāryate bhavān|| gopālamanyaṃ kurute rakṣaṇāya ca gopatiḥ || sutṛṇaṃ cārayanpūrvo gopaḥ kiṃ kurute tadā || 11 || ityevamukte tenātha vacane balisūnunā || provāca bhagavānvākyamādikartā janārdanaḥ ||12|| yānyuktāni vacāṃsītthaṃ tvayā bālena sāṃpratam|| teṣāṃ tvaṃ hetusaṃyuktaṃ śṛṇu pratyuttaraṃ mama || 13 || pūrvamuktastava pitā mayā bāṇa padatrayam || dehi mahyaṃ pramāṇena tadetatsamanuṣṭhitam || 14 || kiṃ na vetti pramāṇaṃ me balistava pitā suta || balerapi hitārthāya kṛtametatpadatrayam || 15 || tasmādyanmama bāleya tvatpitrāṃ'bu kare mahat || dattaṃ tenāsya sutale kalpaṃ yāvadvasiṣyati || 16 || gate manvantare bāṇa śrāddhadevasya sāmpratam || sāvarṇike tvāgate ca balirindro bhaviṣyati || 17 || iti proktvā balisutaṃ bāṇaṃ devastrivikramaḥ || provāca balimabhyetya vacanaṃ madhurākṣaram || 18 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || apūrṇadakṣiṇe yāge gaccha rājanmahātalam || sutalaṃnāma pātālaṃ vasa tatra nirāmayaḥ || 19 || || baliruvāca || || sutalasthasya me nātha kathaṃ caraṇayostava || darśanaṃ pūjanaṃ bhogo nivasāmi yathāsukham || 7.2.19.20 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || daityendra hadaye nityaṃ tāvake nivasāmyaham || ataste darśanaṃ prāptaḥ punaḥ sthāsye tavāntikam || 21 || tathānyamutsavaṃ puṇyaṃ vṛtte śakramahotsave || dīpapratipannāmā'sau tatra bhāvī mahotsavaḥ || 22 || tatra tvāṃ naraśārdūlā hṛṣṭāḥ puṣṭāḥ svalaṃkṛtāḥ || puṣpadīpapradānena arcayiṣyaṃti yatnataḥ || || 23 || tatrotsavaḥ puṇyatamo bhaviṣyati dharātale || tava nāmāṃkito daitya tena tvaṃ vatsaraṃ sukhī || 24 || bhaviṣyasi narā ye tu dṛḍhabhaktisahā nvitāḥ || tvāmarcayanti vidhivatte'pi syuḥ sukhabhāginaḥ || 25 || yathaiva rājyaṃ bhavatastu sāṃprataṃ tathaiva sā bhāvyatha kaumudīti || ityevamuktvā madhumaditīśvaraṃ nivāsayitvā sutalaṃ sabhāryakam || 26 || urvī samādāya jagāma tūrṇaṃ sa śakrasadmāmarasaṃghajuṣṭam || dattvā maghone madhujittriviṣṭapaṃ kṛtvā tu devānmakhabhāgabhoginaḥ || 27 || antardadhe viśvapatirmaheśaḥ saṃpaśyatāṃ vai vasudhādhipānām || 28 || gṛhītveti bale rājyaṃ manuputre niyojitam || dvīpāṃtare ca te daityāḥ preṣitāścājñayā svayam ||29|| pātālanilayā ye tu te tatraiva niveśitāḥ || devānāṃ paramo harṣaḥ saṃjāto balinigrahe ||7.2.19.30|| nivāsāya punaścakre vāmano vāmano manaḥ || tatra kṣetre svanagare vāmanaḥ sa nyuvāsa ha || 31 || || sārasvata uvāca || || prādurbhāvaste kathito narendra puṇyaḥ śucirvāmanasyāghahārī || smṛte yasminsaṃśrute kīrtite ca pāpaṃ yāyātsaṃkṣayaṃ puṇyameti || 32 || || īśvara uvāca || || iti sārasvatavacaḥ śrutvā bhojaḥ sa bhūpatiḥ || namaskṛtya muniśreṣṭhaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 33 || tato yathoktavidhinā sa bhojo nṛpasattamaḥ || vastrāpathakṣetra yātrāṃ parivārajanaiḥ saha || kṛtvā kṛtārthatāṃ prāpto jagāmānte paraṃ padam || 34 || etanmayā puṇyatamaṃ prabhāsakṣetre ca vasrāpathamīritaṃ te || śrutvā paṭhitvā parayā sameto bhaktyā tu viṣṇoḥ padamabhyupaiti || 35 || yathā pāpāni dhūyaṃte gaṃgāvārivigāhanāt || tathā purāṇaśravaṇādduritānāṃ vinā śanam || 36 || idaṃ rahasyaṃ paramaṃ tavoktaṃ na vācyametaddharibhaktivarjite || dvijasya nindānirate'tipāpe gurāvabhakte kṛtapāpabuddhau || 37 || idaṃ paṭhedyo niyataṃ manuṣyaḥ kṛtabhāvanaḥ || tasya bhaktiḥ śive kṛṣṇe niścalā jāyate dhuvam || 38 || tadbhaktyā sakalānarthānprāpnoti puruṣottamaḥ ||| purāṇavācine dadyādgobhūsvarṇavibhūṣaṇam ||39|| vittaśāṭhyaṃ na kartavyaṃ kurvandāridryamāpnuyāt || triḥkṛtvā prapaṭhañchṛṇvaṃnsarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||7.2.19.40|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīye vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmye balaye vāmanakṛtavarapradānavṛttāntavarṇana pūrvakaṃ vastrāpathakṣetrayātrāmāhātmya sārasvatabhojasaṃvādasamāptipuraḥsara vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmyasamāptivarṇanaṃ nāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 19 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe dvitīyaṃ vastrāpathakṣetramāhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam || 7.2 ||
<7.3.1>
|| || śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || atha tṛtīyamarbudakhaṇḍaṃ prārabhyate || || vyāsa uvāca || || oṃnamonaṃtāya sūkṣmāya jñānagamyāya vedhase || śuddhāya viśvarūpāya devadevāya śaṃbhave || 1 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathito vaṃśavistāro bhavatā somasūryayoḥ || manvaṃtarāṇi sarvāṇi sṛṣṭiścaiva pṛthagvidhā || 2 || adhunā śrotumicchāmastīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || kāni tīrthāni puṇyāni bhūtale'sminmahāmate || 3 || || sūta uvāca || || nānā tīrthāni loke'sminyeṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || tisraḥ koṭyo'rddhakoṭiśca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā kṛtā purā || 4 || kṣetrāṇi saritaścaiva parvatāśca nadā stathā || ṛṣīṇāṃ tapaso vīryānmāhātmyaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 5 || teṣāṃ madhye'rbudonāma sarvapāpaharo'naghaḥ || aspṛṣṭaḥ kalidoṣeṇa vasiṣṭhasya prabhāvataḥ || 6 || punaṃti sarvatīrthāni snānadānādikairyathā || arbudo darśanādeva sarvapāpaharo nṛṇām || 7 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kiṃ pramāṇo'rbudo nāma kasmindeśe vyavasthitaḥ || kathaṃ vāsiṣṭhamāhātmyātprathito dharaṇītale || 8 || kāni tīrthāni mukhyāni hyarbude saṃti parvate || sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi naḥ || 9 || || sūta uvāca || || ahaṃ ca saṃpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || arbudasya dvijaśreṣṭhā māhātmyaṃ ca yathā śrutam || 7.3.1.10 || vasiṣṭho nāma devarṣiḥ pitāmahasamudbhavaḥ || sa pūrvaṃ bhūtalaṃ prāptastapastepe sudāruṇam || 11 || niyato niyatāhāraḥ sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || varṣāsvākāśavāsī ca hemaṃte salilāśayaḥ || 12 || paṃcāgnisādhako grīṣme japahomaparāyaṇaḥ || kenacittvatha kālena tasya dhenuḥ payasvinī || naṃdinīti suvikhyātā sā vai kāmadughā śubhā || 13 || sā kadāciddharāpṛṣṭhe bhramamāṇā tṛṇāśayā || patitā dāruṇe śvabhre agādhe timirāvṛte || 14 || etasminneva kāle tu bhagavāṃstīkṣṇadīdhitiḥ || astaṃ gato na saṃprāptā naṃdinī munisattamāḥ || 15 || tasyāḥ kṣīreṇa nityaṃ sa sāyaṃ prātardvijo muniḥ || karoti homamagnau hi susamiddhe jitavrataḥ || 16 || atha ciṃtāparo vipraḥ prāyaścittabhayāddhruvam || vīkṣāṃcakre vane tasminsameṣu viṣameṣu ca || 17 || sa tacchvabhramathāsādya bhūṃbhārāvamathāśṛṇot || tāṃ provāca suniśreṣṭhaḥ kathaṃ tvaṃ patitā śubhe || 18 || ahaṃ homasya codvegānniḥsṛtastvāmavekṣitum|| sā'bravīdbhakṣamāṇāhaṃ viprarṣe tṛṇavāṃchayā || 19 || patitātra vibho trāhi kṛcchrādasmātsuduḥsahāt || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa munirdhyāna māsthitaḥ || 7.3.1.20 || sarasvatīṃ samādadhyau nadīṃ trailokyapāvanīm || sā dhyātā manasā tena muninā tatra tatkṣaṇāt || 21 || śvabhraṃ tatpūrayāmāsa samaṃtādvimalairjalaiḥ || paripūrṇaṃ tataḥ śvabhre niṣkrāṃtā naṃdinī tadā || 22 || saṃhṛṣṭā muninā sārddhaṃ yayāvāśramasammukham || 23 || sa dṛṣṭvā śvabhramadhyaṃ taṃ gaṃbhīraṃ ca mahāmuniḥ || ciṃtayāmāsa medhāvī śvabhrasyaiva prapūraṇe || 24 || tasya ciṃtayato viprā buddhireṣodapadyata || ānīya parvataṃ muktvā śvabhrametatprapūryate || tasmādgacchāmyahaṃ śīghraṃ himavantaṃ nagottamam || 25 || sa eva parvataṃ cātra preṣayiṣyati bhūdharaḥ || yena syātparipūrṇaṃ ca śvabhrametanmahātmanā || 26 || tato jagāma sa munirhimavantaṃ nagottamam || dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhamāyāṃtaṃ hima vānhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || arghyapādyādisaṃskāraiḥ saṃpūjya idamabravīt || 27 || svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha saphalaṃ me'dya jīvitam || yadbhavānme gṛhe prāptaḥ pūjyaḥ sarvadivaukasām || 28 || brūhi kāryaṃ muniśreṣṭha api jīvitamātmanaḥ || nūnaṃ tubhyaṃ pradāsyāmi niyogo dīyatāṃ mama ||29|| ||vasiṣṭha uvāca|| || mamāśramasya sāṃnidhye śvabhramasti sudāruṇam || agādhaṃ nandinī tatra patitā dhenuruttamā || 7.3.1.30 || yatnādākarṣitā tasmādbhūyaḥ patanajādbhayāt || tavāṃtikamanuprāpto nānyo yogyo mahīpatiḥ || 31 || tasmātkañcinnagaśreṣṭhaṃ tatra preṣaya bhūdharam|| yena tatpūryate śvabhraṃ bhṛśaṃ preṣaya tādṛśam || 32 || || himavānuvāca || || kiṃpramāṇaṃ mune śvabhraṃ vistārāyāmato vada || tatpramāṇaṃ nagaṃ kaṃcitpreṣayāmi viciṃtya ca || 33 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || dvisahasraṃ tu dairghyeṇa vistareṇa trisahasrakam|| na saṃkhyā vidyate'dhastāttasya parvatasattama || 34 || || himavānuvāca || || kathaṃ tena pramāṇena sañjāto vivaro mahān|| abhūtkautūhalaṃ tena sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 35 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vasiṣṭhāśramasamīpavarti vivaravṛttāntopakramavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || || cha ||
<7.3.2>
|| vasiṣṭha uvāca || || āsītpūrvaṃ munirnāmnā gautamaśca mahātapāḥ || ahilyā dayitā tasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinī || 1 || śiṣyānadhyāpayāmāsa sa muniḥ śataśastadā || śrutādhyayanasaṃpannānvisasarja tato gṛhān|| 2 || tasyānyo'pi ca yaḥ śiṣyo gurubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || uttaṃko nāma medhāvī nyavasattasya mandire || 3 || na taṃ visarjayāmāsa jarayāpi pariplutam|| uttaṃko'pi suśiṣyatvānno vetti palitaṃ śiraḥ || 4 || jātakāryasamāyukto vidyāpāraṃgato'pi saḥ || kenacittvatha kālena kāṣṭhārthaṃ sa bahiryayau || 5 || prabhūtāni samādāya āśramaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || athāsau nyakṣipattatra bhūtale kāṣṭhasaṃcayam|| 6 || kāṣṭhalagnāṃ tadā śvetāṃ jaṭāmekāṃ dadarśa saḥ || sa dṛṣṭvā duḥkhamāpannaḥ kṛpaṇaṃ paryacintayat ||7|| dhigdhiṅme jīvitaṃ naṣṭaṃ kutaḥ kāryaratasya ca || kalatra saṃgrahaṃ naiva mayā kṛtamabuddhinā||8|| bhaviṣyati kulacchedaḥ śaithilyānmama durmateḥ|| gurupatnyā ca saṃdṛṣṭa uttaṃko duḥkhitastadā||9|| tasya duḥkhaṃ tathā kṣipraṃ gautamāya nieveditam|| gautamena tathetyuktvā mṛduvāṇyā sa bhāṣitaḥ||7.3.2.10|| vatsa gaccha gṛhaṃ tvaṃ ca agnihotrādikāḥ kriyāḥ|| pālayasva vidhānena patnyā saha na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || ityukto guruṇā so'pi pratyuvāca guruṃ prati || dakṣiṇāṃ prārthaya svāminnahaṃ dāsyāmyasaṃśayam || 12 || || gautama uvāca || || sevā kṛtā tvayā vatsa mahatī mama sarvadā || tenaiva paripūrṇatvaṃ jātaṃ me nātra saṃśayaḥ || 13 || || || uttaṃka uvāca || || kiṃcidgrāhyaṃ tvayā svāminsantoṣo jāyate mama || tvatprasādānmuniśreṣṭha vidyāpāraṃgato'smyaham || 14 || || gautama uvāca || || na grāhyaṃ ca mayā putra santuṣṭaḥ sevayāsmyaham || necchāmyahaṃ dhanaṃ tvattaḥ sukhaṃ gaccha gṛhaṃ prati || 15 || ityukto guruṇā so'pi mātaraṃ cābhyabhāṣata || kiṃcidgrāhyaṃ mayā mātaḥ santoṣo dīyatāṃ mama || 16 || || gurupatnyuvāca || || saudāsaṃ gaccha putra tvaṃ mamājñāṃ kuru satvaram || madayantī priyā tasya dharmapatnī yaśasvinī || 17 || kuṇḍale'thānaya kṣipraṃ madayaṃtyāśca putraka || no cecchāpaṃ pradāsyāmi pañcame'hni na āgataḥ || 18 || ityukto gurupatnyā sa prasthitaḥ satvaraṃ tadā || saudāsasyagṛhaṃ prāpa vyāghrāsyaṃ taṃ ca dṛṣṭavān || 19 || dṛṣṭvā prāha tadā vipraṃ bhakṣaṇārthamupasthitam || bhakṣayiṣyāmi vai vipra tvāmahaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.3.2.20 || || uttaṃka uvāca || || avaśyaṃ bhakṣaya tvaṃ māmekaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa || dehi me kuṇḍale tāta dattvā'haṃ gurave punaḥ || āgamiṣyāmi bhakṣasva mā tvaṃ kāryavivarjitam || 21 || || saudāsa uvāca || || gaccha tvaṃ mandire durge yatrā''ste dayitā mama || tāṃ tvamāsādya yatnena jīvitavyabhayāddvija || 22 || yācyatāṃ mama vākyena sā te dāsyati kuṇḍale || tvayā ca nānyathā kāryaṃ yatsatyaṃ dvijasattama || 23 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || madayantyāḥ samīpaṃ tu gatvovāca dvijottamaḥ || dehi me kuṇḍale devi saudāsastvāṃ samādiśat ||24|| || madayaṃtyuvāca || || sandeho'dyāpi me vipra kuṇḍale dvijasattama || abhijñānaṃ tvamānīya nṛpasya dvija darśaya || 25 || sa gatvā tvaritaṃ bhūpamabhijñānamayācata || 26 || || saudāsa uvāca || || yairvinā sugatirnāsti durgatiṃ ye nayaṃti vai || gatvaivaṃ brūhi tāṃ sādhvīṃ mama vākyaṃ dvijottama || pradāsyati tato nūnaṃ kuṇḍale ratnamaṃḍite || 27 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || pratyabhijñānamādāya gatvā tasyai nyavedayat || 28 || tato'sau pradadau tasmai gṛhṇa me kuṇḍale dvija || uvāca yatnamāsthāya nīyatāṃ dvijasattama || 29 || ete ca vāṃchate nityaṃ takṣako dvija kuṇḍale || sa tatheti samādāya vismayotphullalocanaḥ || kautukātpunarāgatya rājānaṃ vākyamabravīt||7.3.2.30|| abhijñānānmayā bhūpa samprāpte dīptakuṇḍale || vākyārthastu na vijñātastato'haṃ punarāgataḥ ||31|| kautukādvada me rājansvakārye ca yathāsthitam || kairvinā sugatirnāsti durgatiṃ ke nayaṃti ca || 32 || || saudāsa uvāca || || ārādhitā dvijā vipra bhavaṃti sugatipradāḥ || asantuṣṭā durgatidāḥ sadyo mama yathā purā ||33 || etāvānmama śāpo'yaṃ vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ|| tenoktaṃ tvāṃ yadā kaścitpraśnaṃ vikhyāpayiṣyati || 34 || tadā doṣavinirmukto bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || tvatprasādādvinirmukto hyahaṃ śāpāddvijottama || sāttvikaṃ dhāma cāpanno gaccha vipra namo'stu te || 35 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca|| || uttaṃkastena nirmuktaḥ satvaraṃ pathamāśritaḥ || gacchaṃścātikṣudhāviṣṭo 'paśyadbilvaphalāni saḥ || 36 || tataḥ kṛṣṇājine baddhvā kuṇḍale nyasya bhūtale || āruroha phalākāṃkṣī sa muniḥ kṣudhayā'nvitaḥ || 37 || etasminneva kāle tu takṣakaḥ pannagottamaḥ || gṛhītvā kuṇḍale tūrṇamagamaddakṣiṇāmukhaḥ || 38 || athottaṃkaḥ phalāhārī avatīrya dharātale || sarvato'nveṣayāmāsa vegena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 39 || sa dṛṣṭvā sammukhaṃ prāptaṃ samīpaṃ pannagottamaḥ || praviveśa bilaṃ raudramandhakāreṇa saṃvṛtam || 7.3.2.40 || uttaṃko'pi bilaṃ prāptaḥ praviśya tamasāvṛtam|| daṇḍakāṣṭhaṃ samādāya kupitohyakhanattadā || || 41 || taṃ tathā duḥkhitaṃ dṛṣṭvā sakleśaṃ gurukāryataḥ || vajramāropayāmāsa daṇḍāṃte pākaśāsanaḥ ||42|| tato vidārayāmāsa sa śīghraṃ dharaṇītalam || praviṣṭaścaiva pātālaṃ kuṇḍalārthaṃ paribhraman ||43|| so'paśyadvājinaṃ tatra sarvaśvetaṃ guṇānvitam|| tenoktaḥ spṛśa me guhyaṃ tataḥ kāryaṃ bhaviṣyati ||44|| sa cakāra tathā śīghraṃ tato dhūmo vyajāyata || pātālaṃ tena sarvatra vyāptaṃ bhūdhara vahninā || 45 || tataśca vyākulāḥ sarve pannagāḥ samupādravan|| takṣakaṃ purataḥ kṛtvā saṃprāptāḥ kuṇḍalānvitāḥ || uttaṃkāya tato dattvā praṇipatya yayurgṛham|| 46 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || athāśvastamuvācedamahamagnirdvijottama || yastvayā''rādhitaḥ pūrvamupādhyāyanideśataḥ || 47 || jñātvā tvāṃ duḥkhitaṃ prāptamiha prāptaḥ kṛpāparaḥ || sarvathā tvaṃ ca me pṛṣṭhaṃ bhagavañchīghramāruha || 48 || nayāmi tatra yatrāste guruḥ sarvaguṇālayaḥ || ārūḍhastasya pṛṣṭhe sa pratasthe hyāśramaṃ prati || 49 || tatkṣaṇātsamanuprāpto gautamasya niveśanam || etasminneva kāle tu ahilyā kṛtamaṃḍanā ||7.3.2.50|| snātā cābhyetya bhartāraṃ sādhvī vākyamuvāca ha || uttaṃko'dya na saṃprāptaḥ śāpaṃ dāsyāmyahaṃ dhruvam || 51 || śithilo gurukṛtyeṣu sa yadālakṣito mayā || tasyā vākyāvasāne tu uttaṃkaḥ paryyadṛśyata || 52 || prasannavadano hṛṣṭaḥ kuṇḍalābhyāṃ samanvitaḥ || praṇipatya sa tāṃ bhaktyā kuṇḍale saṃnyavedayat || 53 || sā dṛṣṭvā tatkṣaṇātsādhvī karṇābhyāṃ saṃnyaveśayat|| svagṛhāya tatastūrṇamuttaṃkaṃ visasarja ha || 54 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || evaṃ sa vivaro jātastakṣakottaṃkakāraṇāt || yathā me ciṃtyate nityaṃ dhenvarthaṃ śvabhrapūraṇe || 55 || tasmāttvaṃ pūraya kṣipraṃ nānyaḥ śakto'tra karmaṇi || śīghraṃ kuru nagaśreṣṭha mama kāryamasaṃśayam || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe vivarotpattivṛttāṃte gautamaśiṣyottaṃkacaritravarṇanaṃnāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 2 || cha || ||
<7.3.3>
|| sūta uvāca || || śrutvā himācalo vākyaṃ vasiṣṭhasya mahātmanaḥ|| cintayāmāsa tatkāryaṃ vivarasya prapūraṇe||1|| ciraṃ vicārya tamṛṣimidamāha nagottamaḥ|| ka upāyo nagānāṃ vai tatra gaṃtuṃ vadasva me ||2|| pakṣacchedastu śakreṇa sarveṣāṃ ca purā kṛtaḥ || tasmādasya muniśreṣṭha kāryasya paśya niścayam||3|| || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || astyupāyo nagānāṃ tu tatra netuṃ mahānaga || tavāyaṃ tanayastatra vikhyāto naṃdivarddhanaḥ ||4|| tasyārbuda iti khpāto vayasyaḥ paramaṃ priyaḥ || nāgaḥ prāṇabhṛtāṃ śreṣṭhaḥ khecaro'pi ca vīryavān ||5|| sa vā ūrdhvagatiḥ kṣipraṃ kṣaṇānneṣyatyasaṃśayaḥ ||
