līlayā sarvakṛtyeṣu taṃ viditvā'hamāgataḥ ||6|| ādeśo dīyatāmasya duḥkhaṃ kartuṃ ca nārhasi || avaśyaṃ yadi bhakto'si tatra preṣaya satvaram||7|| ||sūta uvāca|| || vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā himavānputravatsalaḥ || duḥkhena mahatā''viṣṭaściṃtayāmāsa bhūdharaḥ ||8|| mainākastanayo'smākaṃ praviṣṭaḥ sāgare bhayāt || jyeṣṭhaṃ tu sarvathā cātha vasiṣṭho netumāgataḥ || kiṃ kṛtyamadhunā'smākaṃ kathaṃ śreyo bhaviṣyati || 9 || itaḥ śāpabhayaṃ tīvramito duḥkhaṃ ca putrajam|| varaṃ putraviyogo'stu na śāpo dvijasaṃbhavaḥ || 7.3.3.10 || sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā naṃdivardhanamuktavān || gaccha tvaṃ putra me vākyādvasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ prati || 11 || tatrāsti vivaro raudrastaṃ prapūraya satvaram || arbudaṃ nāgamādāya mitraṃ prāṇabhṛtāṃ varam || 12 || || naṃdivarddhana uvāca || || pāpīyānsa vibho deśaḥ phalamūlairvivarjitaḥ || pālāśaiḥ khādirairāḍhyo dhavaiḥ śālmalibhistathā || 13 || suniṣṭhurairnṛpaśubhirbhillaiśca vividhairapi || nadyo vahaṃti no tatra duṣṭā lokāśca vāsinaḥ || nārho'haṃ parvataśreṣṭha tatra gaṃtuṃ kathaṃcana || 14 || athovāca vasiṣṭhastaṃ saṃtrastaṃ naṃdivarddhanam || mā bhīḥ kāryā tvayā tatra deśe dauṣṭyātkathaṃcana || 15 || tava mūrdhni sadā vāso mama tatra bhaviṣyati || tīrthāni sarito devāḥ puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || 16 || vṛkṣāśca vividhākārāḥ patrapuṣpaphalānvitāḥ || sadā tatra bhaviṣyaṃti mṛgāśca vihagāḥ śubhāḥ || 17 || ahamevānayiṣyāmi tavārthe ca maheśvaram || tadā sthāsyaṃti vai tatra sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || || 18 || || sūta uvāca || || vasiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutva saṃhṛṣṭo naṃdivarddhanaḥ || arbudaṃ nāgamāsādya vākyametaduvāca ha || 19 || tatra yāvo'dya bhadraṃ te vayasya vinayānvita || etatkāryamahaṃ manye sāṃprataṃ dvijasaṃbhavam || 7.3.3.20 || || arbuda uvāca || || ahaṃ tatrāgamiṣyāmi snehātte parvatātmaja || tatraiva ca vasiṣyāmi tvayā sārddhamasaṃśayam|| 21 || kiṃ tvahaṃ praṇayādbhrātarvakṣyāmi yadvacaḥ śṛṣu || praṇayānnānyathā kāryaṃ yadyahaṃ tava saṃmataḥ || 22 || mannāmnā khyātimāyātu nānyatkiṃcidvṛṇomyaham|| tataḥ so'pi pratijñāya ārūḍhastasya copari || praṇamya pitarau caiva pratasthe muninā saha || 23 || divyairvṛkṣaiḥ śubhaiḥ pūrṇairnadīnirjharasaṃkulaiḥ || madhurairvihagairyukto mṛgaiḥ saumyaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 24 || mukto'rbudena tatraiva vivare munivākyataḥ || samastastatrānāsāgraṃ gataḥ parvatasattamaḥ || 25 || vimukto vivare tasminnarbudena mahātmanā || paripūrṇe mahāraudre saṃtuṣṭo munipuṃgavaḥ || 26 || bravīccārbudaṃ nāgaṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata || parituṣṭo'smi te bhadra karmaṇānena pannaga || 27 || || arbuda uvāca || || eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ yattvaṃ tuṣṭo mahāmune || avaśyaṃ yadi dātavyaṃ tacchṛṇuṣva dvijottama || 28 || yaccaitacchikhare hyasminnirjharaṃ nirmalodakam || nāgatīrthamiti khyātiṃ bhūtale yātu sarvataḥ || 29 || atraivāhaṃ vasiṣyāmi mitrasnehātsadā mune || tatra snātvā divaṃ yātu mānavastvatprasādataḥ || 7.3.3.30 || api vaṃdhyā ca yā nārī snānamātraṃ samācaret|| sā syātputravatī vipra sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyutā || 31 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || yā vaṃdhyāsmiñjale pūrṇe snānamātraṃ kariṣyati || sāpi putramavāpnoti sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 32 || nabhasaḥ śuklapaṃcamyāṃ phalaiḥ pūjāṃ karoti ca || api varṣaśatā nārī sā bhaviṣyati putriṇī || 33 || ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti hyasmiṃstīrthe ca bhaktitaḥ || yāsyaṃti te paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 34 || śrāddhaṃ cātra kariṣyaṃti paṃcamyāṃ ye samāhitāḥ || māse nabhasi tīrthasya phalaṃ teṣāṃ bhaviṣyati || 35 || || sūta uvāca || || evaṃ dattvā varaṃ tasya vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ || naṃdivarddhanamabhyetya vākyametaduvāca ha || 36 || varaṃ ca vriyatāṃ vatsa parituṣṭo'smi te'nagha || vinayātsauhṛdātsarvaṃ dāsyāmi yatsudurllabham|| 37 || || naṃdivarddhana uvāca || || tavāstu vacanaṃ satyaṃ pūrvoktaṃ munisattama || sāṃnidhyaṃ jāyatāmatra avaśyaṃ tava sarvadā || 38 || yathāhamarbudetyevaṃ khyātiṃ gacchāmi bhūtale || prasādāccaiva te bhūyādetanme manasi sthitam || 39 || || sūta uvāca || || evamastviti taṃ procya vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ || cakre svamāśramaṃ tatra tasya vākyena noditaḥ || 7.3.3.40 || panasaiścaṃpakairāmraiḥ priyaṃgubilvadāḍimaiḥ || nānāpakṣisamāyukto devagandharvasevitaḥ || 41 || tasthau tatra muniśreṣṭho hyaruṃdhatyā samanvitaḥ || gomatīmānayāmāsa tapasā munisattamaḥ || 42 || yasyāṃ snātvā divaṃ yāṃti atipāpakṛto narāḥ || māghamāse viśeṣeṇa makarasthe divākare || 43 || yetra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim ||44|| māghamāse viśeṣeṇa tiladānaṃ karoti yaḥ || tilasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ || 45 || bahunā kimihoktena stānamātraṃ samācaret || 46 || vasiṣṭhasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā punarjanma na vidyate || aruṃdhatī pūjanīyā pūjanīyā viśeṣataḥ || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vasiṣṭhājñayā nandivardhanaparvatena vivarapūraṇavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3 ||
<7.3.4>
sūta uvāca || || sa kṛtvā svāśramaṃ tatra vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ || tatra śaṃbhornivāsāya tapastepe sudāruṇam|| 1 || sa babhūva muniḥ samyakphalāhārasamanvitaḥ || śīrṇa parṇāśanaḥ paścāddve śate samapadyata || 2 || jalāhāraḥ pañcaśatavarṣāṇi saṃbabhūva ha || varṣāṇāṃ vāyubhakṣo'bhūttato daśaśatāni ca || 3 || pañcāgnisādhako grīṣme hemante salilāśayaḥ || varṣāsvākāśavāsī ca sahasraṃ ca tato'bhavat || 4 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevastasyarṣeḥ sumahātmanaḥ || bhittvā taṃ parvataṃ sadyastatpuro liṃgamutthitam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayāviṣṭo muniḥ stotramudairayat|| 5 || namaḥ śivāya śuddhāya sarvagāyā'mṛtāya ca || kaparddine namastubhyaṃ namastasmai trimūrttaye || 6 || namaḥ sthūlāya sūkṣmāya vyāpakāya mahātmane || niṣaṃgiṇe namastubhyaṃ trinetrāya namonamaḥ || 7 || namaścandrakalādhāra namo digvasanāya ca || pinākapāṇaye tubhyamaṣṭamūrte namonamaḥ || 8|| namaste jñānarūpāya jñānagamyāya te namaḥ || namaste jñānadehāya sarvajñānamayāya ca || 9 || kāśīpate namastubhyaṃ giriśāya namonamaḥ || jagatkāraṇarūpāya mahādevāya te namaḥ || 7.3.4.10 || gaurīkānta nama stubhyaṃ namastubhyaṃ śivātmane || brahmaviṣṇusvarūpāya trinetrāya namonamaḥ || 11 || viśvarūpāya śuddhāya namastubhyaṃ mahātmane || namo viśvasvarūpāya sarvadevamayāya ca || 12 || || sūta uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || parituṣṭo'smi te bhadraṃ varaṃ varaya suvrata || 13 || ityuktvā parvataṃ bhittvā tatpuro liṃgamutthitam || 14 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || liṃge'smiṃstava sāṃnidhyaṃ sadā bhavatu śaṃkara || mayā pūrvaṃ pratijñātaṃ nagasyeha mahātmane || satyaṃ kuru vaco me tvaṃ yadi tuṣṭo'si śaṃkara || 15 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || adyaprabhṛti liṃge'sminsāṃnidhyaṃ me bhaviṣyati || tvadvākyādbrāhmaṇaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ satyaṃ bhaviṣyati || 16 || stotreṇānena yo martyo māṃ staviṣyati bhaktitaḥ || kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāmāśvine munisattama || 17 || matpriyārthaṃ tu śakreṇa preṣitā munisattama || mandākinīti vikhyātā nadī trailokyapāvinī || 18 || devasyottaradigbhāge kuṃḍaṃ tiṣṭhati nityaśaḥ || tasyāṃ snātvā muniśreṣṭha liṃgaṃ me paśyate tu yaḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 19 || acalaṃ bhedayitvā tu yasmānme liṃgamudgatam|| acaleśvaranāmnaiva loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 7.3.4.20 || asya liṃgasya māhātmyānna kadāciccaliṣyati || sarvathā ma idaṃ liṃgaṃ pralayānte na cālyate || 21 || || sūta uvāca || etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ virarāma maheśvaraḥ || vasiṣṭho'pi suhṛṣṭātmā gautamādyā munīśvarāḥ || 22 || śakrādayastato devāstīrthānyāyatanāni ca || ānayāmāsa brahmarṣistapasā parvatottame || 23 || tatastuṣṭaḥ suraśreṣṭhastatra vāsamathākarot|| 24 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe'caleśvarotpatti varṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<7.3.5>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || arbudasya ca māhātmyaṃ vistareṇa vadasva naḥ || kautukaṃ sūta no jātaṃ kathayasva yathā śubham || 1 || || sūta uvāca || || purāsīcca ṛṣiśreṣṭhaḥ pulastyo bhagavānmuniḥ || yayāteśca gṛhe yātastaṃ natvā cābravīnnṛpaḥ|| 2 || | | yayātiruvāca || || svāgataṃ te muniśreṣṭha saphalaṃ me'dyajīvitam || kathayasva prasādena kathāmarbudasaṃbhavām || 3 || arbudākhyo nago nāma vikhyāto yo dharātale || tasya yātrākramaṃ brūhi tatphalaṃ dvijasattama || 4 || sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi tīrthayātrāparāyaṇa || tasmādvada muniśreṣṭha yena yātrāṃ karomyaham ||5 || || pulastya uvāca || || bahudharmamayo rājannarbudaḥ parvatottamaḥ || aśakto vistarādvaktumapi varṣaśatairapi || 6 || saṃkṣepādeva vakṣyāmi tīrthamukhyāni te tathā || nāgatīrthaṃ tu tatrādyaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām || 7 || nārīṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa putrasaubhāgyadāyakam || śṛṇu rājanpurāvṛttaṃ yato'tyāścaryamuttamam|| 8 || gautamī brāhmaṇī nāmnā satī sādhvī pativratā || bālavaidhavyasaṃprāptā tīrthayātrāparāyaṇā || 9 || arbudaṃ sā ca saṃprāptā nāgatīrthaṃ viveśa ha || tasmiñjale nimagnā sā snātumabhyāyayau purā || 7.3.5.10 || nāyakā putrasaṃyuktā tattīrthaṃ samupāgatā || śuśrūṣāṃ sā tastasyāścakre nānāvidhāṃ nṛpa || 11 || sarvopakaraṇairdarbhaiḥ sumanobhiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || atha sā ciṃtayāmāsa gautamī putraduḥkhitā || 12 || dhanyo'yaṃ tanayo hyasyāḥ śuśrūṣāṃ kurute sadā || putrayuktā tviyaṃ dhanyā dhigahaṃ putravarjitā || 13 || ahaṃ bhartrā viyuktā ca putrahīnā suduḥkhitā || atha sā nirgatā tasmātsalilānnṛpasattama ||14|| vinā'pi bhartṛsaṃyogātsadyo garbhavatī hyabhūt || sā garbhalakṣaṇairyuktā sujanavrīḍayā'nvitā || 15 || cakāra maraṇe buddhiṃ jvālayāmāsa pāvakam || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 16 || || vāguvāca || || no tvaṃ gautami cityāgnau praveśaṃ kartumarhasi || doṣo nāsti tavātrārthe tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 17 || yo yadvāṃchati citte ca jalamadhye sthito naraḥ || cintitaṃ ca tadāpnoti nārī vā nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 || tvayā tasyāḥ sutaṃ dṛṣṭvā putravāṃchā kṛtā hṛdi || tava garbhagato nūnaṃ putraḥ putri bhaviṣyati || 19 || tasmādvirama bhadraṃ te nirdoṣāsi pativrate || virarāma tataḥ sādhvī gautamī maraṇānnṛpa || 7.3.5.20 || śrutvā''kāśagatāṃ vāṇīṃ devadūtena bhāṣitām || dṛṣṭvā patiṃ vinā garbhaṃ vākyameta duvāca ha || 21 || aho tīrthaprabhāvo'yamapūrvaḥ pratibhāti me || yatra saṃjāyate garbhaḥ strīṇāṃ śukrarajovinā || 22 || nāhaṃ kutrāpi yāsyāmi muktvedaṃ tīrthamuttamam || evamuktvā tataḥ sādhvī tatraiva nyavasatsadā ||23|| putraṃ vai janayāmāsa sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || tatra pārthivaśārdūla kṛṣṇapakṣe 'śvinasya ca ||24|| yaḥ punaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ tasya vaṃśo na naśyati || na preto jāyate rājanvaṃśe tasya kadācana ||25|| yaḥ pumānkāmarahitaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret|| śrāddhaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ ||26|| yā strī puṣpaphalānyeva tīrthe cāsminvisarjayet || sā syātputravatī dhanyā saubhāgyaṃ ca prapadyate || 27 || niṣkāmā svargamāpnoti duṣprāpyaṃ tridaśairapi || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrāṃ tasya samācaret || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe nāgatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 || ||
<7.3.6>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha vasiṣṭhaṃ tapasāṃ nidhim || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyakkṛtārthatvamavāpnuyāt || 1 || tatrāsti jalasampūrṇaṃ kuṇḍaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇām|| tasminkuṇḍe nṛpaśreṣṭha vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā || 2 || gomatī ca samānītā tapasā nṛpasattama || tatra snāto naraḥ samyakpātakai rvipramucyate ||3|| ṛṣidhānyena yastatra śrāddhaṃ nṛpa samācaret || sa pitṛṃstārayetsarvānpakṣayorubhayorapi ||4|| atra gāthā purā gītā nāradena mahātma nā || snātvā puṇyodake tatra dṛṣṭvā taṃ munisattamam || 5 || kiṃ gayāśrāddhadānena kimanyairmakhavistaraiḥ || vasiṣṭhasyāśramaṃ prāpya yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || sa pitṝṃstārayetsarvānātmanā nṛpasattama || 6 || tatraivāruṃdhatī sādhvī vasiṣṭhasya samīpataḥ || pūjanīyā viśeṣeṇa sarvakāmapradā nṛṇām || 7 || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi vā || vasiṣṭhadarśanātsadyo narāṇāṃ yāti saṃkṣayam ||8|| dīpaṃ prayacchate yastu vasiṣṭhāgre samāhitaḥ || sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyuktastejasvī jāyate naraḥ || 9 || upavāsaparo yastu tatraikā rajanīṃ nayet || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yatra saptarṣayo'malāḥ || 7.3.6.10 || trirātriṃ kurute yastu vasiṣṭhāgre samāhitaḥ || sa yāti ca maharlokaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitaḥ || 11 || yastu māsopavāsaṃ ca vasiṣṭhāgre karoti ca || so'pi muktimavāpnoti na yāti sa bhavārṇavam|| 12|| śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ|| ṛṣiṃ tarpayate yastu brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati||13|| vasiṣṭhasyāgrato yastu gāyatryaṣṭaśataṃ japet|| ājanmamaraṇātpāpātsadyo mucyeta mānavaḥ|| 14|| vāmadevaṃ yajettatra yadi śraddhāsamanvitaḥ|| agniṣṭomaphalaṃ rājansadyaḥ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 15 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena draṣṭavyo'sau mahāmuniḥ || śucibhiḥ śraddhayā yuktāste yāsyaṃti paraṃ padam || 16 || tasmātsarvātmanā rājanvāmadevaṃ ca pūjayet|| 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe vasiṣṭhāśramamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || || cha || ||
<7.3.7>
pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha supuṇyamacaleśvaram || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā siddhimāpnoti naraḥ śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 1 || tatra kṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || āśvine phālgune vāpi sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 2 || yastu pūjayate bhaktyā dakṣiṇāṃ diśamāsthitaḥ || puṣpaiḥ patraiḥ phalaiścaiva so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 3 || paṃcāmṛtena yastatra tarpaṇaṃ kuru te naraḥ || so'pi devasya sāṃnidhyaṃ śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 4 || pradakṣiṇāṃte yastasya praṇāmaṃ kurute naraḥ || naśyaṃti sarvapāpāni pradakṣiṇapadepade || 5 || tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ tattvaṃ śṛṇu mahāmate || mayā pūrvaṃ śrutaṃ svarge nāradācchakrasannidhau || 6 || tatra pūrvaṃ śuko nīḍaṃ vṛkṣe caivākaroddvijaḥ || gatāgatena nīḍasya kurute taṃ pradakṣiṇām|| 7 || na ca bhaktyā mahārāja pakṣiyonisamudbhavaḥ || athāsau mṛtyumāpannaḥ kālena mahatā śukaḥ || 8 || saṃjātaḥ pārthive vaṃśe rājā veṇuriti smṛtaḥ || jātismaro mahārāja sarvaśatrunikṛntanaḥ || 9 || sa taṃ smṛtvā prabhāvaṃ hi pradakṣiṇāsamudbhavam || acaleśvaramāsādya pradakṣiṇāmathākarot || 7.3.7.10 || naktaṃ dinaṃ mahārāja nānyatkiṃcitkaroti saḥ || na tathā tapase yatno na naivedye kathaṃcana || 11 || na puṣpe dhūpadāne ca pradakṣiṇāparaḥ sadā || kenacittvatha kālena munayo'tra samāgatāḥ || 12 || nāradaḥ śaunakaścaiva hārīto devalastathā || gālavaḥ kapilo naṃdaḥ suhotraḥ kaśyapo nṛpaḥ || 13 || ete cānye ca bahavo devavrataparāyaṇāḥ || kecitsnānaṃ kārayaṃti tasya liṃgasya bhaktitaḥ || 14 || anye ca vividhāṃ pūjāṃ japamanye samāhitāḥ || eke nṛtyaṃti rājeṃdra gāyaṃti ca tathā pare || 15 || balimanye prayacchaṃti stutiṃ kurvaṃti cāpare || athāścaryaṃ paraṃ dṛṣṭvā pradakṣiṇāparaṃ nṛpam || 16 || paraṃ kautukamāpannā vākyametadathābruvan || pradakṣiṇāsamudbhūtaṃ kāraṇaṃ jñātumicchavaḥ || 17 || || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kasmāttvaṃ pārthivaśreṣṭha pradakṣiṇāparaḥ sadā || devasyāsya viśeṣeṇa satyaṃ no vaktumarhasi || 18 || na dadāsi jalaṃ liṃge prabhūtaṃ sumanoharam || puṣpadhūpādikaṃ vātha stotrāṇi vividhāni ca || 19 || samartho'si tathānyeṣāṃ dānānāṃ tvaṃ mahīpate || etannaḥ kautukaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || 7.3.7.20 || || veṇuruvāca || || yadahaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || pūrvadehāṃtare vṛttaṃ sarvaṃ satyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 21 || prāsāde'sminpurā pakṣī śuko'haṃ sthitavāṃstadā || kṛtavāṃśca tadā devaṃ pradakṣiṇāmaharniśam ||22|| kṛpayā'sya prabhāvācca jāto jātismarastvaham || adhunā parayā bhaktyā yatkaromi pradakṣiṇām || 23 || na jāne kiṃ phalaṃ me'dya devasyāsya prasādataḥ || etasmātkāraṇāccāhaṃ nānyatkiṃcitkaromi bhoḥ || 24 || || || pulastya uvāca || || veṇuvākyaṃ tataḥ śrutvā munayaḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || vismayotphullanayanāḥ sādhusādhviti cābruvan || 25 || tataḥ pradakṣiṇa parāḥ sarve tatra maharṣayaḥ || babhūvurmunayaḥ sarve śraddhayā parayā yutāḥ || 26 || so'pi rājā mahābhāgo veṇuḥ śaṃbhoḥ prasādataḥ || śāśvataṃ sthānamāpanno durllabhaṃ tridaśairapi || 27 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe'caleśvaraprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 ||
<7.3.8>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha bhadrakarṇaṃ mahāhradam || trinetrābhāḥ śilā yatra dṛśyaṃte'dyāpi bhūriśaḥ ||1|| tasyaiva paścime bhāge liṃgamasti pinākinaḥ || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavastatra trinetrasadṛśo bhavet || 2 || bhadrakarṇagaṇonāma purāsīcchivavallabhaḥ || tenātra sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ hradaścaiva vinirmitaḥ || 3 || kenacittvatha kālena saṃgrāme dānavaiḥ saha || yuyudhe purataḥ śaṃbhornānāgaṇasamanvitaḥ || 4 || naṣṭe skaṃde hate sainye vīrabhadre parājite || gatāste bhayasaṃtrastā mahākāle vinirjite || 5 || balavānnamucirnāma dānavo balavattaraḥ || khaḍgacarmadharaḥ śīghraṃ maheśvaramupādravat || 6 || bhadrakarṇastu taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ tadanaṃtaram || pataṃtaṃ saṃmukhastasya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt || 7 || chittvā'simasinā tasya carma cāpi mahābalaḥ || stanayoraṃtare daityaṃ kopāviṣṭo'hanannṛpa || 8 || athāsau nihatastena praviśya vipulaṃ tamaḥ || nipapāta mahīpṛṣṭhe vāyubhagna iva drumaḥ || vadhaṃ prāptastu daityo'sau natvā haramasau sthitaḥ || satye sthitaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 7.3.8.10 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || tava vīryeṇa saṃtuṣṭo dharmeṇa ca viśeṣataḥ || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yo hṛdaye sthitaḥ || 11 || || bhadrakarṇaṃ uvāca || || yanmayā sthāpitaṃ liṃgamarbude surasattama || atrāstu tava sāṃnidhyaṃ hrade'smiṃśca sthiro bhava || 12 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || māghamāse caturddaśyāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣe sadā mama || sāṃnidhyaṃ ca viśeṣeṇa hrade liṃge bhaviṣyati || 13 || bhadrakarṇahrade snātvā trinetraṃ yaḥ samāhitaḥ || drakṣyate sa tu me sthānaṃ śāśvataṃ yāsyati dhuvam || 14 || tasmātsarvatra yatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || pūjayitvā ca talliṃgaṃ śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 15 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe bhadrakarṇahradatrinetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || || cha ||
<7.3.9>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || kedāramiti vikhyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇām || 1 || yatra mandākinī puṇyā sarasvatyā samāgatā || tatra snāto naro rājanmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 2 || śṛṇu rājanyathāvṛttamitihāsa purātanam || ṛṣibhirbahudhā gītamarbude parvatottame || 3 || ajapālo nṛpaśreṣṭhaḥ sūryavaṃśasamudbhavaḥ || saptadvīpavatīṃ pṛthvīṃ sa pāti nātra saṃśayaḥ || 4 || na hastino na pādātā na cāśvāstasya bhūpateḥ || na rathāśca mahārāja na kośāśca tathāvidhāḥ || 5 || na gṛhṇāti karaṃ rājanprajābhyothādhikaṃ nṛpa || rājyaṃ sa īdṛśaṃ cakre sarvalokahite rataḥ ||6|| jātāparādho bhūpṛṣṭhe jāyate cetkathaṃcana || taṃ gatvā nigrahaṃ tasya cakruḥ śastrāṇi tatkṣaṇāt || 7 || evamasya narendrasya varttamānasya bhūtale || sukhena ramate loko rājye nihatakaṃṭake || 8 || kāmaṃ varṣati parjanyaḥ sasyāni rasavaṃti ca || gāvaḥ prabhūtadugdhāśca vidyamāne narādhipe || 9 || kenacittvatha kālena vasiṣṭho bhagavānmuniḥ || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena tasya gehamupāgataḥ || 7.3.9.10 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pūjayāmāsa śāstradṛṣṭena vartmanā || pratyutthānābhivādābhyāmarghyapādyādibhistathā || 11 || evaṃ saṃpūjitastena bhaktyā paramayā nṛpa || sukhopaviṣṭo viśrāṃto vasiṣṭho munisattamaḥ || rājarṣīṇāṃ kathāścakre devarṣīṇāṃ tathaiva ca || | || 12 || tataḥ kathāvasāne tu kasmiṃścinnṛpasattama || papraccha vinayopetastaṃ muniṃ śaṃsitavratam || 13 || || ajapāla uvāca || || atītānāgataṃ vipra varttamānaṃ tathaiva ca || tvaṃ vetsi sakalaṃ brahmaṃstapaścaryāprabhāvataḥ || 14 || kautukaṃ hṛdi me jātaṃ varttate munipuṃgava || prasādaḥ kriyatāṃ mahyaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ || 15 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca|| || brūhi pārthivaśārdūla yatte manasi varttate || kathayiṣyāmi tatsarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham || 16 || || rājovāca || || kena karmavipākena mamaitadrājyamuttamam || niṣkaṇṭakaṃ sadā kṣemaṃ sarvakāmasamanvitam || 17 || na dīno na ca duḥkhārtto vyādhigrasto na ko'pi ca || vidyate mama rājye ca na daridro mahāmune || 18 || nārīyaṃ mama sādhvī ca prāṇebhyo'pi garīyasī || maccittā madgataprāṇā nityaṃ mama hite ratā || anayā ciṃtitaṃ brahmansarvaṃ vistarato vada || 19 || kiṃ dānasya prabhāvena vratayāgasya vā mune || tapaso vā muniśreṣṭha vratasya niyamasya ca || 7.3.9.20 || janmāntarakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || kathayasva prasādena vistareṇa dvijottama || 21 || || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || śṛṇu sarvaṃ mahīpāla vistareṇa ca kathyate || na ca manyustvayā kāryo na ca vrīḍā mahāmate || 22 || anyadehāṃtare rājañchūdrajātisamudbhavaḥ || śūdrajātiriyaṃ sādhvī tava patnī hyabhūtpurā || 23 || kenacittvatha kālena durbhikṣe samupasthite || annakṣayānmahārāja sarva lokaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ || 24 || tatastvaṃ bhāryayā sārddhamanyadeśāṃtare gataḥ || samāruhya ca kṛcchreṇa kasmiṃścidgirinirjhare || 25 || tvayā dṛṣṭaṃ manohāri śubhaṃ paṃkajakānanam || tatra snātvā payaḥ pītvā pitṛdevāḥ pratarpitāḥ || 26 || manasā ciṃtitaṃ hyetatpadmānyādāya karomyaham || vikrayaṃ yena cāhāro bhavenmama ca sarvathā || 27 || tataḥ padmāni bhūrīṇi gṛhītvā bhāryayā saha || gato yatra jano bhūri gataḥ pārthivasattama || 28 || na ke'pi prati gṛhṇaṃti lokā durbhikṣapīḍitāḥ|| bhramitastvaṃ ca sarvatra śrāṃto vairāgyamāgataḥ || 29 || tato dināvasāne tu guhāmekāṃ samāśritaḥ || bhūmau padmāni nikṣipya kṣudhāviṣṭaḥ prasuptavān|| 7.3.9.30 || etasminneva kāle tu karṇayoste samāgataḥ || paṭhatāṃ dvijamukhyānāṃ dhvanirvedapurāṇayoḥ || 31 || taṃ śrutvā sahasotthāya jñātvā jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ || padmānyādāya tatraiva sabhāryaḥ śivamaṃdire || 32 || tatra nāgavatī veśyā śivarātriparāyaṇā || kedāre parayā bhaktyā karoti niśi jāgaram || 33 || tasyāḥ pārśve sthitā dāsī tvayā pṛṣṭā nareśvara || devasya purato bāle kimarthaṃ rātrijāgaram || 34 || tayoktaṃ śivarātryāṃ vai veśyeyaṃ varavarṇinī || kurute nāgavatī nāma rātrau bhaktyā ca jāgaram || 35 || yaḥ śraddhābhaktisaṃyuktaḥ kurute rātrijāgaram || pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ sa yāti paramaṃ padam|| 36 || kṛtvopavāsaṃ padmairyyaḥ pūjayettryaṃbakaṃ naraḥ || sa yāti rudrasālokyaṃ sevyamāno 'psarogaṇaiḥ || 37 || sakāmo labhate kāmāndevairapi sudurllabhān || sa tvaṃ padmāni me dehi kāṃcanaṃ ca palatrayam|| eteṣāṃ mūlyamādāya prāṇādhāraṃ samācara || 38 || tatastvaṃ bhāryayā cokto gṛhyamāṇe ca kāṃcane || na grāhyaṃ mūlyameteṣāṃ tvayā nātha kathaṃcana || 39 || upavāso balājjāto hyannābhāvādvayorapi || padmairebhirharaḥ pūjyo dvābhyāmevādya niścayam || 7.3.9.40|| idaṃ tvayā'dya karttavyaṃ tyājyamasyāstu kāṃcanam|| bhāryāyā vacanaṃ śrutvā taiḥ padmaiḥ pūjitaḥ śivaḥ ||41|| śraddhayā ca sabhāryeṇa jāgaraṃ ca śivāgrataḥ || kṛtaṃ tvayā mahārāja bhāryayā śivamaṃdire ||42|| purāṇaśravaṇaṃ jātaṃ tatra pārthivasattama || śivarātryāṃ mahārāja padmaistu pūjitaḥ śivaḥ ||43|| kedārasyāgrato bhaktyā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā|| kṛtaṃ tvayā mahārāja ekāgreṇa ca cetasā||44|| tataḥprabhāte saṃjāte bhikṣāṃ kṛtvā ca pāraṇā || kṛtā tvayā mahārāja śivāgre saha bhāryayā ||44|| tataḥ kālāṃtareṇaiva kāladharmaṃ gato bhavān || bhāryeyaṃ ca tvayā sārdhaṃ saṃpraviṣṭā hutāśanam ||46|| tato jātā mahārāja daśārṇādhipateḥ sutā || vaidehe nagare rājā jātastvaṃ pārthivottama || 47 || ajapāla iti khyāto nāmnā ca dharaṇītale || sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tvaṃ ca vallabho nṛpasattama || 48 || etasmātkāraṇājjātā bhāryeyaṃ prāṇasaṃmatā || bhūyo'pi tava saṃjātā yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi ||49|| tasya devasya māhātmyātkedārasya mahīpateḥ || rājyaṃ te sukhadaṃ nṛṇāṃ tathā nihatakaṇṭakam || 7.3.9.50 || prāptaṃ tvayā mahārāja kedārasya prasādataḥ || yena tvaṃ sainyahīno'pi pṛthivīṃ parirakṣasi || 51 || || pulastya uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājā vismayānvitaḥ || gamanāya matiṃ cakre kedāraṃ prati bhūmipaḥ || 52 || sa gatvā parvate ramye pūjayitvā ca taṃ vibhum || śivarātriparaḥ samyagvarṣevarṣe babhūva ha || 53 || putraṃ rājye ca saṃsthāpya tato'rbudamathāgamat || prāpto muktiṃ tato bhūyaḥ sabhāryastatprabhāvataḥ || 54 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ kedārasya mahīpate || māhātmyaṃ śubhadaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarva pāpapraṇāśanam || 55 || māghaphālgunayormadhye kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśī || śivarātririti khyātā bhūtale'sminmahāmate || 56 || tasyāṃ tu sarvathā rājanyātrāṃ tasya samācaret|| kedārasya mahārāja prakuryātpūjanaṃ nṛpa || 57 || māghakṛṣṇacaturdaśyāṃ yaḥ kuryāttatra jāgaram || kṛtopavāso nṛpate śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 58 || snātvā gaṃgāsarasvatyoḥ saṃgame sarvakāmade || ye prapaśyanti kedāraṃ te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || 59 || kuṇḍe kedārasaṃjñe yaḥ prapibedvimalaṃ jalam || saptapūrvānsapta parānpūrvajāṃstārayettu saḥ || 7.3.9.60 || yaścaitacchṛṇuyānnityaṃ bhaktyā paramayā nṛpa || so'pi pāpairvimucyeta kedārasya prabhāvataḥ || 61 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe kedāramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
<7.3.10>
|| yayātiruvāca || || kedāraṃ śrūyate brahmanparvate ca himācale || gaṃgā tasmādviniṣkrāntā praviṣṭā pūrvasāgaram || 1 || tathā sarasvatī devī cūtavṛkṣādvinirgatā || paścimaṃ sāgaraṃ prāptā gṛhītvā vaḍavānalam|| 2 || kathamatra samāyātaḥ kedāraścātra kautukam|| sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi vicitraṃ mama bhūsura || 3 || || pulastya uvāca || || satyametanmahārāja yanno'tra paripṛcchasi || śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā yathā jātaṃ śrutaṃ tu vai || 4 || gaṃgādyāni ca tīrthāni kedārādyā divaukasaḥ || mayā saha purā devāḥ śakrādyā nṛpasattamāḥ || 5 || brahmāṇaṃ prati rājendra gatāḥ sarve maharṣayaḥ|| sarve tatra kathāścakrurdharmyā nānā pṛthakpṛthak || 6 || samudāye ca devānāṃ sarvatīrthāni pārthiva || kṣetrāṇyupa sthitānyeva vanānyupavanāni ca || 7 || tataḥ kathāprasaṃgena indraḥ prāha caturmukham || kautukena samāyuktaḥ papraccha nṛpasattama || 8 || || || indra uvāca || || bhagavanpuṇyamāhātmyaṃ śrotumicchāmi sāṃpratam || pramāṇaṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ kṛtādīnāṃ pṛthagvidham || 9 || || brahmovāca || || lakṣaṃ saptadaśa proktaṃ yugamānaṃ surādhipa || aṣṭāviṃśatibhiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasraiḥ kṛtamucyate || 7.3.10.10 || lakṣadvādaśabhiḥ proktaṃ yugaṃ tretābhisaṃjñitam || ṣaṇṇavatyadhikaiścaiva sahasraiḥ parimāṇitam|| 11 || lakṣāṇyaṣṭau catuḥṣaṣṭisahasraiḥ parikīrtitam || tato vai dvāparaṃ nāma yugaṃ devaprakīrtitam || 12 || lakṣaiścaturbhirvikhyāto dvātriṃśadbhiḥ kalistathā|| sahasraiśca suraśreṣṭha yugamānamitīritam|| 13|| catuṣpadaḥ kṛte dharmaḥ śuklavarṇo janārdanaḥ|| na durbhikṣaṃ na ca vyādhistasminbhavati vai kvacit || 14 || kriyate ca tadā dharmo nākāle maraṇaṃ nṛṇām || lāṃgalena vinā sasyaṃ bhūrikṣīrāśca dhenavaḥ || 15 || kāmaḥ krodho bhayaṃ lobho matsaraścābhyasūyatā || tasminyuge sahasrākṣa na bhavaṃti kadācana || 16 || tatastretāyuge jātastripādo dharma eva ca || cirāyuṣo narāstasminraktavarṇo janārdanaḥ || 17 || tasminyajñāḥ pravarttaṃte prāṇināmiṣṭadāyinaḥ || na kāmādipravṛttiśca tasminsaṃjāyate nṛṇām|| 18 || tapasā brahmacaryeṇa snānairdānaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ || tathā yajñairjapairhomaistatra vṛttirbhavennṛṇām || 19 || tatastu dvāparaṃ nāma tṛtīyaṃ yuga mucyate || dvipado dharmaḥ sañjātaḥ pītavarṇo janārddanaḥ || 7.3.10.20 || phalākāṃkṣāpravṛttāni japayajñatapāṃsi ca || satyānṛtānvito loko dvāpare surasattama || 21 || tatrānyonyaṃ mahīpālā yuyudhurvasudhātale || supūtāśca divaṃ yāṃti yajñairiṣṭvā janārdanam || 22 || tataḥ kaliyugaṃ ghoraṃ caturthaṃ tu prava rttate || ekapādo bhaveddharmaḥ saṃtrasto nityapūjane || 23 || kṛṣṇavarṇo bhavedviṣṇuḥ pāpādhikyaṃ pravartate || māyā ca matsaraścaiva kāmaḥ krodhastathā bhayam || 24 || arthalubdhāstathā bhūpā lobhamohaśatānvitāḥ || alpāyuṣo narāstatra alpasasyā ca medinī || 25 || alpakṣīrāstathā gāvaḥ satyahīnā dvijātayaḥ || tatra māyāvino lokā jaihvyaupasthyaparāyaṇāḥ || 26 || satyahīnāstathā pāpā bhaviṣyaṃti kalau yuge || tatra ṣoḍaśame varṣe narāḥ palitakuntalāḥ || 27 || nāryo dvādaśame varṣe bhaviṣyaṃti sugarbhitāḥ || bhaviṣyati kramādvarṇasaṃkaraśca surādhipa || 28 || ekākārā bhaviṣyaṃti sarvavarṇāśramāśca vai || nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti yajñāśca kuladharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 29 || vyarthāni tatra tīrthāni mlecchaspṛṣṭāni sarvaśaḥ || bhaviṣyaṃti suraśreṣṭha prabhāvarahitāni ca || 7.3.10.30 || etacchrutvā tato vākyaṃ brahmaṇo'vyaktajanmanaḥ || tatra sthitāni tīrthāni brahmāṇamidamabruvan || || 31 || || tīrthānyūcuḥ || || kathaṃ vayaṃ bhaviṣyāmaḥ saṃprāpte dāruṇe kalau || sthānaṃ no brūhi deveśa sthātavyaṃ ca sadaiva hi || 32 || || brahmovāca || || arbudaḥ parvataśreṣṭhaḥ kalistatra na vidyate || atastatra ca gaṃtavyaṃ tīrthairāyatanaiḥ saha || 33 || api kṛtvā mahatpāpamarbudaṃ prekṣate tu yaḥ || kalidoṣavinirmuktaḥ sa yāsyati parāṃ gatim ||34|| || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā caturvaktro brahmalokaṃ gato nṛpa || tataḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni gatāni ca kalau yuge || 35 || bhūmāvarbudaśailendre saṃsthitāni kalerbhayāt || gaṃgā sarasvatī caiva yamunā puṣkarāṇi ca || 36 || kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ ca brahmāvartaṃ tathaiva ca|| tisraḥkoṭyo'rddhakoṭiśca yāni tīrthāni bhūtale || 37 || teṣāṃ vāsaśca sañjātaḥ parvate'rbudasaṃjñike || evaṃ tatra samāpannā gaṃgā caiva sarasvatī || 38 || tatra śāṃtā narāḥ samyakparaṃ nirvāṇamāpnuyuḥ || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā mahārāja svarge yāṃti ca pūrvajāḥ || 39 || śṛṇu tatrābhavatpūrvaṃ yadāścaryaṃ mahāmate || ṛṣirmaṃkaṇakonāma sarasvatyāstaṭe sthitaḥ || 7.3.10.40 || tapastepe sudharmātmā kāmakrodhavivarjitaḥ || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya kṣutamāsītkadācana || 41 || pittaṃ prapatitaṃ tatra tacca raktamayaṃ babhau || taddṛṣṭvā'tīva hṛṣṭaḥ sa maṃkaṇarṣirbabhūva ha || 42 || siddho'hamiti vijñāya tato nṛtyaṃ cakāra saḥ || tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || 43 || tatra saṃkṣobhamāpannaṃ sāgarā api cukṣubhuḥ || gṛhakṛtyāni saṃtyajya sarve vismayamā gatāḥ || 44 || tasyaivaṃ nṛtyamānasya sarve lokā nṛpottama || nanṛtuḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha prabhāvāttasya sanmuneḥ || 45 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve gatvā kāmaniṣūdanam || yathā'yaṃ nṛtyate naiva tathā kuru maheśvara ||46|| atha brāhmaṇarūpeṇa śaṃbhunokto dvijottamaḥ || tvayā brahmaṃstapastaptamadhunā nṛtyate katham || || 47 || || maṃkaṇa uvāca || || kiṃ na paśyasi he brahmanraktaṃ pittaṃ ca me sthitam || saṃjātaṃ siddhimāpanno raktaṃ pittaṃ yato mama || 48 || etasmātkāraṇāddharṣāddvija nṛtyaṃ karomyaham || evamuktastatastena devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 49 || tarjanyā tāḍayāmāsa svāṃguṣṭhaṃ nṛpasattama || tatoṃguṣṭhādviniṣkrāṃtaṃ bhasma vai bisapāṃḍuram || 7.3.10.50 || tato maṃkaṇakaṃ prāha paśya vipra karānmama || śubhraṃ bhasma viniṣkrāṃtaṃ paśya me dvija kautukam || 51 || || || pulastya uvāca || || taddṛṣṭvā vismito vipro jñātvā taṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā vākyametaduvāca ha ||52|| || maṃkaṇa uvāca || || nūnaṃ bhavānmahādevaḥ sākṣāddṛṣṭaḥ prasīda me || niścitaṃ tvaṃ mayā jñāta etanme hṛdi vartate || 53 || nānyasyāyaṃ prabhāvaśca tvayā yo me pradarśitaḥ || māṃ samuddhara deveśa kṛpāṃ kṛtvā maheśvara || 54 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || samyagjñāto'smi viprendra tvayā'haṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nṛtyādhikyaṃ yataḥ kṛtam || 55 || || maṃkaṇa uvāca || || ye'tra snānaṃ prakurvaṃti sarasvatyāṃ samāhitāḥ || tvatprasādātphalaṃ teṣāṃ rājasūyāśvamedhayoḥ || 56 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti sarasvatyāṃ samāhitāḥ || te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 57 || atra gaṃgāsarasvatyoḥ saṃgame lokaviśrute || śrāddhaṃ kuryurdvijaśreṣṭha te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || 58 || suvarṇaṃ ye'tra dāsyaṃti yathāśaktyā dvijottame || sarva pāpavinirmuktāste yāsyanti parāṃ gatim || 59 || ityuktvāṃtardadhe rājandevadevo maheśvaraḥ || 7.3.10.60 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe'rbudācale kaliyugapabhāvātsarvatīrthāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 ||
<7.3.11>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha devaṃ koṭīśvaraṃ param || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyakparāṃ siddhimavāpnuyāt || 1 || śṛṇu tatrābhavatpūrvaṃ yadāścaryaṃ mahīpate || dakṣiṇasyā munivarāḥ koṭisaṃkhyāpramāṇataḥ || 2 || anyo'nyaṃ spardhayā sarve helayā'rbudamāgatāḥ || ahaṃ pūrvamahaṃ pūrvaṃ prapaśyāmyacaleśvaram || 3 || āgamiṣyati yaḥ paścādbrāhmaṇaḥ śvā bhaviṣyati || pāpīyānbhaktirahitaḥ śraddhāhīno bhaviṣyati || 4 || ityevaṃ spardhamānāste helayā'rbudamāgatāḥ || tataḥ sarve yatātmānaḥ samyagvrataparāyaṇāḥ || 5 || śāṃtāstapasvinaḥ sarve vedavidyāviśāradāḥ || teṣāmīhitamājñāya samyakkāmaniṣūdanaḥ || 6 || kṛpayā parayāviṣṭo bhaktibhāvānmaheśvaraḥ || koṭiṃ kṛtvā''tmaliṃgānāṃ tasminsthāne vyavasthitaḥ || 7 || ekasminneva kāle tu sarvairdṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || munibhiśca nṛpaśreṣṭha koṭisaṃkhyaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || 8 || atha te munayaḥ sarve samaṃ dṛṣṭvā maheśvaram || vismayotphullanayanā sādhusādhviti cābruvan || 9 || bhaktiyuktā dvijāḥ sarve'stuvaṃste vaidikaiḥ stavaiḥ || teṣāṃ tuṣṭastataḥ śaṃbhurvākyametaduvāca ha || 7.3.11.10 || || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || tuṣṭo'haṃ munayaḥ sarve śraddhayā parayā hi vaḥ || varaṃ vai vriyatāṃ śīghraṃ sarvaiścaiva pṛthakpṛthak ||11|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || eṣa eva varo'smākaṃ sarveṣāṃ hṛdi varttitaḥ || yugapaddarśanāddeva jāyatāṃ phalamuttamam || 12 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādviśeṣādbrāhmaṇasya ca || darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti teṣāṃ ca tīrthajaṃ phalam || 13 || || munaya ūcuḥ || || avaśyaṃ yadi dātavyo varo'smākaṃ maheśvara || ekaṃ koṭimayaṃ liṃgaṃ kriyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja || 14 || yasmindṛṣṭe phalaṃ nṛṇāṃ jāyate koṭiliṃgajam || evameṣa varo'smākaṃ dīyatāṃ vṛṣabhadhvaja || || 15 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ saprārthamānānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || nirbhidya parvataśreṣṭhaṃ sahasā liṃgamudgatam || 16 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || kṛpayā parayā sarvāṃstānṛṣīnvasudhādhipa || 17 || || vāguvāca || || koṭīśvarākhyaṃ me liṃgaṃ loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || māghakṛṣṇacaturddaśyāṃ yaścainaṃ pūjayiṣyati || 18 || sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya phalaṃ viprā bhaviṣyati || dākṣiṇātyo naro yastu śrāddhamatra kariṣyati || 19 || phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ tasya gayāśrāddhasamaṃ bhavet || tasmādviśeṣataḥ pūjyaṃ mama liṃgaṃ ca mānavaiḥ || 7.3.11.20 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā tu sā vāṇī virarāma mahīpate || tataste munayaḥ sarve gaṃdhadhūpānulepanaiḥ || 21 || talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsuḥ śraddhayā parayā nṛpa || pūjayitvā gatāḥ siddhiṃ sarve liṃgaprasādataḥ || 22 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhātakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe koṭīśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 11 || || cha ||
<7.3.12>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha rūpatīrthamanuttamam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṝṇāṃ rūpasaubhaṇyadāyakam|| 1 || tatra pūrvaṃ vapurnāmnā loke khyātā varāpsarāḥ || siddhiṃ gatā mahārāja yathā pūrvaṃ nigadyate || 2 || purā''sītkācidābhīrī virūpā vikṛtānanā || lambodarī ca kugrīvā sthūladaṃtaśiroruhā || 3 || ekadā phalamādātuṃ bhramamāṇā'rbudācale || māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ patitā girinirjhare || 4 || divyamālyāṃbaradharā divyairaṃgaiḥ samanvitā || padmanetrā sukeśāṃtā sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 5 || sā saṃjātā mahārāja tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || etasminneva kāle tu śakrastatra samāgataḥ || 6 || krīḍārthaṃ parvataśreṣṭhe tāṃ dadarśa śubhekṣaṇām || tataḥ kāmaśarairviddhastāmuvāca sumadhyamām || 7 || || indra uvāca || || kā tvaṃ vada varārohe kimarthaṃ tvamihāgatā || devī vā nāgakanyā vā siddhā vidyādharī tu vā || 8 || mano me'pahṛtaṃ subhrūstvayā ca padmanetrayā || śakro'haṃ sarvadeveśo bhaja māṃ cāruhāsini || 9 || || nāryuvāca || || ābhīrī tridaśādhīśa tathāhaṃ bahubhartṛkā || phalārthaṃ tu samāyātā patitā girinirjhare || 7.3.12.10 || snātvā rūpamidaṃ prāptā surūpaṃ ca śubhaṃ mayā || durllabhastvaṃ hi devānāṃ kiṃ punarmartyajanmanām || 11 || vaśagāste surāḥ sarve mayi kiṃ kriyate spṛhā || bhaja māṃ tridaśādhīśa yathākāmaṃ surādhipa || 12 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktastayā śakraḥ kāmayāmāsa tāṃ tadā || nivṛttamadano bhūtvā tāmuvāca sumadhyamām || 13 || || indra uvāca || || varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi yatte manasi varttate || vinayāttava tuṣṭo'haṃ dāsyāmi varamuttamam || 14 || || nāryuvāca || || māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ naro vā vanitā tathā || snānaṃ yaḥ kurute bhaktyā prītāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ || 15 || surūpaṃ jāyatāṃ teṣāṃ durllabhaṃ tridaśairapi || māṃ naya tvaṃ sahasrākṣa surāvāsaṃ surādhipa ||16|| || pulastya uvāca || || evamastviti tāmuktvā gṛhītvā tāṃ surādhipaḥ || vimāne ca tayā sārddhaṃ jagāma tridivaṃ prati || 17 || vapuḥ prāptaṃ tayā yasmāttasmātpā rthivasattama || nāmnā vapuriti khyātā sā babhūva varāpsarāḥ || 18 || māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ devāstasmiñjalāśaye || snānaṃ sarve prakurvaṃti prabhāte bhaktisaṃyutāḥ ||19|| tatrānyā devakanyāśca siddhayakṣāṃganāstathā || yastatra kurute snānaṃ tasminkāle narādhipa ||7.3.12.20|| rūpaṃ ca labhate tādṛgyādṛglabdhaṃ tayā purā || sarve tatra bhaviṣyaṃti siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || 21 || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge bilamasti suśobhanam || yatrāgatya prakurvaṃti snānaṃ pātālakanyakāḥ| ||22|| tatra snātvā gṛhītvāpo bile tasminvrajaṃti tāḥ || tatra vaināyake pīṭhe mahatpāṣāṇajaṃ jalam||23|| tenodakena saṃyuktaḥ siddho bhavati mānavaḥ || gṛhītvā tajjalaṃ yastu yatra yatrābhigacchati || 24 || svarge vā bhūtale vāpi na kenāpi pradhṛṣyate || tatrāsti vivaradvāre tilakonāma pādapaḥ || 25 || tasya puṣpaiḥ phalaiścaiva sarvaṃ kāryaṃ prasiddhyati || bhakṣaṇāddhāraṇādvāpi siddho bhavati mānavaḥ ||26|| tasminbile tu pāṣāṇāḥ samantācchaṃkhasannibhāḥ || tenodakena saṃspṛṣṭā bhavaṃti ca hiraṇmayāḥ || 27 || vandhyā nārī jalaṃ tatra yā pibettilakānvitam || api varṣaśatābdā ca sadyo garbhavatī bhavet|| || 28 || vyādhigrasto'pi yo marttyaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret || nīrogo jāyate sadyo grahagrasto vimucyate || 29 || bhūtapretapiśācānāṃ doṣaḥ sadyaḥ praṇaśyati || tenodakena saṃspṛṣṭe sarvaṃ naśyati duṣkṛtam || 7.3.12.30 || api kīṭapataṃgā ye piśācāḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || tenodakena ye spṛṣṭāḥ sadyo yāsyaṃti sadgatim || 31 || || yayātiruvāca || || apyadbhutamidaṃ brahmanmāhātmyaṃ bhavatā mama || kathitaṃ rūpatīrthasya na bhūtaṃ na bhaviṣyati || || 32 || kimatra kāraṇaṃ brahmansarvebhyo'pyadhikaṃ smṛtam || sarvaṃ vistarato brūhi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 33 || || pulastya uvāca || || tatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptamadityā nṛpasattama || indre rājyaparibhraṣṭe balau trailokyanāyake || avatīrṇaścaturbāhuradityāṃ nṛpasattama || 34 || tasmiñjāte mahāviṣṇāvadityā cāsurāntake || guptayā vivaradvāre bhayāddānavasaṃbhavāt || 35 || jātamātro haristasminsthāpito nirjhare tayā || tasmātpavitratāṃ prāptaṃ tīrthaṃ nṝṇāmabhīṣṭadam || 36 || na cānyatkāraṇaṃ rājansatyametanmayoditam || māghaśuklatṛtīyāyāṃ tatra jātastrivikramaḥ || 37 || tilakaḥ sarva vṛkṣāgryaḥ putravatparipālitaḥ || adityā sevito nityaṃ svahastena jalaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 38 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāmiha loke paratra ca || 39 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe rūpatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 12 || || cha ||
<7.3.13>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || aṃbarīṣasya rājarṣeraiśānyāṃ pāpanāśanam || 1 || yatra svayaṃ hṛṣīkeśaḥ kāle ca kalisaṃjñake || tasya vākyādṛtastīrthe svayaṃ hi paritiṣṭhati || 2 || purāsītpṛthivīpālo hyaṃbarīṣo yuge kṛte || harimārādhayāmāsa tapastepe suduṣkaram || 3 || tasmiṃstīrthe sa rājendro mitabhakṣo jitendriyaḥ || sahasramekaṃ varṣāṇāṃ tata āsītphalāśanaḥ || 4 || sahasre dve tato rājañchīrṇaparṇāśano'bhavat|| sahasre dve tato bhūyo jalāhāro babhūva ha || 5 || sahasratritayaṃ rājanvāyubhakṣo babhūva ha || cintayanpuṃḍarīkākṣaṃ mānase śraddhayānvitaḥ || 6 || daśa varṣasahasrānte tataśca nṛpasattama || tutoṣa bhagavānviṣṇustasyāsau darśanaṃ dadau || 7 || kṛtvā devapate rūpamāruhyairāvataṃ gajam || abravīdvarado'smīti aṃbarīṣaṃ narādhipam || 8 || || iṃdra uvāca || || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te rājanyanmanasīpsitam || tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktisaṃyuktamāgato'hamasaṃśayam || 9 || || || aṃbarīṣa uvāca || || muktiṃ dātumaśaktosi tvaṃ ca vṛtraniṣūdana || tava prasādāddeveśa trailokyaṃ mama varttate || svāgataṃ gaccha deveśa na varo rocate mama || 7.3.13.10 || sarvathā dāsyate mahyaṃ varaṃ tuṣṭaścaturbhujaḥ || tadāhaṃ pratigṛhṇāmi gaccha deva namostu te || 11 || || indra uvāca || || varaṃ varaya rājarṣe yatte manasi varttate || brahmaviṣṇutrinetrāṇāmahamīśo nṛpotama || 12 || anyeṣāṃ caiva devānāṃ trailokyasyāpyahaṃ vibhuḥ || varaṃ varaya tasmāttvaṃ prasādānme sudurllabham || 13 || prasanne mayi rājendra prasannāḥ sarvadevatāḥ || kuru me vacanaṃ rājangṛhyatāṃ varamuttamam || 14 || || aṃbarīṣa uvāca || || rājā tvaṃ sarvadevānāṃ trailokyasya tatheśvaraḥ || saptadvīpavatī rājā ahaṃ vṛtraniṣūdana || 15 || haṣīkeśasya sadbhaktaṃ viddhi māṃ tāta niścayam || āgataśca hṛṣīkeśo varaṃ dāsyatyasaṃśayam || 16 || || indra uvāca || || dadato mama bhūpāla na gṛhṇāsi varaṃ yadi || vajraṃ tvāṃ prerayiṣyāmi vadhāya kṛtaniścayaḥ || 17 || evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ sṛkkiṇī parilelihan || kuliśaṃ bhrāmayāmāsa gṛhītvā dakṣiṇe kare || 18 || tasyevaṃ bhrāmyamāṇasya mahotpātā babhūvire || tataḥ parvataśṛṃgāṇi viśīrṇāni samaṃtataḥ || 19 || āvṛtaṃ gagana meghairvidhunvānairmahīṃ tadā || na kiṃciddṛśyate tatra sarvaṃ saṃtamasāvṛtam || 7.3.13.20 || etasminneva kāle tu sa rājā harivatsalaḥ || nimīlya locane svīye samādhistho babhūva ha || 21 || tatastuṣṭo jagannātha sākṣātpratyakṣatāṃ gataḥ || airāvataḥ sa garuḍastatkṣaṇātsamajāyata || 22 || tamuvāca hṛṣīkeśo meghagaṃbhīrayā girā || dhyānasthitaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭhaṃ śaṃkha cakragadādharaḥ || 23 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || parituṣṭo'smi te vatsānanyabhakta janeśvara || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 24 || || || aṃbarīṣa uvāca || || yadi prasanno bhagavanyadi deyo varo mama || saṃsārābdhestāraṇāya varado bhava me hare || 25 || || pulastya uvāca || || athāha bhagavānviṣṇuraṃbarīṣaṃ janādhipam || jñānayogaṃ suvistīrṇaṃ saṃsārakṣayakāraṇam || 26 || yasmiñjāte naraḥ sadyaḥ saṃsārānmucyate nṛpa || śrutvā sa nṛpatiḥ samyakpraṇamyovāca keśavam || 27 || || aṃbarīṣa uvāca || || bhagavanyastvayā prokto yogo'yaṃ mama vistarāt || durjñeyaḥ sa nṛṇāṃ deva viśeṣācca kalau yuge || 28 || api cetsuprasanno'si kriyāyogaṃ bravīhi me || lokānāṃ tāraṇārthāya śaṃkhacakragadādhara || 29 || || pulastya uvāca || || tatastasmai narendrāya kriyāyogaṃ janārddanaḥ || yathāyogyaṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha kathayāmāsa keśavaḥ || 7.3.13.30 || taṃ śrutvā tuṣṭahṛdayoṃ'barīṣo vākyamabravīt || 31 || || aṃbarīṣa uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavanrūpeṇānena mādhava || mamāśrame tvaṃ deveśa sadā sannihito bhava || 32 || yatastvatpratimāmekāmarcayāmi vidhānataḥ || pūjayiṣyaṃti lokāstvāṃ śaṃkhacakragadādharam || 33 || || pulastya uvāca || || tathokto mādhavenāsau cakāra harimaṃdiram || pratimāṃ pūjayāmāsa gandhapuṣpānulepanaiḥ || 34 || tataḥ kālena mahatā bhagavānviṣṇumaṃdire || tenaiva vapuṣā prāptaḥ saputraḥ sahabāṃdhavaḥ || 35 || adyāpi bhagavānviṣṇuḥ satyavākyena bhūpateḥ || sadā saṃnihito viṣṇustasminnavasare kalau || 36 || tadārabhya mahārāja kriyāyogo dharātale || pravṛttaḥ pratimākāraḥ kāle ca kalisaṃjñake || 37 || yastaṃ pūjayate bhaktyā hṛṣīkeśe nṛpārbude || sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ prasādācca harernṛpa || 38 || ekādaśyāṃ mahārāja jāgaraṃ yaḥ sadā nṛpa || kariṣyati nirāhāro hṛṣīkeśāgrataḥ sthitaḥ || sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ durllabhaṃ tridaśairapi || || 39 || yatpuṇyaṃ kapilādāne kārtikyāṃ jyeṣṭhapuṣkare || tatphalaṃ labhate marttyo hṛṣīkeśasya darśanāt || 7.3.13.40 || śukle vā yadi vā kṛṣṇe saṃprāpte harivāsare || yaḥ paśyati hṛṣīkeśamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 41 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjayettu vidhānataḥ || yastatra caturo māsansamyagvrataparāyaṇaḥ || abhyarcayeddhṛṣīkeśaṃ na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 42 || ekaḥ sarvāṇi tīrthāni karoti nṛpasattama || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || || 43 || eko dānāni sarvāṇi brāhmaṇebhyaḥ prayacchati || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 44 || ekaḥ kanyāsahasraṃ tu pradadyācca yathāvidhi || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 45 || sūryagrahe kurukṣetre dadyāddānamanuttamam || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 46 || agniṣṭomādibhiryajñairyajatyekaḥ sadakṣiṇaiḥ|| paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 47 || eko himālayaṃ gatvā tyajati sva kalevaram || paśyatyanyo haṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ |||48||| ekastu bhṛgupātena tyajeddehaṃ sutīrthake || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 49 || ekaḥ prāyopaveśena prāṇāṃstyajati mānavaḥ || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 7.3.13.50 || brahmajñānaṃ vadatyekaḥ śrutvā jñānavi śāradaḥ || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 51 || gayāśrāddhaṃ karotyekaḥ pitṛpakṣe nṛpottama || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 52 || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasraṃ ca karotyekaḥ samāhitaḥ || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cātumāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 53 || vrataṃ tapaḥ sahasrābdamekaḥ samyakcarennaraḥ || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 54 || ekastu caturo vedānsamyakpaṭhati brāhmaṇaḥ || paśyatyanyo hṛṣīkeśaṃ cāturmāsyaṃ samāhitaḥ || 55 || bahunā kimihoktena śṛṇu saṃkṣepato nṛpa || ekatastu bhavetsarvamekato haridarśanam || 56 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena sthātavyaṃ harisaṃnidhau || ambarīṣasya rājarṣeḥ sthānake pāpanāśane || 57 || ekatastu hṛṣīkeśa ekataḥ karṇikeśvaraḥ || tayormartyā mṛtā ye ca mānavā nṛpasattama || 58 || api kṛtvā mahatpāpaṃ gacchaṃti harisannidhau || hṛṣīkeśaṃ samālokya sadyo muktimavāpnuyāt || 59 || puṣpamekaṃ hṛṣīkeśe yaścāropayate nṛpa || sukhasaubhāgyasaṃyukta iha loke paratra ca || 7.3.13.60 || hṛṣīkeśasya yo bhaktyā kariṣyatyanulepanam || sa yāsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 61 || saṃmārjanaṃ ca tasyāgre yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ || yāvatyo reṇavastatra tāvadvarṣaśatāni saḥ || modate viṣṇulokastho nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 62 || kārtike śuklapakṣe ca ekādaśyāṃ nṛpottama || dīpamāropayedyaśca hṛṣīkeśāgrato nṛpa || 63 || yathāyathā prakāśeta pāpaṃ janmāṃtarārjitam || tathātathā vrajennāśaṃ tasya kāyādaśeṣataḥ || 64 || paṃcāmṛtena yaḥ pūjāṃ hṛṣīkeśe kariṣyati || dadhnā kṣīreṇa vā yastu na sa bhūyo'bhijāyate || 65 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena hṛṣīkeśaṃ samarcayet || saṃsārabaṃdhato rājanmuktimāpnoti mānavaḥ || 66 || hṛṣīkeśe viśeṣeṇa karttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ sadā || 67 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe hṛṣīkeśamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 || || cha ||
<7.3.14>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha devaṃ siddheśvaraṃ param || siddhidaṃ prāṇināṃ samyaksiddhena sthāpitaṃ purā || 1 || tatra viśvāvasurnāma siddhastepe mahātapaḥ || bahuvarṣāṇi saṃsthāpya śivaṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 2 || jitakrodho jitamado jitasarveṃdriyakriyaḥ || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṃte bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || tutoṣa nṛpatestasya svayaṃ darśanamāyayau || 3 || abravīttaṃ mahādevo varadosmīti pārthiva|| 4 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi varttate || dāsyāmi te prasanno'haṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 5 || || || viśvāvasuruvāca || || etalliṃgaṃ suraśreṣṭha dhyātvā manasi niścayam || sarvānkāmānavāpnotu prasādāttava śaṃkara || 6|| || pulastya uvāca || || evamastviti sa procya tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || siddheśvaraṃ tato gatvā siddhiṃ yāti sahasraśaḥ || 7 || prabhāvāttasya liṃgasya kāmāniṣṭānavāpnuyuḥ || tato dharmakriyāḥ sarvā gatā nāśaṃ dharātale || 8 || na kaścidyajate yajñairna dānāni prayacchati || siddheśvaraprasādena siddhiṃ yāṃti narā bhuvi || 9 || ucchinneṣu ca yajñeṣu dāneṣu nṛpasattama || indrādyāstridaśāḥ sarve paraṃ duḥkhamupāgatāḥ || 7.3.14.10 || jñātvā yajñavighātaṃ ca tadvighātāya vāsavaḥ || vajreṇācchādayāmāsa yathā siddhirna jāyate || 11 || tathāpi saṃnidhau tasya siddheśasya nṛpottama || karmaṇo jāyate siddhiḥ pātakasya parikṣayaḥ || 12 || yastu māghacaturddaśyāṃ somavāre nṛpottama || śuklāyāṃ vātha kṛṣṇāyāṃ spṛṣṭvā siddho bhavennaraḥ || 13 || adyāpi jāyate siddhiḥ satyametanmayoditam|| tasmātsiddheśvaraṃ gatvā natvā yāsyati sadgatim || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe siddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturddaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 ||
<7.3.15>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tataḥ śukreśvaraṃ gacchecchukreṇa sthāpitaṃ purā || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ sadyaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 || dṛṣṭvā daityānpurā devairnirjitānnṛpasattama || cintayāmāsa medhāvī bhārgavastānprati dvijaḥ || 2 || kathaṃ daityāḥ surāñjitvā prāpsyaṃti ca mahāyaśaḥ || ārādhya śaṃkaraṃ siddhiṃ gacchāmi manasepsitam || 3 || evaṃ sa niścayaṃ kṛtvā gato'rbudamathācalam || bhūme vivaramāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam || 4 || śivaliṃgaṃ pratiṣṭhāpya dhūpagaṃdhānulepanaiḥ || aniśaṃ pūjayāmāsa śraddhayā parayānvitaḥ || 5 || tato varṣasahasrāṃte tutoṣa bhagavāñchivaḥ || tasya saṃdarśanaṃ dattvā vākyametaduvāca ha || 6 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || parituṣṭo'smi te vipra bhaktyā tava dvijottama || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 7 || || śukra uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo mahādeva vidyāṃ dehi maheśvara || yayā jīvaṃti saṃprāptā mṛtyuṃ saṃkhyepi jaṃtavaḥ || 8 || || pulastya uvāca || || pradāya vai śivastasmai tāṃ vidyāṃ nṛpasattama || abravīcca punaḥ śukraṃ varamanyaṃ vṛṇīṣva me || 9 || || śukra uvāca || || etatkārtikamāsasya śuklāṣṭamyāṃ tu yaḥ spṛśet || tato liṃgaṃ pūjayecca yaḥ pumāñchraddhayānvitaḥ|| 7.3.15.10 || alpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya mā bhūttava prasādataḥ || iṣṭānkāmānavāpnotu ihaloke paratra ca || 11 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamastviti sa procya tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || śukropi dānavānsaṃkhye hatāndevairanekaśaḥ ||12|| vidyāyāśca prabhāvena jīvayāmāsa tānmuniḥ || tasyāgre'sminmahākuṇḍaṃ nirmalaṃ pāpanāśanam || 13 || tatra snāto naraḥ samyakpātakaiśca pramucyate || tatra śrāddhena rājeṃdra tuṣṭā yāṃti pitāmahāḥ || 14 || tarpitāḥ salilenaiva kiṃ punaḥ piṃḍadānataḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || 15 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇaekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe śukreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 15 || || cha ||
<7.3.16>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam|| maṇikarṇikasaṃjñaṃ tu sarvalokeṣu viśrutam||1|| yatra siddhiṃ gatā rājanvālakhilyā maharṣayaḥ|| taistatra nirmitaṃ kuṇḍaṃ suramyaṃ giri gahvare || 2 || teṣāṃ tatropaviṣṭānāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || mahāścaryamabhūttatra tattvaṃ śṛṇu narādhipa || 3 || kirātavanitā kācinnāmnā ca maṇikarṇikā || atikṛṣṇā virūpākṣī karālā bhīṣaṇākṛtiḥ || 4 || tṛṣārttā tatra saṃprāptā madhyaṃdinagate ravau || graste ca rāhuṇā sūrye praviṣṭā salile tu sā || 5 || etasminneva kāle tu divyarūpavapurdharā || munīnāṃ paśyatāṃ caiva viniṣkrāṃtā sumadhyamā || 6 || atha tasyāḥ patiḥ prāptastadanveṣaṇatatparaḥ || papraccha tāṃ varārohāṃ patnyā duḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ || 7 || mama bhāryātra saṃprāptā yadi dṛṣṭā sumadhyame || śīghraṃ vada varārohe bālako'yaṃ tadudbhavaḥ || 8 || tṛṣārttaśca kṣudhāviṣṭo rudate ca muhurmuhuḥ || dṛṣṭā cetkathyatāṃ subhrūrvinā'yaṃ tāṃ mariṣyati || 9 || || stryuvāca || || sā'haṃ te dayitā kānta tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || divyarūpamidaṃ prāptā devairapi sudurlabham || 7.3.16.10 || tvaṃ cāpi salile hyasminkuru snānaṃ tvarānvitaḥ || prāpsyasi tvaṃ paraṃ rūpaṃ yathā prāptaṃ mayā'nagha || 11 || athāsau saha putreṇa praviṣṭastatra nirjhare || vimukte bhāskare rājanvirūpaścābhavatpunaḥ || 12 || duḥkhena mṛtyumāpannastasminneva jalāśaye || atha sā bhartṛśokācca maraṇe kṛtaniścayā || 13 || citiṃ kṛtvā samaṃ tena jvālayāmāsa pāvakam || atha te munayo dṛṣṭvā tathāśīlāṃ śubhāṃganām || 14 || kṛpayā parayāviṣṭāstāmūcurvismayānvitāḥ || sarve tasyāśca saṃdṛṣṭvā sāhasaṃ ca nṛpottama || 15 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || divyarūpaṃ tvayā prāptaṃ devairapi sudurlabham || kasmādenaṃ supāpmānamanugacchasi bhāmini || 16 || || stryuvāca || || pativratāhaṃ viprendrāḥ sadā bhartṛparāyaṇā || kiṃ rūpeṇa kariṣyāmi vinā patyā nijena ca || 17 || virūpo vā surūpo vā daridro vā dhanādhipaḥ || strīṇāmekaḥ patirbharttā gatirnānyā jagattraye || 18 || bālako'yaṃ muniśreṣṭhā bhavaccharaṇamāgataḥ || ahaṃ kāntena saṃyuktā praviśāmi hutāśanam || 19 || || pulastya uvāca || || atha te munayaḥ sarve jñātvā tasyāḥ suniścayam || kṛpayā parayāviṣṭāḥ saṃvīkṣya ca parasparam || 7.3.16.20 || tato jīvāpayāmāsustatpatiṃ te munīśvarāḥ || sadrūpeṇa samāyuktaṃ divya lakṣaṇalakṣitam || 21 || etasminneva kālaṃ tu vimānaṃ manasepsitam || devakanyāsamākīrṇaṃ sadyastatra samāgatam || 22 || atha tau daṃpatī teṣāṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || purataḥ praṇipatyātha prasthitau tridivaṃ prati || 23 || atha tairmunibhiḥ proktā sā nārī maṇikarṇikā || varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi sarve tuṣṭā vayaṃ tava || 24 || pativratatvena tuṣṭāḥ satyena ca viśeṣataḥ || nāsmākaṃ darśanaṃ vyarthaṃ jāyate ca kathaṃcana || 25 || || maṇikarṇikovāca || || yadi māṃ munayastuṣṭāḥ prayacchatha varaṃ mudā || yadatrāsti mahāliṃgaṃ mannāmnā tadbhaviṣyati || 26 || etadeva mamābhīṣṭaṃ nānyadasti prayojanam|| sarveṣāṃ ca prasādena svargaṃ gacchāmi sāṃpratam || 27 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || evaṃ bhavatu te khyātistīrthaliṃge varānane || tava nāmānvitaṃ jātaṃ tīrthaṃ vai maṇikarṇikā || 28 || || pulastya uvāca || || bhartrā saha divaṃ prāptā putreṇaiva samanvitā || vālakhilyāstaponiṣṭhā viśeṣāttatra saṃsthitāḥ || 29 || tatra sūryagrahe prāpte snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || yaḥ karoti phalaṃ tasya kurukṣetra samaṃ bhavet || 7.3.16.30 || yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya snānaṃ tatra karoti yaḥ || taṃ taṃ prāpnoti rājendra samyagdhyānasamanvitaḥ || 31 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || tīrthe dānaṃ yathāśaktyā devarṣipitṛtarpaṇam || 32 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe maṇikarṇikeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha ||
<7.3.17>
|| pulastya uvāca || || paṃgu tīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapātakanāśanam || yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ paṃgunā brāhmaṇena ca || 1 || paṃgunāmā dvijaḥ pūrvaṃ cyavanasyānvaye'bhavat || aśaktaścalituṃ bhūmau paṃgubhāvānnṛpottama || 2 || gṛhakṛtyaniyukto'sāvekadā bāndhavairnṛpa || paṃgurgaṃtuṃ na śakto'sau paraṃ duḥkhamavāptavān || 3 || athāsau taiḥ parityakto gatvārbudamathācalam || ekaṃ saraḥ samāsādya tapastepe sudāruṇam || 4 || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpya tatraiva pūjayāmāsa taṃ vibhum || gandhapuṣpādinaivedyaiḥ samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || 5 || śivabhaktiparo jāto vāyubhakṣo babhūva ha || japahomarato nityaṃ paṃgunāmā dvijottamaḥ || 6 || tatastuṣṭo mahādevo brāhmaṇaṃ nṛpasattama || paṃguṃ prati mahārāja vākyametaduvāca ha || 7 || || īśvara uvāca || || paṃgo tuṣṭo mahādevo varaṃ varaya suvrata || tava dāsyāmyahaṃ sarvaṃ yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 8 || || paṃguruvāca || || nāmnā me khyātimāyātu tīrthametatsureśvara || paṃgubhāvo'tra me yātu prasādāttava śaṃkara || 9 || tavāstu satataṃ cātra sāṃnidhyaṃ saha bhāryayā || evamuktaḥ sa tenātha vipraṃ prati vacobravīt || 7.3.17.10 || || īśvara uvāca || || nāmnā tava dvijaśreṣṭha tīrthametadbhaviṣyati || khyātiṃ tapaḥprabhāvena tīrthaṃ yāsyati sattama || 11 || caitraśuklacaturddaśyāṃ sāṃnidhyaṃ me bhavettathā || 12 || || || pulastya uvāca || || snānamātreṇa vipro'sau divyarūpamavāpa ha || tatra tasthau mahādevo gauryā saha maheśvaraḥ || 13 || tasmindine nṛpaśreṣṭha snānaṃ tatra samācaret || sa paṃgutvādvinirmukto divyarūpamavāpnuyāt || 14 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe paṃgutīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha || ||
<7.3.18>
|| || pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha yamatīrthamanuttamam || mocakaṃ narakebhyaśca prāṇināṃ pāpanāśanam || 1 || purā citrāṃgado nāma rājā paramalobhavān || na tena sukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkṛtaṃ pārthivasattama || 2 || atīva niṣṭhuro duṣṭo devabrāhmaṇapīḍakaḥ || paradāraharo nityaṃ paravittaharastathā || 3 || satyaśaucavihīnastu māyāmatsarasaṃyutaḥ || sa kadācinmṛgayāsakta ārūḍho'rbudaparvate || 4 || aṭanātsa pariśrāṃtaḥ kṣutpipāsāsamākulaḥ || tena tatra hradaḥ prāptaḥ svacchodakaprapūritaḥ || 58 || padminībhiḥ samākīrṇo grāhanakrajhaṣākulaḥ || nānāpakṣisamāyukto manohārī suvistaraḥ || 6 || tṛṣārtaḥ saṃpraviṣṭaḥ sa tasminneva jalāśaye || grāheṇa tatkṣaṇāddhṛtvā bhakṣito nṛpasattama || 7 || tasyārthe narakā raudrā nirmitāśca yamena ca || yamadūtaistataḥ kṣiptaḥ sa nītvā pāpakṛttamaḥ || 8 || tasya sparśena te sarve narakasthā sukhaṃ gatāḥ || te dūtā dharmarājāya vṛttāṃtaṃ narakodbhavam || ācakhyurvismayāviṣṭā narakasthānāṃ sukhodbhavam || 9 || tadā vaivasvataḥ prāha bhūmāvastyarbudācalaḥ || tatra me'tipriyaṃ tīrthaṃ yatra taptaṃ mayā tapaḥ || 7.3.18.10 || tatrāsau mṛtyumāpanno bhātyadastviha kāraṇam || tairuktaṃ satyametaddhi mṛto'sāvarbudācale || grāheṇa sa dhṛtastatra mṛtyuṃ prāpto nṛpādhamaḥ ||11|| || || yama uvāca || || mucyatāmāśu tenāyaṃ nāneyāścāpare janāḥ || ye mṛtā mama tīrthe vai sarvapātakanāśane || 12 || tatastaiḥ kiṃkarairmukto yamavākyānnṛpottama || triviṣṭapaṃ mudā prāptaḥ sevyamāno'psarogaṇaiḥ|| 13 || yastu bhaktisamāyuktaḥ snānaṃ tatra samācaret || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 14 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || caitraśuklatrayodaśyāṃ yatra siddhiṃ gato yamaḥ || 15 || tasminneva naraḥ samyakchrāddhakṛtyaṃ samācaret || ākalpaṃ pitarastasya svarge tiṣṭhaṃti pārthiva ||16|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe yamatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 ||
<7.3.19>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || vārāhasya hareriṣṭaṃ sadā vāsasukhapradam || 1 || vārāheṇāvatāreṇa pṛthvī tatra samuddhṛtā || hariṇoktā sthirā tiṣṭha na bhetavyaṃ kadācana || 2 || ahaṃ ceto gamiṣyāmi vaikuṇṭhe ca punaḥ śubhe || varaṃ varaya kalyāṇi yadyadiṣṭaṃ sudurlabham || 3 || || pṛthivyuvāca || || yadi deyo varo mahyaṃ śaṃkhacakragadādhara || anena vapuṣā tiṣṭha hyasmiṃstīrthe sadā hare || 4 || || hariruvāca || || anena vapuṣā devi parvate'rbudasaṃjñake || ahaṃ sthāsyāmi te vākyātsadā loka hite rataḥ || 5 || mamāgre yo hradaḥ puṇyaḥ sunirmalajalānvitaḥ || māghamāse site pakṣa ekādaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || 6 || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā mucyate brahmahatyayā || tatra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti manuṣyāḥ śraddhayānvitāḥ || 7 || pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || 8 || || pulastya uvāca || || ityuktvāṃtardadhe rājangoviṃdo garuḍadhvajaḥ || tasmindine nṛpaśreṣṭha snātvā vrataṃ samācaret ||9|| tarpaṇaṃ piṃḍadānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādbhaktitatparaḥ || sa yāti viṣṇusālokyaṃ pūrvajaiḥ saha pārthiva || 7.3.19.10 || tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti gatvā brāhmaṇasattame || asmiṃstīrthe nṛpaśreṣṭha godānaṃ ca karoti yaḥ || 11 || romasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi svarge tiṣṭhati mānavaḥ || tasmātsarvātmanā rājangodānaṃ ca samācaret || 12 || ekādaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa karttavyaṃ snānamuttamam || dānaṃ kuryādyathāśaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 13 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe vārāhatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśodhyāyaḥ || 19 ||
<7.3.20>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gaccheta caṃdreśaṃ prabhāsaṃ nṛpasattama || prabhā tatra purā prāptā caṃdreṇa sumahātmanā || 1 || dakṣasya kanyakā rājansaptaviṃśatisaṃkhyayā || ūḍhāścaṃdreṇa tāḥ sarvā aśvinīpramukhāḥ purā || 2 || tāsāṃ madhye ca rohiṇyā saha reme sa nityadā || tyaktāḥ sarvāśca caṃdreṇa dakṣakanyāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || gatvā svapitaraṃ natvā prāhurasrāvilekṣaṇāḥ || 3 || vayaṃ tyaktāḥ prajānātha nirdoṣāḥ patinā tataḥ || śaraṇaṃ tvāmanuprāptā duḥkhena mahatānvitāḥ || 4 || gatirbhava suraśreṣṭha sarveṣāṃ tvaṃ hitaṃ kuru || asmākamupadiśyainaṃ caṃdraṃ ca rohiṇīratam || 5 || || pulastya uvāca || || sa tāsāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gato yatra niśākaraḥ || abravīcca samaṃ paśya sarvāsu tanayāsu me || 6 || atha vrīḍāsamāyuktaścaṃdrastaṃ pratyabhāṣata || tava vākyaṃ kariṣyāmi dakṣa gaccha namostu te || 7 || gate dakṣe tato bhūyaścaṃdramā rohiṇīrataḥ || tyaktvā ca kanyakāḥ sarvāḥ prajāpatisamudbhavāḥ || 8 || atha gatvā punaḥ sarvā dakṣamūcuḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || na kṛtaṃ tava vākyaṃ vai caṃdreṇaiva durātmanā || 9 || daurbhāgyaduḥkhasaṃtaptā mariṣyāma na saṃśayaḥ || anena jīvitenāpi maraṇaṃ niścayaṃ bhavet || 7.3.20.10 || || pulastya uvāca || || atha roṣasamāyukto dakṣo gatvā'bravīdvidhum || mama vākyaṃ tvayā caṃdra yasmātpāpa kṛtaṃ na hi || 11 || kṣayameṣyasi tasmāttvaṃ yakṣmaṇā nāsti saṃśayaḥ|| evaṃ dattvā tataḥ śāpaṃ gato dakṣaḥ svamālayam || 12 || yakṣmaṇā vyāpitaścaṃdraḥ kṣayaṃ yāti dinedine || kṣīṇo dyutivihīnastu ciṃtayāmāsa caṃdramāḥ || 13 || ki karttavyaṃ mayā tatra hyasmiñchāpe sudāruṇe || atha kiṃ pūjayiṣyāmi sarvakāmapradaṃ śivam || 14 || sa evaṃ niścayaṃ kṛtvā gatorbudamathācalam || tapastepe jitakrodho japahomaparāyaṇaḥ || 15 || tasmai tuṣṭo mahādevo varṣāṇāmayute gate || abravīdvarado'smīti tato'smai darśanaṃ dadau || 16 || || īśvara uvāca || || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate || tava dāsyāmyahaṃ caṃdra yadyapi syātsudurllabham|| 17 || || caṃdra uvāca|| || vyādhikṣayaṃ suraśreṣṭha kuru me tripurāṃtaka || yakṣmaṇā vyāpito deho mamāyaṃ ca jagatpate || 18 || || īśvara uvāca || || dakṣaśāpena te caṃdra yakṣmā kāye vyavasthitaḥ || na śakto hyanyathā kartuṃ śāpastasya mahātmanaḥ ||19|| tasmāttvaṃ tasya tāḥ sarvāḥ kanyakā mama vākyataḥ || niśākara samaṃ paśya tava vyādhirgamiṣyati || 7.3.20.20 || kṛṣṇe kṣayaśca te caṃdra śukle vṛddhirbhaviṣyati || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te anyamiṣṭaṃ sudurllabham||21 || || caṃdra uvāca || || caṃdragrahe naro yo'tra somavāre ca śaṃkara || bhaktyā snānaṃ karotyeva sa yātu paramāṃ gatim || 22 || piṇḍadānena deveśa svargaṃ gacchaṃtu pūrvajāḥ || prasādāttava deveśa tīrthaṃ bhavatu muktidam || 23 || || īśvara uvāca || || bhaviṣyaṃti naro'traiva vipāpmāno niśākara || yasmātprabhā tvayā prāptā tīrthe'sminvimalodake|| 24 || prabhāsatīrthaṃ vikhyātaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati|| yatra somagrahe prāpte somavāre viśeṣataḥ || 25 || kariṣyaṃti narāḥ snānaṃ te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti piṃḍadānaṃ tathā narāḥ || || 26 || gayāśrāddhasamaṃ puṇyaṃ teṣāṃ caṃdra bhaviṣyati || tathā dānaṃ prakartavyaṃ somalokairgrahe tava || 27 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā virūpākṣastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || candro'pi bubhuje sarvāḥ patnīśca dakṣasaṃbhavāḥ || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe caṃdraprabhāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || cha ||
<7.3.21>
|| pulastya uvāca|| || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha piṇḍodakamanuttamam || tīrthaṃ yatra tapastaptaṃ piṇḍodakadvijātinā || 1 || purā piṇḍodakonāma brāhmaṇo'bhūnmahāmate || mandaprajño'lpamedhāvī sopādhyāyena pāṭhitaḥ || 2 || aśakto'dhyayanaṃ kartuṃ jāḍyabhāvānmahīpate || sa vairāgyaṃ paraṃ gatvā saṃprāpto girigahvare || 3 || etasminneva kāletu tatraiva ca sarasvatī|| vīṇāvinodasaṃyuktā vivikte tamupasthitā || 4 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā brāhmaṇaṃ khinnaṃ vairāgyeṇa samanvitam || kṛpāviṣṭā mahādevī vākyametaduvāca ha || 5 || || sarasvatyuvāca || || kasmāttvaṃ khidyase vipra virakta iva bhāsase || kasmānna hṛṣyasi hṛdā kasmādatra tvamāgataḥ || vada śīghraṃ mahābhāga tavāṃtike vasāmyaham || 6 || || piṇḍodaka uvāca || || ahaṃ vairāgyamāpanna upādhyāyatiraskṛtaḥ || jñānahīno mahābhāge mṛtyuṃ vāṃchāmi sāṃpratam || 7 || na me sarasvatī devī jihvāgre parivartate || kāraṇaṃ nānyadastīha mṛtyormama varānane || || dṛṣṭo'kasmāttvayā cāhaṃ tato yāsyāmi cānyataḥ || maraṇaṃ hi mama śreyo mūkabhāvānna jīvitam || 9 || || sarasvatyuvāca ||. || ahaṃ sarasvatī devī sadāsminvaraparvate|| niśāmukhe trayodaśyāṃ karomi vasatiṃ dvija || tasmāttvaṃ prārthaya varaṃ yadabhīṣṭaṃ sudurlabham || 7.3.21.10 || || piṇḍodaka uvāca || || prasādāttava vai vāṇi sarvajñatvaṃ mamepsitam || etattīrthaṃ tu mannāmnā khyātiṃ yātu śucismite || 11 || || sarasvatyuvāca || || adyaprabhṛti sarvajño hyatra loke bhaviṣyasi || nāmnā tava tathā tīrthametatkhyātiṃ prayāsyati ||12|| niśāmukhe trayodaśyāṃ yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati || bhaviṣyati sa sarvajño yadyapi syātsumandadhīḥ || 13 || atra me satataṃ vāso bhaviṣyati dvijottama || yasmāttasmātsadā snānaṃ kartavyaṃ susamāhitaiḥ || 14 || evamuktvā tato devī tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || piṇḍodako hi sarvajño bhūtvātha svagṛhaṃ yayau || vyasmāpayajjanānsarvāṃstattīrthasya samāśrayāt || 15 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe piṇḍodakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 || cha ||
<7.3.22>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha śrīmātāṃ devavaṃditām || sarvakāmapradāṃ nṛṇāmihaloke paratra ca ||1|| yā ca sarvamayī śaktiryayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat || sā tasminparvate sākṣātsvayaṃ vāsamarocayat ||2|| purā devayuge rājā kaliṃgonāma dānavaḥ || jarāmaraṇahīnosau devānāṃ ca bhayaṃkaraḥ||3|| tena sarvamidaṃ vyāptaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram|| balaprabhāvataḥ svargo jitastena surādhipaḥ || brahmalokamanuprāpto devaiḥ sarvaiḥ samanvitaḥ ||4|| tena daityena sarve'pi trāsitāḥ suramānavāḥ || kaliṃgonāma daityaḥ sa svayamindro babhūva ha || 5 || vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā viśvedevāḥ surarṣayaḥ || tena sarve kṛtā daityā yathāyogyaṃ narādhipa || 6 || yajñabhāgānsvayaṃ sarve bubhujuste ca dānavāḥ || tapo'rthe ca tato devā gatāḥ sarve'rbudācalam || 7 || adyāpi devatākhātaṃ trailokye khyātimāgatam || tatra vrataparāḥ sarve patramūlaphalāśinaḥ || 8 || avyaktāḥ paramatrāsāddhyāyaṃtaste ca saṃsthitāḥ || paṃcāgnisādhakāḥ kecittatra vrataparāyaṇāḥ || 9 || ekāhārā nirāhārā vāyubhakṣāstathā pare || anye māsopavāsāśca cāndrāyaṇaparāyaṇāḥ || 7.3.22.10 || kṛcchrasāṃtapane niṣṭhā mahāpārākiṇaḥ pare || aṃbubhakṣā vāyubhakṣāḥ phenapāścoṣmapāḥ pare || 11 || japahomaparāścānye dhyānāsaktāstathā pare || balinaivadyadānaiśca gaṃdhadhūpairnarādhipa || 12 || pūjayaṃtaḥ parāṃ śaktiṃ devīṃ svakāryahetave || evaṃ teṣāṃ vratasthānāṃ tapasā bhāvitātmanām || vimuktirabhavadrājansarveṣāṃ karmabandhanāt || 13 || tataḥ pūrṇe sahasrāṃte varṣāṇāṃ nṛpasattama|| devī pratyakṣatāṃ prāptā kanyakārūpadhāriṇī|| 14|| pūrvaṃ jātā mahārāja dhūmamūrtirbhayāvahā|| tato jvālā tataḥ kanyā śuklavāso'nulepanā|| dṛṣṭvā tāṃ tuṣṭuvurdevāḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭāstataḥ|| 15|| namo'stu sarvage devi namaste sarvapūjite|| kāmage'cintye namaste tridaśāśraye || 16 || namaste paramādevi brahmayone namonamaḥ || ardhamātrekṣare caiva tasyārdhārdhe namonamaḥ || 17 || namaste padmapatrākṣi viśvamātarnamonamaḥ || namaste varade devi rajaḥsattvatamomayi || 18 || svasvarūpasthite devi tvaṃ ca saṃsāralakṣaṇam || tvaṃ buddhistvaṃ dhṛtiḥ kṣāṃtistvaṃ svāhā tvaṃ svadhā kṣamā || 19 || tvaṃ vṛddhistvaṃ gatiḥ kartrī śacī lakṣmīśca pārvatī || sāvitrī tvaṃ ca gāyatrī ajeyā pāpanāśinī ||7.3.22.20|| yaccānyadatra deveśi trailokye'stītisaṃjñitam || tadrūpaṃ tāvakaṃ devi parvateṣu ca saṃsthitam || 21 || vahninā ca yathā kāṣṭhaṃ taṃtunā ca yathā paṭaḥ || tathā tvayā jagadvyāptaṃ guptā tvaṃ sarvataḥ sthitā || 22 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ stutā jaganmātā tānuvāca surottamān || varo me yācyatāṃ śīghramabhīṣṭaḥ surasattamāḥ || 23 || kimatra guptabhāvena tiṣṭhatha śvabhramadhyagāḥ || madbhaktānāṃ bhayaṃ nāsti trailokyepi carācare || 24 || || || devā ūcuḥ || kaliṃgena vayaṃ devi nirastāḥ saṃgare muhuḥ || tena vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 25 || yajñabhāgo hṛto'smākaṃ daityānāṃ sa prakalpitaḥ || tena svargaḥ samākrāntaḥ surāḥ sarve nirākṛtāḥ || 26 || hatvā daityānyathā bhūyaḥ śakraḥ svapadamāpnuyāt || tathā kuru mahābhāge vara eṣo'smadīpsitaḥ || 27 || || devyuvāca || || yathā yūyaṃ mayā sṛṣṭāstathaivāyaṃ mahāsuraḥ || viśeṣo nāsti me kaścidubhayoḥ surasattamāḥ || 28 || tasmāttānvārayiṣyāmi śakrādyāṃstridivātpunaḥ || evamuktvā varārohā preṣayāmāsa pārthiva || 29 || dūtaṃ kaliṃgadaityāya tyaja tvaṃ tridivaṃ drutam || sa gatvā bāṣkaliṃ daityaṃ sāmapūrvaṃ vaco'bravīt || 7.3.22.30 || || dūta uvāca || || yā sā sarvagatā devī śaktirūpā śuci smitā || śrīmātā jagatāṃ mātā devairārādhitā parā || teṣāṃ tuṣṭā ca devī tvāmidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 31 || svasthānaṃ gaccha śīghraṃ tvaṃ śakro yātu triviṣṭapam || madvākyāddānavaśreṣṭha devatvaṃ na bhavettava || 32 || || pulastya uvāca || || sa dūtavacanaṃ śrutvā dānavo madagarvitaḥ || 34 || ahaṃ lokeśvaro matvā sagarvamidamabravīt || 33 || || bāṣkaliruvāca || || kā śrīmāteti ke devā nāsmātsvargaṃ tyajāmyaham || na tāṃ jānāmi tāṃścaiva gatvā brūhi mamājñayā || 34 || na bhavadbhyasvahaṃ svargaṃ prayacchāmi kathaṃcana || dūto'vadhyo bhavedrājñāmapi vaire sudāruṇe || etasmātkāraṇāddūta na tvāṃ prāṇairviyojaye || 35 || śrīmātāṃ yadi me dūta darśayiṣyasi cettataḥ || abhīṣṭānsaṃpradāsyāmi satyameva bravīmyaham || 36 || ahaṃ tvayā samaṃ tatra yāsye yatra sthitā ca sā || nigrahaṃ ca kariṣyāmi vākyaṃ me satyakāraṇam || 37 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā madonmatto dūtena ca sa dānavaḥ || arbudaṃ prayayau tūrṇaṃ roṣeṇa mahatā vṛtaḥ || 38 || dṛṣṭvā bāṣkalimāyāṃtaṃ devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ || vāryamāṇāstadā devyā palāyanaparāyaṇāḥ || 39 || bhayena mahatāviṣṭā diśo bhejuḥ samaṃtataḥ || athāsau bāṣkaliḥ prāptaḥ sainyena mahatā vṛtaḥ || 7.3.22.40 || śrīmātā tiṣṭhate yatra parvaterbudasaṃjñake || dūtaṃ ca preṣayāmāsa tamuvāca narādhipaḥ || 41 || || bāṣkaliruvāca || || gaccha dūtavara brūhi śrīmātāṃ cāruhāsinīm|| bhāryā me bhava suśroṇi ahaṃ te vaśagaḥ sadā || 42 || bhaviṣyati hi me rājyaṃ sarvaṃ vaśagataṃ tava || anyathā dharṣayiṣyāmi sarvaiḥ sārddhaṃ surottamaiḥ ||43|| kimiṃdreṇālpavīryeṇa kimanyaiśca varānane || sahasrākṣo na me tulyo na me tulyāḥ surāsurāḥ || 44 || || pulastya uvāca || || etacchrutvā tato gatvā sa dūtaḥ saṃnyavedayat || tasya sarvaṃ yathāvākyaṃ tenoktaṃ ca mahīpate ||45|| tataḥ śrutvā smitaṃ kṛtvā ciṃtayāmāsa bhāminī || jarā maraṇahīnoyaṃ daityendraḥ śaṃbhunā kṛtaḥ || 46 || kathamasya mayā kāryo nigraho devatākṛte || punaściṃtayate yāvatsā devī dānavaṃ prati || tāvattatrāgataḥ śīghraṃ sa kāmena pariplutaḥ || 47 || atha dṛṣṭinipātena sā devī dānavādhipam || vyalokayattatastasyā niścayaḥ saṃbabhūva ha || 48 || tato jahāsa sā devīśanakairvṛpasattama || mukhāttasyāstataḥ sainyaṃ niṣkrāṃtamatibhīṣaṇam|| 49 || hastino hayavaryāśca pādātāśca pṛthagvidhāḥ || rathasāhasramārūḍhā yodhāścāpi sahasraśaḥ || 7.3.22.50 || taiḥ sainyaṃ dānaveśasya sarvaṃ śastrairnipātitam || paśyatastasya daityasya niścalasyāsurasya ca || 51 || hate sainya bale tasminniṃdrādyāstridivaukasaḥ || tāmūcurvacanaṃ devi dānavaṃ hantumarhasi || nāsmiñjīvati no rājyaṃ svarge devi bhaviṣyati || 52 || || pulastya uvāca || || śrutvā tadvacanaṃ teṣāṃ jñātvā taṃ mṛtyuvarjitam || parvatasya mahāśṛṃgaṃ dattvā tasyopari svayam || 53 || niviṣṭā sā jaganmātā śrīmātā kāmarūpiṇī || hitāya jagatāṃ rājannadyāpi varaparvate || tatraiva vasate sākṣānnṛṇāṃ kāmapradāyinī || 54 || etasminneva kāle tu sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || tuṣṭuvustāṃ mahāśaktiṃ bhayahantrīṃ praharṣitāḥ || 55 || prasannā'bhūttato devī teṣāṃ tatra narādhipa || svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ surāḥ sarve pariyāṃtu gatavyathāḥ || gatvā sthānaṃ svakaṃ sarve paripāṃtu gatavyathāḥ || 56 || varaṃ varaya devendra brūhi yatte manogatam || tatsarvaṃ saṃpradāsyāmi tuṣṭāhaṃ bhaktitastava || 57 || || || indra uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭāsi me devi śāśvate bhaktivatsale || atraiva sthīyatāṃ tāvatsvarge yāvadahaṃ vibhuḥ || 58 || praśāsmi rājyaṃ deveśi śāśvate bhaktavatsale || ajaraścāmaraścaiva yato daityaḥ sureśvari || 59 || hareṇa nirmitaḥ pūrvaṃ yena tiṣṭhati niścalaḥ || prasādāttava lokāśca trayaḥ saṃtu nirāmayāḥ ||7.3.22.60|| atra tvāṃ pūjayiṣyāmo vayaṃ sarve sametya ca || caitraśuklacaturddaśyāṃ dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ yāṃtu sadgatim || 61 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ sarvadevaiḥ samanvitaḥ || hṛṣṭastriviṣṭapaṃ prāpto devyāstasyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 62 || sāpi tatra sthitā devī devānāṃ hitakāmyayā || ||| 63 || yastāṃ paśyati caitrasya caturddaśyāṃ site nṛpa || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjjitam || 64 || kiṃ vratairniyamairvāpi dānairdatte narādhipa || sarve taddarśanasyāpi kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 65 || tatraiva pāduke divye tayā nyaste narādhipa || yaste paśyati bhūyo'sau saṃsāraṃ na hi paśyati || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti iha loke paratra ca || 66 || || yayātiruvāca || || kasminkāle dvijaśreṣṭha devyā mukte'tra pāduke || kasmācca kāraṇādbrūhi sarvaṃ vistarato mama || 67 || || pulastya uvāca || || tāṃ devīṃ mānavāḥ sarve saṃvīkṣya nṛpasattama || prāpnuvaṃti parāṃ siddhiṃ dvividhāṃ dharmakāriṇaḥ || 68 || etasminneva kāle tu yajñadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || praṇaṣṭā bhūtale rājaṃstīrthayātrāvratodbhavāḥ || 69 || śūnyāste narakāḥ sarve saṃbabhūvuryamasya ye || yajñabhāgavihīnāśca devāḥ kaṣṭamupāgatāḥ || 7.3.22.70 || atha sarve nṛpaśreṣṭha devāstatra samāgatāḥ || ūcurgatvā'rbudaṃ tatra śrīmātāṃ parame śvarīm|| 71 || || devā ūcuḥ || || agniṣṭomādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā naṣṭāḥ sureśvari || martyaloke vayaṃ tena karmaṇātīva pīḍitāḥ || 72 || dṛṣṭvā tvāṃ devi pāpmānaḥ siddhiṃ yāṃti sapūrvajāḥ || tasmādyathā vayaṃ puṣṭiṃ vrajāmaste prasādataḥ || 73 || na niṣkrāmati daityaśca bāṣkalistvaṃ tathā kuru || 74 || || pulastya uvāca || || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā saṃciṃtya suciraṃ tadā || muktvā sve pāduke tatra kṛtvā cāśmasamudbhave || devānuvāca rājeṃdra sarvānarttimupāgatān || 75 || || śrīdevyuvāca || || yuṣmadvākyena tyakto hi mayā'yaṃ parvatottamaḥ || vinyaste pāduke tasya rakṣārthaṃ bāṣkaleḥ surāḥ || 76 || matpādukābharākrāṃto na sa daityaḥ surottamāḥ || sthānātpracalituṃ śaktaḥ staṃbhitaḥ syādyathā mayā || 77 || etacchāstraṃ mayā kṛtsnaṃ pādukārthaṃ vinirmitam || adhyātmakaṃ hitārthāya prāṇināṃ pṛthivītale || 78 || śāstramārgeṇa cānena bhaktyā yaḥ pāduke mama || pūjayiṣyati siddhiḥ syāttasya maddarśanodbhavā || 79 || caitraśuklacaturddaśyāmahamatrārbude sadā || ahorātre vasiṣyāmi suguptā girigahvare || || 7.3.22.80 || parvato'yaṃ mamābhīṣṭo na ca tyaktuṃ mano dadhe || tathāpi saṃparityakto yuṣmākaṃ hitakāmyayā || 81 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā tu sā devī samaṃtāddevakiṃnaraiḥ || stūyamānā yayau svargaṃ muktvā te pāduke śubhe || 82|| adyāpi siddhimāyāṃti yogino dhyānatatparāḥ || tanniṣṭhāstadgataprāṇā yathā devyāḥ pradarśanāt|| 83 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tva paripṛcchasi || śrīmātāsaṃbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ pādukābhyāṃ ca bhūmipa ||84|| yastvetatpaṭhate bhaktyā ślāghate vā'tha yo naraḥ || sarvapāpairmahārāja mucyate jñānatatparaḥ || 85 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śrīmātāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 ||
<7.3.23>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha śuklatīrthamanuttamam || yatkhyātimagamatpūrvaṃ sakāśāddāśavargataḥ || 1 || purā''sīdrajako nāmnā śamilākṣo mahīpate || nīlīmadhye tu vastrāṇi prakṣiptāni mahīpate || 2 || athāsau bhayamāpanno jñātvā vastraviḍaṃbanam|| deśāṃtaraṃ prasthito'sau svakuṭumbasamāvṛtaḥ || 3 || atha tasya sutā rājandāśakanyāsakhī śubhā || duḥkhena mahatāviṣṭā dāśyaṃtikamupādravat || 4 || tasyai nivedayāmāsa bhayaṃ vastrasamudbhavam || videśacalanaṃ caiva bāṣpagadgadayā girā || 5 || dāśakanyāpi duḥkhena tasyā duḥkhasamanvitā || abravīdvāṣsaṃklinnāṃ niśvasaṃtī muhurmuhuḥ || 6 || || dāśakanyovāca || || astyupāyo mahānatra vidito mama śobhane || dhruvaṃ tena kṛtenaiva nirbhayaṃ te ca te pituḥ || 7 || atrāsti nirjharaṃ subhrūrarbude varavarṇini || tatra me bhrātaraścaiva tathānye matsyajīvinaḥ || 8 || yaccānyadapi tatraiva kṣipyate salile śubhe || tatsarvaṃ śuklatāmeti paśya me vapurīdṛśam || 9 || sarveṣāmeva dāśānāṃ tasya toyasya majjanāt || tāni vastrāṇi tatraiva tātastava sumadhyame || jale prakṣālayetkṣipraṃ prayāsyaṃti suśuklatām || 7.3.23.10 || tvayā'tra na bhayaṃ kāryaṃ gatvā tātaṃ nivāraya || prasthitaṃ paradeśāya nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 11 || || pulastya uvāca || || sā tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā gatvā sarvaṃ nyavedayat || janakāya sutā tūrṇaṃ tato'sau tuṣṭimāptavān|| 12 || prātarutthāya tūrṇaṃ sa nirjharaṃ tamupādravat|| kṣiptamātrāṇi rājendra tāni vastrāṇi tena vai || || 13 || tasmiṃstoyetiśuklatvaṃ gatāni bahulāṃ tataḥ || kāṃtimāpuśca paramāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvāṃbarāṇi ca || 14 || athāsau vismayāviṣṭastāni cādāya satvaraḥ || rājñe nivedayāmāsa vṛttāṃtaṃ ca tadudbhavam || 15 || tato vismayamāpannaḥ sa rājā tatra nirjhare || anyāni nīlīraktāni vastrāṇi cākṣipajjale || 16 || sarvāṇi śuklatāṃ yāṃti viśiṣṭāni bhavaṃti ca || jñātvā tataḥ paraṃ tīrthaṃ snānaṃ cakre yathāvidhi || 17 || tyaktvā rājyaṃ sa tatraiva tapastepe mahīpatiḥ || tataḥ siddhiṃ parāṃ prāptastīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 18 || ekādaśyāṃ narastatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute nṛpa || sa kulāni samuddhṛtya daśa yāti divaṃ tataḥ || snānenava vipāpatvaṃ tatkṣaṇādeva jāyate || 19 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śuklatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 ||
<7.3.24>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha guhāmadhyanivāsinī || devī kātyāyanī yatra śuṃbhadānavanāśinī || 1 || śuṃbhonāma mahādaityaḥ purā''sītpṛthivītale || tena sarvaṃ jagadvyāptaṃ jitvā devānraṇājire || 2 || sa śaṃkaravarāddaityo devadānavarakṣasām|| avadhyo yoṣitaṃ muktvā sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ bhuvi || 3 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve gatvā'rbudamathācalam || tapastepurvadhārthāya śuṃbhasya jagatīpate || devīmārādhayāmāsurvyaktarūpāṃ sureśvarīm || 4 || atha teṣāṃ prasannā sā dṛṣṭigocaramāgatā || abravīdvaradāsmīti brūta kiṃ karavāṇi ca || 5 || || devā ūcuḥ || || sarvaṃ no'pahṛtaṃ devi śuṃbhena sudurātmanā || taṃ niṣūdaya kalyāṇi sovadhyonyaiḥ sadā raṇe || 6 || tvayā saṃrakṣitā devi purā bāṣkalito vayam || 7 || nānyā'smākaṃ gatirmātastvāṃ muktvā cāruhāsinīm || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktā surairdevī gatvā śuṃbhaniketanam|| ājuhāva raṇe kruddhā bhartsayitvā muhurmuhuḥ || 7 || sa tayā yācite yuddhe jñātvā tāṃ yoṣitaṃ nṛpa || avajñāya tato daityaḥ preṣayāmāsa dānavān || 9 || jīvagrāheṇa duṣṭeyaṃ gṛhyatāṃ paruṣasvanā || kriyatāṃ dāruṇo daṃḍo mama vākyānna saṃśayaḥ || 7.3.24.10 || atha tasya samādeśāddānavāstāṃ tato drutam || gatvā nirbhartsayāmāsurveṣṭayitvā diśo daśa || 11 || tato'valokanāddaityāstayā te bhasmasātkṛtāḥ || tataḥ śuṃbhaḥ prakupitaḥ svayameva samāyayau ||12|| abravīttiṣṭhatiṣṭheti khaṅgamudyamya bhīṣaṇaḥ || so'pidevyā mahārāja tathā caivāvalokitaḥ ||13|| abhavadbhasmasātsadyaḥ pataṃga iva pāvakam|| hate tasmiṃstato daityāḥ śeṣāḥ pārthivasattama|| bhittvā rasātalaṃ jagmuḥ pātālaṃ bhayasaṃyutāḥ ||14|| tato devagaṇāḥ sarve tuṣṭuvustāṃ sureśvarīm|| abruvaṃśca varaṃ brūhi yatte manasi varttate ||15|| devyuvāca || || tatraiva parvate sthāsye hyarbude'haṃ surottamāḥ || abhīṣṭaḥ parvato'smākaṃ saṃ sadā'rbudasaṃjñitaḥ ||16|| || devā ūcuḥ || || tatrasthāṃ tvāṃ samālokya marttyā yāṃti triviṣṭapam || vinā yajñaistathā dānaiḥ svargaḥ saṃkīrṇatāṃ gataḥ|| nānyatkāraṇamastīha niṣedhasya sureśvari ||17|| || devyuvāca || || tatrāhaṃ vijane ramye guhāmadhye sureśvarāḥ || sthāsyāmi viralāḥ kecidyāsyaṃti prāṇino mama || dṛṣṭigocaramārge hi gatvā taṃ parvataṃ prati ||17|| || devā ūcuḥ || || yadyevaṃ devi te'bhīṣṭamevaṃ kuru śucismite || vayaṃ tvāṃ tatra drakṣyāmaḥ śuklāṣṭamyāṃ sadā śuceḥ || 19 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktāḥ surā devyā prahṛṣṭāstridivaṃ yayuḥ || sāpi devī girau tatra gatvā caivārbude nṛpa || 7.3.24.20 || guhāmadhyaṃ samāsādya nityaṃ jagaddhitāya vai || vivikte nyavasatprītā durllabhā suramānavaiḥ || 21 || yastāṃ paśyati rājendra śuklāṣṭamyāṃ samāhitaḥ || abhīṣṭaṃ sa sadāpnoti yadyapi syātsudurllabham ||22|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe kātyāyanīmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || ||9||
<7.3.25>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tataḥ piṃḍārakaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛpa || yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ maṃkinā brāhmaṇena ca || siddhiṃ gatastathā rājaṃstīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 1 || purā maṃkirabhūdvipro nāmamātreṇa bhūpate || mūrkho brāhmaṇakṛtyānāmanabhijñaḥ sumandadhīḥ || 2 || athāsau parvate ramye lokānāṃ nṛpasattama || mahiṣī rakṣayāmāsa tataḥ piṃḍārakarmaṇi ||3|| kasyacittvatha kālasya tena vittamupārjitam|| dūrātkṛcchreṇa ca stokaṃ jagṛhe goyugaṃ tataḥ || 4||| tatastaddamayāmāsa goyugaṃ nṛpasattama || atha daivavaśādrājandamitaṃ tasya goyugam|| 5 || nibaddhamuṣṭramāsādya grīvādeśe balātsthitam || athoṣṭrastvarayā rājannutthitastrāsatatparaḥ ||6|| goyugena hi grīvāyāṃ lambamānena bhūpate || taddṛṣṭvā sumahāścaryaṃ vināśaṃ goyugasya tu || 7 || maṃkirvairāgyamāpannastyaktvā grāmaṃ vanaṃ yayau || sa gatvā nirjharaṃ kañcidarbude nṛpasattama ||8|| trikālaṃ kurute snānaṃ gāyatrījapamuttamam || tenāsau gatapāpo'bhūddivyadarśī ca bhūmipa ||9|| etasminneva kāle tu tena mārgeṇa śaṃkaraḥ || saha gauryā viniṣkrāṃtaḥ krīḍārthaṃ ramyaparvate ||7.3.25.10|| sa dṛṣṭaḥ sahasā tena piṃḍāreṇa mahātmanā || praṇāmamakarodrājaṃstatastaṃ śaṃkaro'bravīt || 11 || na vṛthā darśanaṃ me syādvaro me gṛhyatāṃ dvija || yadabhīṣṭaṃ mahārāja yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 12 || || piṃḍāraka uvāca || || gaṇo'haṃ tava deveśa bhavāni tripurāṃtaka || yathā tathā kuru vibho nānyanme hṛdi vartate || 13 || etatpiṇḍārakaṃ tīrtha mama nāmnā prasidhyatu || 14 || || bhagavānuvāca || || bhaviṣyasi gaṇo'smākaṃ dehāṃte tvaṃ dvijottama || etatpiṃḍārakaṃnāma tīrthamatra bhaviṣyati || 15 || ahamatra mahāṣṭamyāṃ nivekṣyāmi mahāmate || ye ca snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti saṃprāpte cāṣṭamīdine || te yāsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ yatrāhaṃ nityasaṃsthitaḥ || 16 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā mahādevastatraivāṃtaradhīyata ||| maṃkiḥ piṃḍārakastatra tapastepe divāniśam || 17 || tataḥ kālena mahatā tyaktvā dehaṃ divaṃ gataḥ || yatrāste bhagavānrudro gaṇastatra babhūva ha || 18 ||| tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ mantreṇa cācaret ||19|| rājendra mahiṣīdānamathāṣṭamyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || ya icchati sadā'bhīṣṭamiha loke paratra ca ||7.3.25.20|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe piṃḍārakatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ|| 25|| ||
<7.3.26>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || tasminkanakhalaṃnāma parvate pāpanāśane || 1 || śṛṇu tatrā'bhavatpūrvaṃ yadāścaryaṃ mahīpate || pārthivaḥ sumatirnāma saṃprāpto'rbudaparvate ||2|| sūryagrahe mahīpāla tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ gataḥ || tena viprārthamānītaṃ suvarṇaṃ jātyameva hi ||3|| prabhūtaṃ patitaṃ toye pramādāttasya bhūpateḥ || na labdhaṃ tena bhūpāla anveṣaṇapareṇa ca || 4 || tataḥ snātvā gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ paścāttāpasamanvitaḥ || tataḥ kālena mahatā sa bhūyastatra cāgataḥ || 5 || snānārthaṃ bhāskare graste taṃ ca deśamapaśyata || ciṃtayāmāsa medhāvī
