hyasmindeśe tadā mama || 6 || suvarṇaṃ patitaṃ hastānna ca labdhaṃ kathaṃcana || 7 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya vāguvācāśarīriṇī || nātra nāśo'sti rājendra iha loke paratra ca || 8 || atra koṭiguṇaṃ jātaṃ suvarṇaṃ yatpurātanam || paścāttāpastvayā bhūri kṛto yaddravyanāśane || 9 || tasmātsaṃkhyā ca saṃjātā tathaivākalpitasya ca || ye'tra śraddhāsamāyuktāḥ suvarṇairnṛpasattama || yatnācchrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti suvarṇaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 7.3.26.10 || brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyaṃti saṃkhyā tasya na vidyate || atrānveṣaya deśe tvaṃ prāpsyase nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 11 || sa śrutvā bhāratī tatra hyākāśādutthitāṃ nṛpa || anveṣamāṇo'smindeśe suvarṇaṃ tacca labdhavān || 12 || śubhraṃ koṭiguṇaṃ prājyaṃ tatastuṣṭiṃ samāgataḥ || jñātvā tīrthaprabhāvaṃ taṃ brāhmaṇebhyaḥ sahasraśaḥ || pradadau ca dayāyukta uddiśya pitṛdevatāḥ || 13 || tatastasya prabhāveṇa sa dānasya mahīpatiḥ || saṃjāto dhanadonāma yakṣo nānādhanapradaḥ || 14 || tatra yaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ grahe sūryasya bhūmipa || ākalpaṃ pitarastasya tṛptiṃ yāṃti sutarpitāḥ || 15 || snānena ṛṣayo devāstuṣṭiṃ yāṃti mahoragāḥ || nāśaḥ saṃjāyate sadyaḥ pāpasya pṛthivīpate || 16 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || yathāśaktyā tathā dānaṃ śrāddhaṃ ca nṛpasattama || 17 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kanakhalatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṅviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 26 || || cha ||
<7.3.27>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha cakratīrthamanuttamam || yatra cakraṃ purā muktaṃ viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 1 || nihatya dānavānsaṃkhye kṛtvā snānaṃ sunirjhare || viṣṇuḥ prākṣālayattoyaṃ tena tanmedhyatāṃ gatam || 2 || tatra śrāddhaṃ tu yaḥ kuryācchayane bodhane hareḥ || ākalpaṃ pitarastasya tṛptiṃ yāṃti narādhipa || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe cakratīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || || cha ||
<7.3.28>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha supuṇyaṃ mānuṣaṃ hradam || yatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅmanuṣyo jāyate sadā || 1 || na tiryaktvamavāpnoti kṛtvā'pi bahupātakam || tatrāścaryamabhūtpūrvaṃ yattacchṛṇu narādhipa || 2 || mṛgayūthamanuprāpta vyādhavyāptaṃ samantataḥ || te mṛgā bhayasantrastāḥ praviṣṭā jalamadhyataḥ || 3 || sadyo manuṣyatāṃ prāptāḥ pūrvajātismarāstathā || etasminneva kāle tu vyādhāste samupāgatāḥ || 4 || cāpabāṇadharāḥ sarve yathā vai yamakiṃkarāḥ || papracchuśca mṛgānbhūpa mānuṣatvamupāgatān || 5 || mṛgayūthamanu prāptamasminsthāne jalāśraye || kena mārgeṇa tadyātaṃ vadadhvaṃ satvaraṃ hi naḥ || vayaṃ sarve pariśrāṃtāḥ kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 6 || || manuṣyā ūcuḥ || || vayaṃ te hariṇāḥ sarve mānuṣyaṃ bhāvamāśritāḥ || tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa satyametadasaṃśayam || 7 || || pulastya uvāca || || tataste śabarāḥ sarve tyaktvā cāpāni pārthiva || kṛtvā snānaṃ jale tasminsadyaḥ siddhiṃ gatā nṛpa || 8 || tataḥ śakrastu taddṛṣṭvā tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛpa || pūrayāmāsa sarvatra pāṃsubhirnṛpasattama || 9 || adyāpi manujāstatra budhāṣṭamyāṃ narādhipa || snānaṃ ye prakariṣyaṃti tiryaktvaṃ na vrajaṃti te || 7.3.28.10 || pitṛmedhaphalaṃ kṛtsnaṃ śrāddhadānādavāpnuyuḥ || 11 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe manuṣyatīrthaprabhāva varṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || || cha ||
<7.3.29>
|| paulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha kapilātīrthamuttamam || yatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅmucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 1 || purā'bhūnnṛpatirnāma suprabhaḥ paravīrahā || nityaṃ ca mṛgayāśīlo mṛgāṇāmahite rataḥ || 2 || na tathā strīṣu no bhoge nāśvayāne na vāraṇe || tasyābhūdanurāgaśca yathā mṛgavimarddane || 3 || sa kadācinnṛpaśreṣṭha mṛgāsakto'rbudaṃ gataḥ || apaśyatsānudeśe ca mṛgīṃ śiśusamāvṛtām || 4 || stanaṃ dhayantīṃ susnigdhāṃ śiśoḥ kṣīrānurāgiṇaḥ || sā tena viddhā bāṇena sahasā nataparvaṇā || 5 || atha sā pārthivaṃ dṛṣṭvā pragṛhītaśarāsanam || dvitīyaṃ yojayānaṃ ca mṛgī bāṇaṃ sunirmalam || 6 || tataḥ sā kopasantaptā bhūpālaṃ pratyabhāṣata || nāyaṃ dharmaḥ smṛtaḥ kṣāttro yastvayādya niṣevitaḥ ||7 || śayāno maithunāsaktaḥ stanapo vyādhipīḍitaḥ || na haṃtavyo mṛgo rājanmṛgī ca śiśunā vṛtā || 8 || tadadya maraṇaṃ jātaṃ mama sarvaṃ nṛpādhama || tava bāṇaṃ samāsādya putrasya ca mayā vinā || 9 || yasmādahamadharmeṇa hatā bhūmipate tvayā || tasmādatraiva sānau tvaṃ raudravyāghro bhaviṣyasi|| 7.3.29.10 || || pulastya uvāca || || tacchrutvā sumahatpāpaṃ sa nṛpo bhayasaṃkulam || tāṃ vai prasādayāmāsa prāṇaśeṣāṃ tadā mṛgīm || 11 || avivekānmayā bhadre hatā tvaṃ nirghṛṇena ca || kuru śāpavimokṣaṃ tvaṃ tasmāddīnasya sanmṛgi || 12 || || mṛgyuvāca || || yadā tu kapilāṃ nāma drakṣyase tvaṃ payasvinīm || dhenuṃ tayā samālāpātprakṛtiṃ yāsyase punaḥ || 13 || evamuktvā mṛgī rājāgrataḥ prāṇairvyayujyata || pīḍitā śaraghātena putrasnehādviśeṣataḥ || 14 || athā'sau pārthivaḥ sadyo raudrāsyaḥ samajāyata || vyāghro daśakarālaśca tīkṣṇadantanakhastathā || bhakṣayāmāsa tāṃ senāmātmīyāṃ krodhamūrcchitaḥ || 15 || tataste sainikā rājanhataśeṣāḥ suduḥkhitāḥ || svagṛhāṇi yayustatra yathā vṛttaṃ jane pure || 16 || nivedayanto vṛttāṃtaṃ catvareṣu trikeṣu ca || yathā vai vyāghratāṃ prāptaḥ sa rājā'rbudaparvate || 17 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya putraṃ bhūriparākramam || rājye'bhiṣecayāmāsu nāmnā khyātaṃ mahaujasam || 18 || kasyacittvatha kālasya tasminsānau nṛpottama || tṛṣārtaṃ gokulaṃ prāptaṃ gopagopīsamākulam || 19 || tatraikā gauḥ paribhraṣṭā svayūthāttṛṇatṛṣṇayā || kapileti ca vikhyātā svayūthasyāgragāminī|| || 7.3.29.20 || acchinnāgratṛṇaṃ yā tu sadā bhakṣayate nṛpa || atha sā gahvaraṃ prāptā gireḥ śūnyaṃ bhayaṃkaram || 21 || tatrāsasāda tāṃ vyāghro daṃṣṭrotkaṭamukhāvahaḥ || sā taṃ dṛṣṭavatī pāpaṃ trāsamāpa mṛgīva hi || 22 || smaraṃtī gokule baddhaṃ svasutaṃ kṣīrapāyinam || duḥkhena rudatīṃ tāṃ sa dṛṣṭvovāca mṛgādhipaḥ || 23 || || vyāghra uvāca || || kiṃ vṛthā rudyate dheno māṃ prāpya na hi jīvitam || vidyate kasyacinmūrkhe smareṣṭāṃ devatāṃ tataḥ || 24 || || || kapilovāca || || svajīvitabhayādvyāghra na rodimi kathaṃcana || putro me bālako goṣṭhyāṃ kṣīrapāyī pratīkṣate || 25 || nādyāpi sa tṛṇā nyatti tenāhaṃ śokaviklavā || rodmi vyāghra sutasnehātsatyenātmānamālabhe || 26 || pāyayitvā sutaṃ bālaṃ dṛṣṭvā pṛṣṭvā janaṃ svakam || punaḥ pratyāgamiṣyāmi yadi tvaṃ manyase vibho || 27 || || vyāghra uvāca || || gatvā svasutasāṃnidhyaṃ dṛṣṭvātmīyaṃ ca gokulam || punarāgamanaṃ yatte na ca tacchraddadhāmyaham || 28 || bhayānmāṃ bhāṣase caivaṃ nāsti prāṇasamaṃ bhayam || tasmātprāṇabhayānna tvamāgamiṣyasi dhenuke || 29 || || kapilo vāca || || śapathairāgamiṣyāmi satyametacchṛṇuṣva me || pratyayo yadi te bhūyānmāṃ muñca tvaṃ mṛgādhipa || 7.3.29.30 || || vyāghra uvāca || || brūhi tāñchapathānbhadre samāgacchasi yaiḥ punaḥ|| tato'haṃ pratyayaṃ gatvā mocayiṣyāmi vā na vā || 31 || || kapilovāca || || vedādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vaṃcayettu yaḥ || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 32 || gurudroharatānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 33 || yatpāpaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ hatvā gāṃ ca hatvā prajāyate || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 34 || mitradrohe ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ guruvaṃcake || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 35 || yo gāṃ spṛśati pādena brāhmaṇaṃ pāvakaṃ tathā || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 36 || kūpārāmataḍāgānāṃ yo bhaṃgaṃ kuruta naraḥ || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 37 || kṛtaghnasya ca yatpāpaṃ sūcakasya ca yadbhavet || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 38 || madyamāṃsaratānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 39 || rājapaiśunyakartṝṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 7.3.29.40 || vedavikrayakartṝṇāṃ yatpāpaṃ saṃprajāyate || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 41 || dīyamānaṃ dvijātīnāṃ nivārayati yo'lpadhīḥ || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 42 || viśvastaghātakānāṃ ca yatpāpaṃ samudāhṛtam || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 43 || dvijadveṣaratānāṃ hi yatpāpaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 44 || paravādaratānāṃ ca pāpaṃ yacca durātmanām || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || || 45 || rātrau ye pāpakarmāṇo bhakṣaṃti dadhisaktukān || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 46 || vṛṃtākaṃ mūlakaṃ śvetaṃ raktaṃ ye'śnaṃti gṛṃjanam || tena pāpena lipyāmi yadyahaṃ nāgame punaḥ || 47 || || pulastya uvāca || || sa tasyāḥ śapathāñchrutvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ || pratyayaṃ ca tadā gatvā vyāghro vākyamathābravīt || 48 || || vyāghra uvāca || || gaccha tvaṃ gokule bhadre punarāgamanaṃ kuru || na caitadavagaṃtavyaṃ yadayaṃ vañcito mayā || 49 || kapile gaccha paśya tvaṃ tanayaṃ sutavatsale || pāyayitvā stanaṃ pūrṇamavaghrāya ca mūrdhani || 7.3.29.50 || mātaraṃ bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā sakhīḥ svajanavabāṃdhavān || satyamevāgrataḥ kṛtvā nānyathā kartumarhasi || 51 || || pulastya uvāca || || sā'nujñātā mṛgendreṇa kapilā putravatsalā ||| aśrupūrṇamukhī dīnā prasthitā gokulaṃ prati || 52 || vepamānā bhayodvignā śokasāgaramadhyagā || kariṇīva hi raudreṇa hariṇā sā balīyasā ||| tataḥ svagokulaṃ prāptā rabhamāṇā muhurmuhuḥ || 53 || tasyāḥ śabdaṃ tataḥ śrutvā jñātvā vatsaḥ svamātaram || sammukhaḥ prayayau tūrṇamūrddhvapucchaḥ praharṣitaḥ || 54 || akālāgamanaṃ tasyā raudraṃ bhaṃbhāravaṃ tathā || dṛṣṭvā śrutvā ca vatso'sau śaṃkitaḥ paripṛcchati || 55 || || vatsa uvāca || || na te paśyāmi saumyatvaṃ durmanā iva lakṣyame || kimarthamanyavelāyāṃ samāyātā vadasva me || 56 || || kapilovāca || || piba putra stanaṃ paścātkāraṇaṃ cāpi me śṛṇu || āgatā'haṃ tava snehātkuru tṛptiṃ yathepsitām ||57 || apaścimamidaṃ putra durlabhaṃ mātṛdarśanam || mayā'dya putra gaṃtavyaṃ śapathairāgatā yataḥ ||58|| vyāghrasya kāmarūpasya dātavyaṃ jīvitaṃ mayā || tenāhaṃ śapathairmuktā kāraṇāttava putraka || 59 || mayā'dya tatra gaṃtavyaṃ mṛgarājasamīpataḥ || yadā ca śapathaiḥ putra dāsyāmi ca kalevaram ||7.3.29.60|| || vatsa uvāca || || ahaṃ tatra gamiṣyāmi yatra tvaṃ gaṃtumicchasi || ślāghyaṃ hi maraṇaṃ me'dya tvayā saha na saṃśayaḥ ||61|| ekākinā'pi marttavyaṃ yasmānmayā tvayā vinā || yadi māṃ sahitaṃ tatra tvayā vyāghro vadhiṣyati ||62|| yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ dhruvaṃ sā me bhaviṣyati || tasmādavaśyaṃ yāsyāmi tvayā saha na saṃśayaḥ || 63 || athavā'traiva tiṣṭha tvaṃ śapathāḥ saṃtu me tava || tava sthāne prayāsyāmi mātastvaṃ yadi manyase || 64 || jananyā viprayuktasya jīvitaṃ na hi me priyam || nāsti mātṛsamaḥ kaścidbālānāṃ kṣīrajīvinām || 65 || nāsti mātṛsamo nātho nāsti mātṛsamā gatiḥ || ye mātṛniratāḥ putrāste yāṃti paramāṃ gatim || 66 || || kapilovāca || || mamaiva vihito mṛtyurna te putraka sāṃpratam || na cāyamanyabhūtānāṃ mṛtyuḥ syādanyamṛtyutaḥ || 67 || apaścimamidaṃ putra mātuḥ sandeśamuttamam || śṛṇuṣvāvahito bhūtvā pariṇāmasukhāvaham || 68 || vane cara sadā vatsa apramādaparo bhava || pramādātsarvabhūtāni vinaśyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 69 || na ca lobhena cartavyaṃ viṣamasthaṃ tṛṇaṃ kvacit || lobhādvināśo jaṃtūnāmiha loke paratra ca || 7.3.29.70 || samudramaṭavīṃ yuddhaṃ viśaṃte lobhamohitāḥ || lobhādi kāryamatyugraṃ kurvaṃti tyājya eva saḥ || 71 || lobhātpramādādāśvāsātpuruṣo bādhyate tribhiḥ || tasmāllobho na karttavyo na pramādo na viśvaset || 72 || ātmā ca satataṃ putra rakṣitavyaḥ prayatnataḥ || sarvebhyaḥ śvāpadebhyaśca mlecchebhyastaskarāditaḥ ||73|| tiryagbhyaḥ pāpayonibhyaḥ sadā vicaratā vane || na ca śokastvayā kāryaḥ sarveṣāṃ maraṇaṃ dhuvam || 74 || asmākaṃ prativācaṃ ca śṛṇu śokavināśinīm || yathā hi pathikaḥ kaścicchāyārthī vṛkṣamāsthitaḥ || viśrāntaśca punaryāti tadvadbhūtasamāgamaḥ || 75 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ saṃbhāṣya taṃ vatsamavaghrāya ca mūrddhani || svamātaraṃ sakhīvargaṃ tato draṣṭuṃ samāgatā || 76 || abravīcca tato vākyaṃ putraśokena duḥkhitā || aṃbāḥ śṛṇuta me vākyamapaścimamidaṃ sphuṭam || 77 || anāthamabalaṃ dīnaṃ phenapaṃ mama putrakam || mātṛśokābhisaṃtaptaṃ sarvāstaṃ pālayiṣyatha || 78 || bhāvinīnāmayaṃ putraḥ sāṃprataṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || snapanīyaḥ pāyitavyaḥ poṣyaḥ pālyaḥ svaputravat || 79 || caraṃtaṃ viṣame sthāne caraṃtaṃ paragokule || akāryeṣu pravartaṃtaṃ he sakhyo vārayiṣyatha || 7.3.29.80 || kṣamadhvaṃ ca mahābhāgā yāsye'haṃ satyasaṃśrayāt || yatrā'sau tiṣṭhate vyāghro muktā'haṃ yena sāṃpratam || 81|| sarvāstā vacanaṃ śrutvā tasyāḥ śokasamanvitāḥ || viṣādaṃ paramaṃ gatvā vākyamūcuḥ suduḥkhitāḥ|| 82|| kapile naiva gaṃtavyaṃ na te doṣo bhaviṣyati|| prāṇātyaye na doṣo'sti saṃparāye ca dāruṇe|| 83|| atra gāthā purā gītā munibhirdharmavādibhiḥ|| prāṇātyaye samutpanne śapathe nāsti pātakam|| 84|| kapilovāca|| prāṇināṃ prāṇa rakṣārthaṃ vadāmyevānṛtaṃ vacaḥ || nātmārthamupayuñjāmi svalpamapyanṛtaṃ kvacit || 85 || aśvamedhasahasraṃ tu satyaṃ ca tulayā dhṛtam || aśvamedhasahasrāddhi satyameva viśiṣyate || 86 || tasmānnānṛtamātmānaṃ kariṣye jīvitāśayā || ājñāpayatu māmāryā yāsye yatra mṛgādhipaḥ || 87 || || vayasyā ūcuḥ || || kapile tvaṃ namaskāryā sarvairapi surāsuraiḥ || yattvaṃ paramasatyena prāṇāṃstyajasi dustyajān || 88 || avaśyaṃ na ca te bhāvī mṛtyuḥ satyātkathaṃcana || pramāṇaṃ yadi satyaṃ hi vraja paṃthāḥ śivo'stu te || 89 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktā ca kapilā gatā yatra mṛgādhipaḥ || athāsau kapilāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayotphullalocanaḥ || abravītpraśritaṃ vākyaṃ harṣagadgadayā girā || 7.3.29.90 || || vyāghra uvāca || || svāgataṃ tava kalyāṇi kapile satyavādini || nahi satyavatāṃ kiṃcidaśubhaṃ vidyate kvacit || 91 || tvayoktaṃ kapile pūrvaṃ śapathairāgamāya ca || tena me kautukaṃ jātaṃ yātā''gacchetpunaḥ katham || 92 || tasmādgaccha mayā muktā yatrā'sau tanayastava || tiṣṭhate gokule baddhaḥ kṣīrapāyī suduḥkhitaḥ ||93|| || || pulastya uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu sa rājā prakṛtiṃ gataḥ || mṛgīśāpena nirmukto divyarūpavapurdharaḥ || tato'bravītprahṛṣṭātmā kapilāṃ satyavādinīm || 94 || || rājovāca || || prasādāttava mukto'haṃ śāpādasmātsudāruṇāt || kiṃ te priyaṃ karomyadya dhenuke brūhi satvaram || 95 || || kapilovāca || || kṛtakṛtyā'smi rājenda yattvaṃ mukto'si kilbiṣāt|| pipāsā bādhatetyarthaṃ sāṃprataṃ jalamānayam || 96 || naivānṛtaṃ vijānīhi satyametanmayoditam || 97 || || pulastya uvāca || || athāsau pārthivo haste cāpamādāya satvaram || sajyaṃ kṛtvā śaraṃ gṛhya jaghāna dharaṇītalam || 98 || tataḥ salilamuttasthau nirmalaṃ śītalaṃ śubham || tatra sā kapilā snātvā vitṛṣā samapadyata || 99 || etasminnantare dharmaḥ svayaṃ tatra samāgataḥ || abravītkapilāṃ hṛṣṭo varaṃ varaya śobhane ||7.3.29.100 || tava satyena tuṣṭo'haṃ nāsti te sadṛśī kvacit || trailokye sakale dhenurna bhaviṣyati vai śubhe || 101 || || kapilovāca || || prasādāttava gaccheya saha rājñā sagokulā || suprabheṇa padaṃ divyaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam|| 102 || mannāmnā khyātimāyātu puṇyametajjalāśayam || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ tathā || 103 || || dharma uvāca || || ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyaṃti supuṇye salile śubhe || caturddaśyāṃ viśeṣeṇa te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || 104 || tava nāmnā supuṇyaṃ hi tīrthametadbhaviṣyati || darśamuddiśya martyastu prāpsyate gosahasrakam || snānāllakṣaguṇaṃ dānātpuṇyaṃ caiva tathā'kṣayam || 105 || ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti mānavāḥ susamāhitāḥ|| sarvadānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ bhuktimuktī mahātmanām || 106 || api kīṭapataṃgā ye tṛṣārtāḥ salile śubhe || majjayiṣyati yāsyaṃti te'pi sthānaṃ divaukasām|| 107 || kiṃ punarbhaktisaṃyuktā mānavāḥ satyavādinaḥ || manasvino mahābhāgāḥ śraddhāvaṃto vicakṣaṇāḥ || 108 || || pulastya uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu vimānāni sahasraśaḥ || samāyātāni rājeṃdra kapilāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || 109 || tānyāruhyātha kapilā gopagokulasaṃkulā || suprabheṇa samāyuktā tatpadaṃ paramaṃ gatā || 7.3.29.110 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena tatra snānaṃ samācaret || śrāddhaṃ caivātmanaḥ śaktyā dānaṃ pārthivasattama || || 111 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kapilātīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ||29||
<7.3.30>
pulastya uvāca|| agnitīrthaṃ tato gacchetpāvanaṃ paramaṃ nṛṇām|| tatra vahniḥ purā naṣṭo labdhaśca tridaśairapi|| 1 || yayātiruvāca|| kimarthaṃ bhagavanvahniḥ purā naṣṭo dvijottama|| kathaṃ tatraiva labdhastu kautukaṃ me mahāmune||2|| pulastya uvāca|| purā vṛṣṭinirodho'bhūdyāvaddvādaśavatsarān|| saṃśayaṃ paramaṃ prāptaḥ sarvo lokaḥ kṣudhārditaḥ || 3 || prāyo mṛto mṛtaprāyaḥ śeṣo'bhūddharaṇītale || naṣṭā araṇyajā grāmyāḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || 4 || evaṃ kṛcchramanuprāpte martyaloke narādhipaḥ || viśvāmitro munivaraḥ saṃdehaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 5 || annauṣadhirasābhāvādasthiśeṣo vyajāyata || anyasmindivase prāptaḥ kṣutkṣāmaḥ paryaṭandiśaḥ || 6 || caṃḍālanilayaṃ prāptaḥ kṣuttṛṣāpīḍito bhṛśam || tatrāpaśyanmṛtaṃ śvānaṃ śuṣkaṃ pārthivasattama || 7 || tamādāya gṛhaṃ prāptaḥ prakṣālya salilena tu || kṣutkṣāmaḥ pācayāmāsa tatastaṃ pāvake'juhot || 8 || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇaṃ jñātvā havyavāhastato nṛpa || śakrasyopari manyuṃ svaṃ cakre'tīva mahīpate || 9 || naṣṭauṣadhirase loke yuktametaddhi sāṃpratam || yādṛgāptaṃ havistādṛgagnibhakṣo viśiṣyate || 7.3.30.10 || nābhakṣyaṃ bhakṣayiṣyāmi tyajiṣye kṣitimaṃḍalam || yena śakrādayo devā yāṃti kaṣṭatarāṃ daśām|| 11 || evaṃ saṃciṃtya manasā sakopo havyavāhanaḥ || praṇaṣṭaḥ sakalaṃ hitvā martyalokaṃ carācaram || 12 || praṇaṣṭe sahasā vahnāvagniṣṭomādikāḥ kriyāḥ || praṇaṣṭāstu janāḥ sarve viśeṣātsaṃśayaṃ gatāḥ || 13 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve saṃdehaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || yajñabhāgavihīnatvānmaṃtraṃ cakrustato mithaḥ || 14 || tyaktastu vahninā martyastato nāśaṃ gatā narāḥ || śeṣanāśādvayaṃ sarve vinaṃkṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || tasmādanveṣyatāṃ vahniryatra tiṣṭhati sāṃpratam || yathā carati martye ca tathā nītirvidhīyatām|| 16 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ te niścayaṃ kṛtvā sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || anvaiṣayaṃstathāgniṃ te samaṃtātkṣitimaṃḍale || 17 || tataste purato dṛṣṭvā śukaṃ śrāṃtā divaukasaḥ || papracchuḥ śraddhayā vahniryadi dṛṣṭaḥ prakathyatām ||18|| || śuka uvāca || || yo'yaṃ vaṃśo mahānagre pradagdho vahnisaṃgataḥ || praṇaṣṭo havyavāhotra mayā dṛṣṭo mahādyutiḥ || 19 || śukenāvedito vahniḥ śaptvā taṃ manyunā vṛtaḥ || gadgadā bhāvi te vāṇī proktvedaṃ prasthito drutam || 7.3.30.20 || praviveśa śamīgarbhamaśvatthaṃ tarusattamam || tatrastho dviparājñā sa kathito vibudhānprati || 21 || sa taṃ provāca te jihvā viparītā bhaviṣyati || tato jalāśayaṃ gatvā parvate'rbudasaṃjñake || 22 || praviṣṭo bhagavānvahniryathā devairna lakṣyate || tatrotthena dardureṇa teṣāṃ prokto hutāśanaḥ || 23 || atrā'sau tiṣṭhate vahnirnirjhare parvatasya ca || dagdhāśca jalajāḥ sarve sutaptenaiva vāriṇā || || 24 || kṛcchrādahaṃ viniṣkrāṃtastasmānmṛtyumukhātsurāḥ || tacchrutvā yatnamāsthāya praviṣṭo havyavāhanaḥ || 25 || bhaviṣyasi vijihvastvaṃ śaptvā taṃ darduraṃ nṛpaḥ || 26 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve niṣkrāṃtāḥ salilāśrayāt || saṃveṣṭya tuṣṭuvuḥ sarve stavairvedodbhavairnṛpa || 27 || || devā ūcuḥ || || tvamagne sarvabhūtānāmaṃtaścarasi pāvaka || tvayā hīnaṃ jagatsarvaṃ nāśaṃ yāsyati satvaram || 28 || tvaṃ mukhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ tvayi lokāḥ pratiṣṭhitāḥ || bhūloke ca tvayā tyakte vayaṃ sarve savāsavāḥ || vināśameva yāsyāmastasmāttvaṃ trātumarhasi || 29 || tvaṃ brahmā tvaṃ mahādevastvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ divākaraḥ || tvaṃ caṃdrastvaṃ ca dhanado maruttvaṃ ca sureśvaraḥ ||7.3.30.30|| iṃdrādyā vibudhāḥ sarve tvadāyattā hutāśana || kimarthaṃ bhagavanmarttyaṃ tyaktvā tvamatra saṃsthitaḥ || kimarthaṃ bhagavannasmānanāgāṃstyaktumicchasi || 31 || || pulastya uvāca || || veṣṭito bhagavānvahnirdevaiḥ stutiparāyaṇaiḥ || tasyaiva nirjharasyātha taṭastho vākyamabravīt || 32 || || vahniruvāca || || abhakṣyabhakṣaṇe śakro māmicchati niyojitum || tenaiva na karotyeṣa vṛṣṭiṃ marttye sureśvaraḥ || 33 || ato'haṃ bhūtalaṃ tyaktvā praviṣṭo nirjhare tviha || praṇaṣṭānnarase loke na cāhaṃ sthātumutsahe || 34 || || śakra uvāca || || śṛṇu yasmānmayā rodhaḥ kṛto vṛṣṭerhutāśana || devāpirnāma dharmajñaḥ kṣatriyāṇāṃ yaśaskaraḥ || 35 || pratīpastatsutaḥ sādhuḥ sarvaśīlavatāṃ varaḥ || devāpau ca gate svargaṃ jyeṣṭhabhrātaramagrajam|| saṃtyaktvā jagṛhe rājyaṃ śaṃtanustatsuto'varaḥ || 36 || etasmātkāraṇādrājye tasya vṛṣṭirnirākṛtā || tavādeśātkariṣyāmi nivartasva hutāśana || 37 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā sahasrākṣaḥ puṣkarāvartakānghanān || drutamājñāpayāmāsa vṛṣṭyarthaṃ jagatītale|| 38|| atha śakrasamādiṣṭā vidyutvanto balāhakāḥ|| gambhīrarāviṇaḥ sarvaṃ bhūtalaṃ pracurairjalaiḥ|| pūrayāmāsuratyugrā dyutimanto mahīpate|| 39|| tato'gamatparāṃ tuṣṭiṃ bhagavānhavyavāhanaḥ|| rocayāmāsa bhūpṛṣṭhe vasatiṃ devakāraṇāt|| 7.3.30.40|| devā ūcuḥ|| tavā''deśātkṛtā vṛṣṭiranyatkāryaṃ hutāśana || yatte priyaṃ tadasmākaṃ suśīghraṃ hi nivedaya || 41 || || agniruvāca || || etajjalāśayaṃ puṇyaṃ mannāmnā tīrthamuttamam || khyātiṃ yātu dharāpṛṣṭhe yuṣmākaṃ hi prasādataḥ || 42 || || devā ūcuḥ || || agnitīrthamidaṃ loke prakhyātiṃ saṃprayāsyati || atra snāto naraḥ samyagagnilokaṃ prayāsyati || 43 || yastilāndāsyati narastīrthe'sminsusamāhitaḥ || agniṣṭomasya yajñasya phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati ||44|| || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā surāḥ sarve svasvasthānaṃ yayustataḥ || vahniśca bhagavānrājanyathāpūrvamavartata || 45 || yaścaitpaṭhate nityaṃ prātarutthāya cottamam || agnitīrthasya māhātmyaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 46 || ahorātrakṛtātpāpātsa śṛṇvannapi mucyate || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekā śītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe'gnitīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 || cha ||
<7.3.31>
|| pulastya uvāca || || raktānubandhaṃ vai gacchettīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || yatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅmucyate brahmahatyayā || 1 || purā''sītpārthivonāma iṃdraseno mahīpatiḥ || tasyā''sītsupriyā bhāryā sunandānāma bhāminī || pativratā patiprāṇā sadā patyuḥ priye sthitā || 2 || kasyacittvatha kālasya sa rājā saparigrahaḥ || paradeśaṃ gato haṃtuṃ śatrusaṃghaṃ durāsadam || 3 || taṃ nihatya dhanaṃ bhūri gṛhītvā prasthito gṛham || tato'gre preṣayāmāsa sa dūtaṃ kṛtrimaṃ nṛpa || 4 || sunandāṃ brūhi gatvā tvamindraseno hato raṇe || tadākārastato lakṣyaḥ pātivratye mamājñayā || 5 || yadi sā niścayaṃ gacchenmaraṇaṃ prati bhāminī || tadā rakṣyā prayatnena vācyaṃ hāsyaṃ mamodbhavam || 6 || evamukto gato dūtastatkṣaṇānnṛpasattama || tasyai nivedadāmāsa yaduktaṃ tena bhūbhujā || 7 || atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sunaṃdā cāruhāsinī || gataprāṇā nṛpaśreṣṭha patiprāṇā mahāsatī || 8 || yasminkāle mṛtā sā tu sunandā śīlamaṃḍanā || tasminkāle nṛpaḥ so'pi tatpāpena samāśritaḥ || 9 || athāpaśyaddvitīyāṃ sa cchāyāṃ gātrasya copari || tathā gurutaraṃ kāyaṃ sālasyaṃ samapadyata || 7.3.31.10 || tejohīnaṃ sudurgaṃdhi vivarṇaṃ nṛpasattama || atha prāpto gṛhaṃ rājā śrutvā bhāryāsamudbhavam || 11 || vināśaṃ duḥkhaśokārtaḥ karuṇaṃ paryadevayat|| sa jñātvā pāpamātmānaṃ strīhatyāsuvidūṣitam|| 12 || brāhmaṇānāṃ samādeśāttathā yātrāparo'bhavat || kṛtvaurddhvadaihikaṃ tasyā laghumātra parigrahaḥ || vārāṇasyāṃ gataḥ pūrvaṃ tatra dānaṃ dadau bahu ||13|| kapālamocane tīrthe sarvapāpapraṇāśane || trinetro yatra nirmuktaḥ purā vai brahmahatyayā ||14|| tasya cchāyā dvitīyā sā na naṣṭā tatra bhūpate || tataḥ kanakhalaṃ prāptaḥ supuṇyaṃ śuddhidaṃ nṛṇām || 15 || tathaiva puṣkarāraṇyaṃ tasmādamarakaṇṭakam || kurukṣetraṃ tato rājanprāpto'sau nṛpasattamaḥ || 16 || prabhāsaṃ somatīrthaṃ ca tatastu kṛmijāṃgale || ekahaṃsaṃ tato rājanpuṇyapāriplavaṃ tataḥ || 17 || rudrakoṭiṃ virūpākṣaṃ tataḥ paṃcanadaṃ nṛpa || evamādīni tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || paribhramanmahīpāla pariśrāṃto narādhipaḥ || 18 || tato varṣasahasrāṃte saṃprāpto'rbudaparvate || tatrāpaśyannarapatistīrthānyāyatanāni ca || 19 || tapasvisaṃghānvividhānbrāhmaṇānvedapāragān || dadau dānāni bahuśo brāhmaṇebhyo yadṛcchayā || 7.3.31.20 || prāpto raktānubaṃdhaṃ ca tīrthaṃ tatraiva parvate || tatra snāto viniṣkrāṃto yāvatpaśyati bhūmipaḥ || 21 || tāvanna dṛśyate cchāyā dvitīyā strīvadhodbhavā || laghutvaṃ sarvagātrāṇi saṃprāptāni mahīpate || 22 || vigandhatā praṇaṣṭā ca tejovṛddhiḥ parābhavat || tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā dattvā dānāni bhūriśaḥ || stūyamānaścaturdikṣu baṃdibhiḥ prasthito gṛham || 23 || tato raktānubaṃdhasya somātikramaṇaṃ nṛpa || yāvatkaroti rājendra tāvadasya punastathā ||24|| sā cchāyā dṛśyate dehe dvitīyā nṛpasattama || sa eva gandho gātreṣu tejohāniśca sā nṛpa || 25 || tato duḥkhābhisaṃtapto gatastatraiva tatkṣaṇāt || raktabaṃdhamanuprāpto vipāpmā so'bhavatpunaḥ || 26 || sa jñātvā tīrthamāhātmyaṃ paraṃ pārthivasattamaḥ || tatra dārūṇi cāhṛtya citāṃ kṛtvā tato nṛpa || dānaṃ dattvā dvijāgrebhyaḥ praviṣṭo havyavāhanam || 27 || tato vimānamāruhya parityajya kalevaram || divyamālyāṃbaradharaḥ śivalokamupāgamat || 28 || śivalokamanuprāpte tasminpārthivasattame || devarṣayastadā vākyamidamāhuḥ suvismayāt || 29 || tīrthebhyastu paraṃ tīrthamidaṃ vai pāvanaṃ param || indraseno hyataḥ pāpāttīrthasaṃgādvyamucyata || 7.3.31.30 || tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ khyātaṃ ca dharaṇītale || raktānāṃ prāṇināṃ yasmādanubandhaṃ karoti yat || 31 || raktānubandhamityeva tasmāttatkīrttyate kṣitau || tatra santarpya vai devānyaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute nṛpa || 32 || tatra saṃkramaṇe bhānoryaḥ snānaṃ kurute naraḥ || śraddhayā parayā yukto mucyate brahmahatyayā || 33 || pitṛkṣetre gayāyāṃ ca śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute naraḥ || gayāśrāddhasamaṃ prāhuḥ phalaṃ tasya maharṣayaḥ || 34 || candrasūryoparāge vā godānaṃ nṛpasattama || yaḥ karoti narastatra sa kulānsapta tārayet || 35 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe raktānubandhamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || || 31 || || cha || ||
<7.3.32>
pulastya uvāca || || mahāvināyakaṃ gacchettataḥ pārthivasattama || yasmindṛṣṭe nṛṇāṃ sadyo nirvighnatvaṃ prajāyate || 1 || || || yayātiruvāca || || kathaṃ mahattvamagamatpūrvaṃ tatra vināyakaḥ || kasminkāle dvijaśreṣṭha sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 2 || || pulastya uvāca || || purodvarttanajaṃ lepaṃ gṛhītvā nṛpa pārvatī || vinodārthaṃ cakārātha bālakaṃ sukumārakam || 3 || lepābhāvācchirohīnaṃ śeṣāṃgāvayavaṃ nṛpa || yathoktaṃ nirmayitvā taṃ skandaṃ vākyamathābravīt || 4 || lepamānaya bhadraṃ te śiro'rthaṃ skanda satvaram || yenāyaṃ putrako me syādbhrātā te paradurjayaḥ || 5 || tato gaurīsamādeśāllepālabdhau nṛpottama || mattaṃ gajavaraṃ dṛṣṭvā śirastasya samānayat || 6 || tasminniyojayāmāsa gātre lepasamudbhave || mahaddhīdaṃ śiro bhāvi putra kasmāttvayā''hṛtam || 7 || bruvaṃtyāścāpi pārvatyā mā meti ca muhurmuhuḥ || nyaste śirasi tadgātre daivayogānnarādhipa || 8 || viśeṣānnāyakatvaṃ ca gātrebhyaḥ samajāyata || bālakapratimaṃ kāntaṃ sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitam || 9 || trigaṃbhīraṃ caturhastaṃ saptaraktaṃ mahīpate || ṣaḍunnataṃ pañcadīrghaṃ paścasūkṣmaṃ susundaram|| 7.3.32.10 || trivistīrṇaṃ mahārāja dṛṣṭvā gaurī suvismitā || sajīvaṃ kārayāmāsa svaśaktyā śaktirūpiṇī || 11 || sa sajīvaḥ kṛto devyā samuttasthau ca tatkṣaṇāt || ādeśaṃ yācayāmāsa vinayānatakandharaḥ || 12 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā cādbhutākāraṃ proktvā putraṃ muhurmuhuḥ || śaṃbhoḥ sakāśamanayatprahṛṣṭenāntarātmanā || 13 || tato'bravītsutaṃ deva mamaiva gātralepajam || dehi deva varānitthaṃ mahattvaṃ yena gacchati || 14 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || śarīrasthaṃ śiro mukhyaṃ yasmātparvatanandini || mahattvidaṃ śiraḥ proktaṃ tvayā skandena yojitam|| 15 || viśeṣānnāyakatvaṃ ca gātre cāsya yataḥ sthitam|| mahāvināyako hyeṣa tasmānnāmnā bhaviṣyati || 16|| gaṇānāṃ caiva sarveṣāmādhipatyaṃ nagātmaje || asya dattaṃ mayā yasmādbhaviṣyati gaṇādhipaḥ || 17 || sarvakāryeṣu ye martyāḥ pūrvamenaṃ gaṇādhipam || smariṣyaṃti na vai teṣāṃ kāryahānirbhaviṣyati || 18 || tato'sya pradadau skandaḥ prakrīḍārthaṃ kuṭhārakam || tadeva cāyudhaṃ tasya supriyaṃ hi sadā'bhavat || 19 || tato gaurī dadau bhojyapātraṃ modakapūritam || putrasnehātsa tatprāpya lāsyamevaṃ tadā'karot || 7.3.32.20 || tasya bhakṣyasya gandhena niṣkrānto mūṣako bilāt || bhakṣaṇāccāmaro jātastasya vāhyo vyajāyata || 21 || || pulastya uvāca || || mahāvināyako hyevaṃ tatra jāto mahī pate || tasmindṛṣṭe ca yatpuṇyaṃ tattvamekamanāḥ śṛṇu || 22 || bālye vayasi yatpāpaṃ vārddhake yauvane'pi yat || karoti mānavo rājaṃstasmātpāpātpramucyate || 23 || māghamāse site pakṣe caturthyāṃ samupoṣitaḥ || yastaṃ paśyati vāggmī sa sarvajñaśca prajāyate || tasyāgre sumahatkuṇḍaṃ svacchodakapūritam || 24 || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā yaḥ paśyati vināyakam|| tasyānvaye'pi sarvajñā jāyante mānavā nṛpa ||25|| gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa kṛtvā vai triḥ pradakṣiṇam|| yastaṃ paśyati rājendra duritaṃ na sa paśyati || 26 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena taṃ prapaśyedvināyakam || ya icchetsakalānkāmāniha loke paratra ca || 27 || gṛhastho'pi ca yo bhaktyā smaretkārya upasthite || avighnaṃ tasya tatsarvaṃ saṃsiddhimupagacchati || 28 || prātarutthāya yo martyaḥ smareddevaṃ vināyakam || tasya taddinajātāni siddhiṃ kṛtyāni yāṃti hi || 29 || vivāhe kalahe yuddhe prasthāne kṛṣikarmaṇi || praveśe ca smaredyastu bhaktipūrvaṃ vināyakam || tasya tadvāṃchitaṃ sarvaṃ prasādāttasya siddhyati || 7.3.32.30 || mahāvināyakīṃ śāṃtiṃ yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ || na taṃ pretā grahā rogāḥ pīḍayaṃti vināyakāḥ ||31|| || yayātiruvāca || || mahāvaināyikīṃ śāṃtiṃ vada me munisattama || ke maṃtrāḥ kiṃ vidhānaṃ ca paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 32 || || pulastya uvāca || || śuklapakṣe śubhe vāre nakṣatre doṣavarjite || śreṣṭhacaṃdrabale śāṃtiṃ gaṇeśasya samācaret || 33 || pūrvottare same deśe kṛtvā vediṃ ca maṃḍapam || madhye cāṣṭadalaṃ padmaṃ gṛhyasūtraṃ prayojayet ||34|| indrādilokapālāṃśca dikṣu sarvāsu bhūpate || gaṇeśapūrvikāścāpi mātaraśca viśeṣataḥ || 35 || gaṃdhapuṣpopahāraiśca yathoktairbalivistaraiḥ || śvetavastrayugacchannaṃ kalaśaṃ jalapūritam || 36 || tasyaiva pūrvadigbhāge sahiraṇyaṃ phalānvitam || 37 || gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa sahasraṃ cāṣṭasaṃyutam || japettatra tathā cārūnpaṃcāṃgānnṛpasattama || 35 || vināyakaṃ samuddiśya puraḥ kuṇḍe karātmake || caturasre yoniyute mekhalābhirvibhūṣite || 39 || madhudūrvākṣataihomairgrahahomādanaṃtaram || gaṇānāṃ tveti maṃtreṇa daśasāhasrikastathā || 7.3.32.40 || kāryo vai pārthivaśreṣṭha kāryaścodaṅmukhairdvijaiḥ || caturbhiścaturai rājanpītavastrānulepanaiḥ || 41 || pītāṃbaradharaiścaiva dhṛtahemāṃgulīyakaiḥ || tato homāvasāne tu yajamānaṃ nṛpottama || 42 || mṛgacarmoparisthaṃ ca maṃtrairebhirvidhānataḥ || snāpayetprāṅmukhaṃ śāṃtaṃ śuklavastrāvaguṃṭhitam || 43 || imaṃ me gaṃge yamune paṃcanadyaḥ supuṣkare || śrīsūktasahitaṃ viṣṇoḥ pāvamānaṃ vṛṣākapim || 44 || samyaguccārya vighnānāṃ tato nāśaṃ prapadyate || grahāḥ saumyatvamāyāṃti bhūtā naśyaṃti tatkṣaṇāt ||45|| ādhayo vyādhayo raudrā duṣṭarogā jvarādayaḥ || praṇaśyaṃti drutaṃ sarve tathotpātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || 46 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || vināyakasya māhātmyaṃ mahattvaṃ śāṃtikaṃ tathā ||47|| yaśca kīrttayate samyakcaturthyāṃ susamāhitaḥ || śṛṇoti vā nṛpaśreṣṭha tasyā'vighnaṃ sadā bhavet || 48 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyanyajeccedaṃ samāhitaḥ || tattadāpnoti nūnaṃ ca gaṇanāthaprasādataḥ || 49 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vināyakamāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 || || ||
<7.3.33>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tataḥ pārtheśvaraṃ gacchedevaṃ pātakanāśanam || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā mānavaḥ samyaṅmucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 1 || pārthānāmnyabhavatsādhvī devalasya priyā satī || tayā pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ tatra sthāne mahīpate || 2 || sā pūrvamabhavadvaṃdhyā ṛṣipatnī yaśasvinī || vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatvā tataścaivārbudaṃ gatā || 3 || vāyubhakṣā nirāhārā samacittā''sane sthitā || tato varṣasahasrāṃte bhaktyā tasyā mahīpate || || 4 || udbhidya dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ sahasā liṃgamutthitam || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || 5 || pūjayaitanmahābhāge śivaliṃgaṃ supāvanam || tvadbhaktyā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhānniḥsṛtaṃ kāmadaṃ mahat || 6 || yo yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyanpūjayiṣyati mānavaḥ || anyopi tadabhipretaṃ prāpsyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 7 || pārtheśvarākhyametaddhi loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || evamuktvā tato vāṇī virarāma mahīpate ||8|| tataḥ sā vismayāviṣṭā pūjayāmāsa tattadā || tataḥ putraśataṃ prāptaṃ divyaṃ vaṃśadharaṃ tathā || 9 || tataḥ prabhṛti talliṃgaṃ vikhyātaṃ dharaṇītale || tatrāsti nirmalaṃ toyaṃ girigahvaraniḥsṛtam || 7.3.33.10 || tatra snātvā naraḥ samyagyastaṃ paśyati bhāvataḥ || na sa paśyati saṃsāre duḥkhaṃ saṃtānasaṃbhavam || 11 || śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ jāgaraṃ tasya cāgrataḥ || yaḥ karoti nirāhāraḥ sa putraṃ labhate dhuvam || 12 || piṃḍanirvāpaṇaṃ tatra yaḥ karoti samāhitaḥ || tasya putratvamāyāti pitarastatprasādataḥ || || 13 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe pārtheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśo' dhyāyaḥ || 33 || || cha ||
<7.3.34>
|| pulastya uvāca || || kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ tato gacchetkṛṣṇasya dayitaṃ sadā || yatra sannihito nityaṃ svayaṃ viṣṇurmahīpate || || || yayātiruvāca || || kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ kathaṃ tatra jātaṃ brāhmaṇasattama || kasminkāle mune brūhi sarvaṃ vistarato mama || |||| 2 || || pulastya uvāca || || tasminnekārṇave ghore naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame || caṃdrārkapavane naṣṭe jyotiṣi pralayaṃ gate || 3 || tato yugasahasrāṃte vibuddhaḥ kamalāsanaḥ || ekākī ciṃtayāmāsa kathaṃ sṛṣṭirbhavediti || 4 || bhramaṃścāpi caturvaktro yāvatpaśyati dūrataḥ || caturbhujaṃ viśālākṣaṃ puruṣaṃ purataḥ sthitam || 5 || taṃ covāca caturvaktraḥ kastvaṃ kena vinirmitaḥ || kimarthamiha saṃprāptaḥ sarvaṃ vistarato vada || 6 || tamuvācātha goviṃdaḥ prahasañchlakṣṇayā girā || 7 || ahamādyaḥ pumāneko mayā sṛṣṭo bhavānapi || sraṣṭumicchāmi bhūyo'pi bhūtagrāmaṃ caturvidham || 8|| || pulastya uvāca || || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kruddho devaḥ pitāmahaḥ || abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ bhartsayaṃśca punaḥpunaḥ || 9 || sṛṣṭastvaṃ hi mayā mūḍha prathamo'hamasaṃśayam || tvādṛśānāṃ sahasrāṇi kariṣye'hamasaṃśayam || 7.3.34.10 || evaṃ vivadamānau tau mitho rājanmahādyutī || spardhayā roṣatāmrākṣau yuyudhāte parasparam|| 11 || muṣṭibhirbāhubhiścaiva nakhairdaṃtairvikarṣaṇaiḥ || evaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tayoryuddhamavarttata || 12 || tato varṣasahasrāṃte tayormadhye nṛpottama || prādurbhūtaṃ mahāliṃgaṃ divyaṃ tejomayaṃ śubham || 13 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || yuddhādbrahmannivartasva tvaṃ ca viṣṇo mamājñayā || 14 || etanmāheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ yo'sya cāṃte gamiṣyati || sa jyeṣṭhaḥ sa vibhuḥ karttā yuvayornātra saṃśayaḥ || 15 || adhobhāgaṃ vrajatveka ekaścorddhvaṃ mamājñayā || tacchrutvā satvaro brahmā vyomamārgaṃ samāśritaḥ || 16 || vidārya vasudhāṃ kṛṣṇo'pyadhastātsatvaraṃ gataḥ || sa bhittvā saptapātālānadho yāvatprayāti ca || tāvatkālāgnirudrastu dṛṣṭastena mahātmanā || 17 || gaṃtumicchaṃstato'dhastādyāvadvegaṃ karoti saḥ || tāvattasyārcibhirdagdhaḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ samapadyata || 18 || tato mūrchābhisaṃtapto dahyamāno'dbhutāgninā || nivartya sahasā viṣṇurvailakṣyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 19 || tathā liṃgaṃ samāsādya bhaktyā pūjā kṛtā tataḥ || vedoktaiḥ paramaiḥ sūkṣmaiḥ stutiṃ cakre mahīpate || 7.3.34.20 || brahmā'pi vyomamārgeṇa gato haṃsavimānataḥ || divyaṃ varṣasahasraṃ tu tasyāṃtaṃ nābhyapadyata || 21 || tato varṣasahasrāṃte ketakīṃ so'pyapaśyata || āyāṃtīṃ vyomamārgeṇa tayā pṛṣṭaścaturmukhaḥ || 22 || kva tvayā gamyate brahmannirālaṃbe mahāpathi || śūnye tattvaṃ samācakṣva paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 23 || || brahmovāca || || mama spardhā samutpannā viṣṇunā saha śobhane || liṃgasyāsya hi paryaṃtaṃ yo labhiṣyati cāvayoḥ || 24 || sa jyāyānitaro hīno hyetaduktaṃ pinākinā || prasthito'haṃ tataścorddhvamadhomārgaṃ gato hariḥ || 25 || labdhvā liṃgasya paryaṃtaṃ yāsyāmi kṣitimaṃḍale || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tatpuṣpamabhyabhāṣata || 26 || vyarthaśramo'si lokeśa nāṃto liṃgasya vidyate || caturyugasahasrāṇāṃ koṭirekā pitāmaha || 27 || liṃgamūrdhnaḥ pataṃtyā me kālo jāto mahādyute || tathāpi kṣiti pṛṣṭhaṃ tu na prāptāsmi kathaṃcana || 28 || yāvatkālena haṃsaste yojanaṃ saṃpragacchati || tāvatkālena gacchāmi yojanānāmahaṃ śatam || 29 || tasmānnivartanaṃ yuktaṃ mama vākyena te vibho || darśayitvā ca māṃ viṣṇorjyeṣṭhatvaṃ vraja sāṃpratam || 7.3.34.30 || tato hṛṣṭamanā bhūtvā gṛhītvā tāṃ caturmukhaḥ || punarvarṣasahasrāṃte bhūmipṛṣṭhamupāgataḥ || darśayāmāsa tāṃ viṣṇoreṣā liṃgasya mūrdhataḥ || 31 || mayā''nītā śubhā mālā labdhaścāṃtaṃ caturbhuja || tvayā labdho na cāsatyaṃ vada me puruṣottama || 32 || || viṣṇuruvāca || || anaṃtasyāprameyasya devadevasya śūlinaḥ || nāhaṃ śaktaḥ paraṃ pāraṃ gaṃtuṃ brahmankathaṃcana || 33 || yadi tvayā'sya paryaṃto labdho brahmankathaṃcana || tatte tuṣṭiṃ gato nūnaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 34 || nānyathā cāsya paryaṃto dṛśyate kena citkvacit || tasmājjyeṣṭho bhavāñchreṣṭhaḥ kaniṣṭho'hamasaṃśayam || 35 || || pulastya uvāca || || etasminneva kāle tu bhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || kopaṃ cakre mahārāja brahmāṇaṃ prati tatkṣaṇāt || 36 || athāha darśanaṃ gatvā dhigdhigvyarthaprajalpaka || mithyā prajalpamānena kimidaṃ sāhasaṃ kṛtam || || 37 || yasmāttvayā mṛṣā proktaṃ mama paryaṃtadarśanam || tasmāttvaṃ sarvavarṇānāṃ pūjārho na bhaviṣyasi || 38 || ye ca tvāṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti mānavā moha saṃyutāḥ || te kṛcchraṃ paramaṃ prāpya nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti kṛtsnaśaḥ || 39 || ketakyā ca tathā proktaṃ yasmāttasmātsuduṣṭayā || asyā hi sparśanāllokaḥ śvapākatvaṃ prayāsyati || 7.3.34.40 || evaṃ śāpo tayordattvā devaḥ provāca keśavam || prasannavadano bhūtvā tadā tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 41 || || bhagavānuvāca || || vāsudeva mahābāho tuṣṭaste'haṃ mahāmate|| satyasaṃbhāṣaṇādeva varaṃ varaya suvrata ||42|| || śrīvāsudeva uvāca|| || eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yattvaṃ tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || na cāpuṇyavatāṃ deva tvaṃ tuṣṭimadhigacchasi || avaśyaṃ yadi me deyo varo deveśvara tvayā ||43|| liṃgametadanaṃtākhyaṃ laghutāṃ naya mā ciram|| yena sṛṣṭirbhavelloke vyāptaṃ viśvamanena tu || 44 || || pulastya uvāca || || tataḥ saṃkṣipya talliṃgaṃ laghu kṛtvā maheśvaraḥ || abravītkeśavaṃ bhūyaḥ śṛṇu vākyamidaṃ hare || 45 || etanmedhyatame deśe liṃgaṃ sthāpaya me hare || pūjaya tvaṃ vidhānena paraṃ śreyaḥ prapatsyase || 46 || mama tejovinirdagdhaḥ kṛṣṇatvaṃ hi yato gataḥ || kṛṣṇa eva tato nāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyati || 47 || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti te nāma prātarutthāya mānavaḥ || kīrtayiṣyati yo bhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim ||48|| || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā tamīśānastatraivāṃtaradhīyata || vāsudevo'pi talliṃgaṃ gṛhītvā'rbudaparvate || nirjhare sthāpayāmāsa supuṇye vimalodake || 49 || kṛṣṇatīrthaṃ tato jātaṃ nāmnā hi dharaṇītale || śṛṇu pārthivaśārdūla tatra snātasya yatphalam || 7.3.34.50 || snātvā kṛṣṇahrade puṇye talliṃgaṃ paśyate tu yaḥ || sarvatīrthodbhavaṃ śreyaḥ sa marttyo labhate'khilam || 51 || tathā ca sarvadānānāṃ niṣkāmaḥ prāpnuyātphalam || sakāmo'pi phalaṃ ceṣṭaṃ yadyapi syātsudurllabham || 52 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || ya icchecchāśvataṃ śreyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 53 || ekādaśyāṃ mahārāja nirāhāro jitendriyaḥ || yastatra jāgaraṃ kṛtvā liṃgasyāgre subhaktitaḥ || 54 || prabhāte kurute śrāddhaṃ yastu śraddhāsamanvitaḥ || pitṛnsaṃtārayetsarvānpūrvajaiḥ saha dharmavit || 55 || tilānkṛṣṇānnarastatra brāhmaṇebhyo dadāti yaḥ || brahmahatyādibhiḥ pāpaiḥ sa marttyo mucyate dhruvam || || 56 || darśanādeva rājendra kṛṣṇatīrthasya mānavaḥ || mucyate sarvapāpebhyo nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 57 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisā hasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe kṛṣṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 ||
<7.3.35>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha tīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || māmuhradamiti khyātaṃ tasminparvatarodhasi || 1 || tatra snāto naraḥ samyakchraddhāvānsusamāhitaḥ || mucyate pātakairghoraiḥ pūrvajanmakṛtairapi || 2 || tasya paścimadigbhāge liṃgamasti mahīpate || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇāṃ sthāpitaṃ mudgalena tu || 3 || snātvā māmuhrade puṇye yastalliṃgaṃ ca paśyati || śuklapakṣe caturddaśyāṃ phālgune māsi mānavaḥ || sa prāpnoti paraṃ śreyaḥ sarvatīrtheṣu durlabham || 4 || yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ dakṣiṇāṃ mūrtimāśritaḥ || pitarastasya tṛpyaṃti yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam|| 5 || tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti nīvārāṇāṃ maharṣayaḥ || śākamūlādibhiḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tuṣṭidaṃ nṛpa || 6 || || yayātiruvāca || || māmuhradamiti vibho kathaṃ nāmā'bhavatpurā || mudgalasyāśramaṃ brūhi mama sarvaṃ vidhānataḥ || 7 || || || pulastya uvāca || || tatrasthasya purā rājanmudgalasya mahātmanaḥ || vimānaṃ varamādāya devadūtaḥ samāgataḥ || 8 || so'bravīddevarājñāhaṃ preṣito munisattama || tavārthāyā''ruhainaṃ tvaṃ vimānaṃ gamyatāṃ divi|| 9 || || mudgala uvāca || || svargasya ye guṇā dūta ye ca doṣā prakīrtitāḥ ||| tānme vada kariṣye'haṃ śrutvā vai yatkṣamaṃ bhavet|| 7.3.35.10 || brūhi tānsakalāndūta tvāgamiṣyāmyahaṃ tataḥ || 11 || || devadūta uvāca|| || alametena darpeṇa kriyatāṃ śakrajalpitam|| puṇyaiḥ svakairdvijaśreṣṭha samāgaccheridaṃ tataḥ || 12 || || mudgala uvāca || || aśrutaistairna gacche'hametanme hṛdi niścitam || kariṣye'haṃ tapo bhūri pūjayiṣye maheśvaram || 13 || || dūta uvāca || || na śaktaḥ svarguṇānvaktumapi varṣaśatairapi || saṃkṣepātkathayiṣyāmi yadi te niścayaḥ paraḥ || 14 || naṃdanādīni ramyāṇi tatra devavanāni ca || ananyasadṛśā bhogāḥ sadā tṛptirdvijottama ||45||| bubhukṣā naiva tṛṣṇā ca nidrālasye na ca prabho || raṃbhādyapsaraso mukhyā gaṃdharvāstuṃbarādayaḥ || ramayaṃti naraṃ tatra gītairnṛtyairanekaśaḥ || 16 || evaṃ ca vasate tatra janaḥ svarge tapodhana || yāvatpuṇyakṣayastāvatpaścātpātamavāpnuyāt ||17|| eka eva mune doṣaḥ svarloke pratibhāti me || sa eva patanākhyastu svargiṇāṃ ca bhayāvahaḥ || 18 || na puṇyaṃ labhate tatra kartuṃ vipra kathaṃcana || karmabhūmiriyaṃ brahmanbhogabhūmistu sā smṛtā || 19 || yadatra kriyate karma śubhaṃ tatropa bhujyate || tathā dṛṣṭvā vimānasthānbhūridharmādisaṃyutān||7.3.35.20|| bahutejonvitānsvarge hyalpapuṇyo dvijottama || paścāttāpajaduḥkhena svargastho duḥkhitaḥ sadā || 21 || na mayā sukṛtaṃ bhūri kṛtaṃ marttye kathaṃcana || 22 || tathā ca patamānāṃśca dṛṣṭvā cānyānsahasraśaḥ || ātmanaśca mahadduḥkhaṃ jāyate ca tadadbhutam|| 23 || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ guṇadoṣasamudbhavam || svargasaṃceṣṭitaṃ brahmankuruṣva yadabhīpsitam || 24 || || mudgala uvāca || || patanasya bhayaṃ yatra puṇyahānirna varddhanam|| tena svargeṇa me dūta naiva kāryaṃ kathaṃcana|| 25|| vācyastvayā mamādeśāddevarājaḥ sphuṭaṃ vacaḥ|| kṣamyatāmaparādho me na svargāya spṛhā mama|| 26|| tatkarmā'haṃ kariṣyāmi yena no patanādbhayam|. sādhayiṣyāmi tām̐llokānye sadā pātavarjitāḥ|| 27|| || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā nṛpaśreṣṭha mudgalaḥ svarganiḥspṛhaḥ || sthitastatraiva nirataḥ śivadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || 28 || śrutvā dūto'pi śakrasya tasya vākyaṃ savistaram|| kathayāmāsa śakrasya taṃ bhūyaḥ so'bhyabhāṣata || 29 || devadūtāpramāṇaṃ ca vimānaṃ hi tvayā kṛtam || na kṛtaṃ kena citpūrvaṃ na kariṣyati kaścana || 7.3.35.30 || tasmāttatra drutaṃ gatvā balādānaya taṃ munim || ānayasvānyathā śāpaṃ tava dāsyāmyasaṃśayam || 31 | || || pulastya uvāca || || śakrasya vacanaṃ śrutvā devadūte bhayānvitaḥ || prasthitaḥ satvaraṃ tatra mudgalo yatra tiṣṭhati || 32 || mudgalo'pi vimānasthaṃ punardṛṣṭvā samāgatam || māmuhrade praviśyātha vārayāmāsa taṃ tadā || 33 || sa tasya vacanenaiva staṃbhito likhito yathā || calituṃ naiva śaknoti prabhāvāttasya sanmuneḥ || 34 || cirakālagataṃ jñātvā dūtaṃ tu tridaśādhipaḥ || svayaṃ tatrāyayau kopādāruhyairāvaṇaṃ gajam || 35 ||| atha dṛṣṭvā tadā dūtaṃ staṃbhitaṃ mudgalena tu || vadhārthaṃ tūdyatastasya sa vajraṃ bhrāmayaṃstadā || 36 || etasminneva kāle tu utpātāstatra dāruṇāḥ || apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakruḥ paśavaḥ pakṣiṇaśca ye || tāndṛṣṭvā cintayāmāsa mudgalo vismayānvitaḥ || 37 || atha dṛṣṭvāṃbaragataṃ vajrodyatakaraṃ harim || staṃbhayāmāsa taṃ sadyo dṛṣṭipātena mudgalaḥ || 38 || tatra śakraḥ stutiṃ cakre bhagnotsāho nṛpottama || muñca māṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha yāsyāmi tridaśālayam || 39 || svarge vā yadi vā marttye tiṣṭha tvaṃ svecchayā dvija || mayā kṛtaḥ samudyogo hitārthaṃ te mune hyayam || 7.3.35.40 || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te nityaṃ yo manasi sthitaḥ || taṃ te sarvaṃ pradāsyāmi yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 41 || || mudgala uvāca || || eṣa eva varaḥ ślāghyo yattvaṃ dṛṣṭaḥ sureśvara || darśanaṃ te sahasrākṣa svapneṣvapi sudurlabham || 42 || avaśyaṃ yadi me deyo varo vṛtraniṣūdana || tvatprasādena me mokṣo jāyatāṃ śīghrameva hi || 43 || mā mu hradaṃ samāgatya dūtaḥ prokto mayā yataḥ || tato māmuhradamiti khyātiṃ yātu dharātale || 44 || tīrthametatsahasrākṣa sarva pāpapraṇāśanam || atra snātvā divaṃ yāṃtu tvatprasādātsureśvara || 45 || piṇḍadānātparāṃ prītiṃ labhaṃtāṃ pitaro'tra hi || 46 || || indra uvāca || || māmuhradamiti khyātaṃ tīrthametadbhaviṣyati || variṣṭhaṃ nātra sandeho matprasādādvijottama || 47 || atra ye phālgune māsi paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitāḥ || kariṣyaṃti punaḥ snānaṃ te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || 48 || piṇḍadānādgayātulyaṃ lapsyaṃte phalamuttamam || puṇyadānaphalaṃ cātra saṃkhyāhīnaṃ dvijottama || 49 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā yayau svargaṃ dūtamādāya vajrabhṛt || mudgalo'pi paraṃ brahma ciṃtayanhyaniśaṃ tataḥ || 7.3.35.50 || śukladhyānaparo bhūtvā mokṣaṃ prāptastato'kṣayam || 51 || atra gāthā purā gītā nāradena mahātmanā || bahuviprasamavāye parvatesminmahīpate || 52 || māmu hrade naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā taṃ mudgaleśvaram || iha bhuktvā'khilānkāmānante muktimavāpsyati || etasmātkāraṇādrājanmāmuhradamiti smṛtam || 53 || tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pravaraṃ lokaviśrutam || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || 54 || mokṣakāmo viśeṣeṇa ya icchetparamaṃ padam || caṇḍikāśramamāsādya kiṃ punaḥ paritapyate || 55 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe prathame'rbudakhaṇḍe māmuhradotpattivarṇanaṃnāma pañcatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || || cha ||
<7.3.36>
|| yayātiruvāca || || caṃḍikāyā dvijaśreṣṭha kathaṃ tatrāśramo'bhavat || kasminkāle phalaṃ tena kiṃ dṛṣṭena bhavennṛṇām || 1 || || pulastya uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā mānavaḥ samyaksarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 2 || purā devayuge rājanmahiṣonāma dānavaḥ || pitāmahavarāddṛptaḥ sarvadevabhayaṃkaraḥ || 3 || tena śakrādayo devā jitāḥ saṃkhye sahasraśaḥ || bhayāttasya divaṃ hitvā gatāste vai yathādiśam || 4 || trailokyaṃ sa vaśe kṛtvā svayamindro babhūva ha || 5 || ādityā vasavo rudrā nāsatyau marutāṃ gaṇāḥ || kṛtāstena tathā daityā yathārhaṃ balavattarāḥ || 6 || vahnirbhayaṃ samāpannastyaktvā devagaṇāṃstadā || dānavebhyo havirbhāgaṃ devebhyo na prayacchati || 7 || uddyotaṃ kurute sūryo yādṛktasyābhisaṃmataḥ || yajñabhāgaṃ vinā'pyeṣa bhayātpārthivasattama || 8 || lokapālāstathā sarve tasya karma pracakrire || dāsavatpārthivaśreṣṭha yajñabhāgaṃ vinākṛtāḥ || || 9 || kasyacittvatha kālasya sarve devāḥ sametya tu || papracchurvinayopetā vipraśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim || 7.3.36.10 || bhagavānkiṃ vayaṃ kurmaḥ kutra yāmo nirāśrayāḥ || tasmādbrūhi kṣayopāyaṃ mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ || 11 || evamukto gururddevairdhyātvā kālaṃ ciraṃ nṛpa || tatastāṃstridaśānprāha jīvayanniva bhūpateḥ || 12 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || brahmalabdhavaro daityaḥ pauruṣe ca vyavasthitaḥ || avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāṃ muktvekāṃ yoṣitaṃ surāḥ || vrajadhvaṃ sahitāstasmādarbudaṃ parvatottamam || 13 || tapo'rthaṃ tatra saṃsiddhirjāyatāmacirāddhi vaḥ || śaktirūpāṃ parāṃ devīṃ caṃḍikāṃ kāmarūpiṇīm||14|| ārādhayadhvamekāṃte yayā vyāptamidaṃ jagat || sā tuṣṭā vai vadhārthaṃ tu mahiṣasya durātmanaḥ || 15 || kariṣyati samudyogamavatārasamudbhavam || tasyā hastena so'vaśyaṃ vadhaṃ prāpsyati durmatiḥ || 16 || ahaṃ vaḥ kīrtayiṣyāmi śaktiyaṃ maṃtramuttamam || pūjāvidhānasaṃyuktaṃ bhuktimuktipradaṃ śubham || 17 ||| || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktāḥ surāḥ sarve harṣeṇa mahatānvitāḥ || tenaiva sahitā rājangatāḥ parvatamarbudam || 18 || tatra snātāñchucīnsarvāndīkṣayāmāsa gīṣpatiḥ || śaktiyaiḥ paramairmaṃtraiḥ sadyaḥsiddhikarairnṛpa || 19 || sārdhayāmatrayaṃ tatra parivārasamanvitāḥ || balipūjopahāraiśca gaṃdhaṃ mālyānulepanaiḥ || 7.3.36.20 || maṃtreṇa vividhenaiva cārustotreṇa bhaktitaḥ || prārthayaṃtastathā nityaṃ dīpajyotiḥ samāhitāḥ || 21 || nirmamā nirahaṃkārā gurubhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || aṃganyāsasamāyuktāḥ samadarśitvamāgatāḥ ||22|| evaṃ saṃtiṣṭhamānānāṃ teṣāṃ pārthivasattama || sapta māsā vyatikrāṃtāstatastuṣṭā sureśvarī || 23 || dīpajyotiḥsamāveśātteṣāṃ gātreṣu pārthiva || maṃtreṇa paripūtānāṃ paraṃ tejo vyavardhata || 24 || dvādaśārkaprabhā jātāḥ ṣaṇmāsābhyaṃtareṇa te || atha tāṃstejasā yuktāñjñātvā jīvo mahīpate || 25 || maṃḍalaṃ racayāmāsa sarvasiddhipradāyakam || upaveśya tataḥ sarvānsamastāṃstridaśālayān || 26 || teṣāṃ śarīragaṃ tejaḥ śaktiyairmaṃtrasattamaiḥ || ākṛṣya nyasayāmāsa maṃḍale tatra pārthiva || 27 || tatastejomayī kanyā tatra jātā svarūpiṇī || śaktirūpā mahākāyā divyalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 28 || iṃdrastasyai dadau vajraṃ svapāśaṃ ca jaleśvaraḥ || śaktiṃ ca bhagavānagniḥ siṃhayānaṃ dhanādhipaḥ || 29 || anye caiva gaṇāḥ sarve nijaśastrāṇi harṣitāḥ || tasyai dadurnṛpaśreṣṭha stutiṃ cakruḥ samāhitāḥ || 7.3.36.30 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaste devadeveśi namaste kāṃcanaprabhe || namaste padmapatrākṣi namaste jagadambike || 31 || namaste viśvarūpe ca namaste viśvasaṃstute || tvaṃ matistvaṃ dhṛtiḥ kāṃtistvaṃ sudhā tvaṃ vibhāvarī || 32 || kṣamā ṛddhiḥ prabhā svāhā sāvitrī kamalā satī || tvaṃ gaurī tvaṃ mahāmāyā cāmuṇḍā tvaṃ sarasvatī || 33 || bhairavī bhīṣaṇākārā caṃḍamuṃḍāsidhāriṇī || bhūtapriyā mahākāyā ghaṭālī vikramotkaṭā || 34 || madyamāṃsapriyā nityaṃ bhaktatrāṇaparāyaṇā || tvayā vyāptamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 35 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ stutā suraiḥ sarvaistato devī praharṣitā || tānabravīdvaraṃ sarvā gṛhṇaṃtu mama devatāḥ || 36 || || devā ūcuḥ || || dānavo mahiṣo nāma pitāmahavarānvitaḥ || avadhyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ devānāṃ ca tathā kṛtaḥ || 37 || muktvaikāṃ yoṣitaṃ devi tasmāttvaṃ vinipātaya || 38 || || devyuvāca || || gacchadhvaṃ tridaśāḥ sarve svāni sthānāni nirvṛtāḥ || 39 || ahaṃ taṃ sūdayiṣyāmi samaye paryupasthite || evamuktā gatāḥ sarve devāḥ sthānāni harṣitāḥ || 7.3.36.40 || devī tatraiva saṃhṛṣṭā sthitā parvatarodhasi || kasyacittvathakālasya nārado bhagavānmuniḥ || 41 || tatra devīṃ ca saṃdṛṣṭvā tīrthayātrāparāyaṇaḥ || triviṣṭapamanuprāpto mahiṣo yatra tiṣṭhati || 42 || tatra dṛṣṭvā muniṃ prāptaṃ praṇamya mahiṣāsuraḥ || vinayena samāyukto hyabhyutthānamathākarot ||43|| tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa madhuparkārghaviṣṭaraiḥ || sukhāsīnaṃ suviśrāṃtaṃ jñātvā vākyamuvāca ha || 44 || kuto bhavānitaḥ prāptaḥ kimarthaṃ munisattama || amī putrāstathā rājyaṃ kalatrāṇi dhanāni ca || 45 || ahaṃ bhṛtyasamāyuktaḥ kimanena dvijottama || sarvaṃ te'haṃ pradāsyāmi brūhi yena prayojanam|| 46 || || nārada uvāca || || abhinaṃdāmi te sarvametattvayyupapadyate | niḥspṛhā hi vayaṃ nityaṃ munidharmaṃ samāśritāḥ || 47 || kautūhalādiha prāptaścirātte darśanaṃ gataḥ || marttyalokātsamāyāto yāsyāmi brahmaṇaḥ padam || 48 || || mahiṣāsura uvāca || || kvaciddṛṣṭaṃ tvayā kiñcidāścaryaṃ bhūtale mune || daivaṃ vā mānuṣaṃ vāpi dānavā laṃbhitā vibho || 49 || || nārada uvāca || || atyāścaryaṃ mayā dṛṣṭaṃ dānavendra dharātale || yatra dṛṣṭaṃ kvacitpūrvaṃ trailokye sacarācare || 7.3.36.50 || astyarbuda iti khyātaḥ parvato dharaṇītale || 4|| sarvartupuṣpitairvṛkṣaiḥ śobhitaḥ svargasannibhaḥ || 51 || bakulaiścaṃpakaiścāmrairaśokaiḥ karṇikārakaiḥ || śālaistālaiśca kharjūrairvaṭairbhallātakairdhavaiḥ || 52 || saralaiḥ panasairvṛkṣaistiṃdukaiḥ karavīrakaiḥ || maṃdāraiḥ pārijātaiśca malayaiścaṃdanaistathā || 53 || puṣpajātiviśeṣaiśca sugaṃdhairapyanekakaiḥ || khādyaiḥ sarvestathā lehyaiścoṣyaiḥ phalavarairvṛtaḥ || 54 || na sa vṛkṣo na sā vallī nauṣadhī sā dharātale || na tatra yā'surajyeṣṭha parvate vīkṣitā mayā || 55 || pakṣiṇo madhurārāvāścakoraśikhicātakāḥ || kokilā dhārtarāṣṭrāśca bhramarāḥ śvetapatrakāḥ || 56 || yeṣāṃ śabdaṃ samākarṇya munayo'pi samāhitāḥ || kṣobhaṃ yāṃti trikālajñāḥ kaṃdarpaśarapīḍitāḥ || 57 || nirjharāṇi suramyāṇi nadyaśca vimalodakāḥ || padminīkhaṃḍasaṃyuktā hradāḥ śatasahasraśaḥ || 58 || padmapatraviśālākṣā madhyakṣāmāḥ śucismitāḥ || vivekino narāstatra śāstravratasamanvitāḥ || 59 || kiṃ cātra bahunoktena yatkiṃcittatra parvate || svedajāṃḍajasaṃjñeyā udbhijjāśca jarāyujāḥ || sarvalokottarāstatra dṛśyaṃte parvatottame || 7.3.36.60 || daśayojanavistāro dvābhyāṃ saṃhitaparvataḥ || uccaiḥ paṃca ca sa śrīmānmartye svargo vyajāyata || 61 || tatrā'haṃ kautukāviṣṭa itaścetaśca vīkṣayan || sarvāścaryamayīṃ nārīmapaśyaṃ lokasuṃdarīm || 62 || na devī nāpi gaṃdharvī nāsurī na ca mānuṣī || tādṛgrūpā mayā dṛṣṭā na śrutā ca varāṃganā || 63 || ratiḥ prītirumā lakṣmīḥ sāvitrī ca sarasvatī || tasyā rūpasya leśena naitāstulyāḥ striyo'khilāḥ || 64 || ahaṃ dṛṣṭvā tathā rūpāṃ nārīṃ kāmena pīḍitaḥ || tadā dānavaśārdūla vaiklavyaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 65 || tato dhairyamavaṣṭabhya mayā manasi ciṃtitam || na kariṣye samālāpaṃ tayā saha ca karhicit || 66 || yasyā darśanamātreṇa kāmo me hṛdi varddhitaḥ || tasyāḥ saṃbhāṣaṇeneva kiṃ bhaviṣyati me punaḥ || 67 || cirakālaṃ tapastaptaṃ brahmacaryeṇa vai mayā || nāśaṃ yāsyati tatsarvaṃ viṣayairnirjitasya ca || tasmādgacchāmi cānyatra yāvanna vikṛtirbhavet || 68 || nārīnāma tapovighnaṃ pūrvaṃ sṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃbhuvā || argalā svargamārgasya sopānaṃ narakasya ca || 69 || tāvaddhairyaṃ tapaḥ satyaṃ tāvatsthairyaṃ kulatrapā || yāvatpaśyati no nārīmaikāṃte ca viśeṣataḥ || 7.3.36.70 || etatsaṃciṃtya bahudhā nimīlya nayane tataḥ || aprajalpya varārohāṃ tāmahaṃ cātra saṃsthitaḥ || 71 || || pulastya uvāca || || nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā mahiṣaḥ kāmapīḍitaḥ || śravaṇādapi rājeṃdra punaḥ papraccha taṃ munim || 72 || || mahiṣāsura uvāca || || kā'sau brāhmaṇaśārdūla tādṛgrūpā varāṃganā || yasyāḥ saṃdarśanādeva bhavāneva smarānvitaḥ || 73 || devī vā mānuṣī vāpi yakṣiṇī pannagī mune || kumārī vā sakāṃtā vā brūhi sarvaṃ savistaram || 74 || || nārada uvāca || || na sā pṛṣṭā mayā kiṃcinna jānāmi tadanvayam || etanme varttate vitte sā kumārī yaśasvinī || 76 || akṣamālādharā bālā kamaṃḍalusamanvitā || tapastepe girau tatra hetunā kenacicchubhā || 76 || so'haṃ yāsyāmi daityeśa brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || notsahe tatkathāṃ kartuṃ kāmabāṇabhayāturaḥ || || 77 || evamuktvā tato rājanbrahmalokaṃ gato muniḥ || mahiṣo'pi smarāviṣṭaścaraṃ tasyāḥ samādiśat || 78 || gatvā bhavāndrutaṃ tatra dṛṣṭvā tāṃ ca varāṃganām|| kimarthaṃ sā tapastepe ko vai tasyāḥ parigrahaḥ || 79 || athā'sau mahiṣādeśāddūto gatvārbudācalam || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ padmagarbhābhāṃ jñātvā sarva viceṣṭitam || 7.3.36.80 || tasmai nivedayāmāsa mahiṣāya savismayaḥ || dṛṣṭā daityavara strī ca sarvalakṣaṇalakṣitā || 81 || devatejobhavā kanyā sā'dyāpi varavarṇinī || tvadvadhārthaṃ tapastepe kaumāravratamāśritā || 82 || evaṃ tatra bhavaṃtī sma pṛṣṭāḥ sarve tapasvinaḥ || satyametanmahābhāga kuruṣva yadanaṃtaram || 83 || tasyā rūpaṃ vayaḥ kāṃtirvarṇituṃ naiva śakyate || nālāpaṃ kurute bālā sā kenāpi samaṃ vibhau || 84 || || pulastya uvāca || || tacchrutvā mahiṣo vākyaṃ bhūyaḥ kāmanipīḍitaḥ || dūtaṃ saṃpreṣayāmāsa dānavaṃ ca vicakṣaṇam ||85 || vicakṣaṇa drutaṃ gatvā madarthe tāṃ tapasvinīm || sāmabhedapradānena daṃḍenāpi samānaya || 86 || athā'sau prayayau śīghraṃ praṇipatya vicakṣaṇaḥ || arbude parvataśreṣṭhe yatra sā parameśvarī || praṇamya vinayopeto vākyametaduvāca tām||87|| mahiṣo nāma vikhyātastrailokyādhipatirbalī|| danuvaṃśasamudbhūtaḥ kāmarūpasamanvitaḥ||88|| sa tvāṃ vāṃchati kalyāṇi dharmapatnīṃ svadharmataḥ || tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te sarvakāmapradaṃ patim || 89 || yadi syāttava kāṃto'sau tvaṃ ca tasya tathā priyā|| tatkṛtārthaṃ dvayoreva yauvanaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.3.36.90 || evamuktā tatastena devī vacanamabravīt || kiñcitkopasamāyuktā muhuḥ prasphuritādharā || 91 || || devyuvāca || ||| avadhyaḥ sarvathā dūtaḥ sarvatra parikīrtitaḥ || avasthāsu tato na tvaṃ sahasā bhasmasātkṛtaḥ ||92|| gatvā brūhi durācāraṃ mahiṣaṃ dānavādhamam || nāhaṃ śakyā tvayā pāpa labdhuṃ nānyena kenacit || 93 || vadhārthaṃ te samudyoga eṣa sarvo mayā kṛtaḥ || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā mahiṣaṃ sa punaryayau || 94 || bhayena mahatāviṣṭastasyā rūpeṇa vismitaḥ || sarvaṃ nivedayāmāsa mahiṣāya viceṣṭitam || tasyāścaiva tathā''lāpānaspṛhatvaṃ ca kṛtsnaśaḥ || 95 || tacchutvā mahiṣo rājankāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ || senāpatiṃ samāhūya vākyametaduvāca ha ||96|| arbude parvate senāṃ kalpayasva sudurdharām || hastyaśvakalpitāṃ bhīmāṃ rathapattisamākulām || 97 || tato'sau kalpayāmāsa caturaṃgāṃ varūthinīm || patākācchatraśabalāṃ vāditrārāvabhūṣitām || 98 || tato dvipāśca saṃnaddhā dṛśyaṃte'dhiṣṭhitā bhaṭaiḥ || itaścetaśca dhāvantaḥ sapakṣāḥ parvatā iva || 99 || aśvāścaivāpyakalmāṣā vāyuvegāḥ suvarcasaḥ || aṃgatrāṇasamāyuktāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ || 7.3.36.100 || vimānapratimākārā rathāstena prakalpitāḥ || kiṃkiṇījālasadghaṃṭāpatākābhiralaṃkṛtāḥ || 101 || pattayaśca mahākāyā maheṣvāsā mahābalāḥ || asicarmadharāścānye prāsapaṭṭiśapāṇayaḥ || 102 || lakṣamekaṃ mataṃgānāṃ rathānāṃ triguṇaṃ tataḥ || aśvā daśaguṇā rājannasaṃkhyātāḥ padātayaḥ || 103 || tataścārbudamāsādya veṣṭayitvā sa dūrataḥ || saṃmitaiḥ sacivaiḥ sārdhaṃ tadaṃtikamupādravat || 104 || dhyānasthāṃ vīkṣya tāṃ devīṃ kandarpaśarapīḍitaḥ || tato'bravītsa tāṃ vākyaṃ vinayena samanvitaḥ || 105 || śrutvā tavedṛśaṃ rūpamahaṃ prāpto varānane || gāṃdharveṇa vivāhena tasmādvaraya māṃ drutam || 106 || ṣaṣṭibhāryāsahasrāṇi mama saṃti śucismite || kṛtvā māṃ darpitaṃ kāṃtaṃ tāsāṃ tvaṃ svāminī bhava || || 107 || anarhaṃ te tapo bāle bhuṃkṣva bhogānyathepsitān || trailokyasvāminī bhūtvā mayā sārdhamaharniśam ||108|| evamuktā'pi sā tena nottaraṃ pratyabhāṣata || tataḥ kāmasamāviṣṭastadaṃtikamupāyayau ||109|| tatastaṃ lolupaṃ dṛṣṭvā sā devī kopasaṃyutā || asmaradvāhanaṃ siṃhaṃ samāyātaḥ sa sā''ruhat || 7.3.36.110 || abravītparuṣaṃ vākyaṃ gacchagaccheti cāsakṛt || no cettvāṃ ca vadhiṣyāmi sthāne'smindānavādhama || 111 || athā'sau sacivaiḥ sārddhaṃ samaṃtātparyaveṣṭayat || pragrahārthaṃ tu tāṃ devīṃ kāmabāṇaprapīḍitaḥ || 112 || tato jahāsa sā devī saśabdaṃ parameśvarī || tasmādaharniśaṃ sārddhaṃ niṣkrāṃtā puruṣā ghanāḥ || 113 || susannaddhāḥ saśastrāśca roṣeṇa mahatā'nvitāḥ || tatastānabravīddevī pāpo'yaṃ vadhyatāmiti || 114 || tataste sahitāḥ sarve mahiṣaṃ samupādravan|| tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti jalpanto muṃcanto'straṇi bhūriśaḥ || 115 || tataḥ samabhavadyuddhaṃ gaṇānāṃ dānavaiḥ saha || tataste sacivāḥ sarve vaivasvatagṛhaṃ gatāḥ || 116 || athā'sau mahiṣo ruṣṭaḥ sacivairviṃnipātitaiḥ || svasainyamānayāmāsa tasminparvatarodhasi || 117 || rathapravaramāruhya sārathiṃ samabhāṣata || naya māṃ sārathe tūrṇaṃ yatra sā''ste vyavasthitā || 118 || hatvaināmadya yāsyāmi pāraṃ roṣasya dustaram || evamuktastato rājanprerayāmāsa sārathiḥ || 119 || rathaṃ tenaiva mārgeṇa yatra sā tiṣṭhate dhruvam || etasminneva kāle tu tatrotpātāḥ sudāruṇāḥ || 7.3.36.120 || bahavastena mārgeṇa yenāsau prasthito nṛpa || sammukhaḥ pravavau vāto rūkṣaḥ karkarasaṃyutaḥ || 121 || papāta mahatī colkā nihatya ravimaṃḍalam || apasavyaṃ mṛgāścakrustasya mārge nṛpottama || 122 || upaviṣṭāstathā vāṃtā bahumūtraṃ prasusruvuḥ || rathadhvaje samāviṣṭo gṛdhraḥ śabdamathākarot || 123 || sa tānsarvānanādṛtya mahotpātānsudāruṇān || prayayau sammukhastasyā devyāḥ kopaparāyaṇaḥ || 124 || vimuṃcaṃśca śarānnādāṃstiṣṭhatiṣṭheti ca bruvan || na kaściddṛśyate tatra teṣāṃ madhye nṛpottama || 125 || mahiṣaṃ roṣasaṃyuktaṃ yo vārayati saṃgare || tena hatvā gaṇagaṇānkṛtaṃ rudhirakardamam ||| || 126 || tato devī samāsādya proktā garveṇa pārthiva || na tvayā saṃgaro bhīru nūnaṃ kartuṃ mamocitaḥ || 127 || na ca bāliśi me vīryaṃ na saubhāgyaṃ na vā dhanam || na karoṣi hi tena tvaṃ mama vākyaṃ kathañcana || 128 || nūnaṃ tattvena jānāmi avaliptāsi bhāmini|| kuruṣvādyāpi me vākyaṃ bhāryā bhava mama priyā || 129 || striyaṃ tvāṃ notsahe haṃtuṃ pauruṣe ca vyavasthitaḥ || asakṛnnirjitaḥ saṃkhye mayā śakraḥ suraiḥ saha || 7.3.36.130 || trailokye nāsti mattulyaḥ pumānkaścicca bāliśi|| evamuktā tato devī kopena mahatā'nvitā || 131 || pragṛhya saśaraṃ cāpaṃ vākyametaduvāca ha || nālāpo yujyate pāpa kartuṃ saha mama tvayā || 132 || kumāryāḥ kāmayuktena tathāpi śṛṇu me vacaḥ || na tvayā nirjitaḥ śakraḥ svavīryeṇa raṇājire || 133 || pitāmaha varaṃ devā manyaṃte dānavādhama || gauravāttasya tena tvamātmānaṃ manyase'dhikam || 134 || muktvaikāṃ kāminīṃ pāpa tvaṃ kṛtaḥ padmayoninā || avadhyaḥ sarvasattvānāṃ puṃsaḥ jātau dharātale || 135 || pitāmahavaraḥ so'tra jayaśīlo'si dānava || yadi te pauruṣaṃ cāsti tacchīghraṃ saṃpradarśaya || 136 || eṣā tvāmiṣubhistīkṣṇairnayāmi yamasādanam || evamuktvā tato devī śarānaṣṭau mumoca ha || 137 || caturbhiścaturo vāhānanayadyamasādanam || sāratheśca śiraḥ kāyācchareṇaikena cākṣipat || 138 || dhvajaṃ ciccheda caikena tato'nyena hṛdi kṣataḥ || sa gātraviddho vyathito dhvajayaṣṭiṃ samāśritaḥ || || 139 || mūrchayā sahito rājankiṃcitkālamadhomukhaḥ || tataḥ sa cetano bhūtvā mumoca niśitāñcharān || 7.3.36.140 || devī sakhīsamāyuktā sarvadeśeṣvatāḍayat || tataḥ kṣuraprabāṇena dhanustasya dvidhā'karot || 141 || chinnadhanvā tato daityaścarmakhaṅgasamanvitaḥ || vidrāvya sahasā devīṃ tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt|| 142 || tasya cāpatatastūrṇaṃ khaḍgaṃ dvābhyāṃ hyakṛntayat || śarābhyāmardhabāṇena prahasya prāsameva ca || 143 || viśastro viratho rājansa tadā dānavādhamaḥ || tato'smaraccharānbhūpa śastrāṇi vividhāni ca || 144 || brahmāstraṃ manasi dhyāyaṃstṛṇaṃ tasyai mumoca saḥ || muktenāstreṇa tasmiṃstu dhūmavartirvyajāyata || 145 || etasminneva kāle tu sa brahmāste divaukasaḥ || paraṃ bhayamanuprāptā dṛṣṭvā tasya parākramam || 146 || tato devī kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā tadastraṃ pārthivottama || brahmāstreṇāhanattūrṇaṃ tato vyarthaṃ vyajāyata || 147 || brahmāstre viphale jāte hyāgneyaṃ dānavottamaḥ || preṣayāmāsa tāṃ kruddho hyahanadvāruṇena sā|| 148 || evaṃ nānāprakārāṇi tena muktāni sā tadā || astrāṇi viphalānyeva cakre devī sahasraśaḥ || 149 || evaṃ niḥśeṣitāstro'sau dānavo balavattaraḥ|. cakāra paramāṃ māyāṃ divyairastraiḥ sureśvarī|| 7.3.36.150|| vyakṣipacca mahākāyaṃ mahiṣaṃ parvatākṛtim|| dīrghatīkṣṇaviṣāṇābhyāṃ yuktamaṃjanasaṃnibham|| 151|| siṃhaskaṃdhaṃ ca sā devī tatastamadhyarohata|| khaḍgena tīkṣṇena śiro devī tasya nyakṛṃtata|| 152| śūlena bhedayāmāsa pṛṣṭhadeśe sureśvarī || tataḥ kalevarāttasmānniścakrāma mahānpumān || 153 || carmakhaḍgadharo raudrastiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt || tamapyevaṃ gṛhītvā tatkeśapāśe sureśvarī || 154 || nistriṃśenāhanatproccaiḥ sa ca prāṇairvyayujyata || dānavaḥ pārthivaśreṣṭha pārśve siṃhavidārite || 155 || tato jaghāna bhūyo'pi dānavānsā ruṣānvitā || hataśeṣāśca ye daityā nirbhidya dharaṇītalam || 156 || praviṣṭā bhayasaṃtrastāḥ pātālaṃ jīvitaiṣiṇaḥ || tato deva gaṇāḥ sarve vasavo maruto'śvinau ||157|| viśvedevāstathā sādhyā rudrā guhyakakinnarāḥ || ādityāḥ śakrasaṃyuktāḥ sametya parameśvarīm || 158 || samaṃtāddivyapuṣpaiśca tāṃ devīṃ samavākiran || stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stotrairnamaṃto bhaktitatparāḥ || 159 || yuktaṃ kṛtaṃ maheśāni yaddhataḥ pāpakṛttamaḥ || trailokyaṃ sakalaṃ dhvastaṃ pāpenānena suṃdari || 7.3.36.160 || tvayā dattaṃ punā rājyaṃ vāsavasya triviṣṭape || tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ yanmanasīpsitam || sarve devāḥ prasannāste pradāsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 161 || || devyuvāca || || yadi devāḥ prasannā me yadi deyo varo mama || āśramo'traiva me puṇyo jāyatāṃ khyātisaṃyutaḥ|| 162|| asmiṃścāhaṃ sadā devāḥ sthāsyāmi varaparvate|| 163|| rūpeṇānena deveśi ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti mānavāḥ|| āśrame'tra mahāpuṇye te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim||164|| brahmajñānasamāyuktāste bhaviṣyaṃti mānavāḥ|| 165|| yasmāccaṃḍaṃ kṛtaṃ karma tvayā dānavasūdanāt|| tasmāttvaṃ caṃḍikānāma loke khyātiṃ gamiṣyasi|| 166|| tava nāmnā tathā khyāta āśramo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati|| 167|| ye'tra kṛṣṇa caturddaśyāmāśvine māsi śobhane || piṃḍadānaṃ kariṣyaṃti snānaṃ kṛtvā samāhitāḥ || 168 || gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ kṛtyaṃ teṣāṃ devi bhaviṣyati || tvaddarśanāttathā muktiḥ pātakasya bhaviṣyati || 169 || || kṛṣṇa uvāca || || ekarātriṃ bhaviṣyaṃti ye'tra śraddhāsamanvitāḥ || upavāsaparāsteṣāṃ pāpaṃ yāsyati saṃkṣayam || 7.3.36.170 || putrahīnaśca yo martyo nārī vāpi samāhitā || tanmanāḥ piṃḍadānaṃ vai tathā snānaṃ kariṣyati || aputro labhate śīghraṃ suputraṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 171 || || indra uvāca || || bhraṣṭarājyo nṛpo yo'tra snānaṃ dānaṃ kariṣyati || sarvaśatrukṣayastasya rājyāvāptirbhaviṣyati || 172 || || || agniruvāca|| || atrāgatya śuciḥ śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ || ātmavittānusāreṇa tasya yajñaphalaṃ bhavet ||173|| || yama uvāca|| || atra snātvā tilānyastu brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyati || alpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya na kadācidbhaviṣyati ||174|| || rākṣasā ūcuḥ || || piṃḍadānaṃ narā ye'tra kariṣyaṃti tavā''śrame || pretotthaṃ na bhayaṃ tasya devi kvāpi bhaviṣyati ||175|| || varuṇa uvāca || || snānārthaṃ brāhmaṇeṃdrāṇāṃ yo'tra toyaṃ pradāsyati || vimalastu sadā bhāvi iha loke paratra ca || 176 || || vāyuruvāca || || vilepanāni śubhrāṇi sugaṃdhāni viśeṣataḥ || yotra dāsyati viprebhyo nīrogaḥ sa bhaviṣyati || 177 || || dhanada uvāca || || yo'tra vittaṃ yathāśaktyā brāhmaṇebhyaḥ pradāsyati || na bhaviṣyati loke sa vittahīnaḥ kathaṃcana || || 178 || || īśvara uvāca || || yo'tra vrataparo bhūtvā cāturmāsyaṃ vasiṣyati || iha loke pare caiva tasya bhāvi sadā sukham || 179 || || || vasava ūcuḥ || || trirātraṃ yo naraḥ samyagupavāsaṃ kariṣyati || ājanmamaraṇātpāpānmuktaḥ sa ca bhaviṣyati |||7.3.36.180||| || āditya uvāca || || atrāśramapade puṇye ye narā bhaktisaṃyutāḥ || chatropānatpradātārasteṣāṃ lokāḥ sanātanāḥ || 181 || || aśvināvūcatuḥ || || miṣṭānnaṃ śraddhayopeto brāhmaṇāya pradāsyati || yo'tra tasya parā prītirbhaviṣyatyavināśinī 1| 182 || || tīrthānyūcuḥ || || adyaprabhṛti sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāmiha saṃsthitiḥ || bhaviṣyati viśeṣeṇa hyāśrame lokaviśrute ||183|| kṛṣṇapakṣe caturddaśyāmāśvine māsi bhaktitaḥ || upavāsaparo bhūtvā yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati || sarveṣāmeva tīrthānāṃ sa phalaṃ hi labhiṣyati || 184 || || gaṃdharvā ūcuḥ || || gītavādyāni yaścātra prakariṣyati mānavaḥ || saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva rūpavānsa bhaviṣyati || 185 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || āśrame'smiṃstrirātraṃ ya upavāsaṃ kariṣyati || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrasya phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati || 186 || || pulastya uvāca || || evaṃ sarve varāndattvā devyai devā nṛpottama || tadājñayā divaṃ jagmurdevī tatraiva saṃsthitā || 187 || atha marttyā divaṃ jagmurdṛṣṭvā devīṃ tadāśrame || anāyāsena saṃpūrṇāstato martyaistriviṣṭapaḥ || 188 || agniṣṭomādikāḥ sarvāḥ kriyā naṣṭā dharātale || dharmakriyāstathā cānyā muktvā devyāḥ prapūjanam || 189 || tato bhītaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ saṃmaṃtrya guruṇā saha || āhvayāmāsa vegena kāmaṃ krodhaṃ bhayaṃ madam || 7.3.36.190 || vyāmohaṃ gṛhaputrotthaṃ tṛṣṇāmāyāsamanvitam || gatvā yūyaṃ drutaṃ martye sthātukāmānnarānstriyaḥ ||191|| caṃḍikāyatane puṇye sevadhvaṃ hi mamājñayā || viśeṣeṇāśvine māsi kṛṣṇapakṣeṃ'tyavāsare || 192 || evamuktāstataḥ sarve kāmādyāste drutaṃ yayuḥ || martyaloke mahārāja rakṣāṃ cakruśca sarvaśaḥ || 193 || evaṃ jñātvā drutaṃ gaccha tatra pārthivasattama || yadīcchasi paraṃ śreya iha loke paratra ca || 194 || yo yāti caṃḍikāṃ draṣṭumaburdaṃ prati pārthiva || nṛtyaṃti pitarastasya garjaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ || 195 || tārayiṣyati naḥ sarvānsa putro ya ihāśrame || caṃḍikāyāḥ pragatvā'tha kuryācchrāddhaṃ samāhitaḥ || 196 || ekayā labhyate rājyaṃ svargaścaiva dvitīyayā || tṛtīyayā bhavenmokṣo yātrayā tatra pārthiva || 197 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrāṃ tatra samācaret || arbude parvataśreṣṭhe sarvatīrthamaye śubhe || 198 || tatra ślokaḥ purā gīto nāradena maharṣiṇā || snātvā tatrāśrame puṇye bahuvipra samāgame || 119 || punaṃtyevānyatīrthāni snānadānairasaṃśayam || arbudālokanādeva vipāpmā tatra jāyate || 7.3.36.200 || yaḥ śṛṇoti sadākhyānameta cchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || sa prāpnoti naraśreṣṭha kāmānmanasi vāṃchitān || 201 || yasyaitattiṣṭhate gehe likhitaṃ pustakaṃ nṛpa || tasyāpi vāṃchitāḥ kāmāḥ saṃpadyate dinedine || 202 || paṭhati śraddhayopeto yo vā bhūmipate naraḥ || so'pi yātrāphalaṃ rājam̐llabhate puruṣottamaḥ || 203 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe .tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe caṃḍikāśramotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36 || ||
<7.3.37>
|| pulastya uvāca || || nāgahradaṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || yatra nāgaistapastaptaṃ ramye parvatarodhasi || 1 || kadrūśāpaṃ purā śrutvā nāgāḥ sarve bhayāturāḥ || papracchurnāgarājānaṃ śeṣaṃ praṇatakandharāḥ || 2 || mātṛśāpena saṃtaptā vayaṃ pannagasattama || kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ śāpamokṣo bhavetkatham|| 3 || || śeṣa uvāca || || prasāditā mayā mātā śāpamuktikṛte purā || tayoktaṃ ye tapoyuktā dharmātmānaḥ susaṃyatāḥ || 4 || na dahiṣyati tānvahniryajñe pārikṣitasya hi || tasmādgatvārbudaṃnāma parvataṃ dharaṇītale || 5 || tatra yūyaṃ tapoyuktā bhavadhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || yatrāste sā svayaṃ devī caṃḍikā kāmarūpiṇī || 6 || yasyāḥ saṃkīrttanenāpi naśyaṃti vipado dhruvam || ārādhayadhvamaniśaṃ tāṃ devīṃ mama vākyataḥ || 7 || tasyāḥ prasādataḥ sarve bhaviṣyatha gatajvarāḥ || etamevātra paśyāmi upāyaṃ nāgasattamāḥ || daivo vā mānuṣo vā'pi nānyo vo muktikārakaḥ || 8 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktāstato nāgā nāgarājena pārthiva || praṇamya taṃ tato jagmurarbudaṃ parvataṃ prati || 9 || te bhittvā dharaṇīpṛṣṭhaṃ parvate tadanantaram || nijagmurbilamārgeṇa kṛtvā śvabhre suvistaram || 7.3.37.10 || tato dhṛtavratāḥ sarve devī bhaktiparāyaṇāḥ || vasaṃti bhaktisaṃyuktāścaṇḍikārādhanāya te || 11 || tasthustatra sadā homaṃ kurvanto jāpyamuttamam || ekāhārā nirāhārā vāyubhakṣāstathā pare || 12 || dantolūkhalinaḥ kecidaśmakuṭṭāstathā pare || pañcāgnisādhakāścānye sadyaḥ prakṣālakāstathā || 13 || gītaṃ vādyaṃ tathā cakruranye devāḥ purastadā || ananyaśradayopetāṃstāndṛṣṭvā pannagottamān || 14 || tato devī susantuṣṭā vākyametaduvāca ha || 15 || || || devyuvāca || || parituṣṭāsmi vo vatsāḥ kimarthaṃ tapyate tapaḥ || varayadhvaṃ varaṃ matto yaḥ sthito bhavatāṃ hṛdi || 16 || || nāgā ūcuḥ || || mātṛśāpena saṃtaptā vayaṃ devi nirāśrayāḥ || nāgarājasamādeśāccharaṇaṃ tvāṃ samāgatāḥ || 17 || sā tvaṃ rakṣa bhayāttasmācchāpavahnisamudbhavāt || vayaṃ mātrā purā śaptāḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāntare || pārikṣitasya yajñe vaḥ pāvako bhakṣayiṣyati || 18 || || devyuvāca || || yāvattasya bhavedyajña stāvadyūyaṃ mamāntike || saṃtiṣṭhata vinā bhītyā bhogānbhuṅdhvaṃ supuṣkalān || 19 || samāpte ca kratau bhūyo gaṃtāraḥ svaṃ niketanam || yuṣmābhirbheditaṃ yasmādetatparvatakandaram || 7.3.37.20 || nāgahradaṃ tu tattīrthametadbhāvi dharātale || atra yaḥ śrāvaṇe māsi pañcamyāṃ bhaktitatparaḥ || 21 || kariṣyati naraḥ snānaṃ tasya nāhikṛtaṃ bhayam || bhaviṣyati punaḥ śrāddhātpitṝnsaṃtārayiṣyati || 22 || ye bhogā bhūtale khyātā ye divyā ye ca mānuṣāḥ || naro nityaṃ labhiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 23 || || pulastya uvāca || || tato hṛṣṭā babhūvuste muktvā taddāruṇaṃ bhayam || devyāḥ śaraṇamāpannāstasthustatra nagottame || 24 || tataḥ kālena mahatā satre pārikṣitasya ca || nirvṛtte te tadā jagmuḥ sunirvṛttā rasātalam || 25 || devyā caivābhyanujñātāḥ praṇipatya muhurmuhuḥ || kṛcchrātpārthivaśārdūla tadbhaktyā niścalīkṛtāḥ || 26 || adyāpi kṛṣṇapaṃcamyāṃ śrāvaṇe māsi pārthiva || sānnidhyaṃ tatra kurvaṃti devīdarśanalālasāḥ || 27 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret || snānaṃ ca pārthivaśreṣṭha ya icchecchreya ātmanaḥ || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe nāgodbhavatīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 || ||
<7.3.38>
|| pulastya uvāca || || kuṃḍaṃ tu śivaliṃgākhyaṃ tato gacchenmahīpate || yatra sā jāhnavī guptā tiṣṭhate bhūpasattama || 1 || tasyāṃ snāto naraḥ samyaksarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || mucyate pātakātkṛtsnādājanmamaraṇāṃtikāt || 2 || || yayāti ruvāca || || kimarthaṃ tatra sā guptā jāhnavī tiṣṭhate vibho || kasminkāle samāyātā paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 3 || || pulastya uvāca || || yadā prasādito devairbhagavānvṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || arbude'sminsadā stheyamacalena tvayā vibho || 4|| tatra saṃsthāpite liṃge svayaṃ devena śaṃbhunā || yatpātitaṃ purā liṃgaṃ vālakhilyairmaharṣibhiḥ || 5 || atikopasamāyuktaiḥ kasmiṃścitkāraṇāṃtare || tadā devena pratijñātaṃ sarveṣāṃ tridivaukasām || 6 || acale tu mayātraiva sthātavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || tataḥ kālena mahatā vasatastasya tatra ca || 7 || acaleśvararūpasya gaṃgā citte vyajāyata || kathaṃ nityaṃ tayā sārddhaṃ bhaviṣyati samāgamaḥ || 8 || atha jānāti no gaurī māninī parameśvarī || tasyaivaṃ cintayānasya bahuśo nṛpasattama || 9 || upāyaṃ sumahaddhyātvā jāhnavīsaṃgasaṃbhavam || tenādiṣṭā gaṇāḥ sarve naṃdibhṛṅgipuraḥsarāḥ || 7.3.38.10 || abhiprāyo'sti me kaścijjalāśrayavratodbhavaḥ || kriyatāmuttamaṃ kuṇḍamasminparvatarodhasi || 11 || tatrāhaṃ jalamadhyasthaḥ sthāsyāmi jalatatparaḥ || tacchrutvā tvaritaṃ cakrurgaṇāḥ kuṇḍamanekaśaḥ || 12 || svacchodakasamākīrṇaṃ sutīrthaṃ susukhāvaham || tato gaurīmanujñāpya jāhnavīsaṃgalālasaḥ || 13 || vratavyājena deveśo viveśa tadanantaram || cintayāmāsa tatrastho gaṃgāṃ trailokyapāvinīm || 14 || sā dhyātā tatkṣaṇāttatra śivena saha saṃgatā || evaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra jāhnavīṃ bhajate sadā || 15 || vratavyājena rājendra na tu gaurī vyajānata || kasyacittvatha kālasya nārado bhagavānmuniḥ || kaivalyajñānasaṃpannastatrāyātaḥ paribhraman || 16 || sa tu dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ jalasthaṃ vratadhāriṇam || kāmajairiṃgitairyuktaṃ tatrā'sau vismayānvitaḥ || 17 || vaktranetravikāro'yaṃ kimasya vratadhāriṇaḥ || īdṛkkāmasamāyuktastato dhyānasthito muniḥ || 18 || athā'paśyaddhyānadṛṣṭyā gaṃgāsaktaṃ maheśvaram || gauryā bhayena savyājaṃ tato vismayamāgataḥ || 19 || tadā sa kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ haraviceṣṭitam || 7.3.38.20 || tato devī tvarāyuktā yayau yatra maheśvaraḥ || ātāmranayanā roṣādvepamānā muhurmuhuḥ || 21 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā kopasaṃyuktāṃ samāyātāṃ maheśvarīm || uvāca jāhnavī bhītā jñātvā divyena cakṣuṣā || 22 || āvayoḥ saṃgame devī nāradena niveditā || seyaṃ ruṣṭā samāyāti kuruṣva yadanantaram || 23 || || śrīmahādeva uvāca || || karttavyaṃ jāhnavi śreyaḥ puro gatvā nagātmajām || atyarthaṃ māninī hyeṣā sāmnā ca vaśavartinī || 24 || tatkṣaṇājjāyate sādhvī tasmātsāmaparā bhava || no cecchāpaṃ mayā sārdhaṃ tava dāsyatyasaṃśayam || 25 || evamuktā ca rudreṇa jāhnavī nṛpasattama || kuṇḍānnirgatya sā gaṃgā sammukhaṃ prayayau tadā || 26 || pratyudyayau salajjā ca kṛtāṃjalipuraḥsarā || praṇamya śirasā ceyaṃ tataḥ prāha svalaṃkṛtā || 27 || purā'haṃ tava kāṃtena nipatantī nabhastalāt || dhṛtā devi tavā pyetadviditaṃ nṛpateḥ kṛte || 28 || bhagīrathābhidhānasya tataḥ sneho vyavardhata || āvayostava bhītyā ca nābhūtkvāpi samāgamaḥ || 29 || adhunā tava vākyena jāne'haṃ na sureśvari || samāhūtā'smi rudreṇa kiṃ vā svacchandataḥ śubhe || 7.3.38.30 || trailokyasya prabhurayaṃ tanniṣkramya kathañcana || tasmādatraiva saṃprāptā satyametanmayoditam || 31 || || pulastya upāca || || tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā tato devī praharṣitā || provāca madhuraṃ vākyaṃ satyametattva yoditam|| 32 || tasmādvaraya bhadraṃ te varaṃ matto yathepsitam || muktvaikaṃ patidharmmatve mama kāṃtaṃ maheśvaram|| 33 || || gaṃgovāca || || api daurbhāgyayuktā'haṃ bhāryā jātā'smi śūlinaḥ || tasmādekaṃ dinaṃ dehi krīḍanārthamanena tu || 34 || caitraśuklatrayodaśyāmahorātraṃ sureśvari || śivakuṃḍaṃ tathāstvetanmayā yasmātsamāvṛtam || 35 || śivagaṃgābhidhānaṃ ca tasmātkuṇḍaṃ dharātale || khyātiṃ yātu prasādena tava parvatanaṃdini || 36 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamastviti sā devī procya gaṃgāṃ mahānadīm || tato visarjayāmāsa tāmāliṃgya muhurmuhuḥ || 37 || gatāyāmatha gaṃgāyāmadhovaktraṃ sulajjitam || pāṇau gṛhya yayau rudraṃ bhramamāṇā gṛhaṃ prati ||38|| evametatpurāvṛttaṃ tasminkuṇḍe narādhipa || tasmātsarvaprayatnena caturddaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || 39 || śuklāyāṃ caitramāse tu snānaṃ tatra samācaret || sāṃnidhyāddevadevasya gaṃgāyāśca nṛpottama || 7.3.38.40 || yatra saṃkṣayamāyāti sarvaṃ tatrāśubhaṃ kṛtam || tatra yo vṛṣabhaṃ dadyādbrāhmaṇāya nṛpottama || tadromasaṃkhyayāsvarge sa pumānvasati dhruvam ||41|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śivagaṃgākuṇḍotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭātriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || ||
<7.3.39>
|| yayātiruvāca || || yattvayā kīrtitaṃ brahmanpūrvaṃ devaiḥ prasāditaḥ || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa sthirarūpo maheśvaraḥ || 1 || kasmāttatpātitaṃ liṃgaṃ vālakhilyairmahātmabhiḥ || kasmāttatrācalo jāto devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 2 || etanme kautukaṃ sarvaṃ yathāvadvaktumarhasi || tasmindṛṣṭe ca kiṃ puṇyaṃ narāṇāṃ tatra jāyate || 3 || || pulastya uvāca || || maheśvarasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu pārthivasattama || atra te kīrtayiṣyāmi pūrvavṛttaṃ kathāṃtaram || 4 || yadā pañcatvamāpannā satī satyaparākramā || apamānena dakṣasya yajñe na ca nimaṃtritā || 5 || tadā kāmo drutaṃ gṛhya puṣpacāpaṃ tamabhyagāt|| kandarppaṃ sahasā dṛṣṭvā sandhiteṣuṃ sudurjayam || 6 || āpatantaṃ bhayāttasya praṇaṣṭastripurāṃtakaḥ || sa tadā bhramamāṇaśca itaścetaśca pārthiva || 7 || vālakhilyāśramaṃ prāptaḥ puṇyaṃ sadvṛkṣaśobhitam || sa tatra bhagavāṃsteṣāṃ dārairdṛṣṭaḥ surūpavān|| 8 || digvāsāḥ supriyālāpastatastāḥ kāmamohitāḥ || tyaktvā putragṛhādyaṃ ca sarvāstatpṛṣṭhasaṃsthitāḥ || babhūvuścāniśaṃ rājanmāṃ bhajasveti cābruvan || 9 || cakrurāliṃganaṃ kāściccumbanaṃ ca tathāparāḥ || anyāstasya hi liṃgaṃ tatspṛśaṃti ca muhurmuhuḥ || 7.3.39.10 || sa cāpi bhagavāñchambhurniṣkāmaḥ parameśvaraḥ || jagadvyāptiṃ samāśritya sarvaprāṇiṣu vartate || 11 || sa cāpi bhagavācchaṃbhustāsāṃ sarati prāṅmukhaḥ || bhrāṃtastatrāśrame teṣāṃ dārānkāmena pīḍayan || 12 || atha te munayo dṛṣṭvā vikṛtiṃ dārasaṃbhavām || ajānanto mahādevaṃ ruṣṭāstasya mahātmanaḥ || || 13 || daduḥ śāpaṃ susaṃtaptāḥ kalatrārthe paraṃtapa || patatāṃ patatāṃ liṅgametatte pāpakṛttama || 14 || viḍambayasi no dārānajasraṃ cāsya darśanāt || tataścaivāpatalliṃgaṃ tatkṣaṇāttatpuradviṣaḥ || 15 || brahmavākyena rājarṣe cakampe vasudhā tataḥ || śīrṇāni giriśṛṃgāṇi cukṣubhurmakarālayāḥ || || 16 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve bhayatrastā narādhipa || akāle pralayaṃ matvā trailokye paryavasthitam || 17 || tata pitāmahaṃ jagmu stasmai sarvaṃ nyavedayan || pralayasyeva cihnāni dṛśyante parameśvara || 18 || kiṃ nimittaṃ suraśreṣṭha na jānīmo vayaṃ prabho || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ciraṃ dhyātvā pitāmahaḥ || 19 || abravītpātitaṃ liṃgaṃ vālakhilyaiḥ pinākinaḥ || tenaite dāruṇotpātāḥ saṃjātā bhayasūcakāḥ || 7.3.39.20 || tasmānmayā samāyuktāḥ sarve tatra divaukasaḥ || vrajaṃtu yena talliṃgaṃ sthāne saṃsthāpayecchivaḥ ||21|| yāvanno jāyate loke pralayo' kālasaṃbhavaḥ || evaṃ saṃmaṃtrya te sarve tato'rbudamupāyayuḥ || 22 || vālakhilyāśrame yatra talliṃgaṃ nipapāta ha || tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ sūktairvedoktairvinayānvitāḥ || 23 || || devā ūcuḥ || || namaste devadeveśa bhaktānāṃ cābhayaṃkara || namaste sarvavāsāya sarvayajñamayāya ca || 24 || sarveśvarāya devāya paramajyotiṣe namaḥ || namaḥ sphuṭatara jñānagamyāya vedhase || 25 || tryaṃbakāya ca bhīmāya pinākavarapāṇaye || tvayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva || 26 || saṃsāre vibudhaśreṣṭha jagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || na tadasti triloke'sminsusūkṣmamapi śaṃkara || yattvayā na prabho vyāptaṃ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakāraṇāt || 27 || pṛthivyādīni bhūtāni tvayā sṛṣṭāni kāmataḥ || yāsyaṃti tāni bhūyo'pi tava kāye jagatpate || 28 || prasīda bhagavaṃstasmālliṃgametatsureśvara || sthāne sthāpaya bhadraṃ te yāvanna syātprajākṣayaḥ || 29 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || nirvikārasya malliṃgaṃ vālakhilyaiḥ prapātitam|| kathaṃ bhūyaḥ pragṛhṇāmi yāvacchuddhirna jāyate || 7.3.39.30 || śakto'haṃ vālakhilyānāṃ nigrahaṃ karttumañjasā || kintu me brāhmaṇā mānyāḥ pūjyāśca surasattamāḥ || 31 || acalaṃ liṃgametaddhi noddharttuṃ śakyate vibho || eka evātra nirdiṣṭa upāyo nāparaḥ smṛtaḥ || 32 || yadi me tvaṃ purā liṃgaṃ pūjayethāḥ pitāmaha || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve tato viprāstato'pare || 33 || tato nau śāṃtimāgacchejjagatsthāvarajaṃgamam || 34 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktaḥ sa bhagavāñchaṃkareṇa nṛpottama || tatastaṃ pūjayāmāsa brahmā pūrvaṃ subhaktitaḥ || 35 || brahmaṇo'nantaraṃ viṣṇustataḥ śakra stato'pare || vālakhilyādayo viprā mantraiśca śatarudriyaiḥ || 36 || tataste dāruṇotpātā upaśāṃtāśca tatkṣaṇāt || abhavatsumukho loko vṛtto gandhavaho mṛduḥ || 37 || athovāca mahādevaḥ sarvāṃstāṃstridaśālayān|| vṛṇudhvaṃ suvaraṃ sarve matto yanmanasīpsitam || 38 || || devā ūcuḥ || || tava liṃgasya saṃsparśādapi pāpakṛto narāḥ || svargaṃ yāsyaṃti deveśa nāśaṃ yāsyati kilbiṣam || vratadānāni sarvāṇi tīrthayātrāyutāni ca || 39 || tasmādvajreṇa devendrastavaitalliṃgamuttamam|| chādayiṣyati sarvatra yadi tvaṃ manyase prabho || 7.3.39.40 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || abhiprāyo mamāpyeṣa vartate hṛdi padmaja || evaṃ karotu devendraḥ sarvadharmavivṛddhaye || 41 || pulastya uvāca || || tataḥ saṃchādayāmāsa vajreṇa tridaśādhipaḥ || talliṃgaṃ sarvamartyānāṃ yathā'dṛśyaṃ vyajāyata || 42 || adyāpi vajrasaṃsparśāttatsānnidhyaṃ gato naraḥ || ājanmamaraṇātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 43 || māhātmyaṃ kīrtitaṃ yasmāttalliṃge śaṃkareṇa tu || vastreṇācchāditaṃ caiva śakreṇaiva dharātale || 44 || tataḥprabhṛti liṃgasya marttye pūjā vyajāyata || purāsīcchaṃkaraḥ pūjyo yathānye tridaśālayāḥ || 45 || evametatpurāvṛttamarbude parvatottame || liṃgasya patanātpūjāṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ pari pṛcchasi || 46 || phālgunāntacaturddaśyāṃ naivedyaṃ nūtanairyavaiḥ || yo dadātyacaleśāya sa bhūyo neha jāyate || 47 || brāhmaṇānbhojayedyastu bhaktyā tasminnavairyavaiḥ || yavasaṃkhyāpramāṇāni yugāni divi modate || 48 || tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsanti saktūnāṃ munisattamāḥ || nūtanānāṃ mahārāja yataḥ proktaṃ purāriṇā || 49 || kiṃ dānairvividhairdattaiḥ kiṃ yajñaiśca suvistaraiḥ || kiṃ tīrthairvividhaihomaistapobhiḥ kiṃ ca kaṣṭadaiḥ || 7.3.39.50 || phālgunāntacaturddaśyāṃ sumaheśvarasannidhau || dharmāṇyetāni sarvāṇi kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm|| 51 || śṛṇu rājanpurā vṛttaṃ tatrāścaryaṃ yaduttamam || kaścitpāpasamācāraḥ kuṣṭhī kṣāmatanurnaraḥ || 52 || bhikṣārthamāgatastatra lokairanyaiḥ samanvitaḥ || tena bhikṣārjitaṃ tatra saktūnāṃ kuḍavaṃ nṛpa || 53 || tato roga parikleśādbhojanaṃ na cakāra saḥ || dāghārdito jale tasminsnāto bhaktivivarjitaḥ || saktūnkṛtvopadhāne tānsa ca supto niśāgame || 54 || tato nidrābhibhūtasya sārameyo jahāra ca ||
