bhakṣayāmāsa yukto'nyaiḥ sārameyairbubhukṣitaḥ || 55 || athāsau vismayādrājanpaṃcatvaṃ samupasthitaḥ || tato jātismaro jāto vidarbhādhipatergṛhe || 56 || bhīmonāma nṛpaśreṣṭha damayantīpitā hi yaḥ || taṃ prabhāvaṃ hi vijñāya saktūnāṃ tatra parvate || 57 || phālgunāṃtacaturdaśyāṃ varṣe varṣe jagāma saḥ || kṛtvā caivopavāsaṃ tu rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || 58 || acaleśvarasānnidhye dadau saktūṃstato bahūn || sahiraṇyāndvijendrāṇāṃ paśupakṣimṛgeṣu ca || 59 || atha te munayaḥ sarve gālavapramukhā nṛpa || papracchuḥ kautukāviṣṭāḥ saktudānakṛte nṛpam || 7.3.39.60 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || hastvaśvarathadānānāṃ śaktirasti tavādbhutā || kasmātsaktūnpramuktvā tvaṃ nānyaddātumihecchasi || 61 || || pulastya uvāca || || athā'sau kathayāmāsa pūrvametatsamudbhavam || saktudānasya māhātmyaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām || 62 || pūrvaṃ bhaktyā vihīnasya śunā vai saktavo hṛtāḥ || tatprabhāvādiyaṃ prāptirmama jātā dvijottamāḥ || 63 || sāṃprataṃ bhaktida ttānāṃ kiṃ syājjānāmi no phalam|| etasmātkāraṇāddānaṃ saktūnāṃ prakaromyaham || tīrthe'sminbhaktisaṃyuktaḥ satyenātmānamālabhe || 64 || || || pulastya uvāca || || tataste munayo hṛṣṭāḥ sādhusādhviti cābruvan|| cakruścaivātmaśaktyā te saktūnāṃ dānamuttamam || 65|| eṣa prabhāvo rājarṣe saktudānasya kīrttitaḥ || maheśvarasya māhātmyaṃ satyaṃ cāpi prakīrttitam || 66 || yaścaitacchṛṇuyādbhaktyā kathyamānaṃ dvijānanāt || ahorātra kṛtātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 67 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe śivaliṃga maheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃpuraḥsara saktudānamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || || cha ||
<7.3.40>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tataḥ kāmeśvaraṃ gacchettatra kāmapratiṣṭhitam || yasmindṛṣṭe sadā martyaḥ surūpaḥ suprabho bhavet || 1 || || yayātiruvāca || || tvayā proktaṃ purā śaṃbhuḥ kāmabāṇa bhayātkila || vālakhilyāśramaṃ prāpto yatra liṃgaṃ papāta ha || 2 || sa kathaṃ pūjitastena śaṃbhurme kautukaṃ mahat || vada sarvaṃ dvijaśreṣṭha kāmeśvaraniveśanam || 3 || || pulastya uvāca || || muktaliṃge'pi deveśe na smarastaṃ mumoca ha || darśayannātmano bāṇaṃ tasyāsau pṛṣṭhataḥ sthitaḥ || 4 || tato vārāṇasīṃ prāptastadbhayāttripurāṃtakaḥ || tatrā'pi ca tathā dṛṣṭvā dhṛtacāpaṃ manobhavam||5|| tataḥ prayāgamāpannaḥ kedāraṃ ca tataḥ param|| naimiṣaṃ bhadrakarṇaṃ ca jaṃbūmārge tripuṣkaram ||6|| gokarṇaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca puṇyaṃ ca kṛmijāṃgalam|| gagādvāraṃ gayāśīrṣaṃ kālābhīṣṭaṃ vaṭeśvaram ||7|| kiṃ vā tena bahūktena tīrthānyāyatanāni ca || asaṃkhyāni gato devaḥ kāmaṃ ca dadṛśe tathā || 8 || yatrayatra mahādevastadbhayānnṛpa gacchati || tatratatra punaḥ kāmaṃ prapaśyati dhṛtāyudham|| 9 || kasyacittvathakālasya punaḥ prāpto'rbudaṃ prati || tatrāpaśyattathā kāmamākarṇākarṣitāyudham|| ākuṃcitaikapādaṃ ca sthiradṛṣṭiṃ nṛpo ttama || 7.3.40.10 || athā'sau bhagavāñchāṃtaḥ priyāduḥkhasamanvitaḥ || krodhaṃ cakre viśeṣeṇa dṛṣṭvā taṃ purataḥ sthitam|| 11 || tasya kopābhibhūtasya tṛtīyānnayanānnṛpa || niścakrāma mahājvālā yayā'sau bhasmasātkṛtaḥ || 12 || sacāpaḥ saśaro rājaṃstasminparvatarodhasi || śaṃkaro roṣaparyaṃtaṃ gatvā saukhyamavāptavān|| 13 || kailāsaṃ parvataśreṣṭhaṃ jagāma surapūjitaḥ || dagdhe manobhave bhāryā ratirasya pativratā || vyalapatkaruṇaṃ dīnā patiśokapari plutā || 14 || tato dārūṇi cāhṛtya citiṃ kṛtvā narādhipa || ārurohāgnisaṃdīptāṃ citiṃ sā patiduḥkhitā|| tāvadākāśagāṃ vāṇīṃ śuśrāva ca yaśasvinī|| 15|| vāguvāca|| mā putri sāhasaṃ kārṣīstapasā tiṣṭha sundari|| bhūyaḥ prāpsyasi bharttāraṃ kāmeṃ tuṣṭena śaṃbhunā||16|| sā śrutvā tāṃ tadā vāṇīṃ samuttasthau samumadhyamā|| devamārādhayāmāsa divānaktamataṃdritā|| vratairdānairjapairhomairupavāsaistathā paraiḥ||17|| tato varṣa sahasrāṃte tuṣṭastasyā maheśvaraḥ || abravīdvada kalyāṇi varaṃ yanmanasi sthitam || 18 || || ratiruvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva bhagavam̐lloka bhāvanaḥ || akṣatāṃgaḥ punaḥ kāmaḥ kāṃto me jāyatāṃ patiḥ || 19 || evamukte tayā vākye tatkṣaṇātsamupasthitaḥ || yathā supto mahārāja tadvadrūpaḥ sa harṣita || 7.3.40.20 || ikṣuyaṣṭimayaṃ cāpaṃ puṣpabāṇasamanvitam || bhṛṃgaśreṇimayyā maurvyā śobhitaṃ sumanoharam || 21 || tato ratisamāyuktaḥ praṇipatya maheśvaram|| anujñātastu tenaiva svavyāpāre'bhyavarttata || 22 || sa dṛṣṭvā śivamāhātmyaṃ śraddhāṃ kṛtvā nṛpottama || śivaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa parvate'rbudasaṃjñite || 23 || yasmindṛṣṭe mahārāja nārī vā yadi vā naraḥ || saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva na daurbhāgyamavāpnuyāt || 24 || evametanmayā khyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || kāmeśvarasya māhātmyaṃ kāmadāha savistaram || 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 40 || || cha ||
<7.3.41>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha mārkaṃḍeyasya cāśramam|| yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ mārkaṃḍena mahātmanā || 1 || mṛkaṇḍo brāhmaṇonāma purā''sīcchaṃsitavrataḥ || ante vayasi saṃjātastasya putro'tisundaraḥ || 2 || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇaḥ śāṃtaḥ sūryasamaprabhaḥ || kasyacittvatha kālasya tasyāśramapade nṛpa || 3 || āgato brāhmaṇo jñānī kaścitsāmudravicchubhaḥ || tato'sau krīḍamānastu bālakaḥ paṃcavārṣikaḥ || 4 || ānāsāgraśikhāgrābhyāṃ ciraṃ caivāvalokitaḥ || tato'hasatsa sahasā taṃ mṛkaṇḍo hyalakṣayat|| 5 || athā'bravīcciraṃ dṛṣṭastvayā putro mama dvija|| tato hasitavānbhūyaḥ kimidaṃ kāraṇaṃ vada|| 6|| asakṛtsa mṛkaṇḍena yāvatpṛṣṭo dvijottamaḥ || uparodhavaśāttasmai yathārthaṃ saṃnyavedayat || 7 || asya bālasya cihnāni yāni kāye dvijottama || ajaraścāmaraścaiva tairbhavetpuruṣaḥ kila || 8 || ṣaṇmāsenāsya bālasya nūnaṃ mṛtyurbhaviṣyati || etasmātkāraṇāddhāsyaṃ mayā'kāri dvijottama || anṛtaṃ noktapūrvaṃ me vairiṣvapi kadācana || 9 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā tu sa jñānī uṣitvā tatra śarvarīm || mṛkaṃḍenābhyanujñāta iṣṭaṃ deśaṃ jagāma ha || 7.3.41.10 || mṛkaṃḍopi sutaṃ jñātvā tataḥ kṣīṇāyuṣaṃ nṛpa || paṃcavārṣikamapyārttaścakāropanayānvitam || 11 || śrutādhyayanasaṃpannaṃ yaṃyaṃ paśyasi cāgrataḥ || tasyābhivādanaṃ kāryaṃ tvayā putraka nityaśaḥ || 12 || tataścakre brahmacārī piturvākyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || 13 || bālaṃ vṛddhaṃ yuvānaṃ ca yaṃyaṃ paśyati cakṣuṣā || namaskaroti taṃ sarvaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ vinayānvitaḥ || 14 || kasyacittvatha kālasya tasyāśramasamīpataḥ || saptarṣayaḥ samāyātāstīrthayātrāparāyaṇāḥ || 15 || atha tānsatvaraṃ gatvā vaṃdayāmāsa pārthiva || bālaḥ savinayopetaḥ sarvāṃścaiva yathākramam || 16 || dīrghāyurbhava tairuktaḥ sa bālastuṣṭitatparaiḥ || āsthitāśca yathābhīṣṭaṃ deśaṃ bālaṃ visarjya tam || 17 || teṣāṃ madhyeṃ'girānāma divyajñānasamanvitaḥ || tenāvalokito bālaḥ sūkṣmadṛṣṭyā paraṃtapa || 18 || atha tānabravītsarvānmunīnkiṃcitsavismayaḥ || dīrghāyurna ca bālo'yaṃ yuṣmābhiḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ || 19 || gamiṣyati kumāro'yaṃ nidhanaṃ paṃcame dine || tanna yuktaṃ hi no vākyamasatyaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 7.3.41.20 || yathā'yaṃ cirajīvī syāttathā nītirvidhīyatām || atha te munayo bhītā mithyā vākyasya pārthiva || 21 || bālakaṃ taṃ samādāya brahmalokaṃ gatāstadā || tatra dṛṣṭvā caturvaktraṃ namaścakrurmunīśvarāḥ || 22 || teṣāmanaṃtaraṃ tena bālake nābhivāditaḥ || dīrghāyurbhava tenā'pi brahmaṇoktaḥ sa bālakaḥ || 23 || tataḥ saptarṣayo hṛṣṭāḥ svacitte nṛpasattama || sukhāsīnānsaviśrāṃtānabravīnmunipuṃgavān || 24 || || brahmovāca || || paripṛcchata kiṃ kāryaṃ kuto yūyamihāgatāḥ || 25 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || tīrthayātrāprasaṃgena bhramamāṇā mahītalam || arbudaṃ parvataṃ nāma tasya tīrtheṣu vai gatāḥ || 26 || athāgatya drutaṃ dūrādbālenānena vaṃditāḥ || dīrghāyurbhava saṃdiṣṭastataścāyamanekadhā || paṃcame divase'syāpi mṛtyurdeva bhaviṣyati || 27 || yathā vayaṃ tvayā sārddhamasatyā na caturmukha || bhavāmo'sya kṛte deva tathā kiṃcidvidhīyatām|| 28|| atha brahmā prahṛṣṭātmā dṛṣṭvā taṃ munidārakam || matprasādādayaṃ bālo bhāvī kalpāyurabravīt || 29 || tataste munayo hṛṣṭāstamādāya gṛhaṃ prati || prasthitā brahmalokāttu namaskṛtvā caturmukham || 7.3.41.30 || atha tasya pitā tatra mṛkaṃḍo munisattamaḥ || tato bhāryāsamāyukto vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 31 || hā putraputra karuṇaṃ ruditvā dharmavatsalaḥ || anāmaṃtrya ca māṃ kasmāddīrghaṃ paṃthānamāśritaḥ ||32|| akṛtvāpi kriyāḥ kāryāḥ kathaṃ mṛtyuvaśaṃ gataḥ || so'haṃ tvayā vinā putra na jīvāmi kathaṃcana || 33 || evaṃ vilapatastasya bahudhā nṛpasattama || bālaścābhyāgatastatra yatra deśe purā sthitaḥ || 34 || athāsau prayayau bālaḥ prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā || taṃ dṛṣṭvā pathi tātaśca saṃprahṛṣṭo babhūva ha || 35 || papracchāṃkaṃ samāropya cirāgamana kāraṇam|| tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa sarvaṃ muniviceṣṭitam || darśanaṃ brahmalokasya padmayonervaraṃ tathā || 36 || || bālaka uvāca || || ajaraścāmaraścāhaṃ kṛtastāta svayaṃbhuvā || tasmātsatyaṃ madarthe te vyetvasau mānaso jvaraḥ ||37|| so'hamārādhayiṣyāmi tathaiva caturānanam || kṛtvā''śramapadaṃ ramyamarbude parvatottame || 38 || amṛtasrāvi tadvākyaṃ śrutvā putrasya sa dvijaḥ || mṛkaṃḍo harṣasaṃyukto vācamityabravīcca tam || 39 || mārkkaṃḍo'pi drutaṃ gatvā ramya marbudaparvatam || tapastepe suvistīrṇaṃ dhyāyandevaṃ pitāmaham|| 7.3.41.40 || tasyāśramapade puṇye śrāvaṇe māsi pārthiva || paurṇamāsyāṃ viśeṣeṇa yaḥ kuryātpitṛtarpaṇam || pitṛmedhaphalaṃ tasya sakalaṃ syādasaṃśayam ||41|| ṛṣiyogena yastatra tarpayedbrāhmaṇottamān || brahmaloke ciraṃ vāsastasya saṃjāyate nṛpa || || 42 || yaḥ snānaṃ kurute tatra samyakchraddhāsamanvitaḥ || nālpamṛtyubhayaṃ tasya kule kvāpi prajāyate || 43 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍa tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe mārkaṃḍeyāśramapadotpattivarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||41||
<7.3.42>
|| pulastya uvāca || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ param|| uddālakena muninā sthāpitaṃ lokaviśrutam || 1 || tasminspṛṣṭe'tha vā dṛṣṭe pūjite ca viśeṣataḥ || sarvaroga vinirmukto gārhasthyaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 2 || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate ||3|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍa uddālakeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||42 ||
<7.3.43>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha siddhaliṃgaṃ susiddhidam|| siddhaistu sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || 1 || tatrāsti śobhanaṃ kuṇḍaṃ sunirmalajalānvitam || tatra snāto naraḥ samyaṅmucyate brahmahatyayā || 2 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyaṃstatra snāti naro nṛpa || avaśyaṃ tamavāpnoti niṣṭhāṃte ca parāṃ gatim || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe siddheśvaramahimavarṇanaṃnāma trayaścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ ||43|| ||cha|| ||
<7.3.44>
pulastya uvāca || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha gajatīrthamanuttamam || yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ diggajairbhāvitātmabhiḥ || 1 || bhūbhāradharaṇaiścānyairairāvaṇamukhairnṛpa || tatra snāto naraḥ samyaggajadānaphalaṃ labhet || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe gajatīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || || cha ||
<7.3.45>
|| pulastya uvāca|| || devakhātaṃ tato gacchetsupuṇyaṃ tīrthamuttamam || yatkhyātirvibudhaiḥ sarvaiḥ svayameva vyadhīyata || 1 || tatra yaḥ kurute śrāddhamamāvāsyāṃ viśeṣataḥ || kanyāgate ravau rājansa labhetparamaṃ padam || pitṝnsa tārayatyeva prāptānapi sudurgatim|| 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe śrīdevakhātotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 45 ||
<7.3.46>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato vyāseśvaraṃ gacchedvyāsena sthāpitaṃ hi yat || taṃ dṛṣṭvā jāyate martyo medhāvī matimāñchuciḥ || saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva vyāsasya vacanaṃ yathā || 1 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe vyāsatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭcatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 46 || || cha ||
<7.3.47>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha supūrṇaṃ gautamāśramam || yatra pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ gautamena mahātmanā || 1 || purā''sīdgautamo nāma muniḥ paramadhārmikaḥ || sa bhaktyā''rādhayāmāsa devadevaṃ maheśvaram || 2 || bhaktyā''rādhayamānasya nirbhidya dharaṇītalam || samuttasthau mahalliṃgaṃ paraṃ māheśvaraṃ nṛpa || 3 || etasminneva kāle tu vāguvācāśarīriṇī || pūjayaitanmahalliṃgaṃ tvadbhaktyā samupasthitam|| varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yatte manasi vartate ||4|| || gautama uvāca|| || atrāśramapade deva tvayā śambho jagatpate || sadā kāryaṃ hi sānnidhyaṃ yadi tuṣṭo mama prabho|| 5 || yastvāṃ paśyati sadbhaktyā brahmalokaṃ sa gacchatu || 6 || || ākāśavāṇyuvāca || || māghamāse caturddaśyāṃ yo'tra māṃ vīkṣayiṣyati || kṛṣṇāyāṃ brāhmaṇaśreṣṭha sa yāsyati parāṃ gatim ||7|| evamuktvā tato vāṇī virarāma mahīpate || tatrāsti kuṇḍamaparaṃ pavitraṃ jalapūritam|| tatra snāto naraḥ sadyaḥ kulaṃ tārayate'khilam || 8 || yastatra kurute śrāddhaṃ viśeṣādindusaṃkṣaye || gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ tasya sakalaṃ jāyate dhruvam || 9 || tatra dānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tilānāṃ munipuṃgavāḥ || tilasaṃkhyāni varṣāṇi dānātsvarge vasennṛpa || 7.3.47.10 || arbude gautamī yātrā siṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau || amāyāṃ somavāreṇa dviṣaḍgodāvarīphalam || 11 || ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi bhāgīrathyavagāhane || sakṛdgodāvarīsnānātsiṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau || 12 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśātisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe gautamāśramatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 || || cha ||
<7.3.48>
|| pulastya uvāca || || kulasaṃtāraṇaṃ gacchettatra tīrthamanuttamam || yatra snāto naraḥ samyakkulaṃ tārayate'khilam|| 1 || daśa pūrvānbhaviṣyāṃśca tathātmānaṃ nṛpottama || uddharecchraddhayāyuktastatra dānena mānavaḥ || 2 || āsīdaprastuto nāma rājā pūrvaṃ sa pāpakṛt || nāpi dānaṃ tathā jñānaṃ na dhyānaṃ na ca satkriyā || 3 || tasmiñchāsati lokānāṃ nāsītsaukhyaṃ kadācana || paradāra rucirnityaṃ mahādaṇḍaparaśca saḥ || 4 || nyāyato'nyāyato vāpi karoti dhanasaṃgraham || sa ghātayati lokāṃśca nirdoṣānpāpakṛttamaḥ || 5 || tato vārdhakyamāpannastathāpi na śamaṃ gataḥ || kasyacittvatha kālasya pitṛbhiḥ pratibodhitaḥ || taṃ prasuptaṃ samāsādya nārakeyaiḥ suduḥkhitaiḥ || 6|| || pitara ūcuḥ || || vayaṃ śuddhasamācārā nityaṃ dharmaparāyaṇāḥ || dānayajñatapaḥśīlāḥ svadāraniratāstathā || 7 || svakarmabhiḥ kulāṃgāra divaṃ prāptā yathārhataḥ || kuputraṃ tvāṃ samāsādya narakaṃ samupasthitāḥ || tasmāduddhara naḥ sarvānkṛtvā kiṃcicchubhārcanam || 8 || karmabhistava pāpātmanvayaṃ narakamāśritāḥ || narakaṃ daśa yāsyaṃti bhaviṣyāśca tathā bhavān || 9 || evamuktvā ca te sarve pitarastu suduḥkhitāḥ || yātāśca narakaṃ bhūyaḥ prabuddhaḥ so'pi pārthivaḥ || 7.3.48.10 || tato duḥkhamanuprāptaḥ pitṛvākyāni saṃsmaran || ruroda prātarutthāya taṃ bhāryā pratyabhāṣata || 11 || || indumatyuvāca || || kimarthaṃ rājaśārdūla tvaṃ rodiṣi mahāsvanam || kathaṃ te kuśalaṃ rājye śarīre vā pure'thavā || 12 || || || rājovāca || || mayā dṛṣṭo'dya svapnāṃte pitā hyatha pitāmahaḥ || apaśyaṃ duḥkhitāndevi tābhyāmathāgrajānpitṝn || 13 || upālabdho'smi taiḥ sarvaistava karmabhirīdṛśaiḥ || dāruṇe narake prāptā adharmādiviceṣṭitaiḥ || 14 || athānye daśa yāsyanti bhaviṣyāśca bhavānapi || tasmātkṛtvā śubhaṃ karma durgateścoddharasva naḥ || 15 || evamuktaḥ prabuddho'haṃ pitṛbhirvaravarṇini || tenāhaṃ duḥkhamāpannastadvākyaṃ hṛdi saṃsmaran || 16 || || || indumatyuvāca || || satyametanmahārāja yadukto'si pitāmahaiḥ || na tvayā sukṛtaṃ karma saṃsmare'haṃ kṛtaṃ purā || 17 || yathā suputramāsādya taraṃti pitaro nṛpa || kuputreṇa tathā yāṃti narakaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 || sa tvamāhūya vipreṃdrāndharmaśāstravicakṣaṇān || pṛṣṭvā tānkuru yacchreyaḥ pitṝṇāmātmanā saha || 19 || ānayāmāsa rājā'sau tato viprānanekaśaḥ || vedavedāṃgatattvajñāndharmaśāstravicakṣaṇān || uvāca vinayopeto bhāryayā sahito hitān|| 7.3.48.20 || || rājovāca || || karmaṇā kena pitaro nirayasthā dvijottamāḥ || svargaṃ yāṃti suputreṇa tāritāḥ procyatāṃ sphuṭam || || 21 || || brāhmaṇā ūcuḥ || || pitṛmedhena rājeṃdra kṛtena vidhipūrvakam || nirayasthā divaṃ yāṃti yadyapi syuḥ supāpinaḥ || 22 || || rājovāca || || dīkṣayaṃtu dvijāḥ sarve tadarthaṃ māṃ dhṛtavratam || yatkiṃcidatra karttavyaṃ procyatāmakhilaṃ hi tat || 23 || tathoktāste nṛpeṃdreṇa brāhmaṇāḥ satyavādinaḥ || samagrāḥ pārthivaṃ procuryaduktaṃ yajñakarmaṇi || 24 || dīkṣā grāhyā nṛpaśreṣṭha puraścaraṇamāditaḥ || kṛtvā kāyaviśuddhyarthaṃ tataḥ śreyaskarī bhavet || 25 || sa tvaṃ pāpasamācāro bālyātprabhṛti pārthiva || asaṃkhyaṃ pātakaṃ tasmāttīrthayātrāṃ samācara || 26 || sarvatīrthābhiṣiktastvaṃ yadā syānnṛpasattama || prāyaścittena yogyaḥ syāstato yajñasya nānyathā || 27 || prabhāsādīni tīrthāni yāni saṃti dharātale || gaṃtavyaṃ teṣu sarveṣu snānaṃ kuru samāhitaḥ || 28 || manasā gaccha durgāṇi dadaddānamanuttamam || naśyettenāśubhaṃ kiṃcidapi brahmavadhodbhavam || yanna yāti nṛṇāṃ rājaṃstīrthasnānādinā bhuvi || 29 || || pulastya uvāca || || viprāṇāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā sa rājā śraddhayā'nvitaḥ || tīrthayātrāparo bhūtvā paribabhrāma medinīm|| || 7.3.48.30 || niyato niyatāhāro dadaddānāni bhūriśaḥ || rājye putraṃ pratiṣṭhāpya vasuṃ satyaparākramam || 31 || kasyacittvatha kālasya tīrthayātrānuṣaṃgataḥ || yāto'sau nṛpatiścaiva hyarbude nirmalodakam || 32 || sa snānamakarottatra śraddhāpūtena cetasā || snātamātrasya tasyātha tasminneva jalāśaye || || 33 || vimuktāḥ pitaro raudrānnarakātsupraharṣitāḥ || tato divyavimānasthā divyamālyāṃbarānvitāḥ || 34 || tamūcustāritāḥ sarve vayaṃ putra tvayā'dhunā || tīrthasyāsya prabhāveṇa bhaviṣyāśca tathā daśa || 35 || ātmā ca pārthivaśreṣṭha snānācca jalatarpaṇāt || yasmātkulaṃ tvayā putra tīrthe'smiṃstāritaṃ tataḥ || 36 || kulasaṃtāraṇaṃnāma tīrthametadbhaviṣyati || tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra sahā'smābhirdivaṃ prati || āgacchānena dehena tīrthasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 37 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktaḥ sa rājeṃdro divyakāṃtivapustadā || taṃ vimānamathāruhya gataḥ svargaṃ ca taiḥ saha || 38 || eṣa prabhāvo rājarṣe kulasaṃtāraṇasya ca || mayā te varṇitaḥ samyagbhūyaḥ kiṃ paripṛcchasi || 39 || || yayātiruvāca || || sa kiṃprabhāvo rājā sa tathā pāpasamanvitaḥ || svadehena gataḥ svargametanme kautukaṃ mahat || 7.3.48.40 || || pulastya uvāca || || rākāsomavyatīpāta samakāle nṛpottama || sa snāto yatra bhūpālastanmahacchreyase param || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kulasaṃtāraṇatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 48 ||
<7.3.49>
|| pulastya uvāca || || rāmatīrthaṃ tato gacchetpuṇyamṛṣiniṣevitam|| tatra snātasya marttyasya jāyate pāpasaṃkṣayaḥ || 1 || pitṝṇāṃ ca parā tuṣṭiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || purāsīdbhārgavo rāmaḥ sarvaśastrabhṛtāṃ varaḥ || 2 || tena pūrvaṃ tapastaptaṃ śatrūṇāmicchatā kṣayam|| tataḥ pāśupataṃ nāma tasyāstraṃ paramaṃ dadau || 3 || tapastuṣṭo mahādevo gate varṣaśatatraye || abravīdvarado'smīti sa vavre śatrusaṃkṣayam || 4 || tataḥ pāśupataṃ nāma tasyāstraṃ paramaṃ dadau || smaraṇenāpi śatrūṇāṃ yasya saṃjāyate kṣayaḥ || 5 || abravīdvacanaṃ cāpi prahasya vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || jāmadagnya mahābāho śṛṇu me paramaṃ vacaḥ || 6 || astreṇānena yuktastvamajeyaḥ sarvadehinām || bhaviṣyasi na saṃdeho matprasādādbhṛgūdvaha || 7 || etajjalāśayaṃ puṇyaṃ trailokye sacarācare || rāmatīrthamiti khyātaṃ matprasādādbhaviṣyati || 8 || ye'tra śrāddhaṃ kariṣyaṃti paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitāḥ || saṃprāpte kārttike māsi kṛttikāyogasaṃyute || 9 || pitṛmedhaphalaṃ teṣāmaśeṣaṃ ca bhaviṣyati || tathā śatrukṣayo rājanvāsaḥ svargeṣu cākṣayaḥ || 7.3.49.10 || || pulastya uvāca || || evamuktvā mahādevastataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ || rāmo'pyasūdayatkṣatraṃ pitṛduḥkhena duḥkhitaḥ || 11 || triḥsapta tarpayāmāsa pitṝṃstatra praharṣitaḥ || jamadagnau mṛte tena pratijñātaṃ mahātmanā || 12 || dṛṣṭvā mātuḥ kṣatānyaṃge triḥsapta manujādhipa || śastrajātāni viprāṇāṃ samāje samupasthite || 13 || pitā me nihato yasmātkṣatriyaistāpaso dvijaḥ || ayudhyamāna evātha tasmātkṛtvā trisapta vai || 14 || kṣattrahīnāmahaṃ pṛthvīṃ pradāsye salilaṃ pituḥ || tatsarvaṃ tasya saṃjātaṃ tīrthamāhātmyato nṛpa || 15 || tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena śrāddhaṃ tatra samācaret || kṣatriyaśca viśeṣeṇa ya icchecchatrusaṃkṣayam || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe rāmatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 || || cha ||
<7.3.50>
|| pulastya uvāca || || koṭitīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapātakanāśanam || tīrthānāṃ yatra saṃjātā koṭiḥ pārthiva helayā ||1|| yadā syātkalikālastu raudro rājanmahītale || mlecchabhūtā janāḥ sarve tatsparśāttīrthaviplavaḥ || 2 || tisraḥ koṭyo'rdhakoṭiśca tīrthānāṃ bhūmivāsinām || teṣāṃ koṭistato'vātsītparvate'rbudasaṃjñake || 3 || puṣkare ca tathā koṭiḥ kurukṣetre ca pārthiva || vārāṇasyāmardhakoṭiḥ stutā devaiḥ savāsavaiḥ || rājannetāni rakṣaṃti sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || 4 || yadā yadā bhayārttāni mlecchasparśātsamaṃtataḥ || sthāneṣveteṣu tiṣṭhaṃti tīrthānyukteṣu satvaram || 5 || koṭitīrthāni trīṇyeva tatra jātāni bhūtale || ardha koṭisametāni sarvapāpaharāṇi ca || 6 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena snānaṃ tatra samācaret || kṛṣṇapakṣe trayodaśyāṃ nabhasye ca viśeṣataḥ || 7 || tatra snānādikaṃ sarvaṃ japahomādikaṃ ca yat || sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ rājaṃstatprasādādasaṃśayam || 8 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe koṭitīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 || || cha ||
<7.3.51>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha caṃdrodbhedamanuttamam || tīrthaṃ pāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ niśānāthena nirmitam || 1 || pratijñātaṃ yadā rājangrahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ || rāhuṇā kṛtavaireṇa cchinne śirasi viṣṇunā || 2 || tadā bhayānvitaścandro matvā daityaṃ durāsadam|| pīyūṣabhakṣaṇodyuktaṃ tataścārbudamabhyagāt || 3 || tatra bhittvā gireḥ śṛṃge kṛtvā vivaramuttamam|| praviṣṭastasya madhye tu tapastepe suduścaram|| 4 || tataḥ kālena mahatā tuṣṭastasya maheśvaraḥ || abravīdvṛṇu bhadraṃ te varaṃ yatte hṛdisthitam || 5 || || caṃdra uvāca || || pratijñātaṃ suraśreṣṭha rāhuṇā grahaṇaṃ mama || balavāneṣa durdharṣaḥ prakṛtyā siṃhikāsutaḥ || 6 || sāṃprataṃ bhakṣitaṃ tena pīyūṣaṃ surasattama || ahaṃ madhye dhṛtaścāpi rāhuṇā'sau durāsadaḥ || 7 || pīyamāne'mṛte deva devaiḥ pūrvaṃ parājitaiḥ || daivataṃ rūpamāsthāya dānavo'sau samāgataḥ || 8 || apibaccāmṛtaṃ rāhustenāsya mṛtyuvarjitam || amṛtaṃ cākṣayaṃ jātaṃ śiro devabhayapradam || 9 || tato devaiḥ kṛtaṃ sāma grahamadhye pratiṣṭhitaḥ || pratijñāte grahe'smākaṃ tato me bhayamāviśat || 7.3.51.10 || bhayāttasya suraśreṣṭha bhittvā śṛṃgaṃ gireridam || kṛtaṃ śvabhramagādhaṃ ca tapo'rthaṃ surasattama || tasmādatra prasādaṃ me kuru kāmaniṣūdana || 11 || || bhagavānuvāca || || avadhyaḥ sarvadevānāmajeyaḥ sa mahābalaḥ || kariṣyati grahaṃ nūnaṃ rāhuḥ kopaparāyaṇaḥ || paraṃ tava niśānātha kariṣye'haṃ pratikriyām || 12 || grahaṇe tava saṃprāpte snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || kariṣyaṃti janā loke samyakchreyaḥsamanvitāḥ || 13 || tābhistava na saṃtāpaḥ svalpo'pyevaṃ bhaviṣyati || akṣayaṃ sukṛtaṃ teṣāṃ kṛtaṃ karma bhaviṣyati || 14 || grahaṇe tava saṃjāte mama vākyādasaṃśayam || etadbhinnaṃ tvayā yasmāttapo'rthaṃ śikharaṃ gireḥ || candrodbhedamiti khyātaṃ tīrthaṃ loke bhaviṣyati || 15 || grahaṇe tava saṃprāpte yo'tra snānaṃ kariṣyati || na tasya punarevātra janma loke bhaviṣyati ||16|| yo vā somadine snānaṃ darśanaṃ tatra cācaret || tava loke dhruvaṃ vāsastasya caṃdra bhaviṣyati || 17 || evamuktvā sa bhagavāṃstataścāṃtardadhe haraḥ|| candro'pi prayayau hṛṣṭaḥ svasthānaṃ nṛpasattama || 18 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe candrodbhedatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 51 || || cha ||
<7.3.52>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha īśānīśikharaṃ mahat || yatra gauryā tapastaptaṃ supuṇyaṃ lokaviśrutam || 1 || yasya saṃdarśanenāpi naraḥ pāpātpramucyate || labhate cātisaubhāgyaṃ saptajanmāṃtarāṇi ca || 2 || || yayātiruvāca || || kasminkāle tapastaptaṃ devyā tatra munīśvara || kimarthaṃ ca mahattvetatkautukaṃ vaktumarhasi || 3 || || pulastya uvāca || || śṛṇu rājankathāṃ divyāmadbhutāṃ lokaviśrutām || yasyāḥ saṃśravaṇādeva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 4 || purā gauryā samāsaktaṃ jñātvā devāḥ savāsavāḥ || maṃtraṃ cakrurbhayāviṣṭā ekāṃte samupāśritāḥ || 9 || vīryaṃ yadi trinetrasya kṣetre gauryāḥ patiṣyati || asmākaṃ patanaṃ nūnaṃ jagataśca bhaviṣyati || 6 || saṃtatestu vināśāya tato gacchāmahe vayam|| 7 || evaṃ saṃmaṃtrya devāste kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gatāḥ || tatastu naṃdinā sarve niṣiddhāḥ samayaṃ vinā || 8 || || naṃdyuvāca || || ekāṃte bhagavānrudraḥ sahagauryā vyavasthitaḥ || tasmāddevagaṇāḥ sarve gacchadhvaṃ nilayaṃ svakam || 9 || atha devagaṇāḥ sarve vañcayitvā ca taṃ gaṇam|| praiṣayaṃstatra vāyuṃ ca guptamūcurvacastvidam|| 7.3.52.10 || gatvā vāyo bhavaṃ brūhi na kāryā saṃtatistvayā || evaṃ devagaṇā deva prārthayaṃti bhayāturāḥ || 11 || tato vāyurdrutaṃ gatvā sthito yatra maheśvaraḥ || uccairjagāda tadvākyaṃ yaduktaṃ tridaśālayaiḥ || 12 || tatastu bhagavāñcharvo vrīḍayā parayā yutaḥ || gaurīṃ tyaktvā samuttasthau bāḍhamityeva cābravīt || 13 || tato gaurī suduḥkhārtā śaśāpa tridaśālayān || 14 || || gauryuvāca || || yasmādahaṃ kṛtā devaiḥ putrahīnā samāgataiḥ || tasmātte'pi bhaviṣyanti santānena vivarjjitāḥ || 15 || yasmādvāyo samāyātaḥ sthāne'smiñjanavarjite || tasmātkāyavinirmuktastvaṃ bhaviṣyasi sarvadā || 16 || evamuktvā tato dīrghaṃ bhartuḥ kopaparāyaṇā || tyaktvā pārśvaṃ gatā rājannarbudaṃ nagasattamam|| 17 || sutārthaṃ sā tapastepe yatavākkāyamānasā || tato varṣasahasrānte devadevo maheśvaraḥ ||918 || indrādyairvibudhaiḥ sārddhaṃ tadaṃtikamupāgamat|| atha śakro vinītātmā devīṃ tā pratyabhāṣata || 19 || eṣa devaḥ śivaḥ prāptastava pārśvaṃ svalajjayā || nāyāti tatprasādo'sya kriyatā mahatī bhava || 7.3.52.20 || || devyuvāca || || tyaktā'haṃ tava vākyena patinā samayānvitā || putraṃ labdhvā prayāsyāmi tasya pārśve sureśvara || 21 || tasyāstaṃ niścayaṃ jñātvā svayaṃ devaḥ samāyayau || abravītprahasanvākyaṃ prasādaḥ kriyatāmiti || 22|| dṛṣṭidānena deveśi bhāṣaṇena varānane || mayā devahitaṃ kāryaṃ sarvāvasthāsu pārvati || 23 || akāle tena muktā'si nivṛttiḥ surate kṛtā || putrārthaṃ te samāraṃbho yataścāsītsureśvari || 24 || tasmātte bhavitā putro nijadehasamudbhavaḥ || matprasādādasaṃdigdhaṃ caturthe divase priye || 25 || nijāṃgamalamādāya yādṛgrūpaṃ sureśvari || kariṣyasi na sandehastādṛgeva bhaviṣyati || 26 || sadyo devagaṇānāṃ ca daityānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || tathā vai sarvamarttyānāṃ siddhido bahurūpadhṛk || 27 || evamuktā trinetreṇa parituṣṭā sureśvarī || ālāpaṃ patinā cakre sārddhaṃ harṣasamanvitā || 28 || caturthe divase prāpte tataḥ snātvā śivā nṛpa || tadodvarttanajaṃ lepaṃ gṛhītvā kautukātkila || caturbhujaṃ cakārā'tha haravākyādvināyakam || 29 || tataḥ sajīvatāṃ prāpya haravākyena taṃ tadā || viśeṣeṇa mahārāja nāyako'sau kṛtaḥ kṣitau || sarveṣāṃ caiva martyānāṃ tataḥ khyāto babhūva ha || 7.3.52.30 || vināyaka iti śrīmānpūjyastrailokyavāsinām || sarveṣāṃ devamukhyānāṃ babhūva hi vināyakaḥ || 31 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve devīpriyahite ratāḥ || tasmai dadurvarāndivyānprocurdevīṃ ca pārthiva || 32 || || || devā ūcuḥ || || tavāyaṃ tanayo devi sarveṣāṃ naḥ puraḥsaraḥ || prathamaṃ pūjite cāsminpūjā grāhyā tataḥ suraiḥ || 33 || etacchṛṃgaṃ gire ramyaṃ tava saṃsevanācchubhe || sarvapāpaharaṃ nṛṇāṃ darśanācca bhaviṣyati || 34 || ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyanti supuṇye salilāśraye || te yāṃsyaṃti paraṃ sthānaṃ jarāmaraṇavarjitam || 35 || māghamāse tṛtīyāyāṃ śuklāyāṃ ye samāhitāḥ || saptajanmāṃtarāṇyeva bhaviṣyanti sukhānvitāḥ || 36 || evamuktvā surāḥ sarve svasthānaṃ tu tato gatāḥ || devo'pi sahito devyā kailāsaṃ parvataṃ gataḥ || 37 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍa īśānīśikharamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 || || cha ||
<7.3.53>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchedbrahmapadaṃ tīrthaṃ trailokyaviśrutam || yatra pūrvaṃ padaṃ nyastaṃ brahmaṇā lokakāriṇā || 1 || purā brahmādayo devāstatra sarve samāhitāḥ || arbude parvate ramya ṛṣayaśca sunirmalāḥ || 2 || acaleśvarayātrāyāṃ subhaktyā bhāvitā nṛpa || atha te munayaḥ sarve procurdevaṃ pitāmaham || 3 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || prabhūtaniyamairhomairvratasnānaiśca nityaśaḥ || upavāsaiśca nirviṇṇā vayaṃ sarve pitāmaha || 4 || tasmātsadupadeśaṃ tvaṃ kiṃciddātumihārhasi || tarāmo yena deveśa durgaṃ saṃsārasāgaram || 5 || ayācitopacāraiśca japahomaiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ || mantrairvrataistathā dānaiḥ svargaprāptiṃ vadasva naḥ || 6 || teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā tadā devaḥ kṛpānvitaḥ || ciṃtayāmāsa suciramiha kiṃcitprahasya ca ||7|| tataḥ svakaṃ padaṃ tyaktvā ramye parvatarodhasi || athovāca munīnsarvānbrahmā saṃślakṣṇayā girā || 8 || || brahmovāca || || etanmahāpadaṃ ramyaṃ sarvapātakanāśanam || spṛśaṃtu ṛṣayaḥ sarve tato yāsyatha sadgatim || ||9|| vinā snānena dānena vratahomajapādibhiḥ|| hitārthaṃ sarvalokānāṃ mayā nyastaṃ padaṃ śubham||7.3.53.10|| asminpade mayā nyaste yāṃti lokāḥ sahasraśaḥ|| spṛśaṃtu ṛṣayaḥ sarve devāścāpi padaṃ mama || 11 || ekaivātra prakarttavyā śraddhā vā'vyabhicāriṇī || yaśca śraddhānvitaḥ samyakpadametanmunīśvarāḥ || 12 || pūjayiṣyati saṃprāpte kārtike pūrṇimādine || toyaiḥ phalaiśca vividhairgaṃdhamālyānulepanaiḥ || 13 || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā tu miṣṭānnena svaśaktitaḥ || sa yāsyati na sandeho mama lokaṃ sudurlabham || 14 || || pulastya uvāca || || tato munigaṇāḥ sarve samyakchraddhāsamanvitāḥ || pūjayitvā padaṃ tatra brahmalokaṃ samāgatāḥ || 15 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena padaṃ pūjyaṃ narottama || pitāmahapadaṃ samyakchraddhayā svargadāyakam|| 16 || anyatkautūhalaṃ rājanmahaddṛṣṭaṃ mahādbhutam || padasya tasya yacchrutvā jāyate vismayo mahān || 17 || āyāmavistareṇā'pi prāpte kṛtayuge nṛpa || na saṃkhyā jāyate rājañchuklavarṇasya mānavaiḥ || 18 || tatastretāyuge prāpte raktavarṇaṃ pradṛśyate || suvyaktaṃ saṃkhyayā yuktaṃ sarvalokanamaskṛtam || 19 || dvāpare kapilaṃ tacca laghumātraṃ pradṛśyate || kalau kṛṣṇaṃ susūkṣmaṃ ca ramye parvatarodhasi || 7.3.53.20 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe brahmapadotpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tripañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 53 || || cha ||
<7.3.54>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tatastripuṣkaraṃ gacchedabhīṣṭaṃ padmajasya ca || brahmaṇā tatsamānītaṃ parvate'rbudasaṃjñake || 1 || vasiṣṭhasya purā satre varttamāne narādhipa || tasminnage samāyātā brahmādyāśca surottamāḥ || 2 || pratijñātaṃ mahārāja brahmaṇā'vyaktajanmanā || yāvatsthāsye nṛloke'smiṃstāvatsandhyāṃ tripuṣkare || vaṃdayiṣyāmi saṃprāpte saṃdhyākāle samāhitaḥ || 3 || etasminneva kāle tu prasthitaḥ puṣkaraṃ prati || saṃdhyārthaṃ padmajo yāvadvasiṣṭhastāvadabravīt || 4 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || karmakālaśca samprāpto yajñe'sminsurasattama || sa vinā na tvayā deva siddhiṃ yāsyati karhicit || 5|| tasmādānaya cātraiva padmayone tripuṣkaram || saṃdhyopāstiṃ tataḥ kṛtvā tatra bhūyaḥ sureśvara || brahmatvaṃ kuru deveśa satre cāsmindayānidhe || 6 || evamukto vasiṣṭhena brahmā loka pitāmahaḥ || dhyātvā tatrānayāmāsa jyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhikam || puṣkaratritayaṃ cāgātsupuṇye salilāśaye || 7 || tataḥprabhṛti saṃjātamarbude'smiṃstripuṣkaram || 8 || tatra yaḥ kārtike māsi paurṇamāsyāṃ samāhitaḥ || snānaṃ karoti dānaṃ ca tasya lokāḥ sanātanāḥ || 9 || tasya cottaradigbhāge sāvitrīkuṇḍamuttamam || snānadānādikaṃ kurvanyatra yāti śubhāṃ gatim || 7.3.54.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe tripuṣkaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣpaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 54 || || cha ||
<7.3.55>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha puṇyaṃ rudrahradaṃ śubham || yatra snāto naro bhaktyā gaṇādhīśatvamāpnuyāt || 1 || purā hatvāṃ'dhakaṃ daityaṃ sagaṇo vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || tataḥ snāto hradaṃ kṛtvā tato rudrahrado'bhavat || 2 || caturddaśyāṃ mahārāja yastatra kurute naraḥ || snānaṃ tasya bhavetpuṇyaṃ sarvatīrthasamudbhavam || 3 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe rudrahradamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 55 || || cha ||
<7.3.56>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha guheśvaramanuttamam || guhāmadhye gataṃ liṃgaṃ siddhaiḥ saṃpūjitaṃ purā || 1 || yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya saṃpūjayati mānavaḥ || taṃtaṃ sa labhate rājanniṣkāmo mokṣamāpnuyāt || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe guheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭpañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||56 ||
<7.3.57>
|| pulastya uvāca || || aviyuktavanaṃ gacchettataḥ pārthivasattama || yasmindṛṣṭe narobhīṣṭairna viyujyeta karhicit ||1|| tatra pūrvaṃ śacī rājanpraviṣṭā duḥkhasaṃyutā || nahuṣeṇa hṛte rājye devendrasya mahātmanaḥ || 2 || tatprabhāvātpunaḥ prāpto viyukto'pi śatakratuḥ || tatastasya varo datto vanasya hi tayā nṛpa || 3 || naro vā yadi vā nārī viyuktā'tra vane śubhe || priyairnivāsa ekasminrātrimekāṃ vasiṣyati || 4 || sa tena labhate saṃgaṃ bhūya eva yathā mayā || priyaiḥ sa labhate vāsamekarātraṃ vasannṛpa || 5 || phaladānaṃ praśaṃsaṃti tatra brāhmaṇasattamāḥ || vaṃdhyānāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa yataḥ putraphalaṃ labhet || 6 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe'viyuktakṣetramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 57 ||
<7.3.58>
|| pulastya uvāca || || umāmāheśvaraṃ gacchettato rājansupuṇyadam|| sthāpitaṃ bhaktiyuktena dhundhumāreṇa yatpurā || 1 || dāṃpatyaṃ pūjayedbhaktyā yastatra manujādhipa || sapta janmāṃtarāṇyeva na sa daurbhāgyamāpnuyāta || 2 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍa umāmāheśvaratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 58 ||
<7.3.59>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato mahaujasaṃ gacchettīrthaṃ pātakanāśanam || yasminsnāto naro rājaṃstejasā yujyate dhruvam || brahmahatyāgninā śakraḥ purā dainyaṃ paraṃ gataḥ || 1 || niḥśrīkastejasā hīno durgandhena samanvitaḥ || parityaktaḥ suraiḥ sarvairviṣādaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 2 || tataḥ papraccha devendro dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ bṛhaspatim || bhagavaṃstejaso vṛddhiḥ kathaṃ syānme yathā purā || 3 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || tīrthayātrāṃ suraśreṣṭha kuruṣva dharaṇītale || tīrthaṃ vinā dhruvaṃ vṛddhistejaso na bhaviṣyati ||4|| tatastīrthānyanekāni bhrāṃtvā śakro narādhipa || krameṇaivārbudaṃ prāptastatra dṛṣṭvā jalāśayam || snānaṃ cakre tataḥ śrānto mahaujāḥ pratyapadyata || 5 || durgandhena vinirmuktastato devaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || uvāca prahasanvākyaṃ śṛṇudhvaṃ sarvadevatāḥ || 6 || ye'tra snānaṃ kariṣyanti prāpte śakrocchraye sadā || āśvine śuklapakṣāṃte te yāsyaṃti parāṃ gatim || suśrīkāśca bhaviṣyaṃti sadā janmanijanmani || 7 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe mahaujasatīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 || || cha ||
<7.3.60>
|| pulastya uvāca || || tato gacchennṛpaśreṣṭha jaṃbūtīrthamanuttamam || tatra snāto naraḥ samyagiṣṭaṃ phalamavāpnuyāt| || jaṃbūdvīpasamutthānāṃ tīrthānāṃ nṛpasattama || 1 || āsītpurā nimirnāma kṣatriyaḥ sūryavaṃśajaḥ || vayasaḥ pariṇāme sa parvataṃ cārbudaṃ gataḥ || 2 || prāyopaveśanaṃ kṛtvā sthitastatra samāhitaḥ || athājagmurmunigaṇāstasya pārśve sahasraśaḥ || 3 || cakrurdharmakathāṃ puṇyāṃ rājarṣīṇāṃ mahātmanām || devarṣīṇāṃ purāṇānāṃ tathānyeṣāṃ mahātmanām || 4 || tataḥ kaścitkathāṃte ca lomaśo nāma sanmuniḥ || kīrttayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ sarvatīrthasamudbhavam || 5 || tacchrutvā pārthivo rājannimiḥ paramadurmanāḥ || babhūva na kṛtaṃ pūrvaṃ yatastīrthāvagāhanam || 6 || tataḥ provāca taṃ vipramastyupāyo dvijottama || kaścidyena ca sarveṣāṃ tīrthānāṃ labhyate phalam || 7 || || || lomaśa uvāca || || dayā me nṛpa sañjātā tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitaṃ bhṛśam || tīrthayātrākṛte yasmātkariṣye'haṃ tava priyam || 8 || atraiva cānayiṣyāmi jaṃbūdvīpodbhavāni ca || sarvatīrthāni rājendra mantraśaktyā na saṃśayaḥ || 9 || snānaṃ kuru mahārāja hyekībhūteṣu tatra ca || asmiñjalāśaye puṇye satyametadbravīmyaham || 7.3.60.10 || evamuktvā sa viprarṣirdhyānaṃ cakre samāhitaḥ || tatastīrthāni sarvāṇi tatrāyātāni tatkṣaṇāt || 11 || pratyayārthaṃ ca rājarṣe jaṃbūvṛkṣo vyajāyata || tatra snānaṃ nṛpaścakre sarvatīrthamaye dhruve || 12 || sadehaśca gataḥ svarge tīrthasnānādanantaram || tataḥ prabhṛti tattīrthaṃ jaṃbūtīrthamanusmṛtam || 13 || kanyāgate ravau tatra yaḥ śrāddhaṃ kurute naraḥ || gayāśīrṣasamaṃ tasya puṇyamāhurmaharṣayaḥ || 14 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṇḍe jaṃbūtīrthaprabhāvavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 60 || | cha || ||
<7.3.61>
|| pulastya uvāca || || gaṃgādharaṃ tato gacchetsupuṇyaṃ vimalodakam || yena gaṃgā dhṛtā rājannipatantī nabhastalāt || 1 || āhūtā deva devena hyacaleśvararūpiṇā || hareṇa rabhasā rājanyatpurā kathitaṃ tava || 2 || tatra yaḥ kurute snānamaṣṭamyāṃ ca samāhitaḥ || sa gacchetparamaṃ sthānaṃ devai rapi sudurlabham || 3 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīya'rbudakhaṇḍe gaṃgādharatīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 61 || || cha ||
<7.3.62>
|| pulastyasya uvāca || || tataḥ kaṭeśvaraṃ gacchelliṃgaṃ gaurīvinirmitam || tathā gaṃgeśvaraṃ cānyadgaṅgayā nirmitaṃ svayam || 1 || purā samabhavadyuddhamumāyāḥ saha gaṃgayā || saubhāgyaṃ prati rājendra tato gaurītyabhāṣata || 2 || yayā saṃpūjitaḥ śaṃbhuḥ śīghraṃ yāsyati darśanam || sā saubhāgyavatī nūnabhāvayoḥ saṃbhaviṣyati || 3 || evamuktā tato gaṃgā satvaraityātra parvate || liṃgamanveṣayāmāsa cirakālādavāpa sā || 4 || dṛṣṭvā gauryātha kaṭakaṃ parvatasya manoharam || liṃgākāraṃ mahārāja pūjayāmāsa sā tadā || 5 || samyakchraddhāsamopetā tatastuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || pradadau darśanaṃ tasyā varado'smīti cābravīt || 6 || || gauryuvāca || || sāpatnyajerṣyayā deva mayā liṃgaṃ prakalpitam || tasmātkaṭeśvarākhyā ca loke cāsya bhaviṣyati || 7 || yā nārī patinā muktā sapatnīduḥkhaduḥkhitā || asya saṃdarśanādeva sā bhaviṣyati vijvarā || sutasaubhāgyasaṃpannā bhartṛprāṇasamā tathā || 8 || gaṃgayārādhito deva evameva varaṃ dadau || tasmālliṃgadvayaṃ tacca draṣṭavyaṃ manujādhipa || 9 || viśeṣataśca nārībhiḥ sapatnīdoṣahānidam || sukhasaubhāgyadaṃ nityaṃ tathā'bhīṣṭapradaṃ nṛṇām || 7.3.62.10 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe kaṭeśvaragaṃgeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62||
<7.3.63>
|| pulastya uvāca || || etatte sarvamākhyātaṃ yanmāṃ tvaṃ paripṛcchasi || arbudasya mahārāja māhātmyaṃ hi samāsataḥ || 1 || vistareṇa ca saṃkhyā syādapi varṣaśatairapi || asaṃkhyānīha tīrthāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || padepade gṛhāṇyeva nirmitāni maharṣibhiḥ || 2 || na tattīrthaṃ na sā siddhirna sa vṛkṣo mahīpate || na sā nadī na deveśo yasya tatrāsti na sthitiḥ || 3 || ye vasaṃti mahārāja suramye'rbudaparvate || nūnaṃ te puṇyakarmāṇo na vasaṃti triviṣṭape || 4 || kiṃ tasya jīvitenārthaḥ kiṃ dhanaiḥ kiṃ japairnṛpa || yo na paśyati mandātmā samantādarbudācalam || 5 || api kīṭapataṃgā ye paśavaḥ pakṣiṇo mṛgāḥ || svedajāścāṇḍajāścāpi hyudbhijjāśca jarāyujāḥ || 6 || tasminmṛtā mahārāja niṣkāmāḥ kāmato'pi vā || te yānti śivasāyujyaṃ jarā maraṇavarjitam || 7 || yaścaitacchuṇuyānnityaṃ purāṇaṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || arbudasya mahārāja sa yātrāphalamaśnute || 8 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena yātrāṃ tatra samācaret || ya icchedātmanaḥ siddhimiha loke paratra ca || 9 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīye'rbudakhaṃḍe'rbudakhaṇḍamāhātmyaphalaśrutivarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe tṛtīyamarbudakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam || 7.3 ||
<7.4.1>
||||śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ || || atha skāṃde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthaṃ dvārakāmāhātmyam || || śaunaka uvāca || || kathaṃ sūta yuge hyasminraudre vai kalisaṃjñake || bahupākhaṃḍasaṃkīrṇe prāpsyāmo madhusūdanam || 1 || yugatraye vyatikrānte dharmācārapare sadā || prāpte kaliyuge ghore kva viṣṇurbhagavāniti || 2 || || sūta uvāca || || divaṃ yāte mahārāje rāme daśarathātmaje || duṣṭarājanyabhāreṇa pīḍite dharaṇītale || 3 || devānāṃ kāryasiddhyarthaṃ bhūbhāraharaṇāya ca || vasudevagṛhe sākṣādāvirbhūte janārdane || 4 || naṃdavrajaṃ gate deve pūtanāśoṣaṇe sati || ghātite ca tṛṇāvarte śakaṭe parivartite || || 5 || damite kāliye nāge pralaṃbe ca niṣūdite || dhṛte govardhane śaile paritrāte ca gokule || 6 || surabhyā cābhiṣikte tu indre ca vimadīkṛte || rāsakrīḍārate deve dārite keśidānave || 7 || akrūravacanāddeve mathurāyāṃ gate harau || hate kuvalayāpīḍe mallarāje ca ghātite || 8 || paśyatāṃ deva daityānāṃ bhojarāje nipātite || yadupuryāmabhiṣikta ugrasene narādhipe || 9 || jarāsaṃdhabale raudre yavane ca hate kṣitau || rājasūye kratuvare caidye caiva nipātite || 7.4.1.10 || nivṛtte bhārate yuddhe bhāre ca kṣapite bhuvaḥ || yātrāvyājasamānīte prabhāsaṃ yādave kule || 11 || madyapānaprasakte tu parasparavadho dyate || kalahenātiraudreṇa vinaṣṭe yādave kule || 12 || gātraṃ saṃtyajya cātraiva gate'naṃte dharātalāt || aśvatthamūlalamāśritya samāsīne janārdane || || 13 || vyādhaprahārabhinnāṃge parityakte kalevare || svadhāmasaṃsthite deve pārthe ca punarāgate || 14 || yadupuryyāṃ plāvitāyāṃ sāgareṇa samaṃtataḥ || śakraprasthaṃ tato gatvā kārayitvā harergṛham || 15 || dvāpare ca vyatikrāṃte dharmādharmavimiśrite || saṃprāpte ca mahāraudre yuge vai kalisaṃjñite || 16 || kṣīyamāṇe ca saddharme vidharme prabale tathā || naṣṭadharmakriyāyoge vedavādabahiṣkṛte || ekapāde sthite dharme varṇāśramavivarjite || 17 || asminyuge vilulite hyṛṣayo vanacāriṇaḥ || sametyāmaṃtrayansarve gargacyavanabhārgavāḥ || 18 || asito devalo dhaumyaḥ kraturuddālakastathā || ete cānye ca bahavaḥ parasparamathābruvan || 19 || paśyadhvaṃ munayaḥ sarve kalivyāptaṃ digaṃtaram || samaṃtātparidhāvadbhirdasyubhirbādhyate prajā || 7.4.1.20 || adharmaparamaiḥ puṃbhiḥ satyārjavanirākṛtaiḥ || kathaṃ sa bhagavānviṣṇuḥ saṃprāpyo munisattamāḥ || 21 || ko vā bhavābdhau patatastārayiṣyati saṃgatān || na kalau saṃbhavastasya triyugo madhusūdanaḥ || taṃ vinā puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ kathaṃ syāma kalau yuge || 22 || teṣāṃ ciṃtayatāmevaṃ duḥkhitānāṃ tapasvinām || uvāca vacanaṃ tatra ṛṣiruddālakastadā|| 23|| uddālaka uvāca || yāvanna kalidoṣeṇa lipyāmo munisattamāḥ || apāpā brahmasadanaṃ gacchāmaḥ parisaṃgatāḥ || 24 || pṛcchāmo lokadhātāraṃ sthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ kalau yuge || yadi viṣṇuḥ kalau na syādrudreṇa brahmaṇā'saha || 25 || taṃ vinā puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ tyakṣyāmaḥ svakalevaram || vinā bhagavatā loke kaḥ sthāsyati kalau yuge || 26 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || sādhusādhviti te coktvā prasthitā brahmaṇoṃ'tikam|| 27 || kathayantaḥ kathāṃ viṣṇoḥ svarūpamanuvarṇanam || tāpasāḥ prayayuḥ sarve saṃhṛṣṭā brahmaṇoṃ'tikam || ||28|| dadṛśuste tadā devamāsīnaṃ paramāsane || pitāmahabhūtagaṇairmūrtāmūrtairvṛtaṃ tathā || 29 || dṛṣṭvā caturmukhaṃ devaṃ daṃḍavatpraṇatāḥ kṣitau || pra ṇamya devadevaṃ tu stotreṇa tuṣuvustadā || 7.4.1.30 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || namaste padmasaṃbhūta caturvaktrākṣayāvyaya || namaste sṛṣṭikartre tu pitāmaha namo'stu te ||31|| evaṃ stutaḥ sanmunibhiḥ suprītaḥ kamalodbhavaḥ || pādyārghyeṇābhivandyaitānpapraccha munipuṃgavān || 32 || || brahmovāca || kimāgamanakṛtyaṃ vo brūta tattvena putrakāḥ || kuśalaṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ putraśiṣyāgnibandhuṣu || 33 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || bhavatprasādātsakalaṃ prāptaṃ nastapasaḥ phalam || yadbhavaṃtaṃ prapaśyāmaḥ sarvadevaguruṃ prabhum || 34 || śṛṇvetatkāraṇaṃ śaṃbho ete prāptāstavāṃtikam || yugatraye vyatikrāṃte kṛtādidvāparāṃtake || 35 || prāpte kaliyuge ghore kva viṣṇuḥ pṛthivītale || yaṃ dṛṣṭvā paramāṃ muktiṃ yāsyāmo muktabandhanāḥ || 36 || || brahmovāca || || matsyakūrmādirūpaiśca bhagavāñjñāyate mayā || viṣṇoḥ pāramikāṃ mūrtiṃ na jānāmi dvijottamāḥ || 37 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || yadi tvaṃ na vijānāsi tāta viṣṇoravasthitim || gatvā prayāgaṃ tatraiva saṃtyakṣyāmaḥ kalevaram || 38 || || brahmovāca || || mā viṣādaṃ vrajadhvaṃ hi upadekṣyāmi vo hitam || ito vrajadhvaṃ pātālaṃ yatrāste daityasattamaḥ || 39 || taṃ gatvā paripṛcchadhvaṃ prahlādaṃ daityasattamam || sa jñāsyati hareḥ sthānaṃ yāthātathyena bho dvijāḥ ||7.4.1.40|| tacchutvā vacanaṃ tasya brahmaṇaḥ paramātmanaḥ || praṇipatya ca deveśaṃ prasthitāste tapodhanāḥ || 41 || jagmuḥ saṃhṛṣṭamanasaḥ stuvanto daityasattamam || dhanyaḥ sa daityarājo'yaṃ yo jānāti janārddanam || 42 || iti saṃciṃtayānāste prāptā vai sutalaṃ dvijāḥ ||43|| gatvā te tasya nagaraṃ viviśurbhavanottamam || dūrādeva sa tāndṛṣṭvā balirvairocanistadā || pratyutthāyārhayāñcakre prahlādena samanvitaḥ || 44 || madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ caiva dattvā cārghyaṃ tathaiva ca || uvāca prāṃjalirbhūtvā prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā|| 45|| svāgataṃ vo mahābhāgāḥ suvyuṣṭā rajanī mama|| bhavato yatprapaśyāmi brūta kiṃ karavāṇi ca|| 46|| evaṃ hi daityarājena satkṛtāste dvijottamāḥ|| ūcuḥ prahṛṣṭamanaso dānavendrasutaṃ tadā|| 47|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kāryārthinastu saṃprāptāḥ prahlāda harivallabha || tadasmākaṃ mahābāho bhavāṃstrātā bhavārṇavāt || 48 || kathaṃ daitya yuge hyasminraudre vai kalisaṃjñake || bhaviṣyāmo vinā viṣṇuṃ bhītānāmabhayapradam || 49 || asminyuge hyadharmeṇa jito dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || anṛtena jitaṃ satyaṃ viprāśca vṛṣalairjitāḥ || 7.4.1.50 || viṭairjitā vedamārgāḥ strībhiśca puruṣā jitāḥ || brāhmaṇāścāpi vadhyante mleccha rājanyarūpibhiḥ || 51 || asminvilulitaprāye varṇāśramavivarjite || avilupte vedamārge kva viṣṇurbhagavāniti || 52 || vinā jñānādvinā dhyānādvinā ceṃdriyanigrahāt || prāpyate bhagavānyatra tadguhyaṃ kathayasva naḥ ||53|| daityarāja tvamasmākaṃ suhṛnmārgapradarśakaḥ || kathayasva mahābhāga yatra tiṣṭhati keśavaḥ || 54 || evaṃ sa dvijamukhyaiśca saṃpṛṣṭo daityasattamaḥ || praṇamya brāhmaṇānsarvānbhaktyā saṃhṛṣṭamānasaḥ || 55 || sa namaskṛtya devebhyo brahmaṇe paramātmane || bhagavadbhaktiryuktaḥ sanvyāharttumupacakrame || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kalibhītamaharṣibhirbrahmavacanātprahlādasaṃnidhau kaliyuge bhagavatsthitiviṣaye praśnakaraṇavarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 || cha ||
<7.4.2>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || sarveṣāmapi bhūtānāṃ daityadānavarakṣasām || bhavanto vai pūjyatamā devādīnāṃ tathaiva ca ||1|| anujñayā tu yuṣmākaṃ prasādātkeśavasya hi || adhiṣṭhānaṃ bhagavataḥ kathayāmi nibodhata || 2 || paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya tiṣṭhati || kuśasthalīti yā pūrvaṃ kuśena sthāpitā purī || 3 || vahate gomatī yatra sāgareṇa samaṃtataḥ || dvārāvatīti sā viprā ānartteṣu prakīrttitā || 4 || tasyāṃ vasati viśvātmā sarvakāmaprado hariḥ || kalā ṣoḍaśasaṃyukto mūrtiṃ dvādaśakānvitaḥ|| 5 || tadeva paramaṃ dhāma tadeva paramaṃ padam || dvārakā sā ca vai dhanyā yatrā''ste madhusūdanaḥ || 6 || yatra kṛṣṇaścaturbāhuḥ śaṃkhacakragadādharaḥ || narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti tatra gatvā kalau yuge || 7 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya prahlādasya mahātmanaḥ || vismayāviṣṭamanasastamūcurmunisattamāḥ || 8 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kṣayaṃ yadukule yāte bhāre copahṛte bhuvaḥ || prabhāse yādavaśreṣṭhaḥ svasthānamagamaddhariḥ || 9 || dvārāvatyā plāvitāyāṃ samaṃtātsāgareṇa hi || kathaṃ sa bhagavāṃstatra kalau daitya prakīrtyate || 7.4.2.10 || kathayasva suraśreṣṭha kathaṃ viṣṇurmahītale || sthitaścānarttaviṣaya etadvistarato vada|| 11|| ugrasene narapatau praśāsati vasundharām || kṛṣṇo yadupurīmetāṃ śobhayāmāsa sarvataḥ ||12|| ramamāṇe ramānāthe rāmābhiramaṇe harau || ekadā tu samāsīne sabhāyāṃ yadusattame 13 || kathābhiḥ kriyamāṇābhirvicitrābhiranekadhā || uddhavaḥ kathayāmāsa pracāraṃ yadunaṃdanam || 14 || yātrāyāmanusaṃprāptaṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam || sthitaṃ taṃ gomatītīre cakratīrthasamīpataḥ || 15 || tacchrutvā sahasotthāya bhagavānrukmiṇīgṛham || jagāma hṛṣṭamanasā viśvaśaktiradhokṣajaḥ || 16 || āgatyovāca vaidarbhīṃ saṃprāptamṛṣisattamam || taponirdhūta pāpmā'yamatriputro mahātapāḥ || 17 || ātithyenārcito vipro dāsyate ca mahodayam|| gṛhiṇī na gṛhe yasya satpātrāgamanaṃ vṛthā || 18 || tasya devā na gṛhṇaṃti pitaraśca tathodakam|| tadāgacchasva gacchāmo nimaṃtrayitumatrijam || 19 || tathetyuktvā tu sā devī rathamāruruhe satī || rathamāruhya deveśo rukmiṇyā sahito hariḥ || jagāma tatra yatrāste durvāsā munisattamaḥ || 7.4.2.20 || dṛṣṭvā jvalaṃtaṃ tapasā kūle nadanadīpateḥ || kāpālikasya purataḥ susnātaṃ varasīkaraiḥ || 21 || praṇamya bhagavānbhaktyā papracchā'nāmayaṃ tataḥ || paścādvidarbhatanayā rukmiṇī praṇanāma tam || 22 || durvāsāścāpi tau dṛṣṭvā darśanārthamupāgatau || papraccha kuśalaṃ tatra svāgatenābhinaṃdya ca ||23|| || durvāsā uvāca || || kuśalaṃ kṛṣṇa sarvatra kutra vāsastavā'dhunā || kati dārā dhanāpatyametadvistarato vada || 24 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || samudreṇa pradattā me bhūbhirdvādaśayojanā || tasyāṃ nivasato brahmanpurī hemamayī mama || 25 || prāsādāstatra sauvarṇā navalakṣāṇi saṃkhyayā || tasyāṃ vasāmi saṃhṛṣṭastvatprasādātsunirbhayaḥ || 26 || tacchutvā vacanaṃ tasya vismayāviṣṭamānasaḥ || pratyuvāca sa durvāsāḥ prahasya madhusūdanam||27|| vasaṃti tāvakā ye ca teṣāṃ saṃkhyā vadasva bhoḥ || yāvatyaśca mahiṣyaste putrāḥ parijanāstathā ||28|| || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || brahmanṣoḍaśasāhasraṃ bhāryyāścāṣṭādhikā mama|| tāsāṃ madhye'bhīṣṭatamā vidarbhādhipateḥ sutā || 29 || ekaikasyā daśa sutāḥ kanyā caikā tathā mune || ṣaṭpaṃcāśadyadūnāṃ tu koṭyaḥ parijano mama|| 7.4.2.30 || śeṣāḥ prakṛtayo brahmaṃsteṣāṃ saṃkhyā na vidyate || tacchrutvā ciṃtayāmāsa kimetaditi vismitaḥ || 31 || aho hyanaṃtavīryasya māyāmāśritya tiṣṭhataḥ || anaṃtā sarvakartṛtve pravṛttirdṛśyatāmiya m||32|| || durvāsā uvāca || || svāgataṃ te mahābāho brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || darśanena tvadīyena prītimeti ca me manaḥ||33|| || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca|| || yadi prasanno bhagavāṃstadāgacchasva me gṛham|| śirasā dhāryya pādāṃbu prayāsyāmi pavitratām|| 34|| durvāsā uvāca|| akṣamāsārasarvasvaṃ kiṃ māṃ nayasi mādhava|| naya māṃ yadi madvākyaṃ karoṣi saha bhāryayā||35|| prahlāda uvāca|| evamastviti coktvā sa prasthitaḥ svarathena hi| taṃ dṛṣṭvā prasthitaṃ viṣṇuṃ prahasyovāca bhartsayan|| 36 || || durvāsā uvāca || || durvāsasaṃ na jānāsi muñcemānhayasattamān || tvaṃ ca bhāryā tathā ceyaṃ vahataṃ svarathena mām || 37 || ||śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || bhagavanyathā prabravīṣi vipra kartāsmi tattathā || tvayā kṛpālunā brahmanpārito'haṃ sabāṃdhavaḥ|| 38 || || prahlāda uvāca|| || tau tathā ṛṣivaryyo'sau yuktāṃ devīṃ rathe svake || tathaiva puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ yāhi yāhītyabhāṣata|| 39 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā devatāḥ sarvā vahamānaṃ rathaṃ harim || sādhusādhviti bhāṣaṃta ūcuḥ sarve parasparam || 7.4.2.40 || aho brahmaṇyadevasya parāṃ bhaktiṃ prapaśyata || skandhe kṛtvā dhuraṃ yo hi vahate bhāryyayā saha || 41 || vikīryamāṇaḥ kusumaiḥ surasaṃghairjanārdanaḥ || jagāma sa rathaṃ gṛhya sabhāryo dvārakāṃ prati || || 42 || uhyamāne rathe tasminrukmiṇī tṛṣitā'bhavat || uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ vaidarbhī śramavyākulalocanā || 43 || śrāntā bhāraparikliṣṭā vahatī kopanaṃ dvijam || pāyayitvodakaṃ kānta naya māṃ mandiraṃ svakam || 44 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyāḥ pādākrāntyā dharātalāt || ānayāmāsa bhagavāngagāṃ tripathagāṃ śubhām || 45 || taddṛṣṭvā nirmalaṃ śītaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ pāvanaṃ tathā || papau pipāsitā devī rukmiṇī jāhnavījalam || 46|| pītaṃ tayā jalaṃ dṛṣṭvā cukopa ṛṣisattamaḥ || jajvāla jvalanaprakhyaḥ śaśāpa parameśvarīm || 47 || || durvāsā uvāca || māmapṛṣṭvā jalaṃ yasmātpītavatyasi rukmiṇī|| tasmātpānaratā nityaṃ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ|| 48|| aviyuktā rathādyasmānmāmapṛṣṭvā jalaṃ tvayā|| pītaṃ tasmācca kṛṣṇena viyuktā tvaṃ bhaviṣyasi || 49 || || prahlāda uvāca || || etāvaduktvā vacanaṃ krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || parityajya rathaṃ vipro bhūmāvevāvatiṣṭhati || 7.4.2.50 || evaṃ śaptā tadā devī rudodātīva vihvalā || uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ karuṇaṃ kathaṃ sthāsye tvayā vinā || 51 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || āyāsye pratyahaṃ devi dvikālaṃ bhavanaṃ tava || yo māṃ paśyati cātrasthaṃ sa tvāmeva prapaśyati || 52 || māṃ hi dṛṣṭvā naro yastu tvāṃ na paśyati bhaktitaḥ || arddhṃ yātrā phalaṃ tasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 53 || āśvāsya ca priyāmevaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ yadunandanaḥ || tataḥ prasādayāmāsa durvāsasamakalmaṣam || 54 || bāhyo pavanamadhye tu pūjayāmāsa taṃ tathā || avanijya svayaṃ pādau viprapādāvanejanam || dhārayāmāsa śirasā jagataḥ pāvano hariḥ || 55 || dattvārghyaṃ gāṃ ca viprāya madhuparkaṃ sa bhaktitaḥ || vidhivadbhojayāmāsa ṣaḍrasena dvijottamam || 56 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye durvāso dvārakānayana durvāsodatta rukmiṇīśāpavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyo'dhyāyaḥ||2||
<7.4.3>
ṛṣaya ūcuḥ|| aho brahmaṇyadevasya kṛṣṇasyāmitatejasaḥ || mahimā yadayaṃ naiva mṛṣā cakre munervacaḥ || 1 || tena cakre na roṣaṃ sa setupālo janārdanaḥ || bhṛgoryaścaraṇāghātaṃ dadhāra hṛdi lāñchanam || 2 || sā tu devī kathaṃ tena preyasā viprayojitā || ekākinī sthitā tatra kathyatāmasureśvara || 3 || utkaṇṭhitā ati vayaṃ śrotuṃ dvāravatīṃ mudā || idamādau bubhutsāmaścittakhedāpanuttaye || 4 || || prahlāda uvāca || ||| śrūyatāmṛṣayaḥ sarve gadato mama vistarāt || yathā śāpodbhavaṃ duḥkhaṃ mumoca harivallabhā ||5|| atha durvāsasaḥ śāpamavāpyāruntudaṃ tadā|| yādavendrasya gṛhiṇī sahasā paryadevayat ||6|| || || rukmiṇyuvāca || || kalyāṇī bata vāṇīyaṃ laukikī saṃvibhāvyate || kūpake caiva sindhau ca pramāṇānnādhikaṃ jalam || 7 || yāsāhaṃ bhūribhāgyā vai prāpya nāthaṃ jagatpatim|| iyamekākinī jātā paulastyāddevahelanāt || 8 || kva maṃgalālayaḥ śrīmānanavadyaguṇo hariḥ || alpapuṇyā susaṃbādhā kāminī kvāticañcalā || 9 || tathāpi ghaṭayāmāsa dhātā vaṃcanakovidaḥ || vidhānamaśubhāyā me viyogaviṣamavyatham || 7.4.3.10 || anyathā varṇaguravaḥ snātāstraividyavartmani || kathaṃ nu śaptumarhanti svayaṃ khinnāmanāgasam || 11 || vidadhe vajramayaṃ tu kiṃ nvidaṃ hṛdayaṃ me'tikaṭhorameva hi || śatadhā na vidīryate yato virahe durviṣahe madhudviṣaḥ || 12 || adhikṛtya suduścaraṃ tapaḥ pratilabdhaḥ prathamaṃ mayātmajaḥ || tanayena vinākṛtā'pyahaṃ na mṛtā paṃcasu vāsareṣviha || 13 || upalabhya sudāruṇāmimāmapi pīḍāmavitāsmyahaṃ tadā || yadidaṃ vidhunoti kalmaṣaṃ khalu tanmāṃ samupetya lakṣavṛddhim || 14 || iti sā'tivilapya duḥkhitārthā kurarītulyatayā śuśoca vegāt || viraheṇa vighūrṇitāśayā dvijaśāpāpahatā mumūrccha sadyaḥ || 15 || atha durvāsasā śaptā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā || mūrcchanāmāpa tatraiva hyājagāma payonidhiḥ || 16 || sudhāśīkaragarbheṇa padmakiṃjalkavāyunā || nyavījayadimāṃ devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām|| 17 || etasminnantare tatra vyomamārgeṇa nāradaḥ || gāyanguṇānbhagavato vīṇāpāṇiḥ samāgataḥ || 18 || sa dṛṣṭvā siṃdhunā''śvāsyamānāṃ viśvasya mātaram || avatīrya śrutakatho bodhayāmāsa nāradaḥ || 19 || || nārada uvāca || || mā khedaṃ deva deveśi devi tvadadhipe patau || dūrīkṛte vipraśāpātkuru kalyāṇi dhīratām || 7.4.3.20 || tvaṃ hi sākṣādbhagavatī kṛṣṇaśca puruṣottamaḥ || avatīrṇo dharābhāramapanetuṃ yadṛcchayā || 21 || devo hyasau paraṃ brahma sadā'nirviṇṇamānasaḥ || māyāśaktistvametasya sargasthityantakāriṇaḥ || 22 || saṃhṛtya nikhilaṃ śete yayā'sau kalayā svarāṭ || tadāpi na viyujyeta tvayā viśvapatiḥ prabhuḥ || 23 || aviyuktastvayā nityaṃ devadevo jagatpatiḥ || līlāvatāreṣvetasya sarveṣu tvaṃ sahāyinī || 24 || yogaṃ viyogaṃ ca tathā na yātyeṣa tvayā'naghe || viḍaṃbayati bhūtānāmupakārāya ceśvaraḥ || 25 || ārādhanīyāḥ satataṃ bhūdevā bhūtimīpsatā || prakopanīyā naivaite tattvajñā hi tapasvinaḥ || 26 || ityevaṃ śikṣayam̐llokaṃ viyogaṃ te'numanyate || muni śāpāddhariḥ sākṣādgūḍhaḥ kapaṭamānuṣaḥ || 27|| api smarasi kalyāṇi jāto raghukule svayam|| lokānugrahamanvicchanbhūbhāraharaṇotsukaḥ || 28 || taṃ hariṃ jagatāmīśaṃ rukmiṇi tvaṃ na vetsi kim|| prāṇebhyo'pi garīyāṃsamayaṃ devaḥ sa eva hi || 29 || yenedaṃ pūritaṃ viśvaṃ bahirantaśca suvrate || asaṃgasya vibhoḥ saṃgaḥ kathaṃ syāditi manmatiḥ || 7.4.3.30 || tayā tvayā niyukto'sāviti pratyemi sarvaśaḥ || tadvimuñcā''dhimatyarthamātmānamanusaṃsmara|| prasīda mātaḥ saṃdhehi dhīratāṃ svamanīṣayā || 31 || iti bruvati devarṣāvavasāne nadīpatiḥ || provāca vacanaṃ tasyai vācā mṛdusuvarṇayā || 32 || || || samudra uvāca || || yadāha devi devarṣirnatvā tvāṃ satyameva tat || gīyase tvaṃ hi vedeṣu nityaṃ viṣṇuḥ sahāyinī || 33 || paraḥ pumāneva nirastavigraho gūḍho'dhipaste vidadhāti bhūyaḥ || viśvaṃ vyavasthāpayati svarociṣā tvayā sahāyena bibharti mūrtim || 34 || tadeṣa parikhedaste na manāgapi yujyate || vakṣaḥsthalasthā bhavatī nityaṃ śrīvatsalakṣmaṇaḥ || 35 || iyaṃ bhāgīrathī devī madādeśādupāgatā || vinodayiṣyatyaniśaṃ tvāṃ hi devi śarīriṇī || 36 || etasyāḥ syānmṛdu svādu payaḥ pūropaśobhitam || pradeśo'yamaśeṣo'pi bhavitā tvatsukhapradaḥ || 37 || nānādrumalatākīrṇaṃ nikuṃjairupaśobhitam || mātaṃgaiśca samājuṣṭaṃ maṃjuguṃjanmadhuvratam|| 38 || navapallavabhaṅgībhiḥ kusumastabakaiḥ śubhaiḥ || phalairamṛtakalpaiśca maṃjarī rājibhistathā || 39 || naṃdanasya śriyā juṣṭaṃ manonayananandanam|| vanaṃ ramyataraṃ cātra hyacireṇa bhaviṣyati || 7.4.3.40 || tvayā saṃbodhanīyāḥ sma vayaṃ mātaḥ sadaiva hi || agamyarūpā vidyā tvamasmābhirbodhyase katham || 41 || tadā vāmanujānīhi prasīda parameśvari || namaste viśvajanani bhūyo 'pi ca namonamaḥ || 42 || || prahlāda uvāca || || evamuktvā jagaddhātrīṃ jagmatustau yathāgatam || ājagāma ca tatraiva devī bhāgīrathī svayam || 43 || vanaṃ samabhavattatra divyabhūruhasevitam || sevyaṃ samastalokānāṃ phalapuṣpasamṛddhimat .|| 44 || prasādena ca bhūtānāṃ gaṃgā'śeṣāghahāriṇī || bhūṣayāmāsa taddeśaṃ sā ca viṣṇupadī sarit || 45|| devo ca munivākyena gaṃgāyāśca vinodanāt || saundaryā tasya deśasya kiñcitsvāsthyamavāpa ha || 46 || atha viṣṇupadīṃ devīṃ śrutvā sāgarasaṃgatām || itastataḥ samājagmuḥ śraddadhānāḥ payasvinīm ||47|| dvārakāvāsinaścaiva janāḥ kānanaśobhayā || hṛṣṭacittāḥ samājagmuraniśaṃ rukmiṇīvanam ||48|| śrutvā tadakhilaṃ sarvaṃ durvāsāḥ śāṃbhavī kalā || cukopa smayamānaśca bhūya etadabhāṣata || 49 || || durvāsā uvāca || || kaḥ prabhustriṣu lokeṣu mahyaṃ vacanamanyathā || vidhātumapi devānāmādyo lokapitāmahaḥ || 7.4.3.50 || kiṃ na jānāti loko'yaṃ mayi roṣakaṣāyite || śakraṃ prati tribhuvanaṃ bhraṣṭaśrīkamabhūttadā ||51 || mama śāpamavijñāya nandanapratime vane || kathaṃ sā rukmiṇī tatra ramate janasevite || 52 || tadete taravaḥ sarve saṃtvabhojyaphalā nṛṇām || vibhraṣṭasarvasaubhāgyāḥ kusumastabakojjhitāḥ || 53 || iyaṃ tu śāpanirdagdhā haracūḍāmaṇiḥ sarit || vāryasyāḥ syādapeyaṃ tu naiveha sthātumarhati ||54|| || prahlāda uvāca || || tadā sarvamabhūttatra yadyadāha ca vai muniḥ || vāci vīryaṃ hi viprāṇāṃ nirmitaṃ viṣṇunā svayam || 55 || sā tu devī tathā vṛttamavekṣya bhṛśaduḥkhitā || mene duratyayaṃ daivamāpatattatpunaḥpunaḥ || 56 || tatastu sā viniścitya maraṇaṃ duḥkhabheṣajam || uttarīyāṃbareṇaiva bahiḥ kiñcitprabaddhya tu || |||57|| athāvabudhya tatsarvaṃ sarvabhūtaguhāśayaḥ || tāṃ jñātvā satvaraṃ cā''gātsuparṇena dayānidhiḥ ||58 || dadarśa tādṛśīṃ devīṃ kaṇṭhapāśakarāṃ vibhuḥ || adhastāttaruśākhāyāṃ nimīlitavilocanām || 59 || vibhraṣṭabhūṣaṇagaṇāṃ kṛśadehavallīṃ mlānānanāṃbujarucaṃ maraṇe prasaktām || mene sa vigrahavatīṃ karuṇāṃ kṛpālustāṃ saukhyadāṃ guṇavatīṃ praṇatārtihantrīm || 7.4.3.60 || saṃśrutya sā'pi patagādhipate ravaṃ vai pronmīlya netrakamale'tha dadarśa kṛṣṇam || sāmanyata trikavivartitalocanābjaṃ prāptaṃ tamiṣṭasuhṛdaṃ nijajīvanātham || 61 || sā romaharṣavivaśā trapayā parītā kopānurāgakaluṣā kṛtavipralāpā || saṃvarddhitadviguṇaśokabharā ca devī nānārasaṃ bata dṛśorviṣayaṃ prapede || 62 || tasyāḥ sasādhvasavisargacikīrṣitāyāḥ pāśaṃ vyapohya karacāru saroruheṇa || ādāya pāṇimamṛtopamayā ca vācā saṃjīvayannidamudāramudājahāra || 63 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || kimetatsāhasaṃ bhīru cikīrṣatyavicāritam || nanu devi mamācakṣva kiṃ nu te khedakāraṇam || 64 || tvaṃ vidyā'haṃ paro bodhastvaṃ māyā ceśvarastvaham || tvaṃ ca buddhirahaṃ jīvo viyogaḥ kathamāvayoḥ || 65 || tvayā vimohitātmāno bhrāmyantyajabhavādayaḥ || sā kathaṃ kṣubhyasi tvaṃ tu kiṃ svadhāma na budhyase || 66 || tvayā hi baddhā ṛṣayaste carantīha karmabhiḥ || tāṃ tvāṃ kathamṛṣiḥ śaptuṃ śaknuyādvaravarṇini || 67 || śikṣārthaṃ tviha lokānāmevaṃ me devi ceṣṭitam || manmāyayā samāviṣṭaḥ kurute vivaśaḥ pumān || paśya kopaparītātmā yaḥ sa śānto munīśvaraḥ || 68 || || prahlāda uvāca || || so'bhyetya bhaktinamro'tha durvāsā munisattamaḥ || vicārya manasā sarvaṃ paścāttāpānupāśrayat || 69 || kiṃ mayā kṛtamityuktvā tatsamīpamupāgamat || apatadviluṭhanbhūmau daṇḍavaccāśrusaṃplutaḥ || 7.4.3.70 || pitarau jagato devau kṣāmayāmāsa dīnavat || tuṣṭāva sūktavākyaistu rahasyairbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 71 || āha cedaṃ jagannāthaṃ yadi mayyastyanugrahaḥ || tadā pureva saṃyogo deva devyā vidhīyatām || 72 || atha prahasya govindastamāha munisattamam|| na hi te vacanaṃ jātu mṛṣā bhavitumarhati || 73 || mayaivaṃ vihitaḥ setuḥ kathamucchedyatāṃ dvija || sadbhirācaritaḥ setuḥ siddho lokasya pālakaḥ || 74 || dinedine dvikālaṃ ca āyāsye munisattama || vinodayiṣye tāṃ tāṃ tu munikanyāṃ ca kāmyayā || 75 || tuṣyāmi sādhanairnānyairmatkathākathanairapi || yathā saṃpūjya māmatra mama prītirbhaviṣyati || 76 || yadā ca mayi vai(?)kuṇṭhamadhirūḍhe mahāmune || pravekṣyati tadā tejo mama sarvaṃ trivikrame || 77 || rukmiṇīyaṃ ca manmūrteḥ saṃyogaṃ punareṣyati || iyaṃ bhāgīrathī cāpi sāgareṇa samā guṇaiḥ || tyaktvā hyaśeṣaduḥkhāni sukhaṃ caiva gamiṣyati || 78 || anugrahaṃ vidhāyaivamṛṣiṇā saha keśavaḥ || viveśa svapurīṃ tatra vidhāyopāṃtikaṃ munim || 79 || sāpi devī ca saṃbudhya tadā tasya viceṣṭitam|| anugrahādbhagavato babhūva vigata jvarā || 7.4.3.80 || yataśca muktā duḥkhena tatra devī haripriyā|| tato bhāgīrathī sā tu gaditā duḥkhamocinī || 81 || amāvāsyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ yastasyāḥ saṃgame śubhe || snāyādaśeṣaduḥkhāttu sa naraḥ parimucyate || 82 || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ cāvalokitā || narāṇāṃ rukmiṇī devī sarvānkāmā nprayacchati || 83 || ityetatkathitaṃ devyā ṛṣayo duḥkhamocanam || anugrahaśca devasya kiṃ bhūyaḥ śrotumicchatha || 84 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye rukmiṇīduḥkhamocanavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ ||3|| ||7|||
<7.4.4>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || evaṃ saṃpūjitastena hariṇā brāhmaṇottamaḥ || uvāca parisantuṣṭo varaṃ brūhīti keśavam|| 1 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavanyadi deyo varo mama || sthātavyamatra bhavatā na tyaktavyaṃ kadācana || 2 || || durvāsā uvāca || || yadi tiṣṭhāmyahaṃ kṛṣṇa tathā tvamapi keśava || tiṣṭhasva ṣoḍaśakalo nityaṃ madvacanena hi || 3 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || ye'tra paśyaṃti bhaktyā tvāṃ māṃ cāpi dvijasattama || kiṃ dāsyasi phalaṃ teṣāṃ bhāvināṃ bhagavanvada || 4 || || durvāsā uvāca || || yaḥ snātvā saṃgame kṛṣṇa gomatyāḥ sāgarasya ca || tvāṃ māṃ samarcati naraḥ sarvapāpaiḥ samucyate ||5 || tathānyacchṛṇu kṛṣṇātra snātvā dāsyati yaddhanam || mama dattasya deveśa prāpnuyātṣoḍaśottaram|| 6 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || yo naraḥ pūjayitvā tvāṃ pūjayiṣyati māmiha || tasya muktiṃ pradāsyāmi yā surairapi durllabhā || 7 || || prahlāda uvāca || || parasparaṃ varau dattvā kṛṣṇadurvāsasau mudā|| tataḥ prabhṛti viprendrāstasminsthāne hyatiṣṭhatām|| varadānamiti proktaṃ tattīrthaṃ sarvakāmadam || 8 || varadāne naraḥ snāto gosahasraphalaṃ labhet || viṣṇudurvāsasoryatra varadānamabhūtpurā || 9 || tadāprabhṛti viprendrāstiṣṭhate dvārakāṃ hariḥ || durvāsasā girā baddho na jahāti kadācana || 7.4.4.10 || yatra traivikramī mūrtirvahate yatra gomatī || narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti cakratīrthena saṃgatāḥ || 11 || kalevaraṃ parityaktaṃ prabhāse hariṇā yadā || kalābhiḥ sahitaṃ tejastasyāṃ mūrtau niveśitam || 12 || tasmātkaliyuge viprā nānyatra prāpyate hariḥ || yadi kāryyaṃ hi kṛṣṇena tatra gacchata mā ciram || 13 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sādhu bhāgavataśreṣṭha sādhu mārgapradarśaka || yattvayā hi parijñātaṃ tanna jānāti kaścana || 14 || kiṃ phalaṃ gamane tasyāṃ kiṃ phalaṃ kṛṣṇadarśane || kāni tīrthāni tatraiva ke devāstadvadasva naḥ || 15 || kasminmāse tithau kasyāṃ kasminparvaṇi mānavaiḥ || gantavyaṃ kāni deyāni dānāni danujarṣabha || 16 || ||sūta uvāca || || iti pṛṣṭastadā taistu mahābhāgavato'suraḥ || kathayāmāsa viprebhyo bhagavadbhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 17 || || prahlāda uvāca || || bho bhūmidevāḥ śṛṇuta paraṃ guhyaṃ sanātanam || yatkasyacinna cākhyātaṃ tadvadāmi suvistarāt || 18 || yadā matiṃ ca kurute dvārakāgamanaṃ prati || tadā narakanirmuktā gāyanti pitaro divi || 19 || yāvatpadāni kṛṣṇasya mārge gacchati mānavaḥ || padepade'śvamedhasya yajñasya labhate phalam || 7.4.4.20 || yātrārthaṃ devadevasya yaḥ prerayati cāparān || mānavānnātra sandeho labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || 21 || dvārakāṃ gacchamānasya yo dadāti pratiśrayam || tathaiva madhurāṃ vācaṃ nandate krīḍate hi saḥ || 22 || adhvani śrāṃtadehasya vāhanaṃ yaḥ prayacchati || haṃsayuktena sa naro vimānena divaṃ vrajet || 23 || yātrāyāṃ gacchamānasya madhyāhne kṣudhitasya ca || annaṃ dadāti yo bhaktyā śṛṇu tasyāpi yadbhavet || 24 || gayāśrāddhena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate mānavo bhuvi || annadānena tatpuṇyaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptirakṣayā || 25 || upānahau tu yo dadyāddvārakāṃ prati gacchatām|| kṛṣṇaprasādātsa naro gajaskandhena gacchati || ||26|| vighnamācarate yastu dvārakāṃ prati gacchatām|| narake majjate mūḍhaḥ kalpamātraṃ tu raurave||27|| mārgasthitasya yo dhanyaḥ prayacchati kamaṇḍalum|| prapādānasahasrasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ||28|| yātrāyāṃ gacchamānasya pādabhyaṃgaṃ dadāti yaḥ|| pādaprakṣālanaṃ caiva sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 29 || gāthāṃ śṛṇoti yo viṣṇorgītaṃ ca gāyataḥ pathi || dānaṃ dadāti viprendrāstasmāddhanyataro na hi|| 7.4.4.30|| kailāsaśikharāvāsaṃ śvetābhramiva nirmalam || prāsādaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya yaḥ paśyati narottamaḥ|| 31 || dūrāddhemamayaṃ dṛṣṭvā kalaśaṃ dhvajasaṃyutam|| vāhanaṃ saṃparityajya luṭhate dharaṇīṃ gataḥ || 32 || pañcasūnākṛtaṃ pāpaṃ tathā'dharmakṛtaṃ ca yat || kṛmikīṭapataṃgāśca nihatāḥ pathi gacchatā || parānnaṃ parapānīyamaspṛśya sparśasaṃgamam || tatsarvaṃ nāśamāpnoti bhagavatketudarśanāt || 34|| paṭhennāmasahasraṃ tu stavarājamathāpi vā || gajendramokṣaṇaṃ caiva pathi gacchañchanaiḥ śanaiḥ || 35 || gāyamāno bhagavataḥ prādurbhāvānanekadhā || nṛtyadbhirharṣasaṃyuktairhṛṣyamāṇaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || svayaṃ nṛtyanharṣayukto bhakto gaccheddhareḥ puram || 36 || viṣṇoḥ krīḍākaraṃ sthānaṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam || yasmindṛṣṭe kalau nṝṇāṃ muktirevopajāyate || 37 || || prahlāda uvāca || || pūrvaṃ hi devarājena bṛhaspatirudāradhīḥ || praṇamya parayā bhaktyā pṛṣṭaśca sa mahāmatiḥ || 38 || || indra uvāca || || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ || caturyugaṃ yathābhāgairdharmavṛddhiṃ jano labhet || 39 || etacchrutvā mahendrasya vacanaṃ munisattamāḥ || bṛhaspatiruvācainaṃ mahendraṃ deva saṃvṛtam|| 7.4.4.40 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || kṛtaṃ tretā dvāparaṃ ca kaliśca surasattama || caturyugamidaṃ proktaṃ tattvato munisattamaiḥ || 41 || kṛte dharmaścatuṣpādo vedādiphalameva ca || tīrthaṃ dānaṃ tapo vidyā dhyānamāyurarogatā || 42 || pādahīnaṃ sarvametadyugaṃ tretābhidhaṃ prabho || pādadvayaṃ dvāpare tu sarvasyaitasya vāsava || 43 || pādenaikena tatsarvaṃ vibhāge prathame kalau || ūrdhvaṃ vināśaḥ sarvasya bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 44 || mantrāstīrthāni yajñāśca tapo daivādikaṃ tathā || pragacchaṃti samucchedaṃ vedāḥ śāstrāṇi caiva hi ||45|| mlecchaprāyāśca bhūpālā bhaviṣyantyamarādhipa|| lokaḥ kariṣyate nindāṃ sādhūnāṃ vratacāriṇām || 46 || || prahlāda uvāca || || śrutvā bṛhaspatervākyametattīrthasya bho dvijāḥ || prakaṃpitāḥ surāḥ sarve mleccha saṃsargajādbhayāt || 47 || bṛhaspatiṃ suraguruṃ papracchurvinayānvitāḥ || mlecchasaṃsargajo doṣo gaṃgayāpi na pūyate || 48 || kathayasva prasādena sthānaṃ kalivivarjitam || yatra gatvā nivatsyāmo yāsyāmo nirvṛtiṃ parām || 49 || yena duḥkhavinirmuktā bhaviṣyāmo gatavyathāḥ || kṛpayā sumukho bhūtvā brūhi tīrthaṃ hitāya naḥ || 7.4.4.50 || || prahlāda uvāca || || etacchrutvā surendrasya vākyamaṃgirasāṃ varaḥ || ciraṃ dhyātvā jagādedaṃ vākyaṃ devapurohitaḥ || || 51 || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || pañcakrośapramāṇaṃ hi tīrthaṃ tīrthavarottamam|| dvārakānāma vikhyātaṃ kalidoṣavivarjitam|| ||52|| viṣṇunā nirmitaṃ sthānaṃ lokasya gatidāyakam || muktidaṃ kalikāle tu jñānahīnajanasya ca ||53 || ūṣaraṃ karmaṇāṃ kṣetraṃ puṇyaṃ pāpavināśanam|| na prarohaṃti pāpāni punarnaṣṭāni tatra vai || 54 || tisraḥ koṭayo'rdhakoṭī ca tīrthānīha mahītale || 55 || evaṃ tīrthayutā tatra dvārakā muktidāyakā || sevanīyā prayatnena prāpya mānuṣyamuttamam ||56|| || prahlāda uvāca || || bṛhaspatervacaḥ śrutvā śatakraturathā'bravīt || vācaspate mama ihi dvāravatyā mahodayam|| gamane kiṃ phalaṃ proktaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya darśane || 57 || anyāni tatra tīrthāni mukhyāni vada me guro || yathābhiṣeke gomatyāḥ phalaṃ yadapi saṃgame ||58||| || || bṛhaspatiruvāca || || śrūyatāṃ tāta vakṣyāmi māhātmyaṃ dvārakodbhavam || manuṣyarūpo bhagavānyatra krīḍati keśavaḥ ||59|| nārāyaṇaḥ sa īśāno dhyeyaścādau jaganmayaḥ || sa eva devatāmukhyaḥ purīṃ dvāravatīṃ sthitaḥ || 7.4.4.60 || ekaikasminpade datte purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati || puṇyaṃ kratusahasreṇa kalau bhavati dehinām ||61|| kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye gacchaṃti narottamāḥ || kulakoṭiśatairyuktāste gacchanti hareḥ padam ||62|| ye dhyāyaṃti manovṛttyā gamanaṃ dvārakāṃ prati || teṣāṃ vilīyate pāpaṃ pūrvajanmāyutaiḥ kṛtam || 63 || kṛṣṇasya darśane buddhirjāyate yasya dehinaḥ || vaktrāvalokanāttasya pāpaṃ yāti sahasradhā || 64 || ye gatā dvārakāyāṃ ca ye mṛtāḥ kṛṣṇasannidhau || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam ||65|| sulabhā mathurā kāśī hyavantī ca tathā surāḥ || ayodhyā sulabhā loke durlabhā dvārakā kalau || 66 || gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ṣaṇmāsātkṛṣṇasaṃnidhau|| jīvanmuktāstu te jñeyāḥ satyametatsurottama || 67 || kṛṣṇakrīḍākaraṃ sthānaṃ vāñchanti manasā priye || teṣāṃ hṛdi sthitaṃ pāpaṃ kṣālayetpretanāyakaḥ || 68 || atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhanti vigrahe || yāvanna gacchati naraḥ kalau dvāravatīṃ prati || 69 || puṇyasaṃkhyā ca tīrthānāṃ brahmaṇā vihitā purā || dānādhyayana saṃjñānāṃ muktvā dvāravatīṃ kalau || 7.4.4.70 || cakratīrthe tu yo gacchetprasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ || kulaikaviṃśatiyutaḥ sa gacchetparamaṃ padam || 71 || lobhenā'pyaparādhena dambhena kapaṭena vā || cakratīrthaṃ ca yo gacchenna punarviśate bhavam || 72 || prayāge hyasthipātena yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam || tadeva śatasāhasraṃ cakratīrthāsthipātanāt || 73 || pṛthivyāṃ caiva tattīrthaṃ paramaṃ parikīrtitam || cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ brahmahatyāvināśanam || 74 || ye ye kule bhaviṣyaṃti tatpūrvaṃ mānavāḥ kṣitau || sarve viṣṇupuraṃ yāṃti cakratīrthāsthipātanāt || 75 || kiṃ jātairbahubhiḥ putrairgaṇanāpūrakātmakaiḥ || varameko bhavetputraścakratīrthaṃ tu yo vrajet || 76 || tapasā kiṃ prataptena dānenādhyayanena kim || sarvāvastho'pi mucyeta gataḥ kṛṣṇapurīṃ yadi || 77 || kalikāla kṛtairdoṣairatyugrairapi mānavaḥ || kalau kṛṣṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā lipyate na kadācana || 78 || dānaṃ cādhyayanaṃ śaucaṃ kāraṇaṃ na hi putraka || hīnavarṇo'pi pāpātmā gataḥ kṛṣṇapurīṃ yadi || 79 || vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre narmadāyāṃ ca yatphalam || tatphalaṃ nimiṣārdhena dvāravatyāṃ dinedine || 7.4.4.80 || dhanyānāmapi dhanyāste devānāmapi devatāḥ || kṛṣṇopari matiryeṣāṃ hīyate na kadācana || 81 || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge gomatyudadhisaṃgame || snātvā kṛṣṇasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā lipyate naiva sa kvacit || 82 || yasya kasyāpi māsasya dvādaśī prāpya mānavaḥ || kṛṣṇakrīḍāpurīṃ dṛṣṭvā muktaḥ saṃsāragahvarāt || 83 || yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇālaye prāṇā gatāḥ surapate kalau || svargānna teṣāmāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 84 || vijñeyā mānuṣā vatsa garbhasthāste mahītale || dvāravatyāṃ na yairdevo dṛṣṭaḥ kaṃsaniṣūdanaḥ || 85 || durlabho dvārakāvāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || durlabhaṃ gomatīsnānaṃ durlabho rukmiṇīpatiḥ || 86 || tapaḥ paraṃ kṛtayuge tretāyāṃ jñānamucyate || dvāpare tu paro yajñaḥ kalau keśavakīrtanam || 87 || hemabhārasahasraistu dattairyatphalamāpyate || dṛṣṭvā tatkoṭi guṇitaṃ hareḥ sarvapradaṃ mukham || 88 || dvārakāyāṃ ca yaddattaṃ śaṃkhoddhāre tathaiva ca || piṃḍārake mahātīrthe dattaṃ caivākṣayaṃ bhavet || 89 || gomahiṣyādi yaddattaṃ suvarṇavasanāni ca || vṛṣo bhūmigraho rūpyaṃ kanyādānaṃ tathaiva ca || 7.4.4.90 || yaccānyadapi devendra triṣu sthāneṣu yacchati || tanmuktikārakaṃ proktaṃ pitṝṇāmātmanastathā || 91 || ūṣaraṃ hi yato loke kṣetrametatprakīrtitam || ato muktikaraṃ sarvaṃ dānaṃ coktaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 92 || yatkiṃcitkurute tatra dānaṃ krīḍāvagāhanam || tadanantaphalaṃ prāha bhagavānmadhusūdanaḥ || 93 || pretatvaṃ naiva tasyāsti na yāmyā nārakī vyathā || yena dvāravatīṃ gatvā kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇā'valokanam || 94 || vārimātreṇa gomatyāṃ piṇḍadāne kṛte kalau || pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 95 || nityaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye smaranti gṛhasthitāḥ || namasyāḥ sarvalokānāṃ devānāṃ ca surottama || 96 || brahmajñānaṃ gayāśrāddhaṃ maraṇaṃ gograheṣu ca || vāsaḥ puṃsāṃ dvārakāyāṃ muktireṣā caturvidhā || 97 || brahmajñānena mucyante prayāge maraṇena vā || athavā snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau || 98 || kṛtārthaḥ kṛtapuṇyo'haṃ bravītyevaṃ mahodadhiḥ || pavitritaṃ ca madgātraṃ gomatīvārisaṃplavāt || 99 || atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhaṃti vigrahe || yāvatsnānaṃ na gomatyāṃ vāriṇā pāpahāriṇā || 7.4.4.100 || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā gomatyāṃ rukmiṇīhrade || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ ramyaṃ kulānāṃ tārayecchatam || 101 || kṛṣṇaṃ ca ye dvāravatīṃ manuṣyāḥ smaraṃti nityaṃ haribhaktiyuktāḥ || vidhūtapāpāḥ kila saṃbhavāṃte gacchaṃti lokaṃ paramaṃ murāreḥ || 102 || adhautapādaḥ prathamaṃ namaskuryādgaṇeśvaram || sarvavighravināśaśca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 103 || nīlotpaladalaśyāmaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ devakinandanam || daṇḍavatpraṇametprītyā praṇamedagrajaṃ punaḥ || 104 || bālye ca yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ kaumāre yauvane tathā || darśanātkṛṣṇadevasya tannaśyennātra saṃśayaḥ || 105 || vāṇyā'tha manasā yacca karmaṇā samupārjitam || pāpaṃ janmasahasreṇa tannaśyennātra saṃśayaḥ || 106 || hemabhārasahasraistu dattairyatphalamāpyate || tatphalaṃ koṭiguṇitaṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokanāt || 107 || namaskṛtya ca deveśaṃ puṇḍarīkākṣamacyutam || durvāsasaṃ maheśānaṃ dvārakāparirakṣakam ||108|| praṇamya parayā bhaktyā vainateyasamanvitam |'| dvāramāgatya ca punaḥ svargadvāropamaṃ śubham|| 109 || viśramya ca muhūrttārddhaṃ suhṛdbhirbāndhavairvṛtaḥ || tatrāśritānsamāhūya brāhmaṇānmantrakovidān || pūjādravyaṃ samānīya tatastīrthaṃ vrajedbudhaḥ || 7.4.4.110 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāyātrāvidhivarṇanaṃnāma caturtho'dhyāyaḥ || 4 || || cha ||
<7.4.5>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā gomatīṃ kṛṣṇasaṃśrayām || yasyā darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktaḥ kṛṣṇasāyujyamāpnuyāt|| 1 || duritaughakṣayakaramamaṃgalyavināśanam || sarvakāmapradaṃ nṝṇāṃ praṇamedgomatījalam || 2 || mahāpāpakṣayakaramagatīnāṃgatipradam || pūrvapuṇyavaśātprāptaṃ praṇamedgomatījalam || 3 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || daityendra saṃśayo'smākaṃ taṃ tvaṃ chettumihārhasi || iyaṃ kā gomatī tatra kenānītā mahāmate || 4 || kena kāryavaśeneha saṃprāptā varuṇālayam || sarvaṃ bhāgavataśreṣṭha hyetadvistarato vada || 5 || || prahlāda uvāca || || ekārṇave purā bhūte naṣṭe sthāvara jaṃgame || tadā brahmā samabhavadviṣṇornābhisaroruhāt || 6 || ādiṣṭaḥ prabhuṇā brahmā sṛjasva vividhāḥ prajāḥ || iti dhātā samādiṣṭo hariṇā sṛṣṭi kāraṇe || 7 || uktvā bāḍhamiti brahmā tataḥ sṛṣṭau mano dadhe || sasarja mānasātsadyaḥ sanakādyānkumārakān || uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā prajāḥ sṛjata putrakāḥ || 8 || brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā te kṛtāṃjalayo'bruvan || bhagavanbhagavadrūpaṃ draṣṭukāmā vayaṃ prabho || 9 || na bandhamanuvarttāmaḥ sṛṣṭirūpaṃ durāsadam|| ityuktvā te yayuḥ sarve sanakādyā kumārakāḥ || 7.4.5.10|| paścimāṃ diśamāsthāya tīre nadanadīpateḥ || tejomayasya rūpasya draṣṭukāmā mahātmanaḥ || tasminmānasamādhāya tepire paramaṃ tapaḥ || 11 || bahuvarṣasahasraistu prasanne dharaṇīdhare || bhittvā jalaṃ samuttasthau tejorūpaṃ durāsadam || || 12 || anekadaityadamanaṃ bahuyaṃtravidāraṇam || sūryakoṭiprabhābhāsaṃ sahasrāraṃ sudarśanam || 13 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā vismitāḥ sarve brahmaputrāḥ parasparam || vīkṣamāṇā bhagavataḥ paramāyudhamuttamam || 14 || tānvilokya tathābhūtānvāguvācāśarīriṇī || bho brahmaputrā bhagavāñchrīghramāvirbhaviṣyati || 15 || arhaṇārthaṃ bhagavataḥ śīghramarghyaṃ prakalpyatām|| āyudhaṃ lokanāthasya dvijāḥ śīghraṃ prasādyatām || 16 || tacchrutvā''kāśavacanaṃ tuṣṭuvuste sudarśanam || 1 || ṛṣaya ucuḥ || || jyotirmaya namaste'stu namaste harivallabha || sudarśana namaste'stu sahasrārā'kṣarā'vyaya ||18|| namaste sūryarūpāya brahma rūpāya te namaḥ || amoghāya namastubhyaṃ rathāṃgāya namonamaḥ || 19 || evaṃ te pūjayāmāsuḥ sumanobhistathā'kṣataiḥ || 7.4.5.20 || stavairnānāvidhaiḥ stutvā praṇemurharivallabham || tatprasādya sunābhaṃ tu prabhusaṃdarśanotsukāḥ || 20 || asmaranmanasā devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pitaraṃ svakam || teṣāṃ tu ciṃtitaṃ jñātvā brahmā gaṃgāmathābravīt || 21 || yāhi śīghraṃ saricchreṣṭhe pṛthivyāṃ harikāraṇāt || gāṃ gatā tvaṃ mahābhāge tato bahumatā'si me || 22 || urvyāṃ te gomatī nāma suprasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 23 || vasiṣṭhasyānugā bhūtvā yāhi śīghraṃ dharātalam || tātaṃ putrīvānuyātā vasiṣṭhatanayā bhava || 24 || bāḍhamityeva sā devī prasthitā varuṇālayam || vasiṣṭhastvagrato yāti taṃ gaṃgā pṛṣṭhato'nvagāt || 25 || tāṃ dṛṣṭvā manujāḥ sarve vasiṣṭhena samanvitām || namaścakrurmahābhāgāṃ gacchato paścimārṇavam || 26 || āvirbabhūva tatraiva yatra te munayaḥ sthitāḥ || draṣṭukāmā hare rūpaṃ śriyā juṣṭaṃ caturbhujam || 27 || dṛṣṭvā vasiṣṭhamanugāmāyāntīṃ surapāvanīm || avākiranmahābhāgāṃ sumanobhiśca sarvaśaḥ || 28 || divyairmālyaiḥ sugandhaiśca gandhadhūpaistathā'kṣataiḥ || saṃpūjya hṛṣṭamanasaḥ sādhusādhviti cābruvan || 29 || vasiṣṭhaṃ te'gragaṃ dṛṣṭvā hyudatiṣṭhaṃstato dvijāḥ || arghyādisatkriyāṃ kṛtvā prahṛṣṭā idamabruvan || || 7.4.5.30 || yasmāttvayā samānītā hyasmim̐lloke saridvarā || tasmāttava sutetyevaṃ khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati || 31 || goḥ svargādāgatā yasmādidaṃ sthānaṃ matī matā || tasmāddhi gomatīnāma khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati || 32 || asyā darśanamātreṇa muktiṃ yāsyaṃti mānavāḥ || kiṃ punaḥ snāna dānādi kṛtvā yāṃti hareḥ padam || 33 || tāmeva cārghyaṃ dattvā te yogīṃdrā īḍire harim || paraṃ puruṣasūktena puruṣaṃ śeṣaśāyinam || 34 || iti saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāṃ harirāvirbabhūva ha || pītakauśeyavasano vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || divyamālyānuliptāṃgo divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 35 || śeṣāsanagataṃ devaṃ divyānekodyatāyudham || jvalatkirīṭamukuṭaṃ sphuranmakarakuṃḍalam || 36 || bhaktābhayapradaṃ śāṃtaṃ śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābhujam || sadā prasannavadanaṃ ghanaśyāmaṃ caturbhujam || 37 || pādasaṃvāhanāsaktalakṣmyā juṣṭaṃ manoharam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā munayaḥ sarve harṣotkarṣasamanvitāḥ || viṣṇuṃ te viṣṇusūktaiśca tuṣṭuvurvedasaṃbhavaiḥ || 38 || evaṃ saṃstuvatā teṣāṃ viṣṇurdīnānukaṃpakaḥ || uvāca suprasannena manasā dvijasattamān || 39 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || bhobhoḥ kumārāstuṣṭo'haṃ pradāsyāmi yathepsitam || bhaviṣyatha jñānayutā aspṛṣṭā mama māyayā || 7.4.5.40 || yasmānmokṣārthibhirviprā jalenāhaṃ prasāditaḥ || tasmādidaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ param || 41 || anugrahāya bhavatāṃ yatra cakraṃ sudarśanam || niḥsṛtaṃ prathamaṃ viprā jalaṃ bhittvā mamāgrataḥ || || 42 || cakratīrthamiti khyātaṃ tasmādetadbhaviṣyati || mamāpi niyataṃ vāso bhaviṣyati mahārṇave || 43 || ye'tra snānaṃ prakurvaṃti prasaṃgenāpi mānavāḥ || cakratīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhāsteṣāṃ muktiḥ kare sthitā || 44 || bhavato'pi sadā hyatra tiṣṭhadhvaṃ ca dvijarṣabhāḥ || vāyubhūtāṃtarikṣasthāḥ sarvakāmasya dāyakāḥ || 45 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tacchrutvā hṛṣṭamanasaḥ kṛtvārghyaṃ surapāvanīm || avanijya hareḥ pādau mūrdhnā'paścāpyadhārayan || || 46 || prakṣālya sā hareḥ pādau praviṣṭā varuṇālayam || tasminmahāpāpaharā gomatī sāgaraṃ gatā || 47 || varaṃ dattvā tato viṣṇustatraivāntara dhīyata || sanakādyā brahmasutāstasthustatra samāhitāḥ || 48 || evaṃ sā gomatī tatra saṃjātā sāgaraṃgamā || sarvapāpaharā proktā pūrvagaṃgeti yā śrutā || || 49 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmyaṃ sanatkumāratapobalena bhagavatprādurbhāva vṛttāntavarṇanapuraḥsara gomatyutpattimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
<7.4.6>
|| ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || sādhusādhu mahābhāga prahlādā surasattama || yena naḥ kalimadhye tu darśito bhagavānhariḥ || 1 || tvanmukhakṣīrasiṃdhūtthā katheyamamṛtopamā || karṇābhyāṃ pibatāṃ tṛptirmunīnāṃ na prajāyate || kathayasva mahābāho tīrthayātrāṃ suvistarām || 2 | asmābhistatra gaṃtavyaṃ vahate yatra gomatī || tiṣṭhate yatra bhagavāṃścakratīrthāvalokakaḥ || ||3 || bhavābdhau patitāṃstāta uddharasva bhavārṇavāt || tīrthayātrāvidhānaṃ ca kathayasva mahāmate || 4 || || prahlāda uvāca || || gatvā tu gomatītīre praṇameddaṃḍavacca tām || prakṣālya pāṇipādau ca kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān || 5 || gṛhītvā tu phalaṃ śubhramakṣataiśca samanvitam || prāṅmukhaḥ prayato bhūtvā dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ || 6 || brahmalokātsamāyāte vasiṣṭhatanaye śubhe || sarvapāpaviśuddhyarthaṃ dadāmyarghyaṃ tu gomati || 7 || vasiṣṭhatanaye devi suravaṃdye yaśasvini || trailokyavaṃdite devi pāpaṃ me hara gomati || 8 || ityuccāryya dvijaśreṣṭhā mṛdamālabhya pāṇinā || viṣṇuṃ saṃsmṛtya manasā maṃtrametamudīrayet || 9 || aśvakrāṃte rathakrāṃte viṣṇukrāṃte vasuṃdhare || uddhṛtā'si varāheṇa kṛṣṇena śatabāhunā || 7.4.6.10 || mṛttike hara me pāpaṃ yanmayā pūrvasaṃcitam || tvayā hatena pāpena pūtaḥ saṃvatsaraṃ bhavet ||11|| ityevaṃ mṛdamālipya snānaṃ kuryyādyathāvidhi || āpo asmāniti snātvā śṛṇudhvaṃ yatphalaṃ labhet || 12 || kurukṣetre ca yatpuṇyaṃ rāhugraste divākare || snānamātreṇa tatpuṇyaṃ gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || 13 || bhaktyā snātvā tu tatraivaṃ kuryātkarma yathoditam|| devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥ || 14 || ye ca rauravasaṃsthā hi ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ || gomatīnīradānena muktiṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || vināpyakṣatadarbhairvā vinā bhāvanayā tathā || vārimātreṇa gomatyāṃ gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet || 16 || tataśca viprānāhūya vedajñāṃstīrasaṃśrayān || viśvedevādi
