saṃpūjya pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret || 17 || śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānataḥ || dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā || 18 || suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ rājatakhurabhūṣitām || ratnapucchāṃ vastrayutāṃ tāmrapṛṣṭhāṃ savatsakām || 29 || dadyādvipraṃ samabhyarcya vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || saptadhānyayutāṃ dadyādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 7.4.6.20 || āsīmāṃtaṃ visṛjyaitānbrāhmaṇānniyateṃdriyaḥ || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ || 21 || gomatī gomayasnānaṃ godānaṃ gopicandanam || darśanaṃ gopināthasya gakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ || 22 || tasmāccaiva prakartavyaṃ godānaṃ gomatītaṭe || evaṃ kṛtvā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || 23 || ye gatā narakaṃ ghoraṃ ye ca pretatvamāgatāḥ || pūrvakarmavipākena sthāvaratvaṃ gatāśca ye || 24 || pitṛpakṣe ca ye kecinmātṛpakṣe kulodbhavāḥ || sarve te muktimāyāṃti gomatyā darśanātkalau || 25 || kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ narairyaistu gomatyāṃ bhūsurottamāḥ || hayamedhasya yajñasya phalamāyāṃtyasaṃśayam || 26 || gaṃgāsnānena yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge parikīrttitam || tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti gomatyāṃ śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ || 27 || viṣṇulokaṃ hi gacchaṃti pitarastatkulodbhavāḥ || anekajanmasāhasraṃ pāpaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 28 || vācā ca yatkṛtaṃ pāpaṃ karmaṇā manasā tathā|| tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti gomatīdarśanena hi||29|| yo naraḥ kārttike snānaṃ gomatyāṃ kurute dvijāḥ|| prasanno bhagavāṃstasya lakṣmyā saha na saṃśayaḥ||7.4.6.30|| pratyahaṃ hutam̐ bhoktāraṃ tarpayetsusamāhitaḥ|| pratyahaṃ ṣaḍrasaṃ deyaṃ bhojanaṃ ca dvijātaye||31|| pūjayetkṛṣṇadevaṃ ca pratyahaṃ bhaktitatparaḥ || yena kenāpi viprendrāḥ sthātavyaṃ niyamena tu ||32|| brāhmaṇānujñayā tatra gṛhṇīyānniyamānnaraḥ || saṃpūrṇe kārttike māsi saṃprāpte bodhavāsare || 33 || paṃcāmṛtena deveśaṃ snāpayettīrthavāriṇā || śrīkhaṇḍaṃ kuṃkumonmiśraṃ mṛganābhisamanvitam || vilepayecca deveśaṃ bhaktyā dāmodaraṃ harim || 34 || kusumairvārisaṃbhūtaistulasyā karavīrakaiḥ || taddeśasaṃbhavaiḥ puṣpaiḥ pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam || 35 || naivedyaṃ ruciraṃ dadyādvi ṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || gītavādyādinṛtyena tathā pustakavācanaiḥ || 36 || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kāryyaṃ stotrairnānāvidhairapi || āhūya brāhmaṇānbhaktyā bhojayecca svaśaktitaḥ || 37 || tato rathasthitaṃ devaṃ pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam || kārttikāṃte ca vipreṃdrā gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 38 || snātvā pitṝṃśca saṃtarpya pūjayecca janārddanam || suvastrairbhūṣaṇaiścāpi samabhyarcya ramāpatim || anujñayā tu viprāṇāṃ vrataṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ nayet || 39 || evaṃ yaḥ snāti viprendrāḥ kārttike kṛṣṇasannidhau || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati ||7.4.6.40|| māghasnānaṃ naro bhaktyā gomatyāṃ kurute tu yaḥ || vainateyodaye nityaṃ saṃtuṣṭaḥ saha bhāryayā || 41 || tilā hiraṇyasahitā deyā brāhmaṇasattame || modakā guḍasaṃmiśrāḥ pratyahaṃ dakṣiṇānvitāḥ || 42 || tilairājyāplutairhomaḥ karttavyaḥ pratyahaṃ naraiḥ || homārthaṃ sevayedvahniṃ na śītārthaṃ kadācana ||43|| gomatyāṃ snāti yo bhaktyā māghaṃ mādhavavallabham || samāptau raktavastrāṇi kañcukoṣṇīṣameva ca || 44 || dadyādupānahau bhaktyā kuṃkumaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || kambalaṃ tailapakvaṃ ca viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 45 || svāmikāryyamṛtānāṃ ca saṃgrāme śastrasaṃkule || gavārthe brāhmaṇārthe ca mṛtānāṃ yā gatiḥ smṛtā || 46 || māghasnāne ca sā proktā gomatyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || sarvadānaphalaṃ tasya sarva tīrthaphalaṃ tathā || 47 || māghasnānānnaro yāti viṣṇulokaṃ sanātanam || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti samabhyarcya janārddanam || 48|| māghaṃ yaḥ kṣapate sarvaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || brāhmaṇānujñayā viprāḥ sarvaṃ saṃpūrṇatāṃ vrajet || 49 || pāpino'pi dvijaśreṣṭhā ye snātā gomatījale || yajvināṃ ca gatiṃ yāṃti prasādāccakrapāṇinaḥ || 7.4.6.50 || brahmarudrapadādūrdhvaṃ yatpadaṃ cakrapāṇinaḥ || snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ tatproktaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau || 51 || mitradrohe ca yatpāpaṃ yatpāpaṃ gurughātini || tatpāpaṃ samavāpnoti yātrābhaṃgaṃ karoti yaḥ ||52|| brahmasvahāriṇaḥ pāpāstathā devasvahāriṇaḥ || snānamātreṇa śuddhyaṃti gomatyāṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 53 || bhītā'bhayapradānena yatpuṇyaṃ labhate naraḥ || tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti gomatyāṃ snānamātrataḥ || 54 || bhītābhaya pradānena putrāniṣṭānna saṃśayaḥ || dhanakāmastu vipulaṃ labhate dhanamūrjitam|| 55 || prāpnuyādīpsitānkāmāngomatīnīrasaṃgame || kṛtakṛtyo bhavedviprā ṛṇānmucyeta paitṛkāt || 56 || manasā vacasā caiva karmaṇā yadupārjitam || tatsarvaṃ naśyate pāpaṃ gomatīnīrasaṃgamāt || 57 || pītāṃbaradharo bhūtvā tathā garuḍavāhanaḥ || vanamālī caturbāhurdivyagandhānulepanaḥ || yāti viṣṇvālayaṃ viprā apunarbhavalakṣaṇam || 58 || gomatīsnānamātreṇa mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto yāti viṣṇuṃ sanātanam || 59 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatyudadhisaṃgame snānadānādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 || || cha ||
<7.4.7>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā rathāṃgākhyaṃ mahodadhim || cakrāṃkā yatra pāṣāṇā dṛśyaṃte muktidāyakāḥ || 1 || yaiḥ pūjyate jagannāthaḥ pratyahaṃ bhāva saṃyutaiḥ || sadā netrairanimiṣairvīkṣyate ca janārdanaḥ || 2 || yacca sākṣādbhagavatā dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇena dṛṣṭitaḥ || tattīrthaṃ sarvapāpaghnaṃ cakrākhyaṃ paramaṃ hareḥ || 3 || yasya prasiddhiḥ paramā trailokye sacarācare || prayāgādadhikaṃ yacca muktidaṃ hyasti pāvanam || 4 || surairapi prapūjyaṃte yatrāṃgāni śarīriṇām || aṃkitāni ca cakreṇa ṣaṇmāsānnātra saṃśayaḥ || 5 || yaddṛṣṭvā mucyate pāpātprasaṃgenāpi mānavaḥ || tattīrthaṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ pāvanaṃ pravaraṃ smṛtam|| || 6 || tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ prakṣālya caraṇau mudā || karau cāsyaṃ caiva punaḥ praṇameddaṃḍavatpunaḥ || 7 || praṇipatya gṛhītvārghyaṃ paṃcaratnasamanvitam || sapuṣpākṣatagaṃdhaiśca phalahemasucaṃdanaiḥ || 8 || saṃpannamarghyamādāya maṃtrametamudīrayet || pratyaṅmukhaḥ suniyataḥ saṃmukho vā mahodadheḥ ||9|| oṃ namo viṣṇu rūpāya viṣṇucakrāya te namaḥ || gṛhāṇārghyaṃ mayā dattaṃ sarvakāmaprado bhava || 7.4.7.10 || agniśca tejo mṛḍayā ca rudro retodhā viṣṇuramṛtasya nābhiḥ || etadbruvanvāḍavāḥ satyavākyaṃ tato'vagāheta patiṃ nadīnām ||11|| mṛdamālabhya sajalāṃ viprā devakaracyutām || dhārayitvā tu śirasā snānaṃ kuryyādyathāvidhi || 12 || tarpayecca pitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathākramam || tarpayitvā havirdravyaṃ prokṣayitvā ca bhaktitaḥ || 13 || aśvamedhasahasreṇa samyagyaṣṭena yatphalam || snānamātreṇa tatproktaṃ cakratīrthe dvijottamāḥ || 14 || prayāge yatphalaṃ proktaṃ māghyāṃ mādhavapūjane || snānamātreṇa tatproktaṃ cakra tīrthe dvijottamāḥ || 15 || kārayecca tataḥ śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || viśvedevānsuvarṇena rājatena tathā pitṝn || 16 || saṃtarpya bhojanenaiva vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ|| dīnāndhakṛpaṇebhyaśca dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ|| 17|| cakratīrthe tīrthavare viśeṣāddvijasattamāḥ|| ratnadānaṃ prakurvīta prīṇanārthaṃ jagatpateḥ || 18 || gantrīmanaḍuhā yuktāṃ sarvāstaraṇasaṃyutām || sopaskarāṃ ca dadyādvai viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti|| 19 || suvinītaṃ śīlayutaṃ tathā sopaskaraṃ hayam || bhūṣayitvā ca viprāya dadyāddakṣiṇayā saha || 7.4.7.20 || evaṃ kṛte dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ|| muktiṃ prayāṃti tasyaiva pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ || 21 || pretayoniṃ gatā ye ca ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ || pacyaṃte narake ye ca mahārauravasaṃjñake || 22 || te sarve tṛptimāyāṃti cakatīrtha prabhāvataḥ || śrāddhe kṛte dvijaśreṣṭhā gayāśrāddhaphalaṃ labhet || 23 || yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ yajvanāṃ yā gatiḥ smṛtā || cakratīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ snātvā tāṃ labhate naraḥ || 24 || śrāddhaṃ praśastaṃ vipreṃdrāḥ saṃprāpte caṃdrasaṃkṣaye || sūryagrahe viśeṣeṇa kurukṣetraphalaṃ smṛtam || śrāddhe snāne tathā dāne pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe tathā|| 25 || praśastaṃ cakratīrthaṃ ca nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 26 || sarvadā pāvanaṃ viprāścakratīrthaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || yastu śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta yātrāyāmāgato naraḥ || 27 || cakratīrthe dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ saṃpūjya madhusūdanam || pūjiteṣu dvijeṃdreṣu viṣṇusāṃnidhyamāpnuyāt || 28 || vācā kṛtaṃ karmakṛtaṃ manasāṃ samupārjitam || snānamātreṇa tatpāpaṃ naśyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsa khaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatyudadhisaṃgamatīrasthacakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptamo'dhyāyaḥ || 7 || || cha ||
<7.4.8>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || mā gacchadhvaṃ suranadīṃ kāliṃdīṃ mā sarasvatīm || gacchadhvaṃ ca dvijaśreṣṭhā gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 1 || prāpyate helayā yatra sarve kāmā na saṃśayaḥ || gomatījalakallolaiḥ krīḍate yatra sāgaraḥ || 2 || pāpaghnaṃ gomatītīraṃ prāpyate puṇyavannaraiḥ || sāgareṇa ca saṃmiśraṃ mahāpātakanāśanam || 3 || gomatī saṃgatā yatra sāgareṇa dvijottamāḥ || muktidvāraṃ tu tatproktaṃ kalikāle na saṃśayaḥ || 4 || yatpuṇyaṃ labhate tūrṇaṃ gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 5 || namaskṛtya ca toyeśaṃ gomatīṃ ca saridvarām || arghyaṃ dadyādvidhānena kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān || 6 || maṃtreṇānena vipreṃdrā dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ || brāhmaṇaiḥ saha saṃgatya sadā tattīrthavāsibhiḥ || 7 || bhaktyā cārghyaṃ pradāsyāmi devāya paramā tmane || trāhi māṃ pāpinaṃ ghoraṃ namaste surarūpiṇe || 8 || tīrtharāja namastubhyaṃ ratnākara mahārṇava || gomatyā saha goviṃda gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 9|| dattvā cārghyaṃ śikhāṃ baddhvā saṃsmṛtya jalaśāyinam || kuryācca prāṅmukhaḥ snānaṃ tataḥ pratyaṅmukhastathā|| 7.4.8.10|| snātvā ca parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsaṃtarpayettataḥ || viśvedevādi saṃpūjya pitṝṇāṃ śrāddhamācaret || 11 || yathoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ suvarṇaṃ viprasattamāḥ || 12 || daṃpatyorvāsasī caiva kaṃcukoṣṇīṣameva ca || lakṣmyā saha jagannātho viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 13 || mahādānāni sarvāṇi gomatyudadhisaṃgame || saptadvīpapatirbhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 14 || yastulāpuruṣaṃ dadyādgomatyudadhisaṃgame || saptadvīpapatirbhūtvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 15 || ātmānaṃ tolayedyastu svarṇena rajatena vā || vastrairvā kuṃkumairvāpi phalairvāpi tathā rasaiḥ || 16 || bhuktvā bhogānsuvipulāṃstathā kāmānmanoharān || saṃpūjyamānastridaśairyāti viṣṇvālayaṃ naraḥ || 17 || hiraṇyarūpyadānaṃ ca hyaśvaṃ dhenuṃ tathaiva ca || gomatīsaṃgame dattvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 18 || bhūmidānaṃ ca yo dadyādgomatyudadhisaṃgame || snātvā śucirhariṃ smṛtvā tasmāddhanyataro nahi || 19 || kanyādānaṃ ca yaḥ kuryādvidyādānamathāpi vā || gomatyāḥ saṃgame snātvā yāti brahmapadaṃ naraḥ || 7.4.8.20 || yo dadyātsvarṇadhenuṃ ca ghṛtadhenuṃ samāhitaḥ || brahmāṇḍadānamapi vā tasya puṇyamanaṃtakam || 21 || tathā lavaṇadhenuṃ ca jaladhenumathāpi vā || dattvā yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 22 || yugādiṣu ca sarveṣu gomatyudadhisaṃgame || snātvā saṃtarpya ca pitṝnakṣayaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 23 || āṣāḍhyāṃ ca tathā māghyāṃ kārtikyāṃ saṃgame naraḥ || pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ snānaṃ śrāddhaṃ pāvakapūjanam || kuryāccaiva tathā dānaṃ yadīcchedakṣayaṃ padam || 24 || pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptirgayāśrāddhena vai yathā || tadvacchrāddhānmahābhāga gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 25 || kuryyātsnānaṃ tathā dānaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || pañcakāsu dvijaśreṣṭhāstathā caivāṣṭakāsu ca || 26 || vaidhṛtau ca vyatīpāte chāyāyāṃ kuṃjarasya ca || ṣaṣṭhyāṃ ca kapilākhyāyāṃ tathā hi dvādaśīṣu ca || 27 || gomatyāṃ saṃgame snātvā dadyāddānaṃ viśeṣataḥ || nirmalaṃ sthānamāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati || 28 || śrāddhapakṣe tvamāvāsyāṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || helayā prāpyate puṇyaṃ dattvā piṇḍaṃ gayāsamam || 29 || tasmātsarvaṃ prayatnena tvamāvāsyāṃ dvijottamāḥ || śrāddhaṃ hi pitṛpakṣāṃte kāryyaṃ gomatisaṃgame || 7.4.8.30 || yadyapyaśrotriyaṃ śrāddhaṃ yadyapyupahataṃ bhavet || pakṣaśrāddhakṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ dinenaikena labhyate || 31 || śraddhāhīnaṃ mantrahīnaṃ pātrahīnamathāpi vā || dravyahīnaṃ kālahīnaṃ manasaḥ svāsthyavarjitam || 32 || śrāddhapakṣe hyamāyāṃ tu gomatyudadhisaṃgame || paripūrṇaṃ bhavetsarvaṃ pitṝṇāṃ tṛptirakṣayā || 33 || gomatī kamalā caiva caṃdrabhāgā tathaiva ca || tisrastu saṃgatā nadyaḥ praviṣṭā varuṇālayam || 34 || gayāyāṃ piṃḍadānena prayāge hyasthipātane || tatpuṇyaṃ samavāpnoti pakṣāṃte śrāddhakṛnnaraḥ || 35 || yadīcchetsarvatīrtheṣu helayā tvabhiṣecanam || snānaṃ kurvīta bhaktyā vai gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 36 || pakṣepakṣe samagrā tu pitṛpūjā kṛtā ca yaiḥ || sampūrṇā jāyate teṣāṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 317 || śrāddhe kṛte tvamāvasyāṃ pitṛpakṣe ca vai dvijāḥ || aputrā caiva yā nārī kākavaṃdhyā ca yā bhavet || 38 || mṛtaputrā tathā viprāḥ saṃgame snānamācaret || doṣaiḥ pramucyate sarvairgomapyudadhisaṃgame || snātvā sukhamavāpnoti prajāṃ ca cirajīvinīm || 39 || yāni kāni ca dānāni pṛthivyāṃ sambhavaṃti hi || tāni sarvāṇi deyāni gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 7.4.8.40 || sarvadaiva ca viprendrā viśeṣātsarvaparvasu || snānaṃ kurvīta niyato gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 41 || darśanādeva pāpasya kṣayo bhavati bho dvijāḥ || praṇāme manasastuṣṭirmuktiścaivāvagāhane || 42 || śrāddhe kṛte pitṝṇāṃ tu tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī || dāne manorathāvāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 43 || kṛtakṛtyāstu te dhanyā yaiḥ kṛtaṃ pitṛtarpaṇam || śrāddhaṃ ca ṛṣiśārdūlā gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 44 || pitṛpakṣe ca vai kecinmātṛpakṣe tathaiva ca || tathā śvaśurapakṣe ca ye cānye mitrabāṃdhavāḥ || 45 || sthāvaratvaṃ gatā ye ca pudgalatvaṃ ca ye gatāḥ || piśācatvaṃ gatā ye ca ye ca pretatvamāgatāḥ || 46 || tiryyagyonigatā ye ca ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ || snānamātreṇa te sarve muktiṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || kiṃ punaḥ śrāddhadānādi gomatīsaṃgame tathā || kṛtvā muktimavāpnoti mānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ || 48 || śravaṇadvādaśīyoge gomatyudadhisaṃgame || snātvā muktimavāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati || 49 || santyajya sarvatīrthāni gomatyudadhisaṃgame || snānaṃ kṛtvā tathā śrāddhaṃ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || paraṃ lokamavāpnoti hyarcayitvā tu vāmanam || 7.4.8.50 || samyaksnātvā naro yastu pūjayedgaruḍadhvajam || pītāṃbaradharo bhūtvā divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 51 || vīkṣyamāṇaḥ surastrībhirnāgārikṛtaketanaḥ || caturbhujadharo bhūtvā vanamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || saṃstūyamāno munibhiryāti viṣṇvālayaṃ naraḥ || 52 || gomatīsaṃgame snātvā kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || yatra daityavadhaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || 53 || cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ pūrvaṃ kṛṣṇena svayameva hi || tenaiva cakratīrthaṃ hi khyātaṃ lokatraye dvijāḥ || 54 || bhavaṃti yatra pāṣāṇāścakrāṃkā muktidāyakāḥ || yaiḥ pūjitairjagannāthaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ sāṃnidhyamāvrajet || 55 || tatraiva yadi labhyeta cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ saha || 56 || dvādaśātmā sa vijñeyo mokṣadaḥ sarvadehinām || ekacakrāṃkito yastu dvāravatyāṃ suśobhanaḥ || 57 || sudarśanābhidhāno'sau mokṣaikaphalado hi saḥ || lakṣmīnārāyaṇo dvābhyāṃ bhuktimuktiphalapradaḥ || 58 || tribhistrivikramaścaiva trivargaphaladāyakaḥ || śrīprado ripuhantā ca caturbhiḥ saṃyutaḥ sa hi || 59 || pañcabhirvāsudevastu janmamṛtyubhayāpahaḥ || pradyumnaḥ ṣaḍbhirevāsau lakṣmīṃ kāṃtiṃ dadāti yaḥ || 7.4.8.60 || saptabhirbalabhadraśca cakrago'tra prakīrtitaḥ || lācchitaścāṣṭabhirbhaktiṃ dadāti puruṣottamaḥ || 61 || sarvaṃ dadyānnavavyūho durlabho yaḥ surairapi || daśāvatāro daśamī rājyado nātra saṃśayaḥ ||62 || ekādaśabhiraiśvaryaṃ cakragaḥ saṃprayacchati || nirvāṇaṃ dvādaśātmā ca dvādaśabhirdadāti ca || 63 || ata ūrdhvaṃ mahābhāgāḥ saukhyamokṣapradāyakāḥ || yato'tra te ca pāṣāṇāḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa citritāḥ || 64 || teṣāṃ sparśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā kṛṣṇacakreṇa cihnitaḥ || 65 || pūjayitvā cakradharaṃ hariṃ dhyāyetsanātanam || nāputro nādhano rogī na sa saṃjāyate naraḥ || 66 || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmajam || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti sakṛccakrāṃkadarśanāt || 67 || mleccha deśe śubhe vāpi cakrāṃko dṛśyate yadi || tatra caiva harikṣetraṃ muktidaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || 68 || mṛtyukāle'pi samprāpte yadi dhyāyeddhariṃ naraḥ || cakrāṃkaṃ dhārayedaṃge sa yāti paramaṃ padam||69|| hṛdayasthe ca cakrāṃke pūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || nopasarpaṃti taṃ bhītā dūtāḥ kṛṣṇāyudhaṃ tadā || vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamā pnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā ||7.4.8.70 || api pāpasamācāraḥ kiṃ punardhārmikaḥ śuciḥ || gomatī saṃgame snātvā cakratīrthe tathaiva ca || mucyate pātakairghorai rmānavo nātra saṃśayaḥ ||71|| rājasāḥ sattvamāyāṃti viṣṇudharmaṃ sanātanam || kṣetrasya tasya māhātmyātsatyametatprakīrtitam || 72 || tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ cāpi yatkiñcidviṣṇupūjane || tacca sattvatvamāyāti nimnagā ca yathārṇave || 73 || durlabhā dvārakā vipra durlabhaṃ gomatījalam || durlabhaṃ jāgaro rātrau durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || 74 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatyudadhi saṃgamasnānādimāhātmyapūrvaka cakratīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 || ||
<7.4.9>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ saptakuṇḍānsuviśrutān || sarvapāpapraśamanānṛddhibuddhivivarddhanān||1|| ārādhitaḥ sa ca yadā harirāvirbabhūva ha || saṃstūyamāno munibhirlakṣmyā saha jagatpatiḥ || 2 || arhaṇaṃ ca tadā cakrurharaye suragaṅgayā || vāmapārśve sthitāṃ padmāmabhiṣektuṃ samudyatām || 3 || sanakādyā brahmasutāḥ saptaite manasā dvijāḥ || pṛthakpṛthagghradānkṛtvā siṣicuḥ sāgarodbhavām || 4 || tato lakṣmīhradāḥ proktā devyā nātraiva saṃjñitāḥ || prāpte tu dvāparasyāṃte rukmiṇīsaṃśrayeṇa tu || 5 || rukmiṇīhradamityevaṃ kalau khyātiṃ gatāḥ punaḥ || bhṛguṇā sevitaṃ yasmādbhṛgutīrthamiti smṛtam || 6 || tasmingatvā mahābhāgāḥ prakṣālya caraṇau mṛdā || ācamya ca kuśāngṛhya prāṅmukho niyataḥ śuciḥ || 7 || saṃpūrṇaṃ cārghyamādāya phalapuṣpākṣatādibhiḥ || rajataṃ ca śire kṛtvā mantrametamudīrayet || 8 || bhaktyā cārghyaṃ pradāsyāmi hrade rukmiṇisaṃjñite || sarvapāpavināśāya rukmiṇyāḥ prīṇanāya ca || 9 || snānaṃ kuryyāttato viprāḥ kṛtvā śirasi tārakam || devānmanupyānsantarpya pitṝnatha viśeṣataḥ || 7.4.9.10 || śrāddhaṃ tataḥ prakurvīta viprānāhūya bhaktitaḥ || dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyādrajataṃ rukmameva ca || 11 || viśeṣataḥ pradeyāni phalāni rasavanti ca || dampatyorbhojanaṃ dadyānmiṣṭānnena dvijottamāḥ || 12|| viprapatnyastu saṃpūjyāḥ striyaścānyāḥ svaśaktitaḥ || kañcukai raktavastraiśca rukmiṇī prīyatāmiti || 13 || evaṃ kṛte dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 14 || vasate ca sadā gehe lakṣmīstasya na saṃśayaḥ || ārogyaṃ manasastuṣṭirna codvegaḥ kadācana || 15 || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptiḥ prajā bhavati niścalā || hīnasattvo naiva bhaveddīrghāyuśca bhavennaraḥ || 16 || āḍhyo bhavati sarvatra yaḥ snāto rukmiṇī hrade || na lakṣmyā mucyate viprā nālakṣmyā vriyate naraḥ || 17 || na vairaṃ kalahastasya yaḥ snāto rukmiṇīhrade || gamanāgamanaṃ na syātsaṃsārabhramaṇaṃ tathā || 18 || duḥkhaśokau kutastasya yaḥ snāto rukmiṇīhrade || sarvapāpavinirmukto mahābhayavivarjitaḥ || 19 || sarvānkāmāniha prāpya yāti viṣṇupadaṃ naraḥ || 7.4.9.20 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakā māhātmye rukmiṇīhradamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 || || cha ||
<7.4.10>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || kṛkalāsamiti khyātaṃ nṛgatīrthamanuttamam || 1 || nṛgo yatra mahīpālaḥ kṛkalāsavapurdharaḥ || kṛṣṇena saha saṃgatya saṃprāpa paramāṃ gatim || 2 || ; || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || nṛgo nāma nṛpaḥ ko'yaṃ kathaṃ kṛṣṇena saṃgataḥ || karmaṇā kṛkalāsatvaṃ kena tadvada vistarāt || 3 || || prahlāda uvāca || || nṛgo nāma nṛpo viprāḥ sārvabhaumo balānvitaḥ || buddhimāndhṛtimāndakṣaḥ śrīmānsarvaguṇānvitaḥ || 4 || anekaśatasāhasrā bhūmipā api tadvaśāḥ || | | hastyaśvarathasaṃghaiśca pattibhirbahubhirvṛtaḥ || 5 || sainyaṃ ca tasya nṛpateḥ kośaṃ caivākṣayaṃ tathā || sa nityaṃ gurubhaktaśca devatārādhane rataḥ || 6 || mahā dānāni viprendrā dadātyanudinaṃ nṛpaḥ || śaśvatsa gosahasraṃ tu dadāti nṛpasattamaḥ || 7 || prakṣālya caraṇau bhaktyā hyupaviśyāsane śubhe || paridhāpya śubhe kṣaume sugandhenopalipya ca || 8 || saṃpūjya puṣpamālābhi dhūpena ca sugandhinā || dadau dakṣiṇayā sārddhaṃ prativiprāya gāṃ tadā || tāṃbūlasahitāṃ bhaktyā viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 9 || evaṃ pradadatastasya yajataśca tathā makhaiḥ || yayau kālo dvijaśreṣṭhā bhogāṃścaivānubhuñjataḥ || 7.4.10.10 || ekadā tu dvijaśreṣṭhaṃ jaiminiṃ saṃśitavratam || śraddhayā taṃ ca nṛpatiḥ pratigrahaparāṅmukham || uvāca vākyaṃ nṛpatiḥ kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitaḥ || 11 || māmuddhara mahābhāga kṛpāṃ kuru taponidhe || gṛhāṇa gāṃ mayā dattāṃ dayāṃ kṛtvā mamopari || 12 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya anicchannapi gauravāt || nṛpasya cābravīdvipra evamastviti lajjitaḥ || 13 || avanijya tataḥ pādau śirasā dhārayajjalam || suvarṇaśṛṃgasahitāṃ raupyakhuravibhūṣitām || 14 || ratnapucchāṃ kāṃsyadohāṃ sitavastrāvaguṃṭhitām || samabhyarcya ca viprendraṃ dadau dakṣiṇayānvitām || 15 || āsīmāntamanuvrajya hṛṣṭo rājā babhūva ha || taruṇīṃ haṃsavarṇāṃ ca haṃsīnāmeti viśrutām || 16 || gāṃ gṛhya svagṛhaṃ prāpto dāmnā baddhāṃ savatsakām || sa tasyai yavasaṃ cārdraṃ dadau brāhmaṇasattamaḥ || 17 || || sutṛptā yavasenaiva madhyāhne tṛṣitāṃ tadā || gṛhītvā niryayau vipro dāmabaddhāṃ jalāśayam || 18 || mārge gajāśvasaṃbādhe trastā sā uṣṭradarśanāt || hastādācchidya sā dhenurbrāhmaṇasya yayau tadā || 19 || vicinvansakalāmurvīṃ nāpaśyattāṃ dvijarṣabhaḥ || sā yayau vidrutā dhenustanmahadrājagodhanam || || 7.4.10.20 || dvitīye'hni punarvipramāhūya nṛpasattamaḥ || saṃpūjya vidhivadbhaktyā vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 21 || vidhivadgāṃ dadau tāṃ ca sa nṛpaḥ somaśarmaṇe || gṛhītvā rājabhavanānniryayau gāṃ dvijarṣabhaḥ || 22 || āśaṃsamāno rājānaṃ dharmajñamiti kovidam || sa ca vipro vicinvānaḥ sarvato gāṃ suduḥkhitaḥ || || 23 || dadarśa pathi gacchantīṃ pṛṣṭhataḥ somaśarmaṇaḥ || dṛṣṭvā tāṃ gāṃ ca sa munirjaiministamabhāṣata || 24 || mama gāṃ cāpi hṛtvā tvaṃ nayase dasyuvatkatham || sa tasya vacanaṃ śrutvā vismayaṃ dasyukīrttanāt || 25 || rājato hi mayā labdhāṃ gāṃ nayāmi svamandiram || gohartteti ca māṃ kasmādbravīṣi dvijasattama || 26 || || brāhmaṇa uvāca || || mayāpi rājato labdhā mameyaṃ gaurna saṃśayaḥ || kathaṃ nayasi vipra tvaṃ mayi jīvati mandiram || 27 || so'bravīdadya me labdhā kathaṃ māṃ vadase mṛṣā || so'bravīddhyo mayā labdhā balānnetuṃ tvamicchasi || 28 || mameyamiti saṃkruddhaḥ somaśarmā'bravīdvacaḥ || prajvalatkrodharaktākṣo mameyamiti so'paraḥ || 29 || vivadatau tathā viprau rājadvāramupāgatau || kurvāṇau kalahaṃ ghoraṃ tyaktukāmau svajīvitam || 7.4.10.30 || saṃkruddhau brāhmaṇau dṛṣṭvā śapantau tau parasparam || rājñe nivedayāmāsa dvāsthaṃ praṇayapūrvakam || 31 || avajñāya tadā viprau vivadantau ruṣānvitau || kāmavyākulacetasko na bahirniḥsṛto nṛpaḥ || 32 || evaṃ vivadamānau tau trirātraṃ samupasthitau || avajñātau nṛpeṇātha rājānaṃ prati ca krudhā || 33 || ūcatuḥ kupito vākyaṃ sāmarṣau nṛpatiṃ prati || avamanyase nau yasmāttvaṃ na nirgacchasi mandirāt || 34 || śāstā bhavānprajānāṃ hi na nyāyena niyokṣyati || bhaviṣyati bhavāṃstasmātkṛkalāso na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || evaṃ śaptvā tadā viprāvanyasmai gāṃ pradāya tau || kṣudhitau khedasaṃyuktau svagṛhaṃ gantumudyatau ||36|| prasthitau tau nṛgo dvāra āgatya samupasthitaḥ || daṃḍavatpraṇipatyā''śu kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata || 37 || amoghavacanā yūyaṃ tattathā na tadanyathā || mamopari kṛpāṃ kṛtvā śāpāṃta upadiśyatām || 38 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā ūcaturvacanaṃ nṛpam || dvāparasya yugasyāntaṃ bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ || 39 || vasudevagṛhe rājanharirāvirbhaviṣyati || tasya saṃsparśanādeva śāpamuktirbhaviṣyati || 7.4.10.40 || ityuktvā tau tadā viprau prayātau svaniveśanam || rājā bahuvidhānbhogānbhuktvā dattvā ca bhūriśaḥ || || 41 || iṣṭvā ca vividhairyajñaiḥ kāladharmamupeyivān || tataḥ sa gatavānviprā dharmarājaniveśanam || 42 || satkṛtyokto yamenātha svāgatena nṛpottamaḥ || prathamaṃ sukṛtaṃ rājannathavā duṣkṛtaṃ tvayā || bhoktavyamiti me brūhi tatte saṃpādyate mayā || 43 || || nṛga uvāca || || yadyasti duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcitprathamaṃ pratipādaya || anujñāto yamenaivaṃ kṛkalāso bhaveti vai || tato varṣasahasrāṇi kṛkalāsatvamāptavān || 44 || ekasmindivase viprāḥ sarve yadukumārakāḥ || vanaṃ jagmurmṛgānhantuṃ sarve kṛṣṇasamanvitāḥ || 45 || tṛṣārdditāśca madhyāhne vicinvaṃto jalaṃ hrade || satvaṃ ca sumahattatra kṛkalāsaṃ ca saṃsthitam || 46 || cakruścoddharaṇe tasya yatnaṃ yadukumārakāḥ || ākṛṣyamāṇaḥ sa tadā gurutvānna cacāla ha || 47 || yadā na śekuste sarva ācakhyuḥ kṛṣṇarāmayoḥ || dadarśa taṃ tadā kṛṣṇo nṛgaṃ matvā hasanniva || 48 || cikṣepa vāmahastena līlayaiva jagatpatiḥ || sa saṃspṛṣṭo bhagavatā vimuktaḥ śāpabaṃdhanāt ||49|| tyaktvā kalevaraṃ rājā divyamālyānulepanaḥ || kṛtāṃjaliruvācedaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 7.4.10.50 || namaste jagadādhāra sargasthityaṃtakāriṇe || sahasraśirase tubhyaṃ brahmaṇe'naṃtaśaktaye || 51 || evaṃ saṃstuvataḥ prāha bhagavāndevakīsutaḥ || dadāmi te varaṃ tuṣṭo yatte manasi varttate || 52 || yāhi puṇyakṛtām̐llokāndarśanātsparśanācca me || evamuktaḥ sa devena saṃprahṛṣṭatanūruhaḥ || 53 || uvāca yadi tuṣṭo'si yadi deyo varo mama || gartteyaṃ mama nāmnā tu khyātiṃ gacchatu keśava || 54 || yaḥ snātvā parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati || tvatprasādena goviṃda viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchatu || 55 || evamuktvā sa bhagavānpunardvārāvatīmagāt || 56 || sa ca rājā vimānena divyamālyānulepanaḥ || jagāma bhavanaṃ viṣṇorvibudhairanusaṃstutaḥ || 57 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tadāprabhṛti vipreṃdrāḥ sa kūpo nṛgasaṃjñayā || varadānācca kṛṣṇasya pāvanaḥ sarvadehinām || || 58 || tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭhā hyarghyaṃ dadyādyathāvidhi || phalapuṣpākṣatairyuktaṃ caṃdanena ca bhūsurāḥ || 59 || namaste viśvarūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane || arghyaṃ gṛhāṇa deveśa kūpe'sminnṛgasaṃjñake || 7.4.10.60 || tataḥ snāyāddvijaśreṣṭhā mṛdamālipya pāṇinā || saṃtarpayetpitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathākramāt || || 61 || tataḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || viprebhyo bhojanaṃ dadyāddakṣiṇāṃ ca svaśaktitaḥ || 62 || viśeṣataḥ pradātavyā savatsā gauḥ svalaṃkṛtā || śayyā sopaskarāṃ dadyādviṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 63 || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca sadā tattīravāsinām || dadyāddānaṃ svaśaktyā ca vitta śāṭhyavivarjitaḥ ||64|| snānamātreṇa viprendrā labhedgodānajaṃ phalam|| pitṛṇāṃ śrāddhadānena viyoniṃ na ca gacchati ||65|| kṛkalāse kṛtaṃ śrāddhaṃ yenaiva tarpaṇaṃ tathā || sa gacchedviṣṇulokaṃ tu pitṛbhiḥ sahito naraḥ || 66 || tathā manorathāvāptiryātrā ca saphalā bhavet || sarvatīrthaphalāvāptiṃ labhate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 67 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kṛkalāsāparanāmakanṛga tīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma daśamo'dhyāyaḥ || 10 || || cha ||
<7.4.11>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ viṣṇupadodbhavam || yasya darśanamātreṇa gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ labhet || 1 || yasyotpattirmayā pūrvaṃ kathitā dvijasattamāḥ || yasya saṃsmaraṇādeva kīrtanātpāpanāśanam || 2 || hariṇā yā samānītā rukmiṇyarthe mahātmanā || yasyā gaṇḍūṣamātreṇa hayamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 3 || viṣṇoḥ pādaprasūtāyā vaiṣṇavīti ca viśrutā || tatra gatvā mahābhāga gṛhītvā'rghyaṃ vidhānataḥ || 4 || namasye tvāṃ bhagavati viṣṇupādatalodbhave || gṛhāṇārghyamidaṃ devi gaṃge tvaṃ hariṇā saha || 5 || ityuccārya dvijaśreṣṭhā mṛdamālabhya pāṇinā || prāṅmukhaḥ saṃyato bhūtvā snānaṃ kuryādatandritaḥ || 6 || devānpitṝnmanuṣyāṃśca tarpitavyaṃ tilākṣataiḥ || upahṛtyopahārāṃśca hyāhūya brāhmaṇāṃstataḥ || 7 || śraddhayā parayā yuktaḥ śrāddhaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || yathoktāṃ dakṣiṇāṃ dadyātsuvarṇaṃ rajataṃ tathā || 8 || dīnāndha kṛpaṇānāñca dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ suvarṇaṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 9 || upānahau tato deye jalakumbhaṃ dvijātaye || dadhyodanaṃ salavaṇaṃ śākajīrakasaṃyutam || 7.4.11.10 || raktavastraiḥ kaṃcukībhī rukmiṇīṃ paridhāpayet || viprapatnīśca viprāṃśca viṣṇurmeprīyatāmiti|| 11 || evaṃ kṛte dvija śreṣṭhāḥ kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ|| pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirgayāśrāddhena vai yathā || 12 || vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāyānti pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ || jīvate sa śriyāyuktaḥ putrapautrasamanvitaḥ || 13 || prītaḥ sadā bhavettasya rukmiṇyā saha keśavaḥ || yacchate vāñchitānsarvānaihikāmuṣmikānprabhuḥ || 14 || etanmāhātmyamatulaṃ viṣṇupādodbhavaṃ tathā || yaḥ śṛṇoti harau bhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ sa mucyate || 15 || śrutvā'dhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye viṣṇupadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikādaśo'dhyāya.|| || 11 || || cha ||
<7.4.12>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā gopracāramataḥ param || yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhedgodānajaṃ phalam || 1 || yatra snāto jagannātho nabhasye daivatairvṛtaḥ || kaṭadānaṃ ca tatproktaṃ dvādaśyāṃ dvijasattamāḥ || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathaṃ tu tatra daityendrā'bhavadvai gopracārakam || tīrthaṃ kathaya tattvena yatra snāto janārddanaḥ || 3 || || prahlāda uvāca || || hate kaṃse bhojarāje kṛṣṇenāmitatejasā || ugrasene cābhiṣikte madhupuryyāṃ mahātmanā || 4 || uddhavaṃ preṣayāmāsa gokule gokulapriyaḥ || suhṛdāṃ priyakāmārthaṃ gopagopījanasya ca || 5 || namaskṛtya ca govidaṃ prayayau naṃdagokulam || sa tatsadṛśaveṣeṇa vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 6 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā divasasyāṃte goviṃdānucaraṃ priyam || uddhavaṃ pūjayāmāsa vastrālaṃkārabhūṣaṇaiḥ || 7 || taṃ bhuktavaṃtaṃ viśrāṃtaṃ yaśodā putravatsalā || ānaṃdabāṣpapūrṇākṣī papracchānāmayaṃ hareḥ || 8 || kacciddhi staḥ sukhaṃ putrau rāmakṛṣṇau yadūttamau || kaccitsmarati goviṃdo vayasyāngopabālakān || 9 || kaccideṣyati goviṃdo gokulaṃ madhureśvaraḥ || tārayiṣyati putro'sau gokulaṃ vṛjinārṇavāt || 7.4.12.10 || ityuktvā bāṣpapūrṇākṣau yaśodā naṃda eva ca || dīrghaṃ rurudaturdīnau putrasnehavaśaṃgatau || 11 || uddhavastau tato dṛṣṭvā prāṇasaṃśayamāgatau || madhuraiḥ kṛṣṇasaṃdeśaiḥ snehayuktairajīvayat || 12 || namaskaroti bhavatīṃ bhavaṃtaṃ ca sahāgrajaḥ || anāmayaṃ pṛṣṭavāṃśca tau ca kṣemeṇa tiṣṭhataḥ || 13 || kṣiprameṣyati dāśārho rāmeṇa sahito vibhuḥ || atrāgatya jagannātho vidhāsyati ca vo hitam || 14 || ityevaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃdeśaiḥ samāśvāsyoddhavastadā || sukhaṃ suṣvāpa śayane nandādyairabhinaṃditaḥ || 15 || gopyastadā rathaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvāre naṃdasya vismitāḥ || ko'yaṃ ko'yamiti prāhuḥ kṛṣṇāgamanaśaṃkayā || 16 || gopālarājasya gṛhe rathenādityavarcasā || samāgato mahābāhuḥ kṛṣṇaveṣānugastathā || 17 || parasparaṃ samāgamya sarvāstā vrajayoṣitaḥ || vivikte kṛṣṇadūtaṃ taṃ papracchuḥ śokakarṣitāḥ || 18 || || śrīgopya ūcuḥ || || kasmāttvamiha saṃprāptaḥ kiṃ te kāryyamihādya vai || dasyurūpapraticchanno hyasmānsaṃhartumicchasi || 19 || pūrvameva hataṃ tena kṛṣṇena hṛdayādikam|| pāyayitvā'dharaviṣaṃ yoṣidvrātaṃ palāyitaḥ || 7.4.12.20 || ityevamuktvā tā gopyo mumuhuḥ śokavihvalāḥ || īkṣaṃtyaḥ kṛṣṇadāsaṃ taṃ nipeturdharaṇītale || 21 || uddhavastaṃ janaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇasnehahṛtāśayam || āśvāsayāmāsa tadā vākyaiḥ śrotrasukhāvahaiḥ || 22 || || uddhava uvāca || || bhagavānapi dāśārhaḥ kandarpaśarapīḍitaḥ || na bhuṃkte na svapiti ca cintayanvastvaharniśam || 23 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasya lalitā krodhamūrchitā || uddhavaṃ tāmranayanā provāca rudatī tadā || 24 || || lalitovāca || || asatyo bhinnamaryyādaḥ krūraḥ krūrajanapriyaḥ || tvaṃ mā kṛthā naḥ purataḥ kathāṃ tasyā'kṛtātmanaḥ || 25 || dhigdhikpāpasamācāro dhigdhigvai niṣṭhurāśayaḥ || hitvā yaḥ strījanaṃ mūḍho gato dvāravatīṃ hariḥ || 26 || || || śyāmalovāca || || kiṃ tasya mandabhāgyasya alpapuṇyasya durmateḥ || mā kurudhvaṃ kathāḥ sādhvyaḥ kathāṃ kathayatā'parām || 27 || || || dhanyovāca || || kenāyaṃ hi samānīto dūto duṣṭajanasya ca || yātu tena pathā pāpaḥ punarnāyāti yena ca ||28|| || viśākhovāca || || na śīlaṃ na kulaṃ yasya nāsti pāpakṛtaṃ bhayam || tasya strīhanane sādhvyo jñāyate janma karma ca || hīnasya puruṣārthena tena saṃgo nirarthakaḥ || 29 || || || rādhovāca || || bhūtānāṃ ghātane yasya nāsti pāpakṛtaṃ bhayam || tasya strīhanane sādhvyaḥ śaṃkā kāpi na vidyate || 7.4.12.30 || || śaibyovāca || || satyaṃ brūhi mahābhāga kiṃ karoti yadūttamaḥ || saṃgato nāgarastrībhirasmākaṃ kiṃ kathāṃ smaret || 31 || || padmovāca || || kadoddhava mahābhāga nāgarījanavallabhaḥ || sameṣyatīha dāśārhaḥ padmapatrāyatekṣaṇaḥ || 32 || || bhadrovāca || || hā kṛṣṇa hā gopavara hā gopījanavallabha || samuddhara mahābāho gopīḥ saṃsārasāgarāt|| 33 || || prahlāda uvāca || || iti tā vividhairvākyairvilapaṃtyo vrajastriyaḥ || ruruduḥ susvaraṃ devyaḥ smaraṃtyaḥ kṛṣṇa ceṣṭitam || 34 || tāsāṃ tadruditaṃ śrutvā bhaktisnehasamanvitaḥ || vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā sādhusādhviti cābravīt || 35 || || uddhava uvāca || || yaṃ na brahmā na ca haro na devā na maharṣayaḥ || svabhāvamanugacchaṃti sarvā dhanyā vrajastriyaḥ || 36 || sarvāsāṃ saphalaṃ janma jīvitaṃ yauvanaṃ dhanam || yāsāṃ bhavedbhagavati bhaktiravyabhicāriṇī || 37 || || gopya ūcuḥ || || sādhu darśaya goviṃdaṃ sādhu darśaya vallabham || nayāsmānsādhu tatraiva yatra tiṣṭhati so'cyutaḥ || 37 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tāsāṃ tadbhāṣitaṃ śrutvā tathā vilapitaṃ bahu || bāḍhamityeva tā ūca uddhavaḥ snehavihvalāḥ || 39 || uddhavena samaṃ sarvāstatastā vrajayoṣitaḥ || anujagmurmudā yuktāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ || 7.4.12.40 || gāyantyaḥ priyagītāni tadbālacaritāni ca || jagmuḥ sahaiva śanakairuddhavena vrajāṃganāḥ || 41 || yadupuryyāṃ tato dṛṣṭvā udyānavipināvalīḥ || adya devaṃ prapaśyāmaḥ kṛṣṇākhyaṃ naṃdanaṃdanam || || 42 || dvāravatyāṃ tu gamanāddhyānāllakṣmīpatestadā || aśeṣakalmaṣānmuktā vidhvastākhilabandhanāḥ || 43 || saṃprāptāstāstataḥ sarvāstīre mayasarasya ca || praṇipatyoddhavaḥ prāha gopikāḥ kṛṣṇadevatāḥ || 44 || sthīyatāṃ mātaraścātrātraiveṣyati mahābhujaḥ || kṛṣṇaḥ kamalapatrākṣo vidhāsyati ca vo hitam || 45 || || gopya ūcuḥ || || kasyoddhava idaṃ cātra saraḥ sārasaśobhitam || saṃpūrṇaṃ paṃkajaiścitraiḥ kalhārakumudotpalaiḥ || 46 || || || uddhava uvāca || || mayo nāma mahādaityo māyāvī lokaviśrutaḥ || kṛtaṃ tena saraḥ śubhraṃ tasya nāmnā ca viśrutam || 47 || || śrīgopya ūcuḥ || || śīghramānaya goviṃdaṃ sādhu darśaya cācyutam|| nayanānaṃdajananaṃ tāpatrayavināśanam || 48 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tāsāṃ gopikānāṃ tadoddhavaḥ || dūtaiḥ samānayāmāsa śrīkṛṣṇaṃ śīghrayāyibhiḥ || 49 || āyāṃtaṃ śīghrayānena dṛṣṭvā devakinaṃdanam || bhrājamānaṃ suvapuṣā vanamālāvibhūṣitam || || 7.4.12.50 || jvalatkirīṭamukuṭaṃ sphuranmakarakuṇḍalam|| śrīvatsāṃkaṃ mahābāhuṃ pītakauśeyavāsasam || 51 || ātapatrairvṛtaṃ mūrdhni saṃvṛtaṃ vṛṣṇipuṃgavaiḥ || saṃstutaṃ baṃdimukhyaiśca gītavāditranisvanaiḥ || 52 || paurajānapadairlokairvaiṣṇavaiḥ sarvato vṛtam || paśyantaṃ haṃsamithunaiḥ saraḥ sārasaśobhitam ||53 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā'cyutamāyāṃtaṃ lokakāṃtaṃ manoharam || priyaṃ priyāścirāddṛṣṭvā mumuhustā vrajāṃganāḥ || 54 || cirāya saṃjñāṃ saṃprāpya vilepuśca suduḥkhitāḥ || hā nātha kāṃta hā kṛṣṇa hā vrajeśa manohara ||55 || saṃvardhito'si yairbālye krīḍito vatsapālakaiḥ || te'pi tvayā parityaktāḥ kathaṃ duṣṭo'si nirghṛṇaḥ || 56 || na te dharmo na sauhārddaṃ na satyaṃ sakhyameva ca || pitṛmātṛparityāgī kathaṃ yāsyasi sadgatim || 57 || svāminbhaktaparityāgaḥ sarvaśāstreṣu garhitaḥ || tyajatā'smānvane vīra dharmo nāvekṣitastvayā || 58 || || prahlāda uvāca || || śrutvā tāsāṃ vilapitaṃ gopīnāṃ naṃda naṃdana| ananyaśaraṇāḥ sarvā bhāvajño bhagavānvibhuḥ|| sāṃtvayāmāsa vacanairvrajeśastā vrajāṃganāḥ|| 59|| adhyātmaśikṣayā gopīḥ prabhustā anvaśikṣayat|| 7.4.12.60|| śrībhagavānuvāca|| bhavatīnāṃ viyogo me na hi sarvātmanā kvacit|| vasāmi hṛdaye śaśvadbhūtānāmaviśeṣataḥ||61|| ahaṃ sarvasya prabhavo matto devāḥ savāsavāḥ || ādityā vasavo rudrāḥ sādhyā viśve marudgaṇāḥ || 62 || brahmā rudraśca viṣṇuśca sanakādyā maharṣayaḥ || iṃdriyāṇi mano buddhistathā sattvaṃ rajastamaḥ || 63 || kāmaḥ krodhaśca lobhaśca moho'haṃkāra eva ca || etatsarvamaśeṣeṇa matto gopyaḥ pravarttate || 64 || etajjñātvā mahābhāgā mā sma kṛdhvaṃ manaḥ śuci || sarvabhūteṣu māṃ nityaṃ bhāvayadhvamakalmaṣāḥ|| 65 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tāḥ kṛṣṇavacanaṃ śrutvā gopyo vidhvastabandhanāḥ || vimuktasaṃśayakleśā darśanānandasaṃplutāḥ|| ūcuśca gopavadhvastāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ nirmalamānasāḥ || 66 || || || gopya ūcuḥ || || adya naḥ saphalaṃ janma adya naḥ saphalā dṛśaḥ || yattvāṃ paśyāma govinda nāgarījanavallabham || 67 || puṇyahīnā na paśyaṃti kṛṣṇākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ param || vākyairhetvarthasaṃyuktairyadi saṃbodhitā vayam || tathāpi māyā hṛdayānnāpaiti madhusūdana || 68 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || darśanātsparśanāccāsya vimuktā'śeṣabandhanāḥ || snātvā ca sakalānkāmānavāpsyatha vrajāṃganāḥ || 69 || || gopya ūcuḥ || || adbhuto hi prabhāvaste saraso'sya udāhṛtaḥ || vidhiṃ brūhi jagannātha vistarādvṛṣṇinandana || 7.4.12.70 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || bhavatīnāṃ mayā sārddhaṃ sañjātamatra darśanam || tasmānmayā sadā hyatra snātavyaṃ niyamena hi || 71 || yaḥ snātvā parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsantarpayiṣyati || śrāvaṇasya site pakṣe dvādaśyāṃ niyataḥ śuciḥ || 72 || dattvā dānaṃ svaśaktyā ca māmuddiśya tathā pitṝn || labhate vaiṣṇavaṃ lokaṃ pitṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 73 || maya tīrthaṃ samāsādya kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān || phalamekaṃ gṛhītvā tu mantreṇārghyaṃ pradāpayet || 74 || gṛhāndhakūpe patitaṃ māyā pāśaśatairvṛtam || māmuddhara mahīnātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 75 || || arghyamantraḥ || || snātvā yaḥ parayā bhaktyā pitṝnsaṃtarpya bhāvataḥ || kuryācchrāddhaṃ ca parayā pitṛbhaktyā samanvitaḥ || 76 || dakṣiṇāṃ ca tato dadyādrajataṃ rukmameva ca || viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ pāyasaṃ ca saśarkaram || 77 || navanītaṃ ghṛtaṃ chatraṃ kaṃbalājinameva ca || bhavatībhiḥ samaṃ yasmātsaṃjātaṃ mama darśanam || āgaṃtavyaṃ mayā tasmātsadā hyasmiñjalāśaye || 78 || yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute mayasya sarasi priyāḥ || gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ tasya viṣṇulokastathā'kṣayaḥ || 79 || muktiṃ prayāṃti tasyaiva pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ || putrapautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ || yāvajjīvaṃ sukhaṃ bhuktvā cānte haripuraṃ vrajet || 7.4.12.80 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye mayanirmitasaromāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvādaśo'dhyāyaḥ ||12 || cha ||
<7.4.13>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || iti kṛṣṇavacaḥ śrutvā gopyaḥ saṃhṛṣṭamānasāḥ || tasminmayasare snātvā vimuktā'śeṣabandhanāḥ || 1 || kṛṣṇadarśanasaṃjātaparamānandasaṃplutāḥ || ūcuśca vacanaṃ gopyo madhuraṃ mādhavaṃ prati || 2 || || gopya ūcuḥ || || dhanyaḥ sa daityapravaro mayo yena kṛtaṃ saraḥ || yasmiṃstvaṃ devataiḥ sārddhaṃ sameṣyasi jagatpate || 3 || yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavannanugrāhyā vayaṃ yadi || asmākamapi vārṣṇeya kārayasva sarottamam || 4 || kīrttanānmṛtyuloke'smiṃstava saṃdarśanena hi || aharniśaṃ tava dhyānādyāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 5 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || kariṣye vaḥ priyaṃ sādhvyo yūyaṃ mama parigrahāḥ || anugrāhyā mayā nityaṃ bhaktigrāhyo'smi sarvadā || 6 || || prahlāda uvāca || || ityuktvā bhagavānkṛṣṇo gopīnāṃ hitakāmyayā || sarasaḥ sannidhau tasya sarastvanyaccakāra ha || 7 || tadagādhaṃ svacchajalaṃ nalinīdalaśobhitam || haṃsasārasayugmaiśca cakravākaiśca śobhitam || 8 || kumudotpalakahlārapadminīkhaṇḍamaṇḍitam || sevitaṃ dvijamukhyaiśca siddhavidyādharaistathā || 9 || sevitaṃ yadunārībhistathā yadukumārakaiḥ || divārātrau susaṃpūrṇaṃ sarvairjānapadairjanaiḥ || 7.4.13.10 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā jalakallolaiḥ susaṃpūrṇaṃ jalāśayam || harṣādgopījanaṃ kṛṣṇaḥ provāca vacanaṃ tadā || 11 || paśyadhvaṃ gopikāḥ śubhraṃ saraḥ saraṃ samīpataḥ || svacchamiṣṭajalāpūrṇaṃ sajjanānāṃ yathā manaḥ || 12 || kāraṇādbhavatīnāṃ ca yasmātkṛtamidaṃ saraḥ || bhavatīnāṃ tathā nāmnā khyātametadbhaviṣyati || 13 || gorvācāvācakaḥ śabdo bhavatībhirmayā saha || gopracāreti vai nāmnāṃ khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati || 14 || yuṣmākaṃ priyakāmārthaṃ yasmātkṛtamidaṃ saraḥ || tasmādgopīsara iti khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati || 15 || || gopya ūcuḥ || || anugrāhyā yadi vayamasmannāmnā kṛtaṃ saraḥ || anyatkimapi vārṣṇeya prārthayāmo vadasva naḥ || 16 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || prārthyatāṃ yadabhipretaṃ yadvo manasi vartate || bhaktyā samāgatā yūyaṃ nāstyadeyaṃ tato mayā || 17 || || gopya ūcuḥ || || yadi tuṣṭo'si bhagavanyadi deyo varo hi naḥ || tasmāttvayā sadā kṛṣṇa narayānena mādhava || 18 || atrāgatya nabhasye'sminsnātavyaṃ niyamena hi || yatra tvaṃ tatra devāśca yajñāstīrthāni keśava || 19 || yatra tvaṃ tatra dānāni vratāni niyamāśca ye || oṃkāraśca vaṣaṭkāraḥ svāhākāraḥ svadhā tathā || 7.4.13.20 || bhūrbhuvaḥsvarmaharlloko janaḥ satyaṃ tapastathā || tvanmayaṃ hi jagatsarvaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam ||21 || tasmāttvayi jagannāthe hyatra snāte janārdane || snātamatra tribhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 22 || trailokyapāvanī gaṃgā tava pādajalaṃ hi tat || lakṣmīrvakṣaḥsthalasthāne mukhe devī sarasvatī || 23 || sarvabhūtamayaścātra tatastvaṃ jagadīśvara || yaddadāsi manuṣyāṇāṃ bhaviṣyāṇāṃ kalau yuge || tadvadasva mahābāho kṛpāṃ kṛtvā jagatpate || 24 || yātrāyāmāgatānāṃ ca atha ṣaṇmāsavāsinām || sadaivātra sthitānāṃ ca yatphalaṃ tadvadasva naḥ || 25 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || yatphalaṃ hi manuṣyāṇāṃ snātānāṃ gopikāsare || tacchṛṇudhvamasaṃdigdhaṃ prasanne mayi gopikāḥ || 26 || sopaskarāṃ savatsāṃ ca vastrālaṃkārabhūṣitām || yathoktadakṣiṇopetāṃ brāhmaṇāya kuṭuṃbine || 27 || sadācārāya śuddhāya daridrāyānukāriṇe || gāṃ dattvā phalamāpnoti snānamātreṇa tatphalam || 28 || yāvatpadāni manujaḥ kṛṣṇena saha gacchati || kulāni devyastāvaṃti vasaṃti harimandire || 29 || kṛṣṇena saha gacchanti gītavāditranisvanaiḥ || stuvanto vividhaiḥ stotrairgoviṃdaṃ gopikāsare || 7.4.13.30 || na māturjaṭhare teṣāṃ yātanā jāyate nṛṇām || sarvānkāmānavāpyāṃte vaiṣṇavaṃ lokamāpnuyuḥ || 31 || arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena snānaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥ || maṃtreṇānena vai sādhvyaḥ śraddhayā parayā yutaḥ || 32 || namaste goparūpāya viṣṇave paramātmane || gopracāre jagannātha gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 33 || arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena mṛdamālipya pāṇinā || snāyācchraddhāsamāyuktastarpayetpitṛdevatāḥ || 34 || śrāddhaṃ kuryyāttato bhaktyā ekacittaḥ samāhitaḥ || yathoktadakṣiṇā dadyādrajataṃ rukmameva ca || 35 || viśeṣataḥ pradātavyaṃ tāṃbūlaṃ kajjalaṃ tathā || dukūlāni ca deyāni tathā kausuṃbhakāni ca || 36 || daṃpatyorvāsasī caiva bhūṣaṇāni svaśaktitaḥ || gāvo deyā dvijātibhyo vṛṣabhāśca dhuraṃdharāḥ || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ deyaṃ svaśaktitaḥ || 37 || evaṃ kṛtvā naraḥ samyaguttamāṃ gatimāpnuyāt || prayāṃti paramaṃ lokaṃ pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ || 38 || labhate putrakāmastu putrāniṣṭānmanoramān || 39 || yaṃ yaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ svargamokṣādikaṃ naraḥ || tatsarvaṃ samavāpnoti yaḥ snāti gopikāsare || 7.4.13.40 || yāvallokā bhaviṣyaṃti tāvatsthāsyati vai saraḥ || yāvatsaro yaśastāvadbhavatīnāṃ bhaviṣyati || 41 || yāvatkīrtirmanuṣyeṣu tāvatsvarge mahīyate || vimuktāḥ sakalātpāpādyāsyaṃti paramāṃ gatim || 42 || tatpuṇyaṃ gopīsara idaṃ jalaiḥ pūrṇaṃ sadaiva hi || avagāhyaṃ mayā gopyo nabhasye niyamena hi || 43 || bhavatyaḥ patibhāvena brahmabhāvena vā punaḥ || ciṃtayaṃtyaḥ paraṃ māṃ hi parāgatimavāpsyatha || 44 || || prahlāda uvāca || || anujñātā bhagavatā tatastā gopakanyakāḥ || namaskṛtya ca goviṃdaṃ yayuḥ sarvā yathāgatā || 45 || bhagavānapi goviṃda uddhavena samanvitaḥ || visṛjya gopikāḥ kṛṣṇaḥ svakaṃ maṃdiramāviśat || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gopīsarastīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayodaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 13 ||
<7.4.14>
|| śrīprahrāda uvāca || || saṃtyanekāni tīrthāni bahvāścaryakarāṇi ca || prāpte kaliyuge ghore tāni pupluvirerṇave || 1 || uddeśato mayā viprāḥ kīrtyamānā nibodhata || saṃkṣepato vipravarā yathā teṣāṃ ca yāḥ kriyāḥ || 2 || saṃhṛtya ca bhuvo bhāraṃ sādhū nsaṃsthāpya satpathe || dvāravatyāmagātkṛṣṇo vṛṣṇisaṃghaiḥ samāvṛtaḥ || 3 || darśanārthaṃ tadā brahmā daivataiḥ parivāritaḥ || varuṇo yamavitteśau sūryyācandramasau tathā || 4 || āgatya saha kṛṣṇena kāryaṃ saṃsādhya cātmanaḥ || vedhāścakre tadā tīrthaṃ svanāmnā kīrtitaṃ bhuvi || 5 || brahmakuṇḍamiti khyātaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || tattīre sthāpayāmāsa sahasrakiraṇaṃ prabhum || 6 || mūlaṃ surāṇāṃ hi kila brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ || tena saṃsthāpitaṃ yasmānmūla sthānamiti smṛtam || 7 || brahmatīrthaṃ tu taddṛṣṭvā candraścakre tataḥ saraḥ || taḍāgaṃ candranāmnā vai sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 8 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā tejasā yuktaṃ saṃhṛṣṭāḥ surasattamāḥ || ūcuste lokasraṣṭāraṃ śṛṇuṣva vacanaṃ hi naḥ || 9 || yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute pitṝnsaṃtarpayiṣyati || pūjayiṣyati deveśaṃ mūlasthānaṃ surarṣabha || 7.4.14.10 || sarvapāpavinirmukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ || saptamyāṃ māghamāsasya śuklapakṣe dvijarṣabhāḥ || yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute mānavo bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || 11 || mūlasthānaṃ ca deveśa saṃsnāpya pravilepayet || pūjayiṣyati vastrādyaiḥ svaśaktyā bhūṣaṇaistathā || 12 || puṣpadhūpādibhiścaiva naivedyena ca mānavaḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti brahmalokaṃ sa gacchati || 13 || sāvitrīṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā brahmaṇā sthāpitāṃ ca vai || kṛtvā cāyatanaṃ divyaṃ svāṃ mūrtiṃ sanniveśya ca || nāma cakre tadā devyāḥ svayaṃ tasyāḥ pitāmahaḥ || 14 || yaḥ paśyati svayaṃ bhaktyā kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā jagatpatim || sāvitrīṃ sa sukhī bhūtvā sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 15 || āyurārogyamaiśvaryyaṃ putrasantānameva ca || na daurbhāgyaṃ bhavettasya na dāridyaṃ na mūrkhatā || na ca vyādhibhayaṃ tasya yaḥ paśyati vidhiṃ naraḥ || 16 || gatvā saṃsnāpayeddevīṃ kuṃkumena kusuṃbhakaiḥ || saṃchādya vastraiḥ saṃpūjya puṣpairnānāvidhai stathā || 17 || naivedyaphalatāṃbūlagrīvāsūtrakadīpakaiḥ || saṃpūjya parayā bhaktyā yātrāṃ ca saphalā labhet || 18 || na vaidhavyaṃ na daurbhāgyaṃ na vaṃdhyā na mṛtaprajā || vidhirdṛṣṭo narairyaistu kule teṣāṃ prajāyate || 19 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena vidhiṃ paśyetsubhāvataḥ || parituṣṭo bhavetkṛṣṇo yātrā ca saphalā bhavet || 7.4.14.20 || || prahlāda uvāca || || brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ dṛṣṭvā saraḥ paramaśobhanam || indraścakre mahābhāgaḥ saraḥ paramaśobhanam || 21 || sthāpayāmāsa deveśo liṃgamapratimaujasam || tasminsnātvā ca labhate yasmādindrapadaṃ naraḥ || 22 || tasmādindrapadaṃ nāma suprasiddhaṃ dharātale || indreṇa sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ yasmādbhāvanayā saha || prasiddhamiṃdranāmnā vā indreśvaramiti smṛtam ||23|| yasya prasiddhiratulā vṛddhiliṃgamiti dvijāḥ|| yasya darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 24 || pitṝṇāmakṣayā tṛptirjāyate dvijasattamāḥ || aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturddaśyāṃ snātvā cendrapade naraḥ || 25 || indreśvaraṃ ca saṃpūjya yāti muktipadaṃ naraḥ || viśeṣatastu saṃpūjyo makarasthe divākare || 26 || uttarāyaṇasaṃkrāṃtau liṃgapūraṇakena hi || śivarātrau viśeṣeṇa saṃpūjya umayā saha || rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā paramaṃ lokamāpnuyāt || 27 || || prahlāda uvāca|| || brahmatīrthaṃ ca taddṛṣṭvā tathā śakrasarobhavam || darśayanviṣṇunā sārddhamekarūpatvamāpnuyāt || 28 || saraścakāra deveśo bhagavānpārvatīpatiḥ || sumṛṣṭanirmalajalaṃ nalinīdalaśobhitam || 29 || utpalaiḥ sarvataśchannaṃ saraḥ sārasaśobhitam || tadagādhajalaṃ dṛṣṭvā svayameva pinākadhṛk || sabrahmaviṣṇunā sārddhaṃ snātastatra vṛṣadhvajaḥ || 7.4.14.30 || te devāstatsaro dṛṣṭvā brahmaviṣṇusurā'surāḥ || ūcuḥ sarve susaṃhṛṣṭā vīkṣaṃtaḥ pārvatīpatim || 31 || yasmātkṛtamidaṃ devā īśvareṇa mahatsaraḥ || mahādeva saronāma suprasiddhaṃ bhaviṣyati || 32 || yo'tra snānaṃ prakurute pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇaṃ tathā || śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ bhaktyā ca sa gacchetparamāṃ gatim || 33 || suprasannā bhaviṣyanti sarve devā na saṃśayaḥ || darśanātpāpanirmukto mahādevasarasya ca || 34 || maheśasya ca taddṛṣṭvā saraḥ paramaśobhanam || cakāra pārvatī tatra saraścāpratimaṃ tathā || 35 || gaurīsara iti khyātaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā na durgatimavāpnuyāt || 36 || na daurbhāgyaṃ striyaścaiva na vaidhavyaṃ kadācana || snātvā gaurītīrthavare sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt ||37|| varuṇaśca tato dṛṣṭvā puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || cakāra ca saro divyaṃ viṣṇubhaktisamanvitaḥ || 38 || nāmnā varuṇapadaṃ tacca pāpakṣayakaraṃ bhuvi || nabhasye paurṇamāsyāṃ ca saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || 39 || śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayānvitaḥ || uttamaṃ lokamāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati || 7.4.14.40 || pradadyādudakumbhāṃśca dadhyodanasamanvitān || gāśca vāsāṃsi ratnāni viṣṇurme prīyatāmiti || 41 || saro dṛṣṭvā jaleśasya saraścakre dhaneśvaraḥ || yakṣādhipasaronāma suprasiddhaṃ dharātale || 42 || tathā tatra naro bhaktyā saṃpūjya pitṛdevatāḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti dadyādvastradvijātaye || 43 || || prahlāda uvāca || || viṣṇuṃ varapradaṃ śrutvā bhrātṝṇāṃ brahmanaṃdanāḥ || maṃdākinī vasiṣṭhena samānītā dharātale || 44 || ambarīṣādayaḥ sarva ājagmuḥ kṛṣṇapālitām|| dvāravatyāṃ ca te dṛṣṭvā gomatīṃ sāgaraṃgamām || 45 || tīrthāni devatānāṃ ca puṇyānyāyatanāni ca || tīrthaṃ paṃcanadaṃ cakruḥ prajānāṃ patayastathā || 46 || paṃca nadyaḥ samāhūtāstatrā''jagmuḥ surānvitāḥ || marīcaye gomatī ca lakṣmaṇā cātraye tathā || 47 || caṃdrabhāgā cāṃgirase pulahāya kuśāvatī || pāvanārthaṃ jāṃbavatī jagāma kratave tathā || 48 || tāsu snātvā mahābhāgā brahmaputrā yaśasvinaḥ || nāma tasya tadā cakruḥ paṃcanadyaśca tāpasāḥ ||49|| tasmātpaṃcanadaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || snātavyaṃ tatra manujaiḥ svargamokṣārthibhistadā || 7.4.14.50 || tatra gatvā suniyato gṛhītvārghyaṃ phalena hi || maṃtreṇānena vai viprā dadyādarghyaṃ vidhānataḥ || 51 || brahmaputraiḥ samānītāḥ paṃcaitāḥ saritāṃ varāḥ || gṛhṇaṃtvarghyamimaṃ devyaḥ sarvapāpapraśāṃtaye ||52|| || ityarghyamantraḥ || || snānaṃ kṛtvā vidhānena pitṝnsaṃtarppayennaraḥ || śrāddhaṃ kuryyādvidhānena śradbhayā parayā yutaḥ ||53|| paṃcaratnaṃ tato deyaṃ saptadhānyaṃ dvijātaye || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇānāṃ ca dānaṃ dadyātsvaśaktitaḥ || 54 || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || putrapautrasamāyuktaḥ paraṃ sukhamavāpnuyāt || 55 || pretayoniṃ gatā ye ca ye ca kīṭatvamāgatāḥ || sarve te muktimāyāṃti pitarastrikulodbhavāḥ || 56 || śrutvā'dhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ śivaloke ca modate || sarvapāpa vinirmuktaḥ sa yāti paramaṃ padam || 57 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye pañcanadatīrthamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturdaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 14 || || cha ||
<7.4.15>
|| prahlāda uvāca | || śrutvā tamāgataṃ devaṃ brahmāṇaṃ pitaraṃ svakam || sanakādyā namaskarttuṃ jagmuḥ sarve pitāmaham ||1|| taṃ dṛṣṭvā lokakarttāraṃ daṇḍavatpraṇatāḥ kṣitau || tato dṛṣṭvā sa tanayānsaṃgṛhya pariṣasvaje ||2|| pṛṣṭaścānāmayaṃ taistu pṛṣṭvā tānsamuvāca ha || ārādhito yairbhagavāndhanyā yūyaṃ vayaṃ tathā || 3 || saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ yātā bhagavaddarśanena hi || na jñātaṃ putrakāḥ samyagajñānādbālabuddhibhiḥ || 4 || yenārcito mahādevastasya tuṣyati keśavaḥ || anarcite nīlakaṇṭhe na gṛhṇātyarcanaṃ hariḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena pūjyatāṃ nīlalohitaḥ|| 5|| yena saṃpūrṇatāṃ yāti kṛṣṇapūjā kṛtā sadā|| tacchrutvā vacanaṃ tasyā brahmaputrā yayustadā|| 6|| devāgārāgrato gatvā yogasiddhā maharṣayaḥ|| liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsuḥ śivabhaktipuraskṛtā|| 7|| saṃsthāpya śivaliṃgaṃ te snānārthaṃ munisattamāḥ|| kūpaṃ cakrustataḥ sarva ṛṣayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || 8 || dṛṣṭvā tamamṛtaprakhyaṃ jalapūrṇaṃ sunirmalam || saṃhṛṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve sādhusādhviti cābruvan || 9 || sthāpitaṃ śivaliṃgaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā lokapitāmahaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ brahmā prītaḥ putrāṃstadā dvijāḥ || 7.4.15.10 || || brahmovāca || || bhavadbhiryogasaṃsiddhairyasmātsaṃsthāpitaḥ śivaḥ || tasmātsiddheśvara iti khyātiṃ loke gamiṣyati || 11 || samīpe śitikaṇṭhasya kūpoyamṛṣibhiḥ kṛtaḥ || ṛṣitīrthamiti khyātaṃ tasmālloke bhaviṣyati| || 12 || vinā śrāddhena viprendrā dānena pitṛtarpaṇāt || bhaktitaḥ snānamātreṇa pitṛbhiḥ saha mucyate || 13 || asatyavādino ye ca paranindā parāyaṇāḥ || snānamātreṇa śudhyanti ṛṣitīrthe na saṃśayaḥ || 14 || snānaṃ praśastaṃ viṣuve manvādiṣu tathaiva ca || tathā kṛtayugādyāyāṃ māghasya dvijasattamāḥ || 15 || śivarātrau vasedyastu liṃge siddheśasaṃjñite || snātvā ṛṣikṛte tīrthe kiṃ tasyānyena vai dvijāḥ || gatvā tatra mahābhāgā gṛhītvā phalamuttamam || 16 || arghyaṃ dattvā vidhānena kṛtvā ca karayoḥ kuśān || gṛhṇaṃtvarghyamimaṃ devā yogasiddhā maharṣayaḥ || 17 || ṛṣitīrthe ca pāpaghne siddheśvarasamanvite || dattvārghyaṃ mṛdamālabhya snānaṃ kuryātsamāhitaḥ ||18|| tarpayecca pitṝndevānmanuṣyāṃśca yathākramam || tataḥ śrāddhaṃ prakurvīta pitṝṇāṃ śraddhayā'nvitaḥ || 19 || tathā ca dakṣiṇāṃ dadyādvittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || viśeṣataḥ pradeyāni phalāni rasavaṃti ca || 7.4.15.20 || dadyācchayāmākanīvārānvidrumaṃ cājināni ca || saptadhānyāni śālīṃśca saktūṃśca guḍasaṃyutān || 21 || gaṃdhamālyāni tāṃbūlaṃ vastrāṇi ca tathā payaḥ || evaṃ kṛtvā samagraṃ ca kṛtakṛtyo bhavennaraḥ || 22 || pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ siddheśvaramumāpatim || saphalaṃ janma martyasya jīvitaṃ ca sujīvitam || 23 || yaḥ snātvā ṛṣitīrthe tu paśyetsiddheśvaraṃ śivam || pitarastasya tuṣyanti tuṣyanti ca pitāmahāḥ || 24 || aputrā putriṇaḥ syuste putriṇaścāpi pautriṇaḥ || nirdhanā dhanavaṃtaśca siddheśvararatā narāḥ || 25 || duṣkṛtaṃ yāti vilayaṃ sukṛtaṃ ca vivarddhate || bhavenmanorathāvāptiḥ praṇate siddhanāyake || 26 || ṛṣitīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā siddheśvaraṃ haram || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 27 || śivarātryāṃ viśeṣeṇa siddheśaḥ saṃprapūjitaḥ || yaṃyaṃ kāmayate kāmaṃ taṃ dadāti na saṃśayaḥ || cintāmaṇisamaḥ svāmī hyathavā cākṣayo nidhiḥ ||28|| śrutvādhyāyamimaṃ puṇyaṃ sarvāghaharaṇaṃ param || prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ mānavaḥ śraddhayānvitaḥ||29|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakā māhātmya ṛṣitīrthasiddheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcadaśo'dhyāyaḥ||15||
<7.4.16>
prahlāda uvāca|| tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhā gadātīrthamanuttamam|| yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhedbhūdānajaṃ phalam|| 1 || tarpayetpitṛdevāṃśca ṛṣīṃścaiva yathākramam || śrāddhaṃ ca kārayettatra pitṝṇāṃ tṛptihetave || 2 || gadātīrthe tu deveśaṃ viṣṇuṃ vārāharūpiṇam || samabhyarcya naro bhaktyā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 3 || nāgatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsaraḥ paramaśo bhanam|| yatra snātvā naraḥ samyaṅnāgalokamavāpnuyāt || 4 || bhadratīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarastribhuvanārcitam || snānamātreṇa labhate tiladhenuphalaṃ naraḥ || || 5 || citrātīrthaṃ tato gacchetsaraḥ paramaśobhanam || snānamātreṇa labhate ghṛtadhenuphalaṃ naraḥ || 6 || yadā dvārāvatī viprā plāvitā sāgareṇa hi || puṇyāni bahutīrthāni cchannāni jalapāṃsubhiḥ || 7 || dṛśyāni katicitsaṃti hyadṛśyānyaparāṇi ca || tāni sarvāṇi viprendrāḥ kathayiṣyāmi sarvataḥ || 8 || caṃdrabhāgāṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśinīm || yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet || 9 || devī caṃdrārcitā yatra yaśodā naṃdanaṃdinī || kaumārikā śaktihastā khaṅgakheṭakadhāriṇī || 7.4.16.10|| keśyādidaityadalinī svasā vai rāmakṛṣṇayoḥ || yasyā darśanamātreṇa sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt|| 11 || tato gaccheta viprendrāstīrthaṃ mahiṣasaṃjñakam || yasya darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 12 || muktidvāraṃ tato gacchettīrthaṃ pāpa praṇāśanam|| 13 || vasiṣṭhena samānītā muninā yatra gomatī || snāto bhavati gaṃgāyāṃ yatra snātvā kalau yuge || 14 || gomatī niḥsṛtā yasmā tpraviṣṭā varuṇālayam || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā aśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 15 || bhṛguṇā hi tapastaptaṃ sthāpitā yatra cāṃbikā || bhṛgvarcitā tato devī prasiddhā śrūyate kṣitau || 16 || saṃsiddhiṃ paramāṃ yāti yasyāḥ saṃsmaraṇānnaraḥ || śivaliṃgānyanekāni yatra santi mahītale ||17|| tato gaccheta viprendrāḥ kālindīsara uttamam|| kālindī sūryatanayā saraścakre tvanuttamam || 18 || tatra snātvā naro bhaktyā na durgatimavāpnuyāt || sāṃbatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpapraṇāśanam|| 19 || kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ ca vidhivallabhedgodānajaṃ phalam || 7.4.16.20 || gacchecca śāṃkaraṃ tīrthaṃ tatastrailokyapāvanam || yatra snātvā naro bhaktyā labhedbahusuvarṇakam || 21 || tato nāgasaro gacchettīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || pitṝnsantarpya vidhivannāgalokamavāpnuyāt || 22 || lakṣmīṃ nadīṃ tato gacchedgacchantīṃ sāgaraṃ prati || yasyā darśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 23 || śrāddhe kṛte tu viprendrāḥ pitaro muktimāpnuyuḥ || dāne manorathāvāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ|| 24|| kaṃbusarastato gacchettīrthaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam|| tarpaṇe ca kṛte śrāddhe hyagniṣṭomaphalaṃ labhet||25|| kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsnātvā santarpayetpitṝn|| dānaṃ dattvā yathāśaktyā nirmalaṃ lokamāpnuyāt||26|| dyumnatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva sarvapāpapraṇāśanam|| kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ ca tatraiva vājimedhaphalaṃ labhet || 27 || kuśatīrthaṃ tato gacchetpitṝṇāṃ tṛptirakṣayā || yatra śrāddhāttarpaṇācca jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || || 28 || jālatīrthaṃ tato gacchetsarvapāpaharaṃ śubham || durvāsasā yatra śaptāḥ kopādyadukumārakāḥ || 29 || devo jāleśvarastatra saṃ babhūva umāpatiḥ || jāleśvaraṃ naro dṛṣṭvā sadyaḥ pāpātpramucyate || 7.4.16.30 || saṃpūjya devaṃ bhaktyā ca śivalokamavāpnuyāt || 31 || cakrasvāmisutīrthaṃ ca tato gaccheddhi mānavaḥ || kṛtvā snānaṃ pitṝṃstarpya viṣṇulokamavāpnuyāt || 32 || jaratkārukṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || snātvā tatra dvijaśreṣṭhā na durgatimavāpnuyāt || 33 || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthaṃ khañjanakābhidham || āsītkhañjanako nāma daityaścātibalānvitaḥ || 34 || tataḥ khañjanakaṃ tīrthaṃ tasya nāmneti viśrutam || tatra snātvā naro yāti somalokaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 35 || santi tīrthānyanekāni suguptāni dvijottamāḥ || tāni gacchettu viprendrāḥ sarvapāpāpanuttaye || 36 || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāstīrthamānakadundubheḥ || śūratīrthaṃ paramakaṃ gadatīrthamataḥ param || 37 || gāvalgaṇasya tīrthaṃ ca akrūrasya mahātmanaḥ || baladevasya tīrthaṃ tu ugrasenasya cāparam || 38 || arjunasya ca tīrthaṃ tu subhadrātīrthameva ca || devakītīrthamādyaṃ tu rohiṇītīrthameva ca || 39 || uddhavasya ca tīrthaṃ tu sāraṃgākhyaṃ tathaiva ca || satyabhāmākṛtaṃ tīrthaṃ bhadrātīrthamataḥ param || 7.4.16.40 || jāmadagnyasya tīrthaṃ tu rāmasya ca mahātmanaḥ || bhāsatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva śukatīrthamataḥ param || 41 || kardamasya ca tīrthaṃ tu kapilasya mahātmanaḥ || somatīrthaṃ ca tatraiva rohiṇītīrthameva ca || 42 || etānyanyāni saṃkṣepānmayā vaḥ kathitāni ca || sarvapāpaharāṇīha mokṣadāni na saṃśayaḥ || 43 || pracchannāni dvijavarāstīrthāni kalisaṃkrame || plāvitāni samudreṇa pāṃsunā'pyudakena ca || 44 || etanmayā vaḥ kathitaṃ saṃkṣepāttīrthavistaram || ātmaprajñānumānena kimanyacchrotumicchatha || 45 || śṛṇuyātparayā bhaktyā tīrthayātrāmimāṃ dvijāḥ || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakā māhātmye tīrthavṛndamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣoḍaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 16 || || cha ||
<7.4.17>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || kṛtvā'bhiṣekaṃ tīrtheṣu yathāvaddatta dakṣiṇaḥ || pūjayecca tato devaṃ kṛṣṇākhyaṃ puruṣaṃ param || 1 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || pūjāvidhiṃ tu kṛṣṇasya śrotukāmāḥ samāsataḥ || kathayā''caraṇopetaṃ yathāvaddaityasattama || 2 || dvārapālāśca ke tatra kaḥ pūrvaṃ kaśca pṛṣṭhataḥ || purīyaṃ sarvato daitya tiṣṭhate kena pālitā || 3 || ānupūrvyātsamāsena pūjanīyā yathāvidhi || kathayasva vidhijño'si kṛṣṇaikacaraṇapriyaḥ || 4 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || śrūyatāṃ pūjanaṃ viprāḥ śrutapūrvaṃ vidhānataḥ || kalau kṛṣṇasya viprendrā yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥ || 5 || pūrvadvārasthitāndevāñchuṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || jayaṃtaḥ prathamaṃ pūjyaḥ sarvapāpaharaḥ śubhaḥ || 6 || sthāpito devarājena pūjārthaṃ keśavasya hi || tasyaivānucarānvakṣye tānnibodhata sattamāḥ || 7 || vajranābhaḥ sunābhaśca vajrabāhurmahā hanuḥ || vajradaṃṣṭro vajradhārī vajrahā vajralocanaḥ || 8 || śvetamūrdhā śvetamālī jayantānucarāśca te || ete śastrodyatakarā rakṣante tamaharniśam || 9 || pūrvadvāre susaṃnaddhā jayantoddeśakāriṇaḥ || pūrvadvāre ca rakṣārthaṃ naranātho vināyakaḥ || 7.4.17.10 || taruṇārkaśca vai sūryo devyo vai sahamātaraḥ || īśvaraścāpi durvāsā nāgarājastu takṣakaḥ || 11 || senānīḥ kārtikeyaśca rākṣasaśca mahāhanuḥ || tatra dīrghanakhonāma dānavaḥ supratiṣṭhitaḥ || 12 || viśvāvasuśca gandharvo menakā ca varāpsarāḥ || sanatkumārasahito vasiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 13 || ete pūjyāḥ pūrvatastu nyagrodhaśca mahādrumaḥ || pūrvadvārasthitā hyeta āgneyāñchṛṇutātha me || 14 || jvālāmukho'tha raktākṣaḥ smaśānanilayaḥ krathaḥ || māṃsādo rudhirāhāraḥ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛṣṇajaṭādharaḥ || 15 || trāsano bhañjanaścaiva hyāgnyeyyāṃ diśi saṃsthitāḥ || diśaṃ rakṣaṃti saṃnaddhā dakṣiṇāṃ śṛṇutātha me || 16 || daṇḍapāṇirmahānādaḥ pāśahastaḥ sulocanaḥ || anivartyakramaścaiva tathā duṃdubhinisvanaḥ || 17 || kharasvano ghargharavāktathā maunapriyaḥ sadā || mallikākṣaśca eteṣāṃ praṇato dvārapālakaḥ || 18 || dakṣiṇadvārarakṣārthaṃ dundubhiśca vināyakaḥ || mahiṣārkaśca vai sūryo bhūṣaṇaśca tatheśvaraḥ || 19 || caṇḍikā ca tathā devī hyūrddhvabāhuśca rākṣasaḥ || padmākṣaḥ kṣetrapālaśca nāgaścāśvatarastathā || 7.4.17.20 || citrāṃgadaśca gandharva urvaśī ca varāpsarāḥ || yo rājā sarvavṛkṣāṇāṃ śālaścāpi mahādrumaḥ || 21 || sanātana ṛṣiśreṣṭho hyagastyaśca mahātapāḥ || ete yāmyadiśi dvāraṃ rakṣanti susamāhitāḥ || 22 || gītakṛnnartako nagnaḥ kaṃbalī dahanapriyaḥ || hasano netrabhaṃgaśca bhrūvikāro vijṛṃbhakaḥ || 23 || muśalī prabhureteṣāṃ saṃnaddho vartate dvijāḥ || rakṣanti nairṛtīmāśāṃ paścimāṃ śṛṇutāparān || 24 || svastikaḥ śaṃkhamūrddhā ca nīlavāsāḥ śubhānanaḥ|| pāśahastaḥ śūlahasta ekapādaikalocanaḥ|| 25|| paścimāyāṃ diśi tathā puṣpadanto vināyakaḥ|| uddhavārkaśca vai sūryaḥ śivaḥ satrājiteśvaraḥ || 26 || tuṃbarurnāmagandharvo ghṛtācī ca varāpsarāḥ || mahodaraśca nāgendro rākṣasaśca ghaṭotkacaḥ || 27 || daityaḥ pañcajanonāma ṛṣiḥ kaśyapa eva ca || devī kapālinīnāma aśvatthastu mahādrumaḥ || 28 || kapilaḥ kṣetrapālaśca pratīcīṃ pāti vai diśam || namaskāryāstathā pūjyā vāyavyo śṛṇutāparān || 29 || bhaṃjano bhairavaścaiva kāliko'tha ghaṭodaraḥ || jhaṃjhakāmardanaḥ piṃgo ruruḥ sarvabhujovraṇī ||7.4.17.30|| supārśvaḥ prabhureteṣāṃ saṃnaddhaḥ pālayandiśam || udīcyāṃ diśi viprendrāḥ śyāmalaśca gaṇādhipaḥ || 31 || manvantako virūpākṣo golakaḥ śveta saṃplutaḥ || unmattaḥ prabhureteṣāmudīcyāṃ pālayandiśam || 32 || mūlasthānaśca vai sūryya indreśaśca maheśvaraḥ || devī kaṇṭheśvarīnāma kṣetrapālaśca khañjanaḥ || 33 || vāsukirnāgarājaśca kūrmapṛṣṭhaśca dānavaḥ || sanakaśca ṛṣiśreṣṭho golako rākṣasastathā || 34 || nāradonāma gandharvo raṃbhā caiva varāpsarāḥ || ete pūjyāḥ prayatnena plakṣonāma mahādrumaḥ || 35 || yakṣeśaḥ savitānāma śyāmaḥ pūjyaḥ prayatnataḥ || aiśānyāṃ diśi viprendrāḥ sthitā ye tānvadāmyaham|| 36 || durdharo bhairavārāvaḥ kiṃkiṇīko mahābalaḥ || karālo vikaṭo mūlo balibhukto balipriyaḥ || 37 || eteṣāṃ kṣetrapālānāṃ sastrīṇāṃ ca dvijottamāḥ || netā prabhu(ma?)śca svāmī ca jayantaḥ pālakastathā || 38 || nigṛhṇātyanugṛhṇāti rakṣitā puravāsinām || jayantādeśamādāya te duṣṭānghātayanti ca || 39 || nāgasthalasthitaḥ svāmī jayantaḥ pālakaḥ sadā || nāgarājaiḥ parivṛtaḥ pūjanīyaḥ prayatnataḥ || 7.4.17.40 || māṃsapriyamukhāścaita aiśānīṃ pāṃti vai diśam || sahasraśīrṣako devaḥ śeṣo nāgasthalasthitaḥ || ananto vāsukiścaiva takṣakaḥ padma eva ca || 41 || śaṃkhaḥ kaṃbalakaścaiva nāgaścāśvatarastathā || muktakaḥ kāliyaścaiva janako'thāparājitaḥ || 42 || karkoṭakamukhā nāgāste ca santi sahasraśaḥ || te pūjyā gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca balibhirdhūpadīpakaiḥ ||43|| pāyasena ca māṃsena hyannādyaiḥ surayā tathā || tataḥ saṃpūjya devaśaṃ jayaṃtaṃ rakṣiṇāṃ varam || 44 || gaṃdha puṣpopahāraiśca dhūpavastrādibhūṣaṇaiḥ || tato gaccheddvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇaṃ devakinandanam || saṃpūjyaḥ prathamaṃ tatra gaṇeśo rukmisaṃjñakaḥ||45|| || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathaṃ sa rukmidaityendro yo duṣṭo gaṇatāṃ gataḥ || sākṣādbhagavato dvāri pratyahaṃ pūjyate naraḥ || 46 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || kṛṣṇāya rukmiṇīṃ dātuṃ yadā bhīṣmaka udyataḥ || taddveṣātkrodhasaṃyukto rukmī caidyamamanyata ||47|| yadā jahāra bhagavānrukmiṇīmaṃbikālayāt || sarvānvidrāvya vai bhūpāñjarāsandhamukhānraṇe ||48|| tadā rukmī mahābāhurbhīṣmakasya suto balī || nāhatvā vinivartiṣye tamahaṃ yādavaṃ raṇe ||49|| pratijñāṃ sarvabhūpānāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ kṛtavāndvijāḥ|| evamuktvā sa sannaddho yuddhāya paridhāvitaḥ||7.4.17.50|| akṣauhiṇyā dalenaivāyuddhyatkṛṣṇena bho dvijāḥ || sa yudhyamānaḥ kṛṣṇena vadhyamāno hataujasaḥ ||51|| baddho bhagavatā tatra kṛtvā vairūpyameva ca || rāmeṇa baṃdhanānmukto maraṇāya matiṃ dadhau ||52|| rukmiṇī bhrātaraṃ dṛṣṭvā maraṇe kṛtaniścayam|| uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ vaidarbhī bhrātaraṃ hyānayasva me ||53|| tatastatpriyakāmārthamanumānya janārddanaḥ|| cakāra pārṣadāṃ madhye pravaraṃ vighnanāśanam ||54|| etasmātkāraṇādviprāḥ prathamaṃ pūjyate sadā || gaṃdhadhūpākṣatairvastrairmodakaistaṃ pratarpayet ||55|| tasmiṃstuṣṭe jagannāthastuṣṭo bhavati nānyathā ||56|| iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye bhagavatparicārakavargakathanapūrvakarukmigarvaparihāravṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāma saptadaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 17 || || cha ||
<7.4.18>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || pūjayedgaṇanāthaṃ taṃ rukmiṇaṃ rukmabhūṣitam || durvāsasaṃ ca kṛṣṇaṃ ca balabhadraṃ ca bhaktitaḥ || 1 || yajatyeko mahāyajñaiḥ saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥ || ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau || 2 || vāpīkūpataḍāgāni karotyekaḥ samāhitaḥ || ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau || 3 || gobhūtilahiraṇyādi dadātyeko dinedine || ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau || 4 || prāṇāyāmādisaṃyukto japadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ || ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau || 5 || jāhnavyādiṣu tīrtheṣu susnātvaikaḥ samāhitaḥ || ekaḥ paśyati deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tulyaphalau hi tau ||6|| tribhirvikramaṇairyena vikrāṃtaṃ bhuvanatrayam || trivikramaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā mucyate pātakatrayāt || 7 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathaṃ traivikramī mṛrttirāgateyaṃ dharātale || kalānyāsācca kṛṣṇatvaṃ kadeyaṃ prāptavatyatha || 8 || daitya saṃśayamasmākaṃ chettumarhasyaśeṣataḥ || durvāsasaśca kṛṣṇasya saṃbhavaḥ kathyatāmiti || 9 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tacchrūyatāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā yathā mūrttistrivikramī || durvāsasā samāyuktā saṃbhūtā dharaṇītale || 7.4.18.10 || pūrvaṃ kṛtayugasyāṃte balinā ca puraṃdaraḥ || nirjitya bhraṃśitaḥ sthānāttadarthaṃ madhusūdanaḥ || || 11 || kaśyapādvāmano jajñe tato'bhūcca trivikramaḥ || tribhiḥ kramairmitām̐llokānākramya madhuhā hariḥ || 12 || baliṃ cakāra bhagavānpātālatalavāsi nam || bhaktyā tvananyayā kṛṣṇo daityena paritoṣitaḥ || 13 || svayaṃ caivā'vasattatra bhaktyā krīto haristadā || anugrahāya bhagavāndvārapālo babhūva ha ||14|| durvāsāścāpi bhagavānātreyo munisattamaḥ|| aṭaṃstīrthāni mokṣārthaṃ muktikṣetramaciṃtayat ||15|| evaṃ citayamānaḥ sa jñānadṛṣṭyā mahāmuniḥ|| gomatyā saṃgamo yatra cakratīrthena bho dvijāḥ || 16 || tanmuktikṣetramājñāya gamanāya matiṃ dadhe || sotītya nagaragrāmānudyānāni vanāni ca || 17 || ānarttaviṣayaṃ prāpya daityabhūmiṃ viveśa ha || niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkārāṃ vedadhvanivivarjjitām ||18|| kuśena daityarājena sevitāṃ pālitāṃ tathā || bahumleccha samākīrṇāmadharmopārjakairjanaiḥ || 19 || pratyāsannāmiti jñātvā cakratīrthamagāddvijaḥ || snātvā ca saṃgame puṇye mokṣye'haṃ ca kṛtāhnikaḥ || 7.4.18.20 || iti kṛtvā sa niyamaṃ yayau śīghraṃ munistadā || snātvā śīghraṃ prayāsyāmi daityabhūmiṃ vihāya ca||21|| ityevaṃ ciṃtayanmārge śīghrameva jagāma saḥ|| dṛṣṭvā ca saṃgamaṃ puṇyaṃ gomatyā sāgarasya ca || 22 || nidhāya vāsasī tatra mṛdamālabhya gomayam || śikhāṃ ca baddhvā karayoḥ kṛtvā ca niyataḥ kuśān || || 23 || yāvatsnāti ca vipro'sau dṛṣṭo daityairdurātmabhiḥ || bruvaṃtaḥ ko'yamityevaṃ hanyatāṃhanyatāmiti ||24|| asmābhiḥ pālite deśe kaḥ snāti manujādhamaḥ || bruvaṃta iti jaghnuste jānubhirmuṣṭibhistathā || 25 || brāhmaṇo'haṃ na haṃtavyaḥ śrutvā cā'tīva pīḍitaḥ || taṃ dṛṣṭvā hanyamānaṃ tu brāhmaṇaṃ tairdurātmabhiḥ || 26 || nivārayāmāsa ca tānrururnāma mahāsuraḥ || jagṛhustasya vastrāṇi kuśāṃste cikṣipurjale || 27 || cakarṣuścaraṇau gṛhya śapaṃto duṣṭacetasaḥ || pade gṛhītvā tamṛṣiṃ nītvā sīmni vyasarjayan || 28 || taṃ tadā mūrchitaprāyaṃ dṛṣṭvocuḥ kupitāśca te || atrāgato yadi punarhaniṣyāmo na saṃśayaḥ || ānarttaviṣayāṃstānvai dṛṣṭvā tatra jalāśayam || 29 || prāṇasaṃśayamāpannastataściṃtāparo'bhavat || śapyehaṃ yadi daiteyāṃstapasaḥ kiṃ vyayena me || 7.4.18.30 || athavā niyamabhraṣṭastyakṣye cedaṃ kalevaram || mama pakṣaṃ ca kaḥ kuryyātko me dāsyati jīvitam || 31 || cakratīrthe ca kaḥ snānaṃ kārayiṣyati māmiha || ko vā daityagaṇānetāñchakto jetuṃ mahāmṛdhe || taṃ vinā puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ bhaktānāmabhayapradam || 32 || brahmādīnāṃ ca netāraṃ śaraṇāgatavatsalam || cakrahastaṃ vinā medya konyaḥ śarmmaprado bhavet || 33 || iti dhyātvā ca suciraṃ jñātvā pātālavāsi nam || ātreyo viṣṇuśaraṇaṃ jagāma dharaṇītalam || 34 || upavāsaiḥ kṛśo dīno bhūtalaṃ praviveśa ha || sa daittyarājabhavanaṃ gandharvāpsarasāvṛtam || || 35 || śobhitaṃ suramukhyena viṣṇunā prabhaviṣṇunā || durvāsāḥ praviveśātha prahṛṣṭenāṃtarātmanā|| 36 || durvāsasamathāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityapatistadā || pratyutthāyārhayāṃcakre svāsane saṃnyaveśayat ||37|| madhuparkaṃ ca gāṃ caiva dattvārghyaṃ pārśvataḥ sthitaḥ || provāca praṇato brahmankathamatrāgato bhavān ||38|| sukhopaviṣṭaḥ sa ṛṣistatrāpaśyattrivikramam || daityendradvāradeśe tu tiṣṭhantamakutobhayam || 39 || taṃ dṛṣṭvā devadeveśaṃ śrīvatsāṃkaṃ caturbhujam || ruroda sa ṛṣiśreṣṭhastrāhitrāhītyuvāca ca || 7.4.18.40 || saṃsārabhayabhītānāṃ duḥkhitānāṃ janārdana || śatrubhiḥ paribhūtānāṃ śaraṇaṃ bhava keśava || 41 || mama duḥkhābhitaptasya śatrubhiḥ karṣitasya ca || parābhūtasya dīnasya kṣudhayā pīḍitasya ca || 42 || apūrṇaniyamasyā'tha kleśitatya ca dānavaiḥ || brahmaṇyadeva viprasya śaraṇaṃ bhava keśava || 43 || ityuktvā darśayāmāsa śarīraṃ daityatāḍitam || tadbrāhmaṇāvamānaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā cukrodha vāmanaḥ || 44 || kenāpamānito brahmanniyamaḥ kena khaṇḍitaḥ || kathayasva mahābhāga dharmapāle mayi sthite || 45 || || durvāsā uvāca || || muktitīrthamahaṃ jñātvā jñānena madhusūdana || cakratīrthaṃ gataḥ snātuṃ yātrāyāṃ harṣasaṃyutaḥ || 46 || akṛtasnāna evā'haṃ dṛṣṭo daityairdurāsadaiḥ || gale gṛhītaḥ kṛṣṇāhaṃ muṣṭibhistāḍitastathā || 47 || balādgṛhītvā vāsāṃsi kuśāṃścaivākṣataiḥ saha || jale kṣiptvā caraṇayorgṛhītvā māṃ samākṛṣan || 48 || sīmāṃte māṃ tu prakṣipya procuste dānavādhamāḥ || haniṣyāmo yadi punarāgaṃtāsi na saṃśayaḥ || 49 || snāto'haṃ cakratīrthe tu kariṣye bhojanaṃ vibho || tasmātsnāpaya goviṃda niyamaṃ saphalaṃ kuru || 7.4.18.50 || tava prasādātsnātvā'haṃ bhuktvā ca prītamānasaḥ || pratijñāṃ saphalāṃ kṛtvā vicariṣye mahīmimām || 51 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye cakratīrthamāhātmye rākṣasakṛtadurvāsaḥparābhavavṛttāntavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭādaśo'dhyāyaḥ || 18 || || cha ||
<7.4.19>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || tacchrutvā devadeveśaściṃtayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || uvāca vacanaṃ tatra durvāsasamakalmaṣam || 1|| || śrībhagavānuvāca || || parādhīno'smi viprendra bhaktyā krīto'smi nānyathā || balerādeśakārī ca daityendravaśago hyaham|| 2 || tasmātprārthaya viprendra daityaṃ vairocaniṃ balim|| asyādeśātkariṣyāmi yadabhīṣṭaṃ tavādhunā || 3 || tacchrutvā vacanaṃ vipro baliṃ provāca satvaram || yajvanāṃ tvaṃ variṣṭhaśca dātṝṇāṃ tvaṃ mato'dhikaḥ || 4 || pārāvāraḥ kṛpāyāśca dayāṃ kuru mamopari || preṣayasva mahābhāga devaṃ daityavinigrahe || 5 || saṃpūrṇaniyamaḥ snātastvatprasādādbhavāmyaham|| tacchutvā vacanaṃ daityo nātihṛṣṭamanāstadā || durvāsasamuvācedaṃ naitadevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 6 || anyatprārthaya viprendra yatte manasi varttate || taddāsyāmi na sandeho yadyapi syātsudurlabham || 7 || ātmānamapi dāsyāmi nāhaṃ tyakṣye hariṃ dvija || bahubhiḥ sukṛtaiḥ prāptaṃ kathaṃ tyakṣyāmi keśavam || 8 || || durvāsā uvāca || || nātilubdhaṃ hi māṃ viddhi kimanyatprārthayāmyaham || rakṣa me jīvitaṃ daitya preṣayasva janārddanam || 9 || || baliruvāca || || jānāsi tvaṃ yathā vipra hiraṇyākṣaṃ nipātitam || bhūtvā yajñavarāhastu dadhārorvīṃ balāddivi || 7.4.19.10 || yathā ca daityapravaramavadhyaṃ daityadānavaiḥ || hatavānhiraṇyakaśipuṃ nṛsiṃhaḥ sarvagaḥ prabhuḥ || 11 || tathaiva vṛtraṃ namuciṃ rakṣo laṃkeśa saṃjñakam || jaghāna māyayā viṣṇuḥ surārthaṃ surasattamaḥ || 12 || prathamaṃ vāmano bhūtvā hyayācata padatrayam || punastrivikramo bhūtvā bhuvanāni jahāra me || 13 || mayā puṇyavaśādviṣṇuryadi prāptaḥ kathañcana || nāhaṃ tyakṣye jagannāthaṃ māyāvāmanakaṃ prabhum || 14 || || durvāsā uvāca || || nāhaṃ bhokṣye vinā snānaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || yadi na preṣyasi hariṃ tatastyakṣye kalevaram || 15 || || baliruvāca || || yadbhāvyaṃ tadbhavatu te yajjānāsi tathā kuru || brahmarudrendranamitaṃ nāhaṃ tyakṣye padadvayam || 16 || tadā vivadamānau tau dṛṣṭvā sa jagadīśvaraḥ || brahmaṇyadevaḥ kṛpayā brāhmaṇaṃ tamuvāca ha || 17 || svastho bhava dvijaśreṣṭha snāpayiṣye na saṃśayaḥ || hatvā daityagaṇānsarvāngomatyudadhisaṃgame || 18 || || prahlāda uvāca || || | śrutvā bhagavato vākyaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ prati daityarāṭ || dṛḍhaṃ jagrāha caraṇau patitvā pādayostadā || 19 || tataḥ samṛddhimagamatpādau dattvā baleḥ prabhuḥ || śaṃkhacakragadāpāṇirviṣṇurdurvāsasā'nvitaḥ || 7.4.19.20 || prasthitau tau tadā dṛṣṭvā durvāsasajanārddanau || anantaḥ puruṣo 'gacchanmuśalī ca halāyudhaḥ || 21 || muśalī cāgrato'gacchattato viṣṇustrivikramaḥ || tayoranvagamadviprā durvāsā bhūtalādbahiḥ || 22 || bhittvā rasātalaṃ sarve samuttasthustvarānvitāḥ || āvirbabhūvustatraiva gomatyudadhisaṃgame || 23 || sannaddhau dṛḍhadhanvānau saṃkarṣaṇajanārdanau || ūcatustau tadā vipraṃ kuru snānaṃ yadṛcchayā || 24 || tayostu vacanaṃ śrutvā snānaṃ cakre tvarānvitaḥ || snātvā cāvaśyakaṃ karma kartumārabhata dvijaḥ || 25 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye cakratīrthe kṛṣṇabalarāmadurvāsasasamāgamapūrvakaṃ durvāsasaḥ snānādyāhnikavidhividhānavarṇanaṃnāmaikonaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || || 19 || || cha ||
<7.4.20>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || brahmaghoṣadhvaniṃ śrutvā dānavo durmukhastadā || krodhasaṃraktanayano durvāsasamathābravīt || 1 || hanyamānastvamasmābhiryadi muktosi vai dvija || kasmātpunaḥ samāyāto maraṇāya ca duṣṭadhīḥ || 2 || ityuktvā muṣṭinā hantuṃ prādravaddānavādhamaḥ || prāha pradhāvamānaṃ taṃ durvāsā munisattamaḥ || 3 || sparśaṃ mā kuru pāpiṣṭha brāhmaṇaṃ māṃ kṛtāhnikam || taṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavaṃ viṣṇurbrāhmaṇaṃ hantumudyatam || 4 || tasya kruddho jagannātho durvāsasaḥ kṛte tadā || cakreṇa kṣuradhāreṇa śiraściccheda līlayā || 5 || || prahlāda uvāca || || durmukhaṃ nihataṃ dṛṣṭvā dānavo duḥsahastadā || ākrośaduccairditijāñchīghramāgamyatāmiti ||6|| śrutvā daityagaṇāḥ sarve durmukhaṃ nihataṃ tadā || durvāsasaṃ punastatra paritrātaṃ ca viṣṇunā || || 7 || kūrmapṛṣṭho golakaśca krodhano vedadūṣakaḥ || yajñaghno yajñahaṃtā ca dharmāntakastapasvihā || 8 || ete cānye ca bahavo vividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ || || krodhasaṃraktanayanāḥ śapanto brāhmaṇaṃ tathā || 9 || parikṣipya tadātreyaṃ viṣṇuṃ saṃkarṣaṇaṃ tathā || tomarairbhindipālaiśca muśalaiśca bhuśuṃḍibhiḥ || 7.4.20.10 || astrairnānāvidhaiścāpi yuyudhuḥ krodhamūrchitāḥ || dānavaiḥ saṃvṛto viṣṇuḥ samantādghoradarśanaiḥ || 11 || saṃkarṣaṇaśca śuśubhe caṃdrādityau ghanairiva || gṛhītvā dhanuṣī divye śīghraṃ saṃyojya cāśugān || 12 || tānmārgaṇagaṇairdaityāñjaghnatuste mahāmṛdhe || te hanyamānāḥ samare viṣṇunā vidrutā diśaḥ || 13 || dānavānvidrutāndṛṣṭvā viṣṇunā nihatānparān || golakaḥ kūrmapṛṣṭhaśca mānaṃ kṛtvā nyavartatām || 14 || saṃkarṣaṇaṃ golakaśca hyājaghāna tribhiḥ śaraiḥ || anantaṃ vyathitaṃ dṛṣṭvā golakaḥ krodhamūrchitaḥ ||15 || utpatya tarasā mūrdhni durvāsasamatāḍayat || sa muṣṭighātābhihataścukrośa patitaḥ kṣitau ||16|| saṃkarṣaṇastu patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā mūrdhni pratāḍitam || dṛṣṭvā cukopa bhagavāṃstiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt || saṃgṛhya muśalaṃ vīro jaghāna samare ripum || 17 || muśalenāhato mūrdhni golako vikalendriyaḥ || saṃbhinnamastakaścaiva papāta ca mamāra ca || 18 || golakaṃ patitaṃ dṛṣṭvā krandaṃtaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ tathā || kūrmapṛṣṭhaṃ ca bhagavānviṣṇurhantuṃ mano dadhe || nārācena sutīkṣṇena jaghāna hṛdaye ripum || 19 || sa viṣṇubāṇābhihatastyaktaśastraḥ palāyitaḥ || tasminprabhinne'tibale gate vai kūrmapṛṣṭhake || abhajyata balaṃ sarvaṃ vidrutaṃ ca diśo daśa || 7.4.20.20 || tatprabhagraṃ balaṃ sarvaṃ nihataṃ golakaṃ tathā || dvārasthaḥ kathayāmāsa daityarājñe kuśāya saḥ || 21 || golakaṃ nihataṃ śrutvā daityānanyāṃśca daityarāṭ || yodhānājñāpayāmāsa sannaddhānsvabalasya ca || 22 || ājñāṃ kuśasya te labdhvā daityāḥ paṃcajanādayaḥ || yuddhāyābhimukhāḥ sarve rathairnāgaiśca niryayuḥ || 23 || anīkaṃ daśasāhasraṃ kūrmapṛṣṭhasya niryayau || ayute dve rathānāṃ tu nāgānāmayutaṃ tathā || 24 || daśāyutāni cāśvānāmuṣṭrāṇāṃ ca tathaiva ca || bakaśca niryayau daityo bahusainyasamanvitaḥ || 25 || tathā dīrghanakho daityaḥ svenānīkena saṃvṛtaḥ || maṃtriputro mahāmāyo daityarāja kuśasya vai || niryayau vighaso daityaḥ praghasaśca mahābalaḥ || 26 || ūrddhvabāhurvakraśirāḥ kañcukaśca śivolukaiḥ || brahmaghno yajñahā daityo rāhurbarbarakastathā || 27 || sunāmā vasunāmā ca maṃtriṇau buddhisattamau || senāpatiścogradaṃṣṭastasya bhrātā mahāhanuḥ || 28 || ete cānye ca bahavo daityāḥ krodhasamanvitāḥ || mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa niryayuryuddhakāṃkṣiṇaḥ || 29 || snātvā śuklāṃbaradharaḥ śuklamālāvibhūṣitaḥ || kuśaḥ śaṃbhuṃ mahādevaṃ bhavānīpatimavyayam || ārcayamāsa bhūteśaṃ parameṇa samādhinā || 7.4.20.30 || paṃcāmṛtena saṃsnāpya tathā gandhairvi lipya ca || arcayāmāsa daityendro hyanekakusumotkaraiḥ || 31 || gītavāditraśabdaiśca tathā maṃgalavācakaiḥ || pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ brāhmaṇānsvasti vācya ca || 32 || bhūṣayitvā bhūṣaṇaiśca maṇivajravibhūṣaṇaiḥ || mukuṭenārkavarṇena jvaladbhāskararociṣā || 33 || bhrājamāno daityarājo hāreṇā'tīva śobhitaḥ || saṃnahya ca mahābāhuḥ sārathiṃ samudaikṣata || 34 || sunāmānaṃ vasuṃ caiva maṃtriṇau vākyamabravīt || kaścāyamasurānhaṃti kimarthaṃ jñāyatāmiti || || 35 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā rururvacanamabravīt || gatehni brāhmaṇaḥ snātuṃ gomatyāḥ saṃgame kila || 36 || āgataḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ sandaityaistatra mahī pate || tena viṣṇuḥ samānītaḥ saṃkarṣaṇasamanvitaḥ || 37 || so'smānhaṃti mahārāja brahmaṇyo jagadīśvaraḥ || tena te bahavo daityā hatāḥ kecitpalāyitāḥ || 38 || || sunāmovāca || || snātvā gacchatu vipro'sau vāsudevasamanvitaḥ || rājanvṛthā vigraheṇa kiṃ kāryaṃ kathayasva naḥ || 39 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kuśaḥ krodhasamanvitaḥ || kathaṃ golakahaṃtāraṃ na haniṣyāmi keśavam ||7.4.20.40|| etāvaduktvā sa kruddho yayau daityapatistadā || tato vāditra śabdaiśca bherīśabdaiḥ samanvitaḥ || 41 || dadarśa tatra deveśaṃ sahasraśirasaṃ prabhum || tathā viṣṇuṃ cakrapāṇiṃ durvāsasamakalmaṣam || 42 || īśvarāṃśaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā na hantavyo'yamīśvaraḥ || viṣṇumuddiśya tānsarvānprerayāmāsa dānavān || 43 || nāgaiḥ parvatasaṃkāśai rathairjaladasannibhaiḥ || aśvairmahājavaiścaiva parivavruḥ samaṃtataḥ || 44 || tato yuddhaṃ samabhavaddevayordānavaiḥ saha || ācchāditau tau dadṛśurdaityairdevagaṇāstadā || 45 || tato gṛhītvā muśalaṃ halaṃ ca balavānhalī || jaghāna daityapravarānkālānalayamopamān || 46 || te hanyamānā daiteyā balena balaśālinā || sarvato vidrutā bhagnāḥ kuśameva yayustadā || 47 || bakaśca yajñakopaśca brahmaghno vedadūṣakaḥ || mahāmakhaghno jaṃbhaśca rāhurvakraśirāstathā ||48|| ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pravarā dānavottamāḥ || krodhasaṃraktanayanā bibhiduste janārddanam || 49 || tataḥ krodhasamāyuktau saṃkarṣaṇajanārdanau || cakralāṃgalaghātena jaghnaturdānavottamān || 7.4.20.50 || | cakreṇa ca śiraḥ kāyāccicchedāśu bakasya vai || cūrṇayāmāsa muśalī yajñahaṃtārameva ca || 51 || rāhuṃ jaghāna cakreṇa tathānyānmuśalena ca || te hatā hanyamānāśca bhagnā jagmurdiśo daśa ||52|| kuśaḥ svāṃ vāhinīṃ dṛṣṭvā vidrutāṃ nihatāṃ tathā || krodhasaṃraktanayanaḥ prāha yāhīti sārathim ||53|| sa tayoraṃtikaṃ gatvā nāma viśrāvya cātmanaḥ || uvāca kastvaṃ daiteyānmama haṃsi gadādhara || 54 || || śrīvāsudeva uvāca || || yasmādvimuktidaṃ puṇyaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgamam || ruddhaṃ durātmabhiḥ pāpaistasmātte nihatā mayā || 55 || || kuśa uvāca || || māṃ na jānāsi cātrasthaṃ kathaṃ jīvanprayāsyasi || yudhyasva tvaṃ sthiro bhūtvā tatastyakṣyasi jīvitam || 56 || ityuktvā paṃcaviṃśatyā tāḍayāmāsa keśavam || anaṃtaṃ cāṣṭabhirbāṇairhatvā''treyaṃ nirīkṣya tam || īśvarāṃśaṃ ca taṃ dṛṣṭvā prāha yāhīti mā ciram || 57 || sa bāṇairbhinnasarvāṃgaḥ śārṅgaṃ hi dhanuṣāṃ varam || vikṛṣya ghātayāmāsa caturbhiścaturo hayān || 58 || sārathestu śiraḥ kāyādarddhacaṃdreṇa pattriṇā || ciccheda dhanurekena dhvajamekena cicchide || 59 || sa cchinnadhanvā viratho hatāśvo hatasārathiḥ || pragṛhya ca mahākhaṅgamuvāca vacanaṃ tadā || 7.4.20.60 || yadi tvāṃ pātayiṣyāmi kīrtirme hyatulā bhavet || pātito'haṃ tvayā vīra yāsyāmi paramāṃ gatim || 61 || tiṣṭhatiṣṭha hare sthāne śaraṇaṃ me sadāśivaḥ || dhāvaṃtamatisaṃkruddhaṃ khaṅgahastaṃ nirīkṣya tam || cakreṇa śitadhāreṇa śiraściccheda līlayā || 62 || taṃ chinnaśirasaṃ bhūmau patitaṃ vīkṣya dānavam || athovāha rathenājau daityaḥ khaṃjanakastathā || 63 || apayāte kuśe daitye viṣṇuḥ saṃkarṣaṇastadā || durvāsasā ca sahitaḥ saṃnyavartata harṣitaḥ || 64 || śivālaye tu patitaṃ kuśaṃ nikṣipya dānavaḥ || snānagandhārcanairdhūpairgītavādyairatoṣayat || 65 || avāpa jīvitaṃ sadyaḥ prasādācchaṃkarasya ca || utthitaḥ sa tadā daityo bruvañchivaśiveti ca || 66 || taṃ punarjovitaṃ dṛṣṭvā daityaṃ daityagaṇastadā || uvāca sumanā vākyaṃ varddhasva suciraṃ vibho ||67|| snāpayitvā yadi punarbrāhmaṇaṃ vinivarttate || yatheṣṭaṃ gacchatu tadā kiṃ vṛthā vigraheṇa te || 68 || tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kuśo vacanamabravīt || gaccha preṣaya tau śīghraṃ vipratrāṇakarāvubhau || 69 || sa ca rājñā samādiṣṭa sumanā munisattamāḥ || uvāca viṣṇumānamya namaskṛtya halāyudham || 7.4.20.70 || kuśena preṣitaścāsmi samīpe te janārdana || kiṃ tavāpakṛtaṃ nātha yena daityāñjighāṃsasi|| 71|| durvāsasaṃ snāpayitvā gaccha mukto'si mānada || amaratvaṃ mahādevātprāptaṃ viddhi kuśena hi || 72 || || || śrīviṣṇuruvāca || || muktitīrthamidaṃ ruddhaṃ bhavadbhiḥ pāpakarmabhiḥ || tasmāddhaniṣye sarvāṃśca dānavānnātra saṃśayaḥ ||73|| durvāsasaśca ye darbhāstilāścaivākṣataiḥ saha || punastānānayadhvaṃ hi kṣiptā ye varuṇālaye || 74 || savāhanaparīvārāḥ sajātikulabāṃdhavāḥ || puṇyatīrthamidaṃ hitvā praviśadhvaṃ dharātale || 75 || sumanāstadvacaḥ śrutvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || yudhyadhvamiti taṃ coktvā naitadevaṃ bhaviṣyati || 76 || kuśāya kathayāmāsa yaduktaṃ śārṅgadhanvinā || kruddhastadvacanaṃ śrutvā maṃtriṇā samudīritam || 77 || rathamāruhya vegena yayau yoddhumariṃdamaḥ || saṃsmṛtya manasā devaṃ pinākiṃ vṛṣabhadhvajam || 78 || tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ sumahallomaharṣaṇam || anyeṣāṃ dānavānāṃ ca keśavasya kuśasya ca || 79 || yajñaghno gadayā gurvyā saṃkarṣaṇamatāḍayat || saṃkarṣaṇahataḥ śīrṣṇi musalena papāta ha || 7.4.20.80 || kañcukaṃ ca jaghānāśu cakreṇa bhagavānhariḥ || ulmukaścātha nihato brahmaghnaśca nipātitaḥ || || 81 || ete cānye ca bahavo ghātitāḥ keśavena hi || dānavānpatitāndṛṣṭvā kuśaḥ paramakopitaḥ ||82|| jaghāna yudhi saṃrabdhaḥ paramāstreṇa keśavam || bhagavānkrodhasaṃyuktaścakreṇa cāharacchiraḥ || 83 || taṃ chinnaśirasaṃ bhūmau pātitaṃ vīkṣya keśavaḥ
