|| ciccheda bāhū pādau ca khaṅgena tilaśastathā ||84|| khaṃḍaśo ghātitaṃ dṛṣṭvā keśavena kuśaṃ tadā || saṃgṛhya te punardetyā ninyuḥ sarve śivālayam || 85 || prasādācchūlinaḥ sadyo jīvitaṃ prāpya dānavaḥ || utthitaḥ sahasā kruddhaḥ kva viṣṇuriti cābravīt || 86 || gadāmudyamya saṃkruddho yoddhumāgājjanārddanam || tamudyatagadaṃ dṛṣṭvā nihataṃ jīvitaṃ punaḥ || || 87 || durvāsasamathovāca kimidaṃ na mriyeta yat || mayā'sakṛcchiraśchinnaṃ khaṃḍaśastilaśaḥ kṛtam || 88 || jīvatyayaṃ punaḥ kasmātkāraṇaṃ katha yasva naḥ || ityuktaściṃtayāmāsa dhyānena ṛṣisattamaḥ || 89 || jñātvā tatkāraṇaṃ sarvamuvāca madhusūdanam || mahādevena tuṣṭena kuśo'yamamaraḥ kṛtaḥ || || 7.4.20.90 || khaṃḍaśaśca kṛtaścāpi na ca prāṇairviyujyate || tataḥ sa vismayāviṣṭo haṃtavyo'yaṃ mayā katham || 91 || upāyaṃ ca kariṣyāmi yenāyaṃ na bhave diti || tataḥ sa jīvitaṃ prāpya prasādācchaṃkarasya ca || carmakhaṅgamathādāya tiṣṭhatiṣṭheti cābravīt || 92 || tamāyāṃtaṃ tato dṛṣṭvā kuśaṃ śivaparigraham || jaghāna gadayā gurvyā gadāhastaṃ tadā kuśam || 93 || sa bhinnamūrddhā nyapatatkeśavenābhitāḍitaḥ || bhūmau nipatitaṃ vegātparigṛhya kuśaṃ hariḥ || || 94 || garte nikṣipya taddehaṃ pūrayāmāsa vai punaḥ || liṃgaṃ saṃsthāpayāmāsa tasyopari janārddanaḥ || 95 || sa labdhasaṃjño danujaḥ śivaliṃgamapaśyata || ātmoparisthitaṃ tacca tadā cintāparo'bhavat|| 96 || iti śrīskāndemahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye cakratīrthe rākṣasakuśaviṣṇuyuddhe kuśarākṣasopari viṣṇunā śivaliṃgasthāpanavarṇanaṃnāma viṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 20 || || cha || || ||
<7.4.21>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || śivaligamalaṃghyaṃ hi buddhipūrvaṃ hato hyaham || uvāca kṛṣṇaṃ danujaśchalito'haṃ tvayā'nagha || 1 || || śrīviṣṇu ruvāca || || parituṣṭosmi te daitya śauryeṇa śivasaṃśrayāt || varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te yadicchasi mahāmate || 2 || || kuśa uvāca || || yathā pūjyo mahādevo mama tvaṃ ca tathā hare || eka eva dvidhāmūrtistasmāttvāṃ varayāmyaham || 3 || śivaliṃgaṃ tvayā nātha sthāpitaṃ yanmamopari || mama nāmnā bhavatu ca kuśeśvara iti smṛtam ||4|| anugrāhyo yadyahaṃ te mama kīrtirbhavatviyam || evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktastatraivāvasthito'suraḥ || 5 || tato'nyadānavānsarvānpreṣayāmāsa mādhavaḥ || rasātalagatā kecitkecidviṣṇuṃ samāgatāḥ || 6 || anaṃtaḥ saṃsthitastatra viṣṇuśca tadanaṃtaram || jñātvā vimuktidaṃ tīrthaṃ durvāsā munipuṃgavaḥ || 7 || gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe ca bhagavāṃśca trivikramaḥ || tena tanmuktidaṃ matvā durvāsāstatra saṃsthitaḥ || 8 || evaṃ trivikramaḥ svāmī tadāprabhṛti saṃsthitaḥ || kalau punaḥ kalānyāsātkṛṣṇatvamagamatprabhuḥ || 9 || || prahlāda uvāca || || pūjāvidhiṃ harerviprāḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || viśeṣātphaladaḥ proktaḥ pūjito madhumādhave || 7.4.21.10 || madhusūdanīṃ naro yastu dvāravatyāṃ karoti ca || pūjayetkṛṣṇadevaṃ ca snāpayitvā vilipya ca || 11 || gandhaiśca vāsasā''cchādya dhūpairdīpairanekadhā || naivedyairbhūṣaṇaiścaiva tāṃbūlena phalena ca || 12 || ārārtikena saṃpūjya daṇḍavatpraṇipatya ca || ghṛtena dīpakaṃ dattvā rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ tathā || kuryyācca gītavāditraistathā pustakavācakaiḥ || 13 || kṛtvā caivaṃ vidhiṃ bhaktyā sarvānkāmānavāpnu yāt || 14 || tathā nabhasi sampūjya pavitrāropaṇena ca || pitṝṇāṃ cākṣayā tṛptiḥ saphalāḥ syurmanorathāḥ || 15 || prabodhavāsare prāpte kārtike dvija sattamāḥ || saṃpūjya kṛṣṇaṃ deveśaṃ parāṃ gatimavāpnuyāt || 16 || tathā nabhasye saṃpūjya pavitrāropaṇena ca || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ ca gacchati || 17 || yugādiṣu ca saṃpūjya hyayane dakṣiṇottare || āṣāḍhajyeṣṭhamāgheṣu pauṣādidvādaśīṣu ca || 18 || kalau kṛṣṇaṃ pūjayitvā gomatyudadhisaṃgame || vimalaṃ lokamāpnoti yatra gatvā na śocati || 19 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatītīrastha kṣetrastha bhagavatpūjāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 21 ||
<7.4.22>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || śṛṇudhvaṃ dvijaśārdūlā yathāvatkathayāmi vaḥ || snāpayitvā jagannāthaṃ tathā gaṃdhairvilipya ca || pūjayitvā tulasyā tu bhūṣayitvā ca bhūṣaṇaiḥ || 1 || naivedyena ca santarpya tathā nīrājanādibhiḥ || durvāsasaṃ tathā pūjya puṃḍarīkākṣameva ca ||2|| anaṃtaṃ vainateyādīnbhaktyā sampūjya mānavaḥ || dadyāddānaṃ svaśaktyā ca vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ || 3 || dīnāṃdhakṛpaṇāṃstatra tarpayecca samāśritān || 4 || rukmiṇīṃ ca tato gacchedvidarbhatanayāṃ naraḥ || upahṛtyopahārāṃśca balibhirgaṃdhadīpakaiḥ || 5 || pīḍayaṃti grahāstāvadvyādhayo'bhibhavaṃti ca || bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau || 6 || upasargabhayaṃ tāvadduḥkhaṃ ca bhūtasaṃbhavam || bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau || 7 || bhaveddaridrī duḥkhī ca tāvadvai parayācakaḥ || bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau || 8 || tāvanmṛtaprajā nārī durbhāgyā duḥkhasaṃyutā || bhaktyā na paśyati yadā nārīkṛṣṇapriyāṃ tathā || 9 || tāvacchatrubhayaṃ puṃsāṃ gṛhabhaṃgaṃ ca mūrkhatā || bhaktyā na paśyati naro yāvatkṛṣṇapriyāṃ kalau||7.4.22.10|| saṃpūjya krṛṣṇaṃ vidhivadrukmiṇīṃ pūjayettataḥ || snāpayeddadhidugdhābhyāṃ madhuśarkarayā tathā || 11 || ghṛtena vividhairgandhaistathaivekṣurasena ca || tīrthodakena saṃsnāpya sarvānkāmānavāpnuyāt || 12 || evaṃ yaḥ snāpayeddevīṃ rukmiṇīṃ krṛṣṇavallabhām || na tasya durllabhaṃ kiṃcidiha loke paratra ca || 13 || śrīkhaṇḍakuṃkumenaiva tathā mṛgamadena ca || vilepayedaputrastu sa putraṃ labhate dhuvam || 14 || sadā sa bhogī bhavati rūpavāñjanapūjitaḥ || pūjayenmālatīpuṣpaiḥ śatapatraiḥ sugandhibhiḥ || 15 || karavīrairmallikābhiśca campakaistu viśeṣataḥ || kamalairvārisaṃbhūtaiḥ ketakībhiśca pāṭalaiḥ || 16 || dhūpenāguruṇā caiva pūjayedgauggu lena ca || vastraiḥ sukomalaiḥ śubhrairnānādeśasamudbhavaiḥ || 17 || bhaktyā saṃchādya vaidarbhīṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām || bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayeddevīṃ maṇiratna samanvitaiḥ || 18 || tasminkule nā'sukhaḥ syānnā'dharmo nā'dhanastathā || nā'putro na vikarmasthaḥ kitavo nīcasevakaḥ || 19 || yaiḥ pūjitā jaganmātā rukmiṇī mānavaiḥ kalau || naivedyairbhakṣyabhojyādyairdevī me prīyatāmiti || tāṃbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ bhāvena vinivedayet || 7.4.22.20 || gṛhītvā ca phalaṃ śubhraṃ hyakṣataiśca samanvitam|| mantreṇānena vai viprā hyarghyaṃ dadyādvidhānataḥ || 21 || kṛṣṇapriye namastubhyaṃ vidarbhādhipanaṃdini || sarvakāma prade devi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 22 || ārārtikaṃ tataḥ kuryājjvalantaṃ bhāvanānvitaḥ || nīrājanaṃ prakartavyaṃ karpūreṇa viśeṣataḥ || 23 || śaṃkhe kṛtvā tu pānīyaṃ bhrāmayedbhāvasaṃyutaḥ || bhrāmayitvā ca śirasā dhāraṇīyaṃ viśuddhaye || 24 || daṇḍavatpraṇamedbhūmau namaḥ kṛṣṇapriyeti ca || viprapatnīśca viprāṃśca pūjayecchaktito dvijāḥ|| 25 || grīvāsūtrakasindūrairvāsobhiḥ kañcukaistathā || sugandhakusumairarcya kuṃkumena vilipya ca || 26 || kausuṃbhakaiḥ kajjalena tāṃbūlena ca toṣayet || bhakṣyairbhojyaimodakaiśca ikṣubhirmadhusarpibhiḥ || 27 || prīto bhavati deveśo rukmiṇyā saha keśavaḥ || viśeṣataḥ phalānīha dātavyāni dvijottamāḥ || 28 || unmattakaṃ tato devaṃ dvārapālaṃ prapūjayet || snāpayitvā sugandhena kuṃkumena vilipya ca || 29 || dhūpena dhūpayitvā tu puṣpādyaiḥ saṃprapūjayeta || naivedyairbhakṣyabhojyaiśca māṃsena surayā tathā || 7.4.22.30 || prabhūtabalibhiścaiva piṣṭena vividhena ca || yoginīnāṃ catuḥṣaṣṭiṃ tasminpīṭhe prapūjayet || 31 || arcayeddharasiddhiṃ ca kṣetrapālaṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || virūpasvāminīṃ tatra tathā vai saptamātaraḥ || 32 || aṣṭamūrtīḥ kṛṣṇapatnīḥ pīṭhe tasminprapūjayet || rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca śubhāṃ jāṃbavatīṃ tathā || 33 || mitravindāṃ ca kālindīṃ bhadrāṃ nāgnajitīṃ tathā || aṣṭamīṃ lakṣmaṇāṃ tatra pūjayetkṛṣṇavallabhāḥ || 34 || etāḥ saṃpūjya vidhivatsaṃtarpya dadhipāyasaiḥ || gītavāditraghoṣeṇa dīpairjāgaraṇena ca || 35 || putra pautrasamāyukto dhanadhānyasamanvitaḥ || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti tasya viṣṇuḥ prasīdati || 36 || kiṃ tasya bahudānaistu kiṃ vratairniyamaistathā || yena dṛṣṭā jaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā || 37 || kiṃ yajñairbahubhistasya saṃpūrṇavaradakṣiṇaiḥ || yena dṛṣṭā jaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā || 38 || tena dattaṃ hutaṃ tena japtaṃ tena sanātanam || yena dṛṣṭā jaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā ||39|| helayā tena saṃprāptāḥ siddhayo'ṣṭau na saṃśayaḥ || gatvā dvāravatīṃ yena dṛṣṭā keśavavallabhā || 7.4.22.40 || saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya saphalāśca manorathāḥ || kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ gatvā dṛṣṭvā mādhavavallabhām || 41 || deva rājyena kiṃ tasya tathā muktipadena ca || na dṛṣṭā cejjaganmātā rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā || 42 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena rukmiṇī kṛṣṇavallabhā || sadā'rcanīyā manujairdraṣṭavyā sarvakāmadā||43|| viśeṣataḥ pūjanīyā navarātre sadāśvine || navamyāṃ tu narairyaistu pūjitā harivallabhā||41|| snānagandhādi vastraistu prabhūtabalibhistathā || gītavāditraghoṣeṇa dīpajāgaraṇena ca || toṣitā bhīṣmakasutā sarvānkāmānprayacchati || 45 || tathā dīpotsavadine caturddaśyāṃ samāhitaḥ || pūjayitvā yathāśāstramīpsitaṃ labhate phalam || 46 || māghamāse sitāṣṭamyāṃ kandarppajananī tu yaiḥ || pūjitā gandha puṣpādyairupahārairanekaśaḥ || saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāṃ saphalāśca manorathāḥ || 47 || dvādaśyāṃ caitramāse tu kṛṣṇena saha rukmiṇīm || ye paśyaṃti narā devīṃ rukmiṇīṃ madhumādhave || kṛṣṇena saha gacchantīṃ dhanyāste mānavā bhuvi ||48|| putrapautrasamāyuktā dhanadhānyasamanvitāḥ|| jīvite vyādhinirmuktāḥ padaṃ gacchantyanāmayam || 49 || jyeṣṭhāṣṭamyāṃ narairyaistu pūjitā kuṣṇavallabhā || teṣāṃ manorathāvāptirjāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 7.4.22.50 || tathā bhādrapade māsi mātuḥ pūjā kṛtā tu yaiḥ || sarvapāpavinirmuktā yāṃti viṣṇupade narāḥ || 51 || kārttike māsi dvādaśyāṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutām || ye paśyaṃti narāsteṣāṃ na bhayaṃ vidyate kvacit || 52 || yastvekatra sthitāṃ paśyedrukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇasaṃyutām || saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ tasya hyakṣayā putrasaṃtatiḥ || akṣayaṃ dhanadhānyaṃ ca kadā naiva daridratā || 53 || ya evaṃ rukmiṇīṃ paśyetpūjayetkṛṣṇavallabhām || sarvapāpavinirmukto viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 54 || yaḥ snāyātsarvatīrtheṣu dānaṃ śaktyā dadāti yaḥ || tasya puṇyaphalaṃ caiva loke yajjāyate dvijāḥ || kathitaṃ tadaśeṣeṇa kalau kṛṣṇasya saṃsthitau || 55 || dvārāvatīṃ vinā viprā muktirna prāpyate kalau || purāṇasaṃhitāmetāṃ kṛtavānbalibandhanaḥ || dadau sa tu prasādena pūrvaṃ mahyaṃ dvijottamāḥ || 56 || ihārthe ca purā proktaṃ itihāso dvijottamāḥ || pradyumnena susaṃvāde mārkaṇḍena mahātmanā || 57 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye rukmiṇīpūjanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 22 || cha || ||
<7.4.23>
|| mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyamiṃdradyumna nibodha me || kalau nivasate yatra kleśahā rukmiṇīpatiḥ || 1 || kalau kṛṣṇasya māhātmyaṃ ye śṛṇvaṃti paṭhaṃti ca || na teṣāṃ jāyate vāso yamaloke yugāṣṭakam || 2 || nityaṃ kṛṣṇakathā yasya prāṇādapi garīyasī || na tasya durllabhaṃ kiṃcidiha loke paraṃ nṛpa || 3 || manvaṃtarasahasraistu kāśīvāsena yatphalam || tatphalaṃ dvārakāvāse vasatāṃ paṃcabhirdinaiḥ || 4 || kalau nivasate yastu śvapaco dvārakāṃ yadi || yatīnāṃ gatimāpnoti prāha hyevaṃ prajāpatiḥ ||5 || dvārakāṃ gaṃtukāmaṃ yaḥ pratyahaṃ kurute naraḥ || phalamāpnoti manujaḥ kurukṣetrasamudbhavam || 6 || somagrahe ca yatproktaṃ yatphalaṃ somanāyake || dṛṣṭvā tatphalamāpnoti dvāravatyāṃ janārddanam || 7 || puṣkare kārttikīṃ kṛtvā yatphalaṃ varṣakoṭibhiḥ || tatphalaṃ dvārakāvāse dinenaikena jāyate || 8 || dvārakāyāṃ dinaikena dṛṣṭe devakinaṃdane || phalaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ jñeyamatra lakṣaśatodbhavam || 9 || kalau nivasatāṃ bhūpa dhanyāsteṣāṃ manorathāḥ || kṛṣṇasya darśane nityaṃ dvārakāgamane matiḥ || 7.4.23.10 || ekāmapi dvādaśīṃ tu yaḥ karoti nṛpottama || kṛṣṇasya sannidhau bhūpa dvārakāyāḥ phalaṃ śṛṇu || 11 || dhanyāste kṛtakṛtyāste te janā lokapāvanāḥ || dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ yaistu pāpakoṭyayutāpaham || 12 || yatphalaṃ vratasaṃyuktairvāsaraiḥ kṛṣṇasaṃyutaiḥ || yajñairdānairbṛhadbhiśca dvārakāyāṃ tathaikayā || 13 || kṣīrasnānaṃ prakurvaṃti ye narāḥ kṛṣṇa mūrdhani || śatāśvamedhajaṃ puṇyaṃ biṃdunā biṃdunā smṛtam || 14 || dadhi kṣīrāddaśaguṇaṃ ghṛtaṃ dadhno daśottaram || ghṛtāddaśaguṇaṃ kṣaudraṃ kṣaudrāddaśaguṇottaram ||| | 15|| puṣpodakaṃ ca ratnodaṃ varddhanaṃ ca daśottaram|| maṃtrodakaṃ ca gaṃdhodaṃ tathaiva nṛpasattama|| 16 || ikṣo rasena snapanaṃ śatavājimakhaiḥ samam|| tathaiva tīrthanīraṃ sa phalaṃ yacchati bhūmipa ||17 || kṛṣṇaṃ snānārdragātraṃ ca vastreṇa parimārjati|| tasya lakṣārjitasyāpi bhavetpāpasya mārjanam|| 18 || snāpayitvā jagannāthaṃ puṣpamālāvarohaṇam || kurute pratipuṣpaṃ tu svarṇaniṣkāyutaṃ phalam || 19 || snānakāle tu devasya śaṃkhādīnāṃ tu vādanam | kurute brahmaloke tu vasate brahmavāsaram || 7.4.23.20 || snānakāle sa kṛṣṇasya paṭhennāmasahasrakam || pratyakṣaraṃ labhetpreṣṭaṃ kapilāgośatodbhavam || 21 || phalametanmahīpāla gītāyāḥ parikīrtitam || gajeṃdramokṣaṇenaivaṃ stavarājena kīrttitam || 22 || stavairṛṣikṛtairanyaiḥ paṭhitaiśca narādhipa || toṣamāpnoti deveśaḥ sarvānkāmānprayacchati || 23 || kiṃ punarvedapāṭhaṃ tu snānakāle karoti yaḥ || tasya yallabhate puṇyaṃ na jñātaṃ naranāyaka || 24 || snāna kāle ca saṃprāpte kṛṣṇasyāgre tu nartanam || gītaṃ caiva punastatra stavanaṃ vadanena hi ||25 || snānakāle tu kṛṣṇasya jayaśabdaṃ karoti yaḥ || karatāla samāyuktaṃ gītanṛtyaṃ karoti ca ||26|| tatra ceṣṭāṃ prakurvāṇo hasate jalpate'pi vā || muktaṃ tena paraṃ māturyoniyaṃtrasya nirgamam || 27 || nottānaśāyī bhavati māturaṃke nareśvara || guṇānpaṭhati kṛṣṇasya yaḥ kāle snānakarmaṇaḥ || 28 || caṃdanāgurumiśreṇa kaṃkumena sugaṃdhinā || vilepayati yaḥ kṛṣṇaṃ karpūramṛganābhinā || kalpaṃ tu bhavane viṣṇorvasate pitṛbhiḥ saha ||29|| pratyekaṃ caṃdanādīnāmiṃdradyumna na cānyathā || nānādeśasamudbhūtaiḥ suvastraiśca sukomalaiḥ || 7.4.23.30 || dhūpayitvā sugaṃdhaiśca yo dhūpayati mānavaḥ || manvaṃtarāṇi vasate tatsaṃkhyāni harergṛhe ||31|| svaśaktyā devadeveśaṃ bhūṣaṇairbhūṣayaṃti ca || hemajairatulaiḥ śubhrairmaṇijaiśca suśobhanaiḥ || 32 || teṣāṃ phalaṃ mahārāja rudrāśca vāsavādayaḥ || 33 || jānaṃti munayo naiva varjayitvā tu mādhavam || ye'rcayaṃti jagannāthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham || ketakītulasīpatraiḥ puṣpairmālatisaṃbhavaiḥ || 34 || taddeśasaṃbhavaiścānyairbhūribhiḥ kusumairnṛpa || ekaikaṃ nṛpa śārdūla rājasūyasamaṃ smṛtam || 35 || ye kurvaṃti narāḥ pūjāṃ svaśaktyā rukmiṇīpateḥ || krīḍaṃti viṣṇuloke te manvataraśataṃ narāḥ || 36 || yaḥ punastulasīpatraiḥ komalamaṃjarīyutaiḥ || pūjayecchraddhayā yastu kṛṣṇaṃ devakinaṃdanam || 37 || yā gatiryogayuktānāṃ yā gatiryogaśālinām || yā gatirdānaśīlānāṃ yā gatistīrthasevinām || 38 || yā gatirmātṛbhaktānāṃ dvādaśīṃ vedhavarjitām || kurvatāṃ jāgaraṃ viṣṇornṛtyatāṃ gāyatāṃ phalam ||39|| vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu bhaktānāṃ yatphalaṃ vedavādinām || paṭhatāṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu yacchatām || 7.4.23.40 || tulasīmālayā kṛṣṇaḥ pūjito rukmiṇī patiḥ || phalametanmahīpāla yacchate nātra saśayaḥ || 41 || yathā lakṣmīḥ priyā viṣṇostulasī ca tato'dhikā || dvārakāyāṃ samutpannā viśeṣeṇa phalādhikā || 42 || yatra tatra sthito viṣṇustulasīdalamālayā || pūjito dvārakātulyaṃ puṇyaṃ sa yacchate kalau || 43 || yo'rcayetketakīpatraiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham || patrepatre'śvamedhasyaphalaṃ yacchati bhūbhuja ||44|| yo'rcayenmālatīpuṣpaiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ tribhuvaneśvaram || tenāptaṃ nāsti saṃdeho yatphalaṃ durlabhaṃ hareḥ || 45 || ṛtukālodbhavaiḥ puṣpairyo'rcayedrukmiṇīpatim || sarvānkāmānavāpnoti durlabhāndevamānuṣaiḥ || 46 || kṛṣṇenāguruṇā kṛṣṇaṃ dhūpayaṃti kalau yuge || sakarpūreṇa rājendra kṛṣṇatulyā bhavaṃti te || 47 || sājyena guggulenāpi sugaṃdhena janārddanam || dhūpayitvā naro yāti padaṃ bhūyaḥ sadā śivam || 48 || yo dadāti mahīpāla kṛṣṇasyāgre tu dīpakam || pātakaṃ tu samutsṛjya jyotīrūpaṃ labhetpadam || 49 || dvāre kṛṣṇasya yo nityaṃ dīpamālāṃ karoti hi || saptadvīpavatīrājyaṃ dvīpedvīpe phalaṃ labhet || 7.4.23.50 || naivedyāni manojñāni kṛṣṇāya vinivedayet || kalpāṃtaṃ tatpitṝṇāṃ hi tṛptirbhavati śāśvatī || 51 || phalāni yacchate yo vai suhṛdyāni nareśvara || jāyaṃte tasya kalpāṃtaṃ saphalāstu manorathāḥ || 52 || tāṃbūlaṃ tu sakarpūraṃ sapūgaṃ naranāyaka || kṛṣṇāya yacchate yo vai padaṃ tasyāgnidaivatam || 53 || sanīraṃ karpuropetaṃ kuṃbhaṃ kṛṣṇāgrato nyaset || kalpāṃte na jalāpekṣāṃ kurvaṃti ca pitāmahāḥ ||54|| vyajanenātha vastreṇa subhaktyā mātariśvanā || devadevasya rājendra kurute dharmavāraṇam||59|| tatkule nāsti pāpiṣṭho na ca loke yamasya ca || vāyulokānmahīpāla na punarvidyate gatiḥ||56|| kṛṣṇaveśmani yaḥ kuryyātsadhūpaṃ puṣpamaṃḍapam || sapuṣpakavimānaistu krīḍate koṭibhirddivi||57|| calaccāmaravātena kṛṣṇaṃ yastoṣayennaraḥ || tasyottamāṃgaṃ deveśaścuṃbate svamukhena hi ||58|| yaḥ kuryātkṛṣṇabhavanaṃ kadalīstaṃbhaśobhitam || || vasatyarkaloke tu yāvadvasati medinī || 59 || dhūpaṃ caṃdanamālāṃ tu kurute kṛṣṇasadmani || devakanyāyutairlakṣaiḥ sevyate suranāyakaiḥ || 7.4.23.60 || dhvajamāropayedyastu prāsādopari bhaktitaḥ || tasya brahmapade vāsaḥ krīḍate brahmaṇā saha || 61 || prāṃgaṇaṃ varṇakopetaṃ svastikaiśca samanvitaiḥ || devadevasya kurute krīḍate bhuvanatraye||62|| yo dadyānmaṇḍape puṣpaprakaraṃ rukmiṇīpateḥ|| devodyāneṣu sarveṣu krīḍate naranāyakaiḥ||63|| prāsāde devadevasya citrakarma karoti yaḥ|| vasate rudraloke tu yāvattiṣṭhaṃti sāgarāḥ||64|| dadyāccandramayaṃ yastu kṛṣṇopari nareśvara|| vasate dvārakāṃ yāvatsomaloke sa tiṣṭhati ||65 || chatraṃ bahuśalākaṃ tu kiṃkiṇīvasraguṇṭhitam || divyaratnaiśca saṃyuktaṃ hemadaṇḍasamanvitam || 66 || samarpayati kṛṣṇāya cchatraṃ lakṣārbudairvṛtam || amaraiḥ sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ krīḍate pitṛbhiḥ saha || 67 || dadyānnaravimānaṃ tu kṛṣṇāya naranāyaka || satkṛto dhanadenaiva vasate brahmavāsaram || 68 || kṛtā pūjā dikaṃ bhūpa jvalaṃtaṃ kṛṣṇamūrddhani || ārārtikaṃ prakurvāṇo modate kṛṣṇasannidhau || 69 || dīptimaṃtaṃ sakarpūraṃ karotyārārtikaṃ nṛpa || kṛṣṇasya vasate loke saptakalpāni mānavaḥ || 7.4.23.70 || dhṛtvā śaṃkhodakaṃ yastu bhrāmayetkeśavopari || saṃnidhau vasate viṣṇoḥ kalpāṃtaṃ kṣīrasāgare || 71 || evaṃ kṛtvā tu kṛpṇasya yaḥ karoti pradakṣiṇām || paṭhannāmasahasraṃ tu stavamanyaṃ paṭhannṛpa || saptadvīpavatīpuṇyaṃ labhate tu padepade || 72 || kuryyāddaṇḍanamaskāramaśvamedhāyutaiḥ samam || kṛṣṇaṃ saṃtoṣayedyastu sugītairmadhuraiḥ svaraiḥ || sāmavedaphalaṃ tasya jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 73 || yo nṛtyati prahṛṣṭātmā bhāvairbahu subhaktitaḥ || sa nirddahati pāpāni manvaṃtarakṛtānyapi || 74 || yaḥ kṛṣṇāgre mahābhaktyā kuryyātpustakavācanam || pratyakṣaraṃ labhetpuṇyaṃ kapilāśatadānajam || |75|| ṛgyajuḥsāmabhirvāgbhiḥ kṛṣṇaṃ saṃtoṣayaṃti ye || kalpāṃtaṃ brahmaloke tu te vasaṃti dvijottamāḥ || 76 || yogaśāstrāṇi vedāṃtā npurāṇaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || paṭhaṃti ravibiṃbaṃ te bhittvā yāṃti harerlayam || 77 || gītā nāmasahasraṃ tu stavarājo hyanusmṛtiḥ || gajendramokṣaṇaṃ caiva kṛṣṇasyātīva vallabham || 78 || śrīmadrāgavataṃ yastu paṭhate kṛṣṇasannidhau || kulakoṭiśatairyuktaḥ krīḍate yogibhiḥ sadā || 79 || yaḥ paṭhedrāmacaritaṃ bhārataṃ vyāsabhāṣitam || purāṇāni mahīpāla prāpto muktiṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||7.4.23.80|| dvādaśīvāsare prāpta evaṃ kurvaṃti ye narāḥ || gītādyaiḥ śatasāhasraṃ puṇyaṃ yacchati keśavaḥ || 81|| jāgare koṭiguṇitaṃ puṇyaṃ bhavati bhūbhipa || vasatāṃ dvārakāvāsātpratyahaṃ labhate phalam ||82|| gomatīnīrapūtānāṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāvaloki nām || darśanātpātakaṃ teṣāṃ yāti varṣaśatārjitam ||83|| dhanyāste mānuṣe loke gomatyudadhivāriṇā|| tarpayaṃti pitṝndevāngatvā dvāravatīṃ kalau || ||84|| gaṃgādvāre prayāge ca gaṃgāyāṃ kurujāṃgale || prabhāse śuklatīrthe ca śrīsthale puṣkare'pi ca ||85|| snānena piṃḍadānena pitṝṇāṃ tarpaṇe kṛte || tṛptirbhavati bhūpāla tathā gomatidarśanāt ||86|| yojanairbahubhistiṣṭhangomatīti ca yo vadet || cāṃdrāyaṇasahasrasya phalamāpnoti yatnataḥ || 87 || dhanyā dvāravatī loke vahate yatra gomatī || svayaṃ tu tiṣṭhate yatra nityaṃ rukmiṇivallabhaḥ ||88|| na snātā gomatītīre kalau pāpena mohitāḥ || bhaviṣyati kathaṃ teṣāṃ pāpabaṃdhasya saṃkṣayaḥ || 89 || nirmitā svarganiḥśreṇī kalau kṛṣṇena gomatī || manasaḥ prītijananī jaṃtūnāṃ narasattama || 7.4.23.90 || na dṛśyaṃ svargasopānaṃ dṛśyate gomatīsamam|| sukhadaṃ pāpināṃ puṃsāṃ snānamātreṇa mokṣadam || 91 || gomatīnīrasaṃyukto yatra garjati sāgaraḥ || tatra gacchennaravyāghra kṛṣṇastiṣṭhati yatra vai|| 92 || yatra cakrāṃkitaśilā gomatyudadhiniḥsṛtāḥ || yacchaṃti pūjitā mokṣaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate || 93 || yatra cakrāṃkitā mṛtsnā tiṣṭhate nirmalā nṛpa || kalau pāpavināśārthaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate || 94 || apradṛśyā purā loke daityadānavarakṣasām || śaraṇyā devatādīnāṃ purīṃ tāṃ ko na sevate || 95 || tyajate yāṃ kalau naiva kṛṣṇo devakinandanaḥ || karmaṇā manasā vācā tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate || 96 || || mārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || śṛṇu rājanpravakṣyāmi kathāṃ pāpapraṇāśinīm || yāṃ śrutvā mucyate nūnaṃ duḥkhasaṃsāra baṃdhanāt || 97 || avantīviṣaye pūrvaṃ brāhmaṇo vedapāragaḥ || caṃdraśarmeti vikhyātaḥ śivabhaktaḥ sadā nṛpa || 98 || manasā karmaṇā vācā nānyaṃ dhyāti sadāśivāt || śaivādvratādvrataṃ nānyatkaroti ca narādhipa || 99 || nopavāsaṃ haridine kurute na vrataṃ hareḥ || vinā caturdaśīṃ rājannānyadevasamudbhavam || 7.4.23.100 || yatrayatra śivakṣetraṃ yatra tīrthaṃ tu śāṃkaram || tatra gacchati rājendra vaiṣṇavaṃ naiva gacchati || 101 || prativarṣaṃ tu kurute somanāthasya darśanam || na jahāti viśeṣeṇa somaparva nareśvara || 102 || evaṃ prakurvatastasya varṣāṇi navasaptatiḥ || gatāni kila rājendra śivabhaktiṃ prakurvataḥ||103|| kadācitsomaparvaṇyāgate somopanāyakam|| nānādeśānmahīpāla hyasaṃkhyātāśca mānavāḥ|| 104|| gatāḥ kṛṣṇapurīṃ sarve dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum|| āhūtastaiścaṃdraśarmā na gato dvārakāṃ purīm||105|| śivakṣetrātparaṃ tīrthaṃ nāhaṃ manye jaga ttraye || nānyadevo mayā jñāta īśvarāddevanāyakāt || 106 || vinā'nye caṃdraśarmāṇaṃ gatāste dvārakāṃ purīm || anyasmindivase rājangacchataḥ svagṛhaṃ prati || cakruste darśanaṃ svapne caṃdraśarmapitāmahāḥ || 108 || pretabhūtā mahākāyāḥ kṣutkṣāmāścaiva bhīṣaṇāḥ || dṛṣṭvā svapnaṃ mahā raudraṃ bhīto'sau ca prakaṃpitaḥ || 109 || || candraśarmovāca || || ke yūyaṃ vikṛtākārā jaṃtūnāṃ ca bhayānakāḥ || pṛthvīsamudbhavā jīvā na dṛṣṭā na śrutā mayā || 7.4.23.110 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || mā bhayaṃ kuru vipreṃdra tava pūrvapitāmahāḥ || āgatāstvatsamīpe tu mahāduḥkhena pīḍitāḥ || 111 || || || candraśarmovāca || || iṣṭaṃ dattaṃ tapastaptaṃ bhavadbhirmatpitāmahaiḥ || pretatve kāraṇaṃ yatsyādbhavatāṃ vismayo mama ||112|| || pretā ūcuḥ || || śṛṇu putra pravakṣyāmaḥ pretayonestu kāraṇam || vāsaraṃ vāsudevasya sadā viddhaṃ kṛtaṃ purā || 113 || pretatvaṃ tena saṃprāptamasmābhiḥ śṛṇu putraka || viśeṣeṇa kṛtaṃ rātrau viddhaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 114 || patanaṃ narake ghore bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || tvayā saha na saṃdeho yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 115 || candraśarmovāca || || haribhaktivihīnānāṃ dvādaśīvratavarjinām|| nāśaṃ na yāti pretatvaṃ pūjitaiḥ śaṃkarādibhiḥ ||116|| na vā santoṣito devo bhaktyā tripuranāśanaḥ || pradāsyati gatiṃ nūnaṃ pretatvaṃ na gamiṣyati || 117 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || prāyaścittaṃ vinā putra dvādaśīvedhasaṃbhavam || āpanna gacchate nūnaṃ pretatvaṃ naiva gacchati || 118 || prāyaścittī sadā putra pūjayāno'pi śaṃkaram || vinā keśavapūjābhiḥ pāpaṃ bhajati govadham || 119 || prathamaṃ keśavaḥ pūjyaḥ paścāddevo maheśvaraḥ || pūjanīyāśca bhaktyā vai yāścānyāḥ saṃti devatāḥ || 7.4.23.120 || mūlācchākhāḥ praśākhāśca bhavaṃti bahuśastataḥ || vāsudevātsamudbhūtaṃ jagadetaccarācaram|| 121 || tasmānmūlaṃ parityajya śākhāṃ naivārcayedbudhaḥ || viśeṣeṇa jagannāthaṃ trailokyādhipatiṃ harim || 122|| taddine ye prakurvaṃti samyagvedhena śobhitam || saśalyaṃ tanna saṃdehaḥ pretatvaṃ yāti tena ca || 123 || havyaṃ devā na gṛhṇanti kavyaṃ ca pitarastathā || pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti no sūryastathā caiva pitāmahāḥ || 124 || pretāste ye prakurvaṃti saśalyaṃ vāsaraṃ hareḥ || paurṇamāsīdvaye prāpte rākā sāgnivivarjitā || 125 || viśeṣeṇa tu vaiśākhī śrāddhādīnāṃ praśasyate || vaiśākhe tu tṛtīyāṃ vai pūrvaviddhāṃ karoti yaḥ || 126 || havyaṃ devā na gṛhṇaṃti kavyaṃ caiva pitāmahāḥ|| yatra devā na gṛhṇaṃti kathaṃ tatra pitāmahāḥ || tasmātkāryyā tṛtīyā ca pūrvaviddhā budhairnaraiḥ || 127 || kurvate yadi mohādvā pretatvaṃ śāśvataṃ tataḥ || nāpayāti kṛtaiḥ puṇyairbahuśastīrthasevanaiḥ || 128 || daśamīṃ paurṇamāsīṃ ca pitroḥ sāṃvatsaraṃ dinam || pūrvaviddhaṃ prakurvāṇo narakaṃ pratipadyate || 129|| darśaśca paurṇamāsī ca sāgnikaiḥ pūrvasaṃyutā || nāgnihīnaistu karttavyā punarāha prajāpatiḥ ||7.4.23.130|| kṣayāhe tu punaḥ proktā svakālavyāpinī tithiḥ || śrāddhaṃ tatra prakartavyaṃ hrāsavṛddhī na kāraṇam || 131 || tatroktaṃ manunā putra vedāṃtairbhāṣyakāribhiḥ || tatpramāṇaṃ prakartavyaṃ pretatvaṃ bhavato'nyathā || || 132 || etai. prakāraiḥ pretatvaṃ prāṇināṃ jāyate bhuvi || nirīkṣya dharmaśāstrāṇi kāryyaṃ vihitamātmanaḥ || 133 || praṇamya somanāthaṃ tu yātrāṃ kṛtvā na gacchati || kṛṣṇasya darśanārthāya tasya kiṃ jāyate phalam || 134 || kathyate paramā mūrtirharirīśvarasaṃ saṃsthitā|| vibhedo nātra kartavyo yathā śaṃbhustathā hariḥ|| 135|| kṛṣṇasya somanāthasya nāṃtaraṃ dṛśyate kvacit|| yātrā śrīsomanāthasya saṃpūrṇā kṛṣṇadarśanāt|| 136|| tasmādubhayataḥ putra gantavyaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ|| dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ gaṃtavyaṃ dvārakāṃ prati|| 137|| prabhāse somanāthasya liṃgamadhye vyavasthitaḥ || svayaṃ tiṣṭhati puṇyātmā bhogaṃ gṛhṇāti keśavaḥ || 138 || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ dvārakāṃ na naro gataḥ || patanaṃ narake ghore pitṝṇāṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 139 || viśeṣeṇa tvayā vatsa na kṛtaṃ dvādaśīvratam || vrataṃ kṛtaṃ yadasmābhistatkṛtaṃ vedhasaṃyutam || nirgamaṃ yamalokāddhi tadasmākaṃ na dṛśyate || 7.4.23.140 || || candraśarmovāca || || yadi tāta mayā'jñānānna kṛtaṃ dvādaśīvratam || kasmātkṛtaṃ saśalyaṃ tu bhavadbhirdvādaśīvratam || 141 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || kuvipraistu kudaivajñaiḥ śukramāyāvimohitaiḥ || pāruṣyatāhetukaiśca pretayonimimāṃ gatāḥ || || 142 || dattaṃ taptaṃ hutaṃ japtamasmākaṃ viphalaṃ gatam || saṃprāptā pretayonistu saśalyādvādaśīvratāt || 143 || saśalyaṃ ye prakurvaṃti vāsaraṃ keśava priyam || teṣāṃ pitāmahāḥ svargātpretatvaṃ yāṃti putraka || 144 || || candraśarmovāca || || pretatvaṃ nāśamāyāti kathametatpitāmahāḥ || karmaṇā kena tatsarvaṃ yaccāhaṃ prakaromi tat || 145 || || pretā ūcuḥ || || mā gayāṃ mā prayāgaṃ ca puṣkare kurujāṃgale || ayodhyāyāmavaṃtyāṃ vā madhurāyāṃ na cārbude || 146 || na cānyattīrthalakṣaṃ tu varjayitvā tu gomatīm || gaṃgā sarasvatī caiva narmadā naiva puṣkaram || 147 || yādṛśaṃ gomatītīre kalau pretatvanāśanam || gomatīnīradānena kṛṣṇavaktravilokanāt || 148 || vilayaṃ yāṃti pāpāni janmakoṭikṛtānyapi || vṛthā saṃnyāsināṃ puṇyaṃ vṛthā ca vanavāsinām || 149 || saśalyaṃ vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ kurvaṃti yadi putraka || tasmādgaccha mukhaṃ paśya pūrṇacandrasamaṃ mukham || 7.4.23.150 || kṛṣṇasya dvārakāṃ gatvā yathāsmākaṃ gatirbhavet || viphalaṃ tava saṃjātā na kṛtaṃ yadupārjjitam || 151 || tadvyartha sakalaṃ jātaṃ vinā keśava pūjanāt || vinā keśavapūjāyāḥ śaṃkaro yastvayārccitaḥ || tatpuṇyaṃ viphalaṃ jātaṃ pretayoniṃ gamiṣyasi || 152 || saṃpūrṇaṃ tava puṇyaṃ ca dvārakā kṛṣṇadarśanāt || bhaviṣyati na sandeho gomatyudadhisannidhau || 153 || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ yadi na paśyati || yātrāphalaṃ na cāpnoti vadatyevaṃ svayaṃ śivaḥ || 154 || dṛṣṭo'haṃ tairna sandeho yaiḥ kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || ekā mūrtirna sandeho mama kṛṣṇasya nāṃtaram || 155 || dṛṣṭvā māṃ dvārakāṃ gatvā karttavyaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ tu māṃ paśyedyāsyatyeva mahāphalam || 156 || kṛṣṇadarśanapūtātmā yo māṃ paśyati mānavaḥ || na tasya punarāvṛttirmama lokācca vaiṣṇavāt || 157 || ityāha devadeveśaḥ svayaṃ somapatiḥ purā || viprāṇāṃ śrutamasmābhirvadatāṃ puṣkare satām || 158 || tasmādgaccha prayāṇārtha kuru kṛṣṇasya darśanam || anyathā yāsyase yoniṃ paiśācīṃ pāpadāyinīm || 159 || kṛtāparādho'pi yadā kurute kṛṣṇadarśanam || mucyate nā'tra saṃdehaḥ pāpājjanmakṛtādapi || 7.4.23.160 || pūjite devadeveśe kṛṣṇe devakinandane || pūjitā devatāḥ sarvā brahmarudrabhagādikāḥ || 161 || vinā kṛṣṇasya pūjāṃ ca rudrādyāstridivaukasaḥ || pūjitā naiva kurvaṃti tuṣṭiṃ putra pitāmahāḥ || 162 || tasmāddvāravatīṃ gatvā kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ kuru || pretayonervinirmuktā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 163 || gomatīnīradhautāni yasyāṃgāni kalau yuge || munibhiryonigamanaṃ tasya dṛṣṭaṃ na putraka || 164 || tāḍitāḥ pādayugmena gomatīnīravīcayaḥ || agatīnāṃ prakurvati gatiṃ vai brahmavādinām || 165 || yaḥ punaḥ kurute śrāddhaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 166 || sasāgaradharāyāṃ ca sarvatīrtheṣu yatphalam || dinenaikena tatpuṇyaṃ dvārakākṛṣṇasannidhau || 167 || yatphalaṃ tridaśairdṛṣṭaṃ sarvatīrthasamudbhavam || tatphalaṃ labhate sarvaṃ dvārakāyāṃ dinedine || 168 || tīrthakoṭisahasraistu kṛtaiḥ śrāddhaiśca yatphalam || pitṝṇāṃ tatphalaṃ proktaṃ gomatītilatarpaṇāt || 169 || yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ yastu yacchate kṛṣṇamandire || sikthesikthe bhavettṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ yugasaṃkhyayā || 7.4.23.170 || kaupīnācchādanaṃ chatraṃ pāduke ca kamaṇḍalum || dattvā saṃnyāsināṃ yāti sapta kalpāni tatphalam || 171 || dhanyāste mānavāḥ putra vasanti śvapacādayaḥ || dvārakāyāṃ gatiṃ yāṃti vasatāṃ tatra yoginām || || 172 || trikālaṃ ye prapaśyaṃti vadanaṃ pratyahaṃ hareḥ || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 173 || yā nārī vidhavā bhūtvā kurute dvārakāśrayam || kulāyutasahasraṃ tu nayate paramaṃ padam || 174 || putreṇāpīha kiṃ kāryyaṃ na gato dvārakāṃ yadi || nārī putraśatācchreṣṭhā gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ vaset || || 175 || kṛṣṇaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ gatvā yo'rccayettulasīdalaiḥ || prāptaṃ janmaphalaṃ tena tāritāḥ prapitāmahāḥ || 176 || tulasīdalamālāṃ tu kṛṣṇottīrṇāṃ tu yo vahet || patrepatre'śvamedhānāṃ daśānāṃ labhate phalam || 177 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtāṃ yo mālāṃ vahate naraḥ || phalaṃ yacchati daityāriḥ pratyahaṃ dvārakodbhavam || 178 || nivedya viṣṇave mālāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavām || vahate yo naro bhaktyā tasya naivāsti pātakam || sadā prītamanāstasya kṛṣṇo devakinaṃdanaḥ || 179 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtaṃ śirobāhvādibhūṣaṇam || jāyate yasya martyasya tasya dehe sadā hariḥ || 7.4.23.180 || tulasīmālayā yastu bhūṣitaḥ karma cā''caret || pitṝṇāṃ devatānāṃ ca kṛtaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ kalau ||181|| tulasīkāṣṭhamālāṃ tu pretarājasya dūtakāḥ || dṛṣṭvā dūreṇa naśyaṃti vātoddhūtā yathā'layaḥ || 182 || jāyate tadgrahe naiva pāpasaṃkramaṇaṃ kutaḥ || śrutaṃ purāṇamasmābhiḥ kathitaṃ brahmavādibhiḥ || 183 || tasmānmālā tvayā dhāryyā tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhavā || harate nātra saṃdeha aihikāmuṣmikaṃ tvagham || 184 || tulasīmālayā yastu bhūṣito bhramate yadi || duḥsvapnaṃ durnimittaṃ ca na bhayaṃ śātravaṃ kvacit || 185 || kṛtvā vai tīrthasaṃnyāsaṃ yatayo vidhavāḥ striyaḥ || jīvanmuktāḥ kalau jñeyāḥ kulakoṭisamanvitāḥ || || 186 || dhārayaṃti na ye mālāṃ haitukāḥ pāpamohitāḥ || narakānna nivartaṃte dagdhāḥ kopāgninā hareḥ || 187 || unmīlinī vaṃjulinī trispṛśā pakṣavarddhinī || tvayā putra prakarttavyā jayaṃtī vijayā jayā || 188 || pāpaghnī cāṣṭamī proktā kṛṣṇasyātīva vallabhā || kṛtā kalau yuge putra dvārakā mokṣadāyinī || 189 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāgamanamāhātmya tulasīdhāraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma trayoviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 23 || || cha ||
<7.4.24>
|| śrīmārkaṃḍeya uvāca || || pitṝṇāṃ pretarūpāṇāṃ kṛtvā vākyaṃ mahīpate || caṃdraśarmā dvijaśreṣṭho dvārakāṃ samupāgataḥ || 1 || rukmiṇīsahitaḥ kṛṣṇo yatra tiṣṭhati cānvaham || yatra tiṣṭhaṃti tīrthāni tatra yāto dvijottamaḥ || 2 || yatra tiṣṭhaṃti yajñāśca yatra tiṣṭhaṃti devatāḥ || yatra tiṣṭhaṃti ṛṣayo munayo yogavittamāḥ || 3 || yā purī siddhagaṃdharvaiḥ sevyate kiṃnarairnareḥ || apsarogaṇayakṣaiśca dvārakā sarvakāmadā || 4 || svargārohaṇaniśreṇī vahate yatra gomatī || sā purī mokṣadā nṛṇāṃ dṛṣṭā vipravareṇa hi ||5|| yasyāḥ sīmāṃ praviṣṭasya brahmahatyādipātakam || naśyate darśanādeva tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate || 6 || gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ dṛṣṭvā gomatīṃ caiva sāgaram || manye kṛtārthamātmānaṃ jīvitaṃ yauvanaṃ dhanam || 7 || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ kṛṣṇasya mukhapaṃkajam || dhanyo'haṃ kṛtyakṛtyohaṃ sabhāgyo'haṃ dharātale || || 8 || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ ramyaṃ rukmiṇīṃ dvārakāṃ purīm|| tīrthakoṭisahasraistu sevitaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam ||9|| puṇyairlakṣasahasraistu prāptā dvāravatī śubhā || śuklā vaiśākhamāse tu saṃprāptā madhusūdanī || 7.4.24.10 || dvādaśī trispṛśānāma pāpakoṭiśatāpahā || dhanyāḥ sarve manuṣyāste vaiśākhe madhusūdanī ||1 1|| saṃprāptā trispṛśā yaistu budhavāreṇa saṃyutā || na yajñaistu na vedaistu na tīrthaiḥ koṭisevitaiḥ || prāpyate tatphalaṃ naiva dvārakāyāṃ yathā nṛṇām || 12 || evamuktvā dvijaśreṣṭho gomatītīramāśritaḥ || upaspṛśya yathānyāyaṃ śāstradṛṣṭena karmaṇā || 13 || kṛtvā snānaṃ yathoktaṃ tu saṃtarpya pitṛdevatāḥ || cakratīrthātsamādāya śilāṃścakrāṃkitāñchubhān || pūjitāḥ puruṣasūktena yathoktavidhinā nṛpa || 14 || śivapūjā kṛtā paścātsaṃsmṛtya pitṛbhāṣitam || dattvā piṃḍodakaṃ samyakpitṝṇāṃ vidhipūrvakam ||15|| vilepanaṃ ca vastrāṇi puṣpāṇi dhūpadīpako || naivedyāni manojñāni kaṃdamūlaphalāni ca || 16 || tāṃbūlaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ kṛtvā nīrājanādikam || pradakṣiṇāṃ namaskāraṃ stutipūrvaṃ punaḥpunaḥ || 17 || kṣamāpayitvā deveśaṃ cakre jāgaraṇaṃ tataḥ || yāmatraye vyatīte tu caṃdraśarmā hyuvāca ha || 18 || āturasya ca dīnasya śṛṇu kṛṣṇa vaco mama || saṃsārabhayasaṃtrastaṃ māṃ tvamuddhara keśava ||19|| tvatpādāṃbuja bhaktānāṃ na duḥkhaṃ pāpināmapi || kiṃ punaḥ pāpahīnānāṃ dvādaśīsevināṃ nṛṇām||7.4.24.20|| daśamīvedhajaṃ pāpaṃ kathitaṃ mama pūrvajaiḥ || duṣkṛtaṃ nāśamāyātu tvatprasādājjanārddana || 21 || saviddhaṃ tvaddinaṃ kṛṣṇa yatkṛtaṃ jāgaraṃ hare || tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu yathālavaṇamaṃbhasi || 22 || saviddhaṃ vāsaraṃ yasmā tkṛtaṃ mama pitāmahaiḥ || pretatvaṃ tena saṃprāptaṃ mahāduḥkhaprasādhakam || 23 || yathā pretatvanirmuktā mama pūrvapitāmahāḥ || muktiṃ prayāṃti deveśa tathā kuru jagatpate || 24 || punareva yaduśreṣṭha prasādaṃ kartumarhasi || avidyāmohitenāpi na kṛtaṃ tava pūjanam || 25 || mayā pāpena deveśa śivabhaktiḥ samāśritā || tava bhaktiḥ kṛtā naiva na kṛtaṃ tava vāsaram || 26 || na dṛṣṭā dvārakā kṛṣṇa na snāto gomatījale || na dṛṣṭaṃ pādapadmaṃ ca tvadīyaṃ mokṣadā yakam || 27 || na kṛtā dvārakāyātrā dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum || viphalaṃ sukṛtaṃ jātaṃ yanmayā samupārjitam || 28 || matpūrvajaistu kathitaṃ sarvameva sureśvara || tatpuṇyaṃ mā vṛthā yātu prasādāttava keśava || 29 || dṛṣṭaṃ tu tava vaktraṃ ca durllabhaṃ bhuvanatraye || tannāsti devakīputra purāṇeṣu śrutaṃ mayā ||7.4.24.30|| sāparādhāstu ye kecicchiśupālādayaḥ smṛtāḥ || tvatkareṇa hatāḥ kopānmuktiṃ prāptā mahīvarāḥ || 31 || adyaprabhṛti karttavyaṃ pūjanaṃ pratyahaṃ ca tat|| palārdhenāpi viddhaṃ syādbhoktavyaṃ vāsare tava || 32 || tvatpriyā ca mayā kāryyā dvādaśī vratasaṃyutā || bhaktirbhāgavatānāṃ ca kāryyā prāṇairddhanairapi |||| 33 || nityaṃ nāmasahasraṃ tu paṭhanīyaṃ tava priyam || pūjā tu tulasīpatrairmayā kāryā sadaiva hi || 34 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtā mālā dhāryyā sadā mayā || nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ ca karttavyaṃ saṃprāpte jāgare tava || 35 || dvārakāyāṃ prakarttavyaṃ pratyahaṃ gamanaṃ mayā || tvatkathāśravaṇārthaṃ ca nityaṃ pustakavācanam || 36 || nityaṃ pādodakaṃ mūrdhnā mayā dhāryaṃ subhaktitaḥ || naivedyabhakṣaṇaṃ caiva kariṣyāmi subhaktitaḥ || 37 || nirmālyaṃ śirasā dhāryyaṃ tvadīyaṃ sādaraṃ mayā || tava dattvā yadiṣṭaṃ tu bhakṣaṇīyaṃ sadā mayā || 38 || tathā tathā prakarttavyaṃ yena tuṣṭirbhavettava || tathyametanmayā kṛṣṇa tavāgre parikīrtitam || 39 || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || sādhusādhu mahābhāga candraśarmandvijottama || āgamiṣyaṃti malloke tvayā saha pitāmahāḥ || 7.4.24.40 || paśya pretatvanirmuktā matprasādāddvijottama || ākāśe garuḍārūḍhāstava pūrvapitāmahāḥ || 41 || || pitāmahā ūcuḥ || || tvatprasādādvayaṃ putra muktiṃ prāptā na saṃśayaḥ || pretayonervinirmuktāḥ kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokanāt || 42.|| dhanyāste mānuṣe loke putrapautraprapautrakāḥ || dṛṣṭvā śrīsomanāthaṃ tu kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaṃti dvārakām || 43 || dhanyā ca vidhavā nārī kṛṣṇayātrāṃ karoti yā || uddhariṣyati loke'sminkulānāṃ nirayācchatam || 44 ||| śvapaco'pi karotyevama yātrāṃ ca hariśāṃkarīm|| sa yāti paramāṃ muktiṃ pitṛbhiḥ parivāritaḥ || 45 || yaḥ punastīrthasaṃnyāsaṃ kṛtvā tiṣṭhati tatra vai || viṣṇulokānnivṛttirna kalpakoṭiśatairapi ||46|| vaṃcitāste na sandeho dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ prabhum || dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ naiva na snātā gomatījale || 47 || kiṃ jalairbahubhiḥ puṇyaistīrthakoṭisamudbhavaiḥ || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ yastu dvārakāṃ naiva gacchati || dhikkurvaṃti ca taṃ pāpaṃ pitaro divi saṃsthitāḥ || 48 || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā punaḥ śivam|| sauparṇe kathitaṃ puṇyaṃ yātrāśatasamudbhavam || 49 || dṛṣṭvā someśvaraṃ devaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ naiva prapaśyati || mohādvyarthagataṃ tasya sarvaṃ saṃsārakarma vai || 7.4.24.50 || āgatya yaḥ prabhāse ca kṛṣṇaṃ paśyati vai naraḥ || prabhāsāyutasaṃkhyaṃ tu phalamāpnoti yatnataḥ || 51 || yasmātsarvāṇi tīrthāni sarve devāstathā makhāḥ || dvārakāyāṃ samāyāṃti trikālaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau || 52 || tīrthairnānāvidhaiḥ putra tatsthānaiḥ kiṃ prayojanam || phalaṃ samastatīrthānāṃ dṛṣṭvā dvāravatīṃ labhet || 53 || hate kaṃse jarāsandhe narake ca nipātite || uttārite bhuvo bhāre kṛṣṇo devakinaṃdanaḥ || cakre dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ sannidhau sāgarasya ca || 54 || sthitaḥ prītamanāḥ kṛṣṇo lapsyate kāminīsukham || 55 || brahmāgnivāyusūryāśca vāsavādyā divaukasaḥ || marttyā viprāśca rājānaḥ pātālātpannageśvarāḥ || 56 || nadyo nadāśca śailāśca vanānyupavanāni ca || puragrāmā hyaraṇyāni sāgarāśca sarāṃsi ca || 57 || yakṣāścāsuragaṃdharvāḥ siddhā vidyādharāstathā || rambhādyapsarasaścaiva prahlādādyā diteḥ sutāḥ || rakṣā vibhīṣaṇādyāśca dhanado rakṣa nāyakaḥ || 58 || ṛṣayo munayaḥ siddhāḥ sanakādyāśca yoginaḥ || grahā ṛkṣāṇi yogāśca dhruvaḥ paramavaiṣṇavaḥ || 59 || yatkiṃcittriṣu lokeṣu tiṣṭhate sthāṇujaṃgamam || śrīkṛṣṇasannidhau nityaṃ pratyahaṃ tiṣṭhate sadā || 7.4.24.60 || na tyajaṃti purīṃ puṇyāṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasevitām || sā tvayā sevitā putra sāṃprataṃ kṛṣṇadarśanāt || piśācayoninirmuktā yāsyāmaḥ paramāṃ gatim || 61 || dvādaśīvedhajaṃpāpaṃ dvārakāyāḥ prabhāvataḥ || naṣṭaṃ putra na sandehaḥ saṃprāptāḥ paramaṃ padam || 62 || dvādaśīvedhasambhūtaṃ yattvayā pāpamarjitam || kṛṣṇasya darśanātkṣīṇaṃ na jahyaṃ dvādaśīvratam || 63 || rakṣaṇīyaṃ prayatnena vedho daśamisambhavaḥ || no cetputra na saṃdehaḥ pretayonimavāpsyasi || 64 || trailokya saṃbhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ bhavati bhūtale|| saśalyaṃ ye prakurvaṃti vāsaraṃ kṛṣṇasaṃjñakam||65|| prāyaścittaṃ na tasyāsti saśalyaṃ vāsaraṃ hareḥ || ye kurvaṃti na te yāṃti manvataraśatairdivam || 66 || pretatvaṃ duḥsahaṃ putra duḥsahā yamayātanā || tasmātputra na karttavyaṃ saśalyaṃ dvādaśīvratam || 67 || kārayaṃti hi ye tvajñāḥ kūṭayuktāśca hetukāḥ || pretayoniṃ prayāsyaṃti pitṛbhiḥ saha sarvataḥ || 68 || dvādaśī daśamīviddhā saṃtānapravināśinī || dhvaṃsinī pūrvapuṇyānāṃ kṛṣṇabhaktivināśinī ||69|| svasti te'stu gamiṣyāmaḥ prasādādrukmiṇīpateḥ || prāptaṃ viṣṇupadaṃ putra apunarbhavasaṃjñakam ||7.4.24.70|| || || śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca || || caṃdraśarmanprasanno'haṃ tava bhaktyā dvijottama || śaivabhāvaprapanno'pi yastvaṃ jāto'si vaiṣṇavaḥ || 71 || navasaptativarṣāṇi na kṛtaṃ vāsare mama || saṃpūrṇaṃ matprasādena tava jātaṃ na saṃśayaḥ ||72|| ekenaivopavāsena trispṛśāsaṃbhavena hi || dvārakāyāḥ prasādena maddṛṣṭyālokanena hi || 73 || avidyāmohitenaiva śivabhaktyā mamārcanam || na kṛtaṃ matprasādena kṛtaṃ caiva bhaviṣyati || 74 || vaiśākhe yairahaṃ dṛṣṭo dvārakāyāṃ dvijottama || trispṛśāvāsare caiva vaṃjulīvāsare tathā || 75 || unmīlinīdine prāpte prāpte vā pakṣavarddhinī || naiteṣāṃ cāparādho'sti yadyapi brahmaghātakāḥ || 76 || janmaprabhṛti puṇyasya prakṛtasyāpi bhūsura || matpurīdarśanenāpi phalabhāgī bhavennaraḥ || 77 || dṛṣṭvā samastatīrthāni prabhāsādīni bhūtale || matpurīdarśanenaiva pṛṣṭvā'pīha bhavetphalam || 78 || māhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāstu maddine yatra tatra vā || paṭhenmama purīṃ puṇyāṃ labhate matprasādataḥ || 79 || matpurīṃ vasatāṃ puṇyaṃ trikālaṃ mama darśanāt || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti yastvidaṃ paṭhate kalau || 7.4.24.80 || kalau kāśī ca mathurā hyavaṃtī ca dvijottama || ayodhyā ca tathā māyā kāṃcī caiva ca matpurī || 81 || śāligrāmabhavaṃ caiva badarī ca tathottamā || kurukṣetraṃ bhṛgukṣetraṃ puṣkaraṃ śubhasaṃjñakam ||82|| prayāgaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca kṣetraṃ vai hāṭakeśvaram || gaṃgādvāraṃ śaukaraṃ ca gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgamam || 83 || naimiṣaṃ daṇḍakāraṇyaṃ tathā vṛndāvanaṃ dvija || saiṃdhavaṃ cārbudākhyaṃ ca sarvāṇyāyatanāni ca || 84 || vanāni māgadhādīni puṣkarāṇi dvijottama || śailarājādayaḥ śailā himādripramukhā hi ye || 85 || gaṃgādayaśca sarito bhūtale saṃti yāni vai || tīrthāni triṣu kāleṣu samāni dvārakāpuraḥ || 86 || kalinā kalitaṃ sarvaṃ varjayitvā tu matpurīm || vipra varṣaśate prāpte matpuryāṃ mama darśane || 87 || tava mṛtyurmahīdeva matprasādādbhaviṣyati || trispṛśāvāsare prāpte vaiśākhe śuklapakṣataḥ || 88 || saṃgame budhavārasya divā bhūmau mamāgrataḥ || daśamaṃ dvāramāsādya tava prāṇasya nirgamam || bhaviṣyati na saṃdeho matprasādena bhūsura || 89 || svasthānaṃ gaccha vipreṃdra sarvānkāmānavāpsyasi || madbhaktānāṃ yugāṃte'pi vināśo nopapadyate || 7.4.24.90 || madbhaktiṃ vahatāṃ puṃsāmiha loke pare'pi vā || nāśubhaṃ vidyate kiṃcitkulakoṭiṃ nayeddivam || 91 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || tato varṣaśate prāpte gatvā dvāravatīṃ purīm || prāṇānkṛṣṇopadeśena tyaktvā mokṣaṃ jagāma ha || 92|| indradyumna tadākhyātaṃ māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || punarev pravakṣyāmi yatte manasi varttate || 93 || śṛṇvatāṃ paṭhatāṃ caiva māhā tmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || sarvaṃ phalamavāpnoti kṛṣṇena kathitaṃ ca yat || 94 || vistārayaṃti loke'smim̐llikhitaṃ yasya veśmani || pratyakṣaṃ dvārakāpuṇyaṃ prāpyate kṛṣṇasaṃbhavam || 95|| iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakākhaṇḍe candraśarmopākhyāne candraśarmaṇo dvārakāgamanapūrvaka kṛṣṇadattavaragrahaṇādi dvārakānagarīśraiṣṭhyamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma caturviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 24 || || cha ||
<7.4.25>
|| iṃdradyumna uvāca || || kathayasva muniśreṣṭha kiṃcitkautūhalaṃ mama || puṇyaṃ pavitraṃ pāpaghnaṃ tīrthaṃ tu vada vistarāt || 1 || || mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || mathurā dvārakā'yodhyā kalikāle purītrayam || dharmārthakāmadaṃ bhūpa mokṣadaṃ harivallabham || 2 || madhurāyāṃ tu kāliṃdī gomatī kṛṣṇasannidhau || ayodhyāyāṃ tu sarayūrmuktidā sevitā sadā || 3 || drāravatyāmayodhyāyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ rāmaṃ śubhapradam || mathurāyāṃ hariṃ viṣṇuṃ smṛtvā muktimavāpnuyāt || 4 || dhanyā sā mathurā loke yatra jāto hariḥ svayam || dvārakā saphalā loke krīḍitaṃ yatra viṣṇunā || 5 || dhanyānāmapi sā pūjyā ayodhyā sarvakāmadā || yā svayaṃ rāmadevena pālitā dharmabuddhinā || 6 || yaddadāti phalaṃ kāśī sevitā kalpasaṃkhyayā || kalā dadāti mathurā vāsareṇāpi tatphalam || 7 || manvaṃtarasahasre tu prayāge yatphalaṃ bhavet || nimiṣārddhena vasatāṃ dvārakāyāṃ tu tatphalam || 8 || prabhāse ca kurukṣetre yatphalaṃ vatsaraiḥ śataiḥ || vasatāṃ nimiṣārddhena hyayodhyāyāṃ ca tadbhavet || 9 || ayodhyādhipatiṃ rāmaṃ mathurāyāṃ tu keśavam || dvārakāvāsinaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kīrtanaṃ cāpi durllabham || 7.4.25.10 || mathurākīrtanenāpi śravaṇāddvārakāpuraḥ || ayodhyādarśanenāpi triśuddhaṃ ca padaṃ vrajet|| 11 || kṛṣṇaṃ svayaṃbhuvaṃ devaṃ dvārakā tridivopamā || śrutā cāpyathavā dṛṣṭā kurute janmasaṃkṣayam || 12 || śrutābhilikhitā dṛṣṭā hyayodhyā mathurāpurī || pāpaṃ harati kalpotthaṃ dvārakā ca tṛtīyakā || 13 || kṛṣṇaṃ viṣṇuṃ hariṃ devaṃ viśrāṃtaṃ ca kalau smṛtam || dvādaśyāṃ jāgare rātrāvaśvamedhāyutaṃ phalam || 14 || bālakrīḍanakaṃ sthānaṃ ye smaraṃti dinedine || svarṇaśailapadaṃ nṛṇāṃ jāyate rājasattama || 15 || dhanyāste mānavā loke kalikāle narottama|| plavanaṃ siṃdhutoyena gomatyāṃ yairnaraiḥ kṛtam || 16 || paścimāśāṃ naraḥ snātvā kṛtvā vai karasaṃpuṭam || dvārakāṃ ye smariṣyaṃti teṣāṃ koṭiguṇaṃ phalam || 17 || manasā cintayedyo vai kalau dvāravatīṃ purīm || kapilā'yutapuṇyaṃ ca labhate helayā naraḥ || 18 || gaṃgāsāgarajaṃ puṇyaṃ gaṃgādvārabhavaṃ tathā || kalau dvāravatīṃ gatvā prāpnoti manujādhipa || 19 || saptakalpasmaro bhūpa mārkaṇḍeyaḥ smarāmyaham || samānā vā'dhikā vāpi dvāravatyā na kāpi pūḥ ||7.4.25.20|| durvāsasā samo dhanyo nāsti nāpyadhiko nṛpa || bhāṣābaṃdhaṃ yena kṛtvā dvārakāyāṃ dhṛto hariḥ || 21 || mā kāśīṃ mā kurukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ mā ca puṣkaram || dvārakāṃ gaccha rājarṣe paśya kṛṣṇamukhaṃ śubham || 22 || aśvamedhasahasraṃ tu rājasūyaśataṃ kalau || padepade ca labhate dvārakāṃ yāti yo naraḥ || 23 || saphalaṃ jīvitaṃ teṣāṃ kalau nṛpavarottama || ye ṣāṃ na skhalitaṃ cittaṃ dvārakāṃ prati gacchatām || 24 || mātā ca putriṇī tena pitā caiva pitāmahāḥ || piṃḍadānaṃ kṛtaṃ yena gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || 25 || gopīcandanamudrāṃ tu kṛtvā bhramati bhūtale || so'pi deśo bhavetpūtaḥ ki punaryatra saṃsthitam || 26 || dvārakāyāṃ samudbhūtāṃ tulasīṃ kṛṣṇasevitām || nityaṃ bibharti śirasā sa bhavettridaśādhipaḥ|| 27 || daityārerbhagavattithiśca vijayā nīraṃ ca gagodbhavaṃ nityaṃkāśipurī tathaiva tulasī dhātrīphalaṃ vallabham||28|| śāstraṃ bhāgavataṃ tathā ca dayitaṃ rāmāyaṇaṃ dvārakā puṇyaṃ mālatisambhavaṃ sudayitaṃ gītaṃ kṛtaṃ jāgaram || 29 || gṛhe yasya sadā tiṣṭhedgopīcandanamṛttikā || dvārakā tiṣṭhate tatra kṛṣṇena sahitā kalau || 7.4.25.30 || kṛtaghno vā'tha goghno'pi haitukaḥ kṛtsnapāpakṛt || gopīcandanasaṃparkātpūto bhavati tatkṣaṇāt || 31 || gopīcandanakhaṃḍaṃ tu yo dadātīha vaiṣṇave || kulamekottaraṃ tena śataṃ tāritameva vā || 32 || dvārakāsambhavā bhūpa tulasī yasya maṃdire || tasya vaivasvato nityaṃ bibheti saha kiṃkaraiḥ || || 33 || dvārakāsaṃbhavā mṛtsnā tulasīkṛṣṇakīrtanam || kratukoṭiśataṃ puṇyaṃ kathitaṃ vyāsasūnunā || 34 || āloḍya sarvaśāstrāṇi purāṇāni punaḥpunaḥ || mayā dṛṣṭā mahīpāla na dvārakāsamā purī || 35 || dvārakāgamanaṃ yena kṛtaṃ kṛṣṇasya kīrtanam || snātaṃ tīrthasahasraistu teneṣṭaṃ kratukoṭibhiḥ ||36|| idriyāṇāṃ tu damanaṃ kiṃ kariṣyati dehinām || sāṃkhyamadhyayanaṃ cāpi dvārakāṃ gacchate na cet ||37|| paśavaste na sandeho gardabhena samā janāḥ || dṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamukhaṃ yairna gatvā dvāravatīṃ purīm || 38 || kṛtakṛtyāstu te dhanyā dvādaśyāṃ jāgare hareḥ || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ bhaktyā nṛtyamānā muhurmuhuḥ ||39|| kṛṣṇālayaṃ tu yo gatvā gomatyāṃ piṃḍapātanam || karoti śaktyā dānaṃ ca muktāstasya pitāmahāḥ ||7.4.25.40|| pretatvaṃ ca piśā catvaṃ na bhavettasya dehinaḥ || janmajanmani rājeṃdra yo gato dvārakāṃ purīm || 41 || anaśanena yatpuṇyaṃ prayāge tyajatastanum || dvādaśyāṃ nimiṣārddhena tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || 42 || sūryagrahe gavāṃ koṭiṃ dattvā yatphalamāpnuyāt || tatphalaṃ kalikāle tu dvāravatyāṃ dinedine || 43 || koṭibhāraṃ suvarṇasya grahaṇe caṃdrasūryayoḥ || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇadarśane || 44 || dolāsaṃsthaṃ ca ye kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaṃti madhumādhave || teṣāṃ putrāśca pautrāya mātāmahapitāmahāḥ || 45 || śvaśurādyāḥ sabhṛtyāśca paśavaśca narottama || krīḍaṃti viṣṇunā sārddhaṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 46 || yā kāciddvādaśī bhūpa jāyate kṛṣṇasannidhau || paśyāmi nāṃtaraṃ kiñcitkalikāle viśeṣataḥ || 47 || kṛṣṇasya sannidhau nityaṃ vāsarā dvādaśīsamāḥ || yugādibhiḥ samāḥ sarve nityaṃ kṛṣṇasya sannidhau||48|| kalau dvāravatī sevyā jñātvā puṇyaṃ viśeṣataḥ || ṣaṭapuryaścaiva sulabhā durllabhā dvārakā kalau||49|| smaraṇātkīrtanādyasmādbhuktimuktī sadā nṛṇām || durvāsasā tu ṛṣiṇā rakṣitā tiṣṭhate purī||7.4.25.50|| kalau na śakyate gaṃtuṃ vinā kṛṣṇaprasādataḥ || kṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ kartuṃ yānti rudrādayaḥ surāḥ||51|| trikālaṃ jagatīnātha rukmiṇīdarśanāya ca || saphalā bhāratī tasya kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti yā vadet||52|| dvārakā yāyinaṃ dṛṣṭvā gāyaṃti divisaṃsthitāḥ || narakātpitaro muktāḥ pracalaṃti hasaṃti ca ||53|| gopyaṃ yatpātakaṃ puṃsāṃ gomatī tadvyapohati || smaraṇātkīrttanādvāpi kiṃ punaḥ plavane kṛte || 54 || rukmiṇīsahitaṃ devaṃ śaṃkhoddhāre ca śaṃkhinam || piṃḍārake caturbāhuṃ dṛṣṭvā'nyaiḥ kiṃ kariṣyati ||55|| rukmiṇī devakīputraścakratīrthaṃ ca gomatī || gopīnāṃ caṃdanaṃ loke tulasī durlabhā kalau || 56 || durlabhāste sutā jñeyā dharaṇīpāpanāśakāḥ || gayāṃ gatvā tu ye piṃḍaṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || kariṣyaṃti kalau prāpte vaṃjulīsamupoṣaṇam || 57 || samaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ teṣāṃ vaṃjulī dvārakā samā || yena nyūnā nādhikā'pi kathitaṃ viṣṇunā svayam || 58 || vaṃjulī cādhikāṃ rājañchṛṇu vakṣyāmi kāraṇam|| dvādaśyāmupavāsena dvādaśyāṃ pāraṇena tu || prāpyate helayā caiva tadviṣṇoḥ paramaṃ padam || 59 || gṛheṣu vasatāṃ tīrthaṃ gṛheṣu vasatāṃ tapaḥ || gṛheṣu vasatāṃ mokṣo vaṃjulīsamupoṣaṇāt || 7.4.25.60 || vaṃjulī dvārakā gaṃgā gayā goviṃdakīrttanam || gomatī gokulaṃ gītā durllabhaṃ gopicandanam || 61 || etacchṛṇoti yo bhaktyā kṛtvā manasi keśavam || aśvamedhasahasrasya phalamāpnoti mānavaḥ || 62 || śroṣyaṃti jāgare ye vai māhātmyaṃ keśavasya ca || sarvapāpavinirmuktāḥ padaṃ yāsyaṃti vaiṣṇavam || || 63 || paṭhiṣyaṃti narā nityaṃ ye vai śropyaṃti bhaktitaḥ || tulāpuruṣadānasya phalaṃ te prāpnuvaṃti hi|| 64|| kṛṣṇajāgaraṇe dānaṃ yaccālpamapi dīyate || sarvaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ jñeyamityāhuḥ kavayo nṛpa || 65 || mānakūṭaṃ tulākūṭaṃ kanyāhayagavāṃ krayāt || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte || 66 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye vaṃjulīdvārakāgaṃgāgayāgovindagomatīgokula gītāgopīcandanamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 25 ||
<7.4.26>
|| śrīmārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || prahlādaṃ sarvadharmajñaṃ vedaśāstrārthapāragam || vaiṣṇavāgamatattvajñaṃ bhagavadbhaktitatparam || 1 || sukhāsīnaṃ mahāprājñamṛṣayo draṣṭumāgatāḥ || sarvaśāstrārthatattvajñāḥ svadharmapratipālakāḥ || || 2 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || vinā jñānādvinā dhyānādvinā cendriyanigrahāt || anāyāsena yenaitatprāpyate paramaṃ padam || 3 || saṃkṣepātkathaya snehāddṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalodayam || dharmānmanujaśārdūla brūhi sarvānaśeṣataḥ || 4 || ityukto'sau mahābhāgo nārāyaṇaparāyaṇaḥ || kathayāmāsa saṃkṣepātsarvalokahitodyataḥ || 5 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || śrūyatāmabhidhāsyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ mahat || yasya saṃśravaṇādeva sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || || 6 || aṣṭādaśapurāṇānāṃ sārātsārataraṃ ca yat || tadahaṃ kathayiṣyāmi bhuktimuktiphalapradam || 7 || sukhāsīnaṃ mahādevaṃ jagataḥ kāraṇaṃ param || papraccha ṣaṇmukho bhaktyā sarvalokahitodyataḥ || 8 || || skanda uvāca || || bhagavansarvalokānāṃ duḥkhasaṃsārabheṣajam || kathayasva prasādena sukhopāyaṃ vimuktaye || 9 || || īśvara uvāca || || caturvidhaṃ tu yatpāpaṃ koṭijanmārjitaṃ kalau || jāgare vaiṣṇavaṃ śāstraṃ vācayitvā vyapohati ||7.4.26.10|| vaiṣṇavasya tu śāstrasya yo vaktā jāgare hareḥ || madbhaktaṃ taṃ vijānīyādvipannastvanyathā bhavet || 11 || harijāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ madbhaktena vijānatā || anyathā pāpino jñeyā ye dviṣanti janārddanam || 12 || jāgaraṃ ye ca kurvaṃti gāyaṃti harivāsare || agniṣṭomaphalaṃ teṣāṃ nimiṣārddhena ṣaṇmukha||13|| jāgare paśyatāṃ viṣṇormukhaṃ rātrau muhurmuhuḥ || yeṣāṃ hṛṣyaṃti romāṇi rātrau jāgaraṇe hareḥ || kulāni divi tāvaṃti vasaṃti harisannidhau || 14 || yamasya pathi nirmuktā janāḥ pāpaśatairvṛtāḥ|| gītaśāstravinodena dvādaśījāgarānvitāḥ || 15 || suprabhātā niśā teṣāṃ dhanyāḥ sukṛtino narāḥ || prāṇātyayena muhyaṃti yaiḥ kṛtaṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ ||16|| putriṇaste narā loke dhaninaḥ khyātapauruṣāḥ || yeṣāṃ vaṃśodbhavāḥ putrāḥ kurvaṃti harijāgaram ||17|| iṣṭaṃ makhaiḥ kṛtaṃ dānaṃ dattaṃ piṃḍaṃ gayāśire || snātaṃ nityaṃ prayāge tu yaiḥ kṛtaṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ || 18 || dayitā viṣṇubhaktāśca nityaṃ mama ṣaḍānana || kurvaṃti vāsaraṃ viṣṇoryasmājjāgaraṇaṃ hitam ||19 || śrutvā harṣaṃ na cāpnoti jāgaraṃ na karoti yaḥ || prakaṭīkaroti tannūnaṃ jananyā durviceṣṭitam || 7.4.26.20 || saṃprāpya vāsaraṃ viṣṇorna yeṣāṃ jāgaro hareḥ || vyarthaṃ gataṃ ca tatpuṇyaṃ teṣāṃ varṣaśatodbhavam || 21 || putro vā putraputro vā dauhitro duhitā'pi vā || | kariṣyati kule'smākaṃ kalau jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 22 || pātyamānāḥ prajalpaṃti pitaro yamakiṃkaraiḥ || muktirbhaviṣyatyasmākaṃ narakājjāgare kṛte ||23|| | nānyathā jāyate'smākaṃ muktiryajñaśatairapi || vinā jāgaraṇenaiva naralokātkathaṃcana || tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryaṃ pitṝṇāṃ hitamicchatā || 24 || bhaktirbhāgavatānāṃ ca goviṃdasyāpi kīrtanam || na dehagrahaṇaṃ tasmātpunarloke bhaviṣyati || 25 || jāgaraṃ kurute yaśca saṃgame vijayādine || punarddehaprajananaṃ dagdhaṃ tenā''tmanā svayam || 26 || trispṛśā vāsaraṃ yena kṛtaṃ jāgaraṇānvitam || keśavasya śarīre tu sa līno nātra saṃśayaḥ ||27 || unmīlinī kṛtā yena rātrau jāgaraṇānvitā || prabhavaṃti na pāpāni sthūlasūkṣmāṇi tasya tu || 28 || satālavādyasaṃyuktaṃ saṃgītaṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ || yaḥ kārayati devasya dvādaśyāṃ dānasaṃyutam || 29 || tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi mahābhāgavatasya hi || tilaprasthahasraṃ tu sahiraṇyaṃ dvijātaye || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti hyayane ravisaṃkrame || 7.4.26.30 || hemabhāraśataṃ nityaṃ savatsaṃ kapilāyutam || pre kṣaṇīyapradānena tatphalaṃ prāpnuyātkalau || 31 || yaḥ punarvāsare putra divyairṛṣikṛtaiḥ stavaiḥ || toṣayetpadmanābhaṃ vai vaidikairviṣṇusāmabhiḥ || 32 || ṛgyajuḥsāmasambhūtaivaiṣṇavaiścaiva putraka || saṃskṛtaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ stotrairanyaiśca vividhaistathā || 33 || prītiṃ karoti deveśo dvādaśyāṃ jāgare sthitaḥ || śṛṇu puṇyaṃ samāsena yadgītaṃ brahmaṇā mama || 34 || triḥsaptakṛtvo dharaṇīṃ triguṇīkṛtya ṣaṇmukha || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānnaraḥ || 35 || gavāṃ śatasahasreṇa savatsenāpi yatphalam || tatphalaṃ prāpnuyānmarttyaḥ stotrairyastoṣayeddharim || 36 || vaidikī daśaguṇā prītiryāmenaikena jāgare || evaṃ phalānusāreṇa kāryyaṃ jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 37 || yaḥ punaḥ paṭhate rātrau gītāṃ nāmasahasrakam || dvādaśyāṃ purato viṣṇorveṣṇavānāṃ samīpataḥ || 38 || puṇyaṃ bhāgavataṃ skāṃdapurāṇaṃ dayitaṃ hareḥ || mādhuraṃ bālacaritaṃ gopīnāṃ caritaṃ tathā || 39 || etānpaṭhati rātrau yaḥ pūjayitvā tu keśavam || na vedmyahaṃ phalaṃ vatsa yadi jñāsyati keśavaḥ || 7.4.26.40 || dīpaṃ prajvālayedrātrau yaḥ stavairharijāgare || na cāstaṃ gacchate tasya puṇyaṃ kalpaśatairapi || 41 || maṃjarīsahitaiḥ patraistulasīsambhavairharim || jāgare pūjayedbhaktyā nāsti tasya punarbhavaḥ || 42 || snānaṃ vilepanaṃ pūjā dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca saṃstavam || naivedyaṃ ca satāṃbūlaṃ jāgare dattamakṣayam ||43|| dhyātumicchati ṣaḍvaktraṃ yo māṃ bhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || sa karotu mahābhaktyā dvādaśyāṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ || 44 || vāsare vāsudevasya sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || dehamāśritya tiṣṭhaṃti ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram || 45 || jāgarevāsudevasya mahābhāratakīrtanam || ye kurvaṃti gatiṃ yāṃti yogināṃ te na saṃśayaḥ || 46 || caritaṃ rāmadevasya ye vadhaṃ rāvaṇasya ca || paṭhaṃti jāgare viṣṇoste yāṃti paramāṃ gatima || 47 || adhītya caturo vedānkṛtvā caivārcanaṃ hareḥ || snātvā ca sarvatīrtheṣu jāgare tatphalaṃ hareḥ || 48 || rathānāmayutairyattu sahasrairvaravāraṇaiḥ || lakṣeṇāśvavarāṇāṃ tu tatphalaṃ jāgare hareḥ || 49 || dhānyaśailasahasraistu tulāpuruṣako ṭibhiḥ || yatphalaṃ munibhiḥ proktaṃ tatphalaṃ jāgare hareḥ || 7.4.26.50 || kanyākoṭipradānaṃ ca svarṇabhāraśataṃ tathā || dattaṃ ratnāyutaśataṃ yaiḥ kṛto jāgaro hareḥ || 51 || aṣṭādaśapurāṇaistu paṭhitairyatphalaṃ bhavet || tatphalaṃ śatasāhasraṃ kṛte jāgaraṇe hareḥ || 52 || manvādi paṭhatāṃ śāstraṃ yatphalaṃ hi dvijanmanaḥ || adhikaṃ phalamāpnoti kurvāṇo jāgaraṃ hareḥ || 53 || durbhikṣe cānnadātṝṇāṃ puṃsāṃ bhavati yatphalam || saṃnyāsināṃ sahasraistu yatphalaṃ bhojitaiḥ kalau || phalaṃ tatsamavāpnoti kurvatāṃ jāgaraṃ hareḥ || 54 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśījāgaraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaḍviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 26 || || cha ||
<7.4.27>
|| īśvara uvāca || || sthitvā dvādaśijāgare kratu same duḥkhāpahe puṇyade ramyaṃ bhāgavataṃ śṛṇoti puruṣaḥ kṛtvā hareḥ pūjanam || puṇyaṃ vājimakhasya koṭiguṇitaṃ saṃprāpya bhaktottamaśchittvā pāśasamūha pakṣanicayaṃ prāpnoti kṛṣṇālayam || 1 || hatyāpāpasamūhakoṭinicayairgurvaṃganākoṭibhiḥsteyairlakṣaguṇairgurorvadhakaraiḥ saṃveṣṭito yadyapi || śrutvā bhāgavataṃ chinatti sakalaṃ kṛtvā harerjāgaraṃ muktiṃ yāti narendra nirmalavapurbhittvā ravermaṃḍalam || 2 || ekādaśī dvādaśisaṃpraviṣṭā kṛtā nabhasye śravaṇena yuktā || viśeṣataḥ somasutena saṃgame karoti muktiṃ prapitāmahānām || 3 || yaddīyate dvādaśivāsare śubhe viṣṇuṃ samuddiśya tathā pitṝṇām || paryyāptamiṣṭhaiḥ kratutīrthadānairbhaktyā pradattaṃ khalu merutulyam || 4 || mahānadīṃ prāpya dinaṃ ca viṣṇostoyāṃjaliṃ yastupitṝndadāti || śrāddhaṃ kṛtaṃ tena samāḥ sahasraṃ yacchanti kāmānpitaraḥ sutṛptāḥ ||5|| śaraṇāgatānāṃ paripālanena hyannapradānena śṛṇuṣva putra || ṛṇapradāne dvijadevatānāṃ tadvai phalaṃ jāga raṇen viṣṇoḥ || 6 || yaḥ svarṇadhenuṃ madhunīradhenuṃ kṛṣṇājinaṃ raupyasuvarṇameru || brahmāṃḍadānaṃ pradadāti yāti sa vai phalaṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ || 7 || satyena śaucena damena yatphalaṃ kṣamādayādānabalena ṣaṇmukha || daśāśvamedhairbahudakṣiṇaiśca teṣāṃ phalaṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ || 8 || snānena yatprāpya nadīṃ vīraṣṭhāṃ yatpiṃḍadānena piturgayāyām || yaddhemadānātkurujāṃgale ca tatsyātphalaṃ jāgaraṇena viṣṇoḥ || 9 || hatyāyutānāṃ yadi saṃcitānisteyāni rukmasya tathāmitāni || nihaṃtyanekāni purākṛtāni śrījāgare ye prapaṭhaṃti gītam || 7.4.27.10 || mārgaṃ na te saurapurasya dūtānvanāṃtaraṃ ṣaṇmukha kiṃcidanyat || svapne na paśyaṃti ca te manuṣyā yeṣāṃ gatā jāgaraṇena nidrā || 11 || kāṣāyavastraiśca jaṭābharaiśca pūrtāgnihotraiḥ kimu cānya mantraiḥ || dharmārthakāmavaramokṣakarīṃ ca bhadrāmekāṃ bhajasva kalikālavināśinīṃ ca || 12 || ityuktapūrvaṃ kila nāradena śreyorthabuddhyā vinatāsutāya || kṛṣṇātparaṃ nānyadihāsti daivaṃ vrataṃ tadahnaḥ paramaṃ na kiṃcit || 13 || bhobhoḥ surāḥ śṛṇuta nārada ityavocadbhobhoḥ khagendraṛṣisiddhamunīndrasaṃghāḥ || utkṣipya bāhumatha bhaktajanena coktaṃ naikādaśīvratasamaṃ vratamasti kiṃcit|| 14 || pakṣīndra pāpapuruṣā na hariṃ bhajaṃti tadbhaktiśāstraniratā na kalau bhavaṃti || kurvaṃti mūḍhamanaso daśamīvimiśrāmekādaśīṃ śubhadinaṃ ca parityajaṃti || 15 || ārttaḥ sadā caiva sadā ca rogī pāpī sadā caiva sadā ca duḥkhī || sadā kulaghno'tha sadā ca nārakī viddhaṃ murārerdinamāśrayettu yaḥ || 16 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśījāgaraṇasya sarvatovareṇyatvavarṇanaṃnāma saptaviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 27 || || cha ||
<7.4.28>
|| mārkaṇḍeya uvāca || || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇoryathānyāyaṃ nareśvara || pitṝnyacchati puṇyaṃ ca tataḥ kiṃ kurute yamaḥ || 1 || bhukto vā yadi vā'bhuktaḥ svaccho vā'svaccha eva vā || vimuktiḥ kathitā tatra harijāgaraṇānnṛṇām ||2|| asnāto vā naraḥ snāto jāgare samupasthite || sarvatīrthāpluto jñeyastaṃ dṛṣṭvā divamāvrajet || 3 || śvapacā jāgaraṃ kṛtvā padaṃ nirvāṇamāgatāḥ || kiṃ punarvarṇasaṃbhūtāḥ sadācāraparāstathā || 4 || yuvatīnādamākarṇya yathā nidrā na jāyate || jāgare caivameva syāttatkathānāṃ ca kīrtane || 5 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ || utkallanaṃ manaḥpāpaṃ śodhayedviṣṇu jāgaraḥ || 6 || vimuktiḥ kāmukasyoktā kiṃ punarvīkṣatāṃ harim || 7 || vācikaṃ mānasaṃ pāpaṃ karaṇairyadupārjitam|| anyairnimiṣamātreṇa vyapohati na saṃśayaḥ || 8 || goṣṭhyāṃ samāgatā ye tu teṣāṃ pāpaṃ kutaḥ smṛtam || mātṛpūjā gayāśrāddhaṃ sutīrthagamanaṃ tathā || jāgarasya nṛṇāṃ rājansamāni kavayo viduḥ || 9 || jananīpūjanaṃ bhūpa hyaśvamedhāyutaiḥ samam || pūrṇaṃ varṣaśataṃ bhūpa kuśāgreṇoddhṛtaṃ jalam || 7.4.28.10 || pibanpātre dvijaḥ samyaktīrthe puṣkarasaṃjñite || jāgarasyaiva caitāni kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 11 || kṛtvā kāṃcanasaṃpūrṇāṃ vasudhāṃ vasudhādhipa || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ harijāgare || 12 || nikṛṃtanaṃ karmaṇaśca hyātmanā duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam || vyapohati na saṃdeho yena jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtam || || saṃkṣepataḥ pravakṣyāmi punareva mahīpate || jāgare padmanābhasya yatphalaṃ kavayo viduḥ || 14 || raverbiṃbamidaṃ bhittvā sa yogī harijāgare || prayāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ yogigamyaṃ niraṃjanam || sāṃkhyayogaiḥ suduḥkhena prāpyate yatpadaṃ hareḥ || 15 || nadyo nadā yathā yāṃti sāgare saṃsthitiṃ kramāt || evaṃ jāgaraṇātsarve tatpade yāṃti saṃsthitim || 16 || merumaṃdaramānāni kṛtvā pāpāni vā naraḥ || harijāgaraṇe tāni vyapohati na saṃśayaḥ || 17 || rājyaṃ svargaṃ tathā mokṣaṃ yaccānyadīpsitaṃ nṛṇām || dadāti bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ svagītairjāgare sthitaḥ || 18 || jāgareṇaiva pāpānāṃ śvapacānāṃ mahīpate || tatpadaṃ kavibhiḥ proktaṃ kiṃ punastu dvijanmanām || 19 || japadhyānavihīnasya gāyakasyāpi bhūpate || karmabhraṣṭasya ca prokto mokṣastu harijāgare || 7.4.28.20 || tannāsti triṣu lokeṣu puṇyaṃ puṇyavatāṃ nṛṇām || yattu sādhayate bhūpa jāgare saṃvyavasthitaḥ || 21 || tvayā punaridaṃ kāryyaṃ smarttavyo garuḍadhvajaḥ || ekādaśyāṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kartavyaṃ jāgaraṃ sadā || 22 || jāgare varttamānasya śvapacasya gatirbhavet || kiṃpunarvarṇajātīnāṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahīpate || 23 || ye tu jāgaraṇe nidrāṃ na yāṃti nṛpapuṃgava || na teṣāṃ jananī yāti khedaṃ garbhāvadhāraṇāt || 24 || tasmājjāgaraṇaṃ kāryyaṃ māturjaṭharavarjibhiḥ || bhītermokṣaparairmartyaiḥ sukhaceṣṭābahiṣkṛtaiḥ || 25 || yastu jāgaraṇaṃ rātrau kuryādbhaktisamanvitaḥ || nimiṣenimiṣe rājannaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet || 26 || śayano tthāpanābhyāṃ ca samaṃ puṇyamudāhṛtam || viśeṣo nāsti bhūpāla viṣṇunā kathitaṃ purā || 27 || brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ sthitāḥ śūdrāśca jāgare || pakṣiṇaḥ kṛmikīṭāśca hyaneke caiva jaṃtavaḥ || te gatāḥ paramaṃ sthānaṃ yogigamyaṃ niraṃjanam || 28 || yāni kāni ca pāpāni brahmahatyāsamāni ca || kṛṣṇajāgaraṇe tāni kṣayaṃ yāṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 29 || ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve sarvatīrthasamanvitāḥ || ekato devadevasya jāgaraḥ kṛṣṇavallabhaḥ || na samaṃ hyadhikaḥ proktaḥ kavibhiḥ kṛṣṇajāgaraḥ || 7.4.28.30 || sūryaśakrādayo devā brahmarudrādayo gaṇāḥ || nityameva samāyāṃti jāgare kṛṣṇavallabhe || 31 || gaṃgā sarasvatī revā yamunā ca śatahradā|| caṃdrabhāgā vitastā ca nadyaḥ sarvāśca tatra vai ||32|| sarāṃsi ca hradāścaiva samudrāḥ kṛtsnaśo nṛpa || ekādaśyāṃ nṛpaśreṣṭha gacchaṃti harijāgare || 33 || spṛhaṇīyāstu devebhyo ye narāḥ kṛṣṇajāgare || nṛtyaṃ gītaṃ prakurvaṃti vīṇāvādyaṃ tathaiva ca || 34 || bhaktyā vā'pyathavā'bhaktyā śucirvāpyathavā'śuciḥ || kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ viṣṇormucyate pāpakoṭibhiḥ || 35 || pādayoḥ pāṃsukaṇikā yāvattiṣṭhaṃti bhūtale || tāvadvarṣasahasrāṇi jāgarī vasate divi || 36 || tasmādgṛhaṃ pragantavyaṃ jāgare mādhavasya ca || kalau malavināśāya dvādaśadvādaśīṣu ca || 37 || subahūnyapi pāpāni kṛtvā jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || nirddahenmerutulyāni yugakoṭiśatānyapi || 38 || unmīlinī mahīpāla yaiḥ kṛtā prītisaṃyutaiḥ || kalau jāgaraṇopetā phalaṃ vakṣyāmi tacchṛṇu || 39 || sthitau yugasahasraṃ tu pādenaikena bhūtale || kāśyāṃ ca jāhnavītīre tatphalaṃ labhate naraḥ ||7.4.28.40|| bhavedyugasahasraṃ ca vinā''hāreṇa yatphalam|| unmīlinīṃ samāsādya phalaṃ jāgaraṇe hareḥ || 41 || duṣprāpyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ sthānaṃ makhakoṭiśataiḥ kṛtaiḥ || helayā prāpyate nūnaṃ dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte || 42 || na kurvaṃti vrataṃ viṣṇorjāgareṇa samanvitam || parasvaṃ pāradāryaṃ ca pāpaṃ tānprati gacchati ||43|| ekenaivopavāsena bhāvahīnāstu mānavāḥ || nirddagdhā'khilapāpāste prayāṃti svargakānanam || 44 || yatra bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ yatra jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || śāligrāmaśilā yatra tatra gaccheddhariḥ svayam|| 45 || na puryyaḥ pāvanāḥ sapta kalau vedavaco nahi || yādṛśaṃ vāsaraṃ viṣṇoḥ pāvanaṃ jāgarānvitam|| 46 || saṃprāpte vāsare viṣṇorye na kurvaṃti jāgaram|| majjaṃti narake ghore narānāryyo na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśījāgaṇaraṇamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭāviṃśatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 28 || || dha || || ||
<7.4.29>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || athānyacca pravakṣyāmi guhyādguhyataraṃ mahat || dvārakāyāḥ paraṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ hyuttamottamam || 1 || itihāsaṃ purāvṛttaṃ varṇayiṣye manoharam || tīrthakṣetrādidevānāmṛṣīṇāṃ saṃśayāpaham ||2|| saubhāmyamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā siṃharāśigate gurau || godāvaryyāṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nārado bhagavatpriyaḥ || 3 || gautamasyā'bhito dṛṣṭvā trailokyasaṃbhavāni vai || tīrthāni saritaḥ sarvā vismayaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 4 || tatra kāśī kurukṣetramayodhyā mathurāpurī || māyā kāṃcī hyavaṃtī ca araṇyānyāśramaiḥ saha || 5 || harikṣetraṃ gayā miśrakṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam || prabhāsādīni puṇyāni muktikṣetrāṇyaśeṣataḥ || 6 || jāhnavī yamunā revā tatra puṇyā sarasvatī || sarayūrgaṃḍakī tāpī payoṣṇī saritāṃ varā || 7 || kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī puṇyā kāveryyādyāḥ saridvarāḥ || svarge martye ca pātāle varttamānāḥ satīrthakāḥ || 8 || sthitā godāvarītīre siṃharāśiṃ gate gurau || tathā ca puṣkarādīni saptasiṃdhusarāṃsi ca || 9 || mervādiparvatāḥ puṇyā darśanātpāpanāśanāḥ || tīrtharāja prayāgaśca sarvatīrthasamanvitaḥ || 7.4.29.10 || vedopavedāḥ śāstrāṇi purāṇāni ca sarvaśaḥ || siddhā munigaṇāḥ sarve devarṣipitṛdevatāḥ || 11 || caṃdrādityau suragaṇāḥ siṃhasthe ca bṛhaspatau || sthitā godāvarītīre varṣamekaṃ praharṣitāḥ ||12 || yāni kāni ca puṇyāni tīrthakṣetrāṇi saṃti vai || trailokye tāni sarvāṇi gautamyāṃ vīkṣya vismitāḥ || 13 || devarṣirnāradastatra munibhirmudito'vasat || siṃhasyāṃte(sthāṃte) ca sarvāṇi svasthānagamanāya vai ||14|| āmantrya gautamīṃ devīṃ sthitāni puratastataḥ || sarveṣāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ viprā gautamī khinnamānasā || taptā durjanasaṃsargānnāradaṃ duḥkhitā'bravīt || 15 || || gautamyuvāca || || paśyaitāni sutīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ sarito'malāḥ || sāgarā girayaḥ puṇyā gayātritayameva ca||16|| kṣetrāṇi mokṣadānyaṃga trailokyajāni nārada || devāśca pitaraḥ siddhā ṛṣayo mānavādayaḥ ||17|| tīrtha rāja prayāgaśca sarvatīrthasamanvitaḥ || eteṣāmeva sarveṣāṃ matsaṃsargānmahāmune || viśuddhānāṃ prakāśena rājate bhuvanatrayam ||18|| prayāṃti tāni sarvāṇi svaṃsvaṃ sthānaṃ prati prabho || adhunā'haṃ pariśrāṃtā dahyamānā tvaharniśam ||19|| durjanānāṃ susaṃparkādbhṛśaṃ pāpātmanā prabho || saubhaṇyamadhunā prāptaṃ satsaṃsargeṇa nārada ||7.4.29.20|| prayāṃtyetāni sarvāṇi svasthānaṃ muditāni ca ||21|| etāni matprasādena puṇyāni kathitāni ca || kathaya śramaśāṃtyarthaṃ duḥkhi tā kiṃ karomyaham||22|| || prahlāda uvāca || || godāvaryyā vacaḥ śrutvā bhagavānnārado dvijāḥ || kṣaṇaṃ dhyātvā tu duḥkhārttaḥ prāha saṃśayamānasaḥ ||23|| || || nārada uvāca || || aho atyadbhutaṃ hyetadgautamyā vyasanaṃ mahat || paśyantvasaṃśayaṃ devāstīrthakṣetrasaridvarāḥ||24|| satpuṇyanicayo yasyāṃ yuṣmākaṃ samabhūddhruvam || tasyāḥ pāpāgniśamanaṃ kathaṃ syāditi cintyatām|| 25 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || tadā cintayatāṃ teṣāṃ sarveṣāṃ bhāvitātmanām || gautamo bhagavāṃstatra samāyāto munīśvarāḥ || 26 || dṛṣṭvā tamṛṣayo devā yathocitamapūjayan || jāhnavī yamunā puṇyā narmadā ca sarasvatī || 27 || anyāśca sarvāḥ saritastrailokyamanuvartitāḥ || vārāṇasī kurukṣetra pramukhānyāśramaiḥ saha || yugapattāni sarvāṇi saṃpūjya munimabuvan||28|| tvatprasādena vai trātāḥ samyakchuddhā mahāmune || yadānītā tvayā gaṃgā gautamī bhūtalaṃ prati ||29|| kṛtārthā mānavāḥ sarve sarvapāpavivarjitāḥ || kiṃtu durjanasaṃparkātsaṃtaptā gautamī bhṛśam||7.4.29.30|| kathaṃ pāpairvinirmuktā paramānandasaṃplutā || suprabhā jāyate devī tadgautama vicintyatām || 31 || || prahlāda uvāca || || evamukto munistaistu cintākulitamānasaḥ || nāradasya mukhaṃ vīkṣya prahasangautamo'bravīt || 32 || || gautama uvāca || || sarveṣāṃ kṣetratīrthānāṃ mahāśubhavināśinī || gautamīyaṃ mahābhāgā asyāstāpaḥ kva śāmyati ||33|| nāsti lokatraye tīrthaṃ snātuṃ siṃhagate gurau || yadvai nāyāti gautamyāṃ kṣetraṃ cāpi viśuddhaye || kāśīprayāgamukhyāni rājaṃte yatprasādataḥ || 34 || vadaṃtu munayaḥ sarve kṣetratīrthasamāśritāḥ || śuddhaṃ vicāryaṃ yatkāryyaṃ mayā'smiñjātasaṃkaṭe || 35 || || prahlāda uvāca || || ityuktvā munayaḥ sarve nocuḥ kiñcidvimohitāḥ || tatropāyamavijñāya gautamīṃ gautamo'bravīt || 36 || || gautama uvāca || || ānītāsi mayā devi tapasā''rādhya śaṃkaram|| vadiṣyati sa copāyamityuktvā'cintayattadā ||37|| gautamaḥ śraddhayā bhaktyā gaṃgāmaulimakhaṃḍadhīḥ || tadā'bhūnmahadāścaryaṃ śṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayo'malāḥ || 38 || dhyāyamāne mahādeve gautamena mahātmanā || akasmādabhavadvāṇī harṣayantī jagattrayam || 39 || nādayantī diśaḥ sarvā ābrahmabhuvanaṃ dvijāḥ || arūpalakṣaṇākārā viṣādaśamanī śubhā ||| || 7.4.29.40 || || divyavāṇyuvāca || || aho bata mahāścaryyaṃ sarveṣāṃ sukhade śubhe || prasaṃge'tra mahākṣetre magnā duḥkhārṇave budhāḥ|| 41 || aho he gautamācāryya ṛṣayo nāradādayaḥ || śṛṇvaṃtu tīrthakṣetrāṇi kṛpayā saṃvadāmyaham || 42 || paścimasya samudrasya tīramāśritya vartate || asmācca diśi vāyavyāṃ dvārakākṣetramuttamam || 43 || yatrā''ste gomatī puṇyā sāgareṇa samanvitā || paścimābhimukho yatra mahāviṣṇuḥ sadā sthitaḥ || 44 || anekapāparāśīnāmugrāṇāmapi sarvadā || dāhasthāna samākhyātamindhanānāṃ yathā'nalaḥ || 45 || devaviśvadruho yatra dagdhvā pātakamadbhutam || lokatrayavadhājjātaṃ virājate'rkavatsadā || 46 || tadgamyatāṃ mahābhāgā gomatīmaghadāhakām || godāvarīṃ puraskṛtya kṣetratīrthasamanvitām || 47 || prāpya dvāravatīṃ puṇyāṃ matprasādāddvijottamāḥ || prabhāvāddvārakāyāśca satyamāvirbhaviṣyati || 48 || || prahlāda uvāca || || ityukte sati te sarve harṣa nirbharamānasāḥ || śrutvā sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ jagarjurharināmabhiḥ || 49 || jitaṃ bho jitamasbhābhirdhanyā dhanyatamā vayam || daivādapagato moho jñātaṃ tīrthottamottamam || 7.4.29.50 || tadā sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāraṇyāśramaiḥ saha || vārāṇasīprayāgādi sarāṃsi sindhavo nagāḥ || 51 || gayā ca devakhātāni pitaro devamānavāḥ || śrutvā pramuditā vācaṃ procurjayajayeti ca || 52 || aho sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ sarveṣāṃ no'ghanāśanam || rājānaṃ tīrtharājānaṃ dvārakāṃ śirasā namaḥ|| 93 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || śrutvā sarvottamaṃ kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvottamottamam || devottamottamaṃ devaṃ śrīkṛṣṇaṃ kleśanāśanam ||54|| utkaṇṭhā hyabhavatteṣāṃ tīrthādīnāṃ hyanuttamā || procuranyonyato vācaṃ sarvāṇi yugapattadā || 55 || || ṛṣitīrthadevā ūcuḥ || || kadā drakṣyāmahe puṇyāṃ dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇapālitām || śrīkṛṣṇadevamūrtiṃ ca kṛṣṇavaktraṃ suśobhitam || 56 || kadā nu gomatīsnānamasmākaṃ tu bhaviṣyati || cakratīrthe kadā snātvā kṛṣṇadevasya maṃdiram || drakṣyāmaḥ sumahāpuṇyaṃ muktidvāramapāvṛtam || 57 || durllabho dvārakāvāso durllabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || durllabhaṃ gomatī snānaṃ rukmiṇīdarśanaṃ dvijāḥ || 58 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gautamītīrasthasamastatīrthakṣetrādīnāṃ devavāṇyā dvārakāprabhāvaṃ śrutvā dvārakāgamanotsukatāpūrvaka gomatīvarṇanaṃnāmaikonatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 29 ||
<7.4.30>
|| || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || tadā teṣāṃ sutīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmabhavanmudaḥ || gantuṃ dvāravatīṃ puṇyāṃ sarveṣāmapi sarvaśaḥ || 1 || dvārakāgamane dṛṣṭvā tathā nāradagautamau || mahotsavo mahāṃstatra bhaviṣyati manoharaḥ ||2 || tīrthānāṃ kṛṣṇayātrāyāṃ gantavyamityavo catuḥ || atha te hyṛṣayo devāḥ sarvatīrthasamanvitāḥ || 3 || gautamīṃ tu puraskṛtya yayurdvāravatīṃ mudā || tadā sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāraṇyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || dvārakāgamanaṃ cakruḥ sānandā ṛṣayaḥ surāḥ || 4 || śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā kṛṣṇadarśanalālasāḥ|| vīṇāninādatattvajñaṃ nāradaṃ pathi te' bruvan|| 5 || || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || rāśayaḥ puṇyapuñjānāṃ kṛtā vai tapasāṃ tathā || yajñadānavratānāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ mahatāṃ bhuvi || 6 || saṃprāptastatprasādo'yaṃ yaddrakṣyāmaḥ kuśasthalīm || pṛcchāmahe'dhunā tvāṃ vai yogināṃ paramaṃ gurum || 7 || dvārakāyāstu yātrāyāṃ ko vidhiḥ saṃprakīrtitaḥ || niyamaḥ ko'tra karttavyo varjanīyaṃ ca kiṃ mune || 8 || śrotavyaṃ kīrtitavyaṃ ca smartavyaṃ kiṃ ca vai pathi || utsavāścātra ke proktā dvārakāyāśca tatpathi||| ekaikaśca mahābhāga bhaktānandavivarddhanam || etatsarvaṃ mahābhāga kṛpayā saṃprakīrtyatām || 7.4.30.10 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || kṛtābhyaṃgastu pūrvedyuḥ saṃpūjya śraddhayā harim|| bhojayedvaiṣṇavānviprānsvaśaktyā saṃpraharṣitaḥ || 11 || anujñāto mahāviṣṇoḥ prasādamupayujya vai || śayīta bhuvi suprīto dvārakāṃ kṛṣṇamānasaḥ || 12 || śvobhūte tu śuciḥ snātaḥ saṃpūjya jagadīśvaram || pradakṣiṇaṃ namaskṛtya mahāviṣṇoranujñayā || pṛṣṭvā kulavṛddhāṃśca brāhmaṇānvaiṣṇavānpriyān|| 12 || tatastu tadanujñāto gītavāditrasaṃstavaiḥ || yātrāraṃbhaṃ prakurvīta dvārakāyāṃ praharṣitaḥ || 14 || dvārakāṃ gacchamānastu śānto dāṃtaḥ śuciḥ sadā || brahmacaryamadhaḥ śayyāṃ kurvīta niyatendriyaḥ || 15 || sahasranāmapaṭhanaṃ purāṇapaṭhanaṃ tathā || karttavyaṃ sakṛpaṃ cittaṃ satāṃ śuśrūṣaṇaṃ tathā || 16 || annadānādikaṃ sarvaṃ vibhave sati mānavaḥ || api svalpaṃ svaśaktyā vai kṛtaṃ koṭiguṇaṃ bhavet || 17 || pathi kṛṣṇasya yo bhaktyā grāsamekaṃ prayacchati || dvīpāṃtā tena dattā bhūḥ puṇyasyānto na vidyate || 18 || kiṃ punardvārakākṣetre kṛṣṇasya ca samīpataḥ || kalāvekekasikthe ca rājasūyāyutaṃ phalam|| 19 || gayāśrāddhasahasrāṇi kṛtāni śatasaṃkhyayā || annadānaṃ kṛtaṃ yaistu dvārakāpathi mānavaiḥ || 7.4.30.20 || auṣadhaṃ cānnapānīyaṃ pāduke kaṃbalaṃ tathā|| vāsāṃsyupānahau caiva vittaṃ ca vibhave sati || varjayetsaṃkaraṃ vidvānyūthālāpāṃstathaiva ca || 21 || paranindāṃ ca paiśunyaṃ parasya parivañcanam || parānnaṃ parapākaṃ ca sati vitte tyajedbudhaḥ || 22 || na doṣo hīnavittasya tāvanmātraparigrahe || śrotavyā satkathā viṣṇornāmasaṃkīrttanāmṛtam|| 23 || dvārakāpathigacchadbhiranyonyaṃ bhaktivarddhanam || japtavyaṃ vaidikaṃ jāpyaṃ stotramāgamikaṃ tathā || 24 || yātrāyāṃ yatphalaṃ proktaṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca vai kalau || na śakyate mayā vaktuṃ vadanairyugasaṃkhyayā || 25 || ityetatkathitaṃ sarvaṃ yatpṛṣṭaṃ tu dvijottamāḥ || yatadhvaṃ tatprayatnena viṣṇuprāptau ca satvaram || 26 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || evaṃ te nāradenoktā munayo hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || cakruste sahitāḥ sarve kṛṣṇadevasya tatpathi || 27 || kecicchṛṇvanti tā viṣṇoḥ satkathā lokaviśrutāḥ || yāsāṃ saṃśravaṇādeva bhagavānviśate hṛdi || 28 || kīrtyamānāni nāmāni mahāpuṇyapradāni vai || pāvanāni sadā loke kalau viprā viśeṣataḥ || 29 || purāṇasaṃhitā divyā munibhiḥ parikīrtitāḥ || prakāśayaṃti yā viṣṇormahimānaṃ sumaṃgalam || 7.4.30.30 || sadguṇāḥ karmavīryyāṇi kṛtāni viṣṇunā purā || līlāvatārarūpaistu śṛṇvanti parayā mudā || ||31|| apare vāsudevasya caritāni sumaṃgalāḥ || vadaṃti parayā bhaktyā sānandāḥ sāśrulocanāḥ || 32 || anye smaraṃti deveśamanādinidhanaṃ vibhum|| kecijjapaṃti munayaḥ stotrāṇi parayā mudā || 33 || kecittu śatanāmāni japanti munayaḥ pathi || anye sahasranāmāni lakṣanāma tathā'pare || 34 || kecillaukikagītāni harināmāni harṣitāḥ || utsavaiśca vrajaṃtyanye patākādivibhūṣitāḥ || 35 || gītavāditraghoṣeṇa karatālasvanena ca || || nāsti dhanyatamastasmāttriṣu lokeṣu kaścana || 36 || darśanaṃ yasya saṃjātaṃ vaiṣṇavānāmanuttamam|| tathaiva jāhnavī puṇyā yamunā ca sarasvatī || || 37 || revādyāḥ saritaḥ sarvāḥ pracakrurgītanarttanam || prayāgādīni tīrthāni sāgarāḥ parvatottamāḥ || 38 || vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ puṇyānyanyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || trailokye yāni tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi devanāyakāḥ || cakrurgītaṃ ca nṛtyaṃ ca dvārakāyāśca satpathi || 39 || ekaikasminpade datte dvārakāpathi gacchatām || puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ tatpādarajasaṃkhyayā || 7.4.30.40 || atha te munayaḥ sarve tīrthakṣetrādisaṃyutāḥ || śrīmatkṛṣṇālayaṃ dūrāddadṛśurnāradādayaḥ || 41 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāṃ prati godāvaryāditīrthakṣetradeva maharṣigamanotsavayātrāvarṇanaṃnāma triṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
<7.4.31>
|| prahlāda uvāca||| || divyasvaprabhayā dhvāṃtaṃ bhūtānāṃ nāśayansadā || janayanparamānaṃdaṃ bhaktānāṃ ca bhayāpahaḥ || 1 || patākābhirdhvajasthābhirdvārakājayavarddhanaḥ || divyapuṇyaprakāśena rājate girirāḍiva || 2 || dṛṣṭvā''layaṃ tadā viṣṇostadāyudhavibhūṣitam|| vihāya pāduke cchatraṃ daṇḍavatpatitā bhuvi || 3 || bhūmisaṃluṭhanaṃ teṣāṃ tīrthānāmadbhutaṃ mahat || abhavadvipra śārdūlāḥ kṣetrādīnāṃ ca sarvaśaḥ || 4 || vārāṇasī kurukṣetraṃ prayāgo jāhnavī tathā || yamunā narmadā puṇyā puṇyā prācī sarasvatī || 5 || godāvarī mahāpuṇyā gayā tisrastu maṃgalāḥ || śāligrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ puṇyā cakranadī śubhā || 6 || payoṣṇī tapatī kṛṣṇā kāveryyādyāḥ supuṇyadāḥ || puṣkarādīni tīrthāni sāgarāḥ parvatottamāḥ || 7 || ayodhyā mathurā māyā avaṃtyādyāśca muktidāḥ || śrīraṃgākhyamanaṃtaṃ ca prabhāsaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 8 || puruṣottamaṃ mahākṣetramaraṇyānyādayaḥ śubhāḥ || trailokye varttamānāni sarvatīrthāni sarvaśaḥ || 9 || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇālayaṃ puṇyaṃ muhurmuhuḥ praharṣitāḥ || jaya śabdairnamaḥśabdairgarjaṃto harināmabhiḥ || 7.4.31.10 || ānaṃdāśrūṇi muṃcaṃtaḥ premṇā gadgadayā girā || stuvaṃti munayaḥ sarve tīrthādīni ca sarvaśaḥ || 11 || atha saṃstuvatāṃ teṣāmanyonyaṃ muditātmanām || vīkṣya vaktrāṇi sarveṣāṃ maharṣirnārado'bravīt || 12 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || rāśayaḥ puṇya puṃjānāṃ kṛtā yuṣmābhiruttamāḥ || tajjanmanā sahasraistu yaddṛṣṭaṃ kṛṣṇamaṃdiram || 13 || darśanaṃ kṛṣṇadevasya dvārakāgamane matiḥ || dṛḍhabhaktirmahāviṣṇornālpasya tapasaḥ phalam || 14 || dhanyā vai pūrvajāsteṣāṃ vaṃśajāḥ kṛṣṇadarśanaṃ || sotsavā dvārakāṃ yāṃti paśyaṃti ca haripriyām || 19 || dhanyeyaṃ gautamī gaṃgā gautamo'yaṃ mahātapāḥ || yatprasādena sarveṣāṃ kalyāṇaṃ samupasthitam || 16 || yajñādhyayanadānānāṃ tapovratasamādhinām|| saṃprāptaphalamasmābhiryuṣmābhiḥ sarvatīrthakāḥ || 17 || yūyaṃ sarvāṇi tīrthāni kṣetrāṇi caiva kṛtsnaśaḥ || kṛṣṇājñayā sarvakālaṃ tiṣṭhadhvaṃ sarvadaivataiḥ || || 18 || vasaṃti ye'tra te dhanyā ekāhamapi pāvanāḥ || paśyaṃtu sumahābhāgā godāvaryyatra jāhnavī || 19 || iyaṃ ca śobhate puṇyā dvārakā kṛṣṇa vallabhā || prapaśyaṃtu mahābhāgāstathā vārāṇasīṃ śubhām || 7.4.31.20 || kṣetrāṇi kurumukhyāni paśyaṃtu dvārakāṃ prabhoḥ || tādṛśī mathurā kāśī māyā'dhyodhyā ca rājate || 21 || avantī na ca kāṃcī ca kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam || sūryoparāgakāle'pi kurukṣetraṃ na rājate || 22 || īdṛśaṃ na gayātīrthaṃ yādṛgetatprakāśate || 23 || grahanakṣatratārāṇāṃ yathā sūryyo virājate || sakṣetratīrtharājānāṃ dvārakārko virājate || 24 || || prahlāda uvāca || || niśamya nāradenoktaṃ prahṛṣṭāśca tathā dvijāḥ || kṣetrāṇi sarvatīrthāni puraskṛtya ca gautamam || 25 || vihāya gautamīṃ tatra prayayurhyagratogrataḥ || prahṛṣṭā gautamī tatra praṇamya tvaritā yayau || 26 || gītavādyaiśca nṛtyaiśca patākābhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || prayayuḥ stotrapāṭhaiśca sarve te dvārakāśraye || 27 || sa tīrthānyagrataḥ kṛtvā madhye kṛtvā tu śobhanam || prayāgaṃ tīrtharājaṃ ca prahṛṣṭaṃ kṣetradarśanāt || 28 || tataḥ paścātsaritsnānaṃ cakāra ṛṣisattamaḥ || jāhnavī gautamī revā yamunāprāksarasvatī || 29 || sarayūrgaṃḍakī tāpī payoṣṇī yamunā tathā || kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī gaṃgā kāverī cāghanāśinī || || 7.4.31.30 || maṃdākinī mahāpuṇyā puṇyā bhogavatī nadī || vrajaṃti yugapatsarvāḥ paśyaṃtyo dvārakāṃ purīm || 31 || tataste sāgarāḥ sapta svaiḥsvaistīrthaiḥ samanvitāḥ || tataḥ paścādaraṇyānyāśramaiḥ puṇyaiyutāni ca || 32 || tatastu parvatā ramyā mervādyāstu suśobhanāḥ || nṛtyaṃto gāyamānāśca stavādyaistu maharṣibhiḥ || 33 || tataśca ṛṣayo devāḥ samaṃtāddhṛṣṭamānasāḥ || gāyaṃto nṛtyamānāśca garjaṃto harināmabhiḥ || 34 || vāditraninadairuccairjayaśabdaiḥ praharṣitāḥ || prāptāste gomatītīraṃ sarvayajñasamanvitāḥ || vavaṃdire mahāpuṇyāḥ sarve te hṛṣṭamānasāḥ || 35 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || he bhāgīrathi he reve yamune śṛṇu gautami || śreṣṭhā śrīgomatīdevī vikhyātā bhuvanatraye || 36 || yasyāḥ sakṛjjalasnānaṃ sparddhate brahmavidyayā || tena vai gomatī seyaṃ sarvatīrthottamottamā || brahmajñānena mucyaṃte prayāgamaraṇena vā || snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ mucyate pūrvajaiḥ saha || 37 || || prahlāda uvāca || || niśamya tāni tīrthāni māhātmyaṃ mahadadbhutam || gomatyāḥ śraddhayā snātvā utsavairagrato yayuḥ || 38 || tataḥ kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni saritaḥ sāgarādayaḥ || dadṛśurdvārakāṃ ramyāmāgatā dvāramaṇḍape || 39 || sthitāṃ siṃhāsane divye maṇikāṃcanabhūṣite || sundarāṃ śukla varṇāṃ ca rudrādityasamaprabhām || 7.4.31.40 || divyavastrāṃ sugaṃdhāḍhyāṃ ratnābharaṇabhūṣitām || kirīṭakuṇḍalairdivyaiḥ śobhitāṃ kaṃkaṇādibhiḥ || 41 || varadābhayahastāṃ ca śaṃkhacakragadāyudhām|| śvetātapatraśobhāḍhyāṃ cāmaravyajanādibhiḥ || 42 || saṃstavaiḥ stūyamānāṃ ca gītavādyādiharṣitām || mahāsiṃhāsanasthāṃ tu dṛṣṭvā dvāravatīṃ purīm|| praṇemuryugapatsarve sarvāṇi ca subhaktitaḥ || 43 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye mūrtimatīdvāravatīdarśanavarṇanaṃnāmaikatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 31 || || cha ||
<7.4.32>
|| prahlāda uvāca || nāradastvagrato gatvā praṇamyātha haripriyām || uvāca lalitāṃ vācaṃ harṣayandvārakāṃ purīm || 1 || || śrīnārada uvāca || || paśyapaśya mahābhāge sarve prāptāḥ suśobhane || tīrthakṣetrāṇi devāśca ṛṣayaścaiva kṛtsnaśaḥ || 2 || paśyemaṃ purataḥ prāptaṃ prayāgaṃ tīrthakaiḥ saha || dvārake tava pādābje luṇṭhaṃte śraddhayādbhutam || 3 || idaṃ tu puṣkaraṃ tīrthaṃ namati śraddhayā śubhe || iyaṃ tu gautamī puṇyā sarvatīrthasamāśrayā || 4 || siṃhasthe ca gurau bhadre saṃprāptā saubhagaṃ mahat || kintu durjanasaṃsargāddagdhā pāpāgninā bhṛśam || 5 || tatropāyamabhijñāya ṛṣīṇāṃ śṛṇvatāṃ tadā || śrutvā karṇe mahacchabdaṃ saṃprāpteyaṃ tavāṃtikam || 6 || namaskaroti devi tvāṃ dvārake gautamī śubhā || paśyapaśya mahāpuṇyā iyaṃ bhāgīrathī śubhā || 7 || namaskaroti te pādau saṃhṛṣṭā ca punaḥpunaḥ || paśyemāṃ narmadāṃ ramyāṃ praṇatāṃ tava pādayoḥ || 8 || yamunā candrabhāgeyamiyaṃ prācīsarasvatī || sarayūrgaṃḍakī prāptā gomatī pūrvavāhinī || || 9 || śoṇaḥ sindhunadī caitā anyāśca saritāṃ varāḥ || kṛṣṇā bhīmarathī puṇyā kāveryyādyāḥ saridvarāḥ || 7.4.32.10 || sītācakṣurnadī bhadrā namaṃtyetāḥ padāṃbujam || dvārake tā mahāpuṇyāḥ saptadvīpodbhavāḥ parāḥ||11|| mandākinī mahāpuṇyā bhogavatyādisaṃyutā|| paśyāścaryamidaṃ bhadre vārāṇasī vimuktidā ||12|| bhaktyā te ca padāṃbhojaṃ śirasyādhāya vartate || kurukṣetraṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ namati tvāmaharniśam ||13|| dvārake mathurāṃ paśya praṇatāṃ tava pādayoḥ || ayodhyā'vaṃtikāmāyāstā namaṃti padāṃbujam|| 14 || kāṃcī gayā viśālā ca virajā luṭhati kṣitau || śāligrāmaṃ mahākṣetraṃ patitaṃ tava pādayoḥ|| virājate prabhāsaṃ ca kṣetraṃ ca puruṣottamam || 15 || bhārgavādīni cānyāni sarvakṣetrāṇi sundari || dvārake praṇamaṃti tvāṃ bhaktyotthāya punaḥpunaḥ || || 16 || paśyemānsāgarānsapta patitastāṃba pādayoḥ || paśyāraṇyāni sarvāṇi naimiṣaṃ praṇataṃ puraḥ || 17 || dhanuṣkaṃ ca daśāraṇyaṃ daṃḍakāraṇyamarbudam|| nārāyaṇāśramaṃ paśya dvārake praṇataṃ tathā || 18 || ayaṃ meruśca kailāso mandarādyāḥ sahasraśaḥ || himādrirviṃdhyaśailaśca śrīśailādyāḥ praharṣitāḥ || ete hyṛṣigaṇāḥ sarve namaṃtisma punaḥpunaḥ || 19 || gaṃgādyāḥ sāgarāḥ śailā nṛtyaṃti puratastava || ṛṣidevagaṇāḥ sarve sarve garjaṃti nāmabhiḥ ||
