7.4.32.20 || || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || ityevaṃ vadatastasya dvārakā hṛṣṭamānasā || nṛtyato muditānvīkṣya sarvānpremṇābhinaṃdya ca || uvāca lalitā vācaṃ gautamīṃ spṛśya pāṇinā || 21 || bhāgīrathīprayāgādīnkṣetrādīnatha sarvaśaḥ || dvārakā madhurālāpaiḥ sarvānānaṃdayattadā || 22 || athāścaryamabhūttatra sarvānaṃdavivarddhanam || atha tāvattadā''kāśe gītavādyajayasvanāḥ || 23 || garjanāni supuṇyāni hariśabdaiḥ pṛthakpṛthak || apaśyanvai tadā sarve brahmādyā devanāyakāḥ || 24 || maheśaḥ svagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ bhavānyā samadṛśyata || indrastu tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ yakṣagandharvakinnaraiḥ || 25 || marudbhirlokapālaiścā nṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ || siddhavidyādharāḥ sarve vasvādityāśca sagrahāḥ || 26 || bhṛgvādyāḥ sanakādyāśca nṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ || brahmāṇaṃ ca namaskṛtya saptasvargasthitāḥ surāḥ || 27 || ūcuste dvārakāṃ dṛṣṭvā brahmeśānādayastadā || harṣavihvalitātmāno vīkṣyā'nyonyaṃ ca vismitāḥ || 28 || || || devā ūcuḥ || || seyaṃ vai dvārakā devī vahate yatra gomatī || yatrā''ste bhagavānkṛṣṇaḥ seyaṃ puṇyā virājate || 29 || sarvakṣetrottamā yā ca sarvatīrthottamottamā || svargādapyadhikā bhūmau dvārakeyaṃ prakāśate || 7.4.32.30 || etadvai cakratīrthaṃ ca yacchilā cakra cihnitā || muktidā pāpināṃ loke mlecchadeśe'pi pūjitā || 31 || || prahlāda uvāca || || brahmādīnāgatāndṛṣṭvā vismitā nāradādayaḥ || kṣetrāṇi tīrthamukhyāni vismitāni saridvarāḥ || praṇemuryugapatsarve sarvāḥ sarvāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 32 || brahmādīnāṃ ca tīrthānāṃ dṛṣṭvā yātrāṃ manoharām || dvārakāṃ prati viprendrā vismitā dvārakaukasaḥ || 33 || dṛṣṭvā devagaṇāḥ sarve dvārakāṃ prati maṃdire || gītavādyādi nirghoṣairnṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ || 34 || vadanto jayaśabdāṃśca seyaṃ kṛṣṇapriyeti ca || dṛṣṭvā brahmamaheśānau dvārakāṃ prītamānasau || 35 || tyaktvā ca vāhane śreṣṭhe daṇḍavatpatitau bhuvi || ūcatuśca tadā devau dvārakāṃ prati harṣitau || 36 || śreṣṭhā tvamamba sarvebhyo'smadādibhyo'pi sarvataḥ || yatastvāṃ na tyajetsākṣādbhagavānviṣṇuravyayaḥ || 37 || ato darśaya deveśaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kaṃsavināśanam || yaddarśanānmahāsiddhiḥ sarveṣāṃ ca bhaviṣyati || 38 || || || prahlāda uvāca || || ityuktvā prayayau devī tīrthakṣetrādisaṃyutā || brahmeśānau puraskṛtya hṛṣṭau dṛṣṭvā mahotsavān || 39 || gītavādyapatākaiśca divyopāyanapāṇibhiḥ || prāpyovāca tato devāndvārakā harṣavihvalā || 7.4.32.40 || paśyatāṃ paśyatāṃ devāḥ so'yaṃ vai dvārakeśvaraḥ || prāpya saṃdarśanaṃ yasya muktānāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet || na vidyate sahasreṣu brahmāṃḍeṣu ca yatphalam || 41 || tato devagaṇāḥ sarve kṣetratīrthādisaṃyutāḥ || paścimābhimukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ kleśavināśanam || praṇemuryugapatsarve prahṛṣṭāḥ samupāgatāḥ || 42 || gītavādyapraghoṣaiśca nṛtyamānāḥ samaṃtataḥ || jayaśabdaṃ namaḥśabdaṃ garjaṃto harināmabhiḥ || 43 || brahmā bhavo bhavānī ca sendrā devagaṇā bhuvi || dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaṃ praṇemuste bhaktyotthāya punaḥpunaḥ|| 44 || prayāgādīni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ sarito'malāḥ || ṛṣayo devagaṃdharvāḥ śukādyāḥ sanakādayaḥ || vīkṣya vaktraṃ mahāviṣṇoḥ praṇemuśca muhurmuhuḥ || 45 || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti jaya kṛṣṇeti vādinaḥ || snātvā tu gomatīnīre tīre caiva mahodadheḥ || kamalāsanaḥ saṃhṛṣṭaḥ śrīmatkṛṣṇamapūjayat || 46 || svardhenupayasā snāpya divyaiścā mṛtapaṃcakaiḥ || bhavaścātha bhavānī ca pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 47 || indro devagaṇāḥ sarve yoginaḥ sanakādayaḥ || ṛṣayo nāradādyāśca gaṃgādyāśca saridvarāḥ || 48 || amūlyābharaṇairbhaktyā mahāratnavinirmitaiḥ || divyairmālyairanekaiśca nandanādisamudbhavaiḥ || 49 || priyayā śrītulasyā vai śrīmatkṛṣṇamapūjayan || dhūpairnīrājanairdivyaiḥ karpūraiśca pṛthakpṛthak || 7.4.32.50 || naivedyairvividhaiḥ puṣpairdivyaiḥ karpūravāsitaiḥ || sakarpūraiśca tāṃbūlaiḥ priyaiścopāyanaistathā ||51 mahāmāṃgalikaiḥ sarvaiḥ sudivyairmaṃgalā''rtikaiḥ || saṃpūjyaivaṃ mahāviṣṇuṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kleśavināśanam || prahṛṣṭā nanṛtuḥ sarve gītavādyapraharṣitāḥ ||52 || purataḥ kṛṣṇadevasya hyapsarobhiḥ samanvitāḥ || brahmā ca brahmaputrāśca tataḥ sendrā marudgaṇāḥ || 53 || brahmādīnnṛtyataḥ prekṣya bhagavānkamalekṣaṇaḥ || vārayāmāsa hastena prītaḥ prāha surānvibhuḥ|| 54 || || śrībhagavānuvāca || || bhobho brahmanmaheśāna he bhavāni maheśvari || kṣetrāṇi sarvatīrthāni nāradaḥ sanakādayaḥ || prīto'haṃ bhavatā samyaksarvānkāmānavāpsyatha || 55 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tadābhilaṣitām̐llabdhvā sa rvānkāmavarānatha || bhaktyā paramayā śrīmatkṛṣṇaṃ procuḥ praharṣitāḥ || 56 || || devā ūcuḥ || || prāptaḥ kāmavaro'smābhiḥ sarvataḥ kṛpayā vibho || sapremā tvatpadāṃbhoje bhaktirbhavyā'napāyinī || 57 || || prahlāda uvāca || || tathaiva pūjayāmāsū rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇavallabhām || atha brahmamaheśānau sarveṣāṃ śṛṇva tāmidam || 58 || śraddhayā parayā yuktau dvārakāṃ pratyavocatuḥ || tvaṃ devi sarvatīrthānāṃ kṣetrāṇāmuttamottamā || 59 || parvatānāṃ yathā meruḥ sindhūnāṃ sāgaro yathā || prāṇo yathā śarīrāṇāmindriyāṇāṃ tu vai manaḥ || 7.4.32.60 || tejasvināṃ yathā vahnistattvānāṃ caittya ījyate || yathā graharkṣatārāṇāṃ somo vai jyotiṣāṃ dhuvam || eṣāṃ prakāśapuṃjānāṃ yathā sūryyaḥ prakāśate || 61 || yathā naḥ sarvadevānāṃ mahāviṣṇurayaṃ mahān || tathaiva sarvatīrthānāṃ pūjyeyaṃ dvārakā śubhā || 62 || || prahlāda uvāca || || ityuktvā sarvadevānāṃ kṣetrādīnāṃ ca sattamāḥ || ādhipatye sureśānau dvārakāmabhiṣecatuḥ || 63 || brahmeśānau tathā devāḥ prajeśā ṛṣayo'malāḥ || tīrthānāṃ kṣetrarājānāṃ mahārājatvakāraṇam||64|| cakrurmahābhiṣekaṃ tu dvārakāyāḥ praharṣitāḥ|| vādayanto vicitrāṇi vāditrāṇi mahotsave || 65 || divyaiḥ pañcāmṛtaistoyaiḥ sarvatīrthasamudbhavaiḥ || puṇyaiścākāśagaṃgāyā diggajānāṃ karoddhṛtaiḥ || 66 || atha vāsāṃsi divyāni dattvā cā''camanaṃ tathā || carcitāṃ candanairdivyairdivyābharaṇabhūṣitām || 67 || pūjāṃ ca cakrire puṣpaiścaṃdanādisamudbhavaiḥ || tadā jātā mahādivyā puruṣāḥ pārṣadā hareḥ || 68 || viṣvaksenasunaṃdādyā dyotayanto diśo daśa || jayaśabdaṃ namaḥśabdaṃ vadaṃtaḥ puṣpavarṣiṇaḥ || 69 || gītavāditraghoṣeṇa nṛtyamānāḥ praharṣitāḥ || kirīṭakuṇḍalairhārairvaijayaṃtyā vibhūṣitāḥ || 7.4.32.70 || śyāmāścaturbhujāḥ pītavastramālyairvibhūṣitāḥ || svaprabhā dīpyamānau te dṛṣṭvā brahmamaheśvarau || 71 || nāradaṃ sanakādīṃśca mahābhāgavatānṛṣīn || te'pi tānapi saṃhṛṣṭāḥ praharṣāgatasaṃbhramāḥ ||72|| vavaṃdire tato 'nyo'nyaṃ hṛṣṭā āliṃganādibhiḥ || ṛṣayo'nye ca devāśca praṇemurviṣṇupārṣadān || 73 || atha te samupāgamya dvārakāṃ viṣṇupārṣadāḥ || natvā'tha dvārakānāthaṃ dvārakāṃ vai tathaiva ca || 74 || saṃpūjya śraddhayā bhaktyā niḥśreyasavanodbhavaiḥ || kusumairvividhairdivyaistulasyā tadvanotthayā || 75 || tadutpannaiḥ phalairdivyairdhūpairnīrājanaiḥ prabhum || vividhaiścānnatāṃbūlairdattvā kṛṣṇamatoṣayan || 76 || kṣetratīrthādirājānāṃ mahārājastvamīśvari || iti sarve vadantastu dvārakāṃ ca vavaṃdire || 77 || etasminnaṃtare viprā devadundubhinisvanāḥ || aśrūyaṃta mahāśabdā abhavanpuṣpavṛṣṭayaḥ ||78|| athā''sīnmahadāścaryyaṃ śṛṇvantu ṛṣisattamāḥ || kurukṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ ca savyadakṣiṇapārśvayoḥ || 79 || sthitvā jagṛhaturddivye śvetacchatre manohare || dvārakāyastathā śubhre cāmaravyajane śubhe || 7.4.32.80 || ayodhyā mathurā māyā vārāṇasī jayasvanaiḥ || stuvaṃtyanyāstathānyāni sarvakṣetrāṇi sarvaśaḥ || 81 || tīrthāni saritaḥ sarvā dvārakāyā mukhāṃbujam || paśyataḥ paramānaṃdaṃ lebhire devamānavāḥ || 82 || āhuśca pārṣadā viṣṇordhanyānyetāni sarvaśaḥ || dṛṣṭvā tu dvārakāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvalokaikamaṇḍanām || 83 || vedayajñatapojāpyaiḥ samyagārādhito hariḥ || prasīdedyasya tasya syāddvārakāgamane matiḥ || 84 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye viṣṇupārṣadavarṇitadvārakāmāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 32 ||
<7.4.33>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || śrutvā brahmamaheśānau yaduktaṃ viṣṇupārṣadaiḥ || dvārakāyāstu māhātmyaṃ tadvarṇayitumūcatuḥ|| || 1 || || śrībrahmeśānāvūcatuḥ || || bhobhoḥ kṣetrāṇi tīrthāni sarāṃsi sāgarādayaḥ || prayāgādīni tīrthāni kāśyādyā muktidāyakāḥ || 2 || bhavatāṃ tīrtharājānāṃ mahārājastviyaṃ śubhā || dvārakā sevanīyā vai sthīyatāṃ svecchayā bahiḥ || 3 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || maheśavacanaṃ śrutvā sarveṣāmutsavo'bhavat || pradakṣiṇāṃ tataḥ kṛtvā dvārakāṃ praṇipatya ca || āvāsaṃ cakrire tatra kṣetratīrthāni harṣataḥ || 4 || bhāgīrathī prayāgaṃ ca yamunā ca sarasvatī || sarayūgaṃḍakī puṇyā gomatī pūrvavāhinī || 5 || anyāśca saritaḥ sarvāḥ sindhuśoṇau nadau tathā || paṃcāśatkoṭibhistīrthairdigbhāge hyuttare sthitāḥ || laṃpaṭāḥ kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ paśyato dvārakāṃ muhuḥ || 6 || mandākinī tathā puṇyā nadī bhāgīrathī ca yā || mahānadī narmadā ca śiprā prācī sarasvatī || 7 || cakṣurbhadrā tathā sītā nadyo'nyāḥ pāpanāśinī || vartaṃte pūrvadigbhāge tīrthaiśca ṣaṣṭikoṭibhiḥ || 8 || payoṣṇī tapatī puṇyā vidarbhā ca payasvinī || godāvarī mahāpuṇyā bhīmā kṛṣṇānadī tathā || 9 || kāverīpramukhāḥ puṇyā anyaiścaivāghanāśinīḥ || svatīrthasahitā bhaktyā navanavatikoṭibhiḥ || 7.4.33.10 || sthitā dakṣiṇadigbhāge dvārakāsevanotsukāḥ || krīḍaṃti gomatīnīre tīre ca kṛṣṇasannidhau ||1 1|| saptadvīpeṣu yāḥ saṃti tathā'nyā vai saridvarāḥ || sāgarāśca tathā sapta paścimāyāṃ diśi sthitāḥ ||12|| krīḍaṃti cakratīrthe vai tīrthaiśca śatakoṭibhiḥ|| paśyaṃti ca muhuḥ kṛṣṇaṃ paścimābhimukhaṃ sadā || 13 || vidiśāsu ca sarvāsu tīrthasaṃkhyā na vidyate || puṣkarādīni tīrthāni viśālā virajā gayā || 14 || śataikakoṭibhistīrthairgomatyudadhisaṃgame || varttaṃte kṛṣṇasevāyāṃ sotsavāni dvijottamāḥ || 15 || vārāṇasī pūraiśānyāmavantī pūrvadiksthitā || āgneyyāṃ diśi kāṃtī ca dakṣiṇe mathurā sthitā || 16 || nairṛtyāṃ ca tathā māyā ayodhyā paścime sthitāḥ|| vāyavyāṃ tu kurukṣetraṃ harikṣetraṃ tathottare || 17 || śivakṣetraṃ ca aiśānyāmaiṃdryāṃ ca puruṣottamaḥ || āgneyyāṃ ca bhṛgukṣetraṃ prabhāsaṃ dakṣiṇāśritam||18|| śrīraṃgaṃ nairṛte bhāge lohadaṃḍaṃ tu paścime || nārasiṃhāni vāyavye kokāmukhyaṃ tathottare || 19 || kāmākhyā reṇukādīni śākteyāni ca sarvaśaḥ || kṣetrarājāni sarvāṇi yathāsthāne vasaṃti hi || 7.4.33.20 || uttare caiva saurāṇi gāṇapatyāni kṛtsnaśaḥ || kṣetrāṇyuttarataḥ saṃti rukmiṇyāḥ sannidhau dvijāḥ || 21 || dhenukaṃ naimiṣāraṇyaṃ daṃḍakaṃ saiṃdhavaṃ tathā || daśāraṇyamarbudaṃ ca naranārāyaṇāśramam || 22 || yathādiśaṃ vasaṃti sma dvārakāyāḥ samantataḥ || mervādyāḥ parvatāḥ saumye dvārakāsevanotsukāḥ || 23 || kailāsādyāśca aiśānyāmaindryāṃ himavadādayaḥ || śrīśailādyāśca āgneyyāṃ siṃhādryādyā yame tathā || 24 || nairṛtyāṃ vāmamārgādyā mahendraṛṣabhādayaḥ || anye ca puṇyaśailāśca salokāloka mānasāḥ || dvārakāṃ paritaḥ saṃti paryyupāsaṃti pratyaham || 25 || evaṃ brahmādayo devā ṛṣayaḥ sanakādayaḥ || kṣetratīrthādibhiryuktā anyaiḥ puṇyatamaistathā || 26 || śraddhayā parayā bhaktyā kanyārāśisthite gurau || āyāṃti dvārakāṃ draṣṭuṃ brāhmyādyāśca praharṣitāḥ|| 27 || iti śrīskānde mahā purāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyā saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāmāhātmyavarṇanapūvakaṃ dvārakāyāṃ sarvatīrthakṣetrādikṛtanivāsa varṇanaṃnāma trayastriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 33|| || cha ||
<7.4.34>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || evamadbhutamāhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāṃ munīśvarāḥ || sarveṣāṃ kṣetratīrthānāṃ mahāpāpavidārakm||1|| varṇānāmaśramāṇāṃ ca patitānāṃ viśeṣataḥ| mahāpāpaharaṃ proktaṃ mahāpuṇyavivarddhanaṃ||2|| atyugrapāparāśīnāṃ dāhasthānaṃ yathā smṛtam || dvārakāgamanaṃ viprāḥ kiṃ punardvārakāsthitiḥ || 3 || viśeṣeṇa tu viprendrāḥ kanyārāśisthite gurau || brahmādayopi dṛśyaṃte yatra tīrthaiśca saṃyutāḥ || 4 || prativarṣaṃ prakurvaṃti dvārakāgamanaṃ narāḥ || teṣāṃ pādarajaḥ spṛṣṭvā divaṃ yāṃti ca pāpinaḥ || 5|| gomatī nīrapūtānāṃ kṛṣṇavaktrāvalokinām || darśanātpātakaṃ teṣāṃ yāti janmaśatārjitam || 6 || itihāsena pūrvoktaṃ śrūyatāṃ munipuṅgavāḥ || dilīpavasiṣṭha saṃvāde paramāścaryyavarddhanam || 7 || kāśyāṃ tu vajralepo hi kṣetra ekatra naśyati || yāturdarśanataḥ śrutvā dilīpo vākyamabravīt || 8 || || dilīpa uvāca || || vajralepaśca kāśyāṃ tu ghoro yatra vinaśyati || kṛtsnaśo'tha mahāpuṇyaṃ prāpyaṃ yatra tadasti kim || 9 || na prarohaṃti pāpāni yasminkṣetre dvijottama || tatkṣetraṃ kathyatāṃ puṇyaṃ yatra pāpaṃ praṇaśyati ||7.4.34.10|| || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || āsītkāśyāṃ purā kaścittridaṇḍī mokṣadharmavit || japandaśāśvemedhe tu gāyatrīṃ ca samāhitaḥ|| 11 || tatra kācitsamāyātā yuvatī gajagāminī || tīre saṃsthāpya vāsāṃsi gaṃgāyāḥ śramaśāntaye || praviṣṭā ca jale nagnā jalakrīḍāṃ cakāra ha || 12 || nagnāṃ tāṃ krīḍatīṃ vīkṣya yatirmadanapūritaḥ || daivāgnibhraṃśito mārgātsahasā ca vimohitaḥ || 13 || manasā kāmayāmāsa sā'pi taṃ taruṇaṃ yatim || tayośca saṃgatistatra saṃjātā pāpakarmaṇoḥ || 14 || tayā vimohitaḥ sadyastāmevānusasāra saḥ || tatprītyai cārjayāmāsa dhanamanyāyatastadā || 15 || vārāṇasyāṃ hi na tyaktaścaṃḍālasya pratigrahaḥ || snānahīnaḥ sadā pāpī rātrau cauryyeṇa varttate ||16|| kasmiṃścitsamaye pāpī māṃsārthī tu vanaṃ gataḥ || dadarśa pramadāṃ tatra mātaṃgīṃ madirekṣaṇām || 17 || tasyāḥ prathamatāruṇyaṃ dṛṣṭvā garveṇa pāpmanā || vane'tha nirjane tatra mātaṃgīsaṃgameyivān || 18 || tayā sahānnapānādi kṛtavānpāpamohitaḥ || aśnāti surayā paṃkaṃ gomāṃsaṃ pāpalaṃpaṭaḥ || 19 || tadgṛhe nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ pāpātmā sarvabhakṣakaḥ || vārāṇasīprabhāvena na prāpto narakaṃ tadā || 7.4.34.20 || kiṃ tu tatra kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ vajralepaṃ sudāruṇam || śūdrīsaṃparka pāpena jāto'sau krūrayoniṣu || 21 || vṛko vyāghroragaḥ śvānaḥ śṛgālaḥ sūkaro'bhavat || duraṃtāṃ yātanāṃ prāptaḥ śamaleśaṃ na vindati || 22 || evaṃ janmasahasraistu na tasya pāpakarmaṇaḥ || mātaṃgyā saṃgajaṃ pāpaṃ vyanaśyata yugāyutaiḥ || 23 | tato'sau saptame jātaḥ śaśakaścaiva janmani || tato'sau rākṣaso jātaḥ pāpātmā sarvabhakṣakaḥ || 24 || prāṇino bhakṣayansarvānsaṃprāpto viṃdhyaparvate || asmādanantaraṃ bhāvyaṃ kṛkalāsatvamadbhutam|| || 25 || śūdrīsaṃgajapāpena bhāvyaṃ ca kṛmiyoninā || mātaṃgīsaṃgame proktaṃ phalaṃ hyatijugupsitam || 26 || yugāyutaṃ sahasraistu bhokṣyamāṇaṃ sudāruṇam || atyāścaryyamabhūttatra dilīpa śrūyatāṃ mahat || 27 || ālokitaṃ ca viṃdhyādrau sarveṣāṃ vismayāspadam || dṛṣṭvā dvārāvatīṃ kaścitkṛṣṇavaktraṃ suśobhanam || 28 || gomatīnīrapūtastu viṃdhyaṃ prāptaḥ sa pāṃthikaḥ || mātrāṃ kṛṣṇaprasādasya skandhe kṛtvā praharṣitaḥ || 29 || prayāsyansvagṛhaṃ tatra dadarśa pathi rākṣasam || drutaṃ ca krūrakarmāṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhakṣitumāgatam || 7.4.34.30 || tasya darśanamātreṇa vajralepaḥ sudāruṇaḥ || vārāṇasīsamudbhūto bhasmasādabhavatkṣaṇāt || 31 || janmakoṭiśatenāpi yo na śakyo vyapohitum || tatpāpaparvatānmuktaḥ kṛṣṇapāṃthikadarśanāt || 32 || dagdhe'tha krūrabhāve tu ghanamukto yathā śaśī || reje puṇyaprakāśena kṛṣṇapāṃthikadarśanāt || 33 || tato'bhimukhamabhyetya dvārakāpathikaṃ mudā || nanāma śraddhayā bhūmau taddarśanamahotsavaḥ || 34 || natvā'tha vismitaḥ prāha aho'dya tava darśanāt || gato ghoratamo bhāvaḥ prāptā saṃsiddhiruttamā || 35 || kasmāttvamāgato bhadra prabhāvaḥ kīdṛśastava || vajralepastu kāśyāṃ vai dagdhaste darśanādanu || 36 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || ityevaṃ rākṣasenoktaṃ śrutvā kṛṣṇasya pāṃthikaḥ || vismayaṃ paramāpannaḥ prāha taṃ harṣamānasaḥ || 37 || || pāṃthika uvāca || ||| śrīmaddvāravatīṃ dṛṣṭvā hyāgato'smyatra rākṣasa || vajralepaharo'smākaṃ prabhāvaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanāt|| 38 || gomatyāṃ yaḥ sakṛtsnātvā paśyetkṛṣṇamukhāṃbujam ||| sarvānuddharate pāpādapi trailākyadāhakāt || 39 || || vasiṣṭha uvāca || || ityukto rākṣaso hṛṣṭaḥ śuddhātmā bhaktisaṃyutaḥ || natvā pradakṣiṇaṃ kṛtvā saṃprāpto dvārakāṃ tadā || 7.4.34.40 || gomatyāṃ sa tanuṃ tyaktvā prāpto'sau vaiṣṇavaṃ padam || stūyamānaḥ sureśānairgadharvaiḥ puṣpavṛṣṭibhiḥ || 41 || itthaṃ mahāprabhāvo hi dvārakāyāḥ prakīrttitaḥ || na prarohaṃti pāpāni yasyāḥ pāṃthikadarśanāt || dvārakāyāṃ tu kiṃ vācyaṃ na prarohaṃti pātakam || 42 || ityetatkathitaṃ rājanyatpṛṣṭohaṃ tvayā'nagha || sarvakṣetrottamaṃ kṣetraṃ vajralepavināśanam || 43 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || vasiṣṭhenoditaṃ śrutvā dilīpo hṛṣṭa mānasaḥ || dvārakāṃ kṣetrarājaṃ taṃ jñātvā ca vismayaṃ yayau || 44 || yayau dvāravatīṃ hṛṣṭo devadevasya sādaram || kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā parāṃ siddhiṃ saṃprāpto devamaṃdire || 45 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāpānthadarśana mātrataḥ kāśyāṃ kṛtasya pāpavajralepasya vināśane yativṛttāntavarṇanapūrvakaṃ dilīpakṛtadvārakāyātrāvarṇanaṃnāma catustriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 34 || ||
<7.4.35>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ samaṃtāddaśayojanam || diviṣṭhā yatra paśyaṃti sarvāneva caturbhujān || 1 || aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ dṛṣṭvā nityaṃ caturbhujān || dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarvānnamasyaṃti divaukasaḥ || 2 || aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ sarvaśāstreṣu viśrutam || aho kṣetrasya māhātmyaṃ śṛṇvaṃtu ṛṣayo'malāḥ || 3 || muktiṃ necchaṃti yatrasthāḥ kṛṣṇasevotsukāḥ sadā || yatratyāścaiva pāṣāṇā yatra kvāpi vimuktidāḥ || 4 || api kīṭa pataṃgādyāḥ paśavo'tha sarīsṛpāḥ || vimuktāḥ pāpinaḥ sarve dvārakāyāḥ prasādataḥ || kiṃ punarmānavā nityaṃ dvārakāyāṃ vasaṃti ye || 5 || yā gatiḥ sarvajaṃtūnāṃ dvārakāpuravāsinām || sā gatirdurlabhā nūnaṃ munīnāmūrddhvaretasām || 6 || sarveṣu kṣetratīrtheṣu vasatāṃ varṣakoṭibhiḥ || tatphalaṃ nimiṣāddheṃna dvārakāyāṃ dinedine || 7 || dvārakāyāṃ sthitāḥ sarve narā nāryyaścaturbhujāḥ || dvārakāvāsinaḥ sarvānyaḥ paśyetkaluṣāpahān || satyaṃsatyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ kṛṣṇasyātipriyo bhavet || 8 || dvārakāvāsino ye vai niṃdaṃti puruṣādhamāḥ || kṛṣṇasnehavihīnāste pataṃti duḥkhasāgare || 9 || jayaṃtena bhṛśaṃ trastāḥ śūlāgrāropitāściram || karṣitāstāḍitāste vai mūrcchitāḥ punarutthitāḥ || 7.4.35.10 || trāhitrāhi jayaṃta tvaṃ vadaṃto hi bhayāturāḥ || smaraṃtaḥ pūrvapāpaṃ te jayaṃtena pratāḍitāḥ ||11|| || jayaṃta uvāca || || kiṃ kṛtaṃ maṃdabhāgyairvo yatpāpaṃ ca sudāruṇam || sarvaṃ puṇyaphalaṃ labdhvā dvārakāvāsamuttamam||12|| dvārakāvāsināṃ niṃdā mahāpāpādhikā dhruvam || na nivarteta tatpāpaṃ sā jñeyā parameśvarī || 13 || ataḥ kṛṣṇājñayā sarvānpāpino daṃḍayāmyaham || vaiṣṇavānāṃ ca niṃdāyāḥ phalaṃ bhuktvā sudāruṇam || 14 || tatastu dvārakāyāṃ ca puṇyaṃ janma bhaviṣyati || kṛṣṇaṃ pratoṣya saṃsiddhirbhaviṣyati sudurllabhā || 15 || tasmāttadbhujyatāṃ pāpaṃ jātaṃ vaiṣṇavaniṃdanāt || tatratyānāṃ prabhurnaiva yama īṣṭe maheśvaraḥ || 16 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || tasmāddvāravatīṃ gatvā saṃsevyo devanāyakaḥ || 17 || gomatītīramāśritya dvārakāyāṃ prayacchati || yattu kiṃciddhanaṃ viprāḥ śrūyatāṃ tatphalodayam || 18 || hemabhārasahasraistu ravivāre ravigrahe || kurukṣetre yadāpnoti gajāśvarathadānataḥ || 19 || sahasraguṇitaṃ tasmātsatyaṃsatyaṃ mayoditam || hemamāṣārddhamānena dvārakādānayogataḥ || 7.4.35.20 || patrāṇāṃ caiva puṣpāṇāṃ naivedyasikthasaṃkhyayā || kṛṣṇadevasya pūjāyāmanaṃtaṃ bhavati dvijāḥ || 21 || annadānaṃ tu yaḥ kuryyāddvārakāyāṃ tu tatphalam|| naiva śaknomyahaṃ vaktuṃ brahmā śeṣamaheśvarau || 22|| brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vaiśyaḥ śūdro vā'pyatha vāṃ'tyajaḥ || nārī vā dvārakāyāṃ vai bhaktyā vāsaṃ karoti vai || 23 || kulakoṭiṃ samuddhṛtya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || satyaṃsatyaṃ dvijaśreṣṭhā nānṛtaṃ mama bhāṣitam|| 24|| dvārakāvāsinaṃ dṛṣṭvā spṛṣṭvā caiva viśeṣataḥ || mahāpāpavinirmuktāḥ svargaloke vasaṃti te || 25 || pāṃsuvo dvārakāyā vai vāyunā samudīritāḥ || pāpināṃ muktidāḥ proktāḥ kiṃ punardvārakā bhuvi || 26 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || śrūyatāṃ dvijaśārdūlā mahāmohavināśanam|| dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ gomatīkṛṣṇasannidhau || 27 || kuśāvarttātsamārabhya yāvadvai sāgarāvadhi || yasyāṃ tithau samāyāti siṃhe devapurohitaḥ|| 28 || tasyāṃ hi gomatīsnānaṃ dviṣaṅgodāvarīphalam|| avagāhitā prayatnena siṃhāṃte gautamī sakṛt || 29|| godāvaryyāṃ bhavetpuṇyaṃ vasato varṣasaṃkhyayā || tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti gomatīsevanāddvijāḥ ||7.4.35.30|| gomatyāṃ śraddhayā snānaṃ pūrṇe siṃhasthite gurau || sahasraguṇitaṃ tatsyāddvāravatyāṃ dinedine || 31 || gacchagaccha mahābhāga dvārakāmiti yo vadet || tasyāvalokanādeva mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 32|| dvāraketi ca yo brūyāddvārakābhimukho naraḥ || kṛpayā kṛṣṇadevasya muktibhāgī bhaveddhruvam | 33 || dvārakāṃ gomatīṃ puṇyāṃ rukmiṇīṃ kṛṣṇameva ca|| smaraṃti ye'nvahaṃ bhaktyā dvārakāphalabhāginaḥ || 34 || sahasrayojanasthānāṃ yeṣāṃ syāditi mānasam|| dvāravatyāṃ gamiṣyāmo drakṣyāmo dvārakeśvaram || 35 || sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyaṃte dhanyāste lokapāvanāḥ || kiṃ vācyaṃ dvārakāyātrāṃ ye prakurvaṃti mānavāḥ || kiṃ punardvārakānāthaṃ kṛṣṇaṃ paśyaṃti ye narāḥ || 36 || mitradhrugbrahmahā goghnaḥ paradārāpahārakaḥ || mātṛhā pitṛhā caiva brahmasvāpaharastathā || 37 || ete cānye ca pāpiṣṭhā mahāpāpayutāśca ye || sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyaṃte kṛṣṇadevasya darśanāt ||38 || kiṃ vedaiḥ śraddhayā hīnairvyākhyānairapi kṛtsnaśaḥ || hemabhārasahasraiḥ kiṃ kurukṣetre ravigrahe || 39 || gajāśvarathadānaiḥ kiṃ kiṃ maṃdirapratiṣṭhayā || teṣāṃ pūjādinā samyagiṣṭā pūrtādibhiśca kim || 7.4.35.40 || rājasūyāśvamedhādyaiḥ sarvayajñaiśca kiṃ bhavet || sevanaiḥ kṣetratīrthānāṃ tapobhirvividhaistu kim || 41 || kiṃ mokṣasādhanaiḥ kleśairdhyānayogasamādhibhiḥ || dvārakeśvarakṛṣṇasya darśanaṃ yasya jāyate|| 42|| māhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāstu athavā yaḥ śṛṇoti ca || viśeṣeṇa tu vaiśākhyāṃ jayaṃtyāścaiva jāgare|| 43|| māghyāṃ ca phālgune caitre jyeṣṭhe caiva viśeṣataḥ|| adyāpi dvārakā puṇyā kalāvapi viśeṣataḥ||44|| yasyāṃ satraṃ prapāṃ kṛtvā prāsādaṃ maṃcameva ca|| yatīnāṃ śaraṇaṃ kṛtvā tīre maṃḍapameva ca||45|| vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ jīrṇoddhāramathāpi vā|| mūrtiṃ viṣṇoḥ pratiṣṭhāpya dattvā vā bhogasādhanam || 46|| śrūyatāṃ tatphalaṃ viprāḥ sarvotkṛṣṭaṃ vadāmyaham || saṃprāpya vāṃchitānkāmānkṛṣṇānugrahabhājanam||47|| tejomayeṣu lokeṣu bhuktvā bhogānanukramāt || prāpnoti viṣṇulokaṃ vai naro devanamaskṛtam || 48 || sthāpayeddvārakāyāṃ vai mūrtiṃ dāruśilāmayīm|| trailokyaṃ sthāpitaṃ tena viṣṇoḥ sāyujyatāmiyāt||49|| praroho nāsti pāpasya puṇyasya vṛddhiruttamā || dvārakāyāṃ kathaṃ jātaṃ vailakṣaṇyamidaṃ prabho || kṣetrebhyaḥ sarvatīrthebhya āścaryyaṃ kathayaṃti te || 7.4.35.50 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakānāmamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma pañcaviṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 35 || || cha ||
<7.4.36>
|| sūta uvāca || || prahlādasya vacaḥ śrutvā sthitastatra sabhāsthale || papracchātyutsukamanā balistatkṣetravaibhavam ||1|| prahlādastadvacaḥ śrutvā bhaktibhāvapuraskṛtam || abhinandya ca taṃ premṇā pravaktumupacakrame ||2|| || prahlāda uvāca|| || ekaikasminpade datte purīṃ dvāravatīṃ prati || puṇyaṃ kratusahasrāṇāṃ phalaṃ bhavati dehinām ||3|| ye'pīcchaṃti manovṛttyā gamanaṃ dvārakāṃ prati || teṣāṃ pralīyate pāpaṃ pūrvajanmāyutārjitam ||4|| atyugrāṇyapi pāpāni tāvattiṣṭhaṃti vigrahe || yāvanna gacchate jaṃtuḥ kalau dvāravatīṃ prati ||5|| lobhenā'pyuparodhena daṃbhena kapaṭena vā || cakratīrthe tu yo gacchenna punarviśate bhuvi ||6| hīnavarṇo'pi pāpātmā mṛtaḥ kṛṣṇupurīṃ prati || kali kālakṛtairdoṣairatyugrairapi mānavaḥ || bhaktyā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā na lipyati kadācana ||7|| tāvadvirājate kāśī hyavaṃtī mathurāpurī || yāvanna paśyate jaṃtuḥ purīṃ kṛṣṇena pālitām|| 8 || yeṣāṃ kṛṣṇālaye prāṇā gatā dānavanāyaka || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 9 || durlabho dvārakāvāso durlabhaṃ kṛṣṇadarśanam || durlabhaṃ gomatīsnānaṃ rukmiṇīdarśanaṃ kalau || 7.4.36.10 || nityaṃ kṛṣṇapurīṃ ramyāṃ ye smaraṃti gṛhe sthitāḥ || na teṣāṃ pātakaṃ kiṃciddehamāśritya tiṣṭhati || 11 || keśavārcā gṛhe yasya na tiṣṭhati mahīpate || tasyānnaṃ na ca bhoktavyamabhakṣyeṇa samaṃ smṛtam || 12 || noṣṇatvaṃ dvija rāje vai na śītatvaṃ hutāśane || vaiṣṇavānāṃ na pāpatvamekādaśyupavāsinām || 13 || nāsti nāsti mahābhāgāḥ kalikālasamaṃ yugam || smaraṇātkīrttanādviṣṇoḥ prāpyate paramavyayam || 14 || satyabhāmāpatiryatra yatra puṇyā ca gomatī || narā muktiṃ prayāsyaṃti tatra snātvā kalau yuge || 15 || mādhave śuklapakṣe tu trispṛśāṃ dvādaśīṃ yadi || labhate dvārakāyāṃ tu nāsti dhanyatarastataḥ || 16 || trispṛśāṃ dvādaśīṃ prāpya gatvā kṛṣṇapurīṃ naraḥ || yaḥ karoti harerbhaktyā so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet|| 17 || naṃdāyāṃ tu jayāyāṃ vai bhadrā caiva bhavedyadi || upavāsārcane gīte durllabhā kṛṣṇasannidhau ||18|| udayaikādaśī svalpā aṃte caiva trayodaśī || saṃpūrṇā dvādaśī madhye trispṛśā ca hareḥ priyā || 19 || ekena copavāsena upavāsā'yutaṃ phalam || jāgare śatasāhasraṃ nṛtye koṭiguṇaṃ kalau || 7.4.36.20 || tatphalaṃ labhate marttyo dvārakāyāṃ dinedine || gṛheṣu vasatāmetatkiṃ punaḥ kṛṣṇasaṃnidhau || || 21 || vāṅmanaḥkāyajairdoṣairhatā ye pāpabuddhayaḥ || dvāravatyāṃ vimucyaṃte dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇamukhaṃ śubham || 22 || daityeśvara narāḥ ślāghyā dvāravatyāṃ gatāśca ye || 23 || durllabhānīha tīrthāni durlabhāḥ parvatottamāḥ || durllabhā vaiṣṇavā loke dvārakāvasatiḥ kalau || 24 || gavāṃ koṭisahasrāṇi ratnako ṭiśatāni ca || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti tatphalaṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || 25 || yasyāḥ sīmāṃ praviṣṭasya brahmahatyādipātakam || naśyate darśanādeva tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate || 26 || cakrāṃkitā śilā yatra gomatyudadhisaṃgame || yacchati pūjitā mokṣaṃ tāṃ purīṃ ko na sevate || 27 || siṃhasthe ca gurau viprā godāvaryyāṃ tu yatphalam|| tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || 28 || dvārakā'vasthitaṃ toyaṃ ṣaṇmāsaṃ pibate naraḥ || tasya cakrāṃkito deho bhavate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 29 || manvantarasahasrāṇi kāśīvāsena yatphalam || tatphalaṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca vasataḥ paṃcabhirddinaiḥ || 7.4.36.30 || tāvanmṛtaprajā nārī durbhagā daityapuṃgava || yāvanna paśyate bhaktyā kalau kṛṣṇapriyāṃ purīm || 31 || rukmiṇīṃ satyabhāmāṃ ca devīṃ jāṃbavatīṃ tathā || mitraviṃdāṃ ca kāliṃdīṃ bhadrāṃ nāgnajitīṃ tathā || 32 || saṃpūjya lakṣmaṇāṃ tatra vaiṣṇavīḥ kṛṣṇavallabhāḥ || etāḥ saṃpūjya vidhivacchreṣṭhaputraśca labhyate || 33 || tāvadbhavabhayaṃ puṃsāṃ gṛhabhaṃgaśca mūrkhatā || yāvanna paśyate bhaktyā kalau kṛṣṇapurīṃ naraḥ || 34 || na sarvatra mahāpuṇyaṃ saṃgame saritāṃpateḥ || jāhnavīsaṃgamānmuktirgomatīnīrasaṃgamāt || saṃparke gomatīnīrapūto'haṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || 35 || gomatīnīrasaṃpṛktaṃ ye māṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ || na teṣāṃ punarāvṛttirityāha saritāṃpatiḥ || 36 || dvārakāṃ gacchamānasya vipattiśca bhavedyadi || na tasya punarāvṛttiḥ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 37 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakādarśanagomatīsaritsnānavidhimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṭtriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 36|| || cha ||
<7.4.37>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti śvapaco jāgaranniśi || japedapi kalau nityaṃ kṛṣṇarūpī bhaveddhi saḥ || 1 || kṛṣṇakṛṣṇeti kṛṣṇeti kalau vadatyaharniśam || nityaṃ yajñāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ tīrthakoṭisamudbhavam || 2 || saṃpūrṇaikādaśī bhūtvā dvādaśyāṃ varddhate yadi || unmīlinīti vikhyātā tithīnāmuttamā tithiḥ ||3|| vaṃjulīvāsare ye vai rātrau kurvaṃti jāgaram|| yajñāyutāyutaṃ puṇyaṃ muhūrtārddhena jāyate||4|| saṃpūrṇā dvādaśī bhūtvā varddhate cāpare dine || trayodaśyāṃ muniśreṣṭhā vaṃjulī durllabhā kalau || 5 || unmīlinīmanuprāpya ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram || nimiṣārddhena tatpuṇyaṃ gavāṃ koṭiphalapradam || 6|| saṃpūrṇaikādaśī bhūtvā pratya'haṃ varddhate yadi || darśaśca paurṇamāsī ca pakṣavṛddhistathocyate ||7|| pakṣavṛddhikarīṃ prāpya ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram || nimiṣārddhārddhamātreṇa gavāṃ koṭiphalapradam || 8 || || śrīprahlāda uvāca || || cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā mucyate sarva kilbiṣaiḥ || sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ dāhapralayavarjitam || 9 || cakraṃ prakṣālitaṃ yatra kṛṣṇena svayameva hi || tena vai cakratīrthaṃ hi puṇyaṃ ca paramaṃ hareḥ || bhavaṃti tatra pāṣāṇāścakrāṃkā muktidāyakāḥ || 7.4.37.10 || tatraiva yadi labhyaṃte cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ saha || dvādaśātmā sa vijñeyo mokṣadaḥ parikīrtitaḥ || || 11 || ekacakreṇa pāṣāṇo dvāravatyāṃ suśobhanaḥ || sudarśanābhidheyosau mokṣaikaphaladāyakaḥ ||12|| lakṣmīnārāyaṇau dvau tau bhuktimuktiphalapradau || tribhiścaivācyutaṃ devaṃ sadendrapadadāyakam || 13 || bhūtido vighnahaṃtā ca catuścakro janārddanaḥ || pañcabhirvāsudevastu janmamṛtyubhayāpahaḥ || 14 || pradyumnaḥ ṣaḍbhirevāsau lakṣmīṃ kāṃtiṃ dadāti ca || saptabhirbaladevastu gotrakīrtivivarddhanaḥ || 15 || vāṃchitaṃ cāṣṭabhirbhaktyā dadāti puruṣottamaḥ || sarvaṃ dadyānnavavyūho durllabho yaḥ surottamaiḥ || 16 || rājyaprado daśabhistu daśāvatāra eva ca || ekādaśabhiraiśvaryyamaniruddhaḥ prayacchati || 17 || nirvāṇaṃ dvādaśātmā tu cakrairdvādaśabhiḥ smṛtam || ata ūrdhvamanaṃto'sau saukhyamokṣapradāyakaḥ || 18 || ye kecittatra pāṣāṇāḥ kṛṣṇacakreṇa mudritāḥ|| teṣāṃ sparśanamātreṇa mucyate sarvakilbiṣaiḥ || 19 || brahmahatyādikaṃ pāpaṃ manovākkāyakarmajam || tatsarvaṃ vilayaṃ yāti cakrāṃkitaprapūjanāt ||7.4.37.20|| mlecchadeśe śubhe vā'pi cakrāṃko yatra tiṣṭhati || yojanāni daśa dve ca mama kṣetraṃ ca sundari || 21 || mṛtyukāle ca saṃprāpte hṛdaye yastu dhārayet || cakrākaṃ pāpadalanaṃ sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 22 || gomatīsaṃgame snātvā bhṛgutīrthe tathaiva ca || na māturvasate kukṣau yadyapi syātsa pātakī || || 23 || tāmasaṃ rājasaṃ vāpi yatkṛtaṃ viṣṇupūjanam || tatsāttvikatvamabhyeti nimnagāṃbho yathārṇave || 24 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśīti sāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakākṣetrasthasudarśanapramukhānantāntacakracihnāṃkita pāṣāṇamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakatatpūjanaphalādikathanaṃnāma saptatriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ ||37|| |
<7.4.38>
||śrīprahlāda uvāca || || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ śṛṇu pautra mayoditam || śṛṇvato gadataścāpi muktiḥ kṛṣṇādbhaveddhruvam || 1 || putreṇa lokāñjayati pautreṇānantyamaśnute || atha putrasya pautreṇa nākamevādhirohati||2|| yasya putraḥ śucirdakṣaḥ pūrve vayasi dhārmikaḥ || viṣṇubhaktiṃ ca kurute taṃ putraṃ kavayo viduḥ || 3 || hemaśṛṃgaṃ raupyakhuraṃ savatsaṃ kāṃsyadohanam|| savastraṃ kapilānāṃ tu sahasraṃ ca dinedine || 4 || dattvā yatphalamāpnoti brāhmaṇe vedapārage || tatphalaṃ snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ madhubhiddine || 5 || yastvekaṃ bhojayedvipraṃ dvārakāyāṃ ca saṃsthitam || subhikṣe bho dvijaśreṣṭhāḥ phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ bhavet||6|| phalaṃ lakṣaguṇaṃ proktaṃ durbhikṣe kṛṣṇasannidhau|| evaṃ dharmānusāreṇa dayādbhikṣāṃ tu bhikṣuke || 7 || api naḥ sa kule kaścidbhaviṣyati narottamaḥ || yo yatīno kalau prāpte pitṝnuddiśya dāsyati || 8 || dvārakāyāṃ viśe ṣeṇa satkṛtya kṛṣṇasannidhau || annadānaṃ yatīnāṃ tu kaupīnācchādanāni ca || 9 || nātmanaḥ kratubhiḥ sviṣṭairnāsti tīrthaiḥ prayojanam|| yatra vā tatra vā kāryyaṃ yatīnāṃ prīṇanaṃ sadā || 7.4.38.10 || śvapacādayo'pi te dhanyā ye gatā dvārakāṃ purīm || prāpya bhāgavatānye vai pitṝnuddiśya putrakāḥ || || 11 || bhaktyā saṃpūjayiṣyaṃti vastrairdānaiśca bhūribhiḥ || 12 || gayāpiṃḍena nāsmākaṃ tṛptirbhavati tādṛśī || yādṛśī viṣṇubhaktānāṃ satkāreṇopa jāyate || 13 || vaiśākhe ye kariṣyaṃti dvādaśīṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || kṛṣṇaṃ saṃpūjayantaśca rātrau kurvaṃti jāgaram ||14|| māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ tu dvārakāsaṃbhavaṃ śubham || kṛṣṇasya bālacaritaṃ bālakṛṣṇādidarśanam || 15 || krīḍanaṃ gokulasyaiva krīḍā gopījanasya ca || kṛṣṇāvatārakarmāṇi śrotavyāni punaḥpunaḥ || 16 || rukmaśṛṃgīṃ raupyakhurīṃ muktālāṃgūlabhūṣitām|| savatsāṃ brāhmaṇe dattvā homārthaṃ cāhitāgnaye || 17 || nimiṣasparśanāṃśena phalaṃ kṛṣṇasya jāgare || yatkiṃcitkurute pāpaṃ koṭijanmasu mānavaḥ || kṛṣṇasya jāgare rātrau dahate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 18 || paṭhedbhāgavataṃ rātrau purāṇaṃ dayitaṃ hareḥ || yāvatsūryyakṛtā''loko yāvaccandrakṛtā niśā || 19 || yāvatsasāgarā pṛthvī yāvacca kulaparvatāḥ || tāvatkālaṃ vasetsvarge nānyathā mama bhāṣitam || 7.4.38.20 || āsphoṭayaṃti pitaraḥ praharṣaṃti pitāmahāḥ || evaṃ taṃ svasutaṃ dṛṣṭvā śṛṇvānaṃ kṛṣṇasaṃbhavam || 21 || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yatra no jāgare paṭhet || tanmlecchasadṛśaṃ sthānamapavitraṃ parityajet || 22 || śāligrāmaśilā naiva yatra bhāgavatā na hi || tyajettīrthaṃ mahāpuṇyaṃ puṇyamāyatanaṃ tyajet || 23 || tyajedguhyaṃ tathā'raṇyaṃ yatra na dvādaśīvratam || 24 || sudeśo'pi bhavenniṃdyo yatra no vaiṣṇavā vratam|| kudeśo'pi bhavetpuṇyo yatra bhāgavatāḥ kalau || 25 || saṃkīrṇayonayaḥ pūtā ye bhaktā madhusūdane || mlecchatulyāḥ kulīnāste ye na bhaktā janārdane|| 26 || rathārūḍhaṃ prakurvaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ madhumādhave || muktiṃ prayāṃti te sarve kulakoṭisamanvitāḥ || 27 || devakīnandanasyārthe rathaṃ kārāpayanti ye || kalpāṃtaṃ viṣṇuloke te vasanti pitṛbhiḥ saha || 28 || dvārakāyāstu māhātmyaṃ śrāvayedyaḥ kalau nṛṇām|| bhāvamutpādayedyo vai labhetkratuśataṃphalam || 29 || yo nārcayati pāpiṣṭho devamanyatra gacchati || koṭijanmārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ harate rukmiṇīpatiḥ || 7.4.38.30 || śaṃkhoddhārasamudbhūtāṃ nityaṃ dehe bibhartti hi || mṛttikāṃ daityarājendra śṛṇu vakṣyāmi yatphalam || 31 || yo dadāti yatīnāṃ ca vaiṣṇavānāṃ prayacchati || svarṇabhāraśataṃ puṇḍraṃ nityaṃ prāpnoti mānavaḥ || 32 || gṛhe yasya sadā tiṣṭhecchaṃkhoddhārasya mṛttikā || nitya kriyākṛtaṃpuṇyaṃ labhetkoṭiguṇaṃ bale || 33 || yasya puṇḍraṃ lalāṭe tu gopīcaṃdanasaṃjñakam || na jahāti gṛhaṃ tasya lakṣmīḥ kṛṣṇapriyā dvijāḥ || 34 || na graho bādhate tasya norago na ca rākṣasaḥ || piśācā na ca kūṣmāṃḍā na ca pretā na jaṃbhakāḥ || 35 || nāgnicaurabhayaṃ tasya darīṇāṃ caiva bandhanam || vidyudulkābhayaṃ caiva na cotpātasamudbhavam || 36 || nāriṣṭaṃ nāpaśakunaṃ durnimittādikaṃ ca yat || satkṛte viṣṇubhakte ca śāligrāmaśilārcane || 37 || pīte pādodake viprā naivedyasyāpi bhakṣaṇe || tulasīsannidhau viṣṇorvilayāvasare kṛte || 38 || purā devena kathitaṃ śṛṇu pātraṃ vadāmyaham || priyā bhāgavatā yeṣāṃ teṣāṃ dāso'smyahaṃ sadā || 39|| vihāya mathurāṃ kāśīmavantīṃ sarvapāpahām || māyāṃ kāṃcīmayodhyāṃ ca saṃprāpte ca kalau yuge || || 7.4.38.40 || vasāmyahaṃ dvārakāyāṃ sarvasenāsamāvṛtaḥ || tīrthavratairyajñadānai rudrādyairmunicāraṇaiḥ || 41 || śraddhātyāgena bhaktyā vā yastoṣayitumicchati || gatvā dvāravatīṃ ramyāṃ draṣṭavyo'haṃ kalau yuge || 42 || trailokye yāni tīrthāni mayā śuddhāni bhūriśaḥ ||| vinyastāni ca gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe'tipāvane || 43 || dinenaikena gomatyāṃ cakratīrthe kalau yuge || trailokyasaṃbhavaistīrthaiḥ snāto bhavati mānavaḥ || 44 || koṭipāpavinirmukto matsamaṃ vasate naraḥ || mama loke na saṃdehaḥ kulakoṭisamanvitaḥ || 45 || nāparādhakṛtaiḥ pāpairliptaḥ syādu tkaṭaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || śatajanmāyutānīha lakṣmīrna cyavate gṛhāt || 46 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye gomatītīragata dvārakācakratīrthayorjāgarādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāṣṭātriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 38 || || cha ||
<7.4.39>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || jayā ca vijayā caiva jayaṃtī pāpanāśinī || unmīlinī vaṃjulī ca trispṛśā pakṣavarddhinī || 1 || puṇyaṃ sarvapurāṇānāṃ te labhaṃte dinedine || pakvānnaṃ ye prakurvaṃti havirddhānyasamudbhavam || 2 || jāgare padmanābhasya ghṛtenaiva supācitam || vartidvayasamāyuktaṃ dīpaṃ ghṛtasamanvitam || 3 || yaḥ kuryyājjāgare viṣṇoḥ śāligrāmaśilāgrataḥ || śālagrāmaśilāgre tu ye prakurvaṃti jāgaram || 4 || kurvaṃti nṛtyavādye ca lokānāṃ raṃjanāya ca || saṃchādayaṃti kusumaiḥ śāligrāmaśilāṃ ca ye || 5 || cakrāṃkitāṃ viśeṣeṇa pratimāṃ vaiṣṇavīṃ dvijāḥ || caṃdanaṃ ca sakarpūraṃ kṛṣṇāgurusamanvitam || 6 || yuktaṃ mṛgamadenāpi yaḥ karoti vilepanam || dvādaśyāṃ devadevasya rātrau jāgaraṇe sadā || 7 || tasya puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi saṃkṣepeṇa ca vo'grataḥ || tatphalaṃ koṭitīrthe tu ujjayinyāṃ mahālaye || 8 || vārāṇasyāṃ kurukṣetre mathurāyāṃ tripuṣkare || ayodhyāyāṃ prayāge ca tīrthe sāgarasaṃgame || 9 || sarvapuṇyeṣu tīrtheṣu devatāyataneṣu ca || kṛtairyajñāyutaistatra vratadānaiśca puṣkalaiḥ || 7.4.39.10 || vedairadhītairyatpuṇyaṃ purāṇaiścāvagāhitaiḥ || tapobhiścaritaiḥ puṇyaṃ samyagāśrama pālanaiḥ || 11 || yatphalaṃ munibhiḥ proktaṃ vedavyāsena putraka || tatphalaṃ jāgare viṣṇoḥ pakṣayoḥ śuklakṛṣṇayoḥ || 12 || haimavatyai purā proktaṃ kailāse śūlapāṇinā || nāradāya purā proktaṃ brahmaṇā matsamīpataḥ || 13 || aruṇena vajrahastāya kathitaṃ pṛcchate purā || dvādaśījāgarasyoktaṃ phalaṃ viprā mayā ca vaḥ|| tatkurudhvaṃ dvijā yūyaṃ jāgaraṃ viṣṇuvāsare || 14 || || sūta uvāca || || ityuktvā brāhmaṇānprāha baliṃ pautraṃ svakaṃ tataḥ || tvamapi śraddhayā pautra kuru jāgaraṇaṃ hareḥ || 15 || dvārakā manasā dhyātā pāpaṃ varṣaśatānvitam || kīrtanācchatajanmotthaṃ dahate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 16 || pāpaṃ janmasahasrotthaṃ padamātreṇa gacchatām || dvārakā harate nūnaṃ muktiḥ kṛṣṇasya darśanāt || 17 || na śaknoti yadā gaṃtuṃ dvārakāṃ caiva mānavaḥ || māhātmyaṃ paṭhanīyaṃ tu dvārakāsaṃbhavaṃ gṛhe || 18 || dātavyaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu śrotavyaṃ bhaktibhāvataḥ || dvādaśyāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa paṭhanīyaṃ tu jāgare || 19 || dvārakā saṃbhavaṃ puṇyaṃ sa saṃprāpnoti mānavaḥ || prasādādvāsudevasya satyaṃsatyaṃ ca bhāṣitam || 7.4.39.20 || gṛhe saṃtiṣṭhate nityaṃ mathurā dvārakā tathā || avaṃtī ca tathā māyā prayāgaṃ kurujāṃgalam || 21 || tripuṣkaraṃ naimiṣaṃ ca gaṃgādvāraṃ ca saukaram || caṃdreśaṃ caiva kedāraṃ tathā rudramahālayam || 22 || vastrāpathaṃ mahādevaṃ mahākālaṃ tathaiva ca || bhūteśvaraṃ bhasmagātraṃ somanāthamumāpatim|| 23 || koṭiliṃgaṃ trinetraṃ ca devaṃ bhṛguvanecaram || dīpeśvaraṃ mahānādaṃ devaṃ caivācaleśvaram || 24 || brahmādayaḥ suragaṇā gṛhe tiṣṭhaṃti sarvadā || pitaro nāgagaṃdharvā munayaḥ siddhacāraṇāḥ || 25 || tīrthāni yāni kāni syuraśvamedhādayo makhāḥ || kṛṣṇajanmāṣṭamīṃ pautra yaḥ karoti viśeṣataḥ || 26 || yathā bhāgavataṃ śāstraṃ tathā bhāgavato naraḥ || ubhayoraṃtaraṃ nāsti haraharyostathaiva ca || 27 || nīlīkṣetraṃ tu yo yāti mūlakaṃ bhakṣayettu yaḥ || naivāsti narakoddhāraṃ kalpakoṭiśatairapi || 28 || nīlīkarma tu yaḥ kuryyādbrāhmaṇo lobhamohitaḥ || nāpnoti sukṛtaṃ kiṃcitkuryyādvā rasavikrayam || 29 || prasīdati na viśvātmā vaiṣṇave cāpamānite || aśvatthaṃ chedayedyo vai ekaikasmiṃśca parvaṇi || 7.4.39.30 || manvaṃtarāṇi tāvaṃti raurave vasatirbhavet || ariṣṭakāṣṭhairdaityeṃdra kāryyaṃ yaḥ kurute kvacit || na pūjāmarghadānaṃ ca tasya gṛhṇāti bhāskaraḥ || 31 || chedāpakasya cārke tu cchedakasya ca daityaja || śataṃ janmāni dāridyaṃ jāyate ca sarogatā || 32 || ropayetpālayedyo vai sūryyavṛkṣaṃ narottamaḥ || saptakalpaṃ vasetso'tra samīpe bhāskarasya hi || 33 || ropitairdevavṛkṣaistu yatphalaṃ lakṣakoṭibhiḥ || nyagrodhavṛkṣeṇaikena ropitena phalaṃ hi tat || 34 || dhātrīdrume'pyevameva phalaṃ bhavati ropite || tulasīropaṇe caiva adhikaṃ cāpi suvrata || amaratvaṃ ca te yāṃti nātra kāryyā vicāraṇā || 35 || dvārakāṃ kalikāle tu prātarutthāya kīrtayet || sa sarvapāpanirmuktaḥ svargaṃ yāti na saṃśayaḥ || 36 || rohiṇīsahitā ye na dvādaśī samupoṣitā || mahāpātakasaṃyuktaḥ kalpāṃte nākamāpnuyāt || 37 || vāsaraḥ ko vinā sūryyaṃ vinā somena kā niśā || vinā vṛkṣeṇa ko grāmo dvādaśī kiṃ vrataṃ vinā || 38 || gṛhaṃ ca narakaṃ tasya yamadaṇḍaṃ dvitīyakam || na yatra paṭhate nityaṃ viṣṇornāmasahasrakam || 39 || narakaṃ ca bhavettasya dvitīyaṃ yamaśāsanam || naiva bhāgavataṃ yatra purāṇaṃ gīyate kalau || andhakūpeṣu kṣipyaṃte jvaliteṣu hutāśane || 7.4.39.40 || dviṣaṃti ye bhāgavataṃ na kurvaṃti dinaṃ hareḥ || yamadūtaiśca nīyante tathā bhūmau bhavaṃti te || 41 || vācyamānaṃ na śṛṇvaṃti hareścaritamuttamam || karapatraiśca pīḍyaṃte sutīvrairyama śāsanāt|| 42 || nindāṃ kurvaṃti ye pāpā vaiṣṇavānāṃ mahātmanām || teṣāṃ nirayapātastu yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 43 || gokoṭitīrthādadhikaṃ snānaṃ tatrādhikaṃ bhavet || ye paśyaṃti mahāpuṇyā gopīcaṃdanamṛttikām|| gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 44 || vaiṣṇavānāṃ prayacchaṃti gopīcaṃ danamṛttikām || yeṣāṃ lalāṭe tilakaḥ gopīcaṃdanasaṃbhavam|| 45 || gopīcaṃdanapuṃḍreṇa dvādaśyāṃ jāgare kṛte || viṣṇornāmasahasrasya pāṭhena muktimāpnuyāt || 46 || ye nityaṃ prātarutthāya vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu kīrtanam|| gomatīsmaraṇaṃ kuryuḥ kṛṣṇatulyā na saṃśayaḥ || 47 || ye nityaṃ prātarutthāya dvāraketi vadaṃti ca || tīrthakoṭibhavaṃ puṇyaṃ labhaṃte ca dinedine || 48 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvādaśīvratādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonacatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 39 || || cha ||
<7.4.40>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || svanāmāṃkita patraistu śrīpatiṃ yo'rcayeta vai || saptalokānanuprāpya saptadvīpādhipo bhavet|| 1 || mākāntavṛkṣapatraistu yo'rcayeta sadā harim || puṇyaṃ bhavati tasyeha vājimedhāyutaṃ kalau || 2 || lakṣmīṃ sarasvatīṃ devīṃ sāvitrīṃ caṃḍikāṃ tathā || pūjayitvā divaṃ yāti patraiḥ śrīvṛkṣasaṃbhavaiḥ || 3 || tulasyā adhikaṃ proktaṃ dalaṃ śrīvṛkṣasaṃbhavam|| tasmānnityaṃ prayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadā'cyutaḥ || 4 || dvādaśyāṃ ravivāreṇa śrīvṛkṣamarcayanti ye || brahmahatyādikaiḥ pāpairna lipyaṃte kṛtairapi || 5 || yathā karipade'nyāni praviśaṃti padāni ca || tathā sarvāṇi puṇyāni praviṣṭāni harerdine || 6 || adhruveṇaiva dehena pratikṣa ṇavināśinā || kathaṃ nopāsate jaṃturdvādaśīṃ jāgarānvitām || 7 || atītānpuruṣānsapta bhaviṣyāṃśca caturddaśa || narakāttārayetsarvām̐llokānkṛṣṇeti kīrtanāt || na te jīvaṃti loke'sminyatratatra sthitā narāḥ || 8 || dvārakāyāṃ ca saṃprāptāstriṣu lokeṣu vaṃditāḥ|| dvārakāyāṃ prakurvaṃti yatīnāṃ bhojanaṃ sthitim || grāsegrāse makhaśataṃ te labhaṃte phalaṃ narāḥ ||9 || yatīnāṃ ye prayacchaṃti kaupīnācchādanādikam || vasatāṃ dvārakāmadhye yathāśaktyā tu bhojanam || śṛṇu puṇyaṃ pravakṣyāmi samāsena hi daityaja || 7.4.40.10 || koṭibhirvedavidvadbhirgayāyāṃ pitṛvatsalaiḥ || bhojitairyatsamāpnoti tatphalaṃ daityanāyaka || 11 || ekasminbhojite pautra bhikṣuke phalamīdṛśam|| dātavyaṃ bhikṣuke cānnaṃ kuryyādvai cātmavikrayam || 12 || dhanyāste yatayaḥ sarve ye vasaṃti kalau yuge || kṛṣṇamāśritya daityendra dvārakāyāṃ dinedine || 13 || prāṇino ye mṛtāḥ keciddvārakāṃ kṛṣṇasannidhau || pāpinastatpadaṃ yāṃti bhittvā sūryasya maṃḍalam || 14 || dvārakācakratīrthe ye nivasaṃti narottamāḥ || teṣāṃ nivāritāḥ sarve yamena yamakiṃkarāḥ || 15 || snātvā paśyaṃti gomatyāṃ kṛṣṇaṃ kalimalāpaham || na teṣāṃ viṣaye yūyaṃ na cāsmadviṣaye tu te || 16 || api kīṭaḥ pataṃgo vā vṛkṣā vā ye tadāśritāḥ || yāṃti te kṛṣṇasadanaṃ saṃsāre na punarhiṃ te || 17 || kiṃ punardvijavaryyāśca kṣatriyāśca viśeṣataḥ || trivarṇapūjāsaṃyuktāḥ śūdrāstatra nivāsinaḥ || 18 || gītāṃ paṭhaṃti kṛṣṇāgre kārtikaṃ sakalaṃ dvijāḥ || ekabhaktena naktena tathaivāyācitena ca || 19 || trirātreṇāpi kṛcchreṇa tathā cāndrāyaṇena ca || yāvakaistaptakṛcchrādyaiḥ pakṣamāsamupoṣaṇaiḥ || 7.4.40.20 || kṣapayaṃti ca ye māsaṃ kārtikaṃ vratacāriṇaḥ || snātvā vai gomatīnīre tathā vai rukmiṇīhrade || 21 || śaṃkhacakragadā hastāḥ kṛṣṇarūpā bhavaṃti te || upoṣyaikādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ daśamīsaṃgavarjitām || 22 || śrāddhaṃ kurvaṃti dvādaśyāṃ cakratīrthe ca nirmale || brāhmaṇānbhojayitvā ca madhupāyasasarpiṣā || 23 || saṃtarpya vidhivadbhaktyā śaktyā dattvā tu dakṣiṇām || gobhūhiraṇyavāsāṃsi tāṃbūlaṃ ca phalāni ca || 24 || upānahau cchatrasumaṃ jalapūrṇā ghaṭāstathā || pakvānnasaṃyutāḥ śubhrāḥ saphalā dakṣiṇānvitāḥ|| 25 || evaṃ yaḥ kurute samyakkṛṣṇamuddiśya kārtike || mārkaṃḍeya samā prītiḥ pitṝṇāṃ jāyate dhruvam || 26 || kṛṣṇasya tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ tuṣṭirbhavati cākṣayā || 27 || ye kārtike puṇyatamā manuṣyāstiṣṭhaṃti māsaṃ vratadānayuktāḥ || rathāṃgatīrthe kṛtapūtagātrāste yāṃti puṇyaṃ padamavyayaṃ ca || 28 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye kārtike cakratīrthasnānadānaśrāddhādimāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ|| 40 || cha ||
<7.4.41>
|| śrīprahlāda uvāca || || dhanyāstu naralokāste gomatyāṃ tu kṛtodakāḥ || pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kṛṣṇaṃ ketakītulasīdalaiḥ || 1 || na teṣāṃ saṃbhavo'stīha ghorasaṃsā ragahvare || teṣāṃ mṛtyuḥ punarnāsti hyamaratvaṃ hi te gatāḥ || 2 || anyatra vai yatīnāṃ tu koṭīnāṃ yatphalaṃ bhavet || dvārakāyāṃ tu caikena bhojitena tato'dhikam || 3 || atītaṃ varttamānaṃ ca bhaviṣyadyacca pātakam || nirddahennāsti saṃdeho dvārakā manasā smṛtā || 4 || jñātvā kaliyuge ghore hāhābhūtamacetanam|| dvārakāṃ ye na muñcanti kṛtārthāste narottamāḥ || 5 || mṛtānāṃ yatra jaṃtūnāṃ śvetadvīpe sthitiḥ sadā || 6 || agniṣvāttā barhiṣada ājyapāḥ somapāśca ye || ekaviṃśatiḥ pitṛgaṇā dvārakāyāṃ vasaṃti te|| 7 || puṣkarādīni tīrthāni gaṃgādyāḥ saritastathā || kurukṣetrādi kṣetrāṇi kāśyādīnyūṣarāṇi ca || 8 || gayādipitṛtīrthāni prabhāsādyāni yāni ca || sthānāni yāni puṇyāni grāmāśca nivasaṃti vai || 9 || kāśyādipuryo yā nityaṃ nivasaṃti kalau yuge || nityaṃ kṛṣṇasya sadane pāpināṃ muktide sadā || 7.4.41.10 || vaiśākhaśukladvādaśyāṃ prabodhinyāṃ śeṣataḥ || vaiśākhyāṃ daityaśārdūla kalpādiṣu yugādiṣu || 11 || caṃdrasūryoparāgeṣu manvādiṣu na saṃśayaḥ || vyatīpāteṣu saṃkrāṃtau vaidhṛtau daityanāyaka || 12 || tilodakaṃ ca yaddatta tatsthale pitṛbhaktitaḥ || tatsarvamakṣayaṃ proktaṃ gomatyāṃ snānapūrvakam ||13 || ye'tra śrāddhaṃ prakurvaṃti piṃḍadānapuraḥsaram || teṣāmatrākṣayā tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāmupajāyate || 14 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturtha dvārakāmāhātmye gomatīsnāna kṛṣṇapūjana yatibhojana dāna śrāddhādisatphalavarṇanaṃnāmaikacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 41 || || cha ||
<7.4.42>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || vṛṣotsargaṃ kariṣyaṃti vaiśākhyāṃ caiva kārtike || dvārakāyāṃ piśācatvaṃ muktvā yāṃti pitāmahāḥ || 1 || brahmahatyā surāpānaṃ steyaṃ gurvaṃganāgamaḥ || evaṃvidhāni pāpāni kṛtvā caiva gurūṇyapi|| 2 || snānamātreṇa gomatyāṃ śrīkṛṣṇasya ca darśanāt || vilayaṃ yāti daityendra kalpakoṭikṛtānyapi || 3 || rukmiṇīṃ ye prapaśyaṃti bhaktiyuktāḥ kalau narāḥ || purīṃ pradakṣiṇāṃ kṛtvā japtvā nāmasahasrakam || 4 || pradakṣiṇīkṛtaṃ sarvaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ nātra saṃśayaḥ || mahādānaistu cānyatra yatphalaṃ parikīrtitam|| dvārakāyāṃ tu rukmiṇyāṃ dṛṣṭāyāṃ jāyate tadā || 5 || dvādaśīvāsare prāpte māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || paṭhate saṃnidhau viṣṇoḥ śṛṇu vakṣyāmi tatphalam || 6 || sarveṣu caiva lokeṣu kāmacārī virājate || padmavarṇena yānena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā || 7 || divyaśvetāśvayuktena kāmagena yathāsukham || ābhūtasaṃplavaṃ yāvatkrīḍate'psarasāṃ gaṇaiḥ || 8 || kṛtakṛtyaśca bhavati kalpakoṭisamanvitaḥ || yathā nirmathanādagniḥ sarvakāṣṭheṣu dṛśyate || tathā ca dṛśyate dharmo dvādaśīsevanānnare ||9|| ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi pitṛbhiḥ parikīrtitam || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ gomatyāṃ śraddhayā naraḥ || snātvā saṃpūjya kṛṣṇaṃ ca śrāddhaṃ kuryātsapiṇḍakam || 7.4.42.10|| api syātsa kule'smākaṃ gomatyudadhisaṃgame || snātvā paśyati yaḥ kṛṣṇamasmākaṃ tāraṇāya vai || 11 || apisyātsa kula'smākaṃ yaḥ śrutvā brāhmaṇānanāt || dvārakāmāhātmyamidaṃ pūjayiṣyati bhaktitaḥ || 12 || bhaviṣyati kule'smākaṃ yo gaccheddvārakāṃ purīm || saṃprāpya dvādaśīṃ śuddhāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati jāgaram || 13 || bhaviṣyati kule'smākaṃ putro vā duhitā tathā || stuvannāmasahasraṃ tu kṛṣṇasyāgre paṭhiṣyati || 14 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ bhaviṣyati dhṛtavrataḥ || gopīcandanadānena yastoṣayati vaiṣṇavān|| || 15 || api syātsa kule'smākaṃ vaiṣṇavānāṃ tu sannidhau || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ paṭhiṣyati jitendriyaḥ || 16 || bhaviṣyati kule'smākaṃ māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || likhitvā kṛṣṇatuṣṭyarthaṃ svagṛhe dhārayiṣyati || 17 || svarṇadānaṃ ca godānaṃ bhūmidānaṃ tathaiva ca || yāvajjīvaṃ bhaveddattaṃ yenedaṃ dhāritaṃ kalau || 18 || taptakṛcchraṃ mahākṛcchraṃ māsopoṣaṇameva ca || yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtaṃ tena yenedaṃ śrāvitaṃ kalau || 19 || prāyaścittāni cīrṇāni pāpānāṃ nāśanāya(?) || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yena vistāritaṃ kalau || 7.4.42.20 || tāvattiṣṭhaṃti puruṣe brahmahatyādikāni ca || yāvanna likhate jaṃturmāhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || 21 || dānaiḥ sarvaiśca kiṃ tasya sarvatīrthāvagāhanaiḥ || dvārakāyāśca māhātmyaṃ yenedaṃ likhitaṃ gṛhe || 22 || sarva duḥkhapraśamanaṃ sarvakāryyaprasādhanam|| caturvargapradaṃ nityaṃ haribhaktivivarddhanam || 23 || na cādhirbhavate nūnaṃ yāmyaṃ tasya bhayaṃ nahi || māhātmyaṃ paṭhate yatra dvārakāyāḥ samudbhavam|| 24 || likhitaṃ tiṣṭhate yasya gṛhe tattīrthameva ca || balācchuṇuṣva māhātmyaṃ dvārakāyāḥ samudbhavam || 25 || vidhi mantrakriyāhīnāṃ pūjāṃ gṛhṇāti keśavaḥ || māhātmyaṃ tiṣṭhate nityaṃ likhitaṃ yasya veśmani || na tasyāgaḥsahasraistu kṛtairlipyati mānavaḥ || 26 || yaḥ paṭhecchṛṇute vāpi māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || na bhavedbhūtavaikalyaṃ dharmavaikalyameva ca || 27 || yaḥ smaretprātarutthāya māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || dvādaśīnāṃ ca sarvāsāṃ yaccoktaṃ labhate phalam || 28 || tridaśaiḥ pūjyate nityaṃ vandyate siddhacāraṇaiḥ || māhātmyaṃ paṭhate yo vai dvārakāyāḥ samudbhavam || 29 || dvārakā vasate yatra tatra viṣṇuḥ sanātanaḥ || tatra tīrthāni sarvāṇi sarve devāḥ savāsavāḥ || yajñā vedāśca ṛṣayastrailokyaṃ sacarā caram || 7.4.42.30 || śakto hi dvārakāṃ gaṃtuṃ mānavo na hi putraka || kṛṣṇadarśanajaṃ puṇyaṃ māhātmyaṃ paṭhato bhavet ||31 || satyaṃ śaucaṃ śrutaṃ vittaṃ suśīlaṃ ca kṣamā''rjavam || sarvaṃ ca niṣphalaṃ tasya māhātmyaṃ na śṛṇoti yaḥ || 32 || ṣaṇmāse ca bhavetputro lakṣmīścaiva vivarddhate || tasya yaḥ śṛṇute bhaktyā māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || 33 || iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṃḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakākṣetre vṛṣotsargādikriyākaraṇa dvārakāmāhātmyaśravaṇādiphalavarṇanaṃnāma dvicatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 42 || || cha ||
<7.4.43>
|| prahlāda uvāca || || sāvitrīṃ ca bhavānīṃ ca durgāṃ caiva sarasvatīm || yo'rcayettulasīpatraiḥ sarvakāmasamanvitaḥ || 1 || gṛhītvā tulasīpatraṃ bhaktyā viṣṇuṃ samarcayet || arcitaṃ tena sakalaṃ sadevāsuramānuṣam|| 2 || caturddaśyāṃ maheśānaṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ pitāmaham || ye'rcayanti ca saptamyāṃ tulasyā ca gaṇādhipam ||3 || śaṃkhodakaṃ tīrthavarādvariṣṭhaṃ pādodakaṃ tīrthavarādvariṣṭham|| naivedyaśeṣaṃ kratukoṭitulyaṃ nirmālyaśeṣaṃ vratadānatulyam || 4 || mukundāśanaśeṣaṃ tu yo bhunakti dinedine || sikthesikthe bhavetpuṇyaṃ cāndrāyaṇaśatādhikam || 5 || naivedyaśeṣaṃ tulasīvimiśraṃ viśeṣataḥ pādajalena viṣṇoḥ || yo'śnāti nityaṃ puruṣo murāreḥ prāpnoti yajñāyutakoṭipuṇyam || 6 || yaḥ śrāddhakāle haribhuktaśeṣaṃ dadāti bhaktyā pitṛdevatānām || tenaiva piṃḍātsutilairvimiśrādākalpakoṭiṃ pitaraḥ sutṛptāḥ || 7 || snānārcanakriyākāle ghaṃṭāvādyaṃ karoti yaḥ || purato vāsudevasya gavāṃ koṭiphalaṃ labhet || 8 || sarvavādyamayī ghaṃṭā keśavasya sadā priyā || vādanāllabhate puṇyaṃ yajñakoṭiphalaṃ naraḥ || 9 || vāditrāṇāmabhāve tu pūjākāle ca sarvadā || ghaṃṭāvādyaṃ naraiḥ kāryyaṃ sarvavādyamayī yataḥ || 7.4.43.10 || tulasīkāṣṭhasaṃbhūtaṃ candanaṃ yacchate hareḥ || nirddahetpātakaṃ sarvaṃ pūrvajanmaśatārjitam || 11 || dadāti pitṛ piṃḍeṣu tulasīkāṣṭhacandanam || pitṝṇāṃ jāyate tṛptirgayāśrāddhena vai tathā || 12 || sarveṣāmeva devānāṃ tulasīkāṣṭhacandanam || pitṝṇāṃ ca viśeṣeṇa sadā'bhīṣṭaṃ hareḥ kalau || 13 || harerbhāgavatā bhūtvā tulasīkāṣṭhacandanam || nārpayati sadā viṣṇorna te bhāgavatāḥ kalau || 14 || śarīraṃ dahyate yasya tulasīkāṣṭhavahninā || nīyamāno yamenāpi viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 15 || yadyekaṃ tulasīkāṣṭhaṃ madhye kāṣṭhasya yasya hi || dāhakāle bhavenmuktaḥ pāpakoṭiśatāyutaiḥ || 16 || dahyamānaṃ naraṃ dṛṣṭvā tulasīkāṣṭhavahninā || janmakoṭisahasraistu toṣitastairjanārdanaḥ || 17 || dahyamānaṃ naraṃ sarve tulasīkāṣṭhavahninā || vimānasthāḥ suragaṇāḥ kṣipaṃti kusumāṃjalīn || 18 || nṛtyaṃtyo'psaraso hṛṣṭā gītaṃ gāyanti susvaram || jvalate yatra daityendra tulasīkāṣṭhapāvakaḥ || 19 || kurute vīkṣaṇaṃ viṣṇuḥ santuṣṭaḥ saha śaṃbhunā || 7.4.43.20 || gṛhītvā taṃ kare śauriḥ puruṣaṃ svayamagrataḥ|| mārjate tasya pāpāni paśyatāṃ tridivaukasām || mahotsavaṃ ca kṛtvā tu jayaśabdapuraḥsaram || 21 || || sūta uvāca || || prahlādenoditaṃ śrutvā māhātmyaṃ dvārakābhavam || prahṛṣṭā ṛṣayaḥ sarve tathā daityeśvaro baliḥ || 22 || tataḥ sarve'bhinandyainaṃ prahlādaṃ daityapuṅgavam || udyuktā dvārakāṃ gatvā draṣṭuṃ kṛṣṇamukhāmbujam || 23 || tataste balinā sārdhaṃ munayaḥ saṃśitavratāḥ || āgatya dvārakāṃ snātvā gomatyāṃ vidhipūrvakam || 24 || kṛṣṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā samabhyarcya kṛtvā yātrāṃ yathāvidhi || dattvā dānāni bahuśaḥ kṛtakṛtyāstato'bhavan || 25 || jagmuḥ svīyāni sthānāni baliḥ pātālamāyayau || prahlādaṃ ca praṇamyāśu mene svasya kṛtārthatām || 26 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye dvārakāmāhātmyaśravaṇādiphalaśrutivarṇanapuraḥsaratulasīpatrakāṣṭhamahimavarṇanapūrvakaṃ prahlādadvijasaṃvāda samāptyanaṃtaraṃ balinā saha dvijakṛtadvārakāyātrāvidhivarṇanaṃnāma tricatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 43 || || cha ||
<7.4.44>
|| sūta uvāca || || etatpurāṇamakhilaṃ purā skandena bhāṣitam || bhṛgave brahmaputrāya tasmāllebhe tathāṃ'girāḥ || 1 || tataśca cyavanaḥ prāpa ṛcīkaśca tato muniḥ || evaṃ paraṃparā prāptaṃ sarveṣu bhuvaneṣvapi || 2 || skāndaṃ purāṇametacca kumāreṇa puroddhṛtam || yaḥ śṛṇoti satāṃ madhye naraḥ pāpādvimucyate || 3 || idaṃ purāṇamāyuṣyaṃ caturvarṇasukhapradam || nirmitaṃ ṣaṇmukheneha niyataṃ sumahātmanā || 4 || evametatsamākhyātamākhyānaṃ bhadramastu vaḥ || 5 || maṇḍitaṃ saptabhiḥ khaṇḍaiḥ skāndaṃ yaḥ śṛṇuyānnaraḥ || na tasya puṇyasaṃkhyānaṃ kartuṃ śakyeta kenacit || 6 || ya idaṃ dharmamāhātmyaṃ brāhmaṇāya prayacchati || svargaloke vasettāvadyāvadakṣarasaṃkhyayā || 7 || yathā hi varṣato dhārā yathā vā divi tārakāḥ || gaṃgāyāṃ sikatā yadvattadvatsaṃkhyā na vidyate || 8 || yo naraḥ śṛṇuyādbhaktyā dināni ca kiyanti vai || sarvārthasiddho bhavati ya etatpaṭhate naraḥ || 9 || putrārthī labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam || labhate patikāmā yā patiṃ kanyā manoramam || 7.4.44.10|| samāgamaṃ labhante ca bāndhavāśca pravāsibhiḥ || skāndaṃ purāṇaṃ śrutvā tu pumānāpnoti vāñchitam || 11 || śṛṇvataḥ paṭhataścaiva sarvakāmapradaṃ nṛṇām||12|| puṇyaṃ śrutvā purāṇaṃ vai dīrghamāyuśca vindati|| mahīṃ vijayate rājā śatrūṃścāpyadhitiṣṭhati||13|| vedavicca bhavidvipraḥ kṣatriyo rājyamāpnuyāt|| dhanaṃ dhānyaṃ tathā vaiśyaḥ śūdraḥ sukhamavāpnuyāt||14|| adhyāyamekaṃ śṛṇuyācchlokaṃ ślokārdhameva vā|| yaḥ ślokapādaṃ śṛṇuyādviṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 15 || śrutvā purāṇametaddhi vācakaṃ yastu pūjayet|| tena brahmā ca viṣṇuśca rudraścaiva prapūjitaḥ || 16 || ekamapyakṣaraṃ yastu guruḥ śiṣye nivedayet || pṛthivyāṃ nāsti taddravyaṃ yaddattvā hyanṛṇī bhavet || 17 || ataḥ saṃpūjanīyastu vyāsaḥ śāstropadeśakaḥ || gobhū hiraṇyavastrādyairbhojanaiḥ sārvakāmikaiḥ || 18 || ya evaṃ bhaktiyuktastu śrutvā śāstramanuttamam || pūjayedupadeṣṭāraṃ sa śaivaṃ padamāpnuyāt || 19 || purāṇaśra vaṇādeva anekabhavasaṃcitam || pāpaṃ praśamamāyāti sarvatīrthaphalaṃ labhet || 7.4.44.20 || amṛtenodarasthena mriyante sarvadevatāḥ || kaṇṭhasthitaviṣeṇāpi yo jīvati sa pātu vaḥ || 21 || || vyāsa uvāca || || ityuktvoparate sūte śaunakādi maharṣayaḥ || saṃpūjya vidhivatsūtaṃ praśasyāthābhyanandayan || || 22 || ṛṣaya ūcuḥ || || kathito bhavatā sargaḥ pratisargastathaiva ca || vaṃśānuvaṃśacaritaṃ purāṇānāmanukramaḥ || 23 || manvantarapramāṇaṃ ca brahmāṇḍasya ca vistaraḥ || jyotiścakrasvarūpaṃ ca yathāvadanuvarṇitam || 24 || dhanyāḥ sma kṛtakṛtyāḥ sma vayaṃ tava mukhāmbujāt || skāndaṃ mahāpurāṇa hi śrutvā sūtātiharṣitāḥ || 25 || vayaṃ maharṣayo viprāḥ pradadmo'dya tavā''śiṣaḥ || vyāsaśiṣya mahāprājña ciraṃ jīva sukhī bhava || 26 || iti dattvā''śiṣastasmai dattvā vāsovibhūṣaṇam || visṛjya lomaśaṃ sūtaṃ yajñakarmāṇyathācaran || 27 || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthe dvārakāmāhātmye skandamahāpurāṇaśravaṇapaṭhanapustakapradānapaurāṇikavyāsapūjanamāhātmyavarṇanapūrvakaṃ samastaskāndamahā purāṇagranthasamāptyupasaṃhārasūtasatkāravṛttāntavarṇanaṃnāma catuścatvāriṃśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 44 || || cha || || śrīḥ || || cha || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptame prabhāsakhaṇḍe caturthaṃ dvārakāmāhātmyaṃ sampūrṇam || 7.4 || || iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇe saptamaṃ prabhāsakhaṇḍaṃ sampūrṇam|| 7 ||
